<file path="op-core/src/private_document_publication.rs">
//! Durable private documents share the canonical SHM lock and commit manifest.
//! The marker is a publication gate, never a document or identity authority.
use super::*;

/// A durable receipt can survive a failed post-commit contract check without
/// certifying or exposing its document as committed runtime state.
pub enum PrivateDocumentCommit<T> {
    Publish {
        current: Option<Vec<u8>>,
        durable: T,
    },
    RetainPending {
        durable: T,
        error: anyhow::Error,
    },
    /// The domain owner proved rejection before any durable effect was
    /// submitted. Clear this exact operation's marker without changing state.
    Abort {
        error: anyhow::Error,
    },
}

/// Only Committed permits an owner-scoped wake. Pending retains the durable
/// receipt when available; errors never certify the old SHM document as current.
#[must_use = "only a committed publication permits a private state wake"]
pub enum PrivateDocumentPublication<T> {
    Committed {
        projection: ProjectionCommit,
        durable: T,
    },
    Pending {
        operation_id: String,
        durable: Option<T>,
        error: anyhow::Error,
    },
}

fn sync_boundary(directory: &File, phase: &str) -> Result<()> {
    #[cfg(test)]
    super::super::tests::write_fault(phase)?;
    let _ = phase;
    directory.sync_all()?;
    Ok(())
}

impl PrivateProjectionDirectory {
    /// Metadata for explicit durable recovery. It does not read state or grant
    /// authority to substitute a different document for the pending operation.
    pub fn pending_document(&self) -> Result<Option<PendingDocumentPublication>> {
        require_private(&self.directory, false)?;
        let Some(locked) = LockedDirectory::from_directory(self.directory.try_clone()?, false)?
        else {
            return Ok(None);
        };
        Ok(locked
            .manifest()?
            .and_then(|(manifest, _)| manifest.document_pending))
    }

    /// Run an owned synchronous durable operation after sealing the pending
    /// gate, then publish exactly its returned complete document. Run this whole
    /// helper in a cancellation-owned blocking worker. The callback may use its
    /// durable domain owner, but must never reenter any SHM projection helper.
    ///
    /// Once the callback starts, every error or panic retains the gate. A
    /// callback may return `Abort` only when its domain owner proves no durable
    /// effect was submitted; that exact marker is then cleared. Admission that
    /// cannot make this guarantee requires a durable recovery.
    /// The callback receives only the previously committed document. It must
    /// enforce domain revisions and validate the exact candidate before return.
    pub fn commit_document_durable<T>(
        &self,
        plugin_id: &str,
        operation_id: &str,
        commit: impl FnOnce(Option<&[u8]>) -> Result<(Option<Vec<u8>>, T)>,
    ) -> Result<PrivateDocumentPublication<T>> {
        self.commit_document_durable_with_decision(plugin_id, operation_id, |previous| {
            commit(previous)
                .map(|(current, durable)| PrivateDocumentCommit::Publish { current, durable })
        })
    }

    /// Variant for post-durable contract checks. RetainPending preserves the
    /// completed durable receipt while leaving the original pending gate intact.
    pub fn commit_document_durable_with_decision<T>(
        &self,
        plugin_id: &str,
        operation_id: &str,
        commit: impl FnOnce(Option<&[u8]>) -> Result<PrivateDocumentCommit<T>>,
    ) -> Result<PrivateDocumentPublication<T>> {
        let name = filename(plugin_id)?;
        ensure!(
            plugin_id != "identity_sled",
            "identity uses its dedicated paired projection"
        );
        identity_transaction::validate_operation_id(operation_id)?;
        require_private(&self.directory, true)?;
        let locked = LockedDirectory::from_directory(self.directory.try_clone()?, true)?
            .context("private namespace lock missing")?;
        let old = locked.manifest()?;
        let had_manifest = old.is_some();
        let mut manifest = old.map_or_else(Manifest::default, |(manifest, _)| manifest);
        ensure!(
            manifest.document_pending.is_none(),
            "private namespace has a pending document operation"
        );
        manifest.require_available(plugin_id)?;
        manifest
            .generation
            .checked_add(1)
            .context("projection generation overflow")?;
        let previous = read_file(&locked.directory, &name, MAX_PROJECTION, false)?;
        ensure!(
            had_manifest || previous.is_none(),
            "uncommitted private document has no manifest"
        );
        manifest.document_pending = Some(PendingDocumentPublication {
            plugin_id: plugin_id.into(),
            operation_id: operation_id.into(),
        });
        write_file(
            &locked.directory,
            MANIFEST_NAME,
            &simd_json::to_vec(&manifest)?,
            0o644,
            None,
        )?;
        if let Err(error) = sync_boundary(&locked.directory, "private_document_marker_sync") {
            return Ok(PrivateDocumentPublication::Pending {
                operation_id: operation_id.into(),
                durable: None,
                error,
            });
        }
        match commit(previous.as_deref()) {
            Ok(PrivateDocumentCommit::Publish { current, durable }) => Ok(finish(
                &locked, manifest, &name, previous, current, durable, false,
            )),
            Ok(PrivateDocumentCommit::RetainPending { durable, error }) => {
                Ok(PrivateDocumentPublication::Pending {
                    operation_id: operation_id.into(),
                    durable: Some(durable),
                    error,
                })
            }
            Ok(PrivateDocumentCommit::Abort { error }) => {
                manifest.document_pending = None;
                match write_file(
                    &locked.directory,
                    MANIFEST_NAME,
                    &simd_json::to_vec(&manifest)?,
                    0o644,
                    None,
                ) {
                    Ok(()) => Err(error),
                    Err(cleanup) => Ok(PrivateDocumentPublication::Pending {
                        operation_id: operation_id.into(),
                        durable: None,
                        error: cleanup.context("failed to clear rejected private operation"),
                    }),
                }
            }
            Err(error) => Ok(PrivateDocumentPublication::Pending {
                operation_id: operation_id.into(),
                durable: None,
                error,
            }),
        }
    }

    /// Exact-operation recovery invokes the authoritative durable reader. It
    /// never passes potentially mixed SHM bytes to the callback and has no
    /// clear-marker/old-state rollback alternative. On process activation an
    /// owner must recover/reconcile durability before enabling private reads;
    /// volatile SHM cannot retain markers across machine reboot.
    pub fn recover_document<T>(
        &self,
        plugin_id: &str,
        operation_id: &str,
        load_durable: impl FnOnce() -> Result<(Option<Vec<u8>>, T)>,
    ) -> Result<PrivateDocumentPublication<T>> {
        self.recover_document_with_decision(plugin_id, operation_id, || {
            load_durable()
                .map(|(current, durable)| PrivateDocumentCommit::Publish { current, durable })
        })
    }

    /// Keep a recovered durable receipt even when current admission prevents
    /// publication. Only Publish may clear the exact pending operation.
    pub fn recover_document_with_decision<T>(
        &self,
        plugin_id: &str,
        operation_id: &str,
        load_durable: impl FnOnce() -> Result<PrivateDocumentCommit<T>>,
    ) -> Result<PrivateDocumentPublication<T>> {
        let name = filename(plugin_id)?;
        ensure!(
            plugin_id != "identity_sled",
            "identity uses its dedicated paired projection"
        );
        identity_transaction::validate_operation_id(operation_id)?;
        require_private(&self.directory, true)?;
        let locked = LockedDirectory::from_directory(self.directory.try_clone()?, true)?
            .context("private namespace lock missing")?;
        let (manifest, _) = locked
            .manifest()?
            .context("private recovery requires a commit manifest")?;
        ensure!(
            manifest
                .document_pending
                .as_ref()
                .is_some_and(|pending| pending.plugin_id == plugin_id
                    && pending.operation_id == operation_id),
            "private recovery requires the exact pending plugin and operation"
        );
        manifest
            .generation
            .checked_add(1)
            .context("projection generation overflow")?;
        // Check file safety without treating its potentially mixed bytes as a
        // predecessor or recovery authority.
        match open_at(
            &locked.directory,
            name.as_ref(),
            OFlag::O_RDONLY | OFlag::O_NONBLOCK,
            0,
        ) {
            Ok(file) => check_file(&file, false, locked.directory.metadata()?.uid())?,
            Err(Errno::ENOENT) => {}
            Err(error) => return Err(error.into()),
        }
        match load_durable() {
            Ok(PrivateDocumentCommit::Publish { current, durable }) => Ok(finish(
                &locked, manifest, &name, None, current, durable, true,
            )),
            Ok(PrivateDocumentCommit::RetainPending { durable, error }) => {
                Ok(PrivateDocumentPublication::Pending {
                    operation_id: operation_id.into(),
                    durable: Some(durable),
                    error,
                })
            }
            Ok(PrivateDocumentCommit::Abort { .. }) => Ok(PrivateDocumentPublication::Pending {
                operation_id: operation_id.into(),
                durable: None,
                error: anyhow::anyhow!(
                    "private recovery owner did not provide an authoritative durable row"
                ),
            }),
            Err(error) => Ok(PrivateDocumentPublication::Pending {
                operation_id: operation_id.into(),
                durable: None,
                error,
            }),
        }
    }
}

#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)] // Explicit old/new document and durable receipt remain paired.
fn finish<T>(
    locked: &LockedDirectory,
    mut manifest: Manifest,
    name: &str,
    previous: Option<Vec<u8>>,
    current: Option<Vec<u8>>,
    durable: T,
    recovery: bool,
) -> PrivateDocumentPublication<T> {
    let operation_id = manifest
        .document_pending
        .as_ref()
        .expect("pending operation")
        .operation_id
        .clone();
    let result = (|| -> Result<ProjectionCommit> {
        ensure!(
            current
                .as_ref()
                .is_none_or(|bytes| bytes.len() as u64 <= MAX_PROJECTION),
            "private document exceeds projection size limit"
        );
        if recovery || previous != current {
            manifest.generation = manifest
                .generation
                .checked_add(1)
                .context("projection generation overflow")?;
        }
        restore_file(&locked.directory, name, current.as_deref(), 0o600, None)?;
        sync_boundary(&locked.directory, "private_document_data_sync")?;
        manifest.document_pending = None;
        // This final rename is the commit point. All data and the preceding
        // pending marker were synced; no fallible step follows the commit.
        write_file(
            &locked.directory,
            MANIFEST_NAME,
            &simd_json::to_vec(&manifest)?,
            0o644,
            None,
        )?;
        Ok(ProjectionCommit {
            generation: manifest.generation,
            previous,
            current,
        })
    })();
    match result {
        Ok(projection) => PrivateDocumentPublication::Committed {
            projection,
            durable,
        },
        Err(error) => PrivateDocumentPublication::Pending {
            operation_id,
            durable: Some(durable),
            error,
        },
    }
}

<file path="op-core/src/private_projection_directory_tests.rs">
use super::*;

#[test]
fn private_owners_reuse_committed_generations_without_sharing_payloads() {
    let root = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let path = root.path().join("private");
    let namespace = PrivateProjectionDirectory::prepare(&path).unwrap();
    let first = namespace.prepare_child("owner-a").unwrap();
    let other = namespace.prepare_child("owner-b").unwrap();
    let payload = br#"{"document_revision":1,"specs":{"a":{"children":["b"]},"b":{}}}"#;
    let committed = first
        .update("gemma_brain", |_| Ok(Some(payload.to_vec())))
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(committed.generation, 1);
    let ids = ["gemma_brain".to_string()];
    assert_eq!(
        first.read_snapshot(&ids).unwrap().states["gemma_brain"],
        payload
    );
    assert!(other.read_snapshot(&ids).unwrap().states.is_empty());
    assert!(
        read_projection_snapshot_in(root.path().to_str().unwrap(), &ids)
            .unwrap()
            .states
            .is_empty()
    );
    assert_eq!(std::fs::metadata(&path).unwrap().mode() & 0o7777, 0o700);
    assert_eq!(
        std::fs::metadata(path.join("owner-a")).unwrap().mode() & 0o7777,
        0o700
    );
    assert_eq!(
        std::fs::metadata(path.join("owner-a/gemma_brain.json"))
            .unwrap()
            .mode()
            & 0o777,
        0o600
    );
    // The same manifest format/mode remains behind the 0700 directory.
    assert_eq!(
        std::fs::metadata(path.join("owner-a/.manifest.json"))
            .unwrap()
            .mode()
            & 0o777,
        0o644
    );
    assert_eq!(
        first
            .update("gemma_brain", |old| Ok(old.map(<[u8]>::to_vec)))
            .unwrap()
            .generation,
        1
    );
    assert_eq!(
        first
            .update("gemma_brain", |_| Ok(None))
            .unwrap()
            .generation,
        2
    );
    assert!(first.read_snapshot(&ids).unwrap().states.is_empty());
}

#[test]
fn held_namespace_and_owner_descriptors_survive_path_replacement() {
    let root = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let original = root.path().join("private");
    let moved = root.path().join("moved");
    let namespace = PrivateProjectionDirectory::prepare(&original).unwrap();
    let owner = namespace.prepare_child("owner").unwrap();
    std::fs::rename(&original, &moved).unwrap();
    let replacement = PrivateProjectionDirectory::prepare(&original).unwrap();
    let replacement_owner = replacement.prepare_child("owner").unwrap();
    owner
        .update("gemma_brain", |_| Ok(Some(b"old-inode".to_vec())))
        .unwrap();
    namespace.prepare_child("later").unwrap();
    assert!(moved.join("later").is_dir());
    assert!(!original.join("later").exists());
    let ids = ["gemma_brain".to_string()];
    assert!(replacement_owner
        .read_snapshot(&ids)
        .unwrap()
        .states
        .is_empty());
    assert_eq!(
        std::fs::read(moved.join("owner/gemma_brain.json")).unwrap(),
        b"old-inode"
    );
}

#[test]
fn private_namespace_rejects_permissive_or_redirected_paths_and_does_not_create_on_read() {
    let root = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let path = root.path().join("missing");
    assert!(PrivateProjectionDirectory::open(&path).unwrap().is_none());
    assert!(!path.exists());
    std::fs::create_dir(&path).unwrap();
    std::fs::set_permissions(&path, std::fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o755)).unwrap();
    assert!(PrivateProjectionDirectory::prepare(&path).is_err());
    assert!(!path.join(LOCK_NAME).exists());
    std::fs::set_permissions(&path, std::fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o700)).unwrap();
    let reader = PrivateProjectionDirectory::open(&path).unwrap().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        reader
            .read_snapshot(&["gemma_brain".into()])
            .unwrap()
            .generation,
        0
    );
    assert!(!path.join(LOCK_NAME).exists());
    let namespace = PrivateProjectionDirectory::prepare(&path).unwrap();
    assert!(namespace.prepare_child("../escape").is_err());
    assert!(namespace.open_child("..").is_err());
    let outside = root.path().join("outside");
    std::fs::create_dir(&outside).unwrap();
    std::os::unix::fs::symlink(&outside, path.join("redirect")).unwrap();
    assert!(namespace.prepare_child("redirect").is_err());
    assert!(namespace.open_child("redirect").is_err());
    assert!(namespace
        .update("identity_sled", |_| Ok(Some(b"{}".to_vec())))
        .is_err());
    // Permissions are rechecked through the held descriptor before each use.
    std::fs::set_permissions(&path, std::fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o750)).unwrap();
    assert!(namespace.read_snapshot(&["gemma_brain".into()]).is_err());
}

#[test]
fn failed_private_publication_preserves_previous_committed_document() {
    let root = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let owner = PrivateProjectionDirectory::prepare(&root.path().join("owner")).unwrap();
    owner
        .update("gemma_brain", |_| Ok(Some(b"before".to_vec())))
        .unwrap();
    super::super::tests::inject("gemma_brain.json", 1, false);
    assert!(owner
        .update("gemma_brain", |_| Ok(Some(b"after".to_vec())))
        .is_err());
    let snapshot = owner.read_snapshot(&["gemma_brain".into()]).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(snapshot.generation, 1);
    assert_eq!(snapshot.states["gemma_brain"], b"before");
}

#[test]
fn independent_handles_serialize_complete_document_folds() {
    let root = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let path = root.path().join("owner");
    let initial = PrivateProjectionDirectory::prepare(&path).unwrap();
    initial
        .update("gemma_brain", |_| Ok(Some(b"0".to_vec())))
        .unwrap();
    let threads = (0..4)
        .map(|_| {
            let owner = PrivateProjectionDirectory::open(&path).unwrap().unwrap();
            std::thread::spawn(move || {
                for _ in 0..10 {
                    owner
                        .update("gemma_brain", |old| {
                            let count: u64 = std::str::from_utf8(old.unwrap())?.parse()?;
                            Ok(Some((count + 1).to_string().into_bytes()))
                        })
                        .unwrap();
                }
            })
        })
        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
    for worker in threads {
        worker.join().unwrap();
    }
    let snapshot = initial.read_snapshot(&["gemma_brain".into()]).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(snapshot.generation, 41);
    assert_eq!(snapshot.states["gemma_brain"], b"40");
}

#[test]
fn private_identity_lock_order_rejects_aliases_and_finishes_concurrent_revocation() {
    use std::sync::mpsc;
    use std::time::Duration;
    let temporary = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let identity = temporary.path().join("identity");
    std::fs::create_dir(&identity).unwrap();
    std::fs::set_permissions(&identity, std::fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o700)).unwrap();
    let identity_text = identity.to_str().unwrap();
    let gid = nix::unistd::getegid().as_raw();
    update_projection_with_credentials_in(identity_text, "identity_sled", gid, |_| {
        Ok(Some((b"{}".to_vec(), b"private-credential".to_vec())))
    })
    .unwrap();
    let namespace = PrivateProjectionDirectory::prepare(&temporary.path().join("jobs")).unwrap();
    namespace.ensure_distinct_from(&identity).unwrap();
    let alias = PrivateProjectionDirectory::open(&identity)
        .unwrap()
        .unwrap();
    assert!(alias.ensure_distinct_from(&identity).is_err());
    let link = temporary.path().join("redirect");
    std::os::unix::fs::symlink(&identity, &link).unwrap();
    assert!(namespace.ensure_distinct_from(&link).is_err());
    let (entered_tx, entered_rx) = mpsc::channel();
    let (release_tx, release_rx) = mpsc::channel();
    let identity_owned = identity_text.to_owned();
    let revocation = std::thread::spawn(move || {
        commit_identity_projection_durable_in(&identity_owned, gid, "delete-credential", |_| {
            entered_tx.send(()).unwrap();
            release_rx.recv_timeout(Duration::from_secs(3)).unwrap();
            Ok((None, ()))
        })
        .unwrap()
    });
    entered_rx.recv_timeout(Duration::from_secs(3)).unwrap();
    let (reading_tx, reading_rx) = mpsc::channel();
    let (done_tx, done_rx) = mpsc::channel();
    let identity_owned = identity_text.to_owned();
    let writer = namespace.clone();
    let publication = std::thread::spawn(move || {
        let result = writer.commit_document_durable_with_decision("tched_router", "output", |_| {
            reading_tx.send(()).unwrap();
            // Approved one-way acquisition only: private job file lock ->
            // canonical identity reader. Identity writers never acquire jobs.
            let credential = read_credential_in(&identity_owned, "identity_sled")?;
            ensure!(credential.is_none(), "revocation did not become visible");
            Ok(PrivateDocumentCommit::RetainPending {
                durable: (),
                error: anyhow::anyhow!("admission withdrawn"),
            })
        });
        done_tx.send(()).unwrap();
        result.unwrap()
    });
    reading_rx.recv_timeout(Duration::from_secs(3)).unwrap();
    release_tx.send(()).unwrap();
    done_rx.recv_timeout(Duration::from_secs(3)).unwrap();
    assert!(matches!(
        revocation.join().unwrap(),
        CredentialPublication::Committed { .. }
    ));
    assert!(matches!(
        publication.join().unwrap(),
        PrivateDocumentPublication::Pending { .. }
    ));
    assert!(namespace.read_snapshot(&["tched_router".into()]).is_err());
}
</file>

<file path="op-core/src/private_projection_directory.rs">
//! Service-private namespaces using the canonical projection transaction.
//!
//! This handle supplies filesystem confinement only. Callers must derive the
//! namespace from verified identity and pin the owning plugin contract before
//! every use. It never supplies catalog membership, authorization, recovery of
//! a durable backend, or a public broadcast/cache path.

use super::*;
use std::sync::Arc;

#[path = "private_document_publication.rs"]
mod publication;
pub use publication::{PrivateDocumentCommit, PrivateDocumentPublication};

#[derive(Clone)]
pub struct PrivateProjectionDirectory {
    directory: Arc<File>,
}

fn require_private(directory: &File, writer: bool) -> Result<()> {
    let metadata = directory.metadata()?;
    ensure!(
        metadata.is_dir()
            && metadata.mode() & 0o7777 == 0o700
            && trusted_directory_owner(metadata.uid(), nix::unistd::geteuid().as_raw(), writer),
        "private projection namespace must be a trusted owner-only 0700 directory"
    );
    Ok(())
}

impl PrivateProjectionDirectory {
    /// Prepare a private namespace and its lock without publishing state. New
    /// path components are created 0700. Existing permissive directories are
    /// rejected, never silently tightened after private data could be exposed.
    pub fn prepare(path: &Path) -> Result<Self> {
        let directory = directory(path, true, 0o700)?.context("private namespace missing")?;
        Self::prepare_directory(directory)
    }

    fn prepare_directory(directory: File) -> Result<Self> {
        require_private(&directory, true)?;
        let _lock = LockedDirectory::from_directory(directory.try_clone()?, true)?
            .context("private namespace lock missing")?;
        Ok(Self {
            directory: Arc::new(directory),
        })
    }

    /// Open existing state without creating directories, locks or files.
    pub fn open(path: &Path) -> Result<Option<Self>> {
        let Some(directory) = directory(path, false, 0)? else {
            return Ok(None);
        };
        require_private(&directory, false)?;
        Ok(Some(Self {
            directory: Arc::new(directory),
        }))
    }

    /// Establish the one-way private-document -> canonical identity-read lock
    /// order before entering a private transaction. Both paths are opened
    /// without symlink traversal and compared with this held directory inode.
    /// This does not authorize any identity or document read.
    pub fn ensure_distinct_from(&self, other: &Path) -> Result<()> {
        require_private(&self.directory, false)?;
        let other = directory(other, false, 0)?.context("identity projection directory missing")?;
        let held = self.directory.metadata()?;
        let other = other.metadata()?;
        ensure!(
            held.dev() != other.dev() || held.ino() != other.ino(),
            "private document namespace aliases the canonical identity directory"
        );
        Ok(())
    }

    /// Derive a child from the held namespace descriptor. The name must be an
    /// opaque flat identifier supplied by the domain owner, never a user path.
    pub fn prepare_child(&self, name: &str) -> Result<Self> {
        filename(name)?;
        require_private(&self.directory, true)?;
        match nix::sys::stat::mkdirat(
            Some(self.directory.as_raw_fd()),
            name,
            Mode::from_bits_truncate(0o700),
        ) {
            Ok(()) | Err(Errno::EEXIST) => {}
            Err(error) => return Err(error.into()),
        }
        let child = open_at(
            &self.directory,
            name.as_ref(),
            OFlag::O_RDONLY | OFlag::O_DIRECTORY,
            0,
        )?;
        Self::prepare_directory(child)
    }

    pub fn open_child(&self, name: &str) -> Result<Option<Self>> {
        filename(name)?;
        require_private(&self.directory, false)?;
        let child = match open_at(
            &self.directory,
            name.as_ref(),
            OFlag::O_RDONLY | OFlag::O_DIRECTORY,
            0,
        ) {
            Ok(file) => file,
            Err(Errno::ENOENT) => return Ok(None),
            Err(error) => return Err(error.into()),
        };
        require_private(&child, false)?;
        Ok(Some(Self {
            directory: Arc::new(child),
        }))
    }

    /// Exact committed bytes for caller-selected sealed IDs. The original
    /// manifest/lock rules apply; no path is reopened after handle creation.
    pub fn read_snapshot(&self, plugin_ids: &[String]) -> Result<ProjectionSnapshot> {
        for plugin in plugin_ids {
            filename(plugin)?;
            ensure!(
                plugin != "identity_sled",
                "identity uses its dedicated paired projection"
            );
        }
        require_private(&self.directory, false)?;
        let Some(locked) = LockedDirectory::from_directory(self.directory.try_clone()?, false)?
        else {
            return Ok(ProjectionSnapshot {
                generation: 0,
                states: BTreeMap::new(),
            });
        };
        read_locked_snapshot(&locked, plugin_ids)
    }

    /// Fold and commit one complete private document with the existing
    /// transaction writer. The synchronous closure has no external effects and
    /// must not call another projection helper. Revision checks belong inside
    /// this closure; domain durability/recovery belongs to its upstream owner.
    pub fn update(
        &self,
        plugin_id: &str,
        fold: impl FnOnce(Option<&[u8]>) -> Result<Option<Vec<u8>>>,
    ) -> Result<ProjectionCommit> {
        let name = filename(plugin_id)?;
        ensure!(
            plugin_id != "identity_sled",
            "identity uses its dedicated paired projection"
        );
        require_private(&self.directory, true)?;
        let locked = LockedDirectory::from_directory(self.directory.try_clone()?, true)?
            .context("private namespace lock missing")?;
        update_locked_projection(&locked, plugin_id, &name, fold)
    }
}
