<file path="op-core/src/types.rs">
//! Common types used across op-dbus-v2

use chrono::{DateTime, Utc};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use simd_json::OwnedValue;
use simd_json::ValueBuilder;
use std::collections::HashMap;
use uuid::Uuid;

/// Bus type for DBus connections
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Serialize, Deserialize, Default)]
#[serde(rename_all = "lowercase")]
pub enum BusType {
    #[default]
    System,
    Session,
}

impl std::fmt::Display for BusType {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
        match self {
            BusType::System => write!(f, "system"),
            BusType::Session => write!(f, "session"),
        }
    }
}

/// DBus service information
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct ServiceInfo {
    pub name: String,
    pub bus_type: BusType,
    pub activatable: bool,
    pub active: bool,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub pid: Option<u32>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub uid: Option<u32>,
}

/// DBus object path information
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct ObjectInfo {
    pub path: String,
    pub interfaces: Vec<InterfaceInfo>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub children: Vec<String>,
}

/// DBus interface information
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct InterfaceInfo {
    pub name: String,
    pub methods: Vec<MethodInfo>,
    pub signals: Vec<SignalInfo>,
    pub properties: Vec<PropertyInfo>,
}

/// DBus method information
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct MethodInfo {
    pub name: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub in_args: Vec<ArgInfo>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub out_args: Vec<ArgInfo>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub annotations: HashMap<String, String>,
}

/// DBus signal information
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct SignalInfo {
    pub name: String,
    pub args: Vec<ArgInfo>,
}

/// DBus property information
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct PropertyInfo {
    pub name: String,
    pub signature: String,
    pub access: PropertyAccess,
}

/// DBus method/signal argument
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct ArgInfo {
    pub name: Option<String>,
    pub signature: String,
    pub direction: ArgDirection,
}

/// Argument direction
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize, Default)]
#[serde(rename_all = "lowercase")]
pub enum ArgDirection {
    #[default]
    In,
    Out,
}

/// Property access mode
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "lowercase")]
pub enum PropertyAccess {
    Read,
    Write,
    ReadWrite,
}

/// Tool definition (local to avoid cycle)
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct ToolDefinition {
    pub name: String,
    pub description: String,
    pub input_schema: OwnedValue,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub schema_version: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub category: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub tags: Vec<String>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub namespace: String,
}

/// Tool execution request
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct ToolRequest {
    pub id: String,
    pub tool_name: String,
    pub arguments: OwnedValue,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub timeout_ms: Option<u64>,
}

impl ToolRequest {
    pub fn new(tool_name: impl Into<String>, arguments: OwnedValue) -> Self {
        Self {
            id: Uuid::new_v4().to_string(),
            tool_name: tool_name.into(),
            arguments,
            timeout_ms: None,
        }
    }
}

/// Tool execution result
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct ToolResult {
    pub id: String,
    pub success: bool,
    pub content: OwnedValue,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub error: Option<String>,
    pub execution_time_ms: u64,
}

impl ToolResult {
    pub fn success(id: impl Into<String>, content: OwnedValue, exec_time: u64) -> Self {
        Self {
            id: id.into(),
            success: true,
            content,
            error: None,
            execution_time_ms: exec_time,
        }
    }

    pub fn error(id: impl Into<String>, error: impl Into<String>, exec_time: u64) -> Self {
        Self {
            id: id.into(),
            success: false,
            content: OwnedValue::null(),
            error: Some(error.into()),
            execution_time_ms: exec_time,
        }
    }
}

/// Agent definition
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct AgentDefinition {
    pub id: String,
    pub name: String,
    pub description: String,
    pub capabilities: Vec<String>,
    pub tools: Vec<String>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub model: Option<String>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub config: HashMap<String, OwnedValue>,
}

/// Agent status
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize, Default)]
#[serde(rename_all = "lowercase")]
pub enum AgentStatus {
    #[default]
    Idle,
    Running,
    Paused,
    Error,
    Stopped,
}

/// Chat message for AI interactions
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct ChatMessage {
    pub id: String,
    pub role: ChatRole,
    pub content: String,
    pub timestamp: DateTime<Utc>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub tool_calls: Vec<ToolCall>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub metadata: HashMap<String, OwnedValue>,
}

impl ChatMessage {
    pub fn user(content: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
        Self {
            id: Uuid::new_v4().to_string(),
            role: ChatRole::User,
            content: content.into(),
            timestamp: Utc::now(),
            tool_calls: Vec::new(),
            metadata: HashMap::new(),
        }
    }

    pub fn assistant(content: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
        Self {
            id: Uuid::new_v4().to_string(),
            role: ChatRole::Assistant,
            content: content.into(),
            timestamp: Utc::now(),
            tool_calls: Vec::new(),
            metadata: HashMap::new(),
        }
    }

    pub fn system(content: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
        Self {
            id: Uuid::new_v4().to_string(),
            role: ChatRole::System,
            content: content.into(),
            timestamp: Utc::now(),
            tool_calls: Vec::new(),
            metadata: HashMap::new(),
        }
    }
}

/// Chat role
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "lowercase")]
pub enum ChatRole {
    User,
    Assistant,
    System,
    Tool,
}

/// Tool call within a chat message
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct ToolCall {
    pub id: String,
    pub tool_name: String,
    pub arguments: OwnedValue,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub result: Option<ToolResult>,
}

/// System health status
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct HealthStatus {
    pub healthy: bool,
    pub version: String,
    pub uptime_secs: u64,
    pub components: HashMap<String, ComponentHealth>,
}

/// Component health information
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct ComponentHealth {
    pub name: String,
    pub status: ComponentStatus,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub message: Option<String>,
    pub last_check: DateTime<Utc>,
}

/// Component status
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize, Default)]
#[serde(rename_all = "lowercase")]
pub enum ComponentStatus {
    Healthy,
    Degraded,
    Unhealthy,
    #[default]
    Unknown,
}

// ============================================================================
// OBJECT SCHEMA REFERENCE (for D-Bus schema linking)
// ============================================================================

/// Reference to a D-Bus object schema stored in StateStore
///
/// Used to link plugins to their discovered D-Bus interfaces.
/// These schemas are persisted and restored during disaster recovery.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct ObjectSchemaRef {
    /// Object type (e.g., "dbus_interface", "dbus_service")
    pub object_type: String,
    /// Namespace - typically D-Bus service name (e.g., "org.freedesktop.NetworkManager")
    pub namespace: String,
    /// D-Bus object path (e.g., "/org/freedesktop/NetworkManager")
    pub path: String,
    /// Hash of the interface schema for integrity verification
    pub schema_hash: String,
}

impl ObjectSchemaRef {
    pub fn new(
        object_type: impl Into<String>,
        namespace: impl Into<String>,
        path: impl Into<String>,
        schema_hash: impl Into<String>,
    ) -> Self {
        Self {
            object_type: object_type.into(),
            namespace: namespace.into(),
            path: path.into(),
            schema_hash: schema_hash.into(),
        }
    }
}

<file path="op-core/tests/no_s6_regression.rs">
//! Guard against s6 returning to the tree.
//!
//! This host boots runit as PID 1 and has no s6 installed, so any code that
//! spawns an s6 binary or hardcodes the s6 runtime tree is dead on arrival.
//! The `runit-sv-migration` spec removed every such site; this test fails if one
//! comes back, which is cheaper than discovering it when a service silently
//! never starts.
//!
//! Runs under plain `cargo test` — no CI infrastructure required.
//!
//! OSCAL subid: `obs.software.runit.s6-regression-guard@v1`

use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

/// Spawning any of these fails at runtime: the binaries do not exist.
const FORBIDDEN_SPAWNS: &[&str] = &[
    "Command::new(\"s6-rc\")",
    "Command::new(\"s6-svc\")",
    "Command::new(\"s6-svstat\")",
    "Command::new(\"s6-svscan\")",
    "Command::new(\"s6-logwatch\")",
    "Command::new(\"s6d\")",
    "Command::new(\"service6\")",
    "Command::new(\"systemctl\")",
];

/// The s6 layout. Runit uses `/run/runit/service` and `/etc/runit/sv`.
const FORBIDDEN_PATHS: &[&str] = &["\"/run/service", "\"/etc/s6/sv", "\"/run/s6-rc"];

/// Files allowed to mention the forbidden strings, and why.
fn is_allowed(path: &Path) -> bool {
    let name = path.to_string_lossy();
    // This test necessarily contains the strings it forbids.
    if name.ends_with("no_s6_regression.rs") {
        return true;
    }
    // The path module documents what the s6 tree was, and asserts against it.
    if name.ends_with("op-core/src/runit.rs") {
        return true;
    }
    false
}

fn workspace_crates_dir() -> PathBuf {
    // CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR is <workspace>/crates/op-core.
    PathBuf::from(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"))
        .parent()
        .expect("op-core has a parent directory")
        .to_path_buf()
}

fn rust_sources(dir: &Path, out: &mut Vec<PathBuf>) {
    let Ok(entries) = std::fs::read_dir(dir) else {
        return;
    };
    for entry in entries.flatten() {
        let path = entry.path();
        let name = entry.file_name().to_string_lossy().to_string();
        if path.is_dir() {
            // Skip build output and vendored trees.
            if matches!(name.as_str(), "target" | "node_modules" | ".git") {
                continue;
            }
            rust_sources(&path, out);
        } else if name.ends_with(".rs") {
            // Generated protobuf code is not hand-maintained source.
            if path.to_string_lossy().contains("/proto/") {
                continue;
            }
            out.push(path);
        }
    }
}

#[test]
fn no_crate_spawns_an_s6_binary() {
    let mut files = Vec::new();
    rust_sources(&workspace_crates_dir(), &mut files);
    assert!(!files.is_empty(), "found no Rust sources to scan");

    let mut findings = Vec::new();
    for file in &files {
        if is_allowed(file) {
            continue;
        }
        let Ok(text) = std::fs::read_to_string(file) else {
            continue;
        };
        for (idx, line) in text.lines().enumerate() {
            for needle in FORBIDDEN_SPAWNS {
                if line.contains(needle) {
                    findings.push(format!("{}:{}: {}", file.display(), idx + 1, needle));
                }
            }
        }
    }

    assert!(
        findings.is_empty(),
        "s6-era binaries are not installed on this host; these spawns would fail \
         at runtime. Use `sv` (see op_core::runit) instead:\n  {}",
        findings.join("\n  ")
    );
}

#[test]
fn no_crate_hardcodes_the_s6_service_tree() {
    let mut files = Vec::new();
    rust_sources(&workspace_crates_dir(), &mut files);

    let mut findings = Vec::new();
    for file in &files {
        if is_allowed(file) {
            continue;
        }
        let Ok(text) = std::fs::read_to_string(file) else {
            continue;
        };
        for (idx, line) in text.lines().enumerate() {
            for needle in FORBIDDEN_PATHS {
                if line.contains(needle) {
                    findings.push(format!("{}:{}: {}", file.display(), idx + 1, needle));
                }
            }
        }
    }

    assert!(
        findings.is_empty(),
        "these are s6 paths; runit uses /etc/runit/sv and /run/runit/service. \
         Import op_core::runit instead of hardcoding:\n  {}",
        findings.join("\n  ")
    );
}

/// The agent-facing tool family must not advertise s6 verbs.
#[test]
fn agent_tools_are_named_sv_not_s6() {
    let mut files = Vec::new();
    rust_sources(&workspace_crates_dir(), &mut files);

    let mut findings = Vec::new();
    for file in &files {
        if is_allowed(file) {
            continue;
        }
        let Ok(text) = std::fs::read_to_string(file) else {
            continue;
        };
        for (idx, line) in text.lines().enumerate() {
            if line.contains("\"s6_") {
                findings.push(format!("{}:{}", file.display(), idx + 1));
            }
        }
    }

    assert!(
        findings.is_empty(),
        "s6_* tool names were removed in favour of sv_*; a stale name in the \
         registry is exactly what makes a model reach for a dead tool:\n  {}",
        findings.join("\n  ")
    );
}
</file>

<file path="op-cozo-store/examples/delete_identity_session.rs">
use std::path::PathBuf;

use op_cozo_store::CozoGraphShuttle;

fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    let mut args = std::env::args().skip(1);
    let db_path = PathBuf::from(
        args.next()
            .ok_or("usage: delete_identity_session DB SESSION")?,
    );
    let session_id = args
        .next()
        .ok_or("usage: delete_identity_session DB SESSION")?;
    if args.next().is_some() || session_id.is_empty() {
        return Err("usage: delete_identity_session DB SESSION".into());
    }

    let store = CozoGraphShuttle::new_persistent(db_path)?;
    let before = store.get_identity_sled(&session_id)?.is_some();
    store.delete_session(&session_id)?;
    let after = store.get_identity_sled(&session_id)?.is_some();
    println!("session_id={session_id} existed_before={before} exists_after={after}");
    Ok(())
}
</file>

<file path="op-cozo-store/examples/load_crate_graph.rs">
//! Load the generated crate graph (`docs/crate-graph/crate-graph.cozo`) into a
//! `CozoGraphShuttle` and print a few structural queries as proof it landed.
//!
//! ```sh
//! scripts/crate-graph.sh
//! cargo run -p op-cozo-store --example load_crate_graph -- docs/crate-graph/crate-graph.cozo
//! cargo run -p op-cozo-store --example load_crate_graph -- docs/crate-graph/crate-graph.cozo /path/to/rocksdb-dir
//! ```
//!
//! With a second argument the graph is written to a persistent RocksDB store
//! (`CozoGraphShuttle::new_persistent`); otherwise it lives in memory for the
//! duration of the run. The script targets the seed relations `graph_node` and
//! `graph_edge`, so it also loads into any store the shuttle already manages.

use std::path::PathBuf;

use op_cozo_store::CozoGraphShuttle;

fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    let mut args = std::env::args().skip(1);
    let script_path = PathBuf::from(
        args.next()
            .ok_or("usage: load_crate_graph SCRIPT.cozo [ROCKSDB_DIR]")?,
    );
    let store = match args.next() {
        Some(dir) => CozoGraphShuttle::new_persistent(PathBuf::from(dir))?,
        None => CozoGraphShuttle::new_in_memory()?,
    };

    let script = std::fs::read_to_string(&script_path)?;
    store.run_query(&script, None)?;

    let queries: &[(&str, &str)] = &[
        (
            "nodes by label",
            "?[label, count(label)] := *graph_node[_, label, _] :order -count(label)",
        ),
        (
            "edges by rel",
            "?[rel, count(rel)] := *graph_edge[_, rel, _, _] :order -count(rel)",
        ),
        (
            "crate fan-in (depends_on)",
            r#"?[dst, count(dst)] := *graph_edge[_, "depends_on", dst, _] :order -count(dst) :limit 12"#,
        ),
        (
            "crate fan-out (depends_on)",
            r#"?[src, count(src)] := *graph_edge[src, "depends_on", _, _] :order -count(src) :limit 12"#,
        ),
        (
            "module-level imports not backed by a Cargo dependency",
            r#"
            dep[a, b] := *graph_edge[a, "depends_on", b, _]
            dep[a, b] := *graph_edge[a, "dev_depends_on", b, _]
            dep[a, b] := *graph_edge[a, "build_depends_on", b, _]
            ?[module, target] := *graph_edge[module, "imports", target, _],
                                 *graph_edge[owner, "contains", module, _],
                                 not dep[owner, target]
            :limit 20
            "#,
        ),
        (
            "plugin registrations whose module is never declared (phantoms)",
            r#"?[id, file] := *graph_node[id, "plugin", p], j = parse_json(p), get(j, "declared") == false, file = get(j, "file")"#,
        ),
        (
            "runit service -> binary -> crate",
            r#"?[svc, bin, crate] := *graph_edge[svc, "runs_bin", bin, _], *graph_edge[crate, "provides_bin", bin, _]"#,
        ),
        (
            "transitive closure size of op-core (reverse depends_on)",
            r#"
            up[c] := c = "crate:op-core"
            up[c] := up[d], *graph_edge[c, "depends_on", d, _]
            ?[count(c)] := up[c]
            "#,
        ),
    ];

    for (title, q) in queries {
        let rows = store.run_query(q, None)?;
        println!("== {title}");
        println!("{}", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&rows)?);
    }
    Ok(())
}
</file>

<file path="op-cozo-store/src/bin/identity_sled_bind.rs">
//! Bind provisioned identity containers into Cozo: instance JSON + btrfs
//! device metadata, then drop host-only ghost session rows.
//!
//! Must run while op-grpc-bridge does not hold `/var/lib/op-dbus/identity-cozo`.

use std::collections::HashSet;
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

use op_cozo_store::CozoGraphShuttle;

fn main() {
    if let Err(error) = run() {
        eprintln!("identity-sled-bind: {error:#}");
        std::process::exit(1);
    }
}

fn run() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
    let db = std::env::var("IDENTITY_SLED_COZO_DB_PATH")
        .unwrap_or_else(|_| "/var/lib/op-dbus/identity-cozo".to_string());
    let keep_raw = std::env::var("IDENTITY_SLED_KEEP_SESSIONS").unwrap_or_else(|_| {
        "bea37ecb-92be-197c-660f-09e806f1a34f,f036f8d8-aabb-c5f2-49c9-18dac19f41ea".to_string()
    });
    let keep: HashSet<String> = keep_raw
        .split(',')
        .map(str::trim)
        .filter(|s| !s.is_empty())
        .map(str::to_string)
        .collect();
    let overlay_dir = PathBuf::from(
        std::env::var("IDENTITY_SLED_BIND_OVERLAY")
            .unwrap_or_else(|_| "/run/opdbus/identity-sled-bind".to_string()),
    );

    let store = CozoGraphShuttle::new_persistent(PathBuf::from(&db))?;
    let rows = store.list_identity_sessions()?;
    for row in &rows {
        if !keep.contains(&row.session_id) {
            eprintln!("dropping ghost session {}", row.session_id);
            store.delete_identity_sled(&row.session_id)?;
            continue;
        }
        let mut rec = row.clone();
        rec.instance_json = read_overlay(&overlay_dir, &row.session_id, "instance.json")?;
        rec.btrfs_device_json = read_overlay(&overlay_dir, &row.session_id, "btrfs_device.json")?;
        rec.active = false;
        store.put_identity_sled(&rec)?;
        eprintln!(
            "bound {} instance_len={} btrfs_len={}",
            rec.session_id,
            rec.instance_json.len(),
            rec.btrfs_device_json.len()
        );
    }
    eprintln!("remaining:");
    for row in store.list_identity_sessions()? {
        eprintln!(
            "  {} instance_len={} btrfs_len={} instance_head={:?}",
            row.session_id,
            row.instance_json.len(),
            row.btrfs_device_json.len(),
            row.instance_json.chars().take(48).collect::<String>()
        );
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn read_overlay(dir: &Path, session_id: &str, name: &str) -> anyhow::Result<String> {
    let path = dir.join(session_id).join(name);
    let raw = std::fs::read_to_string(&path)
        .map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!("read {}: {e}", path.display()))?;
    let value: serde_json::Value =
        serde_json::from_str(&raw).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!("parse {}: {e}", path.display()))?;
    Ok(serde_json::to_string(&value)?)
}
</file>

<file path="op-cozo-store/src/ctl_plane_chatbot_episodes.rs">
//! Durable private chatbot episodes in a dedicated Cozo domain owner.

use super::identity_transactions::commit_checked;
use super::*;
use cozo::MultiTransaction;

const MAX_LIST_LIMIT: usize = 200;
pub const MAX_CHATBOT_EPISODE_BYTES: usize = 16 * 1024 * 1024;
pub const MAX_CHATBOT_SNAPSHOT_BYTES: usize = 16 * 1024 * 1024;
const SNAPSHOT_ENVELOPE_BYTES: usize = 4 * 1024;
const MAX_SNAPSHOT_EPISODE_BYTES: usize = MAX_CHATBOT_SNAPSHOT_BYTES - SNAPSHOT_ENVELOPE_BYTES;
const MAX_PRINCIPAL_BYTES: usize = 512;
const MAX_SESSION_BYTES: usize = 256;
const MAX_GENESIS_BYTES: usize = 512;
const MAX_EPISODE_ID_BYTES: usize = 128;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct EpisodeScope {
    pub principal_id: String,
    pub session_id: String,
    pub session_genesis: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub struct EpisodeEmbeddingRecord {
    pub vector: Vec<f32>,
    pub provider: String,
    pub model: String,
    pub provider_model: Option<String>,
    pub dimensions: u32,
    pub config_revision: u64,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub struct ScopedEpisodeRecord {
    pub scope: EpisodeScope,
    pub episode_id: String,
    pub content_hash: String,
    pub episode: Value,
    pub embedding: Option<EpisodeEmbeddingRecord>,
}

/// One durable knowledge push in an identity scope. `push_id` is the
/// zero-padded scope revision that committed it, so ids order by commit.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub struct ScopedKnowledgeRecord {
    pub scope: EpisodeScope,
    pub push_id: String,
    pub content_hash: String,
    pub push: Value,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub struct EpisodeSnapshot {
    pub episodes: Vec<ScopedEpisodeRecord>,
    pub episode_count: u64,
    pub revision: u64,
    pub truncated: bool,
    /// Newest knowledge pushes of the scope, bounded by the snapshot limit.
    pub knowledge: Vec<ScopedKnowledgeRecord>,
    pub knowledge_count: u64,
    pub knowledge_truncated: bool,
}

/// Knowledge pushes kept in the private SHM snapshot.
pub const KNOWLEDGE_SNAPSHOT_LIMIT: usize = 32;
const MAX_KNOWLEDGE_PUSH_BYTES: usize = 64 * 1024;
const MAX_SNAPSHOT_KNOWLEDGE_BYTES: usize = 2 * 1024 * 1024;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub struct EpisodePage {
    pub episodes: Vec<ScopedEpisodeRecord>,
    pub episode_count: u64,
    pub revision: u64,
    pub next_episode_id: Option<String>,
}

fn error(message: &str) -> CozoError {
    CozoError::Other(message.into())
}

fn validate_embedding(value: &EpisodeEmbeddingRecord) -> std::result::Result<(), CozoError> {
    if value.dimensions == 0
        || value.vector.len() != value.dimensions as usize
        || !value.vector.iter().all(|component| component.is_finite())
        || value.provider.is_empty()
        || value.provider.len() > 128
        || value.model.is_empty()
        || value.model.len() > 512
        || value
            .provider_model
            .as_ref()
            .is_some_and(|model| model.is_empty() || model.len() > 512)
    {
        return Err(error("invalid chatbot episode embedding"));
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn bounded_identity(value: &str, maximum: usize) -> bool {
    !value.is_empty()
        && value.len() <= maximum
        && !value.chars().any(char::is_control)
        && value.trim() == value
}

fn validate_scope(scope: &EpisodeScope) -> std::result::Result<(), CozoError> {
    if !bounded_identity(&scope.principal_id, MAX_PRINCIPAL_BYTES)
        || !bounded_identity(&scope.session_id, MAX_SESSION_BYTES)
        || !bounded_identity(&scope.session_genesis, MAX_GENESIS_BYTES)
    {
        return Err(error("invalid chatbot episode identity scope"));
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn validate_episode_id(episode_id: &str) -> std::result::Result<(), CozoError> {
    if !bounded_identity(episode_id, MAX_EPISODE_ID_BYTES) {
        return Err(error("invalid chatbot episode id"));
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn validate_row(row: &ScopedEpisodeRecord) -> std::result::Result<(), CozoError> {
    validate_scope(&row.scope)?;
    validate_episode_id(&row.episode_id)?;
    if row.content_hash.len() != 64
        || !row
            .content_hash
            .bytes()
            .all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_hexdigit())
        || serde_json::to_vec(&row.episode)?.len() > MAX_CHATBOT_EPISODE_BYTES
    {
        return Err(error("invalid chatbot episode document"));
    }
    let object = row
        .episode
        .as_object()
        .ok_or_else(|| error("invalid chatbot episode document"))?;
    let matches =
        |field: &str, expected: &str| object.get(field).and_then(Value::as_str) == Some(expected);
    if !matches("principal_id", &row.scope.principal_id)
        || !matches("session_id", &row.scope.session_id)
        || !matches("session_genesis", &row.scope.session_genesis)
        || !matches("on_behalf_of", &row.scope.principal_id)
        || !matches("episode_id", &row.episode_id)
        || !matches("content_hash", &row.content_hash)
    {
        return Err(error(
            "chatbot episode document differs from its identity key",
        ));
    }
    if let Some(embedding) = &row.embedding {
        validate_embedding(embedding)?;
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn validate_knowledge_row(row: &ScopedKnowledgeRecord) -> std::result::Result<(), CozoError> {
    validate_scope(&row.scope)?;
    if row.push_id.len() != 20
        || !row.push_id.bytes().all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_digit())
        || row.content_hash.len() != 64
        || !row
            .content_hash
            .bytes()
            .all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_hexdigit())
        || serde_json::to_vec(&row.push)?.len() > MAX_KNOWLEDGE_PUSH_BYTES
    {
        return Err(error("invalid knowledge push document"));
    }
    let object = row
        .push
        .as_object()
        .ok_or_else(|| error("invalid knowledge push document"))?;
    let matches =
        |field: &str, expected: &str| object.get(field).and_then(Value::as_str) == Some(expected);
    if !matches("principal_id", &row.scope.principal_id)
        || !matches("session_id", &row.scope.session_id)
        || !matches("session_genesis", &row.scope.session_genesis)
        || !matches("push_id", &row.push_id)
        || !matches("content_hash", &row.content_hash)
    {
        return Err(error(
            "knowledge push document differs from its identity key",
        ));
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn read_knowledge_rows(
    tx: &MultiTransaction,
    script: &str,
    values: Params,
    scope: &EpisodeScope,
) -> std::result::Result<Vec<ScopedKnowledgeRecord>, CozoError> {
    let rows = tx
        .run_script(script, values)
        .map_err(|error| CozoError::Other(format!("knowledge read failed: {error}")))?;
    rows.rows
        .into_iter()
        .map(|row| {
            let [DataValue::Str(push_id), DataValue::Str(content_hash), DataValue::Str(push_json)] =
                row.as_slice()
            else {
                return Err(error("corrupt knowledge push row"));
            };
            let record = ScopedKnowledgeRecord {
                scope: scope.clone(),
                push_id: push_id.to_string(),
                content_hash: content_hash.to_string(),
                push: serde_json::from_str(push_json)
                    .map_err(|_| error("corrupt knowledge push JSON"))?,
            };
            validate_knowledge_row(&record)?;
            Ok(record)
        })
        .collect()
}

fn knowledge_count(
    tx: &MultiTransaction,
    scope: &EpisodeScope,
) -> std::result::Result<u64, CozoError> {
    let rows = tx
        .run_script(
            "?[count(push_id)] := *ctl_plane_chatbot_knowledge{principal_id, session_id, session_genesis, push_id}, principal_id = $principal, session_id = $session, session_genesis = $genesis",
            params(scope, None),
        )
        .map_err(|error| CozoError::Other(format!("knowledge count failed: {error}")))?;
    match rows.rows.as_slice() {
        [] => Ok(0),
        [row] => match row.as_slice() {
            [DataValue::Num(Num::Int(count))] if *count >= 0 => Ok(*count as u64),
            _ => Err(error("corrupt knowledge count row")),
        },
        _ => Err(error("corrupt knowledge count row")),
    }
}

fn params(scope: &EpisodeScope, episode_id: Option<&str>) -> Params {
    let mut values = BTreeMap::from([
        (
            "principal".into(),
            DataValue::Str(scope.principal_id.as_str().into()),
        ),
        (
            "session".into(),
            DataValue::Str(scope.session_id.as_str().into()),
        ),
        (
            "genesis".into(),
            DataValue::Str(scope.session_genesis.as_str().into()),
        ),
    ]);
    if let Some(episode_id) = episode_id {
        values.insert("episode".into(), DataValue::Str(episode_id.into()));
    }
    values
}

fn read_rows(
    tx: &MultiTransaction,
    script: &str,
    values: Params,
    scope: &EpisodeScope,
) -> std::result::Result<Vec<ScopedEpisodeRecord>, CozoError> {
    let rows = tx
        .run_script(script, values)
        .map_err(|error| CozoError::Other(format!("episode read failed: {error}")))?;
    rows.rows
        .into_iter()
        .map(|row| {
            let [DataValue::Str(episode_id), DataValue::Str(content_hash), DataValue::Str(episode_json), DataValue::Str(embedding_json)] =
                row.as_slice()
            else {
                return Err(error("corrupt chatbot episode row"));
            };
            let record = ScopedEpisodeRecord {
                scope: scope.clone(),
                episode_id: episode_id.to_string(),
                content_hash: content_hash.to_string(),
                episode: serde_json::from_str(episode_json)
                    .map_err(|_| error("corrupt chatbot episode JSON"))?,
                embedding: if embedding_json.is_empty() {
                    None
                } else {
                    Some(
                        serde_json::from_str::<EpisodeEmbeddingWire>(embedding_json)
                            .map_err(|_| error("corrupt chatbot episode embedding"))?
                            .into(),
                    )
                },
            };
            validate_row(&record)?;
            Ok(record)
        })
        .collect()
}

fn read_scope_state(
    tx: &MultiTransaction,
    scope: &EpisodeScope,
) -> std::result::Result<(u64, u64), CozoError> {
    let rows = tx
        .run_script(
            "?[revision, episode_count] := *ctl_plane_chatbot_episode_scopes{principal_id, session_id, session_genesis, revision, episode_count}, principal_id = $principal, session_id = $session, session_genesis = $genesis",
            params(scope, None),
        )
        .map_err(|error| CozoError::Other(format!("episode scope read failed: {error}")))?;
    match rows.rows.as_slice() {
        [] => Ok((0, 0)),
        [row] => match row.as_slice() {
            [DataValue::Num(Num::Int(revision)), DataValue::Num(Num::Int(count))]
                if *revision >= 0 && *count >= 0 =>
            {
                Ok((*revision as u64, *count as u64))
            }
            _ => Err(error("corrupt chatbot episode scope row")),
        },
        _ => Err(error("corrupt chatbot episode scope row")),
    }
}

fn write_scope_state(
    tx: &MultiTransaction,
    scope: &EpisodeScope,
    revision: u64,
    count: u64,
) -> std::result::Result<(), CozoError> {
    let revision = i64::try_from(revision).map_err(|_| error("episode revision exhausted"))?;
    let count = i64::try_from(count).map_err(|_| error("episode count exhausted"))?;
    let mut values = params(scope, None);
    values.insert("revision".into(), DataValue::Num(Num::Int(revision)));
    values.insert("count".into(), DataValue::Num(Num::Int(count)));
    tx.run_script(
        "?[principal_id, session_id, session_genesis, revision, episode_count] <- [[$principal, $session, $genesis, $revision, $count]] :put ctl_plane_chatbot_episode_scopes {principal_id, session_id, session_genesis => revision, episode_count}",
        values,
    )
    .map_err(|error| CozoError::Other(format!("episode scope write failed: {error}")))?;
    Ok(())
}

fn snapshot_in_transaction(
    tx: &MultiTransaction,
    scope: &EpisodeScope,
    limit: usize,
) -> std::result::Result<EpisodeSnapshot, CozoError> {
    if !(1..=MAX_LIST_LIMIT).contains(&limit) {
        return Err(error("chatbot episode snapshot limit must be 1..=200"));
    }
    let (revision, episode_count) = read_scope_state(tx, scope)?;
    let script = format!(
        "?[episode_id, content_hash, episode_json, embedding_json] := *ctl_plane_chatbot_episodes{{principal_id, session_id, session_genesis, episode_id, content_hash, episode_json, embedding_json}}, principal_id = $principal, session_id = $session, session_genesis = $genesis :order -episode_id :limit {limit}"
    );
    let candidates = read_rows(tx, &script, params(scope, None), scope)?;
    let mut episodes = Vec::with_capacity(candidates.len());
    let mut bytes = 0usize;
    for row in candidates {
        let row_bytes = serde_json::to_vec(&row.episode)?.len()
            + serde_json::to_vec(&row.episode_id)?.len()
            + 2;
        if bytes.saturating_add(row_bytes) > MAX_SNAPSHOT_EPISODE_BYTES {
            break;
        }
        bytes += row_bytes;
        episodes.push(row);
    }
    let knowledge_total = knowledge_count(tx, scope)?;
    let knowledge_limit = limit.min(KNOWLEDGE_SNAPSHOT_LIMIT);
    let script = format!(
        "?[push_id, content_hash, push_json] := *ctl_plane_chatbot_knowledge{{principal_id, session_id, session_genesis, push_id, content_hash, push_json}}, principal_id = $principal, session_id = $session, session_genesis = $genesis :order -push_id :limit {knowledge_limit}"
    );
    let mut knowledge = Vec::new();
    let mut knowledge_bytes = 0usize;
    for row in read_knowledge_rows(tx, &script, params(scope, None), scope)? {
        let row_bytes = serde_json::to_vec(&row.push)?.len() + row.push_id.len() + 4;
        if knowledge_bytes.saturating_add(row_bytes) > MAX_SNAPSHOT_KNOWLEDGE_BYTES {
            break;
        }
        knowledge_bytes += row_bytes;
        knowledge.push(row);
    }
    Ok(EpisodeSnapshot {
        truncated: episode_count > episodes.len() as u64,
        episodes,
        episode_count,
        revision,
        knowledge_truncated: knowledge_total > knowledge.len() as u64,
        knowledge,
        knowledge_count: knowledge_total,
    })
}

#[derive(serde::Serialize, serde::Deserialize)]
struct EpisodeEmbeddingWire {
    vector: Vec<f32>,
    provider: String,
    model: String,
    provider_model: Option<String>,
    dimensions: u32,
    config_revision: u64,
}

impl From<EpisodeEmbeddingRecord> for EpisodeEmbeddingWire {
    fn from(value: EpisodeEmbeddingRecord) -> Self {
        Self {
            vector: value.vector,
            provider: value.provider,
            model: value.model,
            provider_model: value.provider_model,
            dimensions: value.dimensions,
            config_revision: value.config_revision,
        }
    }
}

impl From<EpisodeEmbeddingWire> for EpisodeEmbeddingRecord {
    fn from(value: EpisodeEmbeddingWire) -> Self {
        Self {
            vector: value.vector,
            provider: value.provider,
            model: value.model,
            provider_model: value.provider_model,
            dimensions: value.dimensions,
            config_revision: value.config_revision,
        }
    }
}

impl CozoGraphShuttle {
    /// Opt this handle into the private chatbot episode domain. Generic Cozo
    /// stores deliberately do not expose these relations.
    pub fn initialize_chatbot_episode_store(&self) -> std::result::Result<(), CozoError> {
        let _guard = self
            .episode_transaction
            .lock()
            .map_err(|_| error("chatbot episode owner is poisoned"))?;
        self.runtime_document_preflight()?;
        for relation in [
            r#":create ctl_plane_chatbot_episodes {
                principal_id: String, session_id: String, session_genesis: String, episode_id: String
                =>
                content_hash: String,
                episode_json: String,
                embedding_json: String default ""
            }"#,
            r#":create ctl_plane_chatbot_episode_scopes {
                principal_id: String, session_id: String, session_genesis: String
                => revision: Int, episode_count: Int
            }"#,
            r#":create ctl_plane_chatbot_knowledge {
                principal_id: String, session_id: String, session_genesis: String, push_id: String
                =>
                content_hash: String,
                push_json: String
            }"#,
        ] {
            if let Err(error) =
                self.db
                    .run_script(relation, BTreeMap::new(), ScriptMutability::Mutable)
            {
                let message = error.to_string();
                if !message.contains("already exists")
                    && !message.contains("AlreadyExists")
                    && !message.contains("conflicts with an existing")
                {
                    return Err(CozoError::Other(format!(
                        "chatbot episode relation initialization failed: {message}"
                    )));
                }
            }
        }
        for probe in [
            "?[principal_id, session_id, session_genesis, episode_id, content_hash, episode_json, embedding_json] := *ctl_plane_chatbot_episodes{principal_id, session_id, session_genesis, episode_id, content_hash, episode_json, embedding_json} :limit 0",
            "?[principal_id, session_id, session_genesis, revision, episode_count] := *ctl_plane_chatbot_episode_scopes{principal_id, session_id, session_genesis, revision, episode_count} :limit 0",
            "?[principal_id, session_id, session_genesis, push_id, content_hash, push_json] := *ctl_plane_chatbot_knowledge{principal_id, session_id, session_genesis, push_id, content_hash, push_json} :limit 0",
        ] {
            self.db
                .run_script(probe, BTreeMap::new(), ScriptMutability::Immutable)
                .map_err(|error| {
                    CozoError::Other(format!(
                        "chatbot episode relation verification failed: {error}"
                    ))
                })?;
        }
        self.sync_runtime_document_store()
    }

    pub fn insert_scoped_episode_and_snapshot(
        &self,
        row: &ScopedEpisodeRecord,
        snapshot_limit: usize,
    ) -> std::result::Result<EpisodeSnapshot, CozoError> {
        validate_row(row)?;
        if row.embedding.is_some() {
            return Err(error(
                "new chatbot episodes cannot contain a derived embedding",
            ));
        }
        let _guard = self
            .episode_transaction
            .lock()
            .map_err(|_| error("chatbot episode owner is poisoned"))?;
        self.runtime_document_preflight()?;
        let tx = self.db.multi_transaction(true);
        if !read_rows(
            &tx,
            "?[episode_id, content_hash, episode_json, embedding_json] := *ctl_plane_chatbot_episodes{principal_id, session_id, session_genesis, episode_id, content_hash, episode_json, embedding_json}, principal_id = $principal, session_id = $session, session_genesis = $genesis, episode_id = $episode",
            params(&row.scope, Some(&row.episode_id)),
            &row.scope,
        )?
        .is_empty()
        {
            return Err(error("chatbot episode already exists"));
        }
        let (revision, count) = read_scope_state(&tx, &row.scope)?;
        let revision = revision
            .checked_add(1)
            .ok_or_else(|| error("episode revision exhausted"))?;
        let count = count
            .checked_add(1)
            .ok_or_else(|| error("episode count exhausted"))?;
        let episode_json = serde_json::to_string(&row.episode)?;
        let embedding_json = row
            .embedding
            .clone()
            .map(EpisodeEmbeddingWire::from)
            .map(|value| serde_json::to_string(&value))
            .transpose()?
            .unwrap_or_default();
        let mut values = params(&row.scope, Some(&row.episode_id));
        values.insert(
            "hash".into(),
            DataValue::Str(row.content_hash.as_str().into()),
        );
        values.insert("document".into(), DataValue::Str(episode_json.into()));
        values.insert("embedding".into(), DataValue::Str(embedding_json.into()));
        tx.run_script(
            "?[principal_id, session_id, session_genesis, episode_id, content_hash, episode_json, embedding_json] <- [[$principal, $session, $genesis, $episode, $hash, $document, $embedding]] :put ctl_plane_chatbot_episodes {principal_id, session_id, session_genesis, episode_id => content_hash, episode_json, embedding_json}",
            values,
        )
        .map_err(|error| CozoError::Other(format!("episode write failed: {error}")))?;
        write_scope_state(&tx, &row.scope, revision, count)?;
        let snapshot = snapshot_in_transaction(&tx, &row.scope, snapshot_limit)?;
        commit_checked(&tx)?;
        self.sync_runtime_document_store()?;
        Ok(snapshot)
    }

    /// Append one knowledge push to the scope. The store assigns `push_id`
    /// from the advanced scope revision; `source_id` inside the document is
    /// the caller's idempotency key and a duplicate is rejected.
    pub fn insert_scoped_knowledge_and_snapshot(
        &self,
        scope: &EpisodeScope,
        push: &Value,
        content_hash_for: &dyn Fn(&Value) -> std::result::Result<String, CozoError>,
        snapshot_limit: usize,
    ) -> std::result::Result<(ScopedKnowledgeRecord, EpisodeSnapshot), CozoError> {
        validate_scope(scope)?;
        let object = push
            .as_object()
            .ok_or_else(|| error("invalid knowledge push document"))?;
        let source_id = object
            .get("source_id")
            .and_then(Value::as_str)
            .filter(|id| bounded_identity(id, MAX_EPISODE_ID_BYTES))
            .ok_or_else(|| error("knowledge push requires a bounded source_id"))?
            .to_string();
        let _guard = self
            .episode_transaction
            .lock()
            .map_err(|_| error("chatbot episode owner is poisoned"))?;
        self.runtime_document_preflight()?;
        let tx = self.db.multi_transaction(true);
        let existing = read_knowledge_rows(
            &tx,
            "?[push_id, content_hash, push_json] := *ctl_plane_chatbot_knowledge{principal_id, session_id, session_genesis, push_id, content_hash, push_json}, principal_id = $principal, session_id = $session, session_genesis = $genesis",
            params(scope, None),
            scope,
        )?;
        if existing.iter().any(|row| {
            row.push.get("source_id").and_then(Value::as_str) == Some(source_id.as_str())
        }) {
            return Err(error("knowledge push already exists"));
        }
        let (revision, count) = read_scope_state(&tx, scope)?;
        let revision = revision
            .checked_add(1)
            .ok_or_else(|| error("episode revision exhausted"))?;
        let push_id = format!("{revision:020}");
        let mut document = push.clone();
        let doc = document
            .as_object_mut()
            .ok_or_else(|| error("invalid knowledge push document"))?;
        doc.insert("push_id".into(), Value::String(push_id.clone()));
        doc.insert(
            "principal_id".into(),
            Value::String(scope.principal_id.clone()),
        );
        doc.insert("session_id".into(), Value::String(scope.session_id.clone()));
        doc.insert(
            "session_genesis".into(),
            Value::String(scope.session_genesis.clone()),
        );
        doc.insert("content_hash".into(), Value::String(String::new()));
        let content_hash = content_hash_for(&document)?;
        document
            .as_object_mut()
            .ok_or_else(|| error("invalid knowledge push document"))?
            .insert("content_hash".into(), Value::String(content_hash.clone()));
        let record = ScopedKnowledgeRecord {
            scope: scope.clone(),
            push_id: push_id.clone(),
            content_hash: content_hash.clone(),
            push: document.clone(),
        };
        validate_knowledge_row(&record)?;
        let mut values = params(scope, None);
        values.insert("push".into(), DataValue::Str(push_id.into()));
        values.insert("hash".into(), DataValue::Str(content_hash.into()));
        values.insert(
            "document".into(),
            DataValue::Str(serde_json::to_string(&document)?.into()),
        );
        tx.run_script(
            "?[principal_id, session_id, session_genesis, push_id, content_hash, push_json] <- [[$principal, $session, $genesis, $push, $hash, $document]] :put ctl_plane_chatbot_knowledge {principal_id, session_id, session_genesis, push_id => content_hash, push_json}",
            values,
        )
        .map_err(|error| CozoError::Other(format!("knowledge write failed: {error}")))?;
        // Knowledge advances the shared scope revision; the episode count is unchanged.
        write_scope_state(&tx, scope, revision, count)?;
        let snapshot = snapshot_in_transaction(&tx, scope, snapshot_limit)?;
        commit_checked(&tx)?;
        self.sync_runtime_document_store()?;
        Ok((record, snapshot))
    }

    /// Newest-first knowledge pushes of the scope.
    pub fn list_scoped_knowledge(
        &self,
        scope: &EpisodeScope,
        limit: usize,
    ) -> std::result::Result<Vec<ScopedKnowledgeRecord>, CozoError> {
        validate_scope(scope)?;
        if !(1..=MAX_LIST_LIMIT).contains(&limit) {
            return Err(error("chatbot knowledge list limit must be 1..=200"));
        }
        let _guard = self
            .episode_transaction
            .lock()
            .map_err(|_| error("chatbot episode owner is poisoned"))?;
        let tx = self.db.multi_transaction(false);
        let script = format!(
            "?[push_id, content_hash, push_json] := *ctl_plane_chatbot_knowledge{{principal_id, session_id, session_genesis, push_id, content_hash, push_json}}, principal_id = $principal, session_id = $session, session_genesis = $genesis :order -push_id :limit {limit}"
        );
        let rows = read_knowledge_rows(&tx, &script, params(scope, None), scope)?;
        commit_checked(&tx)?;
        Ok(rows)
    }

    pub fn get_scoped_episode(
        &self,
        scope: &EpisodeScope,
        episode_id: &str,
    ) -> std::result::Result<Option<ScopedEpisodeRecord>, CozoError> {
        validate_scope(scope)?;
        validate_episode_id(episode_id)?;
        let _guard = self
            .episode_transaction
            .lock()
            .map_err(|_| error("chatbot episode owner is poisoned"))?;
        let tx = self.db.multi_transaction(false);
        let mut rows = read_rows(
            &tx,
            "?[episode_id, content_hash, episode_json, embedding_json] := *ctl_plane_chatbot_episodes{principal_id, session_id, session_genesis, episode_id, content_hash, episode_json, embedding_json}, principal_id = $principal, session_id = $session, session_genesis = $genesis, episode_id = $episode",
            params(scope, Some(episode_id)),
            scope,
        )?;
        commit_checked(&tx)?;
        match rows.len() {
            0 => Ok(None),
            1 => Ok(rows.pop()),
            _ => Err(error("duplicate chatbot episode rows")),
        }
    }

    pub fn list_scoped_episodes(
        &self,
        scope: &EpisodeScope,
        after_episode_id: Option<&str>,
        limit: usize,
    ) -> std::result::Result<Vec<ScopedEpisodeRecord>, CozoError> {
        validate_scope(scope)?;
        if let Some(cursor) = after_episode_id {
            validate_episode_id(cursor)?;
        }
        if !(1..=MAX_LIST_LIMIT).contains(&limit) {
            return Err(error("chatbot episode list limit must be 1..=200"));
        }
        let _guard = self
            .episode_transaction
            .lock()
            .map_err(|_| error("chatbot episode owner is poisoned"))?;
        let tx = self.db.multi_transaction(false);
        let cursor = after_episode_id.unwrap_or("");
        let mut values = params(scope, None);
        values.insert("cursor".into(), DataValue::Str(cursor.into()));
        let script = format!(
            "?[episode_id, content_hash, episode_json, embedding_json] := *ctl_plane_chatbot_episodes{{principal_id, session_id, session_genesis, episode_id, content_hash, episode_json, embedding_json}}, principal_id = $principal, session_id = $session, session_genesis = $genesis, episode_id > $cursor :order episode_id :limit {limit}"
        );
        let rows = read_rows(&tx, &script, values, scope)?;
        commit_checked(&tx)?;
        Ok(rows)
    }

    pub fn list_scoped_episode_page(
        &self,
        scope: &EpisodeScope,
        after_episode_id: Option<&str>,
        limit: usize,
    ) -> std::result::Result<EpisodePage, CozoError> {
        validate_scope(scope)?;
        if let Some(cursor) = after_episode_id {
            validate_episode_id(cursor)?;
        }
        if !(1..MAX_LIST_LIMIT).contains(&limit) {
            return Err(error("chatbot episode page limit must be 1..=199"));
        }
        let _guard = self
            .episode_transaction
            .lock()
            .map_err(|_| error("chatbot episode owner is poisoned"))?;
        let tx = self.db.multi_transaction(false);
        let (revision, episode_count) = read_scope_state(&tx, scope)?;
        let cursor = after_episode_id.unwrap_or("");
        let mut values = params(scope, None);
        values.insert("cursor".into(), DataValue::Str(cursor.into()));
        let fetch = limit + 1;
        let script = format!(
            "?[episode_id, content_hash, episode_json, embedding_json] := *ctl_plane_chatbot_episodes{{principal_id, session_id, session_genesis, episode_id, content_hash, episode_json, embedding_json}}, principal_id = $principal, session_id = $session, session_genesis = $genesis, episode_id > $cursor :order episode_id :limit {fetch}"
        );
        let candidates = read_rows(&tx, &script, values, scope)?;
        let mut episodes = Vec::with_capacity(candidates.len().min(limit));
        let mut bytes = 0usize;
        let mut more = false;
        for row in candidates {
            if episodes.len() == limit {
                more = true;
                break;
            }
            let row_bytes = serde_json::to_vec(&row.episode)?.len()
                + serde_json::to_vec(&row.episode_id)?.len()
                + 2;
            if bytes.saturating_add(row_bytes) > MAX_SNAPSHOT_EPISODE_BYTES {
                more = true;
                break;
            }
            bytes += row_bytes;
            episodes.push(row);
        }
        if more && episodes.is_empty() {
            return Err(error("chatbot episode exceeds the bounded page payload"));
        }
        let next_episode_id = more.then(|| {
            episodes
                .last()
                .expect("nonempty bounded episode page")
                .episode_id
                .clone()
        });
        commit_checked(&tx)?;
        Ok(EpisodePage {
            episodes,
            episode_count,
            revision,
            next_episode_id,
        })
    }

    pub fn snapshot_scoped_episodes(
        &self,
        scope: &EpisodeScope,
        limit: usize,
    ) -> std::result::Result<EpisodeSnapshot, CozoError> {
        validate_scope(scope)?;
        let _guard = self
            .episode_transaction
            .lock()
            .map_err(|_| error("chatbot episode owner is poisoned"))?;
        let tx = self.db.multi_transaction(false);
        let snapshot = snapshot_in_transaction(&tx, scope, limit)?;
        commit_checked(&tx)?;
        Ok(snapshot)
    }

    pub fn compare_exchange_episode_embedding(
        &self,
        scope: &EpisodeScope,
        episode_id: &str,
        content_hash: &str,
        expected: Option<&EpisodeEmbeddingRecord>,
        replacement: &EpisodeEmbeddingRecord,
        snapshot_limit: usize,
    ) -> std::result::Result<EpisodeSnapshot, CozoError> {
        validate_scope(scope)?;
        validate_episode_id(episode_id)?;
        validate_embedding(replacement)?;
        let _guard = self
            .episode_transaction
            .lock()
            .map_err(|_| error("chatbot episode owner is poisoned"))?;
        self.runtime_document_preflight()?;
        let tx = self.db.multi_transaction(true);
        let current = read_rows(
            &tx,
            "?[episode_id, content_hash, episode_json, embedding_json] := *ctl_plane_chatbot_episodes{principal_id, session_id, session_genesis, episode_id, content_hash, episode_json, embedding_json}, principal_id = $principal, session_id = $session, session_genesis = $genesis, episode_id = $episode",
            params(scope, Some(episode_id)),
            scope,
        )?
        .pop()
        .ok_or_else(|| error("chatbot episode does not exist"))?;
        if current.content_hash != content_hash || current.embedding.as_ref() != expected {
            return Err(error("chatbot episode embedding compare-exchange conflict"));
        }
        let (revision, count) = read_scope_state(&tx, scope)?;
        let revision = revision
            .checked_add(1)
            .ok_or_else(|| error("episode revision exhausted"))?;
        let embedding_json =
            serde_json::to_string(&EpisodeEmbeddingWire::from(replacement.clone()))?;
        let mut values = params(scope, Some(episode_id));
        values.insert("embedding".into(), DataValue::Str(embedding_json.into()));
        tx.run_script(
            "?[principal_id, session_id, session_genesis, episode_id, embedding_json] <- [[$principal, $session, $genesis, $episode, $embedding]] :update ctl_plane_chatbot_episodes {principal_id, session_id, session_genesis, episode_id => embedding_json}",
            values,
        )
        .map_err(|error| CozoError::Other(format!("episode embedding write failed: {error}")))?;
        write_scope_state(&tx, scope, revision, count)?;
        let snapshot = snapshot_in_transaction(&tx, scope, snapshot_limit)?;
        commit_checked(&tx)?;
        self.sync_runtime_document_store()?;
        Ok(snapshot)
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn scope(principal: &str) -> EpisodeScope {
        EpisodeScope {
            principal_id: principal.into(),
            session_id: "session".into(),
            session_genesis: "ab".repeat(32),
        }
    }

    fn row(scope: EpisodeScope, id: &str, hash: &str) -> ScopedEpisodeRecord {
        ScopedEpisodeRecord {
            episode: serde_json::json!({
                "principal_id": scope.principal_id.clone(),
                "session_id": scope.session_id.clone(),
                "session_genesis": scope.session_genesis.clone(),
                "on_behalf_of": scope.principal_id.clone(),
                "episode_id": id,
                "content_hash": hash,
            }),
            scope,
            episode_id: id.into(),
            content_hash: hash.into(),
            embedding: None,
        }
    }

    fn embedding(value: f32) -> EpisodeEmbeddingRecord {
        EpisodeEmbeddingRecord {
            vector: vec![value, value],
            provider: "fixture".into(),
            model: "model".into(),
            provider_model: Some("reported".into()),
            dimensions: 2,
            config_revision: 3,
        }
    }

    /// The chatbot's episodes are the ledger of its activity: they must
    /// outlive the process and stay invisible across principals.
    #[test]
    fn scoped_episodes_survive_a_reopen_and_stay_isolated_by_principal() {
        let dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let path = dir.path().join("episodes");
        let alice = scope("alice");
        let bob = scope("bob");
        {
            let store = CozoGraphShuttle::new_persistent(path.clone()).unwrap();
            store.initialize_chatbot_episode_store().unwrap();
            store
                .insert_scoped_episode_and_snapshot(&row(alice.clone(), "001", &"aa".repeat(32)), 8)
                .unwrap();
            store
                .insert_scoped_episode_and_snapshot(&row(alice.clone(), "002", &"bb".repeat(32)), 8)
                .unwrap();
            store
                .insert_scoped_episode_and_snapshot(&row(bob.clone(), "001", &"cc".repeat(32)), 8)
                .unwrap();
        }
        // Process restart.
        let store = CozoGraphShuttle::new_persistent(path).unwrap();
        store.initialize_chatbot_episode_store().unwrap();
        let alice_rows = store.list_scoped_episodes(&alice, None, 10).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            alice_rows
                .iter()
                .map(|r| r.episode_id.as_str())
                .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
            vec!["001", "002"],
            "alice's episodes persisted in order"
        );
        let bob_rows = store.list_scoped_episodes(&bob, None, 10).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(bob_rows.len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(bob_rows[0].content_hash, "cc".repeat(32));
        // A third principal on the same session/genesis sees nothing.
        assert!(store
            .list_scoped_episodes(&scope("carol"), None, 10)
            .unwrap()
            .is_empty());
    }

    /// The store only checks the hash shape; the plugin owns the real digest.
    fn fixture_hash(document: &Value) -> std::result::Result<String, CozoError> {
        let bytes = serde_json::to_vec(document)?;
        let mut acc = 0xcbf2_9ce4_8422_2325u64;
        for byte in bytes {
            acc = (acc ^ u64::from(byte)).wrapping_mul(0x0100_0000_01b3);
        }
        Ok(format!("{acc:016x}").repeat(4))
    }

    /// Knowledge pushes share the scope revision with episodes, survive a
    /// restart, stay private to their principal, and reject duplicates.
    #[test]
    fn knowledge_pushes_advance_the_scope_revision_and_persist_privately() {
        let dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let path = dir.path().join("episodes");
        let alice = scope("alice");
        {
            let store = CozoGraphShuttle::new_persistent(path.clone()).unwrap();
            store.initialize_chatbot_episode_store().unwrap();
            let before = store
                .insert_scoped_episode_and_snapshot(&row(alice.clone(), "001", &"aa".repeat(32)), 8)
                .unwrap();
            assert_eq!((before.revision, before.knowledge_count), (1, 0));
            let (record, snapshot) = store
                .insert_scoped_knowledge_and_snapshot(
                    &alice,
                    &serde_json::json!({"source_id": "p-1", "trigger": "ErrorAssistance"}),
                    &fixture_hash,
                    8,
                )
                .unwrap();
            assert_eq!(record.push_id, format!("{:020}", 2));
            assert_eq!(record.push["principal_id"], "alice");
            assert_eq!(record.push["content_hash"], record.content_hash);
            assert_eq!(
                (
                    snapshot.revision,
                    snapshot.episode_count,
                    snapshot.knowledge_count
                ),
                (2, 1, 1)
            );
            assert!(!snapshot.knowledge_truncated);
            let duplicate = store.insert_scoped_knowledge_and_snapshot(
                &alice,
                &serde_json::json!({"source_id": "p-1"}),
                &fixture_hash,
                8,
            );
            assert!(duplicate.is_err(), "source_id is the idempotency key");
            for i in 2..5 {
                store
                    .insert_scoped_knowledge_and_snapshot(
                        &alice,
                        &serde_json::json!({"source_id": format!("p-{i}")}),
                        &fixture_hash,
                        8,
                    )
                    .unwrap();
            }
        }
        let store = CozoGraphShuttle::new_persistent(path).unwrap();
        store.initialize_chatbot_episode_store().unwrap();
        let snapshot = store.snapshot_scoped_episodes(&alice, 2).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(snapshot.knowledge_count, 4);
        assert_eq!(snapshot.knowledge.len(), 2, "bounded by the snapshot limit");
        assert!(snapshot.knowledge_truncated);
        assert!(
            snapshot.knowledge[0].push_id > snapshot.knowledge[1].push_id,
            "newest first"
        );
        assert_eq!(snapshot.revision, 5);
        assert!(store
            .list_scoped_knowledge(&scope("bob"), 10)
            .unwrap()
            .is_empty());
        assert_eq!(store.list_scoped_knowledge(&alice, 10).unwrap().len(), 4);
    }

    #[test]
    fn immutable_scoped_rows_cursor_and_embedding_cas_are_atomic() {
        let store = CozoGraphShuttle::new_in_memory().unwrap();
        store.initialize_chatbot_episode_store().unwrap();
        let alice = scope("alice");
        let bob = scope("bob");
        let first_hash = "aa".repeat(32);
        let second_hash = "bb".repeat(32);
        let hidden_hash = "cc".repeat(32);
        let first = row(alice.clone(), "001", &first_hash);
        let second = row(alice.clone(), "002", &second_hash);
        let hidden = row(bob.clone(), "001", &hidden_hash);
        let snapshot = store
            .insert_scoped_episode_and_snapshot(&first, 32)
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!((snapshot.revision, snapshot.episode_count), (1, 1));
        store
            .insert_scoped_episode_and_snapshot(&second, 32)
            .unwrap();
        store
            .insert_scoped_episode_and_snapshot(&hidden, 32)
            .unwrap();
        assert!(store
            .insert_scoped_episode_and_snapshot(&first, 32)
            .is_err());
        let before_invalid = store.snapshot_scoped_episodes(&alice, 32).unwrap();
        let mut invalid = row(alice.clone(), "003", &"dd".repeat(32));
        invalid.episode["on_behalf_of"] = serde_json::json!("another-principal");
        assert!(store
            .insert_scoped_episode_and_snapshot(&invalid, 32)
            .is_err());
        assert_eq!(
            store.snapshot_scoped_episodes(&alice, 32).unwrap(),
            before_invalid
        );
        assert_eq!(
            store
                .list_scoped_episodes(&alice, Some("001"), 10)
                .unwrap()
                .iter()
                .map(|row| row.episode_id.as_str())
                .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
            ["002"]
        );
        let first_page = store.list_scoped_episode_page(&alice, None, 1).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(first_page.episodes[0].episode_id, "001");
        assert_eq!(first_page.next_episode_id.as_deref(), Some("001"));
        let second_page = store
            .list_scoped_episode_page(&alice, first_page.next_episode_id.as_deref(), 1)
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(second_page.episodes[0].episode_id, "002");
        assert!(second_page.next_episode_id.is_none());
        assert!(store.get_scoped_episode(&bob, "002").unwrap().is_none());

        let replacement = embedding(0.5);
        let snapshot = store
            .compare_exchange_episode_embedding(&alice, "001", &first_hash, None, &replacement, 1)
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!((snapshot.revision, snapshot.episode_count), (3, 2));
        assert!(snapshot.truncated);
        assert_eq!(
            store
                .get_scoped_episode(&alice, "001")
                .unwrap()
                .unwrap()
                .embedding,
            Some(replacement.clone())
        );
        assert!(store
            .compare_exchange_episode_embedding(
                &alice,
                "001",
                "wrong",
                Some(&replacement),
                &embedding(0.75),
                32,
            )
            .is_err());
        assert_eq!(
            store.snapshot_scoped_episodes(&alice, 32).unwrap().revision,
            3
        );
        let mut invalid_embedding = embedding(0.5);
        invalid_embedding.vector[0] = f32::NAN;
        assert!(store
            .compare_exchange_episode_embedding(
                &alice,
                "001",
                &first_hash,
                Some(&replacement),
                &invalid_embedding,
                32,
            )
            .is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn generic_cozo_store_has_no_episode_relations_and_cannot_mutate_episode_owner() {
        let generic = CozoGraphShuttle::new_in_memory().unwrap();
        let private = CozoGraphShuttle::new_in_memory().unwrap();
        assert!(generic.ensure_distinct_from(&generic.clone()).is_err());
        generic.ensure_distinct_from(&private).unwrap();
        private.initialize_chatbot_episode_store().unwrap();

        let relations = generic
            .db
            .run_script("::relations", BTreeMap::new(), ScriptMutability::Immutable)
            .unwrap();
        assert!(!relations.rows.iter().any(|row| {
            row.first().is_some_and(|value| {
                matches!(value, DataValue::Str(name) if name.starts_with("ctl_plane_chatbot_episode"))
            })
        }));
        assert!(generic
            .db
            .run_script(
                "?[episode_id] := *ctl_plane_chatbot_episodes{episode_id}",
                BTreeMap::new(),
                ScriptMutability::Mutable,
            )
            .is_err());

        generic
            .db
            .run_script(
                ":create ctl_plane_chatbot_episodes { marker: String => value: String }",
                BTreeMap::new(),
                ScriptMutability::Mutable,
            )
            .unwrap();
        generic
            .db
            .run_script(
                "?[marker, value] <- [['forged', 'generic-only']] :put ctl_plane_chatbot_episodes {marker => value}",
                BTreeMap::new(),
                ScriptMutability::Mutable,
            )
            .unwrap();

        let snapshot = private
            .snapshot_scoped_episodes(&scope("alice"), 32)
            .unwrap();
        assert!(snapshot.episodes.is_empty());
        assert_eq!((snapshot.episode_count, snapshot.revision), (0, 0));
    }

    #[test]
    fn multimegabyte_rows_are_whole_and_snapshot_pagination_is_bounded() {
        let store = CozoGraphShuttle::new_in_memory().unwrap();
        store.initialize_chatbot_episode_store().unwrap();
        let owner = scope("alice");
        let payload = "x".repeat(6 * 1024 * 1024);
        for (id, hash) in [
            ("001", "11".repeat(32)),
            ("002", "22".repeat(32)),
            ("003", "33".repeat(32)),
        ] {
            let mut episode = row(owner.clone(), id, &hash);
            episode.episode["decision_output"] = serde_json::json!(payload.clone());
            store
                .insert_scoped_episode_and_snapshot(&episode, 32)
                .unwrap();
        }

        let snapshot = store.snapshot_scoped_episodes(&owner, 32).unwrap();
        assert_eq!((snapshot.episode_count, snapshot.revision), (3, 3));
        assert!(snapshot.truncated);
        assert_eq!(snapshot.episodes.len(), 2);
        assert_eq!(snapshot.episodes[0].episode_id, "003");
        assert_eq!(snapshot.episodes[1].episode_id, "002");
        assert_eq!(
            snapshot.episodes[0].episode["decision_output"]
                .as_str()
                .unwrap()
                .len(),
            payload.len()
        );

        let first = store.list_scoped_episode_page(&owner, None, 3).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            first
                .episodes
                .iter()
                .map(|row| row.episode_id.as_str())
                .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
            ["001", "002"]
        );
        assert_eq!(first.next_episode_id.as_deref(), Some("002"));
        let second = store
            .list_scoped_episode_page(&owner, first.next_episode_id.as_deref(), 3)
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(second.episodes.len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(second.episodes[0].episode_id, "003");
        assert!(second.next_episode_id.is_none());
        assert_eq!(
            store
                .get_scoped_episode(&owner, "003")
                .unwrap()
                .unwrap()
                .episode["decision_output"]
                .as_str()
                .unwrap()
                .len(),
            payload.len()
        );
    }
}

<file path="op-cozo-store/src/identity_transactions_tests.rs">
use super::*;
use std::{
    cell::RefCell,
    sync::{Arc, Barrier},
    time::Duration,
};
thread_local! { static FAILURE: RefCell<Option<&'static str>> = const { RefCell::new(None) }; }
pub(super) fn fault(point: &str) -> std::result::Result<(), CozoError> {
    if FAILURE.with(|f| {
        let mut f = f.borrow_mut();
        if *f == Some(point) {
            *f = None;
            true
        } else {
            false
        }
    }) {
        return Err(err("injected identity transaction failure"));
    }
    Ok(())
}
fn inject(point: &'static str) {
    FAILURE.with(|f| *f.borrow_mut() = Some(point));
}
fn row(sid: &str) -> IdentitySledRecord {
    IdentitySledRecord {
        session_id: sid.into(),
        wireguard_pubkey: format!("key-{sid}"),
        interface: String::new(),
        peer_ip: String::new(),
        mutation_index: 0,
        session_genesis: String::new(),
        trace_id: String::new(),
        schema_version: 3,
        vector_id: String::new(),
        sealed_id: String::new(),
        principal_kind: None,
        btrfs_device_json: String::new(),
        instance_json: format!("{{\"name\":\"{sid}\"}}"),
        session_started_at: 1,
        last_seen_at: 1,
        active: false,
        expires_at: 0,
    }
}
fn genesis(sid: &str) -> GenesisInputsRecord {
    GenesisInputsRecord {
        session_id: sid.into(),
        arrival_timestamp: 10,
        chain_head_at_arrival: "head".into(),
        catalog_hash_at_arrival: "catalog".into(),
        head_timestamp_at_arrival: 9,
        schema_content_hash: "record-format".into(),
    }
}
fn put(
    store: &CozoGraphShuttle,
    sid: &str,
    op: &str,
    record: IdentitySledRecord,
    genesis: Option<GenesisInputsRecord>,
) -> IdentityRevision {
    let expected = store.read_identity_revision(sid).unwrap();
    store
        .apply_identity_intent(
            sid,
            op,
            IdentityIntent::CompareExchange(Box::new(IdentityCompareExchange {
                expected,
                record: Some(record),
                genesis,
            })),
        )
        .unwrap()
        .current
}

#[test]
fn native_commit_errors_are_not_mistaken_for_transport_success() {
    assert!(unwrap_commit_reply::<(), _, &str>(Ok(Err("native commit conflict"))).is_err());
    assert!(unwrap_commit_reply::<(), &str, _>(Err("closed channel")).is_err());
    assert!(unwrap_commit_reply::<(), &str, &str>(Ok(Ok(()))).is_ok());
}

#[test]
fn row_genesis_revision_commit_together_and_anchored_fields_are_immutable() {
    let store = CozoGraphShuttle::new_in_memory().unwrap();
    let mut anchored = row("sid-a");
    anchored.sealed_id = "fixture-authored-SID1-bytes".into();
    anchored.session_genesis = "fixture-anchor".into();
    anchored.trace_id = "fixture-trace".into();
    let first = put(
        &store,
        "sid-a",
        "first",
        anchored.clone(),
        Some(genesis("sid-a")),
    );
    assert_eq!(first.revision, 1);
    assert_eq!(first.record, Some(anchored.clone()));
    assert_eq!(first.genesis, Some(genesis("sid-a")));
    let mut conflicting = anchored;
    conflicting.sealed_id = "substitute".into();
    assert!(store
        .apply_identity_intent(
            "sid-a",
            "invalid-binding",
            IdentityIntent::CompareExchange(Box::new(IdentityCompareExchange {
                expected: first.clone(),
                record: Some(conflicting),
                genesis: first.genesis.clone()
            }))
        )
        .is_err());
    assert_eq!(store.read_identity_revision("sid-a").unwrap(), first);
    let all = store.read_identity_recovery_snapshot().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(all, [first]);
}

#[test]
fn mid_transaction_errors_do_not_commit_partial_row_genesis_or_revision() {

                "new",

                }))
