<file path="op-grpc-bridge/src/context_bundle.rs">
//! What the control-plane chatbot recalls before it answers.
//!
//! Before 2026-09-19 the production turn (`tched_router.Chat`) forwarded the
//! UI's messages verbatim: episodes were written to Cozo and vectorised, user
//! memory sat in namespaces, the context engine produced knowledge pushes —
//! and none of it reached a turn. The chatbot is the consumer now. This module
//! gathers, for the verified session scope only:
//!
//! 1. recent reasoning episodes of this principal/session (Cozo),
//! 2. namespace memory entries that match the query (Cozo),
//! 3. semantic recall through the cognitive memory tool when the Qdrant
//!    shuttle is configured (best-effort, bounded),
//! 4. session activity signals from the context engine,
//! 5. pending knowledge pushes for this session (drained on read),
//!
//! renders them into one bounded system message, and reports what it used so
//! the committed episode records the provenance of the answer.

use std::time::Duration;

use op_cognitive_mcp::CognitiveMcpServer;
use op_cozo_store::EpisodeScope;

use crate::mutation_engine::MutationEngine;
use crate::specialist;

/// Characters of recalled context injected into one turn.
pub const TURN_BUDGET_CHARS: usize = 8_000;
/// Episodes scanned (most recent first) when looking for relevant ones.
const EPISODE_SCAN: usize = 120;
/// Episodes rendered when nothing matches the query lexically.
const EPISODE_FALLBACK: usize = 3;
/// Semantic recall must answer within this or is skipped for the turn.
const SEMANTIC_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(2);

#[derive(Debug, Default, Clone)]
pub struct ContextBundle {
    pub episodes: Vec<String>,
    pub memories: Vec<String>,
    pub semantic: Vec<String>,
    pub activity: Vec<String>,
    pub pushes: Vec<String>,
}

impl ContextBundle {
    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {
        self.episodes.is_empty()
            && self.memories.is_empty()
            && self.semantic.is_empty()
            && self.activity.is_empty()
            && self.pushes.is_empty()
    }

    /// Provenance labels for the episode's `tools_consulted`, e.g.
    /// `context:episodes=3`, so the audit record says what the answer drew on.
    pub fn provenance(&self) -> Vec<String> {
        let mut out = Vec::new();
        for (label, items) in [
            ("episodes", &self.episodes),
            ("memory", &self.memories),
            ("semantic", &self.semantic),
            ("activity", &self.activity),
            ("knowledge_pushes", &self.pushes),
        ] {
            if !items.is_empty() {
                out.push(format!("context:{label}={}", items.len()));
            }
        }
        out
    }

    /// One system message, within `budget_chars`, sections in priority order.
    pub fn render(&self, budget_chars: usize) -> Option<String> {
        if self.is_empty() {
            return None;
        }
        let mut text = String::from(
            "## Recalled for this session (ground your answer in it; do not repeat it verbatim)\n",
        );
        let mut spent = text.len();
        for (heading, items) in [
            ("Knowledge pushed for this session", &self.pushes),
            ("Session activity", &self.activity),
            ("Relevant memory", &self.memories),
            ("Semantic recall", &self.semantic),
            ("Recent episodes", &self.episodes),
        ] {
            if items.is_empty() {
                continue;
            }
            let header = format!("\n### {heading}\n");
            if spent + header.len() > budget_chars {
                break;
            }
            text.push_str(&header);
            spent += header.len();
            for item in items {
                let line = format!("- {}\n", item.trim());
                if spent + line.len() > budget_chars {
                    break;
                }
                text.push_str(&line);
                spent += line.len();
            }
        }
        Some(text)
    }
}

/// Gather the bundle for one turn of `scope` about `query`. Never fails the
/// turn: every source is best-effort and logged on error.
pub async fn assemble_for_turn(
    engine: &MutationEngine,
    scope: &EpisodeScope,
    query: &str,
) -> ContextBundle {
    let mut bundle = ContextBundle::default();
    // The selected mode decides what memory a turn may recall (OD-65);
    // ui_render recalls nothing at all — not even pending pushes.
    let context = match crate::memory_binding::context_for(
        engine,
        &scope.principal_id,
        Some(&scope.session_id),
    )
    .await
    {
        Ok(context) => context,
        Err(error) => {
            tracing::warn!(%error, "context bundle: selected chat mode does not resolve; no memory recalled");
            return bundle;
        }
    };
    if !context.mode.has_memory() {
        return bundle;
    }
    let namespaces = vec![context.memory_namespace.clone()];
    let terms = op_agents::dynamic::TaskContext {
        question: query.to_string(),
        ..Default::default()
    }
    .terms();

    // 1. Episodes, scoped to this principal/session.
    match engine.ctl_plane_chatbot_episode_cozo().await {
        Ok(store) => match store.list_scoped_episodes(scope, None, EPISODE_SCAN) {
            Ok(records) => {
                let mut recent: Vec<(String, String)> = Vec::new();
                for record in records.iter().rev() {
                    let goal = record.episode["goal_text"]
                        .as_str()
                        .unwrap_or_default()
                        .to_string();
                    let decision = record.episode["decision_output"]
                        .as_str()
                        .unwrap_or_default()
                        .to_string();
                    if goal.is_empty() && decision.is_empty() {
                        continue;
                    }
                    let started = record.episode["started_at"]
                        .as_str()
                        .unwrap_or_default()
                        .to_string();
                    let line = format!(
                        "[{started}] asked: {} → answered: {}",
                        truncate(&goal, 200),
                        truncate(&decision, 300)
                    );
                    let haystack = format!("{goal} {decision}").to_ascii_lowercase();
                    let relevant = terms.iter().any(|t| haystack.contains(t.as_str()));
                    if relevant {
                        bundle.episodes.push(line.clone());
                    }
                    if recent.len() < EPISODE_FALLBACK {
                        recent.push((started, line));
                    }
                    if bundle.episodes.len() >= 6 {
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if bundle.episodes.is_empty() {
                    bundle.episodes = recent.into_iter().map(|(_, line)| line).collect();
                }
            }
            Err(error) => tracing::warn!(%error, "context bundle: episode recall failed"),
        },
        Err(error) => tracing::warn!(%error, "context bundle: episode store unavailable"),
    }

    let Ok(runtime) = engine.cognitive_mcp().await else {
        bundle.pushes = engine.take_pending_knowledge(&scope.session_id).await;
        return bundle;
    };

    // 2. Namespace memory (this session's namespace + shared pieces).
    bundle.memories = specialist::memory_snippets(
        runtime,
        &namespaces,
        &op_agents::dynamic::TaskContext {
            question: query.to_string(),
            ..Default::default()
        },
    )
    .await;

    // 3. Semantic recall, only when the shuttle exists, bounded in time.
    bundle.semantic = semantic_recall(runtime, &context.memory_namespace, query).await;

    // 4. Activity signals and 5. pending pushes.
    bundle.activity = specialist::activity_lines(runtime, &scope.session_id).await;
    bundle.pushes = engine.take_pending_knowledge(&scope.session_id).await;
    bundle
}

async fn semantic_recall(
    runtime: &CognitiveMcpServer,
    namespace: &str,
    query: &str,
) -> Vec<String> {
    if runtime.qdrant_shuttle().is_none() {
        return Vec::new();
    }
    let input = simd_json::json!({
        "operation": "semantic_query",
        "query": query,
        "namespace": namespace,
        "container_id": namespace,
        "limit": 5,
    });
    let registry = runtime.tool_registry();
    let call = registry.execute("cognitive_memory", input);
    match tokio::time::timeout(SEMANTIC_TIMEOUT, call).await {
        Ok(Ok(result)) => {
            let value: serde_json::Value = serde_json::to_value(result).unwrap_or_default();
            value
                .get("results")
                .and_then(|r| r.as_array())
                .map(|items| {
                    items
                        .iter()
                        .take(5)
                        .map(|item| {
                            truncate(
                                &item
                                    .as_str()
                                    .map(str::to_owned)
                                    .unwrap_or_else(|| item.to_string()),
                                300,
                            )
                        })
                        .collect()
                })
                .unwrap_or_default()
        }
        Ok(Err(error)) => {
            tracing::debug!(%error, "context bundle: semantic recall unavailable");
            Vec::new()
        }
        Err(_) => {
            tracing::debug!("context bundle: semantic recall timed out");
            Vec::new()
        }
    }
}

fn truncate(text: &str, max: usize) -> String {
    if text.chars().count() <= max {
        text.to_string()
    } else {
        let cut: String = text.chars().take(max).collect();
        format!("{cut}…")
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn render_orders_by_priority_and_respects_budget() {
        let bundle = ContextBundle {
            episodes: vec!["ep1".into(), "ep2".into()],
            memories: vec!["mem1".into()],
            semantic: vec![],
            activity: vec!["act1".into()],
            pushes: vec!["push1".into()],
        };
        let text = bundle.render(TURN_BUDGET_CHARS).unwrap();
        let p = text.find("push1").unwrap();
        let a = text.find("act1").unwrap();
        let m = text.find("mem1").unwrap();
        let e = text.find("ep1").unwrap();
        assert!(p < a && a < m && m < e, "priority order: {text}");
        assert_eq!(
            bundle.provenance(),
            vec![
                "context:episodes=2",
                "context:memory=1",
                "context:activity=1",
                "context:knowledge_pushes=1"
            ]
        );

        let tiny = bundle.render(200).unwrap();
        assert!(tiny.contains("push1"));
        assert!(!tiny.contains("ep2"), "budget cut the tail: {tiny}");
        assert!(ContextBundle::default().render(1_000).is_none());
    }
}
</file>

<file path="op-grpc-bridge/src/cron_dispatch.rs">
//! Canonical Cron method integration.
//!
//! The admitted OP-DBUS method and verified session authorize the call. The
//! tched-router bearer authenticates only this bridge to the loopback daemon.
//! Cron records are install-global: scheduled execution remains autonomous
//! under the configured native agent's risk/tool policy and does not retain or
//! re-check the caller's OP-DBUS grant.

use crate::{
    cron_gateway::TchedRouterCronGateway,
    cron_methods::{mark_publication_unverified, CronMethods},
    method_contract_admission,
    mutation_engine::MutationEngine,
    sealed_schema_reader::{
        blob_catalog_dir_from_env, read_manifest_pinned_schema_document,
        ManifestPinnedSchemaDocument,
    },
};
use anyhow::{Context, Result};
use op_state_store::PluginSchema;
use std::sync::Arc;

const PLUGIN: &str = "cron";
static CRON_OPERATION: tokio::sync::Mutex<()> = tokio::sync::Mutex::const_new(());

struct SealPin {
    schema_hash: String,
    schema_json: String,
}

fn is_mutation(method: &str) -> bool {
    matches!(
        method,
        "create_job" | "update_job" | "delete_job" | "enable_job" | "disable_job" | "run_job"
    )
}

fn pin_current_contract() -> Result<SealPin> {
    let pinned = read_manifest_pinned_schema_document(&blob_catalog_dir_from_env(), PLUGIN)?;
    method_contract_admission::admit_compiled_state_contract(&pinned, PLUGIN)?;
    Ok(SealPin {
        schema_hash: pinned.schema_hash,
        schema_json: pinned.blob.schema_json,
    })
}

fn seal_is_unchanged(expected: &SealPin) -> Result<()> {
    let current: ManifestPinnedSchemaDocument =
        read_manifest_pinned_schema_document(&blob_catalog_dir_from_env(), PLUGIN)?;
    method_contract_admission::admit_compiled_state_contract(&current, PLUGIN)?;
    anyhow::ensure!(
        current.schema_hash == expected.schema_hash
            && current.blob.schema_json == expected.schema_json,
        "cron plugin seal changed during native operation"
    );
    Ok(())
}

async fn blocking<T: Send + 'static>(
    operation: impl FnOnce() -> Result<T> + Send + 'static,
) -> Result<T> {
    tokio::task::spawn_blocking(operation)
        .await
        .context("cron sealed-contract worker failed")?
}

/// Commit one complete native Cron readback. This is shared by admitted method
/// calls and the autonomous event observer; the observer never projects event
/// payloads. The global operation guard orders mutations and observations.
pub(crate) async fn publish_observed_snapshot(
    engine: &MutationEngine,
    service: &CronMethods,
) -> Result<()> {
    let _operation = CRON_OPERATION.lock().await;
    let pin = blocking(pin_current_contract).await?;
    let state = service.observe_state().await?;
    let expected_hash = pin.schema_hash.clone();
    blocking(move || seal_is_unchanged(&pin)).await?;
    engine
        .process_observed_state(
            PLUGIN,
            simd_json::serde::to_owned_value(state)?,
            expected_hash,
        )
        .await
        .map_err(anyhow::Error::msg)
        .context("complete native Cron observation could not be committed")
        .map(|_| ())
}

/// Dispatch an already method/capability-admitted call. Identity is checked
/// again before the first daemon request; no caller-supplied identity reaches
/// the native gateway.
#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
pub(crate) async fn dispatch(
    engine: &MutationEngine,
    method: &str,
    args: &serde_json::Value,
    actor: &str,
    capability: Option<&str>,
    session: Option<&str>,
    genesis: Option<&str>,
    admitted_schema: &PluginSchema,
) -> Result<serde_json::Value> {
    let mutation = is_mutation(method);
    let _operation = CRON_OPERATION.lock().await;
    let caller = crate::tched_router_admission::RouterCaller {
        actor: actor.to_owned(),
        capability: capability.map(str::to_owned),
        session: session.map(str::to_owned),
        genesis: genesis.map(str::to_owned),
    };
    let pinned = crate::tched_router_admission::readmit_call(
        engine,
        admitted_schema,
        PLUGIN,
        method,
        &caller,
    )
    .await?;
    let pin = SealPin {
        schema_hash: pinned.schema_hash,
        schema_json: pinned.blob.schema_json,
    };
    let service = CronMethods::new(Arc::new(TchedRouterCronGateway::production()));
    let mut receipt = service.dispatch_observed(method, args).await?;

    let expected_hash = pin.schema_hash.clone();
    let post_seal = blocking(move || seal_is_unchanged(&pin)).await;
    if post_seal.is_err() {
        if mutation {
            if receipt
                .output
                .get("disposition")
                .and_then(serde_json::Value::as_str)
                != Some("indeterminate")
            {
                mark_publication_unverified(method, &mut receipt.output)?;
            }
            return Ok(receipt.output);
        }
        return post_seal.map(|_| receipt.output);
    }

    if let Some(state) = receipt.state {
        let state = simd_json::serde::to_owned_value(state)?;
        if let Err(_error) = engine
            .process_observed_state(PLUGIN, state, expected_hash)
            .await
        {
            if mutation {
                mark_publication_unverified(method, &mut receipt.output)?;
                return Ok(receipt.output);
            }
            anyhow::bail!("cron observation could not be committed to authoritative state");
        }
    }
    Ok(receipt.output)
}
</file>

<file path="op-grpc-bridge/src/cron_gateway_tests.rs">
use super::*;
use crate::cron_methods::CronMethods;
use axum::{
    body::to_bytes,
    extract::{Request, State},
    http::{header::AUTHORIZATION, Method, StatusCode},
    response::IntoResponse,
    routing::any,
    Json, Router,
};
use serde_json::{json, Value};
use std::sync::{
    atomic::{AtomicUsize, Ordering},
    Arc,
};
use tokio::sync::Mutex;

#[derive(Clone)]
struct NativeFixture {
    jobs: Arc<Mutex<Vec<Value>>>,
    calls: Arc<AtomicUsize>,
}

fn job(id: &str, enabled: bool) -> Value {
    json!({
        "id": id,
        "expression": "*/5 * * * *",
        "schedule": {"kind":"cron", "expr":"*/5 * * * *", "tz":"UTC"},
        "command": "",
        "prompt": "summarize",
        "name": "digest",
        "job_type": "agent",
        "session_target": "isolated",
        "model": null,
        "agent_alias": "operator",
        "enabled": enabled,
        "delivery": {"mode":"none", "channel":null, "to":null, "thread_id":null, "best_effort":true},
        "delete_after_run": false,
        "allowed_tools": ["file_read"],
        "uses_memory": false,
        "source": "imperative",
        "shell_output_format": "wrapped",
        "created_at": "2026-09-13T00:00:00Z",
        "next_run": "2026-09-13T00:05:00Z",
        "last_run": null,
        "last_status": null,
        "last_output": null
    })
}

async fn native_gateway(State(state): State<NativeFixture>, request: Request) -> impl IntoResponse {
    if request
        .headers()
        .get(AUTHORIZATION)
        .and_then(|v| v.to_str().ok())
        != Some("Bearer fixture-token")
    {
        return (
            StatusCode::UNAUTHORIZED,
            Json(json!({"error":"unauthorized"})),
        );
    }
    state.calls.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst);
    let method = request.method().clone();
    let path = request.uri().path().to_string();
    let body = to_bytes(request.into_body(), 1024 * 1024)
        .await
        .expect("bounded fixture body");
    let parsed: Value = if body.is_empty() {
        json!({})
    } else {
        serde_json::from_slice(&body).expect("JSON body")
    };
    let mut jobs = state.jobs.lock().await;
    let response = match (method, path.as_str()) {
        (Method::GET, "/api/cron") => json!({"jobs": jobs.clone()}),
        (Method::GET, "/api/cron/one/runs") => json!({"runs":[{
            "id":1, "job_id":"one", "started_at":"2026-09-13T00:00:00Z",
            "finished_at":"2026-09-13T00:00:01Z", "status":"ok",
            "output":"private output", "duration_ms":1
        }]}),
        (Method::POST, "/api/cron") => {
            let mut created = job("created", true);
            created["agent_alias"] = parsed["agent"].clone();
            created["name"] = parsed.get("name").cloned().unwrap_or(Value::Null);
            created["expression"] = parsed["schedule"].clone();
            created["schedule"] = json!({
                "kind":"cron",
                "expr":parsed["schedule"],
                "tz":parsed.get("tz").cloned().unwrap_or(Value::Null)
            });
            created["prompt"] = parsed.get("prompt").cloned().unwrap_or(Value::Null);
            created["command"] = parsed.get("command").cloned().unwrap_or(json!(""));
            // `CreateJobInput` serializes an absent Option as JSON null. The
            // native `CronAddBody` deserializes that as None and applies the
            // documented true default; the fixture must preserve that wire
            // behavior instead of storing null in the required bool field.
            created["uses_memory"] = parsed
                .get("uses_memory")
                .filter(|value| !value.is_null())
                .cloned()
                .unwrap_or(json!(true));
            jobs.push(created.clone());
            json!({"status":"ok", "job":created})
        }
        (Method::PATCH, "/api/cron/one") => {
            let current = jobs.iter_mut().find(|value| value["id"] == "one").unwrap();
            if let Some(enabled) = parsed.get("enabled") {
                current["enabled"] = enabled.clone();
            }
            if let Some(name) = parsed.get("name") {
                current["name"] = name.clone();
            }
            json!({"status":"ok", "job":current.clone()})
        }
        (Method::POST, "/api/cron/one/run") => json!({
            "status":"ok", "job_id":"one", "success":true,
            "output":"private output", "duration_ms":1,
            "started_at":"2026-09-13T00:00:00Z", "finished_at":"2026-09-13T00:00:01Z"
        }),
        (Method::DELETE, "/api/cron/created") => {
            jobs.retain(|value| value["id"] != "created");
            json!({"status":"ok"})
        }
        _ => return (StatusCode::NOT_FOUND, Json(json!({"error":"not found"}))),
    };
    (StatusCode::OK, Json(response))
}

#[test]
fn dynamic_job_id_is_one_encoded_path_segment() {
    assert_eq!(encoded_segment("job/with ?#%"), "job%2Fwith%20%3F%23%25");
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn real_bounded_transport_maps_all_nine_canonical_methods() {
    let fixture = NativeFixture {
        jobs: Arc::new(Mutex::new(vec![job("one", true)])),
        calls: Arc::new(AtomicUsize::new(0)),
    };
    let listener = tokio::net::TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").await.unwrap();
    let address = listener.local_addr().unwrap();
    let server_fixture = fixture.clone();
    let server = tokio::spawn(async move {
        axum::serve(
            listener,
            Router::new()
                .fallback(any(native_gateway))
                .with_state(server_fixture),
        )
        .await
        .unwrap();
    });
    let gateway = TchedRouterCronGateway {
        client: TchedRouterRuntimeClient::new(
            format!("http://{address}"),
            "operator".into(),
            Some("fixture-token".into()),
        ),
    };
    let methods = CronMethods::new(Arc::new(gateway));

    methods.dispatch("list_jobs", &json!({})).await.unwrap();
    methods
        .dispatch("get_job", &json!({"job_id":"one"}))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    methods
        .dispatch("get_history", &json!({"job_id":"one","limit":1}))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    methods.dispatch("create_job", &json!({
        "job_type":"agent", "agent":"operator", "schedule":"*/5 * * * *", "prompt":"summarize"
    })).await.unwrap();
    methods
        .dispatch("update_job", &json!({"job_id":"one","name":"renamed"}))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    methods
        .dispatch("disable_job", &json!({"job_id":"one"}))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    methods
        .dispatch("enable_job", &json!({"job_id":"one"}))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    methods
        .dispatch("run_job", &json!({"job_id":"one"}))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    methods
        .dispatch("delete_job", &json!({"job_id":"created"}))
        .await
        .unwrap();

    assert_eq!(fixture.calls.load(Ordering::SeqCst), 11);
    server.abort();
}

<file path="op-grpc-bridge/src/cron_gateway.rs">
//! Exact v0.8.4 cron route mapping over the existing hardened tched-router
//! runtime client. No second reqwest client or bearer authority is introduced.

use anyhow::{anyhow, Result};
use async_trait::async_trait;
use op_plugins::state_plugins::cron::*;
use serde::Deserialize;

use crate::cron_methods::{CronGateway, ProviderMutation};
use crate::tched_router_runtime::{
    GatewayJsonRequest, GatewayMethod, GatewayProfile, GatewayRequestError,
    TchedRouterRuntimeClient,
};

#[derive(Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
struct JobsResponse {
    jobs: Vec<CronJobRecord>,
}
#[derive(Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
struct RunsResponse {
    runs: Vec<CronRunRecord>,
}
#[derive(Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
struct JobResponse {
    status: String,
    job: CronJobRecord,
}
#[derive(Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
struct StatusResponse {
    status: String,
}

pub(crate) struct TchedRouterCronGateway {
    client: TchedRouterRuntimeClient,
}
impl TchedRouterCronGateway {
    pub(crate) fn production() -> Self {
        Self {
            client: TchedRouterRuntimeClient::from_env(),
        }
    }

    pub(crate) fn from_client(client: TchedRouterRuntimeClient) -> Self {
        Self { client }
    }
}

fn encoded_segment(raw: &str) -> String {
    const HEX: &[u8; 16] = b"0123456789ABCDEF";
    let mut out = String::with_capacity(raw.len());
    for byte in raw.bytes() {
        if byte.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || matches!(byte, b'-' | b'.' | b'_' | b'~') {
            out.push(char::from(byte));
        } else {
            out.push('%');
            out.push(char::from(HEX[(byte >> 4) as usize]));
            out.push(char::from(HEX[(byte & 0x0f) as usize]));
        }
    }
    out
}

fn read_error(error: GatewayRequestError) -> anyhow::Error {
    match error {
        GatewayRequestError::BeforeEffect(_) => {
            anyhow!("tched_router cron request failed before a provider result")
        }
        GatewayRequestError::InvalidResponse(_) => {
            anyhow!("tched_router cron response was unavailable or invalid")
        }
        GatewayRequestError::IndeterminateMutation(_) => {
            anyhow!("unexpected indeterminate classification for cron read")
        }
        GatewayRequestError::ProviderRejected { status, .. } => {
            anyhow!("tched_router rejected cron request with HTTP {status}")
        }
    }
}

fn mutation<T>(result: std::result::Result<T, GatewayRequestError>) -> Result<ProviderMutation<T>> {
    match result {
        Ok(value) => Ok(ProviderMutation::Completed(value)),
        Err(GatewayRequestError::IndeterminateMutation(_)) => Ok(ProviderMutation::Indeterminate(
            "native cron request may have taken effect; observe current state before retrying".into(),
        )),
        Err(GatewayRequestError::BeforeEffect(_)) => {
            Err(anyhow!("tched_router cron mutation failed before submission"))
        }
        Err(GatewayRequestError::ProviderRejected { status, .. }) => {
            Err(anyhow!("tched_router rejected cron mutation with HTTP {status}"))
        }
        // The shared transport promises this only for reads. Fail closed if a
        // future implementation violates that classification.
        Err(GatewayRequestError::InvalidResponse(_)) => Ok(ProviderMutation::Indeterminate(
            "native cron response was invalid after mutation submission; observe current state before retrying".into(),
        )),
    }
}

fn completed_job(
    result: std::result::Result<JobResponse, GatewayRequestError>,
) -> Result<ProviderMutation<CronJobRecord>> {
    match mutation(result)? {
        ProviderMutation::Completed(response) => {
            if response.status == "ok" {
                Ok(ProviderMutation::Completed(response.job))
            } else {
                Ok(ProviderMutation::Indeterminate(
                    "native cron response did not establish mutation completion; observe current state before retrying".into(),
                ))
            }
        }
        ProviderMutation::Indeterminate(detail) => Ok(ProviderMutation::Indeterminate(detail)),
    }
}

#[async_trait]
impl CronGateway for TchedRouterCronGateway {
    async fn list_jobs(&self) -> Result<Vec<CronJobRecord>> {
        let response: JobsResponse = self
            .client
            .send_gateway_json(GatewayJsonRequest {
                method: GatewayMethod::Get,
                relative_path: "/api/cron",
                query: &[],
                body: None,
                operation: "list cron jobs",
                profile: GatewayProfile::Config,
                mutation: false,
            })
            .await
            .map_err(read_error)?;
        Ok(response.jobs)
    }

    async fn list_runs(&self, job_id: &str, limit: u32) -> Result<Vec<CronRunRecord>> {
        let path = format!("/api/cron/{}/runs", encoded_segment(job_id));
        let limit = limit.to_string();
        let response: RunsResponse = self
            .client
            .send_gateway_json(GatewayJsonRequest {
                method: GatewayMethod::Get,
                relative_path: &path,
                query: &[("limit", limit.as_str())],
                body: None,
                operation: "list cron history",
                profile: GatewayProfile::Config,
                mutation: false,
            })
            .await
            .map_err(read_error)?;
        Ok(response.runs)
    }

    async fn create_job(&self, input: CreateJobInput) -> Result<ProviderMutation<CronJobRecord>> {
        let body = serde_json::to_value(input)?;
        completed_job(
            self.client
                .send_gateway_json(GatewayJsonRequest {
                    method: GatewayMethod::Post,
                    relative_path: "/api/cron",
                    query: &[],
                    body: Some(&body),
                    operation: "create cron job",
                    profile: GatewayProfile::Config,
                    mutation: true,
                })
                .await,
        )
    }

    async fn update_job(&self, input: UpdateJobInput) -> Result<ProviderMutation<CronJobRecord>> {
        let path = format!("/api/cron/{}", encoded_segment(&input.job_id));
        let mut body = serde_json::to_value(&input)?;
        let object = body
            .as_object_mut()
            .expect("typed update serializes as object");
        object.remove("job_id");
        object.retain(|_, value| !value.is_null());
        completed_job(
            self.client
                .send_gateway_json(GatewayJsonRequest {
                    method: GatewayMethod::Patch,
                    relative_path: &path,
                    query: &[],
                    body: Some(&body),
                    operation: "update cron job",
                    profile: GatewayProfile::Config,
                    mutation: true,
                })
                .await,
        )
    }

    async fn delete_job(&self, job_id: &str) -> Result<ProviderMutation<()>> {
        let path = format!("/api/cron/{}", encoded_segment(job_id));
        match mutation::<StatusResponse>(
            self.client
                .send_gateway_json(GatewayJsonRequest {
                    method: GatewayMethod::Delete,
                    relative_path: &path,
                    query: &[],
                    body: None,
                    operation: "delete cron job",
                    profile: GatewayProfile::Config,
                    mutation: true,
                })
                .await,
        )? {
            ProviderMutation::Completed(response) => {
                if response.status == "ok" {
                    Ok(ProviderMutation::Completed(()))
                } else {
                    Ok(ProviderMutation::Indeterminate(
                        "native cron response did not establish delete completion; observe current state before retrying".into(),
                    ))
                }
            }
            ProviderMutation::Indeterminate(detail) => Ok(ProviderMutation::Indeterminate(detail)),
        }
    }

    async fn run_job(&self, job_id: &str) -> Result<ProviderMutation<ManualRunResult>> {
        let path = format!("/api/cron/{}/run", encoded_segment(job_id));
        mutation(
            self.client
                .send_gateway_json(GatewayJsonRequest {
                    method: GatewayMethod::Post,
                    relative_path: &path,
                    query: &[],
                    body: None,
                    operation: "run cron job",
                    profile: GatewayProfile::LongRunning,
                    mutation: true,
                })
                .await,
        )
    }
}

<file path="op-grpc-bridge/src/cron_methods_tests.rs">
use super::*;
use op_state::StatePlugin;
use std::{
    sync::atomic::{AtomicUsize, Ordering},
    time::Duration,
};
use tokio::sync::Mutex;

fn assert_output(method: &str, value: &serde_json::Value) {
    let schema = op_plugins::state_plugins::cron::CronPlugin::new()
        .schema()
        .unwrap();
    let contract = serde_json::to_value(schema.methods[method].returns.as_ref().unwrap()).unwrap();
    jsonschema::Validator::new(&contract)
        .unwrap()
        .validate(value)
        .unwrap();
}

struct Fixture {
    jobs: Mutex<Vec<CronJobRecord>>,
    runs: Mutex<Vec<CronRunRecord>>,
    calls: AtomicUsize,
    run_delay: Duration,
    indeterminate_run: bool,
    diverge_create: bool,
    fail_list_after_delete: bool,
    deleted: AtomicUsize,
}

fn default_delivery() -> CronDelivery {
    CronDelivery {
        mode: "none".into(),
        channel: None,
        to: None,
        thread_id: None,
        best_effort: true,
    }
}

fn job(id: &str, enabled: bool) -> CronJobRecord {
    CronJobRecord {
        id: id.into(),
        expression: "*/5 * * * *".into(),
        schedule: CronSchedule::Cron {
            expr: "*/5 * * * *".into(),
            tz: Some("UTC".into()),
        },
        command: String::new(),
        prompt: Some("summarize".into()),
        name: Some("digest".into()),
        job_type: CronJobType::Agent,
        session_target: CronSessionTarget::Isolated,
        model: None,
        agent_alias: "operator".into(),
        enabled,
        delivery: CronDelivery {
            mode: "none".into(),
            channel: None,
            to: None,
            thread_id: None,
            best_effort: true,
        },
        delete_after_run: false,
        allowed_tools: Some(vec!["file_read".into()]),
        uses_memory: false,
        source: "imperative".into(),
        shell_output_format: CronShellOutputFormat::Wrapped,
        created_at: "2026-09-13T00:00:00Z".into(),
        next_run: "2026-09-13T00:05:00Z".into(),
        last_run: None,
        last_status: None,
        last_output: None,
    }
}

#[async_trait]
impl CronGateway for Fixture {
    async fn list_jobs(&self) -> Result<Vec<CronJobRecord>> {
        self.calls.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst);
        if self.fail_list_after_delete && self.deleted.load(Ordering::SeqCst) != 0 {
            bail!("fixture list failure containing bearer=must-not-escape")
        }
        Ok(self.jobs.lock().await.clone())
    }
    async fn list_runs(&self, job_id: &str, limit: u32) -> Result<Vec<CronRunRecord>> {
        self.calls.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst);
        Ok(self
            .runs
            .lock()
            .await
            .iter()
            .filter(|r| r.job_id == job_id)
            .take(limit as usize)
            .cloned()
            .collect())
    }
    async fn create_job(&self, input: CreateJobInput) -> Result<ProviderMutation<CronJobRecord>> {
        self.calls.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst);
        let mut created = job("created", true);
        match input {
            CreateJobInput::Agent {
                agent,
                name,
                schedule,
                tz,
                prompt,
                delivery,
                session_target,
                model,
                allowed_tools,
                delete_after_run,
                uses_memory,
            } => {
                created.agent_alias = agent;
                created.name = name;
                created.expression = schedule.clone();
                created.schedule = CronSchedule::Cron { expr: schedule, tz };
                created.command.clear();
                created.prompt = Some(prompt);
                created.delivery = delivery.unwrap_or_else(default_delivery);
                created.session_target = session_target.unwrap_or(CronSessionTarget::Isolated);
                created.model = model;
                created.allowed_tools = allowed_tools;
                created.delete_after_run = delete_after_run.unwrap_or(false);
                created.uses_memory = uses_memory.unwrap_or(true);
                created.job_type = CronJobType::Agent;
            }
            CreateJobInput::Shell {
                agent,
                name,
                schedule,
                tz,
                command,
                delivery,
                shell_output_format,
            } => {
                created.agent_alias = agent;
                created.name = name;
                created.expression = schedule.clone();
                created.schedule = CronSchedule::Cron { expr: schedule, tz };
                created.command = command;
                created.prompt = None;
                created.delivery = delivery.unwrap_or_else(default_delivery);
                created.shell_output_format =
                    shell_output_format.unwrap_or(CronShellOutputFormat::Wrapped);
                created.job_type = CronJobType::Shell;
            }
        }
        if self.diverge_create {
            created.name = Some("provider-diverged".into());
        }
        self.jobs.lock().await.push(created.clone());
        Ok(ProviderMutation::Completed(created))
    }
    async fn update_job(&self, input: UpdateJobInput) -> Result<ProviderMutation<CronJobRecord>> {
        self.calls.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst);
        let mut jobs = self.jobs.lock().await;
        let found = jobs
            .iter_mut()
            .find(|j| j.id == input.job_id)
            .context("missing")?;
        if let Some(enabled) = input.enabled {
            found.enabled = enabled;
        }
        if let Some(name) = input.name {
            found.name = Some(name);
        }
        Ok(ProviderMutation::Completed(found.clone()))
    }
    async fn delete_job(&self, job_id: &str) -> Result<ProviderMutation<()>> {
        self.calls.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst);
        let mut jobs = self.jobs.lock().await;
        let before = jobs.len();
        jobs.retain(|j| j.id != job_id);
        ensure!(jobs.len() + 1 == before, "missing");
        self.deleted.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst);
        Ok(ProviderMutation::Completed(()))
    }
    async fn run_job(&self, job_id: &str) -> Result<ProviderMutation<ManualRunResult>> {
        self.calls.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst);
        tokio::time::sleep(self.run_delay).await;
        if self.indeterminate_run {
            return Ok(ProviderMutation::Indeterminate(
                "native run may still be executing".into(),
            ));
        }
        Ok(ProviderMutation::Completed(ManualRunResult {
            status: "ok".into(),
            job_id: job_id.into(),
            success: true,
            output: "private output".into(),
            duration_ms: 1,
            started_at: "2026-09-13T00:00:00Z".into(),
            finished_at: "2026-09-13T00:00:01Z".into(),
        }))
    }
}

fn fixture_with_run(
    run_delay: Duration,
    fail_list_after_delete: bool,
    indeterminate_run: bool,
    diverge_create: bool,
) -> Arc<Fixture> {
    Arc::new(Fixture {
        jobs: Mutex::new(vec![job("one", true)]),
        runs: Mutex::new(vec![CronRunRecord {
            id: 1,
            job_id: "one".into(),
            started_at: "2026-09-13T00:00:00Z".into(),
            finished_at: "2026-09-13T00:00:01Z".into(),
            status: "ok".into(),
            output: Some("private output".into()),
            duration_ms: Some(1),
        }]),
        calls: AtomicUsize::new(0),
        run_delay,
        indeterminate_run,
        diverge_create,
        fail_list_after_delete,
        deleted: AtomicUsize::new(0),
    })
}

fn fixture(run_delay: Duration, fail_list_after_delete: bool) -> Arc<Fixture> {
    fixture_with_run(run_delay, fail_list_after_delete, false, false)
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn all_nine_methods_return_provider_observations() {
    let backend = fixture(Duration::ZERO, false);
    let methods = CronMethods::new(backend.clone());
    let list = methods
        .dispatch("list_jobs", &serde_json::json!({}))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(list["scope"], "global_daemon");
    assert_eq!(list["jobs"][0]["agent_alias"], "operator");
    assert_output("list_jobs", &list);
    let got = methods
        .dispatch("get_job", &serde_json::json!({"job_id":"one"}))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(got["job"]["id"], "one");
    assert_output("get_job", &got);
    let history = methods
        .dispatch(
            "get_history",
            &serde_json::json!({"job_id":"one","limit":1}),
        )
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(history["runs"][0]["job_id"], "one");
    assert_output("get_history", &history);
    let created = methods.dispatch("create_job", &serde_json::json!({
            "job_type":"agent", "agent":"operator", "schedule":"*/5 * * * *", "prompt":"summarize"
        })).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(created["job"]["id"], "created");
    assert_eq!(created["disposition"], "confirmed");
    assert_output("create_job", &created);
    let updated = methods
        .dispatch(
            "update_job",
            &serde_json::json!({"job_id":"one","name":"renamed"}),
        )
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(updated["job"]["name"], "renamed");
    assert_output("update_job", &updated);
    let disabled = methods
        .dispatch("disable_job", &serde_json::json!({"job_id":"one"}))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(disabled["job"]["enabled"], false);
    assert_output("disable_job", &disabled);
    let enabled = methods
        .dispatch("enable_job", &serde_json::json!({"job_id":"one"}))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(enabled["job"]["enabled"], true);
    assert_output("enable_job", &enabled);
    let run = methods
        .dispatch("run_job", &serde_json::json!({"job_id":"one"}))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(run["disposition"], "completed");
    assert_eq!(run["result"]["success"], true);
    assert_output("run_job", &run);
    let deleted = methods
        .dispatch("delete_job", &serde_json::json!({"job_id":"created"}))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(deleted["provider_completed"], true);
    assert_eq!(deleted["absent_on_readback"], true);
    assert_output("delete_job", &deleted);
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn invalid_mutation_is_rejected_before_provider_call() {
    let backend = fixture(Duration::ZERO, false);
    let methods = CronMethods::new(backend.clone());
    assert!(methods
        .dispatch(
            "create_job",
            &serde_json::json!({
                "job_type":"agent", "agent":"operator", "schedule":"*/5 * * * *", "prompt":""
            })
        )
        .await
        .is_err());
    assert!(methods
        .dispatch(
            "update_job",
            &serde_json::json!({
                "job_id":"one", "tz":"UTC", "clear_tz":true
            })
        )
        .await
        .is_err());
    assert_eq!(backend.calls.load(Ordering::SeqCst), 0);
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn divergent_create_readback_is_never_confirmed() {
    let backend = fixture_with_run(Duration::ZERO, false, false, true);
    let result = CronMethods::new(backend)
        .dispatch(
            "create_job",
            &serde_json::json!({
                "job_type":"agent", "agent":"operator", "name":"requested",
                "schedule":"*/5 * * * *", "prompt":"exact prompt",
                "uses_memory":false
            }),
        )
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(result["disposition"], "provider_completed_unverified");
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn observed_receipts_reuse_exact_readback_and_never_invent_state() {
    let backend = fixture(Duration::ZERO, false);
    let methods = CronMethods::new(backend.clone());

    let get = methods
        .dispatch_observed("get_job", &serde_json::json!({"job_id":"one"}))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    let get_state = get.state.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(get.output["job"]["id"], get_state.jobs[0].id);
    assert_eq!(backend.calls.load(Ordering::SeqCst), 1);

    let created = methods
        .dispatch_observed(
            "create_job",
            &serde_json::json!({
                "job_type":"agent", "agent":"operator",
                "schedule":"*/5 * * * *", "prompt":"summarize"
            }),
        )
        .await
        .unwrap();
    let created_id = created.output["job"]["id"].as_str().unwrap().to_string();
    assert!(created
        .state
        .unwrap()
        .jobs
        .iter()
        .any(|job| job.id == created_id));

    let deleted = methods
        .dispatch_observed("delete_job", &serde_json::json!({"job_id":"created"}))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(deleted.output["absent_on_readback"], true);
    assert!(!deleted
        .state
        .unwrap()
        .jobs
        .iter()
        .any(|job| job.id == "created"));

    let indeterminate = CronMethods::new(fixture_with_run(Duration::ZERO, false, true, false))
        .dispatch_observed("run_job", &serde_json::json!({"job_id":"one"}))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(indeterminate.output["disposition"], "indeterminate");
    assert!(indeterminate.state.is_none());
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn completed_delete_with_failed_readback_is_not_falsely_failed() {
    let backend = fixture(Duration::ZERO, true);
    backend.jobs.lock().await.push(job("remove-me", true));
    let result = CronMethods::new(backend)
        .dispatch("delete_job", &serde_json::json!({"job_id":"remove-me"}))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(result["provider_completed"], true);
    assert!(result["absent_on_readback"].is_null());
    assert!(!result["readback_error"]
        .as_str()
        .unwrap()
        .contains("bearer="));
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn provider_indeterminate_run_is_returned_without_retry() {
    let backend = fixture_with_run(Duration::ZERO, false, true, false);
    let methods = CronMethods::new(backend.clone());
    let result = methods
        .dispatch("run_job", &serde_json::json!({"job_id":"one"}))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(result["disposition"], "indeterminate");
    assert_eq!(backend.calls.load(Ordering::SeqCst), 1);
}

<file path="op-grpc-bridge/src/cron_methods.rs">
//! Staged native adapter for all nine retained cron methods.
//!
//! Integration contract:
//! * generated dispatch performs exact sealed method admission and verifies the
//!   current identity has the method's exact `cron.read`/`cron.invoke` grant;
//! * the gateway bearer authenticates this loopback daemon client only;
//! * MutationEngine runs every mutation branch as an owned task through native
//!   completion and commits the returned observed state before notification;
//! * audit records digest create/update bodies and run output, never raw text.

use anyhow::{bail, ensure, Context, Result};
use async_trait::async_trait;
use op_plugins::state_plugins::cron::*;
use std::{collections::BTreeSet, sync::Arc};

pub(crate) enum ProviderMutation<T> {
    Completed(T),
    /// The request was admitted and may have reached the daemon, but no
    /// authoritative response was received. The string is already sanitized.
    Indeterminate(String),
}

#[async_trait]
pub(crate) trait CronGateway: Send + Sync {
    async fn list_jobs(&self) -> Result<Vec<CronJobRecord>>;
    async fn list_runs(&self, job_id: &str, limit: u32) -> Result<Vec<CronRunRecord>>;
    async fn create_job(&self, input: CreateJobInput) -> Result<ProviderMutation<CronJobRecord>>;
    async fn update_job(&self, input: UpdateJobInput) -> Result<ProviderMutation<CronJobRecord>>;
    async fn delete_job(&self, job_id: &str) -> Result<ProviderMutation<()>>;
    async fn run_job(&self, job_id: &str) -> Result<ProviderMutation<ManualRunResult>>;
}

pub(crate) struct CronMethods {
    gateway: Arc<dyn CronGateway>,
}

pub(crate) struct CronDispatchReceipt {
    pub(crate) output: serde_json::Value,
    pub(crate) state: Option<CronStateV2>,
}

impl CronMethods {
    pub(crate) fn new(gateway: Arc<dyn CronGateway>) -> Self {
        Self { gateway }
    }

    /// Observe the complete schema-shaped global state from the native owner.
    /// MutationEngine calls this after a mutation and commits it to SHM before
    /// returning/notifying. Failure means no new state is fabricated.
    pub(crate) async fn observe_state(&self) -> Result<CronStateV2> {
        Ok(CronStateV2 {
            scope: CronScope::GlobalDaemon,
            event_stream: CronEventStreamIntegrity::default(),
            jobs: self.list_jobs().await?,
        })
    }

    /// Dispatch and retain the exact complete observation used for SHM.
    /// The caller holds the global cron operation guard through publication.
    pub(crate) async fn dispatch_observed(
        &self,
        method: &str,
        args: &serde_json::Value,
    ) -> Result<CronDispatchReceipt> {
        if method == "get_job" {
            return self.get_job_observed(args).await;
        }
        if method == "delete_job" {
            return self.delete_observed(args).await;
        }
        let mut output = self.dispatch(method, args).await?;
        if method == "list_jobs" {
            let listed: ListJobsOutput = serde_json::from_value(output.clone())?;
            return Ok(CronDispatchReceipt {
                output,
                state: Some(CronStateV2 {
                    scope: listed.scope,
                    event_stream: CronEventStreamIntegrity::default(),
                    jobs: listed.jobs,
                }),
            });
        }
        if !matches!(
            method,
            "create_job" | "update_job" | "delete_job" | "enable_job" | "disable_job" | "run_job"
        ) || output
            .get("disposition")
            .and_then(serde_json::Value::as_str)
            == Some("indeterminate")
        {
            return Ok(CronDispatchReceipt {
                output,
                state: None,
            });
        }
        match self.observe_state().await {
            Ok(state) => Ok(CronDispatchReceipt {
                output,
                state: Some(state),
            }),
            Err(_) => {
                mark_publication_unverified(method, &mut output)?;
                Ok(CronDispatchReceipt {
                    output,
                    state: None,
                })
            }
        }
    }

    pub(crate) async fn dispatch(
        &self,
        method: &str,
        args: &serde_json::Value,
    ) -> Result<serde_json::Value> {
        match method {
            "list_jobs" => {
                let _: ListJobsInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
                output(ListJobsOutput {
                    scope: CronScope::GlobalDaemon,
                    jobs: self.list_jobs().await?,
                })
            }
            "get_job" => Ok(self.get_job_observed(args).await?.output),
            "get_history" => {
                let input: GetHistoryInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
                validate_job_id(&input.job_id)?;
                ensure!(
                    (1..=MAX_CRON_HISTORY).contains(&input.limit),
                    "history limit must be between 1 and {MAX_CRON_HISTORY}"
                );
                // Native GET /runs first proves the job exists and clamps the
                // same range; this adapter rejects instead of silently clamping.
                let runs = self.gateway.list_runs(&input.job_id, input.limit).await?;
                ensure!(
                    runs.len() <= input.limit as usize,
                    "tched_router returned more history rows than requested"
                );
                ensure!(
                    runs.iter().all(|run| run.job_id == input.job_id),
                    "tched_router returned history for another job"
                );
                output(GetHistoryOutput {
                    scope: CronScope::GlobalDaemon,
                    job_id: input.job_id,
                    runs,
                })
            }
            "create_job" => {
                let input: CreateJobInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
                validate_create(&input)?;
                let expected = input.clone();
                match self.gateway.create_job(input).await? {
                    ProviderMutation::Completed(job) => {
                        let valid = validate_job(&job).is_ok();
                        let matches = valid && create_matches(&expected, &job);
                        output(JobMutationOutput {
                            scope: CronScope::GlobalDaemon,
                            disposition: if matches {
                                MutationDisposition::Confirmed
                            } else {
                                MutationDisposition::ProviderCompletedUnverified
                            },
                            job: Some(job),
                            diagnostic: (!matches).then(|| {
                                "provider completed create but readback was invalid or owner/type diverged"
                                    .to_string()
                            }),
                        })
                    }
                    ProviderMutation::Indeterminate(diagnostic) => output(JobMutationOutput {
                        scope: CronScope::GlobalDaemon,
                        disposition: MutationDisposition::Indeterminate,
                        job: None,
                        diagnostic: Some(diagnostic),
                    }),
                }
            }
            "update_job" => {
                let input: UpdateJobInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
                validate_update(&input)?;
                let prior = exact_job(self.list_jobs().await?, &input.job_id)?;
                validate_update_for_job(&input, &prior)?;
                let expected = input.clone();
                match self.gateway.update_job(input).await? {
                    ProviderMutation::Completed(job) => {
                        let valid = validate_job(&job).is_ok();
                        let matches = valid && update_matches(&expected, &prior, &job);
                        output(JobMutationOutput {
                            scope: CronScope::GlobalDaemon,
                            disposition: if matches {
                                MutationDisposition::Confirmed
                            } else {
                                MutationDisposition::ProviderCompletedUnverified
                            },
                            job: Some(job),
                            diagnostic: (!matches).then(|| {
                                "provider completed update but readback was invalid or diverged"
                                    .to_string()
                            }),
                        })
                    }
                    ProviderMutation::Indeterminate(diagnostic) => output(JobMutationOutput {
                        scope: CronScope::GlobalDaemon,
                        disposition: MutationDisposition::Indeterminate,
                        job: None,
                        diagnostic: Some(diagnostic),
                    }),
                }
            }
            "enable_job" | "disable_job" => {
                let input: JobIdInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
                validate_job_id(&input.job_id)?;
                let enabled = method == "enable_job";
                let patch = UpdateJobInput {
                    job_id: input.job_id.clone(),
                    agent: None,
                    name: None,
                    schedule: None,
                    tz: None,
                    clear_tz: None,
                    command: None,
                    prompt: None,
                    enabled: Some(enabled),
                    uses_memory: None,
                    shell_output_format: None,
                };
                match self.gateway.update_job(patch).await? {
                    ProviderMutation::Completed(job) => {
                        let valid = validate_job(&job).is_ok();
                        let matches = valid && job.id == input.job_id && job.enabled == enabled;
                        output(JobMutationOutput {
                            scope: CronScope::GlobalDaemon,
                            disposition: if matches {
                                MutationDisposition::Confirmed
                            } else {
                                MutationDisposition::ProviderCompletedUnverified
                            },
                            job: Some(job),
                            diagnostic: (!matches).then(|| {
                                "provider completed toggle but readback was invalid or diverged"
                                    .to_string()
                            }),
                        })
                    }
                    ProviderMutation::Indeterminate(diagnostic) => output(JobMutationOutput {
                        scope: CronScope::GlobalDaemon,
                        disposition: MutationDisposition::Indeterminate,
                        job: None,
                        diagnostic: Some(diagnostic),
                    }),
                }
            }
            "delete_job" => Ok(self.delete_observed(args).await?.output),
            "run_job" => {
                let input: JobIdInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
                validate_job_id(&input.job_id)?;
                let id = input.job_id;
                // MutationEngine already owns the complete admitted operation.
                // Await the shared transport's bounded long-running request so
                // its global operation guard is not released while a detached
                // provider mutation is still completing.
                match self.gateway.run_job(&id).await? {
                    ProviderMutation::Completed(result) => {
                        if result.job_id == id {
                            output(RunJobOutput {
                                scope: CronScope::GlobalDaemon,
                                job_id: id,
                                disposition: RunDisposition::Completed,
                                result: Some(result),
                                diagnostic: None,
                            })
                        } else {
                            output(RunJobOutput {
                                scope: CronScope::GlobalDaemon,
                                job_id: id,
                                disposition: RunDisposition::Indeterminate,
                                result: None,
                                diagnostic: Some("native cron run response identified another job; inspect history before retrying".into()),
                            })
                        }
                    }
                    ProviderMutation::Indeterminate(diagnostic) => output(RunJobOutput {
                        scope: CronScope::GlobalDaemon,
                        job_id: id,
                        disposition: RunDisposition::Indeterminate,
                        result: None,
                        diagnostic: Some(diagnostic),
                    }),
                }
            }
            _ => bail!("unsupported cron method: {method}"),
        }
    }

    async fn list_jobs(&self) -> Result<Vec<CronJobRecord>> {
        let jobs = self.gateway.list_jobs().await?;
        ensure!(
            jobs.len() <= MAX_CRON_JOBS,
            "tched_router returned more than {MAX_CRON_JOBS} cron jobs"
        );
        let mut ids = BTreeSet::new();
        for job in &jobs {
            validate_job(job)?;
            ensure!(
                ids.insert(job.id.as_str()),
                "tched_router returned duplicate cron job IDs"
            );
        }
        Ok(jobs)
    }

    async fn get_job_observed(&self, args: &serde_json::Value) -> Result<CronDispatchReceipt> {
        let input: JobIdInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
        validate_job_id(&input.job_id)?;
        let jobs = self.list_jobs().await?;
        let job = exact_job(jobs.clone(), &input.job_id)?;
        Ok(CronDispatchReceipt {
            output: output(GetJobOutput {
                scope: CronScope::GlobalDaemon,
                job,
            })?,
            state: Some(CronStateV2 {
                scope: CronScope::GlobalDaemon,
                event_stream: CronEventStreamIntegrity::default(),
                jobs,
            }),
        })
    }

    async fn delete_observed(&self, args: &serde_json::Value) -> Result<CronDispatchReceipt> {
        let input: JobIdInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
        validate_job_id(&input.job_id)?;
        if let ProviderMutation::Indeterminate(diagnostic) =
            self.gateway.delete_job(&input.job_id).await?
        {
            return Ok(CronDispatchReceipt {
                output: output(DeleteJobOutput {
                    scope: CronScope::GlobalDaemon,
                    job_id: input.job_id,
                    provider_completed: false,
                    disposition: MutationDisposition::Indeterminate,
                    absent_on_readback: None,
                    readback_error: Some(diagnostic),
                })?,
                state: None,
            });
        }
        // This exact list is both deletion evidence and the SHM candidate.
        // No second observation can disagree with the returned disposition.
        match self.list_jobs().await {
            Ok(jobs) => {
                let absent = !jobs.iter().any(|job| job.id == input.job_id);
                Ok(CronDispatchReceipt {
                    output: output(DeleteJobOutput {
                        scope: CronScope::GlobalDaemon,
                        job_id: input.job_id,
                        provider_completed: true,
                        disposition: if absent {
                            MutationDisposition::Confirmed
                        } else {
                            MutationDisposition::ProviderCompletedUnverified
                        },
                        absent_on_readback: Some(absent),
                        readback_error: (!absent).then(|| {
                            "provider reported deletion but readback retained the job".to_string()
                        }),
                    })?,
                    state: Some(CronStateV2 {
                        scope: CronScope::GlobalDaemon,
                        event_stream: CronEventStreamIntegrity::default(),
                        jobs,
                    }),
                })
            }
            Err(_) => Ok(CronDispatchReceipt {
                output: output(DeleteJobOutput {
                    scope: CronScope::GlobalDaemon,
                    job_id: input.job_id,
                    provider_completed: true,
                    disposition: MutationDisposition::ProviderCompletedUnverified,
                    absent_on_readback: None,
                    readback_error: Some(
                        "global cron readback unavailable after provider completed deletion"
                            .to_string(),
                    ),
                })?,
                state: None,
            }),
        }
    }
}

pub(crate) fn mark_publication_unverified(
    method: &str,
    output: &mut serde_json::Value,
) -> Result<()> {
    let object = output
        .as_object_mut()
        .context("cron mutation output is not an object")?;
    let message = "provider operation completed but the complete global cron state could not be observed for publication";
    match method {
        "create_job" | "update_job" | "enable_job" | "disable_job" | "delete_job" => {
            object.insert(
                "disposition".into(),
                serde_json::Value::String("provider_completed_unverified".into()),
            );
            let field = if method == "delete_job" {
                "readback_error"
            } else {
                "diagnostic"
            };
            object.insert(field.into(), serde_json::Value::String(message.into()));
        }
        "run_job" => {
            // The run result itself is complete; only state publication evidence
            // is unavailable.
            object.insert(
                "diagnostic".into(),
                serde_json::Value::String(message.into()),
            );
        }
        _ => bail!("state-readback annotation requested for non-mutation"),
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn output(value: impl serde::Serialize) -> Result<serde_json::Value> {
    let value = serde_json::to_value(value)?;
    let bytes = serde_json::to_vec(&value)?;
    ensure!(
        bytes.len() <= 8 * 1024 * 1024,
        "cron method output exceeds 8 MiB"
    );
    Ok(value)
}

fn validate_job_id(value: &str) -> Result<()> {
    validate_atom("job_id", value, 256)
}
fn validate_agent(value: &str) -> Result<()> {
    validate_atom("agent", value, 128)
}
fn validate_atom(field: &str, value: &str, max: usize) -> Result<()> {
    ensure!(
        !value.is_empty() && value.len() <= max,
        "{field} must be 1..={max} bytes"
    );
    ensure!(
        !value.chars().any(char::is_control),
        "{field} contains control characters"
    );
    Ok(())
}
fn validate_text(field: &str, value: &str, max: usize) -> Result<()> {
    ensure!(
        !value.trim().is_empty() && value.len() <= max,
        "{field} must be non-empty and at most {max} bytes"
    );
    Ok(())
}
fn validate_optional_text(field: &str, value: Option<&str>, max: usize) -> Result<()> {
    if let Some(value) = value {
        validate_text(field, value, max)?;
    }
    Ok(())
}
fn validate_delivery(delivery: Option<&CronDelivery>) -> Result<()> {
    let Some(delivery) = delivery else {
        return Ok(());
    };
    ensure!(
        delivery.mode.eq_ignore_ascii_case("none")
            || delivery.mode.eq_ignore_ascii_case("announce"),
        "delivery.mode must be none or announce"
    );
    if delivery.mode.eq_ignore_ascii_case("announce") {
        validate_optional_text("delivery.channel", delivery.channel.as_deref(), 128)?;
        validate_optional_text("delivery.to", delivery.to.as_deref(), 1024)?;
        ensure!(
            delivery.channel.is_some() && delivery.to.is_some(),
            "announce delivery requires channel and to"
        );
        validate_optional_text("delivery.thread_id", delivery.thread_id.as_deref(), 1024)?;
    }
    Ok(())
}
fn validate_tools(tools: Option<&Vec<String>>) -> Result<()> {
    let Some(tools) = tools else {
        return Ok(());
    };
    ensure!(
        tools.len() <= MAX_CRON_TOOL_NAMES,
        "allowed_tools exceeds {MAX_CRON_TOOL_NAMES} entries"
    );
    let mut unique = BTreeSet::new();
    for tool in tools {
        validate_atom("allowed_tools entry", tool, 128)?;
        ensure!(
            unique.insert(tool.as_str()),
            "allowed_tools contains duplicates"
        );
    }
    Ok(())
}
fn validate_schedule(expr: &str, tz: Option<&str>) -> Result<()> {
    validate_text("schedule", expr, 1024)?;
    validate_optional_text("tz", tz, 128)
}
fn validate_create(input: &CreateJobInput) -> Result<()> {
    match input {
        CreateJobInput::Agent {
            agent,
            name,
            schedule,
            tz,
            prompt,
            delivery,
            session_target: _,
            model,
            allowed_tools,
            delete_after_run: _,
            uses_memory: _,
        } => {
            validate_agent(agent)?;
            validate_optional_text("name", name.as_deref(), 256)?;
            validate_schedule(schedule, tz.as_deref())?;
            validate_text("prompt", prompt, MAX_CRON_TEXT_BYTES)?;
            validate_delivery(delivery.as_ref())?;
            validate_optional_text("model", model.as_deref(), 256)?;
            validate_tools(allowed_tools.as_ref())?;
        }
        CreateJobInput::Shell {
            agent,
            name,
            schedule,
            tz,
            command,
            delivery,
            shell_output_format: _,
        } => {
            validate_agent(agent)?;
            validate_optional_text("name", name.as_deref(), 256)?;
            validate_schedule(schedule, tz.as_deref())?;
            validate_text("command", command, MAX_CRON_TEXT_BYTES)?;
            validate_delivery(delivery.as_ref())?;
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}
fn schedule_matches(job: &CronJobRecord, expression: &str, timezone: Option<&str>) -> bool {
    // v0.8.4 validates a Cron { expr, tz } without expanding five-field
    // expressions or adding a seconds field. Preserve that exact expression;
    // only the API's documented timezone trim is accepted.
    job.expression == expression
        && matches!(
            &job.schedule,
            CronSchedule::Cron { expr, tz }
                if expr == expression
                    && timezone.is_none_or(|expected| tz.as_deref() == Some(expected.trim()))
        )
}

fn create_matches(input: &CreateJobInput, job: &CronJobRecord) -> bool {
    match input {
        CreateJobInput::Agent {
            agent,
            name,
            schedule,
            tz,
            prompt,
            delivery,
            session_target,
            model,
            allowed_tools,
            delete_after_run,
            uses_memory,
        } => {
            job.job_type == CronJobType::Agent
                && job.agent_alias == agent.as_str()
                && job.name.as_ref() == name.as_ref()
                && schedule_matches(job, schedule, tz.as_deref())
                && job.command.is_empty()
                && job.prompt.as_deref() == Some(prompt.as_str())
                && delivery.as_ref().is_none_or(|value| &job.delivery == value)
                && session_target
                    .as_ref()
                    .is_none_or(|value| &job.session_target == value)
                && model
                    .as_ref()
                    .is_none_or(|value| job.model.as_ref() == Some(value))
                && allowed_tools
                    .as_ref()
                    .is_none_or(|value| job.allowed_tools.as_ref() == Some(value))
                && delete_after_run.is_none_or(|value| job.delete_after_run == value)
                && uses_memory.is_none_or(|value| job.uses_memory == value)
        }
        CreateJobInput::Shell {
            agent,
            name,
            schedule,
            tz,
            command,
            delivery,
            shell_output_format,
        } => {
            job.job_type == CronJobType::Shell
                && job.agent_alias == agent.as_str()
                && job.name.as_ref() == name.as_ref()
                && schedule_matches(job, schedule, tz.as_deref())
                && job.command == command.as_str()
                && job.prompt.is_none()
                && delivery.as_ref().is_none_or(|value| &job.delivery == value)
                && shell_output_format
                    .as_ref()
                    .is_none_or(|value| &job.shell_output_format == value)
        }
    }
}

fn validate_update(input: &UpdateJobInput) -> Result<()> {
    validate_job_id(&input.job_id)?;
    if let Some(agent) = &input.agent {
        validate_agent(agent)?;
    }
    validate_optional_text("name", input.name.as_deref(), 256)?;
    if let Some(schedule) = &input.schedule {
        validate_schedule(schedule, input.tz.as_deref())?;
    } else {
        validate_optional_text("tz", input.tz.as_deref(), 128)?;
    }
    ensure!(
        !(input.clear_tz == Some(true) && input.tz.is_some()),
        "provide either tz or clear_tz=true, not both"
    );
    ensure!(
        !(input.command.is_some() && input.prompt.is_some()),
        "update cannot set command and prompt together"
    );
    validate_optional_text("command", input.command.as_deref(), MAX_CRON_TEXT_BYTES)?;
    validate_optional_text("prompt", input.prompt.as_deref(), MAX_CRON_TEXT_BYTES)?;
    ensure!(
        input.name.is_some()
            || input.schedule.is_some()
            || input.tz.is_some()
            || input.clear_tz == Some(true)
            || input.command.is_some()
            || input.prompt.is_some()
            || input.enabled.is_some()
            || input.uses_memory.is_some()
            || input.shell_output_format.is_some(),
        "update_job requires at least one change"
    );
    Ok(())
}

fn validate_update_for_job(input: &UpdateJobInput, prior: &CronJobRecord) -> Result<()> {
    if prior.job_type == CronJobType::Shell && (input.command.is_some() || input.prompt.is_some()) {
        ensure!(
            input.agent.is_some(),
            "agent is required when changing shell job content"
        );
    }
    if prior.job_type == CronJobType::Agent {
        ensure!(
            input.shell_output_format.is_none(),
            "shell_output_format is not applicable to agent jobs"
        );
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn update_matches(input: &UpdateJobInput, prior: &CronJobRecord, job: &CronJobRecord) -> bool {
    if job.id != input.job_id
        || input
            .name
            .as_ref()
            .is_some_and(|value| job.name.as_ref() != Some(value))
        || input.enabled.is_some_and(|value| job.enabled != value)
        || input
            .uses_memory
            .is_some_and(|value| job.uses_memory != value)
        || input
            .shell_output_format
            .as_ref()
            .is_some_and(|value| &job.shell_output_format != value)
    {
        return false;
    }

    if input.schedule.is_some() || input.tz.is_some() || input.clear_tz == Some(true) {
        let CronSchedule::Cron {
            expr: prior_expr,
            tz: prior_tz,
        } = &prior.schedule
        else {
            return false;
        };
        // PATCH trims a supplied expression before constructing Schedule;
        // preserving an existing expression does not rewrite it.
        let expression = input
            .schedule
            .as_deref()
            .map(str::trim)
            .unwrap_or(prior_expr);
        let timezone = if input.clear_tz == Some(true) {
            None
        } else {
            input.tz.as_deref().or(prior_tz.as_deref())
        };
        if !schedule_matches(job, expression, timezone) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    let content = input.command.as_deref().or(input.prompt.as_deref());
    match (prior.job_type.clone(), content) {
        (CronJobType::Agent, Some(expected)) => job.prompt.as_deref() == Some(expected),
        (CronJobType::Shell, Some(expected)) => job.command == expected,
        (_, None) => true,
    }
}
fn validate_job(job: &CronJobRecord) -> Result<()> {
    validate_job_id(&job.id)?;
    validate_agent(&job.agent_alias)?;
    validate_text("source", &job.source, 32)?;
    ensure!(
        job.allowed_tools
            .as_ref()
            .is_none_or(|tools| tools.len() <= MAX_CRON_TOOL_NAMES),
        "provider job allowed_tools exceeds bound"
    );
    Ok(())
}
fn exact_job(jobs: Vec<CronJobRecord>, id: &str) -> Result<CronJobRecord> {
    let mut matches = jobs.into_iter().filter(|job| job.id == id);
    let job = matches.next().context("cron job not found")?;
    ensure!(
        matches.next().is_none(),
        "tched_router returned duplicate cron job IDs"
    );
    Ok(job)
}

#[cfg(test)]
#[path = "cron_methods_tests.rs"]
mod tests;

<file path="op-grpc-bridge/src/cron_observer.rs">
//! Event-driven observation of autonomous native cron executions.
//!
//! `/api/events` is a wakeup source only. The event payload is never persisted,
//! logged, or projected. Every accepted `cron_result` causes one complete,
//! bounded `/api/cron` readback, which MutationEngine commits before notifying
//! its consumers.

use crate::{
    cron_dispatch, cron_gateway::TchedRouterCronGateway, cron_methods::CronMethods,
    mutation_engine::MutationEngine, tched_router_runtime::TchedRouterRuntimeClient,
};
use anyhow::{bail, ensure, Context, Result};
use futures::StreamExt;
use std::{future::Future, sync::Arc, time::Duration};

const MAX_SSE_FRAME_BYTES: usize = 256 * 1024;
const MAX_WAKEUPS_PER_CHUNK: usize = 1024;
const MAX_RECONNECTS: usize = 8;
const RECONNECT_DELAYS: [Duration; MAX_RECONNECTS] = [
    Duration::from_millis(250),
    Duration::from_millis(500),
    Duration::from_secs(1),
    Duration::from_secs(2),
    Duration::from_secs(4),
    Duration::from_secs(5),
    Duration::from_secs(5),
    Duration::from_secs(5),
];

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
enum Wakeup {
    CronResult,
    Gap,
}

#[derive(Default)]
struct SseDecoder {
    pending: Vec<u8>,
}

impl SseDecoder {
    fn push(&mut self, chunk: &[u8]) -> Result<Vec<Wakeup>> {
        let mut wakeups = Vec::new();
        for byte in chunk {
            self.pending.push(*byte);
            let delimiter_len = if self.pending.ends_with(b"\r\n\r\n") {
                Some(4)
            } else if self.pending.ends_with(b"\n\n") {
                Some(2)
            } else {
                None
            };
            ensure!(
                self.pending.len() <= MAX_SSE_FRAME_BYTES,
                "native event frame exceeds {MAX_SSE_FRAME_BYTES} bytes"
            );
            let Some(delimiter_len) = delimiter_len else {
                continue;
            };
            self.pending.truncate(self.pending.len() - delimiter_len);
            let frame = std::mem::take(&mut self.pending);
            if let Some(wakeup) = parse_frame(&frame)? {
                wakeups.push(wakeup);
                ensure!(
                    wakeups.len() <= MAX_WAKEUPS_PER_CHUNK,
                    "native event chunk contains more than {MAX_WAKEUPS_PER_CHUNK} state wakeups"
                );
            }
        }
        Ok(wakeups)
    }

    fn finish(self) -> Result<()> {
        ensure!(
            self.pending.iter().all(u8::is_ascii_whitespace),
            "native event stream ended with a truncated frame"
        );
        Ok(())
    }
}

fn parse_frame(frame: &[u8]) -> Result<Option<Wakeup>> {
    let frame = std::str::from_utf8(frame).context("native event frame is not UTF-8")?;
    let mut event_name = None;
    let mut data = String::new();
    for line in frame.lines() {
        let line = line.strip_suffix('\r').unwrap_or(line);
        if line.starts_with(':') || line.is_empty() {
            continue;
        }
        if let Some(value) = line.strip_prefix("event:") {
            event_name = Some(value.trim());
        } else if let Some(value) = line.strip_prefix("data:") {
            if !data.is_empty() {
                data.push('\n');
            }
            data.push_str(value.strip_prefix(' ').unwrap_or(value));
            ensure!(
                data.len() <= MAX_SSE_FRAME_BYTES,
                "native event data exceeds {MAX_SSE_FRAME_BYTES} bytes"
            );
        }
    }
    if event_name == Some("gap") {
        return Ok(Some(Wakeup::Gap));
    }
    if data.is_empty() {
