<file path="op-grpc-bridge/src/generation_admission.rs">
//! Exact pinned admission retained through a private generation worker.
//! The owner context is not reconstructed from prompt/job fields. An optional
//! facade origin carries only original schema evidence, never extra authority.
use anyhow::{Context, Result};
use op_plugins::state_plugins::tched_router::generation::GenerationOwner;
use op_state_store::PluginSchema;
use std::{
    path::{Path, PathBuf},
    sync::Arc,
};

use crate::{
    interceptor::load_capability_grants,
    method_contract_admission,
    mutation_engine::MutationEngine,
    project_dispatch,
    sealed_schema_reader::{read_manifest_pinned_catalog, ManifestPinnedSchemaDocument},
};

pub(crate) const PLUGIN: &str = "tched_router";

#[derive(Clone)]
pub(crate) struct GenerationOrigin {
    pub(crate) schema_hash: String,
    pub(crate) schema_json: String,
}
impl GenerationOrigin {
    pub(crate) fn admit(catalog: &Path, admitted: &PluginSchema) -> Result<Self> {
        let catalog = read_manifest_pinned_catalog(catalog)?;
        let pinned = catalog
            .plugins
            .get("large_language_model")
            .context("generation facade seal is absent")?;
        method_contract_admission::admit_pinned_compiled_method(
            pinned,
            "large_language_model",
            "stream_generate",
            Some("llm.invoke"),
        )?;
        anyhow::ensure!(
            serde_json::to_value(admitted)? == serde_json::to_value(&pinned.schema)?,
            "generation facade seal changed after admission"
        );
        Ok(Self {
            schema_hash: pinned.schema_hash.clone(),
            schema_json: pinned.blob.schema_json.clone(),
        })
    }
}

#[derive(Clone)]
pub(crate) struct GenerationCaller {
    pub actor: String,
    pub session: String,
    pub genesis: String,
}
impl GenerationCaller {
    pub async fn verify(
        &self,
        engine: &MutationEngine,
        capability: &str,
    ) -> Result<GenerationOwner> {
        let session = project_dispatch::verified_session(
            engine,
            &self.actor,
            Some(&self.session),
            Some(&self.genesis),
        )
        .await?;
        anyhow::ensure!(session == self.session, "generation session changed");
        anyhow::ensure!(
            load_capability_grants(&self.actor).contains(capability),
            "current exact generation capability grant is required"
        );
        GenerationOwner::new(self.actor.clone(), session)
    }
}

#[derive(Clone)]
pub(crate) struct GenerationPins {
    pub catalog: PathBuf,
    pub catalog_hash: String,
    pub document: Arc<ManifestPinnedSchemaDocument>,
    pub origin: Option<GenerationOrigin>,
}
impl GenerationPins {
    pub fn load(
        catalog: &Path,
        admitted: Option<&PluginSchema>,
        method: &str,
        capability: &str,
        origin: Option<GenerationOrigin>,
    ) -> Result<Self> {
        let mut catalog_value = read_manifest_pinned_catalog(catalog)?;
        let document = Arc::new(
            catalog_value
                .plugins
                .remove(PLUGIN)
                .context("generation owner plugin seal is absent")?,
        );
        method_contract_admission::admit_compiled_state_contract(&document, PLUGIN)?;
        method_contract_admission::admit_pinned_compiled_method(
            &document,
            PLUGIN,
            method,
            Some(capability),
        )?;
        if let Some(admitted) = admitted {
            anyhow::ensure!(
                serde_json::to_value(admitted)? == serde_json::to_value(&document.schema)?,
                "generation owner seal changed after admission"
            );
        }
        let pins = Self {
            catalog: catalog.to_owned(),
            catalog_hash: catalog_value.catalog_hash,
            document,
            origin,
        };
        pins.check_catalog(method, capability)?;
        Ok(pins)
    }

    pub fn check_catalog(&self, method: &str, capability: &str) -> Result<String> {
        let current = read_manifest_pinned_catalog(&self.catalog)?;
        anyhow::ensure!(
            current.catalog_hash == self.catalog_hash,
            "generation catalog changed; explicit recovery required"
        );
        let document = current
            .plugins
            .get(PLUGIN)
            .context("generation owner plugin seal was withdrawn")?;
        anyhow::ensure!(
            document.schema_hash == self.document.schema_hash
                && document.blob.schema_json == self.document.blob.schema_json,
            "generation owner seal changed; explicit recovery required"
        );
        method_contract_admission::admit_compiled_state_contract(document, PLUGIN)?;
        method_contract_admission::admit_pinned_compiled_method(
            document,
            PLUGIN,
            method,
            Some(capability),
        )?;
        if let Some(origin) = &self.origin {
            let facade = current
                .plugins
                .get("large_language_model")
                .context("generation facade seal was withdrawn")?;
            anyhow::ensure!(
                facade.schema_hash == origin.schema_hash
                    && facade.blob.schema_json == origin.schema_json,
                "generation facade seal changed"
            );
            method_contract_admission::admit_pinned_compiled_method(
                facade,
                "large_language_model",
                "stream_generate",
                Some("llm.invoke"),
            )?;
        }
        Ok(current.catalog_hash)
    }

    /// Call immediately before native input or private publication, with the
    /// same actor/session. Inside the private transaction the only projection
    /// read permitted is the DISTINCT canonical identity namespace; generation
    /// state must never be read recursively. Identity writers never wait on
    /// generation workers while retaining an identity lock.
    pub async fn check(
        &self,
        engine: &MutationEngine,
        caller: &GenerationCaller,
        method: &str,
        capability: &str,
    ) -> Result<GenerationOwner> {
        let owner = caller.verify(engine, capability).await?;
        if self.origin.is_some() {
            anyhow::ensure!(
                load_capability_grants(&caller.actor).contains("llm.invoke"),
                "generation facade grant was withdrawn"
            );
        }
        self.check_catalog(method, capability)?;
        Ok(owner)
    }
}
</file>

<file path="op-grpc-bridge/src/generation_jobs_dispatch.rs">
//! MutationEngine-owned private generation publication. The only value source
//! exposed to readers is the complete committed owner SHM document. Native
//! chunks are inputs to durable transitions, never an alternate stream/cache.
use crate::{
    generation_admission::{GenerationCaller, GenerationOrigin, GenerationPins, PLUGIN},
    mutation_engine::MutationEngine,
    tched_router_generation_native::{
        NativeErrorCode, NativeGenerationAdmission, NativeGenerationError, NativeGenerationEvent,
        NativeGenerationTask, NativeGenerationTerminal,
    },
};
use anyhow::{Context, Result};
use futures::future::BoxFuture;
use op_core::projection_shm::{
    PrivateDocumentCommit, PrivateDocumentPublication, PrivateProjectionDirectory,
};
use op_plugins::state_plugins::{runtime_documents::RuntimeDocuments, tched_router::generation::*};
use op_state_store::PluginSchema;
use serde_json::Value;
use std::{
    collections::HashMap,
    path::PathBuf,
    sync::{
        atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering},
        Arc, Mutex as StdMutex,
    },
};
use tokio::sync::{broadcast, watch, Mutex};

const MAX_OWNERS: usize = 256;
const MAX_OWNER_CALLS: usize = 32;
#[cfg(test)]
#[path = "generation_jobs_tests.rs"]
mod tests;
pub(crate) fn is_generation_method(method: &str) -> bool {
    op_plugins::state_plugins::tched_router::generation::is_method(method)
}

/// Production implements this over the existing configured native router
/// client. Fixtures inject the same native WS transport at a temporary server.
pub(crate) trait GenerationBackend: Send + Sync {
    fn spawn(
        &self,
        input: StartGenerationInput,
        native_session: String,
        gate: Arc<dyn NativeGenerationAdmission>,
    ) -> Result<NativeGenerationTask>;
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, serde::Serialize, serde::Deserialize)]
pub(crate) struct GenerationWake {
    pub generation: u64,
    pub document_revision: Option<u64>,
}
struct OwnerSlot {
    operation: Arc<Mutex<()>>,
    calls: Arc<tokio::sync::Semaphore>,
    activated: AtomicBool,
    wakes: broadcast::Sender<GenerationWake>,
    workers: StdMutex<HashMap<String, watch::Sender<bool>>>,
    worker_finished: tokio::sync::Notify,
}
struct WorkerRegistration {
    slot: Arc<OwnerSlot>,
    id: String,
}
impl Drop for WorkerRegistration {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        if let Ok(mut workers) = self.slot.workers.lock() {
            workers.remove(&self.id);
        }
        self.slot.worker_finished.notify_waiters();
    }
}
impl OwnerSlot {
    fn new() -> Self {
        let (wakes, _) = broadcast::channel(32);
        Self {
            operation: Arc::new(Mutex::new(())),
            calls: Arc::new(tokio::sync::Semaphore::new(MAX_OWNER_CALLS)),
            activated: AtomicBool::new(false),
            wakes,
            workers: StdMutex::new(HashMap::new()),
            worker_finished: tokio::sync::Notify::new(),
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Clone)]
pub(crate) struct GenerationPublisher {
    root: PrivateProjectionDirectory,
    methods: GenerationMethods,
    catalog: PathBuf,
    backend: Arc<dyn GenerationBackend>,
    owners: Arc<StdMutex<HashMap<String, Arc<OwnerSlot>>>>,
}

#[derive(Clone)]
enum Action {
    Recover,
    Create {
        input: StartGenerationInput,
        id: String,
    },
    Running(String),
    Append {
        id: String,
        fragments: Vec<String>,
    },
    Complete {
        id: String,
        output: String,
        provider: Option<String>,
        model: Option<String>,
    },
    Cancel {
        id: String,
        revision: u64,
    },
    Finish {
        id: String,
        status: GenerationStatus,
        reason: Option<GenerationFailure>,
    },
    Delete {
        id: String,
        revision: u64,
    },
}
impl Action {
    async fn apply(
        self,
        methods: &GenerationMethods,
        owner: &GenerationOwner,
        hash: &str,
    ) -> Result<Option<GenerationState>> {
        let state = match self {
            Self::Recover => return methods.recover(owner).await,
            Self::Create { input, id } => methods.create(owner, &input, &id, hash).await?,
            Self::Running(id) => methods.running(owner, &id).await?,
            Self::Append { id, fragments } => methods.append_batch(owner, &id, fragments).await?,
            Self::Complete {
                id,
                output,
                provider,
                model,
            } => {
                methods
                    .complete(owner, &id, output, provider, model)
                    .await?
            }
            Self::Cancel { id, revision } => methods.request_cancel(owner, &id, revision).await?,
            Self::Finish { id, status, reason } => {
                methods.finish(owner, &id, status, reason).await?
            }
            Self::Delete { id, revision } => methods.delete(owner, &id, revision).await?,
        };
        Ok(Some(state))
    }
}

#[derive(Clone)]
pub(crate) struct CommittedGeneration {
    pub generation: u64,
    pub schema_hash: String,
    pub schema_json: String,
    pub catalog_hash: String,
    pub state: Option<GenerationState>,
}
impl CommittedGeneration {
    pub fn plugin_state(&self) -> Result<Option<Value>> {
        self.state
            .as_ref()
            .map(GenerationState::plugin_state)
            .transpose()
    }
}
pub(crate) struct GenerationSubscription {
    caller: GenerationCaller,
    owner: GenerationOwner,
    pins: GenerationPins,
    slot: Arc<OwnerSlot>,
    pub receiver: broadcast::Receiver<GenerationWake>,
    pub initial: CommittedGeneration,
}

fn validate_state(pins: &GenerationPins, state: &GenerationState) -> Result<Vec<u8>> {
    let value = state.plugin_state()?;
    GenerationState::from_plugin_state(&value)?;
    let owned = simd_json::serde::to_owned_value(value)?;
    let validation = pins.document.schema.validate(&owned);
    anyhow::ensure!(
        validation.valid && validation.warnings.is_empty(),
        "generation projection does not match its pinned state contract"
    );
    pins.document
        .schema
        .validate_exact_schema_fields(&owned)
        .map_err(|_| anyhow::anyhow!("generation child contract failed"))?;
    Ok(simd_json::to_vec(&owned)?)
}
fn decode_state(bytes: &[u8], pins: &GenerationPins) -> Result<GenerationState> {
    let value: Value = serde_json::from_slice(bytes)
        .map_err(|_| anyhow::anyhow!("invalid committed generation JSON"))?;
    let state = GenerationState::from_plugin_state(&value)?;
    validate_state(pins, &state)?;
    Ok(state)
}

impl GenerationPublisher {
    pub(crate) fn new(
        root: PrivateProjectionDirectory,
        documents: Arc<RuntimeDocuments>,
        catalog: PathBuf,
        backend: Arc<dyn GenerationBackend>,
    ) -> Self {
        Self {
            root,
            methods: GenerationMethods::new(documents),
            catalog,
            backend,
            owners: Arc::new(StdMutex::new(HashMap::new())),
        }
    }
    fn slot(&self, owner: &GenerationOwner) -> Result<Arc<OwnerSlot>> {
        let mut slots = self
            .owners
            .lock()
            .map_err(|_| anyhow::anyhow!("generation owner table unavailable"))?;
        if let Some(slot) = slots.get(owner.selector()) {
            return Ok(slot.clone());
        }
        anyhow::ensure!(
            slots.len() < MAX_OWNERS,
            "generation live owner capacity reached"
        );
        let slot = Arc::new(OwnerSlot::new());
        slots.insert(owner.selector().into(), slot.clone());
        Ok(slot)
    }

    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    pub(crate) async fn dispatch(
        &self,
        engine: &MutationEngine,
        admitted: &PluginSchema,
        method: &str,
        args: &Value,
        actor: &str,
        session: Option<&str>,
        genesis: Option<&str>,
        origin: Option<GenerationOrigin>,
    ) -> Result<Value> {
        anyhow::ensure!(is_generation_method(method), "unknown generation method");
        let caller = GenerationCaller {
            actor: actor.into(),
            session: session
                .context("generation requires verified session")?
                .into(),
            genesis: genesis
                .context("generation requires verified genesis")?
                .into(),
        };
        let capability = admitted
            .methods
            .get(method)
            .and_then(|m| m.required_capability.as_ref())
            .context("generation capability is absent")?
            .clone();
        let owner = caller.verify(engine, &capability).await?;
        let pins =
            GenerationPins::load(&self.catalog, Some(admitted), method, &capability, origin)?;
        let slot = self.slot(&owner)?;
        let permit = slot
            .calls
            .clone()
            .try_acquire_owned()
            .map_err(|_| anyhow::anyhow!("generation owner call queue is full"))?;
        let publisher = self.clone();
        let engine = engine.clone();
        let method = method.to_owned();
        let args = args.clone();
        tokio::spawn(async move {
            let _permit = permit;
            let _guard = slot.operation.clone().lock_owned().await;
            pins.check(&engine, &caller, &method, &capability).await?;
            publisher
                .dispatch_locked(
                    &engine,
                    &caller,
                    &owner,
                    &pins,
                    &slot,
                    &method,
                    &capability,
                    args,
                )
                .await
        })
        .await
        .map_err(|_| anyhow::anyhow!("generation dispatch owner failed"))?
    }

    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    async fn dispatch_locked(
        &self,
        engine: &MutationEngine,
        caller: &GenerationCaller,
        owner: &GenerationOwner,
        pins: &GenerationPins,
        slot: &Arc<OwnerSlot>,
        method: &str,
        capability: &str,
        args: Value,
    ) -> Result<Value> {
        if method == "recover_generation_jobs" {
            let _: GenerationEmptyInput = serde_json::from_value(args)
                .map_err(|_| anyhow::anyhow!("invalid generation recovery input"))?;
            anyhow::ensure!(
                slot.workers
                    .lock()
                    .map_err(|_| anyhow::anyhow!("generation workers unavailable"))?
                    .is_empty(),
                "cancel active generation workers before recovery"
            );
            let receipt = self
                .commit_locked(
                    engine,
                    caller,
                    owner,
                    pins,
                    slot,
                    method,
                    capability,
                    Action::Recover,
                    false,
                )
                .await?;
            return Ok(serde_json::to_value(GenerationWorkspaceOutput {
                state: receipt.state,
            })?);
        }
        anyhow::ensure!(
            slot.activated.load(Ordering::Acquire),
            "explicit generation recovery is required"
        );
        let current = self.read_locked(owner, pins)?;
        pins.check(engine, caller, method, capability).await?;
        match method {
            "get_generation_jobs" => {
                let _: GenerationEmptyInput = serde_json::from_value(args)
                    .map_err(|_| anyhow::anyhow!("invalid generation read input"))?;
                Ok(serde_json::to_value(GenerationWorkspaceOutput {
                    state: current.state,
                })?)
            }
            "get_generation_job" => {
                let input: GenerationJobInput = serde_json::from_value(args)
                    .map_err(|_| anyhow::anyhow!("invalid generation job input"))?;
                validate_id(&input.job_id)?;
                let revision = current.state.as_ref().map_or(0, |s| s.generation_revision);
                let job = current
                    .state
                    .and_then(|mut state| state.generation_jobs.remove(&input.job_id));
                Ok(serde_json::to_value(GenerationJobOutput {
                    document_revision: revision,
                    job,
                })?)
            }
            "start_generation" => {
                let input: StartGenerationInput = serde_json::from_value(args)
                    .map_err(|_| anyhow::anyhow!("invalid generation start input"))?;
                input.validate()?;
                if let Some(state) = &current.state {
                    anyhow::ensure!(
                        state.generation_jobs.len() < MAX_JOBS
                            && state
                                .generation_jobs
                                .values()
                                .filter(|j| !j.status.terminal())
                                .count()
                                < MAX_ACTIVE_JOBS,
                        "generation job capacity reached"
                    );
                }
                pins.check(engine, caller, method, capability).await?;
                let id = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();
                let receipt = self
                    .commit_locked(
                        engine,
                        caller,
                        owner,
                        pins,
                        slot,
                        method,
                        capability,
                        Action::Create {
                            input: input.clone(),
                            id: id.clone(),
                        },
                        false,
                    )
                    .await?;
                let output = mutation_output(&receipt, &id)?;
                let (cancel, cancel_rx) = watch::channel(false);
                slot.workers
                    .lock()
                    .map_err(|_| anyhow::anyhow!("generation workers unavailable"))?
                    .insert(id.clone(), cancel);
                self.spawn_worker(
                    engine.clone(),
                    caller.clone(),
                    owner.clone(),
                    pins.clone(),
                    slot.clone(),
                    input,
                    id,
                    cancel_rx,
                );
                Ok(output)
            }
            "cancel_generation" | "delete_generation_job" => {
                let input: GenerationRevisionInput = serde_json::from_value(args)
                    .map_err(|_| anyhow::anyhow!("invalid generation revision input"))?;
                validate_id(&input.job_id)?;
                let job = current
                    .state
                    .as_ref()
                    .and_then(|state| state.generation_jobs.get(&input.job_id))
                    .context("generation job is absent")?;
                anyhow::ensure!(
                    input.expected_revision > 0 && job.revision == input.expected_revision,
                    "generation job revision conflict"
                );
                if method == "cancel_generation" {
                    anyhow::ensure!(!job.status.terminal(), "generation job is already terminal");
                    anyhow::ensure!(
                        slot.workers
                            .lock()
                            .map_err(|_| anyhow::anyhow!("generation workers unavailable"))?
                            .contains_key(&input.job_id),
                        "generation worker is absent; explicit recovery is required"
                    );
                    let receipt = self
                        .commit_locked(
                            engine,
                            caller,
                            owner,
                            pins,
                            slot,
                            method,
                            capability,
                            Action::Cancel {
                                id: input.job_id.clone(),
                                revision: input.expected_revision,
                            },
                            false,
                        )
                        .await?;
                    if let Some(cancel) = slot
                        .workers
                        .lock()
                        .map_err(|_| anyhow::anyhow!("generation workers unavailable"))?
                        .get(&input.job_id)
                    {
                        let _ = cancel.send(true);
                    }
                    mutation_output(&receipt, &input.job_id)
                } else {
                    anyhow::ensure!(
                        job.status.terminal(),
                        "active generation job cannot be deleted"
                    );
                    let receipt = self
                        .commit_locked(
                            engine,
                            caller,
                            owner,
                            pins,
                            slot,
                            method,
                            capability,
                            Action::Delete {
                                id: input.job_id.clone(),
                                revision: input.expected_revision,
                            },
                            false,
                        )
                        .await?;
                    Ok(serde_json::to_value(GenerationDeleteOutput {
                        document_revision: receipt
                            .state
                            .context("generation deletion receipt missing")?
                            .generation_revision,
                        job_id: input.job_id,
                        deleted_revision: input.expected_revision,
                    })?)
                }
            }
            _ => anyhow::bail!("unknown generation method"),
        }
    }

    fn read_locked(
        &self,
        owner: &GenerationOwner,
        pins: &GenerationPins,
    ) -> Result<CommittedGeneration> {
        let directory = self
            .root
            .open_child(owner.selector())?
            .context("generation activation is incomplete")?;
        anyhow::ensure!(
            directory.pending_document()?.is_none(),
            "generation publication awaits explicit recovery"
        );
        let snapshot = directory.read_snapshot(&[PLUGIN.into()])?;
        let state = snapshot
            .states
            .get(PLUGIN)
            .map(|bytes| decode_state(bytes, pins))
            .transpose()?;
        let catalog_hash = pins.check_catalog("get_generation_jobs", READ_CAPABILITY)?;
        Ok(CommittedGeneration {
            generation: snapshot.generation,
            schema_hash: pins.document.schema_hash.clone(),
            schema_json: pins.document.blob.schema_json.clone(),
            catalog_hash,
            state,
        })
    }

    /// Caller owns slot.operation for the entire commit -> activation -> wake
    /// sequence. The outer task is owned, so dropping a client cannot strand a
    /// successful durable effect before publication/notification.
    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    async fn commit_locked(
        &self,
        engine: &MutationEngine,
        caller: &GenerationCaller,
        owner: &GenerationOwner,
        pins: &GenerationPins,
        slot: &OwnerSlot,
        method: &str,
        capability: &str,
        action: Action,
        withdrawn: bool,
    ) -> Result<CommittedGeneration> {
        let root = self.root.clone();
        let methods = self.methods.clone();
        let owner = owner.clone();
        let pins = pins.clone();
        let engine = engine.clone();
        let caller = caller.clone();
        let method = method.to_owned();
        let capability = capability.to_owned();
        let runtime = tokio::runtime::Handle::current();
        let operation = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();
        let recovery = matches!(action, Action::Recover);
        let receipt_pins = pins.clone();
        let result=tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || -> Result<_> {
            let directory=root.prepare_child(owner.selector())?;
            // One-way order: generation owner/file lock -> canonical identity
            // read lock. Identity writers do not acquire generation locks or
            // join workers; the same-namespace recursive read is forbidden.
            directory.ensure_distinct_from(std::path::Path::new(&op_core::projection_shm::shm_state_dir()))?;
            let apply=|previous:Option<&[u8]>|->Result<PrivateDocumentCommit<Option<GenerationState>>> {
                if !withdrawn {runtime.block_on(pins.check(&engine,&caller,&method,&capability))?;}
                let state=runtime.block_on(action.apply(&methods,&owner,&pins.document.schema_hash))?;
                let prepared=(||->Result<Option<Vec<u8>>> {
                    anyhow::ensure!(!withdrawn,"generation admission was withdrawn");
                    runtime.block_on(pins.check(&engine,&caller,&method,&capability))?;
                    let bytes=state.as_ref().map(|state|validate_state(&pins,state)).transpose()?;
                    if let (Some(previous),Some(state))=(previous,state.as_ref()) {
                        let previous=decode_state(previous,&pins)?;
                        anyhow::ensure!(state.generation_revision>=previous.generation_revision,"generation durable revision regressed");
                        anyhow::ensure!(state.generation_revision!=previous.generation_revision || state==&previous,"generation values changed without a revision");
                    }
                    Ok(bytes)
                })();
                Ok(match prepared {Ok(current)=>PrivateDocumentCommit::Publish{current,durable:state},Err(_)=>PrivateDocumentCommit::RetainPending{durable:state,error:anyhow::anyhow!("generation post-durable admission or projection validation failed")}})
            };
            if recovery {
                if let Some(pending)=directory.pending_document()? {
                    anyhow::ensure!(pending.plugin_id==PLUGIN,"generation pending owner mismatch");
                    return directory.recover_document_with_decision(PLUGIN,&pending.operation_id,||apply(None));
                }
            }
            directory.commit_document_durable_with_decision(PLUGIN,&operation,apply)
        }).await.map_err(|_|anyhow::anyhow!("generation publication worker failed"));
        let result = match result {
            Ok(Ok(result)) => result,
            _ => {
                slot.activated.store(false, Ordering::Release);
                anyhow::bail!("generation publication failed; explicit recovery is required");
            }
        };
        match result {
            PrivateDocumentPublication::Committed {
                projection,
                durable,
            } => {
                slot.activated.store(true, Ordering::Release);
                let receipt = CommittedGeneration {
                    generation: projection.generation,
                    schema_hash: receipt_pins.document.schema_hash.clone(),
                    schema_json: receipt_pins.document.blob.schema_json.clone(),
                    catalog_hash: receipt_pins.catalog_hash.clone(),
                    state: durable,
                };
                if projection.previous != projection.current {
                    let _ = slot.wakes.send(GenerationWake {
                        generation: receipt.generation,
                        document_revision: receipt.state.as_ref().map(|s| s.generation_revision),
                    });
                }
                Ok(receipt)
            }
            PrivateDocumentPublication::Pending {
                operation_id,
                durable,
                ..
            } => {
                slot.activated.store(false, Ordering::Release);
                let revision = durable.flatten().map(|state| state.generation_revision);
                anyhow::bail!("generation_publication_pending operation_id={operation_id} document_revision={revision:?}")
            }
        }
    }
}

fn mutation_output(receipt: &CommittedGeneration, id: &str) -> Result<Value> {
    let state = receipt
        .state
        .as_ref()
        .context("generation mutation receipt missing")?;
    let job = state
        .generation_jobs
        .get(id)
        .context("generation job receipt missing")?
        .clone();
    Ok(serde_json::to_value(GenerationMutationOutput {
        document_revision: state.generation_revision,
        job,
    })?)
}

/// Collect only fragments already available now. No await, timer or fill wait.
/// At most one non-fitting fragment is retained ahead of the native queue; it
/// must be processed before any later fragment or the terminal result. A valid
/// prefix commits before an over-limit successor is rejected on the next turn.
fn ready_fragment_batch(
    current: &GenerationState,
    id: &str,
    first: String,
    carry: &mut Option<String>,
    mut next_ready: impl FnMut() -> Option<String>,
) -> Result<Vec<String>> {
    anyhow::ensure!(carry.is_none(), "generation fragment carry is occupied");
    current.preflight_append(id, &first)?;
    let mut fragments = vec![first];
    // Count dequeue attempts as well as nonempty fragments, so an empty-frame
    // burst cannot turn this synchronous section into an unbounded loop.
    for _ in 1..MAX_BATCH_FRAGMENTS {
        let Some(fragment) = next_ready() else { break };
        if fragment.is_empty() {
            continue;
        }
        fragments.push(fragment);
        if current.preflight_append_batch(id, &fragments).is_err() {
            *carry = fragments.pop();
            break;
        }
    }
    Ok(fragments)
}

struct PromptAdmission {
    publisher: GenerationPublisher,
    engine: MutationEngine,
    caller: GenerationCaller,
    pins: GenerationPins,
    slot: Arc<OwnerSlot>,
    owner: GenerationOwner,
    job_id: String,
}
impl NativeGenerationAdmission for PromptAdmission {
    fn check(&self) -> BoxFuture<'_, std::result::Result<(), NativeGenerationError>> {
        Box::pin(async move {
            let _guard = self.slot.operation.lock().await;
            let admitted = async {
                self.pins
                    .check(
                        &self.engine,
                        &self.caller,
                        "start_generation",
                        START_CAPABILITY,
                    )
                    .await?;
                anyhow::ensure!(
                    self.slot.activated.load(Ordering::Acquire),
                    "generation is unavailable"
                );
                let state = self
                    .publisher
                    .read_locked(&self.owner, &self.pins)?
                    .state
                    .context("generation document absent")?;
                anyhow::ensure!(
                    state
                        .generation_jobs
                        .get(&self.job_id)
                        .is_some_and(|job| job.status == GenerationStatus::Running),
                    "generation was cancelled before prompt"
                );
                self.pins
                    .check(
                        &self.engine,
                        &self.caller,
                        "start_generation",
                        START_CAPABILITY,
                    )
                    .await?;
                Ok::<_, anyhow::Error>(())
            }
            .await;
            admitted.map_err(|_| NativeGenerationError::Terminal(NativeErrorCode::Auth))
        })
    }
}

impl GenerationPublisher {
    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    fn spawn_worker(
        &self,
        engine: MutationEngine,
        caller: GenerationCaller,
        owner: GenerationOwner,
        pins: GenerationPins,
        slot: Arc<OwnerSlot>,
        input: StartGenerationInput,
        id: String,
        cancel: watch::Receiver<bool>,
    ) {
        let publisher = self.clone();
        tokio::spawn(async move {
            let _registration = WorkerRegistration {
                slot: slot.clone(),
                id: id.clone(),
            };
            let result = publisher
                .run_worker(&engine, &caller, &owner, &pins, &slot, input, &id, cancel)
                .await;
            // Safe metadata only: no prompt/output, native diagnostic, owner ID
            // or credentials. Publication failures retain their pending gate.
            if result.is_err() {
                tracing::warn!(plugin=PLUGIN,method="start_generation",job_id=%id,"generation worker stopped; committed state or explicit recovery determines outcome");
            }
        });
    }

    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    async fn run_worker(
        &self,
        engine: &MutationEngine,
        caller: &GenerationCaller,
        owner: &GenerationOwner,
        pins: &GenerationPins,
        slot: &Arc<OwnerSlot>,
        input: StartGenerationInput,
        id: &str,
        mut cancel: watch::Receiver<bool>,
    ) -> Result<()> {
        let mut changes = engine.change_tx().subscribe();
        {
            let _guard = slot.operation.lock().await;
            if *cancel.borrow() {
                self.commit_locked(
                    engine,
                    caller,
                    owner,
                    pins,
                    slot,
                    "start_generation",
                    START_CAPABILITY,
                    Action::Finish {
                        id: id.into(),
                        status: GenerationStatus::Cancelled,
                        reason: None,
                    },
                    false,
                )
                .await?;
                return Ok(());
            }
            if pins
                .check(engine, caller, "start_generation", START_CAPABILITY)
                .await
                .is_err()
            {
                return self
                    .withdraw_locked(engine, caller, owner, pins, slot, id)
                    .await;
            }
            self.commit_locked(
                engine,
                caller,
                owner,
                pins,
                slot,
                "start_generation",
                START_CAPABILITY,
                Action::Running(id.into()),
                false,
            )
            .await?;
        }
        let gate = Arc::new(PromptAdmission {
            publisher: self.clone(),
            engine: engine.clone(),
            caller: caller.clone(),
            pins: pins.clone(),
            slot: slot.clone(),
            owner: owner.clone(),
            job_id: id.into(),
        });
        // Never accept a caller-supplied native session or reuse a conversation.
        let native_session = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();
        let mut native = match self.backend.spawn(input, native_session, gate) {
            Ok(native) => native,
            Err(_) => {
                let _guard = slot.operation.lock().await;
                self.commit_locked(
                    engine,
                    caller,
                    owner,
                    pins,
                    slot,
                    "start_generation",
                    START_CAPABILITY,
                    Action::Finish {
                        id: id.into(),
                        status: GenerationStatus::Failed,
                        reason: Some(GenerationFailure::NativeError),
                    },
                    false,
                )
                .await?;
                return Ok(());
            }
        };
        let mut carry = None;
        loop {
            enum Wake {
                Chunk(Option<NativeGenerationEvent>),
                Cancel,
                Revalidate,
            }
            let wake = if let Some(delta) = carry.take() {
                Wake::Chunk(Some(NativeGenerationEvent::TextDelta { delta }))
            } else {
                tokio::select! {
                    event=native.recv_event()=>Wake::Chunk(event),
                    changed=cancel.changed()=>{let _=changed; Wake::Cancel},
                    change=changes.recv()=>match change {
                        Ok(change) if change.plugin_id=="identity_sled" || change.plugin_id=="human_principal" || change.change_type==crate::mutation_engine::ChangeType::SchemaMigration=>Wake::Revalidate,
                        Err(broadcast::error::RecvError::Lagged(_))=>Wake::Revalidate,
                        _=>continue,
                    },
                }
            };
            let _guard = slot.operation.lock().await;
            if pins
                .check(engine, caller, "start_generation", START_CAPABILITY)
                .await
                .is_err()
            {
                native.cancel();
                drop(native);
                return self
                    .withdraw_locked(engine, caller, owner, pins, slot, id)
                    .await;
            }
            if !slot.activated.load(Ordering::Acquire) {
                native.cancel();
                anyhow::bail!("generation publication is pending");
            }
            match wake {
                Wake::Cancel => {
                    native.cancel();
                    self.commit_locked(
                        engine,
                        caller,
                        owner,
                        pins,
                        slot,
                        "start_generation",
                        START_CAPABILITY,
                        Action::Finish {
                            id: id.into(),
                            status: GenerationStatus::Cancelled,
                            reason: None,
                        },
                        false,
                    )
                    .await?;
                    // Cancelled describes the local job term. It does not
                    // claim provider rollback or a nonexistent native task ID.
                    return Ok(());
                }
                Wake::Revalidate => {}
                Wake::Chunk(Some(NativeGenerationEvent::TextDelta { delta })) => {
                    if *cancel.borrow() {
                        continue;
                    }
                    if delta.is_empty() {
                        continue;
                    }
                    let current = self
                        .read_locked(owner, pins)?
                        .state
                        .context("generation state absent")?;
                    let job = current
                        .generation_jobs
                        .get(id)
                        .context("generation job absent")?;
                    if job.status == GenerationStatus::CancelRequested {
                        continue;
                    }
                    let fragments = ready_fragment_batch(&current, id, delta, &mut carry, || {
                        match native.try_recv_event() {
                            Ok(NativeGenerationEvent::TextDelta { delta }) => Some(delta),
                            Err(
                                tokio::sync::mpsc::error::TryRecvError::Empty
                                | tokio::sync::mpsc::error::TryRecvError::Disconnected,
                            ) => None,
                        }
                    });
                    let fragments = match fragments {
                        Ok(fragments) => fragments,
                        Err(_) => {
                            native.cancel();
                            self.commit_locked(
                                engine,
                                caller,
                                owner,
                                pins,
                                slot,
                                "start_generation",
                                START_CAPABILITY,
                                Action::Finish {
                                    id: id.into(),
                                    status: GenerationStatus::Failed,
                                    reason: Some(GenerationFailure::OutputLimit),
                                },
                                false,
                            )
                            .await?;
                            return Ok(());
                        }
                    };
                    self.commit_locked(
                        engine,
                        caller,
                        owner,
                        pins,
                        slot,
                        "start_generation",
                        START_CAPABILITY,
                        Action::Append {
                            id: id.into(),
                            fragments,
                        },
                        false,
                    )
                    .await?;
                }
                Wake::Chunk(None) => {
                    // The adapter closes its event sender only after its
                    // terminal result; all preceding chunks are committed.
                    let terminal = native.wait().await;
                    let action = if *cancel.borrow() {
                        Action::Finish {
                            id: id.into(),
                            status: GenerationStatus::Cancelled,
                            reason: None,
                        }
                    } else {
                        match terminal {
                            Ok(NativeGenerationTerminal::Done(done)) => Action::Complete {
                                id: id.into(),
                                output: done.full_response,
                                provider: done.provider,
                                model: done.model,
                            },
                            Ok(NativeGenerationTerminal::Cancelled) => Action::Finish {
                                id: id.into(),
                                status: GenerationStatus::Failed,
                                reason: Some(GenerationFailure::NativeAborted),
                            },
                            Err(NativeGenerationError::Terminal(code)) => Action::Finish {
                                id: id.into(),
                                status: GenerationStatus::Failed,
                                reason: Some(native_failure(code)),
                            },
                            Err(NativeGenerationError::Timeout) => Action::Finish {
                                id: id.into(),
                                status: GenerationStatus::Failed,
                                reason: Some(GenerationFailure::Deadline),
                            },
                            Err(NativeGenerationError::Cancelled) => Action::Finish {
                                id: id.into(),
                                status: GenerationStatus::Failed,
                                reason: Some(GenerationFailure::NativeAborted),
                            },
                            Err(_) => Action::Finish {
                                id: id.into(),
                                status: GenerationStatus::Failed,
                                reason: Some(GenerationFailure::NativeDisconnected),
                            },
                        }
                    };
                    self.commit_locked(
                        engine,
                        caller,
                        owner,
                        pins,
                        slot,
                        "start_generation",
                        START_CAPABILITY,
                        action,
                        false,
                    )
                    .await?;
                    return Ok(());
                }
            }
        }
    }

    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    async fn withdraw_locked(
        &self,
        engine: &MutationEngine,
        caller: &GenerationCaller,
        owner: &GenerationOwner,
        pins: &GenerationPins,
        slot: &OwnerSlot,
        id: &str,
    ) -> Result<()> {
        // No new native action is authorized here. Finish the accepted worker's
        // durable term under the pending gate, deliberately withhold SHM and
        // wakes, and require current authenticated recovery before future reads.
        self.commit_locked(
            engine,
            caller,
            owner,
            pins,
            slot,
            "start_generation",
            START_CAPABILITY,
            Action::Finish {
                id: id.into(),
                status: GenerationStatus::Interrupted,
                reason: Some(GenerationFailure::AdmissionWithdrawn),
            },
            true,
        )
        .await?;
        anyhow::bail!("generation admission withdrawn")
    }

    pub(crate) async fn subscribe_jobs(
        &self,
        engine: &MutationEngine,
        caller: GenerationCaller,
        declared: &str,
    ) -> Result<GenerationSubscription> {
        anyhow::ensure!(
            declared == READ_CAPABILITY,
            "exact private generation read capability declaration is required"
        );
        let owner = caller.verify(engine, READ_CAPABILITY).await?;
        let pins = GenerationPins::load(
            &self.catalog,
            None,
            "get_generation_jobs",
            READ_CAPABILITY,
            None,
        )?;
        let slot = self.slot(&owner)?;
        let receiver = slot.wakes.subscribe();
        let _guard = slot.operation.lock().await;
        pins.check(engine, &caller, "get_generation_jobs", READ_CAPABILITY)
            .await?;
        anyhow::ensure!(
            slot.activated.load(Ordering::Acquire),
            "explicit generation recovery is required"
        );
        let initial = self.read_locked(&owner, &pins)?;
        pins.check(engine, &caller, "get_generation_jobs", READ_CAPABILITY)
            .await?;
        drop(_guard);
        Ok(GenerationSubscription {
            caller,
            owner,
            pins,
            slot,
            receiver,
            initial,
        })
    }
    pub(crate) async fn revalidate_subscription(
        &self,
        engine: &MutationEngine,
        ticket: &GenerationSubscription,
    ) -> Result<()> {
        let _guard = ticket.slot.operation.lock().await;
        ticket
            .pins
            .check(
                engine,
                &ticket.caller,
                "get_generation_jobs",
                READ_CAPABILITY,
            )
            .await?;
        anyhow::ensure!(
            ticket.slot.activated.load(Ordering::Acquire),
            "generation publication is unavailable"
        );
        Ok(())
    }
    pub(crate) async fn refresh_subscription(
        &self,
        engine: &MutationEngine,
        ticket: &GenerationSubscription,
    ) -> Result<CommittedGeneration> {
        let _guard = ticket.slot.operation.lock().await;
        ticket
            .pins
            .check(
                engine,
                &ticket.caller,
                "get_generation_jobs",
                READ_CAPABILITY,
            )
            .await?;
        anyhow::ensure!(
            ticket.slot.activated.load(Ordering::Acquire),
            "generation publication is unavailable"
        );
        let receipt = self.read_locked(&ticket.owner, &ticket.pins)?;
        ticket
            .pins
            .check(
                engine,
                &ticket.caller,
                "get_generation_jobs",
                READ_CAPABILITY,
            )
            .await?;
        Ok(receipt)
    }
}

fn native_failure(code: NativeErrorCode) -> GenerationFailure {
    match code {
        NativeErrorCode::ApprovalRequired => GenerationFailure::ToolApprovalRequired,
        NativeErrorCode::Bounds => GenerationFailure::OutputLimit,
        NativeErrorCode::Timeout => GenerationFailure::Deadline,
        NativeErrorCode::Auth => GenerationFailure::AdmissionWithdrawn,
        _ => GenerationFailure::NativeError,
    }
}

<file path="op-grpc-bridge/src/generation_jobs_selection.rs">
//! Explicit private-generation selection for the existing StateSync transport.
//! This is path syntax only. Verified identity, exact sealed read admission and
//! owner activation are separate mandatory gates before any private SHM read.
use anyhow::{ensure, Result};

const ROOT: &str = "/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/tched_router";
const MAX_PATHS: usize = 32;
const MAX_PATH_BYTES: usize = 2048;
const MAX_SEGMENTS: usize = 64;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) struct GenerationSelection {
    paths: Vec<String>,
}

fn private_path(path: &str) -> bool {
    ["generation_jobs"].into_iter().any(|child| {
        let root = format!("{ROOT}/{child}");
        path == root || path.starts_with(&(root + "/"))
    })
}

impl GenerationSelection {
    /// Empty/bare-plugin/public selectors remain public. Naming any private
    /// generation subtree opts into strict private mode; mixed requests reject.
    pub(crate) fn from_subscription(
        plugin_ids: &[String],
        paths: &[String],
    ) -> Result<Option<Self>> {
        if !paths.iter().any(|path| private_path(path)) {
            return Ok(None);
        }
        ensure!(
            plugin_ids.is_empty() || plugin_ids == ["tched_router"],
            "private generation subscriptions require one canonical plugin"
        );
        ensure!(
            !paths.is_empty() && paths.len() <= MAX_PATHS,
            "private generation subscriptions require 1..=32 explicit paths"
        );
        let mut canonical = Vec::with_capacity(paths.len());
        for path in paths {
            ensure!(
                private_path(path),
                "private and public state selectors cannot be mixed"
            );
            ensure!(
                path.len() <= MAX_PATH_BYTES && path.split('/').count() <= MAX_SEGMENTS,
                "private generation path exceeds its bounds"
            );
            ensure!(
                !path.chars().any(
                    |character| character.is_control() || matches!(character, '*' | '?' | '\\')
                ) && path
                    .split('/')
                    .skip(1)
                    .all(|part| !part.is_empty() && part != "." && part != ".."),
                "private generation paths must name exact canonical descendants"
            );
            if !canonical.contains(path) {
                canonical.push(path.clone());
            }
        }
        Ok(Some(Self { paths: canonical }))
    }

    pub(crate) fn from_get_state(plugin_id: &str, path: &str) -> Result<Option<Self>> {
        Self::from_subscription(&[plugin_id.to_owned()], &[path.to_owned()])
    }

    pub(crate) fn paths(&self) -> &[String] {
        &self.paths
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    #[test]
    fn private_mode_requires_explicit_generation_path_and_never_a_bare_root() {
        for paths in [
            vec![],
            vec![ROOT.to_owned()],
            vec!["/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/*".into()],
        ] {
            assert!(GenerationSelection::from_subscription(&[], &paths)
                .unwrap()
                .is_none());
        }
        let paths = vec![
            format!("{ROOT}/generation_jobs"),
            format!("{ROOT}/generation_jobs/one/spec/elements/title/props"),
        ];
        let selected = GenerationSelection::from_subscription(&[], &paths)
            .unwrap()
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(selected.paths(), paths);
        assert!(GenerationSelection::from_get_state("other", &paths[0]).is_err());
    }
    #[test]
    fn malformed_mixed_or_unbounded_selectors_fail_before_owner_lookup() {
        let root = format!("{ROOT}/generation_jobs");
        for paths in [
            vec![root.clone(), ROOT.into()],
            vec![root.clone(), "/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/config".into()],
            vec![format!("{root}/*")],
            vec![format!("{root}/one?")],
            vec![format!("{root}/../generation_jobs")],
            vec![format!("{root}//one")],
            vec![format!("{root}/one\n")],
            vec![format!("{root}/{}", "x".repeat(MAX_PATH_BYTES))],
            vec![root.clone(); MAX_PATHS + 1],
        ] {
            assert!(GenerationSelection::from_subscription(&[], &paths).is_err());
        }
        assert!(GenerationSelection::from_subscription(
            &["tched_router".into(), "config".into()],
            &[root]
        )
        .is_err());
    }
}

<file path="op-grpc-bridge/src/generation_jobs_stream.rs">
//! Private principal/session generation views on the existing StateSync service.
//!
//! The publisher owns admission, activation and committed private SHM reads.
//! Owner notifications contain metadata only and serve solely as wakeups. No
//! private value enters MutationEngine's public state cache or change channel.
use crate::generation_admission::GenerationCaller;
use op_plugins::state_plugins::tched_router::generation::READ_CAPABILITY;
use std::{collections::BTreeMap, pin::Pin, sync::Arc, time::Duration};

use futures::Stream;
use serde_json::Value;
use tonic::{Request, Status};

use crate::{
    event_chain_access,
    generation_jobs_dispatch::{CommittedGeneration, GenerationPublisher, GenerationSubscription},
    generation_jobs_selection::GenerationSelection,
    grpc_server::{
        simd_to_prost_struct, simd_to_prost_value, state_heartbeat_frame,
        state_snapshot_frames_with_views, DECLARED_CAPABILITY_HEADER,
    },
    interceptor::load_capability_grants,
    mutation_engine::MutationEngine,
    oracle_assertion::HumanPrincipalIdentity,
    proto::{GetStateRequest, GetStateResponse, StateChange, StateFrameKind, SubscribeRequest},
    state_stream::{PluginSnapshot, StateSnapshot},
};

const PLUGIN: &str = "tched_router";
const HEARTBEAT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(30);
pub(crate) type GenerationStream = Pin<Box<dyn Stream<Item = Result<StateChange, Status>> + Send>>;

struct GenerationAccess {
    identity: HumanPrincipalIdentity,
    capability: String,
}

impl GenerationAccess {
    #[allow(clippy::result_large_err)]
    fn from_request<T>(
        request: &Request<T>,
        identity: HumanPrincipalIdentity,
    ) -> Result<Self, Status> {
        let declared: Vec<_> = request
            .metadata()
            .get_all(DECLARED_CAPABILITY_HEADER)
            .into_iter()
            .collect();
        if declared.len() != 1 {
            return Err(Status::permission_denied(
                "one exact generation read capability declaration is required",
            ));
        }
        let capability = declared[0]
            .to_str()
            .map_err(|_| Status::permission_denied("invalid generation capability declaration"))?
            .to_owned();
        if capability != READ_CAPABILITY {
            return Err(Status::permission_denied(
                "exact sealed generation read capability is required",
            ));
        }
        let access = Self {
            identity,
            capability,
        };
        access.check_grant()?;
        Ok(access)
    }

    #[allow(clippy::result_large_err)]
    fn check_grant(&self) -> Result<(), Status> {
        if !load_capability_grants(&self.identity.principal_id).contains(&self.capability) {
            return Err(Status::permission_denied(
                "current exact-principal generation read grant is required",
            ));
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    async fn revalidate(
        &self,
        engine: &MutationEngine,
        publisher: &GenerationPublisher,
        ticket: &GenerationSubscription,
    ) -> Result<(), Status> {
        event_chain_access::validate_identity(engine, &self.identity).await?;
        self.check_grant()?;
        // This is identity/grant/catalog/activation admission only; it does not
        // read SHM on heartbeats and cannot expose an earlier owner snapshot.
        publisher.revalidate_subscription(engine, ticket).await
            .map_err(|_| Status::permission_denied("generation read admission was withdrawn; reactivate after restoring the exact contract and owner"))
    }
}

async fn open<T>(
    engine: &MutationEngine,
    request: &Request<T>,
    identity: HumanPrincipalIdentity,
) -> Result<
    (
        Arc<GenerationPublisher>,
        GenerationSubscription,
        GenerationAccess,
    ),
    Status,
> {
    let access = GenerationAccess::from_request(request, identity)?;
    // Re-check even when called from an already verified StateSync handler.
    event_chain_access::validate_identity(engine, &access.identity).await?;
    let publisher = engine
        .generation_jobs()
        .map_err(|_| Status::failed_precondition("private generation owner is not configured"))?
        .clone();
    let ticket = publisher
        .subscribe_jobs(
            engine,
            GenerationCaller {
                actor: access.identity.principal_id.clone(),
                session: access.identity.session_id.clone(),
                genesis: access.identity.session_genesis.clone(),
            },
            &access.capability,
        )
        .await
        .map_err(|_| {
            Status::failed_precondition(
                "private generation requires exact admission and explicit recovery",
            )
        })?;
    access.revalidate(engine, &publisher, &ticket).await?;
    Ok((publisher, ticket, access))
}

pub(crate) async fn subscribe(
    engine: Arc<MutationEngine>,
    request: Request<SubscribeRequest>,
    identity: HumanPrincipalIdentity,
    selection: GenerationSelection,
) -> Result<GenerationStream, Status> {
    if !request.get_ref().tags.is_empty() {
        return Err(Status::unimplemented(
            "generation tag selection has no committed selection contract",
        ));
    }
    let (publisher, ticket, access) = open(&engine, &request, identity).await?;
    let req = request.into_inner();
    Ok(build_stream(
        engine,
        publisher,
        ticket,
        access,
        selection,
        req.include_initial_state,
        req.include_schema,
        HEARTBEAT,
    ))
}

#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
fn build_stream(
    engine: Arc<MutationEngine>,
    publisher: Arc<GenerationPublisher>,
    mut ticket: GenerationSubscription,
    access: GenerationAccess,
    selection: GenerationSelection,
    include_initial_state: bool,
    include_schema: bool,
    heartbeat_interval: Duration,
) -> GenerationStream {
    Box::pin(async_stream::stream! {
        let mut previous = match snapshot(&ticket.initial) {
            Ok(snapshot) => snapshot,
            Err(status) => { yield Err(status); return; }
        };
        let initial = state_snapshot_frames_with_views(
            &previous, None, include_schema, include_initial_state,
            StateFrameKind::InitialState, selection.paths(), false, exact_views,
        );
        match initial {
            Ok(frames) => for frame in frames {
                if let Err(status) = access.revalidate(&engine, &publisher, &ticket).await {
                    yield Err(status); return;
                }
                yield Ok(frame);
            },
            Err(status) => { yield Err(status); return; }
        }
        let mut heartbeat = tokio::time::interval(heartbeat_interval);
        heartbeat.set_missed_tick_behavior(tokio::time::MissedTickBehavior::Delay);
        heartbeat.tick().await;
        loop {
            let force_rehydrate = tokio::select! {
                update = ticket.receiver.recv() => match update {
                    // Never inspect a wake's payload as state or use its
                    // generation as proof that a projection committed.
                    Ok(_) => Some(false),
                    Err(tokio::sync::broadcast::error::RecvError::Lagged(_)) => Some(true),
                    Err(tokio::sync::broadcast::error::RecvError::Closed) => return,
                },
                _ = heartbeat.tick() => None,
            };
            if let Err(status) = access.revalidate(&engine, &publisher, &ticket).await {
                yield Err(status); return;
            }
            if let Some(force_rehydrate) = force_rehydrate {
                let current = match publisher.refresh_subscription(&engine, &ticket).await {
                    Ok(receipt) => match snapshot(&receipt) {
                        Ok(snapshot) => snapshot,
                        Err(status) => { yield Err(status); return; }
                    },
                    Err(_) => { yield Err(Status::failed_precondition("committed private generation is unavailable; explicit recovery is required")); return; }
                };
                if current.generation != previous.generation || current.catalog_hash != previous.catalog_hash || force_rehydrate {
                    match state_snapshot_frames_with_views(
                        &current, Some(&previous), include_schema, true,
                        if force_rehydrate { StateFrameKind::InitialState } else { StateFrameKind::Update },
                        selection.paths(), force_rehydrate, exact_views,
                    ) {
                        Ok(frames) => for frame in frames {
                            if let Err(status) = access.revalidate(&engine, &publisher, &ticket).await {
                                yield Err(status); return;
                            }
                            yield Ok(frame);
                        },
                        Err(status) => { yield Err(status); return; }
                    }
                    previous = current;
                }
            }
            // Metadata-only heartbeat reports the last observed generation.
            // It does not poll state and makes no freshness/commit assertion.
            if let Err(status) = access.revalidate(&engine, &publisher, &ticket).await {
                yield Err(status); return;
            }
            yield Ok(state_heartbeat_frame(&previous));
        }
    })
}

pub(crate) async fn get_state(
    engine: Arc<MutationEngine>,
    request: Request<GetStateRequest>,
    identity: HumanPrincipalIdentity,
    selection: GenerationSelection,
) -> Result<GetStateResponse, Status> {
    let (publisher, ticket, access) = open(&engine, &request, identity).await?;
    let current = snapshot(&ticket.initial)?;
    let state = current
        .plugins
        .get(PLUGIN)
        .and_then(|plugin| plugin.state.as_ref())
        .ok_or_else(|| Status::not_found("generation has no committed document"))?;
    let selected = value_at_path(state, &selection.paths()[0])
        .map_err(|_| Status::invalid_argument("invalid generation descendant"))?
        .ok_or_else(|| Status::not_found("generation descendant is absent"))?;
    let owned = simd_json::serde::to_owned_value(selected)
        .map_err(|_| Status::data_loss("committed generation value cannot be encoded"))?;
    access.revalidate(&engine, &publisher, &ticket).await?;
    Ok(GetStateResponse {
        state: selected.is_object().then(|| simd_to_prost_struct(&owned)),
        value: Some(simd_to_prost_value(&owned)),
        effective_hash: String::new(),
        at_event_id: 0,
    })
}

#[allow(clippy::result_large_err)]
fn snapshot(receipt: &CommittedGeneration) -> Result<StateSnapshot, Status> {
    let schema: Value = serde_json::from_str(&receipt.schema_json)
        .map_err(|_| Status::data_loss("pinned generation schema is invalid"))?;
    let state = receipt
        .plugin_state()
        .map_err(|_| Status::data_loss("committed generation envelope is invalid"))?;
    Ok(StateSnapshot {
        generation: receipt.generation,
        catalog_hash: receipt.catalog_hash.clone(),
        plugins: [(
            PLUGIN.to_owned(),
            PluginSnapshot {
                schema_hash: receipt.schema_hash.clone(),
                schema,
                state,
            },
        )]
        .into_iter()
        .collect(),
    })
}

/// Existing state paths use literal object segments. Arrays additionally accept
/// canonical nonnegative indices. Absence differs from explicit JSON null.
fn value_at_path<'a>(state: &'a Value, path: &str) -> anyhow::Result<Option<&'a Value>> {
    let root = crate::state_stream::plugin_object_path(PLUGIN);
    let suffix = path
        .strip_prefix(&(root + "/"))
        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("generation path is outside canonical root"))?;
    let mut current = state;
    for segment in suffix.split('/') {
        anyhow::ensure!(
            !segment.is_empty() && segment != "." && segment != "..",
            "invalid generation path segment"
        );
        current = match current {
            Value::Object(object) => match object.get(segment) {
                Some(value) => value,
                None => return Ok(None),
            },
            Value::Array(items) => {
                anyhow::ensure!(
                    segment == "0"
                        || (!segment.starts_with('0')
                            && segment.bytes().all(|b| b.is_ascii_digit())),
                    "noncanonical generation array index"
                );
                let index: usize = segment
                    .parse()
                    .map_err(|_| anyhow::anyhow!("generation array index exceeds range"))?;
                match items.get(index) {
                    Some(value) => value,
                    None => return Ok(None),
                }
            }
            _ => return Ok(None),
        };
    }
    Ok(Some(current))
}

fn exact_views(
    plugin: &str,
    state: &Value,
    paths: &[String],
) -> anyhow::Result<BTreeMap<String, Value>> {
    anyhow::ensure!(plugin == PLUGIN, "invalid private generation plugin");
    let selection = GenerationSelection::from_subscription(&[PLUGIN.to_owned()], paths)?
        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("explicit generation selection is required"))?;
    let mut selected = BTreeMap::new();
    let mut bytes = 0usize;
    for path in selection.paths() {
        if let Some(value) = value_at_path(state, path)? {
            bytes = bytes
                .checked_add(serde_json::to_vec(value)?.len())
                .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("generation selected-byte overflow"))?;
            anyhow::ensure!(
                bytes <= 16 * 1024 * 1024,
                "generation selection exceeds 16 MiB"
            );
            selected.insert(path.clone(), value.clone());
        }
    }
    Ok(selected)
}

// Tungstenite fixes the handshake callback's error type to an HTTP response.
#![allow(clippy::result_large_err)]

use super::*;
use crate::{
    grpc_server::{OperationGrpcServer, DECLARED_CAPABILITY_HEADER},
    human_principal_dispatch::tests::{
        pk, register, temp_cozo, temp_shm_with_schemas, test_engine, TempCozo, TempShm,
    },
    identity_sled_dispatch::{tests::write_identity, IdentitySledStore},
    oracle_assertion::HumanPrincipalIdentity,
    proto::{state_sync_server::StateSync, GetStateRequest, SubscribeRequest},
    tched_router_runtime::TchedRouterRuntimeClient,
};
use futures::{SinkExt, StreamExt};
use op_plugins::state_plugins::{
    human_principal::HumanPrincipalPlugin, identity_sled::IdentitySledPlugin,
    large_language_model::LargeLanguageModelPlugin, tched_router::TchedRouterPlugin,
};
use op_state::StatePlugin;
use serde_json::json;
use std::time::Duration;
use tokio_tungstenite::{
    accept_hdr_async,
    tungstenite::{
        handshake::server::{Request as WsRequest, Response as WsResponse},
        Message,
    },
};
use tonic::Request;

const LIMIT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(20);
struct GrantsEnvironment(Option<std::ffi::OsString>);
impl Drop for GrantsEnvironment {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        match self.0.take() {
            Some(path) => std::env::set_var("OP_GRANTS_PATH", path),
            None => std::env::remove_var("OP_GRANTS_PATH"),
        }
    }
}
struct NativeFixture {
    endpoint: String,
    frames: tokio::sync::mpsc::Sender<Option<Value>>,
    prompt: tokio::sync::oneshot::Receiver<Value>,
    closed: tokio::sync::oneshot::Receiver<()>,
    task: tokio::task::JoinHandle<()>,
}
impl Drop for NativeFixture {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        self.task.abort();
    }
}
impl NativeFixture {
    async fn new() -> Self {
        let listener = tokio::net::TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").await.unwrap();
        let endpoint = format!("http://{}", listener.local_addr().unwrap());
        let (frames, mut received) = tokio::sync::mpsc::channel::<Option<Value>>(128);
        let (prompt_tx, prompt) = tokio::sync::oneshot::channel();
        let (closed_tx, closed) = tokio::sync::oneshot::channel();
        let task = tokio::spawn(async move {
            let (stream, _) = listener.accept().await.unwrap();
            let mut socket =
                accept_hdr_async(stream, |request: &WsRequest, mut response: WsResponse| {
                    assert_eq!(request.uri().path(), "/ws/chat");
                    assert!(request
                        .uri()
                        .query()
                        .unwrap()
                        .contains("agent_alias=fixture"));
                    assert!(request
                        .uri()
                        .query()
                        .unwrap()
                        .contains("stateless_generation=1"));
                    assert_eq!(request.headers()["authorization"], "Bearer fixture-token");
                    response.headers_mut().insert(
                        "Sec-WebSocket-Protocol",
                        "tched_router.generation.v1".parse().unwrap(),
                    );
                    Ok(response)
                })
                .await
                .unwrap();
            let connect = socket.next().await.unwrap().unwrap();
            let connect: Value = serde_json::from_str(connect.to_text().unwrap()).unwrap();
            let session = connect["session_id"].as_str().unwrap();
            socket.send(Message::Text(json!({"type":"session_start","session_id":session,"resumed":false,"message_count":0,"stateless_generation":1}).to_string())).await.unwrap();
            socket.send(Message::Text(json!({"type":"connected","stateless_generation":1,"provider":"fixture.direct","model":"fixture-model"}).to_string())).await.unwrap();
            let prompt = socket.next().await.unwrap().unwrap();
            let _ = prompt_tx.send(serde_json::from_str(prompt.to_text().unwrap()).unwrap());
            loop {
                tokio::select! {
                    frame=received.recv()=>match frame {Some(Some(frame))=>if socket.send(Message::Text(frame.to_string())).await.is_err(){break},_=>break},
                    message=socket.next()=>match message {Some(Ok(Message::Ping(data)))=>{let _=socket.send(Message::Pong(data)).await;},Some(Ok(Message::Close(_)))|None|Some(Err(_))=>break,_=>{}}
                }
            }
            let _ = socket.close(None).await;
            let _ = closed_tx.send(());
        });
        Self {
            endpoint,
            frames,
            prompt,
            closed,
            task,
        }
    }
    async fn chunk(&self, text: &str) {
        self.frames
            .send(Some(json!({"type":"chunk","content":text})))
            .await
            .unwrap();
    }
    async fn done(&self, text: &str) {
        self.frames.send(Some(json!({"type":"done","full_response":text,"provider":"fixture.direct","model":"fixture-model"}))).await.unwrap();
    }
}
struct Fixture {
    engine: Arc<MutationEngine>,
    server: OperationGrpcServer,

    documents: Arc<RuntimeDocuments>,
    private: PrivateProjectionDirectory,

impl Fixture {
    async fn new(endpoint: String) -> Self {

        let catalog = crate::sealed_schema_reader::blob_catalog_dir_from_env();
        engine

                )),
            )
            .unwrap();
        let mut ids = Vec::new();
        for (byte, name) in [(0xD1, "generation-first"), (0xD2, "generation-second")] {
            let key = pk(byte);
            register(&key, name).await.unwrap();
            let sled = write_identity(&engine, &key).await.unwrap();
            ids.push(HumanPrincipalIdentity {
                principal_id: op_identity::session::derive_principal_id(&key),
                human_pubkey: key,
                session_id: sled.session_id,
                session_genesis: sled.genesis.unwrap(),

            });
        }

        let fixture = Self {
            server: OperationGrpcServer::new(engine.clone()),
            engine,
            first: ids.remove(0),
            second: ids.remove(0),
            documents,
            private,
            catalog,
            grants,
            _environment: environment,
            _root: root,
            _shm: shm,
            _cozo: cozo,
        };
        fixture.grants(true, true);
        fixture
    }
    fn grants(&self, start: bool, read: bool) {
        let mut caps = vec![
            CANCEL_CAPABILITY,
            DELETE_CAPABILITY,
            RECOVER_CAPABILITY,
            "llm.invoke",
        ];
        if start {
            caps.push(START_CAPABILITY)
        }
        if read {
            caps.push(READ_CAPABILITY)
        }
        std::fs::write(&self.grants,serde_json::to_vec(&json!({(self.first.principal_id.clone()):{"capabilities":caps},
            (self.second.principal_id.clone()):{"capabilities":[START_CAPABILITY,READ_CAPABILITY,CANCEL_CAPABILITY,DELETE_CAPABILITY,RECOVER_CAPABILITY,"llm.invoke"]}})).unwrap()).unwrap();
    }
    fn owner(&self, who: &HumanPrincipalIdentity) -> GenerationOwner {
        GenerationOwner::new(who.principal_id.clone(), who.session_id.clone()).unwrap()
    }
    fn caller(&self, who: &HumanPrincipalIdentity) -> GenerationCaller {
        GenerationCaller {
            actor: who.principal_id.clone(),
            session: who.session_id.clone(),
            genesis: who.session_genesis.clone(),
        }
    }
    async fn call(&self, who: &HumanPrincipalIdentity, method: &str, args: Value) -> Result<Value> {
        let schema = TchedRouterPlugin::new().schema().unwrap();
        let cap = schema.methods[method].required_capability.as_deref();
        Ok(self
            .engine
            .dispatch_method_call_with_identity(
                PLUGIN,
                method,
                &args.to_string(),
                cap,
                &who.principal_id,
                Some(&who.session_id),
                Some(&who.session_genesis),
            )
