    }
    async fn activate(&self, who: &HumanPrincipalIdentity) {
        self.call(who, "recover_generation_jobs", json!({}))
            .await
            .unwrap();
    }
    fn request<T>(&self, body: T, who: &HumanPrincipalIdentity, cap: Option<&str>) -> Request<T> {
        let mut req = Request::new(body);
        req.extensions_mut().insert(who.clone());
        if let Some(cap) = cap {
            req.metadata_mut()
                .insert(DECLARED_CAPABILITY_HEADER, cap.parse().unwrap());
        }
        req
    }
    async fn get(
        &self,
        who: &HumanPrincipalIdentity,
        suffix: &str,
    ) -> Result<crate::proto::GetStateResponse, tonic::Status> {
        self.server
            .get_state(self.request(
                GetStateRequest {
                    plugin_id: PLUGIN.into(),
                    object_path: path(suffix),
                },
                who,
                Some(READ_CAPABILITY),
            ))
            .await
            .map(tonic::Response::into_inner)
    }
    async fn ticket(&self) -> GenerationSubscription {
        self.engine
            .generation_jobs()
            .unwrap()
            .subscribe_jobs(&self.engine, self.caller(&self.first), READ_CAPABILITY)
            .await
            .unwrap()
    }
    async fn wait_status(&self, id: &str, status: GenerationStatus) -> GenerationJob {
        self.wait_status_with_limit(id, status, LIMIT).await
    }
    async fn wait_status_with_limit(
        &self,
        id: &str,
        status: GenerationStatus,
        limit: Duration,
    ) -> GenerationJob {
        self.wait_job(id, limit, |job| job.status == status).await
    }
    async fn wait_committed_chunks(&self, id: &str, count: u32) -> GenerationJob {
        self.wait_job(id, LIMIT, |job| job.committed_chunks >= count)
            .await
    }
    async fn wait_job(
        &self,
        id: &str,
        limit: Duration,
        predicate: impl Fn(&GenerationJob) -> bool,
    ) -> GenerationJob {
        tokio::time::timeout(limit, async {
            let publisher = self.engine.generation_jobs().unwrap();
            let mut ticket = self.ticket().await;
            let mut receipt = ticket.initial.clone();
            loop {
                if let Some(job) = receipt
                    .state
                    .as_ref()
                    .and_then(|s| s.generation_jobs.get(id))
                {
                    if predicate(job) {
                        return job.clone();
                    }
                }
                ticket.receiver.recv().await.unwrap();
                receipt = publisher
                    .refresh_subscription(&self.engine, &ticket)
                    .await
                    .unwrap();
            }
        })
        .await
        .unwrap()
    }
}
fn path(suffix: &str) -> String {
    format!("/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/tched_router/{suffix}")
}
fn string_value(response: crate::proto::GetStateResponse) -> String {
    match response.value.unwrap().kind.unwrap() {
        prost_types::value::Kind::StringValue(text) => text,
        _ => panic!("scalar descendant changed type"),
    }
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn llm_stream_facade_and_job_listing_use_private_committed_state() {
    let mut native = NativeFixture::new().await;
    let fixture = Fixture::new(native.endpoint.clone()).await;
    fixture.activate(&fixture.first).await;
    fixture.activate(&fixture.second).await;
    let schema = LargeLanguageModelPlugin::new().schema().unwrap();
    let started = fixture
        .engine
        .dispatch_method_call_with_identity(
            "large_language_model",
            "stream_generate",
            &json!({"agent_alias":"fixture","prompt":"PRIVATE_FACADE_PROMPT"}).to_string(),
            schema.methods["stream_generate"]
                .required_capability
                .as_deref(),
            &fixture.first.principal_id,
            Some(&fixture.first.session_id),
            Some(&fixture.first.session_genesis),
        )
        .await
        .unwrap();
    let id = started["result"]["job"]["job_id"].as_str().unwrap();
    let prompt = tokio::time::timeout(LIMIT, &mut native.prompt)
        .await
        .unwrap()
        .unwrap();
    assert!(prompt.to_string().contains("PRIVATE_FACADE_PROMPT"));
    native.chunk("facade output").await;
    let running = fixture.wait_committed_chunks(id, 1).await;
    assert_eq!(running.output, "facade output");
    assert_eq!(
        string_value(
            fixture
                .get(&fixture.first, &format!("generation_jobs/{id}/output"))
                .await
                .unwrap()
        ),
        "facade output"
    );
    native.done("facade output").await;
    let completed = fixture.wait_status(id, GenerationStatus::Completed).await;
    assert_eq!(completed.output, "facade output");
    let listed = fixture
        .call(&fixture.first, "get_generation_jobs", json!({}))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    let jobs = listed["state"]["generation_jobs"].as_object().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(jobs.len(), 1);
    assert_eq!(jobs[id], serde_json::to_value(&completed).unwrap());
    let other = fixture
        .call(&fixture.second, "get_generation_jobs", json!({}))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    let other_workspace: GenerationWorkspaceOutput = serde_json::from_value(other.clone()).unwrap();
    assert!(other_workspace
        .state
        .is_none_or(|state| state.generation_jobs.is_empty()));
    assert!(!other.to_string().contains("PRIVATE_FACADE_PROMPT"));
    assert!(!other.to_string().contains("facade output"));
    fixture
        .call(
            &fixture.first,
            "delete_generation_job",
            json!({
                "job_id":id,"expected_revision":completed.revision
            }),
        )
        .await
        .unwrap();
    let deleted = fixture
        .call(&fixture.first, "get_generation_jobs", json!({}))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert!(deleted["state"]["generation_jobs"]
        .as_object()
        .unwrap()
        .is_empty());
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn actual_handlers_require_owner_grants_and_serve_only_committed_children() {
    let mut native = NativeFixture::new().await;
    let fixture = Fixture::new(native.endpoint.clone()).await;
    assert!(fixture
        .get(&fixture.first, "generation_jobs")
        .await
        .is_err());
    let missing = fixture.request(
        SubscribeRequest {
            plugin_ids: vec![PLUGIN.into()],
            path_patterns: vec![path("generation_jobs")],
            ..Default::default()
        },
        &fixture.first,
        None,
    );
    assert_eq!(
        fixture
            .server
            .subscribe(missing)
            .await
            .err()
            .unwrap()
            .code(),
        tonic::Code::PermissionDenied
    );
    fixture.activate(&fixture.first).await;
    fixture.activate(&fixture.second).await;
    let mut public_wakes = fixture.engine.change_tx().subscribe();
    let started = fixture
        .call(
            &fixture.first,
            "start_generation",
            json!({"agent_alias":"fixture","prompt":"PRIVATE_NATIVE_PROMPT"}),
        )
        .await
        .unwrap();
    let id = started["job"]["job_id"].as_str().unwrap();
    let prompt = tokio::time::timeout(LIMIT, &mut native.prompt)
        .await
        .unwrap()
        .unwrap();
    assert!(prompt.to_string().contains("PRIVATE_NATIVE_PROMPT"));
    native.chunk("PRIVATE_CHUNK").await;
    let mut ticket = fixture.ticket().await;
    tokio::time::timeout(LIMIT, async {
        loop {
            let receipt = fixture
                .engine
                .generation_jobs()
                .unwrap()
                .refresh_subscription(&fixture.engine, &ticket)
                .await
                .unwrap();
            if receipt.state.as_ref().unwrap().generation_jobs[id].output == "PRIVATE_CHUNK" {
                let job = &receipt.state.as_ref().unwrap().generation_jobs[id];
                assert_eq!(job.status, GenerationStatus::Running);
                assert_eq!(job.committed_chunks, 1);
                break;
            }
            ticket.receiver.recv().await.unwrap();
        }
    })
    .await
    .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        string_value(
            fixture
                .get(&fixture.first, &format!("generation_jobs/{id}/output"))
                .await
                .unwrap()
        ),
        "PRIVATE_CHUNK"
    );
    assert_eq!(
        fixture
            .get(&fixture.second, &format!("generation_jobs/{id}"))
            .await
            .unwrap_err()
            .code(),
        tonic::Code::NotFound
    );
    let mut forged = fixture.first.clone();
    forged.session_id = fixture.second.session_id.clone();
    assert_eq!(
        fixture
            .get(&forged, "generation_jobs")
            .await
            .unwrap_err()
            .code(),
        tonic::Code::Unauthenticated
    );
    assert!(fixture.engine.get_state(PLUGIN).await.is_none());
    let public = crate::state_stream::read_public_state_snapshot(&[PLUGIN.into()])
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert!(!format!("{:?}", public.plugins[PLUGIN].state).contains("PRIVATE_CHUNK"));
    // Canonical mutation auditing is digest-only, even though its result is private.
    while let Ok(wake) = public_wakes.try_recv() {
        let value = simd_json::to_string(&wake.new_value).unwrap();
        assert!(!value.contains("PRIVATE_NATIVE_PROMPT"));
        assert!(!value.contains("PRIVATE_CHUNK"));
    }
    native.done("PRIVATE_CHUNK").await;
    let job = fixture.wait_status(id, GenerationStatus::Completed).await;
    assert_eq!(job.output, "PRIVATE_CHUNK");
    assert_eq!(job.reported_provider.as_deref(), Some("fixture.direct"));
    fixture
        .call(
            &fixture.first,
            "delete_generation_job",
            json!({"job_id":id,"expected_revision":job.revision}),
        )
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        fixture
            .get(&fixture.first, &format!("generation_jobs/{id}"))
            .await
            .unwrap_err()
            .code(),
        tonic::Code::NotFound
    );
    fixture.grants(true, false);
    assert_eq!(
        fixture
            .get(&fixture.first, "generation_jobs")
            .await
            .unwrap_err()
            .code(),
        tonic::Code::PermissionDenied
    );
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn cancelling_the_caller_does_not_cancel_owned_admission_or_publication() {
    let mut native = NativeFixture::new().await;
    let fixture = Fixture::new(native.endpoint.clone()).await;
    fixture.activate(&fixture.first).await;
    let publisher = fixture.engine.generation_jobs().unwrap();
    let owner = fixture.owner(&fixture.first);
    let slot = publisher.slot(&owner).unwrap();
    let guard = slot.operation.lock().await;
    let schema = TchedRouterPlugin::new().schema().unwrap();
    let args = json!({"agent_alias":"fixture","prompt":"caller-dropped"});
    let publisher = publisher.clone();
    let engine = fixture.engine.clone();
    let identity = fixture.first.clone();
    let call = tokio::spawn(async move {
        publisher
            .dispatch(
                &engine,
                &schema,
                "start_generation",
                &args,
                &identity.principal_id,
                Some(&identity.session_id),
                Some(&identity.session_genesis),
                None,
            )
            .await
    });
    tokio::time::timeout(LIMIT, async {
        while slot.calls.available_permits() == MAX_OWNER_CALLS {
            tokio::task::yield_now().await;
        }
    })
    .await
    .unwrap();
    // The semaphore proves pre-task admission finished and the accepted owned
    // call is waiting for the lock, rather than cancelling an unpolled future.
    call.abort();
    let _ = call.await;
    drop(guard);
    tokio::time::timeout(LIMIT, &mut native.prompt)
        .await
        .unwrap()
        .unwrap();
    native.chunk("survives").await;
    native.done("survives").await;
    let id = fixture
        .ticket()
        .await
        .initial
        .state
        .unwrap()
        .generation_jobs
        .into_keys()
        .next()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        fixture
            .wait_status(&id, GenerationStatus::Completed)
            .await
            .output,
        "survives"
    );
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn grant_withdrawal_stops_native_and_retains_pending_until_exact_recovery() {
    let mut native = NativeFixture::new().await;
    let fixture = Fixture::new(native.endpoint.clone()).await;
    fixture.activate(&fixture.first).await;
    let started = fixture
        .call(
            &fixture.first,
            "start_generation",
            json!({"agent_alias":"fixture","prompt":"withdraw"}),
        )
        .await
        .unwrap();
    let id = started["job"]["job_id"].as_str().unwrap();
    tokio::time::timeout(LIMIT, &mut native.prompt)
        .await
        .unwrap()
        .unwrap();
    fixture.grants(false, true);
    native.chunk("must-never-publish").await;
    tokio::time::timeout(LIMIT, &mut native.closed)
        .await
        .unwrap()
        .unwrap();
    let publisher = fixture.engine.generation_jobs().unwrap();
    let slot = publisher.slot(&fixture.owner(&fixture.first)).unwrap();
    let _guard = slot.operation.lock().await;
    assert!(!slot.activated.load(Ordering::Acquire));
    let owner = fixture
        .private
        .open_child(fixture.owner(&fixture.first).selector())
        .unwrap()
        .unwrap();
    assert!(owner.pending_document().unwrap().is_some());
    assert!(owner.read_snapshot(&[PLUGIN.into()]).is_err());
    drop(_guard);
    // Registration completion is an owned lifecycle event, not a state poll.
    tokio::time::timeout(LIMIT, async {
        loop {
            let notified = slot.worker_finished.notified();
            if slot.workers.lock().unwrap().is_empty() {
                break;
            }
            notified.await;
        }
    })
    .await
    .unwrap();
    fixture.activate(&fixture.first).await;
    let recovered = fixture
        .call(&fixture.first, "get_generation_job", json!({"job_id":id}))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(recovered["job"]["status"], "interrupted");
    assert_eq!(recovered["job"]["output"], "");
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn private_pending_failure_blocks_reads_and_recovery_uses_durable_state() {
    let native = NativeFixture::new().await;
    let fixture = Fixture::new(native.endpoint.clone()).await;
    fixture.activate(&fixture.first).await;
    let owner = fixture.owner(&fixture.first);
    let directory = fixture
        .private
        .open_child(owner.selector())
        .unwrap()
        .unwrap();
    let methods = GenerationMethods::new(fixture.documents.clone());
    let handle = tokio::runtime::Handle::current();
    let hash = TchedRouterPlugin::new().schema().unwrap();
    let pins = GenerationPins::load(
        &fixture.catalog,
        Some(&hash),
        "recover_generation_jobs",
        RECOVER_CAPABILITY,
        None,
    )
    .unwrap();
    let owner_copy = owner.clone();
    let schema_hash = pins.document.schema_hash.clone();
    let result = tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || {
        directory.commit_document_durable::<()>(PLUGIN, "fixture-uncertain", move |_| {
            handle.block_on(methods.create(
                &owner_copy,
                &StartGenerationInput {
                    agent_alias: "fixture".into(),
                    prompt: "never-replay".into(),
                },
                "interrupted",
                &schema_hash,
            ))?;
            anyhow::bail!("injected publication uncertainty")
        })
    })
    .await
    .unwrap()
    .unwrap();
    assert!(matches!(result, PrivateDocumentPublication::Pending { .. }));
    assert!(fixture
        .get(&fixture.first, "generation_jobs")
        .await
        .is_err());
    fixture.activate(&fixture.first).await;
    let recovered = fixture
        .call(
            &fixture.first,
            "get_generation_job",
            json!({"job_id":"interrupted"}),
        )
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(recovered["job"]["status"], "interrupted");
    assert_eq!(recovered["job"]["failure"], "process_interrupted");
    assert!(!serde_json::to_string(&recovered)
        .unwrap()
        .contains("never-replay"));
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn actual_subscription_lag_rereads_shm_and_retains_deleted_child_tombstones() {
    let mut native = NativeFixture::new().await;
    let fixture = Fixture::new(native.endpoint.clone()).await;
    fixture.activate(&fixture.first).await;
    let started = fixture
        .call(
            &fixture.first,
            "start_generation",
            json!({"agent_alias":"fixture","prompt":"lag"}),
        )
        .await
        .unwrap();
    let id = started["job"]["job_id"].as_str().unwrap();
    tokio::time::timeout(LIMIT, &mut native.prompt)
        .await
        .unwrap()
        .unwrap();
    let selected = path(&format!("generation_jobs/{id}"));
    let request = fixture.request(
        SubscribeRequest {
            plugin_ids: vec![PLUGIN.into()],
            path_patterns: vec![selected.clone()],
            include_initial_state: true,
            ..Default::default()
        },
        &fixture.first,
        Some(READ_CAPABILITY),
    );
    let mut stream = fixture
        .server
        .subscribe(request)
        .await
        .unwrap()
        .into_inner();
    let initial = tokio::time::timeout(LIMIT, stream.next())
        .await
        .unwrap()
        .unwrap()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(initial.object_path, selected);
    assert!(initial.state_generation > 0);
    // Force 40 ACTUAL publications, not merely 40 fragments which the worker
    // may correctly coalesce. The tested StateSync receiver remains unpolled;
    // this independent committed-SHM observer gates each next native fragment.
    tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(120), async {
        for count in 1..=40u32 {
            native.chunk("x").await;
            let committed = fixture.wait_committed_chunks(id, count).await;
            assert_eq!(committed.committed_chunks, count);
            assert_eq!(committed.revision, u64::from(count) + 2);
        }
    })
    .await
    .unwrap();
    native.done(&"x".repeat(40)).await;
    let complete = fixture.wait_status(id, GenerationStatus::Completed).await;
    fixture
        .call(
            &fixture.first,
            "delete_generation_job",
            json!({"job_id":id,"expected_revision":complete.revision}),
        )
        .await
        .unwrap();
    // The receiver overflowed, but the previously exposed exact child still
    // receives a tombstone from the complete committed current snapshot.
    let removed = tokio::time::timeout(LIMIT, stream.next())
        .await
        .unwrap()
        .unwrap()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(removed.object_path, selected);
    assert_eq!(
        removed.change_type,
        crate::proto::ChangeType::ObjectRemoved as i32
    );
    assert_eq!(
        removed.frame_kind,
        crate::proto::StateFrameKind::InitialState as i32
    );
    assert!(removed.new_value.is_none());
    assert!(removed.state_generation > initial.state_generation);
    fixture.grants(true, false);
    let error = tokio::time::timeout(LIMIT, stream.next())
        .await
        .unwrap()
        .unwrap()
        .unwrap_err();
    assert_eq!(error.code(), tonic::Code::PermissionDenied);
}

        })
        .await
        .unwrap();
        if withdrawal == "origin-grant" {
            // The nested start grant remains present; only the original facade
            // authority is withdrawn after accepted queue admission.
            std::fs::write(&fixture.grants,serde_json::to_vec(&json!({(fixture.first.principal_id.clone()):{"capabilities":[START_CAPABILITY,READ_CAPABILITY,RECOVER_CAPABILITY]}})).unwrap()).unwrap();
        } else {
            let mut schema = if withdrawal == "origin-seal" {
                LargeLanguageModelPlugin::new().schema().unwrap()
            } else {
                TchedRouterPlugin::new().schema().unwrap()
            };
            // Metadata-only reseal leaves the compiled method shape compatible,
            // so this specifically proves the original exact pin is retained.
            schema.description.push_str(" fixture reseal");
            let mut sealer = op_blob::BlobStore::open(&fixture.catalog).unwrap();
            sealer
                .write(&op_blob::blobify_plugin_schema(
                    &schema.name,
                    schema.clone(),
                ))
                .unwrap();
        }
        drop(guard);
        assert!(
            tokio::time::timeout(LIMIT, call)
                .await
                .unwrap()
                .unwrap()
                .is_err(),
            "{withdrawal}"
        );
        assert!(
            fixture
                .documents
                .read(&owner.document_id())
                .await
                .unwrap()
                .is_none(),
            "{withdrawal}"
        );
        assert!(
            matches!(
                native.prompt.try_recv(),
                Err(tokio::sync::oneshot::error::TryRecvError::Empty)
            ),
            "{withdrawal}"
        );
        assert!(
            fixture
                .private
                .open_child(owner.selector())
                .unwrap()
                .unwrap()
                .pending_document()
                .unwrap()
                .is_none(),
            "{withdrawal}"
        );
    }
}

fn fragment_state() -> GenerationState {
    GenerationState {
        generation_revision: 2,
        generation_jobs: [(
            "job".into(),
            GenerationJob {
                job_id: "job".into(),
                revision: 2,
                agent_alias: "fixture".into(),
                status: GenerationStatus::Running,
                output: String::new(),
                committed_chunks: 0,
                reported_provider: None,
                reported_model: None,
                prompt_digest: "a".repeat(64),
                source_schema_hash: "b".repeat(64),
                created_at: 1,
                updated_at: 1,
                failure: None,
            },
        )]
        .into_iter()
        .collect(),
    }
}

#[test]
fn ready_batch_never_waits_and_preserves_order_across_byte_and_count_boundaries() {
    use std::collections::VecDeque;
    let state = fragment_state();
    let mut carry = None;
    let mut calls = 0;
    let first = ready_fragment_batch(&state, "job", "first".into(), &mut carry, || {
        calls += 1;
        None
    })
    .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(first, ["first"]);
    assert_eq!(calls, 1);
    assert!(carry.is_none());
    let mut queued = VecDeque::from(["b".into(), "c".into()]);
    let batch =
        ready_fragment_batch(&state, "job", "a".into(), &mut carry, || queued.pop_front()).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(batch, ["a", "b", "c"]);
    assert!(queued.is_empty());
    let mut queued = VecDeque::from(["boundary".into(), "later".into()]);
    let batch = ready_fragment_batch(
        &state,
        "job",
        "x".repeat(MAX_CHUNK_BYTES),
        &mut carry,
        || queued.pop_front(),
    )
    .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(batch.len(), 1);
    assert_eq!(carry.as_deref(), Some("boundary"));
    let first = carry.take().unwrap();
    let batch =
        ready_fragment_batch(&state, "job", first, &mut carry, || queued.pop_front()).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(batch, ["boundary", "later"]);
    assert!(carry.is_none());
    let mut queued: VecDeque<String> = (1..=MAX_BATCH_FRAGMENTS)
        .map(|index| index.to_string())
        .collect();
    let batch =
        ready_fragment_batch(&state, "job", "0".into(), &mut carry, || queued.pop_front()).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(batch.len(), MAX_BATCH_FRAGMENTS);
    assert_eq!(queued.pop_front().unwrap(), MAX_BATCH_FRAGMENTS.to_string());
    let mut attempts = 0;
    let batch = ready_fragment_batch(&state, "job", "first".into(), &mut carry, || {
        attempts += 1;
        Some(String::new())
    })
    .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(batch, ["first"]);
    assert_eq!(attempts, MAX_BATCH_FRAGMENTS - 1);
}

#[test]
fn ready_batch_commits_valid_prefix_before_an_over_limit_successor() {
    let mut state = fragment_state();
    state
        .generation_jobs
        .get_mut("job")
        .unwrap()
        .committed_chunks = MAX_FRAMES - 1;
    let mut queued =
        std::collections::VecDeque::from(["over-limit".into(), "must-not-overtake".into()]);
    let mut carry = None;
    let batch = ready_fragment_batch(&state, "job", "last-valid".into(), &mut carry, || {
        queued.pop_front()
    })
    .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(batch, ["last-valid"]);
    assert_eq!(carry.as_deref(), Some("over-limit"));
    state
        .generation_jobs
        .get_mut("job")
        .unwrap()
        .committed_chunks = MAX_FRAMES;
    let first = carry.take().unwrap();
    assert!(ready_fragment_batch(&state, "job", first, &mut carry, || queued.pop_front()).is_err());
    assert_eq!(queued.front().unwrap(), "must-not-overtake");
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn native_burst_terminal_follows_all_original_fragments_in_committed_shm() {
    let mut native = NativeFixture::new().await;
    let fixture = Fixture::new(native.endpoint.clone()).await;
    fixture.activate(&fixture.first).await;
    fixture.activate(&fixture.second).await;
    let started = fixture
        .call(
            &fixture.first,
            "start_generation",
            json!({"agent_alias":"fixture","prompt":"bounded-burst"}),
        )
        .await
        .unwrap();
    let id = started["job"]["job_id"].as_str().unwrap();
    tokio::time::timeout(LIMIT, &mut native.prompt)
        .await
        .unwrap()
        .unwrap();
    // A full-size first fragment and more than one batch's fragment count
    // exercise both boundaries. Do not assume any particular scheduling or
    // number of batches: only already-queued fragments may be grouped.
    let fragments: Vec<String> = std::iter::once("x".repeat(MAX_CHUNK_BYTES))
        .chain((0..MAX_BATCH_FRAGMENTS + 2).map(|index| format!("\n{index}:λ")))
        .collect();
    let output = fragments.concat();
    for fragment in &fragments {
        native.chunk(fragment).await;
    }
    native.done(&output).await;
    let complete = fixture
        .wait_status_with_limit(id, GenerationStatus::Completed, Duration::from_secs(90))
        .await;
    assert_eq!(complete.output, output);
    assert_eq!(complete.committed_chunks as usize, fragments.len());
    assert_eq!(
        string_value(
            fixture
                .get(&fixture.first, &format!("generation_jobs/{id}/output"))
                .await
                .unwrap()
        ),
        output
    );
    assert_eq!(
        fixture
            .get(&fixture.second, &format!("generation_jobs/{id}"))
            .await
            .unwrap_err()
            .code(),
        tonic::Code::NotFound
    );
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn pool_decodes_large_plugin_and_state_unary_and_stream_responses() {
    let payload = Arc::new("x".repeat(LARGE));
    let service = LargeResponseService {
        payload: payload.clone(),
    };
    let listener = tokio::net::TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").await.unwrap();
    let address = listener.local_addr().unwrap();
    let server = tokio::spawn(async move {
        tonic::transport::Server::builder()
            .add_service(PluginServiceServer::new(service.clone()))
            .add_service(StateSyncServer::new(service))
            .serve_with_incoming(tokio_stream::wrappers::TcpListenerStream::new(listener))
            .await
            .unwrap();
    });

    let pool = GrpcClientPool::new();
    let mut plugin = pool
        .plugin_service_client(&format!("http://{address}"))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    let plugin_response = plugin
        .call_method(Request::new(crate::proto::CallMethodRequest::default()))
        .await
        .unwrap()
        .into_inner();
    let plugin_payload = match plugin_response.result.unwrap().kind.unwrap() {
        prost_types::value::Kind::StringValue(value) => value,
        other => panic!("unexpected plugin response kind: {other:?}"),
    };
    assert_eq!(plugin_payload, *payload);

    let mut state = pool
        .state_sync_client(&format!("http://{address}"))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    let state_response = state
        .get_state(Request::new(crate::proto::GetStateRequest::default()))
        .await
        .unwrap()
        .into_inner();
    let state_payload = match state_response.value.unwrap().kind.unwrap() {
        prost_types::value::Kind::StringValue(value) => value,
        other => panic!("unexpected state response kind: {other:?}"),
    };
    assert_eq!(state_payload, *payload);

    let mut stream = state
        .subscribe(Request::new(SubscribeRequest::default()))
        .await
        .unwrap()
        .into_inner();
    let frame = stream.next().await.unwrap().unwrap();
    let stream_payload = match frame.new_value.unwrap().kind.unwrap() {
        prost_types::value::Kind::StringValue(value) => value,
        other => panic!("unexpected stream response kind: {other:?}"),
    };
    assert_eq!(stream_payload, *payload);
    server.abort();
}

<file path="op-grpc-bridge/src/grpc_client.rs">
//! gRPC Client - For D-Bus → remote gRPC calls
//!
//! Allows local D-Bus services to call remote gRPC endpoints,
//! enabling distributed operation-dbus deployments.

use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::sync::Arc;
use std::time::Duration;

use base64::Engine as _;
use prost_types::{value::Kind as ProstKind, Struct as ProstStruct, Value as ProstValue};
use tokio::sync::RwLock;
use tonic::metadata::MetadataValue;
use tonic::transport::{Certificate, Channel, ClientTlsConfig, Endpoint};
use tonic::Request;
use tracing::info;

use crate::oracle_assertion_client::DecoyAssertionClient;
use crate::proto::{
    event_chain_service_client::EventChainServiceClient,
    plugin_service_client::PluginServiceClient, state_sync_client::StateSyncClient,
    CallMethodRequest, GetStateRequest, GetStateResponse, MutateRequest,
    OperationType as ProtoOperationType, SubscribeEventsRequest, SubscribeRequest,
};

/// Bounded response envelope for complete plugin documents and SHM state.
/// Native chat can exceed tonic's 4 MiB default; identity admission is unchanged.
pub const MAX_PLUGIN_STATE_RESPONSE_BYTES: usize = 64 * 1024 * 1024;

#[cfg(test)]
#[path = "grpc_client_large_response_tests.rs"]
mod large_response_tests;

/// Configuration for a remote gRPC endpoint
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct RemoteEndpoint {
    pub address: String,
    pub tls_enabled: bool,
    pub connect_timeout: Duration,
    pub request_timeout: Duration,
}

/// Caller-supplied Ghostbridge identity forwarded by an HTTP compatibility
/// adapter into the canonical gRPC method call.
#[derive(Clone)]
pub struct GhostbridgeCallMetadata {
    /// Exact caller-supplied SID1 wire bytes, if this is a local identity call.
    pub sealed_id: Option<Vec<u8>>,
    /// Exact caller-supplied OIA1 wire bytes, if this is a decoy assertion call.
    pub oracle_assertion: Option<Vec<u8>>,
    /// Legacy fields retained for non-plugin Ghostbridge services.
    pub session_genesis: Option<String>,
    pub trace_id: Option<String>,
    pub wireguard_pubkey: Option<String>,
}

impl Default for RemoteEndpoint {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            address: "http://127.0.0.1:8090".to_string(),
            tls_enabled: false,
            connect_timeout: Duration::from_secs(5),
            request_timeout: Duration::from_secs(30),
        }
    }
}

/// gRPC client pool for connecting to remote Operation services
pub struct GrpcClientPool {
    /// Map of endpoint address to channel
    channels: RwLock<HashMap<String, Channel>>,
    /// Default endpoint configuration
    default_config: RemoteEndpoint,
}

impl Default for GrpcClientPool {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}

impl GrpcClientPool {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            channels: RwLock::new(HashMap::new()),
            default_config: RemoteEndpoint::default(),
        }
    }

    pub fn with_default_config(config: RemoteEndpoint) -> Self {
        Self {
            channels: RwLock::new(HashMap::new()),
            default_config: config,
        }
    }

    /// Apply transport settings (timeouts + TLS) to an endpoint.
    ///
    /// TLS is driven by the URI scheme: `https://` gets a tonic
    /// `ClientTlsConfig`. This mirrors `examples/repro_subscribe.rs`, which is
    /// the reference client path. Trust anchors, in priority order:
    ///   1. `OP_DBUS_GRPC_CA_FILE` — PEM file to pin (what op-web's run script
    ///      exports; may point at the leaf cert itself since it is its own CA).
    ///   2. Native system roots (`with_native_roots`).
    ///
    /// `OP_DBUS_GRPC_TLS_DOMAIN` overrides the SNI/verification name when the
    /// dial address is an IP or differs from the certificate SAN.
    fn configure_endpoint(
        &self,
        endpoint: Endpoint,
        addr: &str,
    ) -> Result<Endpoint, GrpcClientError> {
        let endpoint = endpoint
            .connect_timeout(self.default_config.connect_timeout)
            .timeout(self.default_config.request_timeout);

        if !addr.starts_with("https://") {
            return Ok(endpoint);
        }

        let mut tls = ClientTlsConfig::new().with_native_roots();
        if let Ok(path) = std::env::var("OP_DBUS_GRPC_CA_FILE") {
            if !path.trim().is_empty() {
                let pem = std::fs::read(path.trim()).map_err(|e| {
                    GrpcClientError::ConnectionFailed(format!(
                        "failed to read OP_DBUS_GRPC_CA_FILE={path}: {e}"
                    ))
                })?;
                tls = tls.ca_certificate(Certificate::from_pem(pem));
            }
        }
        if let Ok(domain) = std::env::var("OP_DBUS_GRPC_TLS_DOMAIN") {
            if !domain.trim().is_empty() {
                tls = tls.domain_name(domain.trim().to_string());
            }
        }
        endpoint
            .tls_config(tls)
            .map_err(|e| GrpcClientError::ConnectionFailed(format!("TLS config for {addr}: {e}")))
    }

    /// Get or create a channel to the specified address (supports comma-separated endpoints for load balancing)
    async fn get_channel(&self, address: &str) -> Result<Channel, GrpcClientError> {
        {
            let channels = self.channels.read().await;
            if let Some(channel) = channels.get(address) {
                return Ok(channel.clone());
            }
        }

        let addrs: Vec<&str> = address
            .split(',')
            .map(|s| s.trim())
            .filter(|s| !s.is_empty())
            .collect();

        let channel = if addrs.len() > 1 {
            // Native Tonic Load Balancing
            let endpoints = addrs
                .into_iter()
                .map(|addr| {
                    Endpoint::from_shared(addr.to_string())
                        .map_err(|e| {
                            GrpcClientError::ConnectionFailed(format!(
                                "Invalid endpoint {addr}: {e}"
                            ))
                        })
                        .and_then(|e| self.configure_endpoint(e, addr))
                })
                .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()?;

            Channel::balance_list(endpoints.into_iter())
        } else {
            // Single endpoint
            let endpoint = Endpoint::from_shared(address.to_string())
                .map_err(|e| GrpcClientError::ConnectionFailed(e.to_string()))?;
            let endpoint = self.configure_endpoint(endpoint, address)?;

            endpoint
                .connect()
                .await
                .map_err(|e| GrpcClientError::ConnectionFailed(e.to_string()))?
        };

        {
            let mut channels = self.channels.write().await;
            channels.insert(address.to_string(), channel.clone());
        }

        info!("Connected to remote gRPC endpoint(s): {}", address);
        Ok(channel)
    }

    /// Get a Plugin service client
    pub async fn plugin_service_client(
        &self,
        address: &str,
    ) -> Result<PluginServiceClient<Channel>, GrpcClientError> {
        let channel = self.get_channel(address).await?;
        Ok(PluginServiceClient::new(channel)
            .max_decoding_message_size(MAX_PLUGIN_STATE_RESPONSE_BYTES))
    }

    /// Get a StateSync service client
    pub async fn state_sync_client(
        &self,
        address: &str,
    ) -> Result<StateSyncClient<Channel>, GrpcClientError> {
        let channel = self.get_channel(address).await?;
        Ok(
            StateSyncClient::new(channel)
                .max_decoding_message_size(MAX_PLUGIN_STATE_RESPONSE_BYTES),
        )
    }

    /// Get an EventChain service client
    pub async fn event_chain_client(
        &self,
        address: &str,
    ) -> Result<EventChainServiceClient<Channel>, GrpcClientError> {
        let channel = self.get_channel(address).await?;
        Ok(EventChainServiceClient::new(channel))
    }

    /// Close all connections
    pub async fn close_all(&self) {
        let mut channels = self.channels.write().await;
        channels.clear();
        info!("Closed all gRPC client connections");
    }
}

/// High-level client for remote Operation services
#[allow(dead_code)]
pub struct RemoteOperationClient {
    pool: Arc<GrpcClientPool>,
    default_address: String,
    client_id: String,
}

impl RemoteOperationClient {
    pub fn new(pool: Arc<GrpcClientPool>, address: &str, client_id: &str) -> Self {
        Self {
            pool,
            default_address: address.to_string(),
            client_id: client_id.to_string(),
        }
    }

    /// Get state from a remote endpoint
    pub async fn get_state(
        &self,
        plugin_id: &str,
        object_path: &str,
    ) -> Result<simd_json::OwnedValue, GrpcClientError> {
        self.get_state_with_identity(plugin_id, object_path, &private_plugin_identity()?, None)
            .await
    }

    /// Get public state, or a private workspace descendant when the caller
    /// supplies its authored credential and the exact declared capability.
    /// This path never substitutes a process/service identity.
    pub async fn get_state_with_identity(
        &self,
        plugin_id: &str,
        object_path: &str,
        identity: &GhostbridgeCallMetadata,
        capability_id: Option<&str>,
    ) -> Result<simd_json::OwnedValue, GrpcClientError> {
        let mut client = self.pool.state_sync_client(&self.default_address).await?;

        let mut request = Request::new(GetStateRequest {
            plugin_id: plugin_id.to_string(),
            object_path: object_path.to_string(),
        });
        attach_identity_metadata(&mut request, identity, capability_id)?;

        let response = client
            .get_state(request)
            .await
            .map_err(|e| GrpcClientError::RequestFailed(e.to_string()))?;

        decode_get_state_response(response.into_inner())
    }

    /// Set state on a remote endpoint (apply patch)
    pub async fn set_state(
        &self,
        plugin_id: &str,
        object_path: &str,
        state: simd_json::OwnedValue,
        actor_id: &str,
        capability_id: &str,
    ) -> Result<SetStateResult, GrpcClientError> {
        self.set_state_with_identity(
            plugin_id,
            object_path,
            state,
            actor_id,
            capability_id,
            &private_plugin_identity()?,
        )
        .await
    }

    /// Apply state with the exact caller-supplied SID1/OIA1 credential and
    /// capability. The request actor remains the caller's asserted actor; the
    /// server validates that it matches the credential.
    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    pub async fn set_state_with_identity(
        &self,
        plugin_id: &str,
        object_path: &str,
        state: simd_json::OwnedValue,
        actor_id: &str,
        capability_id: &str,
        identity: &GhostbridgeCallMetadata,
    ) -> Result<SetStateResult, GrpcClientError> {
        let mut client = self.pool.state_sync_client(&self.default_address).await?;

        let mut request = Request::new(MutateRequest {
            plugin_id: plugin_id.to_string(),
            object_path: object_path.to_string(),
            operation: ProtoOperationType::ApplyPatch as i32,
            member_name: String::new(),
            value: Some(simd_to_prost_value(&state)),
            actor_id: actor_id.to_string(),
            capability_id: capability_id.to_string(),
            idempotency_key: uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string(),
        });
        attach_identity_metadata(&mut request, identity, Some(capability_id))?;

        let response = client
            .mutate(request)
            .await
            .map_err(|e| GrpcClientError::RequestFailed(e.to_string()))?;

        let resp = response.into_inner();
        if !resp.success {
            if let Some(err) = resp.error {
                return Err(GrpcClientError::RemoteError {
                    code: format!("{}", err.code),
                    message: err.message,
                });
            }
            return Err(GrpcClientError::RemoteError {
                code: "UNKNOWN".to_string(),
                message: "mutation failed".to_string(),
            });
        }

        Ok(SetStateResult {
            event_id: resp.event_id,
            effective_hash: resp.effective_hash,
        })
    }

    /// Call a method on a remote endpoint
    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    pub async fn call_method(
        &self,
        plugin_id: &str,
        object_path: &str,
        interface_name: &str,
        method_name: &str,
        arguments: Vec<simd_json::OwnedValue>,
        actor_id: &str,
        capability_id: &str,
    ) -> Result<simd_json::OwnedValue, GrpcClientError> {
        let mut client = self
            .pool
            .plugin_service_client(&self.default_address)
            .await?;

        let arguments = arguments
            .iter()
            .map(simd_to_prost_value)
            .collect::<Vec<_>>();

        let mut request = Request::new(CallMethodRequest {
            plugin_id: plugin_id.to_string(),
            object_path: object_path.to_string(),
            interface_name: interface_name.to_string(),
            method_name: method_name.to_string(),
            arguments,
            actor_id: actor_id.to_string(),
            capability_id: capability_id.to_string(),
        });
        attach_plugin_identity_metadata(&mut request, &private_plugin_identity()?, capability_id)?;

        let response = client
            .call_method(request)
            .await
            .map_err(|e| GrpcClientError::RequestFailed(e.to_string()))?;

        let resp = response.into_inner();
        if !resp.success {
            if let Some(err) = resp.error {
                return Err(GrpcClientError::RemoteError {
                    code: format!("{}", err.code),
                    message: err.message,
                });
            }
            return Err(GrpcClientError::RemoteError {
                code: "UNKNOWN".to_string(),
                message: "call failed".to_string(),
            });
        }

        if let Some(result) = resp.result {
            Ok(prost_value_to_simd(&result))
        } else {
            Ok(simd_json::json!(null))
        }
    }

    /// Call a method while preserving the Ghostbridge identity supplied by an
    /// outer transport adapter. This keeps HTTP on op-web while capability
    /// enforcement remains in the bridge's canonical gRPC method pipeline.
    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    pub async fn call_method_with_metadata(
        &self,
        plugin_id: &str,
        object_path: &str,
        interface_name: &str,
        method_name: &str,
        arguments: Vec<simd_json::OwnedValue>,
        actor_id: &str,
        capability_id: &str,
        identity: &GhostbridgeCallMetadata,
    ) -> Result<simd_json::OwnedValue, GrpcClientError> {
        let mut client = self
            .pool
            .plugin_service_client(&self.default_address)
            .await?;

        let arguments = arguments
            .iter()
            .map(simd_to_prost_value)
            .collect::<Vec<_>>();

        let mut request = Request::new(CallMethodRequest {
            plugin_id: plugin_id.to_string(),
            object_path: object_path.to_string(),
            interface_name: interface_name.to_string(),
            method_name: method_name.to_string(),
            arguments,
            actor_id: actor_id.to_string(),
            capability_id: capability_id.to_string(),
        });
        attach_plugin_identity_metadata(&mut request, identity, capability_id)?;

        let response = client
            .call_method(request)
            .await
            .map_err(|e| GrpcClientError::RequestFailed(e.to_string()))?;

        let resp = response.into_inner();
        if !resp.success {
            if let Some(err) = resp.error {
                return Err(GrpcClientError::RemoteError {
                    code: format!("{}", err.code),
                    message: err.message,
                });
            }
            return Err(GrpcClientError::RemoteError {
                code: "UNKNOWN".to_string(),
                message: "call failed".to_string(),
            });
        }

        if let Some(result) = resp.result {
            Ok(prost_value_to_simd(&result))
        } else {
            Ok(simd_json::json!(null))
        }
    }

    /// Acquire one fresh OIA1 assertion from the caller's explicit decoy
    /// issuer and forward it through the canonical metadata path.
    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    pub async fn call_method_via_decoy(
        &self,
        plugin_id: &str,
        object_path: &str,
        interface_name: &str,
        method_name: &str,
        arguments: Vec<simd_json::OwnedValue>,
        actor_id: &str,
        capability_id: &str,
        issuer: &DecoyAssertionClient,
    ) -> Result<simd_json::OwnedValue, GrpcClientError> {
        let identity = issuer.acquire().await.map_err(|error| {
            GrpcClientError::RequestFailed(format!("OIA1 assertion acquisition failed: {error:#}"))
        })?;
        self.call_method_with_metadata(
            plugin_id,
            object_path,
            interface_name,
            method_name,
            arguments,
            actor_id,
            capability_id,
            &identity,
        )
        .await
    }

    /// Subscribe to state updates from a remote endpoint
    pub async fn subscribe(
        &self,
        plugin_filters: Vec<String>,
        path_filters: Vec<String>,
        tag_filters: Vec<String>,
    ) -> Result<
        impl tokio_stream::Stream<Item = Result<StateUpdateMessage, GrpcClientError>>,
        GrpcClientError,
    > {
        self.subscribe_with_identity(
            plugin_filters,
            path_filters,
            tag_filters,
            &private_plugin_identity()?,
            None,
        )
        .await
    }

    /// Subscribe using one explicit authored caller credential. Private
    /// workspace subscriptions pass their exact capability; public projection
    /// subscriptions omit it. No service identity is substituted.
    pub async fn subscribe_with_identity(
        &self,
        plugin_filters: Vec<String>,
        path_filters: Vec<String>,
        tag_filters: Vec<String>,
        identity: &GhostbridgeCallMetadata,
        capability_id: Option<&str>,
    ) -> Result<
        impl tokio_stream::Stream<Item = Result<StateUpdateMessage, GrpcClientError>>,
        GrpcClientError,
    > {
        let mut client = self.pool.state_sync_client(&self.default_address).await?;

        let mut request = Request::new(SubscribeRequest {
            plugin_ids: plugin_filters,
            path_patterns: path_filters,
            tags: tag_filters,
            include_initial_state: true,
            include_schema: true,
        });
        attach_identity_metadata(&mut request, identity, capability_id)?;

        let response = client
            .subscribe(request)
            .await
            .map_err(|e| GrpcClientError::RequestFailed(e.to_string()))?;

        let stream = response.into_inner();

        Ok(tokio_stream::StreamExt::map(stream, |result| {
            result
                .map(state_update_message)
                .map_err(|e| GrpcClientError::StreamError(e.to_string()))
        }))
    }

    /// Subscribe to privileged audit metadata using this explicitly configured
    /// session's authored credential and existing snowball.read grant.
    pub async fn stream_events(
        &self,
        from_event_id: Option<u64>,
        plugin_filters: Vec<String>,
        tag_filters: Vec<String>,
    ) -> Result<
        impl tokio_stream::Stream<Item = Result<ChainEventMessage, GrpcClientError>>,
        GrpcClientError,
    > {
        self.stream_events_with_identity(
            from_event_id,
            plugin_filters,
            tag_filters,
            &private_plugin_identity()?,
        )
        .await
    }

    /// Forward an explicit caller credential; never substitute the service
    /// identity when adapting an authenticated outer request.
    pub async fn stream_events_with_identity(
        &self,
        from_event_id: Option<u64>,
        plugin_filters: Vec<String>,
        tag_filters: Vec<String>,
        identity: &GhostbridgeCallMetadata,
    ) -> Result<
        impl tokio_stream::Stream<Item = Result<ChainEventMessage, GrpcClientError>>,
        GrpcClientError,
    > {
        if plugin_filters.len() > 1 {
            return Err(GrpcClientError::RequestFailed(
                "audit subscription supports at most one plugin filter".into(),
            ));
        }
        let mut request = Request::new(SubscribeEventsRequest {
            from_event_id: from_event_id.unwrap_or_default(),
            plugin_id: plugin_filters.first().cloned().unwrap_or_default(),
            tags: tag_filters,
        });
        attach_plugin_identity_metadata(&mut request, identity, "snowball.read")?;

        let mut client = self.pool.event_chain_client(&self.default_address).await?;

        let response = client
            .subscribe_events(request)
            .await
            .map_err(|e| GrpcClientError::RequestFailed(e.to_string()))?;

        let stream = response.into_inner();

        Ok(tokio_stream::StreamExt::map(stream, |result| {
            result
                .map(|event| ChainEventMessage {
                    event_id: event.event_id.to_string(),
                    event_hash: event.event_hash,
                    prev_hash: event.prev_hash,
                    plugin_id: event.plugin_id,
                    operation_type: event.operation_type,
                    target: event.target,
                    decision: event.decision.to_string(),
                    tags_touched: event.tags_touched,
                })
                .map_err(|e| GrpcClientError::StreamError(e.to_string()))
        }))
    }
}

/// Result of a set state operation
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct SetStateResult {
    pub event_id: u64,
    pub effective_hash: String,
}

/// State update message from subscription
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct StateUpdateMessage {
    pub plugin_id: String,
    pub object_path: String,
    pub property_name: Option<String>,
    pub new_value: Option<simd_json::OwnedValue>,
    pub event_id: String,
    pub tags_touched: Vec<String>,
    pub change_type: i32,
    pub frame_kind: i32,
    pub schema_hash: String,
    pub catalog_hash: String,
    pub state_generation: u64,
}

fn state_update_message(update: crate::proto::StateChange) -> StateUpdateMessage {
    StateUpdateMessage {
        plugin_id: update.plugin_id,
        object_path: update.object_path,
        property_name: if update.member_name.is_empty() {
            None
        } else {
            Some(update.member_name)
        },
        new_value: update.new_value.as_ref().map(prost_value_to_simd),
        event_id: update.event_id.to_string(),
        tags_touched: update.tags_touched,
        change_type: update.change_type,
        frame_kind: update.frame_kind,
        schema_hash: update.schema_hash,
        catalog_hash: update.catalog_hash,
        state_generation: update.state_generation,
    }
}

/// Chain event message from event stream
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct ChainEventMessage {
    pub event_id: String,
    pub event_hash: String,
    pub prev_hash: String,
    pub plugin_id: String,
    pub operation_type: String,
    pub target: String,
    pub decision: String,
    pub tags_touched: Vec<String>,
}

/// Errors that can occur in gRPC client operations
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum GrpcClientError {
    ConnectionFailed(String),
    RequestFailed(String),
    StreamError(String),
    ParseError(String),
    RemoteError { code: String, message: String },
}

impl std::fmt::Display for GrpcClientError {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
        match self {
            Self::ConnectionFailed(msg) => write!(f, "Connection failed: {}", msg),
            Self::RequestFailed(msg) => write!(f, "Request failed: {}", msg),
            Self::StreamError(msg) => write!(f, "Stream error: {}", msg),
            Self::ParseError(msg) => write!(f, "Parse error: {}", msg),
            Self::RemoteError { code, message } => {
                write!(f, "Remote error [{}]: {}", code, message)
            }
        }
    }
}

impl std::error::Error for GrpcClientError {}

fn private_plugin_identity() -> Result<GhostbridgeCallMetadata, GrpcClientError> {
    let selector = std::env::var(op_identity::session_projection::SESSION_SELECTOR_ENV)
        .ok()
        .filter(|value| !value.trim().is_empty())
        .or_else(|| {
            std::env::var("IDENTITY_SLED_HOST_SESSION_ID")
                .ok()
                .filter(|value| !value.trim().is_empty())
        })
        .ok_or_else(|| {
            GrpcClientError::RequestFailed(
                "plugin calls require an explicitly configured identity session".into(),
            )
        })?;
    let identity =
        op_identity::resolve_identity_credential_session(Some(&selector)).map_err(|e| {
            GrpcClientError::RequestFailed(format!("private identity unavailable: {e}"))
        })?;
    let encoded = identity
        .sealed_id_header_for_transport("grpc")
        .map_err(|e| GrpcClientError::RequestFailed(format!("private SID1 unavailable: {e}")))?;
    let wire = base64::engine::general_purpose::URL_SAFE_NO_PAD
        .decode(encoded)
        .map_err(|e| {
            GrpcClientError::RequestFailed(format!("private SID1 is not canonical: {e}"))
        })?;
    Ok(GhostbridgeCallMetadata {
        sealed_id: Some(wire),
        oracle_assertion: None,
        session_genesis: None,
        trace_id: None,
        wireguard_pubkey: None,
    })
}

fn attach_plugin_identity_metadata<T>(
    request: &mut Request<T>,
    identity: &GhostbridgeCallMetadata,
    capability_id: &str,
) -> Result<(), GrpcClientError> {
    attach_identity_metadata(request, identity, Some(capability_id))
}

fn attach_identity_metadata<T>(
    request: &mut Request<T>,
    identity: &GhostbridgeCallMetadata,
    capability_id: Option<&str>,
) -> Result<(), GrpcClientError> {
    let validate_wire =
        |wire: &[u8], magic: &[u8; 4]| wire.len() <= 16 * 1024 && wire.starts_with(magic);
    match (
        identity.sealed_id.as_deref(),
        identity.oracle_assertion.as_deref(),
    ) {
        (Some(_), Some(_)) => {
            return Err(GrpcClientError::RequestFailed(
                "multiple identity credentials".into(),
            ))
        }
        (None, None) => {
            return Err(GrpcClientError::RequestFailed(
                "missing identity credential".into(),
            ))
        }
        (Some(wire), None) => {
            if !validate_wire(wire, b"SID1") {
                return Err(GrpcClientError::RequestFailed(
                    "invalid SID1 credential".into(),
                ));
            }
            request.metadata_mut().insert_bin(
                op_identity::sealed_id::HTTP_HEADER_NAME,
                MetadataValue::from_bytes(wire),
            )
        }
        (None, Some(wire)) => {
            if !validate_wire(wire, b"OIA1") {
                return Err(GrpcClientError::RequestFailed(
                    "invalid OIA1 credential".into(),
                ));
            }
            request.metadata_mut().insert_bin(
                "x-oracle-identity-assertion-bin",
                MetadataValue::from_bytes(wire),
            )
        }
    };
    if let Some(capability_id) = capability_id {
        if capability_id.is_empty() {
            return Err(GrpcClientError::RequestFailed(
                "capability metadata cannot be empty".into(),
            ));
        }
        request.metadata_mut().insert(
            "x-opdbus-capability",
            MetadataValue::try_from(capability_id).map_err(|e| {
                GrpcClientError::RequestFailed(format!("Invalid capability metadata: {e}"))
            })?,
        );
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn decode_get_state_response(
    response: GetStateResponse,
) -> Result<simd_json::OwnedValue, GrpcClientError> {
    if let Some(value) = response.value {
        validate_prost_value(&value)?;
        return Ok(prost_value_to_simd(&value));
    }
    if let Some(state) = response.state {
        for value in state.fields.values() {
            validate_prost_value(value)?;
        }
        return Ok(prost_struct_to_simd(&state));
    }
    Err(GrpcClientError::ParseError(
        "GetStateResponse omitted both value and legacy state payloads".into(),
    ))
}

fn validate_prost_value(value: &ProstValue) -> Result<(), GrpcClientError> {
    match value.kind.as_ref() {
        None => Err(GrpcClientError::ParseError(
            "protobuf value has no kind".into(),
        )),
        Some(ProstKind::NumberValue(number)) if !number.is_finite() => Err(
            GrpcClientError::ParseError("protobuf value contains a non-finite number".into()),
        ),
        Some(ProstKind::StructValue(object)) => {
            for nested in object.fields.values() {
                validate_prost_value(nested)?;
            }
            Ok(())
        }
        Some(ProstKind::ListValue(list)) => {
            for nested in &list.values {
                validate_prost_value(nested)?;
            }
            Ok(())
        }
        Some(_) => Ok(()),
    }
}

fn prost_value_to_simd(value: &ProstValue) -> simd_json::OwnedValue {
    let serde_value = prost_value_to_serde(value);
    simd_json::serde::to_owned_value(&serde_value).unwrap_or_else(|_| simd_json::json!(null))
}

fn prost_struct_to_simd(value: &ProstStruct) -> simd_json::OwnedValue {
    let serde_value = serde_json::Value::Object(
        value
            .fields
            .iter()
            .map(|(k, v)| (k.clone(), prost_value_to_serde(v)))
            .collect(),
    );
    simd_json::serde::to_owned_value(&serde_value).unwrap_or_else(|_| simd_json::json!(null))
}

fn prost_value_to_serde(value: &ProstValue) -> serde_json::Value {
    match &value.kind {
        None => serde_json::Value::Null,
        Some(ProstKind::NullValue(_)) => serde_json::Value::Null,
        Some(ProstKind::BoolValue(b)) => serde_json::Value::Bool(*b),
        Some(ProstKind::NumberValue(n)) => serde_json::Number::from_f64(*n)
            .map(serde_json::Value::Number)
            .unwrap_or(serde_json::Value::Null),
        Some(ProstKind::StringValue(s)) => serde_json::Value::String(s.clone()),
        Some(ProstKind::StructValue(s)) => serde_json::Value::Object(
            s.fields
                .iter()
                .map(|(k, v)| (k.clone(), prost_value_to_serde(v)))
                .collect(),
        ),
        Some(ProstKind::ListValue(l)) => {
            serde_json::Value::Array(l.values.iter().map(prost_value_to_serde).collect())
        }
    }
}

fn simd_to_prost_value(value: &simd_json::OwnedValue) -> ProstValue {
    let json = simd_json::to_string(value).unwrap_or_else(|_| "null".to_string());
    let serde_value: serde_json::Value =
        serde_json::from_str(&json).unwrap_or(serde_json::Value::Null);
    serde_to_prost_value(&serde_value)
}

fn serde_to_prost_value(value: &serde_json::Value) -> ProstValue {
    match value {
        serde_json::Value::Null => ProstValue {
            kind: Some(ProstKind::NullValue(0)),
        },
        serde_json::Value::Bool(b) => ProstValue {
            kind: Some(ProstKind::BoolValue(*b)),
        },
        serde_json::Value::Number(n) => ProstValue {
            kind: Some(ProstKind::NumberValue(n.as_f64().unwrap_or(0.0))),
        },
        serde_json::Value::String(s) => ProstValue {
            kind: Some(ProstKind::StringValue(s.clone())),
        },
        serde_json::Value::Array(arr) => ProstValue {
            kind: Some(ProstKind::ListValue(prost_types::ListValue {
                values: arr.iter().map(serde_to_prost_value).collect(),
            })),
        },
        serde_json::Value::Object(map) => ProstValue {
            kind: Some(ProstKind::StructValue(ProstStruct {
                fields: map
                    .iter()
                    .map(|(k, v)| (k.clone(), serde_to_prost_value(v)))
                    .collect(),
            })),
        },
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod identity_metadata_tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn plugin_metadata_forwards_exact_sid1_and_capability() {
        let wire = b"SID1-authored".to_vec();
        let identity = GhostbridgeCallMetadata {
            sealed_id: Some(wire.clone()),
            oracle_assertion: None,
            session_genesis: None,
            trace_id: None,
            wireguard_pubkey: None,
        };
        let mut request = Request::new(());
        attach_plugin_identity_metadata(&mut request, &identity, "router.invoke").unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            request
                .metadata()
                .get_bin(op_identity::sealed_id::HTTP_HEADER_NAME)
                .unwrap()
                .to_bytes()
                .unwrap(),
            wire.as_slice()
        );
        assert_eq!(
            request.metadata().get("x-opdbus-capability").unwrap(),
            "router.invoke"
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn plugin_metadata_rejects_missing_or_dual_credentials() {
        for identity in [
            GhostbridgeCallMetadata {
                sealed_id: None,
                oracle_assertion: None,
                session_genesis: None,
                trace_id: None,
                wireguard_pubkey: None,
            },
            GhostbridgeCallMetadata {
                sealed_id: Some(vec![1]),
                oracle_assertion: Some(vec![2]),
                session_genesis: None,
                trace_id: None,
                wireguard_pubkey: None,
            },
        ] {
            let mut request = Request::new(());
            assert!(attach_plugin_identity_metadata(&mut request, &identity, "x").is_err());
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn state_metadata_accepts_explicit_sid1_with_optional_exact_capability() {
        let identity = GhostbridgeCallMetadata {
            sealed_id: Some(b"SID1-authored-state-reader".to_vec()),
            oracle_assertion: None,
            session_genesis: None,
            trace_id: None,
            wireguard_pubkey: None,
        };
        let mut public = Request::new(GetStateRequest::default());
        attach_identity_metadata(&mut public, &identity, None).unwrap();
        assert!(public
            .metadata()
            .get_bin(op_identity::sealed_id::HTTP_HEADER_NAME)
            .is_some());
        assert!(public.metadata().get("x-opdbus-capability").is_none());

        let mut private = Request::new(SubscribeRequest::default());
        attach_identity_metadata(&mut private, &identity, Some("gemma.read")).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            private.metadata().get("x-opdbus-capability").unwrap(),
            "gemma.read"
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn state_metadata_rejects_malformed_multiple_and_empty_capability() {
        let malformed = GhostbridgeCallMetadata {
            sealed_id: Some(b"not-sid1".to_vec()),
            oracle_assertion: None,
            session_genesis: None,
            trace_id: None,
            wireguard_pubkey: None,
        };
        let mut request = Request::new(());
        assert!(attach_identity_metadata(&mut request, &malformed, None).is_err());

        let multiple = GhostbridgeCallMetadata {
            sealed_id: Some(b"SID1-one".to_vec()),
            oracle_assertion: Some(b"OIA1-two".to_vec()),
            session_genesis: None,
            trace_id: None,
            wireguard_pubkey: None,
        };
        let mut request = Request::new(());
        assert!(attach_identity_metadata(&mut request, &multiple, None).is_err());

        let valid = GhostbridgeCallMetadata {
            sealed_id: Some(b"SID1-one".to_vec()),
            oracle_assertion: None,
            session_genesis: None,
            trace_id: None,
            wireguard_pubkey: None,
        };
        let mut request = Request::new(());
        assert!(attach_identity_metadata(&mut request, &valid, Some("")).is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn get_state_prefers_exact_value_and_falls_back_to_legacy_object() {
        let scalar = GetStateResponse {
            value: Some(serde_to_prost_value(&serde_json::json!("leaf"))),
            state: Some(ProstStruct {
                fields: [(
                    "legacy".into(),
                    serde_to_prost_value(&serde_json::json!(true)),
                )]
                .into_iter()
                .collect(),
            }),
            ..Default::default()
        };
        assert_eq!(
            decode_get_state_response(scalar).unwrap(),
            simd_json::json!("leaf")
        );

        let array = GetStateResponse {
            value: Some(serde_to_prost_value(&serde_json::json!([1, 2, 3]))),
            ..Default::default()
        };
        assert_eq!(
            decode_get_state_response(array).unwrap(),
            // google.protobuf.Value numbers use the double-precision wire form.
            simd_json::json!([1.0, 2.0, 3.0])
        );

        let legacy = GetStateResponse {
            state: Some(ProstStruct {
                fields: [(
                    "legacy".into(),
                    serde_to_prost_value(&serde_json::json!(true)),
                )]
                .into_iter()
                .collect(),
            }),
            ..Default::default()
        };
        assert_eq!(
            decode_get_state_response(legacy).unwrap(),
            simd_json::json!({"legacy": true})
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn get_state_rejects_missing_or_malformed_payloads() {
        assert!(decode_get_state_response(GetStateResponse::default()).is_err());
        assert!(decode_get_state_response(GetStateResponse {
            value: Some(ProstValue { kind: None }),
            ..Default::default()
        })
        .is_err());
        assert!(decode_get_state_response(GetStateResponse {
            value: Some(ProstValue {
                kind: Some(ProstKind::NumberValue(f64::NAN)),
            }),
            ..Default::default()
        })
        .is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn subscription_conversion_preserves_state_and_contract_generations() {
        let message = state_update_message(crate::proto::StateChange {
            event_id: 17,
            plugin_id: "web_ui".into(),
            object_path: "/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/web_ui/page".into(),
            member_name: "spec".into(),
            new_value: Some(serde_to_prost_value(&serde_json::json!(["child"]))),
            tags_touched: vec!["ui".into()],
            change_type: 6,
            frame_kind: 2,
            schema_hash: "ab".repeat(32),
            catalog_hash: "cd".repeat(32),
            state_generation: 42,
            ..Default::default()
        });
        assert_eq!(message.event_id, "17");
        assert_eq!(message.property_name.as_deref(), Some("spec"));
        assert_eq!(message.new_value, Some(simd_json::json!(["child"])));
        assert_eq!(message.frame_kind, 2);
        assert_eq!(message.schema_hash, "ab".repeat(32));
        assert_eq!(message.catalog_hash, "cd".repeat(32));
        assert_eq!(message.state_generation, 42);
    }
}

/// Plugin schema provider.
///
/// The provider reads only from the sealed blob catalog. A blob in the
/// catalog IS the plugin; nothing else is a valid source of truth.
#[tonic::async_trait]
pub trait PluginSchemaProvider: Send + Sync {
    async fn list_plugins(&self) -> Vec<PluginInfo>;
    async fn get_schema(&self, plugin_id: &str) -> Option<(String, String, String)>;
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
struct SchemaMethodCapability {
    required_capability: String,
}

fn read_plugin_schema_json(plugin_id: &str) -> Option<JsonValue> {
    let catalog_dir = crate::sealed_schema_reader::blob_catalog_dir_from_env();
    let document =
        crate::sealed_schema_reader::read_manifest_pinned_schema_document(&catalog_dir, plugin_id)
            .ok()?;
    serde_json::from_str(&document.blob.schema_json).ok()
}

/// Request metadata key by which a caller declares the capability it is exercising.
///
/// `enforce_bridge_capability` requires the declaration to match the method's
/// `required_capability`; a mismatch or an absent header denies. This keeps the gRPC
/// check explicit: the caller states intent, carries an authenticated identity,
/// and that exact principal must be present in the independent grant store.
pub const DECLARED_CAPABILITY_HEADER: &str = "x-opdbus-capability";

fn method_capability_from_schema(
    schema: &JsonValue,
    method_name: &str,
) -> Option<SchemaMethodCapability> {
    let method = schema.get("methods")?.as_object()?.get(method_name)?;
    let required_capability = method
        .get("required_capability")?
        .as_str()?
        .trim()
        .to_string();
    if required_capability.is_empty() {
        return None;
    }
    Some(SchemaMethodCapability {
        required_capability,
    })
}

fn enforce_bridge_capability(
    plugin_id: &str,
    method_name: &str,
    capability_id: Option<&str>,
    identity: Option<&GhostbridgeIdentity>,
) -> Result<(), ProtoMutationError> {
    let schema = read_plugin_schema_json(plugin_id);
    enforce_bridge_capability_with_schema(
        schema.as_ref(),
        plugin_id,
        method_name,
        capability_id,
        identity,
    )
}

/// The decision half of [`enforce_bridge_capability`], split out so tests can
/// drive the gate against an explicit schema document; the production half
/// reads the sealed schema from the SHM blob catalog. Missing target schema,
/// method metadata, request identity, capability declaration, or exact grant
/// all deny. Embedded `PluginSchema.capability_grants` never confer runtime
/// authority.
pub(crate) fn enforce_bridge_capability_with_schema(
    schema: Option<&JsonValue>,
    plugin_id: &str,
    method_name: &str,
    capability_id: Option<&str>,
    identity: Option<&GhostbridgeIdentity>,
) -> Result<(), ProtoMutationError> {
    let method_capability = schema
        .and_then(|schema| method_capability_from_schema(schema, method_name))
        .ok_or_else(|| {
            capability_denied(
                plugin_id,
                method_name,
                capability_id,
                "authoritative method capability metadata is unavailable",
            )
        })?;
    let required = method_capability.required_capability;
    let identity = identity
        .filter(|identity| !identity.principal_id.is_empty() && !identity.session_id.is_empty())
        .ok_or_else(|| {
            capability_denied(
                plugin_id,
                method_name,
                Some(&required),
                "authenticated request identity is unavailable",
            )
        })?;
    let capability_matches = capability_id == Some(required.as_str());
    let principal_grants = load_capability_grants(&identity.principal_id).contains(&required);

    if capability_matches && principal_grants {
        Ok(())
    } else {
        Err(capability_denied(
            plugin_id,
            method_name,
            Some(&required),
            "matching request capability and exact-principal grant are required",
        ))
    }
}

#[allow(clippy::result_large_err)] // Preserve tonic status at the RPC boundary.
fn validate_generated_arguments(
    schema: &JsonValue,
    method_name: &str,
    args: &mut JsonValue,
) -> Result<(), Status> {
    let contract = schema
        .get("methods")
        .and_then(|methods| methods.get(method_name))
        .and_then(|method| method.get("args"))
        .ok_or_else(|| Status::failed_precondition("sealed method input schema is unavailable"))?;
    // A Rust unit input has a null JSON contract and an empty protobuf
    // message. Normalize only that exact case; other inputs retain their
    // required fields, nullability and domain constraints from the blob.
    if contract.get("type").and_then(JsonValue::as_str) == Some("null")
        && args.as_object().is_some_and(|object| object.is_empty())
    {
        *args = JsonValue::Null;
    }
    let validator = jsonschema::Validator::new(contract).map_err(|error| {
        Status::failed_precondition(format!("invalid sealed method input schema: {error}"))
    })?;
    validator.validate(args).map_err(|error| {
        Status::invalid_argument(format!(
            "arguments do not conform to {method_name}: {error}"
        ))
    })
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod generated_argument_tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn typed_requests_obey_sealed_constraints_and_unit_contracts() {
        let schema = serde_json::json!({"methods":{
            "configure":{"args":{"type":"object","required":["port","enabled"],"properties":{
                "port":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":65535},
                "enabled":{"type":"boolean"}
            }}},
            "list":{"args":{"type":"null"}}
        }});
        let mut valid = serde_json::json!({"port":443,"enabled":false});
        validate_generated_arguments(&schema, "configure", &mut valid).unwrap();
        let mut invalid = serde_json::json!({"port":0,"enabled":false});
        assert_eq!(
            validate_generated_arguments(&schema, "configure", &mut invalid)
                .unwrap_err()
                .code(),
            tonic::Code::InvalidArgument
        );
        let mut missing = serde_json::json!({"port":443});
        assert!(validate_generated_arguments(&schema, "configure", &mut missing).is_err());
        let mut empty = serde_json::json!({});
        validate_generated_arguments(&schema, "list", &mut empty).unwrap();
        assert!(empty.is_null());
        let mut supplied = serde_json::json!({"unexpected":true});
        assert!(validate_generated_arguments(&schema, "list", &mut supplied).is_err());
        assert!(validate_generated_arguments(&schema, "missing", &mut empty).is_err());
    }
}

fn capability_denied(
    plugin_id: &str,
    method_name: &str,
    capability: Option<&str>,
    detail: &str,
) -> ProtoMutationError {
    let capability = capability.unwrap_or("<undeclared>").to_string();
    ProtoMutationError {
        code: ProtoErrorCode::PermissionDenied as i32,
        message: format!(
            "AccessDenied: method {plugin_id}.{method_name} requires authoritative capability metadata and grant ({detail})"
        ),
        deny_reason: Some(ProtoDenyReason {
            reason: Some(crate::proto::deny_reason::Reason::CapabilityMissing(
                ProtoCapabilityMissing { capability },
            )),
        }),
    }
}

// tonic::Status is 176 bytes; Boxing the error would ripple through the
// shared bridge surface for zero runtime benefit, so the large Err is the
// deliberate disposition.
#[allow(clippy::result_large_err)]
pub(crate) fn authorize_schema_method(
    plugin_id: &str,
    method_name: &str,
    capability_id: Option<&str>,
    identity: Option<&GhostbridgeIdentity>,
) -> Result<(), Status> {
    enforce_bridge_capability(plugin_id, method_name, capability_id, identity)
        .map_err(|error| Status::permission_denied(error.message))
}

fn enforce_human_principal_self_service(
    plugin_id: &str,
    method_name: &str,
    args: &JsonValue,
    identity: Option<&crate::oracle_assertion::HumanPrincipalIdentity>,
) -> Result<(), ProtoMutationError> {
    if plugin_id != "human_principal" {
        return Ok(());
    }
    let Some(identity) = identity else {
        return Ok(());
    };
    let args = args
        .as_array()
        .and_then(|items| items.first())
        .unwrap_or(args);
    let authorized = match method_name {
        "register_key" | "revoke_key" => args
            .get("human_pubkey")
            .and_then(JsonValue::as_str)
            .is_none_or(|pubkey| pubkey == identity.human_pubkey),
        "set_alias" => args
            .get("principal_id")
            .and_then(JsonValue::as_str)
            .is_none_or(|principal_id| principal_id == identity.principal_id),
        _ => true,
    };
    if authorized {
        return Ok(());
    }
    Err(ProtoMutationError {
        code: ProtoErrorCode::PermissionDenied as i32,
        message: format!(
            "AccessDenied: human assertion may only mutate its own principal via \
             human_principal.{method_name}"
        ),
        deny_reason: Some(ProtoDenyReason {
            reason: Some(crate::proto::deny_reason::Reason::CapabilityMissing(
                ProtoCapabilityMissing {
                    capability: "human_principal.write:self".to_string(),
                },
            )),
        }),
    })
}

fn plugin_id_from_dbus_path(path: &str) -> Option<String> {
    let prefix = "/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/";
    path.strip_prefix(prefix)
        .and_then(|rest| rest.split('/').next())
        .filter(|id| !id.is_empty())
        .map(|id| id.replace('/', "."))
}

#[tonic::async_trait]
impl PluginSchemaProvider for SchemaCatalogPluginProvider {
    async fn list_plugins(&self) -> Vec<PluginInfo> {
        read_schema_catalog_plugins()
    }

    async fn get_schema(&self, plugin_id: &str) -> Option<(String, String, String)> {
        read_schema(plugin_id)
    }
}

struct SchemaCatalogPluginProvider;

fn read_schema_catalog_plugins() -> Vec<PluginInfo> {
    let directory = crate::sealed_schema_reader::blob_catalog_dir_from_env();
    let Ok(catalog) = crate::sealed_schema_reader::read_manifest_pinned_catalog(&directory) else {
        return Vec::new();
    };
    catalog
        .plugins
        .into_iter()
        .filter_map(|(id, document)| {
            let schema: JsonValue = serde_json::from_str(&document.blob.schema_json).ok()?;
            Some(plugin_info_from_schema(&id, &schema))
        })
        .collect()
}

fn read_schema(plugin_id: &str) -> Option<(String, String, String)> {
