<file path="op-grpc-bridge/src/mail_canonical_tests.rs">
//! Canonical mail admission, local D-Bus ownership and complete SHM folding.

use super::*;
use crate::human_principal_dispatch::tests::{
    pk, register, temp_cozo, temp_shm_with_schemas, test_engine,
};
use crate::identity_sled_dispatch::{tests::write_identity, IdentitySledStore};
use op_plugins::state_plugins::{
    human_principal::HumanPrincipalPlugin,
    identity_sled::IdentitySledPlugin,
    mail_server::{
        methods, native_owner::MailAdminService, native_owner::NativePaths, MailServerPlugin,
    },
    runtime_documents::RuntimeDocuments,
};
use op_state::StatePlugin;
use serde_json::{json, Value};
use std::sync::{
    atomic::{AtomicUsize, Ordering},
    Mutex as StdMutex,
};
use tokio::{
    io::{AsyncReadExt, AsyncWriteExt},
    net::UnixListener,
    sync::Notify,
};

struct Environment {
    values: Vec<(&'static str, Option<std::ffi::OsString>)>,
}

impl Environment {
    fn capture(keys: impl IntoIterator<Item = &'static str>) -> Self {
        Self {
            values: keys
                .into_iter()
                .map(|key| (key, std::env::var_os(key)))
                .collect(),
        }
    }
}

impl Drop for Environment {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        for (key, value) in &self.values {
            match value {
                Some(value) => std::env::set_var(key, value),
                None => std::env::remove_var(key),
            }
        }
    }
}

struct NativeFixture {
    root: tempfile::TempDir,
    paths: NativePaths,
    socket: std::path::PathBuf,
    accepted: Arc<AtomicUsize>,
    qmgr_requests: Arc<StdMutex<Vec<Vec<u8>>>>,
    qmgr_request: Arc<Notify>,
    tasks: Vec<tokio::task::JoinHandle<()>>,
}

impl Drop for NativeFixture {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        for task in &self.tasks {
            task.abort();
        }
    }
}

impl NativeFixture {
    async fn new() -> Self {
        let root = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let config = root.path().join("etc");
        let queue = root.path().join("queue");
        std::fs::create_dir_all(&config).unwrap();
        std::fs::create_dir_all(&queue).unwrap();
        let paths = NativePaths {
            domains: config.join("domains"),
            mailboxes: config.join("vmailbox"),
            aliases: config.join("virtual"),
            dovecot_users: config.join("users"),
            dovecot_users_gid: None,
            mail_root: root.path().join("mail"),
            mail_uid: None,
            mail_gid: None,
            showq_socket: queue.join("showq"),
            qmgr_socket: queue.join("qmgr"),
            postfix_master_pid: None,
        };
        std::fs::write(
            &paths.mailboxes,
            "owner@example.com example.com/owner/Maildir/\n",
        )
        .unwrap();
        std::fs::write(
            &paths.dovecot_users,
            "owner@example.com:{SHA512-CRYPT}$6$fixture::::::\n",
        )
        .unwrap();
        std::fs::write(&paths.aliases, "").unwrap();

        let showq = UnixListener::bind(&paths.showq_socket).unwrap();
        let showq_task = tokio::spawn(async move {
            let response = b"protocol\0mail_queue_list_protocol\0\0queue_name\0deferred\0queue_id\0Q1\0time\x001700000000\0size\x001234\0forced_expire\x000\0sender\0sender@example.net\0original_recipient\0\0recipient\0owner@example.com\0log_class\0defer\0reason\0temporary failure\0\0\0";
            while let Ok((mut stream, _)) = showq.accept().await {
                let _ = stream.write_all(response).await;
                let _ = stream.shutdown().await;
            }
        });

        let qmgr = UnixListener::bind(&paths.qmgr_socket).unwrap();
        let qmgr_requests = Arc::new(StdMutex::new(Vec::new()));
        let requests = qmgr_requests.clone();
        let qmgr_request = Arc::new(Notify::new());
        let request_ready = qmgr_request.clone();
        let qmgr_task = tokio::spawn(async move {
            while let Ok((mut stream, _)) = qmgr.accept().await {
                let mut request = Vec::new();
                let _ = stream.read_to_end(&mut request).await;
                requests.lock().unwrap().push(request);
                request_ready.notify_one();
            }
        });

        let service = MailAdminService::new(
            RuntimeDocuments::new(op_cozo_store::CozoGraphShuttle::new_in_memory().unwrap()),
            paths.clone(),
        );
        service.adopt_or_reconcile().await.unwrap();

        let socket = root.path().join("admin.sock");
        let listener = UnixListener::bind(&socket).unwrap();
        let accepted = Arc::new(AtomicUsize::new(0));
        let accepted_connections = accepted.clone();
        let dbus_task = tokio::spawn(async move {
            while let Ok((stream, _)) = listener.accept().await {
                accepted_connections.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst);
                let service = service.clone();
                tokio::spawn(async move {
                    let connection = zbus::connection::Builder::unix_stream(stream)
                        .server(zbus::Guid::generate())
                        .unwrap()
                        .p2p()
                        .serve_at(methods::OBJECT_PATH, service)
                        .unwrap()
                        .build()
                        .await
                        .unwrap();
                    connection.closed().await;
                });
            }
        });

        Self {
            root,
            paths,
            socket,
            accepted,
            qmgr_requests,
            qmgr_request,
            tasks: vec![showq_task, qmgr_task, dbus_task],
        }
    }

    async fn wait_for_flush(&self) {
        if self.qmgr_requests.lock().unwrap().is_empty() {
            tokio::time::timeout(
                std::time::Duration::from_secs(3),
                self.qmgr_request.notified(),
            )
            .await
            .expect("qmgr fixture received flush request");
        }
    }
}

fn validate_json(schema: &impl serde::Serialize, value: &Value) {
    let schema = serde_json::to_value(schema).unwrap();
    jsonschema::Validator::new(&schema)
        .unwrap()
        .validate(value)
        .unwrap();
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn all_nine_mail_methods_cross_mutation_engine_dbus_and_commit_complete_state() {
    let _cozo = temp_cozo();
    let schema = MailServerPlugin::new().schema().unwrap();
    let _shm = temp_shm_with_schemas(&[
        HumanPrincipalPlugin::new().schema().unwrap(),
        IdentitySledPlugin::new().schema().unwrap(),
        schema.clone(),
    ]);
    let engine = test_engine();
    engine
        .install_identity_sled_store_for_test(IdentitySledStore::new(
            op_cozo_store::CozoGraphShuttle::new_in_memory().unwrap(),
        ))
        .unwrap();

    let public_key = pk(0xDA);
    register(&public_key, "mail-fixture").await.unwrap();
    let identity = write_identity(&engine, &public_key).await.unwrap();
    let principal = op_identity::session::derive_principal_id(&public_key);

    let fixture = NativeFixture::new().await;
    let grant_path = fixture.root.path().join("grants.json");
    let _environment = Environment::capture(["OP_GRANTS_PATH", "OP_MAIL_ADMIN_SOCKET"]);
    std::env::set_var("OP_GRANTS_PATH", &grant_path);
    std::env::set_var("OP_MAIL_ADMIN_SOCKET", &fixture.socket);
    let capabilities = schema
        .methods
        .values()
        .filter_map(|method| method.required_capability.clone())
        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
    assert_eq!(schema.methods.len(), 9);
    std::fs::write(
        &grant_path,
        serde_json::to_vec(&json!({(principal.clone()): {"capabilities":capabilities}})).unwrap(),
    )
    .unwrap();

    let mut initial = MailServerPlugin::declared_state();
    initial.container_name = "fixture-mail".into();
    initial.container_status = "Running".into();
    initial.domain = "preserved.example".into();
    initial.healthy = true;
    engine
        .publish_plugin_projection_state(
            "mail_server",
            simd_json::serde::to_owned_value(serde_json::to_value(&initial).unwrap()).unwrap(),
            ChangeType::PropertySet,
            true,
        )
        .await
        .unwrap();
    let before = op_core::projection_shm::read_projection_bytes("mail_server").unwrap();

    let read_capability = schema.methods["get_queue"].required_capability.as_deref();
    assert!(engine
        .dispatch_method_call_with_identity(
            "mail_server",
            "get_queue",
            "{}",
            read_capability,
            &principal,
            None,
            None,
        )
        .await
        .is_err());
    assert_eq!(fixture.accepted.load(Ordering::SeqCst), 0);
    assert_eq!(
        op_core::projection_shm::read_projection_bytes("mail_server").unwrap(),
        before
    );

    let calls = [
        ("add_domain", json!({"domain":"example.net"})),
        (
            "add_mailbox",
            json!({"domain":"example.net","user":"alice","password_hash":"{SHA512-CRYPT}$6$fixture"}),
        ),
        (
            "set_quota",
            json!({"domain":"example.net","user":"alice","quota_mb":256}),
        ),
        (
            "add_alias",
            json!({"domain":"example.net","alias":"info","destination":"alice@example.net"}),
        ),
        ("get_queue", json!({})),
        ("flush_queue", json!({})),
        (
            "remove_alias",
            json!({"domain":"example.net","alias":"info"}),
        ),
        (
            "remove_mailbox",
            json!({"domain":"example.net","user":"alice"}),
        ),
        ("remove_domain", json!({"domain":"example.net"})),
    ];
    for (method, arguments) in calls {
        let declaration = &schema.methods[method];
        validate_json(&declaration.args, &arguments);
        let response = engine
            .dispatch_method_call_with_identity(
                "mail_server",
                method,
                &arguments.to_string(),
                declaration.required_capability.as_deref(),
                &principal,
                Some(&identity.session_id),
                identity.genesis.as_deref(),
            )
            .await
            .unwrap_or_else(|error| panic!("mail_server.{method}: {error:#}"));
        validate_json(declaration.returns.as_ref().unwrap(), &response["result"]);

        let bytes = op_core::projection_shm::read_projection_bytes("mail_server").unwrap();
        let state: Value = serde_json::from_slice(&bytes).unwrap();
        let mut exact_bytes = bytes.clone();
        let exact = simd_json::to_owned_value(&mut exact_bytes).unwrap();
        schema.validate_exact_schema_fields(&exact).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(state["container_name"], "fixture-mail");
        assert_eq!(state["container_status"], "Running");
        assert_eq!(state["domain"], "preserved.example");
        assert_eq!(state["healthy"], true);
        assert!(state["administration"]["domains"]
            .as_array()
            .unwrap()
            .contains(&json!("example.com")));
        let administration = &state["administration"];
        match method {
            "add_domain" => assert!(administration["domains"]
                .as_array()
                .unwrap()
                .contains(&json!("example.net"))),
            "add_mailbox" => assert!(administration["mailboxes"]
                .as_array()
                .unwrap()
                .iter()
                .any(|mailbox| mailbox["address"] == "alice@example.net")),
            "set_quota" => {
                assert!(administration["mailboxes"]
                    .as_array()
                    .unwrap()
                    .iter()
                    .any(|mailbox| {
                        mailbox["address"] == "alice@example.net"
                            && mailbox["quota_bytes"] == 256 * 1024 * 1024
                    }))
            }
            "add_alias" => {
                assert!(administration["aliases"]
                    .as_array()
                    .unwrap()
                    .iter()
                    .any(|alias| {
                        alias["address"] == "info@example.net"
                            && alias["destination"] == "alice@example.net"
                    }))
            }
            "get_queue" => {
                assert_eq!(response["result"]["summary"]["messages"], 1);
                assert_eq!(response["result"]["entries"][0]["queue_id"], "Q1");
            }
            "flush_queue" => assert_eq!(response["result"]["accepted"], true),
            "remove_alias" => assert!(administration["aliases"]
                .as_array()
                .unwrap()
                .iter()
                .all(|alias| alias["address"] != "info@example.net")),
            "remove_mailbox" => assert!(administration["mailboxes"]
                .as_array()
                .unwrap()
                .iter()
                .all(|mailbox| mailbox["address"] != "alice@example.net")),
            "remove_domain" => assert!(!administration["domains"]
                .as_array()
                .unwrap()
                .contains(&json!("example.net"))),
            _ => unreachable!("fixture lists every canonical mail method"),
        }
    }

    fixture.wait_for_flush().await;
    assert_eq!(fixture.accepted.load(Ordering::SeqCst), 9);
    assert_eq!(
        fixture.qmgr_requests.lock().unwrap().as_slice(),
        [b"FADI\0"]
    );
    let final_state: Value = serde_json::from_slice(
        &op_core::projection_shm::read_projection_bytes("mail_server").unwrap(),
    )
    .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        final_state["administration"]["domains"],
        json!(["example.com"])
    );
    assert_eq!(
        final_state["administration"]["mailboxes"]
            .as_array()
            .unwrap()
            .len(),
        1
    );
    assert_eq!(
        final_state["administration"]["mailboxes"][0]["address"],
        "owner@example.com"
    );
    assert_eq!(final_state["administration"]["aliases"], json!([]));
    assert_eq!(final_state["administration"]["queue"]["messages"], 1);
    assert_eq!(final_state["administration"]["queue"]["bytes"], 1234);

    assert_eq!(
        std::fs::read_to_string(&fixture.paths.domains).unwrap(),
        "example.com\tOK\n"
    );
    assert_eq!(
        std::fs::read_to_string(&fixture.paths.mailboxes).unwrap(),
        "owner@example.com\texample.com/owner/Maildir/\n"
    );
    assert_eq!(std::fs::read_to_string(&fixture.paths.aliases).unwrap(), "");
    assert_eq!(
        std::fs::read_to_string(&fixture.paths.dovecot_users).unwrap(),
        "owner@example.com:{SHA512-CRYPT}$6$fixture::::::\n"
    );
    assert!(fixture
        .paths
        .mail_root
        .join("example.net/alice/Maildir")
        .is_dir());
}
</file>

<file path="op-grpc-bridge/src/mcp_config_dispatch_tests.rs">
use crate::{
    human_principal_dispatch::tests::{
        pk, register, temp_cozo, temp_shm_with_schemas, test_engine,
    },
    identity_sled_dispatch::{tests::write_identity, IdentitySledStore},
    tched_router_runtime::TchedRouterRuntimeClient,
};
use op_state::StatePlugin;
use serde_json::json;
use std::{
    sync::{
        atomic::{AtomicUsize, Ordering},
        Arc,
    },
    time::Duration,
};

struct Environment(Vec<(&'static str, Option<std::ffi::OsString>)>);
impl Drop for Environment {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        for (key, value) in &self.0 {
            match value {
                Some(value) => std::env::set_var(key, value),
                None => std::env::remove_var(key),
            }
        }
    }
}

fn write_grants(path: &std::path::Path, actor: &str, allowed: bool) {
    let capabilities = if allowed {
        vec!["mcp.write"]
    } else {
        Vec::<&str>::new()
    };
    std::fs::write(
        path,
        serde_json::to_vec(&json!({(actor.to_owned()):{"capabilities":capabilities}})).unwrap(),
    )
    .unwrap();
}

fn toolset_input(expected_generation: u64) -> serde_json::Value {
    json!({
        "expected_generation":expected_generation,
        "toolsets":[{
            "id":"broker_ops",
            "temperature":"warm",
            "provider":"emqx",
            "requires_provider_health":true,
            "tools":["plugin.emqx.get_status"]
        }]
    })
}

async fn call_tool_groups(
    engine: &crate::mutation_engine::MutationEngine,
    actor: &str,
    session: &str,
    genesis: Option<&str>,
    input: serde_json::Value,
) -> anyhow::Result<serde_json::Value> {
    engine
        .dispatch_method_call_with_identity(
            "mcp",
            "configure_tool_groups",
            &input.to_string(),
            Some("mcp.write"),
            actor,
            Some(session),
            genesis,
        )
        .await
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn canonical_tool_group_dispatch_commits_file_live_owner_and_member_projection() {
    use crate::mcp_policy::{
        AudiencePolicy, McpPolicyOwner, McpProjectionPolicy, ToolsetManifest, HOT_TOOL_NAMES,
    };
    use op_plugins::state_plugins::{
        emqx::EmqxPlugin, human_principal::HumanPrincipalPlugin, identity_sled::IdentitySledPlugin,
        mcp::McpStatePlugin,
    };

    let _cozo = temp_cozo();
    let mcp = McpStatePlugin::new(Arc::new(op_state_store::MemoryStore::new()), "unused")
        .schema()
        .unwrap();
    let _shm = temp_shm_with_schemas(&[
        HumanPrincipalPlugin::new().schema().unwrap(),
        IdentitySledPlugin::new().schema().unwrap(),
        EmqxPlugin::new().schema().unwrap(),
        mcp.clone(),
    ]);
    let engine = test_engine();
    engine
        .install_identity_sled_store_for_test(IdentitySledStore::new(
            op_cozo_store::CozoGraphShuttle::new_in_memory().unwrap(),
        ))
        .unwrap();
    let key = pk(0xE9);
    register(&key, "mcp-policy-fixture").await.unwrap();
    let sled = write_identity(&engine, &key).await.unwrap();
    let actor = op_identity::session::derive_principal_id(&key);
    let directory = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let grants = directory.path().join("grants.json");
    let toolsets_path = directory.path().join("toolsets.json");
    let listener = tokio::net::TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").await.unwrap();
    let _environment = Environment(
        [
            "OP_GRANTS_PATH",
            "TCHED_ROUTER_RUNTIME_ENDPOINT",
            "TCHED_ROUTER_RUNTIME_TOKEN",
        ]
        .into_iter()
        .map(|name| (name, std::env::var_os(name)))
        .collect(),
    );
    std::env::set_var("OP_GRANTS_PATH", &grants);
    std::env::set_var(
        "TCHED_ROUTER_RUNTIME_ENDPOINT",
        format!("http://{}", listener.local_addr().unwrap()),
    );
    std::env::remove_var("TCHED_ROUTER_RUNTIME_TOKEN");
    write_grants(&grants, &actor, true);
    let owner = McpPolicyOwner::for_durable_fixture(
        McpProjectionPolicy {
            audience: AudiencePolicy {
                version: 1,
                rotation_epoch: 1,
                singleton_chatbot_principal_id: "87b0decc-8464-5abf-05d8-b52ec88ff9f1".into(),
            },
            toolsets: ToolsetManifest {
                generation: 1,
                hot: HOT_TOOL_NAMES.iter().map(|name| (*name).into()).collect(),
                sets: vec![],
            },
        },
        toolsets_path.clone(),
        crate::sealed_schema_reader::blob_catalog_dir_from_env(),
    )
    .unwrap();
    engine.install_mcp_policy_owner(owner.clone()).unwrap();

    let first = call_tool_groups(
        &engine,
        &actor,
        &sled.session_id,
        sled.genesis.as_deref(),
        toolset_input(1),
    )
    .await
    .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(first["result"]["generation"], 2);
    assert_eq!(owner.snapshot().toolsets.generation, 2);
    let durable: ToolsetManifest =
        serde_json::from_slice(&std::fs::read(&toolsets_path).unwrap()).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(durable.generation, 2);
    let fresh = op_core::projection_shm::read_projection_bytes("mcp").unwrap();
    let fresh: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_slice(&fresh).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(fresh["toolsets"], first["result"]);
    assert!(fresh.get("config").is_none());

    let pin = crate::sealed_schema_reader::read_manifest_pinned_schema_document(
        &crate::sealed_schema_reader::blob_catalog_dir_from_env(),
        "mcp",
    )
    .unwrap();
    engine
        .process_observed_state(
            "mcp",
            simd_json::serde::to_owned_value(json!({
                "config":{"enabled":true,"deferred_loading":true,"servers":[]},
                "toolsets":first["result"].clone()
            }))
            .unwrap(),
            pin.schema_hash,
        )
        .await
        .unwrap();
    let second = call_tool_groups(
        &engine,
        &actor,
        &sled.session_id,
        sled.genesis.as_deref(),
        toolset_input(2),
    )
    .await
    .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(second["result"]["generation"], 3);
    let projected = op_core::projection_shm::read_projection_bytes("mcp").unwrap();
    let projected: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_slice(&projected).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(projected["config"]["deferred_loading"], true);
    assert_eq!(projected["toolsets"], second["result"]);

    let before_file = std::fs::read(&toolsets_path).unwrap();
    let before_state = op_core::projection_shm::read_projection_bytes("mcp").unwrap();
    assert!(call_tool_groups(
        &engine,
        &actor,
        &sled.session_id,
        sled.genesis.as_deref(),
        toolset_input(1),
    )
    .await
    .is_err());
    assert_eq!(std::fs::read(&toolsets_path).unwrap(), before_file);
    assert_eq!(owner.snapshot().toolsets.generation, 3);
    assert_eq!(
        op_core::projection_shm::read_projection_bytes("mcp").unwrap(),
        before_state
    );

    write_grants(&grants, &actor, true);
    let held = owner.begin_mutation().await;
    let queued_attempt = owner.mutation_attempts() + 1;
    let queued_engine = engine.clone();
    let queued_actor = actor.clone();
    let queued_session = sled.session_id.clone();
    let queued_genesis = sled.genesis.clone();
    let queued = tokio::spawn(async move {
        call_tool_groups(
            &queued_engine,
            &queued_actor,
            &queued_session,
            queued_genesis.as_deref(),
            toolset_input(3),
        )
        .await
    });
    tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(5), async {
        while owner.mutation_attempts() < queued_attempt {
            tokio::task::yield_now().await;
        }
    })
    .await
    .expect("queued method must pass initial admission and reach the owner lock");
    write_grants(&grants, &actor, false);
    drop(held);
    assert!(queued.await.unwrap().is_err());
    assert_eq!(std::fs::read(&toolsets_path).unwrap(), before_file);
    assert_eq!(owner.snapshot().toolsets.generation, 3);
    assert_eq!(
        op_core::projection_shm::read_projection_bytes("mcp").unwrap(),
        before_state
    );
    assert!(
        tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_millis(50), listener.accept())
            .await
            .is_err()
    );
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn queued_mcp_configuration_rechecks_both_original_grants_and_facade_seal() {
    use op_plugins::state_plugins::{
        human_principal::HumanPrincipalPlugin, identity_sled::IdentitySledPlugin,
        mcp::McpStatePlugin, tched_router::TchedRouterPlugin,
    };
    let _cozo = temp_cozo();
    let mcp = McpStatePlugin::new(Arc::new(op_state_store::MemoryStore::new()), "unused")
        .schema()
        .unwrap();
    let router = TchedRouterPlugin::new().schema().unwrap();
    let _shm = temp_shm_with_schemas(&[
        HumanPrincipalPlugin::new().schema().unwrap(),
        IdentitySledPlugin::new().schema().unwrap(),
        mcp.clone(),
        router.clone(),
    ]);
    let engine = test_engine();
    engine
        .install_identity_sled_store_for_test(IdentitySledStore::new(
            op_cozo_store::CozoGraphShuttle::new_in_memory().unwrap(),
        ))
        .unwrap();
    let key = pk(0xE8);
    register(&key, "mcp-queued-fixture").await.unwrap();
    let sled = write_identity(&engine, &key).await.unwrap();
    let actor = op_identity::session::derive_principal_id(&key);
    let target_cap = router.methods["PatchConfig"]
        .required_capability
        .clone()
        .unwrap();
    let directory = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let grants = directory.path().join("grants.json");
    let _environment = Environment(
        [
            "OP_GRANTS_PATH",
            "TCHED_ROUTER_RUNTIME_ENDPOINT",
            "TCHED_ROUTER_RUNTIME_TOKEN",
        ]
        .into_iter()
        .map(|key| (key, std::env::var_os(key)))
        .collect(),
    );
    std::env::set_var("OP_GRANTS_PATH", &grants);
    std::env::remove_var("TCHED_ROUTER_RUNTIME_TOKEN");
    let effects = Arc::new(AtomicUsize::new(0));
    let observed = effects.clone();
    let listener = tokio::net::TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").await.unwrap();
    std::env::set_var(
        "TCHED_ROUTER_RUNTIME_ENDPOINT",
        format!("http://{}", listener.local_addr().unwrap()),
    );
    let http = tokio::spawn(async move {
        let app = axum::Router::new().fallback(axum::routing::any(move || {
            observed.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst);
            async { axum::http::StatusCode::OK }
        }));
        axum::serve(listener, app).await.unwrap();
    });
    for scenario in ["outer_grant", "target_grant", "outer_seal"] {
        let write_grants = |missing: Option<&str>| {
            let allowed = ["mcp.write", target_cap.as_str()]
                .into_iter()
                .filter(|cap| Some(*cap) != missing)
                .collect::<Vec<_>>();
            std::fs::write(
                &grants,
                serde_json::to_vec(&json!({(actor.clone()):{"capabilities":allowed}})).unwrap(),
            )
            .unwrap();
        };
        write_grants(None);
        let mut sealer =
            op_blob::BlobStore::open(crate::sealed_schema_reader::blob_catalog_dir_from_env())
                .unwrap();
        sealer
            .write(&op_blob::blobify_plugin_schema("mcp", mcp.clone()))
            .unwrap();
        let guard = TchedRouterRuntimeClient::selection_guard().await;
        let mut changes = engine.change_tx().subscribe();
        let queued = engine.clone();
        let queued_actor = actor.clone();
        let session = sled.session_id.clone();
        let genesis = sled.genesis.clone();
        let task = tokio::spawn(async move {
            queued.dispatch_method_call_with_identity(
                "mcp", "configure_server", &json!({"operations":[{
                    "op":"replace","path":"/mcp/servers/docs/url","value":"https://docs.example.test/mcp"
                }]}).to_string(), Some("mcp.write"), &queued_actor, Some(&session), genesis.as_deref(),
            ).await
        });
        tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(10), async {
            loop {
                let event = changes.recv().await.unwrap();
                if event.plugin_id == "tched_router"
                    && event.member_name.as_deref() == Some("PatchConfig")
                {
                    break;
                }
            }
        })
        .await
        .expect("canonical nested target must enter before changing admission");
        match scenario {
            "outer_grant" => write_grants(Some("mcp.write")),
            "target_grant" => write_grants(Some(&target_cap)),
            _ => {
                let mut changed = mcp.clone();
                changed.description.push_str(" changed while queued");
                sealer
                    .write(&op_blob::blobify_plugin_schema("mcp", changed))
                    .unwrap();
            }
        }
        drop(guard);
        assert!(
            tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(10), task)
                .await
                .unwrap()
                .unwrap()
                .is_err(),
            "{scenario}"
        );
        assert_eq!(effects.load(Ordering::SeqCst), 0, "{scenario}");
    }
    http.abort();
}
</file>

<file path="op-grpc-bridge/src/mcp_config_dispatch.rs">
//! MCP server configuration reuses the native router owner. Public gateway
//! toolsets use the one root-protected policy file and the live gateway owner.
//! Original admission is retained until each guarded effect commits.

use anyhow::{Context, Result};
use op_plugins::state_plugins::mcp::methods::{complete_method, plan_method};
use op_plugins::state_plugins::mcp::ConfigureToolGroupsInput;
use op_state_store::PluginSchema;
use serde_json::Value;

use crate::{
    interceptor::load_capability_grants,
    method_contract_admission,
    mutation_engine::MutationEngine,
    project_dispatch,
    sealed_schema_reader::{blob_catalog_dir_from_env, read_manifest_pinned_schema_document},
    tched_router_admission::FacadeOrigin,
};

async fn configure_tool_groups(
    engine: &MutationEngine,
    args: &Value,
    actor: &str,
    session: &str,
    genesis: Option<&str>,
    admitted: &PluginSchema,
    capability: &str,
) -> Result<Value> {
    let input: ConfigureToolGroupsInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())
        .context("invalid mcp.configure_tool_groups arguments")?;
    let pinned = read_manifest_pinned_schema_document(&blob_catalog_dir_from_env(), "mcp")?;
    method_contract_admission::admit_compiled_state_contract(&pinned, "mcp")?;
    anyhow::ensure!(
        serde_json::to_value(&pinned.schema)? == serde_json::to_value(admitted)?,
        "admitted MCP schema differs from current sealed plugin"
    );
    let pin_hash = pinned.schema_hash;
    let pin_json = pinned.blob.schema_json;
    let owner = engine.mcp_policy_owner()?;
    let mutation = owner.begin_mutation().await;

    project_dispatch::verified_session(engine, actor, Some(session), genesis).await?;
    anyhow::ensure!(
        load_capability_grants(actor).contains(capability),
        "current exact MCP facade capability grant is required"
    );
    let current = read_manifest_pinned_schema_document(&blob_catalog_dir_from_env(), "mcp")?;
    method_contract_admission::admit_compiled_state_contract(&current, "mcp")?;
    anyhow::ensure!(
        current.schema_hash == pin_hash && current.blob.schema_json == pin_json,
        "MCP plugin seal changed during policy update"
    );

    let output = mutation.configure(input)?;
    engine
        .publish_mcp_toolsets(&output, &pin_hash)
        .await
        .context("MCP policy committed and activated but projection publication failed")?;
    drop(mutation);
    Ok(serde_json::to_value(output)?)
}

#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
pub(crate) fn dispatch<'a>(
    engine: &'a MutationEngine,
    method: &'a str,
    args: &'a Value,
    actor: &'a str,
    session: Option<&'a str>,
    genesis: Option<&'a str>,
    admitted: &'a PluginSchema,
) -> futures::future::BoxFuture<'a, Result<Value>> {
    Box::pin(async move {
        let outer = admitted
            .methods
            .get(method)
            .context("MCP method declaration absent")?;
        let requirement = admitted.resolve_method_capability(outer);
        let capability = requirement.capability().to_owned();
        anyhow::ensure!(
            load_capability_grants(actor).contains(&capability),
            "exact MCP facade capability grant is required"
        );
        let session = project_dispatch::verified_session(engine, actor, session, genesis).await?;
        if method == "configure_tool_groups" {
            return configure_tool_groups(
                engine,
                args,
                actor,
                &session,
                genesis,
                admitted,
                &capability,
            )
            .await;
        }
        let plan = plan_method(method, args)?;
        let target = method_contract_admission::admit_compiled_method(
            "tched_router",
            plan.target_method,
            Some(&plan.required_capability),
        )?;
        method_contract_admission::validate_admitted_arguments(&target, &plan.args)?;
        anyhow::ensure!(
            load_capability_grants(actor).contains(&plan.required_capability),
            "exact nested router configuration grant is required"
        );
        let origin = FacadeOrigin {
            plugin: "mcp",
            method: method.to_owned(),
            target_plugin: "tched_router",
            target_method: plan.target_method,
            admitted: admitted.clone(),
            capability,
        };
        let input = serde_json::to_string(&plan.args)?;
        let result = engine
            .dispatch_method_call_with_facade_origin(
                "tched_router",
                plan.target_method,
                &input,
                Some(&plan.required_capability),
                actor,
                Some(&session),
                genesis,
                origin,
            )
            .await?;
        complete_method(
            method,
            result
                .get("result")
                .cloned()
                .context("router domain result absent")?,
        )
    })
}
