<file path="op-grpc-bridge/src/notebooklm_queries.rs">
//! Bounded asynchronous NotebookLM queries behind canonical method admission.
//! IDs are private to the exact verified principal and session. Results are
//! process-local, expire after 30 minutes, and never enter public projections.
use anyhow::{Context, Result};
use op_plugins::state_plugins::notebooklm::{
    outputs::{
        NotebookQueryFailure, NotebookQueryStartOutput, NotebookQueryState,
        NotebookQueryStatusOutput,
    },
    provider_outputs::NotebookQueryOutput,
    NotebookQueryInput,
};
use std::{
    collections::HashMap,
    future::Future,
    sync::Arc,
    time::{Duration, Instant},
};
use tokio::sync::{oneshot, Mutex, Semaphore};

const RETENTION: Duration = Duration::from_secs(1800);
const MAX_JOBS: usize = 64;
const MAX_SESSION_JOBS: usize = 8;
const MAX_RESULT_BYTES: usize = 1024 * 1024;

type QueryResult = std::result::Result<NotebookQueryOutput, NotebookQueryFailure>;

struct Job {
    principal: String,
    session: String,
    notebook_id: String,
    expires: Instant,
    expires_at: i64,
    receiver: Option<oneshot::Receiver<QueryResult>>,
    result: Option<QueryResult>,
}

pub(crate) struct NotebookQueries {
    jobs: Mutex<HashMap<String, Job>>,
    active: Arc<Semaphore>,
}

impl Default for NotebookQueries {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            jobs: Mutex::new(HashMap::new()),
            active: Arc::new(Semaphore::new(8)),
        }
    }
}

impl NotebookQueries {
    pub(crate) fn prepare(
        input: &NotebookQueryInput,
        selected: Option<&str>,
    ) -> Result<(String, Duration)> {
        anyhow::ensure!(
            !input.question.trim().is_empty() && input.question.len() <= 64 * 1024,
            "question must contain 1 to 65536 bytes"
        );
        let notebook = input
            .notebook_id
            .as_deref()
            .or(selected)
            .context("notebook_id or a selected notebook is required")?;
        anyhow::ensure!(
            uuid::Uuid::parse_str(notebook)?.to_string() == notebook,
            "notebook_id must be a canonical UUID"
        );
        let timeout = input.timeout.unwrap_or(660);
        anyhow::ensure!(
            (1..=900).contains(&timeout),
            "query timeout must be between 1 and 900 seconds"
        );
        Ok((notebook.to_owned(), Duration::from_secs(timeout)))
    }

    pub(crate) async fn start<F>(
        &self,
        principal: &str,
        session: &str,
        notebook_id: String,
        timeout: Duration,
        query: F,
    ) -> Result<NotebookQueryStartOutput>
    where
        F: Future<Output = Result<serde_json::Value>> + Send + 'static,
    {
        anyhow::ensure!(
            !principal.is_empty() && !session.is_empty(),
            "verified query owner is required"
        );
        let permit = self
            .active
            .clone()
            .try_acquire_owned()
            .context("NotebookLM query capacity is exhausted")?;
        let mut jobs = self.jobs.lock().await;
        jobs.retain(|_, job| job.expires > Instant::now());
        anyhow::ensure!(
            jobs.len() < MAX_JOBS,
            "NotebookLM result capacity is exhausted; wait for retained results to expire"
        );
        anyhow::ensure!(
            jobs.values()
                .filter(|job| job.principal == principal && job.session == session)
                .count()
                < MAX_SESSION_JOBS,
            "NotebookLM session query capacity is exhausted; wait for retained results to expire"
        );
        let query_id = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();
        let expires_at = chrono::Utc::now().timestamp() + RETENTION.as_secs() as i64;
        let (sender, receiver) = oneshot::channel();
        jobs.insert(
            query_id.clone(),
            Job {
                principal: principal.into(),
                session: session.into(),
                notebook_id: notebook_id.clone(),
                expires: Instant::now() + RETENTION,
                expires_at,
                receiver: Some(receiver),
                result: None,
            },
        );
        // No await between publication and spawn: cancellation cannot leave a
        // published job whose worker was never started. A panic closes sender.
        tokio::spawn(async move {
            let _permit = permit;
            let result = match tokio::time::timeout(timeout, query).await {
                Err(_) => Err(NotebookQueryFailure::TimedOut),
                Ok(Err(_)) => Err(NotebookQueryFailure::ProviderFailed),
                Ok(Ok(value)) => {
                    let bounded = serde_json::to_vec(&value)
                        .is_ok_and(|bytes| bytes.len() <= MAX_RESULT_BYTES);
                    if bounded {
                        serde_json::from_value(value)
                            .map_err(|_| NotebookQueryFailure::InvalidResponse)
                    } else {
                        Err(NotebookQueryFailure::InvalidResponse)
                    }
                }
            };
            let _ = sender.send(result);
        });
        Ok(NotebookQueryStartOutput {
            query_id,
            notebook_id,
            expires_at,
        })
    }

    pub(crate) async fn status(
        &self,
        principal: &str,
        session: &str,
        query_id: &str,
    ) -> Result<NotebookQueryStatusOutput> {
        anyhow::ensure!(
            uuid::Uuid::parse_str(query_id).is_ok_and(|id| id.to_string() == query_id),
            "query is unavailable"
        );
        let mut jobs = self.jobs.lock().await;
        jobs.retain(|_, job| job.expires > Instant::now());
        let job = jobs
            .get_mut(query_id)
            .filter(|job| job.principal == principal && job.session == session)
            .context("query is unavailable")?;
        if let Some(receiver) = job.receiver.as_mut() {
            match receiver.try_recv() {
                Ok(result) => {
                    job.result = Some(result);
                    job.receiver = None;
                }
                Err(oneshot::error::TryRecvError::Closed) => {
                    job.result = Some(Err(NotebookQueryFailure::WorkerFailed));
                    job.receiver = None;
                }
                Err(oneshot::error::TryRecvError::Empty) => {}
            }
        }
        let (state, result, failure) = match &job.result {
            None => (NotebookQueryState::Running, None, None),
            Some(Ok(result)) => (NotebookQueryState::Completed, Some(result.clone()), None),
            Some(Err(failure)) => (NotebookQueryState::Failed, None, Some(failure.clone())),
        };
        Ok(NotebookQueryStatusOutput {
            query_id: query_id.into(),
            notebook_id: job.notebook_id.clone(),
            expires_at: job.expires_at,
            state,
            result,
            failure,
        })
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use serde_json::json;

    async fn settle(queries: &NotebookQueries, id: &str) -> NotebookQueryStatusOutput {
        tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(2), async {
            loop {
                let status = queries.status("principal", "session", id).await.unwrap();
                if !matches!(status.state, NotebookQueryState::Running) {
                    return status;
                }
                tokio::task::yield_now().await;
            }
        })
        .await
        .unwrap()
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn pending_result_is_private_then_returns_actual_unicode_and_citations() {
        let queries = NotebookQueries::default();
        let (sender, receiver) = oneshot::channel();
        let job = queries
            .start(
                "principal",
                "session",
                "notebook".into(),
                Duration::from_secs(2),
                async { Ok(receiver.await?) },
            )
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert!(matches!(
            queries
                .status("principal", "session", &job.query_id)
                .await
                .unwrap()
                .state,
            NotebookQueryState::Running
        ));
        assert!(queries
            .status("other", "session", &job.query_id)
            .await
            .is_err());
        assert!(queries
            .status("principal", "other", &job.query_id)
            .await
            .is_err());
        sender.send(json!({"answer":"資料 🌊", "question":"q", "conversation_id":null, "sources_used":[{"id":"s"}], "citations":{"1":{"source":"s"}}, "references":[]})).unwrap();
        let result = settle(&queries, &job.query_id).await;
        assert!(matches!(result.state, NotebookQueryState::Completed));
        assert_eq!(result.result.unwrap().answer, "資料 🌊");
        assert!(NotebookQueries::default()
            .status("principal", "session", &job.query_id)
            .await
            .is_err());
        queries
            .jobs
            .lock()
            .await
            .get_mut(&job.query_id)
            .unwrap()
            .expires = Instant::now();
        assert!(queries
            .status("principal", "session", &job.query_id)
            .await
            .is_err());
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn errors_timeouts_and_bad_responses_do_not_become_success_or_echo_secrets() {
        for (value, expected) in [
            (
                Err(anyhow::anyhow!("private token")),
                NotebookQueryFailure::ProviderFailed,
            ),
            (
                Ok(json!({"success":true})),
                NotebookQueryFailure::InvalidResponse,
            ),
            (
                Ok(json!({"answer":"x".repeat(MAX_RESULT_BYTES+1)})),
                NotebookQueryFailure::InvalidResponse,
            ),
        ] {
            let queries = NotebookQueries::default();
            let job = queries
                .start(
                    "principal",
                    "session",
                    "n".into(),
                    Duration::from_secs(1),
                    async { value },
                )
                .await
                .unwrap();
            let status = settle(&queries, &job.query_id).await;
            assert_eq!(
                serde_json::to_value(status.failure).unwrap(),
                serde_json::to_value(Some(expected)).unwrap()
            );
            assert!(status.result.is_none());
        }
        let queries = NotebookQueries::default();
        let job = queries
            .start(
                "principal",
                "session",
                "n".into(),
                Duration::from_millis(1),
                std::future::pending(),
            )
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert!(matches!(
            settle(&queries, &job.query_id).await.failure,
            Some(NotebookQueryFailure::TimedOut)
        ));
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn capacity_rejection_does_not_start_another_provider() {
        let queries = NotebookQueries::default();
        let permits = queries.active.clone().acquire_many_owned(8).await.unwrap();
        let calls = Arc::new(std::sync::atomic::AtomicUsize::new(0));
        let observed = calls.clone();
        assert!(queries
            .start(
                "principal",
                "session",
                "n".into(),
                Duration::from_secs(1),
                async move {
                    observed.fetch_add(1, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::SeqCst);
                    Ok(json!({}))
                }
            )
            .await
            .is_err());
        drop(permits);
        assert_eq!(calls.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::SeqCst), 0);
        let input = NotebookQueryInput {
            question: "q".into(),
            notebook_id: Some(uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string()),
            timeout: Some(901),
        };
        assert!(NotebookQueries::prepare(&input, None).is_err());
    }
}
</file>

<file path="op-grpc-bridge/src/obfuscation_canonical_tests.rs">
//! Canonical flow admission, native-owner receipts and committed child state.
use super::*;
use crate::human_principal_dispatch::tests::{
    pk, register, temp_cozo, temp_shm_with_schemas, test_engine,
};
use crate::identity_sled_dispatch::{tests::write_identity, IdentitySledStore};
use crate::obfuscation_methods::{FlowOwner, ObfuscationMethods};
use anyhow::Result;
use op_plugins::state_plugins::{
    human_principal::HumanPrincipalPlugin, identity_sled::IdentitySledPlugin, openflow::FlowEntry,
    openflow_obfuscation::OpenFlowObfuscationPlugin, runtime_documents::RuntimeDocuments,
};
use op_state::StatePlugin;
use serde_json::{json, Value};

#[derive(Default)]
struct Switch(Mutex<Vec<FlowEntry>>);

#[async_trait::async_trait]
impl FlowOwner for Switch {
    async fn matches(&self, _bridge: &str, flow: &FlowEntry, absent: bool) -> Result<bool> {
        Ok(self.0.lock().await.contains(flow) != absent)
    }
    async fn exchange(
        &self,
        _bridge: &str,
        flow: &FlowEntry,
        expected: Option<&FlowEntry>,
        remove: bool,
    ) -> Result<()> {
        let mut current = self.0.lock().await;
        if let Some(expected) = expected {
            anyhow::ensure!(current.contains(expected), "native comparison conflict");
            current.retain(|entry| entry != expected);
        } else {
            anyhow::ensure!(!current.contains(flow), "native entry already exists");
        }
        if !remove {
            current.push(flow.clone());
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}

struct GrantsEnvironment(Option<std::ffi::OsString>);
impl Drop for GrantsEnvironment {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        if let Some(path) = self.0.take() {
            std::env::set_var("OP_GRANTS_PATH", path);
        } else {
            std::env::remove_var("OP_GRANTS_PATH");
        }
    }
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn flow_methods_commit_verified_children_and_reject_revoked_identity() {
    let _cozo = temp_cozo();
    let schema = OpenFlowObfuscationPlugin::new(Default::default())
        .schema()
        .unwrap();
    let _shm = temp_shm_with_schemas(&[
        HumanPrincipalPlugin::new().schema().unwrap(),
        IdentitySledPlugin::new().schema().unwrap(),
        schema.clone(),
    ]);
    let engine = test_engine();
    engine
        .install_identity_sled_store_for_test(IdentitySledStore::new(
            op_cozo_store::CozoGraphShuttle::new_in_memory().unwrap(),
        ))
        .unwrap();
    let owner = Arc::new(Switch::default());
    assert!(engine
        .obfuscation_methods
        .set(Arc::new(ObfuscationMethods::new(
            Arc::new(RuntimeDocuments::new(
                op_cozo_store::CozoGraphShuttle::new_in_memory().unwrap()
            )),
            owner.clone(),
        )))
        .is_ok());
    let public_key = pk(0xD5);
    register(&public_key, "flow-fixture").await.unwrap();
    let identity = write_identity(&engine, &public_key).await.unwrap();
    let principal = op_identity::session::derive_principal_id(&public_key);
    let root = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let grant_path = root.path().join("grants.json");
    let _environment = GrantsEnvironment(std::env::var_os("OP_GRANTS_PATH"));
    std::env::set_var("OP_GRANTS_PATH", &grant_path);
    let capabilities = schema
        .methods
        .values()
        .filter_map(|m| m.required_capability.clone())
        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
    std::fs::write(
        &grant_path,
        json!({(principal.clone()): {"capabilities":capabilities}}).to_string(),
    )
    .unwrap();

    let mut ids = Vec::new();
    for (revision, priority) in [(0, 123), (1, 124)] {
        let input = json!({"bridge":"fixture0","expected_revision":revision,"ttl":64,"flow":{"table":7,"priority":priority,"match_fields":{"ip":"","in_port":"3"},"actions":[{"type":"output","port":"4"}]}});
        let response = engine
            .dispatch_method_call_with_identity(
                "openflow_obfuscation",
                "obfuscate_flow",
                &input.to_string(),
                schema.methods["obfuscate_flow"]
                    .required_capability
                    .as_deref(),
                &principal,
                Some(&identity.session_id),
                identity.genesis.as_deref(),
            )
            .await
            .unwrap();
        let output = &response["result"];
        let contract =
            serde_json::to_value(schema.methods["obfuscate_flow"].returns.as_ref().unwrap())
                .unwrap();
        jsonschema::Validator::new(&contract)
            .unwrap()
            .validate(output)
            .unwrap();
        ids.push(output["flow_id"].as_str().unwrap().to_owned());
        let state: Value = serde_json::from_slice(
            &op_core::projection_shm::read_projection_bytes("openflow_obfuscation").unwrap(),
        )
        .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(state["revision"], revision + 1);
        assert_eq!(state["flows"][&ids[revision as usize]], output["record"]);
        assert_eq!(
            state["flows"].as_object().unwrap().len(),
            revision as usize + 1
        );
    }
    let remove = json!({"bridge":"fixture0","flow_id":ids[0],"expected_revision":2});
    let before = op_core::projection_shm::read_projection_bytes("openflow_obfuscation").unwrap();
    std::fs::write(&grant_path, "{}").unwrap();
    assert!(engine
        .dispatch_method_call_with_identity(
            "openflow_obfuscation",
            "deobfuscate_flow",
            &remove.to_string(),
            schema.methods["deobfuscate_flow"]
                .required_capability
                .as_deref(),
            &principal,
            Some(&identity.session_id),
            identity.genesis.as_deref(),
        )
        .await
        .is_err());
    assert_eq!(owner.0.lock().await.len(), 2);
    assert_eq!(
        op_core::projection_shm::read_projection_bytes("openflow_obfuscation").unwrap(),
        before
    );
    std::fs::write(
        &grant_path,
        json!({(principal.clone()): {"capabilities":capabilities}}).to_string(),
    )
    .unwrap();
    let response = engine
        .dispatch_method_call_with_identity(
            "openflow_obfuscation",
            "deobfuscate_flow",
            &remove.to_string(),
            schema.methods["deobfuscate_flow"]
                .required_capability
                .as_deref(),
            &principal,
            Some(&identity.session_id),
            identity.genesis.as_deref(),
        )
        .await
        .unwrap();
    let contract =
        serde_json::to_value(schema.methods["deobfuscate_flow"].returns.as_ref().unwrap()).unwrap();
    jsonschema::Validator::new(&contract)
        .unwrap()
        .validate(&response["result"])
        .unwrap();
    let state: Value = serde_json::from_slice(
        &op_core::projection_shm::read_projection_bytes("openflow_obfuscation").unwrap(),
    )
    .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(state["revision"], 3);
    assert_eq!(state["flows"].as_object().unwrap().len(), 1);
    assert!(state["flows"].get(&ids[0]).is_none());
    assert!(state["flows"].get(&ids[1]).is_some());
    assert_eq!(owner.0.lock().await.len(), 1);
}

<file path="op-grpc-bridge/src/obfuscation_methods.rs">
//! The obfuscation plugin owns only its explicit normalization rules. The
//! existing OpenFlow D-Bus controller owns wire encoding, live comparison,
//! barriers and readback. No legacy rule string is installed here.
use anyhow::{ensure, Context, Result};
use async_trait::async_trait;
use op_plugins::state_plugins::{
    openflow::{FlowAction, FlowEntry},
    openflow_obfuscation::{
        DeobfuscateFlowInput, ObfuscateFlowInput, ObfuscationOutput, ObfuscationRecord,
        ObfuscationState,
    },
    runtime_documents::RuntimeDocuments,
};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use serde_json::Value;
use std::{collections::BTreeMap, sync::Arc};
use tokio::sync::Mutex;

const PLUGIN: &str = "openflow_obfuscation";

#[async_trait]
pub(crate) trait FlowOwner: Send + Sync {
    async fn matches(&self, bridge: &str, flow: &FlowEntry, absent: bool) -> Result<bool>;
    async fn exchange(
        &self,
        bridge: &str,
        flow: &FlowEntry,
        expected: Option<&FlowEntry>,
        remove: bool,
    ) -> Result<()>;
}

pub(crate) struct NativeFlowOwner;
#[async_trait]
impl FlowOwner for NativeFlowOwner {
    async fn matches(&self, bridge: &str, flow: &FlowEntry, absent: bool) -> Result<bool> {
        let bus = tokio::time::timeout(
            std::time::Duration::from_secs(10),
            zbus::Connection::system(),
        )
        .await
        .context("OpenFlow owner bus connection timed out")??;
        let proxy = tokio::time::timeout(
            std::time::Duration::from_secs(10),
            zbus::Proxy::new(
                &bus,
                "org.opdbus.v1.plugins.openflow",
                "/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/openflow",
                "org.opdbus.v1.plugins.openflow",
            ),
        )
        .await
        .context("OpenFlow owner proxy connection timed out")??;
        tokio::time::timeout(
            std::time::Duration::from_secs(15),
            proxy.call(
                "VerifyFlow",
                &(bridge, serde_json::to_string(flow)?, absent),
            ),
        )
        .await
        .context("OpenFlow native recovery read timed out")?
        .map_err(Into::into)
    }
    async fn exchange(
        &self,
        bridge: &str,
        flow: &FlowEntry,
        expected: Option<&FlowEntry>,
        remove: bool,
    ) -> Result<()> {
        let bus = tokio::time::timeout(
            std::time::Duration::from_secs(10),
            zbus::Connection::system(),
        )
        .await
        .context("OpenFlow owner bus connection timed out")??;
        let proxy = tokio::time::timeout(
            std::time::Duration::from_secs(10),
            zbus::Proxy::new(
                &bus,
                "org.opdbus.v1.plugins.openflow",
                "/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/openflow",
                "org.opdbus.v1.plugins.openflow",
            ),
        )
        .await
        .context("OpenFlow owner proxy connection timed out")??;
        let expected = expected
            .map(serde_json::to_string)
            .transpose()?
            .unwrap_or_default();
        let result: String = tokio::time::timeout(
            std::time::Duration::from_secs(45),
            proxy.call(
                "CompareExchangeFlow",
                &(bridge, serde_json::to_string(flow)?, expected, remove),
            ),
        )
        .await
        .context("OpenFlow owner timeout; reconcile before retry")??;
        let result: Value = serde_json::from_str(&result)?;
        ensure!(
            result.get("verified") == Some(&Value::Bool(true))
                && result.get("flow") == Some(&serde_json::to_value(flow)?),
            "OpenFlow owner did not verify the requested flow"
        );
        Ok(())
    }
}

pub(crate) struct ObfuscationMethods {
    documents: Arc<RuntimeDocuments>,
    owner: Arc<dyn FlowOwner>,
    operation: Mutex<()>,
}

#[derive(Clone, Default, Serialize, Deserialize)]
struct DurableFlows {
    revision: u64,
    flows: BTreeMap<String, ObfuscationRecord>,
    pending: Option<PendingFlow>,
    completed: Option<PendingFlow>,
}

#[derive(Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
struct PendingFlow {
    method: String,
    arguments: Value,
    flow_id: String,
    record: ObfuscationRecord,
    installed: bool,
}

impl PendingFlow {
    fn is_retry(&self, method: &str, args: &Value) -> bool {
        self.method == method && self.arguments == *args
    }
    fn output(&self, revision: u64) -> Result<Value> {
        Ok(serde_json::to_value(ObfuscationOutput {
            flow_id: self.flow_id.clone(),
            revision,
            installed: self.installed,
            record: self.record.clone(),
        })?)
    }
}

impl ObfuscationMethods {
    pub(crate) fn new(documents: Arc<RuntimeDocuments>, owner: Arc<dyn FlowOwner>) -> Self {
        Self {
            documents,
            owner,
            operation: Mutex::new(()),
        }
    }

    pub(crate) async fn dispatch(
        &self,
        method: &str,
        args: Value,
    ) -> Result<(Value, ObfuscationState)> {
        let _operation = self.operation.lock().await;
        let row = self.documents.read_durable(PLUGIN).await?;
        let mut document_revision = row.as_ref().map_or(0, |row| row.revision);
        let mut document: DurableFlows = row
            .map(|row| serde_json::from_value(row.document))
            .transpose()?
            .unwrap_or_default();
        if let Some(completed) = &document.completed {
            if completed.is_retry(method, &args) {
                ensure!(
                    self.owner
                        .matches(
                            &completed.record.bridge,
                            &completed.record.flow,
                            !completed.installed
                        )
                        .await?,
                    "completed normalization flow changed outside its owner"
                );
                return Ok((
                    completed.output(document.revision)?,
                    ObfuscationState {
                        revision: document.revision,
                        flows: document.flows,
                    },
                ));
            }
        }
        if let Some(pending) = &document.pending {
            ensure!(pending.is_retry(method, &args), "normalization operation {} for {} needs its exact request retried before another change", pending.method, pending.flow_id);
            return self.finish(document, document_revision).await;
        }
        let revision = document.revision;
        let flows = &document.flows;
        let original_arguments = args.clone();
        let (flow_id, record, installed) = match method {
            "obfuscate_flow" => {
                let input: ObfuscateFlowInput = serde_json::from_value(args)?;
                ensure!(
                    revision == input.expected_revision,
                    "obfuscation revision conflict"
                );
                let record = normalize(input)?;
                let flow_id = flow_identity(&record.bridge, &record.flow)?;
                ensure!(
                    flows.len() < 1024 || flows.contains_key(&flow_id),
                    "obfuscation flow count limit"
                );
                (flow_id, record, true)
            }
            "deobfuscate_flow" => {
                let input: DeobfuscateFlowInput = serde_json::from_value(args)?;
                ensure!(
                    revision == input.expected_revision,
                    "obfuscation revision conflict"
                );
                let record = flows
                    .get(&input.flow_id)
                    .context("unknown owned obfuscation flow")?
                    .clone();
                ensure!(
                    record.bridge == input.bridge,
                    "obfuscation flow belongs to another bridge"
                );
                (input.flow_id, record, false)
            }
            _ => anyhow::bail!("unknown obfuscation method"),
        };
        document.pending = Some(PendingFlow {
            method: method.into(),
            arguments: original_arguments,
            flow_id,
            record,
            installed,
        });
        // Persist the exact intent before touching the switch. A process loss
        // leaves enough information to reconcile without inventing a receipt.
        document_revision = self.persist(&document, document_revision).await?;
        self.finish(document, document_revision).await
    }

    async fn persist(&self, document: &DurableFlows, revision: u64) -> Result<u64> {
        let value = serde_json::to_value(document)?;
        Ok(self
            .documents
            .update_at_revision_with_result(PLUGIN, revision, move |_| Ok((value, ())))
            .await?
            .0
            .revision)
    }

    async fn finish(
        &self,
        mut document: DurableFlows,
        revision: u64,
    ) -> Result<(Value, ObfuscationState)> {
        let pending = document
            .pending
            .clone()
            .context("no pending normalization operation")?;
        let prior = document
            .flows
            .get(&pending.flow_id)
            .map(|record| &record.flow);
        if !self
            .owner
            .matches(
                &pending.record.bridge,
                &pending.record.flow,
                !pending.installed,
            )
            .await?
        {
            if let Err(error) = self
                .owner
                .exchange(
                    &pending.record.bridge,
                    &pending.record.flow,
                    prior,
                    !pending.installed,
                )
                .await
            {
                // A proven unchanged switch permits clearing a failed intent.
                // Transport uncertainty preserves it for an exact retry.
                let prior_matches = match prior {
                    Some(flow) => {
                        self.owner
                            .matches(&pending.record.bridge, flow, false)
                            .await
                    }
                    None => {
                        self.owner
                            .matches(&pending.record.bridge, &pending.record.flow, true)
                            .await
                    }
                };
                if matches!(prior_matches, Ok(true)) {
                    document.pending = None;
                    self.persist(&document, revision).await?;
                }
                return Err(error);
            }
        }
        ensure!(
            self.owner
                .matches(
                    &pending.record.bridge,
                    &pending.record.flow,
                    !pending.installed
                )
                .await?,
            "normalization readback changed before receipt commit"
        );
        if pending.installed {
            document
                .flows
                .insert(pending.flow_id.clone(), pending.record.clone());
        } else {
            document.flows.remove(&pending.flow_id);
        }
        document.revision = document
            .revision
            .checked_add(1)
            .context("normalization revision exhausted")?;
        document.pending = None;
        document.completed = Some(pending.clone());
        self.persist(&document, revision).await.context(
            "native flow verified; retry the identical request to recover its durable receipt",
        )?;
        Ok((
            pending.output(document.revision)?,
            ObfuscationState {
                revision: document.revision,
                flows: document.flows,
            },
        ))
    }
}

fn normalize(input: ObfuscateFlowInput) -> Result<ObfuscationRecord> {
    ensure!(
        !input.bridge.is_empty()
            && input.bridge.len() <= 15
            && input
                .bridge
                .bytes()
                .all(|b| b.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || b == b'_' || b == b'-'),
        "invalid bridge name"
    );
    ensure!(
        input.ttl != 0 && input.flow.table < 255 && input.flow.priority != 0,
        "invalid normalization table/priority/TTL"
    );
    ensure!(
        input.flow.cookie.is_none(),
        "normalization cookie is owner-assigned"
    );
    ensure!(
        input.flow.idle_timeout == 0 && input.flow.hard_timeout == 0,
        "owned normalization flows require explicit removal"
    );
    ensure!(
        input.flow.match_fields.contains_key("ip")
            || input.flow.match_fields.contains_key("ipv6")
            || input.flow.match_fields.contains_key("tcp")
            || input.flow.match_fields.contains_key("udp"),
        "TTL normalization requires an explicit IP match"
    );
    ensure!(
        !input.flow.actions.is_empty()
            && !input
                .flow
                .actions
                .iter()
                .any(|a| matches!(a, FlowAction::SetField { field, .. } if field == "nw_ttl")),
        "explicit forwarding actions must not override normalization TTL"
    );
    // Normalize HashMap order before hashing so the same exact rule has a
    // stable ID independent of JSON field insertion order.
    let hash = flow_identity_hash(&input.bridge, &input.flow)?;
    let cookie = (u64::from_be_bytes(hash.as_bytes()[..8].try_into()?) & 0x0000_ffff_ffff_ffff)
        | 0x4f42_0000_0000_0000;
    let mut flow = input.flow;
    flow.cookie = Some(cookie);
    flow.actions.insert(
        0,
        FlowAction::SetField {
            field: "nw_ttl".into(),
            value: input.ttl.to_string(),
        },
    );
    Ok(ObfuscationRecord {
        bridge: input.bridge,
        flow,
        ttl: input.ttl,
    })
}

fn flow_identity_hash(bridge: &str, flow: &FlowEntry) -> Result<blake3::Hash> {
    let identity = serde_json::json!({"bridge":bridge,"table":flow.table,"priority":flow.priority,"match":flow.match_fields.iter().collect::<BTreeMap<_,_>>()});
    Ok(blake3::hash(&serde_json::to_vec(&identity)?))
}

fn flow_identity(bridge: &str, flow: &FlowEntry) -> Result<String> {
    Ok(flow_identity_hash(bridge, flow)?.to_hex().to_string())
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    #[derive(Default)]
    struct Switch(Mutex<Option<FlowEntry>>);
    #[async_trait]
    impl FlowOwner for Switch {
        async fn matches(&self, _bridge: &str, flow: &FlowEntry, absent: bool) -> Result<bool> {
            let current = self.0.lock().await;
            Ok(if absent {
                current.is_none()
            } else {
                current.as_ref() == Some(flow)
            })
        }
        async fn exchange(
            &self,
            _bridge: &str,
            flow: &FlowEntry,
            expected: Option<&FlowEntry>,
            remove: bool,
        ) -> Result<()> {
            let mut current = self.0.lock().await;
            ensure!(current.as_ref() == expected, "switch conflict");
            *current = if remove { None } else { Some(flow.clone()) };
            Ok(())
        }
    }
    fn input() -> Value {
        serde_json::json!({"bridge":"fixture0","expected_revision":0,"ttl":64,"flow":{"table":7,"priority":123,"match_fields":{"ip":"","in_port":"3"},"actions":[{"type":"output","port":"4"}]}})
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn restart_recovers_confirmed_effect_from_durable_intent() {
        let owner = Arc::new(Switch::default());
        let documents = Arc::new(RuntimeDocuments::new(
            op_cozo_store::CozoGraphShuttle::new_in_memory().unwrap(),
        ));
        let request = input();
        let record = normalize(serde_json::from_value(request.clone()).unwrap()).unwrap();
        let flow_id = flow_identity(&record.bridge, &record.flow).unwrap();
        let pending = PendingFlow {
            method: "obfuscate_flow".into(),
            arguments: request.clone(),
            flow_id: flow_id.clone(),
            record: record.clone(),
            installed: true,
        };
        let persisted = DurableFlows {
            pending: Some(pending),
            ..Default::default()
        };
        documents
            .update(PLUGIN, move |_| Ok(serde_json::to_value(persisted)?))
            .await
            .unwrap();
        // The process died after the native effect and before its receipt.
        *owner.0.lock().await = Some(record.flow);
        let restarted = ObfuscationMethods::new(documents, owner);
        let (first, state) = restarted
            .dispatch("obfuscate_flow", request.clone())
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(state.revision, 1);
        assert!(state.flows.contains_key(&flow_id));
        let (retry, again) = restarted.dispatch("obfuscate_flow", request).await.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(first, retry);
        assert_eq!(again.revision, 1);
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn normalize_remove_and_reject_external_drift() {
        let owner = Arc::new(Switch::default());
        let docs = Arc::new(RuntimeDocuments::new(
            op_cozo_store::CozoGraphShuttle::new_in_memory().unwrap(),
        ));
        let service = ObfuscationMethods::new(docs, owner.clone());
        let (reply, state) = service.dispatch("obfuscate_flow", input()).await.unwrap();
        let flow_id = reply["flow_id"].as_str().unwrap();
        let installed = owner.0.lock().await.clone().unwrap();
        assert!(
            matches!(&installed.actions[0], FlowAction::SetField { field, value } if field == "nw_ttl" && value == "64")
        );
        assert_eq!(state.flows[flow_id].flow, installed);
        let removal =
            serde_json::json!({"bridge":"fixture0","flow_id":flow_id,"expected_revision":1});
        owner.0.lock().await.as_mut().unwrap().priority = 999;
        assert!(service
            .dispatch("deobfuscate_flow", removal.clone())
            .await
            .is_err());
        *owner.0.lock().await = Some(installed);
        let (reply, state) = service.dispatch("deobfuscate_flow", removal).await.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(reply["installed"], false);
        assert!(state.flows.is_empty());
        assert!(owner.0.lock().await.is_none());
    }
}
</file>

<file path="op-grpc-bridge/src/openflow_canonical_tests.rs">
use crate::human_principal_dispatch::tests::{
    pk, register, temp_cozo, temp_shm_with_schemas, test_engine,
};
use crate::identity_sled_dispatch::{tests::write_identity, IdentitySledStore};
use op_plugins::state_plugins::{
    human_principal::HumanPrincipalPlugin,
    identity_sled::IdentitySledPlugin,
    openflow::{FlowAction, FlowEntry, OpenFlowPlugin},
};
use op_state::StatePlugin;
use serde_json::{json, Value};
use std::{
    collections::HashMap,
    sync::{
        atomic::{AtomicUsize, Ordering},
        Arc,
    },
};
use tokio::sync::Mutex;

#[derive(Clone, Default)]
struct ControllerFixture {
    effects: Arc<AtomicUsize>,
    flows: Arc<Mutex<Vec<FlowEntry>>>,
}

#[zbus::interface(name = "org.opdbus.v1.plugins.openflow")]
impl ControllerFixture {
    async fn compare_exchange_flow(
        &self,
        bridge: String,
        flow_json: String,
        expected_json: String,
        delete: bool,
    ) -> zbus::fdo::Result<String> {
        if bridge != "fixture0" {
            return Err(zbus::fdo::Error::Failed("unknown bridge".into()));
        }
        let desired: FlowEntry = serde_json::from_str(&flow_json)
            .map_err(|_| zbus::fdo::Error::InvalidArgs("invalid flow".into()))?;
        let expected = if expected_json.is_empty() {
            None
        } else {
            Some(
                serde_json::from_str::<FlowEntry>(&expected_json)
                    .map_err(|_| zbus::fdo::Error::InvalidArgs("invalid expected flow".into()))?,
            )
        };
        let mut flows = self.flows.lock().await;
        match expected.as_ref() {
            Some(expected) => {
                let position = flows
                    .iter()
                    .position(|flow| flow == expected)
                    .ok_or_else(|| zbus::fdo::Error::Failed("CAS conflict".into()))?;
                flows.remove(position);
            }
            None if flows.contains(&desired) => {
                return Err(zbus::fdo::Error::Failed("flow already exists".into()));
            }
            None => {}
        }
        if !delete {
            flows.push(desired.clone());
        }
        self.effects.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst);
        serde_json::to_string(&json!({
            "verified":true,
            "action":if delete { "delete" } else { "add" },
            "flow":desired
        }))
        .map_err(|_| zbus::fdo::Error::Failed("serialize receipt".into()))
    }
}

struct GrantsEnvironment(Option<std::ffi::OsString>);

impl Drop for GrantsEnvironment {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        match self.0.take() {
            Some(value) => std::env::set_var("OP_GRANTS_PATH", value),
            None => std::env::remove_var("OP_GRANTS_PATH"),
        }
    }
}

fn flow(action: FlowAction) -> FlowEntry {
    FlowEntry {
        table: 4,
        priority: 200,
        match_fields: HashMap::from([("in_port".into(), "uplink".into())]),
        actions: vec![action],
        cookie: Some(42),
        idle_timeout: 0,
        hard_timeout: 0,
    }
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn all_three_flow_methods_cross_canonical_admission_native_cas_and_child_fold() {
    let _cozo = temp_cozo();
    let schema = OpenFlowPlugin::new().schema().unwrap();
    let _shm = temp_shm_with_schemas(&[
        HumanPrincipalPlugin::new().schema().unwrap(),
        IdentitySledPlugin::new().schema().unwrap(),
        schema.clone(),
    ]);
    let engine = test_engine();
    engine
        .install_identity_sled_store_for_test(IdentitySledStore::new(
            op_cozo_store::CozoGraphShuttle::new_in_memory().unwrap(),
        ))
        .unwrap();

    let controller = ControllerFixture::default();
    let (server_stream, client_stream) = tokio::net::UnixStream::pair().unwrap();
    let server = zbus::connection::Builder::unix_stream(server_stream)
        .server(zbus::Guid::generate())
        .unwrap()
        .p2p()
        .serve_at("/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/openflow", controller.clone())
        .unwrap()
        .build();
    let client = zbus::connection::Builder::unix_stream(client_stream)
        .p2p()
        .build();
    let (_server, client) = tokio::time::timeout(std::time::Duration::from_secs(5), async {
        tokio::try_join!(server, client)
    })
    .await
    .unwrap()
    .unwrap();
    engine
        .install_openflow_method_connection_for_test(client)
        .unwrap();

    let key = pk(0xC7);
    register(&key, "openflow-canonical-fixture").await.unwrap();
    let identity = write_identity(&engine, &key).await.unwrap();
    let principal = op_identity::session::derive_principal_id(&key);
    let directory = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let grants = directory.path().join("grants.json");
    let _environment = GrantsEnvironment(std::env::var_os("OP_GRANTS_PATH"));
    std::env::set_var("OP_GRANTS_PATH", &grants);
    std::fs::write(
        &grants,
        serde_json::to_vec(&json!({
            (principal.clone()):{"capabilities":["openflow.write"]}
        }))
        .unwrap(),
    )
    .unwrap();

    let sibling = flow(FlowAction::Normal);
    let initial = json!({
        "bridges":[{"name":"authored","flows":[],"socket_ports":null}],
        "observed_flows":{"other":{"sibling":{"flow":sibling,"installed":true}}},
        "controller_endpoint":"tcp:127.0.0.1:6653",
        "auto_discover_containers":false,
        "enable_security_flows":true,
        "obfuscation_level":1
    });
    op_core::projection_shm::write_projection("openflow", &serde_json::to_vec(&initial).unwrap())
        .unwrap();

    let original = flow(FlowAction::Normal);
    let replacement = flow(FlowAction::Output {
        port: "LOCAL".into(),
    });
    let calls = [
        (
            "add_flow",
            json!({"bridge":"fixture0","flow":original.clone()}),
        ),
        (
            "modify_flow",
            json!({"bridge":"fixture0","expected":original,"replacement":replacement.clone()}),
        ),
        (
            "delete_flow",
            json!({"bridge":"fixture0","expected":replacement}),
        ),
    ];
    for (method, arguments) in calls {
        let declaration = &schema.methods[method];
        let response = engine
            .dispatch_method_call_with_identity(
                "openflow",
                method,
                &arguments.to_string(),
                declaration.required_capability.as_deref(),
                &principal,
                Some(&identity.session_id),
                identity.genesis.as_deref(),
            )
            .await
            .unwrap();
        let output_schema = serde_json::to_value(declaration.returns.as_ref().unwrap()).unwrap();
        jsonschema::Validator::new(&output_schema)
            .unwrap()
            .validate(&response["result"])
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(response["result"]["verified"], true);
    }
    assert_eq!(controller.effects.load(Ordering::SeqCst), 3);
    assert!(controller.flows.lock().await.is_empty());

    let committed: Value = serde_json::from_slice(
        &op_core::projection_shm::read_projection_bytes("openflow").unwrap(),
    )
    .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(committed["bridges"], initial["bridges"]);
    assert_eq!(
        committed["observed_flows"]["other"],
        initial["observed_flows"]["other"]
    );
    let fixture_members = committed["observed_flows"]["fixture0"].as_object().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(fixture_members.len(), 1);
    assert_eq!(fixture_members.values().next().unwrap()["installed"], false);

    std::fs::write(&grants, "{}").unwrap();
    let denied = json!({"bridge":"fixture0","flow":flow(FlowAction::Normal)});
    assert!(engine
        .dispatch_method_call_with_identity(
            "openflow",
            "add_flow",
            &denied.to_string(),
            Some("openflow.write"),
            &principal,
            Some(&identity.session_id),
            identity.genesis.as_deref(),
        )
        .await
        .is_err());
    assert_eq!(controller.effects.load(Ordering::SeqCst), 3);
}

<file path="op-grpc-bridge/src/openflow_methods.rs">
//! Canonical exact compare-and-exchange adapter for OpenFlow flow members.

use anyhow::{ensure, Context, Result};
use op_plugins::state_plugins::openflow::{
    AddFlowInput, DeleteFlowInput, FlowAction, FlowEntry, FlowMutationKind, FlowMutationOutput,
    ModifyFlowInput,
};
use serde_json::Value;
use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
use std::time::{Duration, SystemTime, UNIX_EPOCH};
use zbus::{Connection, Proxy};

const SERVICE: &str = "org.opdbus.v1.plugins.openflow";
const PATH: &str = "/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/openflow";
const INTERFACE: &str = "org.opdbus.v1.plugins.openflow";
const CALL_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(45);

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct OpenFlowMethodReceipt {
    pub output: Value,
    /// Exact member known to be live immediately before the operation.
    pub before: Option<FlowEntry>,
    /// Exact member confirmed live after the operation; absent for delete.
    pub after: Option<FlowEntry>,
    pub bridge: String,
}

pub(crate) struct OpenFlowProjectionChange {
    pub object_path: String,
    pub change_type: crate::mutation_engine::ChangeType,
    pub before: Option<FlowEntry>,
    pub value: op_plugins::state_plugins::openflow::FlowObservation,
}

pub(crate) fn projection_change(
    receipt: &OpenFlowMethodReceipt,
) -> Result<OpenFlowProjectionChange> {
    let observed = receipt
        .after
        .as_ref()
        .or(receipt.before.as_ref())
        .context("OpenFlow receipt omitted both member revisions")?;
    let identity = canonical_flow_identity(observed);
    Ok(OpenFlowProjectionChange {
        object_path: format!(
            "{}/observed_flows/{}/{}",
            op_plugins::canonical::plugin_path("openflow"),
            receipt.bridge,
            identity
        ),
        change_type: crate::mutation_engine::ChangeType::ObjectAdded,
        before: receipt.before.clone(),
        value: op_plugins::state_plugins::openflow::FlowObservation {
            flow: observed.clone(),
            installed: receipt.after.is_some(),
        },
    })
}

fn canonical_flow_identity(flow: &FlowEntry) -> String {
    let mut digest = Sha256::new();
    digest.update([flow.table]);
    digest.update(flow.priority.to_be_bytes());
    let mut fields = flow.match_fields.iter().collect::<Vec<_>>();
    fields.sort_unstable();
    for (key, value) in fields {
        digest.update((key.len() as u64).to_be_bytes());
        digest.update(key.as_bytes());
        digest.update((value.len() as u64).to_be_bytes());
        digest.update(value.as_bytes());
    }
    hex::encode(digest.finalize())
}

struct CasRequest {
    bridge: String,
    desired: FlowEntry,
    expected: Option<FlowEntry>,
    delete: bool,
    operation: FlowMutationKind,
}

pub async fn dispatch_openflow_flow_method(
    method: &str,
    args: &Value,
) -> Result<OpenFlowMethodReceipt> {
    let connection = tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(10), Connection::system())
        .await
        .context("OpenFlow owner bus connection timed out")?
        .context("connect to the canonical OpenFlow D-Bus owner")?;
    tokio::time::timeout(
        CALL_TIMEOUT,
        dispatch_openflow_flow_method_on(&connection, method, args),
    )
    .await
    .context("OpenFlow compare/exchange timed out; reconcile the exact member before retrying")?
}

pub(crate) async fn dispatch_openflow_flow_method_on(
    connection: &Connection,
    method: &str,
    args: &Value,
) -> Result<OpenFlowMethodReceipt> {
    let request = cas_request(method, args)?;
    let desired_json = serde_json::to_string(&request.desired)?;
    let expected_json = request
        .expected
        .as_ref()
        .map(serde_json::to_string)
        .transpose()?
        .unwrap_or_default();
    let proxy = Proxy::new(connection, SERVICE, PATH, INTERFACE)
        .await
        .context("create OpenFlow controller D-Bus proxy")?;
    let response: String = proxy
        .call(
            "CompareExchangeFlow",
            &(
                request.bridge.as_str(),
                desired_json.as_str(),
                expected_json.as_str(),
                request.delete,
            ),
        )
        .await
        .context("OpenFlow native compare/exchange failed")?;
    let native: Value = serde_json::from_str(&response)
        .context("OpenFlow owner returned malformed compare/exchange readback")?;
    ensure!(
        native.get("verified").and_then(Value::as_bool) == Some(true),
        "OpenFlow owner did not return a verified readback"
    );
    let expected_action = if request.delete { "delete" } else { "add" };
    ensure!(
        native.get("action").and_then(Value::as_str) == Some(expected_action),
        "OpenFlow owner returned the wrong operation"
    );
    let returned: FlowEntry = serde_json::from_value(
        native
            .get("flow")
            .cloned()
            .context("OpenFlow owner omitted the observed member")?,
    )?;
    ensure!(
        returned == request.desired,
        "OpenFlow owner observed a different member"
    );
    let (before, after) = if request.delete {
        (request.expected, None)
    } else {
        (request.expected, Some(request.desired))
    };
    let output = serde_json::to_value(FlowMutationOutput {
        bridge: request.bridge.clone(),
        operation: request.operation,
        before: before.clone(),
        after: after.clone(),
        verified: true,
        observed_at_unix: SystemTime::now()
            .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
            .unwrap_or_default()
            .as_secs() as i64,
    })?;
    Ok(OpenFlowMethodReceipt {
        output,
        before,
        after,
        bridge: request.bridge,
    })
}

fn cas_request(method: &str, args: &Value) -> Result<CasRequest> {
    let request = match method {
        "add_flow" => {
            let input: AddFlowInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
            CasRequest {
                bridge: input.bridge,
                desired: input.flow,
                expected: None,
                delete: false,
                operation: FlowMutationKind::Added,
            }
        }
        "delete_flow" => {
            let input: DeleteFlowInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
            CasRequest {
                bridge: input.bridge,
                desired: input.expected.clone(),
                expected: Some(input.expected),
                delete: true,
                operation: FlowMutationKind::Deleted,
            }
        }
        "modify_flow" => {
            let input: ModifyFlowInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
            ensure!(
                flow_identity(&input.expected) == flow_identity(&input.replacement),
                "modify_flow cannot change table, priority or match_fields"
            );
            CasRequest {
                bridge: input.bridge,
                desired: input.replacement,
                expected: Some(input.expected),
                delete: false,
                operation: FlowMutationKind::Modified,
            }
        }
        _ => anyhow::bail!("unknown OpenFlow member method: {method}"),
    };
    validate_bridge(&request.bridge)?;
    validate_flow(&request.desired)?;
    if let Some(expected) = &request.expected {
        validate_flow(expected)?;
    }
    Ok(request)
}

fn flow_identity(flow: &FlowEntry) -> (u8, u16, Vec<(&str, &str)>) {
    let mut fields = flow
        .match_fields
        .iter()
        .map(|(key, value)| (key.as_str(), value.as_str()))
        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
    fields.sort_unstable();
    (flow.table, flow.priority, fields)
}

fn validate_bridge(bridge: &str) -> Result<()> {
    ensure!(
        !bridge.is_empty()
            && bridge.len() <= 15
            && bridge
                .bytes()
                .all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || matches!(byte, b'_' | b'-' | b'.')),
        "invalid OpenFlow bridge name"
    );
    Ok(())
}

fn validate_flow(flow: &FlowEntry) -> Result<()> {
    ensure!(flow.table < u8::MAX, "OpenFlow table 255 is reserved");
    ensure!(
        flow.priority > 0,
        "priority 0 is reserved for the protected NORMAL fallback"
    );
    ensure!(!flow.actions.is_empty(), "flow actions must be explicit");
    ensure!(
        !flow
            .actions
            .iter()
            .any(|action| matches!(action, FlowAction::Drop))
            || (flow.actions.len() == 1 && matches!(flow.actions.first(), Some(FlowAction::Drop))),
        "drop must be the only flow action"
    );
    ensure!(
        flow.match_fields.iter().all(|(key, value)| {
            !key.is_empty()
                && key.len() <= 64
                && value.len() <= 256
                && !key.chars().any(char::is_control)
                && !value.chars().any(char::is_control)
        }),
        "invalid OpenFlow match field"
    );
    for action in &flow.actions {
        match action {
            FlowAction::Output { port } => ensure!(!port.is_empty(), "output port is empty"),
            FlowAction::SetField { field, value } => ensure!(
                !field.is_empty() && !value.is_empty(),
                "set_field requires field and value"
            ),
            FlowAction::ArpResponder { mac, ip } => {
                ensure!(mac.split(':').count() == 6, "invalid ARP responder MAC");
                ip.parse::<std::net::Ipv4Addr>()
                    .context("invalid ARP responder IPv4 address")?;
            }
            _ => {}
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::{
        mutation_engine::ChangeType,
        state_tree_fold::{fold_plugin_state, StateTreeFold},
    };
    use simd_json::json as simd_json_value;
    use simd_json::prelude::*;
    use std::collections::HashMap;

    fn flow(actions: Vec<FlowAction>) -> FlowEntry {
        FlowEntry {
            table: 4,
            priority: 200,
            match_fields: HashMap::from([("in_port".into(), "uplink".into())]),
            actions,
            cookie: Some(42),
            idle_timeout: 0,
            hard_timeout: 0,
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn three_methods_build_exact_compare_exchange_requests() {
        let before = flow(vec![FlowAction::Normal]);
        let after = flow(vec![FlowAction::Output {
            port: "LOCAL".into(),
        }]);
        let add = cas_request(
            "add_flow",
            &serde_json::json!({"bridge":"ovsbr0","flow":before.clone()}),
        )
        .unwrap();
        assert!(add.expected.is_none() && !add.delete);
        let delete = cas_request(
            "delete_flow",
            &serde_json::json!({"bridge":"ovsbr0","expected":before.clone()}),
        )
        .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(delete.expected.as_ref(), Some(&delete.desired));
        assert!(delete.delete);
        let modify = cas_request(
            "modify_flow",
            &serde_json::json!({"bridge":"ovsbr0","expected":before,"replacement":after}),
        )
        .unwrap();
        assert!(modify.expected.is_some() && !modify.delete);
    }

    #[test]
    fn wildcard_delete_identity_change_and_fallback_are_unrepresentable() {
        assert!(cas_request(
            "delete_flow",
            &serde_json::json!({"bridge":"ovsbr0","match_fields":{}})
        )
        .is_err());
        let expected = flow(vec![FlowAction::Normal]);
        let mut changed = expected.clone();
        changed.priority += 1;
        assert!(cas_request(
            "modify_flow",
            &serde_json::json!({"bridge":"ovsbr0","expected":expected,"replacement":changed})
        )
        .is_err());
        let mut fallback = flow(vec![FlowAction::Normal]);
        fallback.priority = 0;
        assert!(cas_request(
            "add_flow",
            &serde_json::json!({"bridge":"ovsbr0","flow":fallback})
        )
        .is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn observed_member_fold_preserves_authored_config_and_unrelated_bridges() {
        let before = flow(vec![FlowAction::Normal]);
        let after = flow(vec![FlowAction::Output {
            port: "LOCAL".into(),
        }]);
        let add = projection_change(&OpenFlowMethodReceipt {
            output: Value::Null,
            before: None,
            after: Some(before.clone()),
            bridge: "ovsbr0".into(),
        })
        .unwrap();
        let initial = simd_json_value!({
            "bridges":[{"name":"configured","flows":[],"socket_ports":null}],
            "controller_endpoint":"tcp:127.0.0.1:6653",
            "auto_discover_containers":false,
            "enable_security_flows":true,
            "obfuscation_level":1,
            "observed_flows":{"other":{"keep":{"installed":true,"flow":{"table":1,"priority":1,"match_fields":{},"actions":[{"type":"normal"}],"idle_timeout":0,"hard_timeout":0}}}}
        });
        let StateTreeFold::Present(added) = fold_plugin_state(
            Some(&initial),
            "openflow",
            &add.object_path,
            add.change_type,
            None,
            &simd_json::serde::to_owned_value(add.value).unwrap(),
        )
        .unwrap() else {
            panic!("add must produce state")
        };
        assert_eq!(added["bridges"], initial["bridges"]);
        assert_eq!(
            added["observed_flows"]["other"],
            initial["observed_flows"]["other"]
        );

        let modify = projection_change(&OpenFlowMethodReceipt {
            output: Value::Null,
            before: Some(before),
            after: Some(after.clone()),
            bridge: "ovsbr0".into(),
        })
        .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(add.object_path, modify.object_path);
        let StateTreeFold::Present(modified) = fold_plugin_state(
            Some(&added),
            "openflow",
            &modify.object_path,
            ChangeType::ObjectAdded,
            None,
            &simd_json::serde::to_owned_value(modify.value).unwrap(),
        )
        .unwrap() else {
            panic!("modify must produce state")
        };
        let identity = canonical_flow_identity(&after);
        assert_eq!(
            modified["observed_flows"]["ovsbr0"][identity.as_str()]["flow"]["actions"][0]["type"],
            "output"
        );

        let delete = projection_change(&OpenFlowMethodReceipt {
            output: Value::Null,
            before: Some(after),
            after: None,
            bridge: "ovsbr0".into(),
        })
        .unwrap();
        let StateTreeFold::Present(deleted) = fold_plugin_state(
            Some(&modified),
            "openflow",
            &delete.object_path,
            delete.change_type,
            None,
            &simd_json::serde::to_owned_value(delete.value).unwrap(),
        )
        .unwrap() else {
            panic!("delete must retain the plugin state")
        };
        assert_eq!(
            deleted["observed_flows"]["ovsbr0"][identity.as_str()]["installed"],
            false
        );
        assert_eq!(deleted["bridges"], initial["bridges"]);
        assert!(deleted["observed_flows"]["other"]["keep"].is_object());
    }
}
</file>

<file path="op-grpc-bridge/src/oracle_assertion_client.rs">
//! Client-side acquisition of one OIA1 assertion from the authenticated decoy.
//!
//! This is deliberately only a transport helper. It does not verify the
//! decoy signature, register a principal, provision an identity container, or
//! mint SID1. Those operations remain owned by the bridge and MutationEngine.

use std::net::{IpAddr, SocketAddr};
use std::time::Duration;

use anyhow::{bail, Context, Result};
use base64::Engine as _;
use futures::StreamExt;
use reqwest::redirect::Policy;

use crate::grpc_client::GhostbridgeCallMetadata;

/// Maximum decoded OIA1 envelope accepted by the bridge.
pub const MAX_ASSERTION_WIRE_BYTES: usize = 16 * 1024;
/// Maximum response body, including the base64 representation and line ending.
pub const MAX_ASSERTION_RESPONSE_BYTES: usize = 4 * MAX_ASSERTION_WIRE_BYTES.div_ceil(3) + 2;
/// The issuer is a local/inner-network service; this is a deliberately short
/// bound for one acquisition request.
pub const DEFAULT_ASSERTION_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(8);

/// Acquires one signed OIA1 envelope from an explicitly selected decoy.
///
/// The caller must supply the local WireGuard inner address. Binding the HTTP
/// socket to it selects the intended route; the caller is responsible for
/// ensuring that address is already present on its authenticated WireGuard
/// interface. Signature and trust validation are intentionally left to
/// `AssertionValidator` on the bridge.
pub struct DecoyAssertionClient {
    endpoint: SocketAddr,
    source: IpAddr,
    response_limit: usize,
    http: reqwest::Client,
}

impl DecoyAssertionClient {
    /// Construct a client with no environment, DNS, proxy, or default endpoint.
    pub fn new(endpoint: SocketAddr, source: IpAddr) -> Result<Self> {
        Self::with_limits(
            endpoint,
            source,
            DEFAULT_ASSERTION_TIMEOUT,
            MAX_ASSERTION_RESPONSE_BYTES,
        )
    }

    /// Private constructor used by fixture tests for bounded limits.
    fn with_limits(
        endpoint: SocketAddr,
        source: IpAddr,
        timeout: Duration,
        response_limit: usize,
    ) -> Result<Self> {
        if timeout.is_zero() || timeout > DEFAULT_ASSERTION_TIMEOUT {
            bail!("OIA1 assertion timeout must be positive and at most 8s");
        }
        if response_limit == 0 || response_limit > MAX_ASSERTION_RESPONSE_BYTES {
            bail!("OIA1 assertion response limit is outside the supported bound");
        }
        if endpoint.port() == 0 {
            bail!("OIA1 assertion endpoint port must be nonzero");
        }
        if endpoint.ip().is_unspecified() || endpoint.ip().is_multicast() {
            bail!("OIA1 assertion endpoint must be a specific unicast address");
        }
        if source.is_unspecified() || source.is_multicast() {
            bail!("OIA1 assertion source must be a specific unicast address");
        }
        if endpoint.ip().is_ipv4() != source.is_ipv4() {
            bail!("OIA1 assertion endpoint and source address families differ");
        }
        let http = reqwest::Client::builder()
            .no_proxy()
            .redirect(Policy::none())
            .local_address(Some(source))
            .timeout(timeout)
            .build()
            .context("building bounded OIA1 assertion client")?;
        Ok(Self {
            endpoint,
            source,
            response_limit,
            http,
        })
    }

    /// Fetch and frame-check exactly one OIA1 assertion.
    ///
    /// The returned bytes are the original decoded signed envelope. No retry
    /// or reuse is performed; callers should attach the result to one RPC.
    pub async fn acquire(&self) -> Result<GhostbridgeCallMetadata> {
        let url = format!("http://{}/assertion", self.endpoint);
        let response = self
            .http
            .get(&url)
            .send()
            .await
            .with_context(|| format!("requesting OIA1 assertion from {url}"))?;
        if response.status() != reqwest::StatusCode::OK {
            bail!("OIA1 assertion issuer returned HTTP {}", response.status());
        }

        let mut body = Vec::new();
        let mut stream = response.bytes_stream();
        while let Some(chunk) = stream.next().await {
            let chunk = chunk.context("reading OIA1 assertion response")?;
            if body.len().saturating_add(chunk.len()) > self.response_limit {
                bail!(
                    "OIA1 assertion response exceeds {} bytes",
                    self.response_limit
                );
            }
            body.extend_from_slice(&chunk);
        }

        let encoded = std::str::from_utf8(&body).context("OIA1 assertion response is not UTF-8")?;
        let wire = base64::engine::general_purpose::STANDARD
            .decode(encoded.trim())
            .context("OIA1 assertion response is not standard base64")?;
        if wire.len() > MAX_ASSERTION_WIRE_BYTES {
            bail!("OIA1 assertion exceeds {} bytes", MAX_ASSERTION_WIRE_BYTES);
        }
        let signed = op_identity::oracle_assertion::SignedAssertion::from_wire(&wire)
            .map_err(|error| anyhow::anyhow!("invalid OIA1 assertion envelope: {error}"))?;
        if signed.assertion.tunnel_inner_ip != self.source {
            bail!(
                "OIA1 assertion inner IP {} does not match bound source {}",
                signed.assertion.tunnel_inner_ip,
                self.source
            );
        }

        Ok(GhostbridgeCallMetadata {
            sealed_id: None,
            oracle_assertion: Some(wire),
            session_genesis: None,
            trace_id: None,
            wireguard_pubkey: None,
        })
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use axum::extract::ConnectInfo;
    use axum::http::{HeaderValue, StatusCode, Uri};
    use axum::routing::any;
    use axum::Router;
    use ed25519_dalek::SigningKey;
    use op_identity::oracle_assertion::DecoyIssuer;
    use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};
    use tokio::task::JoinHandle;

    const SOURCE: IpAddr = IpAddr::V4(std::net::Ipv4Addr::LOCALHOST);

    async fn serve(app: Router) -> (SocketAddr, JoinHandle<()>) {
        let listener = tokio::net::TcpListener::bind((std::net::Ipv4Addr::LOCALHOST, 0))
            .await
            .unwrap();
        let address = listener.local_addr().unwrap();
        let task = tokio::spawn(async move {
            axum::serve(
                listener,
                app.into_make_service_with_connect_info::<SocketAddr>(),
            )
            .await
            .unwrap();
        });
        (address, task)
    }

    fn fixture_wire_for(source: IpAddr) -> Vec<u8> {
        let issuer = DecoyIssuer::new(
            SigningKey::from_bytes(&[7u8; 32]),
            "fixture-decoy",
            Duration::from_secs(900),
        );
        issuer
            .issue(
                "AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA=",
                source,
                Duration::from_secs(60),
            )
            .unwrap()
            .to_wire()
    }

    fn fixture_wire() -> Vec<u8> {
        fixture_wire_for(SOURCE)
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn acquires_one_assertion_from_exact_path_and_source() {
        let observed = Arc::new(Mutex::new(None));
        let observed_for_handler = Arc::clone(&observed);
        let wire = fixture_wire();
        let encoded = base64::engine::general_purpose::STANDARD.encode(&wire);
        let app = Router::new().fallback(any(
            move |ConnectInfo(peer): ConnectInfo<SocketAddr>, uri: Uri| {
                let observed = Arc::clone(&observed_for_handler);
                let encoded = encoded.clone();
                async move {
                    *observed.lock().unwrap() = Some((peer, uri.path().to_string()));
                    (StatusCode::OK, encoded)
                }
            },
        ));
        let (endpoint, task) = serve(app).await;
        let result = DecoyAssertionClient::new(endpoint, SOURCE)
            .unwrap()
            .acquire()
            .await
            .unwrap();
        task.abort();

        assert_eq!(result.sealed_id, None);
        assert_eq!(result.session_genesis, None);
        assert_eq!(result.oracle_assertion.as_deref(), Some(wire.as_slice()));
        let (peer, path) = observed.lock().unwrap().clone().unwrap();
        assert_eq!(peer.ip(), SOURCE);
        assert_eq!(path, "/assertion");
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn rejects_http_403_denial() {
        let app = Router::new().fallback(any(|| async {
            (StatusCode::FORBIDDEN, "no verified peer for source\n")
        }));
        let (endpoint, task) = serve(app).await;
        let error = match DecoyAssertionClient::new(endpoint, SOURCE)
            .unwrap()
            .acquire()
            .await
        {
            Ok(_) => panic!("HTTP 403 must not produce an assertion"),
            Err(error) => error,
        };
        task.abort();
        assert!(error.to_string().contains("HTTP 403"));
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn rejects_redirects_without_following_them() {
        let app = Router::new().fallback(any(|| async {
            (
                StatusCode::FOUND,
                [(
                    axum::http::header::LOCATION,
                    HeaderValue::from_static("/other"),
                )],
                "redirect",
            )
        }));
        let (endpoint, task) = serve(app).await;
        let error = match DecoyAssertionClient::new(endpoint, SOURCE)
            .unwrap()
            .acquire()
            .await
        {
            Ok(_) => panic!("redirect must not produce an assertion"),
            Err(error) => error,
        };
        task.abort();
        assert!(error.to_string().contains("HTTP 302"));
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn rejects_malformed_and_oversized_responses() {
        let malformed = Router::new().fallback(any(|| async { (StatusCode::OK, "not-base64") }));
        let (endpoint, task) = serve(malformed).await;
        let error = match DecoyAssertionClient::new(endpoint, SOURCE)
            .unwrap()
            .acquire()
            .await
        {
            Ok(_) => panic!("malformed response must be rejected"),
            Err(error) => error,
        };
        task.abort();
        assert!(error.to_string().contains("base64"));

        let oversized = "A".repeat(MAX_ASSERTION_RESPONSE_BYTES + 1);
        let app = Router::new().fallback(any(move || {
            let oversized = oversized.clone();
            async move { (StatusCode::OK, oversized) }
        }));
        let (endpoint, task) = serve(app).await;
        let error = match DecoyAssertionClient::new(endpoint, SOURCE)
            .unwrap()
            .acquire()
            .await
        {
            Ok(_) => panic!("oversized response must be rejected"),
            Err(error) => error,
        };
        task.abort();
        assert!(error.to_string().contains("exceeds"));
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn rejects_valid_base64_with_malformed_or_trailing_wire() {
        let mut trailing = fixture_wire();
        trailing.push(0);
        for body in [
            base64::engine::general_purpose::STANDARD.encode(b"OIA1"),
            base64::engine::general_purpose::STANDARD.encode(trailing),
        ] {
            let app = Router::new().fallback(any({
                let body = body.clone();
                move || {
                    let body = body.clone();
                    async move { (StatusCode::OK, body) }
                }
            }));
            let (endpoint, task) = serve(app).await;
            let error = match DecoyAssertionClient::new(endpoint, SOURCE)
                .unwrap()
                .acquire()
                .await
            {
                Ok(_) => panic!("malformed OIA1 wire must be rejected"),
                Err(error) => error,
            };
            task.abort();
            assert!(error.to_string().contains("envelope"));
        }
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn rejects_signed_inner_ip_mismatch() {
        let other = IpAddr::V4(std::net::Ipv4Addr::new(127, 0, 0, 2));
        let encoded = base64::engine::general_purpose::STANDARD.encode(fixture_wire_for(other));
        let app = Router::new().fallback(any(move || {
            let encoded = encoded.clone();
            async move { (StatusCode::OK, encoded) }
        }));
        let (endpoint, task) = serve(app).await;
        let error = match DecoyAssertionClient::new(endpoint, SOURCE)
            .unwrap()
            .acquire()
            .await
        {
            Ok(_) => panic!("inner IP mismatch must be rejected"),
            Err(error) => error,
        };
        task.abort();
        assert!(error.to_string().contains("does not match"));
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn rejects_slow_response_with_bounded_timeout() {
        let app = Router::new().fallback(any(|| async {
            tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(100)).await;
            (StatusCode::OK, "anything")
        }));
        let (endpoint, task) = serve(app).await;
        let error = match DecoyAssertionClient::with_limits(
            endpoint,
            SOURCE,
            Duration::from_millis(10),
            MAX_ASSERTION_RESPONSE_BYTES,
        )
        .unwrap()
        .acquire()
        .await
        {
            Ok(_) => panic!("slow response must time out"),
            Err(error) => error,
        };
        task.abort();
        let chain = format!("{error:#}");
        assert!(
            chain.contains("timed out") || chain.contains("deadline") || chain.contains("elapsed")
        );
    }
}
