<file path="op-grpc-bridge/src/project_dispatch_tests.rs">
use super::*;
use crate::{
    human_principal_dispatch::tests::{
        pk, register, temp_cozo, temp_shm_with_schemas, test_engine,
    },
    identity_sled_dispatch::{tests::write_identity, IdentitySledStore},
    oracle_assertion::HumanPrincipalIdentity,
};
use op_state::StatePlugin;

struct GrantsEnvironment(Option<std::ffi::OsString>);
impl Drop for GrantsEnvironment {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        match self.0.take() {
            Some(path) => std::env::set_var("OP_GRANTS_PATH", path),
            None => std::env::remove_var("OP_GRANTS_PATH"),
        }
    }
}

async fn invoke(
    engine: &MutationEngine,
    identity: &HumanPrincipalIdentity,
    method: &str,
    args: Value,
) -> Result<Value> {
    let schema = ProjectPlugin.schema().unwrap();
    let declaration = &schema.methods[method];
    let capability = schema.resolve_method_capability(declaration);
    let output = engine
        .dispatch_method_call_with_identity(
            "project",
            method,
            &args.to_string(),
            Some(capability.capability()),
            &identity.principal_id,
            Some(&identity.session_id),
            Some(&identity.session_genesis),
        )
        .await?["result"]
        .clone();
    jsonschema::Validator::new(&serde_json::to_value(
        declaration.returns.as_ref().unwrap(),
    )?)
    .map_err(|error| anyhow!("invalid project output schema: {error}"))?
    .validate(&output)
    .map_err(|error| anyhow!("invalid project output: {error}"))?;
    Ok(output)
}

#[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread")]
async fn project_membership_and_context_methods_enforce_durable_session_ownership() {
    let _cozo = temp_cozo();
    let _shm = temp_shm_with_schemas(&[
        op_plugins::state_plugins::human_principal::HumanPrincipalPlugin::new()
            .schema()
            .unwrap(),
        op_plugins::state_plugins::identity_sled::IdentitySledPlugin::new()
            .schema()
            .unwrap(),
        ProjectPlugin.schema().unwrap(),
    ]);
    let engine = test_engine();
    engine
        .install_identity_sled_store_for_test(IdentitySledStore::new(
            CozoGraphShuttle::new_in_memory().unwrap(),
        ))
        .unwrap();
    let root = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let _environment = GrantsEnvironment(std::env::var_os("OP_GRANTS_PATH"));
    let grants_path = root.path().join("grants.json");
    std::env::set_var("OP_GRANTS_PATH", &grants_path);
    let mut identities = Vec::new();
    for (byte, name) in [(0xD5, "project-owner"), (0xD6, "project-member")] {
        let key = pk(byte);
        register(&key, name).await.unwrap();
        let sled = write_identity(&engine, &key).await.unwrap();
        identities.push(HumanPrincipalIdentity {
            principal_id: op_identity::session::derive_principal_id(&key),
            human_pubkey: key,
            session_id: sled.session_id,
            session_genesis: sled.genesis.unwrap(),
            expires_at: 0,
        });
    }
    let owner = &identities[0];
    let member = &identities[1];
    std::fs::write(&grants_path, serde_json::to_vec(&json!({
        (owner.principal_id.clone()): {"capabilities":["project.read","project.admin","chat.context","chat.control_plane","cognitive_mcp.read","cognitive_mcp.memory.write","snowball.read"]},
        (member.principal_id.clone()): {"capabilities":["project.read","project.admin","chat.context"]}
    })).unwrap()).unwrap();

    // Seed a trusted catalog fixture for access-control operations. This does
    // not claim provisioning, Incus verification or project document I/O.
    let id = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();
    let agent = known_agent_ids()
        .into_iter()
        .next()
        .expect("builtin agent catalog");
    let project = Project {
        project_id: id.clone(),
        title: "private project fixture".into(),
        owner_session_id: owner.session_id.clone(),
        container_id: id.clone(),
        status: ProjectStatus::Ready,
        persistence_path: root.path().join(&id).to_string_lossy().into_owned(),
        members: vec![],
        invitations: vec![],
        capability_ceiling: BTreeSet::from(["project.read".into(), "chat.context".into()]),
        allowed_agents: BTreeSet::from([agent.clone()]),
        selected_agent: None,
        created_at: chrono::Utc::now().timestamp(),
    };
    save_project(&engine, &project).await.unwrap();
    let args = json!({"project_id":id});
    let owned = invoke(&engine, owner, "get", args.clone()).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(owned["project"]["owner_session_id"], owner.session_id);
    assert!(invoke(&engine, member, "get", args.clone()).await.is_err());
    assert_eq!(
        invoke(&engine, member, "list", json!({})).await.unwrap()["projects"],
        json!([])
    );
    let listed = invoke(&engine, owner, "list", json!({})).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(listed["projects"].as_array().unwrap().len(), 1);
    assert_eq!(listed["projects"][0], owned["project"]);

    let selected = invoke(
        &engine,
        owner,
        "select_agent",
        json!({"project_id":id,"agent_id":agent}),
    )
    .await
    .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(selected["project"]["selected_agent"], agent);
    assert_eq!(
        get_project(&engine, &id)
            .await
            .unwrap()
            .selected_agent
            .as_deref(),
        Some(agent.as_str())
    );
    let invited = invoke(
        &engine,
        owner,
        "invite",
        json!({"project_id":id,
        "invited_session_id":member.session_id,"role":"contributor","ttl_seconds":300}),
    )
    .await
    .unwrap();
    let invitation = invited["project"]["invitations"][0]["invitation_id"]
        .as_str()
        .unwrap();
    let acceptance = json!({"project_id":id,"invitation_id":invitation});
    assert!(invoke(&engine, owner, "accept_invite", acceptance.clone())
        .await
        .is_err());
    let accepted = invoke(&engine, member, "accept_invite", acceptance.clone())
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        accepted["project"]["members"][0]["session_id"],
        member.session_id
    );
    assert_eq!(accepted["project"]["members"][0]["role"], "contributor");
    assert_eq!(accepted["project"]["invitations"], json!([]));
    assert!(invoke(&engine, member, "accept_invite", acceptance)
        .await
        .is_err());
    let durable = get_project(&engine, &id).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        durable.role_for(&member.session_id),
        Some(ProjectRole::Contributor)
    );
    assert!(durable.invitations.is_empty());
    assert_eq!(
        invoke(&engine, member, "list", json!({})).await.unwrap()["projects"][0]["project_id"],
        id
    );
    // A global admin capability does not grant membership administration.
    assert!(invoke(
        &engine,
        member,
        "select_agent",
        json!({"project_id":id,"agent_id":agent})
    )
    .await
    .is_err());
    let revoked = invoke(
        &engine,
        owner,
        "revoke_member",
        json!({"project_id":id,"session_id":member.session_id}),
    )
    .await
    .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(revoked["project"]["members"], json!([]));
    assert!(get_project(&engine, &id)
        .await
        .unwrap()
        .role_for(&member.session_id)
        .is_none());
    assert!(invoke(&engine, member, "get", args.clone()).await.is_err());
    assert!(invoke(
        &engine,
        owner,
        "revoke_member",
        json!({"project_id":id,"session_id":owner.session_id})
    )
    .await
    .is_err());

    for (mode, suffix, read_only, caps) in [
        (
            "personal",
            "personal",
            false,
            json!([
                "chat.context",
                "cognitive_mcp.memory.write",
                "cognitive_mcp.read"
            ]),
        ),
        (
            "control_plane",
            "control_plane",
            false,
            json!([
                "chat.context",
                "cognitive_mcp.memory.write",
                "cognitive_mcp.read"
            ]),
        ),
        (
            "accountability",
            "accountability",
            true,
            json!(["chat.context", "snowball.read"]),
        ),
    ] {
        let context = invoke(&engine, owner, "resolve_context", json!({"mode":mode}))
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(context["session_id"], owner.session_id);
        assert_eq!(
            context["memory_namespace"],
            format!("session/{}/{suffix}", owner.session_id)
        );
        assert_eq!(context["read_only"], read_only);
        assert_eq!(context["effective_capabilities"], caps);
        assert_eq!(context["project_id"], Value::Null);
    }
    assert!(invoke(
        &engine,
        member,
        "resolve_context",
        json!({"mode":"control_plane"})
    )
    .await
    .is_err());
    // OD-65: the selection is per session, persisted, re-resolved on read,
    // and every memory call binds to it (see memory_binding).
    let selected = invoke(
        &engine,
        owner,
        "select_context",
        json!({"mode":"personal","personal_namespace":"notes"}),
    )
    .await
    .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        selected["memory_namespace"],
        format!("session/{}/personal/notes", owner.session_id)
    );
    let current = invoke(&engine, owner, "get_context", json!({}))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(current["memory_namespace"], selected["memory_namespace"]);
    // Nothing selected yet for the member: personal by default.
    let default = invoke(&engine, member, "get_context", json!({}))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        default["memory_namespace"],
        format!("session/{}/personal", member.session_id)
    );
    // Invalid selections are refused before they are stored.
    for bad in [
        json!({"mode":"personal","personal_namespace":"Not Valid"}),
        json!({"mode":"project","personal_namespace":"notes"}),
        json!({"mode":"notebooklm"}),
        json!({"mode":"project","project_id":id}),
    ] {
        assert!(
            invoke(&engine, member, "select_context", bad.clone()).await.is_err(),
            "{bad}"
        );
    }
    // The project owner may select the project; the revoked member may not.
    let project_context = invoke(
        &engine,
        owner,
        "select_context",
        json!({"mode":"project","project_id":id}),
    )
    .await
    .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(project_context["memory_namespace"], format!("project/{id}"));
    assert_eq!(project_context["read_only"], false);
    // ui_render: no memory at all, and it persists like any other selection.
    let ui = invoke(&engine, owner, "select_context", json!({"mode":"ui_render"}))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(ui["memory_namespace"], "");
    assert_eq!(ui["read_only"], true);
    let ui_again = invoke(&engine, owner, "get_context", json!({}))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(ui_again["mode"], "ui_render");
    // A stored selection that stops resolving fails closed on read.
    invoke(
        &engine,
        owner,
        "select_context",
        json!({"mode":"project","project_id":id}),
    )
    .await
    .unwrap();
    let stored = crate::project_dispatch::stored_selection(&engine, &owner.session_id)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(stored.project_id.as_deref(), Some(id.as_str()));

    let mut forged = owner.clone();
    forged.session_id = member.session_id.clone();
    assert!(invoke(&engine, &forged, "get", args).await.is_err());
    let retained = get_project(&engine, &id).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(retained.owner_session_id, owner.session_id);
    assert_eq!(retained.selected_agent.as_deref(), Some(agent.as_str()));
    assert!(retained.members.is_empty());
}
</file>

<file path="op-grpc-bridge/src/project_dispatch.rs">
//! Authenticated project effects, entered only through MutationEngine/D-Bus.
//! No ambient user, caller-supplied owner or cross-project store path is used.
use anyhow::{anyhow, bail, Context, Result};
use op_cozo_store::CozoGraphShuttle;
use op_plugins::state_plugins::{incus::IncusPlugin, project::*};
use serde_json::{json, Value};
use std::collections::{BTreeSet, HashMap};
use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt;
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::sync::{Arc, OnceLock};
use tokio::sync::Mutex;

use crate::{interceptor::load_capability_grants, mutation_engine::MutationEngine};

const PROJECT_ROOT: &str = "/var/lib/op-dbus/projects";
static PROJECT_LOCK: Mutex<()> = Mutex::const_new(());
type Stores = HashMap<String, Arc<CozoGraphShuttle>>;
static STORES: OnceLock<Mutex<Stores>> = OnceLock::new();

fn canonical_id(id: &str) -> Result<()> {
    if uuid::Uuid::parse_str(id)?.to_string() != id {
        bail!("expected a canonical session/project UUID");
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn project_path(id: &str) -> Result<PathBuf> {
    canonical_id(id)?;
    Ok(Path::new(PROJECT_ROOT).join(id))
}

async fn catalog(engine: &MutationEngine, query: &'static str, params: Value) -> Result<Value> {
    let store = engine.identity_sled_store()?.cozo().clone();
    tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || store.run_query(query, Some(params)))
        .await?
        .map_err(Into::into)
}

fn decode_project_rows(value: Value) -> Result<Vec<Project>> {
    value
        .as_array()
        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("invalid project catalog rows"))?
        .iter()
        .map(|row| {
            serde_json::from_str(
                row["document"]
                    .as_str()
                    .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("invalid project catalog document"))?,
            )
            .map_err(Into::into)
        })
        .collect()
}

async fn list_projects(engine: &MutationEngine) -> Result<Vec<Project>> {
    decode_project_rows(
        catalog(
            engine,
            "?[document] := *project_catalog{document}",
            json!({}),
        )
        .await?,
    )
}

async fn get_project(engine: &MutationEngine, id: &str) -> Result<Project> {
    canonical_id(id)?;
    decode_project_rows(
        catalog(
            engine,
            "?[document] := *project_catalog{project_id, document}, project_id = $id",
            json!({"id":id}),
        )
        .await?,
    )?
    .into_iter()
    .next()
    .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("project access denied"))
}

async fn save_project(engine: &MutationEngine, project: &Project) -> Result<()> {
    catalog(engine, "?[project_id, document] <- [[$id, $document]] :put project_catalog {project_id => document}",
        json!({"id":project.project_id, "document":serde_json::to_string(project)?})).await?;
    Ok(())
}

async fn project_store(project: &Project, create: bool) -> Result<Arc<CozoGraphShuttle>> {
    let mut stores = STORES
        .get_or_init(|| Mutex::new(HashMap::new()))
        .lock()
        .await;
    if let Some(store) = stores.get(&project.project_id) {
        return Ok(store.clone());
    }
    let path = project_path(&project.project_id)?;
    if path.to_str() != Some(project.persistence_path.as_str()) {
        bail!("project persistence binding mismatch");
    }
    let store = tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || -> Result<CozoGraphShuttle> {
        if create {
            std::fs::create_dir_all(&path)?;
        }
        // The project namespace is a UUID, never a user path. Refuse symlinks
        // at every owned level and retain private permissions on the host.
        for directory in [Path::new(PROJECT_ROOT).to_path_buf(), path.clone()] {
            let meta = std::fs::symlink_metadata(&directory)?;
            if !meta.is_dir() || meta.file_type().is_symlink() {
                bail!("unsafe project store directory");
            }
            std::fs::set_permissions(&directory, std::fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o700))?;
        }
        let db_path = path.join("cozo");
        if let Ok(meta) = std::fs::symlink_metadata(&db_path) {
            if meta.file_type().is_symlink() {
                bail!("unsafe project database path");
            }
        } else if !create {
            bail!("project database is missing; refusing to create an empty replacement");
        }
        Ok(CozoGraphShuttle::new_persistent(db_path)?)
    })
    .await??;
    let store = Arc::new(store);
    stores.insert(project.project_id.clone(), store.clone());
    Ok(store)
}

async fn require_ready(project: &Project) -> Result<()> {
    if project.status != ProjectStatus::Ready {
        bail!("project provisioning is incomplete");
    }
    IncusPlugin::verify_project_container(
        &project.container_id,
        &project.owner_session_id,
        &project.persistence_path,
    )
    .await
}

fn view_for(mut project: Project, session: &str) -> Project {
    if project.role_for(session) != Some(ProjectRole::Admin) {
        project.invitations.clear();
    }
    project
}

pub(crate) async fn verified_session(
    engine: &MutationEngine,
    actor: &str,
    session: Option<&str>,
    genesis: Option<&str>,
) -> Result<String> {
    let session = session
        .filter(|id| !id.is_empty())
        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("verified session is required"))?;
    canonical_id(session)?;
    let sled = crate::identity_sled_dispatch::stored_session(engine, session)
        .await
        .context("identity credential projection is unavailable")?
        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("verified session does not exist"))?;
    if !sled.is_anchored()
        || sled.genesis.as_deref() != genesis
        || op_identity::session::derive_principal_id(&sled.wireguard_pubkey) != actor
        || sled
            .expires_at
            .is_some_and(|at| at != 0 && at <= chrono::Utc::now().timestamp())
    {
        bail!("verified session binding is invalid");
    }
    let principal =
        crate::human_principal_dispatch::resolve_key_for_assertion(&sled.wireguard_pubkey)
            .await
            .map_err(|_| anyhow!("principal registry is unavailable"))?
            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("session key is not registered"))?;
    if principal.revoked_at != 0 || principal.principal_id != actor {
        bail!("session principal is revoked or mismatched");
    }
    Ok(session.into())
}

pub(crate) async fn dispatch(
    engine: &MutationEngine,
    method: &str,
    args: &Value,
    actor: &str,
    session: Option<&str>,
    genesis: Option<&str>,
) -> Result<Value> {
    let session = verified_session(engine, actor, session, genesis).await?;
    let grants: BTreeSet<String> = load_capability_grants(actor).into_iter().collect();
    let required = match method {
        "create" => "project.create",
        "invite" | "revoke_member" | "select_agent" => "project.admin",
        "put_document" => "project.write",
        "resolve_context" | "select_context" | "get_context" => "chat.context",
        "get" | "list" | "accept_invite" | "list_documents" => "project.read",
        _ => bail!("unknown project method"),
    };
    if !grants.contains(required) {
        bail!("exact project capability grant is required");
    }
    // Serializes ACL changes with all data access: a revocation cannot race a
    // stale read/modify/write of the project document. Cross-process entry is
    // exclusively the bridge; Cozo's process lock prevents a second writer.
    let _lock = PROJECT_LOCK.lock().await;
    if method == "resolve_context" {
        let input: ResolveContextInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
        return Ok(serde_json::to_value(
            resolve_context(engine, &session, &grants, input).await?,
        )?);
    }
    if method == "select_context" {
        let input: SelectContextInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
        let selection = ChatContextSelection {
            mode: input.mode,
            project_id: input.project_id,
            personal_namespace: input.personal_namespace,
        };
        // Validate exactly as a turn would resolve it before persisting.
        let resolved = resolve_selection(engine, &session, &grants, &selection).await?;
        let document = serde_json::to_string(&selection)?;
        catalog(
            engine,
            "?[session_id, document] <- [[$session, $document]] :put chat_context_selection {session_id => document}",
            json!({"session": session, "document": document}),
        )
        .await?;
        return Ok(serde_json::to_value(resolved)?);
    }
    if method == "get_context" {
        let _: GetContextInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
        return Ok(serde_json::to_value(
            current_chat_context(engine, &session, &grants).await?,
        )?);
    }
    if method == "list" {
        let _: EmptyInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
        return Ok(serde_json::to_value(ProjectListOutput {
            projects: list_projects(engine)
                .await?
                .into_iter()
                .filter(|p| p.role_for(&session).is_some())
                .map(|p| view_for(p, &session))
                .collect(),
        })?);
    }
    if method == "create" {
        let input: CreateProjectInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
        if input.title.trim().is_empty() || input.title.len() > 256 {
            bail!("project title must contain 1–256 bytes");
        }
        if !input.capability_ceiling.is_subset(&grants) {
            bail!("project ceiling cannot exceed creator's exact grants");
        }
        if !input.allowed_agents.is_subset(&known_agent_ids()) {
            bail!("project agent is not in the declared catalog");
        }
        let fingerprint = std::env::var("OP_PROJECT_IMAGE_FINGERPRINT")
            .context("project image fingerprint is not configured")?;
        let pool = std::env::var("OP_PROJECT_STORAGE_POOL")
            .context("project storage pool is not configured")?;
        let id = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();
        let mut project = Project {
            project_id: id.clone(),
            title: input.title,
            owner_session_id: session.clone(),
            container_id: id.clone(),
            status: ProjectStatus::Provisioning,
            persistence_path: project_path(&id)?.to_string_lossy().into_owned(),
            members: vec![],
            invitations: vec![],
            capability_ceiling: input.capability_ceiling,
            allowed_agents: input.allowed_agents,
            selected_agent: None,
            created_at: chrono::Utc::now().timestamp(),
        };
        save_project(engine, &project).await?;
        project_store(&project, true).await?;
        IncusPlugin::create_project_container(
            &id,
            &session,
            &fingerprint,
            &pool,
            &project.persistence_path,
        )
        .await
        .with_context(|| format!("project {id} remains provisioning; inspect before retrying"))?;
        project.status = ProjectStatus::Ready;
        save_project(engine, &project).await?;
        return Ok(serde_json::to_value(ProjectOutput { project })?);
    }
    let id = args["project_id"]
        .as_str()
        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("project_id is required"))?;
    let mut project = get_project(engine, id).await?;
    if method == "accept_invite" {
        let input: AcceptInviteInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
        project.accept_invitation(
            &session,
            &input.invitation_id,
            chrono::Utc::now().timestamp(),
        )?;
        save_project(engine, &project).await?;
    } else {
        project.authorize(
            &session,
            method == "put_document",
            matches!(method, "invite" | "revoke_member" | "select_agent"),
        )?;
        match method {
            "get" => {
                let _: ProjectInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
            }
            "invite" => {
                let input: InviteInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
                canonical_id(&input.invited_session_id)?;
                if !(1..=604800).contains(&input.ttl_seconds) {
                    bail!("invitation lifetime must be 1 second to 7 days");
                }
                if project.role_for(&input.invited_session_id).is_some() {
                    bail!("session is already a member");
                }
                if crate::identity_sled_dispatch::stored_session(engine, &input.invited_session_id)
                    .await
                    .context("identity credential projection is unavailable")?
                    .is_none()
                {
                    bail!("invited session does not exist");
                }
                project
                    .invitations
                    .retain(|i| i.invited_session_id != input.invited_session_id);
                project.invitations.push(ProjectInvitation {
                    invitation_id: uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string(),
                    invited_session_id: input.invited_session_id,
                    invited_by_session_id: session.clone(),
                    role: input.role,
                    expires_at: chrono::Utc::now().timestamp() + i64::from(input.ttl_seconds),
                });
                save_project(engine, &project).await?;
            }
            "revoke_member" => {
                let input: RevokeMemberInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
                if input.session_id == project.owner_session_id {
                    bail!("cannot revoke the project owner");
                }
                project.members.retain(|m| m.session_id != input.session_id);
                project
                    .invitations
                    .retain(|i| i.invited_session_id != input.session_id);
                save_project(engine, &project).await?;
            }
            "select_agent" => {
                let input: SelectAgentInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
                if !project.allowed_agents.contains(&input.agent_id)
                    || !known_agent_ids().contains(&input.agent_id)
                {
                    bail!("agent is not allowed for this project");
                }
                project.selected_agent = Some(input.agent_id);
                save_project(engine, &project).await?;
            }
            "put_document" => {
                let input: PutDocumentInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
                if input.document_id.is_empty()
                    || input.document_id.len() > 128
                    || input.content.len() > 1_048_576
                    || input.media_type.is_empty()
                    || input.media_type.len() > 128
                {
                    bail!("invalid project document size or media type");
                }
                require_ready(&project).await?;
                let store = project_store(&project, false).await?;
                let document = ProjectDocument {
                    document_id: input.document_id,
                    collection: input.collection,
                    content: input.content,
                    media_type: input.media_type,
                    author_session_id: session.clone(),
                    updated_at: chrono::Utc::now().timestamp(),
                };
                let params = json!({"collection": serde_json::to_value(document.collection)?, "id":document.document_id, "document":serde_json::to_string(&document)?});
                tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || store.run_query(
                    "?[collection, document_id, document] <- [[$collection, $id, $document]] :put project_documents {collection, document_id => document}", Some(params))).await??;
                return Ok(serde_json::to_value(DocumentOutput { document })?);
            }
            "list_documents" => {
                let input: ListDocumentsInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
                require_ready(&project).await?;
                let store = project_store(&project, false).await?;
                let rows = tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || store.run_query(
                    "?[document] := *project_documents{collection, document}, collection = $collection :limit 100",
                    Some(json!({"collection":input.collection})))).await??;
                let documents = rows
                    .as_array()
                    .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("invalid project document rows"))?
                    .iter()
                    .map(|row| {
                        serde_json::from_str(
                            row["document"]
                                .as_str()
                                .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("invalid project document"))?,
                        )
                        .map_err(Into::into)
                    })
                    .collect::<Result<Vec<ProjectDocument>>>()?;
                return Ok(serde_json::to_value(DocumentsOutput { documents })?);
            }
            _ => bail!("unknown project method"),
        }
    }
    Ok(serde_json::to_value(ProjectOutput {
        project: view_for(project, &session),
    })?)
}

async fn resolve_context(
    engine: &MutationEngine,
    session: &str,
    grants: &BTreeSet<String>,
    input: ResolveContextInput,
) -> Result<ResolvedChatContext> {
    if input.mode != ChatMode::Project && input.project_id.is_some() {
        bail!("project_id is only valid in project mode");
    }
    if input.mode != ChatMode::Personal && input.personal_namespace.is_some() {
        bail!("personal_namespace is only valid in personal mode");
    }
    let mut context = ResolvedChatContext {
        mode: input.mode,
        session_id: session.into(),
        project_id: None,
        memory_namespace: String::new(),
        read_only: input.mode == ChatMode::Accountability,
        effective_capabilities: BTreeSet::new(),
        allowed_agents: BTreeSet::new(),
        selected_agent: None,
    };
    match input.mode {
        ChatMode::Project => {
            let id = input
                .project_id
                .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("project mode requires project_id"))?;
            let project = get_project(engine, &id).await?;
            context.effective_capabilities = project.effective_capabilities(session, grants)?;
            require_ready(&project).await?;
            context.read_only = project.role_for(session) == Some(ProjectRole::Reader);
            context.memory_namespace = format!("project/{id}");
            context.project_id = Some(id);
            context.allowed_agents = project.allowed_agents;
            context.selected_agent = project.selected_agent;
        }
        ChatMode::Personal => {
            context.memory_namespace = memory_namespace_for(
                ChatMode::Personal,
                session,
                None,
                input.personal_namespace.as_deref(),
            )?;
            context.effective_capabilities = grants
                .iter()
                .filter(|cap| {
                    matches!(
                        cap.as_str(),
                        "chat.context" | "cognitive_mcp.read" | "cognitive_mcp.memory.write"
                    )
                })
                .cloned()
                .collect();
        }
        ChatMode::ControlPlane => {
            if !grants.contains("chat.control_plane") {
                bail!("control-plane mode requires an explicit grant");
            }
            context.memory_namespace = format!("session/{session}/control_plane");
            context.effective_capabilities = grants
                .iter()
                .filter(|cap| {
                    matches!(
                        cap.as_str(),
                        "chat.context"
                            | "cognitive_mcp.read"
                            | "cognitive_mcp.memory.write"
                            | "workflows.read"
                            | "workflows.execute"
                    )
                })
                .cloned()
                .collect();
        }
        ChatMode::Accountability => {
            context.memory_namespace = format!("session/{session}/accountability");
            context.effective_capabilities = grants
                .iter()
                .filter(|cap| matches!(cap.as_str(), "chat.context" | "snowball.read"))
                .cloned()
                .collect();
        }
        ChatMode::NotebookLm => {
            // The partition is the notebook this session selected through the
            // notebooklm plugin; none selected → the mode cannot be entered.
            let notebook = selected_notebook(engine, session)
                .await?
                .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("notebooklm mode requires a selected notebook"))?;
            context.memory_namespace =
                memory_namespace_for(ChatMode::NotebookLm, session, Some(&notebook), None)?;
            context.effective_capabilities = grants
                .iter()
                .filter(|cap| {
                    matches!(
                        cap.as_str(),
                        "chat.context"
                            | "cognitive_mcp.read"
                            | "cognitive_mcp.memory.write"
                            | "notebooklm.read"
                            | "notebooklm.query"
                    )
                })
                .cloned()
                .collect();
        }
        ChatMode::UiRender => {
            // No memory at all: nothing recalled, nothing written.
            context.memory_namespace = String::new();
            context.read_only = true;
            context.effective_capabilities = grants
                .iter()
                .filter(|cap| matches!(cap.as_str(), "chat.context"))
                .cloned()
                .collect();
        }
    }
    Ok(context)
}

async fn selected_notebook(engine: &MutationEngine, session: &str) -> Result<Option<String>> {
    let rows = catalog(
        engine,
        "?[notebook_id] := *notebooklm_selection{session_id, notebook_id}, session_id = $session",
        json!({"session": session}),
    )
    .await?;
    Ok(rows
        .as_array()
        .and_then(|rows| rows.first())
        .and_then(|row| row["notebook_id"].as_str())
        .filter(|id| !id.is_empty())
        .map(str::to_owned))
}

async fn resolve_selection(
    engine: &MutationEngine,
    session: &str,
    grants: &BTreeSet<String>,
    selection: &ChatContextSelection,
) -> Result<ResolvedChatContext> {
    resolve_context(
        engine,
        session,
        grants,
        ResolveContextInput {
            mode: selection.mode,
            project_id: selection.project_id.clone(),
            personal_namespace: selection.personal_namespace.clone(),
        },
    )
    .await
}

/// The session's persisted selection (personal when none was made).
pub(crate) async fn stored_selection(
    engine: &MutationEngine,
    session: &str,
) -> Result<ChatContextSelection> {
    let rows = catalog(
        engine,
        "?[document] := *chat_context_selection{session_id, document}, session_id = $session",
        json!({"session": session}),
    )
    .await?;
    let Some(document) = rows
        .as_array()
        .and_then(|rows| rows.first())
        .and_then(|row| row["document"].as_str())
    else {
        return Ok(ChatContextSelection::default());
    };
    Ok(serde_json::from_str(document)?)
}

/// What this session's memory calls and turns bind to right now. Re-resolved
/// on every use so a revoked membership or grant takes effect immediately;
/// a selection that no longer resolves fails closed (no silent fallback to
/// personal).
pub(crate) async fn current_chat_context(
    engine: &MutationEngine,
    session: &str,
    grants: &BTreeSet<String>,
) -> Result<ResolvedChatContext> {
    let selection = stored_selection(engine, session).await?;
    resolve_selection(engine, session, grants, &selection).await
}

#[cfg(test)]
#[path = "project_dispatch_tests.rs"]
mod tests;

<file path="op-grpc-bridge/src/proto_gen.rs">
//! Proto Generator - Generate protobuf definitions from PluginSchema
//!
//! Converts operation-dbus plugin schemas to protobuf message and service
//! definitions, enabling dynamic schema-driven gRPC.
//!
//! For plugins using `#[derive(schemars::JsonSchema)]` on method input types,
//! this generates equivalent protobuf services that mirror the D-Bus objects
//! registered by SchemaBackedInterface.

use op_state_store::{FieldType, PluginSchema, SchemaCatalog, SchemaRegistry};
use std::fmt::Write;

/// Configuration for protobuf generation
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct ProtoGenConfig {
    /// Package name for generated proto
    pub package_name: String,
    /// Whether to generate service definitions
    pub generate_services: bool,
    /// Whether to include validation annotations
    pub include_validation: bool,
    /// Whether to generate streaming RPCs for state changes
    pub generate_streams: bool,
}

impl Default for ProtoGenConfig {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            package_name: "operation.v1".to_string(),
            generate_services: true,
            include_validation: true,
            generate_streams: true,
        }
    }
}

/// Generate protobuf definitions from plugin schemas and their method declarations.
///
/// Each plugin's `MethodDecl` entries become typed RPCs. This mirrors the D-Bus
/// objects created by `SchemaBackedInterface.register_objects()`.
pub fn generate_plugin_method_protos(plugin_schemas: &[(String, PluginSchema)]) -> String {
    let mut output = String::new();

    writeln!(output, "syntax = \"proto3\";").unwrap();
    writeln!(output).unwrap();
    writeln!(output, "package operation.plugin.v1;").unwrap();
    writeln!(output).unwrap();
    writeln!(output, "import \"google/protobuf/struct.proto\";").unwrap();
    writeln!(output).unwrap();

    let mut plugin_ids: Vec<&String> = plugin_schemas.iter().map(|(id, _)| id).collect();
    plugin_ids.sort();

    for plugin_id in plugin_ids {
        let (_, schema) = plugin_schemas
            .iter()
            .find(|(id, _)| id == plugin_id)
            .unwrap();
        generate_plugin_service(&mut output, plugin_id, schema);
    }

    output
}

/// Generate a service for a single plugin with typed method messages.
fn generate_plugin_service(output: &mut String, plugin_id: &str, schema: &PluginSchema) {
    writeln!(
        output,
        "// ================================================"
    )
    .unwrap();
    writeln!(output, "// Plugin: {}", plugin_id).unwrap();
    writeln!(output, "// {} service typed methods", schema.description).unwrap();
    writeln!(
        output,
        "// ================================================"
    )
    .unwrap();
    writeln!(output).unwrap();

    let service_name = to_pascal_case(plugin_id);
    writeln!(output, "service {} {{", service_name).unwrap();

    let mut method_names: Vec<&String> = schema.methods.keys().collect();
    method_names.sort();

    for method_name in method_names {
        let method = &schema.methods[method_name];
        let subid = method.subid.as_str();
        let cap = method.required_capability.as_deref().unwrap_or("none");

        writeln!(output, "  // subid: {}", subid).unwrap();
        writeln!(output, "  // capability: {}", cap).unwrap();

        writeln!(
            output,
            "  rpc {}(google.protobuf.Struct) returns (google.protobuf.Struct);",
            method_name
        )
        .unwrap();
    }

    writeln!(output, "}}").unwrap();
    writeln!(output).unwrap();
}

// ProtoGenerator struct and other methods (kept for compatibility)
pub struct ProtoGenerator {
    config: ProtoGenConfig,
}

impl ProtoGenerator {
    pub fn new(config: ProtoGenConfig) -> Self {
        Self { config }
    }

    pub fn generate_for_schema(&self, schema: &PluginSchema) -> String {
        let mut output = String::new();
        writeln!(output, "syntax = \"proto3\";").unwrap();
        writeln!(output).unwrap();
        writeln!(output, "package {};", self.config.package_name).unwrap();
        writeln!(output).unwrap();
        writeln!(output, "import \"google/protobuf/struct.proto\";").unwrap();
        writeln!(output).unwrap();

        self.generate_message(&mut output, schema);
        output
    }

    pub fn generate_for_catalog(&self, catalog: &SchemaCatalog) -> String {
        let mut output = String::new();
        let mut schema_names: Vec<&str> = catalog.list();
        schema_names.sort_unstable();

        writeln!(output, "syntax = \"proto3\";").unwrap();
        writeln!(output).unwrap();
        writeln!(output, "package {};", self.config.package_name).unwrap();
        writeln!(output).unwrap();
        writeln!(output, "import \"google/protobuf/struct.proto\";").unwrap();
        writeln!(output).unwrap();

        for schema_name in schema_names {
            let Some(schema) = catalog.get(schema_name) else {
                continue;
            };
            writeln!(output, "// =============================================").unwrap();
            writeln!(output, "// {} - {}", schema.name, schema.description).unwrap();
            writeln!(output, "// =============================================").unwrap();
            writeln!(output).unwrap();

            self.generate_message(&mut output, schema);
            self.generate_crud_messages(&mut output, schema);

            if self.config.generate_services {
                self.generate_service(&mut output, schema);
            }

            writeln!(output).unwrap();
        }

        self.generate_unified_service(&mut output, catalog);
        output
    }

    pub fn generate_for_registry(&self, registry: &SchemaRegistry) -> String {
        self.generate_for_catalog(registry)
    }

    fn generate_message(&self, output: &mut String, schema: &PluginSchema) {
        let message_name = to_pascal_case(&schema.name);
        writeln!(output, "message {} {{", message_name).unwrap();

        let mut descendants = String::new();
        let mut fields: Vec<(&str, &op_state_store::FieldSchema)> = schema
            .fields
            .iter()
            .map(|(field_name, field_schema)| (field_name.as_str(), field_schema))
            .collect();
        fields.sort_unstable_by(|left, right| left.0.cmp(right.0));

        for (field_num, (field_name, field_schema)) in (1..).zip(fields) {
            let proto_type = match &field_schema.field_type {
                FieldType::Map(value) => format!(
                    "map<string, {}>",
                    map_value_proto(
                        value,
                        &format!("{message_name}MapValue{field_num}"),
                        &mut descendants
                    )
                ),
                other => self.field_type_to_proto(other),
            };
            let optional_marker =
                if field_schema.required || matches!(&field_schema.field_type, FieldType::Map(_)) {
                    ""
                } else {
                    "optional "
                };
            writeln!(
                output,
                "  {}{} {} = {};",
                optional_marker, proto_type, field_name, field_num
            )
            .unwrap();
        }

        writeln!(output, "}}").unwrap();
        writeln!(output).unwrap();
        output.push_str(&descendants);
    }

    fn generate_crud_messages(&self, output: &mut String, schema: &PluginSchema) {
        let message_name = to_pascal_case(&schema.name);

        writeln!(output, "message Get{}Request {{", message_name).unwrap();
        writeln!(output, "  string object_path = 1;").unwrap();
        writeln!(output, "}}").unwrap();

        writeln!(output, "message Get{}Response {{", message_name).unwrap();
        writeln!(output, "  {} state = 1;", message_name).unwrap();
        writeln!(output, "  string error = 2;").unwrap();
        writeln!(output, "}}").unwrap();

        if self.config.generate_streams {
            writeln!(output, "message {}Update {{", message_name).unwrap();
            writeln!(output, "  string object_path = 1;").unwrap();
            writeln!(output, "  {} state = 2;", message_name).unwrap();
            writeln!(output, "}}").unwrap();
        }

        writeln!(output).unwrap();
    }

    fn generate_service(&self, output: &mut String, schema: &PluginSchema) {
        let service_name = to_pascal_case(&schema.name);

        writeln!(output, "service {}Service {{", service_name).unwrap();
        writeln!(
            output,
            "  rpc Get(Get{}Request) returns (Get{}Response);",
            service_name, service_name
        )
        .unwrap();
        writeln!(output, "}}").unwrap();
        writeln!(output).unwrap();
    }

    fn generate_unified_service(&self, output: &mut String, _catalog: &SchemaCatalog) {
        writeln!(output, "service OperationService {{").unwrap();
        writeln!(
            output,
            "  rpc Get(GenericGetRequest) returns (GenericGetResponse);"
        )
        .unwrap();
        writeln!(output, "}}").unwrap();
    }

    fn field_type_to_proto(&self, field_type: &FieldType) -> String {
        match field_type {
            FieldType::String => "string".to_string(),
            FieldType::Integer => "int64".to_string(),
            FieldType::Float => "double".to_string(),
            FieldType::Boolean => "bool".to_string(),
            FieldType::Array(inner) if matches!(inner.as_ref(), FieldType::Map(_)) => {
                "repeated google.protobuf.Struct".into()
            }
            FieldType::Array(inner) => format!("repeated {}", self.field_type_to_proto(inner)),
            FieldType::Object(_) => "google.protobuf.Struct".to_string(),
            FieldType::Map(_) => "google.protobuf.Struct".into(),
            FieldType::Enum(_) => "string".to_string(),
            FieldType::OneOf(_) => "google.protobuf.Value".to_string(),
            FieldType::JsonSchema(_) | FieldType::Any => "google.protobuf.Value".to_string(),
        }
    }
}

/// New typed map fields use typed record values. Existing Object fields keep
/// their Struct wire representation and all existing field numbers stay put.
/// A protobuf map cannot directly contain a map/repeated value; WKT Struct /
/// ListValue retains those JSON boundaries (arbitrary numbers remain doubles).
fn map_value_proto(kind: &FieldType, name: &str, definitions: &mut String) -> String {
    match kind {
        FieldType::String | FieldType::Enum(_) => "string".into(),
        FieldType::Integer => "int64".into(),
        FieldType::Float => "double".into(),
        FieldType::Boolean => "bool".into(),
        FieldType::Array(_) => "google.protobuf.ListValue".into(),
        FieldType::Map(_) => "google.protobuf.Struct".into(),
        FieldType::Any | FieldType::OneOf(_) | FieldType::JsonSchema(_) => {
            "google.protobuf.Value".into()
        }
        FieldType::Object(fields) => {
            let mut nested = String::new();
            let mut message = format!("message {name} {{\n");
            let mut fields: Vec<_> = fields.iter().collect();
            fields.sort_unstable_by_key(|(key, _)| *key);
            for (index, (key, field)) in fields.into_iter().enumerate() {
                let number = index + 1;
                let child_name = format!("{name}Field{number}");
                let (ty, is_map) = match &field.field_type {
                    FieldType::Map(value) => (
                        format!(
                            "map<string, {}>",
                            map_value_proto(value, &child_name, &mut nested)
                        ),
                        true,
                    ),
                    other => (map_value_proto(other, &child_name, &mut nested), false),
                };
                let presence = if is_map
                    || ty.starts_with("google.protobuf.")
                    || matches!(&field.field_type, FieldType::Object(_))
                {
                    ""
                } else {
                    "optional "
                };
                writeln!(message, "  {presence}{ty} {key} = {number};").unwrap();
            }
            writeln!(message, "}}\n").unwrap();
            definitions.push_str(&message);
            definitions.push_str(&nested);
            name.to_owned()
        }
    }
}

/// Convert string to PascalCase
pub fn to_pascal_case(s: &str) -> String {
    s.split(['_', '-', ' ', '.'])
        .map(|word| {
            let mut chars = word.chars();
            match chars.next() {
                None => String::new(),
                Some(first) => first.to_uppercase().chain(chars).collect(),
            }
        })
        .collect()
}

/// Convert string to snake_case
// Test-only helper retained for future proto_gen tests; currently unreferenced.
#[cfg(test)]
#[allow(dead_code)]
fn to_snake_case(s: &str) -> String {
    let mut result = String::new();
    for (i, c) in s.chars().enumerate() {
        if c.is_uppercase() && i > 0 {
            result.push('_');
        }
        result.push(c.to_lowercase().next().unwrap_or(c));
    }
    result
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn test_to_pascal_case() {
        assert_eq!(to_pascal_case("lxc"), "Lxc");
        assert_eq!(to_pascal_case("network_interface"), "NetworkInterface");
        assert_eq!(to_pascal_case("ovs-bridge"), "OvsBridge");
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod typed_map_proto_tests {
    use super::*;
    use std::collections::HashMap;
    fn field(field_type: FieldType) -> op_state_store::FieldSchema {
        op_state_store::FieldSchema {
            field_type,
            required: false,
            description: String::new(),
            default: None,
            example: None,
            constraints: vec![],
            read_only: false,
            read_only_when: None,
        }
    }
    #[test]
    fn legacy_export_preserves_object_layout_and_adds_typed_map_records() {
        let schema = PluginSchema::builder("fixture")
            .field("existing", field(FieldType::Object(HashMap::new())))
            .field(
                "jobs",
                field(FieldType::Map(Box::new(FieldType::Object(HashMap::from(
                    [
                        ("ready".into(), field(FieldType::Boolean)),
                        (
                            "children".into(),
                            field(FieldType::Map(Box::new(FieldType::String))),
                        ),
                    ],
                ))))),
            )
            .build();
        let proto = ProtoGenerator::new(ProtoGenConfig::default()).generate_for_schema(&schema);
        assert!(proto.contains("optional google.protobuf.Struct existing = 1;"));
        assert!(proto.contains("map<string, FixtureMapValue2> jobs = 2;"));
        assert!(!proto.contains("optional map<"));
        assert!(proto.contains("message FixtureMapValue2 {"));
        assert!(proto.contains("map<string, string> children = 1;"));
        assert!(proto.contains("optional bool ready = 2;"));
    }
}

<file path="op-grpc-bridge/src/proxy_canonical_tests.rs">
//! Real relay effects through authenticated canonical dispatch and sealed SHM.
use super::*;
use crate::human_principal_dispatch::tests::{
    pk, register, temp_cozo, temp_shm_with_schemas, test_engine,
};
use crate::identity_sled_dispatch::{tests::write_identity, IdentitySledStore};
use op_plugins::state_plugins::{
    human_principal::HumanPrincipalPlugin, identity_sled::IdentitySledPlugin,
    proxy_server::ProxyServerPlugin, runtime_documents::RuntimeDocuments,
};
use op_state::StatePlugin;
use serde_json::{json, Value};
use tokio::{
    io::{AsyncReadExt, AsyncWriteExt},
    net::{TcpListener, TcpStream},
};

struct GrantsEnvironment(Option<std::ffi::OsString>);
impl Drop for GrantsEnvironment {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        if let Some(path) = self.0.take() {
            std::env::set_var("OP_GRANTS_PATH", path);
        } else {
            std::env::remove_var("OP_GRANTS_PATH");
        }
    }
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn three_proxy_methods_require_identity_and_publish_actual_committed_state() {
    let _cozo = temp_cozo();
    let schema = ProxyServerPlugin::new().schema().unwrap();
    let _shm = temp_shm_with_schemas(&[
        HumanPrincipalPlugin::new().schema().unwrap(),
        IdentitySledPlugin::new().schema().unwrap(),
        schema.clone(),
    ]);
    let engine = test_engine();
    engine
        .install_identity_sled_store_for_test(IdentitySledStore::new(
            op_cozo_store::CozoGraphShuttle::new_in_memory().unwrap(),
        ))
        .unwrap();
    let documents = Arc::new(RuntimeDocuments::new(
        op_cozo_store::CozoGraphShuttle::new_in_memory().unwrap(),
    ));
    assert!(engine
        .proxy_methods
        .set(Arc::new(crate::proxy_methods::ProxyMethods::new(documents)))
        .is_ok());
    let public_key = pk(0xD4);
    register(&public_key, "proxy-fixture").await.unwrap();
    let identity = write_identity(&engine, &public_key).await.unwrap();
    let principal = op_identity::session::derive_principal_id(&public_key);
    let root = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let grant_path = root.path().join("grants.json");
    let _grant_environment = GrantsEnvironment(std::env::var_os("OP_GRANTS_PATH"));
    std::env::set_var("OP_GRANTS_PATH", &grant_path);
    let capabilities = schema
        .methods
        .values()
        .filter_map(|method| method.required_capability.clone())
        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
    std::fs::write(
        &grant_path,
        serde_json::to_vec(&json!({(principal.clone()): {"capabilities":capabilities}})).unwrap(),
    )
    .unwrap();
    let upstream = TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").await.unwrap();
    let upstream_address = upstream.local_addr().unwrap();
    let responder = tokio::spawn(async move {
        let (mut stream, _) = upstream.accept().await.unwrap();
        let mut request = [0; 4];
        stream.read_exact(&mut request).await.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(&request, b"ping");
        stream.write_all(b"pong").await.unwrap();
    });
    let available = TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").await.unwrap();
    let port = available.local_addr().unwrap().port();
    drop(available);
    let configure = json!({"name":"fixture","enabled":true,"port":port,"upstream":upstream_address.to_string(),"expected_revision":0});
    let capability = schema.methods["configure"].required_capability.as_deref();
    assert!(engine
        .dispatch_method_call_with_identity(
            "proxy_server",
            "configure",
            &configure.to_string(),
            capability,
            &principal,
            None,
            None
        )
        .await
        .is_err());
    assert!(op_core::projection_shm::read_projection_bytes("proxy_server").is_none());
    for (method, arguments, revision, running) in [
        ("configure", configure, 1, false),
        (
            "start_proxy",
            json!({"name":"fixture","expected_revision":1}),
            2,
            true,
        ),
        (
            "stop_proxy",
            json!({"name":"fixture","expected_revision":2}),
            3,
            false,
        ),
    ] {
        let result = engine
            .dispatch_method_call_with_identity(
                "proxy_server",
                method,
                &arguments.to_string(),
                schema.methods[method].required_capability.as_deref(),
                &principal,
                Some(&identity.session_id),
                identity.genesis.as_deref(),
            )
            .await
            .unwrap();
        let result = &result["result"];
        let contract =
            serde_json::to_value(schema.methods[method].returns.as_ref().unwrap()).unwrap();
        jsonschema::Validator::new(&contract)
            .unwrap()
            .validate(result)
            .unwrap();
        let bytes = op_core::projection_shm::read_projection_bytes("proxy_server").unwrap();
        let state: Value = serde_json::from_slice(&bytes).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(state["revision"], revision);
        assert_eq!(state["proxies"]["fixture"]["running"], running);
        assert_eq!(state["proxies"]["fixture"], result["status"]);
        if running {
            let mut peer = TcpStream::connect((std::net::Ipv4Addr::LOCALHOST, port))
                .await
                .unwrap();
            peer.write_all(b"ping").await.unwrap();
            let mut response = [0; 4];
            tokio::time::timeout(
                std::time::Duration::from_secs(3),
                peer.read_exact(&mut response),
            )
            .await
            .unwrap()
            .unwrap();
            assert_eq!(&response, b"pong");
        } else {
            assert!(TcpStream::connect((std::net::Ipv4Addr::LOCALHOST, port))
                .await
                .is_err());
        }
    }
    responder.await.unwrap();
}
</file>

<file path="op-grpc-bridge/src/proxy_methods.rs">
//! MutationEngine-owned, event-driven fixed-destination TCP relays.
//! Cozo owns configuration; live listener handles own running state. A restart
//! retains configuration and requires an explicit start, never a fabricated
//! persisted `running` flag. No subprocess or independent control listener.
use anyhow::{ensure, Context, Result};
use op_plugins::state_plugins::{
    proxy_server::{
        ConfigureProxyInput, ProxyConfig, ProxyMethodOutput, ProxyServerState, ProxyStatus,
        StartProxyInput, StopProxyInput,
    },
    runtime_documents::RuntimeDocuments,
};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use serde_json::Value;
use std::{
    collections::BTreeMap,
    net::{IpAddr, SocketAddr},
    sync::{
        atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering},
        Arc,
    },
    time::Duration,
};
use tokio::{
    net::{TcpListener, TcpStream},
    sync::{oneshot, watch, Mutex, Notify},
    task::{JoinHandle, JoinSet},
};

const PLUGIN: &str = "proxy_server";
const MAX_PROXIES: usize = 64;
const MAX_CONNECTIONS: usize = 256;

#[derive(Default, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
struct Configurations {
    proxies: BTreeMap<String, ProxyConfig>,
    #[serde(default)]
    last_request: Option<(String, Value)>,
}

struct Listener {
    bound: SocketAddr,
    upstream: watch::Sender<SocketAddr>,
    task: JoinHandle<()>,
    shutdown: Option<oneshot::Sender<()>>,
    running: Arc<AtomicBool>,
}
impl Listener {
    async fn stop(mut self) {
        if let Some(shutdown) = self.shutdown.take() {
            let _ = shutdown.send(());
        }
        let _ = (&mut self.task).await;
    }
}
impl Drop for Listener {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        self.task.abort();
    }
}

pub(crate) struct ProxyMethods {
    documents: Arc<RuntimeDocuments>,
    listeners: Mutex<BTreeMap<String, Listener>>,
    pub(crate) changed: Arc<Notify>,
}

impl ProxyMethods {
    pub(crate) fn new(documents: Arc<RuntimeDocuments>) -> Self {
        Self {
            documents,
            listeners: Mutex::new(BTreeMap::new()),
            changed: Arc::new(Notify::new()),
        }
    }

    pub(crate) async fn snapshot(&self) -> Result<ProxyServerState> {
        let listeners = self.listeners.lock().await;
        let row = self.documents.read_durable(PLUGIN).await?;
        let revision = row.as_ref().map_or(0, |row| row.revision);
        let configs = row
            .map(|row| serde_json::from_value(row.document))
            .transpose()?
            .unwrap_or_default();
        Ok(snapshot(revision, configs, &listeners))
    }

    /// Caller holds the engine's operation lock through SHM publication.
    /// The enclosing owned method task survives transport cancellation.
    pub(crate) async fn dispatch(
        &self,
        method: &str,
        args: Value,
    ) -> Result<(Value, ProxyServerState)> {
        let mut listeners = self.listeners.lock().await;
        let previous = self.documents.read_durable(PLUGIN).await?;
        let revision = previous.as_ref().map_or(0, |row| row.revision);
        let mut configs: Configurations = previous
            .map(|row| serde_json::from_value(row.document))
            .transpose()?
            .unwrap_or_default();
        let (name, expected) = match method {
            "configure" => {
                let input: ConfigureProxyInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
                (input.name, input.expected_revision)
            }
            "start_proxy" => {
                let input: StartProxyInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
                (input.name, input.expected_revision)
            }
            "stop_proxy" => {
                let input: StopProxyInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
                (input.name, input.expected_revision)
            }
            _ => anyhow::bail!("unknown proxy method"),
        };
        validate_name(&name)?;
        let retry = expected.checked_add(1) == Some(revision)
            && configs.last_request.as_ref().is_some_and(
                |(previous_method, previous_arguments)| {
                    previous_method == method && *previous_arguments == args
                },
            );
        ensure!(
            revision == expected || retry,
            "proxy revision conflict: current revision is {revision}"
        );
        let request = args.clone();
        let mut prepared = None;
        match method {
            "configure" => {
                let input: ConfigureProxyInput = serde_json::from_value(args)?;
                let old = configs.proxies.get(&name).cloned();
                ensure!(
                    old.is_some() || configs.proxies.len() < MAX_PROXIES,
                    "proxy count limit reached"
                );
                let config = ProxyConfig {
                    enabled: input
                        .enabled
                        .or_else(|| old.as_ref().map(|v| v.enabled))
                        .unwrap_or(false),
                    bind_address: input
                        .bind_address
                        .or_else(|| old.as_ref().map(|v| v.bind_address.clone()))
                        .unwrap_or_else(|| "127.0.0.1".into()),
                    port: input
                        .port
                        .or_else(|| old.as_ref().map(|v| v.port))
                        .context("new proxy requires port")?,
                    upstream: input
                        .upstream
                        .or_else(|| old.as_ref().map(|v| v.upstream.clone()))
                        .context("new proxy requires upstream")?,
                };
                let (bind, _) = addresses(&config)?;
                if config.enabled
                    && listeners
                        .get(&name)
                        .is_some_and(|v| v.running.load(Ordering::Acquire) && v.bound != bind)
                {
                    prepared = Some(
                        TcpListener::bind(bind)
                            .await
                            .context("replacement proxy bind failed")?,
                    );
                }
                configs.proxies.insert(name.clone(), config);
            }
            "start_proxy" => {
                let input: StartProxyInput = serde_json::from_value(args)?;
                let config = configs
                    .proxies
                    .get_mut(&name)
                    .context("configure proxy before starting")?;
                ensure!(config.enabled, "proxy is disabled");
                if let Some(port) = input.port {
                    config.port = port;
                }
                let (bind, _) = addresses(config)?;
                if !listeners
                    .get(&name)
                    .is_some_and(|v| v.running.load(Ordering::Acquire) && v.bound == bind)
                {
                    prepared = Some(TcpListener::bind(bind).await.context("proxy bind failed")?);
                }
            }
            "stop_proxy" => {
                ensure!(configs.proxies.contains_key(&name), "unknown proxy");
            }
            _ => unreachable!(),
        }
        // Even lifecycle transitions advance the CAS revision. Binding failure
        // or CAS conflict leaves the previous relay accepting unchanged.
        configs.last_request = Some((method.into(), request));
        let revision = if retry {
            revision
        } else {
            let committed = serde_json::to_value(&configs)?;
            self.documents
                .update_at_revision_with_result(PLUGIN, expected, move |_| Ok((committed, ())))
                .await?
                .0
                .revision
        };
        let config = configs
            .proxies
            .get(&name)
            .context("missing configured proxy")?;
        let (_, upstream) = addresses(config)?;
        if method == "stop_proxy" || !config.enabled {
            if let Some(listener) = listeners.remove(&name) {
                listener.stop().await;
            }
        } else if let Some(listener) = prepared {
            let bound = listener.local_addr()?;
            let (sender, receiver) = watch::channel(upstream);
            let (shutdown, stopped) = oneshot::channel();
            let running = Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(true));
            let task_running = running.clone();
            let changed = self.changed.clone();
            let task = tokio::spawn(async move {
                serve(listener, receiver, stopped).await;
                // Publish terminal status before the wake-up. JoinHandle
                // completion happens later and is not our observation flag.
                task_running.store(false, Ordering::Release);
                changed.notify_one();
            });
            if let Some(old) = listeners.insert(
                name.clone(),
                Listener {
                    bound,
                    upstream: sender,
                    task,
                    shutdown: Some(shutdown),
                    running,
                },
            ) {
                old.stop().await;
            }
        } else if let Some(listener) = listeners.get(&name) {
            listener.upstream.send_replace(upstream);
        }
        let state = snapshot(revision, configs, &listeners);
        let output = ProxyMethodOutput {
            name: name.clone(),
            revision,
            status: state.proxies[&name].clone(),
        };
        Ok((serde_json::to_value(output)?, state))
    }
}

fn snapshot(
    revision: u64,
    configs: Configurations,
    listeners: &BTreeMap<String, Listener>,
) -> ProxyServerState {
    ProxyServerState {
        revision,
        proxies: configs
            .proxies
            .into_iter()
            .map(|(name, config)| {
                let listener = listeners
                    .get(&name)
                    .filter(|listener| listener.running.load(Ordering::Acquire));
                let status = ProxyStatus {
                    config,
                    running: listener.is_some(),
                    bound_address: listener.map(|v| v.bound.to_string()),
                };
                (name, status)
            })
            .collect(),
    }
}

fn validate_name(name: &str) -> Result<()> {
    ensure!(
        !name.is_empty()
            && name.len() <= 64
            && name
                .bytes()
                .all(|b| b.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || b == b'_' || b == b'-'),
        "invalid proxy name"
    );
    Ok(())
}

fn addresses(config: &ProxyConfig) -> Result<(SocketAddr, SocketAddr)> {
    let ip: IpAddr = config
        .bind_address
        .parse()
        .context("proxy bind requires a literal IP")?;
    ensure!(
        config.port != 0 && !ip.is_multicast(),
        "invalid proxy bind address or port"
    );
    let upstream: SocketAddr = config
        .upstream
        .parse()
        .context("proxy upstream requires literal IP:port")?;
    ensure!(
        upstream.port() != 0 && !upstream.ip().is_unspecified() && !upstream.ip().is_multicast(),
        "invalid proxy upstream"
    );
    let bind = SocketAddr::new(ip, config.port);
    ensure!(
        bind != upstream && !(bind.ip().is_unspecified() && bind.port() == upstream.port()),
        "proxy cannot forward to itself"
    );
    Ok((bind, upstream))
}

async fn serve(
    listener: TcpListener,
    upstream: watch::Receiver<SocketAddr>,
    mut shutdown: oneshot::Receiver<()>,
) {
    // JoinSet drop aborts every relay when the listener owner stops/rebinds.
    let mut connections = JoinSet::new();
    loop {
        tokio::select! {
            _ = &mut shutdown => break,
            result = listener.accept(), if connections.len() < MAX_CONNECTIONS => {
                let Ok((mut incoming, _)) = result else { break };
                let destination = *upstream.borrow();
                connections.spawn(async move {
                    let Ok(Ok(mut outgoing)) = tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(10), TcpStream::connect(destination)).await else { return };
                    // Fixed-duration bound also releases idle/abandoned peers.
                    let _ = tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(3600), tokio::io::copy_bidirectional(&mut incoming, &mut outgoing)).await;
                });
            }
            _ = connections.join_next(), if !connections.is_empty() => {}
        }
    }
    drop(listener);
    connections.abort_all();
    while connections.join_next().await.is_some() {}
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use tokio::io::{AsyncReadExt, AsyncWriteExt};

    async fn setup() -> (ProxyMethods, Arc<RuntimeDocuments>) {
        let docs = Arc::new(RuntimeDocuments::new(
            op_cozo_store::CozoGraphShuttle::new_in_memory().unwrap(),
        ));
        (ProxyMethods::new(docs.clone()), docs)
    }
    async fn free_port() -> u16 {
        TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0")
            .await
            .unwrap()
            .local_addr()
            .unwrap()
            .port()
    }
    async fn echo() -> (SocketAddr, JoinHandle<()>) {
        let listener = TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").await.unwrap();
        let address = listener.local_addr().unwrap();
        let task = tokio::spawn(async move {
            loop {
                let (stream, _) = listener.accept().await.unwrap();
                tokio::spawn(async move {
                    let (mut read, mut write) = stream.into_split();
                    let _ = tokio::io::copy(&mut read, &mut write).await;
                });
            }
        });
        (address, task)
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn configure_start_bytes_reconfigure_and_stop_have_real_effects() {
        let (service, _) = setup().await;
        let (upstream, echo_task) = echo().await;
        let port = free_port().await;
        let (_, state) = service.dispatch("configure", serde_json::json!({"name":"fixture", "enabled":true,"port":port,"upstream":upstream.to_string(),"expected_revision":0})).await.unwrap();
        assert!(!state.proxies["fixture"].running);
        assert!(TcpStream::connect((std::net::Ipv4Addr::LOCALHOST, port))
            .await
            .is_err());
        let (_, state) = service
            .dispatch(
                "start_proxy",
                serde_json::json!({"name":"fixture","expected_revision":1}),
            )
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert!(state.proxies["fixture"].running);
        let mut client = TcpStream::connect((std::net::Ipv4Addr::LOCALHOST, port))
            .await
            .unwrap();
        client.write_all(b"through-real-upstream").await.unwrap();
        let mut response = vec![0; 21];
        tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(3), client.read_exact(&mut response))
            .await
            .unwrap()
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(&response, b"through-real-upstream");
        assert!(service
            .dispatch(
                "stop_proxy",
                serde_json::json!({"name":"fixture","expected_revision":1})
            )
            .await
            .is_err());
        let replacement = free_port().await;
        let (_, state) = service
            .dispatch(
                "configure",
                serde_json::json!({"name":"fixture","port":replacement,"expected_revision":2}),
            )
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert!(state.proxies["fixture"].running);
        assert!(TcpStream::connect((std::net::Ipv4Addr::LOCALHOST, port))
            .await
            .is_err());
        let (_, state) = service
            .dispatch(
                "stop_proxy",
                serde_json::json!({"name":"fixture","expected_revision":3}),
            )
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert!(!state.proxies["fixture"].running);
        assert!(
            TcpStream::connect((std::net::Ipv4Addr::LOCALHOST, replacement))
                .await
                .is_err()
        );
        echo_task.abort();
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn exact_start_retry_recovers_after_owner_restart_without_consuming_revision() {
        let (service, documents) = setup().await;
        let port = free_port().await;
        service.dispatch("configure", serde_json::json!({"name":"fixture","enabled":true,"port":port,"upstream":"127.0.0.1:1","expected_revision":0})).await.unwrap();
        let request = serde_json::json!({"name":"fixture","expected_revision":1});
        service
            .dispatch("start_proxy", request.clone())
            .await
            .unwrap();
        drop(service);
        // Wait for task cancellation from the dead runtime owner, without
        // treating a persisted revision as evidence of a live listener.
        tokio::task::yield_now().await;
        let restarted = ProxyMethods::new(documents);
        assert!(!restarted.snapshot().await.unwrap().proxies["fixture"].running);
        let (reply, state) = restarted
            .dispatch("start_proxy", request.clone())
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert!(state.proxies["fixture"].running);
        assert_eq!(state.revision, 2);
        let (retry, _) = restarted.dispatch("start_proxy", request).await.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(retry, reply);
        restarted
            .dispatch(
                "stop_proxy",
                serde_json::json!({"name":"fixture","expected_revision":2}),
            )
            .await
            .unwrap();
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn failed_bind_preserves_config_and_restart_does_not_claim_running() {
        let (service, documents) = setup().await;
        let occupied = TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").await.unwrap();
        let port = occupied.local_addr().unwrap().port();
        service.dispatch("configure", serde_json::json!({"name":"fixture","enabled":true,"port":port,"upstream":"127.0.0.1:1","expected_revision":0})).await.unwrap();
        assert!(service
            .dispatch(
                "start_proxy",
                serde_json::json!({"name":"fixture","expected_revision":1})
            )
            .await
            .is_err());
        assert_eq!(documents.read(PLUGIN).await.unwrap().unwrap().revision, 1);
        drop(occupied);
        service
            .dispatch(
                "start_proxy",
                serde_json::json!({"name":"fixture","expected_revision":1}),
            )
            .await
            .unwrap();
        drop(service);
        let reopened = ProxyMethods::new(documents);
        let (_, state) = reopened
            .dispatch(
                "configure",
                serde_json::json!({"name":"fixture","expected_revision":2}),
            )
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert!(!state.proxies["fixture"].running);
    }
}
</file>

<file path="op-grpc-bridge/src/schema_integer_arguments.rs">
//! Preserve declared JSON integers after protobuf Value decodes them as f64.
//! Opaque JSON and declared floating-point numbers keep their original shape.
use anyhow::{bail, ensure, Context, Result};
use serde_json::Value;

pub(crate) fn normalize_declared_integers(schema: &Value, input: &mut Value) -> Result<()> {
    visit(schema, schema, input, 0)
}

fn visit(root: &Value, schema: &Value, input: &mut Value, depth: usize) -> Result<()> {
    ensure!(
        depth <= 128,
        "integer argument schema nesting exceeds limit"
    );
    if let Some(reference) = schema.get("$ref").and_then(Value::as_str) {
        let pointer = reference
            .strip_prefix('#')
            .context("external argument schema reference is unsupported")?;
        let referred = root
            .pointer(pointer)
            .context("argument schema reference is missing")?;
        visit(root, referred, input, depth + 1)?;
    }
    for keyword in ["anyOf", "oneOf"] {
        if let Some(branches) = schema.get(keyword).and_then(Value::as_array) {
            let mut matching = Vec::new();
            for branch in branches {
                let mut contract = branch.clone();
                if let Some(object) = contract.as_object_mut() {
                    for definitions in ["$defs", "definitions"] {
                        if let Some(value) = root.get(definitions) {
                            object.entry(definitions).or_insert_with(|| value.clone());
                        }
                    }
                }
                if jsonschema::Validator::new(&contract)?.is_valid(input) {
                    matching.push(branch);
                }
            }
            // Do not decide an ambiguous union's numeric representation.
            if matching.len() == 1 {
                visit(root, matching[0], input, depth + 1)?;
            }
        }
    }
    if let Some(branches) = schema.get("allOf").and_then(Value::as_array) {
        for branch in branches {
            visit(root, branch, input, depth + 1)?;
        }
    }
    let integer = match schema.get("type") {
        Some(Value::String(kind)) => kind == "integer",
        Some(Value::Array(kinds)) => {
            kinds.iter().any(|kind| kind == "integer")
                && kinds.iter().all(|kind| kind == "integer" || kind == "null")
        }
        _ => false,
    };
    if integer {
        if let Value::Number(number) = input {
            if number.is_f64() {
                let value = number.as_f64().context("invalid numeric argument")?;
                ensure!(
                    value.is_finite() && value.fract() == 0.0,
                    "declared integer argument is not integral"
                );
                // Protobuf Value transports every JSON number as a double.
                // Outside the exact IEEE-754 integer range, the caller's
                // integer has already been rounded and cannot be recovered.
                ensure!(
                    value.abs() <= 9_007_199_254_740_991.0,
                    "declared integer argument cannot be represented exactly by the transport"
                );
                // Exclusive upper limits prevent Rust's saturating float cast
                // from accepting 2^64 or rounding it to u64::MAX.
                if (0.0..18_446_744_073_709_551_616.0).contains(&value) {
                    *number = (value as u64).into();
                } else if (-9_223_372_036_854_775_808.0..0.0).contains(&value) {
                    *number = (value as i64).into();
                } else {
