<file path="op-grpc-bridge/src/shared_socket_tests.rs">
use super::*;
use serde_json::json;
use tokio::io::AsyncReadExt;
use tokio_stream::StreamExt;

fn fixture() -> (tempfile::TempDir, Arc<SharedListenerController>) {
    let root = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let controller = SharedListenerController::open_with_lease_dir(
        root.path().join("container.sock"),
        &root.path().join("leases"),
    )
    .unwrap();
    (root, controller)
}

async fn call(controller: &SharedListenerController, method: &str, mut args: Value) -> Value {
    args["path"] = json!(controller.path().to_str().unwrap());
    let value = controller.dispatch(method, &args).await.unwrap();
    let schema = op_plugins::state_plugins::unix_socket::unix_socket_schema_derived();
    let output = serde_json::to_value(schema.methods[method].returns.as_ref().unwrap()).unwrap();
    if let Err(error) = jsonschema::Validator::new(&output)
        .unwrap()
        .validate(&value)
    {
        panic!("invalid {method} output: {error}");
    }
    value
}

async fn accept_native(
    controller: &Arc<SharedListenerController>,
    incoming: &mut ControlledIncoming,
) -> (UnixStream, ManagedUnixStream) {
    let client = UnixStream::connect(controller.path()).await.unwrap();
    let accepted = tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(1), incoming.next())
        .await
        .unwrap()
        .unwrap()
        .unwrap();
    (client, accepted)
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn bind_listen_backlog_and_accept_use_the_actual_incoming_transport() {
    let (_root, controller) = fixture();
    let mut incoming = controller.take_incoming().unwrap();
    assert!(controller.take_incoming().is_err());
    let bound = call(&controller, "bind", json!({})).await;
    assert_eq!(bound["phase"], "bound");
    assert!(std::os::unix::net::UnixStream::connect(controller.path()).is_err());
    let listening = call(&controller, "listen", json!({"backlog":2})).await;
    assert_eq!(listening["requested_backlog"], 2);
    assert_eq!(
        call(&controller, "listen", json!({"backlog":64})).await["requested_backlog"],
        64
    );
    assert!(controller.listen(0).is_err());
    assert!(controller.listen(65536).is_err());
    let client = UnixStream::connect(controller.path()).await.unwrap();
    // Connecting does not invent an event before tonic's sole incoming poll.
    let observed = call(&controller, "accept", json!({"after_sequence":0})).await;
    assert!(observed["event"].is_null());
    assert_eq!(observed["timed_out"], false);
    let accepted = incoming.next().await.unwrap().unwrap();
    let observed = call(&controller, "accept", json!({"after_sequence":0})).await;
    assert_eq!(observed["event"]["sequence"], 1);
    assert_eq!(
        observed["event"]["peer_uid"],
        nix::unistd::geteuid().as_raw()
    );
    assert_eq!(observed["event"]["peer_pid"], std::process::id());
    let mut request = tonic::Request::new(());
    request.extensions_mut().insert(accepted.connect_info());
    assert_eq!(
        extract_peer_cred(&request).unwrap().uid(),
        nix::unistd::geteuid().as_raw()
    );
    assert_eq!(controller.snapshot().unwrap().active_connections, 1);
    drop(accepted);
    drop(client);
    assert_eq!(controller.snapshot().unwrap().active_connections, 0);
    assert_eq!(
        call(&controller, "close", json!({})).await["phase"],
        "closed"
    );
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn force_close_shuts_down_real_connections_and_nonforce_refuses_them() {
    let (_root, controller) = fixture();
    controller.start(8).unwrap();
    let mut incoming = controller.take_incoming().unwrap();
    let (mut client, mut accepted) = accept_native(&controller, &mut incoming).await;
    assert!(controller
        .close(false)
        .unwrap_err()
        .to_string()
        .contains("active connections"));
    assert_eq!(controller.snapshot().unwrap().phase, "listening");
    let closed = call(&controller, "close", json!({"force":true})).await;
    assert_eq!(closed["active_connections"], 0);
    assert!(!controller.path().exists());
    let mut buffer = [0u8; 4];
    assert_eq!(
        tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(1), client.read(&mut buffer))
            .await
            .unwrap()
            .unwrap(),
        0
    );
    assert_eq!(
        tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(1), accepted.read(&mut buffer))
            .await
            .unwrap()
            .unwrap(),
        0
    );
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn intentional_close_keeps_incoming_pending_and_rebind_resumes_same_acceptor() {
    let (_root, controller) = fixture();
    controller.start(8).unwrap();
    let mut incoming = controller.take_incoming().unwrap();
    controller.close(false).unwrap();
    assert!(
        tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_millis(20), incoming.next())
            .await
            .is_err()
    );
    controller.bind().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(controller.snapshot().unwrap().binding_generation, 2);
    assert!(
        tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_millis(20), incoming.next())
            .await
            .is_err()
    );
    controller.listen(12).unwrap();
    let (_client, accepted) = accept_native(&controller, &mut incoming).await;
    assert_eq!(controller.snapshot().unwrap().requested_backlog, Some(12));
    assert_eq!(
        controller
            .observation(0, false)
            .unwrap()
            .event
            .unwrap()
            .binding_generation,
        2
    );
    drop(accepted);
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn unknown_files_symlinks_and_live_sockets_are_never_unlinked() {
    let (root, controller) = fixture();
    fs::write(controller.path(), b"unrelated").unwrap();
    assert!(controller
        .start(8)
        .unwrap_err()
        .to_string()
        .contains("no bridge ownership proof"));
    assert_eq!(fs::read(controller.path()).unwrap(), b"unrelated");
    fs::remove_file(controller.path()).unwrap();
    let target = root.path().join("target");
    fs::write(&target, b"still here").unwrap();
    std::os::unix::fs::symlink(&target, controller.path()).unwrap();
    assert!(controller.bind().is_err());
    assert!(fs::symlink_metadata(controller.path())
        .unwrap()
        .file_type()
        .is_symlink());
    fs::remove_file(controller.path()).unwrap();
    let foreign = std::os::unix::net::UnixListener::bind(controller.path()).unwrap();
    let inode = fs::metadata(controller.path()).unwrap().ino();
    assert!(controller.start(8).is_err());
    assert_eq!(fs::metadata(controller.path()).unwrap().ino(), inode);
    let _client = std::os::unix::net::UnixStream::connect(controller.path()).unwrap();
    drop(foreign);
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn lease_is_exclusive_and_restart_recovers_only_matching_owned_stale_socket() {
    let (root, controller) = fixture();
    let path = controller.path().to_path_buf();
    let leases = root.path().join("leases");
    controller.start(8).unwrap();
    assert!(SharedListenerController::open_with_lease_dir(path.clone(), &leases).is_err());
    // Model a crash: descriptors close, socket pathname and synced proof remain.
    {
        let mut state = controller.lock().unwrap();
        drop(state.listener.take());
        state.ownership = None;
    }
    drop(controller);
    assert!(path.exists());
    let restarted = SharedListenerController::open_with_lease_dir(path.clone(), &leases).unwrap();
    restarted.start(8).unwrap();
    let mut incoming = restarted.take_incoming().unwrap();
    let (_client, _accepted) = accept_native(&restarted, &mut incoming).await;
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn matching_record_does_not_authorize_removing_a_live_listener() {
    let (root, controller) = fixture();
    controller.start(8).unwrap();
    let path = controller.path().to_path_buf();
    let live = {
        let mut state = controller.lock().unwrap();
        state.ownership = None;
        state.listener.take().unwrap()
    };
    drop(controller);
    let inode = fs::metadata(&path).unwrap().ino();
    let restarted =
        SharedListenerController::open_with_lease_dir(path.clone(), &root.path().join("leases"))
            .unwrap();
    assert!(restarted
        .start(8)
        .unwrap_err()
        .to_string()
        .contains("live listener"));
    assert_eq!(fs::metadata(&path).unwrap().ino(), inode);
    drop(live);
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn close_refuses_to_unlink_a_replacement_socket() {
    let (root, controller) = fixture();
    controller.start(8).unwrap();
    fs::rename(controller.path(), root.path().join("old-owned.sock")).unwrap();
    let replacement = std::os::unix::net::UnixListener::bind(controller.path()).unwrap();
    let inode = fs::metadata(controller.path()).unwrap().ino();
    assert!(controller
        .close(false)
        .unwrap_err()
        .to_string()
        .contains("ownership changed"));
    assert_eq!(fs::metadata(controller.path()).unwrap().ino(), inode);
    drop(replacement);
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn cursor_boundaries_use_real_accept_events_and_reject_expired_history() {
    let (_root, controller) = fixture();
    controller.start(8).unwrap();
    let mut incoming = controller.take_incoming().unwrap();
    assert!(controller
        .observation(1, false)
        .unwrap_err()
        .to_string()
        .contains("ahead"));
    for _ in 0..EVENT_CAPACITY + 2 {
        let (_client, _accepted) = accept_native(&controller, &mut incoming).await;
    }
    assert!(controller
        .observation(0, false)
        .unwrap_err()
        .to_string()
        .contains("expired"));
    assert_eq!(
        controller
            .observation(2, false)
            .unwrap()
            .event
            .unwrap()
            .sequence,
        3
    );
    assert!(controller
        .observation(EVENT_CAPACITY as u64 + 3, false)
        .is_err());
    let input = json!({"path":controller.path(),"generation":"previous-bridge","after_sequence":2});
    assert!(controller
        .dispatch("accept", &input)
        .await
        .unwrap_err()
        .to_string()
        .contains("generation changed"));
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn observer_waits_for_native_accept_and_reports_actual_timeout() {
    let (_root, controller) = fixture();
    controller.start(8).unwrap();
    let mut incoming = controller.take_incoming().unwrap();
    let waiting = controller.clone();
    let task = tokio::spawn(async move {
        call(
            &waiting,
            "accept",
            json!({"after_sequence":0,"timeout_secs":1}),
        )
        .await
    });
    let (_client, _accepted) = accept_native(&controller, &mut incoming).await;
    let output = task.await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(output["event"]["sequence"], 1);
    assert_eq!(output["timed_out"], false);
    let timed_out = call(
        &controller,
        "accept",
        json!({"after_sequence":1,"timeout_secs":1}),
    )
    .await;
    assert!(timed_out["event"].is_null());
    assert_eq!(timed_out["timed_out"], true);
    assert!(controller
        .dispatch("bind", &json!({"path":"/tmp/not-configured"}))
        .await
        .is_err());
    assert!(controller
        .dispatch("bind", &json!({"path":controller.path(),"protocol":"raw"}))
        .await
        .is_err());
    assert!(controller
        .dispatch(
            "accept",
            &json!({"path":controller.path(),"timeout_secs":61})
        )
        .await
        .is_err());
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn failed_bind_setup_cleans_its_owned_inode_and_checks_generation_before_bind() {
    let (root, controller) = fixture();
    controller.lock().unwrap().binding_generation = u64::MAX;
    assert!(controller
        .bind()
        .unwrap_err()
        .to_string()
        .contains("generation exhausted"));
    assert!(!controller.path().exists());
    controller.lock().unwrap().binding_generation = 0;
    // A read-only lease descriptor injects a real persistence error after the
    // kernel bind. No live host filesystem or socket is used by this fixture.
    let readonly_path = root.path().join("readonly-lease");
    fs::write(&readonly_path, b"").unwrap();
    let readonly = Flock::lock(
        File::open(readonly_path).unwrap(),
        FlockArg::LockExclusiveNonblock,
    )
    .unwrap();
    controller.lock().unwrap().lease.file = readonly;
    let error = controller.bind().unwrap_err();
    assert!(
        error
            .to_string()
            .contains("newly bound owned pathname was removed"),
        "{error:#}"
    );
    assert!(!controller.path().exists());
    assert_eq!(controller.snapshot().unwrap().phase, "closed");
}
</file>

<file path="op-grpc-bridge/src/shared_socket.rs">
//! One listener owner for the shared tonic UDS. Plugin calls control this
//! owner; only the Incoming stream accepts connections and passes them to
//! tonic's unchanged authenticated route stack.

use std::collections::{HashMap, VecDeque};
use std::fs::{self, File, OpenOptions};
use std::io::{self, Read, Seek, SeekFrom, Write};
use std::net::Shutdown;
use std::os::unix::fs::{FileTypeExt, MetadataExt, OpenOptionsExt, PermissionsExt};
use std::path::{Component, Path, PathBuf};
use std::pin::Pin;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering};
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex, MutexGuard, Weak};
use std::task::{Context as TaskContext, Poll};
use std::time::{Duration, SystemTime, UNIX_EPOCH};

use anyhow::{bail, ensure, Context, Result};
use futures::task::AtomicWaker;
use nix::fcntl::{Flock, FlockArg};
use op_plugins::state_plugins::unix_socket::{
    AcceptInput, AcceptOutput, AcceptedConnection, BindInput, CloseInput, ListenInput,
    UnixSocketState,
};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use serde_json::Value;
use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
use socket2::{Domain, SockAddr, SockRef, Socket, Type};
use tokio::io::{AsyncRead, AsyncWrite, ReadBuf};
use tokio::net::{UnixListener, UnixStream};
use tokio::sync::Notify;
use tokio_stream::Stream;
use tonic::transport::server::{Connected, UdsConnectInfo};

pub const DEFAULT_SOCKET_PATH: &str = "/run/ghostbridge/container.sock";
const EVENT_CAPACITY: usize = 256;

#[cfg(test)]
#[path = "shared_socket_tests.rs"]
mod tests;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
struct SocketOwnership {
    version: u32,
    path: PathBuf,
    device: u64,
    inode: u64,
    uid: u32,
    ctime: i64,
    ctime_nsec: i64,
}

impl SocketOwnership {
    fn read(path: &Path) -> Result<Self> {
        let metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(path)?;
        ensure!(
            metadata.file_type().is_socket(),
            "refusing a non-socket or symlink at {}",
            path.display()
        );
        ensure!(
            metadata.uid() == nix::unistd::geteuid().as_raw(),
            "socket is not owned by the bridge service"
        );
        Ok(Self {
            version: 1,
            path: path.into(),
            device: metadata.dev(),
            inode: metadata.ino(),
            uid: metadata.uid(),
            ctime: metadata.ctime(),
            ctime_nsec: metadata.ctime_nsec(),
        })
    }

    fn remove_matching(&self) -> Result<()> {
        match fs::symlink_metadata(&self.path) {
            Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::NotFound => return Ok(()),
            Err(error) => return Err(error.into()),
            Ok(_) => {}
        }
        ensure!(
            Self::read(&self.path)? == *self,
            "socket ownership changed; refusing to unlink {}",
            self.path.display()
        );
        fs::remove_file(&self.path)?;
        Ok(())
    }
}

struct ListenerLease {
    file: Flock<File>,
    recorded: Option<SocketOwnership>,
}

impl ListenerLease {
    fn acquire(path: &Path, directory: &Path) -> Result<Self> {
        ensure_private_directory(directory)?;
        let hash = format!("{:x}", Sha256::digest(path.as_os_str().as_encoded_bytes()));
        let lease_path = directory.join(format!("{hash}.lease"));
        let file = OpenOptions::new()
            .read(true)
            .write(true)
            .create(true)
            .truncate(false)
            .mode(0o600)
            .custom_flags(nix::libc::O_NOFOLLOW)
            .open(&lease_path)?;
        let metadata = file.metadata()?;
        ensure!(
            metadata.is_file()
                && metadata.nlink() == 1
                && metadata.uid() == nix::unistd::geteuid().as_raw()
                && metadata.mode() & 0o077 == 0
                && metadata.len() <= 4096,
            "listener lease must be a private service-owned regular file"
        );
        let mut file =
            Flock::lock(file, FlockArg::LockExclusiveNonblock).map_err(|(_, error)| {
                anyhow::anyhow!("listener ownership lease is already held or unavailable: {error}")
            })?;
        let mut bytes = Vec::new();
        (&mut *file).take(4097).read_to_end(&mut bytes)?;
        ensure!(
            bytes.len() <= 4096,
            "listener ownership lease exceeds limit"
        );
        let recorded: Option<SocketOwnership> = if bytes.is_empty() {
            None
        } else {
            let record: SocketOwnership = serde_json::from_slice(&bytes)
                .context("invalid listener ownership proof; operator cleanup required")?;
            ensure!(
                record.version == 1
                    && record.path == path
                    && record.uid == nix::unistd::geteuid().as_raw(),
                "listener lease does not prove ownership of this path"
            );
            Some(record)
        };
        Ok(Self { file, recorded })
    }

    fn record(&mut self, ownership: SocketOwnership) -> Result<()> {
        let bytes = serde_json::to_vec(&ownership)?;
        self.file.seek(SeekFrom::Start(0))?;
        self.file.set_len(0)?;
        self.file.write_all(&bytes)?;
        self.file.sync_all()?;
        self.recorded = Some(ownership);
        Ok(())
    }

    fn recover_stale(&self, path: &Path) -> Result<()> {
        match fs::symlink_metadata(path) {
            Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::NotFound => return Ok(()),
            Err(error) => return Err(error.into()),
            Ok(_) => {}
        }
        let recorded = self.recorded.as_ref().context("existing socket has no bridge ownership proof; refusing cleanup, operator action required")?;
        ensure!(
            SocketOwnership::read(path)? == *recorded,
            "existing socket does not match the previous bridge lease; refusing cleanup"
        );
        let probe = Socket::new(Domain::UNIX, Type::STREAM, None)?;
        probe.set_nonblocking(true)?;
        match probe.connect(&SockAddr::unix(path)?) {
            Ok(()) => bail!("previously recorded socket has a live listener; refusing cleanup"),
            Err(error) if error.raw_os_error() == Some(nix::libc::ECONNREFUSED) => {
                recorded.remove_matching()
            }
            Err(error) => {
                bail!("cannot prove recorded socket is stale ({error}); refusing cleanup")
            }
        }
    }
}

fn ensure_private_directory(path: &Path) -> Result<()> {
    if !path.exists() {
        fs::create_dir_all(path)?;
        fs::set_permissions(path, fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o700))?;
    }
    let metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(path)?;
    ensure!(
        metadata.is_dir()
            && !metadata.file_type().is_symlink()
            && metadata.uid() == nix::unistd::geteuid().as_raw()
            && metadata.mode() & 0o077 == 0,
        "socket lease directory must be private and owned by the bridge service"
    );
    Ok(())
}

struct ListenerState {
    listener: Option<UnixListener>,
    listening: bool,
    ownership: Option<SocketOwnership>,
    lease: ListenerLease,
    backlog: Option<u32>,
    binding_generation: u64,
    sequence: u64,
    events: VecDeque<AcceptedConnection>,
    // Duplicated descriptors permit real SHUT_RDWR without taking the stream
    // away from tonic. Dropping a ManagedUnixStream releases its entry.
    connections: HashMap<String, Socket>,
}

pub struct SharedListenerController {
    path: PathBuf,
    generation: String,
    state: Mutex<ListenerState>,
    incoming_taken: AtomicBool,
    incoming_waker: AtomicWaker,
    accepted: Notify,
}

impl SharedListenerController {
    pub fn open(path: PathBuf) -> Result<Arc<Self>> {
        let directory = std::env::var_os("OPDBUS_SOCKET_LEASE_DIR")
            .map(PathBuf::from)
            .unwrap_or_else(|| "/run/opdbus/socket-leases".into());
        Self::open_with_lease_dir(path, &directory)
    }

    pub fn open_with_lease_dir(path: PathBuf, lease_directory: &Path) -> Result<Arc<Self>> {
        ensure!(
            path.is_absolute()
                && path
                    .components()
                    .all(|part| matches!(part, Component::RootDir | Component::Normal(_)))
                && path.file_name().is_some(),
            "configured socket path must be absolute and normalized"
        );
        let lease = ListenerLease::acquire(&path, lease_directory)?;
        Ok(Arc::new(Self {
            path,
            generation: uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string(),
            state: Mutex::new(ListenerState {
                listener: None,
                listening: false,
                ownership: None,
                lease,
                backlog: None,
                binding_generation: 0,
                sequence: 0,
                events: VecDeque::new(),
                connections: HashMap::new(),
            }),
            incoming_taken: AtomicBool::new(false),
            incoming_waker: AtomicWaker::new(),
            accepted: Notify::new(),
        }))
    }

    pub fn path(&self) -> &Path {
        &self.path
    }

    fn lock(&self) -> Result<MutexGuard<'_, ListenerState>> {
        self.state
            .lock()
            .map_err(|_| anyhow::anyhow!("listener controller lock poisoned"))
    }

    fn exact_path(&self, path: &str) -> Result<()> {
        ensure!(
            path == self
                .path
                .to_str()
                .context("configured socket path is not UTF-8")?,
            "method path must exactly equal the configured shared listener path"
        );
        Ok(())
    }

    fn snapshot_locked(&self, state: &ListenerState) -> UnixSocketState {
        UnixSocketState {
            path: self.path.to_string_lossy().into_owned(),
            protocol: "grpc".into(),
            phase: if state.listening {
                "listening"
            } else if state.listener.is_some() {
                "bound"
            } else {
                "closed"
            }
            .into(),
            generation: self.generation.clone(),
            binding_generation: state.binding_generation,
            requested_backlog: state.backlog,
            active_connections: state.connections.len() as u64,
            accepted_connections: state.sequence,
        }
    }

    pub fn snapshot(&self) -> Result<UnixSocketState> {
        let state = self.lock()?;
        Ok(self.snapshot_locked(&state))
    }

    fn bind(&self) -> Result<UnixSocketState> {
        let mut state = self.lock()?;
        if state.listener.is_some() {
            return Ok(self.snapshot_locked(&state));
        }
        let next_generation = state
            .binding_generation
            .checked_add(1)
            .context("listener binding generation exhausted")?;
        let parent = self.path.parent().context("socket has no parent")?;
        fs::create_dir_all(parent)?;
        let metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(parent)?;
        ensure!(
            metadata.is_dir()
                && !metadata.file_type().is_symlink()
                && metadata.uid() == nix::unistd::geteuid().as_raw()
                && metadata.mode() & 0o022 == 0,
            "socket parent must be service-owned and not writable by other users"
        );
        state.lease.recover_stale(&self.path)?;
        let socket = Socket::new(Domain::UNIX, Type::STREAM, None)?;
        socket.set_nonblocking(true)?;
        socket.bind(&SockAddr::unix(&self.path)?)?;
        let mut ownership = SocketOwnership::read(&self.path).context(
            "socket bound but ownership could not be established; refusing unproven cleanup",
        )?;
        let listener_result = (|| -> Result<UnixListener> {
            fs::set_permissions(&self.path, fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o666))?;
            ownership = SocketOwnership::read(&self.path)?;
            state.lease.record(ownership.clone())?;
            Ok(UnixListener::from_std(
                std::os::unix::net::UnixListener::from(socket),
            )?)
        })();
        let listener = match listener_result {
            Ok(listener) => listener,
            Err(error) => {
                if let Err(cleanup) = ownership.remove_matching() {
                    return Err(error).context(format!(
                        "socket setup failed and owned cleanup was refused: {cleanup}"
                    ));
                }
                return Err(error)
                    .context("socket setup failed; newly bound owned pathname was removed");
            }
        };
        state.binding_generation = next_generation;
        state.listener = Some(listener);
        state.ownership = Some(ownership);
        state.listening = false;
        state.backlog = None;
        let result = self.snapshot_locked(&state);
        drop(state);
        self.incoming_waker.wake();
        Ok(result)
    }

    fn listen(&self, backlog: u32) -> Result<UnixSocketState> {
        ensure!((1..=65535).contains(&backlog), "backlog must be 1..=65535");
        let mut state = self.lock()?;
        let listener = state
            .listener
            .as_ref()
            .context("listener is closed; call bind before listen")?;
        SockRef::from(listener).listen(backlog as i32)?;
        state.listening = true;
        state.backlog = Some(backlog);
        let result = self.snapshot_locked(&state);
        drop(state);
        self.incoming_waker.wake();
        Ok(result)
    }

    pub fn start(&self, backlog: u32) -> Result<UnixSocketState> {
        self.bind()?;
        self.listen(backlog)
    }

    fn close(&self, force: bool) -> Result<UnixSocketState> {
        let mut state = self.lock()?;
        ensure!(
            force || state.connections.is_empty(),
            "listener has active connections; force is required to shut them down"
        );
        let mut shutdown_error = None;
        if force {
            state
                .connections
                .retain(|_, socket| match socket.shutdown(Shutdown::Both) {
                    Ok(()) => false,
                    Err(error) if error.kind() == io::ErrorKind::NotConnected => false,
                    Err(error) => {
                        shutdown_error.get_or_insert(error);
                        true
                    }
                });
        }
        drop(state.listener.take());
        state.listening = false;
        state.backlog = None;
        if let Some(ownership) = &state.ownership {
            ownership.remove_matching()?;
        }
        state.ownership = None;
        let result = self.snapshot_locked(&state);
        drop(state);
        self.incoming_waker.wake();
        if let Some(error) = shutdown_error {
            return Err(error).context("listener closed but an active connection shutdown failed");
        }
        Ok(result)
    }

    pub fn take_incoming(self: &Arc<Self>) -> Result<ControlledIncoming> {
        ensure!(
            !self.incoming_taken.swap(true, Ordering::AcqRel),
            "listener already has its sole tonic acceptor"
        );
        Ok(ControlledIncoming {
            owner: self.clone(),
        })
    }

    fn observation(&self, cursor: u64, timed_out: bool) -> Result<AcceptOutput> {
        let state = self.lock()?;
        ensure!(
            cursor <= state.sequence,
            "accept cursor is ahead of this listener"
        );
        if let Some(oldest) = state.events.front() {
            ensure!(
                cursor >= oldest.sequence - 1,
                "accept cursor expired from the bounded connection event history"
            );
        }
        let event = state
            .events
            .iter()
            .find(|event| event.sequence > cursor)
            .cloned();
        Ok(AcceptOutput {
            cursor: event.as_ref().map_or(cursor, |event| event.sequence),
            observed_generation: self.generation.clone(),
            timed_out: timed_out && event.is_none(),
            event,
        })
    }

    async fn observe(&self, input: AcceptInput) -> Result<AcceptOutput> {
        self.exact_path(&input.path)?;
        if let Some(generation) = input.generation {
            ensure!(
                generation == self.generation,
                "accept generation changed; obtain a new listener cursor"
            );
        }
        let seconds = input.timeout_secs.unwrap_or(0);
        ensure!(seconds <= 60, "accept timeout must be 0..=60 seconds");
        let cursor = input.after_sequence.unwrap_or(self.lock()?.sequence);
        let deadline = tokio::time::Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(seconds);
        loop {
            let notified = self.accepted.notified();
            tokio::pin!(notified);
            notified.as_mut().enable();
            let output = self.observation(cursor, false)?;
            if output.event.is_some() || seconds == 0 {
                return Ok(output);
            }
            if tokio::time::timeout_at(deadline, notified).await.is_err() {
                return self.observation(cursor, true);
            }
        }
    }

    pub async fn dispatch(&self, method: &str, args: &Value) -> Result<Value> {
        match method {
            "bind" => {
                let input: BindInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
                self.exact_path(&input.path)?;
                ensure!(input.protocol == "grpc", "shared listener protocol is grpc");
                Ok(serde_json::to_value(self.bind()?)?)
            }
            "listen" => {
                let input: ListenInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
                self.exact_path(&input.path)?;
                Ok(serde_json::to_value(self.listen(input.backlog)?)?)
            }
            "accept" => Ok(serde_json::to_value(
                self.observe(serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?).await?,
            )?),
            "close" => {
                let input: CloseInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
                self.exact_path(&input.path)?;
                Ok(serde_json::to_value(self.close(input.force)?)?)
            }
            _ => bail!("unknown unix_socket method: {method}"),
        }
    }
}

impl Drop for SharedListenerController {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        if let Ok(state) = self.state.get_mut() {
            for socket in state.connections.values() {
                let _ = socket.shutdown(Shutdown::Both);
            }
            drop(state.listener.take());
            if let Some(ownership) = &state.ownership {
                if let Err(error) = ownership.remove_matching() {
                    tracing::warn!(%error, "owned listener cleanup refused");
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

pub struct ControlledIncoming {
    owner: Arc<SharedListenerController>,
}

impl Stream for ControlledIncoming {
    type Item = io::Result<ManagedUnixStream>;
    fn poll_next(self: Pin<&mut Self>, cx: &mut TaskContext<'_>) -> Poll<Option<Self::Item>> {
        self.owner.incoming_waker.register(cx.waker());
        let mut state = match self.owner.state.lock() {
            Ok(state) => state,
            Err(_) => {
                return Poll::Ready(Some(Err(io::Error::other(
                    "listener controller lock poisoned",
                ))))
            }
        };
        if !state.listening {
            return Poll::Pending;
        }
        let Some(listener) = &state.listener else {
            return Poll::Pending;
        };
        let stream = match listener.poll_accept(cx) {
            Poll::Pending => return Poll::Pending,
            Poll::Ready(Err(error)) => return Poll::Ready(Some(Err(error))),
            Poll::Ready(Ok((stream, _))) => stream,
        };
        let shutdown = match SockRef::from(&stream).try_clone() {
            Ok(socket) => socket,
            Err(error) => return Poll::Ready(Some(Err(error))),
        };
        let Some(sequence) = state.sequence.checked_add(1) else {
            return Poll::Ready(Some(Err(io::Error::other(
                "listener event sequence exhausted",
            ))));
        };
        state.sequence = sequence;
        let connection_id = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();
        let credentials = stream.peer_cred().ok();
        let event = AcceptedConnection {
            sequence,
            connection_id: connection_id.clone(),
            binding_generation: state.binding_generation,
            accepted_at_unix_ms: SystemTime::now()
                .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
                .unwrap_or_default()
                .as_millis()
                .min(u64::MAX as u128) as u64,
            peer_uid: credentials.as_ref().map(|cred| cred.uid()),
            peer_gid: credentials.as_ref().map(|cred| cred.gid()),
            peer_pid: credentials.and_then(|cred| cred.pid()),
        };
        state.connections.insert(connection_id.clone(), shutdown);
        state.events.push_back(event);
        if state.events.len() > EVENT_CAPACITY {
            state.events.pop_front();
        }
        drop(state);
        self.owner.accepted.notify_waiters();
        Poll::Ready(Some(Ok(ManagedUnixStream {
            stream,
            connection_id,
            owner: Arc::downgrade(&self.owner),
        })))
    }
}

pub struct ManagedUnixStream {
    stream: UnixStream,
    connection_id: String,
    owner: Weak<SharedListenerController>,
}
impl Connected for ManagedUnixStream {
    type ConnectInfo = UdsConnectInfo;
    fn connect_info(&self) -> Self::ConnectInfo {
        self.stream.connect_info()
    }
}
impl AsyncRead for ManagedUnixStream {
    fn poll_read(
        mut self: Pin<&mut Self>,
        cx: &mut TaskContext<'_>,
        buffer: &mut ReadBuf<'_>,
    ) -> Poll<io::Result<()>> {
        Pin::new(&mut self.stream).poll_read(cx, buffer)
    }
}
impl AsyncWrite for ManagedUnixStream {
    fn poll_write(
        mut self: Pin<&mut Self>,
        cx: &mut TaskContext<'_>,
        buffer: &[u8],
    ) -> Poll<io::Result<usize>> {
        Pin::new(&mut self.stream).poll_write(cx, buffer)
    }
    fn poll_flush(mut self: Pin<&mut Self>, cx: &mut TaskContext<'_>) -> Poll<io::Result<()>> {
        Pin::new(&mut self.stream).poll_flush(cx)
    }
    fn poll_shutdown(mut self: Pin<&mut Self>, cx: &mut TaskContext<'_>) -> Poll<io::Result<()>> {
        Pin::new(&mut self.stream).poll_shutdown(cx)
    }
}
impl Drop for ManagedUnixStream {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        if let Some(owner) = self.owner.upgrade() {
            if let Ok(mut state) = owner.state.lock() {
                state.connections.remove(&self.connection_id);
            }
        }
    }
}

/// Tonic preserves these kernel credentials through ManagedUnixStream's
/// Connected implementation. They are not substituted for SID1/OIA1 admission.
pub fn extract_peer_cred<T>(request: &tonic::Request<T>) -> Option<tokio::net::unix::UCred> {
    request
        .extensions()
        .get::<UdsConnectInfo>()
        .and_then(|info| info.peer_cred)
}
</file>

<file path="op-grpc-bridge/src/specialist.rs">
//! `cognitive_mcp.specialist` — a persona assembled per call from the shared
//! piece pool and answered by the selected router model.
//!
//! Owner direction (2026-09-19): static agents are recreated dynamically from
//! pieces shared across agents with similar functions. The pool lives in
//! [`op_agents::dynamic::PieceLibrary`]; this module scopes it to the verified
//! caller, adds what the session already knows (namespace memory, activity
//! signals, pending knowledge pushes), composes the persona, and completes it
//! through `tched_router.Chat`'s guarded native path. The assembled persona
//! (piece ids and sources) is returned with the answer so the decision is
//! auditable, and the call is recorded as session activity so the context
//! engine can follow up.

use std::sync::Arc;

use anyhow::Context as _;
use op_agents::dynamic::{assemble, AssembledPersona, PieceLibrary, TaskContext};
use op_cognitive_mcp::context_awareness::ActivityType;
use op_cognitive_mcp::memory_store::EntryQuery;
use op_cognitive_mcp::CognitiveMcpServer;
use op_plugins::state_plugins::cognitive_mcp::{
    SpecialistInput, SpecialistOutput, SpecialistPersona,
};
use op_plugins::state_plugins::tched_router::{ChatInput, TchedChatMessage};
use tokio::sync::RwLock;

use crate::mutation_engine::MutationEngine;

/// Verified identity of the caller of a cognitive method.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy)]
pub struct CognitiveCaller<'a> {
    pub actor_id: &'a str,
    pub session_id: Option<&'a str>,
    pub session_genesis: Option<&'a str>,
}

impl CognitiveCaller<'_> {
    /// The session the activity and memory are scoped to: the anchored session
    /// when the caller named one, else the actor itself.
    pub fn scope(&self) -> &str {
        self.session_id.unwrap_or(self.actor_id)
    }
}

/// Memory namespace whose entries are shared agent pieces. Entries are either
/// a plain string (a knowledge piece) or `{kind, domains, tags, title, body}`.
pub const PIECES_NAMESPACE: &str = "agent_pieces";

/// Prompt budget for the assembled persona (chars, before the question).
const PERSONA_BUDGET_CHARS: usize = 12_000;
/// Hot executors a specialist may direct. These are HOT `cognitive_mcp`
/// methods the caller can invoke next; the persona is told they exist.
const EXECUTORS: [&str; 3] = ["rust_pro", "python_pro", "typescript_pro"];

/// Shared pool: seeded from the static catalog once, refreshed with memory
/// pieces on every call (they are the freshest shared knowledge).
static LIBRARY: std::sync::LazyLock<Arc<RwLock<PieceLibrary>>> =
    std::sync::LazyLock::new(|| Arc::new(RwLock::new(PieceLibrary::seeded_from_catalog())));

pub async fn consult(
    engine: &MutationEngine,
    caller: CognitiveCaller<'_>,
    args: &serde_json::Value,
) -> anyhow::Result<serde_json::Value> {
    let input: SpecialistInput =
        serde_json::from_value(args.clone()).context("specialist: invalid input")?;
    let question = input.question.trim();
    anyhow::ensure!(
        !question.is_empty(),
        "specialist: 'question' must not be empty"
    );

    let runtime = engine.cognitive_mcp().await?;
    let scope = caller.scope().to_string();
    // The memory the specialist may draw on is the caller's selected mode.
    let context =
        crate::memory_binding::context_for(engine, caller.actor_id, caller.session_id).await?;
    anyhow::ensure!(
        context.mode.has_memory(),
        "specialist: memory is disabled in ui_render mode"
    );
    let namespaces = vec![context.memory_namespace.clone()];

    // 1. Task context from what the session already knows.
    let mut task = TaskContext {
        question: question.to_string(),
        path: input.path.clone(),
        domain_hints: input.domain_hints.clone(),
        activity: activity_lines(runtime, &scope).await,
        snippets: Vec::new(),
        executors: EXECUTORS.iter().map(|s| s.to_string()).collect(),
    };
    task.snippets = memory_snippets(runtime, &namespaces, &task).await;
    task.snippets
        .extend(engine.take_pending_knowledge(&scope).await);

    // 2. Refresh shared pieces from memory, then compose the persona.
    refresh_memory_pieces(runtime).await;
    let persona: AssembledPersona = {
        let library = LIBRARY.read().await;
        assemble(&library, &task, PERSONA_BUDGET_CHARS)
    };

    // 3. Record the consultation as session activity before answering, so a
    //    failed completion still leaves the signal.
    runtime
        .context_engine()
        .record_activity(
            &scope,
            ActivityType::Query,
            format!("specialist({}): {}", operation_name(&input), question),
            serde_json::json!({
                "persona": persona.name,
                "domains": persona.domains,
                "pieces": persona.piece_ids.len(),
                "path": input.path,
            }),
        )
        .await;

    // 4. Complete through the guarded native router path.
    let output = crate::tched_router_runtime::TchedRouterRuntimeClient::from_env()
        .chat_under_guard(ChatInput {
            message: String::new(),
            messages: vec![
                TchedChatMessage {
                    role: "system".into(),
                    content: persona.system_prompt.clone(),
                },
                TchedChatMessage {
                    role: "user".into(),
                    content: format!("[{}] {question}", operation_name(&input)),
                },
            ],
            provider: String::new(),
            model: String::new(),
            conversation_id: caller.session_id.map(str::to_owned),
        })
        .await
        .context("specialist: native completion failed")?;

    let result = SpecialistOutput {
        answer: output.content,
        persona: SpecialistPersona {
            name: persona.name,
            domains: persona.domains,
            piece_ids: persona.piece_ids,
            sources: persona
                .sources
                .iter()
                .map(|s| serde_json::to_string(s).unwrap_or_default())
                .collect(),
        },
        context_used: task.snippets.len() + task.activity.len(),
        provider: output.provider,
        model: output.model,
    };
    Ok(serde_json::to_value(result)?)
}

/// Compose a persona for `task` from the shared pool, refreshed with memory
/// pieces when the cognitive runtime is available (best effort). Used by
/// event-triggered runs, which have no caller session of their own.
pub(crate) async fn assemble_for_task(
    engine: &MutationEngine,
    task: &TaskContext,
) -> AssembledPersona {
    if let Ok(runtime) = engine.cognitive_mcp().await {
        refresh_memory_pieces(runtime).await;
    }
    let library = LIBRARY.read().await;
    assemble(&library, task, PERSONA_BUDGET_CHARS)
}

fn operation_name(input: &SpecialistInput) -> String {
    serde_json::to_value(&input.operation)
        .ok()
        .and_then(|v| v.as_str().map(str::to_owned))
        .unwrap_or_else(|| "consult".into())
}

/// Recent session signals from the context engine, as short lines.
pub(crate) async fn activity_lines(runtime: &CognitiveMcpServer, scope: &str) -> Vec<String> {
    let Some(signals) = runtime.context_engine().get_session_signals(scope).await else {
        return Vec::new();
    };
    let mut lines = Vec::new();
    if let Some(topics) = signals.get("current_topics").and_then(|v| v.as_array()) {
        let topics: Vec<&str> = topics.iter().filter_map(|t| t.as_str()).collect();
        if !topics.is_empty() {
            lines.push(format!("current topics: {}", topics.join(", ")));
        }
    }
    if signals
        .get("recent_error_count")
        .and_then(|v| v.as_u64())
        .unwrap_or(0)
        > 0
    {
        lines.push(format!(
            "recent errors in this session: {}",
            signals["recent_error_count"]
        ));
    }
    if signals
        .get("is_stuck")
        .and_then(|v| v.as_bool())
        .unwrap_or(false)
    {
        lines.push("the session appears stuck on the same problem".into());
    }
    lines
}

/// Memory entries the caller may see, matched to the task: the bound
/// namespace(s) of the selected mode and the shared pieces namespace,
/// filtered by task terms.
pub(crate) async fn memory_snippets(
    runtime: &CognitiveMcpServer,
    namespaces: &[String],
    task: &TaskContext,
) -> Vec<String> {
    let store = runtime.memory_store();
    let terms = task.terms();
    let mut snippets = Vec::new();
    let pieces = PIECES_NAMESPACE.to_string();
    for namespace_name in namespaces.iter().chain(std::iter::once(&pieces)) {
        let namespace_name = namespace_name.as_str();
        let Ok(Some(_)) = store.get_namespace_by_name(namespace_name).await else {
            continue;
        };
        let Ok(entries) = store
            .query_entries(EntryQuery {
                // `namespace_id` is the namespace name (see EntryQuery).
                namespace_id: Some(namespace_name.to_string()),
                key_pattern: None,
                tags: None,
                limit: Some(200),
                offset: None,
            })
            .await
        else {
            continue;
        };
        for entry in entries {
            let text = match &entry.value {
                serde_json::Value::String(s) => s.clone(),
                other => other.to_string(),
            };
            let haystack =
                format!("{} {} {}", entry.key, entry.tags.join(" "), text).to_ascii_lowercase();
            if terms.iter().any(|t| haystack.contains(t.as_str())) {
                snippets.push(format!(
                    "[{}/{}] {}",
                    namespace_name,
                    entry.key,
                    truncate(&text, 400)
                ));
            }
            if snippets.len() >= 12 {
                return snippets;
            }
        }
    }
    snippets
}

/// Merge the `agent_pieces` namespace into the shared pool.
async fn refresh_memory_pieces(runtime: &CognitiveMcpServer) {
    let store = runtime.memory_store();
    let Ok(Some(_)) = store.get_namespace_by_name(PIECES_NAMESPACE).await else {
        return;
    };
    let Ok(entries) = store
        .query_entries(EntryQuery {
            namespace_id: Some(PIECES_NAMESPACE.to_string()),
            key_pattern: None,
            tags: None,
            limit: Some(500),
            offset: None,
        })
        .await
    else {
        return;
    };
    let mut library = LIBRARY.write().await;
    for entry in entries {
        library.add_from_memory_entry(PIECES_NAMESPACE, &entry.key, &entry.value);
    }
}

fn truncate(text: &str, max: usize) -> String {
    if text.chars().count() <= max {
        text.to_string()
    } else {
        let cut: String = text.chars().take(max).collect();
        format!("{cut}…")
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn scope_prefers_the_anchored_session() {
        let with_session = CognitiveCaller {
            actor_id: "actor",
            session_id: Some("sess"),
            session_genesis: None,
        };
        assert_eq!(with_session.scope(), "sess");
        let bare = CognitiveCaller {
            actor_id: "actor",
            session_id: None,
            session_genesis: None,
        };
        assert_eq!(bare.scope(), "actor");
    }

    #[test]
    fn shared_pool_is_seeded_once_from_the_catalog() {
        let library = LIBRARY.blocking_read();
        assert!(library.len() > 50);
    }
}

<file path="op-grpc-bridge/src/state_stream.rs">
//! StateSync reads of committed public SHM projections.

use std::collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet};
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

use anyhow::{bail, ensure, Context, Result};
use serde_json::Value;

use crate::sealed_schema_reader::{
    read_manifest_pinned_catalog, valid_plugin_id, ManifestPinnedCatalog,
};

const MAX_VIEW_DEPTH: usize = 64;
const MAX_SELECTED_VIEWS: usize = 4096;
const MAX_SELECTED_BYTES: usize = 16 * 1024 * 1024;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub(crate) struct PluginSnapshot {
    pub schema_hash: String,
    pub schema: Value,
    pub state: Option<Value>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub(crate) struct StateSnapshot {
    pub generation: u64,
    pub catalog_hash: String,
    pub plugins: BTreeMap<String, PluginSnapshot>,
}

pub(crate) async fn read_public_state_snapshot(
    requested_plugin_ids: &[String],
) -> Result<StateSnapshot> {
    read_public_state_snapshot_with_admission(requested_plugin_ids, false).await
}

pub(crate) async fn read_public_state_snapshot_after_admission(
    requested_plugin_ids: &[String],
) -> Result<StateSnapshot> {
    read_public_state_snapshot_with_admission(requested_plugin_ids, true).await
}

async fn read_public_state_snapshot_with_admission(
    requested_plugin_ids: &[String],
    allow_missing: bool,
) -> Result<StateSnapshot> {
    read_public_state_snapshot_in(
        crate::sealed_schema_reader::blob_catalog_dir_from_env(),
        op_core::projection_shm::shm_state_dir(),
        requested_plugin_ids.to_vec(),
        allow_missing,
    )
    .await
}

pub(crate) async fn read_public_state_snapshot_in(
    catalog_dir: PathBuf,
    state_dir: String,
    requested_plugin_ids: Vec<String>,
    allow_missing: bool,
) -> Result<StateSnapshot> {
    tokio::time::timeout(
        std::time::Duration::from_secs(5),
        tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || {
            read_public_state_snapshot_sync(
                &catalog_dir,
                &state_dir,
                &requested_plugin_ids,
                allow_missing,
            )
        }),
    )
    .await
    .context("public SHM snapshot read timed out")?
    .context("public SHM snapshot reader task failed")?
}

fn read_public_state_snapshot_sync(
    catalog_dir: &Path,
    state_dir: &str,
    requested_plugin_ids: &[String],
    allow_missing: bool,
) -> Result<StateSnapshot> {
    for _ in 0..3 {
        let before = read_manifest_pinned_catalog(catalog_dir)
            .context("sealed plugin catalog is unavailable")?;
        let selected = select_plugin_ids(&before, requested_plugin_ids, allow_missing)?;
        let projection = op_core::projection_shm::read_projection_snapshot_in(state_dir, &selected)
            .context("committed public SHM projection is unavailable")?;
        let after = read_manifest_pinned_catalog(catalog_dir)
            .context("sealed plugin catalog is unavailable after SHM read")?;
        if catalog_signature(&before) != catalog_signature(&after) {
            continue;
        }

        let mut plugins = BTreeMap::new();
        for plugin_id in selected {
            let document = after
                .plugins
                .get(&plugin_id)
                .with_context(|| format!("sealed plugin disappeared: {plugin_id}"))?;
            let schema = serde_json::from_str(&document.blob.schema_json)
                .with_context(|| format!("sealed schema JSON is invalid for {plugin_id}"))?;
            let state = projection
                .states
                .get(&plugin_id)
                .map(|bytes| {
                    let mut bytes = bytes.clone();
                    let value = simd_json::to_owned_value(&mut bytes)
                        .with_context(|| format!("public SHM state is invalid for {plugin_id}"))?;
                    let public = crate::mutation_engine::public_plugin_value(&plugin_id, &value);
                    document
                        .schema
                        .project_public_state(&public)?
                        .map(serde_json::to_value)
                        .transpose()
                        .with_context(|| format!("public SHM state is invalid for {plugin_id}"))
                })
                .transpose()?
                .flatten();
            plugins.insert(
                plugin_id,
                PluginSnapshot {
                    schema_hash: document.schema_hash.clone(),
                    schema,
                    state,
                },
            );
        }
        return Ok(StateSnapshot {
            generation: projection.generation,
            catalog_hash: after.catalog_hash,
            plugins,
        });
    }
    bail!("sealed catalog changed repeatedly around the public SHM snapshot")
}

fn select_plugin_ids(
    catalog: &ManifestPinnedCatalog,
    requested: &[String],
    allow_missing: bool,
) -> Result<Vec<String>> {
    if requested.is_empty() {
        return Ok(catalog.plugins.keys().cloned().collect());
    }
    let mut selected = BTreeSet::new();
    for plugin_id in requested {
        ensure!(valid_plugin_id(plugin_id), "invalid plugin id: {plugin_id}");
        if catalog.plugins.contains_key(plugin_id) {
            selected.insert(plugin_id.clone());
        } else if !allow_missing {
            bail!("plugin is absent from the sealed catalog: {plugin_id}");
        }
    }
    Ok(selected.into_iter().collect())
}

fn catalog_signature(catalog: &ManifestPinnedCatalog) -> (&str, BTreeMap<&str, &str>) {
    (
        catalog.catalog_hash.as_str(),
        catalog
            .plugins
            .iter()
            .map(|(id, document)| (id.as_str(), document.schema_hash.as_str()))
            .collect(),
    )
}

pub(crate) fn plugin_object_path(plugin_id: &str) -> String {
    op_plugins::canonical::plugin_path(plugin_id)
}

pub(crate) fn validate_public_path_patterns(patterns: &[String]) -> Result<()> {
    for pattern in patterns {
        ensure!(
            pattern.starts_with("/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/"),
            "state path pattern is outside the public plugin tree"
        );
        ensure!(
            !pattern.contains("/credentials")
                && !pattern.contains("/.credentials")
                && !pattern.contains("..")
                && !pattern.chars().any(char::is_control),
            "private or invalid state path pattern"
        );
        ensure!(
            pattern
                .split('/')
                .skip(1)
                .all(|segment| !segment.is_empty() && segment != "." && segment != ".."),
            "state path pattern contains an invalid segment"
        );
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub(crate) fn validate_path_patterns_against_snapshot(
    snapshot: &StateSnapshot,
    patterns: &[String],
) -> Result<()> {
    const PREFIX: &str = "/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/";
    for pattern in patterns {
        let selector = pattern
            .strip_prefix(PREFIX)
            .and_then(|suffix| suffix.split('/').next())
            .context("state path pattern has no plugin selector")?;
        ensure!(
            !selector.is_empty(),
            "state path pattern has no plugin selector"
        );
        let resolves = snapshot.plugins.keys().any(|plugin_id| {
            if selector.contains('*') || selector.contains('?') {
                glob_matches(selector, plugin_id)
            } else {
                selector == plugin_id
            }
        });
        ensure!(
            resolves,
            "state path pattern does not resolve to a sealed public plugin root: {pattern}"
        );
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub(crate) fn state_at_object_path<'a>(
    plugin_id: &str,
    state: &'a Value,
    object_path: &str,
) -> Result<&'a Value> {
    let root = plugin_object_path(plugin_id);
    if object_path == root {
        ensure!(
            state.is_object(),
            "public plugin root state is not an object"
        );
        return Ok(state);
    }
    let suffix = object_path
        .strip_prefix(&(root.clone() + "/"))
        .with_context(|| format!("object path is outside canonical plugin root {root}"))?;
    ensure!(!suffix.is_empty(), "child object path is empty");
    let mut current = state;
    for segment in suffix.split('/') {
        ensure!(
            !segment.is_empty()
                && segment != "."
                && segment != ".."
                && !segment.contains('\\')
                && !segment.chars().any(char::is_control),
            "invalid child object path segment"
        );
        current = current
            .as_object()
            .and_then(|object| object.get(segment))
            .with_context(|| format!("public SHM object path is absent: {object_path}"))?;
    }
    ensure!(
        current.is_object(),
        "requested D-Bus child is not an object"
    );
    Ok(current)
}

pub(crate) fn object_views(
    plugin_id: &str,
    state: &Value,
    patterns: &[String],
) -> Result<BTreeMap<String, Value>> {
    let root = plugin_object_path(plugin_id);
    if patterns.is_empty() {
        ensure!(
            state.is_object(),
            "public plugin root state is not an object"
        );
        ensure!(
            serde_json::to_vec(state)?.len() <= MAX_SELECTED_BYTES,
            "selected public state exceeds 16 MiB"
        );
        return Ok([(root, state.clone())].into_iter().collect());
    }
    let mut output = BTreeMap::new();
    let mut selected_bytes = 0usize;
    for pattern in patterns
        .iter()
        .filter(|pattern| !pattern.contains('*') && !pattern.contains('?'))
    {
        if let Ok(value) = state_at_object_path(plugin_id, state, pattern) {
            insert_selected_view(&mut output, pattern.clone(), value, &mut selected_bytes)?;
        }
    }
    if patterns
        .iter()
        .any(|pattern| pattern.contains('*') || pattern.contains('?'))
    {
        collect_matching_object_views(root, state, patterns, 0, &mut output, &mut selected_bytes)?;
    }
    Ok(output)
}

fn collect_matching_object_views(
    path: String,
    value: &Value,
    patterns: &[String],
    depth: usize,
    output: &mut BTreeMap<String, Value>,
    selected_bytes: &mut usize,
) -> Result<()> {
    ensure!(
        depth <= MAX_VIEW_DEPTH,
        "public state tree exceeds depth 64"
    );
    let Some(object) = value.as_object() else {
        return Ok(());
    };
    if patterns.iter().any(|pattern| glob_matches(pattern, &path)) {
        insert_selected_view(output, path.clone(), value, selected_bytes)?;
    }
    for (segment, child) in object {
        if valid_child_segment(segment) && child.is_object() {
            collect_matching_object_views(
                format!("{path}/{segment}"),
                child,
                patterns,
                depth + 1,
                output,
                selected_bytes,
            )?;
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn insert_selected_view(
    output: &mut BTreeMap<String, Value>,
    path: String,
    value: &Value,
    selected_bytes: &mut usize,
) -> Result<()> {
    if output.contains_key(&path) {
        return Ok(());
    }
    ensure!(
        output.len() < MAX_SELECTED_VIEWS,
        "selected public state exceeds 4096 object frames"
    );
    *selected_bytes = selected_bytes
        .checked_add(serde_json::to_vec(value)?.len())
        .context("selected public state byte count overflow")?;
    ensure!(
        *selected_bytes <= MAX_SELECTED_BYTES,
        "selected public state exceeds 16 MiB"
    );
    output.insert(path, value.clone());
    Ok(())
}

fn valid_child_segment(segment: &str) -> bool {
    !segment.is_empty()
        && segment != "."
        && segment != ".."
        && !segment.contains('/')
        && !segment.contains('\\')
        && !segment.chars().any(char::is_control)
}

fn glob_matches(pattern: &str, value: &str) -> bool {
    let (mut pattern_index, mut value_index, mut star, mut retry) = (0, 0, None, 0);
    let pattern = pattern.as_bytes();
    let value = value.as_bytes();
    while value_index < value.len() {
        if pattern_index < pattern.len()
            && (pattern[pattern_index] == b'?' || pattern[pattern_index] == value[value_index])
        {
            pattern_index += 1;
            value_index += 1;
        } else if pattern_index < pattern.len() && pattern[pattern_index] == b'*' {
            star = Some(pattern_index);
            pattern_index += 1;
            retry = value_index;
        } else if let Some(star_index) = star {
            pattern_index = star_index + 1;
            retry += 1;
            value_index = retry;
        } else {
            return false;
        }
    }
    while pattern_index < pattern.len() && pattern[pattern_index] == b'*' {
        pattern_index += 1;
    }
    pattern_index == pattern.len()
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn sealed_policy_controls_real_committed_child_snapshots() {
        let root = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let catalog = root.path().join("blobs");
        let state_dir = root.path().join("state").to_str().unwrap().to_string();
        let child = op_state_store::PluginSchema::builder("child")
            .string_field("status", false, "Public child status")
            .build();
        let schema = op_state_store::PluginSchema::builder("demo")
            .object_field("child", child.fields, false, "Observed child")
            .string_field("secret", false, "Internal value")
            .public_state_path("/child")
            .build();
        let private_schema = op_state_store::PluginSchema::builder("private")
            .string_field("secret", false, "Internal value")
            .build();
        let mut store = op_blob::BlobStore::open(&catalog).unwrap();
        for schema in [schema, private_schema] {
            store
                .write(&op_blob::blobify_plugin_schema(
                    &schema.name.clone(),
                    schema,
                ))
                .unwrap();
        }
        let commit = op_core::projection_shm::update_projection_in(&state_dir, "demo", |_| {
            Ok(Some(
                br#"{"child":{"status":"ready","hidden":"secret"},"secret":"secret"}"#.to_vec(),
            ))
        })
        .unwrap();
        op_core::projection_shm::update_projection_in(&state_dir, "private", |_| {
            Ok(Some(br#"{"secret":"secret"}"#.to_vec()))
        })
        .unwrap();
        let snapshot =
            read_public_state_snapshot_in(catalog.clone(), state_dir.clone(), vec![], false)
                .await
                .unwrap();
        assert!(snapshot.generation >= commit.generation);
        let public = snapshot.plugins["demo"].state.as_ref().unwrap();
        assert_eq!(public, &serde_json::json!({"child":{"status":"ready"}}));
        assert_eq!(
            state_at_object_path("demo", public, "/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/demo/child").unwrap(),
            &serde_json::json!({"status":"ready"})
        );
        assert!(snapshot.plugins["private"].state.is_none());
        assert!(!snapshot.plugins["private"].schema.is_null());
        op_core::projection_shm::update_projection_in(&state_dir, "demo", |_| {
            Ok(Some(br#"{"secret":"still internal"}"#.to_vec()))
        })
        .unwrap();
        let after =
            read_public_state_snapshot_in(catalog.clone(), state_dir.clone(), vec![], false)
                .await
                .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(after.plugins["demo"].state, Some(serde_json::json!({})));
        assert!(after.generation > snapshot.generation);
        // A partial/in-progress publication is never emitted as a snapshot.
        std::fs::write(
            std::path::Path::new(&state_dir).join(".manifest.json"),
            br#"{"generation":99,"publishing":true}"#,
        )
        .unwrap();
        assert!(
            read_public_state_snapshot_in(catalog, state_dir, vec![], false)
                .await
                .is_err()
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn child_paths_project_objects_without_exposing_scalar_members() {
        let state = serde_json::json!({"root":1,"children":{"a":{"value":2},"scalar":3}});
        assert_eq!(
            state_at_object_path("demo", &state, "/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/demo/children/a").unwrap(),
            &serde_json::json!({"value":2})
        );
        let views = object_views(
            "demo",
            &state,
            &["/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/demo/children/*".into()],
        )
        .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(views.len(), 1);
        assert!(views.contains_key("/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/demo/children/a"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn path_glob_is_anchored() {
        assert!(glob_matches("/org/*/demo", "/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/demo"));
        assert!(!glob_matches(
            "/plugins/demo",
            "/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/demo"
        ));
    }

    #[test]
    fn path_patterns_must_resolve_to_a_sealed_plugin_root() {
        let snapshot = StateSnapshot {
            generation: 1,
            catalog_hash: "catalog".into(),
            plugins: [(
                "demo".into(),
                PluginSnapshot {
                    schema_hash: "schema".into(),
                    schema: serde_json::json!({}),
                    state: None,
                },
            )]
            .into_iter()
            .collect(),
        };
        validate_path_patterns_against_snapshot(&snapshot, &["/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/de*".into()])
            .unwrap();
        assert!(validate_path_patterns_against_snapshot(
            &snapshot,
            &["/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/private_store".into()],
        )
        .is_err());
    }
}
