<file path="op-grpc-bridge/src/state_tree_fold.rs">
//! Pure folding of authoritative object/property changes into one plugin state tree.

use anyhow::{bail, ensure, Context, Result};
use serde_json::{Map, Value as JsonValue};
use simd_json::OwnedValue;

use crate::mutation_engine::ChangeType;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub enum StateTreeFold {
    /// The event carries no state change, or the requested deletion found no node.
    Unchanged,
    /// Complete plugin state after applying the change.
    Present(OwnedValue),
    /// The canonical plugin root was deleted.
    Removed,
}

/// Fold a backend-confirmed set of fields at one object as a single state
/// transaction. Callers commit the final tree once, so paired fields never
/// become independently visible and concurrent sibling branches are retained.
pub(crate) fn merge_plugin_object_fields(
    previous: Option<&OwnedValue>,
    plugin_id: &str,
    object_path: &str,
    fields: &OwnedValue,
) -> Result<StateTreeFold> {
    let fields = serde_json::to_value(fields)?;
    let fields = fields
        .as_object()
        .context("field update must be an object")?;
    logical_path(plugin_id, object_path)?;
    let mut current = previous.cloned();
    for (member, value) in fields {
        let value = simd_json::serde::to_owned_value(value)?;
        match fold_plugin_state(
            current.as_ref(),
            plugin_id,
            object_path,
            ChangeType::PropertySet,
            Some(member),
            &value,
        )? {
            StateTreeFold::Present(state) => current = Some(state),
            _ => unreachable!("a property set produces a complete object"),
        }
    }
    if fields.is_empty() {
        Ok(StateTreeFold::Unchanged)
    } else {
        Ok(StateTreeFold::Present(
            current.context("field update produced no state")?,
        ))
    }
}

/// Fold one already-authoritative state change into the prior complete plugin state.
/// Method arguments and signal payloads are deliberately never folded.
pub fn fold_plugin_state(
    previous: Option<&OwnedValue>,
    plugin_id: &str,
    object_path: &str,
    change_type: ChangeType,
    member_name: Option<&str>,
    new_value: &OwnedValue,
) -> Result<StateTreeFold> {
    if matches!(change_type, ChangeType::MethodCall | ChangeType::Signal) {
        return Ok(StateTreeFold::Unchanged);
    }
    ensure!(
        change_type != ChangeType::SchemaMigration,
        "schema migration has no authoritative state-fold contract"
    );

    let logical = logical_path(plugin_id, object_path)?;
    let mut state = previous
        .map(serde_json::to_value)
        .transpose()
        .context("convert previous plugin state")?;
    let incoming = serde_json::to_value(new_value).context("convert authoritative value")?;

    match change_type {
        ChangeType::PropertySet => {
            if member_name.is_none() {
                ensure!(
                    incoming.is_object(),
                    "whole object state must be a JSON object"
                );
                if logical.segments.is_empty() {
                    return present(incoming);
                }
                let root = object_root_mut(&mut state)?;
                insert_subtree(root, &logical.segments, incoming)?;
                return present(JsonValue::Object(root.clone()));
            }
            let member = member_name.context("property set requires a member at a child path")?;
            validate_segment(member, "property member")?;
            let root = object_root_mut(&mut state)?;
            let object = descend_object_mut(root, &logical.segments, true)?
                .context("property target is absent")?;
            object.insert(member.to_string(), incoming);
            present(JsonValue::Object(root.clone()))
        }
        ChangeType::PropertyDelete => {
            let member = member_name.context("property delete requires a member")?;
            validate_segment(member, "property member")?;
            let Some(root) = existing_root_mut(&mut state)? else {
                return Ok(StateTreeFold::Unchanged);
            };
            let Some(object) = descend_object_mut(root, &logical.segments, false)? else {
                return Ok(StateTreeFold::Unchanged);
            };
            if object.remove(member).is_none() {
                return Ok(StateTreeFold::Unchanged);
            }
            present(JsonValue::Object(root.clone()))
        }
        ChangeType::ObjectAdded => {
            ensure!(
                member_name.is_none(),
                "object add must not include a member"
            );
            ensure!(
                incoming.is_object(),
                "added object state must be a JSON object"
            );
            if logical.segments.is_empty() {
                return present(incoming);
            }
            let root = object_root_mut(&mut state)?;
            insert_subtree(root, &logical.segments, incoming)?;
            present(JsonValue::Object(root.clone()))
        }
        ChangeType::ObjectRemoved => {
            ensure!(
                member_name.is_none(),
                "object removal must not include a member"
            );
            if logical.segments.is_empty() {
                return Ok(StateTreeFold::Removed);
            }
            let Some(root) = existing_root_mut(&mut state)? else {
                return Ok(StateTreeFold::Unchanged);
            };
            if !remove_subtree(root, &logical.segments)? {
                return Ok(StateTreeFold::Unchanged);
            }
            present(JsonValue::Object(root.clone()))
        }
        ChangeType::MethodCall | ChangeType::Signal | ChangeType::SchemaMigration => {
            unreachable!("handled before fold")
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Debug)]
struct LogicalPath {
    segments: Vec<String>,
}

fn logical_path(plugin_id: &str, object_path: &str) -> Result<LogicalPath> {
    ensure!(!plugin_id.is_empty(), "plugin id must not be empty");
    ensure!(
        !plugin_id.contains('/')
            && !plugin_id.contains('\\')
            && !plugin_id.chars().any(char::is_control),
        "plugin id contains invalid path characters"
    );
    let root = op_plugins::canonical::plugin_path(plugin_id);
    if object_path == root {
        return Ok(LogicalPath { segments: vec![] });
    }
    let suffix = object_path
        .strip_prefix(&(root.clone() + "/"))
        .with_context(|| {
            format!("object path is outside canonical plugin root {root}: {object_path}")
        })?;
    let segments = suffix
        .split('/')
        .map(|segment| {
            validate_segment(segment, "child path segment")?;
            Ok(segment.to_string())
        })
        .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
    ensure!(!segments.is_empty(), "child object path is empty");
    Ok(LogicalPath { segments })
}

fn validate_segment(segment: &str, label: &str) -> Result<()> {
    ensure!(!segment.is_empty(), "{label} must not be empty");
    ensure!(
        segment != "." && segment != "..",
        "{label} traverses the state tree"
    );
    ensure!(segment.len() <= 255, "{label} is too long");
    ensure!(
        !segment.chars().any(char::is_control) && !segment.contains('/') && !segment.contains('\\'),
        "{label} contains invalid path characters"
    );
    Ok(())
}

fn object_root_mut(state: &mut Option<JsonValue>) -> Result<&mut Map<String, JsonValue>> {
    if state.is_none() {
        *state = Some(JsonValue::Object(Map::new()));
    }
    existing_root_mut(state)?.context("previous plugin state is not an object")
}

fn existing_root_mut(state: &mut Option<JsonValue>) -> Result<Option<&mut Map<String, JsonValue>>> {
    match state {
        None => Ok(None),
        Some(JsonValue::Object(object)) => Ok(Some(object)),
        Some(_) => bail!("previous plugin state is not an object"),
    }
}

fn descend_object_mut<'a>(
    root: &'a mut Map<String, JsonValue>,
    segments: &[String],
    create: bool,
) -> Result<Option<&'a mut Map<String, JsonValue>>> {
    let mut current = root;
    for segment in segments {
        if !current.contains_key(segment) {
            if !create {
                return Ok(None);
            }
            current.insert(segment.clone(), JsonValue::Object(Map::new()));
        }
        current = current
            .get_mut(segment)
            .and_then(JsonValue::as_object_mut)
            .with_context(|| format!("state path traverses scalar child '{segment}'"))?;
    }
    Ok(Some(current))
}

fn insert_subtree(
    root: &mut Map<String, JsonValue>,
    segments: &[String],
    value: JsonValue,
) -> Result<()> {
    let (leaf, parents) = segments.split_last().context("object path has no child")?;
    let parent = descend_object_mut(root, parents, true)?.context("object parent is absent")?;
    parent.insert(leaf.clone(), value);
    Ok(())
}

fn remove_subtree(root: &mut Map<String, JsonValue>, segments: &[String]) -> Result<bool> {
    let (leaf, parents) = segments.split_last().context("object path has no child")?;
    let Some(parent) = descend_object_mut(root, parents, false)? else {
        return Ok(false);
    };
    Ok(parent.remove(leaf).is_some())
}

fn present(value: JsonValue) -> Result<StateTreeFold> {
    Ok(StateTreeFold::Present(
        simd_json::serde::to_owned_value(value).context("convert folded plugin state")?,
    ))
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use simd_json::json;
    use simd_json::prelude::ValueObjectAccess;

    #[test]
    fn related_field_updates_preserve_siblings_at_root_and_child() {
        let previous = json!({"status":"observed","model_assignments":{"ovs":"old","cozo":"keep"}});
        let StateTreeFold::Present(state) = merge_plugin_object_fields(
            Some(&previous),
            "router",
            "/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/router",
            &json!({"selected_provider":"provider", "selected_model":"model"}),
        )
        .unwrap() else {
            panic!("expected complete tree")
        };
        assert_eq!(state["status"], json!("observed"));
        assert_eq!(state["selected_provider"], json!("provider"));
        assert_eq!(state["selected_model"], json!("model"));
        let StateTreeFold::Present(state) = merge_plugin_object_fields(
            Some(&state),
            "router",
            "/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/router/model_assignments",
            &json!({"ovs":"new"}),
        )
        .unwrap() else {
            panic!("expected complete tree")
        };
        assert_eq!(
            state["model_assignments"],
            json!({"ovs":"new","cozo":"keep"})
        );
        assert_eq!(state["selected_model"], json!("model"));
        assert!(merge_plugin_object_fields(
            Some(&state),
            "router",
            "/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/other",
            &json!({"x":1})
        )
        .is_err());
        assert!(merge_plugin_object_fields(
            Some(&state),
            "router",
            "/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/router/status",
            &json!({"x":1})
        )
        .is_err());
    }

    fn folded(
        previous: Option<&OwnedValue>,
        path: &str,
        change: ChangeType,
        member: Option<&str>,
        value: &OwnedValue,
    ) -> Result<StateTreeFold> {
        fold_plugin_state(previous, "demo", path, change, member, value)
    }

    fn present_value(result: StateTreeFold) -> OwnedValue {
        match result {
            StateTreeFold::Present(value) => value,
            other => panic!("expected present state, got {other:?}"),
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn root_whole_state_and_property_updates_preserve_siblings() {
        let root = "/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/demo";
        let first = present_value(
            folded(
                None,
                root,
                ChangeType::PropertySet,
                None,
                &json!({"a":1,"b":2}),
            )
            .unwrap(),
        );
        let second = present_value(
            folded(
                Some(&first),
                root,
                ChangeType::PropertySet,
                Some("a"),
                &json!(3),
            )
            .unwrap(),
        );
        assert_eq!(second, json!({"a":3,"b":2}));
    }

    #[test]
    fn descendant_insert_replace_and_delete_preserve_other_branches() {
        let root = json!({"instances":{"one":{"status":"up"}},"sibling":7});
        let child = "/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/demo/instances/two";
        let inserted = present_value(
            folded(
                Some(&root),
                child,
                ChangeType::PropertySet,
                Some("status"),
                &json!("down"),
            )
            .unwrap(),
        );
        assert_eq!(inserted["instances"]["one"]["status"], "up");
        assert_eq!(inserted["instances"]["two"]["status"], "down");
        assert_eq!(inserted["sibling"], 7);

        let replaced_by_property_change = present_value(
            folded(
                Some(&inserted),
                child,
                ChangeType::PropertySet,
                None,
                &json!({"status":"starting"}),
            )
            .unwrap(),
        );
        assert_eq!(
            replaced_by_property_change["instances"]["two"],
            json!({"status":"starting"})
        );
        assert_eq!(
            replaced_by_property_change["instances"]["one"]["status"],
            "up"
        );

        let replaced = present_value(
            folded(
                Some(&replaced_by_property_change),
                child,
                ChangeType::ObjectAdded,
                None,
                &json!({"status":"ready","pid":4}),
            )
            .unwrap(),
        );
        assert_eq!(replaced["instances"]["two"]["pid"], 4);
        let removed = present_value(
            folded(
                Some(&replaced),
                child,
                ChangeType::ObjectRemoved,
                None,
                &json!("ignored"),
            )
            .unwrap(),
        );
        assert!(removed["instances"].get("two").is_none());
        assert_eq!(removed["instances"]["one"]["status"], "up");
    }

    #[test]
    fn property_delete_and_root_delete_are_distinct() {
        let root_path = "/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/demo";
        let prior = json!({"keep":1,"drop":2});
        let updated = present_value(
            folded(
                Some(&prior),
                root_path,
                ChangeType::PropertyDelete,
                Some("drop"),
                &json!(null),
            )
            .unwrap(),
        );
        assert_eq!(updated, json!({"keep":1}));
        assert_eq!(
            folded(
                Some(&updated),
                root_path,
                ChangeType::ObjectRemoved,
                None,
                &json!(null),
            )
            .unwrap(),
            StateTreeFold::Removed
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn missing_deletion_does_not_fabricate_empty_state() {
        assert_eq!(
            folded(
                None,
                "/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/demo/missing",
                ChangeType::ObjectRemoved,
                None,
                &json!(null),
            )
            .unwrap(),
            StateTreeFold::Unchanged
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn rejects_wrong_root_traversal_and_scalar_descent() {
        assert!(folded(
            None,
            "/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/other",
            ChangeType::PropertySet,
            None,
            &json!({})
        )
        .is_err());
        assert!(folded(
            None,
            "/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/demo/../other",
            ChangeType::ObjectAdded,
            None,
            &json!({})
        )
        .is_err());
        let scalar = json!({"child":5,"keep":true});
        assert!(folded(
            Some(&scalar),
            "/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/demo/child/grandchild",
            ChangeType::PropertySet,
            Some("value"),
            &json!(1)
        )
        .is_err());
        assert_eq!(scalar, json!({"child":5,"keep":true}));
    }

    #[test]
    fn signals_and_method_arguments_never_become_state() {
        let prior = json!({"actual":"state"});
        for change in [ChangeType::Signal, ChangeType::MethodCall] {
            assert_eq!(
                folded(
                    Some(&prior),
                    "/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/demo",
                    change,
                    Some("method_or_signal"),
                    &json!({"secret_argument":true}),
                )
                .unwrap(),
                StateTreeFold::Unchanged
            );
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn ovsdb_delta_path_is_rejected_until_it_has_a_row_fold_contract() {
        let prior = json!({"Open_vSwitch":{"old":1}});
        assert!(fold_plugin_state(
            Some(&prior),
            "net",
            "/org/opdbus/v1/ovsdb/Bridge",
            ChangeType::PropertySet,
            Some("Bridge"),
            &json!({"uuid":{"new":{"name":"br0"}}}),
        )
        .is_err());
        assert_eq!(prior, json!({"Open_vSwitch":{"old":1}}));
    }

    #[test]
    fn schema_migration_requires_an_explicit_owner_contract() {
        assert!(folded(
            None,
            "/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/demo",
            ChangeType::SchemaMigration,
            None,
            &json!({"schema":"not state"})
        )
        .is_err());
    }
}
</file>

<file path="op-grpc-bridge/src/tched_config_dispatch.rs">
//! Native read adapter for the tched_router v0.8.4 config surface.
//!
//! MutationEngine performs sealed admission and pins/rechecks the exact plugin
//! schema around this helper. This module only maps an already-admitted method
//! to the shared loopback runtime; it is not plugin-existence authority.

use anyhow::Context;
use op_plugins::state_plugins::tched_router::{
    ConfigGetInput, ConfigInitInput, ConfigListInput, ConfigMigrateInput, ConfigPatchInput,
    ConfigSetInput,
};
use op_plugins::state_plugins::tched_router_config_surface::{
    config_method_backing, ConfigMethodBacking,
};
use serde_json::Value;

use crate::tched_router_runtime::{
    ConfigSecretPolicy, NativeConfigMutation, TchedRouterRuntimeClient,
};

pub(crate) enum ConfigReadDispatch {
    Handled(Value),
    /// MutationEngine must read, commit, and return from one masked native
    /// configuration image under the exact seal pin.
    NativeConfig {
        section: Option<&'static str>,
    },
    /// The six plugin-owned fields are read from exact committed protected SHM
    /// by MutationEngine under the same catalog pin.
    CommittedField(&'static str),
    NotAConfigRead,
}

pub(crate) async fn dispatch_config_mutation(
    runtime: &TchedRouterRuntimeClient,
    method: &str,
    args: &Value,
    secrets: &dyn ConfigSecretPolicy,
) -> anyhow::Result<Option<NativeConfigMutation>> {
    let mutation = match method {
        "PatchConfig" | "config_patch" => {
            let input: ConfigPatchInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())
                .context("decode admitted config patch input")?;
            runtime.patch_config(&input, secrets).await?
        }
        "config_set" => {
            let input: ConfigSetInput =
                serde_json::from_value(args.clone()).context("decode admitted config_set input")?;
            runtime.set_config_property(&input, secrets).await?
        }
        "config_init" => {
            let input: ConfigInitInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())
                .context("decode admitted config_init input")?;
            runtime.init_config(&input, secrets).await?
        }
        "config_migrate" => {
            let input: ConfigMigrateInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())
                .context("decode admitted config_migrate input")?;
            runtime.migrate_config(&input, secrets).await?
        }
        _ => return Ok(None),
    };
    Ok(Some(mutation))
}

pub(crate) async fn dispatch_config_read(
    runtime: &TchedRouterRuntimeClient,
    method: &str,
    args: &Value,
    secrets: &dyn ConfigSecretPolicy,
) -> anyhow::Result<ConfigReadDispatch> {
    match method {
        "config_list" => {
            let input: ConfigListInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())
                .context("decode admitted config_list input")?;
            let value = runtime
                .read_config_list(input.prefix.as_deref(), secrets)
                .await?;
            Ok(ConfigReadDispatch::Handled(value))
        }
        "config_get" => {
            let input: ConfigGetInput =
                serde_json::from_value(args.clone()).context("decode admitted config_get input")?;
            let value = runtime.read_config_property(&input.path, secrets).await?;
            Ok(ConfigReadDispatch::Handled(value))
        }
        other => match config_method_backing(other) {
            Some(ConfigMethodBacking::WholeNativeConfig) => {
                Ok(ConfigReadDispatch::NativeConfig { section: None })
            }
            Some(ConfigMethodBacking::NativeSection(section)) => {
                Ok(ConfigReadDispatch::NativeConfig {
                    section: Some(section),
                })
            }
            Some(ConfigMethodBacking::CommittedPluginStateSection(field)) => {
                Ok(ConfigReadDispatch::CommittedField(field))
            }
            Some(ConfigMethodBacking::NativePropertyPatch) | None => {
                Ok(ConfigReadDispatch::NotAConfigRead)
            }
        },
    }
}
</file>

<file path="op-grpc-bridge/src/tched_config_engine.rs">
//! Exact sealed-contract adapter for the native tched_router configuration surface.

use std::sync::Arc;

use anyhow::Context;
use serde_json::{json, Value};

use crate::{
    mutation_engine::MutationEngine,
    sealed_schema_reader::{
        blob_catalog_dir_from_env, read_manifest_pinned_schema_document,
        ManifestPinnedSchemaDocument,
    },
    tched_config_dispatch::{self, ConfigReadDispatch},
    tched_config_secret_policy::PinnedConfigSecretPolicy,
    tched_router_runtime::TchedRouterRuntimeClient,
};

const PLUGIN: &str = "tched_router";

struct PinnedConfigContract {
    schema_hash: String,
    schema_json: String,
    config_schema: Value,
    secrets: PinnedConfigSecretPolicy,
}

fn load_contract(pinned: &ManifestPinnedSchemaDocument) -> anyhow::Result<PinnedConfigContract> {
    crate::method_contract_admission::admit_compiled_state_contract(pinned, PLUGIN)?;
    // The exact field retains the original self-contained native document.
    // Method-output schemas embed a pointer-rebased derivative beneath
    // /properties/config and therefore are not an extraction authority.
    let exact = pinned
        .schema
        .fields
        .get("native_config")
        .context("sealed tched_router has no native_config state field")?;
    let op_state_store::FieldType::JsonSchema(config_schema) = &exact.field_type else {
        anyhow::bail!("sealed tched_router native_config field is not an exact schema");
    };
    let config_schema = serde_json::to_value(config_schema.as_ref())?;
    let secrets = PinnedConfigSecretPolicy::new(Arc::new(config_schema.clone()))?;
    Ok(PinnedConfigContract {
        schema_hash: pinned.schema_hash.clone(),
        schema_json: pinned.blob.schema_json.clone(),
        config_schema,
        secrets,
    })
}

async fn ensure_current_pin(expected: &str, expected_json: &str) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
    let expected = expected.to_string();
    let expected_json = expected_json.to_string();
    tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || {
        let current = read_manifest_pinned_schema_document(&blob_catalog_dir_from_env(), PLUGIN)?;
        anyhow::ensure!(
            current.schema_hash == expected && current.blob.schema_json == expected_json,
            "tched_router seal changed during native config dispatch"
        );
        Ok(())
    })
    .await?
}

fn validate_output(
    admitted: &op_state_store::PluginSchema,
    method: &str,
    output: &Value,
) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
    let declaration = admitted
        .methods
        .get(method)
        .with_context(|| format!("admitted tched_router method '{method}' is absent"))?;
    let returns = declaration
        .returns
        .as_ref()
        .with_context(|| format!("admitted tched_router method '{method}' has no output schema"))?;
    let schema = serde_json::to_value(returns)?;
    let validator =
        jsonschema::Validator::new(&schema).context("invalid admitted method output contract")?;
    validator.validate(output).map_err(|_| {
        anyhow::anyhow!(
            "native output does not conform to admitted tched_router.{method} during output validation"
        )
    })
}

fn validate_native_config(contract: &PinnedConfigContract, config: &Value) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
    let validator = jsonschema::Validator::new(&contract.config_schema)
        .context("invalid sealed native configuration contract")?;
    validator.validate(config).map_err(|_| {
        anyhow::anyhow!("masked native configuration failed sealed-contract validation")
    })
}

fn select_native_config(config: &Value, section: Option<&str>) -> anyhow::Result<Value> {
    let selected = match section {
        None => config.clone(),
        Some(section) => config
            .get(section)
            .cloned()
            .with_context(|| format!("native config section '{section}' is absent"))?,
    };
    Ok(json!({ "config": selected }))
}

/// Returns None only when the method is outside the v3 config facade.
pub(crate) async fn dispatch(
    engine: &MutationEngine,
    pinned: &ManifestPinnedSchemaDocument,
    method: &str,
    args: &Value,
) -> anyhow::Result<Option<Value>> {
    let admitted = &pinned.schema;
    let contract = load_contract(pinned)?;

    if method == "GetConfigSchema" {
        let output = json!({ "config_schema": contract.config_schema.clone() });
        ensure_current_pin(&contract.schema_hash, &contract.schema_json).await?;
        validate_output(admitted, method, &output)?;
        return Ok(Some(output));
    }

    let runtime = TchedRouterRuntimeClient::from_env();
    match tched_config_dispatch::dispatch_config_read(&runtime, method, args, &contract.secrets)
        .await?
    {
        ConfigReadDispatch::Handled(output) => {
            ensure_current_pin(&contract.schema_hash, &contract.schema_json).await?;
            validate_output(admitted, method, &output)?;
            return Ok(Some(output));
        }
        ConfigReadDispatch::CommittedField(field) => {
            let output = engine
                .read_tched_router_config_field(field, &contract.schema_hash)
                .await?;
            let output = json!({ "config": output });
            ensure_current_pin(&contract.schema_hash, &contract.schema_json).await?;
            validate_output(admitted, method, &output)?;
            return Ok(Some(output));
        }
        ConfigReadDispatch::NativeConfig { section } => {
            let observation = runtime.observe_config_and_state(&contract.secrets).await?;
            validate_native_config(&contract, &observation.native_config)?;
            let native_config = observation.native_config.clone();
            let (_, represented) = observation.into_state_and_fields()?;
            engine
                .persist_tched_router_config_observation(
                    method,
                    &represented,
                    &contract.schema_hash,
                )
                .await?;
            let committed = engine
                .read_tched_router_config_field("native_config", &contract.schema_hash)
                .await?;
            anyhow::ensure!(
                committed == native_config,
                "tched_router native config changed after observation publication"
            );
            ensure_current_pin(&contract.schema_hash, &contract.schema_json).await?;
            let output = select_native_config(&committed, section)?;
            validate_output(admitted, method, &output)?;
            return Ok(Some(output));
        }
        ConfigReadDispatch::NotAConfigRead => {}
    }

    let Some(mutation) =
        tched_config_dispatch::dispatch_config_mutation(&runtime, method, args, &contract.secrets)
            .await?
    else {
        return Ok(None);
    };
    anyhow::ensure!(
        !mutation.readback.is_null(),
        "native config mutation completed without authoritative target readback"
    );

    // Method-specific receipts are bound to their target readbacks. A native
    // remove receipt denotes reset, not equality to a null resulting value.
    // This stable full observation supplies one paired config + selection
    // image for one protected SHM generation; no global native CAS is implied.
    let observation = runtime
        .observe_config_and_state(&contract.secrets)
        .await
        .context(
            "native config mutation completed but coherent observation failed; outcome requires reconciliation",
        )?;
    validate_native_config(&contract, &observation.native_config).context(
        "native config mutation completed but its full observation failed contract validation",
    )?;
    let (_, represented) = observation.into_state_and_fields()?;
    engine
        .persist_tched_router_config_observation(
            method,
            &represented,
            &contract.schema_hash,
        )
        .await
        .context(
            "native config mutation completed but protected state publication failed; outcome requires reconciliation",
        )?;
    ensure_current_pin(&contract.schema_hash, &contract.schema_json)
        .await
        .context("native config mutation completed but the admitted seal changed")?;
    validate_output(admitted, method, &mutation.result)
        .context("native config mutation completed but its receipt failed output validation")?;
    Ok(Some(mutation.result))
}

/// Complete paired native configuration and selection observation. The caller
/// holds the final-admitted router guard; this helper never reads a new seal.
pub(crate) async fn coherent_observation(
    pinned: &ManifestPinnedSchemaDocument,
) -> anyhow::Result<(
    op_plugins::state_plugins::tched_router::TchedRouterState,
    Value,
)> {
    let contract = load_contract(pinned)?;
    let observation = TchedRouterRuntimeClient::from_env()
        .observe_config_and_state(&contract.secrets)
        .await?;
    validate_native_config(&contract, &observation.native_config)?;
    let paired = observation.into_state_and_fields()?;
    ensure_current_pin(&contract.schema_hash, &contract.schema_json).await?;
    Ok(paired)
}
</file>

<file path="op-grpc-bridge/src/tched_config_secret_policy.rs">
//! Secret classification from the exact manifest-pinned config schema.

use std::sync::Arc;

use anyhow::{anyhow, Context};
use serde_json::Value;

use crate::tched_router_runtime::ConfigSecretPolicy;

pub(crate) struct PinnedConfigSecretPolicy {
    document: Arc<Value>,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
enum Classification {
    Applicable(bool),
    NotApplicable,
}

impl PinnedConfigSecretPolicy {
    pub(crate) fn new(document: Arc<Value>) -> anyhow::Result<Self> {
        let policy = Self { document };
        let root = policy
            .resolve_one_ref(&policy.document)?
            .unwrap_or(&policy.document);
        anyhow::ensure!(
            root.get("type").and_then(Value::as_str) == Some("object"),
            "pinned tched_router config contract is not an object schema"
        );
        anyhow::ensure!(
            root.get("properties").and_then(Value::as_object).is_some(),
            "pinned tched_router config contract has no properties"
        );
        Ok(policy)
    }

    fn resolve_one_ref<'a>(&'a self, schema: &'a Value) -> anyhow::Result<Option<&'a Value>> {
        let Some(reference) = schema.get("$ref").and_then(Value::as_str) else {
            return Ok(None);
        };
        let pointer = reference
            .strip_prefix('#')
            .context("config contract contains a non-local reference")?;
        self.document
            .pointer(pointer)
            .map(Some)
            .with_context(|| format!("config contract reference '{reference}' is unresolved"))
    }

    fn classify(
        &self,
        schema: &Value,
        segments: &[String],
        depth: usize,
    ) -> anyhow::Result<Classification> {
        anyhow::ensure!(depth <= 64, "config contract nesting exceeds 64 levels");
        if schema.get("x-secret").and_then(Value::as_bool) == Some(true) {
            return Ok(Classification::Applicable(true));
        }

        let mut branch_applied = false;
        for combinator in ["allOf", "anyOf", "oneOf"] {
            if let Some(branches) = schema.get(combinator).and_then(Value::as_array) {
                for branch in branches {
                    match self.classify(branch, segments, depth + 1)? {
                        Classification::Applicable(true) => {
                            return Ok(Classification::Applicable(true));
                        }
                        Classification::Applicable(false) => branch_applied = true,
                        Classification::NotApplicable => {}
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if let Some(referenced) = self.resolve_one_ref(schema)? {
            match self.classify(referenced, segments, depth + 1)? {
                Classification::Applicable(true) => {
                    return Ok(Classification::Applicable(true));
                }
                Classification::Applicable(false) => branch_applied = true,
                Classification::NotApplicable => {}
            }
        }
        if segments.is_empty() {
            return Ok(Classification::Applicable(false));
        }

        let (head, tail) = segments.split_first().expect("checked nonempty");
        if let Some(property) = schema.get("properties").and_then(|v| v.get(head)) {
            return self.classify(property, tail, depth + 1);
        }
        if let Some(additional) = schema.get("additionalProperties") {
            if additional == &Value::Bool(false) {
                return Ok(if branch_applied {
                    Classification::Applicable(false)
                } else {
                    Classification::NotApplicable
                });
            }
            if additional.is_object() {
                return self.classify(additional, tail, depth + 1);
            }
        }
        if let Some(items) = schema.get("items").filter(|items| items.is_object()) {
            // Native Configurable arrays may route elements by natural key
            // (for example mcp.servers.<name>). Every element has the same
            // item contract, whether addressed by name or by its JSON index.
            // This classifies sensitivity only; native property lookup still
            // decides whether the supplied address exists and is writable.
            return self.classify(items, tail, depth + 1);
        }
        Ok(if branch_applied {
            Classification::Applicable(false)
        } else {
            Classification::NotApplicable
        })
    }
}

impl ConfigSecretPolicy for PinnedConfigSecretPolicy {
    fn is_secret(&self, path: &str) -> anyhow::Result<bool> {
        anyhow::ensure!(!path.is_empty(), "config path is empty");
        match self.classify(
            &self.document,
            &path.split('.').map(str::to_string).collect::<Vec<_>>(),
            0,
        )? {
            Classification::Applicable(secret) => Ok(secret),
            Classification::NotApplicable => {
                Err(anyhow!("config path is absent from pinned contract"))
            }
        }
    }

    fn redact_config(&self, config: &mut Value) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
        fn redact_secret(value: &mut Value) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
            match value {
                Value::String(text) => *text = "***MASKED***".to_owned(),
                Value::Null => {}
                Value::Object(fields) => {
                    for child in fields.values_mut() {
                        redact_secret(child)?;
                    }
                }
                Value::Array(items) => {
                    for child in items {
                        redact_secret(child)?;
                    }
                }
                _ => anyhow::bail!("secret config value has invalid type"),
            }
            Ok(())
        }
        fn walk(
            policy: &PinnedConfigSecretPolicy,
            value: &mut Value,
            path: &mut Vec<String>,
        ) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
            if !path.is_empty() {
                match policy.classify(&policy.document, path, 0) {
                    Ok(Classification::Applicable(true)) => {
                        // x-secret also annotates typed maps (MCP env/headers).
                        // Preserve their schema shape and mask all descendants.
                        return redact_secret(value);
                    }
                    Ok(Classification::Applicable(false)) => {}
                    Ok(Classification::NotApplicable) | Err(_) if value.is_string() => {
                        *value = Value::String("***MASKED***".to_string());
                        return Ok(());
                    }
                    Ok(Classification::NotApplicable) | Err(_)
                        if value.is_object() || value.is_array() => {}
                    Ok(Classification::NotApplicable) => {
                        return Err(anyhow!("config path is absent from pinned contract"))
                            .context("cannot prove a non-string native config value is public");
                    }
                    Err(error) => {
                        return Err(error)
                            .context("cannot prove a non-string native config value is public");
                    }
                }
            }
            match value {
                Value::Object(object) => {
                    for (key, nested) in object {
                        path.push(key.clone());
                        walk(policy, nested, path)?;
                        path.pop();
                    }
                }
                Value::Array(items) => {
                    for (index, nested) in items.iter_mut().enumerate() {
                        path.push(index.to_string());
                        walk(policy, nested, path)?;
                        path.pop();
                    }
                }
                _ => {}
            }
            Ok(())
        }
        anyhow::ensure!(config.is_object(), "config response is not an object");
        walk(self, config, &mut Vec::new())
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use serde_json::json;

    fn policy() -> PinnedConfigSecretPolicy {
        PinnedConfigSecretPolicy::new(Arc::new(json!({
            "type":"object",
            "properties": {
                "public": {"type":"string"},
                "providers": {"$ref":"#/$defs/Providers"}
            },
            "$defs": {
                "Providers": {"type":"object", "additionalProperties": {"$ref":"#/$defs/Profile"}},
                "Profile": {"type":"object", "properties": {
                    "model":{"type":"string"},
                    "api_key":{"type":["string","null"], "x-secret":true}
                }}
            }
        })))
        .unwrap()
    }

    #[test]
    fn resolves_dynamic_map_secret_from_pinned_contract() {
        let policy = policy();
        assert!(!policy.is_secret("public").unwrap());
        assert!(!policy.is_secret("providers.work.model").unwrap());
        assert!(policy.is_secret("providers.work.api_key").unwrap());
        assert!(policy.is_secret("providers.work.missing").is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn redacts_declared_and_unknown_string_values_fail_closed() {
        let policy = policy();
        let mut config = json!({
            "public":"visible",
            "providers":{"work":{"model":"m", "api_key":"secret", "opaque":"unknown"}}
        });
        policy.redact_config(&mut config).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(config["public"], "visible");
        assert_eq!(config["providers"]["work"]["model"], "m");
        assert_eq!(config["providers"]["work"]["api_key"], "***MASKED***");
        assert_eq!(config["providers"]["work"]["opaque"], "***MASKED***");
    }

    #[test]
    fn resolves_secrets_in_the_pinned_v084_contract() {
        let document = op_plugins::state_plugins::tched_router_contract::document().clone();
        let policy = PinnedConfigSecretPolicy::new(Arc::new(document)).unwrap();
        assert!(policy
            .is_secret("providers.models.openai.main.api_key")
            .unwrap());
        assert!(!policy
            .is_secret("providers.models.openai.main.model")
            .unwrap());
        assert!(!policy.is_secret("mcp.servers.docs.url").unwrap());
        assert!(!policy.is_secret("mcp.servers.0.url").unwrap());
        assert!(policy
            .is_secret("mcp.servers.docs.headers.Authorization")
            .unwrap());
        assert!(policy.is_secret("mcp.servers.docs.env.API_TOKEN").unwrap());
        assert!(policy
            .is_secret("mcp.servers.docs.unknown_property")
            .is_err());
        let mut config = json!({"mcp":{"servers":[{
            "name":"docs", "url":"https://docs.example.test/mcp",
            "headers":{"Authorization":"Bearer private"}, "env":{}
        }]}});
        policy.redact_config(&mut config).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            config["mcp"]["servers"][0]["headers"]["Authorization"],
            "***MASKED***"
        );
        assert_eq!(config["mcp"]["servers"][0]["env"], json!({}));
        assert_eq!(config["mcp"]["servers"][0]["name"], "docs");
    }

    #[test]
    fn natural_key_arrays_preserve_item_secret_classification_and_redaction() {
        let policy = PinnedConfigSecretPolicy::new(Arc::new(json!({
            "type":"object", "properties":{"servers":{
                "type":"array", "items":{"$ref":"#/$defs/Server"}
            }},
            "$defs":{"Server":{"type":"object", "properties":{
                "name":{"type":"string"},
                "token":{"type":"string", "x-secret":true}
            }}}
        })))
        .unwrap();
        assert!(policy.is_secret("servers.docs.token").unwrap());
        assert!(policy.is_secret("servers.0.token").unwrap());
        assert!(policy.is_secret("servers.docs.unknown").is_err());
        let mut config = json!({"servers":[{"name":"docs", "token":"private"}]});
        policy.redact_config(&mut config).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(config["servers"][0]["name"], "docs");
        assert_eq!(config["servers"][0]["token"], "***MASKED***");
    }

    #[test]
    fn reference_siblings_and_target_combinators_cannot_hide_secrets() {
        let policy = PinnedConfigSecretPolicy::new(Arc::new(json!({
            "type":"object",
            "properties": {
                "sibling": {"$ref":"#/$defs/Text", "x-secret":true},
                "branch": {"oneOf":[
                    {"type":"string"},
                    {"type":"string", "x-secret":true}
                ]}
            },
            "$defs":{"Text":{"type":"string"}}
        })))
        .unwrap();
        assert!(policy.is_secret("sibling").unwrap());
        assert!(policy.is_secret("branch").unwrap());
    }

    #[test]
    fn broken_combinator_reference_fails_closed() {
        let policy = PinnedConfigSecretPolicy::new(Arc::new(json!({
            "type":"object",
            "properties": {
                "ambiguous": {"anyOf":[
                    {"type":"string"},
                    {"$ref":"#/$defs/Missing"}
                ]}
            },
            "$defs":{}
        })))
        .unwrap();
        assert!(policy.is_secret("ambiguous").is_err());
        let mut config = json!({"ambiguous":"must-not-leave"});
        policy.redact_config(&mut config).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(config["ambiguous"], "***MASKED***");
    }

    #[test]
    fn nullable_nonapplicable_branch_does_not_hide_typed_children() {
        let policy = PinnedConfigSecretPolicy::new(Arc::new(json!({
            "type":"object",
            "properties": {
                "optional": {"anyOf":[
                    {"type":"null"},
                    {"type":"object", "properties": {
                        "count":{"type":"integer"},
                        "token":{"type":["string","null"], "x-secret":true}
                    }, "additionalProperties":false}
                ]}
            }
        })))
        .unwrap();
        assert!(!policy.is_secret("optional.count").unwrap());
        assert!(policy.is_secret("optional.token").unwrap());
        let mut config = json!({"optional":{"count":7,"token":"secret"}});
        policy.redact_config(&mut config).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(config["optional"]["count"], 7);
        assert_eq!(config["optional"]["token"], "***MASKED***");
    }

    #[test]
    fn intermediate_reference_secret_sibling_is_retained() {
        let policy = PinnedConfigSecretPolicy::new(Arc::new(json!({
            "type":"object",
            "properties":{"credential":{"$ref":"#/$defs/A"}},
            "$defs": {
                "A":{"$ref":"#/$defs/B", "x-secret":true},
                "B":{"type":"string"}
            }
        })))
        .unwrap();
        assert!(policy.is_secret("credential").unwrap());
    }

    #[test]
    fn local_references_use_json_pointer_escaping() {
        let policy = PinnedConfigSecretPolicy::new(Arc::new(json!({
            "type":"object",
            "properties":{"credential":{"$ref":"#/$defs/A~1B~0C"}},
            "$defs":{"A/B~C":{"type":"string", "x-secret":true}}
        })))
        .unwrap();
        assert!(policy.is_secret("credential").unwrap());
    }

    #[test]
    fn root_local_reference_keeps_the_exact_self_contained_contract() {
        let policy = PinnedConfigSecretPolicy::new(Arc::new(json!({
            "$ref":"#/$defs/Root",
            "$defs":{
                "Root":{"type":"object","properties":{
                    "credential":{"type":"string","x-secret":true}
                }}
            }
        })))
        .unwrap();
        assert!(policy.is_secret("credential").unwrap());
    }

    #[test]
    fn unknown_non_string_scalar_rejects_the_snapshot() {
        let policy = policy();
        let mut config = json!({"public":"visible", "unknown":42});
        assert!(policy.redact_config(&mut config).is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn redaction_preserves_literal_dynamic_key_segments() {
        let policy = policy();
        let mut config = json!({
            "providers":{"work.profile":{"api_key":"secret", "model":"m"}}
        });
        policy.redact_config(&mut config).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            config["providers"]["work.profile"]["api_key"],
            "***MASKED***"
        );
        assert_eq!(config["providers"]["work.profile"]["model"], "m");
    }
}

<file path="op-grpc-bridge/src/tched_router_admission_tests.rs">
use super::*;
use crate::human_principal_dispatch::tests::{
    pk, register, temp_cozo, temp_shm_with_schemas, test_engine,
};
use crate::identity_sled_dispatch::{tests::write_identity, IdentitySledStore};
use op_plugins::state_plugins::{
    human_principal::HumanPrincipalPlugin, identity_sled::IdentitySledPlugin,
    tched_router::TchedRouterPlugin,
};
use op_state::StatePlugin;
use std::sync::{
    atomic::{AtomicUsize, Ordering},
    Arc,
};

struct RestoreGrants(Option<std::ffi::OsString>);
impl Drop for RestoreGrants {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        match self.0.take() {
            Some(value) => std::env::set_var("OP_GRANTS_PATH", value),
            None => std::env::remove_var("OP_GRANTS_PATH"),
        }
    }
}

/// Runs the actual final admission while queued on the actual runtime guard.
/// The counter represents the first possible native effect after admission.
#[tokio::test]
async fn queued_calls_reject_reseal_and_grant_withdrawal_before_effect() {
    let _cozo = temp_cozo();
    let schema = TchedRouterPlugin::new().schema().unwrap();
    let _shm = temp_shm_with_schemas(&[
        HumanPrincipalPlugin::new().schema().unwrap(),
        IdentitySledPlugin::new().schema().unwrap(),
        schema.clone(),
    ]);
    let engine = test_engine();
    engine
        .install_identity_sled_store_for_test(IdentitySledStore::new(
            op_cozo_store::CozoGraphShuttle::new_in_memory().unwrap(),
        ))
        .unwrap();
    let key = pk(0xE3);
    register(&key, "queued-router-fixture").await.unwrap();
    let sled = write_identity(&engine, &key).await.unwrap();
    let actor = op_identity::session::derive_principal_id(&key);
    let capability = schema.methods["SetModel"]
        .required_capability
        .clone()
        .unwrap();
    let directory = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let grants = directory.path().join("grants.json");
    let _environment = RestoreGrants(std::env::var_os("OP_GRANTS_PATH"));
    std::env::set_var("OP_GRANTS_PATH", &grants);
    let write_grants = |allowed: bool| {
        std::fs::write(&grants, serde_json::to_vec(&serde_json::json!({
            (actor.clone()): {"capabilities": if allowed { vec![capability.clone()] } else { vec![] }}
        })).unwrap()).unwrap();
    };
    let caller = || RouterCaller {
        actor: actor.clone(),
        capability: Some(capability.clone()),
        session: Some(sled.session_id.clone()),
        genesis: sled.genesis.clone(),
    };
    let effects = Arc::new(AtomicUsize::new(0));
    for scenario in ["grant", "method", "metadata", "identity"] {
        write_grants(true);
        let catalog = crate::sealed_schema_reader::blob_catalog_dir_from_env();
        let mut sealer = op_blob::BlobStore::open(&catalog).unwrap();
        sealer
            .write(&op_blob::blobify_plugin_schema(
                "tched_router",
                schema.clone(),
            ))
            .unwrap();
        // Prove the original identity, exact grant and full pinned schema pass.
        drop(
            admit_guarded(&engine, &schema, "SetModel", &caller())
                .await
                .unwrap(),
        );
        let guard = crate::tched_router_runtime::TchedRouterRuntimeClient::selection_guard().await;
        let queued_engine = engine.clone();
        let queued_schema = schema.clone();
        let queued_caller = caller();
        let counter = effects.clone();
        let (started, ready) = tokio::sync::oneshot::channel();
        let task = tokio::spawn(async move {
            started.send(()).unwrap();
            let _admitted =
                admit_guarded(&queued_engine, &queued_schema, "SetModel", &queued_caller).await?;
            counter.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst);
            Ok::<_, anyhow::Error>(())
        });
        ready.await.unwrap();
        match scenario {
            "grant" => write_grants(false),
            "identity" => {
                crate::human_principal_dispatch::tests::revoke(&key)
                    .await
                    .unwrap();
            }
            "method" => {
                let mut changed = schema.clone();
                changed
                    .methods
                    .get_mut("SetModel")
                    .unwrap()
                    .required_capability = Some("changed.required.grant".into());
                sealer
                    .write(&op_blob::blobify_plugin_schema("tched_router", changed))
                    .unwrap();
            }
            _ => {
                // Even matching compiled fields/methods cannot substitute a
                // new catalog pin for the schema originally admitted.
                let mut changed = schema.clone();
                changed.description.push_str(" changed while queued");
                sealer
                    .write(&op_blob::blobify_plugin_schema("tched_router", changed))
                    .unwrap();
            }
        }
        drop(guard);
        assert!(
            tokio::time::timeout(std::time::Duration::from_secs(5), task)
                .await
                .unwrap()
                .unwrap()
                .is_err()
        );
        assert_eq!(effects.load(Ordering::SeqCst), 0);
    }
}
