<file path="op-grpc-bridge/src/tched_router_admission.rs">
//! Final router admission under the one runtime operation guard.
//!
//! This retains the original caller metadata and admitted plugin; it mints no
//! identity and grants no authority. Resealing and revocation remain separate
//! transactions, so a change after this check can still race a native request.

use crate::{mutation_engine::MutationEngine, sealed_schema_reader::ManifestPinnedSchemaDocument};
use anyhow::{Context, Result};
use op_state_store::PluginSchema;

pub(crate) struct RouterCaller {
    pub actor: String,
    pub capability: Option<String>,
    pub session: Option<String>,
    pub genesis: Option<String>,
}

/// Original facade admission carried to the final native operation boundary.
/// This is internal evidence, never a wire-supplied identity or grant.
#[derive(Clone)]
pub(crate) struct FacadeOrigin {
    pub plugin: &'static str,
    pub method: String,
    pub target_plugin: &'static str,
    pub target_method: &'static str,
    pub admitted: PluginSchema,
    pub capability: String,
}

impl FacadeOrigin {
    pub fn validate_target(&self, plugin: &str, method: &str) -> Result<()> {
        anyhow::ensure!(
            plugin == self.target_plugin && method == self.target_method,
            "facade evidence does not match its target"
        );
        Ok(())
    }

    pub async fn readmit(&self, engine: &MutationEngine, caller: &RouterCaller) -> Result<()> {
        let outer = RouterCaller {
            actor: caller.actor.clone(),
            capability: Some(self.capability.clone()),
            session: caller.session.clone(),
            genesis: caller.genesis.clone(),
        };
        readmit_call(engine, &self.admitted, self.plugin, &self.method, &outer).await?;
        Ok(())
    }
}

pub(crate) struct GuardedRouterCall {
    pub pinned: ManifestPinnedSchemaDocument,
    _operation: tokio::sync::MutexGuard<'static, ()>,
}

pub(crate) async fn admit_guarded(
    engine: &MutationEngine,
    admitted: &PluginSchema,
    method: &str,
    caller: &RouterCaller,
) -> Result<GuardedRouterCall> {
    let operation = crate::tched_router_runtime::TchedRouterRuntimeClient::selection_guard().await;
    let pinned = readmit_call(engine, admitted, "tched_router", method, caller).await?;
    Ok(GuardedRouterCall {
        pinned,
        _operation: operation,
    })
}

/// Caller already retains the backend's operation guard. This shared check is
/// also used by the Cron facade, whose independent guard orders its own jobs.
pub(crate) async fn readmit_call(
    engine: &MutationEngine,
    admitted: &PluginSchema,
    plugin: &'static str,
    method: &str,
    caller: &RouterCaller,
) -> Result<ManifestPinnedSchemaDocument> {
    // Queued calls must not use identity or grants captured before the wait.
    crate::project_dispatch::verified_session(
        engine,
        &caller.actor,
        caller.session.as_deref(),
        caller.genesis.as_deref(),
    )
    .await?;
    let admitted = admitted.clone();
    let method = method.to_owned();
    let capability = caller.capability.clone();
    let actor = caller.actor.clone();
    let pinned = tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || -> Result<_> {
        let pinned = crate::sealed_schema_reader::read_manifest_pinned_schema_document(
            &crate::sealed_schema_reader::blob_catalog_dir_from_env(),
            plugin,
        )?;
        crate::method_contract_admission::admit_compiled_state_contract(&pinned, plugin)?;
        crate::method_contract_admission::admit_pinned_compiled_method(
            &pinned,
            plugin,
            &method,
            capability.as_deref(),
        )?;
        anyhow::ensure!(
            serde_json::to_value(&pinned.schema)? == serde_json::to_value(&admitted)?,
            "backend seal differs from the originally admitted call"
        );
        let required = capability
            .as_deref()
            .context("backend call requires its exact declared capability")?;
        anyhow::ensure!(
            crate::interceptor::load_capability_grants(&actor).contains(required),
            "current exact backend capability grant is required"
        );
        Ok(pinned)
    })
    .await
    .context("router admission worker failed")??;
    Ok(pinned)
}

#[cfg(test)]
#[path = "tched_router_admission_tests.rs"]
mod tests;
</file>

<file path="op-grpc-bridge/src/tched_router_generation_native.rs">
//! Bounded adapter for the pinned binary's stateless generation WebSocket.
//!
//! The native endpoint has no task identifier: MutationEngine owns the job identity,
//! while this adapter owns one native WebSocket/session at a time.

use std::{future::Future, pin::Pin, sync::Arc, time::Duration};

use futures::{Sink, SinkExt, Stream, StreamExt};
use serde_json::Value;
use tokio::sync::{mpsc, oneshot};
use tokio::task::JoinHandle;
use tokio_tungstenite::{
    connect_async_with_config,
    tungstenite::{client::IntoClientRequest, protocol::WebSocketConfig, Message},
};

const WS_PROTOCOL: &str = "tched_router.generation.v1";
const MAX_PROMPT_BYTES: usize = 64 * 1024;
// JSON escaping expands decoded text; bound allocation separately from output.
const MAX_FRAME_BYTES: usize = 2 * 1024 * 1024;
const MAX_DELTA_BYTES: usize = 16 * 1024;
const MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES: usize = 256 * 1024;
const MAX_EVENTS: usize = 4096;
const MAX_SESSION_ID_BYTES: usize = 256;
const MAX_AGENT_ALIAS_BYTES: usize = 128;
const MAX_TOKEN_BYTES: usize = 8 * 1024;
const TOTAL_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(600);

#[derive(Clone)]
pub(crate) struct NativeGenerationRequest {
    pub(crate) endpoint: String,
    pub(crate) bearer_token: Option<String>,
    pub(crate) agent_alias: String,
    pub(crate) native_session_id: String,
    pub(crate) prompt: String,
    /// Optional extra selection constraints. The stateless ACK must always
    /// identify the native turn's provider and model before prompt release,
    /// and terminal attribution must match that ACK.
    pub(crate) expected_provider: Option<String>,
    pub(crate) expected_model: Option<String>,
    /// Recheck the owner's identity, grants and sealed contract before input.
    pub(crate) before_prompt: Arc<dyn NativeGenerationAdmission>,
}

pub(crate) trait NativeGenerationAdmission: Send + Sync {
    fn check(&self)
        -> Pin<Box<dyn Future<Output = Result<(), NativeGenerationError>> + Send + '_>>;
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) enum NativeGenerationEvent {
    TextDelta { delta: String },
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) struct NativeGenerationUsage {
    pub(crate) input_tokens: Option<u64>,
    pub(crate) output_tokens: Option<u64>,
    pub(crate) tokens_used: Option<u64>,
    pub(crate) cost_usd_micros: Option<u64>,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) struct NativeGenerationDone {
    pub(crate) full_response: String,
    pub(crate) provider: Option<String>,
    pub(crate) model: Option<String>,
    pub(crate) usage: NativeGenerationUsage,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) enum NativeGenerationTerminal {
    Done(NativeGenerationDone),
    Cancelled,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) enum NativeErrorCode {
    Auth,
    Provider,
    ApprovalRequired,
    Protocol,
    Bounds,
    Timeout,
}

#[derive(Debug, thiserror::Error)]
pub(crate) enum NativeGenerationError {
    #[error("invalid native generation request: {0}")]
    InvalidRequest(&'static str),
    #[error("native generation transport failed")]
    Transport,
    #[error("native generation timed out")]
    Timeout,
    #[error("native generation was cancelled")]
    Cancelled,
    #[error("native generation protocol rejected the request: {0:?}")]
    Terminal(NativeErrorCode),
}

/// Owned native turn. Dropping it requests cancellation and aborts the task;
/// the owner must map that terminal condition into its private SHM job state.
pub(crate) struct NativeGenerationTask {
    cancel: Option<oneshot::Sender<()>>,
    events: mpsc::Receiver<NativeGenerationEvent>,
    join: Option<JoinHandle<Result<NativeGenerationTerminal, NativeGenerationError>>>,
}

impl NativeGenerationTask {
    pub(crate) fn spawn(request: NativeGenerationRequest) -> Result<Self, NativeGenerationError> {
        validate_request(&request)?;
        let (cancel, cancel_rx) = oneshot::channel();
        let (event_tx, events) = mpsc::channel(64);
        let join = tokio::spawn(run_native(request, cancel_rx, event_tx));
        Ok(Self {
            cancel: Some(cancel),
            events,
            join: Some(join),
        })
    }

    pub(crate) async fn recv_event(&mut self) -> Option<NativeGenerationEvent> {
        self.events.recv().await
    }

    /// Drain only an event already queued by the bounded native transport.
    /// Empty never waits for another fragment or for the terminal result.
    pub(crate) fn try_recv_event(
        &mut self,
    ) -> Result<NativeGenerationEvent, mpsc::error::TryRecvError> {
        self.events.try_recv()
    }

    pub(crate) async fn wait(mut self) -> Result<NativeGenerationTerminal, NativeGenerationError> {
        let join = self.join.take().ok_or(NativeGenerationError::Transport)?;
        let cancel_guard = self.cancel.take();
        let result = join.await.map_err(|_| NativeGenerationError::Transport)?;
        drop(cancel_guard);
        result
    }

    pub(crate) fn cancel(&mut self) {
        if let Some(cancel) = self.cancel.take() {
            let _ = cancel.send(());
        }
    }
}

impl Drop for NativeGenerationTask {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        self.cancel();
    }
}

async fn run_native(
    request: NativeGenerationRequest,
    mut cancel_rx: oneshot::Receiver<()>,
    events_tx: mpsc::Sender<NativeGenerationEvent>,
) -> Result<NativeGenerationTerminal, NativeGenerationError> {
    let url = ws_url(&request)?;
    let mut handshake = url.into_client_request().map_err(|_| {
        NativeGenerationError::InvalidRequest("failed to construct WebSocket request")
    })?;
    handshake.headers_mut().insert(
        "Sec-WebSocket-Protocol",
        WS_PROTOCOL
            .parse()
            .map_err(|_| NativeGenerationError::InvalidRequest("invalid WebSocket protocol"))?,
    );
    if let Some(token) = request.bearer_token.as_deref() {
        let mut authorization =
            tokio_tungstenite::tungstenite::http::HeaderValue::from_str(&format!("Bearer {token}"))
                .map_err(|_| NativeGenerationError::InvalidRequest("invalid bearer token"))?;
        authorization.set_sensitive(true);
        handshake
            .headers_mut()
            .insert("Authorization", authorization);
    }
    let config = WebSocketConfig {
        max_message_size: Some(MAX_FRAME_BYTES),
        max_frame_size: Some(MAX_FRAME_BYTES),
        ..Default::default()
    };
    let deadline = tokio::time::Instant::now() + TOTAL_TIMEOUT;
    let connect_deadline = std::cmp::min(
        deadline,
        tokio::time::Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(15),
    );
    let (mut socket, response) = tokio::select! {
        _ = &mut cancel_rx => return Err(NativeGenerationError::Cancelled),
        result = tokio::time::timeout_at(connect_deadline, connect_async_with_config(handshake, Some(config), false)) => {
            result.map_err(|_| NativeGenerationError::Timeout)?
                .map_err(|_| NativeGenerationError::Transport)?
        }
    };
    let selected_protocol = response
        .headers()
        .get("Sec-WebSocket-Protocol")
        .and_then(|value| value.to_str().ok());
    if selected_protocol != Some(WS_PROTOCOL) {
        let _ = close_socket(&mut socket).await;
        return Err(NativeGenerationError::Terminal(NativeErrorCode::Protocol));
    }

    let connect = serde_json::json!({
        "type": "connect",
        "session_id": request.native_session_id,
    });
    send_json(&mut socket, connect, &mut cancel_rx, deadline).await?;
    let mut events = 0usize;
    let session_start = recv_message(&mut socket, &mut cancel_rx, deadline).await?;
    let session_start = parse_json_frame(session_start)?;
    if session_start.get("type").and_then(Value::as_str) != Some("session_start")
        || session_start.get("session_id").and_then(Value::as_str)
            != Some(request.native_session_id.as_str())
        || session_start.get("resumed").and_then(Value::as_bool) != Some(false)
        || session_start.get("message_count").and_then(Value::as_u64) != Some(0)
        || session_start
            .get("stateless_generation")
            .and_then(Value::as_u64)
            != Some(1)
    {
        let _ = close_socket(&mut socket).await;
        return Err(NativeGenerationError::Terminal(NativeErrorCode::Protocol));
    }
    let connected = parse_json_frame(recv_message(&mut socket, &mut cancel_rx, deadline).await?)?;
    if connected.get("type").and_then(Value::as_str) != Some("connected")
        || connected
            .get("stateless_generation")
            .and_then(Value::as_u64)
            != Some(1)
    {
        let _ = close_socket(&mut socket).await;
        return Err(NativeGenerationError::Terminal(NativeErrorCode::Protocol));
    }
    let bound_provider = bounded_label(connected.get("provider"))
        .ok_or(NativeGenerationError::Terminal(NativeErrorCode::Protocol))?;
    let bound_model = bounded_label(connected.get("model"))
        .ok_or(NativeGenerationError::Terminal(NativeErrorCode::Protocol))?;
    verify_selection(&request, Some(&bound_provider), Some(&bound_model))?;
    tokio::select! {
        _ = &mut cancel_rx => {
            let _ = close_socket(&mut socket).await;
            return Err(NativeGenerationError::Cancelled);
        }
        _ = tokio::time::sleep_until(deadline) => {
            let _ = close_socket(&mut socket).await;
            return Err(NativeGenerationError::Timeout);
        }
        result = request.before_prompt.check() => result?,
    }
    send_json(
        &mut socket,
        serde_json::json!({
            "type": "message",
            "content": request.prompt,
        }),
        &mut cancel_rx,
        deadline,
    )
    .await?;
    let mut output = String::new();
    loop {
        let message = tokio::select! {
            _ = &mut cancel_rx => {
                let _ = close_socket(&mut socket).await;
                return Err(NativeGenerationError::Cancelled);
            }
            _ = tokio::time::sleep_until(deadline) => {
                let _ = close_socket(&mut socket).await;
                return Err(NativeGenerationError::Timeout);
            }
            message = socket.next() => message,
        };
        let Some(message) = message else {
            return Err(NativeGenerationError::Transport);
        };
        let message = message.map_err(|_| NativeGenerationError::Transport)?;
        let text = match message {
            Message::Text(text) => text,
            Message::Binary(bytes) => {
                if bytes.len() > MAX_FRAME_BYTES {
                    let _ = close_socket(&mut socket).await;
                    return Err(NativeGenerationError::Terminal(NativeErrorCode::Bounds));
                }
                continue;
            }
            Message::Close(_) => {
                return Err(NativeGenerationError::Transport);
            }
            Message::Ping(_) | Message::Pong(_) | Message::Frame(_) => continue,
        };
        let bytes = text.as_bytes();
        if bytes.len() > MAX_FRAME_BYTES {
            let _ = close_socket(&mut socket).await;
            return Err(NativeGenerationError::Terminal(NativeErrorCode::Bounds));
        }
        events = events.saturating_add(1);
        if events > MAX_EVENTS {
            let _ = close_socket(&mut socket).await;
            return Err(NativeGenerationError::Terminal(NativeErrorCode::Bounds));
        }
        let value: Value = serde_json::from_str(text.as_ref())
            .map_err(|_| NativeGenerationError::Terminal(NativeErrorCode::Protocol))?;
        match value.get("type").and_then(Value::as_str).unwrap_or("") {
            "chunk" => {
                let delta = value
                    .get("content")
                    .and_then(Value::as_str)
                    .ok_or(NativeGenerationError::Terminal(NativeErrorCode::Protocol))?;
                if delta.len() > MAX_DELTA_BYTES {
                    let _ = close_socket(&mut socket).await;
                    return Err(NativeGenerationError::Terminal(NativeErrorCode::Bounds));
                }
                if output.len().saturating_add(delta.len()) > MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES {
                    let _ = close_socket(&mut socket).await;
                    return Err(NativeGenerationError::Terminal(NativeErrorCode::Bounds));
                }
                output.push_str(delta);
                tokio::select! {
                    _ = &mut cancel_rx => {
                        let _ = close_socket(&mut socket).await;
                        return Err(NativeGenerationError::Cancelled);
                    }
                    _ = tokio::time::sleep_until(deadline) => {
                        let _ = close_socket(&mut socket).await;
                        return Err(NativeGenerationError::Timeout);
                    }
                    result = events_tx.send(NativeGenerationEvent::TextDelta {
                        delta: delta.to_owned(),
                    }) => result.map_err(|_| NativeGenerationError::Cancelled)?,
                }
            }
            "thinking" | "plan" | "history_trimmed" => {}
            "tool_call" | "tool_result" | "session_start" => {
                let _ = close_socket(&mut socket).await;
                return Err(NativeGenerationError::Terminal(NativeErrorCode::Protocol));
            }
            "approval_request" => {
                let _ = close_socket(&mut socket).await;
                return Err(NativeGenerationError::Terminal(
                    NativeErrorCode::ApprovalRequired,
                ));
            }
            "done" => {
                let full_response = bounded_text(value.get("full_response"), MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES)
                    .ok_or(NativeGenerationError::Terminal(NativeErrorCode::Protocol))?;
                if full_response != output {
                    return Err(NativeGenerationError::Terminal(NativeErrorCode::Protocol));
                }
                let provider = bounded_label(value.get("provider"));
                let model = bounded_label(value.get("model"));
                verify_selection(&request, provider.as_deref(), model.as_deref())?;
                if provider.as_deref() != Some(bound_provider.as_str())
                    || model.as_deref() != Some(bound_model.as_str())
                {
                    return Err(NativeGenerationError::Terminal(NativeErrorCode::Protocol));
                }
                let usage = NativeGenerationUsage {
                    input_tokens: optional_u64(&value, "input_tokens")?,
                    output_tokens: optional_u64(&value, "output_tokens")?,
                    tokens_used: optional_u64(&value, "tokens_used")?,
                    cost_usd_micros: optional_cost(&value)?,
                };
                let _ = close_socket(&mut socket).await;
                return Ok(NativeGenerationTerminal::Done(NativeGenerationDone {
                    full_response,
                    provider,
                    model,
                    usage,
                }));
            }
            "aborted" => return Ok(NativeGenerationTerminal::Cancelled),
            "error" => {
                let code = match value.get("code").and_then(Value::as_str).unwrap_or("") {
                    "AUTH_ERROR" => NativeErrorCode::Auth,
                    "PROVIDER_ERROR" => NativeErrorCode::Provider,
                    "TIMEOUT" => NativeErrorCode::Timeout,
                    "BOUNDS" => NativeErrorCode::Bounds,
                    _ => NativeErrorCode::Protocol,
                };
                let _ = close_socket(&mut socket).await;
                return Err(NativeGenerationError::Terminal(code));
            }
            _ => return Err(NativeGenerationError::Terminal(NativeErrorCode::Protocol)),
        }
    }
}

async fn send_json<S>(
    socket: &mut S,
    value: Value,
    cancel_rx: &mut oneshot::Receiver<()>,
    deadline: tokio::time::Instant,
) -> Result<(), NativeGenerationError>
where
    S: Sink<Message> + Unpin,
{
    let text = serde_json::to_string(&value).map_err(|_| NativeGenerationError::Transport)?;
    if text.len() > MAX_FRAME_BYTES {
        return Err(NativeGenerationError::Terminal(NativeErrorCode::Bounds));
    }
    tokio::select! {
        _ = cancel_rx => Err(NativeGenerationError::Cancelled),
        _ = tokio::time::sleep_until(deadline) => Err(NativeGenerationError::Timeout),
        result = socket.send(Message::Text(text)) => result.map_err(|_| NativeGenerationError::Transport),
    }
}

async fn recv_message<S>(
    socket: &mut S,
    cancel_rx: &mut oneshot::Receiver<()>,
    deadline: tokio::time::Instant,
) -> Result<Message, NativeGenerationError>
where
    S: Stream<Item = Result<Message, tokio_tungstenite::tungstenite::Error>> + Unpin,
{
    tokio::select! {
        _ = cancel_rx => Err(NativeGenerationError::Cancelled),
        _ = tokio::time::sleep_until(deadline) => Err(NativeGenerationError::Timeout),
        result = socket.next() => result.ok_or(NativeGenerationError::Transport)?.map_err(|_| NativeGenerationError::Transport),
    }
}

fn parse_json_frame(message: Message) -> Result<Value, NativeGenerationError> {
    let text = match message {
        Message::Text(text) => text,
        Message::Binary(_)
        | Message::Ping(_)
        | Message::Pong(_)
        | Message::Frame(_)
        | Message::Close(_) => {
            return Err(NativeGenerationError::Terminal(NativeErrorCode::Protocol));
        }
    };
    if text.len() > MAX_FRAME_BYTES {
        return Err(NativeGenerationError::Terminal(NativeErrorCode::Bounds));
    }
    serde_json::from_str(text.as_ref())
        .map_err(|_| NativeGenerationError::Terminal(NativeErrorCode::Protocol))
}

async fn close_socket<S>(socket: &mut S) -> Result<(), ()>
where
    S: Sink<Message> + Unpin,
{
    tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(1), socket.close())
        .await
        .map_err(|_| ())?
        .map_err(|_| ())
}

fn validate_request(request: &NativeGenerationRequest) -> Result<(), NativeGenerationError> {
    let endpoint = reqwest::Url::parse(&request.endpoint)
        .map_err(|_| NativeGenerationError::InvalidRequest("endpoint is not a valid URL"))?;
    if endpoint.scheme() != "http"
        || !endpoint.username().is_empty()
        || endpoint.password().is_some()
        || endpoint.query().is_some()
        || endpoint.fragment().is_some()
        || !matches!(endpoint.path(), "" | "/")
    {
        return Err(NativeGenerationError::InvalidRequest(
            "endpoint must be a loopback origin",
        ));
    }
    let host = endpoint
        .host_str()
        .ok_or(NativeGenerationError::InvalidRequest(
            "endpoint has no host",
        ))?;
    let host_is_loopback = host
        .trim_start_matches('[')
        .trim_end_matches(']')
        .parse::<std::net::IpAddr>()
        .map(|ip| ip.is_loopback())
        .unwrap_or(false);
    if !host_is_loopback {
        return Err(NativeGenerationError::InvalidRequest(
            "endpoint must be loopback",
        ));
    }
    if request.agent_alias.is_empty()
        || request.agent_alias.len() > MAX_AGENT_ALIAS_BYTES
        || !request
            .agent_alias
            .bytes()
            .all(|b| b.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || b == b'-' || b == b'_')
    {
        return Err(NativeGenerationError::InvalidRequest("invalid agent alias"));
    }
    if request.native_session_id.is_empty()
        || request.native_session_id.len() > MAX_SESSION_ID_BYTES
        || !request
            .native_session_id
            .bytes()
            .all(|b| b.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || b == b'-' || b == b'_')
    {
        return Err(NativeGenerationError::InvalidRequest(
            "invalid native session id",
        ));
    }
    if request.prompt.is_empty() || request.prompt.len() > MAX_PROMPT_BYTES {
        return Err(NativeGenerationError::InvalidRequest(
            "prompt exceeds bound or is empty",
        ));
    }
    if request.bearer_token.as_ref().is_some_and(|token| {
        token.is_empty()
            || token.len() > MAX_TOKEN_BYTES
            || !token
                .bytes()
                .all(|b| b.is_ascii_graphic() && b != b'\r' && b != b'\n')
    }) {
        return Err(NativeGenerationError::InvalidRequest(
            "bearer token exceeds bound",
        ));
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn ws_url(request: &NativeGenerationRequest) -> Result<String, NativeGenerationError> {
    let mut endpoint = reqwest::Url::parse(&request.endpoint)
        .map_err(|_| NativeGenerationError::InvalidRequest("endpoint is not a valid URL"))?;
    let scheme = match endpoint.scheme() {
        "http" => "ws",
        _ => {
            return Err(NativeGenerationError::InvalidRequest(
                "endpoint must use HTTP",
            ))
        }
    };
    endpoint
        .set_scheme(scheme)
        .map_err(|_| NativeGenerationError::InvalidRequest("failed to set WebSocket scheme"))?;
    endpoint.set_path("/ws/chat");
    endpoint.set_query(Some(&format!(
        "agent_alias={}&session_id={}&stateless_generation=1",
        percent_encode(&request.agent_alias),
        percent_encode(&request.native_session_id),
    )));
    Ok(endpoint.to_string())
}

fn percent_encode(value: &str) -> String {
    value.bytes().fold(String::new(), |mut out, byte| {
        if byte.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || matches!(byte, b'-' | b'_' | b'.' | b'~') {
            out.push(byte as char);
        } else {
            out.push_str(&format!("%{byte:02X}"));
        }
        out
    })
}

fn bounded_text(value: Option<&Value>, max: usize) -> Option<String> {
    let text = value?.as_str()?;
    (text.len() <= max).then(|| text.to_string())
}

fn bounded_label(value: Option<&Value>) -> Option<String> {
    bounded_text(value, 256).filter(|s| !s.is_empty())
}

fn optional_u64(value: &Value, key: &str) -> Result<Option<u64>, NativeGenerationError> {
    match value.get(key) {
        None => Ok(None),
        Some(raw) => raw
            .as_u64()
            .map(Some)
            .ok_or(NativeGenerationError::Terminal(NativeErrorCode::Protocol)),
    }
}

fn optional_cost(value: &Value) -> Result<Option<u64>, NativeGenerationError> {
    let Some(raw) = value.get("cost_usd") else {
        return Ok(None);
    };
    let cost = raw
        .as_f64()
        .ok_or(NativeGenerationError::Terminal(NativeErrorCode::Protocol))?;
    if !cost.is_finite() || cost < 0.0 || cost > (u64::MAX as f64) / 1_000_000.0 {
        return Err(NativeGenerationError::Terminal(NativeErrorCode::Bounds));
    }
    Ok(Some((cost * 1_000_000.0) as u64))
}

fn verify_selection(
    request: &NativeGenerationRequest,
    provider: Option<&str>,
    model: Option<&str>,
) -> Result<(), NativeGenerationError> {
    if request
        .expected_provider
        .as_deref()
        .is_some_and(|expected| provider != Some(expected))
        || request
            .expected_model
            .as_deref()
            .is_some_and(|expected| model != Some(expected))
    {
        return Err(NativeGenerationError::Terminal(NativeErrorCode::Protocol));
    }
    Ok(())
}

#[cfg(test)]
// Tungstenite fixes the handshake callback's error type to an HTTP response.
#[allow(clippy::result_large_err)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use tokio::net::TcpListener;
    use tokio_tungstenite::{
        accept_hdr_async,
        tungstenite::handshake::server::{Request, Response},
    };

    fn request(endpoint: String) -> NativeGenerationRequest {
        NativeGenerationRequest {
            endpoint,
            bearer_token: Some("fixture-token".to_string()),
            agent_alias: "fixture-agent".to_string(),
            native_session_id: "native-fixture-session".to_string(),
            prompt: "hello".to_string(),
            expected_provider: Some("fixture-provider".to_string()),
            expected_model: Some("fixture-model".to_string()),
            before_prompt: Arc::new(AllowAdmission),
        }
    }

    struct AllowAdmission;
    impl NativeGenerationAdmission for AllowAdmission {
        fn check(
            &self,
        ) -> Pin<Box<dyn Future<Output = Result<(), NativeGenerationError>> + Send + '_>> {
            Box::pin(async { Ok(()) })
        }
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn streams_only_visible_chunks_and_checks_handshake() {
        let listener = TcpListener::bind((std::net::Ipv4Addr::LOCALHOST, 0))
            .await
            .unwrap();
        let address = listener.local_addr().unwrap();
        let server = tokio::spawn(async move {
            let (stream, _) = listener.accept().await.unwrap();
            let socket = accept_hdr_async(stream, |request: &Request, mut response: Response| {
                assert_eq!(request.uri().path(), "/ws/chat");
                assert!(request
                    .uri()
                    .query()
                    .unwrap()
                    .contains("agent_alias=fixture-agent"));
                assert_eq!(
                    request.headers().get("authorization").unwrap(),
                    "Bearer fixture-token"
                );
                assert_eq!(
                    request.headers().get("sec-websocket-protocol").unwrap(),
                    WS_PROTOCOL
                );
                response
                    .headers_mut()
                    .insert("Sec-WebSocket-Protocol", WS_PROTOCOL.parse().unwrap());
                Ok(response)
            })
            .await
            .unwrap();
            let (mut sink, mut stream) = socket.split();
            assert!(matches!(
                stream.next().await.unwrap().unwrap(),
                Message::Text(_)
            ));
            sink.send(Message::Text(
                r#"{"type":"session_start","session_id":"native-fixture-session","resumed":false,"message_count":0,"stateless_generation":1}"#
                    .into(),
            ))
            .await
            .unwrap();
            sink.send(Message::Text(r#"{"type":"connected","stateless_generation":1,"provider":"fixture-provider","model":"fixture-model"}"#.into()))
                .await
                .unwrap();
            assert!(matches!(
                stream.next().await.unwrap().unwrap(),
                Message::Text(_)
            ));
            sink.send(Message::Text(
                r#"{"type":"thinking","content":"secret"}"#.into(),
            ))
            .await
            .unwrap();
            sink.send(Message::Text(r#"{"type":"chunk","content":"hel"}"#.into()))
                .await
                .unwrap();
            sink.send(Message::Text(r#"{"type":"chunk","content":"lo"}"#.into()))
                .await
                .unwrap();
            sink.send(Message::Text(r#"{"type":"done","full_response":"hello","provider":"fixture-provider","model":"fixture-model","input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":3,"tokens_used":5}"#.into())).await.unwrap();
        });
        let mut task = NativeGenerationTask::spawn(request(format!("http://{address}"))).unwrap();
        let mut text = String::new();
        while let Some(NativeGenerationEvent::TextDelta { delta }) = task.recv_event().await {
            text.push_str(&delta);
        }
        let terminal = task.wait().await.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(text, "hello");
        assert!(matches!(terminal, NativeGenerationTerminal::Done(_)));
        server.await.unwrap();
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn cancellation_while_event_channel_is_saturated_finishes_cancelled() {
        let listener = TcpListener::bind((std::net::Ipv4Addr::LOCALHOST, 0))
            .await
            .unwrap();
        let address = listener.local_addr().unwrap();
        let server = tokio::spawn(async move {
            let (stream, _) = listener.accept().await.unwrap();
            let socket = accept_hdr_async(stream, |_: &Request, mut response: Response| {
                response
                    .headers_mut()
                    .insert("Sec-WebSocket-Protocol", WS_PROTOCOL.parse().unwrap());
                Ok(response)
            })
            .await
            .unwrap();
            let (mut sink, mut stream) = socket.split();
            let _ = stream.next().await;
            sink.send(Message::Text(r#"{"type":"session_start","session_id":"native-fixture-session","resumed":false,"message_count":0,"stateless_generation":1}"#.into())).await.unwrap();
            sink.send(Message::Text(r#"{"type":"connected","stateless_generation":1,"provider":"fixture-provider","model":"fixture-model"}"#.into())).await.unwrap();
            let _ = stream.next().await;
            for _ in 0..66 {
                sink.send(Message::Text(r#"{"type":"chunk","content":"x"}"#.into()))
                    .await
                    .unwrap();
            }
            let _ = tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(2), stream.next()).await;
        });
        let mut task = NativeGenerationTask::spawn(request(format!("http://{address}"))).unwrap();
        tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(2), async {
            while task.events.len() < 64 {
                tokio::task::yield_now().await;
            }
        })
        .await
        .unwrap();
        task.cancel();
        assert!(matches!(
            tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(2), task.wait()).await,
            Ok(Err(NativeGenerationError::Cancelled))
        ));

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn bounded_escaped_terminal_matches_committed_deltas() {
        for mismatch in [false, true] {
            let listener = TcpListener::bind((std::net::Ipv4Addr::LOCALHOST, 0))
                .await
                .unwrap();
            let address = listener.local_addr().unwrap();
            let server = tokio::spawn(async move {
                let (stream, _) = listener.accept().await.unwrap();
                let mut socket = accept_hdr_async(stream, |_: &Request, mut response: Response| {
                    response
                        .headers_mut()
                        .insert("Sec-WebSocket-Protocol", WS_PROTOCOL.parse().unwrap());
                    Ok(response)
                })
                .await
                .unwrap();
                let _ = socket.next().await;
                for frame in [
                    serde_json::json!({"type":"session_start","session_id":"native-fixture-session","resumed":false,"message_count":0,"stateless_generation":1}),
                    serde_json::json!({"type":"connected","stateless_generation":1,"provider":"fixture-provider","model":"fixture-model"}),
                ] {
                    socket.send(Message::Text(frame.to_string())).await.unwrap();
                }
                let _ = socket.next().await;
                let delta = "\u{0000}".repeat(MAX_DELTA_BYTES);
                for _ in 0..(MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES / MAX_DELTA_BYTES) {
                    socket
                        .send(Message::Text(
                            serde_json::json!({"type":"chunk","content":delta}).to_string(),
                        ))
                        .await
                        .unwrap();
                }
                let response = if mismatch {
                    "different".into()
                } else {
                    "\u{0000}".repeat(MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES)
                };
                let done = serde_json::json!({"type":"done","full_response":response,"provider":"fixture-provider","model":"fixture-model"}).to_string();
                if !mismatch {
                    assert!(done.len() > MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES && done.len() < MAX_FRAME_BYTES);
                }
                socket.send(Message::Text(done)).await.unwrap();
            });
            let mut task =
                NativeGenerationTask::spawn(request(format!("http://{address}"))).unwrap();
            tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(5), async {
                let mut output = String::new();
                while let Some(NativeGenerationEvent::TextDelta { delta }) = task.recv_event().await {
                    output.push_str(&delta);
                }
                assert_eq!(output.len(), MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES);
                let result = task.wait().await;
                if mismatch {
                    assert!(matches!(result, Err(NativeGenerationError::Terminal(NativeErrorCode::Protocol))));
                } else {
                    assert!(matches!(result, Ok(NativeGenerationTerminal::Done(done)) if done.full_response == output));
                }
            }).await.unwrap();
            server.await.unwrap();
        }
    }
}

<file path="op-grpc-bridge/src/tched_router_legacy_dispatch.rs">
//! Bridge integration for retained tched_router reads and durable role assignments.
//! Canonical admission/verified identity remains in MutationEngine.

use crate::{
    method_contract_admission,
    sealed_schema_reader::{
        blob_catalog_dir_from_env, read_manifest_pinned_schema_document,
        ManifestPinnedSchemaDocument,
    },
};
use anyhow::{Context, Result};
use op_plugins::state_plugins::{
    common::llm_projection::LlmTool,
    runtime_documents::RuntimeDocuments,
    tched_router::ObservedTchedRouterState,
    tched_router_legacy_methods::{ModelRole, TchedRouterLegacyMethods},
};
use serde::Deserialize;
use serde_json::{json, Value};
use std::sync::Arc;

pub(crate) struct LegacyDispatchReceipt {
    pub(crate) output: Value,
    /// Exact runtime observation plus the exact durable assignment row used by
    /// this operation. MutationEngine commits this at the plugin root before
    /// notifying or returning the output.
    pub(crate) represented_state: Value,
    pub(crate) schema_hash: String,
}

#[derive(Clone)]
struct SealPin {
    schema_hash: String,
    schema_json: String,
}

fn seal_is_unchanged(expected: &SealPin) -> Result<()> {
    let current: ManifestPinnedSchemaDocument =
        read_manifest_pinned_schema_document(&blob_catalog_dir_from_env(), "tched_router")?;
    method_contract_admission::admit_compiled_state_contract(&current, "tched_router")?;
    anyhow::ensure!(
        current.schema_hash == expected.schema_hash
            && current.blob.schema_json == expected.schema_json,
        "tched_router plugin seal changed during retained operation"
    );
    Ok(())
}

async fn blocking<T: Send + 'static>(
    operation: impl FnOnce() -> Result<T> + Send + 'static,
) -> Result<T> {
    tokio::task::spawn_blocking(operation)
        .await
        .context("tched_router sealed-contract worker failed")?
}

fn role_for_method(method: &str) -> Option<ModelRole> {
    match method {
        "SetOvsRoutingModel" => Some(ModelRole::OvsRouting),
        "SetObfuscationModel" => Some(ModelRole::Obfuscation),
        "SetVectorizationModel" => Some(ModelRole::Vectorization),
        "SetQdrantRetrievalModel" => Some(ModelRole::QdrantRetrieval),
        "SetCozoRetrievalModel" => Some(ModelRole::CozoRetrieval),
        _ => None,
    }
}

fn role_output(role: ModelRole, model_id: &str) -> Value {
    match role {
        ModelRole::OvsRouting => json!({"ovs_routing": model_id}),
        ModelRole::Obfuscation => json!({"obfuscation": model_id}),
        ModelRole::Vectorization => json!({"vectorization": model_id}),
        ModelRole::QdrantRetrieval => json!({"qdrant_retrieval": model_id}),
        ModelRole::CozoRetrieval => json!({"cozo_retrieval": model_id}),
    }
}

fn model_id(args: &Value) -> Result<&str> {
    let object = args
        .as_object()
        .context("role assignment input must be an object")?;
    anyhow::ensure!(object.len() == 1, "role assignment accepts only model_id");
    object
        .get("model_id")
        .and_then(Value::as_str)
        .context("role assignment requires string model_id")
}

#[derive(Deserialize)]
struct NativeToolsResponse {
    tools: Vec<NativeTool>,
}

#[derive(Deserialize)]
struct NativeTool {
    name: String,
    description: String,
    parameters: Value,
    #[serde(default)]
    output: Option<Value>,
    // v0.8.4 also returns param_domains. The retained OP-DBUS LlmTool
    // contract does not declare that metadata, so it is deliberately not
    // represented rather than copied into an opaque extension.
}

async fn read_native_tools() -> Result<Vec<LlmTool>> {
    read_native_tools_with(&crate::tched_router_runtime::TchedRouterRuntimeClient::from_env()).await
}

async fn read_native_tools_with(
    client: &crate::tched_router_runtime::TchedRouterRuntimeClient,
) -> Result<Vec<LlmTool>> {
    use crate::tched_router_runtime::{GatewayJsonRequest, GatewayMethod, GatewayProfile};
    let response: NativeToolsResponse = client
        .send_gateway_json(GatewayJsonRequest {
            method: GatewayMethod::Get,
            relative_path: "/api/tools",
            query: &[],
            body: None,
            operation: "tched_router tools",
            profile: GatewayProfile::Config,
            mutation: false,
        })
        .await?;
    map_native_tools(response)
}

fn map_native_tools(response: NativeToolsResponse) -> Result<Vec<LlmTool>> {
    anyhow::ensure!(
        response.tools.len() <= 512,
        "native tool catalog exceeds 512 entries"
    );
    let mut names = std::collections::BTreeSet::new();
    response
        .tools
        .into_iter()
        .map(|tool| {
            anyhow::ensure!(
                !tool.name.trim().is_empty()
                    && tool.name.len() <= 256
                    && names.insert(tool.name.clone()),
                "native tool catalog contains an empty, oversized, or duplicate name"
            );
            anyhow::ensure!(
                tool.description.len() <= 16 * 1024,
                "native tool description exceeds bound"
            );
            anyhow::ensure!(
                tool.parameters.is_object(),
                "native tool parameters are not a JSON Schema object"
            );
            anyhow::ensure!(
                tool.output.as_ref().is_none_or(Value::is_object),
                "native tool output is not a JSON Schema object"
            );
            Ok(LlmTool {
                name: tool.name,
                description: tool.description,
                parameters: tool.parameters,
                response_schema: tool.output.unwrap_or(Value::Null),
            })
        })
        .collect()
}

async fn ensure_runtime_unchanged(
    pinned: &ManifestPinnedSchemaDocument,
    expected: &Value,
) -> Result<()> {
    let (_, current) = crate::tched_config_engine::coherent_observation(pinned).await?;
    anyhow::ensure!(
        &current == expected,
        "native tched_router config/selection changed during retained operation"
    );
    Ok(())
}

pub(crate) async fn dispatch(
    pinned: &ManifestPinnedSchemaDocument,
    method: &str,
    args: &Value,
    documents: Option<Arc<RuntimeDocuments>>,
) -> Result<LegacyDispatchReceipt> {
    // The engine retains final admission and the operation guard for this exact pin.
    let pin = SealPin {
        schema_hash: pinned.schema_hash.clone(),
        schema_json: pinned.blob.schema_json.clone(),
    };
    let (native, complete_native) =
        crate::tched_config_engine::coherent_observation(pinned).await?;
    if method == "GetTools" {
        let object = args
            .as_object()
            .context("GetTools input must be an object")?;
        anyhow::ensure!(object.is_empty(), "GetTools does not accept fields");
        let tools = read_native_tools().await?;
        let tools_value = serde_json::to_value(&tools)?;
        let expected = pin.clone();
        blocking(move || seal_is_unchanged(&expected)).await?;
        return Ok(LegacyDispatchReceipt {
            output: json!({"tools": tools_value.clone()}),
            represented_state: {
                let mut fields = complete_native
                    .as_object()
                    .cloned()
                    .context("native router fields must be an object")?;
                fields.insert("tools".into(), tools_value);
                Value::Object(fields)
            },
            schema_hash: pin.schema_hash.clone(),
        });
    }
    let methods = TchedRouterLegacyMethods::new(
        documents.context("retained tched_router method requires the configured durable owner")?,
    );
    let observed = ObservedTchedRouterState::from(&native);
    if matches!(
        method,
        "GetModelRoutes" | "GetProviderCatalog" | "ResolveRoute"
    ) {
        let receipt = methods.observe(method, args, &observed).await?;
        ensure_runtime_unchanged(pinned, &complete_native).await?;
        let expected = pin.clone();
        blocking(move || seal_is_unchanged(&expected)).await?;
        return Ok(LegacyDispatchReceipt {
            output: receipt.output,
            represented_state: with_native_config(receipt.represented_state, &complete_native)?,
            schema_hash: pin.schema_hash.clone(),
        });
    }
    if let Some(role) = role_for_method(method) {
        let requested = model_id(args)?;
        let (receipt, represented_state) = methods
            .assign(role, requested, &observed)
            .await
            .with_context(|| format!("{method} durable assignment failed"))?;
        ensure_runtime_unchanged(pinned, &complete_native)
            .await
            .with_context(|| {
                format!(
                "{method} assignment committed but the native catalog changed before publication"
            )
            })?;
        let expected = pin.clone();
        blocking(move || seal_is_unchanged(&expected)).await.with_context(|| {
            format!("{method} durable assignment committed but its sealed publication contract changed")
        })?;
        return Ok(LegacyDispatchReceipt {
            output: role_output(role, &receipt.model_id),
            represented_state: with_native_config(represented_state, &complete_native)?,
            schema_hash: pin.schema_hash.clone(),
        });
    }
    anyhow::bail!("retained tched_router method has no native/durable adapter: {method}")
}

fn with_native_config(mut fields: Value, native: &Value) -> Result<Value> {
    let config = native
        .get("native_config")
        .context("coherent router observation omitted configuration")?
        .clone();
    fields
        .as_object_mut()
        .context("retained router fields must be an object")?
        .insert("native_config".into(), config);
    Ok(fields)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn tools_adapter_reads_the_real_v084_http_envelope() {
        use tokio::io::{AsyncReadExt, AsyncWriteExt};
        let listener = tokio::net::TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").await.unwrap();
        let address = listener.local_addr().unwrap();
        let server = tokio::spawn(async move {
            let (mut socket, _) = listener.accept().await.unwrap();
            let mut request = Vec::with_capacity(4096);
            while !request.windows(4).any(|window| window == b"\r\n\r\n") {
                assert!(request.len() < 4096, "fixture request exceeded bound");
                let mut chunk = [0_u8; 512];
                let read = socket.read(&mut chunk).await.unwrap();
                assert!(read != 0, "fixture request ended before headers");
                request.extend_from_slice(&chunk[..read]);
            }
            let request = String::from_utf8_lossy(&request);
            assert!(request.starts_with("GET /api/tools HTTP/1.1\r\n"));
            let body = r#"{"tools":[{"name":"state_get","description":"Read state","parameters":{"type":"object","additionalProperties":false},"output":{"type":"object"},"param_domains":{"key":["public"]}}]}"#;
            socket
                .write_all(
                    format!(
                        "HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\ncontent-type: application/json\r\ncontent-length: {}\r\nconnection: close\r\n\r\n{}",
                        body.len(), body
                    )
                    .as_bytes(),
                )
                .await
                .unwrap();
        });
        let client = crate::tched_router_runtime::TchedRouterRuntimeClient::new(
            format!("http://{address}"),
            "fixture".into(),
            None,
        );
        let tools = read_native_tools_with(&client).await.unwrap();
        server.await.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(tools.len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(tools[0].name, "state_get");
        assert_eq!(tools[0].parameters["additionalProperties"], false);
        assert_eq!(tools[0].response_schema["type"], "object");
    }

    #[test]
    fn native_tool_mapping_preserves_parameter_and_output_schemas() {
        let tools = map_native_tools(NativeToolsResponse {
            tools: vec![NativeTool {
                name: "state_get".into(),
                description: "Read state".into(),
                parameters: json!({"type":"object","additionalProperties":false}),
                output: Some(json!({"type":"object","required":["value"]})),
            }],
        })
        .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(tools[0].parameters["additionalProperties"], false);
        assert_eq!(tools[0].response_schema["required"], json!(["value"]));
    }

    #[test]
    fn malformed_or_duplicate_native_tools_are_rejected() {
        let duplicate = || NativeTool {
            name: "same".into(),
            description: String::new(),
            parameters: json!({"type":"object"}),
            output: None,
        };
        assert!(map_native_tools(NativeToolsResponse {
            tools: vec![duplicate(), duplicate()],
        })
        .is_err());
        assert!(map_native_tools(NativeToolsResponse {
            tools: vec![NativeTool {
                parameters: Value::String("not-schema".into()),
                ..duplicate()
            }],
        })
        .is_err());
    }
}
