    #[test]
    fn mutation_response_failures_are_never_reported_before_effect() {
        let mutation = GatewayJsonRequest {
            method: GatewayMethod::Patch,
            relative_path: "/api/config",
            query: &[],
            body: None,
            operation: "patch config",
            profile: GatewayProfile::Config,
            mutation: true,
        };
        assert!(matches!(
            gateway_response_failure(&mutation, "truncated response".into()),
            GatewayRequestError::IndeterminateMutation(_)
        ));
        let read = GatewayJsonRequest {
            method: GatewayMethod::Get,
            mutation: false,
            ..mutation
        };
        assert!(matches!(
            gateway_response_failure(&read, "invalid JSON".into()),
            GatewayRequestError::InvalidResponse(_)
        ));
        assert!(matches!(
            gateway_status_failure(
                &mutation,
                reqwest::StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
                "failed".into()
            ),
            GatewayRequestError::IndeterminateMutation(_)
        ));
        assert!(matches!(
            gateway_status_failure(
                &mutation,
                reqwest::StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST,
                "rejected".into()
            ),
            GatewayRequestError::ProviderRejected { status: 400, .. }
        ));
    }

    async fn one_raw_gateway_response(
        status: &'static str,
        body: &'static str,
    ) -> (TchedRouterRuntimeClient, tokio::task::JoinHandle<()>) {
        use tokio::io::{AsyncReadExt, AsyncWriteExt};

        let listener = tokio::net::TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").await.unwrap();
        let address = listener.local_addr().unwrap();
        let task = tokio::spawn(async move {
            let (mut stream, _) = listener.accept().await.unwrap();
            let mut request = [0_u8; 4096];
            let _ = stream.read(&mut request).await.unwrap();
            let response = format!(
                "HTTP/1.1 {status}\r\nContent-Type: application/json\r\nContent-Length: {}\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n{body}",
                body.len()
            );
            stream.write_all(response.as_bytes()).await.unwrap();
        });
        (
            TchedRouterRuntimeClient::new(format!("http://{address}"), "fixture".into(), None),
            task,
        )
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn real_http_mutation_failures_preserve_uncertain_outcomes() {
        for (status, body, indeterminate) in [
            ("500 Internal Server Error", r#"{"error":"late"}"#, true),
            ("400 Bad Request", r#"{"error":"rejected"}"#, false),
            ("200 OK", "not-json", true),
        ] {
            let (runtime, task) = one_raw_gateway_response(status, body).await;
            let result = runtime
                .send_gateway_json::<Value>(GatewayJsonRequest {
                    method: GatewayMethod::Post,
                    relative_path: "/api/cron/job/run",
                    query: &[],
                    body: None,
                    operation: "run fixture job",
                    profile: GatewayProfile::Config,
                    mutation: true,
                })
                .await;
            if indeterminate {
                assert!(matches!(
                    result,
                    Err(GatewayRequestError::IndeterminateMutation(_))
                ));
            } else {
                assert!(matches!(
                    result,
                    Err(GatewayRequestError::ProviderRejected { status: 400, .. })
                ));
            }
            task.await.unwrap();
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn patch_receipt_is_bound_to_ordered_operations_and_final_readback() {
        let operations = vec![
            ConfigPatchOperation::Test {
                path: "/gateway/port".into(),
                value: json!(8084),
            },
            ConfigPatchOperation::Replace {
                path: "/gateway/port".into(),
                value: json!(8085),
            },
        ];
        let valid = json!({"saved":true,"results":[
            {"op":"test","path":"gateway.port","value":"8084"},
            {"op":"replace","path":"gateway.port","value":"8085"}
        ]});
        let mut sanitized = valid.clone();
        sanitize_patch_response(&mut sanitized, &operations, &StaticSecretPolicy).unwrap();
        verify_patch_readbacks(
            &sanitized,
            &[json!({"path":"gateway.port","kind":"value","value":"8085"})],
        )
        .unwrap();
        assert!(verify_patch_readbacks(
            &sanitized,
            &[json!({"path":"gateway.port","kind":"value","value":"8084"})]
        )
        .is_err());
        assert!(verify_patch_readbacks(
            &sanitized,
            &[json!({"path":"gateway.host","kind":"value","value":"8085"})]
        )
        .is_err());
        for mismatch in ["order", "path", "op"] {
            let mut response = valid.clone();
            match mismatch {
                "order" => response["results"].as_array_mut().unwrap().reverse(),
                "path" => response["results"][1]["path"] = json!("gateway.host"),
                _ => response["results"][1]["op"] = json!("add"),
            }
            assert!(
                sanitize_patch_response(&mut response, &operations, &StaticSecretPolicy).is_err()
            );
        }
        let reset = vec![ConfigPatchOperation::Remove {
            path: "/gateway/port".into(),
        }];
        let mut reset_response =
            json!({"saved":true,"results":[{"op":"remove","path":"gateway.port","value":null}]});
        sanitize_patch_response(&mut reset_response, &reset, &StaticSecretPolicy).unwrap();
        // Native reset has a null receipt and a possibly non-null default.
        verify_patch_readbacks(
            &reset_response,
            &[json!({"path":"gateway.port","kind":"value","value":"8084"})],
        )
        .unwrap();
    }

    #[test]
    fn paired_native_config_and_selection_commit_preserves_sibling_children() {
        use crate::state_tree_fold::{merge_plugin_object_fields, StateTreeFold};
        let directory = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let state_dir = directory.path().to_str().unwrap();
        op_core::projection_shm::prepare_projection_directory_in(state_dir).unwrap();
        let original = json!({
            "selected_provider":"native","selected_model":"old",
            "native_config":{"providers":{"models":{"native":{"model":"old"}}}},
            "memory_namespaces":{"sibling":{"keep":true}},
            "model_assignments":{"vectorization":"embedding-sibling"}
        });
        op_core::projection_shm::update_projection_in(state_dir, "tched_router", |_| {
            Ok(Some(serde_json::to_vec(&original)?))
        })
        .unwrap();
        let paired = NativeConfigObservation {
            state: TchedRouterState::default(),
            native_config: json!({"providers":{"models":{"native":{"model":"new","api_key":"***MASKED***"}}}}),
            represented: json!({"status":"active","selected_provider":"native","selected_model":"new","providers":[],"model_routes":[]}),
        };
        let (_, fields) = paired.into_state_and_fields().unwrap();
        let commit =
            op_core::projection_shm::update_projection_in(state_dir, "tched_router", |previous| {
                let previous: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_slice(previous.unwrap())?;
                let previous = simd_json::serde::to_owned_value(previous)?;
                let fields = simd_json::serde::to_owned_value(fields)?;
                let folded = merge_plugin_object_fields(
                    Some(&previous),
                    "tched_router",
                    "/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/tched_router",
                    &fields,
                )?;
                let StateTreeFold::Present(state) = folded else {
                    panic!("paired field update missing")
                };
                Ok(Some(simd_json::to_vec(&state)?))
            })
            .unwrap();
        let snapshot = op_core::projection_shm::read_projection_snapshot_in(
            state_dir,
            &["tched_router".into()],
        )
        .unwrap();
        let state: Value = serde_json::from_slice(&snapshot.states["tched_router"]).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(state["selected_model"], "new");
        assert_eq!(
            state["native_config"]["providers"]["models"]["native"]["model"],
            state["selected_model"]
        );
        assert_eq!(state["memory_namespaces"], original["memory_namespaces"]);
        assert_eq!(state["model_assignments"], original["model_assignments"]);
        assert_eq!(
            commit.current.as_ref().unwrap(),
            &snapshot.states["tched_router"]
        );
    }
    // Insert inside tched_router_runtime.rs::tests.
    mod config_http_fixture {
        use super::*;
        use axum::{
            extract::{Query, State},
            routing::{get, post},
            Json, Router,
        };
        use serde_json::json;
        use std::{
            collections::HashMap,
            net::SocketAddr,
            sync::{
                atomic::{AtomicUsize, Ordering},
                Arc,
            },
        };

        struct FixturePolicy;
        impl ConfigSecretPolicy for FixturePolicy {
            fn is_secret(&self, path: &str) -> anyhow::Result<bool> {
                anyhow::ensure!(path != "unknown", "unknown fixture path");
                Ok(path.ends_with("api_key"))
            }
            fn redact_config(&self, config: &mut Value) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
                config["providers"]["api_key"] = json!("***MASKED***");
                Ok(())
            }
        }

        #[derive(Clone)]
        struct FixtureState {
            writes: Arc<AtomicUsize>,
        }

        async fn health() -> Json<Value> {
            Json(json!({"status":"ok"}))
        }
        async fn full() -> Json<Value> {
            Json(json!({"gateway":{"port":8084}, "providers":{"api_key":"provider-leak"}}))
        }
        async fn prop(
            State(state): State<FixtureState>,
            Query(q): Query<HashMap<String, String>>,
        ) -> Json<Value> {
            let path = q.get("path").cloned().unwrap_or_default();
            if path.ends_with("api_key") {
                Json(json!({"path":path, "populated":true}))
            } else {
                let value = if state.writes.load(Ordering::SeqCst) == 0 {
                    "8084"
                } else {
                    "8085"
                };
                Json(json!({"path":path, "value":value, "warnings":[]}))
            }
        }
        async fn list() -> Json<Value> {
            Json(json!({"entries":[
            {"path":"gateway.port","category":"Gateway","kind":"integer","type_hint":"u16",
             "value":"8084","populated":true,"is_secret":false,"enum_variants":[],"tab":"","multiline":false},
            {"path":"providers.api_key","category":"Providers","kind":"string","type_hint":"Option<String>",
             "value":"provider-leak","populated":true,"is_secret":true,"enum_variants":[],"tab":"","multiline":false}
        ],"drifted":[]}))
        }
        async fn put_prop(
            State(state): State<FixtureState>,
            Json(_body): Json<Value>,
        ) -> Json<Value> {
            state.writes.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst);
            Json(json!({"path":"gateway.port","value":"8085","warnings":[]}))
        }
        async fn patch_config(
            State(state): State<FixtureState>,
            Json(body): Json<Value>,
        ) -> Json<Value> {
            state.writes.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst);
            let results = body.as_array().unwrap().iter().map(|op| json!({
            "op":op["op"], "path":op["path"].as_str().unwrap().trim_start_matches('/').replace('/', "."),
            "value":"8085"
        })).collect::<Vec<_>>();
            Json(json!({"saved":true,"results":results,"warnings":[]}))
        }
        async fn init() -> Json<Value> {
            Json(json!({"initialized":["gateway"]}))
        }
        async fn migrate() -> Json<Value> {
            Json(json!({"migrated":false,"schema_version":4}))
        }

        async fn fixture() -> (
            TchedRouterRuntimeClient,
            Arc<AtomicUsize>,
            tokio::task::JoinHandle<()>,
        ) {
            let writes = Arc::new(AtomicUsize::new(0));
            let state = FixtureState {
                writes: writes.clone(),
            };
            let app = Router::new()
                .route("/health", get(health))
                .route("/api/config", get(full).patch(patch_config))
                .route("/api/config/prop", get(prop).put(put_prop))
                .route("/api/config/list", get(list))
                .route("/api/config/init", post(init))
                .route("/api/config/migrate", post(migrate))
                .with_state(state);
            let listener = tokio::net::TcpListener::bind(SocketAddr::from(([127, 0, 0, 1], 0)))
                .await
                .unwrap();
            let endpoint = format!("http://{}", listener.local_addr().unwrap());
            let task = tokio::spawn(async move {
                axum::serve(listener, app).await.unwrap();
            });
            (
                TchedRouterRuntimeClient::new(endpoint, "dashboard".into(), None),
                writes,
                task,
            )
        }

        #[tokio::test]
        async fn reads_use_native_shapes_and_pinned_secret_policy() {
            let (runtime, _, task) = fixture().await;
            let policy = FixturePolicy;
            let full = runtime.read_masked_config(&policy).await.unwrap();
            assert_eq!(full["providers"]["api_key"], "***MASKED***");
            assert_eq!(full["gateway"]["port"], 8084);
            let list = runtime.read_config_list(None, &policy).await.unwrap();
            assert!(list["entries"][1].get("value").is_none());
            let secret = runtime
                .read_config_property("providers.api_key", &policy)
                .await
                .unwrap();
            assert_eq!(secret["kind"], "secret");
            assert!(secret.get("value").is_none());

        #[tokio::test]
        async fn mutations_are_bounded_and_read_back_after_effect() {
            let (runtime, writes, task) = fixture().await;
            let policy = FixturePolicy;

                .set_config_property(
                    &ConfigSetInput {
                        path: "gateway.port".into(),
                        value: json!(8085),
                    },

                )
                .await
                .unwrap();
            assert_eq!(set.readback["kind"], "value");
            assert_eq!(writes.load(Ordering::SeqCst), 1);
            let rejected = runtime
                .set_config_property(
                    &ConfigSetInput {
                        path: "providers.api_key".into(),
                        value: json!("***MASKED***"),
                    },
                    &policy,
                )
                .await;
            assert!(rejected.is_err());
            assert_eq!(

                "validation precedes effects"
            );

        #[tokio::test]
        async fn patch_init_and_migrate_return_native_receipts_after_readback() {
            let (runtime, writes, task) = fixture().await;
            let policy = FixturePolicy;
            let patch = runtime
                .patch_config(
                    &ConfigPatchInput {
                        operations: vec![ConfigPatchOperation::Replace {
                            path: "/gateway/port".into(),
                            value: json!(8085),
                        }],
                    },
                    &policy,
                )
                .await
                .unwrap();
            assert_eq!(patch.result["saved"], true);
            assert_eq!(patch.readback[0]["kind"], "value");
            assert_eq!(writes.load(Ordering::SeqCst), 1);

            let init = runtime
                .init_config(
                    &ConfigInitInput {
                        section: Some("gateway".into()),
                    },
                    &policy,
                )
                .await
                .unwrap();
            assert_eq!(init.result["initialized"], json!(["gateway"]));
            assert_eq!(init.readback["gateway"]["port"], 8084);

            let migrate = runtime
                .migrate_config(&ConfigMigrateInput {}, &policy)
                .await
                .unwrap();
            assert_eq!(migrate.result, json!({"migrated":false,"schema_version":4}));
            assert!(migrate.result.get("backup_path").is_none());
            task.abort();
        }

        #[tokio::test]
        async fn actual_patch_transport_rejects_dishonest_results_without_retry() {
            for mismatch in ["path", "op", "readback"] {
                let writes = Arc::new(AtomicUsize::new(0));
                let state = FixtureState {
                    writes: writes.clone(),
                };
                let app = Router::new()
                    .route("/health", get(health))
                    .route("/api/config/prop", get(prop))
                    .route("/api/config", axum::routing::patch(move |State(state): State<FixtureState>| async move {
                        state.writes.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst);
                        Json(json!({"saved":true,"results":[{
                            "op": if mismatch == "op" { "add" } else { "replace" },
                            "path": if mismatch == "path" { "gateway.host" } else { "gateway.port" },
                            "value": if mismatch == "readback" { "PRIVATE_UNVERIFIED_VALUE" } else { "8085" }
                        }]}))
                    }))
                    .with_state(state);
                let listener = tokio::net::TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").await.unwrap();
                let runtime = TchedRouterRuntimeClient::new(
                    format!("http://{}", listener.local_addr().unwrap()),
                    "fixture".into(),
                    None,
                );
                let task = tokio::spawn(async move {
                    axum::serve(listener, app).await.unwrap();
                });
                let error = runtime
                    .patch_config(
                        &ConfigPatchInput {
                            operations: vec![ConfigPatchOperation::Replace {
                                path: "/gateway/port".into(),
                                value: json!(8085),
                            }],
                        },
                        &FixturePolicy,
                    )
                    .await
                    .unwrap_err();
                assert_eq!(
                    writes.load(Ordering::SeqCst),
                    1,
                    "no automatic retry of an uncertain effect"
                );
                assert!(!format!("{error:#}").contains("PRIVATE_UNVERIFIED_VALUE"));
                task.abort();
            }
        }
    }
}
</file>

<file path="op-grpc-bridge/src/tracing.rs">
// 🟢 🛡️ Ghostbridge Trace Middleware
// Stamps X-Ghostbridge-Genesis and X-Ghostbridge-Trace-ID on every HTTP/gRPC
// response. Operates inside the tched_router Axum host (the gRPC/gRPC-Web side of
// The Shuttle). Mirrors the accountability loop enforced by the tonic
// interceptor on the native-gRPC side.

use std::future::Future;
use std::pin::Pin;
use std::task::{Context, Poll};

use axum::extract::Request;
use axum::response::Response;
use tracing::{warn, Span};
use uuid::Uuid;

const GENESIS_HEADER: &str = "X-Ghostbridge-Genesis";
const TRACE_ID_HEADER: &str = "X-Ghostbridge-Trace-ID";

/// Accountability trace context propagated from the HTTP layer into the
/// tonic gRPC service via request extensions. Both the HTTP headers and the
/// gRPC response message carry the same values.
#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct TraceContext {
    pub session_genesis: String,
    pub trace_id: String,
}

impl TraceContext {
    /// Extract or generate trace context from HTTP headers.
    pub fn from_headers(headers: &axum::http::HeaderMap) -> Self {
        let session_genesis = headers
            .get(GENESIS_HEADER)
            .and_then(|v| v.to_str().ok())
            .map(|s| s.to_string())
            .unwrap_or_else(|| {
                warn!("missing Ghostbridge session genesis; leaving identity absent");
                String::new()
            });
        let trace_id = headers
            .get(TRACE_ID_HEADER)
            .and_then(|v| v.to_str().ok())
            .map(|s| s.to_string())
            .unwrap_or_else(|| {
                let id = Uuid::now_v7().to_string();
                warn!(trace_id = %id, "missing X-Ghostbridge-Trace-ID; generated UUIDv7");
                id
            });
        Self {
            session_genesis,
            trace_id,
        }
    }

    /// Extract trace context from tonic request metadata/headers.
    pub fn from_tonic_metadata(metadata: &tonic::metadata::MetadataMap) -> Self {
        let session_genesis = metadata
            .get(GENESIS_HEADER)
            .and_then(|v| v.to_str().ok())
            .map(|s| s.to_string())
            .unwrap_or_default();
        let trace_id = metadata
            .get(TRACE_ID_HEADER)
            .and_then(|v| v.to_str().ok())
            .map(|s| s.to_string())
            .unwrap_or_else(|| {
                let id = Uuid::now_v7().to_string();
                warn!(trace_id = %id, "missing X-Ghostbridge-Trace-ID in gRPC metadata; generated UUIDv7");
                id
            });
        Self {
            session_genesis,
            trace_id,
        }
    }
}

/// Tower layer that ensures every response carries the accountability headers.
#[derive(Clone, Default)]
pub struct GhostbridgeTraceLayer;

impl GhostbridgeTraceLayer {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self
    }
}

impl<S> tower::Layer<S> for GhostbridgeTraceLayer {
    type Service = GhostbridgeTraceService<S>;

    fn layer(&self, inner: S) -> GhostbridgeTraceService<S> {
        GhostbridgeTraceService {
            inner,
            span: Span::current(),
        }
    }
}

/// Tower service wrapping an inner service to inject trace headers.
#[derive(Clone)]
pub struct GhostbridgeTraceService<S> {
    inner: S,
    span: Span,
}

impl<S> tower::Service<Request> for GhostbridgeTraceService<S>
where
    S: tower::Service<Request, Response = Response> + Clone + Send + 'static,
    S::Future: Send + 'static,
{
    type Response = Response;
    type Error = S::Error;
    type Future = Pin<Box<dyn Future<Output = Result<Response, S::Error>> + Send>>;

    fn poll_ready(&mut self, cx: &mut Context<'_>) -> Poll<Result<(), S::Error>> {
        self.inner.poll_ready(cx)
    }

    fn call(&mut self, mut req: Request) -> Self::Future {
        let mut inner = self.inner.clone();
        let span = self.span.clone();

        let context = TraceContext::from_headers(req.headers());
        req.extensions_mut().insert(context.clone());

        Box::pin(async move {
            let _enter = span.enter();
            let mut response = inner.call(req).await?;

            if !context.session_genesis.is_empty() {
                if let Ok(value) = context.session_genesis.parse::<axum::http::HeaderValue>() {
                    response.headers_mut().insert(GENESIS_HEADER, value);
                }
            }
            if let Ok(value) = context.trace_id.parse() {
                response.headers_mut().insert(TRACE_ID_HEADER, value);
            }

            Ok(response)
        })
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use axum::body::Body;
    use tower::Layer;
    use tower::ServiceExt;

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn should_stamp_trace_headers_on_response() {
        let service = GhostbridgeTraceLayer::new()
            .layer(axum::Router::new().route("/", axum::routing::get(|| async { "ok" })));

        let req = Request::builder()
            .uri("/")
            .header(GENESIS_HEADER, "abc123")
            .header(TRACE_ID_HEADER, "trace-123")
            .body(Body::empty())
            .unwrap();

        let response = service.oneshot(req).await.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(response.headers().get(GENESIS_HEADER).unwrap(), "abc123");
        assert_eq!(
            response.headers().get(TRACE_ID_HEADER).unwrap(),
            "trace-123"
        );
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn should_generate_trace_id_when_absent() {
        let service = GhostbridgeTraceLayer::new()
            .layer(axum::Router::new().route("/", axum::routing::get(|| async { "ok" })));

        let req = Request::builder().uri("/").body(Body::empty()).unwrap();

        let response = service.oneshot(req).await.unwrap();
        assert!(response.headers().get(GENESIS_HEADER).is_none());
        let trace_id = response.headers().get(TRACE_ID_HEADER).unwrap();
        let trace_str = trace_id.to_str().unwrap();
        assert!(
            Uuid::parse_str(trace_str).is_ok(),
            "trace id should be a valid UUID"
        );
    }
}
</file>

<file path="op-grpc-bridge/src/ui_workspace_dispatch_tests.rs">
use super::*;
use op_state::StatePlugin;
use op_state_store::{ChainConfig, EventChain};
use serde_json::json;
use std::{future::Future, task::Poll};
use tokio::sync::broadcast::error::TryRecvError;

struct Fixture {
    _root: tempfile::TempDir,
    catalog: std::path::PathBuf,
    publisher: UiWorkspacePublisher,
}

impl Fixture {
    fn new() -> Self {
        let root = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let catalog = root.path().join("catalog");
        let mut sealer = op_blob::BlobStore::open(&catalog).unwrap();
        for schema in [
            op_plugins::state_plugins::gemma_brain::GemmaBrainPlugin::new()
                .schema()
                .unwrap(),
            op_plugins::state_plugins::json_render::JsonRenderPlugin::new()
                .schema()
                .unwrap(),
        ] {
            sealer
                .write(&op_blob::blobify_plugin_schema(
                    &schema.name.clone(),
                    schema,
                ))
                .unwrap();
        }
        let documents = Arc::new(RuntimeDocuments::new(
            op_cozo_store::CozoGraphShuttle::new_in_memory().unwrap(),
        ));
        let private = PrivateProjectionDirectory::prepare(&root.path().join("private")).unwrap();
        Self {
            _root: root,
            catalog: catalog.clone(),
            publisher: UiWorkspacePublisher::new(private, documents, catalog),
        }
    }

    fn owner(principal: &str, session: &str) -> VerifiedOwner {
        let access = UiAccessContext {
            principal_id: principal.into(),
            session_id: session.into(),
            session_genesis: None,
        };
        let key = access.owner_key().unwrap();
        VerifiedOwner { access, key }
    }

    fn prepared(&self) -> (ContractPins, Arc<UiWorkspaceMethods>) {
        let pins = pin_contracts(&self.catalog, None).unwrap();
        let methods = self.publisher.methods(&pins).unwrap();
        (pins, methods)
    }

    async fn publish(
        &self,
        slot: Arc<OwnerSlot>,
        owner: VerifiedOwner,
        method: &str,
        args: Value,
        recovery: bool,
    ) -> Result<Value> {
        let (pins, methods) = self.prepared();
        self.publisher
            .publish_owned(
                slot,
                owner,
                pins,
                methods,
                method.into(),
                args,
                uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string(),
                recovery,
            )
            .await
    }
}

fn spec(text: &str) -> Value {
    json!({"root":"root","elements":{
        "root":{"type":"text","props":{"text":text,"className":null},"children":[]}
    }})
}

#[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread")]
async fn private_workspace_publication_is_complete_scoped_recoverable_and_cancellation_owned() {
    let fixture = Fixture::new();
    let engine = MutationEngine::new(
        Arc::new(tokio::sync::RwLock::new(EventChain::new(
            ChainConfig::default(),
        ))),
        Arc::new(op_network::rovs_proxy::OvsdbDbusClient::new()),
    );
    assert!(fixture
        .publisher
        .subscribe_workspace(
            &engine,
            "principal-a",
            Some("session-a"),
            Some("genesis-a"),
            "gemma.invoke",
        )
        .await
        .err()
        .unwrap()
        .to_string()
        .contains("exact gemma.read"));
    let owner = Fixture::owner("principal-a", "session-a");
    let slot = fixture.publisher.owner_slot(&owner.key).unwrap();
    let mut wakes = slot.wake.subscribe();

    // Explicit activation reconciles an absent durable row as absent. It does
    // not mint an empty workspace or send a state wake.
    let activated = fixture
        .publish(slot.clone(), owner, "recover_ui_workspace", json!({}), true)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(activated, json!({"workspace":null}));
    assert!(slot.activated.load(Ordering::Acquire));
    assert!(matches!(wakes.try_recv(), Err(TryRecvError::Empty)));

    let owner = Fixture::owner("principal-a", "session-a");
    fixture
        .publish(
            slot.clone(),
            owner,
            "create_ui_spec",
            json!({"spec":spec("one"),"tags":[]}),
            false,
        )
        .await
        .unwrap();
    wakes.recv().await.unwrap();
    let owner = Fixture::owner("principal-a", "session-a");
    fixture
        .publish(
            slot.clone(),
            owner,
            "create_ui_spec",
            json!({"spec":spec("PRIVATE_SIBLING"),"tags":[]}),
            false,
        )
        .await
        .unwrap();
    let second = wakes.recv().await.unwrap();

    let (pins, methods) = fixture.prepared();
    let key = Fixture::owner("principal-a", "session-a").key;
    let complete = fixture
        .publisher
        .read_committed_locked(&key, &pins, &methods, "get_ui_workspace", &json!({}))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    let workspace = &complete["workspace"];
    assert_eq!(workspace["document_revision"], 2);
    assert_eq!(
        workspace["projection"]["specs"].as_object().unwrap().len(),
        2
    );
    assert_eq!(second.document_revision, 2);

    let child = fixture
        .publisher
        .private_root
        .open_child(key.namespace_component())
        .unwrap()
        .unwrap();
    let snapshot = child.read_snapshot(&[PLUGIN.to_owned()]).unwrap();
    let prior = snapshot.states[PLUGIN].clone();
    let mut unequal: Value = serde_json::from_slice(&prior).unwrap();
    unequal["specs"]
        .as_object_mut()
        .unwrap()
        .values_mut()
        .next()
        .unwrap()["tags"] = json!(["changed-without-revision"]);
    let unequal = serde_json::to_vec(&unequal).unwrap();
    assert!(compare_revision(Some(&prior), &unequal, &pins.gemma_schema).is_err());

    // A proven pre-effect rejection clears its exact marker. The previous
    // projection remains readable at the same generation and emits no wake.
    let generation = snapshot.generation;
    let owner = Fixture::owner("principal-a", "session-a");
    let rejected = fixture
        .publish(
            slot.clone(),
            owner,
            "update_ui_spec",
            json!({"spec_id":"absent","expected_revision":1,"element_id":"root","properties":{}}),
            false,
        )
        .await
        .unwrap_err();
    assert!(format!("{rejected:#}").contains("UI spec not found"));
    assert!(slot.activated.load(Ordering::Acquire));
    assert!(matches!(wakes.try_recv(), Err(TryRecvError::Empty)));
    assert!(child.pending_document().unwrap().is_none());
    let after_rejection = child.read_snapshot(&[PLUGIN.to_owned()]).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(after_rejection.generation, generation);
    assert_eq!(after_rejection.states[PLUGIN], prior);
    let still_committed = fixture
        .publisher
        .read_committed_locked(&key, &pins, &methods, "get_ui_workspace", &json!({}))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(still_committed["workspace"]["document_revision"], 2);

    // A successful durable mutation followed by a pinned-contract change is
    // genuinely uncertain for publication: it retains the gate and receipt,
    // deactivates reads, and emits no wake until exact durable recovery.
    let (stale_pins, stale_methods) = fixture.prepared();
    let mut changed = op_plugins::state_plugins::gemma_brain::GemmaBrainPlugin::new()
        .schema()
        .unwrap();
    changed
        .description
        .push_str("; changed after the durable operation was prepared");
    op_blob::BlobStore::open(&fixture.catalog)
        .unwrap()
        .write(&op_blob::blobify_plugin_schema(PLUGIN, changed))
        .unwrap();
    let pending = fixture
        .publisher
        .publish_owned(
            slot.clone(),
            Fixture::owner("principal-a", "session-a"),
            stale_pins,
            stale_methods,
            "create_ui_spec".into(),
            json!({"spec":spec("durable-before-contract-change"),"tags":[]}),
            uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string(),
            false,
        )
        .await
        .unwrap_err();
    assert!(format!("{pending:#}").contains("committed_unpublished"));
    assert!(!slot.activated.load(Ordering::Acquire));
    assert!(matches!(wakes.try_recv(), Err(TryRecvError::Empty)));
    assert!(child.pending_document().unwrap().is_some());

    // Restore the compiled contract, then exact recovery rereads the durable
    // row, clears the gate and emits the complete workspace as one generation.
    let canonical = op_plugins::state_plugins::gemma_brain::GemmaBrainPlugin::new()
        .schema()
        .unwrap();
    op_blob::BlobStore::open(&fixture.catalog)
        .unwrap()
        .write(&op_blob::blobify_plugin_schema(PLUGIN, canonical))
        .unwrap();

    let owner = Fixture::owner("principal-a", "session-a");
    fixture
        .publish(slot.clone(), owner, "recover_ui_workspace", json!({}), true)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert!(slot.activated.load(Ordering::Acquire));
    let recovered = wakes.recv().await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(recovered.document_revision, 3);
    assert!(child.pending_document().unwrap().is_none());
    let (pins, methods) = fixture.prepared();
    let recovered = fixture
        .publisher
        .read_committed_locked(&key, &pins, &methods, "get_ui_workspace", &json!({}))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(recovered["workspace"]["document_revision"], 3);
    assert_eq!(
        recovered["workspace"]["projection"]["specs"]
            .as_object()
            .unwrap()
            .len(),
        3
    );

    // Another verified owner maps through the plugin-owned opaque key and
    // cannot see this workspace after its own explicit absent activation.
    let other = Fixture::owner("principal-a", "session-b");
    let other_slot = fixture.publisher.owner_slot(&other.key).unwrap();
    fixture
        .publish(
            other_slot.clone(),
            other,
            "recover_ui_workspace",
            json!({}),
            true,
        )
        .await
        .unwrap();
    let (pins, methods) = fixture.prepared();
    let other_key = Fixture::owner("principal-a", "session-b").key;
    let absent = fixture
        .publisher
        .read_committed_locked(&other_key, &pins, &methods, "get_ui_workspace", &json!({}))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(absent, json!({"workspace":null}));

    // Once submitted, caller cancellation cannot strand a domain success
    // before SHM publication: the independently owned worker waits for the
    // owner lock and completes after the caller future is dropped.
    let cancel_owner = Fixture::owner("principal-c", "session-c");
    let cancel_slot = fixture.publisher.owner_slot(&cancel_owner.key).unwrap();
    fixture
        .publish(
            cancel_slot.clone(),
            cancel_owner,
            "recover_ui_workspace",
            json!({}),
            true,
        )
        .await
        .unwrap();
    let guard = cancel_slot.operation.clone().lock_owned().await;
    let mut cancel_wakes = cancel_slot.wake.subscribe();
    let (pins, methods) = fixture.prepared();
    let mut operation = Box::pin(fixture.publisher.publish_owned(
        cancel_slot.clone(),
        Fixture::owner("principal-c", "session-c"),
        pins,
        methods,
        "create_ui_spec".into(),
        json!({"spec":spec("owned"),"tags":[]}),
        uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string(),
        false,
    ));
    let poll = std::future::poll_fn(|cx| Poll::Ready(operation.as_mut().poll(cx))).await;
    assert!(matches!(poll, Poll::Pending));
    drop(operation);
    drop(guard);
    tokio::time::timeout(std::time::Duration::from_secs(5), cancel_wakes.recv())
        .await
        .unwrap()
        .unwrap();
    assert!(cancel_slot.activated.load(Ordering::Acquire));
    let (pins, methods) = fixture.prepared();
    let workspace = fixture
        .publisher
        .read_committed_locked(
            &Fixture::owner("principal-c", "session-c").key,
            &pins,
            &methods,
            "get_ui_workspace",
            &json!({}),
        )
        .await
        .unwrap();
    let specs = workspace["workspace"]["projection"]["specs"]
        .as_object()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(specs.len(), 1);
    let (minted_id, record) = specs.iter().next().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        uuid::Uuid::parse_str(minted_id).unwrap().to_string(),
        *minted_id
    );
    assert_eq!(record["id"].as_str(), Some(minted_id.as_str()));
    assert_eq!(record["spec"]["elements"]["root"]["props"]["text"], "owned");
    let committed = fixture
        .publisher
        .read_committed_locked(
            &Fixture::owner("principal-c", "session-c").key,
            &pins,
            &methods,
            "get_ui_spec",
            &json!({"spec_id":minted_id}),
        )
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(committed["spec"]["id"].as_str(), Some(minted_id.as_str()));
}
</file>

<file path="op-grpc-bridge/src/ui_workspace_dispatch.rs">
//! Principal/session-private UI workspace publication owned by MutationEngine.
//!
//! RuntimeDocuments is the durable domain owner. This module publishes its
//! exact complete receipt into the verified owner's private projection and
//! emits metadata-only wakes after the projection commit point.

use std::{
    collections::{HashMap, HashSet, VecDeque},
    path::{Path, PathBuf},
    sync::{
        atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering},
        Arc, Mutex as StdMutex, Weak,
    },
};

#[cfg(test)]
use std::sync::atomic::AtomicUsize;

use anyhow::{Context, Result};
use op_core::projection_shm::{
    PrivateDocumentCommit, PrivateDocumentPublication, PrivateProjectionDirectory, ProjectionCommit,
};
use op_plugins::state_plugins::{
    gemma_brain::workspace::{
        UiAccessContext, UiOwnerKey, UiWorkspaceCommit, UiWorkspaceMethods, UiWorkspaceRecovery,
    },
    runtime_documents::{RuntimeDocumentRejected, RuntimeDocuments},
};
use op_state_store::PluginSchema;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use serde_json::Value;
use tokio::sync::{broadcast, Mutex};

use crate::{
    interceptor::load_capability_grants,
    method_contract_admission,
    mutation_engine::MutationEngine,
    project_dispatch,
    sealed_schema_reader::{
        read_manifest_pinned_catalog, ManifestPinnedCatalog, ManifestPinnedSchemaDocument,
    },
    tched_router_admission::{readmit_call, FacadeOrigin, RouterCaller},
};

const PLUGIN: &str = "gemma_brain";
const RENDERER: &str = "json_render";
const READ_METHOD: &str = "get_ui_workspace";
pub(crate) const UI_WORKSPACE_READ_CAPABILITY: &str = "gemma.read";
const MAX_LIVE_OWNERS: usize = 4096;

pub(crate) const UI_WORKSPACE_METHODS: &[&str] = &[
    "get_ui_workspace",
    "get_ui_spec",
    "get_ui_job",
    "list_ui_specs",
    "create_ui_spec",
    "update_ui_spec",
    "handle_ui_event",
    "delete_ui_spec",
    "delete_ui_job",
    "rebind_ui_renderer",
    "recover_ui_workspace",
    "classify",
    "list_perspectives",
    "list_tags",
    "register_tag",
    "analyze_intent",
];

const READ_METHODS: &[&str] = &[
    "get_ui_workspace",
    "get_ui_spec",
    "get_ui_job",
    "list_ui_specs",
    "classify",
    "list_perspectives",
    "list_tags",
    "analyze_intent",
];

pub(crate) fn is_ui_workspace_method(method: &str) -> bool {
    UI_WORKSPACE_METHODS.contains(&method)
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub(crate) struct UiWorkspaceWake {
    pub plugin_id: String,
    pub generation: u64,
    pub document_revision: u64,
    pub schema_hash: String,
}

struct OwnerSlot {
    operation: Arc<Mutex<()>>,
    wake: broadcast::Sender<UiWorkspaceWake>,
    activated: AtomicBool,
    #[cfg(test)]
    queued: AtomicUsize,
}

impl OwnerSlot {
    fn new() -> Self {
        let (wake, _) = broadcast::channel(32);
        Self {
            operation: Arc::new(Mutex::new(())),
            wake,
            activated: AtomicBool::new(false),
            #[cfg(test)]
            queued: AtomicUsize::new(0),
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Clone)]
pub(crate) struct UiWorkspacePublisher {
    private_root: PrivateProjectionDirectory,
    documents: Arc<RuntimeDocuments>,
    catalog_dir: PathBuf,
    owners: Arc<StdMutex<HashMap<String, Weak<OwnerSlot>>>>,
    activations: Arc<StdMutex<ActivationCache>>,
}

#[derive(Default)]
struct ActivationCache {
    active: HashSet<String>,
    order: VecDeque<String>,
}

impl ActivationCache {
    fn contains(&self, owner: &str) -> bool {
        self.active.contains(owner)
    }

    fn set(&mut self, owner: &str, active: bool) {
        self.order.retain(|candidate| candidate != owner);
        self.active.remove(owner);
        if !active {
            return;
        }
        while self.active.len() >= MAX_LIVE_OWNERS {
            if let Some(evicted) = self.order.pop_front() {
                self.active.remove(&evicted);
            }
        }
        self.active.insert(owner.to_owned());
        self.order.push_back(owner.to_owned());
    }
}

struct ContractPins {
    catalog_dir: PathBuf,
    catalog_hash: String,
    gemma_hash: String,
    gemma_json: String,
    gemma_schema: PluginSchema,
    renderer_hash: String,
    renderer_json: String,
}

impl ContractPins {
    fn from_catalog(catalog_dir: &Path, catalog: ManifestPinnedCatalog) -> Result<Self> {
        let catalog_hash = catalog.catalog_hash.clone();
        let gemma = catalog
            .plugins
            .get(PLUGIN)
            .context("gemma_brain is absent from the sealed catalog")?;
        let renderer = catalog
            .plugins
            .get(RENDERER)
            .context("json_render is absent from the sealed catalog")?;
        method_contract_admission::admit_compiled_state_contract(gemma, PLUGIN)?;
        method_contract_admission::admit_compiled_state_contract(renderer, RENDERER)?;
        method_contract_admission::admit_pinned_compiled_method(
            gemma,
            PLUGIN,
            READ_METHOD,
            Some(UI_WORKSPACE_READ_CAPABILITY),
        )?;
        validate_schema_contract(gemma, PLUGIN)?;
        validate_schema_contract(renderer, RENDERER)?;
        Ok(Self {
            catalog_dir: catalog_dir.to_owned(),
            catalog_hash,
            gemma_hash: gemma.schema_hash.clone(),
            gemma_json: gemma.blob.schema_json.clone(),
            gemma_schema: gemma.schema.clone(),
            renderer_hash: renderer.schema_hash.clone(),
            renderer_json: renderer.blob.schema_json.clone(),
        })
    }

    fn recheck(&self) -> Result<String> {
        let catalog = read_manifest_pinned_catalog(&self.catalog_dir)?;
        let current = Self::from_catalog(&self.catalog_dir, catalog)?;
        anyhow::ensure!(
            current.gemma_hash == self.gemma_hash
                && current.gemma_json == self.gemma_json
                && current.renderer_hash == self.renderer_hash
                && current.renderer_json == self.renderer_json,
            "UI workspace plugin or renderer seal changed; explicit recovery is required"
        );
        Ok(current.catalog_hash)
    }
}

fn validate_schema_contract(document: &ManifestPinnedSchemaDocument, plugin: &str) -> Result<()> {
    anyhow::ensure!(
        document.schema.name == plugin && document.blob.manifest.plugin_id == plugin,
        "pinned UI contract has the wrong plugin identity"
    );
    Ok(())
}

fn pin_contracts(catalog_dir: &Path, admitted: Option<&PluginSchema>) -> Result<ContractPins> {
    let pins = ContractPins::from_catalog(catalog_dir, read_manifest_pinned_catalog(catalog_dir)?)?;
    if let Some(admitted) = admitted {
        anyhow::ensure!(
            serde_json::to_value(&pins.gemma_schema)? == serde_json::to_value(admitted)?,
            "admitted gemma_brain schema differs from the current sealed plugin"
        );
    }
    Ok(pins)
}

fn validate_plugin_state(schema: &PluginSchema, state: &Value) -> Result<()> {
    let owned = simd_json::serde::to_owned_value(state.clone())?;
    let validation = schema.validate(&owned);
    anyhow::ensure!(
        validation.valid && validation.warnings.is_empty(),
        "UI workspace projection does not match the exact gemma_brain state contract"
    );
    schema
        .validate_exact_schema_fields(&owned)
        .map_err(|_| anyhow::anyhow!("UI workspace exact child contract validation failed"))?;
    // This strict domain decode validates map keys, revisions, provenance,
    // graph limits and every retained child without consulting Cozo.
    UiWorkspaceRecovery::from_plugin_state(state)?;
    Ok(())
}

fn decode_committed(bytes: &[u8], schema: &PluginSchema) -> Result<UiWorkspaceRecovery> {
    let state: Value = serde_json::from_slice(bytes)
        .context("committed private UI workspace is not valid JSON")?;
    validate_plugin_state(schema, &state)?;
    UiWorkspaceRecovery::from_plugin_state(&state)
}

fn compare_revision(previous: Option<&[u8]>, current: &[u8], schema: &PluginSchema) -> Result<()> {
    let candidate = decode_committed(current, schema)?;
    if let Some(previous) = previous {
        let prior = decode_committed(previous, schema)?;
        anyhow::ensure!(
            candidate.document_revision >= prior.document_revision,
            "UI workspace document revision regressed"
        );
        anyhow::ensure!(
            candidate.document_revision != prior.document_revision || current == previous,
            "UI workspace bytes changed without a document revision change"
        );
    }
    Ok(())
}

struct VerifiedOwner {
    access: UiAccessContext,
    key: UiOwnerKey,
}

async fn verify_owner(
    engine: &MutationEngine,
    actor: &str,
    session: Option<&str>,
    genesis: Option<&str>,
    capability: &str,
) -> Result<VerifiedOwner> {
    let session = project_dispatch::verified_session(engine, actor, session, genesis).await?;
    anyhow::ensure!(
        load_capability_grants(actor).contains(capability),
        "current UI workspace capability grant is required"
    );
    let access = UiAccessContext {
        principal_id: actor.to_owned(),
        session_id: session,
        session_genesis: Some(
            genesis
                .context("private Gemma workspace requires verified genesis")?
                .to_owned(),
        ),
    };
    let key = access.owner_key()?;
    Ok(VerifiedOwner { access, key })
}

impl UiWorkspacePublisher {
    pub(crate) fn new(
        private_root: PrivateProjectionDirectory,
        documents: Arc<RuntimeDocuments>,
        catalog_dir: PathBuf,
    ) -> Self {
        Self {
            private_root,
            documents,
            catalog_dir,
            owners: Arc::new(StdMutex::new(HashMap::new())),
            activations: Arc::new(StdMutex::new(ActivationCache::default())),
        }
    }

    fn is_activated(&self, selector: &str) -> Result<bool> {
        Ok(self
            .activations
            .lock()
            .map_err(|_| anyhow::anyhow!("UI workspace activation table is poisoned"))?
            .contains(selector))
    }

    fn mark_activated(&self, selector: &str, active: bool) -> Result<()> {
        self.activations
            .lock()
            .map_err(|_| anyhow::anyhow!("UI workspace activation table is poisoned"))?
            .set(selector, active);
        Ok(())
    }

    fn owner_slot(&self, key: &UiOwnerKey) -> Result<Arc<OwnerSlot>> {
        let selector = key.namespace_component();
        let mut owners = self
            .owners
            .lock()
            .map_err(|_| anyhow::anyhow!("UI workspace owner table is poisoned"))?;
        owners.retain(|_, owner| owner.strong_count() != 0);
        if let Some(owner) = owners.get(selector).and_then(Weak::upgrade) {
            return Ok(owner);
        }
        anyhow::ensure!(
            owners.len() < MAX_LIVE_OWNERS,
            "UI workspace live owner capacity reached"
        );
        let owner = Arc::new(OwnerSlot::new());
        owner
            .activated
            .store(self.is_activated(selector)?, Ordering::Release);
        owners.insert(selector.to_owned(), Arc::downgrade(&owner));
        Ok(owner)
    }

    #[cfg(test)]
    pub(crate) async fn lock_owner_for_test(
        &self,
        key: &UiOwnerKey,
    ) -> Result<UiWorkspaceTestGate> {
        let slot = self.owner_slot(key)?;
        let guard = slot.operation.clone().lock_owned().await;
        Ok(UiWorkspaceTestGate {
            slot,
            _guard: guard,
        })
    }

    fn methods(&self, pins: &ContractPins) -> Result<Arc<UiWorkspaceMethods>> {
        Ok(Arc::new(UiWorkspaceMethods::from_manifest_pinned_renderer(
            self.documents.clone(),
            Arc::<str>::from(pins.renderer_json.clone()),
            pins.renderer_hash.clone(),
        )?))
    }

    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    pub(crate) async fn dispatch(
        &self,
        engine: &MutationEngine,
        admitted: &PluginSchema,
        method: &str,
        args: &Value,
        actor: &str,
        session: Option<&str>,
        genesis: Option<&str>,
        operation_id: &str,
        facade_origin: Option<FacadeOrigin>,
    ) -> Result<Value> {
        anyhow::ensure!(is_ui_workspace_method(method), "not a UI workspace method");
        let declaration = admitted
            .methods
            .get(method)
            .context("admitted gemma_brain method is absent")?;
        let required_capability = declaration
            .required_capability
            .as_deref()
            .context("UI workspace method has no required capability")?;
        let owner = verify_owner(engine, actor, session, genesis, required_capability).await?;
        let pins = tokio::task::spawn_blocking({
            let admitted = admitted.clone();
            let catalog = self.catalog_dir.clone();
            move || pin_contracts(&catalog, Some(&admitted))
        })
        .await
        .context("UI workspace contract worker failed")??;
        let methods = self.methods(&pins)?;
        let slot = self.owner_slot(&owner.key)?;
        let caller = RouterCaller {
            actor: owner.access.principal_id.clone(),
            capability: Some(required_capability.to_owned()),
            session: Some(owner.access.session_id.clone()),
            genesis: owner.access.session_genesis.clone(),
        };

        if READ_METHODS.contains(&method) {
            anyhow::ensure!(
                slot.activated.load(Ordering::Acquire),
                "UI workspace activation is required"
            );
            let _guard = slot.operation.lock().await;
            readmit_workspace_call(engine, &pins, method, &caller, facade_origin.as_ref()).await?;
            return self
                .read_committed_locked(&owner.key, &pins, &methods, method, args)
                .await;
        }

        let recovery = method == "recover_ui_workspace";
        if !recovery && method != "register_tag" {
            anyhow::ensure!(
                slot.activated.load(Ordering::Acquire),
                "UI workspace activation is required"
            );
        }
        self.publish_owned_admitted(
            slot,
            owner,
            pins,
            methods,
            method.to_owned(),
            args.clone(),
            operation_id.to_owned(),
            recovery,
            Some(QueuedWorkspaceAdmission {
                engine: engine.clone(),
                caller,
                facade_origin,
            }),
        )
        .await
    }

    #[cfg(test)]
    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    async fn publish_owned(
        &self,
        slot: Arc<OwnerSlot>,
        owner: VerifiedOwner,
        pins: ContractPins,
        methods: Arc<UiWorkspaceMethods>,
        method: String,
        args: Value,
        operation_id: String,
        recovery: bool,
    ) -> Result<Value> {
        self.publish_owned_admitted(
            slot,
            owner,
            pins,
            methods,
            method,
            args,
            operation_id,
            recovery,
            None,
        )
        .await
    }

    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    async fn publish_owned_admitted(
        &self,
        slot: Arc<OwnerSlot>,
        owner: VerifiedOwner,
        pins: ContractPins,
        methods: Arc<UiWorkspaceMethods>,
        method: String,
        args: Value,
        operation_id: String,
        recovery: bool,
        admission: Option<QueuedWorkspaceAdmission>,
    ) -> Result<Value> {
        let root = self.private_root.clone();
        let owner_selector = owner.key.namespace_component().to_owned();
        let activation_selector = owner_selector.clone();
        let operation_lock = slot.operation.clone();
        let runtime = tokio::runtime::Handle::current();
        let wake_schema_hash = pins.gemma_hash.clone();
        let publisher = self.clone();
        let worker_slot = slot.clone();
        let worker = tokio::spawn(async move {
            // Keep serialization through activation and wake publication. The
            // owned task survives caller cancellation after native submission.
            #[cfg(test)]
            worker_slot.queued.fetch_add(1, Ordering::AcqRel);
            let _guard = operation_lock.lock_owned().await;
            #[cfg(test)]
            worker_slot.queued.fetch_sub(1, Ordering::AcqRel);
            if let Some(admission) = &admission {
                readmit_workspace_call(
                    &admission.engine,
                    &pins,
                    &method,
                    &admission.caller,
                    admission.facade_origin.as_ref(),
                )
                .await?;
            }
            let publication = tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || -> Result<_> {
                let directory = root.prepare_child(&owner_selector)?;
                if recovery {
                    let pending = directory.pending_document()?;
                    let recover = |previous: Option<&[u8]>| -> Result<PrivateDocumentCommit<PublicationReceipt>> {
                        let recovered = runtime.block_on(methods.recover_snapshot(&owner.access))?;
                        let durable = PublicationReceipt::Recovery(recovered.clone());
                        let prepared = (|| -> Result<Option<Vec<u8>>> {
                            let state = recovered
                                .as_ref()
                                .map(UiWorkspaceRecovery::plugin_state)
                                .transpose()?;
                            if let Some(state) = &state {
                                validate_plugin_state(&pins.gemma_schema, state)?;
                            }
                            pins.recheck()?;
                            let bytes = state.as_ref().map(serde_json::to_vec).transpose()?;
                            if let Some(bytes) = &bytes {
                                compare_revision(previous, bytes, &pins.gemma_schema)?;
                            } else {
                                anyhow::ensure!(
                                    previous.is_none(),
                                    "durable UI workspace disappeared during activation"
                                );
                            }
                            Ok(bytes)
                        })();
                        Ok(match prepared {
                            Ok(current) => PrivateDocumentCommit::Publish { current, durable },
                            Err(_) => PrivateDocumentCommit::RetainPending {
                                durable,
                                error: anyhow::anyhow!(
                                    "UI workspace recovered row failed post-durable contract validation"
                                ),
                            },
                        })
                    };
                    if let Some(pending) = pending {
                        anyhow::ensure!(
                            pending.plugin_id == PLUGIN,
                            "private namespace pending owner mismatch"
                        );
                        directory.recover_document_with_decision(
                            PLUGIN,
                            &pending.operation_id,
                            || recover(None),
                        )
                    } else {
                        directory.commit_document_durable_with_decision(
                            PLUGIN,
                            &operation_id,
                            recover,
                        )
                    }
                } else {
                    let minted =
                        (method == "create_ui_spec").then(|| uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string());
                    directory.commit_document_durable_with_decision(
                        PLUGIN,
                        &operation_id,
                        |previous| {
                            let commit = match runtime.block_on(methods.dispatch_mutation(
                                &owner.access,
                                &method,
                                &args,
                                minted.as_deref(),
                            )) {
                                Ok(commit) => commit,
                                Err(error) => {
                                    return match error.downcast::<RuntimeDocumentRejected>() {
                                        Ok(rejected) => Ok(PrivateDocumentCommit::Abort {
                                            error: rejected.into_cause(),
                                        }),
                                        Err(error) => Err(error),
                                    };
                                }
                            };
                            let durable = PublicationReceipt::Mutation(Box::new(commit.clone()));
                            let prepared = (|| -> Result<Vec<u8>> {
                                let _ = commit.method_result()?;
                                let state = commit.plugin_state()?;
                                validate_plugin_state(&pins.gemma_schema, &state)?;
                                let bytes = serde_json::to_vec(&state)?;
                                compare_revision(previous, &bytes, &pins.gemma_schema)?;
                                pins.recheck()?;
                                Ok(bytes)
                            })();
                            Ok(match prepared {
                                Ok(bytes) => PrivateDocumentCommit::Publish {
                                    current: Some(bytes),
                                    durable,
                                },
                                Err(_) => PrivateDocumentCommit::RetainPending {
                                    durable,
                                    error: anyhow::anyhow!(
                                        "UI workspace commit failed post-durable contract validation"
                                    ),
                                },
                            })
                        },
                    )
                }
            })
            .await
            .context("UI workspace publication worker failed")??;

            match publication {
                PrivateDocumentPublication::Committed {
                    projection,
                    durable,
                } => {
                    worker_slot.activated.store(true, Ordering::Release);
                    publisher.mark_activated(&activation_selector, true)?;
                    match durable_receipt(durable, recovery)? {
                        DurableReceipt::Mutation(commit) => {
                            send_wake(
                                &worker_slot,
                                &projection,
                                commit.document_revision,
                                &wake_schema_hash,
                            );
                            commit.method_result()
                        }
                        DurableReceipt::Recovery(recovered) => {
                            if let Some(recovered) = &recovered {
                                send_wake(
                                    &worker_slot,
                                    &projection,
                                    recovered.document_revision,
                                    &wake_schema_hash,
                                );
                            }
                            Ok(serde_json::json!({"workspace": recovered}))
                        }
                    }
                }
                PrivateDocumentPublication::Pending {
                    operation_id,
                    durable,
                    error: _,
                } => {
                    worker_slot.activated.store(false, Ordering::Release);
                    publisher.mark_activated(&activation_selector, false)?;
                    let revision = durable.as_ref().and_then(PublicationReceipt::revision);
                    if let Some(revision) = revision {
                        anyhow::bail!(
                            "ui_workspace_committed_unpublished operation_id={operation_id} document_revision={revision}"
                        )
                    }
                    anyhow::bail!(
                        "ui_workspace_publication_pending operation_id={operation_id} document_revision=unknown"
                    )
                }
            }
        });
        worker
            .await
            .context("UI workspace publication owner failed")?
    }

    async fn read_committed_locked(
        &self,
        key: &UiOwnerKey,
        pins: &ContractPins,
        methods: &UiWorkspaceMethods,
        method: &str,
        args: &Value,
    ) -> Result<Value> {
        let Some(directory) = self.private_root.open_child(key.namespace_component())? else {
            anyhow::bail!("UI workspace activation is incomplete");
        };
        anyhow::ensure!(
            directory.pending_document()?.is_none(),
            "UI workspace publication is pending recovery"
        );
        let mut snapshot = directory.read_snapshot(&[PLUGIN.to_owned()])?;
        let recovery = snapshot
            .states
            .remove(PLUGIN)
            .map(|bytes| decode_committed(&bytes, &pins.gemma_schema))
            .transpose()?;
        pins.recheck()?;
        methods.dispatch_committed_read(method, args, recovery)
    }

    /// Subscribe before the initial private read. StateSync owns path filtering
    /// and frame diffs; this ticket grants access only to this verified owner.
    pub(crate) async fn subscribe_workspace(
        &self,
        engine: &MutationEngine,
        actor: &str,
        session: Option<&str>,
        genesis: Option<&str>,
        declared_capability: &str,
    ) -> Result<UiWorkspaceSubscription> {
        anyhow::ensure!(
            declared_capability == UI_WORKSPACE_READ_CAPABILITY,
            "private UI workspace subscription requires the exact gemma.read header"
        );
        let catalog = self.catalog_dir.clone();
        let pins = tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || pin_contracts(&catalog, None))
            .await
            .context("UI workspace contract worker failed")??;
        anyhow::ensure!(
            pins.gemma_schema.methods[READ_METHOD]
                .required_capability
                .as_deref()
                == Some(UI_WORKSPACE_READ_CAPABILITY),
            "sealed workspace read capability changed"
        );
        let owner = verify_owner(
            engine,
            actor,
            session,
            genesis,
            UI_WORKSPACE_READ_CAPABILITY,
        )
        .await?;
        let slot = self.owner_slot(&owner.key)?;
        anyhow::ensure!(
            slot.activated.load(Ordering::Acquire),
            "UI workspace activation is required"
        );
        let receiver = slot.wake.subscribe();
        let _guard = slot.operation.lock().await;
        let initial = self.read_receipt_locked(&owner.key, &pins).await?;
        drop(_guard);
        Ok(UiWorkspaceSubscription {
            actor: owner.access.principal_id,
            session: owner.access.session_id,
            genesis: genesis.map(str::to_owned),
            owner_key: owner.key,
            slot,
            receiver,
            initial,
        })
    }

    async fn read_receipt_locked(
        &self,
        key: &UiOwnerKey,
        pins: &ContractPins,
    ) -> Result<CommittedUiWorkspace> {
        let directory = self
            .private_root
            .open_child(key.namespace_component())?
            .context("UI workspace activation is incomplete")?;
        anyhow::ensure!(
            directory.pending_document()?.is_none(),
            "UI workspace publication is pending recovery"
        );
        let snapshot = directory.read_snapshot(&[PLUGIN.to_owned()])?;
        let workspace = snapshot
            .states
            .get(PLUGIN)
            .map(|bytes| decode_committed(bytes, &pins.gemma_schema))
            .transpose()?;
        let catalog_hash = pins.recheck()?;
        Ok(CommittedUiWorkspace {
            generation: snapshot.generation,
            schema_hash: pins.gemma_hash.clone(),
            schema_json: pins.gemma_json.clone(),
            renderer_schema_hash: pins.renderer_hash.clone(),
            renderer_schema_json: pins.renderer_json.clone(),
            catalog_hash,
            workspace,
        })
    }

    pub(crate) async fn refresh_subscription(
        &self,
        engine: &MutationEngine,
        subscription: &UiWorkspaceSubscription,
    ) -> Result<CommittedUiWorkspace> {
        let _guard = subscription.slot.operation.lock().await;
        let (owner, pins) = self
            .revalidate_subscription_pins_locked(engine, subscription)
            .await?;
        self.read_receipt_locked(&owner.key, &pins).await
    }

    /// Revalidate a private ticket for heartbeat/pre-emission use without a
    /// projection read. This is authorization and seal checking, not polling.
    pub(crate) async fn revalidate_subscription(
        &self,
        engine: &MutationEngine,
        subscription: &UiWorkspaceSubscription,
    ) -> Result<()> {
        let _guard = subscription.slot.operation.lock().await;
        self.revalidate_subscription_pins_locked(engine, subscription)
            .await
            .map(|_| ())
    }

    async fn revalidate_subscription_pins_locked(
        &self,
        engine: &MutationEngine,
        subscription: &UiWorkspaceSubscription,
    ) -> Result<(VerifiedOwner, ContractPins)> {
        let owner = verify_owner(
            engine,
            &subscription.actor,
            Some(&subscription.session),
            subscription.genesis.as_deref(),
            UI_WORKSPACE_READ_CAPABILITY,
        )
        .await?;
        anyhow::ensure!(
            owner.key.namespace_component() == subscription.owner_key.namespace_component(),
            "UI workspace subscription owner changed"
        );
        anyhow::ensure!(
            subscription.slot.activated.load(Ordering::Acquire),
            "UI workspace activation is required"
        );
        let catalog = self.catalog_dir.clone();
        let pins = tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || pin_contracts(&catalog, None))
            .await
            .context("UI workspace contract worker failed")??;
        anyhow::ensure!(
            pins.gemma_hash == subscription.initial.schema_hash
                && pins.gemma_json == subscription.initial.schema_json
                && pins.renderer_hash == subscription.initial.renderer_schema_hash
                && pins.renderer_json == subscription.initial.renderer_schema_json
                && pins.catalog_hash == subscription.initial.catalog_hash,
            "UI workspace subscription contract changed; resubscribe after explicit recovery"
        );
        Ok((owner, pins))
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
pub(crate) struct UiWorkspaceTestGate {
    slot: Arc<OwnerSlot>,
    _guard: tokio::sync::OwnedMutexGuard<()>,
}

#[cfg(test)]
impl UiWorkspaceTestGate {
    pub(crate) async fn wait_until_queued(&self) {
        tokio::time::timeout(std::time::Duration::from_secs(5), async {
            while self.slot.queued.load(Ordering::Acquire) == 0 {
                tokio::task::yield_now().await;
            }
        })
        .await
        .expect("workspace operation reached its owner queue");
    }
}

struct QueuedWorkspaceAdmission {
    engine: MutationEngine,
    caller: RouterCaller,
    facade_origin: Option<FacadeOrigin>,
}

async fn readmit_workspace_call(
    engine: &MutationEngine,
    pins: &ContractPins,
    method: &str,
    caller: &RouterCaller,
    facade_origin: Option<&FacadeOrigin>,
) -> Result<()> {
    readmit_call(engine, &pins.gemma_schema, PLUGIN, method, caller).await?;
    if let Some(origin) = facade_origin {
        origin.validate_target(PLUGIN, method)?;
        origin.readmit(engine, caller).await?;
    }
    Ok(())
}

enum PublicationReceipt {
    Mutation(Box<UiWorkspaceCommit>),
    Recovery(Option<UiWorkspaceRecovery>),
}

impl PublicationReceipt {
    fn revision(&self) -> Option<u64> {
        match self {
            Self::Mutation(value) => Some(value.document_revision),
            Self::Recovery(value) => value.as_ref().map(|value| value.document_revision),
        }
    }
}

enum DurableReceipt {
    Mutation(Box<UiWorkspaceCommit>),
    Recovery(Option<UiWorkspaceRecovery>),
}

fn durable_receipt(receipt: PublicationReceipt, recovery: bool) -> Result<DurableReceipt> {
    match (receipt, recovery) {
        (PublicationReceipt::Mutation(value), false) => Ok(DurableReceipt::Mutation(value)),
        (PublicationReceipt::Recovery(value), true) => Ok(DurableReceipt::Recovery(value)),
        _ => anyhow::bail!("UI workspace publication receipt kind mismatch"),
    }
}

fn send_wake(
    slot: &OwnerSlot,
    projection: &ProjectionCommit,
    document_revision: u64,
    schema_hash: &str,
) {
    if projection.previous != projection.current {
        let _ = slot.wake.send(UiWorkspaceWake {
            plugin_id: PLUGIN.to_owned(),
            generation: projection.generation,
            document_revision,
            schema_hash: schema_hash.to_owned(),
        });
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub(crate) struct CommittedUiWorkspace {
    pub generation: u64,
    pub schema_hash: String,
    pub schema_json: String,
    pub renderer_schema_hash: String,
    pub renderer_schema_json: String,
    pub catalog_hash: String,
    pub workspace: Option<UiWorkspaceRecovery>,
}

impl CommittedUiWorkspace {
    /// Complete flat gemma_brain workspace state for private path selection.
    /// This is already owner-scoped and contract-validated; callers must not
    /// insert it into the generic public cache or broadcast channel.
    pub(crate) fn plugin_state(&self) -> Result<Option<Value>> {
        self.workspace
            .as_ref()
            .map(UiWorkspaceRecovery::plugin_state)
            .transpose()
    }
}

pub(crate) struct UiWorkspaceSubscription {
    actor: String,
    session: String,
    genesis: Option<String>,
    owner_key: UiOwnerKey,
    slot: Arc<OwnerSlot>,
    pub receiver: broadcast::Receiver<UiWorkspaceWake>,
    pub initial: CommittedUiWorkspace,
}
