<file path="op-grpc-bridge/src/ui_workspace_stream_selection.rs">
//! Explicit private-workspace selection for the existing StateSync transport.
//! This is path syntax only. Verified identity, exact sealed read admission and
//! owner activation are separate mandatory gates before any private SHM read.
use anyhow::{ensure, Result};

const ROOT: &str = "/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/gemma_brain";
const MAX_PATHS: usize = 32;
const MAX_PATH_BYTES: usize = 2048;
const MAX_SEGMENTS: usize = 64;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) struct WorkspaceSelection {
    paths: Vec<String>,
}

fn private_path(path: &str) -> bool {
    ["jobs", "specs"].into_iter().any(|child| {
        let root = format!("{ROOT}/{child}");
        path == root || path.starts_with(&(root + "/"))
    })
}

impl WorkspaceSelection {
    /// Empty/bare-plugin/public selectors remain public. Naming any private
    /// workspace subtree opts into strict private mode; mixed requests reject.
    pub(crate) fn from_subscription(
        plugin_ids: &[String],
        paths: &[String],
    ) -> Result<Option<Self>> {
        if !paths.iter().any(|path| private_path(path)) {
            return Ok(None);
        }
        ensure!(
            plugin_ids.is_empty() || plugin_ids == ["gemma_brain"],
            "private workspace subscriptions require one canonical plugin"
        );
        ensure!(
            !paths.is_empty() && paths.len() <= MAX_PATHS,
            "private workspace subscriptions require 1..=32 explicit paths"
        );
        let mut canonical = Vec::with_capacity(paths.len());
        for path in paths {
            ensure!(
                private_path(path),
                "private and public state selectors cannot be mixed"
            );
            ensure!(
                path.len() <= MAX_PATH_BYTES && path.split('/').count() <= MAX_SEGMENTS,
                "private workspace path exceeds its bounds"
            );
            ensure!(
                !path.chars().any(
                    |character| character.is_control() || matches!(character, '*' | '?' | '\\')
                ) && path
                    .split('/')
                    .skip(1)
                    .all(|part| !part.is_empty() && part != "." && part != ".."),
                "private workspace paths must name exact canonical descendants"
            );
            if !canonical.contains(path) {
                canonical.push(path.clone());
            }
        }
        Ok(Some(Self { paths: canonical }))
    }

    pub(crate) fn from_get_state(plugin_id: &str, path: &str) -> Result<Option<Self>> {
        Self::from_subscription(&[plugin_id.to_owned()], &[path.to_owned()])
    }

    pub(crate) fn paths(&self) -> &[String] {
        &self.paths
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    #[test]
    fn private_mode_requires_explicit_workspace_path_and_never_a_bare_root() {
        for paths in [
            vec![],
            vec![ROOT.to_owned()],
            vec!["/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/*".into()],
        ] {
            assert!(WorkspaceSelection::from_subscription(&[], &paths)
                .unwrap()
                .is_none());
        }
        let paths = vec![
            format!("{ROOT}/jobs"),
            format!("{ROOT}/specs/one/spec/elements/title/props"),
        ];
        let selected = WorkspaceSelection::from_subscription(&[], &paths)
            .unwrap()
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(selected.paths(), paths);
        assert!(WorkspaceSelection::from_get_state("other", &paths[0]).is_err());
    }
    #[test]
    fn malformed_mixed_or_unbounded_selectors_fail_before_owner_lookup() {
        let root = format!("{ROOT}/specs");
        for paths in [
            vec![root.clone(), ROOT.into()],
            vec![root.clone(), "/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/config".into()],
            vec![format!("{root}/*")],
            vec![format!("{root}/one?")],
            vec![format!("{root}/../jobs")],
            vec![format!("{root}//one")],
            vec![format!("{root}/one\n")],
            vec![format!("{root}/{}", "x".repeat(MAX_PATH_BYTES))],
            vec![root.clone(); MAX_PATHS + 1],
        ] {
            assert!(WorkspaceSelection::from_subscription(&[], &paths).is_err());
        }
        assert!(WorkspaceSelection::from_subscription(
            &["gemma_brain".into(), "config".into()],
            &[root]
        )
        .is_err());
    }
}
</file>

<file path="op-grpc-bridge/src/ui_workspace_stream_tests.rs">
use super::*;
use crate::{
    grpc_server::OperationGrpcServer,
    human_principal_dispatch::tests::{
        pk, register, temp_cozo, temp_shm_with_schemas, test_engine, TempCozo, TempShm,
    },
    identity_sled_dispatch::{tests::write_identity, IdentitySledStore},
    proto::{state_sync_server::StateSync, ChangeType},
};
use futures::StreamExt;
use op_plugins::state_plugins::{
    gemma_brain::{
        workspace::{UiAccessContext, UiWorkspaceMethods},
        GemmaBrainPlugin,
    },
    human_principal::HumanPrincipalPlugin,
    identity_sled::IdentitySledPlugin,
    json_render::JsonRenderPlugin,
    runtime_documents::RuntimeDocuments,
    web_ui::WebUiPlugin,
};
use op_state::StatePlugin;
use prost::Message;
use serde_json::json;
use tonic::Response;

struct GrantsEnvironment(Option<std::ffi::OsString>);
impl Drop for GrantsEnvironment {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        match self.0.take() {
            Some(path) => std::env::set_var("OP_GRANTS_PATH", path),
            None => std::env::remove_var("OP_GRANTS_PATH"),
        }
    }
}

struct Fixture {
    engine: Arc<MutationEngine>,
    server: OperationGrpcServer,
    first: HumanPrincipalIdentity,
    second: HumanPrincipalIdentity,
    documents: Arc<RuntimeDocuments>,
    catalog: std::path::PathBuf,
    grants: std::path::PathBuf,
    _environment: GrantsEnvironment,
    _root: tempfile::TempDir,
    _shm: TempShm,
    _cozo: TempCozo,
}

impl Fixture {
    async fn new() -> Self {
        // Reuse the established process-wide principal and SHM guards. No new
        // parallel environment mutex and no caller-selected live paths.
        let cozo = temp_cozo();
        let shm = temp_shm_with_schemas(&[
            HumanPrincipalPlugin::new().schema().unwrap(),
            IdentitySledPlugin::new().schema().unwrap(),
            GemmaBrainPlugin::new().schema().unwrap(),
            JsonRenderPlugin::new().schema().unwrap(),
            WebUiPlugin::new().schema().unwrap(),
            op_plugins::state_plugins::schema_renderer::SchemaRendererPlugin::new()
                .schema()
                .unwrap(),
        ]);
        let engine = test_engine();
        engine
            .install_identity_sled_store_for_test(IdentitySledStore::new(
                op_cozo_store::CozoGraphShuttle::new_in_memory().unwrap(),
            ))
            .unwrap();
        let root = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let documents = Arc::new(RuntimeDocuments::new(
            op_cozo_store::CozoGraphShuttle::new_in_memory().unwrap(),
        ));
        let private = op_core::projection_shm::PrivateProjectionDirectory::prepare(
            &root.path().join("private"),
        )
        .unwrap();
        let catalog = crate::sealed_schema_reader::blob_catalog_dir_from_env();
        engine
            .configure_ui_workspace(private, documents.clone(), catalog.clone())
            .unwrap();
        let mut identities = Vec::new();
        for (byte, name) in [(0xC1, "workspace-first"), (0xC2, "workspace-second")] {
            let key = pk(byte);
            register(&key, name).await.unwrap();
            let sled = write_identity(&engine, &key).await.unwrap();
            identities.push(HumanPrincipalIdentity {
                principal_id: op_identity::session::derive_principal_id(&key),
                human_pubkey: key,
                session_id: sled.session_id,
                session_genesis: sled.genesis.unwrap(),
                expires_at: 0,
            });
        }
        let grants = root.path().join("grants.json");
        let environment = GrantsEnvironment(std::env::var_os("OP_GRANTS_PATH"));
        std::env::set_var("OP_GRANTS_PATH", &grants);
        let first = identities.remove(0);
        let second = identities.remove(0);
        let fixture = Self {
            server: OperationGrpcServer::new(engine.clone()),
            engine,
            first,
            second,
            documents,
            catalog,
            grants,
            _environment: environment,
            _root: root,
            _shm: shm,
            _cozo: cozo,
        };
        fixture.grant_first(true);
        fixture
    }

    fn grant_first(&self, read: bool) {
        let caps = if read {
            vec!["gemma.read", "gemma.invoke"]
        } else {
            vec!["gemma.invoke"]
        };
        std::fs::write(
            &self.grants,
            serde_json::to_vec(&json!({
                (self.first.principal_id.clone()): {"capabilities":caps},
                (self.second.principal_id.clone()): {"capabilities":["gemma.read", "gemma.invoke"]},
            }))
            .unwrap(),
        )
        .unwrap();
    }

    fn request<T>(
        &self,
        body: T,
        identity: &HumanPrincipalIdentity,
        capability: Option<&str>,
    ) -> Request<T> {
        let mut request = Request::new(body);
        request.extensions_mut().insert(identity.clone());
        if let Some(capability) = capability {
            request
                .metadata_mut()
                .insert(DECLARED_CAPABILITY_HEADER, capability.parse().unwrap());
        }
        request
    }

    fn subscription(
        &self,
        paths: Vec<String>,
        identity: &HumanPrincipalIdentity,
    ) -> Request<SubscribeRequest> {
        self.request(
            SubscribeRequest {
                plugin_ids: vec![PLUGIN.into()],
                path_patterns: paths,
                include_initial_state: true,
                include_schema: false,
                ..Default::default()
            },
            identity,
            Some(UI_WORKSPACE_READ_CAPABILITY),
        )
    }

    async fn mutation(
        &self,
        identity: &HumanPrincipalIdentity,
        method: &str,
        args: Value,
    ) -> Value {
        self.engine
            .dispatch_method_call_with_identity(
                PLUGIN,
                method,
                &args.to_string(),
                Some("gemma.invoke"),
                &identity.principal_id,
                Some(&identity.session_id),
                Some(&identity.session_genesis),
            )
            .await
            .unwrap_or_else(|error| {
                panic!("UI workspace fixture mutation '{method}' failed: {error:#}")
            })["result"]
            .clone()
    }

    async fn activate(&self, identity: &HumanPrincipalIdentity) {
        self.mutation(identity, "recover_ui_workspace", json!({}))
            .await;
    }

    async fn get(
        &self,
        identity: &HumanPrincipalIdentity,
        path: &str,
    ) -> Result<GetStateResponse, Status> {
        self.server
            .get_state(self.request(
                GetStateRequest {
                    plugin_id: PLUGIN.into(),
                    object_path: path.into(),
                },
                identity,
                Some(UI_WORKSPACE_READ_CAPABILITY),
            ))
            .await
            .map(Response::into_inner)
    }

    fn durable_methods(&self) -> UiWorkspaceMethods {
        let renderer = crate::sealed_schema_reader::read_manifest_pinned_schema_document(
            &self.catalog,
            "json_render",
        )
        .unwrap();
        UiWorkspaceMethods::from_manifest_pinned_renderer(
            self.documents.clone(),
            Arc::<str>::from(renderer.blob.schema_json.clone()),
            renderer.schema_hash,
        )
        .unwrap()
    }

    async fn web_ui(
        &self,
        identity: &HumanPrincipalIdentity,
        method: &str,
        args: Value,
    ) -> anyhow::Result<Value> {
        let schema = WebUiPlugin::new().schema().unwrap();
        let declaration = &schema.methods[method];
        let capability = schema.resolve_method_capability(declaration);
        let response = self
            .engine
            .dispatch_method_call_with_identity(
                "web_ui",
                method,
                &args.to_string(),
                Some(capability.capability()),
                &identity.principal_id,
                Some(&identity.session_id),
                Some(&identity.session_genesis),
            )
            .await?;
        let result = response["result"].clone();
        jsonschema::Validator::new(&serde_json::to_value(
            declaration.returns.as_ref().unwrap(),
        )?)
        .map_err(|error| anyhow::anyhow!("invalid web_ui output schema: {error}"))?
        .validate(&result)
        .map_err(|error| anyhow::anyhow!("invalid web_ui result: {error}"))?;
        Ok(result)
    }
}

fn path(suffix: &str) -> String {
    format!("/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/{PLUGIN}/{suffix}")
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn gallery_facades_read_only_the_verified_owners_committed_workspace() {
    let fixture = Fixture::new().await;
    fixture.activate(&fixture.first).await;
    fixture.activate(&fixture.second).await;
    let created = fixture
        .mutation(
            &fixture.first,
            "create_ui_spec",
            json!({
                "spec":canvas("private gallery value"), "tags":[]
            }),
        )
        .await;
    let spec_id = created["spec"]["id"].as_str().unwrap();
    let grants = |first: &[&str], second: &[&str]| {
        std::fs::write(
            &fixture.grants,
            serde_json::to_vec(&json!({
                (fixture.first.principal_id.clone()): {"capabilities":first},
                (fixture.second.principal_id.clone()): {"capabilities":second},
            }))
            .unwrap(),
        )
        .unwrap();
    };
    grants(
        &["schema_renderer.read", "gemma.read"],
        &["schema_renderer.read", "gemma.read"],
    );
    let call = |identity: &HumanPrincipalIdentity, method: &str, args: Value| {
        let engine = fixture.engine.clone();
        let identity = identity.clone();
        let method = method.to_owned();
        async move {
            engine
                .dispatch_method_call_with_identity(
                    "schema_renderer",
                    &method,
                    &args.to_string(),
                    Some("schema_renderer.read"),
                    &identity.principal_id,
                    Some(&identity.session_id),
                    Some(&identity.session_genesis),
                )
                .await
        }
    };
    let listed = call(&fixture.first, "list_galleries", json!({}))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(listed["result"]["galleries"][0]["rendering_count"], 1);
    let other = call(&fixture.second, "list_galleries", json!({}))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    // No committed workspace means no gallery for this owner.
    assert_eq!(other["result"]["galleries"], json!([]));
    let args = json!({"gallery_id":"workspace", "rendering_id":spec_id});
    let owned = call(&fixture.first, "get_rendering", args.clone())
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        owned["result"]["rendering"]["spec"],
        canvas("private gallery value")
    );
    assert_eq!(owned["result"]["render_admitted"], true);
    let other = call(&fixture.second, "get_rendering", args.clone())
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(other["result"]["rendering"], Value::Null);
    assert_eq!(other["result"]["render_admitted"], false);
    grants(&["schema_renderer.read"], &["gemma.read"]);
    assert!(call(&fixture.first, "get_rendering", args.clone())
        .await
        .unwrap_err()
        .to_string()
        .contains("nested Gemma"));
    assert!(call(&fixture.second, "get_rendering", args.clone())
        .await
        .is_err());
    grants(&["schema_renderer.read", "gemma.read"], &[]);
    // A durable-only deletion must not change the gallery's committed SHM view.
    fixture
        .durable_methods()
        .delete_spec(
            &UiAccessContext {
                principal_id: fixture.first.principal_id.clone(),
                session_id: fixture.first.session_id.clone(),
                session_genesis: Some(fixture.first.session_genesis.clone()),
            },
            spec_id,
            1,
        )
        .await
        .unwrap();
    let committed = call(&fixture.first, "get_rendering", args).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(committed["result"]["rendering"]["id"], spec_id);
}
fn canvas(text: &str) -> Value {
    json!({"root":"root", "elements":{"root":{"type":"text","props":{"text":text,"className":null},"children":[]}}})
}

#[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread")]
async fn web_ui_render_and_update_use_committed_owner_state_and_preserve_siblings() {
    let fixture = Fixture::new().await;
    fixture.activate(&fixture.first).await;
    fixture.activate(&fixture.second).await;
    let created = fixture
        .mutation(
            &fixture.first,
            "create_ui_spec",
            json!({"spec":canvas("first"),"tags":[]}),
        )
        .await;
    let sibling = fixture
        .mutation(
            &fixture.first,
            "create_ui_spec",
            json!({"spec":canvas("sibling stays"),"tags":[]}),
        )
        .await;
    let other = fixture
        .mutation(
            &fixture.second,
            "create_ui_spec",
            json!({"spec":canvas("other owner"),"tags":[]}),
        )
        .await;
    let id = created["spec"]["id"].as_str().unwrap();
    let sibling_id = sibling["spec"]["id"].as_str().unwrap();
    let other_id = other["spec"]["id"].as_str().unwrap();
    let rendered = fixture
        .web_ui(&fixture.first, "render_page", json!({"spec_id":id}))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(rendered["spec"], created["spec"]);
    assert_eq!(rendered["render_admitted"], true);
    let hidden = fixture
        .web_ui(&fixture.second, "render_page", json!({"spec_id":id}))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(hidden, json!({"spec":null,"render_admitted":false}));

    let args = json!({"spec_id":id,"expected_revision":1,"element_id":"root",
        "properties":{"text":"changed","className":null}});
    let updated = fixture
        .web_ui(&fixture.first, "update_component", args.clone())
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(updated["spec"]["revision"], 2);
    assert_eq!(updated["spec"]["spec"], canvas("changed"));
    let readback = fixture
        .web_ui(&fixture.first, "render_page", json!({"spec_id":id}))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(readback["spec"], updated["spec"]);
    assert_eq!(
        fixture
            .web_ui(&fixture.first, "render_page", json!({"spec_id":sibling_id}))
            .await
            .unwrap()["spec"],
        sibling["spec"]
    );
    assert_eq!(
        fixture
            .web_ui(&fixture.second, "render_page", json!({"spec_id":other_id}))
            .await
            .unwrap()["spec"],
        other["spec"]
    );
    let committed = fixture.get(&fixture.first, &path("specs")).await.unwrap();
    let before = json_value(committed.value.as_ref().unwrap());
    assert_eq!(before[id]["spec"], canvas("changed"));
    assert_eq!(before[sibling_id]["spec"], canvas("sibling stays"));
    assert_eq!(before.as_object().unwrap().len(), 2);
    assert!(fixture
        .web_ui(&fixture.first, "update_component", args.clone())
        .await
        .is_err());
    assert!(fixture
        .web_ui(&fixture.second, "update_component", args)
        .await
        .is_err());
    let after = fixture.get(&fixture.first, &path("specs")).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(json_value(after.value.as_ref().unwrap()), before);

    // A durable owner write alone is insufficient: render_page must continue
    // to return the last MutationEngine publication, including its revision.
    fixture
        .durable_methods()
        .dispatch_mutation(
            &UiAccessContext {
                principal_id: fixture.first.principal_id.clone(),
                session_id: fixture.first.session_id.clone(),
                session_genesis: Some(fixture.first.session_genesis.clone()),
            },
            "update_ui_spec",
            &json!({"spec_id":id,"expected_revision":2,"element_id":"root",
            "properties":{"text":"durable but unpublished","className":null}}),
            None,
        )
        .await
        .unwrap();
    let still_committed = fixture
        .web_ui(&fixture.first, "render_page", json!({"spec_id":id}))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(still_committed, readback);
    fixture.grant_first(false);
    assert!(fixture
        .web_ui(&fixture.first, "render_page", json!({"spec_id":id}))
        .await
        .is_err());
    assert!(fixture.engine.get_state("gemma_brain").await.is_none());
}

}

async fn web_ui_handle_event_commits_pinned_set_state_to_owners_private_shm() {

            Some("gemma.invoke"),
            &fixture.first.principal_id,
            Some(&fixture.first.session_id),
            Some(&fixture.first.session_genesis),
        )
        .await
        .unwrap();
    let result = &response["result"];
    jsonschema::Validator::new(
        &serde_json::to_value(declaration.returns.as_ref().unwrap()).unwrap(),
    )
    .unwrap()
    .validate(result)
    .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(result["action"], "setState");
    assert_eq!(result["event"], "resize");
    assert_eq!(result["spec"]["revision"], 2);
    assert_eq!(result["spec"]["spec"]["state"]["size"], "large");

    // A later durable-only update must not become StateSync authority before
    // the owner publishes it to the private projection.
    let durable_only = fixture
        .durable_methods()
        .handle_event(
            &UiAccessContext {
                principal_id: fixture.first.principal_id.clone(),
                session_id: fixture.first.session_id.clone(),
                session_genesis: Some(fixture.first.session_genesis.clone()),
            },
            &spec_id,
            2,
            "tile",
            "resize",
        )
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(durable_only.document_revision, 3);
    let committed = fixture.get(&fixture.first, &path("specs")).await.unwrap();
    let committed = json_value(committed.value.as_ref().unwrap());
    assert_eq!(committed[spec_id.as_str()]["revision"].as_f64(), Some(2.0));
    assert_eq!(
        committed[spec_id.as_str()]["spec"]["state"]["size"],
        "large"
    );
    assert!(fixture.engine.get_state("gemma_brain").await.is_none());
    assert_eq!(
        fixture
            .get(&fixture.second, &path("specs"))
            .await
            .unwrap_err()
            .code(),
        tonic::Code::NotFound
    );

    let stale = fixture
        .engine
        .dispatch_method_call_with_identity(
            "web_ui",
            "handle_event",
            &arguments.to_string(),
            Some("gemma.invoke"),
            &fixture.first.principal_id,
            Some(&fixture.first.session_id),
            Some(&fixture.first.session_genesis),
        )
        .await
        .unwrap_err();
    assert!(format!("{stale:#}").contains("stale UI spec revision"));
    let mut forged = fixture.first.clone();
    forged.session_id = fixture.second.session_id.clone();
    assert!(fixture
        .engine
        .dispatch_method_call_with_identity(
            "web_ui",
            "handle_event",
            &json!({
                "spec_id":spec_id,
                "expected_revision":2,
                "element_id":"tile",
                "event":"resize"
            })
            .to_string(),
            Some("gemma.invoke"),
            &forged.principal_id,
            Some(&forged.session_id),
            Some(&forged.session_genesis),
        )
        .await
        .is_err());
    let still_committed = fixture.get(&fixture.first, &path("specs")).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        json_value(still_committed.value.as_ref().unwrap())[spec_id.as_str()]["revision"].as_f64(),
        Some(2.0)
    );
}

#[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread")]
async fn queued_web_ui_event_rechecks_original_facade_seal_before_effect() {
    let fixture = Fixture::new().await;
    fixture.activate(&fixture.first).await;
    let created = fixture
        .mutation(
            &fixture.first,
            "create_ui_spec",
            json!({"spec":event_canvas(),"tags":[]}),
        )
        .await;
    let spec_id = created["spec"]["id"].as_str().unwrap().to_owned();
    let owner = UiAccessContext {
        principal_id: fixture.first.principal_id.clone(),
        session_id: fixture.first.session_id.clone(),
        session_genesis: Some(fixture.first.session_genesis.clone()),
    }
    .owner_key()
    .unwrap();
    let gate = fixture
        .engine
        .ui_workspace()
        .unwrap()
        .lock_owner_for_test(&owner)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    let engine = fixture.engine.clone();
    let identity = fixture.first.clone();
    let arguments = json!({
        "spec_id":spec_id,
        "expected_revision":1,
        "element_id":"tile",
        "event":"resize"
    })
    .to_string();
    let call = tokio::spawn(async move {
        engine
            .dispatch_method_call_with_identity(
                "web_ui",
                "handle_event",
                &arguments,
                Some("gemma.invoke"),
                &identity.principal_id,
                Some(&identity.session_id),
                Some(&identity.session_genesis),
            )
            .await
    });
    gate.wait_until_queued().await;

    let mut changed = WebUiPlugin::new().schema().unwrap();
    changed
        .description
        .push_str("; deliberately changed after facade admission");
    op_blob::BlobStore::open(&fixture.catalog)
        .unwrap()
        .write(&op_blob::blobify_plugin_schema("web_ui", changed))
        .unwrap();
    drop(gate);
    let error = call.await.unwrap().unwrap_err();
    assert!(
        format!("{error:#}").contains("web_ui")
            || format!("{error:#}").contains("facade")
            || format!("{error:#}").contains("seal")
    );

    let committed = fixture.get(&fixture.first, &path("specs")).await.unwrap();
    let committed = json_value(committed.value.as_ref().unwrap());
    assert_eq!(committed[spec_id.as_str()]["revision"].as_f64(), Some(1.0));
    assert_eq!(
        committed[spec_id.as_str()]["spec"]["state"]["size"],
        "small"
    );
}
fn json_value(value: &prost_types::Value) -> Value {
    use prost_types::value::Kind;
    match value.kind.as_ref().unwrap() {
        Kind::NullValue(_) => Value::Null,
        Kind::BoolValue(value) => json!(value),
        Kind::NumberValue(value) => json!(value),
        Kind::StringValue(value) => json!(value),
        Kind::ListValue(value) => Value::Array(value.values.iter().map(json_value).collect()),
        Kind::StructValue(value) => Value::Object(
            value
                .fields
                .iter()
                .map(|(key, value)| (key.clone(), json_value(value)))
                .collect(),
        ),
    }
}
async fn frame(stream: &mut WorkspaceStream) -> Result<StateChange, Status> {
    tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(5), stream.next())
        .await
        .expect("bounded stream progress")
        .expect("stream frame")
}

#[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread")]
async fn real_statesync_handlers_gate_owners_read_only_committed_children_and_rehydrate_lag() {
    let fixture = Fixture::new().await;
    let paths = vec![path("specs")];
    // Missing verified extension, missing/duplicate/wrong capability and a
    // valid grant without explicit activation all fail at the actual handler.
    assert_eq!(
        fixture
            .server
            .subscribe(Request::new(SubscribeRequest {
                path_patterns: paths.clone(),
                ..Default::default()
            }))
            .await
            .err()
            .unwrap()
            .code(),
        tonic::Code::Unauthenticated
    );
    let mut missing = fixture.subscription(paths.clone(), &fixture.first);
    missing.metadata_mut().remove(DECLARED_CAPABILITY_HEADER);
    assert_eq!(
        fixture
            .server
            .subscribe(missing)
            .await
            .err()
            .unwrap()
            .code(),
        tonic::Code::PermissionDenied
    );
    let mut duplicate = fixture.subscription(paths.clone(), &fixture.first);
    duplicate.metadata_mut().append(
        DECLARED_CAPABILITY_HEADER,
        UI_WORKSPACE_READ_CAPABILITY.parse().unwrap(),
    );
    assert_eq!(
        fixture
            .server
            .subscribe(duplicate)
            .await
            .err()
            .unwrap()
            .code(),
        tonic::Code::PermissionDenied
    );
    let mut wrong = fixture.subscription(paths.clone(), &fixture.first);
    wrong
        .metadata_mut()
        .insert(DECLARED_CAPABILITY_HEADER, "gemma.invoke".parse().unwrap());
    assert_eq!(
        fixture.server.subscribe(wrong).await.err().unwrap().code(),
        tonic::Code::PermissionDenied
    );
    assert_eq!(
        fixture
            .server
            .subscribe(fixture.subscription(paths.clone(), &fixture.first))
            .await
            .err()
            .unwrap()
            .code(),
        tonic::Code::FailedPrecondition
    );
    let mut forged = fixture.first.clone();
    forged.session_id = fixture.second.session_id.clone();
    assert_eq!(
        fixture
            .get(&forged, &path("specs"))
            .await
            .unwrap_err()
            .code(),
        tonic::Code::Unauthenticated
    );
    assert_eq!(
        fixture
            .server
            .subscribe(fixture.subscription(
                vec![
                    path("specs"),
                    crate::state_stream::plugin_object_path(PLUGIN)
                ],
                &fixture.first
            ))
            .await
            .err()
            .unwrap()
            .code(),
        tonic::Code::InvalidArgument
    );
    assert_eq!(
        fixture
            .server
            .subscribe(fixture.subscription(vec![path("specs/*")], &fixture.first))
            .await
            .err()
            .unwrap()
            .code(),
        tonic::Code::InvalidArgument
    );

    fixture.activate(&fixture.first).await;
    fixture.activate(&fixture.second).await;
    let mut public_wakes = fixture.engine.change_tx().subscribe();
    let first = fixture
        .mutation(
            &fixture.first,
            "create_ui_spec",
            json!({"spec":canvas("PRIVATE_ORIGINAL"),"tags":[]}),
        )
        .await;
    let id = first["spec"]["id"].as_str().unwrap().to_owned();
    let sibling = fixture
        .mutation(
            &fixture.first,
            "create_ui_spec",
            json!({"spec":canvas("PRIVATE_SIBLING"),"tags":[]}),
        )
        .await;
    let sibling_id = sibling["spec"]["id"].as_str().unwrap().to_owned();
    assert!(fixture.engine.get_state(PLUGIN).await.is_none());
    while let Ok(wake) = public_wakes.try_recv() {
        let encoded = format!("{wake:?}");
        assert!(!encoded.contains("PRIVATE_ORIGINAL") && !encoded.contains("PRIVATE_SIBLING"));
    }

    // Neither a newer durable row nor a poisoned RAM cache is stream authority.
    let access = UiAccessContext {
        principal_id: fixture.first.principal_id.clone(),
        session_id: fixture.first.session_id.clone(),
        session_genesis: Some(fixture.first.session_genesis.clone()),
    };
    fixture
        .durable_methods()
        .create_spec(
            &access,
            "durable-only",
            canvas("PRIVATE_UNCOMMITTED"),
            vec![],
        )
        .await
        .unwrap();
    fixture
        .engine
        .update_state_cache(
            PLUGIN.into(),
            simd_json::json!({"specs":{"ram-only":{"secret":"PRIVATE_RAM"}}}),
        )
        .await;
    let selected = fixture.get(&fixture.first, &path("specs")).await.unwrap();
    let selected_json = json_value(selected.value.as_ref().unwrap());
    assert_eq!(selected_json.as_object().unwrap().len(), 2);
    assert!(!selected_json.to_string().contains("PRIVATE_UNCOMMITTED"));
    assert!(!selected_json.to_string().contains("PRIVATE_RAM"));
    assert!(selected.state.is_some());
    assert_eq!(
        fixture
            .get(&fixture.second, &path("specs"))
            .await
            .unwrap_err()
            .code(),
        tonic::Code::NotFound
    );

    let selected_path = path(&format!("specs/{id}/spec/elements/root/props"));
    let mut stream = fixture
        .server
        .subscribe(fixture.subscription(vec![selected_path.clone()], &fixture.first))
        .await
        .unwrap()
        .into_inner();
    let initial = frame(&mut stream).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(initial.frame_kind, StateFrameKind::InitialState as i32);
    assert_eq!(initial.object_path, selected_path);
    assert_eq!(
        json_value(initial.new_value.as_ref().unwrap())["text"],
        "PRIVATE_ORIGINAL"
    );
    assert!(initial.state_generation > 0);
    assert!(!initial.schema_hash.is_empty() && !initial.catalog_hash.is_empty());
    assert!(initial.actor_id.is_empty() && initial.event_id == 0 && initial.event_hash.is_empty());

    // The additive Value preserves descendant type and null presence. Struct
    // stays absent for nonobjects; no envelope or JSON-string substitution.
    for (suffix, expected) in [
        (
            format!("specs/{id}/spec/elements/root/props/text"),
            json!("PRIVATE_ORIGINAL"),
        ),
        (
            format!("specs/{id}/spec/elements/root/props/className"),
            Value::Null,
        ),
        (format!("specs/{id}/spec/elements/root/children"), json!([])),
    ] {
        let response = fixture.get(&fixture.first, &path(&suffix)).await.unwrap();
        assert!(response.state.is_none());
        let wire = GetStateResponse::decode(response.encode_to_vec().as_slice()).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(json_value(wire.value.as_ref().unwrap()), expected);
    }

    // More complete commits than the owner ring can retain force a SHM read;
    // deletion still produces a tombstone even though the trigger is lag.
    let mut revision = 1;
    for n in 0..35 {
        let changed = fixture
            .mutation(
                &fixture.first,
                "update_ui_spec",
                json!({"spec_id":id,"expected_revision":revision,
            "element_id":"root","properties":{
                "text":format!("private-update-{n}"), "className":null}}),
            )
            .await;
        revision = changed["spec"]["revision"].as_u64().unwrap();
    }
    fixture
        .mutation(
            &fixture.first,
            "delete_ui_spec",
            json!({"spec_id":id,"expected_revision":revision}),
        )
        .await;
    let removed = frame(&mut stream).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(removed.frame_kind, StateFrameKind::InitialState as i32);
    assert_eq!(removed.change_type, ChangeType::ObjectRemoved as i32);
    assert_eq!(removed.object_path, selected_path);
    assert!(removed.new_value.is_none() && removed.old_value.is_none());
    assert!(removed.state_generation > initial.state_generation);
    assert_eq!(
        fixture
            .get(
                &fixture.first,
                &path(&format!("specs/{sibling_id}/spec/elements/root/props/text"))
            )
            .await
            .unwrap()
            .value
            .map(|value| json_value(&value)),
        Some(json!("PRIVATE_SIBLING"))
    );

    // Bare plugin/public selection never upgrades into a private namespace.
    let public = fixture
        .server
        .get_state(fixture.request(
            GetStateRequest {
                plugin_id: PLUGIN.into(),
                object_path: String::new(),
            },
            &fixture.first,
            None,
        ))
        .await;
    assert_eq!(public.unwrap_err().code(), tonic::Code::NotFound);
    let mut public_stream = fixture
        .server
        .subscribe(fixture.request(
            SubscribeRequest {
                plugin_ids: vec![PLUGIN.into()],
                include_initial_state: true,
                include_schema: true,
                ..Default::default()
            },
            &fixture.first,
            None,
        ))
        .await
        .unwrap()
        .into_inner();
    let schema = frame(&mut public_stream).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(schema.change_type, ChangeType::SchemaMigration as i32);
    assert!(!format!("{schema:?}").contains("PRIVATE_SIBLING"));
    assert!(
        tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_millis(30), public_stream.next())
            .await
            .is_err()
    );

    // A frame batch is suspended at each yield. Removing the current grant
    // stops the next private frame, even when it was prepared before revocation.
    let mut revoked = fixture
        .server
        .subscribe(fixture.subscription(vec![path("jobs"), path("specs")], &fixture.first))
        .await
        .unwrap()
        .into_inner();
    frame(&mut revoked).await.unwrap();
    fixture.grant_first(false);
    assert_eq!(
        frame(&mut revoked).await.unwrap_err().code(),
        tonic::Code::PermissionDenied
    );
    assert_eq!(
        fixture
            .get(&fixture.first, &path("specs"))
            .await
            .unwrap_err()
            .code(),
        tonic::Code::PermissionDenied
    );
    fixture.grant_first(true);

    // The heartbeat uses the last committed observation and only revalidates
    // access. Deliberately break the isolated private file after opening the
    // ticket: a state poll here would fail instead of emitting metadata.
    let heartbeat_request = fixture.subscription(vec![path("jobs")], &fixture.first);
    let (publisher, ticket, access_check) =
        open(&fixture.engine, &heartbeat_request, fixture.first.clone())
            .await
            .unwrap();
    let heartbeat_generation = ticket.initial.generation;
    let mut heartbeat_only = build_stream(
        fixture.engine.clone(),
        publisher,
        ticket,
        access_check,
        WorkspaceSelection::from_subscription(&[PLUGIN.into()], &[path("jobs")])
            .unwrap()
            .unwrap(),
        false,
        false,
        Duration::from_millis(1),
    );
    let owner_key = access.owner_key().unwrap();
    let private_file = fixture
        ._root
        .path()
        .join("private")
        .join(owner_key.namespace_component())
        .join("gemma_brain.json");
    let committed_bytes = std::fs::read(&private_file).unwrap();
    std::fs::write(&private_file, b"invalid isolated fixture JSON").unwrap();
    let heartbeat = frame(&mut heartbeat_only).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(heartbeat.frame_kind, StateFrameKind::Heartbeat as i32);
    assert_eq!(heartbeat.state_generation, heartbeat_generation);
    assert!(heartbeat.new_value.is_none());
    std::fs::write(&private_file, committed_bytes).unwrap();
    fixture.grant_first(false);
    assert_eq!(
        frame(&mut heartbeat_only).await.unwrap_err().code(),
        tonic::Code::PermissionDenied
    );
    fixture.grant_first(true);

    let mut withdrawn = fixture
        .server
        .subscribe(fixture.subscription(vec![path("jobs"), path("specs")], &fixture.first))
        .await
        .unwrap()
        .into_inner();
    frame(&mut withdrawn).await.unwrap();
    op_blob::BlobStore::open(&fixture.catalog)
        .unwrap()
        .remove_blob("json_render")
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        frame(&mut withdrawn).await.unwrap_err().code(),
        tonic::Code::PermissionDenied
    );
    let renderer_schema = JsonRenderPlugin::new().schema().unwrap();
    op_blob::BlobStore::open(&fixture.catalog)
        .unwrap()
        .write(&op_blob::blobify_plugin_schema(
            "json_render",
            renderer_schema,
        ))
        .unwrap();
    let mut revoked_identity = fixture
        .server
        .subscribe(fixture.subscription(vec![path("jobs"), path("specs")], &fixture.first))
        .await
        .unwrap()
        .into_inner();
    frame(&mut revoked_identity).await.unwrap();
    crate::human_principal_dispatch::tests::revoke(&fixture.first.human_pubkey)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        frame(&mut revoked_identity).await.unwrap_err().code(),
        tonic::Code::Unauthenticated
    );
}

#[test]
fn exact_selection_and_wire_preserve_false_zero_null_arrays_and_deleted_descendants() {
    let tree = json!({"jobs":{"one":{"zero":0,"flag":false,"nullable":null,"items":[false,{"value":"deep"}]}},"specs":{}});
    let paths = vec![
        path("jobs/one/zero"),
        path("jobs/one/flag"),
        path("jobs/one/nullable"),
        path("jobs/one/items"),
        path("jobs/one/items/1/value"),
    ];
    let current = StateSnapshot {
        generation: u64::MAX - 1,
        catalog_hash: "stored-catalog".into(),
        plugins: [(
            PLUGIN.into(),
            PluginSnapshot {
                schema_hash: "stored-schema".into(),
                schema: json!({}),
                state: Some(tree.clone()),
            },
        )]
        .into_iter()
        .collect(),
    };
    let frames = state_snapshot_frames_with_views(
        &current,
        None,
        false,
        true,
        StateFrameKind::InitialState,
        &paths,
        false,
        exact_views,
    )
    .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(frames.len(), 5);
    for frame in frames {
        let decoded = StateChange::decode(frame.encode_to_vec().as_slice()).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(decoded.state_generation, u64::MAX - 1); // typed metadata, not Value numeric fidelity
        let actual = json_value(decoded.new_value.as_ref().unwrap());
        let expected = value_at_path(&tree, &decoded.object_path).unwrap().unwrap();
        if expected.is_number() {
            assert_eq!(actual.as_f64(), expected.as_f64());
        } else {
            assert_eq!(&actual, expected);
        }
    }
    let mut after = current.clone();
    after.generation = u64::MAX;
    after.plugins.get_mut(PLUGIN).unwrap().state = Some(json!({"jobs":{},"specs":{}}));
    let deleted = state_snapshot_frames_with_views(
        &after,
        Some(&current),
        false,
        true,
        StateFrameKind::InitialState,
        &paths,
        true,
        exact_views,
    )
    .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(deleted.len(), 5);
    assert!(deleted.iter().all(
        |frame| frame.change_type == ChangeType::ObjectRemoved as i32 && frame.new_value.is_none()
    ));
    assert!(value_at_path(&tree, &path("jobs/one/items/01")).is_err());
    assert!(exact_views(PLUGIN, &tree, &[path("jobs/*")]).is_err());
}

<file path="op-grpc-bridge/src/ui_workspace_stream.rs">
//! Private principal/session workspace views on the existing StateSync service.
//!
//! The publisher owns admission, activation and committed private SHM reads.
//! Owner notifications contain metadata only and serve solely as wakeups. No
//! private value enters MutationEngine's public state cache or change channel.
use std::{collections::BTreeMap, pin::Pin, sync::Arc, time::Duration};

use futures::Stream;
use serde_json::Value;
use tonic::{Request, Status};

use crate::{
    event_chain_access,
    grpc_server::{
        simd_to_prost_struct, simd_to_prost_value, state_heartbeat_frame,
        state_snapshot_frames_with_views, DECLARED_CAPABILITY_HEADER,
    },
    interceptor::load_capability_grants,
    mutation_engine::MutationEngine,
    oracle_assertion::HumanPrincipalIdentity,
    proto::{GetStateRequest, GetStateResponse, StateChange, StateFrameKind, SubscribeRequest},
    state_stream::{PluginSnapshot, StateSnapshot},
    ui_workspace_dispatch::{
        CommittedUiWorkspace, UiWorkspacePublisher, UiWorkspaceSubscription,
        UI_WORKSPACE_READ_CAPABILITY,
    },
    ui_workspace_stream_selection::WorkspaceSelection,
};

const PLUGIN: &str = "gemma_brain";
const HEARTBEAT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(30);
pub(crate) type WorkspaceStream = Pin<Box<dyn Stream<Item = Result<StateChange, Status>> + Send>>;

struct WorkspaceAccess {
    identity: HumanPrincipalIdentity,
    capability: String,
}

impl WorkspaceAccess {
    #[allow(clippy::result_large_err)]
    fn from_request<T>(
        request: &Request<T>,
        identity: HumanPrincipalIdentity,
    ) -> Result<Self, Status> {
        let declared: Vec<_> = request
            .metadata()
            .get_all(DECLARED_CAPABILITY_HEADER)
            .into_iter()
            .collect();
        if declared.len() != 1 {
            return Err(Status::permission_denied(
                "one exact workspace read capability declaration is required",
            ));
        }
        let capability = declared[0]
            .to_str()
            .map_err(|_| Status::permission_denied("invalid workspace capability declaration"))?
            .to_owned();
        if capability != UI_WORKSPACE_READ_CAPABILITY {
            return Err(Status::permission_denied(
                "exact sealed workspace read capability is required",
            ));
        }
        let access = Self {
            identity,
            capability,
        };
        access.check_grant()?;
        Ok(access)
    }

    #[allow(clippy::result_large_err)]
    fn check_grant(&self) -> Result<(), Status> {
        if !load_capability_grants(&self.identity.principal_id).contains(&self.capability) {
            return Err(Status::permission_denied(
                "current exact-principal workspace read grant is required",
            ));
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    async fn revalidate(
        &self,
        engine: &MutationEngine,
        publisher: &UiWorkspacePublisher,
        ticket: &UiWorkspaceSubscription,
    ) -> Result<(), Status> {
        event_chain_access::validate_identity(engine, &self.identity).await?;
        self.check_grant()?;
        // This is identity/grant/catalog/activation admission only; it does not
        // read SHM on heartbeats and cannot expose an earlier owner snapshot.
        publisher.revalidate_subscription(engine, ticket).await
            .map_err(|_| Status::permission_denied("workspace read admission was withdrawn; reactivate after restoring the exact contract and owner"))
    }
}

async fn open<T>(
    engine: &MutationEngine,
    request: &Request<T>,
    identity: HumanPrincipalIdentity,
) -> Result<
    (
        Arc<UiWorkspacePublisher>,
        UiWorkspaceSubscription,
        WorkspaceAccess,
    ),
    Status,
> {
    let access = WorkspaceAccess::from_request(request, identity)?;
    // Re-check even when called from an already verified StateSync handler.
    event_chain_access::validate_identity(engine, &access.identity).await?;
    let publisher = engine
        .ui_workspace()
        .map_err(|_| Status::failed_precondition("private workspace owner is not configured"))?
        .clone();
    let ticket = publisher.subscribe_workspace(
        engine, &access.identity.principal_id, Some(&access.identity.session_id),
        Some(&access.identity.session_genesis), &access.capability,
    ).await.map_err(|_| Status::failed_precondition("private workspace requires current sealed read admission and explicit activation/recovery"))?;
    access.revalidate(engine, &publisher, &ticket).await?;
    Ok((publisher, ticket, access))
}

pub(crate) async fn subscribe(
    engine: Arc<MutationEngine>,
    request: Request<SubscribeRequest>,
    identity: HumanPrincipalIdentity,
    selection: WorkspaceSelection,
) -> Result<WorkspaceStream, Status> {
    if !request.get_ref().tags.is_empty() {
        return Err(Status::unimplemented(
            "workspace tag selection has no committed selection contract",
        ));
    }
    let (publisher, ticket, access) = open(&engine, &request, identity).await?;
    let req = request.into_inner();
    Ok(build_stream(
        engine,
        publisher,
        ticket,
        access,
        selection,
        req.include_initial_state,
        req.include_schema,
        HEARTBEAT,
    ))
}

#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
fn build_stream(
    engine: Arc<MutationEngine>,
    publisher: Arc<UiWorkspacePublisher>,
    mut ticket: UiWorkspaceSubscription,
    access: WorkspaceAccess,
    selection: WorkspaceSelection,
    include_initial_state: bool,
    include_schema: bool,
    heartbeat_interval: Duration,
) -> WorkspaceStream {
    Box::pin(async_stream::stream! {
        let mut previous = match snapshot(&ticket.initial) {
            Ok(snapshot) => snapshot,
            Err(status) => { yield Err(status); return; }
        };
        let initial = state_snapshot_frames_with_views(
            &previous, None, include_schema, include_initial_state,
            StateFrameKind::InitialState, selection.paths(), false, exact_views,
        );
        match initial {
            Ok(frames) => for frame in frames {
                if let Err(status) = access.revalidate(&engine, &publisher, &ticket).await {
                    yield Err(status); return;
                }
                yield Ok(frame);
            },
            Err(status) => { yield Err(status); return; }
        }
        let mut heartbeat = tokio::time::interval(heartbeat_interval);
        heartbeat.set_missed_tick_behavior(tokio::time::MissedTickBehavior::Delay);
        heartbeat.tick().await;
        loop {
            let force_rehydrate = tokio::select! {
                update = ticket.receiver.recv() => match update {
                    // Never inspect a wake's payload as state or use its
                    // generation as proof that a projection committed.
                    Ok(_) => Some(false),
                    Err(tokio::sync::broadcast::error::RecvError::Lagged(_)) => Some(true),
                    Err(tokio::sync::broadcast::error::RecvError::Closed) => return,
                },
                _ = heartbeat.tick() => None,
            };
            if let Err(status) = access.revalidate(&engine, &publisher, &ticket).await {
                yield Err(status); return;
            }
            if let Some(force_rehydrate) = force_rehydrate {
                let current = match publisher.refresh_subscription(&engine, &ticket).await {
                    Ok(receipt) => match snapshot(&receipt) {
                        Ok(snapshot) => snapshot,
                        Err(status) => { yield Err(status); return; }
                    },
                    Err(_) => { yield Err(Status::failed_precondition("committed private workspace is unavailable; explicit recovery is required")); return; }
                };
                if current.generation != previous.generation || current.catalog_hash != previous.catalog_hash || force_rehydrate {
                    match state_snapshot_frames_with_views(
                        &current, Some(&previous), include_schema, true,
                        if force_rehydrate { StateFrameKind::InitialState } else { StateFrameKind::Update },
                        selection.paths(), force_rehydrate, exact_views,
                    ) {
                        Ok(frames) => for frame in frames {
                            if let Err(status) = access.revalidate(&engine, &publisher, &ticket).await {
                                yield Err(status); return;
                            }
                            yield Ok(frame);
                        },
                        Err(status) => { yield Err(status); return; }
                    }
                    previous = current;
                }
            }
            // Metadata-only heartbeat reports the last observed generation.
            // It does not poll state and makes no freshness/commit assertion.
            if let Err(status) = access.revalidate(&engine, &publisher, &ticket).await {
                yield Err(status); return;
            }
            yield Ok(state_heartbeat_frame(&previous));
        }
    })
}

pub(crate) async fn get_state(
    engine: Arc<MutationEngine>,
    request: Request<GetStateRequest>,
    identity: HumanPrincipalIdentity,
    selection: WorkspaceSelection,
) -> Result<GetStateResponse, Status> {
    let (publisher, ticket, access) = open(&engine, &request, identity).await?;
    let current = snapshot(&ticket.initial)?;
    let state = current
        .plugins
        .get(PLUGIN)
        .and_then(|plugin| plugin.state.as_ref())
        .ok_or_else(|| Status::not_found("workspace has no committed document"))?;
    let selected = value_at_path(state, &selection.paths()[0])
        .map_err(|_| Status::invalid_argument("invalid workspace descendant"))?
        .ok_or_else(|| Status::not_found("workspace descendant is absent"))?;
    let owned = simd_json::serde::to_owned_value(selected)
        .map_err(|_| Status::data_loss("committed workspace value cannot be encoded"))?;
    access.revalidate(&engine, &publisher, &ticket).await?;
    Ok(GetStateResponse {
        state: selected.is_object().then(|| simd_to_prost_struct(&owned)),
        value: Some(simd_to_prost_value(&owned)),
        effective_hash: String::new(),
        at_event_id: 0,
    })
}

#[allow(clippy::result_large_err)]
fn snapshot(receipt: &CommittedUiWorkspace) -> Result<StateSnapshot, Status> {
    let schema: Value = serde_json::from_str(&receipt.schema_json)
        .map_err(|_| Status::data_loss("pinned workspace schema is invalid"))?;
    let state = receipt
        .plugin_state()
        .map_err(|_| Status::data_loss("committed workspace envelope is invalid"))?;
    Ok(StateSnapshot {
        generation: receipt.generation,
        catalog_hash: receipt.catalog_hash.clone(),
        plugins: [(
            PLUGIN.to_owned(),
            PluginSnapshot {
                schema_hash: receipt.schema_hash.clone(),
                schema,
                state,
            },
        )]
        .into_iter()
        .collect(),
    })
}

/// Existing state paths use literal object segments. Arrays additionally accept
/// canonical nonnegative indices. Absence differs from explicit JSON null.
fn value_at_path<'a>(state: &'a Value, path: &str) -> anyhow::Result<Option<&'a Value>> {
    let root = crate::state_stream::plugin_object_path(PLUGIN);
    let suffix = path
        .strip_prefix(&(root + "/"))
        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("workspace path is outside canonical root"))?;
    let mut current = state;
    for segment in suffix.split('/') {
        anyhow::ensure!(
            !segment.is_empty() && segment != "." && segment != "..",
            "invalid workspace path segment"
        );
        current = match current {
            Value::Object(object) => match object.get(segment) {
                Some(value) => value,
                None => return Ok(None),
            },
            Value::Array(items) => {
                anyhow::ensure!(
                    segment == "0"
                        || (!segment.starts_with('0')
                            && segment.bytes().all(|b| b.is_ascii_digit())),
                    "noncanonical workspace array index"
                );
                let index: usize = segment
                    .parse()
                    .map_err(|_| anyhow::anyhow!("workspace array index exceeds range"))?;
                match items.get(index) {
                    Some(value) => value,
                    None => return Ok(None),
                }
            }
            _ => return Ok(None),
        };
    }
    Ok(Some(current))
}

fn exact_views(
    plugin: &str,
    state: &Value,
    paths: &[String],
) -> anyhow::Result<BTreeMap<String, Value>> {
    anyhow::ensure!(plugin == PLUGIN, "invalid private workspace plugin");
    let selection = WorkspaceSelection::from_subscription(&[PLUGIN.to_owned()], paths)?
        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("explicit workspace selection is required"))?;
    let mut selected = BTreeMap::new();
    let mut bytes = 0usize;
    for path in selection.paths() {
        if let Some(value) = value_at_path(state, path)? {
            bytes = bytes
                .checked_add(serde_json::to_vec(value)?.len())
                .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("workspace selected-byte overflow"))?;
            anyhow::ensure!(
                bytes <= 16 * 1024 * 1024,
                "workspace selection exceeds 16 MiB"
            );
            selected.insert(path.clone(), value.clone());
        }
    }
    Ok(selected)
}

#[cfg(test)]
#[path = "ui_workspace_stream_tests.rs"]
mod tests;
</file>

<file path="op-grpc-bridge/src/wake_doorbell.rs">
//! The EMQX doorbell: sled-gated, content-free wakes for private views.
//!
//! Owner decisions (2026-09-19): no broker ACL tables, no MCP over MQTT, no
//! authoritative state on the broker; SHM is the one truth. So the broker
//! carries exactly one thing per commit — `{"seq": <revision>}` on
//! `opdbus/wake/<owner-key>` — and every verdict here is a *function of the
//! identity the client presented*, never a lookup in a policy table:
//!
//! * A doorbell client's MQTT client id **is** its owner key
//!   (`sha256(principal, session, genesis)`, the same key the private
//!   episode view uses). The broker never sees a principal, session, or key.
//! * `client.authenticate`: the password is one of the door's two
//!   credentials — the inline SID1 (`sid1:…`, provisioned container/agent
//!   sessions) or the OIA1 assertion the decoy issued (`oia1:<base64>`, the
//!   browser). Each is verified exactly as the door verifies it (sled match
//!   with the `mqtt` transport scope, or signature/lifetime/replay/source
//!   binding plus the anchored human session), must belong to an unrevoked
//!   registered principal, and must derive exactly the client id.
//! * `client.authorize`: a doorbell client may only SUBSCRIBE to its own
//!   topic, and only while some anchored, unexpired sled still derives its
//!   client id (re-checked on every subscribe). Every other client is denied
//!   the `opdbus/` namespace and otherwise left to the broker's own rules.
//!
//! Revocation: tombstoning a sled makes the next subscribe fail, and the
//! bridge kicks the owner key's connection through `emqx.kick_client`.

use std::net::SocketAddr;

use base64::Engine as _;
use op_cozo_store::EpisodeScope;

use crate::mutation_engine::MutationEngine;
use crate::oracle_assertion::AssertionValidator;

/// Password prefix for an OIA1 assertion (standard base64 of the wire, as
/// the decoy issuer hands it to the browser).
pub(crate) const OIA1_PASSWORD_PREFIX: &str = "oia1:";

/// Verdict for the broker: `Ignore` leaves the broker's own decision.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub(crate) enum Verdict {
    Ignore,
    Allow,
    Deny,
}

/// Owner key for a verified scope — identical to the private view's key.
pub(crate) fn owner_key(scope: &EpisodeScope) -> String {
    crate::chatbot_episode_state::EpisodePublisher::key(scope)
}

/// Is this client id shaped like an owner key (and therefore a doorbell)?
pub(crate) fn is_doorbell_client(client_id: &str) -> bool {
    op_plugins::state_plugins::emqx::valid_owner_key(client_id)
}

fn scope_of(
    sled: &op_plugins::state_plugins::identity_sled::ContainerIdentitySled,
) -> Option<EpisodeScope> {
    Some(EpisodeScope {
        principal_id: op_identity::session::derive_principal_id(&sled.wireguard_pubkey),
        session_id: sled.session_id.clone(),
        session_genesis: sled.genesis.clone()?,
    })
}

/// `client.authenticate` for a doorbell client: the password is a door
/// credential and must derive exactly `client_id`.
pub(crate) async fn authenticate(
    engine: &MutationEngine,
    validator: &AssertionValidator,
    client_id: &str,
    password: &str,
    peer: Option<SocketAddr>,
) -> Verdict {
    if !is_doorbell_client(client_id) {
        return Verdict::Ignore;
    }
    let outcome = if password.starts_with(op_identity::sealed_id::INLINE_PREFIX) {
        authenticate_sid1(engine, client_id, password).await
    } else if let Some(encoded) = password.strip_prefix(OIA1_PASSWORD_PREFIX) {
        authenticate_oia1(engine, validator, client_id, encoded, peer).await
    } else {
        Err("password is neither an inline SID1 nor an OIA1 assertion".into())
    };
    match outcome {
        Ok(()) => Verdict::Allow,
        Err(reason) => {
            tracing::info!(reason, "doorbell authentication refused");
            Verdict::Deny
        }
    }
}

/// The browser's credential: the decoy-issued assertion, verified by the
/// same validator as the door (signature, lifetime, one-time nonce, source
/// binding), resolved to the anchored human session, then consumed.
async fn authenticate_oia1(
    engine: &MutationEngine,
    validator: &AssertionValidator,
    client_id: &str,
    encoded: &str,
    peer: Option<SocketAddr>,
) -> Result<(), String> {
    let wire = base64::engine::general_purpose::STANDARD
        .decode(encoded.trim())
        .map_err(|_| "OIA1 password is not base64".to_string())?;
    let now = chrono::Utc::now().timestamp();
    let mut pending = validator
        .validate_pending_with_bootstrap(&wire, peer, now, false)
        .map_err(|rejection| format!("assertion rejected: {rejection:?}"))?;
    let session = engine
        .ensure_verified_human_session_context(&pending.identity().human_pubkey)
        .await
        .ok_or_else(|| "assertion identity has no anchored session genesis".to_string())?;
    pending.identity_mut().session_id = session.session_id;
    pending.identity_mut().session_genesis = session.genesis_hex;
    let expected = owner_key(&EpisodeScope {
        principal_id: pending.identity().principal_id.clone(),
        session_id: pending.identity().session_id.clone(),
        session_genesis: pending.identity().session_genesis.clone(),
    });
    if expected != client_id {
        return Err("client id is not the owner key of the presented identity".into());
    }
    // Consume the nonce last: a refused connect must not burn the assertion.
    validator
        .consume_pending(pending)
        .map_err(|rejection| format!("assertion rejected: {rejection:?}"))?;
    Ok(())
}

async fn authenticate_sid1(
    engine: &MutationEngine,
    client_id: &str,
    password: &str,
) -> Result<(), String> {
    let claims = op_identity::sealed_id::SealedId::from_inline_ref(password)
        .map_err(|error| format!("password is not an inline SID1: {error}"))?;
    let wire = claims.seal().map_err(|error| error.to_string())?;
    let claims = crate::identity_sled_dispatch::authenticate_sid1_wire(
        engine,
        &wire,
        op_plugins::state_plugins::emqx::WAKE_TRANSPORT_SCOPE,
    )
    .await?;
    // SID1 proves the sled binding, not that its key remains authorized.
    let principal =
        crate::human_principal_dispatch::resolve_key_for_assertion(&claims.wireguard_pubkey)
            .await
            .map_err(|_| "principal registry is unavailable".to_string())?
            .ok_or_else(|| "sealed identity key is not registered".to_string())?;
    if principal.revoked_at != 0 || principal.principal_id != claims.principal_id {
        return Err("sealed identity principal is revoked or mismatched".into());
    }
    let expected = owner_key(&EpisodeScope {
        principal_id: claims.principal_id,
        session_id: claims.session_id,
        session_genesis: claims.session_genesis,
    });
    if expected != client_id {
        return Err("client id is not the owner key of the presented identity".into());
    }
    Ok(())
}

/// `client.authorize`: pure derivation from the client id and the topic,
/// plus a live sled check for doorbell subscriptions.
pub(crate) async fn authorize(
    engine: &MutationEngine,
    client_id: &str,
    subscribe: bool,
    topic: &str,
) -> Verdict {
    let namespace = op_plugins::state_plugins::emqx::WAKE_TOPIC_PREFIX
        .split('/')
        .next()
        .unwrap_or("opdbus");
    let in_namespace =
        topic == namespace || topic.starts_with(&format!("{namespace}/")) || topic.starts_with('$');
    if !is_doorbell_client(client_id) {
        // Devices and other broker clients never touch the wake namespace
        // (or broker-internal `$` topics through us); the rest is the
        // broker's own authorization.
        return if in_namespace && !topic.starts_with("$SYS") {
            Verdict::Deny
        } else {
            Verdict::Ignore
        };
    }
    let own_topic = match op_plugins::state_plugins::emqx::wake_topic(client_id) {
        Ok(topic) => topic,
        Err(_) => return Verdict::Deny,
    };
    if !subscribe || topic != own_topic {
        return Verdict::Deny;
    }
    match sled_still_derives(engine, client_id).await {
        Ok(true) => Verdict::Allow,
        Ok(false) => {
            tracing::info!("doorbell subscribe refused: no anchored sled derives this key");
            Verdict::Deny
        }
        Err(error) => {
            tracing::warn!(%error, "doorbell subscribe refused: sled projection unavailable");
            Verdict::Deny
        }
    }
}

/// Does any anchored, unexpired sled still derive `client_id`? No table:
/// the sleds are the projection the door itself authenticates against.
async fn sled_still_derives(engine: &MutationEngine, client_id: &str) -> anyhow::Result<bool> {
    let now = chrono::Utc::now().timestamp();
    let sleds = crate::identity_sled_dispatch::all_sessions(engine).await?;
    Ok(sleds.iter().any(|sled| {
        sled.is_anchored()
            && !sled
                .expires_at
                .is_some_and(|expiry| expiry != 0 && expiry <= now)
            && scope_of(sled).is_some_and(|scope| owner_key(&scope) == client_id)
    }))
}

/// Owner keys whose sleds no longer derive them: the connections to kick.
pub(crate) fn owner_key_for_sled(
    sled: &op_plugins::state_plugins::identity_sled::ContainerIdentitySled,
) -> Option<String> {
    scope_of(sled).map(|scope| owner_key(&scope))
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    /// The browser path end to end: a decoy-issued assertion for a
    /// registered key with an anchored sled opens the doorbell exactly once,
    /// only for the client id that is that identity's owner key, and the
    /// subscribe verdict follows the live sled.
    #[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread", worker_threads = 2)]
    async fn an_issued_assertion_opens_the_doorbell_once_for_its_own_owner_key() {
        use crate::human_principal_dispatch::tests::{
            pk, register, temp_cozo, temp_shm_with_schemas, test_engine,
        };
        use crate::identity_sled_dispatch::{tests::write_identity, IdentitySledStore};
        use crate::oracle_assertion::tests::{
            signed_with_fields, test_issuer, trust_store_for_issuer,
        };
        use op_state::StatePlugin as _;

        let _cozo = temp_cozo();
        let _shm = temp_shm_with_schemas(&[
            op_plugins::state_plugins::human_principal::HumanPrincipalPlugin::new()
                .schema()
                .unwrap(),
            op_plugins::state_plugins::identity_sled::IdentitySledPlugin::new()
                .schema()
                .unwrap(),
        ]);
        let engine = test_engine();
        engine
            .install_identity_sled_store_for_test(IdentitySledStore::new(
                op_cozo_store::CozoGraphShuttle::new_in_memory().unwrap(),
            ))
            .unwrap();
        let key = pk(0xD7);
        register(&key, "doorbell-fixture").await.unwrap();
        let sled = write_identity(&engine, &key).await.unwrap();
        let scope = EpisodeScope {
            principal_id: op_identity::session::derive_principal_id(&key),
            session_id: sled.session_id.clone(),
            session_genesis: sled.genesis.clone().unwrap(),
        };
        let client_id = owner_key(&scope);
        assert!(is_doorbell_client(&client_id));

        let issuer = test_issuer();
        let validator = AssertionValidator::new(trust_store_for_issuer(&issuer));
        let now = chrono::Utc::now().timestamp();
        let peer: SocketAddr = "127.0.0.1:40000".parse().unwrap();
        let password = |nonce: u8| {
            let signed = signed_with_fields(
                &issuer,
                &key,
                peer.ip(),
                now - 1,
                now + 300,
                [nonce; 16],
                None,
            );
            format!(
                "{OIA1_PASSWORD_PREFIX}{}",
                base64::engine::general_purpose::STANDARD.encode(signed.to_wire())
            )
        };

        // Wrong client id: refused, and the assertion is NOT consumed.
        let first = password(1);
        assert_eq!(
            authenticate(&engine, &validator, &"aa".repeat(32), &first, Some(peer)).await,
            Verdict::Deny
        );
        assert_eq!(
            authenticate(&engine, &validator, &client_id, &first, Some(peer)).await,
            Verdict::Allow,
            "same assertion, right owner key"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            authenticate(&engine, &validator, &client_id, &first, Some(peer)).await,
            Verdict::Deny,
            "one-time nonce: a replayed connect is refused"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            authenticate(&engine, &validator, &client_id, &password(2), Some(peer)).await,
            Verdict::Allow,
            "a fresh assertion opens it again"
        );

        // Subscribe: own topic only, and only while the sled derives the key.
        let topic = op_plugins::state_plugins::emqx::wake_topic(&client_id).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            authorize(&engine, &client_id, true, &topic).await,
            Verdict::Allow
        );
        assert_eq!(
            authorize(&engine, &client_id, false, &topic).await,
            Verdict::Deny
        );
        assert_eq!(
            owner_key_for_sled(&sled).as_deref(),
            Some(client_id.as_str()),
            "the kick targets the same derived key"
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn only_owner_key_shaped_client_ids_are_doorbells() {
        assert!(is_doorbell_client(&"ab".repeat(32)));
        assert!(!is_doorbell_client("device-42"));
        assert!(!is_doorbell_client(&"AB".repeat(32)));
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn non_doorbell_clients_are_kept_out_of_the_wake_namespace_only() {
        let engine = crate::human_principal_dispatch::tests::test_engine();
        assert_eq!(
            authorize(&engine, "device-42", true, "opdbus/wake/#").await,
            Verdict::Deny
        );
        assert_eq!(
            authorize(&engine, "device-42", false, "opdbus/anything").await,
            Verdict::Deny
        );
        assert_eq!(
            authorize(&engine, "device-42", true, "$share/g/opdbus/wake/x").await,
            Verdict::Deny
        );
        assert_eq!(
            authorize(&engine, "device-42", true, "factory/line1/telemetry").await,
            Verdict::Ignore
        );
        assert_eq!(
            authorize(&engine, "device-42", true, "$SYS/brokers").await,
            Verdict::Ignore
        );
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn doorbell_clients_may_only_subscribe_to_their_own_topic() {
        let engine = crate::human_principal_dispatch::tests::test_engine();
        let key = "cd".repeat(32);
        let other = "ef".repeat(32);
        assert_eq!(
            authorize(&engine, &key, false, &format!("opdbus/wake/{key}")).await,
            Verdict::Deny,
            "doorbells never publish"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            authorize(&engine, &key, true, &format!("opdbus/wake/{other}")).await,
            Verdict::Deny
        );
        assert_eq!(
            authorize(&engine, &key, true, "opdbus/wake/+").await,
            Verdict::Deny
        );
        // Own topic, but no sled derives the key in this fixture.
        assert_eq!(
            authorize(&engine, &key, true, &format!("opdbus/wake/{key}")).await,
            Verdict::Deny
        );
        let validator =
            AssertionValidator::new(crate::oracle_assertion::DecoyTrustStore::parse_bytes(b"{}"));
        assert_eq!(
            authenticate(&engine, &validator, "device-42", "whatever", None).await,
            Verdict::Ignore
        );
        for password in [
            "not-a-credential",
            "sid1:!!",
            "oia1:not-base64!",
            "oia1:QUJDRA==",
        ] {
            assert_eq!(
                authenticate(&engine, &validator, &key, password, None).await,
                Verdict::Deny,
                "{password}"
            );
        }
    }
}

<file path="op-grpc-bridge/src/web_ui_dispatch.rs">
//! Capability-preserving Web UI facade into the canonical private Gemma workspace.

use anyhow::{Context, Result};

use crate::{
    interceptor::load_capability_grants, method_contract_admission,
    mutation_engine::MutationEngine, project_dispatch, tched_router_admission::FacadeOrigin,
};
use op_plugins::state_plugins::web_ui_methods::{complete_method, plan_method, TargetPlan};
use op_state_store::PluginSchema;

fn admit_target(plan: &TargetPlan, actor: &str) -> Result<()> {
    let declaration = method_contract_admission::admit_compiled_method(
        plan.plugin_id,
        plan.method,
        Some(&plan.required_capability),
    )?;
    method_contract_admission::validate_admitted_arguments(&declaration, &plan.args)?;
    anyhow::ensure!(
        load_capability_grants(actor).contains(&plan.required_capability),
        "exact nested gemma_brain capability grant is required"
    );
    Ok(())
}

/// The outer Web UI call is already admitted. The nested call repeats exact
/// Gemma admission at the final workspace boundary with the same verified
/// identity/session/genesis and therefore cannot turn a Web UI grant into a
/// workspace grant.
pub(crate) fn dispatch<'a>(
    engine: &'a MutationEngine,
    method: &'a str,
    args: &'a serde_json::Value,
    actor: &'a str,
    session: Option<&'a str>,
    genesis: Option<&'a str>,
    admitted: &'a PluginSchema,
) -> futures::future::BoxFuture<'a, Result<serde_json::Value>> {
    Box::pin(async move {
        let outer = admitted
            .methods
            .get(method)
            .context("admitted web_ui method is absent")?;
        let outer_capability = admitted
            .resolve_method_capability(outer)
            .capability()
            .to_owned();
        anyhow::ensure!(
            load_capability_grants(actor).contains(&outer_capability),
            "current exact web_ui facade capability grant is required"
        );
        let plan = plan_method(method, args)?;
        admit_target(&plan, actor)?;
        let verified_session =
            project_dispatch::verified_session(engine, actor, session, genesis).await?;
        let target_args = serde_json::to_string(&plan.args)?;
        let engine = MutationEngine::clone(engine);
        let actor = actor.to_owned();
        let genesis = genesis.map(str::to_owned);
        let target_capability = plan.required_capability.clone();
        let target_plugin = plan.plugin_id;
        let target_method = plan.method;
        let origin = FacadeOrigin {
            plugin: "web_ui",
            method: method.to_owned(),
            target_plugin,
            target_method,
            admitted: admitted.clone(),
            capability: outer_capability,
        };
        let target_result = tokio::spawn(async move {
            Box::pin(engine.dispatch_method_call_with_facade_origin(
                target_plugin,
                target_method,
                &target_args,
                Some(&target_capability),
                &actor,
                Some(&verified_session),
                genesis.as_deref(),
                origin,
            ))
            .await
        })
        .await
        .context("web_ui target task failed")?
        .with_context(|| {
            format!("web_ui.{method} target {target_plugin}.{target_method} failed")
        })?;
        let target_domain = target_result
            .get("result")
            .cloned()
            .context("canonical gemma_brain response is missing its domain result")?;
        complete_method(method, target_domain)
    })
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use op_state::StatePlugin;

    #[test]
    fn facade_plan_never_weakens_workspace_capability() {
        for (facade, args) in [
            ("render_page", serde_json::json!({"spec_id":"spec"})),
            (
                "update_component",
                serde_json::json!({
                    "spec_id":"spec",
                    "expected_revision":2,
                    "element_id":"heading",
                    "properties":{"text":"new"}
                }),
            ),
        ] {
            let plan = plan_method(facade, &args).unwrap();
            let target = op_plugins::state_plugins::gemma_brain::GemmaBrainPlugin::new()
                .schema()
                .unwrap();
            let declaration = &target.methods[plan.method];
            assert_eq!(
                plan.required_capability,
                target.resolve_method_capability(declaration).capability()
            );
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn event_uses_exact_workspace_mutation_capability() {
        let plan = plan_method(
            "handle_event",
            &serde_json::json!({"spec_id":"spec","expected_revision":1,"element_id":"tile","event":"resize"}),
        )
        .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(plan.method, "handle_ui_event");
        assert_eq!(plan.required_capability, "gemma.invoke");
    }
}
