<file path="op-grpc-bridge/tests/support/mod.rs">
//! Isolated catalogs for tests entering the real compiled/sealed admission gate.
#![allow(dead_code)]
use std::sync::{Mutex, MutexGuard};

pub struct CatalogScope {
    _guard: MutexGuard<'static, ()>,
    _root: tempfile::TempDir,
    environment: Vec<(&'static str, Option<std::ffi::OsString>)>,
}

impl CatalogScope {
    pub fn new(schemas: &[op_state_store::PluginSchema]) -> Self {
        static ENVIRONMENT: Mutex<()> = Mutex::new(());
        let guard = ENVIRONMENT
            .lock()
            .unwrap_or_else(|error| error.into_inner());
        let root = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let environment = [
            "OP_BLOB_CATALOG_DIR",
            "OP_SHM_STATE_DIR",
            "DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS",
            "OP_PLUGIN_RUNTIME_COZO_PATH",
            "OP_IDENTITY_PROJECTION_GROUP",
        ]
        .into_iter()
        .map(|key| (key, std::env::var_os(key)))
        .collect();
        let catalog = root.path().join("blobs");
        let mut sealer = op_blob::BlobStore::open(&catalog).unwrap();
        for schema in schemas {
            sealer
                .write(&op_blob::blobify_plugin_schema(
                    &schema.name,
                    schema.clone(),
                ))
                .unwrap();
        }
        std::env::set_var("OP_BLOB_CATALOG_DIR", catalog);
        std::env::set_var("OP_SHM_STATE_DIR", root.path().join("state"));
        std::env::set_var(
            "OP_IDENTITY_PROJECTION_GROUP",
            nix::unistd::Group::from_gid(nix::unistd::Gid::current())
                .unwrap()
                .expect("test process group exists")
                .name,
        );
        std::env::set_var(
            "OP_PLUGIN_RUNTIME_COZO_PATH",
            root.path().join("runtime-documents"),
        );
        std::env::set_var(
            "DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS",
            format!("unix:path={}/absent-bus", root.path().display()),
        );
        Self {
            _guard: guard,
            _root: root,
            environment,
        }
    }

    pub fn root(&self) -> &std::path::Path {
        self._root.path()
    }
}

impl Drop for CatalogScope {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        for (key, value) in &self.environment {
            match value {
                Some(value) => std::env::set_var(key, value),
                None => std::env::remove_var(key),
            }
        }
    }
}

/// Seed the result of an isolated identity-container provision before asking
/// MutationEngine to recover and mint its SID1. This mirrors the production
/// typed Cozo lifecycle boundary without invoking Incus in a test.
pub fn provision_identity_record(
    cozo: &op_cozo_store::CozoGraphShuttle,
    root: &std::path::Path,
    wireguard_pubkey: &str,
) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
    use op_cozo_store::{IdentityCompareExchange, IdentityIntent, IdentitySledRecord};
    use op_plugins::state_plugins::{
        identity_sled::{ContainerIdentitySled, SledBtrfsDevice, RECORD_FORMAT},
        incus::IncusInstance,
    };

    let session_id = op_identity::session::derive_session_id(wireguard_pubkey);
    let now = chrono::Utc::now().timestamp();
    let btrfs_root = root.join("identity-btrfs").join(&session_id);
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&btrfs_root)?;
    let sled = ContainerIdentitySled {
        session_id: session_id.clone(),
        wireguard_pubkey: wireguard_pubkey.to_owned(),
        interface: String::new(),
        peer_ip: None,
        mutation_index: 0,
        genesis: None,
        trace_id: String::new(),
        schema_version: RECORD_FORMAT,
        vector_id: String::new(),
        sealed_id: None,
        principal_kind: Some("human".to_owned()),
        btrfs_device: Some(SledBtrfsDevice {
            device_path: btrfs_root.join("fstorage.img").display().to_string(),
            mount_point: btrfs_root.join("mount").display().to_string(),
            btrfs_uuid: "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001".to_owned(),
            cozo_id: session_id.clone(),
            attached: false,
        }),
        instance: Some(IncusInstance {
            name: session_id.clone(),
            status: "Stopped".to_owned(),
            instance_type: "container".to_owned(),
            profiles: vec!["identity".to_owned()],
            config: Some(std::collections::HashMap::from([(
                "boot.autostart".to_owned(),
                "false".to_owned(),
            )])),
            ..Default::default()
        }),
        session_started_at: now,
        last_seen_at: now,
        active: false,
        expires_at: None,
        arrival_timestamp: 0,
        chain_head_at_arrival: String::new(),
        catalog_hash_at_arrival: String::new(),
        head_timestamp_at_arrival: 0,
    };
    let expected = cozo.read_identity_revision(&session_id)?;
    cozo.apply_identity_intent(
        &session_id,
        &format!("fixture-provision-{}", uuid::Uuid::new_v4().simple()),
        IdentityIntent::CompareExchange(Box::new(IdentityCompareExchange {
            expected,
            record: Some(IdentitySledRecord {
                session_id: sled.session_id.clone(),
                wireguard_pubkey: sled.wireguard_pubkey.clone(),
                interface: sled.interface.clone(),
                peer_ip: sled.peer_ip.clone().unwrap_or_default(),
                mutation_index: 0,
                session_genesis: String::new(),
                trace_id: String::new(),
                schema_version: i64::from(RECORD_FORMAT),
                vector_id: sled.vector_id.clone(),
                sealed_id: String::new(),
                principal_kind: sled.principal_kind.clone(),
                btrfs_device_json: serde_json::to_string(
                    sled.btrfs_device.as_ref().expect("fixture btrfs device"),
                )?,
                instance_json: serde_json::to_string(
                    sled.instance.as_ref().expect("fixture identity instance"),
                )?,
                session_started_at: sled.session_started_at,
                last_seen_at: sled.last_seen_at,
                active: false,
                expires_at: 0,
            }),
            genesis: None,
        })),
    )?;
    Ok(())
}
</file>

<file path="op-grpc-bridge/tests/accountability_audit_trail.rs">
//! Integration tests for the audit-trail query surface
//! (`.kiro/specs/accountability-audit-trail`).
//!
//! These exercise `MutationEngine::dispatch_method_call` directly, which is the
//! single dispatch path behind both `PluginV1.Call` over D-Bus and the generated
//! per-plugin gRPC methods. They assert the two things the spec's acceptance
//! criteria hinge on:
//!
//!   1. `snowball.query_events` / `snowball.verify_chain` return real audit
//!      data — not the catch-all echo of their input.
//!   2. Missing runtime ownership and undeclared methods fail explicitly.

mod support;

use std::sync::Arc;

use op_grpc_bridge::MutationEngine;
use op_state::StatePlugin;

fn catalog() -> support::CatalogScope {
    support::CatalogScope::new(&[
        op_plugins::state_plugins::snowball_plugin::SnowballPlugin::new()
            .schema()
            .unwrap(),
        op_plugins::state_plugins::endpoint::EndpointPlugin::new()
            .schema()
            .unwrap(),
    ])
}

fn engine() -> Arc<MutationEngine> {
    let event_chain = Arc::new(tokio::sync::RwLock::new(op_state_store::EventChain::new(
        op_state_store::ChainConfig::default(),
    )));
    let ovsdb = Arc::new(op_network::rovs_proxy::OvsdbDbusClient::new());
    Arc::new(MutationEngine::new(event_chain, ovsdb))
}

/// Every dispatch records an event, so calling a method is how we populate the
/// chain under test.
async fn record_calls(engine: &MutationEngine, count: usize) {
    for _ in 0..count {
        engine
            .dispatch_method_call(
                "snowball",
                "verify_chain",
                "{}",
                Some("snowball.read"),
                "test-actor",
            )
            .await
            .expect("verify_chain dispatches and records an event");
    }
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn query_events_returns_real_audit_data_not_echo() {
    let _catalog = catalog();
    let engine = engine();
    record_calls(&engine, 3).await;

    let response = engine
        .dispatch_method_call(
            "snowball",
            "query_events",
            "{\"limit\":10}",
            Some("snowball.read"),
            "test-actor",
        )
        .await
        .expect("query_events dispatches");

    let result = &response["result"];

    // An echo would surface the input key `limit` and carry no `events` array.
    assert!(
        result.get("limit").is_none(),
        "query_events echoed its input instead of dispatching: {result}"
    );
    let events = result["events"]
        .as_array()
        .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("expected an events array, got: {result}"));

    // 3 recorded calls + the query_events call itself, which is also audited.
    assert_eq!(events.len(), 4, "unexpected page: {result}");
    assert_eq!(result["has_more"], serde_json::json!(false));
    assert_eq!(result["total_in_chain"], serde_json::json!(4));

    // Records carry the accountability surface, not just ids.
    let first = &events[0];
    assert_eq!(first["plugin_id"], serde_json::json!("snowball"));
    assert_eq!(first["method_name"], serde_json::json!("verify_chain"));
    assert_eq!(first["actor_id"], serde_json::json!("test-actor"));
    assert_eq!(first["capability_id"], serde_json::json!("snowball.read"));
    assert_eq!(first["decision"], serde_json::json!("Allow"));
    assert!(!first["event_hash"].as_str().unwrap_or_default().is_empty());
    assert!(!first["timestamp"].as_str().unwrap_or_default().is_empty());
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn query_events_filters_and_clamps_limit() {
    let _catalog = catalog();
    let engine = engine();
    record_calls(&engine, 5).await;

    // limit=2 must return exactly 2 rows and report more available.
    let paged = engine
        .dispatch_method_call(
            "snowball",
            "query_events",
            "{\"limit\":2}",
            Some("snowball.read"),
            "test-actor",
        )
        .await
        .expect("dispatch");
    let paged = &paged["result"];
    assert_eq!(paged["events"].as_array().map(Vec::len), Some(2));
    assert_eq!(paged["has_more"], serde_json::json!(true));

    // An over-max limit is clamped silently rather than rejected (FR-4).
    let clamped = engine
        .dispatch_method_call(
            "snowball",
            "query_events",
            "{\"limit\":100000}",
            Some("snowball.read"),
            "test-actor",
        )
        .await
        .expect("dispatch");
    assert!(
        clamped["result"]["events"]
            .as_array()
            .map(Vec::len)
            .unwrap()
            <= 100,
        "limit was not clamped to 100"
    );

    // plugin_id filter excludes other plugins' events.
    let filtered = engine
        .dispatch_method_call(
            "snowball",
            "query_events",
            "{\"plugin_id\":\"snowball\",\"limit\":50}",
            Some("snowball.read"),
            "test-actor",
        )
        .await
        .expect("dispatch");
    let rows = filtered["result"]["events"].as_array().cloned().unwrap();
    assert!(!rows.is_empty(), "plugin filter returned nothing");
    assert!(
        rows.iter()
            .all(|e| e["plugin_id"] == serde_json::json!("snowball")),
        "plugin filter leaked other plugins"
    );

    // decision filter maps onto the chain's Decision enum.
    let denied = engine
        .dispatch_method_call(
            "snowball",
            "query_events",
            "{\"decision\":\"deny\",\"limit\":50}",
            Some("snowball.read"),
            "test-actor",
        )
        .await
        .expect("dispatch");
    assert_eq!(
        denied["result"]["events"].as_array().map(Vec::len),
        Some(0),
        "no events were denied, so the deny filter must return an empty page"
    );
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn verify_chain_reports_integrity() {
    let _catalog = catalog();
    let engine = engine();
    record_calls(&engine, 4).await;

    let response = engine
        .dispatch_method_call(
            "snowball",
            "verify_chain",
            "{}",
            Some("snowball.read"),
            "test-actor",
        )
        .await
        .expect("verify_chain dispatches");
    let result = &response["result"];

    assert_eq!(result["valid"], serde_json::json!(true), "chain: {result}");
    // 4 recorded calls + this verify_chain call, which is itself audited.
    assert_eq!(result["events_verified"], serde_json::json!(5));
    assert_eq!(result["errors"], serde_json::json!([]));
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn snowball_methods_require_the_initialized_shared_backend() {
    let _catalog = catalog();
    let engine = engine();

    for (method, args, capability) in [
        ("list_snapshots", "{}", "snowball.read"),
        (
            "get_snapshot",
            "{\"snapshot_name\":\"SNP-state-00000000000000000001\"}",
            "snowball.read",
        ),
        ("create_snapshot", "{}", "snowball.invoke"),
        (
            "rollback",
            "{\"snapshot_name\":\"SNP-state-00000000000000000001\"}",
            "snowball.invoke",
        ),
        ("get_current_state", "{}", "snowball.read"),
        (
            "set_retention",
            "{\"hourly\":1,\"daily\":1,\"weekly\":1,\"quarterly\":1}",
            "snowball.invoke",
        ),
        ("get_stats", "{}", "snowball.read"),
    ] {
        let error = engine
            .dispatch_method_call("snowball", method, args, Some(capability), "test-actor")
            .await
            .expect_err("method requires initialized durable backend");
        assert!(
            error
                .to_string()
                .contains("durable Snowball backend is not initialized"),
            "unexpected error for {method}: {error}"
        );
    }
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn undeclared_method_is_rejected_and_its_attempt_remains_auditable() {
    let _catalog = catalog();
    let engine = engine();
    let error = engine
        .dispatch_method_call(
            "endpoint",
            "missing_method",
            "{}",
            Some("endpoint.read"),
            "test-actor",
        )
        .await
        .expect_err("undeclared method cannot reach any backend");
    assert!(
        error.to_string().contains("absent from pinned seal"),
        "unexpected error: {error}"
    );

    // Rejection happens after the immutable attempted-call event is recorded.
    let audit = engine
        .dispatch_method_call(
            "snowball",
            "query_events",
            "{\"plugin_id\":\"endpoint\",\"limit\":10}",
            Some("snowball.read"),
            "test-actor",
        )
        .await
        .expect("audit query remains supported");
    let events = audit["result"]["events"]
        .as_array()
        .expect("audit events array");
    assert_eq!(events.len(), 1);
    assert_eq!(events[0]["plugin_id"], serde_json::json!("endpoint"));
    assert_eq!(
        events[0]["method_name"],
        serde_json::json!("missing_method")
    );
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn audit_methods_are_declared_in_the_plugin_schema() {
    use op_state::StatePlugin;
    use op_state_store::SideEffect;

    let schema = op_plugins::state_plugins::snowball_plugin::SnowballPlugin::new()
        .schema()
        .expect("snowball plugin publishes a schema");

    for name in ["query_events", "verify_chain"] {
        let decl = schema
            .methods
            .get(name)
            .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("{name} missing from schema.methods"));
        assert!(matches!(decl.side_effect, SideEffect::Read));
        assert_eq!(decl.required_capability.as_deref(), Some("snowball.read"));
        assert!(decl.returns.is_some(), "{name} must declare a typed output");
    }

    // Snapshot methods retain their declared, separately gated surface.
    for name in [
        "create_snapshot",
        "list_snapshots",
        "get_snapshot",
        "rollback",
        "get_current_state",
        "set_retention",
        "get_stats",
    ] {
        assert!(
            schema.methods.contains_key(name),
            "{name} disappeared from the schema"
        );
    }
}

/// FR-6: events are written to the `timing_subvol` and the NUMA-aware Btrfs
/// cache as they happen, and a fresh engine over the same path rebuilds the
/// chain from disk — the "survives a restart" claim, exercised without touching
/// a live service.
///
/// The chain path must be on Btrfs (`StreamingSnowball` creates subvolumes).
/// If subvolume creation is unavailable the durability sink stays disabled by
/// design (NFR-4), and this test says so rather than silently passing.
#[tokio::test]
async fn audit_trail_persists_and_survives_a_restart() {
    let _catalog = catalog();
    let test_root = tempfile::Builder::new()
        .prefix("opdbus-audit-test-")
        .tempdir()
        .expect("unique audit test directory");
    let base = test_root.path().join("snowball");
    let base_path = base.to_string_lossy().to_string();

    // ── First "process": record events with durability enabled ──────────────
    let first = engine();
    first.init_audit_durability_at(&base_path).await;
    record_calls(&first, 3).await;

    let timing = base.join("timing");
    let files: Vec<_> = std::fs::read_dir(&timing)
        .map(|dir| {
            dir.filter_map(Result::ok)
                .filter(|e| e.path().extension().and_then(|x| x.to_str()) == Some("json"))
                .collect()
        })
        .unwrap_or_default();

    if files.is_empty() {
        // Sink unavailable (no Btrfs / no permission). Assert the documented
        // degraded behaviour instead: dispatch still succeeds and the in-memory
        // chain is intact.
        let live = first
            .dispatch_method_call(
                "snowball",
                "query_events",
                "{\"limit\":10}",
                Some("snowball.read"),
                "test-actor",
            )
            .await
            .expect("dispatch must succeed even without a durable sink");
        assert!(
            live["result"]["events"]
                .as_array()
                .map(Vec::len)
                .unwrap_or(0)
                >= 3,
            "in-memory chain must still hold the events"
        );
        eprintln!(
            "durable sink unavailable at {base_path}; verified degraded (RAM-only) behaviour"
        );
        return;
    }

    // One file per event: 3 dispatches, each audited.
    assert_eq!(
        files.len(),
        3,
        "expected one timing record per event, found {}",
        files.len()
    );

    let cache = base.with_file_name(format!(
        "{}-cache",
        base.file_name().and_then(|name| name.to_str()).unwrap()
    ));
    let cached_blocks: Vec<_> = std::fs::read_dir(cache.join("blocks/by-hash"))
        .expect("optimized audit cache must be initialized with the timing trail")
        .filter_map(Result::ok)
        .filter(|entry| entry.path().extension().and_then(|ext| ext.to_str()) == Some("json"))
        .collect();
    assert_eq!(
        cached_blocks.len(),
        3,
        "expected every timing footprint to be mirrored into the Btrfs cache"
    );

    // ── Second "process": fresh empty chain, same path ──────────────────────
    let second = engine();
    let replayed = second.init_audit_durability_at(&base_path).await;
    assert_eq!(replayed, 3, "rebuild did not replay every persisted event");

    let restored = second
        .dispatch_method_call(
            "snowball",
            "query_events",
            "{\"limit\":10}",
            Some("snowball.read"),
            "test-actor",
        )
        .await
        .expect("dispatch");
    let restored = &restored["result"];
    let events = restored["events"].as_array().expect("events array");

    // 3 replayed from disk + this query_events call.
    assert_eq!(events.len(), 4, "restored page: {restored}");
    assert_eq!(events[0]["method_name"], serde_json::json!("verify_chain"));
    assert_eq!(events[0]["plugin_id"], serde_json::json!("snowball"));

    // Hash linkage survived persistence, so the rebuilt chain verifies and the
    // new event continues the chain instead of restarting the ids.
    let verified = second
        .dispatch_method_call(
            "snowball",
            "verify_chain",
            "{}",
            Some("snowball.read"),
            "test-actor",
        )
        .await
        .expect("dispatch");
    assert_eq!(
        verified["result"]["valid"],
        serde_json::json!(true),
        "rebuilt chain failed verification: {}",
        verified["result"]
    );
    assert_eq!(events[3]["event_id"], serde_json::json!(4));

    let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&base);
}
</file>

<file path="op-grpc-bridge/tests/chain_event_broadcast.rs">
//! `EventChainService.SubscribeEvents` is fed by the mutation pipeline itself.
//!
//! Both doors that append to the event chain — `dispatch_method_call` and
//! `process_authoritative_change` — must publish what they appended on the
//! engine's chain broadcast. If they don't, the audit stream is silently empty
//! while the ledger behind `GetEvents` keeps filling up, which is exactly the
//! failure these tests exist to catch.

use std::sync::Arc;
use std::time::Duration;

use op_grpc_bridge::{ChangeSource, ChangeType, MutationEngine};
use op_state::StatePlugin;
mod support;

fn engine() -> Arc<MutationEngine> {
    let event_chain = Arc::new(tokio::sync::RwLock::new(op_state_store::EventChain::new(
        op_state_store::ChainConfig::default(),
    )));
    let ovsdb = Arc::new(op_network::rovs_proxy::OvsdbDbusClient::new());
    Arc::new(MutationEngine::new(event_chain, ovsdb))
}

async fn next_event(
    rx: &mut tokio::sync::broadcast::Receiver<op_state_store::ChainEvent>,
) -> op_state_store::ChainEvent {
    tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(5), rx.recv())
        .await
        .expect("a recorded event reaches chain subscribers")
        .expect("chain broadcast stayed open")
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn dispatched_method_call_reaches_chain_subscribers() {
    let _catalog = support::CatalogScope::new(&[
        op_plugins::state_plugins::snowball_plugin::SnowballPlugin::new()
            .schema()
            .unwrap(),
    ]);
    let engine = engine();
    let mut rx = engine.chain_tx().subscribe();

    engine
        .dispatch_method_call(
            // A real engine-local read: cognitive health requires a separately
            // published runtime projection that this isolated fixture lacks.
            "snowball",
            "verify_chain",
            "{}",
            Some("snowball.read"),
            "test-actor",
        )
        .await
        .expect("dispatch records an event");

    let event = next_event(&mut rx).await;
    assert_eq!(event.plugin_id, "snowball");
    assert_eq!(event.actor_id, "test-actor");
    assert_eq!(event.capability_id.as_deref(), Some("snowball.read"));
    assert!(!event.event_hash.is_empty());

    // The broadcast event is the same one GetEvents serves, not a reconstruction.
    let chain = engine.event_chain.read().await;
    let recorded = chain.events().last().expect("chain holds the event");
    assert_eq!(recorded.event_id, event.event_id);
    assert_eq!(recorded.event_hash, event.event_hash);
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn authoritative_change_reaches_chain_subscribers() {
    let _catalog =
        support::CatalogScope::new(&[op_plugins::state_plugins::incus::IncusPlugin::new()
            .schema()
            .unwrap()]);
    let engine = engine();
    let mut rx = engine.chain_tx().subscribe();

    engine
        .process_authoritative_change(
            "incus".to_string(),
            "/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/incus".to_string(),
            ChangeType::PropertySet,
            Some("containers".to_string()),
            None,
            simd_json::json!([]),
            vec!["state".to_string()],
            "test-actor".to_string(),
            None,
            ChangeSource::Grpc,
        )
        .await
        .expect("authoritative change records an event");

    let event = next_event(&mut rx).await;
    assert_eq!(event.plugin_id, "incus");
    assert_eq!(event.actor_id, "test-actor");
    assert!(event.tags_touched.contains(&"state".to_string()));
    assert!(!event.event_hash.is_empty());
}
</file>

<file path="op-grpc-bridge/tests/exact_state_children.rs">
//! Full exact-schema validation must run after child folding, before publication.
use op_grpc_bridge::{ChangeSource, ChangeType, MutationEngine};
use op_state_store::{FieldSchema, FieldType, PluginSchema};
use simd_json::{json, OwnedValue};
use std::sync::Arc;
use tokio::sync::broadcast::error::TryRecvError;
mod support;
fn engine() -> MutationEngine {
    MutationEngine::new(
        Arc::new(tokio::sync::RwLock::new(op_state_store::EventChain::new(
            op_state_store::ChainConfig::default(),
        ))),
        Arc::new(op_network::rovs_proxy::OvsdbDbusClient::new()),
    )
}
async fn change(
    engine: &MutationEngine,
    suffix: &str,
    member: Option<&str>,
    value: OwnedValue,
) -> Result<op_grpc_bridge::mutation_engine::StateChange, String> {
    engine
        .process_authoritative_change(
            "incus".into(),
            format!("/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/incus{suffix}"),
            ChangeType::PropertySet,
            member.map(str::to_owned),
            None,
            value,
            vec![],
            "fixture".into(),
            None,
            ChangeSource::Internal,
        )
        .await
}
#[tokio::test]
async fn protected_exact_grandchild_writes_preserve_siblings_and_reject_before_shm() {
    let native = serde_json::json!({"type":"object","properties":{"jobs":{"type":"object","additionalProperties":{"$ref":"#/$defs/Job"}}},"required":["jobs"],"additionalProperties":false,"$defs":{"Job":{"type":"object","properties":{"children":{"type":"object","additionalProperties":{"type":"object","properties":{"ready":{"type":"boolean"}},"required":["ready"],"additionalProperties":false}}},"required":["children"],"additionalProperties":false}}});
    let schema = PluginSchema::builder("incus")
        .version("2.0.0")
        .field(
            "native",
            FieldSchema {
                field_type: FieldType::exact_json_schema(native).unwrap(),
                required: true,
                description: String::new(),
                default: None,
                example: None,
                constraints: vec![],
                read_only: false,
                read_only_when: None,
            },
        )
        .build();
    let scope = support::CatalogScope::new(&[schema]);
    let engine = engine();
    let initial = json!({"native":{"jobs":{"first":{"children":{"grandchild":{"ready":false}}},"sibling":{"children":{"keep":{"ready":true}}}}}});
    change(&engine, "", None, initial).await.unwrap();
    let mut rx = engine.change_tx().subscribe();
    change(
        &engine,
        "/native/jobs/first/children/grandchild",
        Some("ready"),
        json!(true),
    )
    .await
    .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(rx.try_recv().unwrap().new_value, json!(null)); // wakeup contains no private state
    let path = scope.root().join("state/incus.json");
    let manifest = scope.root().join("state/.manifest.json");
    let before = std::fs::read(&path).unwrap();
    let generation = std::fs::read(&manifest).unwrap();
    let committed: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_slice(&before).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        committed["native"]["jobs"]["first"]["children"]["grandchild"]["ready"],
        true
    );
    assert_eq!(
        committed["native"]["jobs"]["sibling"]["children"]["keep"]["ready"],
        true
    );
    let cache = engine.get_state("incus").await;
    assert!(change(
        &engine,
        "/native/jobs/first/children/grandchild",
        Some("ready"),
        json!("PRIVATE_INVALID")
    )
    .await
    .is_err());
    assert_eq!(std::fs::read(path).unwrap(), before);
    assert_eq!(std::fs::read(manifest).unwrap(), generation);
    assert_eq!(engine.get_state("incus").await, cache);
    assert!(matches!(rx.try_recv(), Err(TryRecvError::Empty)));
    assert!(engine.get_public_state("incus").await.is_none());
}
</file>

<file path="op-grpc-bridge/tests/grpc_speed_test.rs">
// Agent-to-agent gRPC speed test.
//
// Measures round-trip latency and throughput of live gRPC endpoints on the
// internal svc0 (10.200.0.2) and WireGuard (100.69.0.254) networks.
//
// Run: cargo test --test grpc_speed_test -p op-grpc-bridge -- --nocapture

use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

use tonic::transport::Channel;

/// Install rustls CryptoProvider (required by rustls 0.23+).
fn install_crypto_provider() {
    use std::sync::Once;
    static INIT: Once = Once::new();
    INIT.call_once(|| {
        let _ = rustls::crypto::aws_lc_rs::default_provider().install_default();
    });
}

/// Connect to an endpoint, returning None if unreachable.
async fn try_connect(uri: &str) -> Option<Channel> {
    tokio::time::timeout(
        Duration::from_secs(3),
        Channel::from_shared(uri.to_string())
            .unwrap()
            .connect_timeout(Duration::from_secs(2))
            .connect(),
    )
    .await
    .ok()?
    .ok()
}

/// Measure N sequential unary RPCs and report p50/p99/throughput.
async fn bench_get_state(channel: Channel, label: &str, n: usize) {
    use op_grpc_bridge::proto::{state_sync_client::StateSyncClient, GetStateRequest};

    let mut client = StateSyncClient::new(channel);
    let mut latencies = Vec::with_capacity(n);

    // Warmup
    for _ in 0..3 {
        let _ = client
            .get_state(tonic::Request::new(GetStateRequest {
                plugin_id: "tched_router".to_string(),
                object_path: String::new(),
            }))
            .await;
    }

    let wall_start = Instant::now();
    for _ in 0..n {
        let start = Instant::now();
        let _ = client
            .get_state(tonic::Request::new(GetStateRequest {
                plugin_id: "tched_router".to_string(),
                object_path: String::new(),
            }))
            .await;
        latencies.push(start.elapsed());
    }
    let wall = wall_start.elapsed();

    latencies.sort();
    let p50 = latencies[n / 2];
    let p99 = latencies[(n * 99) / 100];
    let avg = latencies.iter().sum::<Duration>() / n as u32;
    let rps = n as f64 / wall.as_secs_f64();

    println!("  [{label}] GetState x{n}:");
    println!("    avg={avg:?}  p50={p50:?}  p99={p99:?}");
    println!("    wall={wall:?}  throughput={rps:.0} rpc/s");
}

/// Measure health check latency.
async fn bench_health(channel: Channel, label: &str, n: usize) {
    let mut client = tonic_health::pb::health_client::HealthClient::new(channel);
    let mut latencies = Vec::with_capacity(n);

    // Warmup
    for _ in 0..3 {
        let _ = client
            .check(tonic_health::pb::HealthCheckRequest {
                service: String::new(),
            })
            .await;
    }

    let wall_start = Instant::now();
    for _ in 0..n {
        let start = Instant::now();
        let _ = client
            .check(tonic_health::pb::HealthCheckRequest {
                service: String::new(),
            })
            .await;
        latencies.push(start.elapsed());
    }
    let wall = wall_start.elapsed();

    latencies.sort();
    let p50 = latencies[n / 2];
    let p99 = latencies[(n * 99) / 100];
    let avg = latencies.iter().sum::<Duration>() / n as u32;
    let rps = n as f64 / wall.as_secs_f64();

    println!("  [{label}] Health x{n}:");
    println!("    avg={avg:?}  p50={p50:?}  p99={p99:?}");
    println!("    wall={wall:?}  throughput={rps:.0} rpc/s");
}

/// Measure reflection ListServices latency.
async fn bench_reflection(channel: Channel, label: &str, n: usize) {
    use tonic_reflection::pb::v1::{
        server_reflection_client::ServerReflectionClient,
        server_reflection_request::MessageRequest, ServerReflectionRequest,
    };

    let mut latencies = Vec::with_capacity(n);

    let wall_start = Instant::now();
    for _ in 0..n {
        let start = Instant::now();

        let mut client = ServerReflectionClient::new(channel.clone());
        let (tx, rx) = tokio::sync::mpsc::channel(2);
        tx.send(ServerReflectionRequest {
            host: String::new(),
            message_request: Some(MessageRequest::ListServices(String::new())),
        })
        .await
        .unwrap();
        drop(tx);

        let resp = client
            .server_reflection_info(tokio_stream::wrappers::ReceiverStream::new(rx))
            .await;
        if let Ok(resp) = resp {
            let mut stream = resp.into_inner();
            let _ = stream.message().await;
        }
        latencies.push(start.elapsed());
    }
    let wall = wall_start.elapsed();

    latencies.sort();
    let p50 = latencies[n / 2];
    let p99 = latencies[(n * 99) / 100];
    let avg = latencies.iter().sum::<Duration>() / n as u32;
    let rps = n as f64 / wall.as_secs_f64();

    println!("  [{label}] Reflection ListServices x{n}:");
    println!("    avg={avg:?}  p50={p50:?}  p99={p99:?}");
    println!("    wall={wall:?}  throughput={rps:.0} rpc/s");
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn grpc_agent_to_agent_speed() {
    install_crypto_provider();

    let endpoints = [
        ("loopback:50051", "http://127.0.0.1:50051"),
        ("loopback:8090", "http://127.0.0.1:8090"),
        ("svc0:50051", "http://10.200.0.2:50051"),
        ("svc0:8090", "http://10.200.0.2:8090"),
        ("wg:8090", "http://100.69.0.254:8090"),
        ("wg:50051", "http://100.69.0.254:50051"),
    ];

    println!("\n══════════════════════════════════════════════════");
    println!("  Agent-to-Agent gRPC Speed Test");
    println!("══════════════════════════════════════════════════\n");

    for (label, uri) in &endpoints {
        print!("Connecting {label} ({uri})... ");
        match try_connect(uri).await {
            Some(channel) => {
                println!("✓");
                bench_health(channel.clone(), label, 100).await;
                bench_get_state(channel.clone(), label, 100).await;
                bench_reflection(channel, label, 20).await;
                println!();
            }
            None => {
                println!("✗ (unreachable)");
            }
        }
    }

    println!("══════════════════════════════════════════════════");
}
</file>

<file path="op-grpc-bridge/tests/json_render_dispatch.rs">
//! Canonical admission, pinned catalog metadata, and durable policy recovery.
mod support;

use op_grpc_bridge::MutationEngine;
use op_plugins::state_plugins::json_render::JsonRenderPlugin;
use op_state::StatePlugin;
use op_state_store::{ChainConfig, EventChain, PluginSchema};
use serde_json::{json, Value};
use std::sync::Arc;
use tokio::sync::RwLock;

fn engine() -> MutationEngine {
    MutationEngine::new(
        Arc::new(RwLock::new(EventChain::new(ChainConfig::default()))),
        Arc::new(op_network::rovs_proxy::OvsdbDbusClient::new()),
    )
}

async fn call(
    engine: &MutationEngine,
    schema: &PluginSchema,
    method: &str,
    args: Value,
) -> anyhow::Result<Value> {
    let response = engine
        .dispatch_method_call(
            "json_render",
            method,
            &serde_json::to_string(&args)?,
            schema.methods[method].required_capability.as_deref(),
            "fixture-principal",
        )
        .await?;
    let result = response["result"].clone();
    let contract = serde_json::to_value(&schema.methods[method].returns)?;
    jsonschema::validate(&contract, &result)
        .map_err(|error| anyhow::anyhow!("response violates contract: {error}"))?;
    Ok(result)
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn current_seal_drives_catalog_and_policy_survives_engine_recreation() {
    let mut schema = JsonRenderPlugin::new().schema().unwrap();
    let scope = support::CatalogScope::new(&[schema.clone()]);
    let engine = engine();
    let before = call(&engine, &schema, "list_components", json!({}))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    let mut components = before["components"].clone();
    components[0]["description"] = json!("changed by the fixture sealer");
    schema.fields.get_mut("components").unwrap().default =
        Some(simd_json::serde::to_owned_value(&components).unwrap());
    let mut sealer = op_blob::BlobStore::open(scope.root().join("blobs")).unwrap();
    sealer
        .write(&op_blob::blobify_plugin_schema(
            "json_render",
            schema.clone(),
        ))
        .unwrap();
    let updated = call(&engine, &schema, "list_components", json!({}))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        updated["components"], components,
        "a live metadata reseal must not use an old adapter snapshot"
    );

    let config = call(&engine, &schema, "get_config", json!({}))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    let mut policy = config["config"].clone();
    policy["expose_catalog"] = json!(false);
    let receipt = call(&engine, &schema, "set_config", json!({"config":policy}))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(receipt["config"], policy);
    let error = call(&engine, &schema, "list_components", json!({}))
        .await
        .unwrap_err();
    assert!(error.to_string().contains("catalog exposure is disabled"));
    let projected = serde_json::to_value(engine.get_state("json_render").await.unwrap()).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(projected["config"], policy);
    assert_eq!(projected["components"], components);

    let recovered = self::engine();
    recovered.seed_missing_plugin_projections().await.unwrap();
    let restored = serde_json::to_value(recovered.get_state("json_render").await.unwrap()).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(restored["config"], policy);
    assert_eq!(restored["components"], components);
    assert_eq!(
        call(&recovered, &schema, "get_config", json!({}))
            .await
            .unwrap()["config"],
        policy
    );
}
</file>

<file path="op-grpc-bridge/tests/large_language_model_dispatch.rs">
mod support;

use op_grpc_bridge::mutation_engine::MutationEngine;
use op_state::StatePlugin;
use op_state_store::{ChainConfig, EventChain, PluginSchema};
use std::{net::TcpListener, sync::Arc};

struct Environment(Vec<(&'static str, Option<std::ffi::OsString>)>);

impl Environment {
    fn new() -> Self {
        Self(
            ["OP_GRANTS_PATH", "TCHED_ROUTER_RUNTIME_ENDPOINT"]
                .into_iter()
                .map(|key| (key, std::env::var_os(key)))
                .collect(),
        )
    }
}

impl Drop for Environment {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        for (key, value) in &self.0 {
            match value {
                Some(value) => std::env::set_var(key, value),
                None => std::env::remove_var(key),
            }
        }
    }
}

fn facade() -> PluginSchema {
    op_plugins::state_plugins::large_language_model::LargeLanguageModelPlugin::new()
        .schema()
        .unwrap()
}

fn tched() -> PluginSchema {
    op_plugins::state_plugins::tched_router::TchedRouterPlugin::new()
        .schema()
        .unwrap()
}

fn engine() -> MutationEngine {
    MutationEngine::new(
        Arc::new(tokio::sync::RwLock::new(EventChain::new(
            ChainConfig::default(),
        ))),
        Arc::new(op_network::rovs_proxy::OvsdbDbusClient::new()),
    )
}

async fn invoke(engine: &MutationEngine, capability: &str) -> anyhow::Result<serde_json::Value> {
    invoke_method(engine, "large_language_model", "list_providers", capability).await
}

async fn invoke_method(
    engine: &MutationEngine,
    plugin: &str,
    method: &str,
    capability: &str,
) -> anyhow::Result<serde_json::Value> {
    let genesis = "ab".repeat(32);
    tokio::time::timeout(
        std::time::Duration::from_secs(5),
        engine.dispatch_method_call_with_identity(
            plugin,
            method,
            "{}",
            Some(capability),
            "fixture-principal",
            Some("00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001"),
            Some(&genesis),
        ),
    )
    .await
    .map_err(|_| anyhow::anyhow!("canonical facade exceeded fixture deadline"))?
}

fn endpoint_without_server() -> TcpListener {
    let listener = TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").unwrap();
    listener.set_nonblocking(true).unwrap();
    std::env::set_var(
        "TCHED_ROUTER_RUNTIME_ENDPOINT",
        format!("http://{}", listener.local_addr().unwrap()),
    );
    listener
}

fn assert_no_http(listener: &TcpListener) {
    assert!(matches!(
        listener.accept(),
        Err(error) if error.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock
    ));
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn nested_target_absence_or_drift_stops_before_http() {
    let target_capability = tched().methods["ListProviders"]
        .required_capability
        .clone()
        .unwrap();
    {
        let _catalog = support::CatalogScope::new(&[facade()]);
        let _environment = Environment::new();
        let listener = endpoint_without_server();
        let error = invoke(&engine(), &target_capability).await.unwrap_err();
        assert!(error.to_string().contains("tched_router"));
        assert_no_http(&listener);
    }
    {
        let mut stale = tched();
        stale.version = "0.0.0".into();
        let _catalog = support::CatalogScope::new(&[facade(), stale]);
        let _environment = Environment::new();
        let listener = endpoint_without_server();
        let error = invoke(&engine(), &target_capability).await.unwrap_err();
        assert!(error.to_string().contains("compiled/sealed"));
        assert_no_http(&listener);
    }
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn missing_grant_or_invalid_session_stops_before_http() {
    let _catalog = support::CatalogScope::new(&[facade(), tched()]);
    let _environment = Environment::new();
    let capability = tched().methods["ListProviders"]
        .required_capability
        .clone()
        .unwrap();
    let grants = tempfile::NamedTempFile::new().unwrap();
    std::fs::write(grants.path(), b"{}").unwrap();
    std::env::set_var("OP_GRANTS_PATH", grants.path());
    let listener = endpoint_without_server();
    let error = invoke(&engine(), &capability).await.unwrap_err();
    assert!(error.to_string().contains("exact nested"));
    assert_no_http(&listener);

    std::fs::write(
        grants.path(),
        serde_json::to_vec(&serde_json::json!({
            "fixture-principal": {"capabilities": [capability.clone()]}
        }))
        .unwrap(),
    )
    .unwrap();
    let error = invoke(&engine(), &capability).await.unwrap_err();
    let error_chain = format!("{error:#}");
    assert!(
        error_chain.contains("identity credential projection is unavailable"),
        "unexpected failure: {error_chain}"
    );
    assert_no_http(&listener);
}
</file>

<file path="op-grpc-bridge/tests/live_reflection_probe.rs">
//! Live probe: distinguish frozen per-method descriptors being *advertised* from *served*.
//!
//! Sealing a plugin's descriptors into the SHM blob and hydrating the reflection
//! catalog only makes them **discoverable**. Mounting them as callable typed gRPC
//! services requires `freeze_plugin_method_reflection()` to run before routes are
//! built, because tonic-reflection is immutable once mounted.
//!
//! Regression this guards: `run_tched_router_server` (the path the `op-grpc-bridge`
//! binary actually takes) called `hydrate_reflection_from_shm()` but not
//! `freeze_plugin_method_reflection()`, so the bridge advertised every sealed
//! plugin while serving none of their per-method services. `cognitive_mcp` is
//! bridge-owned and compiled in, so activation must remain independent of the
//! deliberately absent standalone service definition.
//!
//! Ignored by default: requires a running bridge.
//!   cargo test -p op-grpc-bridge --test live_reflection_probe -- --nocapture --ignored

/// The `:8090` door is TLS-only. Trust it the way op-web does: the PEM at
/// `OP_DBUS_GRPC_CA_FILE` (default: the fabric CA on this host), and the
/// door cert's `localhost` SAN for name verification.
fn install_crypto_provider() {
    let _ = rustls::crypto::aws_lc_rs::default_provider().install_default();
}

fn door_ca_pem() -> Vec<u8> {
    let path = std::env::var("OP_DBUS_GRPC_CA_FILE")
        .ok()
        .filter(|p| !p.trim().is_empty())
        .unwrap_or_else(|| "/etc/op-dbus/tls/tonic-svc0-ca.crt".to_string());
    std::fs::read(path.trim()).unwrap_or_else(|e| {
        panic!(
            "read door CA {}: {e} (set OP_DBUS_GRPC_CA_FILE)",
            path.trim()
        )
    })
}

fn door_domain() -> String {
    std::env::var("OP_DBUS_GRPC_TLS_DOMAIN")
        .ok()
        .filter(|d| !d.trim().is_empty())
        .unwrap_or_else(|| "localhost".to_string())
}

#[tokio::test]
#[ignore = "requires a running bridge on 127.0.0.1:8090"]
async fn cognitive_mcp_per_method_services_are_advertised() {
    use tonic_reflection::pb::v1::{
        server_reflection_client::ServerReflectionClient,
        server_reflection_request::MessageRequest, server_reflection_response::MessageResponse,
        ServerReflectionRequest,
    };

    install_crypto_provider();
    let tls = tonic::transport::ClientTlsConfig::new()
        .ca_certificate(tonic::transport::Certificate::from_pem(door_ca_pem()))
        .domain_name(door_domain());
    let channel = tonic::transport::Channel::from_static("https://127.0.0.1:8090")
        .tls_config(tls)
        .expect("door TLS config")
        .connect()
        .await
        .expect("connect to live bridge :8090");

    let mut client = ServerReflectionClient::new(channel);
    let (tx, rx) = tokio::sync::mpsc::channel(16);
    let request_stream = tokio_stream::wrappers::ReceiverStream::new(rx);
    let mut stream = client
        .server_reflection_info(tonic::Request::new(request_stream))
        .await
        .expect("open reflection stream")
        .into_inner();

    tx.send(ServerReflectionRequest {
        host: String::new(),
        message_request: Some(MessageRequest::ListServices(String::new())),
    })
    .await
    .expect("send ListServices");

    let names: Vec<String> = match stream.message().await.expect("reflection response") {
        Some(resp) => match resp.message_response {
            Some(MessageResponse::ListServicesResponse(r)) => {
                r.service.into_iter().map(|s| s.name).collect()
            }
            other => panic!("unexpected reflection response: {other:?}"),
        },
        None => panic!("no reflection response"),
    };

    let cognitive: Vec<&String> = names
        .iter()
        // Reflection lists the generated per-plugin service
        // (`operation.plugin.v1.CognitiveMcpPluginMethods`); the descriptor-only
        // `operation.method.cognitive_mcp.*` names are deliberately not
        // advertised (OD-49).
        .filter(|n| n.to_ascii_lowercase().contains("cognitivemcp"))
        .collect();

    println!("total services: {}", names.len());
    println!("cognitive_mcp services: {}", cognitive.len());
    for n in &cognitive {
        println!("  {n}");
    }

    assert!(
        !cognitive.is_empty(),
        "no cognitive_mcp per-method services mounted — descriptors were sealed but \
         never activated (is freeze_plugin_method_reflection running before routes \
         are built, and is the plugin reported available?)"
    );

    // The mounted, callable surface is the generated per-plugin service; the
    // per-method `operation.method.<plugin>.<method>.*Service` descriptors are
    // sealed in the blob for typed clients but are not advertised as mounted
    // services (OD-49: reflection lists only what is routable).
    assert!(
        names
            .iter()
            .any(|n| n == "operation.plugin.v1.CognitiveMcpPluginMethods"),
        "cognitive_mcp's generated plugin service is not advertised; found: {cognitive:?}"
    );
    assert!(
        !names.iter().any(|n| n.starts_with("operation.method.")),
        "descriptor-only operation.method.* services must not be advertised as mounted"
    );
}

/// The generated plugin-level service **is** served over tonic-web.
///
/// Two distinct naming schemes coexist, and conflating them is easy:
///
///   served    `operation.plugin.v1.{Plugin}PluginMethods/{Rpc}`
///             generated at compile time by build.rs from the plugin schemas,
///             dispatching through `call_generated_plugin_method_typed` which
///             decodes the request with prost-reflect, hands JSON to
///             MutationEngine, and re-encodes the response.
///
///   reflection-only  `operation.method.{plugin}.{method}.{Svc}/{Rpc}`
///             the per-method frozen descriptors from the sealed blob. Registered
///             with the reflection registry so they are discoverable, but no
///             handler is mounted for these names.
///
/// So the cognitive surface *is* reachable from gRPC and gRPC-Web clients — under
/// the first scheme. Asserting against the second yields a misleading UNIMPLEMENTED.
///
/// This probe sends a valid `tool_name` and expects the call to reach the
/// capability gate (status 7), proving routing + protobuf decode + dispatch all
/// work. Status 12 would mean the service is not mounted at all.
#[tokio::test]
#[ignore = "requires a running bridge on 127.0.0.1:8090"]
async fn cognitive_mcp_plugin_service_is_served_over_tonic_web() {
    // CognitiveMcpInvokeToolRequest { string tool_name = 322087922; }
    // varint tag for field 322087922, wire type 2 -> 92 BF D5 CC 09
    let mut msg: Vec<u8> = vec![0x92, 0xBF, 0xD5, 0xCC, 0x09];
    let tool = b"get_health";
    msg.push(tool.len() as u8);
    msg.extend_from_slice(tool);

    // gRPC-Web frame: 1 flag byte + 4-byte big-endian length + payload
    let mut body: Vec<u8> = vec![0x00];
    body.extend_from_slice(&(msg.len() as u32).to_be_bytes());
    body.extend_from_slice(&msg);

    install_crypto_provider();
    let ca = reqwest::Certificate::from_pem(&door_ca_pem()).expect("door CA PEM");
    let resp = reqwest::Client::builder()
        .add_root_certificate(ca)
        .resolve("localhost", "127.0.0.1:8090".parse().unwrap())
        .build()
        .expect("tls client")
        .post("https://localhost:8090/operation.plugin.v1.CognitiveMcpPluginMethods/InvokeTool")
        .header("Content-Type", "application/grpc-web+proto")
        .body(body)
        .send()
        .await
        .expect("post to tonic-web :8090");

    let status = resp
        .headers()
        .get("grpc-status")
        .and_then(|v| v.to_str().ok())
        .unwrap_or("<absent>")
        .to_string();
    let message = resp
        .headers()
        .get("grpc-message")
        .and_then(|v| v.to_str().ok())
        .unwrap_or("")
        .to_string();

    assert_ne!(
        status, "12",
        "CognitiveMcpPluginMethods/InvokeTool returned UNIMPLEMENTED — the generated \
         plugin service is not mounted (grpc-message: {message})"
    );

    // Reaching a gate proves the route is mounted and the request was decoded.
    // Without credentials the identity interceptor answers UNAUTHENTICATED (16,
    // "Missing Oracle identity assertion"); with a credential but no declared
    // capability_id the capability gate answers PERMISSION_DENIED (7). Either is
    // "served"; only UNIMPLEMENTED (12, asserted above) means "not mounted".
    assert!(
        status == "16" || status == "7" || status == "0",
        "unexpected grpc-status {status} (grpc-message: {message})"
    );
}
</file>

<file path="op-grpc-bridge/tests/native_method_contracts.rs">
//! Backend fixtures live with their plugins; these cases cover the independent
//! generated protobuf boundary, where a valid domain result must not lose data.
use op_plugins::default_registry::DefaultPluginRegistry;
use op_state_store::MemoryStore;
use prost::Message;
use prost_reflect::{DescriptorPool, DynamicMessage, SerializeOptions};
use serde::de::DeserializeSeed;
use serde_json::{json, Value};
use std::sync::Arc;

fn pascal(name: &str) -> String {
    name.split('_')
        .map(|part| format!("{}{}", part[..1].to_uppercase(), &part[1..]))
        .collect()
}

fn assert_preserved(expected: &Value, actual: &Value, path: &str) {
    match (expected, actual) {
        (Value::Number(a), Value::Number(b)) => {
            if a.is_u64() && b.is_u64() {
                assert_eq!(a.as_u64(), b.as_u64(), "{path}");
            } else if a.is_i64() && b.is_i64() {
                assert_eq!(a.as_i64(), b.as_i64(), "{path}");
            } else {
                assert_eq!(a.as_f64(), b.as_f64(), "{path}");
            }
        }
        (Value::Array(a), Value::Array(b)) => {
            assert_eq!(a.len(), b.len(), "{path}");
            for (index, (a, b)) in a.iter().zip(b).enumerate() {
                assert_preserved(a, b, &format!("{path}[{index}]"));
            }
        }
        (Value::Object(a), Value::Object(b)) => {
            for (key, value) in a {
                assert_preserved(value, &b[key], &format!("{path}.{key}"));
            }
        }
        _ => assert_eq!(expected, actual, "{path}"),
    }
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn required_scalar_presence_survives_native_wire() {
    let registry = DefaultPluginRegistry::new(Arc::new(MemoryStore::new()));
    let schema = registry
        .load_plugin("login1")
        .await
        .unwrap()
        .schema()
        .unwrap();
    let contract = serde_json::to_value(&schema.methods["set_user_linger"].args).unwrap();
    let pool = DescriptorPool::decode(op_grpc_bridge::proto::FILE_DESCRIPTOR_SET).unwrap();
    let descriptor = pool
        .get_message_by_name("operation.plugin.v1.Login1SetUserLingerRequest")
        .unwrap();
    for (input, valid) in [
        (json!({"uid":0,"enable":false,"interactive":false}), true),
        (json!({"uid":0,"interactive":false}), false),
        (json!({"enable":false,"interactive":false}), false),
    ] {
        let encoded = serde_json::to_string(&input).unwrap();
        let mut deserializer = serde_json::Deserializer::from_str(&encoded);
        let message = descriptor.clone().deserialize(&mut deserializer).unwrap();
        let decoded =
            DynamicMessage::decode(descriptor.clone(), message.encode_to_vec().as_slice()).unwrap();
        let mut bytes = Vec::new();
        decoded
            .serialize_with_options(
                &mut serde_json::Serializer::new(&mut bytes),
                &SerializeOptions::new()
                    .use_proto_field_name(true)
                    .stringify_64_bit_integers(false)
                    .skip_default_fields(false),
            )
            .unwrap();
        let actual: Value = serde_json::from_slice(&bytes).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            input, actual,
            "explicit zero/false and missing fields must remain distinct"
        );
        assert_eq!(jsonschema::validate(&contract, &actual).is_ok(), valid);
    }
}

        ),

        ),

        ),

        ),

        ),
        (
            "login1",
            "create_session",
            json!({"session_id":"c2","object_path":"/session/c2","runtime_path":"/run/user/1001","uid":1001,"seat_id":"seat0","vtnr":2,"existing":false}),
        ),

        ),
        (
            "dnsresolver",
            "resolve_hostname",
            json!({"addresses":[{"ifindex":2,"family":2,"address":[192,0,2,1]}],"canonical":"test.invalid","flags":9007199254740993u64}),
        ),
        (
            "dnsresolver",
            "resolve_record",
            json!({"records":[{"ifindex":2,"class":1,"record_type":16,"data":[3,102,111,111]}],"flags":0}),
        ),
        (
            "dnsresolver",
            "resolve_service",
            json!({"srv_data":[{"priority":1,"weight":2,"port":443,"hostname":"service.invalid","addresses":[{"ifindex":2,"family":2,"address":[192,0,2,2]}],"canonical":"service.invalid"}],"txt_data":[[3,102,111,111],[0,255]],"canonical_name":"service","canonical_type":"_https._tcp","canonical_domain":"invalid","flags":1}),
        ),
        (
            "qdrant",
            "search_points",
            json!({"results":[{"id":23,"score":0.75,"payload":{"text":"evidence","tags":["a",null]}}]}),
        ),
        (
            "qdrant",
            "scroll_points",
            json!({"points":[{"id":"abc","payload":{"value":3}}],"next_page_offset":"next-id"}),
        ),
        (
            "qdrant",
            "upsert_points",
            json!({"status":"ok","operation_id":9007199254740993u64,"operation_status":"completed"}),

        (
            "incus",
            "exec_instance",
            json!({"name":"fixture","completed":true,"exit_code":3,"stdout":"message\n","stderr":"error\n","response":{"metadata":{"return":3}}}),
        ),
        (
            "packagekit",
            "resolve",
            json!({"transaction":"/org/freedesktop/PackageKit/transactions/t1","packages":["pkg;1;x86_64;installed"],"package_details":[{"info":1,"package_id":"pkg;1;x86_64;installed","summary":"Fixture"}],"exit_code":1,"runtime_ms":50}),
        ),
        (
            "rtnetlink",
            "add_link",
            json!({"interface":"veth-fixture","disposition":"accepted"}),
        ),
        ("memory", "get_entry", json!({"entry":null})),
        (
            "memory",
            "update_entry",
            json!({"entry":{"id":"fixture-id","namespace":"notes","key":"k","value":{"items":[null,true,"📚"]},"created_at":"2026-09-13T00:00:00Z","updated_at":"2026-09-13T00:00:01Z"},"previous_value":null}),
        ),
        (
            "memory",
            "compact",
            json!({"scope":"shared_cozo_database","compacted_at":"2026-09-13T00:00:00Z","reclaimed_bytes":null}),
        ),
        (
            "gcloud_adc",
            "check_auth_status",
            json!({"provider":"google_application_default_credentials","configured":true,"authenticated":false,"validation":"rejected","failure":{"kind":"provider_rejected","retryable":false,"message":"Provider rejected the credential"}}),
        ),
        (
            "keypair",
            "list_keypairs",
            json!({"source":"ssh_agent","keypairs":[]}),
        ),
        (
            "shared_unix_socket",
            "list_registrations",
            json!({"registrations":[],"revision":9007199254740993u64}),
        ),
        (
            "unix_socket",
            "accept",
            json!({"event":null,"observed_generation":"fixture-generation","cursor":9007199254740993u64,"timed_out":false}),
        ),
        (
            "unix_socket",
            "close",
            json!({"path":"/run/fixture.sock","protocol":"grpc","phase":"closed","generation":"fixture-generation","binding_generation":3,"requested_backlog":null,"active_connections":0,"accepted_connections":9007199254740993u64}),
        ),
    ];
    let registry = DefaultPluginRegistry::new(Arc::new(MemoryStore::new()));
    let pool = DescriptorPool::decode(op_grpc_bridge::proto::FILE_DESCRIPTOR_SET).unwrap();
    for (plugin_id, method, result) in cases {
        let plugin = registry.load_plugin(plugin_id).await.unwrap();
        let schema = plugin.schema().unwrap();
        let contract = schema
            .methods
            .get(method)
            .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("missing {plugin_id}.{method}"));
        let returns = serde_json::to_value(contract.returns.as_ref().unwrap()).unwrap();
        jsonschema::validate(&returns, &result)
            .unwrap_or_else(|error| panic!("{plugin_id}.{method}: {error}"));
        let name = format!(
            "operation.plugin.v1.{}{}Response",
            pascal(plugin_id),
            pascal(method)
        );
        let descriptor = pool.get_message_by_name(&name).unwrap();
        let source = serde_json::to_string(&result).unwrap();
        let mut input = serde_json::Deserializer::from_str(&source);
        let message = descriptor
            .clone()
            .deserialize(&mut input)
            .unwrap_or_else(|error| panic!("{name} encoding: {error}"));
        input.end().unwrap();
        let decoded =
            DynamicMessage::decode(descriptor, message.encode_to_vec().as_slice()).unwrap();
        let mut output = Vec::new();
        decoded
            .serialize_with_options(
                &mut serde_json::Serializer::new(&mut output),
                &SerializeOptions::new()
                    .use_proto_field_name(true)
                    .stringify_64_bit_integers(false)
                    .skip_default_fields(false),
            )
            .unwrap();
        let actual: Value = serde_json::from_slice(&output).unwrap();
        assert_preserved(&result, &actual, &name);
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
struct Violation {
    path: String,
    detail: String,
}

fn workspace_root() -> PathBuf {
    PathBuf::from(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join("../..")
}

fn rel_path(root: &Path, path: &Path) -> String {
    path.strip_prefix(root)
        .unwrap_or(path)
        .to_string_lossy()
        .replace('\\', "/")
}

fn is_gate_self(rel: &str) -> bool {
    rel == GATE_SELF_REL
}

fn should_skip_tree_entry(name: &str) -> bool {
    name == "target" || name == ".git"
}

fn collect_files_under(root: &Path, subdir: &str) -> Result<Vec<PathBuf>, String> {
    let base = root.join(subdir);
    if !base.is_dir() {
        return Err(format!("missing scan directory: {}", base.display()));
    }
    let mut files = Vec::new();
    collect_files_recursive(&base, &mut files)?;
    files.sort();
    Ok(files)
}

fn collect_files_recursive(dir: &Path, out: &mut Vec<PathBuf>) -> Result<(), String> {
    let entries = fs::read_dir(dir).map_err(|e| format!("read_dir {}: {e}", dir.display()))?;
    for entry in entries {
        let entry = entry.map_err(|e| format!("read_dir entry {}: {e}", dir.display()))?;
        let path = entry.path();
        let file_type = entry
            .file_type()
            .map_err(|e| format!("file_type {}: {e}", path.display()))?;
        if file_type.is_dir() {
            if should_skip_tree_entry(&entry.file_name().to_string_lossy()) {
                continue;
            }
            collect_files_recursive(&path, out)?;
        } else if file_type.is_file() {
            out.push(path);
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn read_text(path: &Path) -> Result<String, String> {
    match fs::read(path) {
        Ok(bytes) => {
            String::from_utf8(bytes).map_err(|_| format!("skip non-utf8 file: {}", path.display()))
        }
        Err(e) => Err(format!("read {}: {e}", path.display())),
    }
}

fn read_text_or_skip(path: &Path) -> Option<String> {
    read_text(path).ok()
}

/// Shared scanner entry point for token-family gates and the self-test (VAL-GATE-011).
fn scan_crates_for_literal_token(
    root: &Path,
    token: &str,
    exclude_gate_self: bool,
) -> Result<Vec<Violation>, String> {
    let files = collect_files_under(root, "crates")?;
    let mut violations = Vec::new();
    for path in files {
        let rel = rel_path(root, &path);
        if exclude_gate_self && is_gate_self(&rel) {
            continue;
        }
        let Some(text) = read_text_or_skip(&path) else {
            continue;
        };
        if text.contains(token) {
            violations.push(Violation {
                path: rel,
                detail: format!("forbidden token `{token}`"),
            });
        }
    }
    Ok(violations)
}

fn assert_scan_root_sane(root: &Path) -> Result<usize, String> {
    let cargo_toml = root.join("Cargo.toml");
    if !cargo_toml.is_file() {
        return Err(format!(
            "resolved workspace root missing Cargo.toml: {}",
            root.display()
        ));
    }
    let files = collect_files_under(root, "crates")?;
    if files.is_empty() {
        return Err("crates/ scan set is empty".into());
    }
    if files.len() < MIN_CRATES_FILE_FLOOR {
        return Err(format!(
            "crates/ scan set too small ({} files, floor {MIN_CRATES_FILE_FLOOR})",
            files.len()
        ));
    }
    for sentinel in [
        "crates/op-identity/src/lib.rs",
        "crates/op-grpc-bridge/src/lib.rs",
    ] {
        if !root.join(sentinel).is_file() {
            return Err(format!("missing sentinel file: {sentinel}"));
        }
    }
    Ok(files.len())
}

fn strip_cfg_test_modules(source: &str) -> String {
    let mut out = String::new();
    let mut i = 0;
    while i < source.len() {
        if source[i..].starts_with("#[cfg(test)]") {
            i += "#[cfg(test)]".len();
            while i < source.len() && source.as_bytes()[i].is_ascii_whitespace() {
                i += 1;
            }
            if source[i..].starts_with("mod ") {
                if let Some(end) = find_balanced_block_end(source, i) {
                    i = end;
                    continue;
                }
            }
        }
        let ch = source[i..].chars().next().expect("valid utf-8");
        out.push(ch);
        i += ch.len_utf8();
    }
    out
}

fn find_balanced_block_end(source: &str, start: usize) -> Option<usize> {
    let brace_start = source[start..].find('{')? + start;
    let mut depth = 0usize;
    for (offset, ch) in source[brace_start..].char_indices() {
        match ch {
            '{' => depth += 1,
            '}' => {
                depth -= 1;
                if depth == 0 {
                    return Some(brace_start + offset + 1);
                }
            }
            _ => {}
        }
    }
    None
}

fn glob_identity_src_files(root: &Path) -> Result<Vec<PathBuf>, String> {
    let src_root = root.join("crates");
    if !src_root.is_dir() {
        return Err("missing crates/".into());
    }
    let mut matched = Vec::new();
    collect_glob_matches(&src_root, &mut matched)?;
    matched.sort();
    Ok(matched)
}

fn collect_glob_matches(dir: &Path, out: &mut Vec<PathBuf>) -> Result<(), String> {
    for entry in fs::read_dir(dir).map_err(|e| format!("read_dir {}: {e}", dir.display()))? {
        let entry = entry.map_err(|e| format!("read_dir entry: {e}"))?;
        let path = entry.path();
        if path.is_dir() {
            if should_skip_tree_entry(&entry.file_name().to_string_lossy()) {
                continue;
            }
            collect_glob_matches(&path, out)?;
            continue;
        }
        if !path.is_file() {
            continue;
        }
        let name = path
            .file_name()
            .and_then(|n| n.to_str())
            .unwrap_or_default();
        if name.contains("oracle_assertion") || name.contains("human_principal") {
            let components: Vec<_> = path.components().map(|c| c.as_os_str()).collect();
            if components.iter().any(|c| *c == "src") {
                out.push(path);
            }
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn identity_command_new_scope(root: &Path) -> Result<Vec<PathBuf>, String> {
    let mut paths = glob_identity_src_files(root)?;
    for anchor in IDENTITY_ANCHORS {
        let p = root.join(anchor);
        if !p.is_file() {
            return Err(format!("missing identity anchor: {anchor}"));
        }
        if !paths.iter().any(|existing| existing == &p) {
            paths.push(p);
        }
    }
    if paths.is_empty() {
        return Err("identity glob scope is empty".into());
    }
    paths.sort();
    paths.dedup();
    Ok(paths)
}

fn scan_openflow_identity_tagging(root: &Path) -> Result<Vec<Violation>, String> {
    let files = collect_files_under(root, "crates")?;
    let mut violations = Vec::new();
    for path in files {
        let rel = rel_path(root, &path);
        if is_gate_self(&rel) {
            continue;
        }
        let Some(text) = read_text_or_skip(&path) else {
            continue;
        };
        let lower = text.to_ascii_lowercase();
        for token in OPENFLOW_COMPOUND_TOKENS {
            if lower.contains(token) {
                violations.push(Violation {
                    path: rel.clone(),
                    detail: format!("forbidden OpenFlow compound token `{token}`"),
                });
            }
        }
        for (line_no, line) in text.lines().enumerate() {
            if !line.contains("NXM_NX_REG") {
                continue;
            }
            let line_lower = line.to_ascii_lowercase();
            if line_lower.contains("identity")
                || line_lower.contains("pubkey")
                || line_lower.contains("footprint")
                || line_lower.contains("principal")
                || line_lower.contains("session")
            {
                violations.push(Violation {
                    path: rel.clone(),
                    detail: format!(
                        "NXM_NX_REG identity-coupled line {}: {}",
                        line_no + 1,
                        line.trim()
                    ),
                });
            }
        }
    }
    Ok(violations)
}

fn inventory_set(
    root: &Path,
    subdirs: &[&str],
    extension: &str,
) -> Result<BTreeSet<String>, String> {
    let mut set = BTreeSet::new();
    for sub in subdirs {
        let base = root.join(sub);
        if !base.is_dir() {
            continue;
        }
        let files = collect_files_under(root, sub)?;
        for path in files {
            if path.extension().and_then(|e| e.to_str()) != Some(extension) {
                continue;
            }
            let rel = rel_path(root, &path);
            if rel.contains("/.venv/") || rel.contains("/target/") || rel.contains("/node_modules/")
            {
                continue;
            }
            set.insert(rel);
        }
    }
    Ok(set)
}

fn collect_grpc_packages(root: &Path) -> Result<BTreeSet<String>, String> {
    let protos = inventory_set(root, &["crates"], "proto")?;
    let mut packages = BTreeSet::new();
    for rel in protos {
        let text = read_text(&root.join(&rel))?;
        for line in text.lines() {
            let trimmed = line.trim();
            if let Some(rest) = trimmed.strip_prefix("package ") {
                let name = rest.trim_end_matches(';').trim();
                if !name.is_empty() {
                    packages.insert(name.to_string());
                }
            }
        }
    }
    Ok(packages)
}

fn collect_grpc_service_packages(root: &Path) -> Result<BTreeSet<String>, String> {
    let protos = inventory_set(root, &["crates"], "proto")?;
    let mut packages = BTreeSet::new();
    for rel in protos {
        let text = read_text(&root.join(&rel))?;
        let package = text.lines().find_map(|line| {
            line.trim()
                .strip_prefix("package ")
                .map(|rest| rest.trim_end_matches(';').trim())
                .filter(|name| !name.is_empty())
        });
        let declares_service = text.lines().any(|line| {
            line.trim()
                .strip_prefix("service ")
                .and_then(|rest| rest.chars().next())
                .is_some_and(|c| c == '_' || c.is_ascii_alphabetic())
        });
        if declares_service {
            let package = package
                .ok_or_else(|| format!("gRPC service declaration without package in {rel}"))?;
            packages.insert(package.to_string());
        }
    }
    Ok(packages)
}

fn scan_identity_command_new(root: &Path) -> Result<Vec<Violation>, String> {
    let paths = identity_command_new_scope(root)?;
    let mut violations = Vec::new();
    for path in paths {
        let rel = rel_path(root, &path);
        let Some(text) = read_text_or_skip(&path) else {
            continue;
        };
        for pattern in COMMAND_NEW_PATTERNS {
            if text.contains(pattern) {
                violations.push(Violation {
                    path: rel.clone(),
                    detail: format!("forbidden subprocess pattern `{pattern}`"),
                });
            }
        }
    }
    Ok(violations)
}

fn line_matches_xray_daemon_forbidden(line: &str) -> bool {
    let lower = line.to_ascii_lowercase();
    const KEYWORDS: &[&str] = &[
        "identity",
        "session",
        "assertion",
        "footprint",
        "principal",
        "x-ghostbridge-footprint",
        "x-wireguard-pubkey",
        "oia1",
        "x-oracle-identity-assertion-bin",
    ];
    KEYWORDS.iter().any(|kw| lower.contains(kw))
}

fn scan_xray_daemon(root: &Path) -> Result<Vec<Violation>, String> {
    let base = root.join("crates/op-xray-daemon/src");
    if !base.is_dir() {
        return Err("missing crates/op-xray-daemon/src".into());
    }
    let mut files = Vec::new();
    collect_files_recursive(&base, &mut files)?;
    let mut violations = Vec::new();
    for path in files {
        let rel = rel_path(root, &path);
        let Some(text) = read_text_or_skip(&path) else {
            continue;
        };
        for (line_no, line) in text.lines().enumerate() {
            if line_matches_xray_daemon_forbidden(line) {
                violations.push(Violation {
                    path: rel.clone(),
                    detail: format!(
                        "forbidden identity vocabulary line {}: {}",
                        line_no + 1,
                        line.trim()
                    ),
                });
            }
        }
    }
    Ok(violations)
}

fn scrub_permitted_background_constructs(text: &str) -> String {
    text.replace(
        "tokio::task::spawn_blocking",
        "tokio::task::blocked_offload",
    )
    .replace("task::spawn_blocking", "task::blocked_offload")
}

fn scan_background_tasks(root: &Path) -> Result<Vec<Violation>, String> {
    let paths = identity_command_new_scope(root)?;
    let mut violations = Vec::new();
    for path in paths {
        let rel = rel_path(root, &path);
        let Some(text) = read_text_or_skip(&path) else {
            continue;
        };
        let stripped = strip_cfg_test_modules(&text);
        let had_spawn_blocking = stripped.contains("spawn_blocking");
        let text = scrub_permitted_background_constructs(&stripped);
        for pattern in BACKGROUND_FORBIDDEN {
            if text.contains(pattern) {
                violations.push(Violation {
                    path: rel.clone(),
                    detail: format!("forbidden background construct `{pattern}`"),
                });
            }
        }
        if had_spawn_blocking && rel != SPAWN_BLOCKING_ALLOWED {
            violations.push(Violation {
                path: rel.clone(),
                detail: "spawn_blocking outside allowed file".into(),
            });
        }
    }
    Ok(violations)
}

fn scan_xray_in_identity_glob(root: &Path) -> Result<Vec<Violation>, String> {
    let paths = glob_identity_src_files(root)?;
    if paths.is_empty() {
        return Err("xray-agnostic glob scope is empty".into());
    }
    let mut violations = Vec::new();
    for path in paths {
        let rel = rel_path(root, &path);
        let Some(text) = read_text_or_skip(&path) else {
            continue;
        };
        let lower = text.to_ascii_lowercase();
        if lower.contains("xray") {
            violations.push(Violation {
                path: rel,
                detail: "identity path must remain xray-agnostic".into(),
            });
        }
    }
    Ok(violations)
}

fn assert_violations_empty(label: &str, violations: Vec<Violation>) {
    if violations.is_empty() {
        return;
    }
    let mut msg = format!("{label} failed with {} violation(s):\n", violations.len());
    for v in violations {
        msg.push_str(&format!("  {} - {}\n", v.path, v.detail));
    }
    panic!("{msg}");
}

fn boundaries_path(root: &Path) -> PathBuf {
    root.join("docs/src/architecture/identity-boundaries.md")
}

fn ttl_900s_in_issuance_context(text: &str) -> bool {
    for line in text.lines() {
        let lower = line.to_ascii_lowercase();
        if !lower.contains("900 s") {
            continue;
        }
        if lower.contains("ttl") || lower.contains("issuance") || lower.contains("lifetime") {
            return true;
        }
    }
    false
}

#[test]
fn scan_root_non_vacuous() {
    let root = workspace_root()
        .canonicalize()
        .expect("canonicalize workspace root");
    let count = assert_scan_root_sane(&root).expect("scan root sanity");
    eprintln!("negative_topology_gates: scanned {count} files under crates/");
    let empty = tempfile::tempdir().expect("tempdir");
    let err = assert_scan_root_sane(empty.path()).unwrap_err();
    assert!(
        err.contains("Cargo.toml") || err.contains("empty") || err.contains("missing"),
        "empty root must hard-fail: {err}"
    );
}

#[test]
fn retired_waypipe_is_not_a_build_or_proto_input() {
    let root = workspace_root().canonicalize().unwrap();
    assert!(!root.join("crates/op-waypipe-grpc/Cargo.toml").exists());
    for manifest in ["Cargo.toml", "Cargo.lock"] {
        let text = fs::read_to_string(root.join(manifest)).unwrap();
        assert!(
            !text.contains("op-waypipe-grpc"),
            "retired Waypipe in {manifest}"
        );
    }
    assert!(!PINNED_GRPC_PACKAGES.contains(&"op.waypipe.v1"));
    assert!(!PINNED_GRPC_SERVICE_PACKAGES.contains(&"op.waypipe.v1"));
}

#[test]
fn host_is_never_a_wireguard_peer_of_the_decoy() {
    // The former `mkdrt` runit service made this host a peer on the decoy's
    // identity WireGuard (inside WARP). Identity is minted at the human's
    // WireGuard ingress on the decoy and carried by the client over WARP;
    // the host only validates. No host-side WireGuard peer link may return.
    let root = workspace_root();
    assert!(
        !root.join("deploy/runit/mkdrt").exists(),
        "deploy/runit/mkdrt must stay retired"
    );
    let enabled = fs::read_to_string(root.join("deploy/runit/enabled-services")).unwrap();
    assert!(
        !enabled.lines().any(|line| line.trim() == "mkdrt"),
        "mkdrt must not be an enabled service"
    );
    let retired = fs::read_to_string(root.join("deploy/runit/retired-services")).unwrap();
    assert!(
        retired.lines().any(|line| line.trim() == "mkdrt"),
        "mkdrt must be listed in retired-services"
    );
    for run in ["deploy/runit/op-grpc-bridge/run", "deploy/runit/op-web/run"] {
        let text = fs::read_to_string(root.join(run)).unwrap();
        assert!(!text.contains("mkdrt"), "{run} still references mkdrt");
    }
}

fn retired_standalone_adapters_are_not_build_or_proto_inputs() {

}

    let fixture = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let proto_dir = fixture.path().join("crates/demo/proto");
    fs::create_dir_all(&proto_dir).unwrap();
    fs::write(
        proto_dir.join("messages.proto"),
        "syntax = \"proto3\";\npackage fixture.messages.v1;\nmessage Item {}\n",
    )
    .unwrap();
    fs::write(
        proto_dir.join("authored.proto"),
        "syntax = \"proto3\";\npackage fixture.authored.v1;\nservice NewSurface {}\n",
    )
    .unwrap();

    let found = collect_grpc_service_packages(fixture.path()).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(found, BTreeSet::from(["fixture.authored.v1".to_string()]));
}
