/// Exercise the shipped client against the real TLS interceptor, identity sled
/// validator, grants and dispatcher. The identity subsystem authors the bytes.
#[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread")]
async fn built_in_client_forwards_authored_identity_and_preserves_grant_gate() {
    use op_grpc_bridge::{GhostbridgeCallMetadata, GrpcClientPool, RemoteOperationClient};

    struct RestoreEnvironment(Vec<(&'static str, Option<std::ffi::OsString>)>);
    impl Drop for RestoreEnvironment {
        fn drop(&mut self) {
            for (key, value) in &self.0 {
                if let Some(value) = value {
                    std::env::set_var(key, value);
                } else {
                    std::env::remove_var(key);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    let (srv, env) = start_server(false).await;
    let _restore = RestoreEnvironment(
        [
            "OP_DBUS_GRPC_CA_FILE",
            "OP_DBUS_GRPC_TLS_DOMAIN",
            "OP_IDENTITY_SESSION_ID",
        ]
        .into_iter()
        .map(|key| (key, std::env::var_os(key)))
        .collect(),
    );
    let ca = env._root.path().join("client-ca.pem");
    std::fs::write(&ca, &srv.ca_pem).unwrap();
    std::env::set_var("OP_DBUS_GRPC_CA_FILE", &ca);
    std::env::set_var("OP_DBUS_GRPC_TLS_DOMAIN", "localhost");
    let pubkey = pk(91);
    let channel = tls_channel(srv.addr, &srv.ca_pem).await;
    register_human(channel, &env, &pubkey, "built-in-client", [0x91; 16]).await;
    env.grant_human(&pubkey, &["human_principal.read"]);
    let session_id = derive_session_id(&pubkey);
    std::env::set_var("OP_IDENTITY_SESSION_ID", &session_id);
    let projection = op_identity::resolve_identity_credential_session(Some(&session_id)).unwrap();
    let encoded = projection.sealed_id_header_for_transport("grpc").unwrap();
    let wire = base64::engine::general_purpose::URL_SAFE_NO_PAD
        .decode(encoded)
        .unwrap();
    let mut identity = GhostbridgeCallMetadata {
        sealed_id: Some(wire.clone()),
        oracle_assertion: None,
        session_genesis: None,
        trace_id: None,
        wireguard_pubkey: None,
    };
    let client = RemoteOperationClient::new(
        Arc::new(GrpcClientPool::new()),
        &format!("https://{}", srv.addr),
        "identity-test",
    );
    let args = || vec![simd_json::json!({"human_pubkey": pubkey.clone()})];
    async fn client_call(
        client: &RemoteOperationClient,
        pubkey: &str,
        identity: &GhostbridgeCallMetadata,
    ) -> Result<simd_json::OwnedValue, op_grpc_bridge::grpc_client::GrpcClientError> {
        client
            .call_method_with_metadata(
                "human_principal",
                "/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/human_principal",
                "org.opdbus.v1.PluginV1",
                "resolve_key",
                vec![simd_json::json!({"human_pubkey": pubkey})],
                "",
                "human_principal.read",
                identity,
            )
            .await
    }
    client_call(&client, &pubkey, &identity)
        .await
        .expect("exact authored SID1 passes the receiver");
    client
        .call_method(
            "human_principal",
            "/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/human_principal",
            "org.opdbus.v1.PluginV1",
            "resolve_key",
            args(),
            "",
            "human_principal.read",
        )
        .await
        .expect("native client reads the configured private credential");

    // Even a well-formed envelope with a recomputed integrity trailer cannot
    // replace the credential authored and stored by the identity subsystem.
    let mut forged = op_identity::sealed_id::SealedId::open(&wire).unwrap();
    forged.trace_id = "caller-reconstructed".into();
    identity.sealed_id = Some(forged.seal().unwrap());
    let error = client_call(&client, &pubkey, &identity)
        .await
        .unwrap_err()
        .to_string();
    assert!(error.to_lowercase().contains("unauthenticated"), "{error}");
    identity.sealed_id = Some(wire.clone());
    identity.oracle_assertion = Some(fresh_signed(&env.issuer, &pubkey, [0x92; 16]).to_wire());
    assert!(client_call(&client, &pubkey, &identity)
        .await
        .unwrap_err()
        .to_string()
        .contains("multiple identity"));
    identity.sealed_id = None;
    client_call(&client, &pubkey, &identity)
        .await
        .expect("exact caller OIA1 passes the same receiver");
    identity.oracle_assertion = None;
    assert!(client_call(&client, &pubkey, &identity)
        .await
        .unwrap_err()
        .to_string()
        .contains("missing identity"));

    identity.sealed_id = Some(wire);
    env.set_grants(&empty_grants());
    assert!(
        client_call(&client, &pubkey, &identity).await.is_err(),
        "valid identity cannot bypass principal grants"
    );
}

/// The explicit decoy path acquires one OIA1 wire envelope and exercises the
/// receiver's trust, registration, provisioning, signature and grant gates.
#[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread")]
async fn built_in_client_acquires_oia1_from_decoy() {
    use op_grpc_bridge::{DecoyAssertionClient, GrpcClientPool, RemoteOperationClient};

    struct RestoreEnvironment(Vec<(&'static str, Option<std::ffi::OsString>)>);
    impl Drop for RestoreEnvironment {
        fn drop(&mut self) {
            for (key, value) in &self.0 {
                if let Some(value) = value {
                    std::env::set_var(key, value);
                } else {
                    std::env::remove_var(key);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    let (srv, env) = start_server(false).await;
    let _restore = RestoreEnvironment(
        ["OP_DBUS_GRPC_CA_FILE", "OP_DBUS_GRPC_TLS_DOMAIN"]
            .into_iter()
            .map(|key| (key, std::env::var_os(key)))
            .collect(),
    );
    let ca = env._root.path().join("decoy-client-ca.pem");
    std::fs::write(&ca, &srv.ca_pem).expect("client CA");
    std::env::set_var("OP_DBUS_GRPC_CA_FILE", &ca);
    std::env::set_var("OP_DBUS_GRPC_TLS_DOMAIN", "localhost");

    let pubkey = pk(93);
    let channel = tls_channel(srv.addr, &srv.ca_pem).await;
    register_human(channel, &env, &pubkey, "decoy-client", [0x93; 16]).await;

    let signed = env
        .issuer
        .issue(&pubkey, test_ip(), Duration::from_secs(60))
        .expect("fresh decoy assertion");
    let encoded = base64::engine::general_purpose::STANDARD.encode(signed.to_wire());
    let (issuer_addr, issuer_task) = start_assertion_issuer(encoded).await;
    let issuer = DecoyAssertionClient::new(issuer_addr, test_ip()).expect("decoy client");
    let client = RemoteOperationClient::new(
        Arc::new(GrpcClientPool::new()),
        &format!("https://{}", srv.addr),
        "decoy-client",
    );
    let result = client
        .call_method_via_decoy(
            "human_principal",
            "/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/human_principal",
            "org.opdbus.v1.PluginV1",
            "resolve_key",
            vec![simd_json::json!({"human_pubkey": pubkey.clone()})],
            "",
            "human_principal.read",
            &issuer,
        )
        .await
        .expect("decoy OIA1 reaches canonical human resolve");
    let rendered = serde_json::to_string(&result).expect("render resolve result");
    assert!(
        rendered.contains(&pubkey),
        "canonical result omitted pubkey: {rendered}"
    );
    issuer_task.abort();

    // A validly framed assertion from a key absent from the receiver trust
    // store is acquired, then rejected by the server's native validator.
    let untrusted = DecoyIssuer::new(
        SigningKey::from_bytes(&[8u8; 32]),
        "untrusted-decoy",
        Duration::from_secs(900),
    );
    let forged = untrusted
        .issue(&pubkey, test_ip(), Duration::from_secs(60))
        .expect("fresh untrusted assertion");
    let forged_body = base64::engine::general_purpose::STANDARD.encode(forged.to_wire());
    let (forged_addr, forged_task) = start_assertion_issuer(forged_body).await;
    let forged_client = DecoyAssertionClient::new(forged_addr, test_ip()).expect("decoy client");
    let error = client
        .call_method_via_decoy(
            "human_principal",
            "/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/human_principal",
            "org.opdbus.v1.PluginV1",
            "resolve_key",
            vec![simd_json::json!({"human_pubkey": pubkey})],
            "",
            "human_principal.read",
            &forged_client,
        )
        .await
        .expect_err("untrusted issuer must be denied by receiver");
    assert!(error.to_string().contains("UnknownDecoyKey"), "{error}");
    forged_task.abort();
}

fn audit_request<T>(
    env: &TestEnv,
    pubkey: &str,
    nonce: u8,
    capability: Option<&str>,
    body: T,
) -> Request<T> {
    let mut request = Request::new(body);
    attach_assertion(
        request.metadata_mut(),
        &fresh_signed(&env.issuer, pubkey, [nonce; 16]).to_wire(),
    );
    if let Some(capability) = capability {
        attach_capability(request.metadata_mut(), capability);
    }
    request
}

#[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread")]
async fn event_chain_rpc_rejects_missing_grants_and_unbacked_private_aliases() {
    use op_grpc_bridge::proto::{event_chain_service_client::EventChainServiceClient, *};
    let (srv, env) = start_server(false).await;
    let channel = tls_channel(srv.addr, &srv.ca_pem).await;
    let pubkey = pk(202);
    register_human(channel.clone(), &env, &pubkey, "audit-reader", [0xc0; 16]).await;
    let mut client = EventChainServiceClient::new(channel);
    let status = client
        .get_events(Request::new(GetEventsRequest::default()))
        .await
        .unwrap_err();
    assert_eq!(status.code(), Code::Unauthenticated);
    let status = client
        .get_events(audit_request(
            &env,
            &pubkey,
            0xc1,
            Some("snowball.read"),
            GetEventsRequest::default(),
        ))
        .await
        .unwrap_err();
    assert_eq!(
        status.code(),
        Code::PermissionDenied,
        "transport identity is not an audit grant"
    );
    env.grant_human(&pubkey, &["snowball.read", "snowball.invoke"]);
    let status = client
        .get_events(audit_request(
            &env,
            &pubkey,
            0xc2,
            None,
            GetEventsRequest::default(),
        ))
        .await
        .unwrap_err();
    assert_eq!(status.code(), Code::PermissionDenied);
    let status = client
        .get_events(audit_request(
            &env,
            &pubkey,
            0xc3,
            Some("snowball.invoke"),
            GetEventsRequest::default(),
        ))
        .await
        .unwrap_err();
    assert_eq!(
        status.code(),
        Code::PermissionDenied,
        "capability must match the pinned query method"
    );
    let mut duplicate = audit_request(
        &env,
        &pubkey,
        0xc4,
        Some("snowball.read"),
        GetEventsRequest::default(),
    );
    duplicate.metadata_mut().append(
        DECLARED_CAPABILITY_HEADER,
        MetadataValue::from_static("snowball.read"),
    );
    assert_eq!(
        client.get_events(duplicate).await.unwrap_err().code(),
        Code::PermissionDenied
    );

    let page = client
        .get_events(audit_request(
            &env,
            &pubkey,
            0xc5,
            Some("snowball.read"),
            GetEventsRequest {
                limit: 1,
                ..Default::default()
            },
        ))
        .await
        .unwrap()
        .into_inner();
    assert_eq!(page.events.len(), 1);
    assert!(page.has_more);
    let verification = client
        .verify_chain(audit_request(
            &env,
            &pubkey,
            0xc6,
            Some("snowball.read"),
            VerifyChainRequest::default(),
        ))
        .await
        .unwrap()
        .into_inner();
    assert!(verification.valid);
    let proof = client
        .get_proof(audit_request(
            &env,
            &pubkey,
            0xc7,
            Some("snowball.read"),
            GetProofRequest {
                event_id: page.events[0].event_id,
            },
        ))
        .await
        .unwrap()
        .into_inner();
    assert_eq!(proof.event_hash, page.events[0].event_hash);
    assert!(proof.batch_first_event_id > 0);
    client
        .prove_tag_immutability(audit_request(
            &env,
            &pubkey,
            0xc8,
            Some("snowball.read"),
            ProveTagImmutabilityRequest {
                plugin_id: "snowball".into(),
                tag: "fixture-tag".into(),
            },
        ))
        .await
        .unwrap();

    let head = srv.engine.event_chain.read().await.last_hash().to_owned();
    assert_eq!(
        client
            .get_snapshot(audit_request(
                &env,
                &pubkey,
                0xc9,
                Some("snowball.read"),
                GetSnapshotRequest {
                    snapshot_id: "unbacked".into()
                }
            ))
            .await
            .unwrap_err()
            .code(),
        Code::FailedPrecondition
    );
    assert_eq!(
        client
            .create_snapshot(audit_request(
                &env,
                &pubkey,
                0xca,
                Some("snowball.read"),
                CreateSnapshotRequest {
                    plugin_id: "identity_sled".into()
                }
            ))
            .await
            .unwrap_err()
            .code(),
        Code::PermissionDenied
    );
    assert_eq!(
        client
            .create_snapshot(audit_request(
                &env,
                &pubkey,
                0xcb,
                Some("snowball.invoke"),
                CreateSnapshotRequest {
                    plugin_id: "identity_sled".into()
                }
            ))
            .await
            .unwrap_err()
            .code(),
        Code::FailedPrecondition
    );
    assert_eq!(
        client
            .search_semantic_trace(audit_request(
                &env,
                &pubkey,
                0xcc,
                None,
                SearchSemanticTraceRequest::default()
            ))
            .await
            .unwrap_err()
            .code(),
        Code::FailedPrecondition
    );
    assert_eq!(
        srv.engine.event_chain.read().await.last_hash(),
        head,
        "unsupported aliases must have no backend effects"
    );
}

#[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread")]
async fn event_chain_rpc_stream_uses_engine_replays_and_rechecks_revocation() {
    use op_grpc_bridge::proto::{
        event_chain_service_client::EventChainServiceClient, SubscribeEventsRequest,
    };
    let (srv, env) = start_server(false).await;
    let channel = tls_channel(srv.addr, &srv.ca_pem).await;
    let pubkey = pk(203);
    register_human(channel.clone(), &env, &pubkey, "audit-stream", [0xd0; 16]).await;
    env.grant_human(&pubkey, &["snowball.read"]);
    let mut client = EventChainServiceClient::new(channel);
    let mut stream = client
        .subscribe_events(audit_request(
            &env,
            &pubkey,
            0xd1,
            Some("snowball.read"),
            SubscribeEventsRequest::default(),
        ))
        .await
        .unwrap()
        .into_inner();
    // Real MutationEngine append, not a separately fabricated service channel.
    srv.engine
        .dispatch_method_call(
            "snowball",
            "verify_chain",
            "{}",
            Some("snowball.read"),
            &principal_id_for(&pubkey),
        )
        .await
        .unwrap();
    let observed = tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(5), stream.message())
        .await
        .unwrap()
        .unwrap()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(observed.plugin_id, "snowball");
    assert_eq!(
        observed.event_hash,
        srv.engine
            .event_chain
            .read()
            .await
            .events()
            .last()
            .unwrap()
            .event_hash
    );

    let mut replay = client
        .subscribe_events(audit_request(
            &env,
            &pubkey,
            0xd2,
            Some("snowball.read"),
            SubscribeEventsRequest {
                from_event_id: observed.event_id,
                ..Default::default()
            },
        ))
        .await
        .unwrap()
        .into_inner();
    let replayed = tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(5), replay.message())
        .await
        .unwrap()
        .unwrap()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(replayed.event_id, observed.event_id);
    assert_eq!(replayed.event_hash, observed.event_hash);
    let invalid_cursor = audit_request(
        &env,
        &pubkey,
        0xd3,
        Some("snowball.read"),
        SubscribeEventsRequest {
            from_event_id: u64::MAX,
            ..Default::default()
        },
    );
    assert_eq!(
        client
            .subscribe_events(invalid_cursor)
            .await
            .unwrap_err()
            .code(),
        Code::OutOfRange
    );

    env.set_grants(&empty_grants());
    srv.engine
        .dispatch_method_call(
            "snowball",
            "verify_chain",
            "{}",
            Some("snowball.read"),
            "internal-fixture",
        )
        .await
        .unwrap();
    let revoked = tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(5), stream.message())
        .await
        .unwrap()
        .unwrap_err();
    assert_eq!(revoked.code(), Code::PermissionDenied);
}

<file path="op-grpc-bridge/tests/oscal_dispatch.rs">
//! Sealed-catalog OSCAL dispatch and durable annotation integration.
mod support;

use std::sync::Arc;

use anyhow::{anyhow, Result};
use op_grpc_bridge::MutationEngine;
use op_plugins::state_plugins::oscal_subid_registry::OscalSubidRegistryPlugin;
use op_state::StatePlugin;
use op_state_store::{ChainConfig, EventChain, MethodDecl, PluginSchema, SideEffect};
use serde_json::{json, Value};
use tokio::sync::RwLock;

fn make_engine() -> MutationEngine {
    MutationEngine::new(
        Arc::new(RwLock::new(EventChain::new(ChainConfig::default()))),
        Arc::new(op_network::rovs_proxy::OvsdbDbusClient::new()),
    )
}

fn annotated_fixture_schema() -> PluginSchema {
    let mut schema = PluginSchema::builder("fixture")
        .string_field("status", false, "Fixture status")
        .subid("status", "obs.service.fixture.status@v1")
        .build();
    schema.methods.insert(
        "inspect".into(),
        MethodDecl {
            name: "InspectFixture".into(),
            args: simd_json::json!({"type":"object","additionalProperties":false}),
            returns: Some(simd_json::json!({
                "type":"object",
                "properties":{"status":{"type":"string"}},
                "required":["status"],
                "additionalProperties":false
            })),
            side_effect: SideEffect::Read,
            idempotent: true,
            required_capability: Some("fixture.read".into()),
            subid: "obs.service.fixture.inspect@v1".into(),
        },
    );
    schema
}

async fn call_typed(
    engine: &MutationEngine,
    schema: &PluginSchema,
    method: &str,
    args: Value,
) -> Result<Value> {
    let declaration = schema
        .methods
        .get(method)
        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("fixture method {method} is absent"))?;
    let response = engine
        .dispatch_method_call(
            "oscal_subid_registry",
            method,
            &serde_json::to_string(&args)?,
            declaration.required_capability.as_deref(),
            "principal:oscal-fixture",
        )
        .await?;
    let result = response["result"].clone();
    let output_schema = serde_json::to_value(
        declaration
            .returns
            .as_ref()
            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("fixture method {method} has no output contract"))?,
    )?;
    jsonschema::validate(&output_schema, &result)
        .map_err(|error| anyhow!("{method} output violates its sealed contract: {error}"))?;
    Ok(result)
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn sealed_dispatch_is_typed_scoped_and_durable_across_engine_recreation() {
    let oscal_schema = OscalSubidRegistryPlugin::new().schema().unwrap();
    let fixture_schema = annotated_fixture_schema();
    let _catalog = support::CatalogScope::new(&[oscal_schema.clone(), fixture_schema]);
    let engine = make_engine();
    let target = "obs.service.fixture.status@v1";

    let wrong_capability = engine
        .dispatch_method_call(
            "oscal_subid_registry",
            "register",
            &json!({
                "subid": target,
                "expected_revision": 0,
                "control_source": "NIST SP 800-53",
                "control_refs": ["CM-3"],
                "statement_refs": []
            })
            .to_string(),
            Some("oscal.read"),
            "principal:oscal-fixture",
        )
        .await;
    assert!(
        wrong_capability.is_err(),
        "wrong capability must fail closed"
    );

    let unknown = engine
        .dispatch_method_call(
            "oscal_subid_registry",
            "register",
            &json!({
                "subid": "obs.service.fixture.missing@v1",
                "expected_revision": 0,
                "control_source": null,
                "control_refs": [],
                "statement_refs": []
            })
            .to_string(),
            Some("oscal.invoke"),
            "principal:oscal-fixture",
        )
        .await;
    assert!(unknown.is_err(), "an annotation cannot mint a new subid");

    let registered = call_typed(
        &engine,
        &oscal_schema,
        "register",
        json!({
            "subid": target,
            "expected_revision": 0,
            "control_source": "NIST SP 800-53",
            "control_refs": ["CM-3", "AC-1"],
            "statement_refs": ["CM-3_smt.a"]
        }),
    )
    .await
    .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(registered["subid"], target);
    assert_eq!(registered["annotation_revision"], 1);
    assert_eq!(registered["binding_count"], 1);

    drop(engine);
    let reopened = make_engine();
    let lookup = call_typed(&reopened, &oscal_schema, "lookup", json!({"subid": target}))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(lookup["entry"]["annotation"]["revision"], 1);
    assert_eq!(
        lookup["entry"]["annotation"]["control_refs"],
        json!(["AC-1", "CM-3"])
    );
    let encoded = lookup.to_string();
    assert!(!encoded.contains("principal:oscal-fixture"));
    assert!(!encoded.contains("oscal.invoke"));

    let listed = call_typed(
        &reopened,
        &oscal_schema,
        "list_by_category",
        json!({"category":"obs","limit":10}),
    )
    .await
    .unwrap();
    assert!(listed["entries"]
        .as_array()
        .unwrap()
        .iter()
        .any(|entry| entry["subid"] == target));

    let resolved = call_typed(
        &reopened,
        &oscal_schema,
        "resolve",
        json!({"plugin_id":"fixture","schema_method_key":"inspect"}),
    )
    .await
    .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(resolved["subid"], "obs.service.fixture.inspect@v1");
    assert_eq!(resolved["binding"]["schema_key"], "inspect");
    assert_eq!(resolved["binding"]["transport_name"], "InspectFixture");

    let exported = call_typed(
        &reopened,
        &oscal_schema,
        "export",
        json!({"plugin_id":"fixture","limit":10}),
    )
    .await
    .unwrap();
    assert!(exported["entries"]
        .as_array()
        .unwrap()
        .iter()
        .all(|entry| entry["bindings"]
            .as_array()
            .unwrap()
            .iter()
            .all(|binding| binding["plugin_id"] == "fixture")));
}

<file path="op-grpc-bridge/tests/sealed_catalog_authority.rs">
//! Startup consumes sealed plugins without writing or rebuilding their contracts.
use op_grpc_bridge::mutation_engine::MutationEngine;
use op_state_store::{ChainConfig, EventChain, PluginSchema};
use std::sync::Arc;
use tokio::sync::RwLock;

#[tokio::test]
async fn startup_restores_observations_without_publishing_schema_examples_or_resealing() {
    struct Restore(Vec<(&'static str, Option<std::ffi::OsString>)>);
    impl Drop for Restore {
        fn drop(&mut self) {
            for (key, value) in &self.0 {
                match value {
                    Some(value) => std::env::set_var(key, value),
                    None => std::env::remove_var(key),
                }
            }
        }
    }
    let root = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let catalog = root.path().join("blobs");
    let _restore = Restore(
        [
            "OP_BLOB_CATALOG_DIR",
            "OP_SHM_STATE_DIR",
            "DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS",
        ]
        .into_iter()
        .map(|key| (key, std::env::var_os(key)))
        .collect(),
    );
    std::env::set_var("OP_BLOB_CATALOG_DIR", &catalog);
    std::env::set_var("OP_SHM_STATE_DIR", root.path().join("state"));
    std::env::set_var(
        "DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS",
        format!("unix:path={}/absent-bus", root.path().display()),
    );
    let schema = PluginSchema::builder("fixture_uncompiled_plugin")
        .string_field("status", false, "Observed status")
        .example(simd_json::json!({"status":"example-is-not-observed"}))
        .build();
    let blob = op_blob::blobify_plugin_schema("fixture_uncompiled_plugin", schema);
    let mut sealer = op_blob::catalog::BlobStore::open(&catalog).unwrap();
    sealer.write(&blob).unwrap();
    let manifest = catalog.join(op_blob::catalog::MANIFEST_FILENAME);
    let before = std::fs::read(&manifest).unwrap();
    let files_before = std::fs::read_dir(&catalog).unwrap().count();
    let engine = MutationEngine::new(
        Arc::new(RwLock::new(EventChain::new(ChainConfig::default()))),
        Arc::new(op_network::rovs_proxy::OvsdbDbusClient::new()),
    );
    assert_eq!(engine.seed_missing_plugin_projections().await.unwrap(), 0);
    assert!(engine
        .get_state("fixture_uncompiled_plugin")
        .await
        .is_none());
    assert!(!root
        .path()
        .join("state/fixture_uncompiled_plugin.json")
        .exists());
    assert!(!root.path().join("state/.manifest.json").exists());
    assert!(engine.get_state("tched_router").await.is_none());
    assert_eq!(engine.seed_missing_plugin_projections().await.unwrap(), 0);
    assert_eq!(std::fs::read(manifest).unwrap(), before);
    assert_eq!(std::fs::read_dir(&catalog).unwrap().count(), files_before);

    // Mutable values recover from their durable store, while the original
    // catalog remains the only authority for which plugins may be projected.
    let documents = Arc::new(
        op_plugins::state_plugins::runtime_documents::RuntimeDocuments::new(
            op_cozo_store::CozoGraphShuttle::new_persistent(root.path().join("documents")).unwrap(),
        ),
    );
    let config = serde_json::json!({"configs":{"chosen_model":"provider/model","enabled":false}});
    let committed = config.clone();
    documents.update("config", |_| Ok(committed)).await.unwrap();
    documents
        .update("endpoint", |_| {
            Ok(serde_json::json!({"endpoints":["fixture"]}))
        })
        .await
        .unwrap();
    let sockets =
        op_plugins::state_plugins::shared_unix_socket_methods::SharedUnixSocketMethods::new(
            documents.clone(),
            root.path().join("fixture.sock"),
        )
        .unwrap();
    let registration = sockets
        .dispatch(
            "create_unix_socket",
            &serde_json::json!({
                "name":"fixture", "ports":[8081, 8080],
            }),
        )
        .await
        .unwrap();
    // Unsealed rows cannot materialize plugins.
    assert_eq!(
        engine
            .seed_plugin_projections_with_documents(Some(documents.clone()))
            .await
            .unwrap(),
        0
    );
    assert!(engine.get_state("config").await.is_none());
    assert!(engine.get_state("endpoint").await.is_none());
    assert!(engine.get_state("shared_unix_socket").await.is_none());
    sealer
        .write(&op_blob::blobify_plugin_schema(
            "config",
            PluginSchema::builder("config").build(),
        ))
        .unwrap();
    sealer
        .write(&op_blob::blobify_plugin_schema(
            "shared_unix_socket",
            PluginSchema::builder("shared_unix_socket").build(),
        ))
        .unwrap();
    let manifest = catalog.join(op_blob::catalog::MANIFEST_FILENAME);
    let pinned = std::fs::read(&manifest).unwrap();
    op_core::projection_shm::update_projection_in(
        root.path().join("state").to_str().unwrap(),
        "config",
        |_| Ok(Some(br#"{"configs":{"chosen_model":"stale"}}"#.to_vec())),
    )
    .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        engine
            .seed_plugin_projections_with_documents(Some(documents.clone()))
            .await
            .unwrap(),
        2
    );
    let restored =
        serde_json::to_value(engine.get_state("shared_unix_socket").await.unwrap()).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(restored["registrations"][0], registration["registration"]);
    assert_eq!(
        restored["registrations"][0]["ports"],
        serde_json::json!([8080, 8081])
    );
    assert_eq!(
        serde_json::to_value(engine.get_state("config").await.unwrap()).unwrap(),
        config
    );
    assert_eq!(
        serde_json::from_slice::<serde_json::Value>(
            &std::fs::read(root.path().join("state/config.json")).unwrap()
        )
        .unwrap(),
        config
    );
    assert_eq!(
        engine
            .seed_plugin_projections_with_documents(Some(documents.clone()))
            .await
            .unwrap(),
        0
    );
    assert!(engine.get_state("endpoint").await.is_none());
    assert_eq!(std::fs::read(&manifest).unwrap(), pinned);
    documents
        .update("config", |_| Ok(serde_json::json!({"configs":"corrupt"})))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert!(engine
        .seed_plugin_projections_with_documents(Some(documents))
        .await
        .is_err());
    assert_eq!(
        serde_json::to_value(engine.get_state("config").await.unwrap()).unwrap(),
        config
    );
    assert_eq!(std::fs::read(manifest).unwrap(), pinned);
}

<file path="op-grpc-bridge/tests/session_genesis_grep_gates.rs">
use std::{fs, path::Path};

fn rust_files(root: &Path, out: &mut Vec<std::path::PathBuf>) {
    for entry in fs::read_dir(root).expect("read source tree") {
        let path = entry.expect("directory entry").path();
        if path.is_dir() {
            rust_files(&path, out);
        } else if path.extension().and_then(|value| value.to_str()) == Some("rs") {
            out.push(path);
        }
    }
}

#[test]
fn grep_gates() {
    let workspace = Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"))
        .parent()
        .and_then(Path::parent)
        .expect("workspace root");
    let mut files = Vec::new();
    rust_files(&workspace.join("crates"), &mut files);

    let forbidden = [
        "write_sled_from_wg",
        "write_sled_full",
        "SENTINEL_FOOTPRINT",
        "anna_scribe",
        "plugin_schema.dat",
        "OP_SLED_PATH",
        "SHM_SLED_PATH",
        "op-identity-sled",
        "op-sled-top",
    ];
    let mut failures = Vec::new();

    for path in files {
        let source = fs::read_to_string(&path).expect("read Rust source");
        let relative = path.strip_prefix(workspace).unwrap_or(&path);
        if relative.ends_with("crates/op-grpc-bridge/tests/session_genesis_grep_gates.rs") {
            continue;
        }
        for (index, line) in source.lines().enumerate() {
            let code = line.split("//").next().unwrap_or("");
            for pattern in forbidden {
                if code.contains(pattern) {
                    failures.push(format!(
                        "{}:{}: forbidden {pattern}",
                        relative.display(),
                        index + 1
                    ));
                }
            }
            if code.contains("etch_footprint") {
                failures.push(format!(
                    "{}:{}: forbidden etch_footprint",
                    relative.display(),
                    index + 1
                ));
            }
            if relative.starts_with("crates/op-grpc-bridge")
                && code.contains("tracing::")
                && code.to_ascii_lowercase().contains("genesis")
                && !relative.starts_with("crates/op-grpc-bridge/tests")
            {
                failures.push(format!(
                    "{}:{}: genesis referenced by tracing macro",
                    relative.display(),
                    index + 1
                ));
            }
        }

        if source.contains("pub fn mint_genesis")
            && !relative.ends_with("crates/op-identity/src/session_genesis.rs")
        {
            failures.push(format!(
                "{}: mint_genesis implementation outside session_genesis.rs",
                relative.display()
            ));
        }
    }

    assert!(
        failures.is_empty(),
        "session-genesis grep gates failed:\n{}",
        failures.join("\n")
    );
}
</file>

<file path="op-grpc-bridge/tests/shm_state_tree.rs">
//! MutationEngine publishes complete committed trees, including descendant changes.
use std::sync::Arc;

use op_grpc_bridge::{ChangeSource, ChangeType, MutationEngine};
use op_state::StatePlugin;
use op_state_store::PluginSchema;
use simd_json::{json, OwnedValue};
use tokio::sync::broadcast::error::TryRecvError;

mod support;

fn engine() -> MutationEngine {
    MutationEngine::new(
        Arc::new(tokio::sync::RwLock::new(op_state_store::EventChain::new(
            op_state_store::ChainConfig::default(),
        ))),
        Arc::new(op_network::rovs_proxy::OvsdbDbusClient::new()),
    )
}

fn catalog() -> support::CatalogScope {
    // This fixture models two schema-declared children; the real Incus
    // adapter must publish its own schema's topology representation.
    let child = PluginSchema::builder("child")
        .string_field("status", false, "Observed status")
        .integer_field("pid", false, "Observed process ID")
        .build();
    let children = PluginSchema::builder("children")
        .object_field("one", child.fields.clone(), false, "First child")
        .object_field("two", child.fields, false, "Second child")
        .build();
    support::CatalogScope::new(&[PluginSchema::builder("incus")
        .object_field("instances", children.fields, false, "Observed children")
        .integer_field("keep", false, "Sibling value")
        .boolean_field("actual", false, "Observed flag")
        .boolean_field("committed", false, "Committed flag")
        .public_state_paths(&["/instances", "/keep", "/actual", "/committed"])
        .build()])
}

async fn change(
    engine: &MutationEngine,
    suffix: &str,
    kind: ChangeType,
    member: Option<&str>,
    value: OwnedValue,
) -> Result<op_grpc_bridge::mutation_engine::StateChange, String> {
    engine
        .process_authoritative_change(
            "incus".into(),
            format!("/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/incus{suffix}"),
            kind,
            member.map(str::to_string),
            None,
            value,
            vec!["state".into()],
            "fixture".into(),
            None,
            ChangeSource::Internal,
        )
        .await
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn children_merge_against_shm_and_parent_notifications_contain_the_complete_tree() {
    let _catalog = catalog();
    let first = engine();
    change(
        &first,
        "",
        ChangeType::PropertySet,
        None,
        json!({"instances":{"one":{"status":"up"},"two":{"status":"down","pid":3}},"keep":7}),
    )
    .await
    .unwrap();

    // A second engine has no RAM state: the fold must use the committed tree.
    let second = engine();
    let mut rx = second.change_tx().subscribe();
    change(
        &second,
        "/instances/two",
        ChangeType::PropertySet,
        Some("status"),
        json!("ready"),
    )
    .await
    .unwrap();
    let notification = rx.try_recv().unwrap();
    let state = second.get_public_state("incus").await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(state["instances"]["one"]["status"], "up");
    assert_eq!(state["instances"]["two"], json!({"status":"ready","pid":3}));
    assert_eq!(state["keep"], 7);
    assert_eq!(notification.object_path, "/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/incus");
    assert_eq!(notification.new_value, state);

    change(
        &second,
        "/instances/two",
        ChangeType::PropertyDelete,
        Some("pid"),
        json!(null),
    )
    .await
    .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        second.get_public_state("incus").await.unwrap()["instances"]["two"],
        json!({"status":"ready"})
    );
    change(
        &second,
        "/instances/two",
        ChangeType::ObjectRemoved,
        None,
        json!(null),
    )
    .await
    .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        second.get_public_state("incus").await.unwrap(),
        json!({"instances":{"one":{"status":"up"}},"keep":7})
    );
    change(&second, "", ChangeType::ObjectRemoved, None, json!(null))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert!(second.get_public_state("incus").await.is_none());
    assert!(second.get_state("incus").await.is_none());
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn failed_commit_changes_neither_state_mirror_nor_state_notifications() {
    let catalog = catalog();
    let engine = engine();
    let original = json!({"instances":{"one":{"status":"up"}}});
    change(&engine, "", ChangeType::PropertySet, None, original.clone())
        .await
        .unwrap();
    let mut rx = engine.change_tx().subscribe();
    let state_path = catalog.root().join("state/incus.json");
    let manifest_path = catalog.root().join("state/.manifest.json");
    let original_bytes = std::fs::read(&state_path).unwrap();
    let original_manifest = std::fs::read(&manifest_path).unwrap();
    // An interrupted transaction may not be treated as committed state.
    std::fs::write(&manifest_path, br#"{"generation":1,"publishing":true}"#).unwrap();
    assert!(change(
        &engine,
        "/instances/one",
        ChangeType::PropertySet,
        Some("status"),
        json!("bad")
    )
    .await
    .is_err());
    assert_eq!(std::fs::read(&state_path).unwrap(), original_bytes);
    assert_eq!(engine.get_state("incus").await, Some(original));
    assert!(matches!(rx.try_recv(), Err(TryRecvError::Empty)));
    assert!(engine.get_public_state("incus").await.is_none());
    std::fs::write(manifest_path, original_manifest).unwrap();
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn private_backend_fields_stay_in_shm_and_out_of_state_notifications_and_observation_audit() {
    let scope = catalog();
    let engine = engine();
    let mut updates = engine.change_tx().subscribe();
    let mut audit = engine.chain_tx().subscribe();
    change(
        &engine,
        "",
        ChangeType::PropertySet,
        None,
        json!({
            "instances": {"one": {"status": "up", "private_config": "child-secret"}},
            "private_config": "root-secret"
        }),
    )
    .await
    .unwrap();
    let expected = json!({"instances": {"one": {"status": "up"}}});
    assert_eq!(updates.try_recv().unwrap().new_value, expected);
    let event = audit.try_recv().unwrap();
    let serialized = serde_json::to_string(&event).unwrap();
    assert!(!serialized.contains("child-secret"));
    assert!(!serialized.contains("root-secret"));
    let bytes = std::fs::read(scope.root().join("state/incus.json")).unwrap();
    let private: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_slice(&bytes).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        private["instances"]["one"]["private_config"],
        "child-secret"
    );
    assert_eq!(private["private_config"], "root-secret");

    change(
        &engine,
        "/instances/one",
        ChangeType::PropertySet,
        Some("private_config"),
        json!("replacement-secret"),
    )
    .await
    .unwrap();
    let update = updates.try_recv().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(update.old_value, Some(expected.clone()));
    assert_eq!(update.new_value, expected);
    assert!(!serde_json::to_string(&audit.try_recv().unwrap())
        .unwrap()
        .contains("replacement-secret"));
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn method_arguments_and_unsealed_orphan_files_are_never_present_state() {
    let catalog = catalog();
    let engine = engine();
    change(
        &engine,
        "",
        ChangeType::PropertySet,
        None,
        json!({"actual":true}),
    )
    .await
    .unwrap();
    let mut rx = engine.change_tx().subscribe();
    change(
        &engine,
        "",
        ChangeType::MethodCall,
        Some("method"),
        json!({"argument":"not state"}),
    )
    .await
    .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        engine.get_public_state("incus").await.unwrap(),
        json!({"actual":true})
    );
    assert!(matches!(rx.try_recv(), Err(TryRecvError::Empty)));
    std::fs::write(
        catalog.root().join("state/unsealed.json"),
        br#"{"secret":true}"#,
    )
    .unwrap();
    assert!(engine.get_public_state("unsealed").await.is_none());
    assert!(engine
        .process_authoritative_change(
            "unsealed".into(),
            "/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/unsealed".into(),
            ChangeType::PropertySet,
            None,
            None,
            json!({"new":true}),
            vec![],
            "fixture".into(),
            None,
            ChangeSource::Internal,
        )
        .await
        .is_err());
    assert!(matches!(rx.try_recv(), Err(TryRecvError::Empty)));
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn public_reads_ignore_a_prepared_but_uncommitted_working_mirror() {
    let _catalog = catalog();
    let engine = engine();
    change(
        &engine,
        "",
        ChangeType::PropertySet,
        None,
        json!({"committed":true}),
    )
    .await
    .unwrap();
    engine
        .update_state_cache("incus".into(), json!({"prepared":true}))
        .await;
    assert_eq!(
        engine.get_public_state("incus").await.unwrap(),
        json!({"committed":true})
    );
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn generic_identity_updates_cannot_bypass_the_durable_owner() {
    let catalog = support::CatalogScope::new(&[
        op_plugins::state_plugins::identity_sled::IdentitySledPlugin::new()
            .schema()
            .unwrap(),
    ]);
    let engine = engine();
    let mut changes = engine.change_tx().subscribe();
    let mut audit = engine.chain_tx().subscribe();
    for (suffix, kind, member, value) in [
        ("", ChangeType::PropertySet, None, json!({"sleds":[]})),
        (
            "/sleds/one",
            ChangeType::PropertySet,
            Some("active".into()),
            json!(false),
        ),
        ("", ChangeType::ObjectRemoved, None, json!(null)),
    ] {
        let error = engine
            .process_authoritative_change(
                "identity_sled".into(),
                format!("/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/identity_sled{suffix}"),
                kind,
                member,
                None,
                value,
                vec![],
                "fixture".into(),
                None,
                ChangeSource::Internal,
            )
            .await
            .unwrap_err();
        assert!(error.contains("durable intent owner"), "{error}");
    }
    assert!(!catalog.root().join("state/identity_sled.json").exists());
    assert!(!catalog
        .root()
        .join("state/.credentials/identity_sled.json")
        .exists());
    assert!(engine.get_state("identity_sled").await.is_none());
    assert!(matches!(changes.try_recv(), Err(TryRecvError::Empty)));
    assert!(matches!(audit.try_recv(), Err(TryRecvError::Empty)));
}

<file path="op-grpc-bridge/tests/source_reachability_gate.rs">
//! Verified-source gate: every `.rs` under a crate's `src/` must be reachable
//! from a compile root, and no editor/patch artifacts may sit next to source.
//!
//! The 2026-09-19 review found ~41k LOC of orphaned files (never compiled,
//! never tested, contradicting "verified source") and 26 `.patch`/`.bak`/
//! `.sql` strays. This gate keeps the tree honest: a file that is not part of
//! the build cannot be verified and must not be committed as if it were.
//!
//! Reachability follows rustc: `lib.rs`, `main.rs`, `src/bin/*.rs`,
//! `src/bin/*/main.rs` and `[[bin]] path` entries are roots; `mod name;`
//! resolves to `name.rs` or `name/mod.rs` in the module's directory (or
//! `#[path = "…"]`); `include!("…")` pulls a file in. `#[cfg]`-gated modules
//! count as reachable — they are still compiled under some configuration.

use std::collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet};
use std::fs;
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

/// Non-source files allowed next to source (deliberate, referenced).
const ALLOWED_NON_SOURCE_SUFFIXES: &[&str] = &[
    ".rs",
    ".proto",
    ".md",
    ".json",
    ".toml",
    ".txt",
    ".inc",
    ".template",
    ".gitkeep",
    ".ovsschema",
    ".pem",
    ".crt",
    ".key",
    ".yaml",
    ".yml",
    ".sh",
    ".html",
    ".css",
    ".js",
    ".csv",
    ".jsonl",
    ".cozo",
    ".py",
    ".snap",
    ".golden",
    ".xml",
    ".conf",
    ".service",
    ".ron",
];

/// Suffixes that are always artifacts.
const STRAY_SUFFIXES: &[&str] = &[
    ".bak",
    ".patch",
    ".backup",
    ".copied",
    ".stub",
    ".fix",
    ".orig",
    ".rej",
    ".swp",
    ".grpc-additions",
    ".code-workspace",
    ".sql",
];

fn workspace_root() -> PathBuf {
    PathBuf::from(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join("../..")
}

fn rel(root: &Path, path: &Path) -> String {
    path.strip_prefix(root)
        .unwrap_or(path)
        .to_string_lossy()
        .replace('\\', "/")
}

fn walk(dir: &Path, out: &mut Vec<PathBuf>) {
    let Ok(entries) = fs::read_dir(dir) else {
        return;
    };
    for entry in entries.flatten() {
        let path = entry.path();
        let name = entry.file_name().to_string_lossy().to_string();
        if name == "target" || name == ".git" {
            continue;
        }
        if path.is_dir() {
            walk(&path, out);
        } else {
            out.push(path);
        }
    }
}

fn normalize(path: &Path) -> PathBuf {
    let mut out = PathBuf::new();
    for component in path.components() {
        match component {
            std::path::Component::ParentDir => {
                out.pop();
            }
            std::path::Component::CurDir => {}
            other => out.push(other.as_os_str()),
        }
    }
    out
}

/// `mod name;` declarations with an optional preceding `#[path = "…"]`.
fn mod_declarations(source: &str) -> Vec<(Option<String>, String)> {
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    let mut pending_path: Option<String> = None;
    for raw in source.lines() {
        let line = raw.trim();
        if let Some(rest) = line.strip_prefix("#[path") {
            if let Some(start) = rest.find('"') {
                if let Some(end) = rest[start + 1..].find('"') {
                    pending_path = Some(rest[start + 1..start + 1 + end].to_string());
                }
            }
            // `#[path = "x"] mod y;` on one line falls through below.
            if !line.contains(" mod ") {
                continue;
            }
        }
        let without_attr = match line.rfind(']') {
            Some(i) if line.starts_with("#[") => line[i + 1..].trim(),
            _ => line,
        };
        let stripped = without_attr
            .strip_prefix("pub(crate) ")
            .or_else(|| without_attr.strip_prefix("pub(super) "))
            .or_else(|| without_attr.strip_prefix("pub "))
            .unwrap_or(without_attr);
        if let Some(rest) = stripped.strip_prefix("mod ") {
            let name: String = rest
                .chars()
                .take_while(|c| c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || *c == '_')
                .collect();
            let tail = rest[name.len()..].trim_start();
            if !name.is_empty() && tail.starts_with(';') {
                out.push((pending_path.take(), name));
                continue;
            }
        }
        if !line.starts_with("#[") {
            pending_path = None;
        }
    }
    out
}

/// `include!("relative.rs")` targets.
fn include_targets(source: &str) -> Vec<String> {
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    let mut rest = source;
    while let Some(i) = rest.find("include!(\"") {
        let after = &rest[i + "include!(\"".len()..];
        if let Some(end) = after.find('"') {
            let target = &after[..end];
            if target.ends_with(".rs") && !target.contains("OUT_DIR") {
                out.push(target.to_string());
            }
            rest = &after[end..];
        } else {
            break;
        }
    }
    out
}

fn crate_roots(crate_dir: &Path) -> Vec<PathBuf> {
    let src = crate_dir.join("src");
    let mut roots = Vec::new();
    for candidate in ["lib.rs", "main.rs"] {
        let path = src.join(candidate);
        if path.exists() {
            roots.push(path);
        }
    }
    let bin = src.join("bin");
    if let Ok(entries) = fs::read_dir(&bin) {
        for entry in entries.flatten() {
            let path = entry.path();
            if path.extension().is_some_and(|e| e == "rs") {
                roots.push(path);
            } else if path.join("main.rs").exists() {
                roots.push(path.join("main.rs"));
            }
        }
    }
    if let Ok(manifest) = fs::read_to_string(crate_dir.join("Cargo.toml")) {
        for line in manifest.lines() {
            let line = line.trim();
            if let Some(rest) = line.strip_prefix("path") {
                let rest = rest.trim_start().strip_prefix('=').unwrap_or("").trim();
                let value = rest.trim_matches('"');
                if value.ends_with(".rs") {
                    let path = crate_dir.join(value);
                    if path.exists() && normalize(&path).starts_with(normalize(&src)) {
                        roots.push(path);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    roots.into_iter().map(|p| normalize(&p)).collect()
}

fn reachable_sources(crate_dir: &Path) -> BTreeSet<PathBuf> {
    let roots = crate_roots(crate_dir);
    let root_set: BTreeSet<PathBuf> = roots.iter().cloned().collect();
    let mut seen = BTreeSet::new();
    let mut stack = roots;
    while let Some(file) = stack.pop() {
        if !seen.insert(file.clone()) || !file.exists() {
            continue;
        }
        let Ok(source) = fs::read_to_string(&file) else {
            continue;
        };
        let dir = file.parent().unwrap().to_path_buf();
        let name = file.file_name().unwrap().to_string_lossy().to_string();
        let module_dir = if name == "lib.rs"
            || name == "main.rs"
            || name == "mod.rs"
            || root_set.contains(&file)
        {
            dir.clone()
        } else {
            dir.join(name.trim_end_matches(".rs"))
        };
        for target in include_targets(&source) {
            stack.push(normalize(&dir.join(&target)));
        }
        for (explicit, module) in mod_declarations(&source) {
            match explicit {
                Some(path) => {
                    // rustc resolves `#[path]` relative to the current file's
                    // directory for lib/main/mod.rs, else the module directory;
                    // accept either so a moved file cannot hide.
                    stack.push(normalize(&dir.join(&path)));
                    stack.push(normalize(&module_dir.join(&path)));
                }
                None => {
                    stack.push(normalize(&module_dir.join(format!("{module}.rs"))));
                    stack.push(normalize(&module_dir.join(&module).join("mod.rs")));
                }
            }
        }
    }
    seen
}

#[test]
fn every_source_file_under_src_is_reachable_from_a_compile_root() {
    let root = normalize(&workspace_root());
    let crates_dir = root.join("crates");
    let mut orphans: BTreeMap<String, Vec<String>> = BTreeMap::new();
    for entry in fs::read_dir(&crates_dir).expect("crates dir").flatten() {
        let crate_dir = normalize(&entry.path());
        let src = crate_dir.join("src");
        if !src.is_dir() {
            continue;
        }
        let reachable = reachable_sources(&crate_dir);
        let mut all = Vec::new();
        walk(&src, &mut all);
        for file in all {
            let file = normalize(&file);
            if file.extension().is_some_and(|e| e == "rs") && !reachable.contains(&file) {
                orphans
                    .entry(rel(&root, &crate_dir))
                    .or_default()
                    .push(rel(&root, &file));
            }
        }
    }
    assert!(
        orphans.is_empty(),
        "unreachable source files (never compiled, so never verified) — delete them or declare the module:\n{}",
        orphans
            .iter()
            .map(|(c, files)| format!("  {c}:\n{}", files.iter().map(|f| format!("    {f}")).collect::<Vec<_>>().join("\n")))
            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
            .join("\n")
    );
}

#[test]
fn no_editor_or_patch_artifacts_live_next_to_source() {
    let root = normalize(&workspace_root());
    let mut files = Vec::new();
    walk(&root.join("crates"), &mut files);
    let mut strays = Vec::new();
    for file in files {
        let name = file.file_name().unwrap().to_string_lossy().to_string();
        let path = rel(&root, &file);
        let is_stray = STRAY_SUFFIXES.iter().any(|s| name.ends_with(s))
            || (name.contains(".rs.")
                && !ALLOWED_NON_SOURCE_SUFFIXES
                    .iter()
                    .any(|s| name.ends_with(s)));
        if is_stray && !path.contains("/tests/fixtures/") && !path.contains("/testdata/") {
            strays.push(path);
        }
    }
    assert!(
        strays.is_empty(),
        "artifacts committed next to verified source — delete them:\n{}",
        strays.join("\n")
    );
}

#[test]
fn the_gate_sees_through_path_attributes_and_includes() {
    let dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let crate_dir = dir.path().join("fixture");
    let src = crate_dir.join("src");
    fs::create_dir_all(src.join("nested")).unwrap();
    fs::write(
        crate_dir.join("Cargo.toml"),
        "[package]\nname = \"fixture\"\n",
    )
    .unwrap();
    fs::write(
        src.join("lib.rs"),
        "mod plain;\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests;\n#[path = \"nested/renamed.rs\"]\nmod moved;\npub mod wrapper;\n",
    )
    .unwrap();
    fs::write(src.join("plain.rs"), "").unwrap();
    fs::write(src.join("tests.rs"), "").unwrap();
    fs::write(src.join("nested/renamed.rs"), "").unwrap();
    fs::write(src.join("wrapper.rs"), "include!(\"generated_body.rs\");\n").unwrap();
    fs::write(src.join("generated_body.rs"), "").unwrap();
    fs::write(src.join("orphan.rs"), "").unwrap();
    let reachable = reachable_sources(&normalize(&crate_dir));
    let names: BTreeSet<String> = reachable
        .iter()
        .map(|p| rel(&normalize(&crate_dir), p))
        .collect();
    for expected in [
        "src/lib.rs",
        "src/plain.rs",
        "src/tests.rs",
        "src/nested/renamed.rs",
        "src/wrapper.rs",
        "src/generated_body.rs",
    ] {
        assert!(
            names.contains(expected),
            "{expected} missing from {names:?}"
        );
    }
    assert!(!names.contains("src/orphan.rs"));
}

<file path="op-grpc-bridge/tests/tched_config_proto_contract.rs">
//! Check actual generated and freshly sealed transport descriptors. Their field
//! numbers and message layouts differ; the plugin's output contract owns value
//! semantics. Fixtures never read or reseal a live catalog.
use op_plugins::state_plugins::tched_router::{
    tched_router_plugin_schema, ConfigPropertyKind, ConfigPropertyOutput,
};
use op_state_store::PluginSchema;
use prost::Message;
use prost_reflect::{DescriptorPool, DynamicMessage, Kind, MessageDescriptor, SerializeOptions};
use serde::de::DeserializeSeed;
use serde_json::{json, Value};
use std::sync::OnceLock;

struct Contracts {
    schema: PluginSchema,
    native: DescriptorPool,
    sealed: DescriptorPool,
    manifest: op_blob::BlobManifest,
}

fn contracts() -> &'static Contracts {
    static CONTRACTS: OnceLock<Contracts> = OnceLock::new();
    CONTRACTS.get_or_init(|| {
        let schema = tched_router_plugin_schema();
        let blob = op_blob::blobify_plugin_schema("tched_router", schema.clone());
        let bytes = blob.seal();
        let pinned =
            op_blob::BlobRef::from_manifest_pinned(&bytes, &blob.manifest.schema_hash).unwrap();
        let restored: PluginSchema = serde_json::from_str(pinned.schema_json()).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            serde_json::to_value(&restored).unwrap(),
            serde_json::to_value(&schema).unwrap()
        );
        Contracts {
            schema: restored,
            native: DescriptorPool::decode(op_grpc_bridge::proto::FILE_DESCRIPTOR_SET).unwrap(),
            sealed: DescriptorPool::decode(pinned.descriptor_set()).unwrap(),
            manifest: pinned.manifest().unwrap(),
        }
    })
}

impl Contracts {
    fn output_schema(&self, method: &str) -> Value {
        serde_json::to_value(self.schema.methods[method].returns.as_ref().unwrap()).unwrap()
    }

    fn outputs(&self, method: &str, native_name: &str) -> [MessageDescriptor; 2] {
        let manifest = self
            .manifest
            .methods
            .iter()
            .find(|entry| entry.schema_name == method)
            .expect("canonical method key in sealed manifest");
        [
            self.native
                .get_message_by_name(&format!("operation.plugin.v1.{native_name}"))
                .unwrap(),
            self.sealed
                .get_message_by_name(&manifest.output_message)
                .unwrap(),
        ]
    }
}

fn assert_local_refs_resolve(root: &Value, value: &Value) {
    match value {
        Value::Object(object) => {
            if let Some(reference) = object.get("$ref").and_then(Value::as_str) {
                let pointer = reference
                    .strip_prefix('#')
                    .expect("method output contracts use only local references");
                assert!(
                    root.pointer(pointer).is_some(),
                    "unresolved output {reference}"
                );
            }
            for child in object.values() {
                assert_local_refs_resolve(root, child);
            }
        }
        Value::Array(array) => {
            for child in array {
                assert_local_refs_resolve(root, child);
            }
        }
        _ => {}
    }
}

fn roundtrip(descriptor: &MessageDescriptor, input: &Value) -> Value {
    let text = serde_json::to_string(input).unwrap();
    let message = descriptor
        .clone()
        .deserialize(&mut serde_json::Deserializer::from_str(&text))
        .unwrap();
    let decoded =
        DynamicMessage::decode(descriptor.clone(), message.encode_to_vec().as_slice()).unwrap();
    let mut bytes = Vec::new();
    decoded
        .serialize_with_options(
            &mut serde_json::Serializer::new(&mut bytes),
            &SerializeOptions::new()
                .use_proto_field_name(true)
                .stringify_64_bit_integers(false)
                .skip_default_fields(false),
        )
        .unwrap();
    serde_json::from_slice(&bytes).unwrap()
}

fn assert_json_preserved(expected: &Value, actual: &Value) {
    match (expected, actual) {
        (Value::Number(a), Value::Number(b)) => {
            // Struct/Value carry doubles. These fixtures deliberately stay in
            // the exact integer range; this is not a uint64-fidelity claim.
            assert!(a.as_f64().unwrap().abs() <= 9_007_199_254_740_992.0);
            assert_eq!(a.as_f64(), b.as_f64());
        }
        (Value::Object(a), Value::Object(b)) => {
            assert_eq!(a.len(), b.len());
            for (key, value) in a {
                assert_json_preserved(value, b.get(key).unwrap());
            }
        }
        (Value::Array(a), Value::Array(b)) => {
            assert_eq!(a.len(), b.len());
            for (a, b) in a.iter().zip(b) {
                assert_json_preserved(a, b);
            }
        }
        _ => assert_eq!(expected, actual),
    }
}

fn assert_kind_preserved(kind: Kind, expected: &Value, actual: &Value) {
    match kind {
        Kind::Message(message) if !message.full_name().starts_with("google.protobuf.") => {
            assert_message_preserved(&message, expected, actual);
        }
        _ => assert_json_preserved(expected, actual),
    }
}

fn assert_message_preserved(descriptor: &MessageDescriptor, expected: &Value, actual: &Value) {
    let expected = expected.as_object().unwrap();
    let actual = actual.as_object().unwrap();
    for (name, value) in expected {
        let field = descriptor.get_field_by_name(name).unwrap();
        let actual = actual
            .get(name)
            .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("missing field {name}"));
        if field.is_map() {
            let Kind::Message(entry) = field.kind() else {
                panic!("map entry")
            };
            let kind = entry.get_field_by_name("value").unwrap().kind();
            let expected = value.as_object().unwrap();
            let actual = actual.as_object().unwrap();
            assert_eq!(expected.len(), actual.len(), "stable map keys");
            for (key, value) in expected {
                assert_kind_preserved(kind.clone(), value, actual.get(key).unwrap());
            }
        } else if field.is_list() {
            let expected = value.as_array().unwrap();
            let actual = actual.as_array().unwrap();
            assert_eq!(expected.len(), actual.len(), "array cardinality");
            for (value, actual) in expected.iter().zip(actual) {
                assert_kind_preserved(field.kind(), value, actual);
            }
        } else {
            assert_kind_preserved(field.kind(), value, actual);
        }
    }
    // Protobuf repeated/map fields have no presence. Match the bridge's JSON
    // serializer, allowing only those declared empty defaults to be added;
    // absent scalar/nullable properties must never become invented values.
    for (name, value) in actual
        .iter()
        .filter(|(name, _)| !expected.contains_key(*name))
    {
        let field = descriptor.get_field_by_name(name).unwrap();
        assert!(
            (field.is_list() && value == &json!([])) || (field.is_map() && value == &json!({})),
            "unexpected field {name} in {}: {value}",
            descriptor.full_name()
        );
    }
}

#[test]
fn native_config_outputs_survive_generated_and_sealed_descriptors() {
    let contracts = contracts();
    for method in std::iter::once("GetConfig").chain(
        op_plugins::state_plugins::tched_router_config_surface::SECTIONS
            .iter()
            .map(|(method, _, _)| *method),
    ) {
        let output = contracts.output_schema(method);
        assert_local_refs_resolve(&output, &output);
        jsonschema::Validator::new(&output).expect("sealed method output compiles");
    }

    let gateway = json!({"port":0,"allow_public_bind":false,"path_prefix":null,"tls":null});
    let agents = json!({"fixture-agent":{"enabled":false,"cron_jobs":["fixture-job"],
        "identity":{"format":"aieos","aieos_inline":null,"aieos_path":null}}});
    let routes = json!([{"hint":"semantic","model_provider":"openai.fixture", "model":"fixture-model", "dimensions":0,"api_key":null}]);
    for (method, native_name, value) in [
        (
            "GetConfig",
            "TchedRouterGetConfigResponse",
            json!({"config":{}}),
        ),
        (
            "GetConfig",
            "TchedRouterGetConfigResponse",
            json!({"config":{"gateway":gateway.clone(),"agents":agents.clone(),"embedding_routes":routes.clone()}}),
        ),
        (
            "GetGatewayConfig",
            "TchedRouterGetGatewayConfigResponse",
            json!({"config":gateway}),
        ),
        (
            "GetAgentsConfig",
            "TchedRouterGetAgentsConfigResponse",
            json!({"config":agents}),
        ),
        (
            "GetEmbeddingRoutesConfig",
            "TchedRouterGetEmbeddingRoutesConfigResponse",
            json!({"config":routes}),
        ),
    ] {
        let contract = contracts.output_schema(method);
        jsonschema::validate(&contract, &value).expect("native-contract-valid fixture");
        for descriptor in contracts.outputs(method, native_name) {
            let actual = roundtrip(&descriptor, &value);
            assert_message_preserved(&descriptor, &value, &actual);
            jsonschema::validate(&contract, &actual)
                .expect("wire result still satisfies sealed output");
        }
    }

    // Shape-preserving protobuf transport cannot replace the declared native
    // uint16 constraint. Validate against the same resolved wrapper afterward.
    let output = contracts.output_schema("GetGatewayConfig");
    let invalid = json!({"config":{"port":65536}});
    for descriptor in contracts.outputs("GetGatewayConfig", "TchedRouterGetGatewayConfigResponse") {
        assert!(jsonschema::validate(&output, &roundtrip(&descriptor, &invalid)).is_err());
    }
}

#[test]
fn config_property_kind_path_and_nullable_fields_survive_both_descriptors() {
    let contracts = contracts();
    let output = contracts.output_schema("config_get");
    assert_local_refs_resolve(&output, &output);
    let kind_ref = output["properties"]["kind"]["$ref"].as_str().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        output.pointer(kind_ref.strip_prefix('#').unwrap()).unwrap()["enum"],
        json!(["value", "secret"])
    );
    let [native, sealed] = contracts.outputs("config_get", "TchedRouterConfigGetResponse");
    // The native mapper preserves unresolved refs as Value. The sealed mapper
    // resolves this local enum as string; neither creates a second enum owner.
    let Kind::Message(kind) = native.get_field_by_name("kind").unwrap().kind() else {
        panic!("native enum carrier")
    };
    assert_eq!(kind.full_name(), "google.protobuf.Value");
    assert_eq!(
        sealed.get_field_by_name("kind").unwrap().kind(),
        Kind::String
    );
    for descriptor in [&native, &sealed] {
        let path = descriptor.get_field_by_name("path").unwrap();
        assert_eq!(path.kind(), Kind::String);
        assert!(path.supports_presence());
        for field in ["value", "populated"] {
            let Kind::Message(kind) = descriptor.get_field_by_name(field).unwrap().kind() else {
                panic!("nullable carrier")
            };
            assert_eq!(kind.full_name(), "google.protobuf.Value");
        }
        assert!(descriptor.get_field_by_name("warnings").unwrap().is_list());
        for value in [
            json!({"kind":"value","path":"gateway.port","value":"0","warnings":[]}),
            json!({"kind":"value","path":"","value":null,"populated":null,"warnings":[]}),
            json!({"kind":"secret","path":"providers.models.openai.fixture.api_key","populated":false,"warnings":[]}),
            json!({"kind":"secret","path":"providers.models.openai.fixture.api_key","populated":true,"warnings":[{"code":"fixture","path":"providers.models.openai.fixture.api_key","message":"fixture warning"}]}),
        ] {
            jsonschema::validate(&output, &value).unwrap();
            let actual = roundtrip(descriptor, &value);
            assert_json_preserved(&value, &actual);
            jsonschema::validate(&output, &actual).unwrap();
        }
        for invalid in [
            json!({"kind":"invented","path":"gateway.port","warnings":[]}),
            json!({"kind":"value","warnings":[]}),
        ] {
            let actual = roundtrip(descriptor, &invalid);
            assert_json_preserved(&invalid, &actual);
            assert!(
                jsonschema::validate(&output, &actual).is_err(),
                "enum and required path stay schema-enforced"
            );
        }
    }

    for value in [
        json!({"kind":"value","path":"gateway.port","value":"8084"}),
        json!({"kind":"secret","path":"providers.models.openai.fixture.api_key","populated":true}),
    ] {
        let typed: ConfigPropertyOutput = serde_json::from_value(value.clone()).unwrap();
        assert!(matches!(
            typed.kind,
            ConfigPropertyKind::Value | ConfigPropertyKind::Secret
        ));
        assert_eq!(serde_json::to_value(typed).unwrap(), value);
    }
}

<file path="op-grpc-bridge/tests/tched_router_backing.rs">
//! Canonical dispatch tested against an isolated upstream HTTP fixture.
mod support;

use axum::{
    extract::{Query, State},
    http::{header, StatusCode},
    response::{IntoResponse, Response},
    routing::{get, patch, post},
    Json, Router,
};
use op_grpc_bridge::mutation_engine::MutationEngine;
use op_state_store::{ChainConfig, EventChain};
use serde::Deserialize;
use serde_json::{json, Value};
use std::{
    collections::HashMap,
    net::SocketAddr,
    sync::{
        atomic::{AtomicUsize, Ordering},
        Arc, OnceLock,
    },
};
use tokio::sync::Mutex as AsyncMutex;

#[derive(Clone)]
struct Fixture {
    inner: Arc<AsyncMutex<FixtureState>>,
    requests: Arc<AtomicUsize>,
}
struct FixtureState {
    provider: String,
    models: HashMap<String, String>,
    write_fail: bool,
    chats: usize,
    writes: usize,
    ignore_writes: bool,
    race_provider_before_patch: Option<String>,
    race_model_before_patch: Option<(String, String)>,
    change_provider_on_catalog: Option<String>,
    change_model_on_catalog: Option<(String, String)>,
    oversized_config_list: bool,
    omit_reference_from_list: Option<String>,
    catalog_live: bool,
    patch_redirect: Option<String>,
    projection_block_after_patch: Option<std::path::PathBuf>,
    mcp_url: String,
    complete_native_config: bool,
}

async fn fixture() -> (String, Fixture, tokio::task::JoinHandle<()>) {
    let fixture = Fixture {
        requests: Arc::new(AtomicUsize::new(0)),
        inner: Arc::new(AsyncMutex::new(FixtureState {
            provider: "ollama.main".into(),
            models: HashMap::from([
                ("ollama.main".into(), "old-model".into()),
                ("openai.main".into(), "new-model".into()),
            ]),
            write_fail: false,
            chats: 0,
            writes: 0,
            ignore_writes: false,
            race_provider_before_patch: None,
            race_model_before_patch: None,
            change_provider_on_catalog: None,
            change_model_on_catalog: None,
            oversized_config_list: false,
            omit_reference_from_list: None,
            catalog_live: true,
            patch_redirect: None,
            projection_block_after_patch: None,
            mcp_url: "https://docs.example.test/mcp".into(),
            complete_native_config: false,
        })),
    };
    let app = Router::new()
        .route("/health", get(health_fixture))
        .route("/api/config", get(full_config).patch(config_patch))
        .route("/api/config/list", get(config_list))
        .route("/api/config/prop", get(config_prop))
        .route("/api/config/catalog/models", get(catalog_models))
        .route("/api/tools", get(tools_fixture))
        .route("/a2a/:alias", post(chat_fixture))
        .with_state(fixture.clone())
        .layer(axum::middleware::from_fn_with_state(
            fixture.clone(),
            count_request,
        ));
    let listener = tokio::net::TcpListener::bind(SocketAddr::from(([127, 0, 0, 1], 0)))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    let address = listener.local_addr().unwrap();
    let task = tokio::spawn(async move {
        axum::serve(listener, app).await.unwrap();
    });
    (format!("http://{address}"), fixture, task)
}

async fn count_request(
    State(fixture): State<Fixture>,
    request: axum::extract::Request,
    next: axum::middleware::Next,
) -> Response {
    fixture.requests.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst);
    next.run(request).await
}

async fn full_config(State(f): State<Fixture>) -> Json<Value> {
    let state = f.inner.lock().await;
    let mut families = serde_json::Map::new();
    for (reference, model) in &state.models {
        let (family, alias) = reference
            .split_once('.')
            .expect("fixture provider references are family.alias");
        families
            .entry(family.to_string())
            .or_insert_with(|| Value::Object(serde_json::Map::new()))
            .as_object_mut()
            .expect("fixture provider family is an object")
            .insert(alias.to_string(), json!({"model": model}));
    }
    let mut config = if state.complete_native_config {
        native_config_defaults()
    } else {
        json!({})
    };
    config.as_object_mut().unwrap().extend(
        json!({
            "agents": {"dashboard": {"model_provider": state.provider}},
            "providers": {"models": Value::Object(families)},
            "mcp": {"enabled":true,"servers":[{
                "name":"docs","transport":"http","url":state.mcp_url,
                "env":{}, "headers":{"Authorization":"fixture-private-mcp-token"}
            }]}
        })
        .as_object()
        .unwrap()
        .clone(),
    );
    Json(config)
}

// Fixture data comes from the one imported native contract. It is served by
// the private HTTP owner; no schema or runtime catalog is materialized here.
fn native_config_defaults() -> Value {
    use op_plugins::state_plugins::tched_router_contract::document;
    static DEFAULTS: OnceLock<Value> = OnceLock::new();
    DEFAULTS
        .get_or_init(|| {
            let fields = document()["properties"].as_object().unwrap();
            let config = Value::Object(
                fields
                    .iter()
                    .map(|(name, field)| {
                        let value = field.get("default").cloned().unwrap_or_else(|| {
                            if field["type"] == "array" {
                                json!([])
                            } else {
                                json!({})
                            }
                        });
                        (name.clone(), value)
                    })
                    .collect(),
            );
            jsonschema::validate(document(), &config)
                .expect("native default fixture satisfies the import");
            config
        })
        .clone()
}

async fn config_list(State(f): State<Fixture>) -> Json<Value> {
    let s = f.inner.lock().await;
    if s.oversized_config_list {
        return Json(json!({"entries":[], "padding":"x".repeat(4 * 1024 * 1024 + 1)}));
    }
    Json(json!({
        "entries": s.models.iter()
            .filter(|(reference, _)| Some(reference.as_str()) != s.omit_reference_from_list.as_deref())
            .map(|(r,m)| json!({"path":format!("providers.models.{r}.model"),"value":m}))
            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
    }))
}
async fn health_fixture() -> Json<Value> {
    Json(json!({"status":"ok"}))
}

async fn tools_fixture() -> Json<Value> {
    Json(json!({"tools":[{
