<file path="op-plugins/examples/dump_tched_router_schema.rs">
//! Dump the full 3tched Router PluginSchema (state fields + typed methods).
//!
//! ```bash
//! cargo run -p op-plugins --example dump_tched_router_schema -- /tmp/tched_router.full.schema.json
//! ```

use std::env;
use std::fs;
use std::path::PathBuf;
use std::process::ExitCode;

fn main() -> ExitCode {
    let out = env::args()
        .nth(1)
        .map(PathBuf::from)
        .unwrap_or_else(|| PathBuf::from("/tmp/tched_router.full.schema.json"));

    let schema = op_plugins::state_plugins::tched_router::tched_router_plugin_schema();
    let json = match serde_json::to_string_pretty(&schema) {
        Ok(j) => j,
        Err(e) => {
            eprintln!("serialize schema: {e}");
            return ExitCode::from(1);
        }
    };

    if let Err(e) = fs::write(&out, format!("{json}\n")) {
        eprintln!("write {}: {e}", out.display());
        return ExitCode::from(1);
    }

    eprintln!(
        "wrote {} (fields={} methods={})",
        out.display(),
        schema.fields.len(),
        schema.methods.len()
    );
    ExitCode::SUCCESS
}
</file>

<file path="op-plugins/examples/method_coverage.rs">
//! Offline acceptance evidence for every method in a manifest-pinned catalog.
//! This report is never a runtime schema, registry, or plugin existence source.
//! `inventory <catalog>` emits the full denominator. `check <catalog> <claims>`
//! rejects missing methods, duplicate claims, stale contracts and unexecuted tests.
use anyhow::{bail, ensure, Context, Result};
use op_blob::BlobRef;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
use std::collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet};
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

#[derive(Debug, Serialize)]
struct Method {
    plugin: String,
    method: String,
    schema_hash: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize)]
struct Claim {
    plugin: String,
    method: String,
    schema_hash: String,
    positive_tests: Vec<Proof>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize)]
struct Proof {
    /// Exact libtest name, including its module path; not a substring filter.
    test: String,
    /// Human-reviewed description of the positive behavior asserted by this test.
    behavior: String,
    scope: String,
    /// Test source must still match the source associated with the execution.
    source: PathBuf,
    source_sha256: String,
    /// Captured libtest stdout/stderr from an actually executed test run.
    log: PathBuf,
    log_sha256: String,
    exit_code: i32,
}

fn digest(bytes: &[u8]) -> String {
    format!("{:x}", Sha256::digest(bytes))
}

fn inventory(dir: &Path) -> Result<Vec<Method>> {
    let manifest_path = dir.join(".manifest.json");
    let before = std::fs::read(&manifest_path)?;
    let manifest: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_slice(&before)?;
    let plugins: BTreeMap<String, String> = serde_json::from_value(manifest["plugins"].clone())?;
    ensure!(
        !plugins.is_empty(),
        "empty catalog cannot establish coverage"
    );
    let mut methods = Vec::new();
    for (plugin, schema_hash) in plugins {
        ensure!(
            !plugin.is_empty()
                && plugin
                    .bytes()
                    .all(|b| b.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || b == b'_')
                && schema_hash.len() == 64
                && schema_hash.bytes().all(|b| b.is_ascii_hexdigit()),
            "invalid catalog member"
        );
        let bytes = std::fs::read(dir.join(format!("{plugin}.{}.blob", &schema_hash[..16])))?;
        let blob =
            BlobRef::from_manifest_pinned(&bytes, &schema_hash).map_err(anyhow::Error::msg)?;
        let schema = blob.state_store_schema().map_err(anyhow::Error::msg)?;
        ensure!(schema.name == plugin, "catalog member identity mismatch");
        for method in schema.methods.keys() {
            methods.push(Method {
                plugin: plugin.clone(),
                method: method.clone(),
                schema_hash: schema_hash.clone(),
            });
        }
    }
    ensure!(
        before == std::fs::read(manifest_path)?,
        "catalog changed during inventory"
    );
    methods.sort_by(|a, b| (&a.plugin, &a.method).cmp(&(&b.plugin, &b.method)));
    ensure!(!methods.is_empty(), "catalog has no declared methods");
    Ok(methods)
}

fn passed_exactly(log: &str, test: &str) -> bool {
    let expected = format!("test {test} ... ok");
    log.lines().any(|line| line.trim() == expected)
}

fn validate_proof(proof: &Proof) -> Result<()> {
    ensure!(proof.exit_code == 0, "test process failed");
    ensure!(
        !proof.test.trim().is_empty() && !proof.behavior.trim().is_empty(),
        "positive behavior and exact test name are required"
    );
    ensure!(
        matches!(proof.scope.as_str(), "owner" | "canonical" | "native"),
        "proof scope must identify owner, canonical, or native behavior"
    );
    let source = std::fs::read(&proof.source)
        .with_context(|| format!("read test source {}", proof.source.display()))?;
    ensure!(
        digest(&source) == proof.source_sha256,
        "test source changed"
    );
    let log = std::fs::read(&proof.log)
        .with_context(|| format!("read execution log {}", proof.log.display()))?;
    ensure!(digest(&log) == proof.log_sha256, "execution log changed");
    ensure!(
        passed_exactly(std::str::from_utf8(&log)?, &proof.test),
        "exact positive test did not execute successfully"
    );
    Ok(())
}

fn check(methods: &[Method], claims: &[Claim]) -> Result<serde_json::Value> {
    let expected: BTreeMap<_, _> = methods
        .iter()
        .map(|m| {
            (
                (m.plugin.as_str(), m.method.as_str()),
                m.schema_hash.as_str(),
            )
        })
        .collect();
    let mut seen = BTreeSet::new();
    let mut failures = Vec::new();
    let mut passed = 0;
    for claim in claims {
        let key = (claim.plugin.as_str(), claim.method.as_str());
        let label = format!("{}.{}", key.0, key.1);
        if !seen.insert(key) {
            failures.push(format!("{label}: duplicate claim"));
            continue;
        }
        let Some(hash) = expected.get(&key) else {
            failures.push(format!("{label}: not declared in this catalog"));
            continue;
        };
        if *hash != claim.schema_hash {
            failures.push(format!("{label}: schema changed since the claim"));
            continue;
        }
        if claim.positive_tests.is_empty() {
            failures.push(format!(
                "{label}: no positive behavioral execution evidence"
            ));
            continue;
        }
        let errors: Vec<_> = claim
            .positive_tests
            .iter()
            .filter_map(|proof| validate_proof(proof).err())
            .collect();
        if errors.is_empty() {
            passed += 1;
        } else {
            for error in errors {
                failures.push(format!("{label}: {error:#}"));
            }
        }
    }
    for key in expected.keys().filter(|key| !seen.contains(*key)) {
        failures.push(format!("{}.{}: missing claim", key.0, key.1));
    }
    Ok(serde_json::json!({
        "purpose": "offline behavioral evidence; never runtime schema authority",
        "complete": failures.is_empty(),
        "declared_methods": methods.len(),
        "methods_with_execution_evidence": passed,
        "failures": failures,
        "limits": "Evidence descriptions require review of actual test assertions. The full workspace/source-admission gate must also pass against the unchanged implementation. Owner fixtures do not prove canonical transport or live provider integration."
    }))
}

fn main() -> Result<()> {
    let args: Vec<String> = std::env::args().skip(1).collect();
    match args.as_slice() {
        [mode, dir] if mode == "inventory" => {
            println!(
                "{}",
                serde_json::to_string_pretty(&inventory(Path::new(dir))?)?
            );
        }
        [mode, dir, claims] if mode == "check" => {
            let methods = inventory(Path::new(dir))?;
            let claims: Vec<Claim> = serde_json::from_slice(&std::fs::read(claims)?)?;
            let report = check(&methods, &claims)?;
            println!("{}", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&report)?);
            ensure!(report["complete"] == true, "method coverage is incomplete");
        }
        _ => bail!("usage: method_coverage inventory <catalog> | check <catalog> <claims.json>"),
    }
    Ok(())
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn ignored_filtered_and_similarly_named_tests_are_not_execution() {
        for text in [
            "test owner::method ... ignored",
            "test owner::method_extra ... ok",
            "test owner::method ... FAILED",
            "test result: ok. 0 passed; 1 filtered out",
        ] {
            assert!(!passed_exactly(text, "owner::method"));
        }
        assert!(passed_exactly(
            "test owner::method ... ok\n",
            "owner::method"
        ));
    }

    #[test]
    fn missing_duplicate_unknown_and_contract_drift_fail_completion() {
        let methods = vec![Method {
            plugin: "plugin".into(),
            method: "method".into(),
            schema_hash: "hash".into(),
        }];
        assert_eq!(check(&methods, &[]).unwrap()["complete"], false);
        let claim = || Claim {
            plugin: "plugin".into(),
            method: "method".into(),
            schema_hash: "stale".into(),
            positive_tests: vec![],
        };
        let mut unknown = claim();
        unknown.method = "undeclared".into();
        let report = check(&methods, &[claim(), claim(), unknown]).unwrap();
        let failures = report["failures"].as_array().unwrap();
        assert_eq!(failures.len(), 3);
        assert_eq!(report["methods_with_execution_evidence"], 0);
    }

    #[test]
    fn changed_source_logs_and_failed_runs_cannot_reuse_a_passing_receipt() {
        let dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let source = dir.path().join("case.rs");
        let log = dir.path().join("case.log");
        std::fs::write(&source, b"test source at execution").unwrap();
        std::fs::write(&log, b"test owner::readback ... ok\n").unwrap();
        let mut proof = Proof {
            test: "owner::readback".into(),
            behavior: "asserts a committed value is read back".into(),
            scope: "owner".into(),
            source: source.clone(),
            source_sha256: digest(&std::fs::read(&source).unwrap()),
            log: log.clone(),
            log_sha256: digest(&std::fs::read(&log).unwrap()),
            exit_code: 0,
        };
        validate_proof(&proof).unwrap();
        proof.exit_code = 1;
        assert!(validate_proof(&proof).is_err());
        proof.exit_code = 0;
        std::fs::write(&source, b"changed after execution").unwrap();
        assert!(validate_proof(&proof).is_err());
        std::fs::write(&source, b"test source at execution").unwrap();
        std::fs::write(&log, b"test owner::readback ... ignored\n").unwrap();
        assert!(validate_proof(&proof).is_err());
        proof.log_sha256 = digest(&std::fs::read(&log).unwrap());
        assert!(validate_proof(&proof).is_err());
    }
}
</file>

<file path="op-plugins/examples/method_inventory.rs">
//! Build-time evidence of declared method contracts. This report is never read
//! by runtime discovery, admission or dispatch: only the sealed catalog serves
//! those purposes. Run from the workspace root and redirect stdout as needed.
use anyhow::{ensure, Context, Result};
use op_plugins::default_registry::DefaultPluginRegistry;
use op_state_store::MemoryStore;
use std::sync::Arc;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<()> {
    let registry = DefaultPluginRegistry::new(Arc::new(MemoryStore::new()));
    let mut names = DefaultPluginRegistry::available_plugins();
    names.sort();
    names.dedup();
    let mut plugins = std::collections::BTreeMap::new();
    for name in names {
        let plugin = registry.load_plugin(&name).await?;
        let schema = plugin
            .schema()
            .with_context(|| format!("{name} has no schema"))?;
        ensure!(!plugins.contains_key(&name), "duplicate plugin {name}");
        plugins.insert(
            name,
            serde_json::json!({
                "version": plugin.version(),
                "methods": schema.methods,
            }),
        );
    }
    println!(
        "{}",
        serde_json::to_string_pretty(&serde_json::json!({
            "purpose": "source declaration evidence; not a runtime catalog or implementation claim",
            "plugins": plugins,
        }))?
    );
    Ok(())
}
</file>

<file path="op-plugins/src/bin/gen_tched_router_config_surface.rs">
//! Derive tched_router config methods from the plugin-owned contract.
//! Upstream upgrades are explicit imports, never runtime schema lookups:
//! `cargo run -p op-plugins --bin gen_tched_router_config_surface -- --import-json /tmp/config.json --version VERSION`
//! Default invocation only regenerates derived Rust methods; no schema directory is used.

use op_plugins::state_plugins::tched_router_contract as contract;
use serde_json::Value;
use std::fmt::Write as _;
use std::path::PathBuf;

/// One config section discovered from the official schema document.
struct Section {
    /// serde key on the native config (e.g. "gateway", "channels").
    key: String,
}

/// Local (3tched Router-owned) configuration sections — plain configurations,
/// not a separate "options" projection. Types live in `super::tched_router`.
const LOCAL_SECTIONS: &[(&str, &str)] = &[
    ("model_assignments", "super::tched_router::ModelAssignments"),
    (
        "memory_namespaces",
        "Vec<super::tched_router::MemoryNamespaceOption>",
    ),
    (
        "registration_service",
        "super::tched_router::RegistrationServiceSchema",
    ),
    (
        "user_container",
        "super::tched_router::UserContainerOptions",
    ),
    ("identity_chain", "super::tched_router::IdentityOptions"),
    ("privacy_policy", "super::tched_router::PrivacyOptions"),
];

fn pascal(s: &str) -> String {
    s.split('_')
        .filter(|p| !p.is_empty())
        .map(|p| {
            let mut c = p.chars();
            match c.next() {
                Some(f) => f.to_ascii_uppercase().to_string() + c.as_str(),
                None => String::new(),
            }
        })
        .collect()
}

fn kebab(s: &str) -> String {
    s.replace('_', "-")
}

/// `Get` + Pascal(section) + `Config`, without doubling a trailing `Config`.
fn method_name(section_key: &str) -> String {
    let p = pascal(section_key);
    if p.ends_with("Config") {
        format!("Get{p}")
    } else {
        format!("Get{p}Config")
    }
}

/// Extract sections from the official config schema document.
fn discover_sections(schema: &Value) -> Vec<Section> {
    let props = schema
        .get("properties")
        .and_then(Value::as_object)
        .expect("config schema has properties");
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    for (key, prop) in props {
        let kind = prop.get("type").and_then(Value::as_str);
        let has_ref = prop.get("$ref").is_some();
        // Scalars stay reachable through `GetConfig`; they get no method of
        // their own, matching the previous surface.
        if !has_ref && !matches!(kind, Some("array") | Some("object")) {
            continue;
        }
        out.push(Section { key: key.clone() });
    }
    out.sort_by(|a, b| a.key.cmp(&b.key));
    out
}

/// Rust fn name carrying a section's embedded schema.
fn schema_fn(key: &str) -> String {
    format!("{}_section_schema", key.replace('-', "_"))
}

fn main() {
    let manifest = PathBuf::from(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"));
    let mut args = std::env::args().skip(1);
    let mut import = None;
    let mut import_version = None;
    let mut out_path = manifest.join("src/state_plugins/tched_router_config_surface.rs");
    while let Some(arg) = args.next() {
        match arg.as_str() {
            "--import-json" => {
                import = Some(PathBuf::from(
                    args.next().expect("--import-json needs a path"),
                ))
            }
            "--version" => import_version = Some(args.next().expect("--version needs a version")),
            "--output" => out_path = PathBuf::from(args.next().expect("--output needs a path")),
            value if !value.starts_with('-') => out_path = PathBuf::from(value),
            _ => panic!("unknown argument {arg}"),
        }
    }
    assert_eq!(
        import.is_some(),
        import_version.is_some(),
        "imports require both --import-json and --version"
    );
    let document: Value = match &import {
        Some(path) => serde_json::from_str(&std::fs::read_to_string(path).expect("read import"))
            .expect("import is valid JSON"),
        None => contract::document().clone(),
    };
    let version = import_version
        .as_deref()
        .unwrap_or(contract::BINARY_SCHEMA_VERSION);

    let defs = document
        .get("$defs")
        .and_then(Value::as_object)
        .cloned()
        .unwrap_or_default();
    let prop_count = document
        .get("properties")
        .and_then(Value::as_object)
        .map(|m| m.len())
        .unwrap_or(0);

    // ── Stub guard ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // Refuse to emit from an empty document. A stubbed-out source silently
    // deletes the entire config surface, which is exactly how this file lost
    // its meaning before: `vendor/zeroclawlabs` declared 54 empty structs and
    // every generated method carried a payload with no fields.
    assert!(
        prop_count >= 32 && defs.len() >= 64,
        "REFUSING TO GENERATE: plugin contract has {prop_count} properties and {} definitions; refusing a stub or truncated import",
        defs.len(),
    );

    let upstream = discover_sections(&document);
    assert!(!upstream.is_empty(), "no config sections discovered");
    // Validate all references before changing the plugin contract.
    for section in &upstream {
        let _ = contract::section_from(&document, &section.key);
    }
    if import.is_some() {
        assert!(
            !version.trim().is_empty() && version != "unknown",
            "version is required"
        );
        let raw = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&document).expect("serialize import");
        assert!(!raw.contains("\"####"), "raw string delimiter collision");
        let path = manifest.join("src/state_plugins/tched_router_contract.rs");
        let source = std::fs::read_to_string(&path).expect("read plugin contract");
        let begin = source
            .find("// BEGIN UPSTREAM IMPORT")
            .expect("import start");
        let end = source.find("// END UPSTREAM IMPORT").expect("import end");
        let replacement = format!(
            "// BEGIN UPSTREAM IMPORT\npub const BINARY_SCHEMA_VERSION: &str = {version:?};\nconst CONFIG_SCHEMA: &str = r####\"{raw}\"####;\n"
        );
        let updated = format!("{}{replacement}{}", &source[..begin], &source[end..]);
        let temporary = path.with_extension("rs.tmp");
        std::fs::write(&temporary, updated).expect("write imported contract");
        std::fs::rename(temporary, path).expect("replace imported contract");
    }

    // ── Emit the Rust surface ───────────────────────────────────────────────
    let mut s = String::new();
    s.push_str("//! GENERATED by gen_tched_router_config_surface; do not hand-edit.\n//! All schemas derive from the tched_router plugin contract.\n\n");
    s.push_str("use super::plugin_scaffold_helpers::method_decl_from_schemars_with_output;\n");
    s.push_str("use super::tched_router::{ConfigPatchInput, ConfigPatchOutput};\n");
    s.push_str("use op_state_store::{CapabilityDecl, PluginSchema, SideEffect};\n");
    s.push_str("use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};\n");
    s.push_str("use serde_json::Value as JsonValue;\n\n");

    s.push_str("use super::tched_router_contract as contract;\n\n");
    s.push_str("fn embedded(value: JsonValue) -> schemars::Schema {\n    schemars::Schema::try_from(value).expect(\"plugin config contract is a JSON Schema\")\n}\n\n");
    s.push_str("fn embedded_output_config(value: JsonValue) -> schemars::Schema {\n    embedded(op_state_store::exact_schema::embed_exact_schema(\n        &value,\n        \"/properties/config\",\n    ))\n}\n\n");
    // Shared input/output structs.
    s.push_str(
        "/// Empty input for config read methods.\n\
         #[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]\n\
         pub struct ConfigMethodInput {}\n\n",
    );
    s.push_str(
        "/// Full configuration schema, as printed by `zeroclaw config schema`.\n\
         pub fn full_config_schema(_: &mut schemars::SchemaGenerator) -> schemars::Schema {\n\
         \x20   embedded_output_config(contract::document().clone())\n\
         }\n\n",
    );
    s.push_str(
        "/// Output for `GetConfig` — the full configuration, typed by the official\n\
         /// binary's own schema. Secrets are masked by dispatch.\n\
         #[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]\n\
         #[schemars(extend(\"x-oscal-subid\" = \"exp.service.3tched-router.config.result@v1\"))]\n\
         pub struct GetConfigOutput {\n\
         \x20   /// Full configuration.\n\
         \x20   #[schemars(schema_with = \"full_config_schema\")]\n\
         \x20   pub config: JsonValue,\n\
         }\n\n",
    );
    s.push_str(
        "/// `PatchConfig` uses the same bounded native property-operation contract as\n\
         /// `config_patch`; whole-section replacement is not a v0.8.4 operation.\n\
         pub type PatchConfigInput = ConfigPatchInput;\n\
         pub type PatchConfigOutput = ConfigPatchOutput;\n\n",
    );

    // Per-section schema accessors.
    s.push_str("// ── Section schemas (from the official binary) ──────────────────────────\n\n");
    for sec in &upstream {
        let f = schema_fn(&sec.key);
        let _ = write!(
            s,
            "/// JSON Schema for the `{}` config section.\n\
             pub fn {f}(_: &mut schemars::SchemaGenerator) -> schemars::Schema {{\n\
             \x20   embedded_output_config(contract::section(\"{}\"))\n\
             }}\n\n",
            sec.key, sec.key
        );
    }

    // Per-section output structs.
    let mut all: Vec<(String, Option<String>)> = Vec::new(); // (key, local rust type)
    for sec in &upstream {
        all.push((sec.key.clone(), None));
    }
    for (key, ty) in LOCAL_SECTIONS {
        all.push(((*key).to_string(), Some((*ty).to_string())));
    }

    s.push_str("// ── Per-section outputs ────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n");
    for (key, local) in &all {
        let m = method_name(key);
        match local {
            Some(ty) => {
                let _ = write!(
                    s,
                    "/// Output for `{m}`.\n\
                     #[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]\n\
                     #[schemars(extend(\"x-oscal-subid\" = \"exp.service.3tched-router.{}-config.result@v1\"))]\n\
                     pub struct {m}Output {{\n\
                     \x20   /// Current `{key}` configuration.\n\
                     \x20   pub config: {ty},\n\
                     }}\n\n",
                    kebab(key)
                );
            }
            None => {
                let f = schema_fn(key);
                let _ = write!(
                    s,
                    "/// Output for `{m}`.\n\
                     #[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]\n\
                     #[schemars(extend(\"x-oscal-subid\" = \"exp.service.3tched-router.{}-config.result@v1\"))]\n\
                     pub struct {m}Output {{\n\
                     \x20   /// Current `{key}` configuration.\n\
                     \x20   #[schemars(schema_with = \"{f}\")]\n\
                     \x20   pub config: JsonValue,\n\
                     }}\n\n",
                    kebab(key)
                );
            }
        }
    }

    // Method table + registration.
    s.push_str("/// (method, section key, source) for every config read.\n");
    s.push_str("pub const SECTIONS: &[(&str, &str, SectionSource)] = &[\n");
    for (key, local) in &all {
        let src = if local.is_some() { "Local" } else { "Upstream" };
        let _ = writeln!(
            s,
            "    (\"{}\", \"{key}\", SectionSource::{src}),",
            method_name(key)
        );
    }
    s.push_str("];\n\n");
    s.push_str("/// Where a config section is read from.\n");
    s.push_str("#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]\n");
    s.push_str("pub enum SectionSource {\n    /// The native tched_router configuration, described by the imported plugin-owned contract.\n    Upstream,\n    /// Local 3tched Router state (a plain configuration).\n    Local,\n}\n\n");

    s.push_str("/// Every method owned by this surface (for dispatch membership checks).\n");
    s.push_str(
        "pub const CONFIG_METHODS: &[&str] = &[\n    \"GetConfig\",\n    \"PatchConfig\",\n",
    );
    for (key, _local) in &all {
        let _ = writeln!(s, "    \"{}\",", method_name(key));
    }
    s.push_str("];\n\n");

    s.push_str(
        "/// Register every config method and its declared capability on the schema.\n\
         ///\n\
         /// The plugin is the single declaration point: each method's\n\
         /// `required_capability` has a matching `schema.capabilities` entry\n\
         /// (closure-clean under `validate_capability_closure`).\n\
         pub fn register_config_methods(schema: &mut PluginSchema) {\n",
    );
    s.push_str(
        "    schema.methods.insert(\n\
         \x20       \"GetConfig\".to_string(),\n\
         \x20       method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<ConfigMethodInput, GetConfigOutput>(\n\
         \x20           \"GetConfig\",\n\
         \x20           SideEffect::Read,\n\
         \x20           true,\n\
         \x20           \"cap.software.3tched-router.config.read@v1\",\n\
         \x20           \"obs.service.3tched-router.config.get@v1\",\n\
         \x20       ),\n\
         \x20   );\n\
         \x20   schema.capabilities.insert(\n\
         \x20       \"cap.software.3tched-router.config.read@v1\".to_string(),\n\
         \x20       CapabilityDecl {\n\
         \x20           id: \"cap.software.3tched-router.config.read@v1\".to_string(),\n\
         \x20           description: \"Read the full 3tched Router configuration (secrets masked).\".to_string(),\n\
         \x20       },\n\
         \x20   );\n\
         \x20   schema.methods.insert(\n\
         \x20       \"PatchConfig\".to_string(),\n\
         \x20       method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<PatchConfigInput, PatchConfigOutput>(\n\
         \x20           \"PatchConfig\",\n\
         \x20           SideEffect::Mutation,\n\
         \x20           false,\n\
         \x20           \"cap.software.3tched-router.config.write@v1\",\n\
         \x20           \"mut.service.3tched-router.config.patch@v2\",\n\
         \x20       ),\n\
         \x20   );\n\
         \x20   schema.capabilities.insert(\n\
         \x20       \"cap.software.3tched-router.config.write@v1\".to_string(),\n\
         \x20       CapabilityDecl {\n\
         \x20           id: \"cap.software.3tched-router.config.write@v1\".to_string(),\n\
         \x20           description: \"Apply bounded typed 3tched Router configuration property operations.\".to_string(),\n\
         \x20       },\n\
         \x20   );\n",
    );
    for (key, _local) in &all {
        let m = method_name(key);
        let k = kebab(key);
        let _ = writeln!(
            s,
            "    schema.methods.insert(\n\
             \x20       \"{m}\".to_string(),\n\
             \x20       method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<ConfigMethodInput, {m}Output>(\n\
             \x20           \"{m}\",\n\
             \x20           SideEffect::Read,\n\
             \x20           true,\n\
             \x20           \"cap.software.3tched-router.{k}-config.read@v1\",\n\
             \x20           \"obs.service.3tched-router.{k}-config.get@v1\",\n\
             \x20       ),\n\
             \x20   );\n\
             \x20   schema.capabilities.insert(\n\
             \x20       \"cap.software.3tched-router.{k}-config.read@v1\".to_string(),\n\
             \x20       CapabilityDecl {{\n\
             \x20           id: \"cap.software.3tched-router.{k}-config.read@v1\".to_string(),\n\
             \x20           description: \"Read the 3tched Router `{key}` configuration.\".to_string(),\n\
             \x20       }},\n\
             \x20   );"
        );
    }
    s.push_str("}\n\n");

    s.push_str(include_str!("tched_router_config_surface.dispatch.inc"));

    std::fs::write(&out_path, s).unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("write {}: {e}", out_path.display()));
    eprintln!(
        "wrote {} from plugin contract v{version} ({} upstream sections, {} local, {} config methods)",
        out_path.display(),
        upstream.len(),
        LOCAL_SECTIONS.len(),
        all.len() + 2,
    );
}
</file>

<file path="op-plugins/src/bin/op-mail-admin.rs">
//! Private Postfix/Dovecot administration D-Bus peer for `mail-3tched`.

use anyhow::{ensure, Context, Result};
use nix::fcntl::{Flock, FlockArg};
use op_plugins::state_plugins::mail_server::{methods, native_owner::MailAdminService};
use std::os::unix::fs::{FileTypeExt, MetadataExt, OpenOptionsExt, PermissionsExt};
use tokio::net::UnixListener;

const MAX_CLIENTS: usize = 32;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<()> {
    let arguments = std::env::args_os().skip(1).collect::<Vec<_>>();
    if arguments.as_slice() == ["--check-runtime"] {
        println!(
            "{{\"service\":\"op-mail-admin\",\"runtime\":\"{}\",\"status\":\"ok\"}}",
            if cfg!(target_env = "gnu") {
                "gnu"
            } else if cfg!(target_env = "musl") {
                "musl"
            } else {
                "unknown"
            }
        );
        return Ok(());
    }
    ensure!(
        arguments.is_empty(),
        "usage: op-mail-admin [--check-runtime]"
    );

    let socket = std::env::var_os("OP_MAIL_ADMIN_LISTEN")
        .map(std::path::PathBuf::from)
        .unwrap_or_else(|| methods::DEFAULT_CONTAINER_SOCKET.into());
    let parent = socket
        .parent()
        .context("mail administration socket has no parent")?;
    std::fs::create_dir_all(parent)?;
    let lock_path = parent.join(".mail-admin.lock");
    let lock_file = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()
        .read(true)
        .write(true)
        .create(true)
        .truncate(false)
        .mode(0o600)
        .open(&lock_path)?;
    let _lease = Flock::lock(lock_file, FlockArg::LockExclusiveNonblock)
        .map_err(|(_, error)| error)
        .context("another mail administration owner holds the socket lease")?;
    if let Ok(metadata) = std::fs::symlink_metadata(&socket) {
        ensure!(
            metadata.file_type().is_socket(),
            "refusing to replace non-socket {}",
            socket.display()
        );
        ensure!(
            metadata.uid() == nix::unistd::geteuid().as_raw(),
            "refusing to replace a mail administration socket owned by another uid"
        );
        match std::os::unix::net::UnixStream::connect(&socket) {
            Ok(_) => anyhow::bail!("mail administration socket is already active"),
            Err(error)
                if matches!(
                    error.kind(),
                    std::io::ErrorKind::ConnectionRefused | std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound
                ) => {}
            Err(error) => return Err(error).context("inspect existing mail administration socket"),
        }
        std::fs::remove_file(&socket)
            .with_context(|| format!("remove stale socket {}", socket.display()))?;
    }
    let listener = UnixListener::bind(&socket)
        .with_context(|| format!("bind mail administration socket {}", socket.display()))?;
    std::fs::set_permissions(&socket, std::fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o600))?;

    let service = MailAdminService::production()?;
    service
        .adopt_or_reconcile()
        .await
        .context("adopt or reconcile Postfix/Dovecot administration state")?;

    let clients = std::sync::Arc::new(tokio::sync::Semaphore::new(MAX_CLIENTS));
    loop {
        let (stream, _) = listener.accept().await?;
        let Ok(permit) = clients.clone().try_acquire_owned() else {
            drop(stream);
            continue;
        };
        let service = service.clone();
        let _task = tokio::spawn(async move {
            let _permit = permit;
            let connection = zbus::connection::Builder::unix_stream(stream)
                .server(zbus::Guid::generate())?
                .p2p()
                .serve_at(methods::OBJECT_PATH, service)?
                .build()
                .await?;
            connection.closed().await;
            Ok::<(), zbus::Error>(())
        });
    }
}

<file path="op-plugins/src/bin/opblob.rs">
//! opblob — drive the schema→blob→catalog→btrfs pipeline from the shell.
//!
//! ```text
//! opblob demo-seal <dir>              blobify demo plugins into a catalog dir
//! opblob seal-shm                     blobify real plugins into /dev/shm/opdbus/plugin-blobs
//! opblob stage-shm                    stage the persisted catalog into SHM (boot path)
//! opblob persist                      copy the SHM catalog to the persisted store
//! opblob persist <source> <dest>      atomically copy an isolated sealed catalog
//! opblob seal-plugins <dir>           blobify real plugins into a catalog dir
//! opblob inspect <file.blob>          print identity, services, methods
//! opblob catalog <dir>                list active services in a catalog dir
//! opblob btrfs-seal <image> <dir>     seal a catalog dir into a btrfs image
//! opblob keygen <keyfile>             generate the account WG identity keypair
//! ```

use op_blob::{
    blob, blobify_plugin_schema, btrfs,
    catalog::{ActiveReflectionCatalog, DEFAULT_SHM_DIR},
    demo, descriptor,
    identity::WgKeypair,
    BlobRef,
};
use op_plugins::DefaultPluginRegistry;
use op_state_store::MemoryStore;
use std::process::ExitCode;
use std::sync::Arc;
use std::{
    collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet},
    fs::{File, OpenOptions},
    io::Write,
    os::unix::fs::{MetadataExt, PermissionsExt},
    path::{Path, PathBuf},
};

fn main() -> ExitCode {
    let args: Vec<String> = std::env::args().skip(1).collect();
    let result = match args.as_slice() {
        [cmd, dir] if cmd == "demo-seal" => demo_seal(Path::new(dir)),
        [cmd] if cmd == "seal-shm" => seal_plugins(Path::new(DEFAULT_SHM_DIR)),
        [cmd] if cmd == "stage-shm" => stage_shm(),
        [cmd] if cmd == "persist" => {
            persist_catalog(Path::new(DEFAULT_SHM_DIR), Path::new(PERSISTED_CATALOG_DIR))
        }
        [cmd, source, destination] if cmd == "persist" => {
            persist_catalog(Path::new(source), Path::new(destination))
        }
        [cmd, dir] if cmd == "seal-plugins" => seal_plugins(Path::new(dir)),
        [cmd, file] if cmd == "inspect" => inspect(Path::new(file)),
        [cmd, dir] if cmd == "catalog" => catalog(Path::new(dir)),
        [cmd, image, dir] if cmd == "btrfs-seal" => btrfs_seal(Path::new(image), Path::new(dir)),
        [cmd, keyfile] if cmd == "keygen" => keygen(Path::new(keyfile)),
        _ => {
            eprintln!(
                "usage: opblob demo-seal <dir> | seal-shm | stage-shm | persist [<source> <destination>] | seal-plugins <dir> | inspect <file.blob> | catalog <dir> | btrfs-seal <image> <dir> | keygen <keyfile>"
            );
            return ExitCode::from(2);
        }
    };
    match result {
        Ok(()) => ExitCode::SUCCESS,
        Err(e) => {
            eprintln!("opblob: {e}");
            ExitCode::FAILURE
        }
    }
}

fn account_identity(dir: &Path) -> Result<WgKeypair, String> {
    // The account keypair is the identity; the session it defines persists
    // for the life of the account, so reuse the key if present.
    let keyfile = dir.join("identity.key");
    if keyfile.exists() {
        WgKeypair::load(&keyfile).map_err(|e| e.to_string())
    } else {
        let kp = WgKeypair::generate();
        kp.save(&keyfile).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        Ok(kp)
    }
}

fn demo_seal(dir: &Path) -> Result<(), String> {
    std::fs::create_dir_all(dir).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let kp = account_identity(dir)?;
    let id = kp.public_identity();
    println!(
        "identity  wg-pub {}  key-id {}",
        id.wg_public_key, id.key_id
    );
    println!("session   {} (account-persistent)", id.session.session_id);

    let mut cat = ActiveReflectionCatalog::open(dir).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    for schema in [demo::unix_socket_schema(), demo::wireguard_schema()] {
        let b = blob::blobify_with_identity(&schema, Some(id.clone()));
        let path = cat.upsert_blob(&b).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        println!(
            "sealed    {}  ({} methods, schema {})",
            path.display(),
            b.manifest.methods.len(),
            &b.manifest.schema_hash[..16]
        );
    }
    println!("services:");
    for s in cat.list_services() {
        println!("  {s}");
    }
    Ok(())
}

/// Where the sealed catalog survives a reboot. `/dev/shm` is tmpfs, so without
/// a persisted copy the only way to refill it is to re-seal — which means
/// loading every plugin and probing live backends on the boot path.
const PERSISTED_CATALOG_DIR: &str = "/var/lib/opdbus/plugin-blobs";

/// Catalog manifest filename — written LAST, as the atomic commit point that
/// readers watch for. Mirrors `op_blob::catalog`'s own contract.
const MANIFEST_NAME: &str = ".manifest.json";

/// Boot path: stage the persisted catalog into SHM without regenerating it.
///
/// Sealing is a build-time act — it loads every plugin and calls
/// `schema_live()`, which probes real backends. Doing that at boot makes
/// startup depend on service ordering and costs minutes. Staging is a copy.
///
/// Requires a previously sealed and persisted catalog, including on first boot.
/// Missing release inputs must not silently create a different plugin set.
fn stage_shm() -> Result<(), String> {
    let shm = Path::new(DEFAULT_SHM_DIR);
    let persisted = Path::new(PERSISTED_CATALOG_DIR);

    if !persisted.join(MANIFEST_NAME).is_file() {
        return Err(format!(
            "no persisted catalog at {}; explicitly seal and persist the prepared release before staging",
            persisted.display()
        ));
    }

    copy_catalog(persisted, shm)?;
    println!("staged    {} -> {}", persisted.display(), shm.display());
    Ok(())
}

/// Capture the current SHM catalog as the artifact future boots will stage.
/// Run this after a deliberate `seal-shm`, not on the boot path.
fn persist_catalog(shm: &Path, persisted: &Path) -> Result<(), String> {
    if !shm.join(MANIFEST_NAME).is_file() {
        return Err(format!(
            "no catalog to persist: {} has no {MANIFEST_NAME}",
            shm.display()
        ));
    }
    copy_catalog(shm, persisted)?;
    println!("persisted {} -> {}", shm.display(), persisted.display());
    Ok(())
}

#[derive(Debug)]
struct CatalogFile {
    name: String,
    bytes: Vec<u8>,
    mode: u32,
}

#[derive(Debug)]
struct ValidatedCatalog {
    manifest: Vec<u8>,
    manifest_mode: u32,
    directory_mode: u32,
    blobs: Vec<CatalogFile>,
}

/// Validate and capture one complete committed catalog before touching its
/// destination. The captured bytes close the source validation/copy race.
fn validate_catalog(src: &Path) -> Result<ValidatedCatalog, String> {
    let src = std::fs::canonicalize(src)
        .map_err(|error| format!("resolve source catalog {}: {error}", src.display()))?;
    let source_metadata = std::fs::symlink_metadata(&src)
        .map_err(|error| format!("inspect source catalog {}: {error}", src.display()))?;
    if !source_metadata.is_dir() {
        return Err(format!(
            "source catalog is not a directory: {}",
            src.display()
        ));
    }

    let manifest_path = src.join(MANIFEST_NAME);
    let manifest_metadata = std::fs::symlink_metadata(&manifest_path)
        .map_err(|error| format!("inspect {}: {error}", manifest_path.display()))?;
    if !manifest_metadata.is_file() {
        return Err(format!(
            "catalog manifest is not a regular file: {}",
            manifest_path.display()
        ));
    }
    let manifest = std::fs::read(&manifest_path)
        .map_err(|error| format!("read {}: {error}", manifest_path.display()))?;
    let document: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_slice(&manifest)
        .map_err(|error| format!("parse {}: {error}", manifest_path.display()))?;
    let catalog_hash = document
        .get("catalog_hash")
        .and_then(serde_json::Value::as_str)
        .filter(|hash| hash.len() == 64 && hash.bytes().all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_hexdigit()))
        .ok_or_else(|| "catalog manifest has no valid catalog_hash".to_string())?;
    let plugin_values = document
        .get("plugins")
        .and_then(serde_json::Value::as_object)
        .ok_or_else(|| "catalog manifest has no plugins object".to_string())?;
    let mut plugins = BTreeMap::new();
    for (plugin_id, value) in plugin_values {
        if plugin_id.is_empty()
            || !plugin_id
                .bytes()
                .all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || matches!(byte, b'_' | b'-' | b'.'))
            || blob::canonical_plugin_id(plugin_id) != *plugin_id
        {
            return Err(format!(
                "catalog manifest has invalid plugin id {plugin_id:?}"
            ));
        }
        let schema_hash = value
            .as_str()
            .filter(|hash| hash.len() == 64 && hash.bytes().all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_hexdigit()))
            .ok_or_else(|| format!("catalog manifest has invalid hash for {plugin_id}"))?;
        plugins.insert(plugin_id.clone(), schema_hash.to_ascii_lowercase());
    }

    let expected_names: BTreeSet<String> = plugins
        .iter()
        .map(|(plugin_id, schema_hash)| format!("{plugin_id}.{}.blob", &schema_hash[..16]))
        .collect();
    let mut actual_names = BTreeSet::new();
    for entry in std::fs::read_dir(&src)
        .map_err(|error| format!("read source catalog {}: {error}", src.display()))?
    {
        let entry = entry.map_err(|error| format!("read source catalog entry: {error}"))?;
        let path = entry.path();
        if path.extension().and_then(|value| value.to_str()) != Some("blob") {
            continue;
        }
        let metadata = std::fs::symlink_metadata(&path)
            .map_err(|error| format!("inspect {}: {error}", path.display()))?;
        if !metadata.is_file() {
            return Err(format!(
                "catalog blob is not a regular file: {}",
                path.display()
            ));
        }
        let name = entry
            .file_name()
            .into_string()
            .map_err(|_| "catalog blob filename is not UTF-8".to_string())?;
        actual_names.insert(name);
    }
    if actual_names != expected_names {
        return Err("catalog blob files differ from the committed manifest".into());
    }

    let mut blobs = Vec::with_capacity(plugins.len());
    for (plugin_id, schema_hash) in &plugins {
        let name = format!("{plugin_id}.{}.blob", &schema_hash[..16]);
        let path = src.join(&name);
        let metadata = std::fs::symlink_metadata(&path)
            .map_err(|error| format!("inspect {}: {error}", path.display()))?;
        let bytes =
            std::fs::read(&path).map_err(|error| format!("read {}: {error}", path.display()))?;
        let sealed = BlobRef::new(&bytes)
            .map_err(|error| format!("validate {}: {error}", path.display()))?;
        if sealed.schema_hash_hex() != *schema_hash {
            return Err(format!("{name} differs from the manifest schema hash"));
        }
        let embedded = sealed
            .manifest()
            .map_err(|error| format!("parse {name} manifest: {error}"))?;
        if embedded.plugin_id != *plugin_id
            || embedded.schema_hash != *schema_hash
            || embedded.blob_type != "active_reflection"
        {
            return Err(format!("{name} has inconsistent embedded identity"));
        }
        let schema = sealed
            .state_store_schema()
            .map_err(|error| format!("parse {name} schema: {error}"))?;
        if schema.name != *plugin_id || schema.version != embedded.schema_version {
            return Err(format!("{name} schema identity differs from its manifest"));
        }
        blobs.push(CatalogFile {
            name,
            bytes,
            mode: metadata.permissions().mode(),
        });
    }

    let indexed = ActiveReflectionCatalog::open(&src)
        .map_err(|error| format!("index source catalog {}: {error}", src.display()))?;
    if indexed.active_plugins() != plugins.keys().cloned().collect::<Vec<_>>()
        || indexed.catalog_hash() != catalog_hash.to_ascii_lowercase()
    {
        return Err("catalog manifest identity differs from its sealed blobs".into());
    }
    if std::fs::read(&manifest_path)
        .map_err(|error| format!("re-read {}: {error}", manifest_path.display()))?
        != manifest
    {
        return Err("catalog manifest changed during validation".into());
    }

    Ok(ValidatedCatalog {
        manifest,
        manifest_mode: manifest_metadata.permissions().mode(),
        directory_mode: source_metadata.permissions().mode(),
        blobs,
    })
}

fn write_synced(path: &Path, bytes: &[u8], mode: u32) -> Result<(), String> {
    let mut file = OpenOptions::new()
        .create_new(true)
        .write(true)
        .open(path)
        .map_err(|error| format!("create {}: {error}", path.display()))?;
    file.write_all(bytes)
        .map_err(|error| format!("write {}: {error}", path.display()))?;
    file.set_permissions(std::fs::Permissions::from_mode(mode))
        .map_err(|error| format!("chmod {}: {error}", path.display()))?;
    file.sync_all()
        .map_err(|error| format!("sync {}: {error}", path.display()))
}

fn sync_directory(path: &Path) -> Result<(), String> {
    File::open(path)
        .and_then(|directory| directory.sync_all())
        .map_err(|error| format!("sync directory {}: {error}", path.display()))
}

/// Copy a sealed catalog as one directory transaction. Existing readers see
/// either the prior catalog or the fully validated replacement; an invalid
/// source cannot remove or rewrite destination bytes.
fn copy_catalog(src: &Path, dst: &Path) -> Result<(), String> {
    let catalog = validate_catalog(src)?;
    let source = std::fs::canonicalize(src)
        .map_err(|error| format!("resolve source catalog {}: {error}", src.display()))?;
    let destination_parent = dst
        .parent()
        .filter(|parent| !parent.as_os_str().is_empty())
        .unwrap_or_else(|| Path::new("."));
    let destination_name = dst
        .file_name()
        .ok_or_else(|| format!("destination catalog has no filename: {}", dst.display()))?;
    let destination_parent = std::fs::canonicalize(destination_parent).map_err(|error| {
        format!(
            "resolve destination parent {} before catalog copy: {error}",
            destination_parent.display()
        )
    })?;
    let destination = destination_parent.join(destination_name);
    if destination == source || destination.starts_with(&source) || source.starts_with(&destination)
    {
        return Err("source and destination catalogs are identical, aliased, or nested".into());
    }

    let destination_exists = match std::fs::symlink_metadata(&destination) {
        Ok(metadata) => {
            if !metadata.is_dir() {
                return Err(format!(
                    "destination catalog is not a directory: {}",
                    destination.display()
                ));
            }
            let source_metadata = std::fs::metadata(&source)
                .map_err(|error| format!("inspect {}: {error}", source.display()))?;
            if metadata.dev() == source_metadata.dev() && metadata.ino() == source_metadata.ino() {
                return Err("source and destination catalogs alias the same directory".into());
            }
            true
        }
        Err(error) if error.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => false,
        Err(error) => {
            return Err(format!(
                "inspect destination {}: {error}",
                destination.display()
            ));
        }
    };

    let stage = tempfile::Builder::new()
        .prefix(".opblob-catalog-stage.")
        .tempdir_in(&destination_parent)
        .map_err(|error| format!("create catalog stage: {error}"))?;
    std::fs::set_permissions(
        stage.path(),
        std::fs::Permissions::from_mode(catalog.directory_mode),
    )
    .map_err(|error| format!("chmod catalog stage: {error}"))?;
    for blob in &catalog.blobs {
        write_synced(&stage.path().join(&blob.name), &blob.bytes, blob.mode)?;
    }
    write_synced(
        &stage.path().join(MANIFEST_NAME),
        &catalog.manifest,
        catalog.manifest_mode,
    )?;
    sync_directory(stage.path())?;
    validate_catalog(stage.path()).map_err(|error| format!("validate staged catalog: {error}"))?;

    if destination_exists {
        nix::fcntl::renameat2(
            None,
            stage.path(),
            None,
            &destination,
            nix::fcntl::RenameFlags::RENAME_EXCHANGE,
        )
        .map_err(|error| format!("atomically exchange catalog directory: {error}"))?;
        if let Err(error) = sync_directory(&destination_parent) {
            let rollback = nix::fcntl::renameat2(
                None,
                stage.path(),
                None,
                &destination,
                nix::fcntl::RenameFlags::RENAME_EXCHANGE,
            );
            return Err(match rollback {
                Ok(()) => match sync_directory(&destination_parent) {
                    Ok(()) => format!("{error}; restored prior catalog durably"),
                    Err(rollback_sync_error) => format!(
                        "{error}; restored prior catalog in the current namespace, but rollback durability is unknown: {rollback_sync_error}"
                    ),
                },
                Err(rollback_error) => {
                    let recovery = stage.keep();
                    format!(
                        "{error}; CRITICAL: failed to restore prior catalog: {rollback_error}; prior catalog retained at {}",
                        recovery.display()
                    )
                }
            });
        }
    } else {
        nix::fcntl::renameat2(
            None,
            stage.path(),
            None,
            &destination,
            nix::fcntl::RenameFlags::RENAME_NOREPLACE,
        )
        .map_err(|error| format!("atomically install catalog directory: {error}"))?;
        if let Err(error) = sync_directory(&destination_parent) {
            let rollback = std::fs::rename(&destination, stage.path());
            return Err(match rollback {
                Ok(()) => match sync_directory(&destination_parent) {
                    Ok(()) => format!("{error}; removed uncommitted catalog durably"),
                    Err(rollback_sync_error) => format!(
                        "{error}; removed the uncommitted catalog from the current namespace, but rollback durability is unknown: {rollback_sync_error}"
                    ),
                },
                Err(rollback_error) => format!(
                    "{error}; CRITICAL: failed to remove uncommitted catalog: {rollback_error}"
                ),
            });
        }
    }

    eprintln!("opblob: {} blobs + manifest", catalog.blobs.len());
    Ok(())
}

fn seal_plugins(dir: &Path) -> Result<(), String> {
    std::fs::create_dir_all(dir).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let mut cat = ActiveReflectionCatalog::open(dir).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let rt = tokio::runtime::Builder::new_current_thread()
        .enable_all()
        .build()
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let registry = DefaultPluginRegistry::new(Arc::new(MemoryStore::new()));
    let plugins = rt
        .block_on(registry.load_all_plugins())
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;

    let mut sealed = 0usize;
    let mut sealed_ids = std::collections::HashSet::new();
    let mut missing_schema = Vec::new();
    for plugin in plugins {
        let plugin_id = plugin.name().to_string();
        // Prefer a live-probed schema (real backend reachability folded in)
        // over the static declaration; most plugins have nothing to probe
        // and schema_live() defaults to None, in which case schema() is used.
        let live = rt.block_on(plugin.schema_live());
        let schema = match live.or_else(|| plugin.schema()) {
            Some(schema) => schema,
            None => {
                missing_schema.push(plugin_id);
                continue;
            }
        };
        let blob = blobify_plugin_schema(&plugin_id, schema);
        sealed_ids.insert(blob.manifest.plugin_id.clone());
        let path = cat.upsert_blob(&blob).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        println!(
            "sealed    {}  ({} methods, schema {})",
            path.display(),
            blob.manifest.methods.len(),
            &blob.manifest.schema_hash[..16]
        );
        sealed += 1;
    }

    // A blob in the catalog IS the plugin: sweep blobs whose plugin no
    // longer exists in the build (deregistration by disappearance).
    let mut swept = cat.retain_plugins(&sealed_ids).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    swept.sort();
    for plugin_id in &swept {
        println!("swept     {plugin_id} (plugin no longer exists)");
    }

    println!("catalog   {}", dir.display());
    println!("hash      {}", cat.catalog_hash());
    println!("sealed    {sealed} plugin blobs");
    if !missing_schema.is_empty() {
        missing_schema.sort();
        println!("skipped   {} plugins without schema", missing_schema.len());
        for plugin_id in missing_schema {
            println!("  {plugin_id}");
        }
    }
    println!("services:");
    for s in cat.list_services() {
        println!("  {s}");
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn inspect(file: &Path) -> Result<(), String> {
    let bytes = std::fs::read(file).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let blob = BlobRef::new(&bytes)?;
    let m = blob.manifest()?;
    println!("plugin     {} v{}", m.plugin_id, m.schema_version);
    println!("schema     sha256 {}", m.schema_hash);
    println!(
        "dbus       {} @ {}",
        m.dbus.interface_name, m.dbus.object_path
    );
    if let Some(id) = &m.identity {
        println!(
            "identity   wg-pub {}  key-id {}",
            id.wg_public_key, id.key_id
        );
        println!(
            "session    {} ({:?})",
            id.session.session_id, id.session.lifespan
        );
    }
    for mm in &m.methods {
        println!(
            "method     {}  {}  cap={}  subid={}",
            mm.schema_name,
            mm.grpc_path,
            mm.required_capability.as_deref().unwrap_or("-"),
            mm.subid
        );
    }
    for f in descriptor::decode_file_summaries(blob.descriptor_set())? {
        println!(
            "descriptor {} pkg={} messages={:?} services={:?}",
            f.name, f.package, f.messages, f.services
        );
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn catalog(dir: &Path) -> Result<(), String> {
    let cat = ActiveReflectionCatalog::open(dir).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    println!("active plugins: {:?}", cat.active_plugins());
    for s in cat.list_services() {
        println!("  {s}");
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn btrfs_seal(image: &Path, dir: &Path) -> Result<(), String> {
    let cat = ActiveReflectionCatalog::open(dir).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let paths: Vec<PathBuf> = cat.blob_paths();
    let report = btrfs::seal_blobs_into_btrfs_image(&paths, image).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    println!(
        "sealed {} blobs into {} ({} bytes, subvolumes={})",
        report.blob_count,
        report.image_path.display(),
        report.image_bytes,
        report.subvolumes
    );
    println!("{}", report.mount_hint);
    Ok(())
}

fn keygen(keyfile: &Path) -> Result<(), String> {
    if keyfile.exists() {
        return Err(format!(
            "{} exists — the keypair is the account identity and its session is account-persistent; refusing to overwrite",
            keyfile.display()
        ));
    }
    let kp = WgKeypair::generate();
    kp.save(keyfile).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let id = kp.public_identity();
    println!("private key written to {}", keyfile.display());
    println!("public   {}", id.wg_public_key);
    println!("key-id   {}", id.key_id);
    println!("session  {} (account-persistent)", id.session.session_id);
    Ok(())
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod copy_catalog_tests {
    use super::*;

    fn write_catalog(directory: &Path, schemas: Vec<op_blob::PluginSchema>) {
        let mut catalog = ActiveReflectionCatalog::open(directory).unwrap();
        for schema in schemas {
            catalog
                .upsert_blob(&blob::blobify_with_identity(&schema, None))
                .unwrap();
        }
    }

    fn committed_files(directory: &Path) -> BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>> {
        let mut files = BTreeMap::new();
        for entry in std::fs::read_dir(directory).unwrap() {
            let entry = entry.unwrap();
            let name = entry.file_name().into_string().unwrap();
            if name == MANIFEST_NAME || name.ends_with(".blob") {
                files.insert(name, std::fs::read(entry.path()).unwrap());
            }
        }
        files
    }

    #[test]
    fn invalid_source_leaves_prior_destination_byte_exact() {
        let root = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let source = root.path().join("source");
        let destination = root.path().join("destination");
        write_catalog(&source, vec![demo::unix_socket_schema()]);
        write_catalog(&destination, vec![demo::wireguard_schema()]);
        let before = committed_files(&destination);

        let source_blob = std::fs::read_dir(&source)
            .unwrap()
            .map(Result::unwrap)
            .find(|entry| entry.path().extension().and_then(|value| value.to_str()) == Some("blob"))
            .unwrap()
            .path();
        let mut corrupt = std::fs::read(&source_blob).unwrap();
        corrupt[0] ^= 0xff;
        std::fs::write(source_blob, corrupt).unwrap();

        assert!(copy_catalog(&source, &destination).is_err());
        assert_eq!(committed_files(&destination), before);
    }

    #[test]
    fn identical_and_symlink_aliased_roots_fail_without_changes() {
        use std::os::unix::fs::symlink;

        let root = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let source = root.path().join("source");
        write_catalog(&source, vec![demo::unix_socket_schema()]);
        let before = committed_files(&source);

        assert!(copy_catalog(&source, &source).is_err());
        assert_eq!(committed_files(&source), before);

        let alias = root.path().join("alias");
        symlink(&source, &alias).unwrap();
        assert!(copy_catalog(&source, &alias).is_err());
        assert_eq!(committed_files(&source), before);
    }

    #[test]
    fn changed_catalog_and_removals_commit_exact_source_bytes() {
        let root = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let source = root.path().join("source");
        let destination = root.path().join("destination");
        write_catalog(&source, vec![demo::unix_socket_schema()]);
        write_catalog(
            &destination,
            vec![demo::wireguard_schema(), demo::unix_socket_schema()],
        );
        let retired = committed_files(&destination)
            .into_keys()
            .find(|name| name.starts_with("wireguard."))
            .unwrap();
        let expected = committed_files(&source);

        copy_catalog(&source, &destination).unwrap();

        assert_eq!(committed_files(&destination), expected);
        assert!(!destination.join(retired).exists());
    }
}
</file>

<file path="op-plugins/src/bin/tched_router_config_surface.dispatch.inc">
// ── Native dispatch metadata ───────────────────────────────────────────────
//
// This generated module owns schemas and routing metadata only. Async provider
// I/O and committed-state reads belong to the bridge after canonical admission.

/// The authoritative backing required by one retained config-surface method.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum ConfigMethodBacking {
    /// Masked `GET /api/config` from the pinned v0.8.4 loopback gateway.
    WholeNativeConfig,
    /// One top-level value selected from the masked native config response.
    NativeSection(&'static str),
    /// A field in the committed protected tched_router state. The native
    /// v0.8.4 config document does not contain these plugin-owned fields.
    CommittedPluginStateSection(&'static str),
    /// Bounded typed property operations sent to native `PATCH /api/config`.
    NativePropertyPatch,
}

/// Resolve a canonical method name to its backing without reading state or
/// consulting the Rust registry for plugin existence.
pub fn config_method_backing(method: &str) -> Option<ConfigMethodBacking> {
    match method {
        "GetConfig" => Some(ConfigMethodBacking::WholeNativeConfig),
        "PatchConfig" => Some(ConfigMethodBacking::NativePropertyPatch),
        other => SECTIONS
            .iter()
            .find(|(name, _, _)| *name == other)
            .map(|(_, key, source)| match source {
                SectionSource::Upstream => ConfigMethodBacking::NativeSection(key),
                SectionSource::Local => ConfigMethodBacking::CommittedPluginStateSection(key),
            }),
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod backing_tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn all_declared_config_methods_have_one_explicit_backing() {
        for method in CONFIG_METHODS {
            assert!(
                config_method_backing(method).is_some(),
                "missing backing metadata for {method}"
            );
        }
        assert_eq!(config_method_backing("unknown"), None);
    }

    #[test]
    fn native_and_plugin_owned_sections_are_not_conflated() {
        assert_eq!(
            config_method_backing("GetGatewayConfig"),
            Some(ConfigMethodBacking::NativeSection("gateway"))
        );
        assert_eq!(
            config_method_backing("GetIdentityChainConfig"),
            Some(ConfigMethodBacking::CommittedPluginStateSection(
                "identity_chain"
            ))
        );
        assert_eq!(
            config_method_backing("PatchConfig"),
            Some(ConfigMethodBacking::NativePropertyPatch)
        );
    }
}
</file>

<file path="op-plugins/src/state_plugins/common/errors.rs">
//! 3tched Router error taxonomy (spec §14).
//!
//! `TchedRouterError` is a schema-contract type: it derives `schemars::JsonSchema`
//! so the error shape is surfaced in MCP tool responses and D-Bus method error
//! payloads. subid: `sch.software.3tched-router-error.schema@v1`.

use schemars::JsonSchema;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use thiserror::Error;

/// Failure modes for 3tched Router route resolution, model selection, and execution
/// authorization. Every variant maps to a deterministic, schema-derived denial
/// reason — nothing here reflects a runtime network error (those live in the
/// Provider Adapter Layer).
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Error, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(tag = "kind", rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum TchedRouterError {
    #[error("route not declared: {hint}")]
    RouteNotDeclared { hint: String },

    #[error("provider not declared: {provider}")]
    ProviderNotDeclared { provider: String },

    #[error("model not declared: {model}")]
    ModelNotDeclared { model: String },

    #[error("tool not declared: {tool}")]
    ToolNotDeclared { tool: String },

    #[error("route unavailable: {hint} ({reason})")]
    RouteUnavailable { hint: String, reason: String },

    #[error("privacy tier violation: required {required}, provided {provided}")]
    PrivacyTierViolation { required: String, provided: String },

    #[error("cost policy violation: {policy} ({reason})")]
    CostPolicyViolation { policy: String, reason: String },

    #[error("context window exceeded: limit {limit}, requested {requested}")]
    ContextWindowExceeded { limit: u32, requested: u32 },

    #[error("execution denied: {reason}")]
    ExecutionDenied { reason: String },

    #[error("no candidate route after filtering")]
    NoCandidateAfterFiltering,
}
</file>

    pub schema: String,

/// Rewrite shared `llm-projection` subids so they are plugin-specific.
///
/// Both `antigravity` and `tched_router` flatten the shared [`LlmProjection`] struct,
/// so without this rewrite the top-level projection subids collide. The rewrite
/// replaces the subject token `llm-projection` with `{plugin_name}-llm-projection` in
/// every top-level subid carried by the schema (nested `$defs` subids are not
/// stored in `PluginSchema.subids` and therefore are not touched here).
pub fn rewrite_projection_subids_for_plugin(
    schema: &mut op_state_store::PluginSchema,
    plugin_name: &str,
) {
    let replacement = format!("{plugin_name}-llm-projection");
    for subid in schema.subids.values_mut() {
        *subid = subid.replace("llm-projection", &replacement);
    }
}

    /// Whether structured output is required.
    #[serde(default)]

    /// MIME type for the response.
    #[serde(default)]

    pub response_mime_type: String,
    /// Schema validation mode.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "sch.standard.llm-structured-output.schema-validation@v1"))]
    pub schema_validation: String,
    /// Whether refusals are returned as null.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "obs.software.llm-structured-output.refusals-as-none@v1"))]
    pub refusals_as_none: bool,
}

/// Shared LLM projection embedded by both `tched_router` and `antigravity`.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "sch.software.llm-projection.schema@v1"))]
pub struct LlmProjection {
    /// Declared provider catalog.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "mut.service.llm-projection.providers@v1"))]
    pub providers: Vec<Provider>,
    /// Declared model routes.
    #[serde(default)]

    /// Declared tools.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "exp.service.llm-projection.tools@v1"))]
    pub tools: Vec<LlmTool>,
    /// Configuration schema reference.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "sch.software.llm-projection.config-schema@v1"))]
    pub config_schema: ConfigSchema,
    /// UI surfaces.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "exp.service.llm-projection.ui-surfaces@v1"))]
    pub ui_surfaces: Vec<UiSurface>,
    /// Structured output configuration.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "exp.service.llm-projection.structured-output@v1"))]
    pub structured_output: StructuredOutput,
}

#[cfg(test)]
pub mod schema_helpers {
    use crate::state_plugins::plugin_scaffold_helpers::schema_from_state;
    use crate::state_plugins::schemars_adapter::plugin_schema_from_json;
    use op_state_store::{FieldSchema, FieldType, PluginSchema};
    use serde_json::Value as JVal;
    use simd_json::OwnedValue;

    /// Build a golden `PluginSchema` from a default state value and its schemars
    /// schema JSON.
    ///
    /// The golden starts from the schemars-derived schema (so field types,
    /// descriptions, and subids match the derived contract), then overlays the
    /// default values from `schema_from_state` on the default state. This lets
    /// the golden reproduce the `schema_from_state` output shape while staying
    /// exactly equivalent to the derived schema.
    pub fn golden_from_state_and_schema(
        state: &OwnedValue,
        schema_json: &JVal,
        name: &str,
        category: &str,
        version: &str,
        description: &str,
    ) -> PluginSchema {
        // Base schema derived from schemars: correct types, descriptions, and
        // subids. The derived schema function uses the same path.
        let mut plugin_schema = plugin_schema_from_json(name, version, description, schema_json);
        plugin_schema.category = category.to_string();

        // Defaults come from `schema_from_state` on the default state. The
        // schema_from_state output carries them as examples; overlay them onto
        // the schemars base so the golden matches the derived defaults.
        let example_schema = schema_from_state(name, category, version, description, state);
        for (fname, field) in plugin_schema.fields.iter_mut() {
            if let Some(ex_field) = example_schema.fields.get(fname) {
                overlay_default(field, ex_field);
            }
        }

        // `schema_from_state` serializes default objects in struct field order;
        // the schemars-derived schema keeps properties alphabetically ordered.
        // Sort object keys in every default at every nesting level so the two
        // representations match.
        for field in plugin_schema.fields.values_mut() {
            sort_all_defaults(field);
        }

        plugin_schema
    }

    fn sort_all_defaults(field: &mut FieldSchema) {
        if let Some(default) = field.default.as_mut() {
            sort_object_keys(default);
        }
        match &mut field.field_type {
            FieldType::Object(map) => {
                for v in map.values_mut() {
                    sort_all_defaults(v);
                }
            }
            FieldType::Array(inner) => {
                sort_all_defaults_in_field_type(inner);
            }
            _ => {}
        }
    }

    fn sort_all_defaults_in_field_type(ft: &mut FieldType) {
        match ft {
            FieldType::Object(map) => {
                for v in map.values_mut() {
                    sort_all_defaults(v);
                }
            }
            FieldType::Array(inner) => {
                sort_all_defaults_in_field_type(inner);
            }
            _ => {}
        }
    }

    fn overlay_default(field: &mut FieldSchema, example_field: &FieldSchema) {
        if example_field.example.is_some() {
            field.default = example_field.example.clone();
        }
        match (&mut field.field_type, &example_field.field_type) {
            (FieldType::Object(map1), FieldType::Object(map2)) => {
                for (k, v1) in map1.iter_mut() {
                    if let Some(v2) = map2.get(k) {
                        overlay_default(v1, v2);
                    }
                }
            }
            (FieldType::Array(inner1), FieldType::Array(inner2)) => {
                overlay_default_in_field_type(inner1, inner2);
            }
            _ => {}
        }
    }

    fn overlay_default_in_field_type(ft1: &mut FieldType, ft2: &FieldType) {
        match (ft1, ft2) {
            (FieldType::Object(map1), FieldType::Object(map2)) => {
                for (k, v1) in map1.iter_mut() {
                    if let Some(v2) = map2.get(k) {
                        overlay_default(v1, v2);
                    }
                }
            }
            (FieldType::Array(inner1), FieldType::Array(inner2)) => {
                overlay_default_in_field_type(inner1, inner2);
            }
            _ => {}
        }
    }

    fn sort_object_keys(value: &mut OwnedValue) {
        // Convert to serde_json so we can sort object keys deterministically,
        // then parse back to simd_json. serde_json's Map preserves insertion
        // order, and simd_json's parser preserves JSON order, so the final
        // OwnedValue is sorted alphabetically at every nesting level.
        let json_str = simd_json::to_string(value).unwrap_or_default();
        let serde_value: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(&json_str).unwrap_or_default();
        let sorted = sort_json_value_keys(serde_value);
        let mut bytes = serde_json::to_vec(&sorted).unwrap_or_default();
        *value = simd_json::to_owned_value(&mut bytes).unwrap_or_default();
    }

    fn sort_json_value_keys(value: serde_json::Value) -> serde_json::Value {
        match value {
            serde_json::Value::Object(map) => {
                let mut entries: Vec<(String, serde_json::Value)> = map.into_iter().collect();
                entries.sort_by(|a, b| a.0.cmp(&b.0));
                let sorted: serde_json::Map<String, serde_json::Value> = entries
                    .into_iter()
                    .map(|(k, v)| (k, sort_json_value_keys(v)))
                    .collect();
                serde_json::Value::Object(sorted)
            }
            serde_json::Value::Array(arr) => {
                serde_json::Value::Array(arr.into_iter().map(sort_json_value_keys).collect())
            }
            other => other,
        }
    }
}
</file>
