fn validate_typed_call(
    schema: &op_state_store::PluginSchema,
    method: &str,
    args: &serde_json::Value,
    output: &serde_json::Value,
) {
    let declaration = schema.methods.get(method).expect("declared method");
    let args_schema = serde_json::to_value(&declaration.args).unwrap();
    jsonschema::Validator::new(&args_schema)
        .unwrap()
        .validate(args)
        .unwrap();
    let output_schema =
        serde_json::to_value(declaration.returns.as_ref().expect("typed method output")).unwrap();
    jsonschema::Validator::new(&output_schema)
        .unwrap()
        .validate(output)
        .unwrap();
}

/// Opt-in native proof. The calling thread enters a fresh network namespace
/// before constructing Tokio, netlink, D-Bus, or WireGuard handles, so no host
/// interface can be observed or changed.
#[test]
fn all_native_methods_execute_in_isolated_network_namespace() {
    if std::env::var("OP_WG_KERNEL_NETNS_TEST").as_deref() != Ok("1") {
        return;
    }
    assert_eq!(unsafe { nix::libc::geteuid() }, 0, "fixture requires root");
    assert_eq!(
        unsafe { nix::libc::unshare(nix::libc::CLONE_NEWNET) },
        0,
        "unshare(CLONE_NEWNET) failed"
    );
    let runtime = tokio::runtime::Builder::new_current_thread()
        .enable_all()
        .build()
        .unwrap();
    runtime.block_on(async {
        let owner = WireGuardOwner::new(
            DecoyRole::Decoy,
            ["fixture0".to_string()],
            Arc::new(LinuxKernelWireGuard),
        )
        .unwrap();
        let device_key = owner.generate_keypair().unwrap();
        let first_peer = owner.generate_keypair().unwrap();
        let second_peer = owner.generate_keypair().unwrap();
        let psk = owner.generate_keypair().unwrap();
        let secrets = [device_key.private_key(), psk.private_key()];
        let wireguard_schema = crate::state_plugins::wireguard::wireguard_schema();
        let wg_opdbus_schema = crate::state_plugins::wg_opdbus::wg_opdbus_schema();

        let calls = vec![
            (
                "set_device",
                serde_json::json!({
                    "interface":"fixture0",
                    "private_key":device_key.private_key(),
                    "listen_port":51820,
                    "fwmark":77
                }),
            ),
            ("get_device", serde_json::json!({"interface":"fixture0"})),
            (
                "add_peer",
                serde_json::json!({
                    "interface":"fixture0",
                    "public_key":first_peer.public_key(),
                    "preshared_key":psk.private_key(),
                    "endpoint":"192.0.2.9:51820",
                    "allowed_ips":["10.8.0.9/24","2001:db8::9/64"],
                    "persistent_keepalive":25
                }),
            ),
            ("list_peers", serde_json::json!({"interface":"fixture0"})),
            (
                "set_config",
                serde_json::json!({
                    "interface":"fixture0",
                    "config":{
                        "private_key":device_key.private_key(),
                        "listen_port":51821,
                        "fwmark":78,
                        "peers":[{
                            "public_key":second_peer.public_key(),
                            "allowed_ips":["203.0.113.7/24"],
                            "endpoint":"198.51.100.8:51820",
                            "persistent_keepalive":15
                        }]
                    }
                }),
            ),
            (
                "remove_peer",
                serde_json::json!({
                    "interface":"fixture0",
                    "public_key":second_peer.public_key()
                }),
            ),
        ];
        for (method, args) in calls {
            let receipt = owner
                .dispatch("wireguard", method, args.clone())
                .await
                .unwrap();
            validate_typed_call(&wireguard_schema, method, &args, &receipt.output);
            let encoded = serde_json::to_string(&receipt).unwrap();
            assert!(secrets.iter().all(|secret| !encoded.contains(*secret)));
        }

        let create_args = serde_json::json!({
            "interface_name":"fixture0",
            "addresses":["10.44.0.9/24","2001:db8:44::9/64"],
            "mtu":1420,
            "device":{
                "private_key":device_key.private_key(),
                "listen_port":51822,
                "fwmark":79,
                "peers":[{
                    "public_key":first_peer.public_key(),
                    "preshared_key":psk.private_key(),
                    "endpoint":"192.0.2.10:51820",
                    "allowed_ips":["10.99.0.9/24"],
                    "persistent_keepalive":20
                }]
            }
        });
        let created = owner
            .dispatch("wg_opdbus", "create_interface", create_args.clone())
            .await
            .unwrap();
        validate_typed_call(
            &wg_opdbus_schema,
            "create_interface",
            &create_args,
            &created.output,
        );
        let projection = created.wg_opdbus_state.as_ref().unwrap();
        let status = &projection.interfaces["fixture0"];
        assert!(status.admin_up);
        assert_eq!(status.mtu, Some(1420));
        assert!(status.addresses.contains(&"10.44.0.9/24".to_string()));
        assert!(status.addresses.contains(&"2001:db8:44::9/64".to_string()));

        let status_args = serde_json::json!({"interface_name":"fixture0"});
        let read = owner
            .dispatch("wg_opdbus", "get_status", status_args.clone())
            .await
            .unwrap();
        validate_typed_call(&wg_opdbus_schema, "get_status", &status_args, &read.output);
        let encoded = serde_json::to_string(&(created, read)).unwrap();
        assert!(secrets.iter().all(|secret| !encoded.contains(*secret)));
    });
}
</file>

<file path="op-plugins/src/state_plugins/decoy_network/wireguard_owner.rs">
//! Single Linux-kernel WireGuard authority shared by `wireguard`, `wg_opdbus`,
//! and the decoy WGCF owner.

use crate::state_plugins::{
    wg_opdbus::{
        AnnaScribeServicePersona, CreateInterfaceInput, CreateInterfaceOutput, GetStatusInput,
        WgOpdbusAggregateState, WgOpdbusState,
    },
    wireguard::{
        AddPeerInput, GetDeviceInput, GetDeviceOutput, ListPeersInput, ListPeersOutput,
        PeerMutationOutput, RemovePeerInput, SetConfigInput, SetConfigOutput, SetDeviceInput,
        SetDeviceOutput, WireGuardDeviceConfig, WireGuardInterface, WireGuardPeer,
        WireGuardPeerConfig, WireGuardState,
    },
};
use anyhow::{ensure, Context, Result};
use async_trait::async_trait;
use base64::{engine::general_purpose::STANDARD, Engine as _};
use op_network::wireguard_kernel::{
    self, KernelDeviceConfig, KernelDeviceSnapshot, KernelPeerConfig,
};
use serde_json::Value;
use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
use std::{
    collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet},
    net::IpAddr,
    sync::Arc,
};
use tokio::sync::Mutex;

/// Explicit construction marker. There is intentionally no host/server role.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy)]
pub enum DecoyRole {
    Decoy,
}

/// Secret keypair for in-process WGCF enrollment. It cannot be logged or serialized.
pub struct WireGuardKeyPair {
    private_key: String,
    public_key: String,
}

impl WireGuardKeyPair {
    pub fn private_key(&self) -> &str {
        &self.private_key
    }
    pub fn public_key(&self) -> &str {
        &self.public_key
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, serde::Serialize)]
pub struct WireGuardReceipt {
    pub output: Value,
    pub wireguard_state: WireGuardState,
    pub wg_opdbus_state: Option<WgOpdbusAggregateState>,
}

#[async_trait]
pub trait KernelWireGuard: Send + Sync {
    fn generate_keypair(&self) -> Result<WireGuardKeyPair>;
    fn public_from_private(&self, private: &str) -> Result<String>;
    async fn apply_device(
        &self,
        name: &str,
        config: KernelDeviceConfig,
    ) -> Result<KernelDeviceSnapshot>;
    async fn remove_peer(&self, name: &str, public_key: &str) -> Result<KernelDeviceSnapshot>;
    async fn configure_link(
        &self,
        name: &str,
        addresses: &[(IpAddr, u8)],
        mtu: Option<u32>,
    ) -> Result<KernelDeviceSnapshot>;
    async fn get_device(&self, name: &str) -> Result<Option<KernelDeviceSnapshot>>;
}

/// Real backend. Every call hardcodes wireguard-control's `Backend::Kernel`.
pub struct LinuxKernelWireGuard;

#[async_trait]
impl KernelWireGuard for LinuxKernelWireGuard {
    fn generate_keypair(&self) -> Result<WireGuardKeyPair> {
        let (private_key, public_key) = wireguard_kernel::generate_keypair();
        Ok(WireGuardKeyPair {
            private_key,
            public_key,
        })
    }
    fn public_from_private(&self, private: &str) -> Result<String> {
        wireguard_kernel::public_from_private(private)
    }
    async fn apply_device(
        &self,
        name: &str,
        config: KernelDeviceConfig,
    ) -> Result<KernelDeviceSnapshot> {
        wireguard_kernel::apply_device(name, config).await
    }
    async fn remove_peer(&self, name: &str, public_key: &str) -> Result<KernelDeviceSnapshot> {
        wireguard_kernel::remove_peer(name, public_key).await
    }
    async fn configure_link(
        &self,
        name: &str,
        addresses: &[(IpAddr, u8)],
        mtu: Option<u32>,
    ) -> Result<KernelDeviceSnapshot> {
        wireguard_kernel::configure_link(name, addresses, mtu).await
    }
    async fn get_device(&self, name: &str) -> Result<Option<KernelDeviceSnapshot>> {
        wireguard_kernel::get_device(name).await
    }
}

pub struct WireGuardOwner {
    kernel: Arc<dyn KernelWireGuard>,
    allowed_interfaces: BTreeSet<String>,
    effects: Mutex<()>,
}

impl WireGuardOwner {
    pub fn new(
        role: DecoyRole,
        allowed_interfaces: impl IntoIterator<Item = String>,
        kernel: Arc<dyn KernelWireGuard>,
    ) -> Result<Self> {
        ensure!(
            matches!(role, DecoyRole::Decoy),
            "WireGuard owner requires decoy role"
        );
        let allowed_interfaces = allowed_interfaces
            .into_iter()
            .map(|name| validate_interface(&name))
            .collect::<Result<BTreeSet<_>>>()?;
        ensure!(
            !allowed_interfaces.is_empty(),
            "WireGuard allowlist is empty"
        );
        Ok(Self {
            kernel,
            allowed_interfaces,
            effects: Mutex::new(()),
        })
    }

    pub fn generate_keypair(&self) -> Result<WireGuardKeyPair> {
        let pair = self.kernel.generate_keypair()?;
        validate_key(pair.private_key(), "generated private_key")?;
        validate_key(pair.public_key(), "generated public_key")?;
        Ok(pair)
    }

    pub fn public_from_private(&self, private: &str) -> Result<String> {
        validate_key(private, "private_key")?;
        let public = self.kernel.public_from_private(private)?;
        validate_key(&public, "derived public_key")?;
        Ok(public)
    }

    pub async fn device(&self, interface: &str) -> Result<Option<WireGuardInterface>> {
        let interface = self.allowed_interface(interface)?;
        self.kernel
            .get_device(&interface)
            .await?
            .map(sanitize_device)
            .transpose()
    }

    pub async fn state(&self) -> Result<WireGuardState> {
        let mut interfaces = Vec::new();
        for name in &self.allowed_interfaces {
            if let Some(device) = self.kernel.get_device(name).await? {
                interfaces.push(sanitize_device(device)?);
            }
        }
        Ok(WireGuardState { interfaces })
    }

    /// Complete WG-OPDBUS projection for the same allowlisted kernel owner.
    /// Entries are retained for absent devices so sibling disappearance is an
    /// explicit native observation rather than an omitted member.
    pub async fn wg_opdbus_state(&self) -> Result<WgOpdbusAggregateState> {
        let mut interfaces = BTreeMap::new();
        for name in &self.allowed_interfaces {
            let status = match self.kernel.get_device(name).await? {
                Some(snapshot) => wg_status(snapshot)?,
                None => WgOpdbusState::default(),
            };
            interfaces.insert(name.clone(), status);
        }
        Ok(WgOpdbusAggregateState {
            service_persona: AnnaScribeServicePersona::default(),
            interfaces,
        })
    }

    pub async fn apply_interface_profile(
        &self,
        interface: &str,
        profile: WireGuardDeviceConfig,
        addresses: Vec<String>,
        mtu: Option<u32>,
    ) -> Result<WgOpdbusState> {
        let _guard = self.effects.lock().await;
        let interface = self.allowed_interface(interface)?;
        let config = kernel_config(profile, true)?;
        let expected_public = config
            .private_key
            .as_deref()
            .map(|key| self.kernel.public_from_private(key))
            .transpose()?;
        let addresses = validate_interface_addresses(&addresses)?;
        if let Some(mtu) = mtu {
            ensure!(
                (576..=65_535).contains(&mtu),
                "mtu must be between 576 and 65535"
            );
        }
        self.kernel.apply_device(&interface, config.clone()).await?;
        let snapshot = self
            .kernel
            .configure_link(&interface, &addresses, mtu)
            .await?;
        verify_device_effect(&interface, &config, expected_public.as_deref(), &snapshot)?;
        ensure!(snapshot.admin_up, "WireGuard link did not become active");
        if let Some(mtu) = mtu {
            ensure!(snapshot.mtu == Some(mtu), "WireGuard MTU readback mismatch");
        }
        let wanted_addresses = addresses.iter().copied().collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
        let observed_addresses = snapshot.addresses.iter().copied().collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
        ensure!(
            wanted_addresses.is_subset(&observed_addresses),
            "WireGuard address readback mismatch"
        );
        wg_status(snapshot)
    }

    pub async fn dispatch(
        &self,
        plugin: &str,
        method: &str,
        args: Value,
    ) -> Result<WireGuardReceipt> {
        match plugin {
            "wireguard" => self.dispatch_wireguard(method, args).await,
            "wg_opdbus" => self.dispatch_wg_opdbus(method, args).await,
            _ => anyhow::bail!("unsupported decoy WireGuard plugin: {plugin}"),
        }
    }

    async fn dispatch_wireguard(&self, method: &str, args: Value) -> Result<WireGuardReceipt> {
        let output = match method {
            "set_device" => {
                let input: SetDeviceInput = serde_json::from_value(args)?;
                let _guard = self.effects.lock().await;
                let name = self.allowed_interface(&input.interface)?;
                let desired = kernel_config(
                    WireGuardDeviceConfig {
                        private_key: input.private_key,
                        listen_port: input.listen_port,
                        fwmark: input.fwmark,
                        peers: vec![],
                    },
                    false,
                )?;
                let expected_public = desired
                    .private_key
                    .as_deref()
                    .map(|key| self.kernel.public_from_private(key))
                    .transpose()?;
                let snapshot = self.kernel.apply_device(&name, desired.clone()).await?;
                verify_device_effect(&name, &desired, expected_public.as_deref(), &snapshot)?;
                serde_json::to_value(SetDeviceOutput {
                    interface: sanitize_device(snapshot)?,
                })?
            }
            "get_device" => {
                let input: GetDeviceInput = serde_json::from_value(args)?;
                serde_json::to_value(GetDeviceOutput {
                    interface: self.device(&input.interface).await?,
                })?
            }
            "add_peer" => {
                let input: AddPeerInput = serde_json::from_value(args)?;
                let _guard = self.effects.lock().await;
                let name = self.allowed_interface(&input.interface)?;
                let desired = kernel_peer(input.peer)?;
                let wanted_key = desired.public_key.clone();
                let before = self.kernel.get_device(&name).await?.and_then(|device| {
                    device
                        .peers
                        .into_iter()
                        .find(|peer| peer.public_key == wanted_key)
                });
                let changed = match before {
                    Some(before) => !peer_matches(&desired, &before)?,
                    None => true,
                };
                let config = KernelDeviceConfig {
                    private_key: None,
                    listen_port: None,
                    fwmark: None,
                    peers: vec![desired.clone()],
                    replace_peers: false,
                };
                let snapshot = self.kernel.apply_device(&name, config.clone()).await?;
                verify_device_effect(&name, &config, None, &snapshot)?;
                let interface = sanitize_device(snapshot)?;
                let peer = interface
                    .peers
                    .iter()
                    .find(|peer| peer.public_key == wanted_key)
                    .cloned()
                    .context("peer missing after kernel apply")?;
                serde_json::to_value(PeerMutationOutput {
                    interface,
                    peer: Some(peer),
                    changed,
                })?
            }
            "remove_peer" => {
                let input: RemovePeerInput = serde_json::from_value(args)?;
                let _guard = self.effects.lock().await;
                let name = self.allowed_interface(&input.interface)?;
                let key = validate_key(&input.public_key, "public_key")?;
                let before =
                    self.kernel.get_device(&name).await?.is_some_and(|device| {
                        device.peers.iter().any(|peer| peer.public_key == key)
                    });
                let interface = sanitize_device(self.kernel.remove_peer(&name, &key).await?)?;
                ensure!(
                    !interface.peers.iter().any(|peer| peer.public_key == key),
                    "peer remains after kernel removal"
                );
                serde_json::to_value(PeerMutationOutput {
                    interface,
                    peer: None,
                    changed: before,
                })?
            }
            "list_peers" => {
                let input: ListPeersInput = serde_json::from_value(args)?;
                let device = self
                    .device(&input.interface)
                    .await?
                    .context("WireGuard interface does not exist")?;
                serde_json::to_value(ListPeersOutput {
                    peers: device.peers,
                })?
            }
            "set_config" => {
                let input: SetConfigInput = serde_json::from_value(args)?;
                let _guard = self.effects.lock().await;
                let name = self.allowed_interface(&input.interface)?;
                let desired = kernel_config(input.config, true)?;
                let expected_public = desired
                    .private_key
                    .as_deref()
                    .map(|key| self.kernel.public_from_private(key))
                    .transpose()?;
                let snapshot = self.kernel.apply_device(&name, desired.clone()).await?;
                verify_device_effect(&name, &desired, expected_public.as_deref(), &snapshot)?;
                serde_json::to_value(SetConfigOutput {
                    interface: sanitize_device(snapshot)?,
                })?
            }
            _ => anyhow::bail!("unknown wireguard method: {method}"),
        };
        Ok(WireGuardReceipt {
            output,
            wireguard_state: self.state().await?,
            wg_opdbus_state: Some(self.wg_opdbus_state().await?),
        })
    }

    async fn dispatch_wg_opdbus(&self, method: &str, args: Value) -> Result<WireGuardReceipt> {
        let output = match method {
            "create_interface" => {
                let input: CreateInterfaceInput = serde_json::from_value(args)?;
                let state = self
                    .apply_interface_profile(
                        &input.interface_name,
                        input.device,
                        input.addresses,
                        input.mtu,
                    )
                    .await?;
                serde_json::to_value(CreateInterfaceOutput { status: state })?
            }
            "get_status" => {
                let input: GetStatusInput = serde_json::from_value(args)?;
                let name = self.allowed_interface(&input.interface_name)?;
                let state = match self.kernel.get_device(&name).await? {
                    Some(snapshot) => wg_status(snapshot)?,
                    None => WgOpdbusState::default(),
                };
                serde_json::to_value(&state)?
            }
            _ => anyhow::bail!("unknown wg_opdbus method: {method}"),
        };
        Ok(WireGuardReceipt {
            output,
            wireguard_state: self.state().await?,
            wg_opdbus_state: Some(self.wg_opdbus_state().await?),
        })
    }

    fn allowed_interface(&self, name: &str) -> Result<String> {
        let name = validate_interface(name)?;
        ensure!(
            self.allowed_interfaces.contains(&name),
            "WireGuard interface is not allowed for this decoy owner"
        );
        Ok(name)
    }
}

fn kernel_config(config: WireGuardDeviceConfig, replace_peers: bool) -> Result<KernelDeviceConfig> {
    if let Some(key) = &config.private_key {
        validate_key(key, "private_key")?;
    }
    let mut seen = BTreeSet::new();
    let peers = config
        .peers
        .into_iter()
        .map(|peer| {
            let parsed = kernel_peer(peer)?;
            ensure!(
                seen.insert(parsed.public_key.clone()),
                "duplicate WireGuard peer public key"
            );
            Ok(parsed)
        })
        .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
    Ok(KernelDeviceConfig {
        private_key: config.private_key,
        listen_port: config.listen_port,
        fwmark: config.fwmark,
        peers,
        replace_peers,
    })
}

fn kernel_peer(peer: WireGuardPeerConfig) -> Result<KernelPeerConfig> {
    let public_key = validate_key(&peer.public_key, "public_key")?;
    if let Some(psk) = &peer.preshared_key {
        validate_key(psk, "preshared_key")?;
    }
    let endpoint = peer
        .endpoint
        .map(|value| {
            value
                .parse()
                .context("endpoint must be an IP socket address")
        })
        .transpose()?;
    let allowed_ips = validate_allowed_networks(&peer.allowed_ips)?;
    Ok(KernelPeerConfig {
        public_key,
        preshared_key: peer.preshared_key,
        endpoint,
        persistent_keepalive: peer.persistent_keepalive,
        allowed_ips,
    })
}

fn validate_interface(value: &str) -> Result<String> {
    ensure!(
        !value.is_empty() && value.len() <= 15,
        "invalid interface name length"
    );
    ensure!(
        value
            .bytes()
            .all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || matches!(byte, b'_' | b'-' | b'.')),
        "invalid interface name characters"
    );
    Ok(value.to_owned())
}

fn validate_key(value: &str, label: &str) -> Result<String> {
    let bytes = STANDARD
        .decode(value)
        .with_context(|| format!("invalid {label} base64"))?;
    ensure!(
        bytes.len() == 32 && bytes.iter().any(|byte| *byte != 0),
        "{label} must encode one non-zero 32-byte key"
    );
    ensure!(
        STANDARD.encode(&bytes) == value,
        "{label} must use canonical base64"
    );
    Ok(value.to_owned())
}

fn parse_cidrs(values: &[String], normalize_networks: bool) -> Result<Vec<(IpAddr, u8)>> {
    let mut seen = BTreeSet::new();
    values
        .iter()
        .map(|value| {
            let (address, prefix) = value
                .split_once('/')
                .context("address must use CIDR notation")?;
            let address: IpAddr = address.parse().context("invalid IP address")?;
            let prefix: u8 = prefix.parse().context("invalid CIDR prefix")?;
            ensure!(
                prefix <= if address.is_ipv4() { 32 } else { 128 },
                "CIDR prefix exceeds address width"
            );
            let address = if normalize_networks {
                canonical_network(address, prefix)
            } else {
                address
            };
            ensure!(seen.insert((address, prefix)), "duplicate CIDR");
            Ok((address, prefix))
        })
        .collect()
}

/// Interface assignments retain their host address. Converting these to the
/// containing network would configure a different address on the native link.
fn validate_interface_addresses(values: &[String]) -> Result<Vec<(IpAddr, u8)>> {
    parse_cidrs(values, false)
}

/// Peer AllowedIPs are network selectors, so their host bits are normalized
/// before native application and exact readback comparison.
fn validate_allowed_networks(values: &[String]) -> Result<Vec<(IpAddr, u8)>> {
    parse_cidrs(values, true)
}

fn canonical_network(address: IpAddr, prefix: u8) -> IpAddr {
    match address {
        IpAddr::V4(address) => {
            let bits = u32::from(address);
            let mask = if prefix == 0 {
                0
            } else {
                u32::MAX << (32 - prefix)
            };
            IpAddr::V4((bits & mask).into())
        }
        IpAddr::V6(address) => {
            let bits = u128::from(address);
            let mask = if prefix == 0 {
                0
            } else {
                u128::MAX << (128 - prefix)
            };
            IpAddr::V6((bits & mask).into())
        }
    }
}

fn psk_fingerprint(value: &str) -> Result<[u8; 32]> {
    let canonical = validate_key(value, "preshared_key")?;
    let bytes = STANDARD.decode(canonical)?;
    Ok(Sha256::digest(bytes).into())
}

fn peer_matches(
    expected: &KernelPeerConfig,
    observed: &op_network::wireguard_kernel::KernelPeerSnapshot,
) -> Result<bool> {
    let expected_ips = expected
        .allowed_ips
        .iter()
        .copied()
        .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
    let observed_ips = observed
        .allowed_ips
        .iter()
        .copied()
        .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
    let expected_psk = expected
        .preshared_key
        .as_deref()
        .map(psk_fingerprint)
        .transpose()?;
    Ok(expected.public_key == observed.public_key
        && expected.endpoint == observed.endpoint
        && expected.persistent_keepalive == observed.persistent_keepalive
        && expected_ips == observed_ips
        && expected_psk == observed.preshared_key_sha256)
}

fn verify_device_effect(
    interface: &str,
    expected: &KernelDeviceConfig,
    expected_public: Option<&str>,
    observed: &KernelDeviceSnapshot,
) -> Result<()> {
    ensure!(
        observed.name == interface,
        "WireGuard interface readback mismatch"
    );
    if let Some(public) = expected_public {
        ensure!(
            observed.public_key.as_deref() == Some(public),
            "WireGuard public-key readback mismatch"
        );
    }
    if let Some(port) = expected.listen_port {
        ensure!(
            observed.listen_port == Some(port),
            "WireGuard listen-port readback mismatch"
        );
    }
    if let Some(mark) = expected.fwmark {
        ensure!(
            observed.fwmark == Some(mark),
            "WireGuard fwmark readback mismatch"
        );
    }
    if expected.replace_peers {
        ensure!(
            observed.peers.len() == expected.peers.len(),
            "WireGuard peer-set readback mismatch"
        );
    }
    for peer in &expected.peers {
        let candidate = observed
            .peers
            .iter()
            .find(|candidate| candidate.public_key == peer.public_key)
            .context("WireGuard peer readback mismatch")?;
        ensure!(
            peer_matches(peer, candidate)?,
            "WireGuard peer readback mismatch"
        );
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn sanitize_device(device: KernelDeviceSnapshot) -> Result<WireGuardInterface> {
    let public_key = device
        .public_key
        .map(|key| validate_key(&key, "kernel public_key"))
        .transpose()?;
    let mut peers = device
        .peers
        .into_iter()
        .map(|peer| {
            validate_key(&peer.public_key, "kernel public_key")?;
            Ok(WireGuardPeer {
                public_key: peer.public_key,
                allowed_ips: peer
                    .allowed_ips
                    .into_iter()
                    .map(|(address, prefix)| format!("{address}/{prefix}"))
                    .collect(),
                endpoint: peer.endpoint.map(|value| value.to_string()),
                persistent_keepalive: peer.persistent_keepalive,
                latest_handshake_unix: peer.latest_handshake_unix,
                rx_bytes: peer.rx_bytes,
                tx_bytes: peer.tx_bytes,
            })
        })
        .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
    peers.sort_by(|a, b| a.public_key.cmp(&b.public_key));
    Ok(WireGuardInterface {
        name: validate_interface(&device.name)?,
        public_key,
        listen_port: device.listen_port,
        fwmark: device.fwmark,
        peers,
    })
}

fn wg_status(snapshot: KernelDeviceSnapshot) -> Result<WgOpdbusState> {
    let addresses = snapshot
        .addresses
        .iter()
        .map(|(address, prefix)| format!("{address}/{prefix}"))
        .collect();
    let mtu = snapshot.mtu;
    let admin_up = snapshot.admin_up;
    Ok(WgOpdbusState {
        service_persona: AnnaScribeServicePersona::default(),
        interface: Some(sanitize_device(snapshot)?),
        addresses,
        mtu,
        admin_up,
    })
}

#[cfg(test)]
#[path = "wireguard_owner_tests.rs"]
mod tests;

<file path="op-plugins/src/state_plugins/keypair/agent.rs">
//! SSH agent public-identity query, RFC 9987 sections 4, 5.5 and 8.1.
//! https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9987.html
//! This adapter never requests signatures or private key material.
use super::{KeypairInfo, ListKeypairsInput, ListKeypairsOutput};
use anyhow::{bail, ensure, Context, Result};
use base64::{
    engine::general_purpose::{STANDARD, STANDARD_NO_PAD},
    Engine as _,
};
use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
use std::time::Duration;
use tokio::{
    io::{AsyncReadExt, AsyncWriteExt},
    net::UnixStream,
};

const MAX_RESPONSE: usize = 8 * 1024 * 1024;
const MAX_IDENTITIES: usize = 4096;

pub async fn dispatch_keypair_method(
    method: &str,
    args: &serde_json::Value,
) -> Result<serde_json::Value> {
    ensure!(
        method == "list_keypairs",
        "unknown keypair method: {method}"
    );
    let _: ListKeypairsInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
    let path = std::env::var_os("SSH_AUTH_SOCK")
        .filter(|path| !path.is_empty())
        .context("SSH_AUTH_SOCK is not configured")?;
    ensure!(
        std::path::Path::new(&path).is_absolute(),
        "SSH_AUTH_SOCK must be absolute"
    );
    let output = tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(5), async {
        let mut stream = UnixStream::connect(path)
            .await
            .context("SSH agent is unavailable")?;
        query(&mut stream).await
    })
    .await
    .context("SSH agent identity query timed out")??;
    Ok(serde_json::to_value(output)?)
}

async fn query(stream: &mut UnixStream) -> Result<ListKeypairsOutput> {
    // uint32 packet length followed by SSH_AGENTC_REQUEST_IDENTITIES (11).
    stream.write_all(&[0, 0, 0, 1, 11]).await?;
    let size = stream.read_u32().await? as usize;
    ensure!(
        (1..=MAX_RESPONSE).contains(&size),
        "invalid SSH agent response size"
    );
    let mut packet = vec![0; size];
    stream.read_exact(&mut packet).await?;
    parse(&packet)
}

fn take_u32(bytes: &mut &[u8]) -> Result<u32> {
    ensure!(bytes.len() >= 4, "truncated SSH agent integer");
    let (number, rest) = bytes.split_at(4);
    *bytes = rest;
    Ok(u32::from_be_bytes(number.try_into()?))
}

fn take_string<'a>(bytes: &mut &'a [u8]) -> Result<&'a [u8]> {
    let length = take_u32(bytes)? as usize;
    ensure!(length <= bytes.len(), "truncated SSH agent string");
    let (value, rest) = bytes.split_at(length);
    *bytes = rest;
    Ok(value)
}

fn parse(packet: &[u8]) -> Result<ListKeypairsOutput> {
    let (&kind, mut bytes) = packet.split_first().context("empty SSH agent response")?;
    if kind == 5 {
        bail!("SSH agent rejected the public identity query");
    }
    ensure!(kind == 12, "unexpected SSH agent response type");
    let count = take_u32(&mut bytes)? as usize;
    ensure!(
        count <= MAX_IDENTITIES,
        "SSH agent identity count exceeds limit"
    );
    let mut keypairs = Vec::with_capacity(count);
    for _ in 0..count {
        let blob = take_string(&mut bytes)?;
        let comment = std::str::from_utf8(take_string(&mut bytes)?)
            .context("SSH agent comment is not UTF-8")?;
        let mut public = blob;
        let algorithm = std::str::from_utf8(take_string(&mut public)?)
            .context("SSH public key algorithm is not UTF-8")?;
        ensure!(
            !algorithm.is_empty()
                && algorithm.len() <= 255
                && algorithm.bytes().all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_graphic())
                && !public.is_empty(),
            "invalid SSH public key encoding"
        );
        let fingerprint = format!("SHA256:{}", STANDARD_NO_PAD.encode(Sha256::digest(blob)));
        keypairs.push(KeypairInfo {
            name: if comment.is_empty() {
                fingerprint.clone()
            } else {
                comment.to_owned()
            },
            fingerprint,
            algorithm: algorithm.to_owned(),
            public_key: Some(format!("{algorithm} {}", STANDARD.encode(blob))),
            present: true,
        });
    }
    ensure!(bytes.is_empty(), "SSH agent response has trailing data");
    keypairs.sort_by(|a, b| a.fingerprint.cmp(&b.fingerprint).then(a.name.cmp(&b.name)));
    Ok(ListKeypairsOutput {
        source: "ssh_agent".into(),
        keypairs,
    })
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn string(bytes: &[u8], output: &mut Vec<u8>) {
        output.extend_from_slice(&(bytes.len() as u32).to_be_bytes());
        output.extend_from_slice(bytes);
    }

    fn answer() -> Vec<u8> {
        let mut packet = vec![12, 0, 0, 0, 1];
        let mut key = Vec::new();
        string(b"ssh-ed25519", &mut key);
        string(&[42; 32], &mut key);
        string(&key, &mut packet);
        string(b"fixture public identity", &mut packet);
        packet
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn native_agent_inventory_retains_public_key_and_fingerprint() {
        let (mut client, mut server) = UnixStream::pair().unwrap();
        let provider = tokio::spawn(async move {
            let mut request = [0; 5];
            server.read_exact(&mut request).await.unwrap();
            assert_eq!(request, [0, 0, 0, 1, 11]);
            let packet = answer();
            server.write_u32(packet.len() as u32).await.unwrap();
            // Exercise partial packet reads.
            for chunk in packet.chunks(7) {
                server.write_all(chunk).await.unwrap();
            }
        });
        let result = tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(2), query(&mut client))
            .await
            .unwrap()
            .unwrap();
        provider.await.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(result.source, "ssh_agent");
        assert_eq!(result.keypairs.len(), 1);
        let key = &result.keypairs[0];
        assert_eq!(key.name, "fixture public identity");
        assert_eq!(key.algorithm, "ssh-ed25519");
        assert!(key.fingerprint.starts_with("SHA256:"));
        assert!(key
            .public_key
            .as_ref()
            .unwrap()
            .starts_with("ssh-ed25519 AAAA"));
        let schema = super::super::keypair_schema();
        let returns =
            serde_json::to_value(schema.methods["list_keypairs"].returns.as_ref().unwrap())
                .unwrap();
        jsonschema::validate(&returns, &serde_json::to_value(result).unwrap()).unwrap();
    }

    #[test]
    fn empty_inventory_is_distinct_from_failure_and_malformed_packets() {
        assert!(parse(&[12, 0, 0, 0, 0]).unwrap().keypairs.is_empty());
        for bytes in [
            vec![5],
            vec![6],
            vec![12],
            vec![12, 0, 0, 0, 1],
            vec![12, 255, 255, 255, 255],
        ] {
            assert!(parse(&bytes).is_err());
        }
        let mut trailing = answer();
        trailing.push(0);
        assert!(parse(&trailing).is_err());
        let packet = answer();
        for size in 0..packet.len() {
            assert!(parse(&packet[..size]).is_err());
        }
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn oversized_frame_is_rejected_before_allocation() {
        let (mut client, mut server) = UnixStream::pair().unwrap();
        let provider = tokio::spawn(async move {
            let mut request = [0; 5];
            server.read_exact(&mut request).await.unwrap();
            server.write_u32(u32::MAX).await.unwrap();
        });
        assert!(
            tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(2), query(&mut client))
                .await
                .unwrap()
                .unwrap_err()
                .to_string()
                .contains("response size")
        );
        provider.await.unwrap();
    }
}
</file>

<file path="op-plugins/src/state_plugins/login1/methods.rs">
//! Native wire mappings for the plugin's login1 contract.
//! Signature source: systemd/man/org.freedesktop.login1.xml (also used by elogind).
use super::*;
use anyhow::{bail, ensure, Context};
use serde::de::DeserializeOwned;
use serde_json::{to_value, Value as Json};
use std::collections::BTreeMap;
use std::sync::OnceLock;
use tokio::sync::Mutex;
use zbus::zvariant::{OwnedFd, OwnedValue, Value as DbusValue};

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct UserInfo {
    pub uid: u32,
    pub user: String,
    pub path: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct SeatInfo {
    pub id: String,
    pub path: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct ListSessionsOutput {
    pub sessions: Vec<SessionInfo>,
}
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct ListUsersOutput {
    pub users: Vec<UserInfo>,
}
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct ListSeatsOutput {
    pub seats: Vec<SeatInfo>,
}
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct GetObjectOutput {
    pub object_path: String,
}

/// A successful empty D-Bus reply means the operation was accepted. It does
/// not mean a power transition finished or a screen-lock handler responded.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct LoginOperationOutput {
    pub operation: String,
    pub disposition: LoginOperationDisposition,
}
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum LoginOperationDisposition {
    Accepted,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct CreateSessionOutput {
    pub session_id: String,
    pub object_path: String,
    pub runtime_path: String,
    pub uid: u32,
    pub seat_id: String,
    pub vtnr: u32,
    pub existing: bool,
}

/// Typed transient-scope property values. D-Bus variants retain their width;
/// JSON numbers alone must never choose a D-Bus signature implicitly.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(tag = "type", content = "value", rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum SessionPropertyValue {
    Bool(bool),
    Byte(u8),
    Int32(i32),
    Uint32(u32),
    Int64(i64),
    Uint64(u64),
    Double(f64),
    String(String),
    Strings(Vec<String>),
    Bytes(Vec<u8>),
}
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct SessionProperty {
    pub name: String,
    pub value: SessionPropertyValue,
}
impl SessionPropertyValue {
    fn into_dbus(self) -> Result<OwnedValue> {
        Ok(match self {
            Self::Bool(v) => v.into(),
            Self::Byte(v) => v.into(),
            Self::Int32(v) => v.into(),
            Self::Uint32(v) => v.into(),
            Self::Int64(v) => v.into(),
            Self::Uint64(v) => v.into(),
            Self::Double(v) => {
                ensure!(v.is_finite(), "property must be finite");
                v.into()
            }
            Self::String(v) => DbusValue::from(v).try_into()?,
            Self::Strings(v) => DbusValue::from(v).try_into()?,
            Self::Bytes(v) => DbusValue::from(v).try_into()?,
        })
    }
}

/// CreateSession transfers a lifetime FIFO, not a portable integer file
/// descriptor. Hold it until ReleaseSession/TerminateSession or process exit.
/// These are login1 leases, completely separate from OP-DBUS SID1 identities.
struct SessionLease {
    uid: u32,
    seat: String,
    _fifo: OwnedFd,
}
#[derive(Default)]
struct SessionLeases(Mutex<BTreeMap<String, SessionLease>>);
static SESSION_LEASES: OnceLock<SessionLeases> = OnceLock::new();

fn input<T: DeserializeOwned>(args: &Json) -> Result<T> {
    serde_json::from_value(args.clone()).context("invalid login1 method input")
}

pub async fn dispatch_login1_method(method: &str, args: &Json) -> Result<Json> {
    let proxy = Login1Plugin::new().connect_manager().await?;
    dispatch_with_proxy(
        &proxy,
        SESSION_LEASES.get_or_init(Default::default),
        method,
        args,
    )
    .await
}

async fn dispatch_with_proxy(
    proxy: &Proxy<'_>,
    leases: &SessionLeases,
    method: &str,
    args: &Json,
) -> Result<Json> {
    // Also serializes lease creation/release so an overlapping release cannot
    // run between the upstream create and our acquisition of its FIFO.
    let mut held = leases.0.lock().await;
    match method {
        "list_sessions" => {
            let rows: Vec<(String, u32, String, String, OwnedObjectPath)> =
                proxy.call("ListSessions", &()).await?;
            to_value(ListSessionsOutput {
                sessions: rows
                    .into_iter()
                    .map(|(id, uid, user, seat, path)| SessionInfo {
                        id,
                        uid,
                        user,
                        seat,
                        path: path.to_string(),
                    })
                    .collect(),
            })
            .map_err(Into::into)
        }
        "list_users" => {
            let rows: Vec<(u32, String, OwnedObjectPath)> = proxy.call("ListUsers", &()).await?;
            Ok(to_value(ListUsersOutput {
                users: rows
                    .into_iter()
                    .map(|(uid, user, path)| UserInfo {
                        uid,
                        user,
                        path: path.to_string(),
                    })
                    .collect(),
            })?)
        }
        "list_seats" => {
            let rows: Vec<(String, OwnedObjectPath)> = proxy.call("ListSeats", &()).await?;
            Ok(to_value(ListSeatsOutput {
                seats: rows
                    .into_iter()
                    .map(|(id, path)| SeatInfo {
                        id,
                        path: path.to_string(),
                    })
                    .collect(),
            })?)
        }
        "get_session" | "get_user" | "get_seat" => {
            let path: OwnedObjectPath = match method {
                "get_session" => {
                    proxy
                        .call("GetSession", &(input::<GetSessionInput>(args)?.session_id,))
                        .await?
                }
                "get_user" => {
                    proxy
                        .call("GetUser", &(input::<GetUserInput>(args)?.uid,))
                        .await?
                }
                _ => {
                    proxy
                        .call("GetSeat", &(input::<GetSeatInput>(args)?.seat_id,))
                        .await?
                }
            };
            Ok(to_value(GetObjectOutput {
                object_path: path.to_string(),
            })?)
        }
        "create_session" => {
            let i: CreateSessionInput = input(args)?;
            let properties: Vec<(String, OwnedValue)> = i
                .properties
                .into_iter()
                .map(|p| Ok((p.name, p.value.into_dbus()?)))
                .collect::<Result<_>>()?;
            let (session_id, path, runtime_path, fd, uid, seat_id, vtnr, existing): (
                String,
                OwnedObjectPath,
                String,
                OwnedFd,
                u32,
                String,
                u32,
                bool,
            ) = proxy
                .call(
                    "CreateSession",
                    &(
                        i.uid,
                        i.pid,
                        i.service,
                        i.type_,
                        i.class,
                        i.desktop,
                        i.seat_id,
                        i.vtnr,
                        i.tty,
                        i.display,
                        i.remote,
                        i.remote_user,
                        i.remote_host,
                        properties,
                    ),
                )
                .await?;
            // Keep one FIFO per session: repeated creates must not accumulate
            // descriptors for an already registered login session.
            held.insert(
                session_id.clone(),
                SessionLease {
                    uid,
                    seat: seat_id.clone(),
                    _fifo: fd,
                },
            );
            Ok(to_value(CreateSessionOutput {
                session_id,
                object_path: path.to_string(),
                runtime_path,
                uid,
                seat_id,
                vtnr,
                existing,
            })?)
        }
        "release_session" | "terminate_session" | "lock_session" | "unlock_session" => {
            let i: SessionIdInput = input(args)?;
            let upstream = match method {
                "release_session" => "ReleaseSession",
                "terminate_session" => "TerminateSession",
                "lock_session" => "LockSession",
                _ => "UnlockSession",
            };
            proxy
                .call::<_, _, ()>(upstream, &(i.session_id.clone(),))
                .await?;
            if matches!(method, "release_session" | "terminate_session") {
                held.remove(&i.session_id);
            }
            accepted(method)
        }
        "kill_session" => {
            let i: KillSessionInput = input(args)?;
            ensure!(
                matches!(i.who.as_str(), "all" | "leader"),
                "who must be all or leader"
            );
            proxy
                .call::<_, _, ()>("KillSession", &(i.session_id, i.who, i.signal_number))
                .await?;
            accepted(method)
        }
        "terminate_user" => {
            let uid = input::<UidInput>(args)?.uid;
            proxy.call::<_, _, ()>("TerminateUser", &(uid,)).await?;
            held.retain(|_, lease| lease.uid != uid);
            accepted(method)
        }
        "kill_user" => {
            let i: KillUserInput = input(args)?;
            proxy
                .call::<_, _, ()>("KillUser", &(i.uid, i.signal_number))
                .await?;
            accepted(method)
        }
        "set_user_linger" => {
            let i: SetUserLingerInput = input(args)?;
            proxy
                .call::<_, _, ()>("SetUserLinger", &(i.uid, i.enable, i.interactive))
                .await?;
            accepted(method)
        }
        "terminate_seat" => {
            let seat = input::<SeatIdInput>(args)?.seat_id;
            proxy.call::<_, _, ()>("TerminateSeat", &(&seat,)).await?;
            held.retain(|_, lease| lease.seat != seat);
            accepted(method)
        }
        "attach_device" => {
            let i: AttachDeviceInput = input(args)?;
            proxy
                .call::<_, _, ()>("AttachDevice", &(i.seat_id, i.sysfs_path, i.interactive))
                .await?;
            accepted(method)
        }
        "power_off" | "reboot" | "suspend" | "hibernate" | "flush_devices" => {
            let i: InteractiveInput = input(args)?;
            let upstream = match method {
                "power_off" => "PowerOff",
                "reboot" => "Reboot",
                "suspend" => "Suspend",
                "hibernate" => "Hibernate",
                _ => "FlushDevices",
            };
            proxy.call::<_, _, ()>(upstream, &(i.interactive,)).await?;
            accepted(method)
        }
        "sleep" => {
            proxy
                .call::<_, _, ()>("Sleep", &(input::<SleepInput>(args)?.flags,))
                .await?;
            accepted(method)
        }
        _ => bail!("unknown login1 method '{method}'"),
    }
}

fn accepted(method: &str) -> Result<Json> {
    Ok(to_value(LoginOperationOutput {
        operation: method.to_string(),
        disposition: LoginOperationDisposition::Accepted,
    })?)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use serde_json::json;
    use std::os::fd::AsFd;
    use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex as StdMutex};
    use zbus::{connection::Builder, Guid};

    type Calls = Arc<StdMutex<Vec<(String, Json)>>>;
    struct Manager {
        calls: Calls,
        fifo: OwnedFd,
    }
    impl Manager {
        fn record(&self, method: &str, args: Json) {
            self.calls.lock().unwrap().push((method.into(), args));
        }
    }
    #[zbus::interface(name = "org.freedesktop.login1.Manager")]
    impl Manager {
        fn list_sessions(&self) -> Vec<(String, u32, String, String, OwnedObjectPath)> {
            vec![(
                "s7".into(),
                1001,
                "fixture".into(),
                "seat0".into(),
                OwnedObjectPath::try_from("/session/s7").unwrap(),
            )]
        }
        fn list_users(&self) -> Vec<(u32, String, OwnedObjectPath)> {
            vec![(
                1001,
                "fixture".into(),
                OwnedObjectPath::try_from("/user/u1001").unwrap(),
            )]
        }
        fn list_seats(&self) -> Vec<(String, OwnedObjectPath)> {
            vec![(
                "seat0".into(),
                OwnedObjectPath::try_from("/seat/seat0").unwrap(),
            )]
        }
        fn get_session(&self, id: &str) -> OwnedObjectPath {
            self.record("GetSession", json!(id));
            OwnedObjectPath::try_from("/session/s7").unwrap()
        }
        fn get_user(&self, uid: u32) -> OwnedObjectPath {
            self.record("GetUser", json!(uid));
            OwnedObjectPath::try_from("/user/u1001").unwrap()
        }
        fn get_seat(&self, id: &str) -> zbus::fdo::Result<OwnedObjectPath> {
            if id == "absent" {
                return Err(zbus::fdo::Error::Failed("fixture missing seat".into()));
            }
            self.record("GetSeat", json!(id));
            Ok(OwnedObjectPath::try_from("/seat/seat0").unwrap())
        }
        #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
        fn create_session(
            &self,
            uid: u32,
            pid: u32,
            service: &str,
            type_: &str,
            class: &str,
            desktop: &str,
            seat_id: &str,
            vtnr: u32,
            tty: &str,
            display: &str,
            remote: bool,
            remote_user: &str,
            remote_host: &str,
            properties: Vec<(String, OwnedValue)>,
        ) -> (
            String,
            OwnedObjectPath,
            String,
            OwnedFd,
            u32,
            String,
            u32,
            bool,
        ) {
            self.record(
                "CreateSession",
                json!([
                    uid,
                    pid,
                    service,
                    type_,
                    class,
                    desktop,
                    seat_id,
                    vtnr,
                    tty,
                    display,
                    remote,
                    remote_user,
                    remote_host,
                    properties.len()
                ]),
            );
            assert_eq!(properties[0].0, "MemoryMax");
            assert_eq!(
                u64::try_from(properties[0].1.try_clone().unwrap()).unwrap(),
                8192
            );
            (
                "s7".into(),
                OwnedObjectPath::try_from("/session/s7").unwrap(),
                "/runtime/1001".into(),
                self.fifo.as_fd().try_clone_to_owned().unwrap().into(),
                uid,
                seat_id.into(),
                vtnr,
                false,
            )
        }
        fn release_session(&self, id: &str) {
            self.record("ReleaseSession", json!(id));
        }
        fn terminate_session(&self, id: &str) {
            self.record("TerminateSession", json!(id));
        }
        fn lock_session(&self, id: &str) {
            self.record("LockSession", json!(id));
        }
        fn unlock_session(&self, id: &str) {
            self.record("UnlockSession", json!(id));
        }
        fn kill_session(&self, id: &str, who: &str, signal: i32) {
            self.record("KillSession", json!([id, who, signal]));
        }
        fn terminate_user(&self, uid: u32) {
            self.record("TerminateUser", json!(uid));
        }
        fn kill_user(&self, uid: u32, signal: i32) {
            self.record("KillUser", json!([uid, signal]));
        }
        fn set_user_linger(&self, uid: u32, enable: bool, interactive: bool) {
            self.record("SetUserLinger", json!([uid, enable, interactive]));
        }
        fn terminate_seat(&self, id: &str) {
            self.record("TerminateSeat", json!(id));
        }
        fn attach_device(&self, id: &str, path: &str, interactive: bool) {
            self.record("AttachDevice", json!([id, path, interactive]));
        }
        fn flush_devices(&self, interactive: bool) {
            self.record("FlushDevices", json!(interactive));
        }
        fn power_off(&self, interactive: bool) {
            self.record("PowerOff", json!(interactive));
        }
        fn reboot(&self, interactive: bool) {
            self.record("Reboot", json!(interactive));
        }
        fn suspend(&self, interactive: bool) {
            self.record("Suspend", json!(interactive));
        }
        fn hibernate(&self, interactive: bool) {
            self.record("Hibernate", json!(interactive));
        }
        fn sleep(&self, flags: u64) {
            self.record("Sleep", json!(flags));
        }
    }

    async fn fixture() -> (
        Connection,
        Connection,
        Calls,
        std::os::unix::net::UnixStream,
    ) {
        let calls = Calls::default();
        let (fifo, peer) = std::os::unix::net::UnixStream::pair().unwrap();
        let fifo: std::os::fd::OwnedFd = fifo.into();
        let (a, b) = tokio::net::UnixStream::pair().unwrap();
        let server = Builder::unix_stream(a)
            .server(Guid::generate())
            .unwrap()
            .p2p()
            .serve_at(
                "/org/freedesktop/login1",
                Manager {
                    calls: calls.clone(),
                    fifo: fifo.into(),
                },
            )
            .unwrap()
            .build();
        let client = Builder::unix_stream(b).p2p().build();
        let (server, client) = tokio::try_join!(server, client).unwrap();
        (server, client, calls, peer)
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn all_declared_methods_cross_the_real_dbus_wire() {
        let (_server, client, calls, _fifo_peer) = fixture().await;
        let proxy = Proxy::new(
            &client,
            "org.freedesktop.login1",
            "/org/freedesktop/login1",
            "org.freedesktop.login1.Manager",
        )
        .await
        .unwrap();
        let leases = SessionLeases::default();
        let cases = [
            ("list_sessions", json!({})),
            ("list_users", json!({})),
            ("list_seats", json!({})),
            ("get_session", json!({"session_id":"s7"})),
            ("get_user", json!({"uid":1001})),
            ("get_seat", json!({"seat_id":"seat0"})),
            (
                "create_session",
                json!({"uid":1001,"pid":4321,"service":"fixture","type_":"tty","class":"user","desktop":"","seat_id":"seat0","vtnr":7,"tty":"tty7","display":"","remote":false,"remote_user":"","remote_host":"","properties":[{"name":"MemoryMax","value":{"type":"uint64","value":8192}}]}),
            ),
            ("release_session", json!({"session_id":"s7"})),
            ("terminate_session", json!({"session_id":"s7"})),
            ("lock_session", json!({"session_id":"s7"})),
            ("unlock_session", json!({"session_id":"s7"})),
            (
                "kill_session",
                json!({"session_id":"s7","who":"leader","signal_number":15}),
            ),
            ("terminate_user", json!({"uid":1001})),
            ("kill_user", json!({"uid":1001,"signal_number":15})),
            (
                "set_user_linger",
                json!({"uid":1001,"enable":true,"interactive":false}),
            ),
            ("terminate_seat", json!({"seat_id":"seat0"})),
            (
                "attach_device",
                json!({"seat_id":"seat0","sysfs_path":"/sys/devices/fixture","interactive":false}),
            ),
            ("flush_devices", json!({"interactive":false})),
            ("power_off", json!({"interactive":false})),
            ("reboot", json!({"interactive":false})),
            ("suspend", json!({"interactive":false})),
            ("hibernate", json!({"interactive":false})),
            ("sleep", json!({"flags":0})),
        ];
        let schema = login1_schema();
        assert_eq!(cases.len(), schema.methods.len());
        for (name, args) in cases {
            assert!(schema.methods.contains_key(name));
            let result = tokio::time::timeout(
                std::time::Duration::from_secs(5),
                dispatch_with_proxy(&proxy, &leases, name, &args),
            )
            .await
            .expect("fixture timed out")
            .unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("{name}: {e:#}"));
            match name {
                "list_sessions" => assert_eq!(result["sessions"][0]["uid"], 1001),
                "list_users" => assert_eq!(result["users"][0]["user"], "fixture"),
                "list_seats" => assert_eq!(result["seats"][0]["id"], "seat0"),
                "get_session" => assert_eq!(result["object_path"], "/session/s7"),
                "get_user" => assert_eq!(result["object_path"], "/user/u1001"),
                "get_seat" => assert_eq!(result["object_path"], "/seat/seat0"),
                "create_session" => {
                    assert_eq!(result["runtime_path"], "/runtime/1001");
                    assert!(leases.0.lock().await.contains_key("s7"));
                }
                _ => assert_eq!(result["disposition"], "accepted"),
            }
            if name == "release_session" {
                assert!(leases.0.lock().await.is_empty());
            }
        }
        {
            let recorded = calls.lock().unwrap();
            assert!(recorded.contains(&("KillSession".into(), json!(["s7", "leader", 15]))));
            assert!(recorded.contains(&(
                "AttachDevice".into(),
                json!(["seat0", "/sys/devices/fixture", false])
            )));
        }
        let error = dispatch_with_proxy(&proxy, &leases, "get_seat", &json!({"seat_id":"absent"}))
            .await
            .unwrap_err();
        assert!(error.to_string().contains("fixture missing seat"));
        assert!(dispatch_with_proxy(
            &proxy,
            &leases,
            "kill_session",
            &json!({"session_id":"s7","who":"anything","signal_number":9})
        )
        .await
        .is_err());
    }
}
</file>

<file path="op-plugins/src/state_plugins/mail_server/methods.rs">
//! Canonical `mail_server` method adapter.
//!
//! Generated gRPC enters MutationEngine and reaches this adapter only after the
//! sealed method, identity and capability checks. The adapter then uses the
//! private D-Bus peer owned by `op-mail-admin` inside `mail-3tched`; it never
//! reads Postfix/Dovecot files or starts their command-line tools itself.

use super::{
    AddMailboxInput, AliasInput, AliasMutationOutput, DomainInput, DomainMutationOutput,
    FlushQueueOutput, GetQueueOutput, MailAdministrationState, MailboxMutationOutput, QuotaInput,
    QuotaMutationOutput, RemoveAliasInput, RemoveMailboxInput,
};
use anyhow::{Context, Result};
use serde::{de::DeserializeOwned, Serialize};
use serde_json::Value;
use std::{path::Path, time::Duration};
use tokio::net::UnixStream;
use zbus::{Connection, Proxy};

pub const OBJECT_PATH: &str = "/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/mail_server";
pub const INTERFACE: &str = "org.opdbus.v1.plugins.mail_server.Native";
pub const DEFAULT_HOST_SOCKET: &str = "/run/ghostbridge/mail/admin.sock";
pub const DEFAULT_CONTAINER_SOCKET: &str = "/opt/run-mounts/ghostbridge/mail/admin.sock";
const CALL_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(20);

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct MailMethodReceipt {
    pub output: Value,
    /// Complete native administration readback after the operation.
    pub administration: MailAdministrationState,
}

pub async fn dispatch_mail_server_method(method: &str, args: &Value) -> Result<MailMethodReceipt> {
    let socket = std::env::var_os("OP_MAIL_ADMIN_SOCKET")
        .map(std::path::PathBuf::from)
        .unwrap_or_else(|| DEFAULT_HOST_SOCKET.into());
    tokio::time::timeout(CALL_TIMEOUT, async {
        let stream = UnixStream::connect(&socket).await.with_context(|| {
            format!(
                "connect to mail administration D-Bus peer {}",
                socket.display()
            )
        })?;
        let connection = zbus::connection::Builder::unix_stream(stream)
            .p2p()
            .build()
            .await
            .context("authenticate mail administration D-Bus peer")?;
        dispatch_mail_server_method_on(&connection, method, args).await
    })
    .await
    .context("mail administration request timed out; read back native state before retrying")?
}

pub(crate) async fn dispatch_mail_server_method_on(
    connection: &Connection,
    method: &str,
    args: &Value,
) -> Result<MailMethodReceipt> {
    let proxy = Proxy::new(connection, INTERFACE, OBJECT_PATH, INTERFACE)
        .await
        .context("create mail administration D-Bus proxy")?;
    let reply: zbus::Result<String> = match method {
        "add_domain" => {
            let input: DomainInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
            proxy.call("AddDomain", &(input.domain.as_str(),)).await
        }
        "remove_domain" => {
            let input: DomainInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
            proxy.call("RemoveDomain", &(input.domain.as_str(),)).await
        }
        "add_mailbox" => {
            let input: AddMailboxInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
            proxy
                .call(
                    "AddMailbox",
                    &(
                        input.domain.as_str(),
                        input.user.as_str(),
                        input.password_hash.as_str(),
                    ),
                )
                .await
        }
        "remove_mailbox" => {
            let input: RemoveMailboxInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
            proxy
                .call(
                    "RemoveMailbox",
                    &(input.domain.as_str(), input.user.as_str()),
                )
                .await
        }
        "add_alias" => {
            let input: AliasInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
            proxy
                .call(
                    "AddAlias",
                    &(
                        input.domain.as_str(),
                        input.alias.as_str(),
                        input.destination.as_str(),
                    ),
                )
                .await
        }
        "remove_alias" => {
            let input: RemoveAliasInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
            proxy
                .call(
                    "RemoveAlias",
                    &(input.domain.as_str(), input.alias.as_str()),
                )
                .await
        }
        "set_quota" => {
            let input: QuotaInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
            proxy
                .call(
                    "SetQuota",
                    &(input.domain.as_str(), input.user.as_str(), input.quota_mb),
                )
                .await
        }
        "get_queue" => {
            let _: super::super::plugin_scaffold_helpers::EmptyInput =
                serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
            proxy.call("GetQueue", &()).await
        }
        "flush_queue" => {
            let _: super::super::plugin_scaffold_helpers::EmptyInput =
                serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
            proxy.call("FlushQueue", &()).await
        }
        _ => return Err(anyhow::anyhow!("unknown mail_server method: {method}")),
    };
    let raw = reply.with_context(|| {
        if method == "get_queue" {
            "mail queue D-Bus reply unavailable; reconnect and read native state before retrying"
                .to_string()
        } else {
            format!(
                "mail_server.{method} D-Bus reply unavailable; the native effect may have completed; reconnect and read native state before retrying"
            )
        }
    })?;
    let output = match method {
        "add_domain" | "remove_domain" => typed_output::<DomainMutationOutput>(&raw, method)?,
        "add_mailbox" | "remove_mailbox" => typed_output::<MailboxMutationOutput>(&raw, method)?,
        "add_alias" | "remove_alias" => typed_output::<AliasMutationOutput>(&raw, method)?,
        "set_quota" => typed_output::<QuotaMutationOutput>(&raw, method)?,
        "get_queue" => typed_output::<GetQueueOutput>(&raw, method)?,
        "flush_queue" => typed_output::<FlushQueueOutput>(&raw, method)?,
        _ => unreachable!("method was rejected before native dispatch"),
    };
    let state_raw: String = proxy
        .call("GetState", &())
        .await
        .context("mail operation completed but native state readback failed")?;
    let administration = serde_json::from_str(&state_raw)
        .context("mail owner returned malformed administration state")?;
    Ok(MailMethodReceipt {
        output,
        administration,
    })
}

fn typed_output<T>(raw: &str, method: &str) -> Result<Value>
where
    T: DeserializeOwned + Serialize,
{
    let typed: T = serde_json::from_str(raw)
        .with_context(|| format!("mail owner returned malformed {method} receipt"))?;
    serde_json::to_value(typed).context("serialize typed mail owner receipt")
}

pub fn production_socket() -> &'static Path {
    Path::new(DEFAULT_HOST_SOCKET)
}
</file>

<file path="op-plugins/src/state_plugins/mail_server/native_owner_tests.rs">
use super::*;
use crate::state_plugins::mail_server::{mail_server_schema, methods};
use serde_json::{json, Value};
use std::{
    fs::File,
    path::Path,
    process::{Command, Output, Stdio},
    sync::{Arc, Mutex as StdMutex},
    time::{SystemTime, UNIX_EPOCH},
};
use tokio::net::UnixListener;

struct Fixture {
    _root: tempfile::TempDir,
    service: MailAdminService,
    qmgr_requests: Arc<StdMutex<Vec<Vec<u8>>>>,
    _showq_task: tokio::task::JoinHandle<()>,
    _qmgr_task: tokio::task::JoinHandle<()>,
}

impl Drop for Fixture {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        self._showq_task.abort();
        self._qmgr_task.abort();
    }
}

impl Fixture {
    async fn new() -> Self {
        let root = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let config = root.path().join("etc");
        let queue = root.path().join("queue");
        std::fs::create_dir_all(&config).unwrap();
        std::fs::create_dir_all(&queue).unwrap();
        let paths = NativePaths {
            domains: config.join("domains"),
            mailboxes: config.join("vmailbox"),
            aliases: config.join("virtual"),
            dovecot_users: config.join("users"),
            dovecot_users_gid: None,
            mail_root: root.path().join("mail"),
            mail_uid: None,
            mail_gid: None,
            showq_socket: queue.join("showq"),
            qmgr_socket: queue.join("qmgr"),
            postfix_master_pid: None,
        };
        std::fs::write(
            &paths.mailboxes,
            "owner@example.com example.com/owner/Maildir/\n",
        )
        .unwrap();
        std::fs::write(
            &paths.dovecot_users,
            "owner@example.com:{SHA512-CRYPT}$6$fixture::::::\n",
        )
        .unwrap();
        std::fs::write(&paths.aliases, "").unwrap();

        let showq = UnixListener::bind(&paths.showq_socket).unwrap();
        let showq_task = tokio::spawn(async move {
            let response = b"protocol\0mail_queue_list_protocol\0\0queue_name\0deferred\0queue_id\0Q1\0time\x001700000000\0size\x001234\0forced_expire\x000\0sender\0sender@example.net\0original_recipient\0\0recipient\0owner@example.com\0log_class\0defer\0reason\0temporary failure\0\0\0";
            while let Ok((mut stream, _)) = showq.accept().await {
                let _ = stream.write_all(response).await;
                let _ = stream.shutdown().await;
            }
        });
        let qmgr = UnixListener::bind(&paths.qmgr_socket).unwrap();
        let qmgr_requests = Arc::new(StdMutex::new(Vec::new()));
        let requests = qmgr_requests.clone();
        let qmgr_task = tokio::spawn(async move {
            while let Ok((mut stream, _)) = qmgr.accept().await {
                let mut request = Vec::new();
                let _ = stream.read_to_end(&mut request).await;
                requests.lock().unwrap().push(request);
            }
        });
        let service = MailAdminService::new(
            RuntimeDocuments::new(CozoGraphShuttle::new_in_memory().unwrap()),
            paths,
        );
        service.adopt_or_reconcile().await.unwrap();
        Self {
            _root: root,
            service,
            qmgr_requests,
            _showq_task: showq_task,
            _qmgr_task: qmgr_task,
        }
    }
}

fn validate_contract(method: &str, input: &Value, output: &Value) {
    let schema = mail_server_schema();
    let declaration = &schema.methods[method];
    let input_schema = serde_json::to_value(&declaration.args).unwrap();
    jsonschema::validator_for(&input_schema)
        .unwrap()
        .validate(input)
        .unwrap();
    let output_schema = serde_json::to_value(declaration.returns.as_ref().unwrap()).unwrap();
    jsonschema::validator_for(&output_schema)
        .unwrap()
        .validate(output)
        .unwrap();
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn all_nine_methods_cross_dbus_and_match_the_sealed_typed_contract() {
    let fixture = Fixture::new().await;
    let (server_stream, client_stream) = UnixStream::pair().unwrap();
    let server = zbus::connection::Builder::unix_stream(server_stream)
        .server(zbus::Guid::generate())
        .unwrap()
        .p2p()
        .serve_at(methods::OBJECT_PATH, fixture.service.clone())
        .unwrap()
        .build();
    let client = zbus::connection::Builder::unix_stream(client_stream)
        .p2p()
        .build();
    let (_server, client) = tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(5), async {
        tokio::try_join!(server, client)
    })
    .await
    .unwrap()
    .unwrap();

    let calls = [
        ("add_domain", json!({"domain":"example.net"})),
        (
            "add_mailbox",
            json!({"domain":"example.net","user":"alice","password_hash":"{SHA512-CRYPT}$6$fixture"}),
        ),
        (
            "set_quota",
            json!({"domain":"example.net","user":"alice","quota_mb":256}),
        ),
        (
            "add_alias",
            json!({"domain":"example.net","alias":"info","destination":"alice@example.net"}),
        ),
        ("get_queue", json!({})),
        ("flush_queue", json!({})),
        (
            "remove_alias",
            json!({"domain":"example.net","alias":"info"}),
        ),
        (
            "remove_mailbox",
            json!({"domain":"example.net","user":"alice"}),
        ),
        ("remove_domain", json!({"domain":"example.net"})),
    ];
    for (method, input) in calls {
        let receipt = methods::dispatch_mail_server_method_on(&client, method, &input)
            .await
            .unwrap_or_else(|error| panic!("{method}: {error:#}"));
        validate_contract(method, &input, &receipt.output);
        assert!(receipt
            .administration
            .domains
            .contains(&"example.com".to_string()));
    }
    tokio::task::yield_now().await;
    assert_eq!(
        fixture.qmgr_requests.lock().unwrap().as_slice(),
        [b"FADI\0"]
    );
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn committed_state_renders_exact_postfix_and_dovecot_inputs_and_preserves_maildir() {
    let fixture = Fixture::new().await;
    fixture
        .service
        .add_domain_inner("Example.NET")
        .await
        .unwrap();
    fixture
        .service
        .add_mailbox_inner("example.net", "Alice", "{SHA512-CRYPT}$6$new")
        .await
        .unwrap();
    fixture
        .service
        .set_quota_inner("example.net", "alice", 128)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    fixture
        .service
        .add_alias_inner("example.net", "info", "alice@example.net")
        .await
        .unwrap();

    let paths = &fixture.service.paths;
    assert_eq!(
        std::fs::read_to_string(&paths.domains).unwrap(),
        "example.com\tOK\nexample.net\tOK\n"
    );
    assert!(std::fs::read_to_string(&paths.mailboxes)
        .unwrap()
        .contains("alice@example.net\texample.net/alice/Maildir/"));
    assert_eq!(
        std::fs::read_to_string(&paths.aliases).unwrap(),
        "info@example.net\talice@example.net\n"
    );
    let users = std::fs::read_to_string(&paths.dovecot_users).unwrap();
    assert!(users.contains(
        "alice@example.net:{SHA512-CRYPT}$6$new::::::userdb_quota_rule=*:bytes=134217728"
    ));
    let maildir = paths.mail_root.join("example.net/alice/Maildir");
    assert!(maildir.is_dir());

    fixture
        .service
        .remove_alias_inner("example.net", "info")
        .await
        .unwrap();
    let removed = fixture
        .service
        .remove_mailbox_inner("example.net", "alice")
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert!(removed.maildir_preserved);
    assert!(maildir.is_dir());
    assert!(!std::fs::read_to_string(&paths.dovecot_users)
        .unwrap()
        .contains("alice@example.net"));
}

#[test]
fn showq_protocol_is_parsed_without_invoking_postqueue() {
    let wire = b"protocol\0mail_queue_list_protocol\0\0queue_name\0active\0queue_id\0ABC123\0time\x001700000000\0size\x0042\0forced_expire\x001\0sender\0sender@example.net\0original_recipient\0original@example.net\0recipient\0target@example.com\0log_class\0\0reason\0\0\0\0";
    let output = parse_showq(wire).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(output.summary.messages, 1);
    assert_eq!(output.summary.bytes, 42);
    assert_eq!(output.entries[0].queue_id, "ABC123");
    assert!(output.entries[0].forced_expire);
    assert_eq!(
        output.entries[0].recipients[0].address,
        "target@example.com"
    );
}

#[test]
fn validation_rejects_unsafe_config_tokens_and_plaintext_passwords() {
    assert!(validate_domain("example.com\nrelay_domains=*").is_err());
    assert!(validate_localpart("../owner").is_err());
    assert!(validate_password_hash("{PLAIN}secret").is_err());
    assert!(validate_address("one@example.com,two@example.com").is_err());
}

#[test]
fn explicit_mail_owner_must_match_prepared_root_before_config_effects() {
    use std::os::unix::fs::MetadataExt as _;

    let root = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let mail_root = root.path().join("mail");
    std::fs::create_dir(&mail_root).unwrap();
    let actual = std::fs::metadata(&mail_root).unwrap();
    let wrong_uid = if actual.uid() == 1 { 2 } else { 1 };
    let wrong_gid = if actual.gid() == 1 { 2 } else { 1 };
    let paths = NativePaths {
        domains: root.path().join("domains"),
        mailboxes: root.path().join("vmailbox"),
        aliases: root.path().join("virtual"),
        dovecot_users: root.path().join("users"),
        dovecot_users_gid: None,
        mail_root,
        mail_uid: Some(wrong_uid),
        mail_gid: Some(wrong_gid),
        showq_socket: root.path().join("showq"),
        qmgr_socket: root.path().join("qmgr"),
        postfix_master_pid: None,
    };

    let error = materialize(&paths, &MailDocument::default()).unwrap_err();
    assert!(error
        .to_string()
        .contains("prepared virtual mail root owner"));
    assert!(!paths.domains.exists());
    assert!(!paths.mailboxes.exists());
    assert!(!paths.dovecot_users.exists());
}

const NATIVE_MAIL_FIXTURE_ENV: &str = "OP_MAIL_NATIVE_CONTAINER_TEST";
const NATIVE_MAIL_CONTAINER: &str = "mail-3tched";

struct IsolatedContainerMailFixture {
    root: String,
    dovecot_config: String,
    dovecot_started: bool,
}

impl Drop for IsolatedContainerMailFixture {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        if self.dovecot_started {
            let _ = Command::new("incus")
                .args([
                    "exec",
                    NATIVE_MAIL_CONTAINER,
                    "--",
                    "dovecot",
                    "-c",
                    &self.dovecot_config,
                    "stop",
                ])
                .output();
        }
        if self.root.starts_with("/tmp/opdbus-mail-native-") {
            let _ = Command::new("incus")
                .args([
                    "exec",
                    NATIVE_MAIL_CONTAINER,
                    "--",
                    "find",
                    &self.root,
                    "-depth",
                    "-delete",
                ])
                .output();
        }
    }
}

fn native_command(program: &str, args: &[&str]) -> Output {
    let output = Command::new(program)
        .args(args)
        .output()
        .unwrap_or_else(|error| panic!("start {program}: {error}"));
    assert!(
        output.status.success(),
        "{program} {args:?} failed: stdout={} stderr={}",
