<file path="op-plugins/src/state_plugins/service/methods.rs">
//! Runit lifecycle through the existing root-guarded native D-Bus provider.
use super::{InitInput, RunInput, ServiceName, ShutdownInput};
use anyhow::{ensure, Context, Result};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use serde_json::Value;
use std::time::Duration;
use zbus::{Connection, Proxy};

const DESTINATION: &str = "org.opdbus.v1.Runit.Systemctl";
const PATH: &str = "/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/runit/systemctl";

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct ServiceInitOutput {
    pub name: String,
    pub definition_type: String,
    pub enabled: bool,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct ServiceStatus {
    pub name: String,
    pub active_state: String,
    pub sub_state: String,
    pub main_pid: Option<u32>,
    pub up_time: Option<String>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct ServiceOperationOutput {
    pub name: String,
    pub operation: String,
    /// The native supervisor accepted the operation; status is its observed
    /// process state, not an application readiness/health assertion.
    pub disposition: String,
    pub status: ServiceStatus,
}

pub async fn dispatch_service_method(method: &str, args: &Value) -> Result<Value> {
    tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(30), async {
        let connection = Connection::system().await?;
        dispatch_on(&connection, method, args).await
    })
    .await
    .context(
        "runit lifecycle request timed out; supervisor state must be checked before retrying",
    )?
}

async fn dispatch_on(connection: &Connection, method: &str, args: &Value) -> Result<Value> {
    // Validate before making even a read-only provider call.
    let (name, operation, expected_type) = match method {
        "init" => {
            let input: InitInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
            (input.name, "Enable", Some(input.service_type))
        }
        "run" => {
            let input: RunInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
            ensure!(
                input.args.is_empty(),
                "runit arguments belong in the installed service definition"
            );
            (input.name, "Start", None)
        }
        "shutdown" => {
            let input: ShutdownInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
            (
                input.name,
                if input.force { "ForceStop" } else { "Stop" },
                None,
            )
        }
        _ => anyhow::bail!("unknown service method: {method}"),
    };
    ServiceName::new(&name)?;
    let proxy = Proxy::new(connection, DESTINATION, PATH, DESTINATION).await?;
    let definition_type = if let Some(expected) = expected_type {
        let native: String = proxy.call("GetUnitType", &(name.as_str(),)).await?;
        ensure!(!native.is_empty(), "provider returned no definition type");
        ensure!(
            expected.is_empty() || native == expected,
            "installed service type does not match requested type"
        );
        Some(native)
    } else {
        None
    };
    let (accepted, diagnostic): (bool, String) = proxy.call(operation, &(name.as_str(),)).await?;
    ensure!(
        accepted,
        "runit {operation} rejected for {name}: {diagnostic}"
    );
    if let Some(definition_type) = definition_type {
        let enabled: String = proxy.call("IsEnabled", &(name.as_str(),)).await?;
        ensure!(
            enabled == "enabled",
            "service enablement accepted but readback is {enabled}"
        );
        return Ok(serde_json::to_value(ServiceInitOutput {
            name,
            definition_type,
            enabled: true,
        })?);
    }
    let raw: String = proxy.call("Status", &(name.as_str(),)).await?;
    let status: ServiceStatus = serde_json::from_str(&raw)
        .context("lifecycle operation accepted but provider status is unavailable")?;
    ensure!(
        status.name == name,
        "provider status refers to another service"
    );
    Ok(serde_json::to_value(ServiceOperationOutput {
        name,
        operation: operation.to_owned(),
        disposition: "accepted".to_owned(),
        status,
    })?)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use serde_json::json;
    use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};

    struct Fixture {
        calls: Arc<Mutex<Vec<String>>>,
        reject: bool,
    }
    #[zbus::interface(name = "org.opdbus.v1.Runit.Systemctl")]
    impl Fixture {
        fn get_unit_type(&self, _name: &str) -> &str {
            "longrun"
        }
        fn is_enabled(&self, _name: &str) -> &str {
            "enabled"
        }
        fn enable(&self, name: &str) -> (bool, String) {
            self.reply("Enable", name)
        }
        fn start(&self, name: &str) -> (bool, String) {
            self.reply("Start", name)
        }
        fn stop(&self, name: &str) -> (bool, String) {
            self.reply("Stop", name)
        }
        fn force_stop(&self, name: &str) -> (bool, String) {
            self.reply("ForceStop", name)
        }
        fn status(&self, name: &str) -> String {
            json!({"name":name,"active_state":"active","sub_state":"running","main_pid":123,"up_time":"2s"}).to_string()
        }
    }
    impl Fixture {
        fn reply(&self, operation: &str, name: &str) -> (bool, String) {
            self.calls
                .lock()
                .unwrap()
                .push(format!("{operation}:{name}"));
            (!self.reject, "fixture diagnostic".into())
        }
    }
    async fn pair(reject: bool) -> (Connection, Connection, Arc<Mutex<Vec<String>>>) {
        let (server, client) = tokio::net::UnixStream::pair().unwrap();
        let guid = zbus::Guid::generate();
        let calls = Arc::new(Mutex::new(Vec::new()));
        let server = zbus::connection::Builder::unix_stream(server)
            .server(guid)
            .unwrap()
            .p2p()
            .serve_at(
                PATH,
                Fixture {
                    calls: calls.clone(),
                    reject,
                },
            )
            .unwrap()
            .build();
        let client = zbus::connection::Builder::unix_stream(client).p2p().build();
        let (server, client) = tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(5), async {
            tokio::try_join!(server, client)
        })
        .await
        .unwrap()
        .unwrap();
        (server, client, calls)
    }
    #[tokio::test]
    async fn lifecycle_wire_calls_and_observed_receipts() {
        let (_server, client, calls) = pair(false).await;
        let init = dispatch_on(
            &client,
            "init",
            &json!({"name":"fixture","service_type":"longrun"}),
        )
        .await
        .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(init["definition_type"], "longrun");
        for (method, args, operation) in [
            ("run", json!({"name":"fixture","args":[]}), "Start"),
            ("shutdown", json!({"name":"fixture","force":false}), "Stop"),
            (
                "shutdown",
                json!({"name":"fixture","force":true}),
                "ForceStop",
            ),
        ] {
            let result = dispatch_on(&client, method, &args).await.unwrap();
            assert_eq!(result["operation"], operation);
            assert_eq!(result["status"]["main_pid"], 123);
            assert_eq!(result["disposition"], "accepted");
        }
        assert_eq!(
            *calls.lock().unwrap(),
            [
                "Enable:fixture",
                "Start:fixture",
                "Stop:fixture",
                "ForceStop:fixture"
            ]
        );
    }
    #[tokio::test]
    async fn invalid_requests_never_reach_lifecycle_and_rejections_propagate() {
        let (_server, client, calls) = pair(false).await;
        for (method, args) in [
            ("run", json!({"name":"../bad"})),
            ("run", json!({"name":"fixture","args":["override"]})),
            ("init", json!({"name":"fixture","service_type":"mismatch"})),
        ] {
            assert!(dispatch_on(&client, method, &args).await.is_err());
        }
        assert!(calls.lock().unwrap().is_empty());
        let (_server, client, _) = pair(true).await;
        assert!(dispatch_on(&client, "run", &json!({"name":"fixture"}))
            .await
            .unwrap_err()
            .to_string()
            .contains("rejected"));
    }
}
</file>

<file path="op-plugins/src/state_plugins/adc.rs">
use anyhow::Result;
use async_trait::async_trait;
use op_state::{ApplyResult, Checkpoint, DiffMetadata, PluginCapabilities, StateDiff, StatePlugin};
use op_state_store::PluginSchema;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use simd_json::prelude::*;
use simd_json::OwnedValue as Value;

const ADC_PROBE_TIMEOUT: std::time::Duration = std::time::Duration::from_secs(15);

/// ADC plugin state schema.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
#[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "sch.software.plugin.adc.schema@v2"))]
#[schemars(extend("x-oscal-category" = "software"))]
pub struct AdcState {
    /// Whether ADC is configured.
    #[schemars(
        description = "Whether ADC is configured",
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "exp.software.plugin.adc.configured.render@v1")
    )]
    pub configured: bool,
    /// Whether Google has validated the configured credential.
    pub authenticated: bool,
    /// Current provider validation state.
    pub validation: super::gcloud_adc::AdcValidationState,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct GetStatusInput {}

pub struct AdcPlugin;

impl Default for AdcPlugin {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self
    }
}

impl AdcPlugin {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self
    }
}

#[async_trait]
impl StatePlugin for AdcPlugin {
    fn name(&self) -> &str {
        "adc"
    }

    fn version(&self) -> &str {
        "2.0.0"
    }

    fn schema(&self) -> Option<op_state_store::PluginSchema> {
        Some(adc_schema())
    }

    async fn calculate_diff(&self, _current: &Value, _desired: &Value) -> Result<StateDiff> {
        Ok(StateDiff {
            plugin: self.name().to_string(),
            actions: vec![],
            metadata: DiffMetadata {
                timestamp: chrono::Utc::now().timestamp(),
                current_hash: "unknown".to_string(),
                desired_hash: "unknown".to_string(),
            },
        })
    }

    async fn apply_state(&self, _diff: &StateDiff) -> Result<ApplyResult> {
        Ok(ApplyResult {
            success: true,
            changes_applied: vec![],
            errors: vec![],
            checkpoint: None,
        })
    }

    async fn verify_state(&self, _desired: &Value) -> Result<bool> {
        Ok(true)
    }

    async fn create_checkpoint(&self) -> Result<Checkpoint> {
        Ok(Checkpoint {
            id: uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string(),
            plugin: self.name().to_string(),
            timestamp: chrono::Utc::now().timestamp(),
            state_snapshot: Value::null(),
            backend_checkpoint: None,
        })
    }

    async fn rollback(&self, _checkpoint: &Checkpoint) -> Result<()> {
        Ok(())
    }

    fn capabilities(&self) -> PluginCapabilities {
        PluginCapabilities {
            supports_rollback: false,
            supports_checkpoints: true,
            supports_verification: true,
            atomic_operations: false,
        }
    }
}

/// Canonical `adc` schema, derived from the structs via schemars.
pub fn adc_schema() -> PluginSchema {
    let root = serde_json::to_value(schemars::schema_for!(AdcState))
        .expect("schemars schema serializes to JSON");
    let mut schema = super::schemars_adapter::plugin_schema_from_json(
        "adc",
        "2.0.0",
        "Application default credentials provider validation state",
        &root,
    );

    use super::plugin_scaffold_helpers::method_decl_from_schemars_with_output;
    use op_state_store::SideEffect;

    schema.methods.insert(
        "get_status".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<GetStatusInput, super::gcloud_adc::AdcAuthStatus>(
            "get_status",
            SideEffect::Read,
            true,
            "adc.read",
            "obs.software.plugin.adc.status.get@v2",
        ),
    );

    schema.capabilities.insert(
        "adc.read".to_string(),
        op_state_store::CapabilityDecl {
            id: "adc.read".to_string(),
            description: "Grants: get_status.".to_string(),
        },
    );

    schema
}

pub(crate) async fn dispatch_adc_with_provider(
    provider: &dyn super::gcloud_adc::AdcStatusProvider,
    method: &str,
    args: &serde_json::Value,
) -> Result<serde_json::Value> {
    dispatch_adc_with_provider_timeout(provider, method, args, ADC_PROBE_TIMEOUT).await
}

async fn dispatch_adc_with_provider_timeout(
    provider: &dyn super::gcloud_adc::AdcStatusProvider,
    method: &str,
    args: &serde_json::Value,
    timeout: std::time::Duration,
) -> Result<serde_json::Value> {
    match method {
        "get_status" => {
            serde_json::from_value::<GetStatusInput>(args.clone())?;
            let status = match tokio::time::timeout(timeout, provider.check_auth_status()).await {
                Ok(result) => result?,
                Err(_) => super::gcloud_adc::provider_timeout_status(),
            };
            Ok(serde_json::to_value(status)?)
        }
        other => Err(anyhow::anyhow!("unknown adc method: {other}")),
    }
}

/// Compatibility ADC surface backed by the same official Google provider as
/// `gcloud_adc`; credential material remains inside that adapter.
pub async fn dispatch_adc_method(
    method: &str,
    args: &serde_json::Value,
) -> Result<serde_json::Value> {
    dispatch_adc_with_provider(&super::gcloud_adc::GoogleCloudAuthProvider, method, args).await
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::state_plugins::common::oscal::validate_subid;

    struct FakeProvider(std::result::Result<super::super::gcloud_adc::AdcAuthStatus, &'static str>);

    #[async_trait]
    impl super::super::gcloud_adc::AdcStatusProvider for FakeProvider {
        async fn check_auth_status(&self) -> Result<super::super::gcloud_adc::AdcAuthStatus> {
            self.0.clone().map_err(anyhow::Error::msg)
        }
    }

    fn validated() -> super::super::gcloud_adc::AdcAuthStatus {
        super::super::gcloud_adc::AdcAuthStatus {
            provider: "google_application_default_credentials".to_string(),
            configured: true,
            authenticated: true,
            validation: super::super::gcloud_adc::AdcValidationState::Validated,
            failure: None,
        }
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn compatibility_surface_returns_the_provider_validated_contract() {
        let value = dispatch_adc_with_provider(
            &FakeProvider(Ok(validated())),
            "get_status",
            &serde_json::json!({}),
        )
        .await
        .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(value["configured"], true);
        assert_eq!(value["authenticated"], true);
        assert_eq!(value["validation"], "validated");
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn compatibility_surface_rejects_input_and_propagates_provider_errors() {
        let provider = FakeProvider(Err("provider adapter failed"));
        let error = dispatch_adc_with_provider(
            &provider,
            "get_status",
            &serde_json::json!({"unexpected": true}),
        )
        .await
        .unwrap_err();
        assert!(error.to_string().contains("unknown field"));

        let error = dispatch_adc_with_provider(&provider, "get_status", &serde_json::json!({}))
            .await
            .unwrap_err();
        assert_eq!(error.to_string(), "provider adapter failed");
    }

    struct PendingProvider;

    #[async_trait]
    impl super::super::gcloud_adc::AdcStatusProvider for PendingProvider {
        async fn check_auth_status(&self) -> Result<super::super::gcloud_adc::AdcAuthStatus> {
            std::future::pending().await
        }
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn compatibility_surface_has_a_bounded_provider_deadline() {
        let value = dispatch_adc_with_provider_timeout(
            &PendingProvider,
            "get_status",
            &serde_json::json!({}),
            std::time::Duration::from_millis(1),
        )
        .await
        .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(value["validation"], "provider_unavailable");
        assert_eq!(value["authenticated"], false);
    }

    #[test]
    fn method_schema_has_typed_input_and_output() {
        let method = &adc_schema().methods["get_status"];
        assert_eq!(method.args["type"], "object");
        assert_eq!(method.returns.as_ref().unwrap()["type"], "object");
    }

    #[test]
    fn all_subids_are_valid() {
        let raw = serde_json::to_value(schemars::schema_for!(AdcState)).unwrap();
        let mut stack = vec![&raw];
        while let Some(node) = stack.pop() {
            if let Some(subid) = node.get("x-oscal-subid").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {
                validate_subid(subid).expect("invalid subid");
            }
            if let Some(props) = node.get("properties").and_then(|v| v.as_object()) {
                for (_, v) in props {
                    stack.push(v);
                }
            }
            if let Some(defs) = node
                .get("$defs")
                .or_else(|| node.get("definitions"))
                .and_then(|v| v.as_object())
            {
                for (_, v) in defs {
                    stack.push(v);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

// Self-registration: the plugin registry discovers this via inventory
// (single source of the catalog; no central dispatch list).
inventory::submit! {
    crate::default_registry::PluginReg::new("adc", |_ctx| std::sync::Arc::new(AdcPlugin::new()))
}
</file>

<file path="op-plugins/src/state_plugins/agent_config.rs">
use anyhow::{Context, Result};
use async_trait::async_trait;
use op_state::{ApplyResult, Checkpoint, DiffMetadata, PluginCapabilities, StateDiff, StatePlugin};
use op_state_store::PluginSchema;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use simd_json::OwnedValue as Value;
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::sync::Arc;

/// Agent configuration plugin state schema.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "sch.software.plugin.agent-config.schema@v1"))]
#[schemars(extend("x-oscal-category" = "agents"))]
pub struct AgentConfigState {
    /// List of agent configurations.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(
        description = "List of agent configurations",
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "exp.software.plugin.agent-config.agents.render@v1")
    )]
    pub agents: Vec<AgentConfig>,
}

/// Individual agent configuration.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct AgentConfig {
    /// Agent name.
    #[schemars(
        description = "Agent name",
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "exp.software.agent-config.agent.name.render@v1")
    )]
    pub name: String,
    /// Whether the agent is enabled.
    #[schemars(
        description = "Whether the agent is enabled",
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "exp.software.agent-config.agent.enabled.render@v1")
    )]
    pub enabled: bool,
    /// Default model override.
    #[schemars(
        description = "Default model override",
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "exp.software.agent-config.agent.model.render@v1")
    )]
    pub model: Option<String>,
    /// Enabled tool names.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(
        description = "Enabled tool names",
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "exp.software.agent-config.agent.tools.render@v1")
    )]
    pub tools: Vec<String>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct AgentNameInput {
    pub name: String,
}
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct UpdateConfigInput {
    pub config: AgentConfig,
}
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct RegisterToolInput {
    pub name: String,
    pub tool: String,
}
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct AgentConfigOutput {
    pub config: Option<AgentConfig>,
}
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct AgentToolsOutput {
    pub tools: Vec<String>,
}
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct AgentMutationOutput {
    pub config: AgentConfig,
    pub revision: u64,
}

pub struct AgentConfigPlugin;

impl Default for AgentConfigPlugin {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self
    }
}

impl AgentConfigPlugin {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self
    }
}

#[async_trait]
impl StatePlugin for AgentConfigPlugin {
    fn name(&self) -> &str {
        "agent_config"
    }

    fn version(&self) -> &str {
        "2.0.0"
    }

    fn schema(&self) -> Option<op_state_store::PluginSchema> {
        Some(agent_config_schema())
    }

    async fn calculate_diff(&self, _current: &Value, _desired: &Value) -> Result<StateDiff> {
        Ok(StateDiff {
            plugin: self.name().to_string(),
            actions: vec![],
            metadata: DiffMetadata {
                timestamp: chrono::Utc::now().timestamp(),
                current_hash: "unknown".to_string(),
                desired_hash: "unknown".to_string(),
            },
        })
    }

    async fn apply_state(&self, _diff: &StateDiff) -> Result<ApplyResult> {
        Ok(ApplyResult {
            success: true,
            changes_applied: vec![],
            errors: vec![],
            checkpoint: None,
        })
    }

    async fn verify_state(&self, _desired: &Value) -> Result<bool> {
        Ok(true)
    }

    async fn create_checkpoint(&self) -> Result<Checkpoint> {
        Ok(Checkpoint {
            id: uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string(),
            plugin: self.name().to_string(),
            timestamp: chrono::Utc::now().timestamp(),
            state_snapshot: simd_json::json!(null),
            backend_checkpoint: None,
        })
    }

    async fn rollback(&self, _checkpoint: &Checkpoint) -> Result<()> {
        Ok(())
    }

    fn capabilities(&self) -> PluginCapabilities {
        PluginCapabilities {
            supports_rollback: true,
            supports_checkpoints: true,
            supports_verification: true,
            atomic_operations: false,
        }
    }
}

/// Canonical `agent_config` schema, derived from the structs via schemars.
pub fn agent_config_schema() -> PluginSchema {
    let root = serde_json::to_value(schemars::schema_for!(AgentConfigState))
        .expect("schemars schema serializes to JSON");
    let mut schema = super::schemars_adapter::plugin_schema_from_json(
        "agent_config",
        "2.0.0",
        "Agent configuration and tool assignments",
        &root,
    );

    // Add methods
    use super::plugin_scaffold_helpers::method_decl_from_schemars_with_output;
    use op_state_store::SideEffect;

    schema.methods.insert(
        "get_config".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<AgentNameInput, AgentConfigOutput>(
            "get_config",
            SideEffect::Read,
            true,
            "agent.read",
            "obs.service.agent.config.get@v1",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "update_config".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<UpdateConfigInput, AgentMutationOutput>(
            "update_config",
            SideEffect::Mutation,
            false,
            "agent.invoke",
            "mut.service.agent.config.update@v1",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "list_tools".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<AgentNameInput, AgentToolsOutput>(
            "list_tools",
            SideEffect::Read,
            true,
            "agent.read",
            "obs.service.agent.tool.list@v1",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "register_tool".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<RegisterToolInput, AgentMutationOutput>(
            "register_tool",
            SideEffect::Mutation,
            false,
            "agent.invoke",
            "mut.service.agent.tool.register@v1",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "reset_config".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<AgentNameInput, AgentMutationOutput>(
            "reset_config",
            SideEffect::Mutation,
            true,
            "agent.invoke",
            "mut.service.agent.config.reset@v1",
        ),
    );

    schema.capabilities.insert(
        "agent.read".to_string(),
        op_state_store::CapabilityDecl {
            id: "agent.read".to_string(),
            description: "Grants: get_config, list_tools.".to_string(),
        },
    );
    schema.capabilities.insert(
        "agent.invoke".to_string(),
        op_state_store::CapabilityDecl {
            id: "agent.invoke".to_string(),
            description: "Grants: update_config, register_tool, reset_config.".to_string(),
        },
    );

    schema
}

fn valid_name(value: &str) -> Result<String> {
    let value = value.trim();
    if value.is_empty() || value.chars().any(|c| c.is_control()) {
        anyhow::bail!("agent name/tool must be non-empty and contain no control characters")
    }
    Ok(value.to_string())
}

fn decode_agents(document: Option<serde_json::Value>) -> Result<Vec<AgentConfig>> {
    let document = document.unwrap_or_else(|| serde_json::json!({"agents": []}));
    serde_json::from_value(
        document
            .get("agents")
            .cloned()
            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("agent_config document is missing agents"))?,
    )
    .map_err(Into::into)
}

pub async fn dispatch_agent_config_method(
    method: &str,
    args: &serde_json::Value,
) -> Result<serde_json::Value> {
    dispatch_agent_config_with_store(
        super::runtime_documents::runtime_documents().await?,
        method,
        args,
    )
    .await
}

pub async fn dispatch_agent_config_with_store(
    store: Arc<super::runtime_documents::RuntimeDocuments>,
    method: &str,
    args: &serde_json::Value,
) -> Result<serde_json::Value> {
    let current = store
        .read("agent_config")
        .await?
        .map(|d| d.document)
        .unwrap_or_else(|| serde_json::json!({"agents": []}));
    let agents = decode_agents(Some(current))?;
    match method {
        "get_config" => {
            let i: AgentNameInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
            let name = valid_name(&i.name)?;
            Ok(serde_json::json!({"config": agents.iter().find(|a| a.name==name)}))
        }
        "list_tools" => {
            let i: AgentNameInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
            let name = valid_name(&i.name)?;
            let config = agents
                .iter()
                .find(|a| a.name == name)
                .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("unknown agent '{name}'"))?;
            Ok(serde_json::json!({"tools":config.tools}))
        }
        "update_config" => {
            let i: UpdateConfigInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
            let mut config = i.config;
            config.name = valid_name(&config.name)?;
            let lookup_name = config.name.clone();
            config.tools = config
                .tools
                .into_iter()
                .map(|t| valid_name(&t))
                .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
            config.tools.sort();
            config.tools.dedup();
            let row = store
                .update("agent_config", move |old| {
                    let mut list = decode_agents(old)?;
                    if let Some(a) = list.iter_mut().find(|a| a.name == config.name) {
                        *a = config.clone()
                    } else {
                        list.push(config.clone())
                    };
                    Ok(serde_json::json!({"agents":list}))
                })
                .await?;
            let committed = decode_agents(Some(row.document))?
                .into_iter()
                .find(|a| a.name == lookup_name)
                .context("committed agent config missing")?;
            Ok(serde_json::to_value(AgentMutationOutput {
                config: committed,
                revision: row.revision,
            })?)
        }
        "register_tool" => {
            let i: RegisterToolInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
            let name = valid_name(&i.name)?;
            let tool = valid_name(&i.tool)?;
            let lookup_name = name.clone();
            let row = store
                .update("agent_config", move |old| {
                    let mut list = decode_agents(old)?;
                    let a = list
                        .iter_mut()
                        .find(|a| a.name == name)
                        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("unknown agent '{name}'"))?;
                    if !a.tools.contains(&tool) {
                        a.tools.push(tool.clone());
                        a.tools.sort();
                    }
                    Ok(serde_json::json!({"agents":list}))
                })
                .await?;
            let config = decode_agents(Some(row.document))?
                .into_iter()
                .find(|a| a.name == lookup_name)
                .context("committed agent config missing")?;
            Ok(serde_json::to_value(AgentMutationOutput {
                config,
                revision: row.revision,
            })?)
        }
        "reset_config" => {
            let i: AgentNameInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
            let name = valid_name(&i.name)?;
            let lookup_name = name.clone();
            let row = store
                .update("agent_config", move |old| {
                    let mut list = decode_agents(old)?;
                    let a = list
                        .iter_mut()
                        .find(|a| a.name == name)
                        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("unknown agent '{name}'"))?;
                    a.enabled = false;
                    a.model = None;
                    a.tools.clear();
                    Ok(serde_json::json!({"agents":list}))
                })
                .await?;
            let config = decode_agents(Some(row.document))?
                .into_iter()
                .find(|a| a.name == lookup_name)
                .context("committed agent config missing")?;
            Ok(serde_json::to_value(AgentMutationOutput {
                config,
                revision: row.revision,
            })?)
        }
        other => anyhow::bail!("unknown agent_config method: {other}"),
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::state_plugins::common::oscal::validate_subid;
    use crate::state_plugins::runtime_documents::RuntimeDocuments;

    #[test]
    fn schema_is_schemars_seeded_and_typed() {
        let schema = agent_config_schema();
        assert_eq!(schema.name, "agent_config");
        assert_eq!(schema.version, "2.0.0");
        assert_eq!(
            schema.description,
            "Agent configuration and tool assignments"
        );
        assert!(schema.fields.contains_key("agents"));
        assert!(schema.methods.contains_key("get_config"));
        assert!(schema.methods.contains_key("update_config"));
        assert!(schema.methods.contains_key("list_tools"));
        assert!(schema.methods.contains_key("register_tool"));
        assert!(schema.methods.contains_key("reset_config"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn all_subids_are_valid() {
        let raw = serde_json::to_value(schemars::schema_for!(AgentConfigState)).unwrap();
        let mut stack = vec![&raw];
        while let Some(node) = stack.pop() {
            if let Some(subid) = node.get("x-oscal-subid").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {
                validate_subid(subid).expect("invalid subid");
            }
            if let Some(props) = node.get("properties").and_then(|v| v.as_object()) {
                for (_, v) in props {
                    stack.push(v);
                }
            }
            if let Some(defs) = node
                .get("$defs")
                .or_else(|| node.get("definitions"))
                .and_then(|v| v.as_object())
            {
                for (_, v) in defs {
                    stack.push(v);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn runtime_agent_methods_round_trip_and_reject_unknown() {
        let store = Arc::new(RuntimeDocuments::new(
            op_cozo_store::CozoGraphShuttle::new_in_memory().unwrap(),
        ));
        let cfg = serde_json::json!({"config":{"name":"builder","enabled":true,"model":"m1","tools":["search","search"]}});
        dispatch_agent_config_with_store(store.clone(), "update_config", &cfg)
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            dispatch_agent_config_with_store(
                store.clone(),
                "list_tools",
                &serde_json::json!({"name":"builder"})
            )
            .await
            .unwrap()["tools"],
            serde_json::json!(["search"])
        );
        dispatch_agent_config_with_store(
            store.clone(),
            "register_tool",
            &serde_json::json!({"name":"builder","tool":"write"}),
        )
        .await
        .unwrap();
        dispatch_agent_config_with_store(
            store.clone(),
            "reset_config",
            &serde_json::json!({"name":"builder"}),
        )
        .await
        .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            dispatch_agent_config_with_store(
                store.clone(),
                "get_config",
                &serde_json::json!({"name":"builder"})
            )
            .await
            .unwrap()["config"]["enabled"],
            false
        );
        assert!(dispatch_agent_config_with_store(
            store,
            "list_tools",
            &serde_json::json!({"name":"missing"})
        )
        .await
        .is_err());
    }
}

// Self-registration: the plugin registry discovers this via inventory
// (single source of the catalog; no central dispatch list).
inventory::submit! {
    crate::default_registry::PluginReg::new("agent_config", |_ctx| std::sync::Arc::new(AgentConfigPlugin::new()))
}
</file>

<file path="op-plugins/src/state_plugins/agent_triggers.rs">
//! Event triggers for agent runs (OD-63): sealed plugin state owned by the
//! `persona` plugin, stored as its durable runtime document.
//!
//! A trigger binds a broker topic filter to an **agent identity sled** and a
//! bounded set of plugin methods the run may call. The broker only delivers
//! the event; the table here is the only policy, and it is plugin state
//! (schema-validated, revisioned), never broker state.

use anyhow::{ensure, Context, Result};
use schemars::JsonSchema;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use serde_json::Value;

use super::runtime_documents::RuntimeDocuments;

/// Runtime document id under the `persona` plugin.
pub const TRIGGERS_DOCUMENT: &str = "persona/triggers";
pub const MAX_TRIGGERS: usize = 64;
pub const MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES_CEILING: usize = 256 * 1024;
pub const MAX_ACTIONS_CEILING: u32 = 16;
pub const MAX_TIMEOUT_MS_CEILING: u64 = 10 * 60 * 1000;
/// The doorbell namespace: triggers never fire on wakes.
const RESERVED_PREFIX: &str = "opdbus/";

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct AgentTrigger {
    #[schemars(description = "Stable trigger id (1..=64 chars, [A-Za-z0-9_-])")]
    pub trigger_id: String,
    #[schemars(description = "MQTT topic filter (`+`/`#`); never under opdbus/ or `$`")]
    pub topic_filter: String,
    #[schemars(description = "Identity sled session id of the agent the run executes as [PII]")]
    pub agent_session_id: String,
    #[schemars(
        description = "What the agent is for; composed with shared pieces into its persona"
    )]
    pub instructions: String,
    #[schemars(
        description = "`plugin.method` names the run may dispatch (allow-list; grants still apply)"
    )]
    pub allowed_methods: Vec<String>,
    #[serde(default = "default_payload_bytes")]
    #[schemars(description = "Largest event payload handed to the run (bytes)")]
    pub max_payload_bytes: u32,
    #[serde(default = "default_actions")]
    #[schemars(description = "Actions a single run may perform")]
    pub max_actions: u32,
    #[serde(default = "default_timeout_ms")]
    #[schemars(description = "Run deadline in milliseconds")]
    pub timeout_ms: u64,
    #[serde(default = "default_true")]
    pub enabled: bool,
}

fn default_payload_bytes() -> u32 {
    16 * 1024
}
fn default_actions() -> u32 {
    4
}
fn default_timeout_ms() -> u64 {
    60_000
}
fn default_true() -> bool {
    true
}

/// The durable document: every trigger, with the revision the store assigned.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct TriggerDocument {
    #[serde(default)]
    pub triggers: Vec<AgentTrigger>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct ListTriggersInput {}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct ListTriggersOutput {
    pub triggers: Vec<AgentTrigger>,
    pub revision: u64,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct SetTriggerInput {
    pub trigger: AgentTrigger,
    /// Durable revision the caller read (0 = document absent). CAS.
    pub expected_revision: u64,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct SetTriggerOutput {
    pub trigger: AgentTrigger,
    pub revision: u64,
    pub created: bool,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct DeleteTriggerInput {
    pub trigger_id: String,
    pub expected_revision: u64,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct DeleteTriggerOutput {
    pub deleted: bool,
    pub revision: u64,
}

pub fn validate_trigger_id(id: &str) -> Result<()> {
    ensure!(
        !id.is_empty()
            && id.len() <= 64
            && id
                .bytes()
                .all(|b| b.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || b == b'_' || b == b'-'),
        "trigger_id must be 1..=64 chars of [A-Za-z0-9_-]"
    );
    Ok(())
}

/// MQTT topic-filter grammar plus this system's exclusions.
pub fn validate_topic_filter(filter: &str) -> Result<()> {
    ensure!(
        !filter.is_empty() && filter.len() <= 512 && !filter.chars().any(char::is_control),
        "topic_filter must be 1..=512 bytes without control characters"
    );
    ensure!(
        !filter.starts_with('$'),
        "topic_filter must not name `$` topics"
    );
    ensure!(
        !filter.starts_with(RESERVED_PREFIX) && filter != "#" && filter != "+",
        "topic_filter must not cover the opdbus/ doorbell namespace"
    );
    let levels: Vec<&str> = filter.split('/').collect();
    for (i, level) in levels.iter().enumerate() {
        if *level == "#" {
            ensure!(i == levels.len() - 1, "`#` must be the last level");
        } else if *level != "+" {
            ensure!(
                !level.contains('#') && !level.contains('+'),
                "wildcards must occupy a whole level"
            );
        }
    }
    // A leading `+` or a wildcard first level could still match opdbus/…
    ensure!(
        !matches!(levels[0], "+" | "#"),
        "the first level must be literal so the doorbell namespace is unreachable"
    );
    Ok(())
}

pub fn validate_trigger(trigger: &AgentTrigger) -> Result<()> {
    validate_trigger_id(&trigger.trigger_id)?;
    validate_topic_filter(&trigger.topic_filter)?;
    ensure!(
        !trigger.agent_session_id.is_empty()
            && trigger.agent_session_id.len() <= 256
            && trigger.agent_session_id.trim() == trigger.agent_session_id,
        "agent_session_id must be a bounded session id"
    );
    ensure!(
        !trigger.instructions.trim().is_empty() && trigger.instructions.len() <= 16 * 1024,
        "instructions must be 1..=16384 bytes"
    );
    ensure!(
        !trigger.allowed_methods.is_empty() && trigger.allowed_methods.len() <= 32,
        "allowed_methods must list 1..=32 plugin.method names"
    );
    for name in &trigger.allowed_methods {
        let (plugin, method) = name
            .split_once('.')
            .context("allowed_methods entries are `plugin.method`")?;
        ensure!(
            !plugin.is_empty()
                && !method.is_empty()
                && plugin
                    .bytes()
                    .all(|b| b.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || b == b'_')
                && method
                    .bytes()
                    .all(|b| b.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || b == b'_'),
            "allowed_methods entries are `plugin.method` identifiers"
        );
    }
    ensure!(
        (1..=MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES_CEILING as u32).contains(&trigger.max_payload_bytes),
        "max_payload_bytes must be 1..={MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES_CEILING}"
    );
    ensure!(
        (1..=MAX_ACTIONS_CEILING).contains(&trigger.max_actions),
        "max_actions must be 1..={MAX_ACTIONS_CEILING}"
    );
    ensure!(
        (1_000..=MAX_TIMEOUT_MS_CEILING).contains(&trigger.timeout_ms),
        "timeout_ms must be 1000..={MAX_TIMEOUT_MS_CEILING}"
    );
    Ok(())
}

pub fn validate_document(document: &TriggerDocument) -> Result<()> {
    ensure!(
        document.triggers.len() <= MAX_TRIGGERS,
        "at most {MAX_TRIGGERS} triggers"
    );
    let mut ids = std::collections::BTreeSet::new();
    for trigger in &document.triggers {
        validate_trigger(trigger)?;
        ensure!(
            ids.insert(trigger.trigger_id.as_str()),
            "duplicate trigger_id {}",
            trigger.trigger_id
        );
    }
    Ok(())
}

/// MQTT 3.1.1 topic matching (`+` one level, `#` the rest). Topics starting
/// with `$` never match wildcards at the first level.
pub fn topic_matches(filter: &str, topic: &str) -> bool {
    if topic.starts_with('$') && (filter.starts_with('+') || filter.starts_with('#')) {
        return false;
    }
    let mut f = filter.split('/');
    let mut t = topic.split('/');
    loop {
        match (f.next(), t.next()) {
            (Some("#"), _) => return true,
            (Some("+"), Some(_)) => continue,
            (Some(level), Some(actual)) if level == actual => continue,
            (None, None) => return true,
            _ => return false,
        }
    }
}

fn parse_document(value: Option<Value>) -> Result<TriggerDocument> {
    match value {
        None => Ok(TriggerDocument::default()),
        Some(value) => {
            let document: TriggerDocument =
                serde_json::from_value(value).context("durable trigger document is malformed")?;
            validate_document(&document)?;
            Ok(document)
        }
    }
}

/// Every enabled trigger, for the exhook matcher. Fails closed: a malformed
/// document yields no triggers.
pub async fn enabled_triggers(documents: &RuntimeDocuments) -> Result<Vec<AgentTrigger>> {
    let row = documents.read(TRIGGERS_DOCUMENT).await?;
    let document = parse_document(row.map(|r| r.document))?;
    Ok(document
        .triggers
        .into_iter()
        .filter(|t| t.enabled)
        .collect())
}

pub async fn list_triggers(documents: &RuntimeDocuments) -> Result<ListTriggersOutput> {
    let row = documents.read(TRIGGERS_DOCUMENT).await?;
    let revision = row.as_ref().map(|r| r.revision).unwrap_or(0);
    let document = parse_document(row.map(|r| r.document))?;
    Ok(ListTriggersOutput {
        triggers: document.triggers,
        revision,
    })
}

pub async fn set_trigger(
    documents: &RuntimeDocuments,
    input: SetTriggerInput,
) -> Result<SetTriggerOutput> {
    validate_trigger(&input.trigger)?;
    let trigger = input.trigger.clone();
    let (row, created) = documents
        .update_at_revision_with_result(TRIGGERS_DOCUMENT, input.expected_revision, move |old| {
            let mut document = parse_document(old)?;
            let created = match document
                .triggers
                .iter_mut()
                .find(|t| t.trigger_id == trigger.trigger_id)
            {
                Some(existing) => {
                    *existing = trigger.clone();
                    false
                }
                None => {
                    document.triggers.push(trigger.clone());
                    true
                }
            };
            validate_document(&document)?;
            Ok((serde_json::to_value(&document)?, created))
        })
        .await?;
    Ok(SetTriggerOutput {
        trigger: input.trigger,
        revision: row.revision,
        created,
    })
}

pub async fn delete_trigger(
    documents: &RuntimeDocuments,
    input: DeleteTriggerInput,
) -> Result<DeleteTriggerOutput> {
    validate_trigger_id(&input.trigger_id)?;
    let id = input.trigger_id.clone();
    let (row, deleted) = documents
        .update_at_revision_with_result(TRIGGERS_DOCUMENT, input.expected_revision, move |old| {
            let mut document = parse_document(old)?;
            let before = document.triggers.len();
            document.triggers.retain(|t| t.trigger_id != id);
            Ok((
                serde_json::to_value(&document)?,
                document.triggers.len() != before,
            ))
        })
        .await?;
    Ok(DeleteTriggerOutput {
        deleted,
        revision: row.revision,
    })
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use op_cozo_store::CozoGraphShuttle;

    fn trigger(id: &str, filter: &str) -> AgentTrigger {
        AgentTrigger {
            trigger_id: id.into(),
            topic_filter: filter.into(),
            agent_session_id: "agent-session".into(),
            instructions: "Watch line telemetry and raise alerts.".into(),
            allowed_methods: vec![
                "emqx.publish_wake".into(),
                "cognitive_mcp.memory_store".into(),
            ],
            max_payload_bytes: 4096,
            max_actions: 2,
            timeout_ms: 30_000,
            enabled: true,
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn matcher_follows_mqtt_wildcards() {
        assert!(topic_matches(
            "factory/+/telemetry",
            "factory/line1/telemetry"
        ));
        assert!(!topic_matches(
            "factory/+/telemetry",
            "factory/line1/alerts"
        ));
        assert!(!topic_matches(
            "factory/+/telemetry",
            "factory/a/b/telemetry"
        ));
        assert!(topic_matches("factory/#", "factory/a/b/c"));
        assert!(topic_matches("factory/#", "factory"));
        assert!(!topic_matches("factory/#", "plant/a"));
        assert!(topic_matches("a/b", "a/b"));
        assert!(!topic_matches("a/b", "a/b/c"));
        assert!(!topic_matches("+/x", "$SYS/x"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn filters_can_never_reach_the_doorbell_or_broker_internals() {
        for bad in [
            "opdbus/#",
            "opdbus/wake/+",
            "#",
            "+",
            "+/wake/#",
            "$SYS/#",
            "a/#/b",
            "a/b+",
        ] {
            assert!(validate_topic_filter(bad).is_err(), "{bad}");
        }
        for ok in ["factory/+/telemetry", "devices/#", "a/b/c"] {
            validate_topic_filter(ok).unwrap();
        }
        let mut t = trigger("t1", "factory/#");
        validate_trigger(&t).unwrap();
        t.allowed_methods = vec!["not-a-method".into()];
        assert!(validate_trigger(&t).is_err());
        t.allowed_methods = vec![];
        assert!(validate_trigger(&t).is_err());
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn triggers_are_a_revisioned_durable_document_with_cas() {
        let documents = RuntimeDocuments::new(CozoGraphShuttle::new_in_memory().unwrap());
        assert_eq!(list_triggers(&documents).await.unwrap().revision, 0);
        let created = set_trigger(
            &documents,
            SetTriggerInput {
                trigger: trigger("t1", "factory/#"),
                expected_revision: 0,
            },
        )
        .await
        .unwrap();
        assert!(created.created);
        assert_eq!(created.revision, 1);
        // Stale revision is refused before the closure runs.
        assert!(set_trigger(
            &documents,
            SetTriggerInput {
                trigger: trigger("t2", "plant/#"),
                expected_revision: 0,
            },
        )
        .await
        .is_err());
        let updated = set_trigger(
            &documents,
            SetTriggerInput {
                trigger: AgentTrigger {
                    enabled: false,
                    ..trigger("t1", "factory/#")
                },
                expected_revision: 1,
            },
        )
        .await
        .unwrap();
        assert!(!updated.created);
        assert!(enabled_triggers(&documents).await.unwrap().is_empty());
        let listed = list_triggers(&documents).await.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(listed.triggers.len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(listed.revision, 2);
        let deleted = delete_trigger(
            &documents,
            DeleteTriggerInput {
                trigger_id: "t1".into(),
                expected_revision: 2,
            },
        )
        .await
        .unwrap();
        assert!(deleted.deleted);
        assert!(list_triggers(&documents).await.unwrap().triggers.is_empty());
    }
}
</file>

use anyhow::Result;
use async_trait::async_trait;
use op_state::{ApplyResult, Checkpoint, PluginCapabilities, StateDiff, StatePlugin};
use op_state_store::PluginSchema;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use simd_json::OwnedValue as Value;

/// Provider options read from the durable runtime document.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, Default, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "sch.software.antigravity-chat.config.schema@v1"))]
pub struct ChatConfig {
    /// Provider protocol selected by the durable runtime owner.
    #[serde(default = "default_provider_route")]
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "mut.software.antigravity-chat.config-provider@v1"))]
    pub provider: String,
    /// Base URL consumed by native provider requests.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "mut.software.antigravity-chat.config-base-url@v1"))]
    pub base_url: String,
}

/// Bounded native readback from an OpenAI-compatible `/v1/models` endpoint.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, Default, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[schemars(extend("x-opdbus-exact-json-schema" = true))]
pub struct NativeBridgeStatus {
    pub url: String,
    pub reachable: bool,
    pub http_status: u16,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub model_ids: Vec<String>,
    pub checked_at: String,
}

/// Sanitized receipt from the Google credential owner.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, Default, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[schemars(extend("x-opdbus-exact-json-schema" = true))]
pub struct TokenRefreshReceipt {
    pub credential_type: String,
    /// A valid access token was obtained and discarded without disclosure.
    pub token_available: bool,
    /// Time at which the native credential owner completed the observation.
    pub observed_at: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub scopes: Vec<String>,
}

/// Runtime options consumed by native Antigravity generation requests.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[schemars(extend("x-opdbus-exact-json-schema" = true))]
pub struct ConfigureInput {
    /// Revision of the shared Antigravity runtime document; zero means absent.
    pub expected_revision: u64,
    /// `gemini` or `openai_compatible`.
    #[schemars(regex(pattern = "^(gemini|openai_compatible)$"))]
    pub provider: String,
    /// HTTPS provider base URL, or a loopback HTTP URL for a local bridge.
    pub base_url: String,
    /// Provider model used when a request does not explicitly select one.
    #[schemars(length(min = 1, max = 256), regex(pattern = "^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$"))]
    pub selected_model: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[schemars(extend("x-opdbus-exact-json-schema" = true))]
pub struct ConfigureOutput {
    pub revision: u64,
    pub provider: String,
    pub base_url: String,
    pub selected_model: String,
}

fn default_llm_plugin() -> String {
    "large_language_model".to_string()
}

fn default_provider_route() -> String {
    "gemini".to_string()
}

/// Top-level Antigravity Chat state.
///
/// Gemini model catalog is **not** owned here — resolve via `llm_plugin` +
/// `provider_route` (default `large_language_model` / `gemini`). This plugin
/// holds the native bridge observation, sanitized auth, and selected model id.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, Default, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "sch.software.plugin.antigravity-chat.schema@v1"))]
#[schemars(extend("x-oscal-category" = "llm"))]
pub struct AntigravityChatState {
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "obs.software.antigravity-chat.status@v1"))]
    pub status: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "mut.software.antigravity-chat.bridge@v1"))]
    pub bridge: NativeBridgeStatus,
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "mut.software.antigravity-chat.auth@v1"))]
    pub auth: super::antigravity::AntigravityAuthStatus,
    /// Plugin that owns the model catalog (default large_language_model).
    #[serde(default = "default_llm_plugin")]
    #[schemars(
        description = "Generation/catalog plugin Antigravity delegates to for models (default large_language_model). Catalog lives there; this plugin holds no Gemini model list.",
        example = &"large_language_model",
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "mut.software.antigravity-chat.llm-plugin@v1")
    )]
    pub llm_plugin: String,
    /// Provider route inside `llm_plugin` (default gemini).
    #[serde(default = "default_provider_route")]
    #[schemars(
        description = "Provider route on llm_plugin for the Gemini catalog (default gemini).",
        example = &"gemini",
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "mut.software.antigravity-chat.provider-route@v1")
    )]
    pub provider_route: String,
    /// Session-selected model id from the delegated catalog; empty = provider default.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(
        description = "Selected model id from the delegated catalog. Empty falls back to the provider default. Not a local catalog entry.",
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "mut.software.antigravity-chat.selected-model@v1")
    )]
    pub selected_model: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "sch.software.antigravity-chat.config@v1"))]
    pub config: ChatConfig,
}

pub struct AntigravityChatPlugin;

impl Default for AntigravityChatPlugin {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self
    }
}

impl AntigravityChatPlugin {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self
    }

    pub fn current_state() -> AntigravityChatState {
        AntigravityChatState {
            status: "declared".to_string(),
            bridge: NativeBridgeStatus::default(),
            auth: super::antigravity::AntigravityAuthStatus::default(),
            llm_plugin: default_llm_plugin(),
            provider_route: default_provider_route(),
            selected_model: String::new(),
            config: ChatConfig {
                provider: "gemini".to_string(),
                base_url: "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta".to_string(),
            },
        }
    }
}

#[async_trait]
impl StatePlugin for AntigravityChatPlugin {
    fn name(&self) -> &str {
        "antigravity_chat"
    }
    fn version(&self) -> &str {
        "2.0.0"
    }
    fn schema(&self) -> Option<PluginSchema> {
        let mut schema = antigravity_chat_schema();
        super::common::oscal::ensure_category_metadata_fields(&mut schema);
        Some(schema)
    }
    async fn calculate_diff(&self, _current: &Value, _desired: &Value) -> Result<StateDiff> {
        anyhow::bail!("antigravity_chat reconciliation has no authoritative bridge backend")
    }
    async fn apply_state(&self, _diff: &StateDiff) -> Result<ApplyResult> {
        anyhow::bail!("antigravity_chat apply has no authoritative bridge backend")
    }
    async fn verify_state(&self, _desired: &Value) -> Result<bool> {
        anyhow::bail!("antigravity_chat verification requires bridge readback")
    }
    async fn create_checkpoint(&self) -> Result<Checkpoint> {
        anyhow::bail!("antigravity_chat has no authoritative checkpoint owner")
    }
    async fn rollback(&self, _checkpoint: &Checkpoint) -> Result<()> {
        anyhow::bail!("antigravity_chat has no authoritative rollback owner")
    }
    fn capabilities(&self) -> PluginCapabilities {
        PluginCapabilities {
            supports_rollback: false,
            supports_checkpoints: false,
            supports_verification: false,
            atomic_operations: false,
        }
    }
}

pub(crate) fn antigravity_chat_schema() -> PluginSchema {
    let root = serde_json::to_value(schemars::schema_for!(AntigravityChatState))
        .expect("schemars schema serializes to JSON");
    let mut schema = super::schemars_adapter::plugin_schema_from_json(
        "antigravity_chat",
        "2.0.0",
        "Antigravity Chat — native Google credential and OpenAI-compatible bridge control; model catalog delegated to large_language_model",
        &root,
    );

    use super::plugin_scaffold_helpers::{method_decl_from_schemars_with_output, EmptyInput};
    use op_state_store::SideEffect;

    #[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
    #[schemars(extend("x-opdbus-exact-json-schema" = true))]
    pub struct GetBridgeStatusOutput {
        pub bridge: NativeBridgeStatus,
    }
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
    #[schemars(extend("x-opdbus-exact-json-schema" = true))]
    pub struct RefreshTokenOutput {
        pub token: TokenRefreshReceipt,
    }

    // Model catalog remains owned by llm_plugin/provider_route. These methods
    // control and observe only the concrete provider bridge and credential owner.
    schema.methods.insert(
        "get_bridge_status".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<EmptyInput, GetBridgeStatusOutput>(
            "get_bridge_status",
            SideEffect::Read,
            true,
            "antigravity_chat.read",
            "obs.software.antigravity-chat.bridge.status.get@v1",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "refresh_token".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<EmptyInput, RefreshTokenOutput>(
            "refresh_token",
            SideEffect::Mutation,
            false,
            "antigravity_chat.write",
            "mut.software.antigravity-chat.auth.token.refresh@v1",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "configure".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<ConfigureInput, ConfigureOutput>(
            "configure",
            SideEffect::Mutation,
            false,
            "antigravity_chat.write",
            "mut.software.antigravity-chat.config.set@v1",
        ),
    );
    schema.capabilities.insert(
        "antigravity_chat.read".to_string(),
        op_state_store::CapabilityDecl {
            id: "antigravity_chat.read".to_string(),
            description: "Grants bounded native bridge model readback.".to_string(),
        },
    );
    schema.capabilities.insert(
        "antigravity_chat.write".to_string(),
        op_state_store::CapabilityDecl {
            id: "antigravity_chat.write".to_string(),
            description:
                "Grants revisioned provider configuration and native Google token refresh."
                    .to_string(),
        },
    );

    schema
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::state_plugins::common::oscal::validate_subid;
    use serde_json::Value as JVal;

    #[test]
    fn schema_is_schemars_seeded_and_typed() {
        let schema = antigravity_chat_schema();
        assert_eq!(schema.name, "antigravity_chat");
        assert_eq!(schema.version, "2.0.0");
        assert!(schema.fields.contains_key("status"));
        assert!(schema.fields.contains_key("bridge"));
        assert!(schema.fields.contains_key("auth"));
        assert!(schema.fields.contains_key("llm_plugin"));
        assert!(schema.fields.contains_key("provider_route"));
        assert!(schema.fields.contains_key("selected_model"));
        assert!(schema.fields.contains_key("config"));
        assert!(!schema.fields.contains_key("models"));
        assert!(!schema.methods.contains_key("list_models"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn all_subids_are_valid() {
        let raw = serde_json::to_value(schemars::schema_for!(AntigravityChatState)).unwrap();
        let mut subids = Vec::new();
        collect_subids(&raw, &mut subids);
        assert!(
            !subids.is_empty(),
            "expected at least one x-oscal-subid in the derived schema"
        );
        for subid in subids {
            validate_subid(&subid).unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("invalid subid {subid}: {e}"));
        }
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn generic_lifecycle_never_returns_a_false_receipt() {
        let plugin = AntigravityChatPlugin::new();
        let state = simd_json::json!({});
        assert!(plugin.calculate_diff(&state, &state).await.is_err());
        let diff = StateDiff {
            plugin: plugin.name().to_owned(),
            actions: vec![],
            metadata: op_state::DiffMetadata {
                timestamp: 0,
                current_hash: String::new(),
                desired_hash: String::new(),
            },
        };
        assert!(plugin.apply_state(&diff).await.is_err());
        assert!(plugin.verify_state(&state).await.is_err());
        assert!(plugin.create_checkpoint().await.is_err());
        let checkpoint = Checkpoint {
            id: "fixture".into(),
            plugin: plugin.name().into(),
            timestamp: 0,
            state_snapshot: state,
            backend_checkpoint: None,
        };
        assert!(plugin.rollback(&checkpoint).await.is_err());
        let capabilities = plugin.capabilities();
        assert!(!capabilities.supports_verification);
        assert!(!capabilities.supports_checkpoints);
        assert!(!capabilities.supports_rollback);
        assert!(!capabilities.atomic_operations);
    }

    fn collect_subids(node: &JVal, out: &mut Vec<String>) {
        if let Some(subid) = node.get("x-oscal-subid").and_then(JVal::as_str) {
            out.push(subid.to_string());
        }
        if let Some(props) = node.get("properties").and_then(JVal::as_object) {
            for v in props.values() {
                collect_subids(v, out);
            }
        }
        if let Some(defs) = node
            .get("$defs")
            .or_else(|| node.get("definitions"))
            .and_then(JVal::as_object)
        {
            for v in defs.values() {
                collect_subids(v, out);
            }
        }
        if let Some(items) = node.get("items") {
            collect_subids(items, out);
        }
        if let Some(alternatives) = node
            .get("anyOf")
            .or_else(|| node.get("oneOf"))
            .and_then(JVal::as_array)
        {
            for v in alternatives {
                collect_subids(v, out);
            }
        }
    }
}

// Self-registration: the plugin registry discovers this via inventory
// (single source of the catalog; no central dispatch list).
inventory::submit! {
    crate::default_registry::PluginReg::new("antigravity_chat", |_ctx| std::sync::Arc::new(AntigravityChatPlugin::new()))
}

<file path="op-plugins/src/state_plugins/antigravity.rs">
//! Antigravity SDK provider plugin.
//!
//! Publishes the proven native credential, safety policy, provider route and
//! local response-usage surface through PluginSchema. Gemini model catalog
//! ownership lives on the delegated `llm_plugin` (default
//! `large_language_model`) — this plugin only holds `llm_plugin` /
//! `provider_route` / `selected_model` references.

use anyhow::Result;
use async_trait::async_trait;
use op_state::{ApplyResult, Checkpoint, PluginCapabilities, StateDiff, StatePlugin};
use op_state_store::PluginSchema;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use serde_json::Value as JsonValue;
use simd_json::OwnedValue as Value;
use std::collections::HashMap;

/// Vertex AI authentication configuration.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "sch.software.antigravity.vertex-auth.schema@v1"))]
pub struct VertexAuth {
    /// Whether Vertex AI is enabled.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "obs.software.antigravity.vertex-auth.enabled@v1"))]
    pub enabled: bool,
    /// Whether to use the Vertex AI backend (true) or the Gemini API (false).
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "mut.service.antigravity.vertex-auth.use-vertexai@v1"))]
    pub use_vertexai: String,
    /// Google Cloud project ID.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "exp.service.antigravity.vertex-auth.project@v1"))]
    pub project: String,
    /// Google Cloud location/region.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "exp.service.antigravity.vertex-auth.location@v1"))]
    pub location: String,
    /// Vertex AI API endpoint URL.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "mut.service.antigravity.vertex-auth.api-endpoint@v1"))]
    pub api_endpoint: String,
    /// Credentials type used for Vertex AI.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "obs.software.antigravity.vertex-auth.credentials-type@v1"))]
    pub credentials_type: String,
    /// Service account email for Vertex AI.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "exp.service.antigravity.vertex-auth.service-account@v1"))]
    pub service_account_email: String,
    /// Quota project for Vertex AI billing.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "exp.service.antigravity.vertex-auth.quota-project@v1"))]
    pub quota_project: String,
}

/// Antigravity authentication state.

    /// Identity provider.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "exp.service.antigravity.auth.provider@v1"))]

    #[serde(default)]

    #[serde(default)]

    pub scopes: Vec<String>,
    /// Vertex AI authentication details.
    #[serde(default)]

    #[serde(default)]

/// A single safety filter threshold.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "sch.software.antigravity.safety-setting.schema@v1"))]
pub struct SafetySetting {
    /// Harm category.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(
        regex(pattern = "^HARM_CATEGORY_(UNSPECIFIED|HARASSMENT|HATE_SPEECH|SEXUALLY_EXPLICIT|DANGEROUS_CONTENT|CIVIC_INTEGRITY)$"),
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "obs.software.antigravity.safety-setting.category@v1")
    )]
    pub category: String,
    /// Default blocking threshold.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(
        regex(pattern = "^(HARM_BLOCK_THRESHOLD_UNSPECIFIED|BLOCK_LOW_AND_ABOVE|BLOCK_MEDIUM_AND_ABOVE|BLOCK_ONLY_HIGH|BLOCK_NONE|OFF)$"),
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "mut.service.antigravity.safety-setting.threshold@v1")
    )]
    pub threshold: String,
}

/// Sanitized status emitted by the native Google credential owner.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[schemars(extend("x-opdbus-exact-json-schema" = true))]
pub struct AntigravityAuthStatus {
    /// Native credential kind (`authorized_user`, `service_account`, `api_key`, or `none`).
    pub credential_type: String,
    /// Non-secret source class (`application_default_credentials` or `environment`).
    pub credential_source: String,
    /// Whether enough credential material exists to attempt a provider request.
    pub credential_available: bool,
    /// Whether the credential owner can refresh this credential without a subprocess.
    pub refreshable: bool,
    /// OAuth scopes requested from the native credential owner.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub scopes: Vec<String>,
}

/// Locally observed usage for one provider model.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[schemars(extend("x-opdbus-exact-json-schema" = true))]
pub struct LocalModelUsage {
    pub requests: u64,
    pub prompt_tokens: u64,
    pub completion_tokens: u64,
    pub total_tokens: u64,
}

/// Durable usage report derived only from successful provider responses.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[schemars(extend("x-opdbus-exact-json-schema" = true))]
pub struct LocalUsageReport {
    pub source: String,
    pub requests: u64,
    pub prompt_tokens: u64,
    pub completion_tokens: u64,
    pub total_tokens: u64,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub models: HashMap<String, LocalModelUsage>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub last_recorded_at: Option<String>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct GetUsageReportInput {
    /// Restrict the local response ledger to one exact model id.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(length(min = 1, max = 256), regex(pattern = "^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$"))]
    pub model: Option<String>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[schemars(extend("x-opdbus-exact-json-schema" = true))]
pub struct ConfigureSafetyInput {
    /// Revision of the shared Antigravity runtime document; zero means absent.
    pub expected_revision: u64,
    /// Complete Gemini `safetySettings` replacement applied to later requests.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(length(max = 16))]
    pub settings: Vec<SafetySetting>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[schemars(extend("x-opdbus-exact-json-schema" = true))]
pub struct ConfigureSafetyOutput {
    pub revision: u64,
    pub settings: Vec<SafetySetting>,
}

    #[serde(default)]

    #[serde(default)]

        description = "Catalog plugin Antigravity delegates to for Gemini models (default large_language_model).",
