<file path="op-plugins/src/state_plugins/cozo_methods.rs">
//! Native operations on the bridge-owned cognitive Cozo database.
//!
//! Archives are versioned, tagged-value relation exports, not engine backups.
//! Cozo 0.7.6 does not expose default expressions or complete advanced-index
//! definitions; those and triggers/nonempty descriptions are rejected before
//! archive creation/restoration. Existing schemas must match an archive.

use std::collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet};
use std::fs::{self, File, OpenOptions};
use std::io::{Read, Write};
use std::os::unix::fs::{MetadataExt, OpenOptionsExt, PermissionsExt};
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::sync::Arc;

use anyhow::{bail, ensure, Context, Result};
use op_cozo_store::{CozoGraphShuttle, DataValue, NamedRows, Num, ScriptMutability, Vector};
use schemars::JsonSchema;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use serde_json::{json, Value};
use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};

use super::{
    BackupInput, DescribeRelationInput, ExportRelationsInput, ImportRelationsInput,
    ListRelationsInput, RestoreInput, RunQueryInput,
};

const FORMAT: &str = "opdbus-cozo-relations-v1";
const CODEC: &str = "opdbus-cozo-tagged-values-v1";
const MAX_ARCHIVE_BYTES: u64 = 64 * 1024 * 1024;
const MAX_ROWS: usize = 100_000;
const MAX_RELATIONS: usize = 256;

#[cfg(test)]
#[path = "cozo_methods_tests.rs"]
mod tests;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema, PartialEq)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct RelationRows {
    pub headers: Vec<String>,
    pub rows: Vec<Vec<Value>>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
pub struct QueryOutput {
    pub results: Vec<RelationRows>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
pub struct ImportOutput {
    pub relations: Vec<String>,
    pub rows: u64,
    pub committed: bool,
    /// Imports use normal transactional puts, including their index/trigger semantics.
    pub triggers_enabled: bool,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
pub struct ExportOutput {
    /// Native Cozo JSON representation; backup uses a separate tagged codec
    /// to preserve Bytes/Uuid/vector values inside Any columns losslessly.
    pub encoding: String,
    pub data: BTreeMap<String, RelationRows>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct RelationSummary {
    pub name: String,
    pub arity: u64,
    pub access_level: String,
    pub n_keys: u64,
    pub n_non_keys: u64,
    pub n_put_triggers: u64,
    pub n_rm_triggers: u64,
    pub n_replace_triggers: u64,
    pub description: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct ColumnDescription {
    pub column: String,
    pub is_key: bool,
    pub index: u64,
    #[serde(rename = "type")]
    pub type_name: String,
    pub has_default: bool,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema, PartialEq)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct IndexDescription {
    pub name: String,
    #[serde(rename = "type")]
    pub index_type: String,
    pub relations: Vec<String>,
    pub config: Value,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct TriggerDescription {
    #[serde(rename = "type")]
    pub event: String,
    pub idx: u64,
    pub trigger: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema, PartialEq)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct RelationDescription {
    pub relation: RelationSummary,
    pub columns: Vec<ColumnDescription>,
    pub indices: Vec<IndexDescription>,
    pub triggers: Vec<TriggerDescription>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
pub struct ListRelationsOutput {
    pub relations: Vec<RelationSummary>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
pub struct ArchiveReceipt {
    pub archive: String,
    pub sha256: String,
    pub bytes: u64,
    pub relations: Vec<String>,
    pub rows: u64,
    pub format: String,
    pub scope: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
pub struct RestoreReceipt {
    pub archive: String,
    pub sha256: String,
    pub relations: Vec<String>,
    pub rows: u64,
    pub committed: bool,
    pub atomic: bool,
    /// A native engine transaction commit; no claim of a SQLite engine image
    /// or power-loss durability beyond the configured Cozo storage engine.
    pub durability: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
struct RelationArchive {
    format: String,
    value_codec: String,
    relations: Vec<ArchivedRelation>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
struct ArchivedRelation {
    metadata: RelationDescription,
    /// serde-tagged native DataValue cells, not display strings or JSON
    /// coercions. The versioned codec preserves Any-column value identities.
    rows: Vec<Vec<Value>>,
}

fn native_error(error: impl std::fmt::Display) -> anyhow::Error {
    anyhow::anyhow!("Cozo: {error}")
}

fn run(
    store: &CozoGraphShuttle,
    script: &str,
    params: BTreeMap<String, DataValue>,
    immutable: bool,
) -> Result<NamedRows> {
    store
        .db()
        .run_script(
            script,
            params,
            if immutable {
                ScriptMutability::Immutable
            } else {
                ScriptMutability::Mutable
            },
        )
        .map_err(native_error)
}

fn public_rows(rows: NamedRows) -> Result<RelationRows> {
    ensure!(
        rows.next.is_none(),
        "flatten native Cozo result chains before conversion"
    );
    Ok(RelationRows {
        headers: rows.headers,
        rows: rows
            .rows
            .into_iter()
            .map(|row| row.into_iter().map(Value::from).collect())
            .collect(),
    })
}

fn records<T: serde::de::DeserializeOwned>(rows: NamedRows) -> Result<Vec<T>> {
    let headers = rows.headers;
    rows.rows
        .into_iter()
        .map(|row| {
            ensure!(
                row.len() == headers.len(),
                "native Cozo row/header length mismatch"
            );
            let object: serde_json::Map<String, Value> = headers
                .iter()
                .cloned()
                .zip(row.into_iter().map(Value::from))
                .collect();
            Ok(serde_json::from_value(Value::Object(object))?)
        })
        .collect()
}

fn list_relations(store: &CozoGraphShuttle) -> Result<Vec<RelationSummary>> {
    records(run(store, "::relations", BTreeMap::new(), true)?)
}

fn simple_ident(name: &str) -> bool {
    static IDENTIFIER: std::sync::LazyLock<regex::Regex> = std::sync::LazyLock::new(|| {
        regex::Regex::new(r"^\p{XID_Start}[\p{XID_Continue}_]*$")
            .expect("Cozo identifier regex is valid")
    });
    IDENTIFIER.is_match(name)
}

fn relation_name(name: &str) -> Result<()> {
    ensure!(
        !name.is_empty() && name.len() <= 256 && name.split('.').all(simple_ident),
        "relation name must contain Cozo identifier components"
    );
    Ok(())
}

fn checked_selection(names: &[String]) -> Result<()> {
    ensure!(
        !names.is_empty() && names.len() <= MAX_RELATIONS,
        "select 1..=256 relations"
    );
    let mut seen = BTreeSet::new();
    for name in names {
        relation_name(name)?;
        ensure!(seen.insert(name), "duplicate relation selection");
    }
    Ok(())
}

/// Schema and rows are captured by one immutable imperative transaction. A
/// preliminary list only supplies names/arity for safe query construction;
/// every actual descriptor used by the archive comes from this transaction.
fn snapshot(
    store: &CozoGraphShuttle,
    names: &[String],
    with_data: bool,
) -> Result<Vec<(RelationDescription, NamedRows)>> {
    checked_selection(names)?;
    let before = list_relations(store)?;
    let mut script = "{::relations} as _catalog\n".to_owned();
    let mut returns = vec!["_catalog".to_owned()];
    for (index, name) in names.iter().enumerate() {
        let info = before
            .iter()
            .find(|row| row.name == *name)
            .context("Cozo relation does not exist")?;
        ensure!(
            info.access_level != "index",
            "select the owning relation, not its internal index"
        );
        script.push_str(&format!("{{::columns {name}}} as _columns{index}\n{{::indices {name}}} as _indices{index}\n{{::show_triggers {name}}} as _triggers{index}\n"));
        returns.extend([
            format!("_columns{index}"),
            format!("_indices{index}"),
            format!("_triggers{index}"),
        ]);
        if with_data {
            ensure!(
                info.arity > 0 && info.arity <= 1024,
                "archive relation arity must be 1..=1024"
            );
            let vars = (0..info.arity)
                .map(|column| format!("v{column}"))
                .collect::<Vec<_>>()
                .join(",");
            script.push_str(&format!(
                "{{ ?[{vars}] := *{name}[{vars}] :limit {} }} as _data{index}\n",
                MAX_ROWS + 1
            ));
            returns.push(format!("_data{index}"));
        }
    }
    script.push_str(&format!("%return {}", returns.join(",")));
    let mut results = run(store, &script, BTreeMap::new(), true)?
        .flatten()
        .into_iter();
    let catalog: Vec<RelationSummary> =
        records(results.next().context("snapshot returned no catalog")?)?;
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    for name in names {
        let relation = catalog
            .iter()
            .find(|row| row.name == *name)
            .cloned()
            .context("relation changed before the snapshot")?;
        let mut columns: Vec<ColumnDescription> =
            records(results.next().context("snapshot omitted column metadata")?)?;
        columns.sort_by_key(|column| column.index);
        let indices = records(results.next().context("snapshot omitted index metadata")?)?;
        let triggers = records(
            results
                .next()
                .context("snapshot omitted trigger metadata")?,
        )?;
        let data = if with_data {
            results.next().context("snapshot omitted relation data")?
        } else {
            NamedRows::default()
        };
        out.push((
            RelationDescription {
                relation,
                columns,
                indices,
                triggers,
            },
            data,
        ));
    }
    ensure!(
        results.next().is_none(),
        "unexpected native snapshot result"
    );
    Ok(out)
}

fn supported_metadata(meta: &RelationDescription) -> Result<Vec<TypeSpec>> {
    let name = &meta.relation.name;
    relation_name(name)?;
    ensure!(
        matches!(
            meta.relation.access_level.as_str(),
            "normal" | "protected" | "read_only"
        ),
        "{name}: hidden/index relations cannot be portably archived"
    );
    ensure!(
        meta.relation.description.is_empty(),
        "{name}: Cozo 0.7.6 has no parsed description setter for faithful restore"
    );
    ensure!(
        meta.triggers.is_empty()
            && meta.relation.n_put_triggers == 0
            && meta.relation.n_rm_triggers == 0
            && meta.relation.n_replace_triggers == 0,
        "{name}: portable archive v1 does not restore executable triggers"
    );
    ensure!(
        !meta.columns.is_empty()
            && meta.columns.len() <= 1024
            && meta.columns.len() as u64 == meta.relation.arity,
        "{name}: invalid archive column count"
    );
    let mut names = BTreeSet::new();
    let mut types = Vec::new();
    for (index, column) in meta.columns.iter().enumerate() {
        ensure!(
            simple_ident(&column.column) && names.insert(&column.column),
            "{name}: invalid/duplicate column identifier"
        );
        ensure!(
            column.index == index as u64
                && column.is_key == (index < meta.relation.n_keys as usize),
            "{name}: column ordering/key metadata is inconsistent"
        );
        ensure!(!column.has_default, "{name}.{}: Cozo exposes has_default but not its expression; archive would lose schema behavior", column.column);
        types.push(TypeSpec::parse(&column.type_name)?);
    }
    ensure!(
        meta.relation.n_keys > 0
            && meta.relation.n_keys.checked_add(meta.relation.n_non_keys)
                == Some(meta.relation.arity),
        "{name}: invalid key/value column counts"
    );
    let mut index_names = BTreeSet::new();
    for index in &meta.indices {
        ensure!(
            index.index_type == "normal",
            "{name}: {} index {} has no complete portable reconstruction contract",
            index.index_type,
            index.name
        );
        ensure!(
            simple_ident(&index.name) && index_names.insert(&index.name),
            "{name}: invalid/duplicate index name"
        );
        let columns = index.config["indices"]
            .as_array()
            .context("normal index is missing column offsets")?;
        ensure!(
            !columns.is_empty()
                && columns.iter().all(|value| value
                    .as_u64()
                    .is_some_and(|offset| offset < meta.columns.len() as u64)),
            "{name}: invalid normal index column offsets"
        );
        ensure!(
            index
                .config
                .as_object()
                .is_some_and(|object| object.len() == 1),
            "{name}: unknown normal index metadata"
        );
        ensure!(
            index.relations == vec![format!("{name}:{}", index.name)],
            "{name}: unexpected backing relation for normal index"
        );
    }
    Ok(types)
}

fn archive_from_snapshot(
    snapshot: Vec<(RelationDescription, NamedRows)>,
) -> Result<RelationArchive> {
    let mut relations = Vec::new();
    let mut total = 0usize;
    for (metadata, data) in snapshot {
        let types = supported_metadata(&metadata)?;
        total = total
            .checked_add(data.rows.len())
            .context("archive row count overflow")?;
        ensure!(total <= MAX_ROWS, "portable archive exceeds 100000 rows");
        validate_rows(&metadata, &types, &data.rows)?;
        let rows = data
            .rows
            .into_iter()
            .map(|row| {
                row.into_iter()
                    .map(|cell| {
                        let json = encode_archive_cell(&cell, 0)?;
                        let decoded = decode_archive_cell(&json, 0)?;
                        ensure!(
                            cell == decoded,
                            "Cozo value is not losslessly representable in the archive codec"
                        );
                        Ok(json)
                    })
                    .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()
            })
            .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
        relations.push(ArchivedRelation { metadata, rows });
    }
    Ok(RelationArchive {
        format: FORMAT.into(),
        value_codec: CODEC.into(),
        relations,
    })
}

fn decode_archive(
    archive: &RelationArchive,
) -> Result<Vec<(RelationDescription, Vec<Vec<DataValue>>)>> {
    ensure!(
        archive.format == FORMAT && archive.value_codec == CODEC,
        "unsupported Cozo relation archive format/codec"
    );
    let names = archive
        .relations
        .iter()
        .map(|relation| relation.metadata.relation.name.clone())
        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
    checked_selection(&names)?;
    let mut total = 0usize;
    archive
        .relations
        .iter()
        .map(|relation| {
            let types = supported_metadata(&relation.metadata)?;
            total = total
                .checked_add(relation.rows.len())
                .context("archive row count overflow")?;
            ensure!(total <= MAX_ROWS, "portable archive exceeds 100000 rows");
            let rows = relation
                .rows
                .iter()
                .map(|row| {
                    row.iter()
                        .map(|cell| decode_archive_cell(cell, 0))
                        .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()
                })
                .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
            validate_rows(&relation.metadata, &types, &rows)?;
            Ok((relation.metadata.clone(), rows))
        })
        .collect()
}

// Cozo's Vector serde decoder requires borrowed native-endian bytes; it is
// not JSON-compatible. Store explicit IEEE bit words instead, including for
// vectors nested inside Any/List. Never invoke its unsafe byte decoder here.
fn encode_archive_cell(cell: &DataValue, depth: usize) -> Result<Value> {
    ensure!(depth <= 64, "archive value nesting exceeds 64 levels");
    match cell {
        DataValue::Vec(Vector::F32(values)) => {
            Ok(json!({"VecF32Bits":values.iter().map(|value| value.to_bits()).collect::<Vec<_>>()}))
        }
        DataValue::Vec(Vector::F64(values)) => {
            Ok(json!({"VecF64Bits":values.iter().map(|value| value.to_bits()).collect::<Vec<_>>()}))
        }
        DataValue::List(values) => Ok(
            json!({"List":values.iter().map(|value| encode_archive_cell(value, depth + 1)).collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?}),
        ),
        DataValue::Regex(_) | DataValue::Set(_) | DataValue::Bot => {
            bail!("internal Cozo values are not portable archive cells")
        }
        _ => Ok(serde_json::to_value(cell)?),
    }
}

fn decode_archive_cell(cell: &Value, depth: usize) -> Result<DataValue> {
    ensure!(depth <= 64, "archive value nesting exceeds 64 levels");
    if cell == "Null" {
        return Ok(DataValue::Null);
    }
    let object = cell
        .as_object()
        .context("invalid tagged Cozo archive cell")?;
    ensure!(
        object.len() == 1,
        "Cozo archive cell must have exactly one type tag"
    );
    let (tag, value) = object.iter().next().unwrap();
    match tag.as_str() {
        "List" => Ok(DataValue::List(
            value
                .as_array()
                .context("invalid Cozo list cell")?
                .iter()
                .map(|value| decode_archive_cell(value, depth + 1))
                .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?,
        )),
        "VecF32Bits" | "VecF64Bits" => {
            let values = value.as_array().context("invalid Cozo vector bits")?;
            ensure!(
                values.len() <= 1_000_000,
                "Cozo vector exceeds archive dimension limit"
            );
            if tag == "VecF32Bits" {
                let values = values
                    .iter()
                    .map(|value| {
                        let bits = value
                            .as_u64()
                            .and_then(|bits| u32::try_from(bits).ok())
                            .context("invalid F32 bit word")?;
                        Ok(f32::from_bits(bits))
                    })
                    .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
                Ok(DataValue::Vec(Vector::F32(values.into())))
            } else {
                let values = values
                    .iter()
                    .map(|value| {
                        Ok(f64::from_bits(
                            value.as_u64().context("invalid F64 bit word")?,
                        ))
                    })
                    .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
                Ok(DataValue::Vec(Vector::F64(values.into())))
            }
        }
        // Regex's upstream deserializer panics; native Vec expects borrowed
        // bytes. Reject both before calling any upstream serde implementation.
        "Bool" | "Num" | "Str" | "Bytes" | "Uuid" | "Json" | "Validity" => {
            serde_json::from_value(cell.clone()).context("invalid tagged Cozo value")
        }
        _ => bail!("unsupported/internal Cozo archive cell tag: {tag}"),
    }
}

fn validate_rows(
    meta: &RelationDescription,
    types: &[TypeSpec],
    rows: &[Vec<DataValue>],
) -> Result<()> {
    // Preserve native key equality/order (including numeric semantics).
    // TypeSpec::accepts rejects Regex and other internal values recursively
    // before insertion, so no key here contains the regex cache Clippy flags.
    #[allow(clippy::mutable_key_type)]
    let mut keys = BTreeSet::new();
    for row in rows {
        ensure!(
            row.len() == types.len(),
            "archive row width does not match schema"
        );
        for (value, typ) in row.iter().zip(types) {
            ensure!(
                typ.accepts(value),
                "archive value does not match its declared Cozo type"
            );
        }
        ensure!(
            keys.insert(row[..meta.relation.n_keys as usize].to_vec()),
            "archive contains duplicate relation keys"
        );
    }
    Ok(())
}

/// Parse only Cozo's canonical metadata type grammar, not executable default
/// expressions. This makes every generated :create fragment non-injectable
/// and lets the entire archive be type-checked before the first write.
enum TypeKind {
    Scalar(String),
    List(Box<TypeSpec>, Option<usize>),
    Tuple(Vec<TypeSpec>),
    Vector { f32: bool, length: usize },
}

struct TypeSpec {
    kind: TypeKind,
    nullable: bool,
}

impl TypeSpec {
    fn parse(source: &str) -> Result<Self> {
        ensure!(
            !source.is_empty() && source.len() <= 1024,
            "invalid Cozo archive type length"
        );
        let mut position = 0;
        let parsed = Self::parse_inner(source.as_bytes(), &mut position, 0)?;
        ensure!(
            position == source.len(),
            "unsupported or malformed Cozo archive type"
        );
        Ok(parsed)
    }

    fn parse_inner(bytes: &[u8], position: &mut usize, depth: usize) -> Result<Self> {
        ensure!(depth <= 32, "Cozo archive type nesting is too deep");
        let kind = match bytes.get(*position).copied() {
            Some(b'[') => {
                *position += 1;
                let inner = Self::parse_inner(bytes, position, depth + 1)?;
                let length = if bytes.get(*position) == Some(&b';') {
                    *position += 1;
                    Some(type_length(bytes, position)?)
                } else {
                    None
                };
                ensure!(
                    bytes.get(*position) == Some(&b']'),
                    "invalid Cozo list type"
                );
                *position += 1;
                TypeKind::List(Box::new(inner), length)
            }
            Some(b'(') => {
                *position += 1;
                let mut elements = Vec::new();
                while bytes.get(*position) != Some(&b')') {
                    elements.push(Self::parse_inner(bytes, position, depth + 1)?);
                    if bytes.get(*position) != Some(&b',') {
                        break;
                    }
                    *position += 1;
                }
                ensure!(
                    bytes.get(*position) == Some(&b')'),
                    "invalid Cozo tuple type"
                );
                *position += 1;
                TypeKind::Tuple(elements)
            }
            Some(b'<') => {
                *position += 1;
                let tail = &bytes[*position..];
                let f32 = if tail.starts_with(b"F32;") {
                    true
                } else if tail.starts_with(b"F64;") {
                    false
                } else {
                    bail!("unsupported Cozo vector type");
                };
                *position += 4;
                let length = type_length(bytes, position)?;
                ensure!(
                    length > 0 && bytes.get(*position) == Some(&b'>'),
                    "invalid Cozo vector dimension"
                );
                *position += 1;
                TypeKind::Vector { f32, length }
            }
            _ => {
                let start = *position;
                while bytes.get(*position).is_some_and(u8::is_ascii_alphabetic) {
                    *position += 1;
                }
                let scalar = std::str::from_utf8(&bytes[start..*position])?;
                ensure!(
                    matches!(
                        scalar,
                        "Any"
                            | "Bool"
                            | "Int"
                            | "Float"
                            | "String"
                            | "Bytes"
                            | "Uuid"
                            | "Json"
                            | "Validity"
                    ),
                    "unsupported Cozo archive type {scalar}"
                );
                TypeKind::Scalar(scalar.to_owned())
            }
        };
        let nullable = bytes.get(*position) == Some(&b'?');
        if nullable {
            *position += 1;
        }
        Ok(Self { kind, nullable })
    }

    fn accepts(&self, value: &DataValue) -> bool {
        if matches!(value, DataValue::Null) {
            return self.nullable;
        }
        if !portable_value(value) {
            return false;
        }
        match (&self.kind, value) {
            (TypeKind::Scalar(name), _) if name == "Any" => true,
            (TypeKind::Scalar(name), DataValue::Bool(_)) => name == "Bool",
            (TypeKind::Scalar(name), DataValue::Num(Num::Int(_))) => name == "Int",
            (TypeKind::Scalar(name), DataValue::Num(Num::Float(_))) => name == "Float",
            (TypeKind::Scalar(name), DataValue::Str(_)) => name == "String",
            (TypeKind::Scalar(name), DataValue::Bytes(_)) => name == "Bytes",
            (TypeKind::Scalar(name), DataValue::Uuid(_)) => name == "Uuid",
            (TypeKind::Scalar(name), DataValue::Json(_)) => name == "Json",
            (TypeKind::Scalar(name), DataValue::Validity(_)) => name == "Validity",
            (TypeKind::List(inner, length), DataValue::List(values)) => {
                length.is_none_or(|length| length == values.len())
                    && values.iter().all(|value| inner.accepts(value))
            }
            (TypeKind::Tuple(types), DataValue::List(values)) => {
                types.len() == values.len()
                    && types
                        .iter()
                        .zip(values)
                        .all(|(typ, value)| typ.accepts(value))
            }
            (TypeKind::Vector { f32: true, length }, DataValue::Vec(Vector::F32(values))) => {
                *length == values.len()
            }
            (TypeKind::Vector { f32: false, length }, DataValue::Vec(Vector::F64(values))) => {
                *length == values.len()
            }
            _ => false,
        }
    }
}

fn type_length(bytes: &[u8], position: &mut usize) -> Result<usize> {
    let start = *position;
    while bytes.get(*position).is_some_and(u8::is_ascii_digit) {
        *position += 1;
    }
    let length = std::str::from_utf8(&bytes[start..*position])?
        .parse::<usize>()
        .context("invalid Cozo type dimension")?;
    ensure!(
        length <= 1_000_000,
        "Cozo type dimension exceeds archive limits"
    );
    Ok(length)
}

fn portable_value(value: &DataValue) -> bool {
    match value {
        DataValue::Num(Num::Float(number)) => number.is_finite(),
        DataValue::List(values) => values.iter().all(portable_value),
        DataValue::Vec(Vector::F32(values)) => values.iter().all(|number| number.is_finite()),
        DataValue::Vec(Vector::F64(values)) => values.iter().all(|number| number.is_finite()),
        DataValue::Regex(_) | DataValue::Set(_) | DataValue::Bot => false,
        _ => true,
    }
}

fn restore_archive(store: &CozoGraphShuttle, archive: &RelationArchive) -> Result<()> {
    // Decode/validate every schema, type, row and key before issuing any
    // write. No temporary database or alternate identity/project store opens.
    let decoded = decode_archive(archive)?;
    let existing = list_relations(store)?;
    let existing_names = decoded
        .iter()
        .map(|(meta, _)| meta.relation.name.clone())
        .filter(|name| existing.iter().any(|relation| relation.name == *name))
        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
    let existing_metadata = if existing_names.is_empty() {
        vec![]
    } else {
        snapshot(store, &existing_names, false)?
    };
    for (meta, _) in &decoded {
        if let Some((current, _)) = existing_metadata
            .iter()
            .find(|(current, _)| current.relation.name == meta.relation.name)
        {
            supported_metadata(current)?;
            ensure!(current == meta, "existing relation {} has different metadata; restore requires a matching schema or a missing relation", meta.relation.name);
        }
    }
    let mut script = String::new();
    let mut checks = "{::relations} as _restore_catalog\n".to_owned();
    let mut params = BTreeMap::new();
    for (index, (meta, rows)) in decoded.iter().enumerate() {
        let name = &meta.relation.name;
        let fields = meta
            .columns
            .iter()
            .map(|column| column.column.clone())
            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
        let all = fields.join(",");
        let keys = fields[..meta.relation.n_keys as usize].join(",");
        let values = fields[meta.relation.n_keys as usize..].join(",");
        let bindings = if values.is_empty() {
            keys.clone()
        } else {
            format!("{keys} => {values}")
        };
        if existing_names.contains(name) {
            append_metadata_checks(&mut checks, &mut params, index, meta)?;
            // No relation/index removal or :replace: Cozo's persisted-range
            // cleanup precedes commit, so those would weaken rollback safety.
            if meta.relation.access_level != "normal" {
                script.push_str(&format!("{{::access_level normal {name}}}\n"));
            }
            script.push_str(&format!(
                "{{ ?[{keys}] := *{name}{{{keys}}} :rm {name} {{{keys}}} }}\n"
            ));
            script.push_str(&format!(
                "{{ ?[{all}] <- $rows{index} :put {name} {{{bindings}}} }}\n"
            ));
        } else {
            let key_types = meta.columns[..meta.relation.n_keys as usize]
                .iter()
                .map(|column| format!("{}: {}", column.column, column.type_name))
                .collect::<Vec<_>>()
                .join(",");
            let value_types = meta.columns[meta.relation.n_keys as usize..]
                .iter()
                .map(|column| format!("{}: {}", column.column, column.type_name))
                .collect::<Vec<_>>()
                .join(",");
            let schema = if value_types.is_empty() {
                key_types
            } else {
                format!("{key_types} => {value_types}")
            };
            script.push_str(&format!(
                "{{ ?[{all}] <- $rows{index} :create {name} {{{schema}}} }}\n"
            ));
            for ordinary in &meta.indices {
                let columns = ordinary.config["indices"]
                    .as_array()
                    .unwrap()
                    .iter()
                    .map(|value| fields[value.as_u64().unwrap() as usize].clone())
                    .collect::<Vec<_>>()
                    .join(",");
                script.push_str(&format!(
                    "{{::index create {name}:{} {{{columns}}}}}\n",
                    ordinary.name
                ));
            }
        }
        if meta.relation.access_level != "normal" {
            script.push_str(&format!(
                "{{::access_level {} {name}}}\n",
                meta.relation.access_level
            ));
        }
        params.insert(
            format!("rows{index}"),
            DataValue::List(rows.iter().cloned().map(DataValue::List).collect()),
        );
    }
    // The native imperative runner parses the whole script first, executes
    // its clauses in one engine transaction, and propagates commit failures.
    run(store, &format!("{checks}{script}"), params, false)?;
    Ok(())
}

fn append_metadata_checks(
    script: &mut String,
    params: &mut BTreeMap<String, DataValue>,
    index: usize,
    meta: &RelationDescription,
) -> Result<()> {
    let name = &meta.relation.name;
    params.insert(format!("relation{index}"), DataValue::from(name.as_str()));
    script.push_str(&format!("{{ ?[n,a,l,k,v,p,r,x,d] := *_restore_catalog[n,a,l,k,v,p,r,x,d], n = $relation{index} }} as _meta{index}\n"));
    script.push_str(&format!("{{::columns {name}}} as _check_columns{index}\n{{::indices {name}}} as _check_indices{index}\n{{::show_triggers {name}}} as _check_triggers{index}\n"));
    let relation = &meta.relation;
    let metadata = vec![vec![
        json!(relation.name),
        json!(relation.arity),
        json!(relation.access_level),
        json!(relation.n_keys),
        json!(relation.n_non_keys),
        json!(relation.n_put_triggers),
        json!(relation.n_rm_triggers),
        json!(relation.n_replace_triggers),
        json!(relation.description),
    ]];
    let columns = meta
        .columns
        .iter()
        .map(|column| {
            vec![
                json!(column.column),
                json!(column.is_key),
                json!(column.index),
                json!(column.type_name),
                json!(column.has_default),
            ]
        })
        .collect();
    let indices = meta
        .indices
        .iter()
        .map(|index| {
            vec![
                json!(index.name),
                json!(index.index_type),
                json!(index.relations),
                index.config.clone(),
            ]
        })
        .collect();
    append_row_equality(script, params, &format!("_meta{index}"), 9, metadata);
    append_row_equality(
        script,
        params,
        &format!("_check_columns{index}"),
        5,
        columns,
    );
    append_row_equality(
        script,
        params,
        &format!("_check_indices{index}"),
        4,
        indices,
    );
    append_row_equality(
        script,
        params,
        &format!("_check_triggers{index}"),
        3,
        meta.triggers
            .iter()
            .map(|trigger| {
                vec![
                    json!(trigger.event),
                    json!(trigger.idx),
                    json!(trigger.trigger),
                ]
            })
            .collect(),
    );
    Ok(())
}

fn append_row_equality(
    script: &mut String,
    params: &mut BTreeMap<String, DataValue>,
    table: &str,
    arity: usize,
    expected: Vec<Vec<Value>>,
) {
    let parameter = format!("expected{table}");
    let variables = (0..arity)
        .map(|index| format!("c{index}"))
        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
        .join(",");
    params.insert(
        parameter.clone(),
        DataValue::List(
            expected
                .into_iter()
                .map(|row| DataValue::List(row.into_iter().map(DataValue::from).collect()))
                .collect(),
        ),
    );
    // Symmetric difference must be empty. These assertions execute inside the
    // same transaction, before any row writes, closing the preflight/DDL race.
    script.push_str(&format!("{{ expected[{variables}] <- ${parameter}\n ?[{variables}] := *{table}[{variables}], not expected[{variables}]\n ?[{variables}] := expected[{variables}], not *{table}[{variables}]\n :assert none }}\n"));
}

fn archive_dir(root: &Path) -> Result<PathBuf> {
    if !root.exists() {
        fs::create_dir_all(root)?;
        fs::set_permissions(root, fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o700))?;
    }
    let metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(root)?;
    ensure!(
        metadata.is_dir() && !metadata.file_type().is_symlink(),
        "Cozo archive root must be a real directory"
    );
    ensure!(
        metadata.uid() == nix::unistd::geteuid().as_raw() && metadata.mode() & 0o022 == 0,
        "Cozo archive root must be owned by this service and not group/world writable"
    );
    fs::canonicalize(root).context("cannot resolve Cozo archive directory")
}

fn write_archive(root: &Path, label: &str, archive: &RelationArchive) -> Result<ArchiveReceipt> {
    ensure!(
        !label.is_empty()
            && label.len() <= 64
            && label
                .bytes()
                .all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || matches!(byte, b'_' | b'-')),
        "backup path is a short archive label, not a filesystem path"
    );
    let bytes = serde_json::to_vec(archive)?;
    ensure!(
        bytes.len() as u64 <= MAX_ARCHIVE_BYTES,
        "Cozo archive exceeds 64 MiB"
    );
    let hash = format!("{:x}", Sha256::digest(&bytes));
    let root = archive_dir(root)?;
    let id = uuid::Uuid::new_v4();
    let filename = format!("{label}-{id}.{hash}.cozo.json");
    let temporary = root.join(format!(".tmp-{id}"));
    let result = (|| -> Result<()> {
        let mut file = OpenOptions::new()
            .write(true)
            .create_new(true)
            .mode(0o400)
            .open(&temporary)?;
        file.write_all(&bytes)?;
        file.sync_all()?;
        // hard_link is an atomic, no-overwrite publication on this filesystem.
        fs::hard_link(&temporary, root.join(&filename))?;
        fs::remove_file(&temporary)?;
        File::open(&root)?.sync_all()?;
        Ok(())
    })();
    if result.is_err() {
        let _ = fs::remove_file(&temporary);
    }
    result?;
    Ok(ArchiveReceipt {
        archive: filename,
        sha256: hash,
        bytes: bytes.len() as u64,
        relations: archive
            .relations
            .iter()
            .map(|relation| relation.metadata.relation.name.clone())
            .collect(),
        rows: archive
            .relations
            .iter()
            .map(|relation| relation.rows.len() as u64)
            .sum(),
        format: FORMAT.into(),
        scope: "selected relations; not an engine or whole-host backup".into(),
    })
}

fn read_archive(root: &Path, filename: &str) -> Result<(RelationArchive, String)> {
    ensure!(
        filename.len() <= 256
            && filename
                .bytes()
                .all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || matches!(byte, b'_' | b'-' | b'.')),
        "restore requires an archive receipt basename"
    );
    let prefix = filename
        .strip_suffix(".cozo.json")
        .context("invalid Cozo archive suffix")?;
    let (_, hash) = prefix
        .rsplit_once('.')
        .context("archive name has no content digest")?;
    ensure!(
        hash.len() == 64 && hash.bytes().all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_hexdigit()),
        "invalid archive content digest"
    );
    let root = archive_dir(root)?;
    let file = OpenOptions::new()
        .read(true)
        .custom_flags(nix::libc::O_NOFOLLOW)
        .open(root.join(filename))?;
    let metadata = file.metadata()?;
    ensure!(
        metadata.is_file()
            && metadata.uid() == nix::unistd::geteuid().as_raw()
            && metadata.mode() & 0o222 == 0
            && metadata.len() <= MAX_ARCHIVE_BYTES,
        "restore requires a bounded immutable archive owned by this service"
    );
    let mut bytes = Vec::new();
    file.take(MAX_ARCHIVE_BYTES + 1).read_to_end(&mut bytes)?;
    ensure!(
        bytes.len() as u64 <= MAX_ARCHIVE_BYTES,
        "Cozo archive exceeds 64 MiB"
    );
    ensure!(
        format!("{:x}", Sha256::digest(&bytes)) == hash,
        "Cozo archive content digest mismatch"
    );
    Ok((
        serde_json::from_slice(&bytes).context("invalid Cozo relation archive")?,
        hash.to_owned(),
    ))
}

pub async fn dispatch_cozo_method(
    store: Arc<CozoGraphShuttle>,
    method: &str,
    args: &Value,
) -> Result<Value> {
    let root = std::env::var_os("OP_COZO_ARCHIVE_DIR")
        .map(PathBuf::from)
        .unwrap_or_else(|| "/var/lib/opdbus/cozo-archives".into());
    dispatch_cozo_with_archive_dir(store, root, method, args).await
}

pub async fn dispatch_cozo_with_archive_dir(
    store: Arc<CozoGraphShuttle>,
    archive_root: PathBuf,
    method: &str,
    args: &Value,
) -> Result<Value> {
    let method = method.to_owned();
    let args = args.clone();
    tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || dispatch_sync(&store, &archive_root, &method, &args))
        .await?
}

fn dispatch_sync(
    store: &CozoGraphShuttle,
    root: &Path,
    method: &str,
    args: &Value,
) -> Result<Value> {
    match method {
        "run_query" => {
            let input: RunQueryInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
            ensure!(
                !input.query.trim().is_empty() && input.query.len() <= 1024 * 1024,
                "Cozo query must contain 1..=1048576 bytes"
            );
            let params = input
                .params
                .into_iter()
                .map(|(name, value)| (name, DataValue::from(value)))
                .collect();
            let results = run(store, &input.query, params, false)?
                .flatten()
                .into_iter()
                .map(public_rows)
                .collect::<Result<_>>()?;
            Ok(serde_json::to_value(QueryOutput { results })?)
        }
        "list_relations" => {
            serde_json::from_value::<ListRelationsInput>(args.clone())?;
            Ok(serde_json::to_value(ListRelationsOutput {
                relations: list_relations(store)?,
            })?)
        }
        "describe_relation" => {
            let input: DescribeRelationInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
            let (metadata, _) = snapshot(store, &[input.name], false)?
                .into_iter()
                .next()
                .unwrap();
            Ok(serde_json::to_value(metadata)?)
        }
        "export_relations" => {
            let input: ExportRelationsInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
            checked_selection(&input.relations)?;
            let rows = store
                .db()
                .export_relations(input.relations.iter())
                .map_err(native_error)?;
            let data = rows
                .into_iter()
                .map(|(name, rows)| Ok((name, public_rows(rows)?)))
                .collect::<Result<_>>()?;
            Ok(serde_json::to_value(ExportOutput {
                encoding: "cozo-json".into(),
                data,
            })?)
        }
        "import_relations" => {
            let input: ImportRelationsInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
            let names = input.data.keys().cloned().collect::<Vec<_>>();
            checked_selection(&names)?;
            let metadata = snapshot(store, &names, false)?;
            let mut checks = "{::relations} as _restore_catalog\n".to_owned();
            let mut writes = String::new();
            let mut count = 0u64;
            let mut params = BTreeMap::new();
            for (index, (name, rows)) in input.data.into_iter().enumerate() {
                let meta = &metadata
                    .iter()
                    .find(|(meta, _)| meta.relation.name == name)
                    .context("import target metadata is missing")?
                    .0;
                ensure!(
                    !rows.headers.is_empty()
                        && rows.headers.iter().collect::<BTreeSet<_>>().len() == rows.headers.len(),
                    "import headers must be nonempty and unique"
                );
                let columns = meta
                    .columns
                    .iter()
                    .map(|column| column.column.as_str())
                    .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
                ensure!(
                    rows.headers.iter().all(|header| simple_ident(header))
                        && rows
                            .headers
                            .iter()
                            .map(String::as_str)
                            .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>()
                            == columns,
                    "import headers must exactly name the target relation columns"
                );
                ensure!(
                    rows.rows.iter().all(|row| row.len() == rows.headers.len()),
                    "import row/header length mismatch"
                );
                count += rows.rows.len() as u64;
                ensure!(
                    count <= MAX_ROWS as u64,
                    "native import exceeds 100000 rows"
                );
                append_metadata_checks(&mut checks, &mut params, index, meta)?;
                let keys = meta
                    .columns
                    .iter()
                    .filter(|column| column.is_key)
                    .map(|column| column.column.clone())
                    .collect::<Vec<_>>()
                    .join(",");
                let values = meta
                    .columns
                    .iter()
                    .filter(|column| !column.is_key)
                    .map(|column| column.column.clone())
                    .collect::<Vec<_>>()
                    .join(",");
                let bindings = if values.is_empty() {
                    keys
                } else {
                    format!("{keys} => {values}")
                };
                writes.push_str(&format!(
                    "{{ ?[{}] <- $import{index} :put {name} {{{bindings}}} }}\n",
                    rows.headers.join(",")
                ));
                params.insert(
                    format!("import{index}"),
                    DataValue::List(
                        rows.rows
                            .into_iter()
                            .map(|row| {
                                DataValue::List(row.into_iter().map(DataValue::from).collect())
                            })
                            .collect(),
                    ),
                );
            }
            // The bulk import helper skips advanced indexes and callbacks in
            // Cozo 0.7.6. Native :put programs preserve normal write semantics.
            run(store, &format!("{checks}{writes}"), params, false)?;
            Ok(serde_json::to_value(ImportOutput {
                relations: names,
                rows: count,
                committed: true,
                triggers_enabled: true,
            })?)
        }
        "backup" => {
            let input: BackupInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
            let names = if input.relations.is_empty() {
                list_relations(store)?
                    .into_iter()
                    .filter(|relation| relation.access_level != "index")
                    .map(|relation| relation.name)
                    .collect()
            } else {
                input.relations
            };
            let archive = archive_from_snapshot(snapshot(store, &names, true)?)?;
            Ok(serde_json::to_value(write_archive(
                root,
                &input.path,
                &archive,
            )?)?)
        }
        "restore" => {
            let input: RestoreInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
            let (archive, hash) = read_archive(root, &input.path)?;
            restore_archive(store, &archive)?;
            Ok(serde_json::to_value(RestoreReceipt {
                archive: input.path,
                sha256: hash,
                relations: archive
                    .relations
                    .iter()
                    .map(|relation| relation.metadata.relation.name.clone())
                    .collect(),
                rows: archive
                    .relations
                    .iter()
                    .map(|relation| relation.rows.len() as u64)
                    .sum(),
                committed: true,
                atomic: true,
                durability: "native_engine_transaction_commit".into(),
            })?)
        }
        _ => bail!("unknown cozo method: {method}"),
    }
}
</file>

<file path="op-plugins/src/state_plugins/cozo.rs">
//! CozoDB relational-graph-vector database plugin.
//!
//! Schema derived from CozoDB official documentation (docs.cozodb.org/en/latest/).
//! CozoDB is a Datalog database with dynamic schema — relations are created with
//! `:create` specifying key/value columns and types. The system exposes metadata
//! via `::relations`, `::columns`, `::indices` system ops.
//!
//! Column types (from docs.cozodb.org/en/latest/datatypes.html):
//!   Atomic: Int, Float, Bool, String, Bytes, Uuid, Json, Validity
//!   Composite: \[Type\] (list), (T1, T2) (tuple), <F32; N> (vector)
//!   Special: Any, Any? (nullable)
//!
//! The bridge supplies its existing cognitive Cozo handle; methods do not open
//! another database. Portable archives never invoke SQLite backup APIs.
//! Access levels: normal, protected, read_only, hidden

use schemars::JsonSchema;

use anyhow::Result;
use async_trait::async_trait;
use op_state::{ApplyResult, Checkpoint, DiffMetadata, PluginCapabilities, StateDiff, StatePlugin};
use op_state_store::PluginSchema;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use simd_json::OwnedValue as Value;

#[path = "cozo_methods.rs"]
pub mod methods;
pub use methods::dispatch_cozo_method;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct RunQueryInput {
    pub query: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub params: std::collections::HashMap<String, serde_json::Value>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct ImportRelationsInput {
    /// Native Cozo JSON headers/rows. Existing relations must already exist.
    /// Transactional puts maintain indexes and enable declared triggers.
    pub data: std::collections::BTreeMap<String, methods::RelationRows>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct ExportRelationsInput {
    pub relations: Vec<String>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct BackupInput {
    /// A short archive label, not a filesystem path. The receipt names a unique
    /// immutable artifact beneath OP_COZO_ARCHIVE_DIR.
    pub path: String,
    /// Empty selects all base relations. Archives reject defaults, triggers,
    /// advanced indexes, hidden relations, and nonempty descriptions because
    /// Cozo 0.7.6 cannot expose/recreate that metadata faithfully here.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub relations: Vec<String>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct RestoreInput {
    /// Exact artifact basename from backup's receipt. Existing relation
    /// metadata must match; missing relations are created atomically.
    pub path: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct ListRelationsInput {}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct DescribeRelationInput {
    pub name: String,
}

/// CozoDB column definition — mirrors `::columns` system op output.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct CozoColumn {
    /// Column name.
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "exp.software.cozo.column.name@v1"))]
    pub name: String,
    /// Column type (Int, Float, Bool, String, Bytes, Uuid, Json, Validity, Any, Any?).
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "obs.software.cozo.column.type@v1"))]
    pub r#type: String,
    /// Whether this column is a key in the :create specification.
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "obs.software.cozo.column.is-key@v1"))]
    pub is_key: bool,
    /// Default value for the column.
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "obs.software.cozo.column.default@v1"))]
    pub default: Option<String>,
    /// Column description.
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "exp.software.cozo.column.description@v1"))]
    pub description: String,
}

/// CozoDB index definition — mirrors `::indices` system op output.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct CozoIndex {
    pub name: String, // e.g. "relation_name:index_name"
    pub relation: String,
    pub columns: Vec<String>,
}

/// CozoDB trigger — mirrors `::show_triggers` system op output.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct CozoTrigger {
    pub relation: String,
    pub event: String, // "put", "rm", "replace"
    pub query: String,
}

/// CozoDB stored relation — mirrors `::relations` + `::columns` system op output.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct CozoRelation {
    pub name: String,
    pub description: String,
    pub keys: Vec<CozoColumn>,
    pub values: Vec<CozoColumn>,
    pub access_level: String, // normal, protected, read_only, hidden
    pub row_count: Option<u64>,
}

/// CozoDB HNSW vector index — from docs.cozodb.org/en/latest/vector.html
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct CozoHnswIndex {
    pub name: String,
    pub relation: String,
    pub vector_column: String,
    pub dim: u32,
    pub dtype: String, // "f32" or "f64"
    pub m: u32,
    pub ef_construction: u32,
    pub ef_search: u32,
    pub distance: String, // "Cosine", "Euclid", "Dot"
}

/// Top-level CozoDB plugin state — the shape the projection tree exposes.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "sch.software.plugin.cozo.schema@v1"))]
#[schemars(extend("x-oscal-category" = "data"))]
pub struct CozoState {
    /// CozoDB engine type.
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "src.software.plugin.cozo.engine@v1"))]
    pub engine: String,
    /// Database path (empty for mem).
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "src.software.plugin.cozo.path@v1"))]
    pub path: String,
    /// CozoDB version.
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "obs.software.plugin.cozo.version@v1"))]
    pub version: String,
    /// Registered database relations.
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "obs.software.plugin.cozo.relations@v1"))]
    pub relations: Vec<CozoRelation>,
    /// Database indices.
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "obs.software.plugin.cozo.indices@v1"))]
    pub indices: Vec<CozoIndex>,
    /// HNSW vector indices.
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "obs.software.plugin.cozo.hnsw-indices@v1"))]
    pub hnsw_indices: Vec<CozoHnswIndex>,
    /// Database triggers.
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "obs.software.plugin.cozo.triggers@v1"))]
    pub triggers: Vec<CozoTrigger>,
    /// Currently running queries count.
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "obs.software.plugin.cozo.running-queries@v1"))]
    pub running_queries: u32,
}

pub struct CozoPlugin;

impl Default for CozoPlugin {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self
    }
}

impl CozoPlugin {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self
    }
}

#[async_trait]
impl StatePlugin for CozoPlugin {
    fn name(&self) -> &str {
        "cozo"
    }

    fn version(&self) -> &str {
        "2.0.0"
    }

    fn schema(&self) -> Option<PluginSchema> {
        let mut schema = cozo_schema();
        super::common::oscal::ensure_category_metadata_fields(&mut schema);
        Some(schema)
    }

    async fn calculate_diff(&self, _current: &Value, _desired: &Value) -> Result<StateDiff> {
        Ok(StateDiff {
            plugin: self.name().to_string(),
            actions: vec![],
            metadata: DiffMetadata {
                timestamp: chrono::Utc::now().timestamp(),
                current_hash: String::new(),
                desired_hash: String::new(),
            },
        })
    }

    async fn apply_state(&self, _diff: &StateDiff) -> Result<ApplyResult> {
        Ok(ApplyResult {
            success: true,
            changes_applied: vec![],
            errors: vec![],
            checkpoint: None,
        })
    }

    async fn verify_state(&self, _desired: &Value) -> Result<bool> {
        Ok(true)
    }

    async fn create_checkpoint(&self) -> Result<Checkpoint> {
        Ok(Checkpoint {
            id: uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string(),
            plugin: self.name().to_string(),
            timestamp: chrono::Utc::now().timestamp(),
            state_snapshot: simd_json::json!(null),
            backend_checkpoint: None,
        })
    }

    async fn rollback(&self, _checkpoint: &Checkpoint) -> Result<()> {
        Ok(())
    }

    fn capabilities(&self) -> PluginCapabilities {
        PluginCapabilities {
            supports_rollback: false,
            supports_checkpoints: true,
            supports_verification: true,
            atomic_operations: false,
        }
    }
}

pub(crate) fn cozo_schema() -> PluginSchema {
    let root = serde_json::to_value(schemars::schema_for!(CozoState))
        .expect("schemars schema serializes to JSON");
    let mut schema = super::schemars_adapter::plugin_schema_from_json(
        "cozo",
        "2.0.0",
        "CozoDB relational-graph-vector database — relations, indices, HNSW, triggers, Datalog",
        &root,
    );
    schema.category = "data".to_string();
    schema.subids.insert(
        "__schema__".to_string(),
        "sch.software.plugin.cozo.schema@v1".to_string(),
    );
    schema.subids.insert(
        "engine".to_string(),
        "src.software.plugin.cozo.engine@v1".to_string(),
    );
    schema.subids.insert(
        "path".to_string(),
        "src.software.plugin.cozo.path@v1".to_string(),
    );
    schema.subids.insert(
        "version".to_string(),
        "obs.software.plugin.cozo.version@v1".to_string(),
    );
    schema.subids.insert(
        "relations".to_string(),
        "obs.software.plugin.cozo.relations@v1".to_string(),
    );
    schema.subids.insert(
        "indices".to_string(),
        "obs.software.plugin.cozo.indices@v1".to_string(),
    );
    schema.subids.insert(
        "hnsw_indices".to_string(),
        "obs.software.plugin.cozo.hnsw-indices@v1".to_string(),
    );
    schema.subids.insert(
        "triggers".to_string(),
        "obs.software.plugin.cozo.triggers@v1".to_string(),
    );
    schema.subids.insert(
        "running_queries".to_string(),
        "obs.software.plugin.cozo.running-queries@v1".to_string(),
    );

    schema.methods.insert(
        "run_query".to_string(),
        super::plugin_scaffold_helpers::method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<
            RunQueryInput,
            methods::QueryOutput,
        >(
            "run_query",
            op_state_store::SideEffect::Mutation, // Assuming it could mutate data
            false,
            "cap.data.cozo.query.run@v1",
            "mut.data.cozo.query.run@v1",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "import_relations".to_string(),
        super::plugin_scaffold_helpers::method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<
            ImportRelationsInput,
            methods::ImportOutput,
        >(
            "import_relations",
            op_state_store::SideEffect::Mutation,
            false,
            "cap.data.cozo.relations.import@v1",
            "mut.data.cozo.relations.import@v1",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "export_relations".to_string(),
        super::plugin_scaffold_helpers::method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<
            ExportRelationsInput,
            methods::ExportOutput,
        >(
            "export_relations",
            op_state_store::SideEffect::Read,
            true,
            "cap.data.cozo.relations.export@v1",
            "obs.data.cozo.relations.export@v1",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "backup".to_string(),
        super::plugin_scaffold_helpers::method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<
            BackupInput,
            methods::ArchiveReceipt,
        >(
            "backup",
            op_state_store::SideEffect::Mutation,
            false,
            "cap.data.cozo.backup.create@v1",
            "mut.data.cozo.backup.create@v1",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "restore".to_string(),
        super::plugin_scaffold_helpers::method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<
            RestoreInput,
            methods::RestoreReceipt,
        >(
            "restore",
            op_state_store::SideEffect::Mutation,
            false,
            "cap.data.cozo.backup.restore@v1",
            "mut.data.cozo.backup.restore@v1",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "list_relations".to_string(),
        super::plugin_scaffold_helpers::method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<
            ListRelationsInput,
            methods::ListRelationsOutput,
        >(
            "list_relations",
            op_state_store::SideEffect::Read,
            true,
            "cap.data.cozo.relations.list@v1",
            "obs.data.cozo.relations.list@v1",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "describe_relation".to_string(),
        super::plugin_scaffold_helpers::method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<
            DescribeRelationInput,
            methods::RelationDescription,
        >(
            "describe_relation",
            op_state_store::SideEffect::Read,
            true,
            "cap.data.cozo.relation.describe@v1",
            "obs.data.cozo.relation.describe@v1",
        ),
    );

    schema.capabilities.insert(
        "cap.data.cozo.query.run@v1".to_string(),
        op_state_store::CapabilityDecl {
            id: "cap.data.cozo.query.run@v1".to_string(),
            description: "Grants: run_query.".to_string(),
        },
    );
    schema.capabilities.insert(
        "cap.data.cozo.relations.import@v1".to_string(),
        op_state_store::CapabilityDecl {
            id: "cap.data.cozo.relations.import@v1".to_string(),
            description: "Grants: import_relations.".to_string(),
        },
    );
    schema.capabilities.insert(
        "cap.data.cozo.relations.export@v1".to_string(),
        op_state_store::CapabilityDecl {
            id: "cap.data.cozo.relations.export@v1".to_string(),
            description: "Grants: export_relations.".to_string(),
        },
    );
    schema.capabilities.insert(
        "cap.data.cozo.backup.create@v1".to_string(),
        op_state_store::CapabilityDecl {
            id: "cap.data.cozo.backup.create@v1".to_string(),
            description: "Grants: backup.".to_string(),
        },
    );
    schema.capabilities.insert(
        "cap.data.cozo.backup.restore@v1".to_string(),
        op_state_store::CapabilityDecl {
            id: "cap.data.cozo.backup.restore@v1".to_string(),
            description: "Grants: restore.".to_string(),
        },
    );
    schema.capabilities.insert(
        "cap.data.cozo.relations.list@v1".to_string(),
        op_state_store::CapabilityDecl {
            id: "cap.data.cozo.relations.list@v1".to_string(),
            description: "Grants: list_relations.".to_string(),
        },
    );
    schema.capabilities.insert(
        "cap.data.cozo.relation.describe@v1".to_string(),
        op_state_store::CapabilityDecl {
            id: "cap.data.cozo.relation.describe@v1".to_string(),
            description: "Grants: describe_relation.".to_string(),
        },
    );

    schema
}

inventory::submit! {
    crate::default_registry::PluginReg::new("cozo", |_ctx| std::sync::Arc::new(CozoPlugin::new()))
}
</file>

<file path="op-plugins/src/state_plugins/cron.rs">
//! Global operator cron surface backed by the v0.8.4 tched-router gateway.
//!
//! The plugin owns this schema. The native gateway owns the install-wide job
//! store and applies the configured agent's risk/tool policy at execution.
//! OP-DBUS verifies the current SID1 session and exact method capability before
//! dispatch; those credentials are never forwarded to the gateway.

use anyhow::{bail, Result};
use async_trait::async_trait;
use op_state::{ApplyResult, Checkpoint, PluginCapabilities, StateDiff, StatePlugin};
use op_state_store::{CapabilityDecl, PluginSchema, SideEffect};
use schemars::JsonSchema;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use simd_json::OwnedValue as Value;
pub const MAX_CRON_JOBS: usize = 4096;
pub const MAX_CRON_HISTORY: u32 = 100;
pub const MAX_CRON_TEXT_BYTES: usize = 256 * 1024;
pub const MAX_CRON_TOOL_NAMES: usize = 256;
fn default_true() -> bool {
    true
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum CronScope {
    GlobalDaemon,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum CronEventSequencing {

pub struct CronPlugin;
impl Default for CronPlugin {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self
    }
}
impl CronPlugin {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self
    }
}

#[async_trait]
impl StatePlugin for CronPlugin {
    fn name(&self) -> &str {
        "cron"
    }
    fn version(&self) -> &str {
        "2.1.0"
    }
    fn schema(&self) -> Option<PluginSchema> {
        let mut schema = cron_schema();
        super::common::oscal::ensure_category_metadata_fields(&mut schema);
        Some(schema)
    }
    async fn calculate_diff(&self, _: &Value, _: &Value) -> Result<StateDiff> {
        bail!("cron state is observed from the native gateway; use a declared cron method")
    }
    async fn apply_state(&self, _: &StateDiff) -> Result<ApplyResult> {
        bail!("cron has no generic apply operation; use a declared cron method")
    }
    async fn verify_state(&self, _: &Value) -> Result<bool> {
        bail!("cron has no generic desired-state verification operation")
    }
    async fn create_checkpoint(&self) -> Result<Checkpoint> {
        bail!("cron does not own native gateway checkpoints")
    }
    async fn rollback(&self, _: &Checkpoint) -> Result<()> {
        bail!("cron does not own native gateway rollback")
    }
    fn capabilities(&self) -> PluginCapabilities {
        PluginCapabilities {
            supports_rollback: false,
            supports_checkpoints: false,
            supports_verification: false,
            atomic_operations: false,
        }
    }
}

pub(crate) fn cron_schema() -> PluginSchema {
    let root = serde_json::to_value(schemars::schema_for!(CronStateV2))
        .expect("cron state schema serializes");
    let mut schema = super::schemars_adapter::plugin_schema_from_json(
        "cron",
        "2.1.0",
        "Global operator view and management of the native tched-router cron store",
        &root,
    );
    macro_rules! method {
        ($name:literal, $input:ty, $output:ty, $effect:expr, $idem:expr, $cap:literal, $subid:literal) => {
            schema.methods.insert(
                $name.into(),
                super::plugin_scaffold_helpers::method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<
                    $input,
                    $output,
                >($name, $effect, $idem, $cap, $subid),
            );
        };
    }
    method!(
        "list_jobs",
        ListJobsInput,
        ListJobsOutput,
        SideEffect::Read,
        true,
        "cron.read",
        "obs.service.cron.job.list@v1"
    );
    method!(
        "get_job",
        JobIdInput,
        GetJobOutput,
        SideEffect::Read,
        true,
        "cron.read",
        "obs.service.cron.job.get@v1"
    );
    method!(
        "get_history",
        GetHistoryInput,
        GetHistoryOutput,
        SideEffect::Read,
        true,
        "cron.read",
        "obs.service.cron.history.get@v1"
    );
    method!(
        "create_job",
        CreateJobInput,
        JobMutationOutput,
        SideEffect::Mutation,
        false,
        "cron.invoke",
        "mut.service.cron.job.create@v1"
    );
    method!(
        "update_job",
        UpdateJobInput,
        JobMutationOutput,
        SideEffect::Mutation,
        false,
        "cron.invoke",
        "mut.service.cron.job.update@v1"
    );
    method!(
        "delete_job",
        JobIdInput,
        DeleteJobOutput,
        SideEffect::Mutation,
        false,
        "cron.invoke",
        "mut.service.cron.job.delete@v1"
    );
    method!(
        "enable_job",
        JobIdInput,
        JobMutationOutput,
        SideEffect::Mutation,
        true,
        "cron.invoke",
        "mut.service.cron.job.enable@v1"
    );
    method!(
        "disable_job",
        JobIdInput,
        JobMutationOutput,
        SideEffect::Mutation,
        true,
        "cron.invoke",
        "mut.service.cron.job.disable@v1"
    );
    method!(
        "run_job",
        JobIdInput,
        RunJobOutput,
        SideEffect::Mutation,
        false,
        "cron.invoke",
        "mut.service.cron.job.run@v1"
    );
    schema.capabilities.insert("cron.read".into(), CapabilityDecl {
        id: "cron.read".into(),
        description: "Global operator observation of the native daemon cron job store and run history. Job prompts, commands, delivery targets, and outputs may be present.".into(),
    });
    schema.capabilities.insert("cron.invoke".into(), CapabilityDecl {
        id: "cron.invoke".into(),
        description: "Global operator management and manual execution of native daemon cron jobs. Creating an enabled job delegates future autonomous runs to its configured native agent risk/tool policy; later runs do not re-check the originating OP-DBUS grant.".into(),
    });
    // The global job store may contain prompts, commands, delivery targets and
    // outputs. No field is exposed on the shared public projection by default.
    schema.example = Some(simd_json::json!({
        "scope":"global_daemon",
        "event_stream":{"sequencing":"unsequenced","delivery":"best_effort"},
        "jobs":[]
    }));
    schema
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    #[test]
    fn retained_methods_are_exact_and_typed() {
        let schema = cron_schema();
        let expected = [
            "create_job",
            "delete_job",
            "disable_job",
            "enable_job",
            "get_history",
            "get_job",
            "list_jobs",
            "run_job",
            "update_job",
        ];
        let mut actual = schema
            .methods
            .keys()
            .map(String::as_str)
            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
        actual.sort_unstable();
        assert_eq!(actual, expected);
        assert!(schema
            .methods
            .values()
            .all(|decl| decl.args != simd_json::json!(null)));
        assert!(schema.methods.values().all(|decl| decl
            .returns
            .as_ref()
            .is_some_and(|schema| schema != &simd_json::json!(null))));
        assert!(schema.public_state.paths.is_empty());
    }
    #[test]
    fn unknown_and_cross_variant_create_fields_fail() {
        assert!(serde_json::from_value::<CreateJobInput>(serde_json::json!({
            "job_type":"agent", "agent":"operator", "schedule":"*/5 * * * *",
            "prompt":"digest", "command":"echo bypass"
        }))
        .is_err());
        assert!(serde_json::from_value::<JobIdInput>(serde_json::json!({
            "job_id":"id", "sealed_id":"caller-supplied"
        }))
        .is_err());
    }
    #[test]
    fn global_state_example_matches_contract() {
        let state: CronStateV2 = serde_json::from_value(serde_json::json!({
            "scope":"global_daemon",
            "event_stream":{"sequencing":"unsequenced","delivery":"best_effort"},
            "jobs":[]
        }))
        .unwrap();
        assert!(state.jobs.is_empty());
        assert_eq!(state.event_stream, CronEventStreamIntegrity::default());
    }
}

inventory::submit! {
    crate::default_registry::PluginReg::new("cron", |_ctx| std::sync::Arc::new(CronPlugin::new()))
}
</file>

//! Durable singleton configuration and pure significance rules for the
//! control-plane chatbot. RuntimeDocuments owns the service-scoped row; this
//! module does not create an episode collection or embedding authority.

use super::ctl_plane_chatbot::{
    CtlPlaneChatbotConfig, KnowledgePush, OutcomeClass, ReasoningEpisode, Significance,
    SignificanceLevel,
};
use super::embedding_model::methods::{
    EmbedInput, EmbedOutput, EmbeddingInputType, EmbeddingProvider,
};
use super::runtime_documents::RuntimeDocuments;
use super::tched_router::{MAX_CHAT_REQUEST_BYTES, MAX_CHAT_RESPONSE_BYTES};
use anyhow::{ensure, Context, Result};
use schemars::JsonSchema;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use serde_json::Value;
use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
use std::sync::Arc;

pub const CONFIG_DOCUMENT_ID: &str = "ctl_plane_chatbot.singleton_config.v2";
const MAX_CONFIG_BYTES: usize = 64 * 1024;
const MAX_REASONING_SUMMARY_BYTES: usize = 64 * 1024;
const MAX_TOOLS: usize = 256;

pub struct CompletedChatEpisode {
    pub scope: op_cozo_store::EpisodeScope,
    pub conversation_id: Option<String>,
    pub goal_text: Option<String>,
    pub decision_output: String,
    pub tools: Vec<String>,
    pub started_at: chrono::DateTime<chrono::Utc>,
    pub ended_at: chrono::DateTime<chrono::Utc>,
}

/// An event-triggered agent run, committed as an episode in the agent's own
/// scope (`Trigger::SystemEvent`), with its run record.
pub struct CompletedAgentRun {
    pub scope: op_cozo_store::EpisodeScope,
    pub trigger_id: String,
    pub goal_text: String,
    pub summary: String,
    pub tools: Vec<String>,
    pub started_at: chrono::DateTime<chrono::Utc>,
    pub ended_at: chrono::DateTime<chrono::Utc>,
    pub run: super::ctl_plane_chatbot::RunRecord,
}

pub fn build_completed_agent_run(
    input: CompletedAgentRun,
) -> Result<op_cozo_store::ScopedEpisodeRecord> {
    use super::ctl_plane_chatbot::{ExitReason, RunStatus, Trigger};
    ensure!(
        input.ended_at >= input.started_at,
        "agent run ended before it started"
    );
    let duration_ms = u64::try_from(
        input
            .ended_at
            .signed_duration_since(input.started_at)
            .num_milliseconds(),
    )
    .context("agent run duration is invalid")?;
    let (exit_reason, outcome_class) = match input.run.status {
        RunStatus::Succeeded if input.run.actions.iter().any(|a| a.ok) => {
            (ExitReason::ToolCall, OutcomeClass::GoalAchieved)
        }
        RunStatus::Succeeded => (ExitReason::ResponseEmitted, OutcomeClass::GoalAchieved),
        RunStatus::Timeout | RunStatus::Dropped => {
            (ExitReason::Interrupt, OutcomeClass::Interrupted)
        }
        RunStatus::Failed => (ExitReason::ResponseEmitted, OutcomeClass::Inconclusive),
    };
    let mut episode = ReasoningEpisode {
        principal_id: input.scope.principal_id.clone(),
        session_id: input.scope.session_id.clone(),
        session_genesis: input.scope.session_genesis.clone(),
        on_behalf_of: input.scope.principal_id.clone(),
        episode_id: uuid::Uuid::now_v7().to_string(),
        started_at: input.started_at.to_rfc3339(),
        ended_at: input.ended_at.to_rfc3339(),
        duration_ms,
        trigger: Trigger::SystemEvent,
        exit_reason,
        goal_text: Some(input.goal_text),
        reasoning_summary: None,
        tools_consulted: input.tools,
        decision_output: Some(input.summary),
        outcome_class,
        confidence: None,
        plugin_id: Some("persona".into()),
        conversation_id: Some(format!("trigger:{}", input.trigger_id)),
        content_hash: String::new(),
        pii_flagged: true,
        run: Some(input.run),
    };
    episode.content_hash = episode_content_hash(&episode)?;
    validate_episode(&episode)?;
    Ok(op_cozo_store::ScopedEpisodeRecord {
        scope: input.scope,
        episode_id: episode.episode_id.clone(),
        content_hash: episode.content_hash.clone(),
        episode: serde_json::to_value(episode)?,
        embedding: None,
    })
}

pub fn build_completed_chat_episode(
    input: CompletedChatEpisode,
) -> Result<op_cozo_store::ScopedEpisodeRecord> {
    ensure!(
        input.ended_at >= input.started_at,
        "chat episode ended before it started"
    );
    let duration_ms = input
        .ended_at
        .signed_duration_since(input.started_at)
        .num_milliseconds();
    let duration_ms = u64::try_from(duration_ms).context("chat episode duration is invalid")?;
    let mut episode = ReasoningEpisode {
        principal_id: input.scope.principal_id.clone(),
        session_id: input.scope.session_id.clone(),
        session_genesis: input.scope.session_genesis.clone(),
        on_behalf_of: input.scope.principal_id.clone(),
        episode_id: uuid::Uuid::now_v7().to_string(),
        started_at: input.started_at.to_rfc3339(),
        ended_at: input.ended_at.to_rfc3339(),
        duration_ms,
        trigger: super::ctl_plane_chatbot::Trigger::Goal,
        exit_reason: super::ctl_plane_chatbot::ExitReason::ResponseEmitted,
        goal_text: input.goal_text,
        reasoning_summary: None,
        tools_consulted: input.tools,
        decision_output: Some(input.decision_output),
        outcome_class: OutcomeClass::Inconclusive,
        confidence: None,
        plugin_id: Some("tched_router".into()),
        conversation_id: input.conversation_id,
        content_hash: String::new(),
        pii_flagged: true,
        run: None,
    };
    episode.content_hash = episode_content_hash(&episode)?;
    validate_episode(&episode)?;
    Ok(op_cozo_store::ScopedEpisodeRecord {
        scope: input.scope,
        episode_id: episode.episode_id.clone(),
        content_hash: episode.content_hash.clone(),
        episode: serde_json::to_value(episode)?,
        embedding: None,
    })
}

    pub config: CtlPlaneChatbotConfig,
    pub revision: u64,
    /// Whether the committed config value differs from the preceding row. A
    /// successful same-value CAS still advances the durable revision.
    pub changed: bool,
    pub publication: ConfigPublication,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub diagnostic: Option<String>,
}

pub struct GetDoorbellInput {}

/// How the verified caller rings in: its private-view owner key (also its
/// MQTT client id), the one topic it may subscribe to, and the WSS listener.
/// The credential is the caller's own door credential, never issued here.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct GetDoorbellOutput {
    /// `sha256(principal, session, genesis)` — opaque to the broker.
    pub owner_key: String,
    /// `opdbus/wake/<owner_key>`.
    pub topic: String,
    /// `wss://<host:port>` of the broker's doorbell listener.
    pub listener: String,
    /// Password prefixes the doorbell accepts (`sid1:` inline, `oia1:` base64).
    pub password_prefixes: Vec<String>,
    /// The private state children a wake tells the caller to re-read.
    pub knowledge_paths: Vec<String>,
}

pub struct ListKnowledgeOutput {

    pub knowledge_count: u64,
    /// The scope revision (shared with episodes); a wake carries it as `seq`.
    pub episode_revision: u64,
    pub knowledge_truncated: bool,
}
