}

/// Exact nested request for the canonical embedding owner. PII-marked
/// episodes omit all three fields that the episode schema classifies as PII.
pub fn plan_vectorization(episode: &ReasoningEpisode) -> Result<EmbedInput> {
    validate_episode(episode)?;
    let mut lines = vec![
        format!("episode_id: {}", episode.episode_id),
        format!("trigger: {}", serde_json::to_string(&episode.trigger)?),
        format!(
            "exit_reason: {}",
            serde_json::to_string(&episode.exit_reason)?
        ),
        format!(
            "outcome_class: {}",
            serde_json::to_string(&episode.outcome_class)?
        ),
        format!("tools_consulted: {}", episode.tools_consulted.join(", ")),
    ];
    if !episode.pii_flagged {
        if let Some(goal) = &episode.goal_text {
            lines.push(format!("goal: {goal}"));
        }
        if let Some(reasoning) = &episode.reasoning_summary {
            lines.push(format!("reasoning: {reasoning}"));
        }
        if let Some(decision) = &episode.decision_output {
            lines.push(format!("decision: {decision}"));
        }
    }
    Ok(EmbedInput {
        texts: vec![lines.join("\n")],
        // The canonical embedding owner maps this semantic role only onto
        // providers that expose a native retrieval input-type field.
        input_type: Some(EmbeddingInputType::Document),
        truncate: false,
    })
}

pub fn complete_vectorization(
    episode: &ReasoningEpisode,
    mut embedded: EmbedOutput,
) -> Result<VectorizeOutput> {
    ensure!(
        embedded.vectors.len() == 1,
        "embedding owner returned an invalid vector count"
    );
    let vector = embedded.vectors.remove(0);
    ensure!(
        vector.len() == embedded.dimensions as usize,
        "embedding owner returned an invalid vector length"
    );
    Ok(VectorizeOutput {
        episode_id: episode.episode_id.clone(),
        content_hash: episode.content_hash.clone(),
        vector,
        dimensions: embedded.dimensions,
        model: embedded.model,
        provider_model: embedded.provider_model,
        provider: embedded.provider,
        config_revision: embedded.config_revision,
    })
}

pub fn cosine_similarity(left: &[f32], right: &[f32]) -> Result<f32> {
    ensure!(
        !left.is_empty() && left.len() == right.len(),
        "embedding vectors must have the same nonzero dimension"
    );
    let mut dot = 0.0_f64;
    let mut left_norm = 0.0_f64;
    let mut right_norm = 0.0_f64;
    for (&left, &right) in left.iter().zip(right) {
        ensure!(
            left.is_finite() && right.is_finite(),
            "embedding vector is not finite"
        );
        let left = f64::from(left);
        let right = f64::from(right);
        dot += left * right;
        left_norm += left * left;
        right_norm += right * right;
    }
    ensure!(
        dot.is_finite() && left_norm.is_finite() && right_norm.is_finite(),
        "embedding similarity overflowed"
    );
    if left_norm == 0.0 || right_norm == 0.0 {
        return Ok(0.0);
    }
    let score = dot / (left_norm.sqrt() * right_norm.sqrt());
    ensure!(score.is_finite(), "embedding similarity is not finite");
    Ok(score.clamp(-1.0, 1.0) as f32)
}

pub struct ConfigCommit {
    pub output: SetConfigOutput,
    /// Exact config fields represented by this durable row. MutationEngine
    /// merges these at the plugin root and preserves every unrelated child.
    pub represented_state: Value,
}

pub struct CtlPlaneChatbotMethods {
    documents: Arc<RuntimeDocuments>,
}

impl CtlPlaneChatbotMethods {
    pub fn new(documents: Arc<RuntimeDocuments>) -> Self {
        Self { documents }
    }

    pub async fn get_config(&self, input: GetConfigInput) -> Result<GetConfigOutput> {
        let _ = input;
        match self.documents.read_durable(CONFIG_DOCUMENT_ID).await? {
            None => Ok(GetConfigOutput {
                config: None,
                revision: 0,
            }),
            Some(row) => {
                let config = parse_config(row.document).with_context(|| {
                    format!(
                        "stored chatbot config at revision {} is unsupported or invalid; replace through set_config with expected_revision={}",
                        row.revision, row.revision
                    )
                })?;
                ensure!(row.revision > 0, "chatbot config row has invalid revision");
                Ok(GetConfigOutput {
                    config: Some(config),
                    revision: row.revision,
                })
            }
        }
    }

    pub async fn set_config(&self, input: SetConfigInput) -> Result<ConfigCommit> {
        validate_config(&input.config)?;
        let expected_revision = input.expected_revision;
        let candidate = input.config;
        let stored_candidate = candidate.clone();
        let (row, changed) = self
            .documents
            .update_at_revision_with_result(
                CONFIG_DOCUMENT_ID,
                expected_revision,
                move |previous| {
                    // Full replacement with an exact revision must also be
                    // able to repair an older, unsupported policy document.
                    // Validate the candidate, not the superseded intent.
                    let replacement = serde_json::to_value(&stored_candidate)?;
                    let changed = previous.as_ref() != Some(&replacement);
                    Ok((replacement, changed))
                },
            )
            .await?;
        let config = parse_config(row.document)?;
        ensure!(
            config == candidate,
            "durable chatbot config readback differs from the committed candidate"
        );
        Ok(ConfigCommit {
            represented_state: config_state_fields(&config)?,
            output: SetConfigOutput {
                config,
                revision: row.revision,
                changed,
                publication: ConfigPublication::Committed,
                diagnostic: None,
            },
        })
    }

    pub fn classify_significance(
        input: ClassifySignificanceInput,
    ) -> Result<ClassifySignificanceOutput> {
        validate_episode(&input.episode)?;
        let is_signal = matches!(
            input.episode.outcome_class,
            OutcomeClass::GoalAchieved | OutcomeClass::ConfigSet | OutcomeClass::TaskScheduled
        );
        Ok(ClassifySignificanceOutput {
            significance: Significance {
                level: if is_signal {
                    SignificanceLevel::Signal
                } else {
                    SignificanceLevel::Contextual
                },
                rule: Some(
                    "outcome_class in [goal_achieved, config_set, task_scheduled]".to_string(),
                ),
            },
        })
    }
}

pub fn config_state_fields(config: &CtlPlaneChatbotConfig) -> Result<Value> {
    let value = serde_json::to_value(config)?;
    ensure!(
        value.is_object(),
        "chatbot config must serialize as an object"
    );
    validate_config(config)?;
    Ok(value)
}

fn parse_config(value: Value) -> Result<CtlPlaneChatbotConfig> {
    let config: CtlPlaneChatbotConfig =
        serde_json::from_value(value).context("durable chatbot config is invalid")?;
    validate_config(&config)?;
    Ok(config)
}

fn validate_config(config: &CtlPlaneChatbotConfig) -> Result<()> {
    let defaults = CtlPlaneChatbotConfig::default();
    ensure!(
        config.embedding_plugin == defaults.embedding_plugin
            && config.qdrant_collection == defaults.qdrant_collection
            && config.output_dtype == defaults.output_dtype
            && config.input_type == defaults.input_type
            && config.dedup_window_hrs == defaults.dedup_window_hrs
            && config.queue_alert_threshold == defaults.queue_alert_threshold
            && config.nesting_policy == defaults.nesting_policy,
        "unsupported chatbot policy fields must retain their reserved default values"
    );
    for (field, value) in [
        ("embedding_plugin", config.embedding_plugin.as_str()),
        ("qdrant_collection", config.qdrant_collection.as_str()),
    ] {
        ensure!(
            !value.is_empty() && value.trim() == value && value.len() <= 256,
            "chatbot {field} must be 1..=256 bytes without surrounding whitespace"
        );
        ensure!(
            !value.chars().any(char::is_control),
            "chatbot {field} contains control characters"
        );
    }
    let bytes = serde_json::to_vec(config)?;
    ensure!(
        bytes.len() <= MAX_CONFIG_BYTES,
        "chatbot config exceeds {MAX_CONFIG_BYTES} bytes"
    );
    Ok(())
}

pub fn validate_episode(episode: &ReasoningEpisode) -> Result<()> {
    let bytes = serde_json::to_vec(episode)?;
    ensure!(
        bytes.len() <= op_cozo_store::MAX_CHATBOT_EPISODE_BYTES,
        "reasoning episode exceeds the durable episode bound"
    );
    ensure!(
        !episode.episode_id.is_empty() && episode.episode_id.len() <= 128,
        "reasoning episode_id must be 1..=128 bytes"
    );
    ensure!(
        episode.started_at.len() <= 64 && episode.ended_at.len() <= 64,
        "reasoning timestamps exceed 64 bytes"
    );
    let started = chrono::DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(&episode.started_at)
        .context("reasoning started_at is not RFC3339")?;
    let ended = chrono::DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(&episode.ended_at)
        .context("reasoning ended_at is not RFC3339")?;
    ensure!(ended >= started, "reasoning ended_at predates started_at");
    ensure!(
        episode
            .reasoning_summary
            .as_ref()
            .is_none_or(|value| value.len() <= MAX_REASONING_SUMMARY_BYTES),
        "reasoning summary exceeds {MAX_REASONING_SUMMARY_BYTES} bytes"
    );
    ensure!(
        !episode.principal_id.is_empty()
            && !episode.session_id.is_empty()
            && !episode.session_genesis.is_empty()
            && !episode.on_behalf_of.is_empty()
            && episode.on_behalf_of == episode.principal_id,
        "reasoning episode identity scope is invalid"
    );
    ensure!(
        episode
            .goal_text
            .as_ref()
            .is_none_or(|value| value.len() <= MAX_CHAT_REQUEST_BYTES)
            && episode
                .decision_output
                .as_ref()
                .is_none_or(|value| value.len() <= MAX_CHAT_RESPONSE_BYTES),
        "reasoning goal or decision exceeds the canonical Chat transport bound"
    );
    ensure!(
        episode.tools_consulted.len() <= MAX_TOOLS
            && episode
                .tools_consulted
                .iter()
                .all(|tool| !tool.is_empty() && tool.len() <= 256),
        "reasoning tools_consulted is invalid"
    );
    ensure!(
        episode
            .confidence
            .is_none_or(|value| value.is_finite() && (0.0..=1.0).contains(&value)),
        "reasoning confidence must be finite and between zero and one"
    );
    if let Some(run) = &episode.run {
        ensure!(
            !run.trigger_id.is_empty() && run.trigger_id.len() <= 64,
            "run trigger_id must be 1..=64 bytes"
        );
        ensure!(
            run.topic_ref.len() == 64 && run.topic_ref.bytes().all(|b| b.is_ascii_hexdigit()),
            "run topic_ref must be a 64-hex digest"
        );
        ensure!(run.actions.len() <= 64, "run records at most 64 actions");
        ensure!(
            run.actions.iter().all(|a| {
                !a.method.is_empty()
                    && a.method.len() <= 256
                    && a.error.as_ref().is_none_or(|e| e.len() <= 1024)
            }),
            "run action is invalid"
        );
        ensure!(
            run.reason.as_ref().is_none_or(|r| r.len() <= 1024),
            "run reason exceeds 1024 bytes"
        );
    }
    ensure!(
        episode.content_hash.len() == 64
            && episode
                .content_hash
                .bytes()
                .all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_hexdigit()),
        "reasoning content_hash must be a 64-character hexadecimal SHA-256"
    );
    ensure!(
        episode.content_hash == episode_content_hash(episode)?,
        "reasoning content_hash does not match the episode"
    );
    Ok(())
}

/// SHA-256 of the typed episode serialized with its `content_hash` field
/// retained and set to the empty string.
pub fn episode_content_hash(episode: &ReasoningEpisode) -> Result<String> {
    let mut content = episode.clone();
    content.content_hash.clear();
    Ok(format!(
        "{:x}",
        Sha256::digest(serde_json::to_vec(&content)?)
    ))
}

/// Largest durable knowledge push (typed, serialized).
pub const MAX_KNOWLEDGE_PUSH_BYTES: usize = 64 * 1024;

pub fn validate_knowledge_push(push: &KnowledgePush) -> Result<()> {
    let bytes = serde_json::to_vec(push)?;
    ensure!(
        bytes.len() <= MAX_KNOWLEDGE_PUSH_BYTES,
        "knowledge push exceeds {MAX_KNOWLEDGE_PUSH_BYTES} bytes"
    );
    ensure!(
        !push.principal_id.is_empty()
            && !push.session_id.is_empty()
            && !push.session_genesis.is_empty(),
        "knowledge push identity scope is invalid"
    );
    ensure!(
        push.push_id.len() == 20 && push.push_id.bytes().all(|b| b.is_ascii_digit()),
        "knowledge push_id must be the 20-digit zero-padded scope revision"
    );
    ensure!(
        !push.source_id.is_empty()
            && push.source_id.len() <= 128
            && !push.source_id.chars().any(char::is_control),
        "knowledge source_id must be 1..=128 bytes without control characters"
    );
    ensure!(
        push.created_at.len() <= 64,
        "knowledge created_at exceeds 64 bytes"
    );
    chrono::DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(&push.created_at)
        .context("knowledge created_at is not RFC3339")?;
    ensure!(
        !push.trigger.is_empty() && push.trigger.len() <= 64,
        "knowledge trigger must be 1..=64 bytes"
    );
    ensure!(
        push.trigger_reason.len() <= 4096
            && push
                .suggested_action
                .as_ref()
                .is_none_or(|value| value.len() <= 4096),
        "knowledge reason or suggestion exceeds 4096 bytes"
    );
    ensure!(
        push.relevance_score.is_finite() && (0.0..=1.0).contains(&push.relevance_score),
        "knowledge relevance_score must be finite and between zero and one"
    );
    ensure!(
        push.content_hash.len() == 64
            && push
                .content_hash
                .bytes()
                .all(|b| b.is_ascii_hexdigit() && !b.is_ascii_uppercase()),
        "knowledge content_hash must be a 64-character hexadecimal SHA-256"
    );
    ensure!(
        push.content_hash == knowledge_content_hash(push)?,
        "knowledge content_hash does not match the push"
    );
    Ok(())
}

/// SHA-256 of the typed push serialized with its `content_hash` field
/// retained and set to the empty string.
pub fn knowledge_content_hash(push: &KnowledgePush) -> Result<String> {
    let mut content = push.clone();
    content.content_hash.clear();
    Ok(format!(
        "{:x}",
        Sha256::digest(serde_json::to_vec(&content)?)
    ))
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use op_cozo_store::CozoGraphShuttle;

    fn service() -> CtlPlaneChatbotMethods {
        CtlPlaneChatbotMethods::new(Arc::new(RuntimeDocuments::new(
            CozoGraphShuttle::new_in_memory().unwrap(),
        )))
    }

    fn episode(outcome_class: OutcomeClass) -> ReasoningEpisode {
        let mut episode = ReasoningEpisode {
            principal_id: "did:op:human:test".into(),
            session_id: "test-session".into(),
            session_genesis: "ab".repeat(32),
            on_behalf_of: "did:op:human:test".into(),
            episode_id: "01912abc-def0-7abc-8def-0123456789ab".into(),
            started_at: "2026-09-13T10:00:00Z".into(),
            ended_at: "2026-09-13T10:00:01Z".into(),
            duration_ms: 1_000,
            trigger: super::super::ctl_plane_chatbot::Trigger::Goal,
            exit_reason: super::super::ctl_plane_chatbot::ExitReason::ResponseEmitted,
            goal_text: None,
            reasoning_summary: Some("bounded summary".into()),
            tools_consulted: vec![],
            decision_output: None,
            outcome_class,
            confidence: Some(0.75),
            plugin_id: None,
            conversation_id: None,
            content_hash: String::new(),
            pii_flagged: false,
            run: None,
        };
        episode.content_hash = episode_content_hash(&episode).unwrap();
        episode
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn absent_config_remains_absent_then_revision_cas_is_exact() {
        let service = service();
        assert_eq!(
            service.get_config(GetConfigInput {}).await.unwrap(),
            GetConfigOutput {
                config: None,
                revision: 0
            }
        );
        let first = service
            .set_config(SetConfigInput {
                expected_revision: 0,
                config: CtlPlaneChatbotConfig::default(),
            })
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(first.output.revision, 1);
        assert!(first.output.changed);
        assert!(service
            .set_config(SetConfigInput {
                expected_revision: 0,
                config: CtlPlaneChatbotConfig::default(),
            })
            .await
            .is_err());
        assert_eq!(
            service
                .get_config(GetConfigInput {})
                .await
                .unwrap()
                .revision,
            1
        );
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn same_value_cas_advances_revision_without_claiming_content_change() {
        let service = service();
        service
            .set_config(SetConfigInput {
                expected_revision: 0,
                config: CtlPlaneChatbotConfig::default(),
            })
            .await
            .unwrap();
        let second = service
            .set_config(SetConfigInput {
                expected_revision: 1,
                config: CtlPlaneChatbotConfig::default(),
            })
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(second.output.revision, 2);
        assert!(!second.output.changed);
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn unsupported_reserved_policies_are_rejected_before_revision_cas() {
        let service = service();
        for (field, value) in unsupported_policy_values() {
            let mut config = serde_json::to_value(CtlPlaneChatbotConfig::default()).unwrap();
            config[field] = value;
            let error = service
                .set_config(SetConfigInput {
                    expected_revision: 0,
                    config: serde_json::from_value(config).unwrap(),
                })
                .await
                .err()
                .expect("unsupported policy must fail");
            assert!(error.to_string().contains("reserved default values"));
            assert_eq!(
                service
                    .get_config(GetConfigInput {})
                    .await
                    .unwrap()
                    .revision,
                0
            );
        }
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn unsupported_legacy_config_can_be_replaced_through_revision_cas() {
        let service = service();
        let mut legacy = serde_json::to_value(CtlPlaneChatbotConfig::default()).unwrap();
        legacy["qdrant_collection"] = serde_json::json!("legacy-unimplemented-collection");
        service
            .documents
            .update_at_revision_with_result(CONFIG_DOCUMENT_ID, 0, move |_| Ok((legacy, ())))
            .await
            .unwrap();
        let error = service.get_config(GetConfigInput {}).await.unwrap_err();
        assert!(error.to_string().contains("expected_revision=1"));
        assert!(service
            .set_config(SetConfigInput {
                expected_revision: 0,
                config: CtlPlaneChatbotConfig::default(),
            })
            .await
            .is_err());
        let repaired = service
            .set_config(SetConfigInput {
                expected_revision: 1,
                config: CtlPlaneChatbotConfig::default(),
            })
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert!(repaired.output.changed);
        assert_eq!(repaired.output.revision, 2);
        assert_eq!(
            service.get_config(GetConfigInput {}).await.unwrap().config,
            Some(CtlPlaneChatbotConfig::default())
        );
    }

    fn unsupported_policy_values() -> [(&'static str, Value); 7] {
        [
            ("embedding_plugin", serde_json::json!("other")),
            ("qdrant_collection", serde_json::json!("other")),
            ("dedup_window_hrs", serde_json::json!(12)),
            ("queue_alert_threshold", serde_json::json!(1)),
            ("nesting_policy", serde_json::json!("nested")),
            ("output_dtype", serde_json::json!("int8")),
            ("input_type", serde_json::json!("query")),
        ]
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn singleton_config_reopens_from_the_same_durable_row() {
        let directory = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let path = directory.path().join("chatbot-config");
        {
            let service = CtlPlaneChatbotMethods::new(Arc::new(RuntimeDocuments::new(
                CozoGraphShuttle::new_persistent(path.clone()).unwrap(),
            )));
            let committed = service
                .set_config(SetConfigInput {
                    expected_revision: 0,
                    config: CtlPlaneChatbotConfig::default(),
                })
                .await
                .unwrap();
            assert_eq!(committed.output.revision, 1);
        }
        let reopened = CtlPlaneChatbotMethods::new(Arc::new(RuntimeDocuments::new(
            CozoGraphShuttle::new_persistent(path).unwrap(),
        )));
        let observed = reopened.get_config(GetConfigInput {}).await.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(observed.revision, 1);
        assert_eq!(observed.config, Some(CtlPlaneChatbotConfig::default()));
    }

    #[test]
    fn config_schema_rejects_unimplemented_policy_values() {
        let schema = serde_json::to_value(schemars::schema_for!(SetConfigInput)).unwrap();
        let validator = jsonschema::Validator::new(&schema).unwrap();
        let baseline = serde_json::to_value(SetConfigInput {
            expected_revision: 0,
            config: CtlPlaneChatbotConfig::default(),
        })
        .unwrap();
        assert!(validator.is_valid(&baseline));
        for (field, value) in unsupported_policy_values() {
            let mut input = baseline.clone();
            input["config"][field] = value;
            assert!(!validator.is_valid(&input), "unsupported field: {field}");
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn significance_rule_is_exact_and_has_no_storage_side_effect() {
        for outcome in [
            OutcomeClass::GoalAchieved,
            OutcomeClass::ConfigSet,
            OutcomeClass::TaskScheduled,
        ] {
            assert_eq!(
                CtlPlaneChatbotMethods::classify_significance(ClassifySignificanceInput {
                    episode: episode(outcome)
                })
                .unwrap()
                .significance
                .level,
                SignificanceLevel::Signal
            );
        }
        assert_eq!(
            CtlPlaneChatbotMethods::classify_significance(ClassifySignificanceInput {
                episode: episode(OutcomeClass::Inconclusive)
            })
            .unwrap()
            .significance
            .level,
            SignificanceLevel::Contextual
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn malformed_episode_and_unknown_input_are_rejected() {
        let mut invalid = episode(OutcomeClass::Inconclusive);
        invalid.confidence = Some(f64::NAN);
        assert!(
            CtlPlaneChatbotMethods::classify_significance(ClassifySignificanceInput {
                episode: invalid
            })
            .is_err()
        );
        assert!(
            serde_json::from_value::<ClassifySignificanceInput>(serde_json::json!({
                "episode": episode(OutcomeClass::Inconclusive),
                "vector_id": "invented"
            }))
            .is_err()
        );
        assert!(serde_json::from_value::<SetConfigInput>(serde_json::json!({
            "expected_revision":0,
            "config":{
                "embedding_plugin":"embedding_model",
                "qdrant_collection":"ctl_plane_reasoning_episodes",
                "vector_dims":"1024",
                "output_dtype":"float",
                "input_type":"document",
                "dedup_window_hrs":24,
                "queue_alert_threshold":50,
                "nesting_policy":"flat",
                "vectorization_enabled":true,
                "credential":"must-not-be-accepted"
            }
        }))
        .is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn vectorization_plan_uses_typed_episode_and_redacts_pii_text() {
        let mut value = episode(OutcomeClass::GoalAchieved);
        value.goal_text = Some("private goal".into());
        value.reasoning_summary = Some("private reasoning".into());
        value.decision_output = Some("private decision".into());
        value.pii_flagged = true;
        value.content_hash = episode_content_hash(&value).unwrap();
        let plan = plan_vectorization(&value).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(plan.texts.len(), 1);
        assert!(!plan.texts[0].contains("private goal"));
        assert!(!plan.texts[0].contains("private reasoning"));
        assert!(!plan.texts[0].contains("private decision"));
        assert!(plan.texts[0].contains("outcome_class"));
        assert!(matches!(
            plan.input_type,
            Some(EmbeddingInputType::Document)
        ));
        assert!(!plan.truncate);

        let mut public = episode(OutcomeClass::GoalAchieved);
        public.goal_text = Some("public goal".into());
        public.reasoning_summary = Some("public reasoning".into());
        public.decision_output = Some("public decision".into());
        public.content_hash = episode_content_hash(&public).unwrap();
        let plan = plan_vectorization(&public).unwrap();
        assert!(plan.texts[0].contains("public goal"));
        assert!(plan.texts[0].contains("public reasoning"));
        assert!(plan.texts[0].contains("public decision"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn vectorization_completion_requires_one_exact_dimension_vector() {
        let input = episode(OutcomeClass::Inconclusive);
        let embedded = EmbedOutput {
            vectors: vec![vec![0.25, 0.75]],
            dimensions: 2,
            model: "fixture-model".into(),
            provider_model: Some("reported-model".into()),
            provider: EmbeddingProvider::Voyage,
            config_revision: 4,
        };
        let output = complete_vectorization(&input, embedded).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(output.episode_id, input.episode_id);
        assert_eq!(output.content_hash, input.content_hash);
        assert_eq!(output.vector, vec![0.25, 0.75]);
        assert_eq!(output.config_revision, 4);

        let invalid = EmbedOutput {
            vectors: vec![vec![0.25]],
            dimensions: 2,
            model: "fixture-model".into(),
            provider_model: None,
            provider: EmbeddingProvider::Voyage,
            config_revision: 4,
        };
        assert!(complete_vectorization(&input, invalid).is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn cosine_similarity_is_bounded_and_rejects_invalid_vectors() {
        assert_eq!(cosine_similarity(&[1.0, 0.0], &[1.0, 0.0]).unwrap(), 1.0);
        assert_eq!(cosine_similarity(&[1.0, 0.0], &[-1.0, 0.0]).unwrap(), -1.0);
        assert_eq!(cosine_similarity(&[0.0, 0.0], &[1.0, 0.0]).unwrap(), 0.0);
        assert!(cosine_similarity(&[], &[]).is_err());
        assert!(cosine_similarity(&[1.0], &[1.0, 2.0]).is_err());
        assert!(cosine_similarity(&[f32::NAN], &[1.0]).is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn completed_chat_episode_binds_identity_and_content_hash() {
        let started_at = chrono::DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339("2026-09-14T10:00:00Z")
            .unwrap()
            .with_timezone(&chrono::Utc);
        let ended_at = started_at + chrono::Duration::seconds(2);
        let row = build_completed_chat_episode(CompletedChatEpisode {
            scope: op_cozo_store::EpisodeScope {
                principal_id: "did:op:human:test".into(),
                session_id: "session".into(),
                session_genesis: "ab".repeat(32),
            },
            conversation_id: Some("conversation".into()),
            goal_text: Some("goal".into()),
            decision_output: "answer".into(),
            tools: vec![],
            started_at,
            ended_at,
        })
        .unwrap();
        let episode: ReasoningEpisode = serde_json::from_value(row.episode.clone()).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(episode.on_behalf_of, row.scope.principal_id);
        assert_eq!(episode.duration_ms, 2_000);
        assert!(episode.reasoning_summary.is_none());
        assert!(episode.pii_flagged);
        assert_eq!(row.content_hash, episode_content_hash(&episode).unwrap());
    }

    #[test]
    fn completed_chat_episode_preserves_supported_large_chat_text() {
        let started_at = chrono::DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339("2026-09-14T10:00:00Z")
            .unwrap()
            .with_timezone(&chrono::Utc);
        let goal = "g".repeat(128 * 1024);
        let decision = "d".repeat(192 * 1024);
        let row = build_completed_chat_episode(CompletedChatEpisode {
            scope: op_cozo_store::EpisodeScope {
                principal_id: "did:op:human:test".into(),
                session_id: "session".into(),
                session_genesis: "ab".repeat(32),
            },
            conversation_id: None,
            goal_text: Some(goal.clone()),
            decision_output: decision.clone(),
            tools: vec![],
            started_at,
            ended_at: started_at + chrono::Duration::seconds(1),
        })
        .unwrap();
        let store = CozoGraphShuttle::new_in_memory().unwrap();
        store.initialize_chatbot_episode_store().unwrap();
        store.insert_scoped_episode_and_snapshot(&row, 32).unwrap();
        let observed = store
            .get_scoped_episode(&row.scope, &row.episode_id)
            .unwrap()
            .unwrap();
        let episode: ReasoningEpisode = serde_json::from_value(observed.episode).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(episode.goal_text.as_deref(), Some(goal.as_str()));
        assert_eq!(episode.decision_output.as_deref(), Some(decision.as_str()));
        assert_eq!(episode.content_hash, row.content_hash);
    }
}
</file>

<file path="op-plugins/src/state_plugins/ctl_plane_chatbot.rs">
//! Control-plane chatbot reasoning episode plugin
//!
//! Declares the canonical schema for the chatbot's reasoning episodes —
//! every field, PII classification, significance, and vectorization contract.
//! THE PLUGIN IS THE SCHEMA: downstream (CozoDB, Accountability UI,
//! gRPC EventChainService) inherits from this definition.
//!
//! Related: REQ-1 through REQ-10 (Control-Plane Chatbot Reasoning Episode
//! Vectorization spec). This plugin covers REQ-2 (episode record fields)
//! and REQ-3 (plugin schema registration).

use anyhow::Result;
use async_trait::async_trait;
use op_state::{
    ApplyResult, Checkpoint, DiffMetadata, PluginCapabilities, StateAction, StateDiff, StatePlugin,
};
use op_state_store::PluginSchema;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use simd_json::prelude::*;
use simd_json::OwnedValue as Value;
use std::collections::BTreeMap;

const DEFAULT_COLLECTION: &str = "ctl_plane_reasoning_episodes";
const DEFAULT_DEDUP_WINDOW_HRS: u32 = 24;
const DEFAULT_QUEUE_ALERT_THRESHOLD: u32 = 50;
const DEFAULT_EMBEDDING_PLUGIN: &str = "embedding_model";

// ── Config (vectorization pipeline tuning) ──────────────────────────────────

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema, PartialEq)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct CtlPlaneChatbotConfig {
    #[serde(default = "default_embedding_plugin")]
    #[schemars(extend("const" = DEFAULT_EMBEDDING_PLUGIN))]
    pub embedding_plugin: String,
    #[serde(default = "default_collection")]
    /// Reserved legacy collection label; no Qdrant episode index is implemented.
    #[schemars(extend("const" = DEFAULT_COLLECTION), extend("readOnly" = true))]
    pub qdrant_collection: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub vector_dims: MatryoshkaDim,
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(extend("const" = "float"))]
    pub output_dtype: OutputDtype,
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(extend("const" = "document"))]
    pub input_type: InputType,
    #[serde(default = "default_dedup_window_hrs")]
    /// Reserved legacy value; content-based episode merging is not implemented.
    #[schemars(extend("const" = DEFAULT_DEDUP_WINDOW_HRS), extend("readOnly" = true))]
    pub dedup_window_hrs: u32,
    #[serde(default = "default_queue_alert_threshold")]
    /// Reserved legacy value; vectorization is explicitly invoked, without a queue.
    #[schemars(extend("const" = DEFAULT_QUEUE_ALERT_THRESHOLD), extend("readOnly" = true))]
    pub queue_alert_threshold: u32,
    #[serde(default)]
    /// Reserved legacy value; each completed native Chat creates one episode.
    #[schemars(extend("const" = "flat"), extend("readOnly" = true))]
    pub nesting_policy: NestingPolicy,
    #[serde(default = "default_true")]
    pub vectorization_enabled: bool,
}

fn default_embedding_plugin() -> String {
    DEFAULT_EMBEDDING_PLUGIN.into()
}
fn default_collection() -> String {
    DEFAULT_COLLECTION.into()
}
fn default_chat_llm_plugin() -> String {
    "large_language_model".into()
}
fn default_true() -> bool {
    true
}

impl Default for CtlPlaneChatbotConfig {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            embedding_plugin: default_embedding_plugin(),
            qdrant_collection: default_collection(),
            vector_dims: MatryoshkaDim::D1024,
            output_dtype: OutputDtype::Float,
            input_type: InputType::Document,
            dedup_window_hrs: DEFAULT_DEDUP_WINDOW_HRS,
            queue_alert_threshold: DEFAULT_QUEUE_ALERT_THRESHOLD,
            nesting_policy: NestingPolicy::Flat,
            vectorization_enabled: true,
        }
    }
}

// ── Schema state (schemars-derived) ─────────────────────────────────────────

/// Accepted output dimension of the configured embedding owner. Episode
/// vectorization verifies this exact dimension; it does not truncate or migrate
/// existing vectors when the setting changes.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema, PartialEq)]
pub enum MatryoshkaDim {
    #[serde(rename = "256")]
    D256,
    #[serde(rename = "512")]
    D512,
    #[serde(rename = "1024")]
    D1024,
    #[serde(rename = "2048")]
    D2048,
}

impl Default for MatryoshkaDim {
    fn default() -> Self {
        MatryoshkaDim::D1024
    }
}

impl MatryoshkaDim {
    /// Numeric dimensionality.
    pub fn dims(&self) -> u32 {
        match self {
            MatryoshkaDim::D256 => 256,
            MatryoshkaDim::D512 => 512,
            MatryoshkaDim::D1024 => 1024,
            MatryoshkaDim::D2048 => 2048,
        }
    }
}

/// Historical output formats. The current episode owner supports only `float`;
/// the config contract fixes this value until other formats have backing code.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema, PartialEq)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum OutputDtype {
    Float,
    Int8,
    Uint8,
    Binary,
    Ubinary,
}

impl Default for OutputDtype {
    fn default() -> Self {
        OutputDtype::Float
    }
}

/// Retrieval `input_type` (Voyage input_type). Voyage prepends a retrieval prompt
/// based on this: documents embed as `document`, queries as `query`. The Voyage
/// FAQ says **not** to omit it / use `None` for retrieval, so `None` is
/// intentionally not offered here. Stored reasoning episodes are documents →
/// default `document`; the search side uses `query`. Embeddings with and without
/// input_type stay compatible, so this is a quality knob, not a space knob.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema, PartialEq)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum InputType {
    Query,
    Document,
}

impl Default for InputType {
    fn default() -> Self {
        InputType::Document
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema, PartialEq)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum NestingPolicy {
    Flat,
    Nested,
}

impl Default for NestingPolicy {
    fn default() -> Self {
        NestingPolicy::Flat
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema, PartialEq)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum Trigger {
    Goal,
    ToolResult,
    Interrupt,
    Replan,
    SystemEvent,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema, PartialEq)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum ExitReason {
    ToolCall,
    ResponseEmitted,
    DirectionChange,
    GoalAchieved,
    ConfigSet,
    TaskScheduled,
    Interrupt,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema, PartialEq)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum OutcomeClass {
    GoalAchieved,
    ConfigSet,
    TaskScheduled,
    Delegated,
    Interrupted,
    DirectionChanged,
    Inconclusive,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema, PartialEq)]
pub enum SignificanceLevel {
    Contextual,
    Signal,
}

impl Default for SignificanceLevel {
    fn default() -> Self {
        SignificanceLevel::Contextual
    }
}

fn default_dedup_window_hrs() -> u32 {
    DEFAULT_DEDUP_WINDOW_HRS
}
fn default_queue_alert_threshold() -> u32 {
    DEFAULT_QUEUE_ALERT_THRESHOLD
}
fn default_running() -> bool {
    true
}
fn default_reasoning_active() -> bool {
    false
}
fn default_embedding_queue_depth() -> u32 {
    0
}
fn default_false() -> bool {
    false
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct ReasoningEpisode {
    #[schemars(description = "Verified principal that executed this episode [PII]", extend("readOnly" = true))]
    pub principal_id: String,
    #[schemars(description = "Verified identity session that executed this episode [PII]", extend("readOnly" = true))]
    pub session_id: String,
    #[schemars(description = "Immutable verified session genesis binding [PII]", extend("readOnly" = true))]
    pub session_genesis: String,
    #[schemars(description = "Verified principal on whose behalf the episode ran [PII]", extend("readOnly" = true))]
    pub on_behalf_of: String,
    #[schemars(
        description = "Unique ID (UUID v7 for time-ordering)",
        example = &"01912abc-def0-7abc-8def-0123456789ab",
        extend("readOnly" = true),
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "obs.software.plugin.ctl-plane-chatbot.episode-id@v1")
    )]
    pub episode_id: String,
    #[schemars(
        description = "ISO-8601 timestamp of reasoning entry",
        example = &"2025-05-29T14:30:00Z",
        extend("readOnly" = true),
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "obs.software.plugin.ctl-plane-chatbot.started-at@v1")
    )]
    pub started_at: String,
    #[schemars(
        description = "ISO-8601 timestamp of reasoning exit",
        example = &"2025-05-29T14:30:05Z",
        extend("readOnly" = true),
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "obs.software.plugin.ctl-plane-chatbot.ended-at@v1")
    )]
    pub ended_at: String,
    #[schemars(
        description = "Wall-clock duration in milliseconds",
        example = 5000,
        extend("readOnly" = true),
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "obs.software.plugin.ctl-plane-chatbot.duration-ms@v1")
    )]
    pub duration_ms: u64,
    #[schemars(
        description = "What caused reasoning to start",
        example = &"goal",
        extend("readOnly" = true),
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "obs.software.plugin.ctl-plane-chatbot.trigger@v1")
    )]
    pub trigger: Trigger,
    #[schemars(
        description = "What ended reasoning",
        example = &"tool_call",
        extend("readOnly" = true),
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "obs.software.plugin.ctl-plane-chatbot.exit-reason@v1")
    )]
    pub exit_reason: ExitReason,
    #[schemars(
        description = "High-level goal or prompt active at episode start [PII]",
        example = &"Configure VLAN isolation for tenant-3",
        extend("readOnly" = true),
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "obs.software.plugin.ctl-plane-chatbot.goal-text@v1")
    )]
    pub goal_text: Option<String>,
    #[schemars(
        description = "Compact natural-language summary of reasoning — primary embedding input [PII]",
        example = &"Evaluated 3 bridge configs, chose br-tenant3 for isolation",
        extend("readOnly" = true),
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "obs.software.plugin.ctl-plane-chatbot.reasoning-summary@v1")
    )]
    pub reasoning_summary: Option<String>,
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(
        description = "Ordered list of tools/plugins/MCP calls made during the episode",
        example = &["ovs_list_bridges", "ovs_create_bridge"],
        extend("readOnly" = true),
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "obs.software.plugin.ctl-plane-chatbot.tools-consulted@v1")
    )]
    pub tools_consulted: Vec<String>,
    #[schemars(
        description = "The decision, plan, or action the episode produced [PII]",
        example = &"Create br-tenant3 with VLAN 103 tagged ports",
        extend("readOnly" = true),
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "obs.software.plugin.ctl-plane-chatbot.decision-output@v1")
    )]
    pub decision_output: Option<String>,
    #[schemars(
        description = "Classification of episode outcome. goal_achieved/config_set/task_scheduled => Signal significance",
        example = &"config_set",
        extend("readOnly" = true),
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "obs.software.plugin.ctl-plane-chatbot.outcome-class@v1")
    )]
    pub outcome_class: OutcomeClass,
    #[schemars(
        range(min = 0.0, max = 1.0),
        description = "Optional confidence 0.0-1.0 if the model emits one",
        example = 0.87,
        extend("readOnly" = true),
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "obs.software.plugin.ctl-plane-chatbot.confidence@v1")
    )]
    pub confidence: Option<f64>,
    #[schemars(
        description = "Plugin that owns the context being reasoned about",
        example = &"ovsdb_bridge",
        extend("readOnly" = true),
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "obs.software.plugin.ctl-plane-chatbot.plugin-id@v1")
    )]
    pub plugin_id: Option<String>,
    #[schemars(
        description = "Groups episodes belonging to the same high-level task chain",
        example = &"vlan-isolation-task-3",
        extend("readOnly" = true),
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "obs.software.plugin.ctl-plane-chatbot.conversation-id@v1")
    )]
    pub conversation_id: Option<String>,
    #[schemars(
        description = "SHA-256 of the typed serialized episode with content_hash set to the empty string; validates immutable episode content and embedding updates",
        extend("readOnly" = true),
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "obs.software.plugin.ctl-plane-chatbot.content-hash@v1")
    )]
    pub content_hash: String,
    #[serde(default = "default_false")]
    #[schemars(
        description = "If true, goal_text, reasoning_summary and decision_output are omitted before embedding. Native Chat sets this conservatively; no PII classifier or release workflow is implemented",
        extend("readOnly" = true),
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "obs.software.plugin.ctl-plane-chatbot.pii-flagged@v1")
    )]
    pub pii_flagged: bool,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    #[schemars(
        description = "Present when the episode is an event-triggered agent run (OD-63): status, timing, token usage and the action timeline",
        extend("readOnly" = true),
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "obs.software.plugin.ctl-plane-chatbot.run@v1")
    )]
    pub run: Option<RunRecord>,
}

/// Terminal state of an event-triggered agent run.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum RunStatus {
    Succeeded,
    Dropped,
    Failed,
    Timeout,
}

/// One action the run performed (or was refused).
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct RunAction {
    /// `plugin.method`.
    pub method: String,
    pub ok: bool,
    pub duration_ms: u64,
    /// Refusal or error, bounded.
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub error: Option<String>,
}

/// The run record an event-triggered agent commits with its episode.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct RunRecord {
    pub status: RunStatus,
    pub trigger_id: String,
    /// blake3 digest of the triggering topic (the topic itself may be data).
    pub topic_ref: String,
    pub queued_ms: u64,
    pub duration_ms: u64,
    pub tokens_in: u64,
    pub tokens_out: u64,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub actions: Vec<RunAction>,
    /// Why the run ended other than `succeeded`, bounded.
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub reason: Option<String>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct Significance {

    )]

}

/// One knowledge push the context engine produced for this exact identity
/// scope. Durable in the private episode Cozo owner, projected into the
/// private SHM document, and announced to the UI by a content-free wake.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct KnowledgePush {
    #[schemars(description = "Verified principal this push belongs to [PII]", extend("readOnly" = true))]
    pub principal_id: String,
    #[schemars(description = "Verified identity session this push belongs to [PII]", extend("readOnly" = true))]
    pub session_id: String,
    #[schemars(description = "Immutable verified session genesis binding [PII]", extend("readOnly" = true))]
    pub session_genesis: String,
    #[schemars(
        description = "Durable push id: the zero-padded scope revision that committed it, so ids order by commit",
        example = &"00000000000000000042",
        extend("readOnly" = true),
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "obs.software.plugin.ctl-plane-chatbot.knowledge.push-id@v1")
    )]
    pub push_id: String,
    #[schemars(
        description = "Context-engine push id (idempotency key across retries)",
        extend("readOnly" = true),
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "obs.software.plugin.ctl-plane-chatbot.knowledge.source-id@v1")
    )]
    pub source_id: String,
    #[schemars(
        description = "ISO-8601 time the context engine produced the push",
        example = &"2026-09-19T14:30:00Z",
        extend("readOnly" = true),
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "obs.software.plugin.ctl-plane-chatbot.knowledge.created-at@v1")
    )]
    pub created_at: String,
    #[schemars(
        description = "What triggered the push (context engine trigger name)",
        example = &"ErrorAssistance",
        extend("readOnly" = true),
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "obs.software.plugin.ctl-plane-chatbot.knowledge.trigger@v1")
    )]
    pub trigger: String,
    #[schemars(
        description = "Why the engine pushed it [PII]",
        extend("readOnly" = true),
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "obs.software.plugin.ctl-plane-chatbot.knowledge.trigger-reason@v1")
    )]
    pub trigger_reason: String,
    #[schemars(
        range(min = 0.0, max = 1.0),
        description = "Engine relevance score 0.0-1.0",
        extend("readOnly" = true),
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "obs.software.plugin.ctl-plane-chatbot.knowledge.relevance@v1")
    )]
    pub relevance_score: f64,
    #[schemars(
        with = "serde_json::Value",
        description = "Typed knowledge content as the engine emitted it [PII]",
        extend("readOnly" = true),
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "obs.software.plugin.ctl-plane-chatbot.knowledge.content@v1")
    )]
    pub content: serde_json::Value,
    #[schemars(
        description = "Suggested next action, when the engine proposed one [PII]",
        extend("readOnly" = true),
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "obs.software.plugin.ctl-plane-chatbot.knowledge.suggested-action@v1")
    )]
    pub suggested_action: Option<String>,
    #[schemars(
        description = "SHA-256 of the typed push serialized with content_hash set to the empty string",
        extend("readOnly" = true),
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "obs.software.plugin.ctl-plane-chatbot.knowledge.content-hash@v1")
    )]
    pub content_hash: String,
}

// ── Plugin struct ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

pub struct CtlPlaneChatbotPlugin;

impl CtlPlaneChatbotPlugin {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self
    }
}

impl Default for CtlPlaneChatbotPlugin {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}

// ── StatePlugin impl ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

#[async_trait]
impl StatePlugin for CtlPlaneChatbotPlugin {
    fn name(&self) -> &str {
        "ctl_plane_chatbot"
    }
    fn version(&self) -> &str {
        "4.2.0"
    }

    fn schema(&self) -> Option<PluginSchema> {
        let mut schema = ctl_plane_chatbot_schema();
        super::common::oscal::ensure_category_metadata_fields(&mut schema);
        Some(schema)
    }

    fn is_available(&self) -> bool {
        // Always available — the chatbot is the control plane itself
        true
    }

    fn unavailable_reason(&self) -> String {
        String::new()
    }

    async fn calculate_diff(&self, current: &Value, desired: &Value) -> Result<StateDiff> {
        let cur: CtlPlaneChatbotConfig = simd_json::serde::from_owned_value(current.clone())?;
        let des: CtlPlaneChatbotConfig = simd_json::serde::from_owned_value(desired.clone())?;

        let mut actions = Vec::new();
        macro_rules! field_diff {
            ($field:ident, $key:expr) => {
                if cur.$field != des.$field {
                    actions.push(StateAction::Modify {
                        resource: $key.into(),
                        changes: simd_json::serde::to_owned_value(&des.$field)?,
                    });
                }
            };
        }
        field_diff!(embedding_plugin, "embedding_plugin");
        field_diff!(qdrant_collection, "qdrant_collection");
        field_diff!(vector_dims, "vector_dims");
        field_diff!(output_dtype, "output_dtype");
        field_diff!(input_type, "input_type");
        field_diff!(dedup_window_hrs, "dedup_window_hrs");
        field_diff!(queue_alert_threshold, "queue_alert_threshold");
        field_diff!(nesting_policy, "nesting_policy");
        field_diff!(vectorization_enabled, "vectorization_enabled");

        Ok(StateDiff {
            plugin: self.name().into(),
            actions,
            metadata: DiffMetadata {
                timestamp: chrono::Utc::now().timestamp(),
                current_hash: format!("{:x}", md5::compute(simd_json::to_string(current)?)),
                desired_hash: format!("{:x}", md5::compute(simd_json::to_string(desired)?)),
            },
        })
    }

    async fn apply_state(&self, diff: &StateDiff) -> Result<ApplyResult> {
        let _ = diff;
        anyhow::bail!(
            "generic ctl_plane_chatbot state apply is unsupported; use the canonical set_config method with durable revision CAS"
        )
    }

    async fn verify_state(&self, desired: &Value) -> Result<bool> {
        let _ = desired;
        anyhow::bail!(
            "generic ctl_plane_chatbot verification is unsupported; use the canonical durable get_config receipt"
        )
    }

    async fn create_checkpoint(&self) -> Result<Checkpoint> {
        anyhow::bail!(
            "generic ctl_plane_chatbot checkpoints are unsupported; no canonical durable checkpoint owner is declared"
        )
    }

    async fn rollback(&self, checkpoint: &Checkpoint) -> Result<()> {
        let _ = checkpoint;
        anyhow::bail!(
            "generic ctl_plane_chatbot rollback is unsupported; use an explicit set_config revision transition"
        )
    }

    fn capabilities(&self) -> PluginCapabilities {
        PluginCapabilities {
            supports_rollback: false,
            supports_checkpoints: false,
            supports_verification: false,
            atomic_operations: false,
        }
    }
}

pub(crate) fn ctl_plane_chatbot_schema() -> PluginSchema {
    use super::ctl_plane_chatbot_methods::{
        ClassifySignificanceInput, ClassifySignificanceOutput, GetConfigInput, GetConfigOutput,
        GetDoorbellInput, GetDoorbellOutput, GetEpisodeInput, GetEpisodeOutput, ListEpisodesInput,
        ListEpisodesOutput, ListKnowledgeInput, ListKnowledgeOutput, QueryContextInput,
        QueryContextOutput, SetConfigInput, SetConfigOutput, VectorizeInput, VectorizeOutput,
    };
    let root = serde_json::to_value(schemars::schema_for!(CtlPlaneChatbotState))
        .expect("schemars schema serializes to JSON");
    let mut schema = super::schemars_adapter::plugin_schema_from_json(
        "ctl_plane_chatbot",
        "4.2.0",
        "Control-plane chatbot reasoning episode contract, PII-aware significance rules, durable singleton configuration, and typed embedding facade",
        &root,
    );
    // Finite FieldType maps cannot retain every constraint of the typed
    // episode. Replace the adapter placeholder with its complete schema,
    // derived from the same Rust type before the plugin is ever published.
    schema
        .fields
        .get_mut("episodes")
        .expect("episode snapshot field")
        .field_type = op_state_store::FieldType::exact_json_schema(
        serde_json::to_value(schemars::schema_for!(BTreeMap<String, ReasoningEpisode>))
            .expect("episode map schema serializes"),
    )
    .expect("episode snapshot schema is self-contained");
    schema
        .fields
        .get_mut("knowledge")
        .expect("knowledge snapshot field")
        .field_type = op_state_store::FieldType::exact_json_schema(
        serde_json::to_value(schemars::schema_for!(BTreeMap<String, KnowledgePush>))
            .expect("knowledge map schema serializes"),
    )
    .expect("knowledge snapshot schema is self-contained");

    // Durable writes are announced as signals so the chain (and the vector
    // projection, OD-64) records the committed document under its own
    // schema — the schema is the noise filter for what gets embedded.
    schema.signals.push(op_state_store::SignalDecl {
        name: "episode_committed".to_string(),
        payload: Some(
            simd_json::serde::to_owned_value(schemars::schema_for!(ReasoningEpisode))
                .expect("episode schema serializes"),
        ),
        subid: "evt.service.ctl-plane-chatbot.episode.committed@v1".to_string(),
    });
    schema.signals.push(op_state_store::SignalDecl {
        name: "knowledge_committed".to_string(),
        payload: Some(
            simd_json::serde::to_owned_value(schemars::schema_for!(KnowledgePush))
                .expect("knowledge schema serializes"),
        ),
        subid: "evt.service.ctl-plane-chatbot.knowledge.committed@v1".to_string(),
    });

    // Add methods
    use super::plugin_scaffold_helpers::method_decl_from_schemars_with_output;
    use op_state_store::SideEffect;

    schema.methods.insert(
        "get_config".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<GetConfigInput, GetConfigOutput>(
            "get_config",
            SideEffect::Read,
            true,
            "chatbot.read",
            "obs.service.ctl-plane-chatbot.config.get@v1",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "set_config".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<SetConfigInput, SetConfigOutput>(
            "set_config",
            SideEffect::Mutation,
            false,
            "chatbot.invoke",
            "mut.service.ctl-plane-chatbot.config.set@v1",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "list_episodes".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<ListEpisodesInput, ListEpisodesOutput>(
            "list_episodes",
            SideEffect::Read,
            true,
            "chatbot.read",
            "obs.service.ctl-plane-chatbot.episode.list@v1",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "get_episode".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<GetEpisodeInput, GetEpisodeOutput>(
            "get_episode",
            SideEffect::Read,
            true,
            "chatbot.read",
            "obs.service.ctl-plane-chatbot.episode.get@v1",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "list_knowledge".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<ListKnowledgeInput, ListKnowledgeOutput>(
            "list_knowledge",
            SideEffect::Read,
            true,
            "chatbot.read",
            "obs.service.ctl-plane-chatbot.knowledge.list@v1",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "get_doorbell".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<GetDoorbellInput, GetDoorbellOutput>(
            "get_doorbell",
            SideEffect::Read,
            true,
            "chatbot.read",
            "obs.service.ctl-plane-chatbot.doorbell.get@v1",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "query_context".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<QueryContextInput, QueryContextOutput>(
            "query_context",
            SideEffect::Read,
            true,
            "chatbot.read",
            "obs.service.ctl-plane-chatbot.context.query@v1",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "classify_significance".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<
            ClassifySignificanceInput,
            ClassifySignificanceOutput,
        >(
            "classify_significance",
            SideEffect::Read,
            true,
            "chatbot.invoke",
            "mut.service.ctl-plane-chatbot.classify@v1",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "vectorize".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<VectorizeInput, VectorizeOutput>(
            "vectorize",
            SideEffect::Mutation,
            false,
            "chatbot.invoke",
            "mut.service.ctl-plane-chatbot.vectorize@v1",
        ),
    );

    schema.dependencies.push("embedding_model".to_string());

    schema.capabilities.insert(
        "chatbot.read".to_string(),
        op_state_store::CapabilityDecl {
            id: "chatbot.read".to_string(),
            description: "Grants: get_config, list_episodes, get_episode, query_context."
                .to_string(),
        },
    );
    schema.capabilities.insert(
        "chatbot.invoke".to_string(),
        op_state_store::CapabilityDecl {
            id: "chatbot.invoke".to_string(),
            description: "Grants: set_config, classify_significance, vectorize.".to_string(),
        },
    );

    schema
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn v3_methods_are_typed_and_pure_classification_is_idempotent() {
        let schema = ctl_plane_chatbot_schema();
        assert_eq!(schema.version, "4.2.0");
        for method in [
            "get_config",
            "set_config",
            "list_episodes",
            "get_episode",
            "get_doorbell",
            "list_knowledge",
            "query_context",
            "classify_significance",
            "vectorize",
        ] {
            let declaration = &schema.methods[method];
            assert!(declaration.returns.is_some());
            assert_ne!(declaration.args, simd_json::json!(null));
        }
        let classify = &schema.methods["classify_significance"];
        assert_eq!(classify.side_effect, op_state_store::SideEffect::Read);
        assert!(classify.idempotent);
        let vectorize = &schema.methods["vectorize"];
        let args = simd_json::to_string(&vectorize.args).unwrap();
        let returns = simd_json::to_string(vectorize.returns.as_ref().unwrap()).unwrap();
        assert!(args.contains("episode"));
        assert!(returns.contains("vector"));
        assert!(returns.contains("config_revision"));
        assert!(!returns.contains("vector_id"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn complete_config_fields_are_a_valid_partial_root_without_fake_runtime_state() {
        let schema = ctl_plane_chatbot_schema();
        let state = super::super::ctl_plane_chatbot_methods::config_state_fields(
            &CtlPlaneChatbotConfig::default(),
        )
        .unwrap();
        let state = simd_json::serde::to_owned_value(state).unwrap();
        assert!(schema.validate(&state).valid);
        assert!(state.get("running").is_none());
        assert!(state.get("reasoning_episode").is_none());
        assert!(state.get("vector_id").is_none());
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn generic_lifecycle_hooks_never_claim_durable_config_effects() {
        let plugin = CtlPlaneChatbotPlugin::new();
        let current = simd_json::serde::to_owned_value(CtlPlaneChatbotConfig::default()).unwrap();
        let desired_config = CtlPlaneChatbotConfig {
            vectorization_enabled: false,
            ..CtlPlaneChatbotConfig::default()
        };
        let desired = simd_json::serde::to_owned_value(desired_config).unwrap();
        let diff = plugin.calculate_diff(&current, &desired).await.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(diff.actions.len(), 1, "pure diff remains descriptive only");
        assert!(plugin.apply_state(&diff).await.is_err());
        assert!(plugin.verify_state(&desired).await.is_err());
        assert!(plugin.create_checkpoint().await.is_err());
        let checkpoint = Checkpoint {
            id: "untrusted-fixture".into(),
            plugin: plugin.name().into(),
            timestamp: 0,
            state_snapshot: simd_json::json!(null),
            backend_checkpoint: None,
        };
        assert!(plugin.rollback(&checkpoint).await.is_err());
        let capabilities = StatePlugin::capabilities(&plugin);
        assert!(!capabilities.supports_rollback);
        assert!(!capabilities.supports_checkpoints);
        assert!(!capabilities.supports_verification);
        assert!(!capabilities.atomic_operations);
    }

    #[test]
    fn all_subids_are_valid() {
        let raw = serde_json::to_value(schemars::schema_for!(CtlPlaneChatbotState)).unwrap();
        let mut subids = Vec::new();
        collect_subids(&raw, &mut subids);
        for subid in subids {
            assert!(
                crate::state_plugins::common::oscal::validate_subid(&subid).is_ok(),
                "invalid subid: {subid}"
            );
        }
    }

    fn collect_subids(value: &serde_json::Value, out: &mut Vec<String>) {
        if let Some(obj) = value.as_object() {
            if let Some(subid) = obj.get("x-oscal-subid").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {
                out.push(subid.to_string());
            }
            for v in obj.values() {
                collect_subids(v, out);
            }
        }
        if let Some(arr) = value.as_array() {
            for v in arr {
                collect_subids(v, out);
            }
        }
    }
}

// Self-registration: the plugin registry discovers this via inventory
// (single source of the catalog; no central dispatch list).
inventory::submit! {
    crate::default_registry::PluginReg::new("ctl_plane_chatbot", |_ctx| std::sync::Arc::new(CtlPlaneChatbotPlugin::new()))
}
</file>

<file path="op-plugins/src/state_plugins/datastore.rs">
//! `datastore` indexes the canonical committed public plugin projections.
//!
//! The five retained methods are read-only views over manifest-pinned sealed
//! schemas and the matching SHM projection generation. This plugin owns the
//! method contract; it does not create a database, read private runtime
//! documents, or aggregate independently owned audit/execution stores.

use anyhow::{bail, Result};
use async_trait::async_trait;
use op_state::{ApplyResult, Checkpoint, PluginCapabilities, StateDiff, StatePlugin};
use op_state_store::PluginSchema;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use simd_json::OwnedValue as Value;

pub const MAX_DATASTORE_SELECTION: usize = 256;
pub const MAX_DATASTORE_RESPONSE_BYTES: usize = 16 * 1024 * 1024;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "sch.software.plugin.datastore.schema@v2"))]
#[schemars(extend("x-oscal-category" = "data"))]
pub struct DataStoreState {
    pub generation: u64,
    pub catalog_hash: String,
    pub object_count: usize,
    pub present_count: usize,
    pub withheld_count: usize,
    pub unobserved_count: usize,
    pub state_bytes: u64,
    pub objects: Vec<DataStoreObjectRef>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum PublicObjectExposure {
    /// A committed observation exists and was filtered by the sealed schema's
    /// explicit public-state policy.
    Present,
    /// The sealed schema deliberately declares no public-state paths.
    Withheld,
    /// The schema exposes public paths, but no observation has been committed.
    Unobserved,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct DataStoreObjectRef {
    pub plugin_id: String,
    pub object_path: String,
    pub schema_hash: String,
    pub exposure: PublicObjectExposure,
    pub state_bytes: u64,
}

/// Schema-owned dynamic content inside a typed, generation-bound envelope.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct DataStoreObject {
    pub reference: DataStoreObjectRef,
    /// Structurally exact JSON parsed from the manifest-pinned sealed plugin
    /// schema. `reference.schema_hash` binds it to the original sealed bytes.
    pub schema: serde_json::Value,
    /// Policy-filtered committed state. `None` is explained by `exposure`.
    pub state: Option<serde_json::Value>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct SnapshotBinding {
    pub generation: u64,
    pub catalog_hash: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct PluginSelection {
    /// Exact sealed plugin ids. Empty selects the whole sealed catalog.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(length(max = 256), inner(length(min = 1, max = 128)))]
    pub plugin_ids: Vec<String>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct GetObjectInput {
    #[schemars(length(min = 1, max = 128))]
    pub plugin_id: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct QueryInput {
    /// Exact sealed plugin ids. Empty selects the whole sealed catalog.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(length(max = 256), inner(length(min = 1, max = 128)))]
    pub plugin_ids: Vec<String>,
    /// Optional exact exposure class; no arbitrary query language is accepted.
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub exposure: Option<PublicObjectExposure>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct GetStatsInput {}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct ListObjectsOutput {
    pub binding: SnapshotBinding,
    pub objects: Vec<DataStoreObjectRef>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct GetObjectOutput {
    pub binding: SnapshotBinding,
    pub object: DataStoreObject,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct QueryOutput {
    pub binding: SnapshotBinding,
    pub results: Vec<DataStoreObject>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct GetStatsOutput {
    pub binding: SnapshotBinding,
    pub object_count: usize,
    pub present_count: usize,
    pub withheld_count: usize,
    pub unobserved_count: usize,
    pub state_bytes: u64,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct ExportOutput {
    pub binding: SnapshotBinding,
    pub objects: Vec<DataStoreObject>,
}

pub struct DataStorePlugin;

impl DataStorePlugin {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self
    }
}

impl Default for DataStorePlugin {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}

#[async_trait]
impl StatePlugin for DataStorePlugin {
    fn name(&self) -> &str {
        "datastore"
    }

    fn version(&self) -> &str {
        "2.0.0"
    }

    fn schema(&self) -> Option<PluginSchema> {
        let mut schema = datastore_schema();
        super::common::oscal::ensure_category_metadata_fields(&mut schema);
        Some(schema)
    }

    async fn calculate_diff(&self, _current: &Value, _desired: &Value) -> Result<StateDiff> {
        bail!("datastore is a read-only committed public projection index")
    }

    async fn apply_state(&self, _diff: &StateDiff) -> Result<ApplyResult> {
        bail!("datastore has no mutation or apply operation")
    }

    async fn verify_state(&self, _desired: &Value) -> Result<bool> {
        bail!("datastore has no desired-state verification operation")
    }

    async fn create_checkpoint(&self) -> Result<Checkpoint> {
        bail!("datastore does not own the SHM projection transaction")
    }

    async fn rollback(&self, _checkpoint: &Checkpoint) -> Result<()> {
        bail!("datastore does not own rollback")
    }

    fn capabilities(&self) -> PluginCapabilities {
        PluginCapabilities {
            supports_rollback: false,
            supports_checkpoints: false,
            supports_verification: false,
            atomic_operations: false,
        }
    }
}

pub(crate) fn datastore_schema() -> PluginSchema {
    use super::plugin_scaffold_helpers::method_decl_from_schemars_with_output;
    use op_state_store::SideEffect;

    let root = serde_json::to_value(schemars::schema_for!(DataStoreState))
        .expect("schemars schema serializes to JSON");
    let mut schema = super::schemars_adapter::plugin_schema_from_json(
        "datastore",
        "2.0.0",
        "Read-only index of manifest-pinned, policy-filtered committed public plugin state",
        &root,
    );
    schema.example = Some(simd_json::json!({
        "generation": 7,
        "catalog_hash": "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa",
        "object_count": 1,
        "present_count": 1,
        "withheld_count": 0,
        "unobserved_count": 0,
        "state_bytes": 18,
        "objects": [{
            "plugin_id": "service",
            "object_path": "/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/service",
            "schema_hash": "bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb",
            "exposure": "present",
            "state_bytes": 18
        }]
    }));

    schema.methods.insert(
        "list_objects".into(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<PluginSelection, ListObjectsOutput>(
            "list_objects",
            SideEffect::Read,
            true,
            "datastore.read",
            "obs.service.datastore.object.list@v2",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "get_object".into(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<GetObjectInput, GetObjectOutput>(
            "get_object",
            SideEffect::Read,
            true,
            "datastore.read",
            "obs.service.datastore.object.get@v2",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "query".into(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<QueryInput, QueryOutput>(
            "query",
            SideEffect::Read,
            true,
            "datastore.read",
            "obs.service.datastore.query@v2",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "get_stats".into(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<GetStatsInput, GetStatsOutput>(
            "get_stats",
            SideEffect::Read,
            true,
            "datastore.read",
            "obs.service.datastore.stats@v2",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "export".into(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<PluginSelection, ExportOutput>(
            "export",
            SideEffect::Read,
            true,
            "datastore.read",
            "obs.service.datastore.export@v2",
        ),
    );
    schema.capabilities.insert(
        "datastore.read".into(),
        op_state_store::CapabilityDecl {
            id: "datastore.read".into(),
            description: "Grants read-only access to sealed-schema-filtered public SHM projections through list_objects, get_object, query, get_stats and export.".into(),
        },
    );
    schema
}

inventory::submit! {
    crate::default_registry::PluginReg::new("datastore", |_ctx| std::sync::Arc::new(DataStorePlugin::new()))
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn five_method_contract_is_typed_and_read_only() {
        let schema = datastore_schema();
        assert_eq!(schema.version, "2.0.0");
        assert_eq!(schema.methods.len(), 5);
        for (name, method) in &schema.methods {
            assert_eq!(name, &method.name);
            assert_eq!(method.side_effect, op_state_store::SideEffect::Read);
            assert_eq!(
                serde_json::to_value(&method.args).unwrap()["type"],
                "object"
            );
            assert_eq!(
                serde_json::to_value(method.returns.as_ref().unwrap()).unwrap()["type"],
                "object"
            );
        }
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn lifecycle_hooks_never_fabricate_success() {
        let plugin = DataStorePlugin::new();
        let empty = simd_json::json!({});
        assert!(plugin.calculate_diff(&empty, &empty).await.is_err());
        assert!(plugin.verify_state(&empty).await.is_err());
        assert!(plugin.create_checkpoint().await.is_err());
    }
}
