//! Provider-agnostic embedding contracts and native request adapters.
//!
//! One nonsecret runtime configuration is persisted in RuntimeDocuments and
//! read for every canonical request. Credentials stay in the environment.

use anyhow::Result;
use async_trait::async_trait;
use op_state::{ApplyResult, Checkpoint, DiffMetadata, PluginCapabilities, StateDiff, StatePlugin};
use op_state_store::PluginSchema;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use simd_json::OwnedValue as Value;

#[path = "embedding_model_methods.rs"]
pub mod methods;
pub use methods::{
    dispatch_embedding_model_method, embedding_model_state, restored_embedding_state,
};

/// Default public Voyage AI endpoint. The only copy of this constant — consumers
/// (e.g. `op-cognitive-mcp`) resolve their call-time endpoint through
/// [`voyage_embed_params`] rather than hardcoding it themselves.
const VOYAGE_PUBLIC_URL: &str = "https://api.voyageai.com/v1/embeddings";
/// MongoDB-hosted Voyage AI endpoint (for keys prefixed with `al-`). The only
/// copy of this constant.
const VOYAGE_MONGODB_URL: &str = "https://ai.mongodb.com/v1/embeddings";

/// Top-level state for the generic embedding surface.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "sch.software.plugin.embedding-model.schema@v1"))]
#[schemars(extend("x-oscal-category" = "llm"))]
pub struct EmbeddingModelState {
    /// Durable configuration revision; zero means environment bootstrap.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub config_revision: u64,
    /// Embedding provider / runtime — the only provider-aware field
    /// ("voyage", "ollama", …).
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "mut.service.embedding-model.provider@v1"))]
    pub provider: String,
    /// Active embedding model identifier, e.g. "voyage-4", "voyage-4-lite".
    /// Swappable; resolved from config / provider, never hardcoded.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "mut.service.embedding-model.model-id@v1"))]
    pub model_id: String,
    /// Provider endpoint URL.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "mut.service.embedding-model.endpoint@v1"))]
    pub endpoint: String,
    /// Shared output dimensionality of the embedding space. The voyage-4 trio
    /// all emit 1024-dim vectors into one Qdrant collection; one dim per space.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "mut.service.embedding-model.dimensions@v1"))]
    pub dimensions: u32,
    /// Configuration snapshots are "unprobed". Credential presence is not
    /// evidence that the remote embedding provider is reachable.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "obs.software.embedding-model.status@v1"))]
    pub status: String,
    /// Models reported available by the provider (observed live where the
    /// provider supports enumeration; empty for cloud providers that don't).
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "obs.software.embedding-model.available-models@v1"))]
    pub available_models: Vec<String>,
    /// Content digest of the active model as reported by the provider (observed).
    /// Pins the exact weights the surface is bound to for audit / provenance;
    /// empty for providers that don't expose a digest.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "obs.software.embedding-model.model-digest@v1"))]
    pub model_digest: String,
}

/// Interchangeable Voyage-4 embedding models — the canonical Voyage catalog.
///
/// `voyage-4-large`, `voyage-4` and `voyage-4-lite` share **one** embedding
/// space: vectors from any of the three are directly comparable, so all three
/// write to the *same* Qdrant collection at the *same* dimensionality
/// ([`VoyageModel::SHARED_EMBEDDING_DIMS`]). Switching models is a quality/cost
/// tradeoff only — it never requires re-vectorizing existing data.
///
/// This legacy catalog remains the compatibility set for the existing shared
/// collection. The generic dispatcher accepts other configured models without
/// claiming that their vectors share this collection's embedding space.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema, PartialEq)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum VoyageModel {
    #[serde(rename = "voyage-4-large")]
    Voyage4Large,
    #[serde(rename = "voyage-4")]
    Voyage4,
    #[serde(rename = "voyage-4-lite")]
    Voyage4Lite,
}

impl Default for VoyageModel {
    fn default() -> Self {
        // POC target; cheapest of the shared-space trio.
        VoyageModel::Voyage4Lite
    }
}

impl VoyageModel {
    /// The single shared embedding dimensionality for the interchangeable
    /// voyage-4 trio. One collection, no re-index across models.
    pub const SHARED_EMBEDDING_DIMS: u32 = 1024;

    /// The interchangeable models, all in the shared embedding space.
    pub const SHARED_SPACE: [VoyageModel; 3] = [
        VoyageModel::Voyage4Large,
        VoyageModel::Voyage4,
        VoyageModel::Voyage4Lite,
    ];

    /// Canonical Voyage API model id.
    pub fn model_id(&self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            VoyageModel::Voyage4Large => "voyage-4-large",
            VoyageModel::Voyage4 => "voyage-4",
            VoyageModel::Voyage4Lite => "voyage-4-lite",
        }
    }

    /// Output dimensionality. Identical across the trio so their vectors fuse
    /// and compare in the same Qdrant collection.
    pub fn dimensions(&self) -> u32 {
        Self::SHARED_EMBEDDING_DIMS
    }
}

/// Secret call parameters for the legacy Voyage-specific shared collection.
/// Deliberately not serializable, schema-derived, or Debug-printable.
pub struct VoyageEmbedParams {
    pub endpoint: String,
    pub model_id: String,
    pub api_key: String,
}

/// Incompatible providers, dimensions, model spaces, and credential origins
/// are rejected instead of sending Voyage requests to a different protocol.
pub fn voyage_embed_params() -> Option<VoyageEmbedParams> {
    let key = EmbeddingModelPlugin::voyage_api_key()?;
    let state = match op_core::projection_shm::read_projection_bytes("embedding_model") {
        Some(bytes) => serde_json::from_slice::<EmbeddingModelState>(&bytes).ok()?,
        None => methods::EmbeddingConfig::from_environment().ok()?.state(0),
    };
    let model_id = legacy_voyage_model(&state)?;
    methods::validate_voyage_credential_endpoint(&state.endpoint, &key).ok()?;
    Some(VoyageEmbedParams {
        endpoint: state.endpoint,
        model_id,
        api_key: key,
    })
}

fn legacy_voyage_model(state: &EmbeddingModelState) -> Option<String> {
    if state.provider != "voyage" || state.dimensions != VoyageModel::SHARED_EMBEDDING_DIMS {
        return None;
    }
    let model_id = if state.model_id.is_empty() {
        VoyageModel::default().model_id().to_string()
    } else {
        state.model_id.clone()
    };
    if !VoyageModel::SHARED_SPACE
        .iter()
        .any(|model| model.model_id() == model_id)
    {
        return None;
    }
    Some(model_id)
}

pub struct EmbeddingModelPlugin;
impl Default for EmbeddingModelPlugin {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self
    }
}

impl EmbeddingModelPlugin {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self
    }
    fn voyage_api_key() -> Option<String> {
        [
            "COGNITIVE_MCP_VOYAGE_API_KEY",
            "VOYAGE_API_KEY",
            "VOYAGE_API_KEY_RUST",
        ]
        .iter()
        .find_map(|key| {
            std::env::var(key)
                .ok()
                .filter(|value| !value.trim().is_empty())
        })
    }
    fn voyage_url_for_key(key: &str) -> String {
        if key.trim().starts_with("al-") {
            VOYAGE_MONGODB_URL
        } else {
            VOYAGE_PUBLIC_URL
        }
        .to_string()
    }
}

#[async_trait]
impl StatePlugin for EmbeddingModelPlugin {
    fn name(&self) -> &str {
        "embedding_model"
    }
    fn version(&self) -> &str {
        "2.0.0"
    }
    fn schema(&self) -> Option<PluginSchema> {
        let mut schema = embedding_model_schema();
        super::common::oscal::ensure_category_metadata_fields(&mut schema);
        Some(schema)
    }
    async fn calculate_diff(&self, _current: &Value, _desired: &Value) -> Result<StateDiff> {
        Ok(StateDiff {
            plugin: self.name().to_string(),
            actions: vec![],
            metadata: DiffMetadata {
                timestamp: chrono::Utc::now().timestamp(),
                current_hash: "schema-declared".to_string(),
                desired_hash: "schema-declared".to_string(),
            },
        })
    }
    async fn apply_state(&self, _diff: &StateDiff) -> Result<ApplyResult> {
        anyhow::bail!("embedding configuration changes require set_model or update_config")
    }
    async fn verify_state(&self, desired: &Value) -> Result<bool> {
        let actual = simd_json::serde::to_owned_value(embedding_model_state().await?)?;
        Ok(&actual == desired)
    }
    async fn create_checkpoint(&self) -> Result<Checkpoint> {
        Ok(Checkpoint {
            id: uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string(),
            plugin: self.name().to_string(),
            timestamp: chrono::Utc::now().timestamp(),
            state_snapshot: simd_json::serde::to_owned_value(embedding_model_state().await?)?,
            backend_checkpoint: None,
        })
    }
    async fn rollback(&self, _checkpoint: &Checkpoint) -> Result<()> {
        anyhow::bail!("embedding configuration rollback requires an explicit update_config")
    }
    fn capabilities(&self) -> PluginCapabilities {
        PluginCapabilities {
            supports_rollback: false,
            supports_checkpoints: true,
            supports_verification: true,
            atomic_operations: false,
        }
    }
}

/// Every input/output is plugin-owned and seals with this versioned contract.
pub(crate) fn embedding_model_schema() -> PluginSchema {
    use super::plugin_scaffold_helpers::method_decl_from_schemars_with_output;
    use methods::*;
    use op_state_store::SideEffect;
    let root = serde_json::to_value(schemars::schema_for!(EmbeddingModelState))
        .expect("embedding state schema serializes");
    let mut schema = super::schemars_adapter::plugin_schema_from_json(
        "embedding_model",
        "2.0.0",
        "Native embeddings through a configured Voyage, Ollama, or OpenAI-compatible provider",
        &root,
    );
    macro_rules! method {
        ($name:literal, $input:ty, $output:ty, $effect:ident, $cap:literal, $subid:literal) => {
            schema.methods.insert(
                $name.into(),
                method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<$input, $output>(
                    $name,
                    SideEffect::$effect,
                    true,
                    $cap,
                    $subid,
                ),
            );
        };
    }
    method!(
        "embed",
        EmbedInput,
        EmbedOutput,
        Mutation,
        "embedding.invoke",
        "mut.service.embedding.embed@v1"
    );
    method!(
        "list_models",
        EmptyInput,
        ListModelsOutput,
        Read,
        "embedding.read",
        "obs.service.embedding.model.list@v1"
    );
    method!(
        "get_config",
        EmptyInput,
        ConfigOutput,
        Read,
        "embedding.read",
        "obs.service.embedding.config.get@v1"
    );
    method!(
        "set_model",
        SetModelInput,
        ConfigOutput,
        Mutation,
        "embedding.invoke",
        "mut.service.embedding.model.set@v1"
    );
    method!(
        "update_config",
        UpdateConfigInput,
        ConfigOutput,
        Mutation,
        "embedding.invoke",
        "mut.service.embedding.config.update@v1"
    );
    for (id, description) in [
        (
            "embedding.invoke",
            "Embed texts and change the nonsecret embedding selection",
        ),
        (
            "embedding.read",
            "Read embedding configuration and provider model metadata",
        ),
    ] {
        schema.capabilities.insert(
            id.into(),
            op_state_store::CapabilityDecl {
                id: id.into(),
                description: description.into(),
            },
        );
    }
    schema
}
inventory::submit! {
    crate::default_registry::PluginReg::new("embedding_model", |_ctx| std::sync::Arc::new(EmbeddingModelPlugin::new()))
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn legacy_voyage_consumer_rejects_other_protocols_and_vector_spaces() {
        let mut state = EmbeddingModelState {
            provider: "voyage".into(),
            model_id: "voyage-4-lite".into(),
            dimensions: 1024,
            ..Default::default()
        };
        assert_eq!(
            legacy_voyage_model(&state).as_deref(),
            Some("voyage-4-lite")
        );
        for provider in ["ollama", "openai", "openai_compatible", "unknown"] {
            state.provider = provider.into();
            assert!(legacy_voyage_model(&state).is_none());
        }
        state.provider = "voyage".into();
        state.dimensions = 512;
        assert!(legacy_voyage_model(&state).is_none());
        state.dimensions = 1024;
        state.model_id = "different-vector-space".into();
        assert!(legacy_voyage_model(&state).is_none());
    }
}
</file>

<file path="op-plugins/src/state_plugins/emqx_native_tests.rs">
use super::*;
use serde_json::{json, Value};
use std::sync::{
    atomic::{AtomicU8, Ordering},
    Arc, Mutex,
};
use std::time::Duration;
use tokio::io::{AsyncReadExt, AsyncWriteExt};
use tokio::net::{TcpListener, TcpStream, UnixStream};

const FIXTURE_KEY: &str = "fixture-key";
const FIXTURE_SECRET: &str = "fixture-secret";

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
enum ApiMode {
    Healthy = 0,
    Unauthorized = 1,
    PublicListener = 2,
    UnauthenticatedHook = 3,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
struct HttpRequest {
    method: String,
    target: String,
    authorized: bool,
    body: Option<Value>,
}

struct HttpFixture {
    api_base: String,
    requests: Arc<Mutex<Vec<HttpRequest>>>,
    mode: Arc<AtomicU8>,
    task: tokio::task::JoinHandle<()>,
}

impl Drop for HttpFixture {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        self.task.abort();
    }
}

impl HttpFixture {
    async fn spawn(mode: ApiMode) -> Self {
        let listener = TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").await.unwrap();
        let address = listener.local_addr().unwrap();
        let requests = Arc::new(Mutex::new(Vec::new()));
        let mode = Arc::new(AtomicU8::new(mode as u8));
        let task_requests = requests.clone();
        let task_mode = mode.clone();
        let task = tokio::spawn(async move {
            while let Ok((stream, _)) = listener.accept().await {
                serve_http_request(stream, task_requests.clone(), task_mode.clone()).await;
            }
        });
        Self {
            api_base: format!("http://{address}/api/v5"),
            requests,
            mode,
            task,
        }
    }

    fn set_mode(&self, mode: ApiMode) {
        self.mode.store(mode as u8, Ordering::SeqCst);
    }

    fn requests(&self) -> Vec<HttpRequest> {
        self.requests.lock().unwrap().clone()
    }
}

async fn serve_http_request(
    mut stream: TcpStream,
    requests: Arc<Mutex<Vec<HttpRequest>>>,
    mode: Arc<AtomicU8>,
) {
    let Some((head, body)) = read_http_request(&mut stream).await else {
        return;
    };
    let mut lines = head.lines();
    let Some(request_line) = lines.next() else {
        return;
    };
    let mut request_parts = request_line.split_whitespace();
    let method = request_parts.next().unwrap_or_default().to_string();
    let target = request_parts.next().unwrap_or_default().to_string();
    let expected_auth = "Basic Zml4dHVyZS1rZXk6Zml4dHVyZS1zZWNyZXQ=";
    let authorized = lines.any(|line| {
        line.split_once(':').is_some_and(|(name, value)| {
            name.eq_ignore_ascii_case("authorization") && value.trim() == expected_auth
        })
    });
    let body = if body.is_empty() {
        None
    } else {
        serde_json::from_slice::<Value>(&body).ok()
    };
    requests.lock().unwrap().push(HttpRequest {
        method: method.clone(),
        target: target.clone(),
        authorized,
        body,
    });

    let mode = mode.load(Ordering::SeqCst);
    if !authorized || mode == ApiMode::Unauthorized as u8 {
        write_http_response(&mut stream, 401, json!({"code":"UNAUTHORIZED"})).await;
        return;
    }

    let listener_bind = if mode == ApiMode::PublicListener as u8 {
        "0.0.0.0:1883"
    } else {
        "127.0.0.1:1883"
    };
    let hook_verify = if mode == ApiMode::UnauthenticatedHook as u8 {
        "verify_none"
    } else {
        "verify_peer"
    };
    let hooks = REGISTERED_HOOKS
        .iter()
        .map(|name| json!({"name": name}))
        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
    let response = match (method.as_str(), target.as_str()) {
        ("GET", "/api/v5/status?format=json") => {
            json!({"node_name":"emqx@127.0.0.1","app_status":"running"})
        }
        ("GET", "/api/v5/nodes") => json!({"data":[{
            "node":"emqx@127.0.0.1",
            "node_status":"running",
            "version":EMQX_RELEASE_VERSION
        }]}),
        ("GET", "/api/v5/listeners") => json!({"data":[{
            "id":"tcp:default",
            "type":"tcp",
            "bind":listener_bind,
            "running":true,
            "current_connections":3,
            "max_connections":1024
        }]}),
        ("GET", "/api/v5/exhooks") => json!({"data":[{
            "name":EXHOOK_SERVER_NAME,
            "url":EXHOOK_TARGET,
            "enable":true,
            "ssl":{
                "enable":true,
                "verify":hook_verify,
                "cacertfile":"/etc/op-dbus/tls/tonic-svc0-ca.crt",
                "certfile":"/etc/op-dbus/tls/emqx-exhook-client.crt",
                "keyfile":"/etc/op-dbus/tls/emqx-exhook-client.key"
            },
            "node_status":[{"node":"emqx@127.0.0.1","status":"connected"}],
            "hooks":hooks
        }]}),
        ("PUT", "/api/v5/exhooks/opdbus") => json!({}),
        _ => {
            write_http_response(&mut stream, 404, json!({"code":"NOT_FOUND"})).await;
            return;
        }
    };
    write_http_response(&mut stream, 200, response).await;
}

async fn read_http_request(stream: &mut TcpStream) -> Option<(String, Vec<u8>)> {
    const MAX_REQUEST: usize = 64 * 1024;
    let mut bytes = Vec::new();
    let header_end = loop {
        if let Some(offset) = bytes.windows(4).position(|window| window == b"\r\n\r\n") {
            break offset + 4;
        }
        if bytes.len() >= MAX_REQUEST {
            return None;
        }
        let mut buffer = [0_u8; 4096];
        let read = stream.read(&mut buffer).await.ok()?;
        if read == 0 {
            return None;
        }
        bytes.extend_from_slice(&buffer[..read]);
    };
    let head = String::from_utf8(bytes[..header_end].to_vec()).ok()?;
    let content_length = head
        .lines()
        .find_map(|line| {
            let (name, value) = line.split_once(':')?;
            if name.eq_ignore_ascii_case("content-length") {
                value.trim().parse::<usize>().ok()
            } else {
                None
            }
        })
        .unwrap_or(0);
    if header_end.saturating_add(content_length) > MAX_REQUEST {
        return None;
    }
    while bytes.len() < header_end + content_length {
        let mut buffer = [0_u8; 4096];
        let read = stream.read(&mut buffer).await.ok()?;
        if read == 0 {
            return None;
        }
        bytes.extend_from_slice(&buffer[..read]);
    }
    Some((
        head,
        bytes[header_end..header_end + content_length].to_vec(),
    ))
}

async fn write_http_response(stream: &mut TcpStream, status: u16, body: Value) {
    let body = serde_json::to_vec(&body).unwrap();
    let reason = match status {
        200 => "OK",
        401 => "Unauthorized",
        _ => "Not Found",
    };
    let head = format!(
        "HTTP/1.1 {status} {reason}\r\ncontent-type: application/json\r\ncontent-length: {}\r\nconnection: close\r\n\r\n",
        body.len()
    );
    stream.write_all(head.as_bytes()).await.unwrap();
    stream.write_all(&body).await.unwrap();
    stream.shutdown().await.unwrap();
}

struct RunitFixtureState {
    running: bool,
    reject_lifecycle: bool,
    calls: Vec<String>,
}

#[derive(Clone)]
struct RunitFixture {
    state: Arc<Mutex<RunitFixtureState>>,
}

impl RunitFixture {
    fn lifecycle(&self, action: &str, service: &str, running: bool) -> (bool, String) {
        let mut state = self.state.lock().unwrap();
        state.calls.push(format!("{action}:{service}"));
        if state.reject_lifecycle {
            return (false, "fixture rejected lifecycle request".to_string());
        }
        state.running = running;
        (true, format!("fixture accepted {action}"))
    }
}

#[zbus::interface(name = "org.opdbus.v1.Runit.Systemctl")]
impl RunitFixture {
    fn status(&self, service: &str) -> String {
        let mut state = self.state.lock().unwrap();
        state.calls.push(format!("Status:{service}"));
        if state.running {
            json!({
                "name":service,
                "active_state":"active",
                "sub_state":"running",
                "main_pid":4242,
                "up_time":"17s"
            })
            .to_string()
        } else {
            json!({
                "name":service,
                "active_state":"inactive",
                "sub_state":"down",
                "main_pid":null,
                "up_time":"0s"
            })
            .to_string()
        }
    }

    fn start(&self, service: &str) -> (bool, String) {
        self.lifecycle("Start", service, true)
    }

    fn stop(&self, service: &str) -> (bool, String) {
        self.lifecycle("Stop", service, false)
    }

    fn restart(&self, service: &str) -> (bool, String) {
        self.lifecycle("Restart", service, true)
    }
}

struct NativeFixture {
    transport: EmqxNativeTransport,
    http: HttpFixture,
    runit_state: Arc<Mutex<RunitFixtureState>>,
    _dbus_server: Connection,
}

impl NativeFixture {
    async fn spawn(running: bool, reject_lifecycle: bool, api_mode: ApiMode) -> Self {
        let http = HttpFixture::spawn(api_mode).await;
        let runit_state = Arc::new(Mutex::new(RunitFixtureState {
            running,
            reject_lifecycle,
            calls: Vec::new(),
        }));
        let (server_stream, client_stream) = UnixStream::pair().unwrap();
        let server = zbus::connection::Builder::unix_stream(server_stream)
            .server(zbus::Guid::generate())
            .unwrap()
            .p2p()
            .serve_at(
                RUNIT_OBJECT_PATH,
                RunitFixture {
                    state: runit_state.clone(),
                },
            )
            .unwrap()
            .build();
        let client = zbus::connection::Builder::unix_stream(client_stream)
            .p2p()
            .build();
        let (_dbus_server, client) = tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(5), async {
            tokio::try_join!(server, client)
        })
        .await
        .expect("D-Bus fixture handshake timed out")
        .unwrap();
        let transport = EmqxNativeTransport {
            runit_connection: Some(client),
            api_base: http.api_base.clone(),
            api_credentials: Some((FIXTURE_KEY.to_string(), FIXTURE_SECRET.to_string())),
        };
        Self {
            transport,
            http,
            runit_state,
            _dbus_server,
        }
    }

    async fn call(&self, method: &str, args: Value) -> Result<Value> {
        let schema = emqx_schema();
        let declaration = &schema.methods[method];
        let input_schema = serde_json::to_value(&declaration.args)?;
        jsonschema::validator_for(&input_schema)?
            .validate(&args)
            .map_err(|error| anyhow::anyhow!("EMQX {method} input contract: {error}"))?;
        let output = dispatch_emqx_method_on(&self.transport, method, &args).await?;
        let output_schema = serde_json::to_value(declaration.returns.as_ref().unwrap())?;
        jsonschema::validator_for(&output_schema)?
            .validate(&output)
            .map_err(|error| anyhow::anyhow!("EMQX {method} output contract: {error}"))?;
        Ok(output)
    }

    fn runit_calls(&self) -> Vec<String> {
        self.runit_state.lock().unwrap().calls.clone()
    }
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn retained_read_methods_use_authenticated_native_readback() {
    let fixture = NativeFixture::spawn(true, false, ApiMode::Healthy).await;

    let mcp = fixture.call("get_mcp_status", json!({})).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(mcp["gateway_installed"], false);
    assert_eq!(mcp["internal_transport_only"], true);
    assert_eq!(mcp["external_mcp_endpoint"], "https://10.0.0.3:8090/mcp");

    let status = fixture.call("get_status", json!({})).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(status["running"], true);
    assert_eq!(status["pid"], 4242);
    assert_eq!(status["uptime_seconds"], 17);
    assert_eq!(status["version"], EMQX_RELEASE_VERSION);
    assert_eq!(status["listeners_active"], 1);
    assert_eq!(status["connections_current"], 3);

    let listeners = fixture.call("list_listeners", json!({})).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(listeners["total_connections"], 3);
    assert_eq!(listeners["all_loopback_or_uds"], true);
    assert_eq!(listeners["listeners"][0]["bind"], EMQX_MQTT_TCP_BIND);

    let hooks = fixture.call("list_hooks", json!({})).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(hooks["total_hooks"], REGISTERED_HOOKS.len());
    assert_eq!(hooks["exhook_servers"][0]["transport_authenticated"], true);

    let hook = fixture
        .call("get_hook_status", json!({"server_name":EXHOOK_SERVER_NAME}))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(hook["found"], true);
    assert_eq!(hook["server"]["name"], EXHOOK_SERVER_NAME);

    let requests = fixture.http.requests();
    assert_eq!(
        requests
            .iter()
            .map(|request| request.target.as_str())
            .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
        [
            "/api/v5/status?format=json",
            "/api/v5/nodes",
            "/api/v5/listeners",
            "/api/v5/listeners",
            "/api/v5/exhooks",
            "/api/v5/exhooks",
        ]
    );
    assert!(requests.iter().all(|request| request.authorized));
    assert!(requests.iter().all(|request| request.method == "GET"));
    assert!(fixture
        .runit_calls()
        .iter()
        .all(|call| call == "Status:emqx"));
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn configure_hooks_sends_fixed_mtls_shape_and_verifies_readback() {
    let fixture = NativeFixture::spawn(true, false, ApiMode::Healthy).await;
    let hooks = REGISTERED_HOOKS
        .iter()
        .map(|hook| (*hook).to_string())
        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
    let output = fixture
        .call(
            "configure_hooks",
            json!({
                "server_name":EXHOOK_SERVER_NAME,
                "target":"loopback_mtls",
                "enable":true,
                "hooks":hooks
            }),
        )
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(output["configured"], true);
    assert_eq!(output["server_name"], EXHOOK_SERVER_NAME);
    assert_eq!(output["is_local"], true);

    let requests = fixture.http.requests();
    assert_eq!(requests.len(), 2);
    assert_eq!(requests[0].method, "PUT");
    assert_eq!(requests[0].target, "/api/v5/exhooks/opdbus");
    assert_eq!(requests[1].method, "GET");
    assert_eq!(requests[1].target, "/api/v5/exhooks");
    assert!(requests.iter().all(|request| request.authorized));
    let body = requests[0].body.as_ref().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(body["name"], EXHOOK_SERVER_NAME);
    assert_eq!(body["url"], EXHOOK_TARGET);
    assert_eq!(body["enable"], true);
    assert_eq!(body["ssl"]["verify"], "verify_peer");
    assert_eq!(
        body["ssl"]["certfile"],
        "/etc/op-dbus/tls/emqx-exhook-client.crt"
    );
    assert!(!body.to_string().contains(FIXTURE_SECRET));

    let request_count = requests.len();
    let error = fixture
        .call(
            "configure_hooks",
            json!({
                "server_name":EXHOOK_SERVER_NAME,
                "target":"loopback_mtls",
                "enable":true,
                "hooks":["message.publish"]
            }),
        )
        .await
        .expect_err("partial hook set must be rejected before the API call");
    assert!(error.to_string().contains("exact supported"));
    assert_eq!(fixture.http.requests().len(), request_count);
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn lifecycle_methods_use_fixed_dbus_members_and_observe_status() {
    let fixture = NativeFixture::spawn(false, false, ApiMode::Healthy).await;

    let started = fixture.call("start", json!({})).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(started["started"], true);
    assert_eq!(started["pid"], 4242);
    assert_eq!(started["node_name"], "emqx@127.0.0.1");

    let stopped = fixture.call("stop", json!({})).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(stopped["stopped"], true);
    assert_eq!(stopped["was_running"], true);

    let restarted = fixture.call("restart", json!({})).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(restarted["restarted"], true);
    assert_eq!(restarted["previous_uptime"], 0);
    assert_eq!(restarted["node_name"], "emqx@127.0.0.1");

    let calls = fixture.runit_calls();
    assert!(calls.iter().any(|call| call == "Start:emqx"));
    assert!(calls.iter().any(|call| call == "Stop:emqx"));
    assert!(calls.iter().any(|call| call == "Restart:emqx"));
    assert!(calls.iter().all(|call| call.ends_with(EMQX_SERVICE)));
    let requests = fixture.http.requests();
    assert_eq!(
        requests
            .iter()
            .filter(|request| request.target == "/api/v5/status?format=json")
            .count(),
        2
    );
    assert!(requests.iter().all(|request| request.authorized));
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn native_auth_and_lifecycle_rejections_fail_without_false_success() {
    let unauthorized = NativeFixture::spawn(true, false, ApiMode::Unauthorized).await;
    let error = unauthorized
        .call("get_status", json!({}))
        .await
        .expect_err("API authentication failure must surface");
    let diagnostic = error.to_string();
    assert!(diagnostic.contains("HTTP 401"));
    assert!(!diagnostic.contains(FIXTURE_KEY));
    assert!(!diagnostic.contains(FIXTURE_SECRET));

    let rejected = NativeFixture::spawn(false, true, ApiMode::Healthy).await;
    let error = rejected
        .call("start", json!({}))
        .await
        .expect_err("D-Bus lifecycle rejection must surface");
    assert!(error.to_string().contains("rejected EMQX Start"));
    assert!(rejected.http.requests().is_empty());
    assert!(rejected
        .runit_calls()
        .iter()
        .any(|call| call == "Start:emqx"));

    let unreadable = NativeFixture::spawn(false, false, ApiMode::Unauthorized).await;
    let error = unreadable
        .call("start", json!({}))
        .await
        .expect_err("accepted lifecycle without authenticated health readback must fail");
    assert!(error
        .to_string()
        .contains("accepted but broker health readback failed"));
    assert!(unreadable
        .runit_calls()
        .iter()
        .any(|call| call == "Start:emqx"));
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn native_inventory_policy_violations_fail_closed() {
    let fixture = NativeFixture::spawn(true, false, ApiMode::PublicListener).await;
    let listener_error = fixture
        .call("list_listeners", json!({}))
        .await
        .expect_err("public listener must violate local transport policy");
    assert!(listener_error.to_string().contains("outside loopback/UDS"));

    fixture.http.set_mode(ApiMode::UnauthenticatedHook);
    let hook_error = fixture
        .call("list_hooks", json!({}))
        .await
        .expect_err("unauthenticated ExHook must violate transport policy");
    assert!(hook_error
        .to_string()
        .contains("unauthenticated or non-local"));
}

//! Standalone local EMQX broker plugin — GB.Emqx.
//!
//! This PluginSchema is the single typed present-state/control contract used
//! by D-Bus and generated/generic gRPC. EMQX ExHook callbacks remain a
//! separate `emqx.exhook.v3.HookProvider` protocol in `op-grpc-bridge`.
//! EMQX is not owned by, installed in, or coupled to Netmaker.

use super::plugin_scaffold_helpers::method_decl_from_schemars_with_output;
use anyhow::{Context, Result};
use async_trait::async_trait;
use op_state::{ApplyResult, Checkpoint, DiffMetadata, PluginCapabilities, StateDiff, StatePlugin};
use op_state_store::{CapabilityDecl, PluginSchema, SideEffect, SignalDecl};
use reqwest::Method;
use schemars::JsonSchema;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use serde_json::Value as JsonValue;
use simd_json::OwnedValue as Value;
use std::collections::BTreeSet;
use std::net::SocketAddr;
use std::time::Duration;
use zbus::{Connection, Proxy};

const PLUGIN_NAME: &str = "emqx";
const PLUGIN_VERSION: &str = "2.1.0";
const PLUGIN_CATEGORY: &str = "net";
const PLUGIN_DESCRIPTION: &str =
    "Standalone local EMQX broker: status, listeners, hooks, and fixed-service lifecycle";
const PLUGIN_DISPLAY_NAME: &str = "GB.Emqx";

pub const EMQX_RELEASE_VERSION: &str = "6.2.2";
pub const EMQX_SERVICE: &str = "emqx";
pub const EMQX_DATA_DIR: &str = "/var/lib/emqx";
pub const EMQX_CONFIG_DIR: &str = "/etc/emqx";
pub const EMQX_LOG_DIR: &str = "/var/log/emqx";
pub const EMQX_DASHBOARD_URL: &str = "http://127.0.0.1:18083";
pub const EMQX_API_BASE: &str = "http://127.0.0.1:18083/api/v5";
pub const EMQX_MQTT_TCP_BIND: &str = "127.0.0.1:1883";
/// Doorbell listener: MQTT over WSS on the svc0 fabric address (the same
/// WARP-inner address the `:8090` door binds), TLS from the svc0 material.
/// Browsers loaded over `https://10.0.0.3:8090` can only open `wss://`.
pub const EMQX_MQTT_WSS_BIND: &str = "10.0.0.3:8084";
/// The fabric address shared with the bridge door (`FABRIC_BIND` in the
/// op-grpc-bridge run script). Listeners may bind loopback or this address.
pub const FABRIC_SVC0_IP: &str = "10.0.0.3";
/// Content-free wake topics. `<owner-key>` is the private-view owner key
/// (`sha256(principal, session, genesis)`), so the broker never sees an
/// identity. Payload is `{"seq": <scope revision>}` only.
pub const WAKE_TOPIC_PREFIX: &str = "opdbus/wake/";
/// Transport scope a SID1 must carry to open the doorbell.
pub const WAKE_TRANSPORT_SCOPE: &str = "mqtt";

/// `opdbus/wake/<owner-key>` for a valid owner key.
pub fn wake_topic(owner_key: &str) -> Result<String> {
    anyhow::ensure!(
        valid_owner_key(owner_key),
        "wake owner key must be 64 lowercase hex characters"
    );
    Ok(format!("{WAKE_TOPIC_PREFIX}{owner_key}"))
}

pub fn valid_owner_key(owner_key: &str) -> bool {
    owner_key.len() == 64
        && owner_key
            .bytes()
            .all(|b| b.is_ascii_digit() || (b'a'..=b'f').contains(&b))
}
pub const EXHOOK_PROTO: &str = "emqx.exhook.v3";
pub const EXHOOK_SERVICE: &str = "emqx.exhook.v3.HookProvider";
pub const EXHOOK_SERVER_NAME: &str = "opdbus";
pub const EXHOOK_TARGET: &str = "https://127.0.0.1:9000";

const API_KEY_FILE: &str = "/etc/opdbus/secrets/emqx-api-key";
const API_SECRET_FILE: &str = "/etc/opdbus/secrets/emqx-api-secret";
const RUNIT_BUS_NAME: &str = "org.opdbus.v1.Runit.Systemctl";
const RUNIT_OBJECT_PATH: &str = "/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/runit/systemctl";
const RUNIT_INTERFACE: &str = "org.opdbus.v1.Runit.Systemctl";
const API_RESPONSE_LIMIT: usize = 1024 * 1024;

/// HookSpec names advertised by the bridge. Configuration accepts exactly this
/// set because the ExHook protocol does not support a caller-selected subset.
pub const REGISTERED_HOOKS: &[&str] = &[
    "client.connect",
    "client.connack",
    "client.connected",
    "client.disconnected",
    "client.authenticate",
    "client.authorize",
    "client.subscribe",
    "client.unsubscribe",
    "session.created",
    "session.subscribed",
    "session.unsubscribed",
    "session.resumed",
    "session.discarded",
    "session.takenover",
    "session.terminated",
    "message.publish",
    "message.delivered",
    "message.acked",
    "message.dropped",
];

/// Metadata-only observation of the authenticated broker's ExHook callback.
/// References are digests, not MQTT identities or reusable credentials. Broker
/// message bodies must never enter the globally visible accountability stream.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct BrokerEvent {
    pub event_type: String,
    pub client_ref: String,
    pub topic_ref: Option<String>,
    pub detail_ref: Option<String>,
}

pub const BROKER_EVENT_SIGNAL: &str = "broker_event";
pub const BROKER_EVENT_SUBID: &str = "evt.network.emqx.broker-event@v1";

fn typed_input<T: serde::de::DeserializeOwned>(args: &JsonValue) -> Result<T> {
    serde_json::from_value(if args.is_null() {
        JsonValue::Object(Default::default())
    } else {
        args.clone()
    })
    .map_err(|error| anyhow::anyhow!("emqx method input does not match its schema: {error}"))
}

/// Deterministic declared state. No live probe or credential is allowed here;
/// schema generation and blob sealing must produce identical output offline.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "sch.software.plugin.emqx.schema@v3"))]
#[schemars(extend("x-oscal-category" = "network"))]
#[schemars(extend("x-immutable-paths" = ["software", "service_name", "data_dir", "config_dir", "log_dir", "api_base"]))]
pub struct EmqxState {

    /// EMQX's MCP Bridge is intentionally not installed. The only external
    /// MCP endpoint is the bridge-owned `https://10.0.0.3:8090/mcp`.
    pub mcp_gateway_installed: bool,
}

impl EmqxState {
    pub fn declared() -> Self {
        Self {
            software: "emqx".to_string(),
            plugin_version: PLUGIN_VERSION.to_string(),
            broker_version: EMQX_RELEASE_VERSION.to_string(),
            service_name: EMQX_SERVICE.to_string(),
            data_dir: EMQX_DATA_DIR.to_string(),
            config_dir: EMQX_CONFIG_DIR.to_string(),
            log_dir: EMQX_LOG_DIR.to_string(),
            dashboard_url: EMQX_DASHBOARD_URL.to_string(),
            api_base: EMQX_API_BASE.to_string(),
            listeners: vec![
                EmqxDeclaredListener {
                    id: "tcp:default".to_string(),
                    r#type: "tcp".to_string(),
                    bind: EMQX_MQTT_TCP_BIND.to_string(),
                },
                EmqxDeclaredListener {
                    id: "wss:wake".to_string(),
                    r#type: "wss".to_string(),
                    bind: EMQX_MQTT_WSS_BIND.to_string(),
                },
            ],
            exhook: EmqxExhookDeclaration {
                proto: EXHOOK_PROTO.to_string(),
                service: EXHOOK_SERVICE.to_string(),
                server_name: EXHOOK_SERVER_NAME.to_string(),
                target: EXHOOK_TARGET.to_string(),
                transport: "loopback_mtls".to_string(),
                registered_hooks: REGISTERED_HOOKS
                    .iter()
                    .map(|hook| (*hook).to_string())
                    .collect(),
            },
            mcp_gateway_installed: false,
        }
    }
}

pub struct EmqxPlugin;

impl EmqxPlugin {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self
    }

    pub fn current_state() -> EmqxState {
        EmqxState::declared()
    }
}

impl Default for EmqxPlugin {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}

#[derive(Clone)]
struct EmqxNativeTransport {
    runit_connection: Option<Connection>,
    api_base: String,
    api_credentials: Option<(String, String)>,
}

impl EmqxNativeTransport {
    fn production() -> Self {
        Self {
            runit_connection: None,
            api_base: EMQX_API_BASE.to_string(),
            api_credentials: None,
        }
    }

    async fn runit_connection(&self) -> Result<Connection> {
        match &self.runit_connection {
            Some(connection) => Ok(connection.clone()),
            None => Connection::system()
                .await
                .context("runit D-Bus boundary is unavailable"),
        }
    }

    fn credentials(&self) -> Result<(String, String)> {
        match &self.api_credentials {
            Some(credentials) => Ok(credentials.clone()),
            None => api_credentials_from_files(),
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
pub struct GetStatusInput {}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
pub struct GetStatusOutput {
    pub running: bool,
    pub pid: Option<u32>,
    pub uptime_seconds: Option<u64>,
    pub version: String,
    pub node_name: String,
    pub cluster_status: String,

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Deserialize)]
struct RunitStatus {
    active_state: String,
    main_pid: Option<u32>,
    up_time: Option<String>,
}

impl RunitStatus {
    fn running(&self) -> bool {
        self.active_state == "active"
    }

    fn uptime_seconds(&self) -> Option<u64> {
        self.up_time.as_deref().and_then(parse_uptime_seconds)
    }
}

fn parse_uptime_seconds(value: &str) -> Option<u64> {
    let token = value.split_whitespace().next()?;
    token.trim_end_matches('s').parse().ok()
}

async fn runit_status(transport: &EmqxNativeTransport) -> Result<RunitStatus> {
    let connection = transport.runit_connection().await?;
    let proxy = Proxy::new(
        &connection,
        RUNIT_BUS_NAME,
        RUNIT_OBJECT_PATH,
        RUNIT_INTERFACE,
    )
    .await
    .context("runit D-Bus proxy creation failed")?;
    let encoded: String = proxy
        .call("Status", &(EMQX_SERVICE,))
        .await
        .context("runit D-Bus status call failed")?;
    serde_json::from_str(&encoded).context("runit D-Bus returned an invalid status document")
}

/// `action` is the D-Bus member name, which is CamelCase on the wire: the
/// runit service declares `async fn start/stop/restart`, and zbus's
/// `#[interface]` macro converts those to `Start`/`Stop`/`Restart`. `Proxy::call`
/// sends the literal member name it is given, so the caller must match the
/// converted spelling exactly or the call fails with UnknownMethod.
async fn runit_lifecycle(transport: &EmqxNativeTransport, action: &'static str) -> Result<String> {
    debug_assert!(matches!(action, "Start" | "Stop" | "Restart"));
    let connection = transport.runit_connection().await?;
    let proxy = Proxy::new(
        &connection,
        RUNIT_BUS_NAME,
        RUNIT_OBJECT_PATH,
        RUNIT_INTERFACE,
    )
    .await
    .context("runit D-Bus proxy creation failed")?;
    let (success, message): (bool, String) = proxy
        .call(action, &(EMQX_SERVICE,))
        .await
        .with_context(|| format!("runit D-Bus {action} call failed"))?;
    if !success {
        anyhow::bail!("runit D-Bus rejected EMQX {action}: {message}");
    }
    Ok(message)
}

fn api_client() -> Result<reqwest::Client> {
    reqwest::Client::builder()
        .no_proxy()
        .redirect(reqwest::redirect::Policy::none())
        .connect_timeout(Duration::from_secs(2))
        .timeout(Duration::from_secs(5))
        .build()
        .context("failed to construct bounded EMQX API client")
}

fn api_credentials_from_files() -> Result<(String, String)> {
    let key =
        std::fs::read_to_string(API_KEY_FILE).context("EMQX management API key is unavailable")?;
    let secret = std::fs::read_to_string(API_SECRET_FILE)
        .context("EMQX management API secret is unavailable")?;
    let key = key.trim().to_string();
    let secret = secret.trim().to_string();
    if key.is_empty() || secret.is_empty() {
        anyhow::bail!("EMQX management API credential is empty");
    }
    Ok((key, secret))
}

async fn emqx_api(
    transport: &EmqxNativeTransport,
    method: Method,
    path: &str,
    body: Option<JsonValue>,
) -> Result<JsonValue> {
    let (api_key, api_secret) = transport.credentials()?;
    let url = format!("{}{path}", transport.api_base.trim_end_matches('/'));
    let mut request = api_client()?
        .request(method, &url)
        .basic_auth(api_key, Some(api_secret));
    if let Some(body) = body {
        request = request.json(&body);
    }
    let mut response = request
        .send()
        .await
        .with_context(|| format!("EMQX API request to {path} failed"))?;
    let status = response.status();
    if !status.is_success() {
        anyhow::bail!("EMQX API request to {path} returned HTTP {status}");
    }
    if response
        .content_length()
        .is_some_and(|length| length > API_RESPONSE_LIMIT as u64)
    {
        anyhow::bail!("EMQX API response from {path} exceeded the size limit");
    }
    let mut bytes = Vec::new();
    while let Some(chunk) = response
        .chunk()
        .await
        .with_context(|| format!("EMQX API response from {path} could not be read"))?
    {
        if chunk.len() > API_RESPONSE_LIMIT.saturating_sub(bytes.len()) {
            anyhow::bail!("EMQX API response from {path} exceeded the size limit");
        }
        bytes.extend_from_slice(&chunk);
    }
    if bytes.is_empty() {
        return Ok(serde_json::json!({}));
    }
    serde_json::from_slice(&bytes)
        .with_context(|| format!("EMQX API response from {path} was not valid JSON"))
}

fn response_array(value: &JsonValue) -> Result<&[JsonValue]> {
    value
        .as_array()
        .or_else(|| value.get("data").and_then(JsonValue::as_array))
        .map(Vec::as_slice)
        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("EMQX API returned a non-array inventory"))
}

fn string_field(value: &JsonValue, names: &[&str]) -> Option<String> {
    names
        .iter()
        .find_map(|name| value.get(*name).and_then(JsonValue::as_str))
        .map(str::to_string)
}

fn u64_field(value: &JsonValue, names: &[&str]) -> u64 {
    names
        .iter()
        .find_map(|name| {
            value
                .get(*name)
                .and_then(|field| field.as_u64().or_else(|| field.as_str()?.parse().ok()))
        })
        .unwrap_or(0)
}

fn local_endpoint(value: &str) -> bool {
    if value.starts_with("unix:") || value.starts_with('/') {
        return true;
    }
    let address = value
        .strip_prefix("http://")
        .or_else(|| value.strip_prefix("https://"))
        .unwrap_or(value);
    address
        .parse::<SocketAddr>()
        .map(|address| address.ip().is_loopback() || address.ip().to_string() == FABRIC_SVC0_IP)
        .unwrap_or(false)
}

async fn publish_wake(
    transport: &EmqxNativeTransport,
    input: PublishWakeInput,
) -> Result<PublishWakeOutput> {
    let topic = wake_topic(&input.owner_key)?;
    let response = emqx_api(
        transport,
        Method::POST,
        "/publish",
        Some(serde_json::json!({
            "topic": topic,
            "payload": serde_json::json!({"seq": input.seq}).to_string(),
            "qos": 1,
            "retain": false,
        })),
    )
    .await
    .context("EMQX wake publish failed")?;
    Ok(PublishWakeOutput {
        topic,
        published: true,
        message_id: string_field(&response, &["id"]),
    })
}

async fn kick_client(
    transport: &EmqxNativeTransport,
    input: KickClientInput,
) -> Result<KickClientOutput> {
    anyhow::ensure!(
        !input.client_id.is_empty()
            && input.client_id.len() <= 256
            && !input
                .client_id
                .chars()
                .any(|c| c.is_control() || matches!(c, '/' | '?' | '#' | '%')),
        "client id must be a bounded MQTT client id"
    );
    let path = format!("/clients/{}", input.client_id);
    match emqx_api(transport, Method::DELETE, &path, None).await {
        Ok(_) => Ok(KickClientOutput {
            kicked: true,
            was_connected: true,
        }),
        Err(error) if error.to_string().contains("HTTP 404") => Ok(KickClientOutput {
            kicked: false,
            was_connected: false,
        }),
        Err(error) => Err(error.context("EMQX client kick failed")),
    }
}

async fn query_listeners(transport: &EmqxNativeTransport) -> Result<ListListenersOutput> {
    let status = runit_status(transport).await?;
    if !status.running() {
        let listeners = EmqxState::declared()
            .listeners
            .into_iter()
            .map(|listener| EmqxListener {
                id: listener.id,
                r#type: listener.r#type,
                is_loopback_or_uds: local_endpoint(&listener.bind),
                bind: listener.bind,
                running: false,
                current_connections: 0,
                max_connections: 0,
            })
            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
        return Ok(ListListenersOutput {
            all_loopback_or_uds: listeners.iter().all(|listener| listener.is_loopback_or_uds),
            listeners,
            total_connections: 0,
        });
    }

    let payload = emqx_api(transport, Method::GET, "/listeners", None).await?;
    let listeners = response_array(&payload)?
        .iter()
        .map(|item| {
            let id = string_field(item, &["id", "name"]).unwrap_or_else(|| "unknown".into());
            let listener_type = string_field(item, &["type"])
                .or_else(|| id.split(':').next().map(str::to_string))
                .unwrap_or_else(|| "unknown".into());
            let bind = string_field(item, &["bind", "listen_on"]).unwrap_or_default();
            EmqxListener {
                id,
                r#type: listener_type,
                is_loopback_or_uds: local_endpoint(&bind),
                bind,
                running: item
                    .get("running")
                    .and_then(JsonValue::as_bool)
                    .unwrap_or(true),
                current_connections: u64_field(item, &["current_connections", "current_conns"]),
                max_connections: u64_field(item, &["max_connections", "max_conns"]),
            }
        })
        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
    let total_connections = listeners
        .iter()
        .map(|listener| listener.current_connections)
        .sum();
    let all_loopback_or_uds = listeners.iter().all(|listener| listener.is_loopback_or_uds);
    if !all_loopback_or_uds {
        anyhow::bail!("EMQX reported a listener outside loopback/UDS policy");
    }
    Ok(ListListenersOutput {
        listeners,
        total_connections,
        all_loopback_or_uds,
    })
}

fn exhook_from_json(item: &JsonValue) -> EmqxExhookServer {
    let url = string_field(item, &["url"]).unwrap_or_default();
    let ssl = &item["ssl"];
    let transport_authenticated = url == EXHOOK_TARGET
        && ssl["enable"].as_bool() == Some(true)
        && ssl["verify"].as_str() == Some("verify_peer")
        && ssl["cacertfile"].as_str() == Some("/etc/op-dbus/tls/tonic-svc0-ca.crt")
        && ssl["certfile"].as_str() == Some("/etc/op-dbus/tls/emqx-exhook-client.crt")
        && ssl["keyfile"].as_str() == Some("/etc/op-dbus/tls/emqx-exhook-client.key");
    let status = item["node_status"]
        .as_array()
        .filter(|nodes| !nodes.is_empty())
        .map(|nodes| {
            if nodes
                .iter()
                .all(|node| node["status"].as_str() == Some("connected"))
            {
                "connected"
            } else {
                "disconnected"
            }
        })
        .unwrap_or("unknown");
    EmqxExhookServer {
        name: string_field(item, &["name"]).unwrap_or_default(),
        is_local: local_endpoint(&url),
        transport_authenticated,
        url,
        enable: item
            .get("enable")
            .and_then(JsonValue::as_bool)
            .unwrap_or(false),
        status: status.into(),
        hooks: item["hooks"]
            .as_array()
            .into_iter()
            .flatten()
            .filter_map(|hook| hook["name"].as_str().map(str::to_string))
            .collect(),
    }
}

async fn query_hooks(transport: &EmqxNativeTransport) -> Result<ListHooksOutput> {
    let status = runit_status(transport).await?;
    if !status.running() {
        return Ok(ListHooksOutput {
            exhook_servers: vec![],
            total_hooks: 0,
        });
    }
    let payload = emqx_api(transport, Method::GET, "/exhooks", None).await?;
    let servers = response_array(&payload)?
        .iter()
        .map(exhook_from_json)
        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
    if servers
        .iter()
        .any(|server| !server.is_local || !server.transport_authenticated)
    {
        anyhow::bail!("EMQX reported an unauthenticated or non-local ExHook target");
    }
    Ok(ListHooksOutput {
        total_hooks: servers.iter().map(|server| server.hooks.len()).sum(),
        exhook_servers: servers,
    })
}

fn validate_hook_selection(input: &ConfigureHooksInput) -> Result<()> {
    if input.server_name != EXHOOK_SERVER_NAME {
        anyhow::bail!("only the fixed 'opdbus' ExHook server may be configured");
    }
    if input.target != ExhookTarget::LoopbackMtls {
        anyhow::bail!("unsupported ExHook transport");
    }
    let requested = input.hooks.iter().cloned().collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
    let allowed = REGISTERED_HOOKS
        .iter()
        .map(|hook| (*hook).to_string())
        .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
    if requested != allowed || requested.len() != input.hooks.len() {
        anyhow::bail!("hooks must be the exact supported HookProvider hook set");
    }
    Ok(())
}

async fn configure_hooks(
    transport: &EmqxNativeTransport,
    input: ConfigureHooksInput,
) -> Result<ConfigureHooksOutput> {
    validate_hook_selection(&input)?;
    let body = serde_json::json!({
        "name": EXHOOK_SERVER_NAME,
        "url": EXHOOK_TARGET,
        "enable": input.enable,
        "request_timeout": "5s",
        "failed_action": "ignore",
        "auto_reconnect": "5s",
        "pool_size": 4,
        "ssl": {
            "enable": true,
            "verify": "verify_peer",
            "cacertfile": "/etc/op-dbus/tls/tonic-svc0-ca.crt",
            "certfile": "/etc/op-dbus/tls/emqx-exhook-client.crt",
            "keyfile": "/etc/op-dbus/tls/emqx-exhook-client.key"
        }
    });
    let _ = emqx_api(transport, Method::PUT, "/exhooks/opdbus", Some(body)).await?;
    let verified = query_hooks(transport)
        .await?
        .exhook_servers
        .into_iter()
        .find(|server| server.name == EXHOOK_SERVER_NAME)
        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("EMQX did not return the configured ExHook server"))?;
    if verified.enable != input.enable || !verified.is_local || !verified.transport_authenticated {
        anyhow::bail!("EMQX ExHook verification did not match the requested local mTLS state");
    }
    Ok(ConfigureHooksOutput {
        configured: true,
        server_name: EXHOOK_SERVER_NAME.to_string(),
        is_local: true,
        message: "EMQX accepted and verified the fixed loopback-mTLS ExHook configuration"
            .to_string(),
    })
}

async fn query_status(transport: &EmqxNativeTransport) -> Result<GetStatusOutput> {
    let runit = runit_status(transport).await?;
    if !runit.running() {
        return Ok(GetStatusOutput {
            running: false,
            pid: None,
            uptime_seconds: runit.uptime_seconds(),
            version: EMQX_RELEASE_VERSION.to_string(),
            node_name: "emqx@127.0.0.1".to_string(),
            cluster_status: "stopped".to_string(),
            data_dir: EMQX_DATA_DIR.to_string(),
            config_dir: EMQX_CONFIG_DIR.to_string(),
            listeners_active: 0,
            connections_current: 0,
        });
    }
    // /status defaults to plain text in pinned EMQX 6.2.2. The health JSON
    // omits the version, which must come from the actual node inventory.
    let api = emqx_api(transport, Method::GET, "/status?format=json", None).await?;
    let nodes = emqx_api(transport, Method::GET, "/nodes", None).await?;
    let node_name = api["node_name"]
        .as_str()
        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("EMQX health response has no node_name"))?;
    let node = response_array(&nodes)?
        .iter()
        .find(|node| node["node"].as_str() == Some(node_name))
        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("EMQX health node is absent from node inventory"))?;
    let version = node["version"]
        .as_str()
        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("EMQX node inventory has no version"))?;
    let app_status = api["app_status"]
        .as_str()
        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("EMQX health response has no app_status"))?;
    let listeners = query_listeners(transport).await?;
    Ok(GetStatusOutput {
        running: app_status == "running" && node["node_status"].as_str() == Some("running"),
        pid: runit.main_pid,
        uptime_seconds: runit.uptime_seconds(),
        version: version.into(),
        node_name: node_name.into(),
        cluster_status: app_status.into(),
        data_dir: EMQX_DATA_DIR.to_string(),
        config_dir: EMQX_CONFIG_DIR.to_string(),
        listeners_active: listeners
            .listeners
            .iter()
            .filter(|listener| listener.running)
            .count(),
        connections_current: listeners.total_connections,
    })
}

/// Typed standalone-EMQX dispatcher used by every projected transport.
pub async fn dispatch_emqx_method(method: &str, args: &JsonValue) -> Result<JsonValue> {
    dispatch_emqx_method_on(&EmqxNativeTransport::production(), method, args).await
}

async fn dispatch_emqx_method_on(
    transport: &EmqxNativeTransport,
    method: &str,
    args: &JsonValue,
) -> Result<JsonValue> {
    let output = match method {
        "get_status" => {
            let _: GetStatusInput = typed_input(args)?;
            serde_json::to_value(query_status(transport).await?)?
        }
        "get_mcp_status" => {
            let _: GetMcpStatusInput = typed_input(args)?;
            serde_json::to_value(GetMcpStatusOutput {
                gateway_installed: false,
                gateway_enabled: false,
                gateway_version: None,
                topic_prefix: None,
                internal_transport_only: true,
                external_mcp_endpoint: "https://10.0.0.3:8090/mcp".to_string(),
            })?
        }
        "list_listeners" => {
            let _: ListListenersInput = typed_input(args)?;
            serde_json::to_value(query_listeners(transport).await?)?
        }
        "list_hooks" => {
            let _: ListHooksInput = typed_input(args)?;
            serde_json::to_value(query_hooks(transport).await?)?
        }
        "get_hook_status" => {
            let input: GetHookStatusInput = typed_input(args)?;
            let server = query_hooks(transport)
                .await?
                .exhook_servers
                .into_iter()
                .find(|server| server.name == input.server_name);
            serde_json::to_value(GetHookStatusOutput {
                found: server.is_some(),
                server,
            })?
        }
        "configure_hooks" => {
            let input: ConfigureHooksInput = typed_input(args)?;
            serde_json::to_value(configure_hooks(transport, input).await?)?
        }
        "start" => {
            let _: StartInput = typed_input(args)?;
            let before = runit_status(transport).await?;
            let message = if before.running() {
                "EMQX was already running".to_string()
            } else {
                runit_lifecycle(transport, "Start").await?
            };
            let after = runit_status(transport).await?;
            let broker = query_status(transport)
                .await
                .context("EMQX Start was accepted but broker health readback failed")?;
            if !broker.running {
                anyhow::bail!("EMQX Start was accepted but broker did not report running");
            }
            serde_json::to_value(StartOutput {
                started: after.running(),
                pid: after.main_pid,
                uptime_seconds: after.uptime_seconds(),
                node_name: broker.node_name,
                message,
            })?
        }
        "stop" => {
            let _: StopInput = typed_input(args)?;
            let before = runit_status(transport).await?;
            let message = if before.running() {
                runit_lifecycle(transport, "Stop").await?
            } else {
                "EMQX was already stopped".to_string()
            };
            let after = runit_status(transport).await?;
            serde_json::to_value(StopOutput {
                stopped: !after.running(),
                was_running: before.running(),
                message,
            })?
        }
        "restart" => {
            let _: RestartInput = typed_input(args)?;
            let before = runit_status(transport).await?;
            let message = runit_lifecycle(transport, "Restart").await?;
            let after = runit_status(transport).await?;
            let broker = query_status(transport)
                .await
                .context("EMQX Restart was accepted but broker health readback failed")?;
            if !broker.running {
                anyhow::bail!("EMQX Restart was accepted but broker did not report running");
            }
            serde_json::to_value(RestartOutput {
                restarted: after.running(),
                pid: after.main_pid,
                uptime_seconds: after.uptime_seconds(),
                node_name: broker.node_name,
                previous_uptime: before.uptime_seconds(),
                message,
            })?
        }
        "publish_wake" => {
            let input: PublishWakeInput = typed_input(args)?;
            serde_json::to_value(publish_wake(transport, input).await?)?
        }
        "kick_client" => {
            let input: KickClientInput = typed_input(args)?;
            serde_json::to_value(kick_client(transport, input).await?)?
        }
        other => anyhow::bail!("unknown emqx method: {other}"),
    };
    Ok(output)
}

#[async_trait]
impl StatePlugin for EmqxPlugin {
    fn name(&self) -> &str {
        PLUGIN_NAME
    }

    fn version(&self) -> &str {
        PLUGIN_VERSION
    }

    fn schema(&self) -> Option<PluginSchema> {
        Some(emqx_schema())
    }

    async fn calculate_diff(&self, _current: &Value, _desired: &Value) -> Result<StateDiff> {
        Ok(StateDiff {
            plugin: PLUGIN_NAME.to_string(),
            actions: vec![],
            metadata: DiffMetadata {
                timestamp: chrono::Utc::now().timestamp(),
                current_hash: String::new(),
                desired_hash: String::new(),
            },
        })
    }

    async fn apply_state(&self, _diff: &StateDiff) -> Result<ApplyResult> {
        Ok(ApplyResult {
            success: true,
            changes_applied: vec![],
            errors: vec![],
            checkpoint: None,
        })
    }

    async fn verify_state(&self, desired: &Value) -> Result<bool> {
        let declared = simd_json::serde::to_owned_value(EmqxState::declared())?;
        Ok(&declared == desired)
    }

    async fn create_checkpoint(&self) -> Result<Checkpoint> {
        Ok(Checkpoint {
            id: format!("{PLUGIN_NAME}-checkpoint"),
            plugin: PLUGIN_NAME.to_string(),
            timestamp: chrono::Utc::now().timestamp(),
            state_snapshot: simd_json::serde::to_owned_value(EmqxState::declared())?,
            backend_checkpoint: None,
        })
    }

    async fn rollback(&self, _checkpoint: &Checkpoint) -> Result<()> {
        Ok(())
    }

    fn capabilities(&self) -> PluginCapabilities {
        PluginCapabilities {
            supports_rollback: false,
            supports_checkpoints: true,
            supports_verification: true,
            atomic_operations: true,
        }
    }
}

fn add_method<I, O>(
    schema: &mut PluginSchema,
    name: &str,
    side_effect: SideEffect,
    idempotent: bool,
    capability: &str,
    subid: &str,
) where
    I: JsonSchema,
    O: JsonSchema,
{
    schema.methods.insert(
        name.to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<I, O>(
            name,
            side_effect,
            idempotent,
            capability,
            subid,
        ),
    );
    schema.capabilities.insert(
        capability.to_string(),
        CapabilityDecl {
            id: capability.to_string(),
            description: format!("Grants: {name}."),
        },
    );
}

pub(crate) fn emqx_schema() -> PluginSchema {
    let root = serde_json::to_value(schemars::schema_for!(EmqxState))
        .expect("EMQX state schema serializes");
    let mut schema = super::schemars_adapter::plugin_schema_from_json(
        PLUGIN_NAME,
        PLUGIN_VERSION,
        PLUGIN_DESCRIPTION,
        &root,
    );
    schema.category = PLUGIN_CATEGORY.to_string();
    schema.display_name = Some(PLUGIN_DISPLAY_NAME.to_string());
    let declared = simd_json::serde::to_owned_value(EmqxState::declared())
        .expect("declared EMQX state serializes");
    super::schemars_adapter::apply_state_defaults(&mut schema, &declared);
    schema.example = Some(declared);

    schema.signals.push(SignalDecl {
        name: BROKER_EVENT_SIGNAL.to_string(),
        payload: Some(
            simd_json::serde::to_owned_value(schemars::schema_for!(BrokerEvent))
                .expect("broker event schema serializes"),
        ),
        subid: BROKER_EVENT_SUBID.to_string(),
    });

    add_method::<GetStatusInput, GetStatusOutput>(
        &mut schema,
        "get_status",
        SideEffect::Read,
        true,
        "cap.network.emqx.status.get@v1",
        "obs.network.emqx.status.get@v2",
    );
    add_method::<GetMcpStatusInput, GetMcpStatusOutput>(
        &mut schema,
        "get_mcp_status",
        SideEffect::Read,
        true,
        "cap.network.emqx.mcp.status.get@v1",
        "obs.network.emqx.mcp.status.get@v1",
    );
    add_method::<ListListenersInput, ListListenersOutput>(
        &mut schema,
        "list_listeners",
        SideEffect::Read,
        true,
        "cap.network.emqx.listeners.list@v1",
        "obs.network.emqx.listeners.list@v1",
    );
    add_method::<ListHooksInput, ListHooksOutput>(
        &mut schema,
        "list_hooks",
        SideEffect::Read,
        true,
        "cap.network.emqx.hooks.list@v1",
        "obs.network.emqx.hooks.list@v1",
    );
    add_method::<GetHookStatusInput, GetHookStatusOutput>(
        &mut schema,
        "get_hook_status",
        SideEffect::Read,
        true,
        "cap.network.emqx.hooks.status.get@v1",
        "obs.network.emqx.hooks.status.get@v1",
    );
    add_method::<ConfigureHooksInput, ConfigureHooksOutput>(
        &mut schema,
        "configure_hooks",
        SideEffect::Mutation,
        true,
        "cap.network.emqx.hooks.configure@v1",
        "mut.network.emqx.hooks.configure@v1",
    );
    add_method::<StartInput, StartOutput>(
        &mut schema,
        "start",
        SideEffect::Mutation,
        true,
        "cap.network.emqx.lifecycle.start@v1",
        "mut.network.emqx.lifecycle.start@v1",
    );
    add_method::<StopInput, StopOutput>(
        &mut schema,
        "stop",
        SideEffect::Mutation,
        true,
        "cap.network.emqx.lifecycle.stop@v1",
        "mut.network.emqx.lifecycle.stop@v1",
    );
    add_method::<RestartInput, RestartOutput>(
        &mut schema,
        "restart",
        SideEffect::Mutation,
        false,
        "cap.network.emqx.lifecycle.restart@v1",
        "mut.network.emqx.lifecycle.restart@v1",
    );
    add_method::<PublishWakeInput, PublishWakeOutput>(
        &mut schema,
        "publish_wake",
        SideEffect::Mutation,
        true,
        "cap.network.emqx.wake.publish@v1",
        "mut.network.emqx.wake.publish@v1",
    );
    add_method::<KickClientInput, KickClientOutput>(
        &mut schema,
        "kick_client",
        SideEffect::Mutation,
        true,
        "cap.network.emqx.clients.kick@v1",
        "mut.network.emqx.clients.kick@v1",
    );

    schema
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use serde_json::json;

    #[test]
    fn schema_is_standalone_deterministic_and_complete() {
        let first = emqx_schema();
        let second = emqx_schema();
        assert_eq!(
            serde_json::to_value(&first).unwrap(),
            serde_json::to_value(&second).unwrap()
        );
        let expected = [
            "get_status",
            "get_mcp_status",
            "list_listeners",
            "list_hooks",
            "get_hook_status",
            "configure_hooks",
            "start",
            "stop",
            "restart",
            "publish_wake",
            "kick_client",
        ];
        assert_eq!(first.methods.len(), expected.len());
        for method in expected {
            assert!(first.methods.contains_key(method), "missing {method}");
        }
        let encoded = serde_json::to_string(&first).unwrap().to_ascii_lowercase();
        assert!(!encoded.contains("netmaker"));
        assert!(!encoded.contains("broker.sock"));
        assert!(!encoded.contains("api.sock"));
        assert!(!encoded.contains("100.69.0.1"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn declared_endpoints_are_local_or_fabric_and_mcp_gateway_is_absent() {
        let state = EmqxState::declared();
        assert!(state
            .listeners
            .iter()
            .all(|listener| local_endpoint(&listener.bind)));
        assert!(local_endpoint(&state.exhook.target));
        assert!(
            !local_endpoint("0.0.0.0:8083"),
            "wildcard binds are never declared"
        );
        assert!(
            !local_endpoint("129.80.64.127:8084"),
            "the decoy is not a listener host"
        );
        let wake = state
            .listeners
            .iter()
            .find(|l| l.id == "wss:wake")
            .expect("doorbell listener is declared");
        assert_eq!(
            (wake.r#type.as_str(), wake.bind.as_str()),
            ("wss", EMQX_MQTT_WSS_BIND)
        );
        assert!(!state.mcp_gateway_installed);
    }

    #[test]
    fn wake_topics_are_derived_from_owner_keys_only() {
        let key = "ab".repeat(32);
        assert_eq!(wake_topic(&key).unwrap(), format!("opdbus/wake/{key}"));
        for bad in [
            "",
            "AB",
            &"ab".repeat(31),
            "opdbus/wake/#",
            &"zz".repeat(32),
        ] {
            assert!(wake_topic(bad).is_err(), "{bad:?}");
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn hook_selection_rejects_partial_or_unknown_sets() {
        let partial = ConfigureHooksInput {
            server_name: EXHOOK_SERVER_NAME.to_string(),
            target: ExhookTarget::LoopbackMtls,
            enable: true,
            hooks: vec!["message.publish".to_string()],
        };
        assert!(validate_hook_selection(&partial).is_err());

        let exact = ConfigureHooksInput {
            server_name: EXHOOK_SERVER_NAME.to_string(),
            target: ExhookTarget::LoopbackMtls,
            enable: true,
            hooks: REGISTERED_HOOKS
                .iter()
                .map(|hook| (*hook).to_string())
                .collect(),
        };
        validate_hook_selection(&exact).expect("exact hook set");
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn unknown_method_fails_without_fallback_echo() {
        let error = dispatch_emqx_method("not_a_method", &serde_json::json!({}))
            .await
            .expect_err("unknown method must fail");
        assert!(error.to_string().contains("unknown emqx method"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn lifecycle_inputs_cannot_select_a_service() {
        let schema = serde_json::to_value(schemars::schema_for!(StartInput)).unwrap();
        let encoded = schema.to_string();
        assert!(!encoded.contains("service_name"));
        assert!(!encoded.contains("service"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn secret_files_never_enter_declared_state() {
        let encoded = serde_json::to_string(&EmqxState::declared()).unwrap();
        assert!(!encoded.contains("password"));
        assert!(!encoded.contains("credential"));
        assert!(!encoded.contains(API_KEY_FILE));
        assert!(!encoded.contains(API_SECRET_FILE));
    }

    #[test]
    fn broker_event_signal_has_typed_metadata_payload_and_event_subid() {
        let schema = emqx_schema();
        let signal = schema
            .signals
            .iter()
            .find(|signal| signal.name == BROKER_EVENT_SIGNAL)
            .expect("broker event signal");
        assert_eq!(signal.subid, BROKER_EVENT_SUBID);
        let payload = signal.payload.as_ref().expect("typed payload");
        let payload_json = serde_json::to_value(payload).expect("payload JSON");
        let properties = payload_json.get("properties").expect("payload properties");
        for field in ["event_type", "client_ref", "topic_ref", "detail_ref"] {
            assert!(properties.get(field).is_some(), "missing {field}");
        }
        assert!(payload_json.get("required").is_some());
        assert!(!serde_json::to_string(&payload_json)
            .unwrap()
            .contains("payload"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn method_contracts_preserve_reads_writes_subids_and_idempotence() {
        let schema = emqx_schema();
        let expected = [
            (
                "get_status",
                SideEffect::Read,
                true,
                "obs.network.emqx.status.get@v2",
            ),
            (
                "get_mcp_status",
                SideEffect::Read,
                true,
                "obs.network.emqx.mcp.status.get@v1",
            ),
            (
                "list_listeners",
                SideEffect::Read,
                true,
                "obs.network.emqx.listeners.list@v1",
            ),
            (
                "list_hooks",
                SideEffect::Read,
                true,
                "obs.network.emqx.hooks.list@v1",
            ),
            (
                "get_hook_status",
                SideEffect::Read,
                true,
                "obs.network.emqx.hooks.status.get@v1",
            ),
            (
                "configure_hooks",
                SideEffect::Mutation,
                true,
                "mut.network.emqx.hooks.configure@v1",
            ),
            (
                "start",
                SideEffect::Mutation,
                true,
                "mut.network.emqx.lifecycle.start@v1",
            ),
            (
                "stop",
                SideEffect::Mutation,
                true,
                "mut.network.emqx.lifecycle.stop@v1",
            ),
            (
                "restart",
                SideEffect::Mutation,
                false,
                "mut.network.emqx.lifecycle.restart@v1",
            ),
            (
                "publish_wake",
                SideEffect::Mutation,
                true,
                "mut.network.emqx.wake.publish@v1",
            ),
            (
                "kick_client",
                SideEffect::Mutation,
                true,
                "mut.network.emqx.clients.kick@v1",
            ),
        ];
        for (name, effect, idempotent, subid) in expected {
            let method = schema.methods.get(name).expect(name);
            assert_eq!(method.side_effect, effect, "{name} side effect");
            assert_eq!(method.idempotent, idempotent, "{name} idempotence");
            assert_eq!(method.subid, subid, "{name} subid");
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn exhook_parser_accepts_only_the_pinned_authenticated_shape() {
        let value = json!({
            "name": "opdbus",
            "url": EXHOOK_TARGET,
            "enable": true,
            "ssl": {
                "enable": true,
                "verify": "verify_peer",
                "cacertfile": "/etc/op-dbus/tls/tonic-svc0-ca.crt",
                "certfile": "/etc/op-dbus/tls/emqx-exhook-client.crt",
                "keyfile": "/etc/op-dbus/tls/emqx-exhook-client.key"
            },
            "node_status": [{"node": "emqx@127.0.0.1", "status": "connected"}],
            "hooks": [{"name": "message.publish", "params": {"topics": ["#"]}}]
        });
        let parsed = exhook_from_json(&value);
        assert!(parsed.is_local);
        assert!(parsed.transport_authenticated);
        assert_eq!(parsed.status, "connected");
        assert_eq!(parsed.hooks, vec!["message.publish"]);
    }

    #[test]
    fn exhook_parser_rejects_https_without_exact_mtls_material() {
        let value = json!({
            "name": "opdbus",
            "url": "https://127.0.0.1:9000",
            "enable": true,
            "ssl": {"enable": true},
            "node_status": [{"status": "connected"}],
            "hooks": []
        });
        let parsed = exhook_from_json(&value);
        assert!(parsed.is_local);
        assert!(!parsed.transport_authenticated);
    }

    #[test]
    fn malformed_inventory_fails_closed_instead_of_becoming_empty() {
        assert!(response_array(&json!({"message": "not an inventory"})).is_err());
        assert!(response_array(&json!(null)).is_err());
        let parsed = exhook_from_json(&json!({"name": "opdbus", "hooks": []}));
        assert_eq!(parsed.status, "unknown");
        assert!(!parsed.transport_authenticated);
    }
}
