use anyhow::Result;
use async_trait::async_trait;
use op_state::{ApplyResult, Checkpoint, DiffMetadata, PluginCapabilities, StateDiff, StatePlugin};
use op_state_store::PluginSchema;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use simd_json::json;
use simd_json::prelude::*;
use simd_json::OwnedValue as Value;

/// Endpoint declaration state.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, Default, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "sch.software.plugin.endpoint.schema@v1"))]
#[schemars(extend("x-oscal-category" = "service"))]
pub struct EndpointState {
    /// Declared endpoints.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(
        description = "Declared endpoints",
        example = &["192.168.1.100:8080"],
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "exp.service.endpoint.endpoints.render@v1")
    )]
    pub endpoints: Vec<String>,
}

pub struct EndpointPlugin;

impl Default for EndpointPlugin {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self
    }
}

impl EndpointPlugin {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct EndpointInput {
    /// Exact endpoint declaration to look up, add or remove. Registration
    /// records a declaration; it does not open a listener or route traffic.
    pub endpoint: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct ListEndpointsOutput {
    pub endpoints: Vec<String>,
}
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct GetEndpointOutput {
    pub endpoint: Option<String>,
}
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct EndpointRegistrationOutput {
    pub endpoint: String,
    pub present: bool,
    pub revision: u64,
}

fn endpoint_state(value: Option<serde_json::Value>) -> Result<EndpointState> {
    value
        .map(serde_json::from_value)
        .transpose()
        .map(|s| s.unwrap_or_default())
        .map_err(Into::into)
}

fn checked_endpoint(args: &serde_json::Value) -> Result<String> {
    let input: EndpointInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
    anyhow::ensure!(!input.endpoint.is_empty() && input.endpoint.len() <= 2048
        && input.endpoint.trim() == input.endpoint && !input.endpoint.chars().any(char::is_control),
        "endpoint must be a nonempty declaration without surrounding whitespace or control characters");
    Ok(input.endpoint)
}

pub async fn dispatch_endpoint_method(
    method: &str,
    args: &serde_json::Value,
) -> Result<serde_json::Value> {
    let store = super::runtime_documents::runtime_documents().await?;
    dispatch_endpoint_with_store(&store, method, args).await
}

pub async fn dispatch_endpoint_with_store(
    store: &super::runtime_documents::RuntimeDocuments,
    method: &str,
    args: &serde_json::Value,
) -> Result<serde_json::Value> {
    match method {
        "list_endpoints" => {
            let mut state = endpoint_state(store.read("endpoint").await?.map(|r| r.document))?;
            state.endpoints.sort();
            Ok(serde_json::to_value(ListEndpointsOutput {
                endpoints: state.endpoints,
            })?)
        }
        "get_endpoint" => {
            let endpoint = checked_endpoint(args)?;
            let state = endpoint_state(store.read("endpoint").await?.map(|r| r.document))?;
            Ok(serde_json::to_value(GetEndpointOutput {
                endpoint: state.endpoints.into_iter().find(|item| item == &endpoint),
            })?)
        }
        "add_endpoint" | "remove_endpoint" => {
            let endpoint = checked_endpoint(args)?;
            let key = endpoint.clone();
            let add = method == "add_endpoint";
            let row = store
                .update("endpoint", move |old| {
                    let mut state = endpoint_state(old)?;
                    if add {
                        state.endpoints.push(key);
                    } else {
                        state.endpoints.retain(|item| item != &key);
                    }
                    state.endpoints.sort();
                    state.endpoints.dedup();
                    Ok(serde_json::to_value(state)?)
                })
                .await?;
            let state = endpoint_state(Some(row.document))?;
            Ok(serde_json::to_value(EndpointRegistrationOutput {
                present: state.endpoints.contains(&endpoint),
                endpoint,
                revision: row.revision,
            })?)
        }
        _ => anyhow::bail!("unknown endpoint method '{method}'"),
    }
}

#[async_trait]
impl StatePlugin for EndpointPlugin {
    fn name(&self) -> &str {
        "endpoint"
    }

    fn version(&self) -> &str {
        "2.0.0"
    }

    fn schema(&self) -> Option<op_state_store::PluginSchema> {
        Some(endpoint_schema())
    }

    async fn calculate_diff(&self, _current: &Value, _desired: &Value) -> Result<StateDiff> {
        Ok(StateDiff {
            plugin: self.name().to_string(),
            actions: vec![],
            metadata: DiffMetadata {
                timestamp: chrono::Utc::now().timestamp(),
                current_hash: "unknown".to_string(),
                desired_hash: "unknown".to_string(),
            },
        })
    }

    async fn apply_state(&self, _diff: &StateDiff) -> Result<ApplyResult> {
        Ok(ApplyResult {
            success: true,
            changes_applied: vec![],
            errors: vec![],
            checkpoint: None,
        })
    }

    async fn verify_state(&self, _desired: &Value) -> Result<bool> {
        Ok(true)
    }

    async fn create_checkpoint(&self) -> Result<Checkpoint> {
        Ok(Checkpoint {
            id: uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string(),
            plugin: self.name().to_string(),
            timestamp: chrono::Utc::now().timestamp(),
            state_snapshot: Value::null(),
            backend_checkpoint: None,
        })
    }

    async fn rollback(&self, _checkpoint: &Checkpoint) -> Result<()> {
        Ok(())
    }

    fn capabilities(&self) -> PluginCapabilities {
        PluginCapabilities {
            supports_rollback: false,
            supports_checkpoints: true,
            supports_verification: true,
            atomic_operations: false,
        }
    }
}

/// Derived `endpoint` schema from the `EndpointState` struct.
pub fn endpoint_schema() -> PluginSchema {
    let root = serde_json::to_value(schemars::schema_for!(EndpointState))
        .expect("schemars schema serializes to JSON");
    let mut schema = super::schemars_adapter::plugin_schema_from_json(
        "endpoint",
        "2.0.0",
        "Endpoint configuration",
        &root,
    );

    // Add methods
    use super::plugin_scaffold_helpers::method_decl_from_schemars_with_output;
    use op_state_store::SideEffect;

    schema.methods.insert(
        "list_endpoints".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<(), ListEndpointsOutput>(
            "list_endpoints",
            SideEffect::Read,
            true,
            "endpoint.read",
            "obs.service.endpoint.list@v1",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "get_endpoint".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<EndpointInput, GetEndpointOutput>(
            "get_endpoint",
            SideEffect::Read,
            true,
            "endpoint.read",
            "obs.service.endpoint.get@v1",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "add_endpoint".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<EndpointInput, EndpointRegistrationOutput>(
            "add_endpoint",
            SideEffect::Mutation,
            false,
            "endpoint.invoke",
            "mut.service.endpoint.add@v1",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "remove_endpoint".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<EndpointInput, EndpointRegistrationOutput>(
            "remove_endpoint",
            SideEffect::Mutation,
            true,
            "endpoint.invoke",
            "mut.service.endpoint.remove@v1",
        ),
    );

    schema.capabilities.insert(
        "endpoint.read".to_string(),
        op_state_store::CapabilityDecl {
            id: "endpoint.read".to_string(),
            description: "Grants: list_endpoints, get_endpoint.".to_string(),
        },
    );
    schema.capabilities.insert(
        "endpoint.invoke".to_string(),
        op_state_store::CapabilityDecl {
            id: "endpoint.invoke".to_string(),
            description: "Grants: add_endpoint, remove_endpoint.".to_string(),
        },
    );

    schema
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn schema_is_schemars_seeded_and_typed() {
        let schema = endpoint_schema();
        assert_eq!(schema.name, "endpoint");
        assert_eq!(schema.version, "2.0.0");
        assert!(schema.fields.contains_key("endpoints"));
        assert!(schema.methods.contains_key("list_endpoints"));
        assert!(schema.methods.contains_key("get_endpoint"));
        assert!(schema.methods.contains_key("add_endpoint"));
        assert!(schema.methods.contains_key("remove_endpoint"));
    }

    /// Every `x-oscal-subid` annotation in the derived schema must be a valid
    /// OSCAL subid according to the canonical taxonomy.
    #[test]
    fn all_subids_are_valid() {
        let raw = serde_json::to_value(schemars::schema_for!(EndpointState)).unwrap();
        let mut subids = Vec::new();
        collect_subids(&raw, &mut subids);
        assert!(!subids.is_empty(), "expected at least one subid");
        for subid in subids {
            crate::state_plugins::common::oscal::validate_subid(&subid)
                .unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("invalid subid {subid}: {e}"));
        }
    }

    fn collect_subids(value: &serde_json::Value, out: &mut Vec<String>) {
        if let serde_json::Value::Object(map) = value {
            if let Some(subid) = map.get("x-oscal-subid").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {
                out.push(subid.to_string());
            }
            for v in map.values() {
                collect_subids(v, out);
            }
        } else if let serde_json::Value::Array(arr) = value {
            for v in arr {
                collect_subids(v, out);
            }
        }
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn registration_lookup_and_removal_use_committed_state() {
        use serde_json::json;
        let store = super::super::runtime_documents::RuntimeDocuments::new(
            op_cozo_store::CozoGraphShuttle::new_in_memory().unwrap(),
        );
        let input = json!({"endpoint":"example.test:8080"});
        assert_eq!(
            dispatch_endpoint_with_store(&store, "get_endpoint", &input)
                .await
                .unwrap()["endpoint"],
            serde_json::Value::Null
        );
        assert_eq!(
            dispatch_endpoint_with_store(&store, "add_endpoint", &input)
                .await
                .unwrap()["present"],
            true
        );
        dispatch_endpoint_with_store(&store, "add_endpoint", &input)
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            dispatch_endpoint_with_store(&store, "list_endpoints", &json!({}))
                .await
                .unwrap()["endpoints"],
            json!(["example.test:8080"])
        );
        assert_eq!(
            dispatch_endpoint_with_store(&store, "get_endpoint", &input)
                .await
                .unwrap()["endpoint"],
            "example.test:8080"
        );
        assert!(
            dispatch_endpoint_with_store(&store, "remove_endpoint", &json!({}))
                .await
                .is_err()
        );
        assert_eq!(
            dispatch_endpoint_with_store(&store, "remove_endpoint", &input)
                .await
                .unwrap()["present"],
            false
        );
        assert_eq!(
            dispatch_endpoint_with_store(&store, "list_endpoints", &json!({}))
                .await
                .unwrap()["endpoints"],
            json!([])
        );
    }
}

// Self-registration: the plugin registry discovers this via inventory
// (single source of the catalog; no central dispatch list).
inventory::submit! {
    crate::default_registry::PluginReg::new("endpoint", |_ctx| std::sync::Arc::new(EndpointPlugin::new()))
}

<file path="op-plugins/src/state_plugins/fail2ban_methods.rs">
//! Native Fail2ban control-socket adapter.
//!
//! Fail2ban frames pickled data with `<F2B_END_COMMAND>`. Decoding uses
//! `serde_pickle::Value`, whose model contains data only and cannot import or
//! invoke Python globals. Every frame and decoded tree is bounded before use.

use std::net::IpAddr;
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::time::Duration;
use std::{collections::HashMap, str};

use anyhow::{bail, ensure, Context, Result};
use serde_json::Value as JsonValue;
use serde_pickle::value::Value as PickleValue;
use tokio::io::{AsyncReadExt, AsyncWriteExt};
use tokio::net::UnixStream;

use super::fail2ban::{
    BanIpInput, BanIpOutput, JailInput, JailStatusOutput, MonitorSourceKind, UnbanIpOutput,
};

const END: &[u8] = b"<F2B_END_COMMAND>";
const MAX_FRAME_BYTES: usize = 1024 * 1024;
const MAX_VALUE_DEPTH: usize = 16;
const MAX_VALUE_NODES: usize = 4096;
const MAX_COLLECTION_ITEMS: usize = 1024;
const MAX_TEXT_BYTES: usize = 64 * 1024;

pub struct Fail2banMethods {
    socket: PathBuf,
    deadline: Duration,
}

impl Fail2banMethods {
    pub fn new(socket: impl AsRef<Path>, deadline: Duration) -> Result<Self> {
        let socket = socket.as_ref();
        ensure!(
            socket.is_absolute(),
            "Fail2ban socket path must be absolute"
        );
        ensure!(
            !deadline.is_zero(),
            "Fail2ban request deadline must be positive"
        );
        ensure!(
            deadline <= Duration::from_secs(30),
            "Fail2ban request deadline exceeds 30 seconds"
        );
        Ok(Self {
            socket: socket.to_path_buf(),
            deadline,
        })
    }

    pub async fn dispatch(&self, method: &str, args: &JsonValue) -> Result<JsonValue> {
        match method {
            "ban_ip" => {
                let input: BanIpInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
                validate_jail(&input.jail)?;
                let ip = validate_ip(&input.ip)?;
                let affected = self
                    .request(vec!["set", &input.jail, "banip", &ip])
                    .await
                    .and_then(as_nonnegative_count)?;
                Ok(serde_json::to_value(BanIpOutput {
                    jail: input.jail,
                    ip,
                    affected,
                })?)
            }
            "unban_ip" => {
                let input: BanIpInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
                validate_jail(&input.jail)?;
                let ip = validate_ip(&input.ip)?;
                let affected = self
                    .request(vec!["set", &input.jail, "unbanip", "--report-absent", &ip])
                    .await
                    .and_then(as_nonnegative_count)?;
                Ok(serde_json::to_value(UnbanIpOutput {
                    jail: input.jail,
                    ip,
                    affected,
                })?)
            }
            "get_jail_status" => {
                let input: JailInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
                validate_jail(&input.jail)?;
                let response = self.request(vec!["status", &input.jail]).await?;
                Ok(serde_json::to_value(parse_jail_status(
                    input.jail, &response,
                )?)?)
            }
            "reload" => bail!("fail2ban reload requires a validated configuration stream"),
            _ => bail!("unsupported fail2ban method"),
        }
    }

    async fn request(&self, command: Vec<&str>) -> Result<PickleValue> {
        let command: Vec<String> = command.into_iter().map(str::to_string).collect();
        let mut encoded =
            serde_pickle::to_vec(&command, serde_pickle::SerOptions::new().proto_v2())?;
        ensure!(
            encoded.len() + END.len() <= MAX_FRAME_BYTES,
            "Fail2ban request is too large"
        );
        encoded.extend_from_slice(END);
        let socket = self.socket.clone();
        tokio::time::timeout(self.deadline, async move {
            let mut stream = UnixStream::connect(&socket)
                .await
                .with_context(|| format!("connect Fail2ban socket {}", socket.display()))?;
            stream.write_all(&encoded).await?;
            let frame = read_frame(&mut stream).await?;
            decode_ack(&frame)
        })
        .await
        .context("Fail2ban request deadline exceeded")?
    }
}

async fn read_frame(stream: &mut UnixStream) -> Result<Vec<u8>> {
    let mut frame = Vec::new();
    let mut chunk = [0_u8; 8192];
    loop {
        let read = stream.read(&mut chunk).await?;
        ensure!(read != 0, "truncated Fail2ban response frame");
        frame.extend_from_slice(&chunk[..read]);
        ensure!(
            frame.len() <= MAX_FRAME_BYTES,
            "Fail2ban response frame is too large"
        );
        if let Some(position) = find_subslice(&frame, END) {
            ensure!(
                position + END.len() == frame.len(),
                "trailing data after Fail2ban response terminator"
            );
            frame.truncate(position);
            ensure!(!frame.is_empty(), "empty Fail2ban response frame");
            return Ok(frame);
        }
    }
}

fn find_subslice(haystack: &[u8], needle: &[u8]) -> Option<usize> {
    haystack
        .windows(needle.len())
        .position(|window| window == needle)
}

fn decode_ack(frame: &[u8]) -> Result<PickleValue> {
    preflight_pickle(frame)?;
    let value =
        serde_pickle::value_from_slice(frame, serde_pickle::DeOptions::new().keep_restore_state())
            .context("invalid Fail2ban pickle response")?;
    let mut nodes = 0;
    validate_value(&value, 0, &mut nodes)?;
    let fields = as_sequence(&value).context("Fail2ban response must be an ack tuple")?;
    ensure!(fields.len() == 2, "Fail2ban ack tuple must have two fields");
    let ack = as_i64(&fields[0]).context("invalid Fail2ban ack code")?;
    ensure!(matches!(ack, 0 | 1), "unknown Fail2ban ack code");
    if ack == 1 {
        let detail = first_text(&fields[1]).unwrap_or("provider returned an opaque error");
        bail!("Fail2ban rejected request: {detail}");
    }
    Ok(fields[1].clone())
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
struct PickleShape {
    nodes: usize,
    depth: usize,
    items: usize,
    container: bool,
    global: bool,
}

impl PickleShape {
    const fn scalar() -> Self {
        Self {
            nodes: 1,
            depth: 0,
            items: 0,
            container: false,
            global: false,
        }
    }

    const fn global() -> Self {
        Self {
            global: true,
            ..Self::scalar()
        }
    }

    fn collection(values: &[Self]) -> Result<Self> {
        ensure!(
            values.len() <= MAX_COLLECTION_ITEMS,
            "Fail2ban pickle collection is too large"
        );
        let nodes = values.iter().try_fold(1_usize, |total, value| {
            total
                .checked_add(value.nodes)
                .context("pickle node overflow")
        })?;
        let depth = values
            .iter()
            .map(|value| value.depth)
            .max()
            .unwrap_or(0)
            .checked_add(1)
            .context("pickle depth overflow")?;
        ensure!(
            nodes <= MAX_VALUE_NODES,
            "Fail2ban pickle has too many values"
        );
        ensure!(
            depth <= MAX_VALUE_DEPTH,
            "Fail2ban pickle is too deeply nested"
        );
        Ok(Self {
            nodes,
            depth,
            items: values.len(),
            container: true,
            global: false,
        })
    }

    fn append(&mut self, values: &[Self]) -> Result<()> {
        ensure!(self.container, "pickle mutation target is not a container");
        self.items = self
            .items
            .checked_add(values.len())
            .context("pickle item count overflow")?;
        ensure!(
            self.items <= MAX_COLLECTION_ITEMS,
            "Fail2ban pickle collection is too large"
        );
        self.nodes = values.iter().try_fold(self.nodes, |total, value| {
            total
                .checked_add(value.nodes)
                .context("pickle node overflow")
        })?;
        self.depth = self.depth.max(
            values
                .iter()
                .map(|value| value.depth)
                .max()
                .unwrap_or(0)
                .checked_add(1)
                .context("pickle depth overflow")?,
        );
        ensure!(
            self.nodes <= MAX_VALUE_NODES,
            "Fail2ban pickle has too many values"
        );
        ensure!(
            self.depth <= MAX_VALUE_DEPTH,
            "Fail2ban pickle is too deeply nested"
        );
        Ok(())
    }
}

enum StackItem {
    Mark,
    Value(PickleShape),
}

/// Bounds the pickle VM before `serde_pickle` resolves memo references into an
/// owned tree. Container memo reads are forbidden because they can encode
/// cycles or exponentially expand a small frame while aliases are resolved.
fn preflight_pickle(input: &[u8]) -> Result<()> {
    ensure!(
        input.len() <= MAX_FRAME_BYTES,
        "Fail2ban pickle is too large"
    );
    let mut cursor = 0;
    let mut operations = 0_usize;
    let mut stack = Vec::<StackItem>::new();
    let mut memo = HashMap::<u32, PickleShape>::new();
    let mut next_memo = 0_u32;
    let mut stopped = false;
    while cursor < input.len() {
        operations += 1;
        ensure!(
            operations <= MAX_VALUE_NODES * 4,
            "Fail2ban pickle has too many opcodes"
        );
        let opcode = take(input, &mut cursor, 1)?[0];
        match opcode {
            b'.' => {
                stopped = true;
                break;
            }
            b'(' => stack.push(StackItem::Mark),
            b'0' => {
                stack.pop().context("pickle POP underflow")?;
            }
            b'1' => {
                take_marked(&mut stack)?;
            }
            b'2' => {
                let value = top_value(&stack)?;
                ensure!(
                    !value.container,
                    "container pickle duplication is forbidden"
                );
                stack.push(StackItem::Value(value));
            }
            b'N' | 0x88 | 0x89 => stack.push(StackItem::Value(PickleShape::scalar())),
            b'I' | b'L' | b'F' | b'S' | b'V' => {
                ensure!(
                    take_line(input, &mut cursor)?.len() <= MAX_TEXT_BYTES,
                    "Fail2ban pickle scalar is too large"
                );
                stack.push(StackItem::Value(PickleShape::scalar()));
            }
            b'J' => push_fixed(input, &mut cursor, &mut stack, 4)?,
            b'K' => push_fixed(input, &mut cursor, &mut stack, 1)?,
            b'M' => push_fixed(input, &mut cursor, &mut stack, 2)?,
            b'G' => push_fixed(input, &mut cursor, &mut stack, 8)?,
            b'T' | b'X' | b'B' => {
                let length = take_u32(input, &mut cursor)? as usize;
                push_blob(input, &mut cursor, &mut stack, length)?;
            }
            b'U' | b'C' | 0x8c => {
                let length = usize::from(take(input, &mut cursor, 1)?[0]);
                push_blob(input, &mut cursor, &mut stack, length)?;
            }
            0x8a => {
                let length = usize::from(take(input, &mut cursor, 1)?[0]);
                push_blob(input, &mut cursor, &mut stack, length)?;
            }
            0x8b => {
                let length = take_u32(input, &mut cursor)? as usize;
                push_blob(input, &mut cursor, &mut stack, length)?;
            }
            0x8d | 0x8e | 0x96 => {
                let length = take_u64(input, &mut cursor)?;
                ensure!(length <= usize::MAX as u64, "pickle blob length overflow");
                push_blob(input, &mut cursor, &mut stack, length as usize)?;
            }
            b')' | b']' | b'}' | 0x8f => {
                stack.push(StackItem::Value(PickleShape::collection(&[])?))
            }
            b'l' | b't' | b'd' | 0x91 => {
                let values = take_marked(&mut stack)?;
                stack.push(StackItem::Value(PickleShape::collection(&values)?));
            }
            0x85..=0x87 => {
                let values = pop_values(&mut stack, usize::from(opcode - 0x84))?;
                stack.push(StackItem::Value(PickleShape::collection(&values)?));
            }
            b'a' => mutate_container(&mut stack, 1)?,
            b's' => mutate_container(&mut stack, 2)?,
            b'e' | b'u' | 0x90 => {
                let values = take_marked(&mut stack)?;
                value_mut(stack.last_mut().context("pickle mutation target missing")?)?
                    .append(&values)?;
            }
            b'c' => {
                ensure!(
                    take_line(input, &mut cursor)?.len() <= MAX_TEXT_BYTES,
                    "pickle global is too large"
                );
                ensure!(
                    take_line(input, &mut cursor)?.len() <= MAX_TEXT_BYTES,
                    "pickle global is too large"
                );
                stack.push(StackItem::Value(PickleShape::global()));
            }
            0x93 => {
                let values = pop_values(&mut stack, 2)?;
                ensure!(
                    values.iter().all(|value| !value.container),
                    "invalid STACK_GLOBAL operands"
                );
                stack.push(StackItem::Value(PickleShape::global()));
            }
            b'R' => {
                let args = pop_value(&mut stack)?;
                let callable = pop_value(&mut stack)?;
                ensure!(
                    callable.global && args.container,
                    "unsafe pickle REDUCE operands"
                );
                stack.push(StackItem::Value(args));
            }
            b'p' => memo_put(
                parse_decimal(take_line(input, &mut cursor)?)?,
                &stack,
                &mut memo,
            )?,
            b'q' => {
                let key = u32::from(take(input, &mut cursor, 1)?[0]);
                memo_put(key, &stack, &mut memo)?;
            }
            b'r' => {
                let key = take_u32(input, &mut cursor)?;
                memo_put(key, &stack, &mut memo)?;
            }
            0x94 => {
                memo_put(next_memo, &stack, &mut memo)?;
                next_memo = next_memo.checked_add(1).context("pickle memo overflow")?;
            }
            b'g' => memo_get(
                parse_decimal(take_line(input, &mut cursor)?)?,
                &mut stack,
                &memo,
            )?,
            b'h' => {
                let key = u32::from(take(input, &mut cursor, 1)?[0]);
                memo_get(key, &mut stack, &memo)?;
            }
            b'j' => {
                let key = take_u32(input, &mut cursor)?;
                memo_get(key, &mut stack, &memo)?;
            }
            0x80 => ensure!(
                take(input, &mut cursor, 1)?[0] <= 5,
                "unsupported pickle protocol"
            ),
            0x95 => {
                let length = take_u64(input, &mut cursor)?;
                ensure!(
                    length <= MAX_FRAME_BYTES as u64,
                    "pickle FRAME is too large"
                );
                ensure!(
                    length <= (input.len() - cursor) as u64,
                    "truncated pickle FRAME"
                );
            }
            b'P' | b'Q' | b'b' | b'i' | b'o' | 0x81..=0x84 | 0x92 | 0x97 | 0x98 => {
                bail!("unsupported stateful pickle opcode")
            }
            _ => bail!("unsupported pickle opcode 0x{opcode:02x}"),
        }
        ensure!(
            stack.len() <= MAX_VALUE_NODES,
            "Fail2ban pickle stack is too large"
        );
    }
    ensure!(stopped, "pickle is missing STOP");
    ensure!(cursor == input.len(), "trailing bytes after pickle STOP");
    ensure!(
        stack.len() == 1 && matches!(stack[0], StackItem::Value(_)),
        "pickle result stack is invalid"
    );
    Ok(())
}

fn take<'a>(input: &'a [u8], cursor: &mut usize, length: usize) -> Result<&'a [u8]> {
    let end = cursor
        .checked_add(length)
        .context("pickle length overflow")?;
    let value = input
        .get(*cursor..end)
        .context("truncated pickle operand")?;
    *cursor = end;
    Ok(value)
}
fn take_line<'a>(input: &'a [u8], cursor: &mut usize) -> Result<&'a [u8]> {
    let rest = input.get(*cursor..).context("truncated pickle line")?;
    let length = rest
        .iter()
        .position(|byte| *byte == b'\n')
        .context("unterminated pickle line")?;
    let line = take(input, cursor, length + 1)?;
    Ok(&line[..length])
}
fn take_u32(input: &[u8], cursor: &mut usize) -> Result<u32> {
    Ok(u32::from_le_bytes(take(input, cursor, 4)?.try_into()?))
}
fn take_u64(input: &[u8], cursor: &mut usize) -> Result<u64> {
    Ok(u64::from_le_bytes(take(input, cursor, 8)?.try_into()?))
}
fn push_fixed(
    input: &[u8],
    cursor: &mut usize,
    stack: &mut Vec<StackItem>,
    length: usize,
) -> Result<()> {
    take(input, cursor, length)?;
    stack.push(StackItem::Value(PickleShape::scalar()));
    Ok(())
}
fn push_blob(
    input: &[u8],
    cursor: &mut usize,
    stack: &mut Vec<StackItem>,
    length: usize,
) -> Result<()> {
    ensure!(
        length <= MAX_TEXT_BYTES,
        "Fail2ban pickle blob is too large"
    );
    push_fixed(input, cursor, stack, length)
}
fn top_value(stack: &[StackItem]) -> Result<PickleShape> {
    match stack.last().context("pickle stack underflow")? {
        StackItem::Value(value) => Ok(*value),
        StackItem::Mark => bail!("pickle value expected"),
    }
}
fn pop_value(stack: &mut Vec<StackItem>) -> Result<PickleShape> {
    match stack.pop().context("pickle stack underflow")? {
        StackItem::Value(value) => Ok(value),
        StackItem::Mark => bail!("pickle value expected"),
    }
}
fn pop_values(stack: &mut Vec<StackItem>, count: usize) -> Result<Vec<PickleShape>> {
    ensure!(stack.len() >= count, "pickle stack underflow");
    let mut values = Vec::with_capacity(count);
    for _ in 0..count {
        values.push(pop_value(stack)?);
    }
    values.reverse();
    Ok(values)
}
fn take_marked(stack: &mut Vec<StackItem>) -> Result<Vec<PickleShape>> {
    let mark = stack
        .iter()
        .rposition(|item| matches!(item, StackItem::Mark))
        .context("pickle MARK missing")?;
    let tail = stack.split_off(mark);
    tail.into_iter()
        .skip(1)
        .map(|item| match item {
            StackItem::Value(value) => Ok(value),
            StackItem::Mark => bail!("nested pickle MARK in collection"),
        })
        .collect()
}
fn value_mut(item: &mut StackItem) -> Result<&mut PickleShape> {
    match item {
        StackItem::Value(value) => Ok(value),
        StackItem::Mark => bail!("pickle value expected"),
    }
}
fn mutate_container(stack: &mut Vec<StackItem>, count: usize) -> Result<()> {
    let values = pop_values(stack, count)?;
    value_mut(stack.last_mut().context("pickle mutation target missing")?)?.append(&values)
}
fn parse_decimal(value: &[u8]) -> Result<u32> {
    Ok(str::from_utf8(value)?.parse::<u32>()?)
}
fn memo_put(key: u32, stack: &[StackItem], memo: &mut HashMap<u32, PickleShape>) -> Result<()> {
    ensure!(
        memo.len() < MAX_VALUE_NODES || memo.contains_key(&key),
        "Fail2ban pickle memo is too large"
    );
    memo.insert(key, top_value(stack)?);
    Ok(())
}
fn memo_get(key: u32, stack: &mut Vec<StackItem>, memo: &HashMap<u32, PickleShape>) -> Result<()> {
    let value = *memo.get(&key).context("pickle memo reference is missing")?;
    ensure!(
        !value.container,
        "container pickle memo references are forbidden"
    );
    stack.push(StackItem::Value(value));
    Ok(())
}

fn validate_value(value: &PickleValue, depth: usize, nodes: &mut usize) -> Result<()> {
    ensure!(
        depth <= MAX_VALUE_DEPTH,
        "Fail2ban response nesting is too deep"
    );
    *nodes = nodes
        .checked_add(1)
        .context("Fail2ban node count overflow")?;
    ensure!(
        *nodes <= MAX_VALUE_NODES,
        "Fail2ban response has too many values"
    );
    match value {
        PickleValue::String(value) => ensure!(
            value.len() <= MAX_TEXT_BYTES,
            "Fail2ban string is too large"
        ),
        PickleValue::Bytes(value) => ensure!(
            value.len() <= MAX_TEXT_BYTES,
            "Fail2ban bytes are too large"
        ),
        PickleValue::List(values) | PickleValue::Tuple(values) => {
            ensure!(
                values.len() <= MAX_COLLECTION_ITEMS,
                "Fail2ban collection is too large"
            );
            for value in values {
                validate_value(value, depth + 1, nodes)?;
            }
        }
        PickleValue::None | PickleValue::Bool(_) | PickleValue::I64(_) | PickleValue::F64(_) => {}
        PickleValue::Int(_)
        | PickleValue::Set(_)
        | PickleValue::FrozenSet(_)
        | PickleValue::Dict(_) => {
            bail!("unsupported Fail2ban response value")
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn as_sequence(value: &PickleValue) -> Option<&[PickleValue]> {
    match value {
        PickleValue::List(values) | PickleValue::Tuple(values) => Some(values),
        _ => None,
    }
}

fn as_i64(value: &PickleValue) -> Option<i64> {
    match value {
        PickleValue::I64(value) => Some(*value),
        _ => None,
    }
}

fn as_nonnegative_count(value: PickleValue) -> Result<u64> {
    u64::try_from(as_i64(&value).context("Fail2ban response is not an integer count")?)
        .context("Fail2ban returned a negative count")
}

fn as_text(value: &PickleValue) -> Option<&str> {
    match value {
        PickleValue::String(value) => Some(value),
        PickleValue::Bytes(value) => std::str::from_utf8(value).ok(),
        // Fail2ban IPAddr.__reduce__ serializes as str(<address>); the inert
        // data decoder retains the single constructor argument as a tuple.
        PickleValue::Tuple(values) if values.len() == 1 => as_text(&values[0]),
        _ => None,
    }
}

fn first_text(value: &PickleValue) -> Option<&str> {
    as_text(value).or_else(|| as_sequence(value)?.iter().find_map(first_text))
}

fn parse_jail_status(jail: String, value: &PickleValue) -> Result<JailStatusOutput> {
    let sections = as_sequence(value).context("jail status must be a sequence")?;
    let filter = named_value(sections, "Filter")?;
    let actions = named_value(sections, "Actions")?;
    let filter = as_sequence(filter).context("Filter status must be a sequence")?;
    let actions = as_sequence(actions).context("Actions status must be a sequence")?;
    let currently_failed = named_count(filter, "Currently failed")?;
    let total_failed = named_count(filter, "Total failed")?;
    let currently_banned = named_count(actions, "Currently banned")?;
    let total_banned = named_count(actions, "Total banned")?;
    let banned_ips = named_strings(actions, "Banned IP list")?;
    let (monitor_source_kind, monitored_sources) = if has_named(filter, "File list") {
        (
            MonitorSourceKind::Files,
            named_strings(filter, "File list")?,
        )
    } else {
        (
            MonitorSourceKind::Journal,
            named_strings(filter, "Journal matches")?,
        )
    };
    ensure!(
        u64::try_from(banned_ips.len())? == currently_banned,
        "Fail2ban current-ban count does not match its IP list"
    );
    Ok(JailStatusOutput {
        jail,
        currently_failed,
        total_failed,
        currently_banned,
        total_banned,
        banned_ips,
        monitor_source_kind,
        monitored_sources,
    })
}

fn named_value<'a>(pairs: &'a [PickleValue], name: &str) -> Result<&'a PickleValue> {
    pairs
        .iter()
        .find_map(|pair| {
            let pair = as_sequence(pair)?;
            (pair.len() == 2 && as_text(&pair[0]) == Some(name)).then_some(&pair[1])
        })
        .with_context(|| format!("Fail2ban status is missing '{name}'"))
}

fn has_named(pairs: &[PickleValue], name: &str) -> bool {
    named_value(pairs, name).is_ok()
}

fn named_count(pairs: &[PickleValue], name: &str) -> Result<u64> {
    u64::try_from(as_i64(named_value(pairs, name)?).context("status count is not an integer")?)
        .with_context(|| format!("Fail2ban status '{name}' is negative"))
}

fn named_strings(pairs: &[PickleValue], name: &str) -> Result<Vec<String>> {
    let values = as_sequence(named_value(pairs, name)?)
        .with_context(|| format!("Fail2ban status '{name}' is not a sequence"))?;
    values
        .iter()
        .map(|value| {
            as_text(value)
                .with_context(|| format!("Fail2ban status '{name}' contains a non-string"))
                .map(str::to_string)
        })
        .collect()
}

fn validate_jail(jail: &str) -> Result<()> {
    ensure!(
        !jail.is_empty() && jail.len() <= 64,
        "invalid Fail2ban jail name"
    );
    ensure!(jail != "." && jail != "..", "invalid Fail2ban jail name");
    ensure!(
        jail.bytes()
            .all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || matches!(byte, b'-' | b'_' | b'.')),
        "invalid Fail2ban jail name"
    );
    Ok(())
}

fn validate_ip(ip: &str) -> Result<String> {
    Ok(ip
        .parse::<IpAddr>()
        .context("invalid IP address")?
        .to_string())
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use tokio::net::UnixListener;

    fn text(value: &str) -> PickleValue {
        PickleValue::String(value.to_string())
    }
    fn pair(name: &str, value: PickleValue) -> PickleValue {
        PickleValue::Tuple(vec![text(name), value])
    }
    fn ack(value: PickleValue) -> Vec<u8> {
        serde_pickle::value_to_vec(
            &PickleValue::Tuple(vec![PickleValue::I64(0), value]),
            serde_pickle::SerOptions::new().proto_v2(),
        )
        .unwrap()
    }
    fn status() -> PickleValue {
        PickleValue::List(vec![
            pair(
                "Filter",
                PickleValue::List(vec![
                    pair("Currently failed", PickleValue::I64(1)),
                    pair("Total failed", PickleValue::I64(7)),
                    pair(
                        "File list",
                        PickleValue::List(vec![text("/fixture/auth.log")]),
                    ),
                ]),
            ),
            pair(
                "Actions",
                PickleValue::List(vec![
                    pair("Currently banned", PickleValue::I64(1)),
                    pair("Total banned", PickleValue::I64(3)),
                    pair("Banned IP list", PickleValue::List(vec![text("192.0.2.4")])),
                ]),
            ),
        ])
    }

    async fn fixture(responses: Vec<Vec<u8>>) -> (tempfile::TempDir, Fail2banMethods) {
        let dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let path = dir.path().join("fail2ban.sock");
        let listener = UnixListener::bind(&path).unwrap();
        tokio::spawn(async move {
            for response in responses {
                let (mut stream, _) = listener.accept().await.unwrap();
                let request = read_frame(&mut stream).await.unwrap();
                let command: Vec<String> =
                    serde_pickle::from_slice(&request, serde_pickle::DeOptions::new()).unwrap();
                assert!(matches!(command[0].as_str(), "set" | "status"));
                stream.write_all(&response).await.unwrap();
                stream.write_all(END).await.unwrap();
            }
        });
        let service = Fail2banMethods::new(&path, Duration::from_secs(2)).unwrap();
        (dir, service)
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn native_fixture_covers_ban_unban_and_status() {
        let (_dir, service) = fixture(vec![
            ack(PickleValue::I64(1)),
            ack(PickleValue::I64(1)),
            ack(status()),
        ])
        .await;
        let banned = service
            .dispatch(
                "ban_ip",
                &serde_json::json!({"jail":"sshd","ip":"192.0.2.4"}),
            )
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(banned["affected"], 1);
        let unbanned = service
            .dispatch(
                "unban_ip",
                &serde_json::json!({"jail":"sshd","ip":"192.0.2.4"}),
            )
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(unbanned["affected"], 1);
        let status = service
            .dispatch("get_jail_status", &serde_json::json!({"jail":"sshd"}))
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(status["currently_failed"], 1);
        assert_eq!(status["banned_ips"], serde_json::json!(["192.0.2.4"]));
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn rejects_provider_error_truncated_oversized_and_unknown_values() {
        let rejected = serde_pickle::value_to_vec(
            &PickleValue::Tuple(vec![PickleValue::I64(1), text("Unknown Jail")]),
            serde_pickle::SerOptions::new().proto_v2(),
        )
        .unwrap();
        assert!(decode_ack(&rejected)
            .unwrap_err()
            .to_string()
            .contains("Unknown Jail"));
        assert!(decode_ack(&[0x80]).is_err());
        assert!(decode_ack(&ack(PickleValue::Dict(Default::default()))).is_err());

        let dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let path = dir.path().join("oversized.sock");
        let listener = UnixListener::bind(&path).unwrap();
        tokio::spawn(async move {
            let (mut stream, _) = listener.accept().await.unwrap();
            let _ = read_frame(&mut stream).await.unwrap();
            stream
                .write_all(&vec![b'x'; MAX_FRAME_BYTES + 1])
                .await
                .unwrap();
        });
        let service = Fail2banMethods::new(path, Duration::from_secs(2)).unwrap();
        assert!(service
            .dispatch("get_jail_status", &serde_json::json!({"jail":"sshd"}))
            .await
            .is_err());
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn validates_jail_and_ip_before_connecting() {
        let service = Fail2banMethods::new("/fixture/absent.sock", Duration::from_secs(1)).unwrap();
        for args in [
            serde_json::json!({"jail":"../sshd","ip":"192.0.2.4"}),
            serde_json::json!({"jail":"sshd","ip":"not-an-ip"}),
            serde_json::json!({"jail":"sshd","ip":"192.0.2.4","extra":true}),
        ] {
            assert!(service.dispatch("ban_ip", &args).await.is_err());
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn preflight_rejects_container_memo_aliases_and_cycles() {
        // PROTO 2; EMPTY_LIST; BINPUT 0; MARK; BINGET 0; APPENDS; STOP.
        // Resolving the memo produces a list containing itself.
        let cycle = [0x80, 2, b']', b'q', 0, b'(', b'h', 0, b'e', b'.'];
        let error = preflight_pickle(&cycle).unwrap_err().to_string();
        assert!(error.contains("container pickle memo references"));

        // Even an acyclic repeated container reference is rejected before the
        // decoder can clone its subtree repeatedly.
        let alias = [
            0x80, 2, b']', b'q', 0, b'0', b']', b'(', b'h', 0, b'h', 0, b'e', b'.',
        ];
        assert!(preflight_pickle(&alias).is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn preflight_rejects_excessive_nesting_without_decoding() {
        let mut nested = vec![0x80, 2];
        nested.extend(std::iter::repeat_n(b']', MAX_VALUE_DEPTH + 2));
        nested.extend(std::iter::repeat_n(b'a', MAX_VALUE_DEPTH + 1));
        nested.push(b'.');
        let error = preflight_pickle(&nested).unwrap_err().to_string();
        assert!(error.contains("deeply nested"));
    }
}
</file>

<file path="op-plugins/src/state_plugins/fail2ban.rs">
//! Fail2ban control-plane schema.
//!
//! Runtime calls use the daemon's configured Unix control socket through the
//! native adapter in `fail2ban_methods`; this module never invents daemon state.

use anyhow::{bail, Result};
use async_trait::async_trait;
use op_state::{ApplyResult, Checkpoint, DiffMetadata, PluginCapabilities, StateDiff, StatePlugin};
use op_state_store::PluginSchema;
use schemars::JsonSchema;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use simd_json::OwnedValue as Value;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, Default, JsonSchema)]
#[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "sch.security.plugin.fail2ban.schema@v2"))]
#[schemars(extend("x-oscal-category" = "security"))]
pub struct Fail2banState {
    pub jails: Vec<JailStatusOutput>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct JailInput {
    pub jail: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct BanIpInput {
    pub jail: String,
    pub ip: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum MonitorSourceKind {
    Files,
    Journal,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
pub struct JailStatusOutput {
    pub jail: String,
    pub currently_failed: u64,
    pub total_failed: u64,
    pub currently_banned: u64,
    pub total_banned: u64,
    pub banned_ips: Vec<String>,
    pub monitor_source_kind: MonitorSourceKind,
    pub monitored_sources: Vec<String>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
pub struct BanIpOutput {
    pub jail: String,
    pub ip: String,
    /// Number of bans the daemon reports it applied.
    pub affected: u64,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
pub struct UnbanIpOutput {
    pub jail: String,
    pub ip: String,
    /// Number of bans the daemon reports it removed.
    pub affected: u64,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
pub struct ReloadOutput {
    pub scope: String,
    pub reloaded: bool,
}

pub struct Fail2banPlugin;

impl Fail2banPlugin {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self
    }
}

impl Default for Fail2banPlugin {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}

#[async_trait]
impl StatePlugin for Fail2banPlugin {
    fn name(&self) -> &str {
        "fail2ban"
    }

    fn version(&self) -> &str {
        "2.0.0"
    }

    fn schema(&self) -> Option<PluginSchema> {
        Some(fail2ban_schema())
    }

    async fn calculate_diff(&self, _current: &Value, _desired: &Value) -> Result<StateDiff> {
        Ok(StateDiff {
            plugin: self.name().to_string(),
            actions: vec![],
            metadata: DiffMetadata {
                timestamp: chrono::Utc::now().timestamp(),
                current_hash: String::new(),
                desired_hash: String::new(),
            },
        })
    }

    async fn apply_state(&self, _diff: &StateDiff) -> Result<ApplyResult> {
        Ok(ApplyResult {
            success: true,
            changes_applied: vec![],
            errors: vec![],
            checkpoint: None,
        })
    }

    async fn verify_state(&self, _desired: &Value) -> Result<bool> {
        bail!("Fail2ban StatePlugin verification is unsupported")
    }

    async fn create_checkpoint(&self) -> Result<Checkpoint> {
        bail!("Fail2ban StatePlugin checkpoints are unsupported")
    }

    async fn rollback(&self, _checkpoint: &Checkpoint) -> Result<()> {
        bail!("Fail2ban StatePlugin rollback is unsupported")
    }

    fn capabilities(&self) -> PluginCapabilities {
        PluginCapabilities {
            supports_rollback: false,
            supports_checkpoints: false,
            supports_verification: false,
            atomic_operations: false,
        }
    }
}

pub(crate) fn fail2ban_schema() -> PluginSchema {
    let root = serde_json::to_value(schemars::schema_for!(Fail2banState))
        .expect("schemars schema serializes to JSON");
    let mut schema = super::schemars_adapter::plugin_schema_from_json(
        "fail2ban",
        "2.0.0",
        "Fail2ban jail status and daemon-native ban control",
        &root,
    );
    schema.category = "security".to_string();

    use super::plugin_scaffold_helpers::{method_decl_from_schemars_with_output, EmptyInput};
    use op_state_store::SideEffect;

    schema.methods.insert(
        "ban_ip".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<BanIpInput, BanIpOutput>(
            "ban_ip",
            SideEffect::Mutation,
            false,
            "fail2ban.write",
            "mut.security.fail2ban.ip.ban@v2",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "unban_ip".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<BanIpInput, UnbanIpOutput>(
            "unban_ip",
            SideEffect::Mutation,
            false,
            "fail2ban.write",
            "mut.security.fail2ban.ip.unban@v2",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "get_jail_status".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<JailInput, JailStatusOutput>(
            "get_jail_status",
            SideEffect::Read,
            true,
            "fail2ban.read",
            "obs.security.fail2ban.jail.status@v2",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "reload".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<EmptyInput, ReloadOutput>(
            "reload",
            SideEffect::Mutation,
            false,
            "fail2ban.write",
            "mut.security.fail2ban.service.reload@v2",
        ),
    );

    schema.capabilities.insert(
        "fail2ban.read".to_string(),
        op_state_store::CapabilityDecl {
            id: "fail2ban.read".to_string(),
            description: "Grants: get_jail_status.".to_string(),
        },
    );
    schema.capabilities.insert(
        "fail2ban.write".to_string(),
        op_state_store::CapabilityDecl {
            id: "fail2ban.write".to_string(),
        description: "Grants daemon-native ban_ip and unban_ip; reload requires a validated configuration stream.".to_string(),
        },
    );
    schema
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn methods_are_typed_and_names_match_keys() {
        let schema = fail2ban_schema();
        assert_eq!(schema.version, "2.0.0");
        for name in ["ban_ip", "unban_ip", "get_jail_status", "reload"] {
            let method = &schema.methods[name];
            assert_eq!(method.name, name);
            assert!(method.returns.is_some());
        }
        assert!(schema.example.is_none());
    }
}

inventory::submit! {
    crate::default_registry::PluginReg::new("fail2ban", |_ctx| std::sync::Arc::new(Fail2banPlugin::new()))
}
</file>

//! FreeDesktop Plugin
//!
//! Implements FreeDesktop D-Bus standards support including:
//! - org.freedesktop.DBus.ObjectManager
//! - org.freedesktop.DBus.Properties
//! - org.freedesktop.DBus.Introspectable
//! - org.freedesktop.DBus.Peer
//!
//! This plugin follows the canonical path convention:
//! - D-Bus Path: /org/opdbus/v1/plugins/freedesktop
//! - Interface: org.opdbus.v1.PluginV1
//! - Schema: this plugin's Rust declaration.
//!
//! ## Architecture
//!
//! The bridge executes these standard operations against canonical sealed
//! OP-DBUS plugin objects. The descriptor tables below describe FreeDesktop
//! metadata; they do not grant arbitrary external D-Bus access.
//!
//! ## Canonical Path Compliance
//!
//! This plugin uses the canonical paths as defined in `crate::canonical`:
//! - Object path prefix: `/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/`
//! - Interface: `org.opdbus.v1.PluginV1`
//!
//! Legacy paths like `/opdbus/v1/plugins/` or `/org/opdbus/v1/plugin/plugins/`
//! are normalized to the canonical prefix by `crate::canonical::normalize_plugin_path`.

use crate::canonical;
use anyhow::Result;
use async_trait::async_trait;
use op_state::{
    ApplyResult, Checkpoint, DiffMetadata, PluginCapabilities, PluginSchema, StateDiff, StatePlugin,
};
use schemars::JsonSchema;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use simd_json::prelude::{ValueAsScalar, ValueObjectAccess};
use simd_json::OwnedValue as Value;
use std::collections::HashMap;

/// Enumeration is restricted to the current sealed OP-DBUS plugin catalog.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct GetManagedObjectsInput {}

fn canonical_interface() -> String {
    canonical::PLUGIN_INTERFACE.to_string()
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct GetPropertyInput {
    pub plugin_id: String,
    #[serde(default = "canonical_interface")]
    pub interface_name: String,
    pub property_name: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct GetAllPropertiesInput {
    pub plugin_id: String,
    #[serde(default = "canonical_interface")]
    pub interface_name: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct SetPropertyInput {
    pub plugin_id: String,
    #[serde(default = "canonical_interface")]
    pub interface_name: String,
    pub property_name: String,
    /// A native JSON value checked against the target plugin's sealed field.
    pub value: serde_json::Value,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct IntrospectInput {
    pub plugin_id: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct PingInput {
    pub plugin_id: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct GetMachineIdInput {
    pub plugin_id: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
pub struct ManagedPluginObject {
    pub plugin_id: String,
    pub object_path: String,
    pub interface_name: String,
    pub schema_hash: String,
    /// Only fields declared by this sealed plugin and present in public SHM.
    pub properties: std::collections::BTreeMap<String, serde_json::Value>,
    pub projection_available: bool,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
pub struct GetManagedObjectsOutput {
    pub objects: Vec<ManagedPluginObject>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
pub struct GetPropertyOutput {
    pub plugin_id: String,
    pub property_name: String,
    pub value: serde_json::Value,
    pub read_only: bool,
    pub schema_hash: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
pub struct GetAllPropertiesOutput {
    pub object: ManagedPluginObject,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
pub struct SetPropertyOutput {
    pub plugin_id: String,
    pub property_name: String,
    pub method: String,
    /// The mapped mutation's actual result; no requested-value echo.
    pub result: serde_json::Value,
    pub event_id: u64,
    pub event_hash: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
pub struct IntrospectOutput {
    pub plugin_id: String,
    pub object_path: String,
    pub schema_hash: String,
    /// Canonical PluginV1 ABI with sealed method/field metadata annotations.
    /// A declared plugin method is invoked through Call, not a new D-Bus member.
    pub xml: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
pub struct PingOutput {
    pub plugin_id: String,
    pub object_path: String,
    pub schema_hash: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
pub struct GetMachineIdOutput {
    pub plugin_id: String,
    pub machine_id: String,
}

/// FreeDesktop plugin implementation
pub struct FreeDesktopPlugin {
    schema: Option<PluginSchema>,
    dbus_interfaces: HashMap<String, DbusInterface>,
}

/// D-Bus interface definition
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct DbusInterface {
    pub name: String,
    pub description: String,
    pub methods: Vec<DbusMethod>,
    pub signals: Vec<DbusSignal>,
    pub properties: Vec<DbusProperty>,
}

/// D-Bus method definition
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct DbusMethod {
    pub name: String,
    pub signature: String,
    pub description: String,
}

/// D-Bus signal definition
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct DbusSignal {
    pub name: String,
    pub signature: String,
    pub description: String,
}

/// D-Bus property definition
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct DbusProperty {
    pub name: String,
    pub property_type: String,
    pub access: PropertyAccess,
    pub description: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum PropertyAccess {
    Read,
    Write,
    ReadWrite,
}

impl FreeDesktopPlugin {
    /// Create a new FreeDesktop plugin with default configuration
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        let mut plugin = Self {
            schema: None,
            dbus_interfaces: HashMap::new(),
        };

        // Initialize schema from embedded definition
        plugin.initialize_schema();

        // Register standard FreeDesktop interfaces
        plugin.register_standard_interfaces();

        plugin
    }

    /// Initialize the plugin schema
    fn initialize_schema(&mut self) {
        // Static fallback; the plugin owns its contract.
        // For now, we define the schema programmatically following the canonical structure
        self.schema = Some(
            PluginSchema::builder("freedesktop")
                .category("service")
                .version("2.0.0")
                .category("system")
                .description("FreeDesktop operations scoped to sealed OP-DBUS plugin objects")
                .method(
                    super::plugin_scaffold_helpers::method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<
GetManagedObjectsInput,
                        GetManagedObjectsOutput,
                    >(
                        "GetManagedObjects",
                        op_state_store::SideEffect::Read,
                        true,
                        "freedesktop.read",
                        "obs.software.freedesktop.managed-objects.get@v1",
                    ),
                )
                .method(
                    super::plugin_scaffold_helpers::method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<
GetPropertyInput,
                        GetPropertyOutput,
                    >(
                        "Get",
                        op_state_store::SideEffect::Read,
                        true,
                        "freedesktop.read",
                        "obs.software.freedesktop.property.get@v1",
                    ),
                )
                .method(
                    super::plugin_scaffold_helpers::method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<
GetAllPropertiesInput,
                        GetAllPropertiesOutput,
                    >(
                        "GetAll",
                        op_state_store::SideEffect::Read,
                        true,
                        "freedesktop.read",
                        "obs.software.freedesktop.properties.getall@v1",
                    ),
                )
                .method(
                    super::plugin_scaffold_helpers::method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<
SetPropertyInput,
                        SetPropertyOutput,
                    >(
                        "Set",
                        op_state_store::SideEffect::Mutation,
                        true,
                        "freedesktop.write",
                        "mut.software.freedesktop.property.set@v1",
                    ),
                )
                .method(
                    super::plugin_scaffold_helpers::method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<
IntrospectInput,
                        IntrospectOutput,
                    >(
                        "Introspect",
                        op_state_store::SideEffect::Read,
                        true,
                        "freedesktop.read",
                        "obs.software.freedesktop.introspect@v1",
                    ),
                )
                .method(
                    super::plugin_scaffold_helpers::method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<
PingInput,
                        PingOutput,
                    >(
                        "Ping",
                        op_state_store::SideEffect::Read,
                        true,
                        "freedesktop.read",
                        "obs.software.freedesktop.ping@v1",
                    ),
                )
                .method(
                    super::plugin_scaffold_helpers::method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<
GetMachineIdInput,
                        GetMachineIdOutput,
                    >(
                        "GetMachineId",
                        op_state_store::SideEffect::Read,
                        true,
                        "freedesktop.read",
                        "obs.software.freedesktop.machine-id.get@v1",
                    ),
                )
                .capability(op_state_store::CapabilityDecl {
                    id: "freedesktop.read".to_string(),
                    description:
                        "Grants: GetManagedObjects, Get, GetAll, Introspect, Ping, GetMachineId."
                            .to_string(),
                })
                .capability(op_state_store::CapabilityDecl {
                    id: "freedesktop.write".to_string(),
                    description: "Admits Set; the target plugin's mapped mutation capability is independently required.".to_string(),
                })
                .build(),
        );
    }

    /// Register standard FreeDesktop D-Bus interfaces
    fn register_standard_interfaces(&mut self) {
        // ObjectManager interface
        self.dbus_interfaces.insert(
            canonical::OBJECT_MANAGER_INTERFACE.to_string(),
            DbusInterface {
                name: canonical::OBJECT_MANAGER_INTERFACE.to_string(),
                description: "Interface for enumerating managed objects".to_string(),
                methods: vec![DbusMethod {
                    name: "GetManagedObjects".to_string(),
                    signature: "a{oa{sa{sv}}}".to_string(),
                    description: "Get all managed objects with their interfaces".to_string(),
                }],
                signals: vec![
                    DbusSignal {
                        name: "InterfacesAdded".to_string(),
                        signature: "oa{sa{sv}}".to_string(),
                        description: "Emitted when interfaces are added".to_string(),
                    },
                    DbusSignal {
                        name: "InterfacesRemoved".to_string(),
                        signature: "oas".to_string(),
                        description: "Emitted when interfaces are removed".to_string(),
                    },
                ],
                properties: vec![],
            },
        );

        // Properties interface
        self.dbus_interfaces.insert(
            canonical::PROPERTIES_INTERFACE.to_string(),
            DbusInterface {
                name: canonical::PROPERTIES_INTERFACE.to_string(),
                description: "Standard D-Bus properties interface".to_string(),
                methods: vec![
                    DbusMethod {
                        name: "Get".to_string(),
                        signature: "v".to_string(),
                        description: "Get a property value".to_string(),
                    },
                    DbusMethod {
                        name: "GetAll".to_string(),
                        signature: "a{sv}".to_string(),
                        description: "Get all properties of an interface".to_string(),
                    },
                    DbusMethod {
                        name: "Set".to_string(),
                        signature: "".to_string(),
                        description: "Set a property value".to_string(),
                    },
                ],
                signals: vec![DbusSignal {
                    name: "PropertiesChanged".to_string(),
                    signature: "sa{sv}as".to_string(),
                    description: "Emitted when properties change".to_string(),
                }],
                properties: vec![],
            },
        );

        // Introspectable interface
        self.dbus_interfaces.insert(
            canonical::INTROSPECTABLE_INTERFACE.to_string(),
            DbusInterface {
                name: canonical::INTROSPECTABLE_INTERFACE.to_string(),
                description: "Standard D-Bus introspection interface".to_string(),
                methods: vec![DbusMethod {
                    name: "Introspect".to_string(),
                    signature: "s".to_string(),
                    description: "Return XML introspection data".to_string(),
                }],
                signals: vec![],
                properties: vec![],
            },
        );

        // Peer interface
        self.dbus_interfaces.insert(
            canonical::PEER_INTERFACE.to_string(),
            DbusInterface {
                name: canonical::PEER_INTERFACE.to_string(),
                description: "Standard D-Bus peer interface".to_string(),
                methods: vec![
                    DbusMethod {
                        name: "Ping".to_string(),
                        signature: "".to_string(),
                        description: "Ping the peer".to_string(),
                    },
                    DbusMethod {
                        name: "GetMachineId".to_string(),
                        signature: "s".to_string(),
                        description: "Get the machine ID".to_string(),
                    },
                ],
                signals: vec![],
                properties: vec![],
            },
        );
    }

    /// Get the canonical D-Bus object path for this plugin
    pub fn dbus_path(&self) -> String {
        canonical::plugin_path("freedesktop")
    }

    /// Get the canonical D-Bus interface name for this plugin
    pub fn dbus_interface(&self) -> String {
        canonical::plugin_interface("freedesktop")
    }

    /// Get a registered D-Bus interface by name
    pub fn get_interface(&self, name: &str) -> Option<&DbusInterface> {
        self.dbus_interfaces.get(name)
    }

    /// Get all registered interfaces
    pub fn all_interfaces(&self) -> &HashMap<String, DbusInterface> {
        &self.dbus_interfaces
    }

    /// Validate that a D-Bus path follows the canonical convention
    pub fn validate_canonical_path(&self, path: &str) -> Result<()> {
        if canonical::is_canonical_plugin_path(path) {
            Ok(())
        } else {
            Err(anyhow::anyhow!(
                "Path '{}' is not in canonical form. Expected prefix: {}",
                path,
                canonical::PLUGIN_BASE_PATH
            ))
        }
    }

    /// Normalize a legacy path to canonical form
    pub fn normalize_path(&self, path: &str) -> Option<String> {
        canonical::normalize_plugin_path(path)
    }
}

impl Default for FreeDesktopPlugin {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}

#[async_trait]
impl StatePlugin for FreeDesktopPlugin {
    fn name(&self) -> &str {
        "freedesktop"
    }

    fn version(&self) -> &str {
        "2.0.0"
    }

    fn is_available(&self) -> bool {
        true
    }

    fn unavailable_reason(&self) -> String {
        String::new()
    }

    fn schema(&self) -> Option<PluginSchema> {
        self.schema.clone()
    }

    async fn calculate_diff(&self, _current: &Value, desired: &Value) -> anyhow::Result<StateDiff> {
        // FreeDesktop plugin is informational - we only check if desired state is valid
        let actions = vec![];

        Ok(StateDiff {
            plugin: self.name().to_string(),
            actions,
            metadata: DiffMetadata {
                timestamp: chrono::Utc::now().timestamp(),
                current_hash: String::new(),
                desired_hash: format!("{:x}", md5::compute(simd_json::to_string(desired)?)),
            },
        })
    }

    async fn apply_state(&self, _diff: &StateDiff) -> anyhow::Result<ApplyResult> {
        // FreeDesktop plugin is primarily informational/structural
        // No actual system changes are made
        Ok(ApplyResult {
            success: true,
            changes_applied: vec!["FreeDesktop configuration is informational only".to_string()],
            errors: vec![],
            checkpoint: None,
        })
    }

    async fn verify_state(&self, desired: &Value) -> anyhow::Result<bool> {
        // Verify the desired state has the correct structure
        let current_name = desired.get("name").and_then(|v| v.as_str());
        Ok(current_name == Some("freedesktop"))
    }

    async fn create_checkpoint(&self) -> anyhow::Result<Checkpoint> {
        Ok(Checkpoint {
            id: format!("freedesktop-{}", chrono::Utc::now().timestamp()),
            plugin: self.name().to_string(),
            timestamp: chrono::Utc::now().timestamp(),
            state_snapshot: simd_json::json!(null),
            backend_checkpoint: None,
        })
    }

    async fn rollback(&self, _checkpoint: &Checkpoint) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
        // FreeDesktop plugin is informational, nothing to rollback
        Ok(())
    }

    fn capabilities(&self) -> PluginCapabilities {
        PluginCapabilities {
            supports_rollback: false,
            supports_checkpoints: true,
            supports_verification: true,
            atomic_operations: true,
        }
    }
}

/// FreeDesktopPlugin configuration
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct FreeDesktopConfig {
    pub enable_object_manager: bool,
    pub enable_properties: bool,
    pub enable_introspection: bool,
    pub enable_peer: bool,
}

impl Default for FreeDesktopConfig {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            enable_object_manager: true,
            enable_properties: true,
            enable_introspection: true,
            enable_peer: true,
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn property_contract_requires_canonical_target_and_native_json_value() {
        let input: SetPropertyInput = serde_json::from_value(serde_json::json!({
            "plugin_id": "tched_router",
            "property_name": "selected_model",
            "value": "model-id"
        }))
        .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(input.interface_name, canonical::PLUGIN_INTERFACE);
        assert_eq!(input.value, serde_json::json!("model-id"));
        assert!(
            serde_json::from_value::<SetPropertyInput>(serde_json::json!({
                "property_name": "selected_model", "value": "model-id"
            }))
            .is_err()
        );
        assert!(
            serde_json::from_value::<SetPropertyInput>(serde_json::json!({
                "plugin_id": "tched_router", "property_name": "selected_model",
                "value": "model-id", "destination": "org.external.Service"
            }))
            .is_err()
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_freedesktop_plugin_creation() {
        let plugin = FreeDesktopPlugin::new();
        assert_eq!(plugin.name(), "freedesktop");
        assert_eq!(plugin.version(), "2.0.0");
        assert!(plugin.is_available());
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_canonical_paths() {
        let plugin = FreeDesktopPlugin::new();

        // Verify canonical paths
        assert_eq!(plugin.dbus_path(), "/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/freedesktop");
        assert_eq!(plugin.dbus_interface(), "org.opdbus.v1.PluginV1");
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_registered_interfaces() {
        let plugin = FreeDesktopPlugin::new();

        // Check all standard interfaces are registered
        assert!(plugin
            .get_interface(canonical::OBJECT_MANAGER_INTERFACE)
            .is_some());
        assert!(plugin
            .get_interface(canonical::PROPERTIES_INTERFACE)
            .is_some());
        assert!(plugin
            .get_interface(canonical::INTROSPECTABLE_INTERFACE)
            .is_some());
        assert!(plugin.get_interface(canonical::PEER_INTERFACE).is_some());
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_path_validation() {
        let plugin = FreeDesktopPlugin::new();

        // Valid canonical path
        assert!(plugin
            .validate_canonical_path("/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/test")
            .is_ok());

        // Invalid legacy path (missing /org prefix)
        assert!(plugin
            .validate_canonical_path("/opdbus/v1/plugins/test")
            .is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_path_normalization() {
        let plugin = FreeDesktopPlugin::new();

        // Legacy path should be normalized to canonical
        let normalized = plugin.normalize_path("/opdbus/v1/plugins/test");
        assert_eq!(normalized, Some("/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/test".to_string()));

        // Legacy alias also normalizes to canonical
        let canonical = plugin.normalize_path("/org/opdbus/v1/plugin/plugins/test");
        assert_eq!(canonical, Some("/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/test".to_string()));
    }
}

// Self-registration: the plugin registry discovers this via inventory
// (single source of the catalog; no central dispatch list).
inventory::submit! {
    crate::default_registry::PluginReg::new("freedesktop", |_ctx| std::sync::Arc::new(FreeDesktopPlugin::new()))
}

//! Full System State Plugin
//!
//! This plugin captures the COMPLETE system state for disaster recovery.
//! It aggregates state from all other plugins into a single JSON document
//! that can be used to reinstall/restore the entire system.
//!
//! ## State Categories
//!
//! - **system**: hostname, timezone, locale, kernel parameters
//! - **network**: interfaces, routes, DNS, bridges, VLANs
//! - **services**: systemd units and their configurations
//! - **packages**: installed packages and versions
//! - **users**: user accounts and groups
//! - **storage**: mounts, fstab entries
//! - **containers**: Incus instances (read from SHM present state)
//! - **security**: firewall rules, SELinux/AppArmor policies
//!
//! This plugin is special: it queries OTHER plugins to build the full state.

use anyhow::{Context, Result};
use async_trait::async_trait;
use op_state::{ApplyResult, Checkpoint, StateAction, StateDiff, StatePlugin};
use op_state_store::{Constraint, FieldSchema, FieldType, PluginSchema};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use simd_json::prelude::*;
use simd_json::{json, OwnedValue as Value};
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::path::PathBuf;
use std::sync::Arc;
use tokio::process::Command;
use tokio::sync::RwLock;
use tracing::{debug, info, warn};
use zbus::{Connection, Proxy};

/// Full system state for disaster recovery
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, Default, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[schemars(extend("x-oscal-category" = "system"))]
pub struct FullSystemState {
    /// State schema version
    pub version: u32,

    /// Timestamp of when this state was captured
    pub captured_at: String,

    /// Hostname
    pub hostname: String,

    /// System information
    pub system: SystemInfo,

    /// Network configuration
    pub network: NetworkState,

    /// Systemd services
    pub services: Vec<ServiceState>,

    /// Installed packages
    pub packages: Vec<PackageInfo>,

    /// User accounts
    pub users: Vec<UserInfo>,

    /// Storage mounts
    pub storage: StorageState,

    /// Container state (Incus instances)
    pub containers: ContainerState,

    /// Plugin-specific state (aggregated from all plugins)
    pub plugins: HashMap<String, serde_json::Value>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct SystemInfo {
    pub kernel_version: String,
    pub os_release: String,
    pub timezone: String,
    pub locale: String,
    pub uptime_seconds: u64,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct NetworkState {
    pub interfaces: Vec<InterfaceInfo>,
    pub routes: Vec<RouteInfo>,
    pub dns_servers: Vec<String>,
    pub bridges: Vec<BridgeInfo>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct InterfaceInfo {
    pub name: String,
    pub mac: String,
    pub addresses: Vec<String>,
    pub state: String,
    pub mtu: u32,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct RouteInfo {
    pub destination: String,
    pub gateway: Option<String>,
    pub interface: String,
    pub metric: u32,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct BridgeInfo {
    pub name: String,
    pub ports: Vec<String>,
    pub bridge_type: String, // "linux" or "ovs"
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct ServiceState {
    pub name: String,
    pub enabled: bool,
    pub running: bool,
    pub unit_type: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct PackageInfo {
    pub name: String,
    pub version: String,
    pub arch: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct UserInfo {
    pub name: String,
    pub uid: u32,
    pub gid: u32,
    pub home: String,
    pub shell: String,
    pub groups: Vec<String>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct StorageState {
    pub mounts: Vec<MountInfo>,
    pub block_devices: Vec<BlockDeviceInfo>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct MountInfo {
    pub source: String,
    pub target: String,
    pub fstype: String,
    pub options: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct BlockDeviceInfo {

    pub size_bytes: u64,
    pub fstype: Option<String>,
    pub mountpoint: Option<String>,
