<file path="op-plugins/src/state_plugins/json_render_canvas_profile_tests.rs">
use super::*;
use serde_json::json;

fn validator() -> PinnedCanvasValidator {
    let blob = op_blob::blobify_plugin_schema("json_render", super::super::json_render_schema());
    let bytes = blob.seal();
    let parsed =
        op_blob::BlobRef::from_manifest_pinned(&bytes, &blob.manifest.schema_hash).unwrap();
    let original = parsed.schema_json();
    let validator = PinnedCanvasValidator::from_manifest_pinned_schema(
        Arc::from(original),
        blob.manifest.schema_hash.clone(),
    )
    .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(validator.original_schema_json(), original);
    assert_eq!(validator.schema_hash(), blob.manifest.schema_hash);
    validator
}

fn text() -> Value {
    json!({"root":"root","elements":{"root":{"type":"text","props":{"text":"hello","className":null},"children":[]}}})
}

#[test]
fn actual_seal_retains_source_checked_profile_and_required_nullable_props() {
    let validator = validator();
    assert_eq!(validator.profile.evidence.assurance, "source_checked");
    assert_eq!(validator.profile.evidence.core_version, "0.20.0");
    assert_eq!(validator.profile.components.len(), 8);
    assert_eq!(validator.profile.actions.len(), 1);
    assert_eq!(validator.profile.actions[0].name, "setState");
    validator.validate(&text()).unwrap();
    let mut missing = text();
    missing["elements"]["root"]["props"]
        .as_object_mut()
        .unwrap()
        .remove("className");
    assert!(validator.validate(&missing).is_err());
    let mut unknown = text();
    unknown["elements"]["root"]["props"]["secret"] = json!("PRIVATE_SENTINEL");
    let error = validator.validate(&unknown).unwrap_err();
    assert!(!format!("{error:?}").contains("PRIVATE_SENTINEL"));
}

#[test]
fn rejects_reference_catalog_and_hidden_shell_recursion_and_runtime_features() {
    let validator = validator();
    for component in [
        "Card",
        "Text",
        "antigravityChatContainer",
        "tchedRouterPicker",
        "pageHeader",
        "chatMessage",
    ] {
        let mut value = text();
        value["elements"]["root"]["type"] = json!(component);
        assert!(validator.validate(&value).is_err(), "{component}");
    }
    for (key, value) in [
        ("on", json!({"resize":{"action":"setState"}})),
        ("repeat", json!({"statePath":"/secret"})),
        ("watch", json!({})),
        ("visible", json!({"$state":"/secret"})),
        ("slots", json!({"default":["root"]})),
    ] {
        let mut spec = text();
        spec["elements"]["root"][key] = value;
        assert!(validator.validate(&spec).is_err(), "{key}");
    }
    let mut expression = text();
    expression["elements"]["root"]["props"]["text"] = json!({"$state":"/streams/private/messages"});
    assert!(validator.validate(&expression).is_err());
    let mut state = text();
    state["state"] = json!({"selected":false});
    validator.validate(&state).unwrap();
}

#[test]
fn set_state_event_is_resolved_from_the_pinned_binding() {
    let validator = validator();
    let spec = json!({
        "root":"board",
        "state":{"size":"small"},
        "elements":{
            "board":{"type":"autoTileItem","props":{"size":"small","contentType":null,"tileId":"tile","className":null},"children":[],
                "on":{"resize":{"action":"setState","params":{"statePath":"/size","value":"large"}}}}
        }
    });
    let changed = validator.apply_event(&spec, "board", "resize").unwrap();
    assert_eq!(changed["state"]["size"], "large");
    assert_eq!(changed["elements"], spec["elements"]);
    assert!(validator.apply_event(&spec, "board", "delete").is_err());
}

#[test]
fn all_static_component_contracts_accept_exact_implemented_props() {
    let validator = validator();
    for (name, props) in [
        ("container", json!({"className":null})),
        ("row", json!({"className":null})),
        ("text", json!({"text":"hello","className":null})),
        ("heading", json!({"text":"title","level":2})),
        ("badge", json!({"text":null,"label":"ok","tone":"ok"})),
        (
            "stat",
            json!({"label":"count","value":"3","unit":null,"trend":"flat"}),
        ),
        (
            "autoTile",
            json!({"columns":null,"gap":null,"rowHeight":null,"boardId":null,"reorderable":null,"fit":null,"className":null}),
        ),
        (
            "autoTileItem",
            json!({"size":null,"contentType":null,"tileId":null,"className":null}),
        ),
    ] {
        let spec =
            json!({"root":"root","elements":{"root":{"type":name,"props":props,"children":[]}}});
        validator.validate(&spec).unwrap();
    }
    let bad = json!({"root":"root","elements":{"root":{"type":"heading","props":{"text":"title","level":4},"children":[]}}});
    assert!(validator.validate(&bad).is_err());
}

#[test]
fn graph_and_json_limits_apply_before_unbounded_render_work() {
    let validator = validator();
    let mut cycle = text();
    cycle["elements"]["root"] =
        json!({"type":"container","props":{"className":null},"children":["root"]});
    assert!(validator
        .validate(&cycle)
        .unwrap_err()
        .to_string()
        .contains("cycle"));
    let mut graph = serde_json::Map::new();
    for index in 0..14 {
        graph.insert(
            format!("n{index}"),
            json!({"type":"container","props":{"className":null},
            "children":if index == 13 { vec![] } else { vec![format!("n{}",index+1);2] }}),
        );
    }
    let amplified = json!({"root":"n0","elements":graph});
    assert!(validator
        .validate(&amplified)
        .unwrap_err()
        .to_string()
        .contains("expanded"));
    let mut deep = Value::Null;
    for _ in 0..70 {
        deep = json!([deep]);
    }
    assert!(validator
        .validate(&deep)
        .unwrap_err()
        .to_string()
        .contains("depth"));
}
</file>

<file path="op-plugins/src/state_plugins/json_render_canvas_profile.rs">
//! Plugin-owned static Canvas contract, authored from the active UI checkout.
//! The component declarations below are the sole backend profile definition.
//! Source evidence describes inspected implementation bytes, not deployment.
use super::{
    validation_bounds::{check_children_graph, check_json, GraphLimits, JsonLimits},
    ActionDecl, ComponentDecl, RendererTarget,
};
use anyhow::{ensure, Context, Result};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use serde_json::Value;
use std::{collections::BTreeMap, sync::Arc};

pub const PROFILE_ID: &str = "vercel-chat-canvas-static-v1";

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct CanvasImplementationEvidence {
    pub repository: String,
    pub source_revision: String,
    pub catalog_sha256: String,
    pub registry_sha256: String,
    pub package_lock_sha256: String,
    pub core_version: String,
    pub react_version: String,
    /// Always source_checked: sealing is not a deployment attestation.
    pub assurance: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct CanvasProfile {
    pub id: String,
    pub evidence: CanvasImplementationEvidence,
    /// Distinct from the upstream reference inventory in JsonRenderState.components.
    pub components: Vec<ComponentDecl>,
    /// Exact built-in actions implemented by the pinned renderer and admitted
    /// by the server-side event reducer.
    pub actions: Vec<ActionDecl>,
    /// Generated props remain literal; state is changed only through a
    /// validated action binding, never through prop expressions.
    pub literal_props_only: bool,
    pub json_limits: JsonLimits,
    pub graph_limits: GraphLimits,
}

impl Default for CanvasProfile {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            id: PROFILE_ID.into(),
            evidence: CanvasImplementationEvidence {
                repository: "vercel-json-render-ui".into(),
                source_revision: "e8aad07bf02fc16bbb45554fbc570b66513ec019".into(),
                catalog_sha256: "c0a273cd75243a3297624be9578a2f89540bb20c038e9c2e6be2f01aea2ed011"
                    .into(),
                registry_sha256: "52b254c56350d67c9334815c65c05072bf5f8169b5dee3a93cdb3ff5ea86e61b"
                    .into(),
                package_lock_sha256:
                    "851a6ec0f398cc13300e375aa31dec7d07150de5961dba60eb859d9995412201".into(),
                core_version: "0.20.0".into(),
                react_version: "0.20.0".into(),
                assurance: "source_checked".into(),
            },
            components: components(),
            actions: vec![ActionDecl {
                name: "setState".into(),
                params: vec!["statePath".into(), "value".into()],
                params_schema: serde_json::json!({
                    "$schema":"http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#",
                    "type":"object",
                    "properties":{"statePath":{"type":"string"},"value":{}},
                    "required":["statePath","value"],
                    "additionalProperties":false
                }),
                renderers: vec![RendererTarget::React],
                mutates_state: true,
                description: "Set a value at a JSON Pointer in the spec-owned state object.".into(),
            }],
            literal_props_only: true,
            json_limits: JsonLimits {
                max_depth: 64,
                max_nodes: 65_536,
                max_bytes: 1024 * 1024,
            },
            graph_limits: GraphLimits {
                max_elements: 4096,
                max_edges: 16_384,
                max_depth: 64,
                max_expanded_nodes: 4096,
            },
        }
    }
}

/// Immutable validator constructed from an ALREADY manifest-pinned blob's
/// original schema JSON and stored schema hash. The caller must establish
/// catalog membership and compiled-state compatibility before constructing it.
/// This module never hashes, seals, scans a catalog, or consults a registry.
pub struct PinnedCanvasValidator {
    schema_json: Arc<str>,
    schema_hash: String,
    profile: CanvasProfile,
    props: BTreeMap<String, jsonschema::Validator>,
}

impl PinnedCanvasValidator {
    pub fn from_manifest_pinned_schema(schema_json: Arc<str>, schema_hash: String) -> Result<Self> {
        ensure!(
            schema_json.len() <= 16 * 1024 * 1024,
            "renderer schema exceeds size limit"
        );
        ensure!(
            schema_hash.len() == 64
                && schema_hash
                    .bytes()
                    .all(|b| b.is_ascii_digit() || (b'a'..=b'f').contains(&b)),
            "invalid stored renderer schema hash"
        );
        let schema: op_state_store::PluginSchema = serde_json::from_str(&schema_json)
            .map_err(|_| anyhow::anyhow!("invalid pinned renderer schema"))?;
        ensure!(
            schema.name == "json_render" && schema.version == "3.0.0",
            "incompatible pinned renderer contract"
        );
        let field = schema
            .fields
            .get("canvas_profile")
            .context("sealed Canvas profile absent")?;
        let profile: CanvasProfile = serde_json::from_value(serde_json::to_value(
            field
                .default
                .as_ref()
                .context("sealed Canvas profile has no authored value")?,
        )?)
        .map_err(|_| anyhow::anyhow!("invalid sealed Canvas profile"))?;
        ensure!(
            profile.id == PROFILE_ID && profile.literal_props_only,
            "unsupported Canvas profile"
        );
        ensure!(
            profile.evidence.assurance == "source_checked",
            "invalid Canvas evidence kind"
        );
        let json = profile.json_limits;
        let graph = profile.graph_limits;
        ensure!(
            json.max_depth > 0
                && json.max_depth <= 64
                && json.max_nodes > 0
                && json.max_nodes <= 65_536
                && json.max_bytes > 0
                && json.max_bytes <= 1024 * 1024,
            "invalid Canvas JSON bounds"
        );
        ensure!(
            graph.max_elements > 0
                && graph.max_elements <= 4096
                && graph.max_edges <= 16_384
                && graph.max_depth > 0
                && graph.max_depth <= 64
                && graph.max_expanded_nodes > 0
                && graph.max_expanded_nodes <= 4096,
            "invalid Canvas graph bounds"
        );
        ensure!(
            profile.components.len() == 8,
            "incomplete static Canvas profile"
        );
        ensure!(
            profile.actions.len() == 1
                && profile.actions[0].name == "setState"
                && profile.actions[0].renderers == [RendererTarget::React]
                && profile.actions[0].mutates_state,
            "unsupported Canvas action profile"
        );
        let mut props = BTreeMap::new();
        for component in &profile.components {
            // The single profile declares props; this structural safety gate
            // prevents widening to hidden host controllers or runtime hooks.
            ensure!(
                !matches!(
                    component.name.as_str(),
                    "antigravityChatContainer" | "tchedRouterPicker" | "pageHeader" | "chatMessage"
                ),
                "host shell component cannot appear in generated Canvas"
            );
            ensure!(
                component.slots.iter().all(|slot| slot == "default"),
                "unsupported Canvas slot"
            );
            check_json(
                &component.props_schema,
                JsonLimits {
                    max_depth: 32,
                    max_nodes: 4096,
                    max_bytes: 65_536,
                },
            )?;
            // This authored static profile has inline primitive prop schemas.
            // Never allow a schema retriever (or recursive reference expansion)
            // to become an I/O/work source while constructing the validator.
            let mut pending = vec![&component.props_schema];
            while let Some(value) = pending.pop() {
                match value {
                    Value::Object(object) => {
                        ensure!(
                            !object.contains_key("$ref") && !object.contains_key("$dynamicRef"),
                            "static Canvas props must not contain schema references"
                        );
                        pending.extend(object.values());
                    }
                    Value::Array(array) => pending.extend(array),
                    _ => {}
                }
            }
            ensure!(
                component.props_schema.get("additionalProperties") == Some(&Value::Bool(false)),
                "Canvas props must be closed"
            );
            let validator = jsonschema::validator_for(&component.props_schema)
                .map_err(|_| anyhow::anyhow!("invalid sealed Canvas props schema"))?;
            ensure!(
                props.insert(component.name.clone(), validator).is_none(),
                "duplicate Canvas component"
            );
        }
        Ok(Self {
            schema_json,
            schema_hash,
            profile,
            props,
        })
    }

    pub fn schema_hash(&self) -> &str {
        &self.schema_hash
    }
    pub fn original_schema_json(&self) -> &str {
        &self.schema_json
    }
    pub fn profile(&self) -> &CanvasProfile {
        &self.profile
    }

    pub fn validate(&self, spec: &Value) -> Result<()> {
        check_json(spec, self.profile.json_limits)?;
        let root_object = spec.as_object().context("Canvas spec must be an object")?;
        ensure!(
            root_object.len() <= 3
                && root_object.contains_key("root")
                && root_object.contains_key("elements")
                && root_object
                    .keys()
                    .all(|key| matches!(key.as_str(), "root" | "elements" | "state")),
            "Canvas permits only root, elements and spec-owned state"
        );
        if let Some(state) = root_object.get("state") {
            ensure!(state.is_object(), "Canvas state must be an object");
        }
        let root = root_object["root"]
            .as_str()
            .context("Canvas root must be a string")?;
        valid_id(root)?;
        let elements = root_object["elements"]
            .as_object()
            .context("Canvas elements must be an object")?;
        for (id, element) in elements {
            valid_id(id)?;
            let object = element
                .as_object()
                .context("Canvas element must be an object")?;
            ensure!(
                object.len() <= 4
                    && ["type", "props", "children"]
                        .iter()
                        .all(|name| object.contains_key(*name))
                    && object
                        .keys()
                        .all(|key| matches!(key.as_str(), "type" | "props" | "children" | "on")),
                "Canvas permits only type, literal props, children and event bindings"
            );
            let name = object["type"]
                .as_str()
                .context("Canvas component must be a string")?;
            let validator = self
                .props
                .get(name)
                .context("component is absent from static Canvas profile")?;
            // Do not expose schema-validator diagnostics containing private values.
            ensure!(
                validator.is_valid(&object["props"]),
                "Canvas component props violate sealed contract"
            );
            let component = self
                .profile
                .components
                .iter()
                .find(|component| component.name == name)
                .unwrap();
            if let Some(on) = object.get("on") {
                validate_bindings(on, component)?;
            }
            let children = object["children"]
                .as_array()
                .context("Canvas children must be an array")?;
            ensure!(
                !component.slots.is_empty() || children.is_empty(),
                "Canvas component has no child slot"
            );
            for child in children {
                valid_id(child.as_str().context("Canvas child must be a string")?)?;
            }
        }
        check_children_graph(root, elements, self.profile.graph_limits)
    }

    /// Resolve one caller-named element event through the sealed binding and
    /// apply its sole supported action to spec-owned state.
    pub fn apply_event(&self, spec: &Value, element_id: &str, event: &str) -> Result<Value> {
        self.validate(spec)?;
        valid_id(element_id)?;
        valid_id(event)?;
        let binding = spec["elements"]
            .get(element_id)
            .and_then(|element| element.get("on"))
            .and_then(|on| on.get(event))
            .context("Canvas event binding not found")?;
        let params = binding
            .get("params")
            .and_then(Value::as_object)
            .context("invalid Canvas setState parameters")?;
        let path = params
            .get("statePath")
            .and_then(Value::as_str)
            .context("Canvas setState path is missing")?;
        validate_state_pointer(path)?;
        let mut candidate = spec.clone();
        if candidate.get("state").is_none() {
            candidate["state"] = serde_json::json!({});
        }
        set_state_pointer(
            candidate.get_mut("state").unwrap(),
            path,
            params["value"].clone(),
        )?;
        self.validate(&candidate)?;
        Ok(candidate)
    }
}

fn validate_bindings(value: &Value, component: &ComponentDecl) -> Result<()> {
    let bindings = value
        .as_object()
        .context("Canvas event bindings must be an object")?;
    for (event, binding) in bindings {
        ensure!(
            component.events.contains(event),
            "event is absent from Canvas component contract"
        );
        let object = binding
            .as_object()
            .context("Canvas event binding must be an object")?;
        ensure!(
            object.len() == 2 && object["action"] == "setState" && object.contains_key("params"),
            "unsupported Canvas event action"
        );
        let params = object["params"]
            .as_object()
            .context("Canvas action params must be an object")?;
        ensure!(
            params.len() == 2 && params.contains_key("value"),
            "invalid Canvas setState parameters"
        );
        let path = params
            .get("statePath")
            .and_then(Value::as_str)
            .context("Canvas setState path is missing")?;
        validate_state_pointer(path)?;
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn set_state_pointer(state: &mut Value, pointer: &str, value: Value) -> Result<()> {
    let mut current = state;
    let segments: Vec<_> = pointer[1..].split('/').collect();
    ensure!(
        !segments.is_empty() && segments.len() <= 32,
        "invalid Canvas state path"
    );
    for (index, encoded) in segments.iter().enumerate() {
        ensure!(
            !encoded.is_empty() && encoded.len() <= 128,
            "invalid Canvas state path segment"
        );
        let segment = encoded.replace("~1", "/").replace("~0", "~");
        ensure!(
            !segment.chars().any(char::is_control),
            "invalid Canvas state path segment"
        );
        ensure!(
            !matches!(segment.as_str(), "__proto__" | "prototype" | "constructor"),
            "unsafe Canvas state path segment"
        );
        let object = current
            .as_object_mut()
            .context("Canvas state path crosses a non-object")?;
        if index + 1 == segments.len() {
            object.insert(segment, value);
            return Ok(());
        }
        current = object
            .entry(segment)
            .or_insert_with(|| serde_json::json!({}));
    }
    unreachable!()
}

fn validate_state_pointer(pointer: &str) -> Result<()> {
    ensure!(
        pointer.starts_with('/') && pointer.len() <= 512,
        "invalid Canvas state path"
    );
    let segments: Vec<_> = pointer[1..].split('/').collect();
    ensure!(
        !segments.is_empty() && segments.len() <= 32,
        "invalid Canvas state path"
    );
    for encoded in segments {
        ensure!(
            !encoded.is_empty() && encoded.len() <= 128,
            "invalid Canvas state path segment"
        );
        let mut chars = encoded.chars();
        while let Some(ch) = chars.next() {
            if ch == '~' {
                ensure!(
                    matches!(chars.next(), Some('0' | '1')),
                    "invalid Canvas state pointer escape"
                );
            }
        }
        let segment = encoded.replace("~1", "/").replace("~0", "~");
        ensure!(
            !segment.chars().any(char::is_control),
            "invalid Canvas state path segment"
        );
        ensure!(
            !matches!(segment.as_str(), "__proto__" | "prototype" | "constructor"),
            "unsafe Canvas state path segment"
        );
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn valid_id(id: &str) -> Result<()> {
    ensure!(
        !id.is_empty()
            && id.len() <= 128
            && id
                .bytes()
                .all(|b| b.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || matches!(b, b'_' | b'-')),
        "invalid Canvas element identifier"
    );
    Ok(())
}

#[cfg(test)]
#[path = "json_render_canvas_profile_tests.rs"]
mod tests;

// Authored from the exact chatCatalog declarations checked against chatRegistry.
// This lives in the plugin definition, not a runtime schema capture.
fn components() -> Vec<ComponentDecl> {
    vec![
        ComponentDecl {
            name: "container".into(),
            category: "static_canvas".into(),
            props: vec!["className".into()],
            props_schema: serde_json::json!({"$schema":"http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#","type":"object","properties":{"className":{"anyOf":[{"type":"string"},{"type":"null"}]}},"required":["className"],"additionalProperties":false}),
            slots: vec!["default".into()],
            events: vec![],
            description: "Vertical stack of children.".into(),
        },
        ComponentDecl {
            name: "autoTile".into(),
            category: "static_canvas".into(),
            props: vec![
                "columns".into(),
                "gap".into(),
                "rowHeight".into(),
                "boardId".into(),
                "reorderable".into(),
                "fit".into(),
                "className".into(),
            ],
            props_schema: serde_json::json!({"$schema":"http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#","type":"object","properties":{"columns":{"anyOf":[{"type":"number"},{"type":"null"}]},"gap":{"anyOf":[{"type":"number"},{"type":"null"}]},"rowHeight":{"anyOf":[{"type":"number"},{"type":"null"}]},"boardId":{"anyOf":[{"type":"string"},{"type":"null"}]},"reorderable":{"anyOf":[{"type":"boolean"},{"type":"null"}]},"fit":{"anyOf":[{"type":"string","enum":["content","hint"]},{"type":"null"}]},"className":{"anyOf":[{"type":"string"},{"type":"null"}]}},"required":["columns","gap","rowHeight","boardId","reorderable","fit","className"],"additionalProperties":false}),
            slots: vec!["default".into()],
            events: vec!["reorder".into()],
            description:
                "Dense golden-ratio tile board with local pointer and keyboard reordering.".into(),
        },
        ComponentDecl {

Use { $bindState } on page for current page number."),

}

fn component(
    name: &str,
    category: &str,
    props_schema: JsonValue,
    slots: &[&str],
    events: &[&str],
    description: &str,
) -> ComponentDecl {
    let props = props_schema
        .get("properties")
        .and_then(JsonValue::as_object)
        .map(|properties| properties.keys().cloned().collect())
        .unwrap_or_default();
    ComponentDecl {
        name: name.into(),
        category: category.into(),
        props,
        props_schema,
        slots: slots.iter().map(|value| (*value).into()).collect(),
        events: events.iter().map(|value| (*value).into()).collect(),
        description: description.into(),
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use std::collections::BTreeSet;

    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn pinned_import_has_exact_component_set_and_closed_required_props() {
        let components = components();
        let names: Vec<_> = components.iter().map(|item| item.name.as_str()).collect();
        assert_eq!(
            names,
            [
                "Card",
                "Stack",
                "Grid",
                "Separator",
                "Tabs",
                "Accordion",
                "Collapsible",
                "Dialog",
                "Drawer",
                "Carousel",
                "Table",
                "Heading",
                "Text",
                "Image",
                "Avatar",
                "Badge",
                "Alert",
                "Progress",
                "Skeleton",
                "Spinner",
                "Tooltip",
                "Popover",
                "Input",
                "Textarea",
                "Select",
                "Checkbox",
                "Radio",
                "Switch",
                "Slider",
                "Button",
                "Link",
                "DropdownMenu",
                "Toggle",
                "ToggleGroup",
                "ButtonGroup",
                "Pagination",
            ]
        );
        for component in &components {
            let schema = component.props_schema.as_object().unwrap();
            assert_eq!(schema.get("type"), Some(&serde_json::json!("object")));
            assert_eq!(
                schema.get("additionalProperties"),
                Some(&serde_json::json!(false)),
                "{} props must remain closed",
                component.name
            );
            let properties: BTreeSet<_> = schema["properties"]
                .as_object()
                .unwrap()
                .keys()
                .map(String::as_str)
                .collect();
            let required: BTreeSet<_> = schema["required"]
                .as_array()
                .unwrap()
                .iter()
                .map(|name| name.as_str().unwrap())
                .collect();
            assert_eq!(
                required, properties,
                "{} required set drifted",
                component.name
            );
            assert_eq!(
                component
                    .props
                    .iter()
                    .map(String::as_str)
                    .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>(),
                properties,
                "{} property inventory drifted",
                component.name
            );
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn pinned_button_schema_preserves_nullable_and_required_semantics() {
        let button = components()
            .into_iter()
            .find(|item| item.name == "Button")
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            button.props_schema,
            serde_json::json!({
                "$schema":"http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#",
                "type":"object",
                "properties":{
                    "label":{"type":"string"},
                    "variant":{"anyOf":[
                        {"type":"string","enum":["primary","secondary","danger"]},
                        {"type":"null"}
                    ]},
                    "disabled":{"type":["boolean","null"]}
                },
                "required":["label","variant","disabled"],
                "additionalProperties":false
            })
        );
        assert!(jsonschema::validate(
            &button.props_schema,
            &serde_json::json!({"label":"Save","variant":null,"disabled":null})
        )
        .is_ok());
        assert!(jsonschema::validate(
            &button.props_schema,
            &serde_json::json!({"label":"Save","variant":null})
        )
        .is_err());
        assert!(jsonschema::validate(
            &button.props_schema,
            &serde_json::json!({
                "label":"Save","variant":null,"disabled":null,"invented":true
            })
        )
        .is_err());
    }
}
</file>

//! Durable method adapter for the manifest-pinned json-render reference catalog.

use std::collections::BTreeSet;
use std::sync::Arc;

use anyhow::{bail, ensure, Context, Result};
use op_state_store::{PluginSchema, SideEffect};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use serde_json::{json, Value};

use super::runtime_contract;
use super::{
    ActionsOutput, ComponentDecl, ComponentLookupInput, ComponentOutput, ComponentsOutput,
    ConfigOutput, CoreExportsOutput, EmptyJsonRenderInput, HealthOutput, JsonRenderConfig,
    JsonRenderState, JsonSchemaMode, MethodSurface, PackageLookupInput, PackageOutput,
    PackagesOutput, PromptMode, PromptSurfaceInput, PromptSurfaceOutput, RenderersOutput,
    SchemaExportInput, SchemaExportOutput, SetConfigOutput, SetJsonRenderConfigInput,
    SpecValidationInput, ToolsOutput, ValidationResultOutput, PLUGIN_NAME,
};
use crate::state_plugins::runtime_documents::RuntimeDocuments;

const MAX_SPEC_BYTES: usize = 4 * 1024 * 1024;
const MAX_ELEMENTS: usize = 4096;
const MAX_GRAPH_EDGES: usize = 16_384;
const MAX_GRAPH_DEPTH: usize = 128;
const MAX_EXPANDED_RENDER_NODES: usize = 65_536;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
struct StoredPolicy {
    config: JsonRenderConfig,
}

pub struct JsonRenderMethods {
    snapshot: Arc<JsonRenderState>,
    schema: Arc<PluginSchema>,
    documents: Arc<RuntimeDocuments>,
}

impl JsonRenderMethods {
    /// The bridge must pass the state defaults and method schema read from the
    /// same manifest-pinned plugin blob. Runtime code never rebuilds either.
    pub fn new(
        snapshot: JsonRenderState,
        schema: PluginSchema,
        documents: Arc<RuntimeDocuments>,
    ) -> Result<Self> {
        ensure!(
            schema.name == PLUGIN_NAME,
            "json_render schema owner mismatch"
        );
        ensure!(
            snapshot.source.commit == super::JSON_RENDER_SOURCE_COMMIT,
            "json_render snapshot source commit mismatch"
        );
        ensure!(
            schema.methods.len() == 15,
            "json_render method snapshot is incomplete"
        );
        for (key, method) in &schema.methods {
            ensure!(key == &method.name, "json_render method key/name mismatch");
        }
        let mut component_names = BTreeSet::new();
        for component in &snapshot.components {
            ensure!(
                component_names.insert(component.name.as_str()),
                "duplicate json_render component"
            );
            jsonschema::validator_for(&component.props_schema)
                .with_context(|| format!("invalid {} props schema", component.name))?;
        }
        drop(component_names);
        let renderer_ids: BTreeSet<_> = snapshot
            .renderers
            .iter()
            .map(|item| item.id.as_str())
            .collect();
        let mut action_names = BTreeSet::new();
        for action in &snapshot.actions {
            ensure!(
                action_names.insert(action.name.as_str()),
                "duplicate json_render action"
            );
            jsonschema::validator_for(&action.params_schema)
                .with_context(|| format!("invalid {} parameter schema", action.name))?;
            ensure!(
                !action.renderers.is_empty(),
                "action has no backing renderer"
            );
            for renderer in &action.renderers {
                let renderer = serde_json::to_value(renderer)?;
                ensure!(
                    renderer_ids.contains(renderer.as_str().context("invalid renderer")?),
                    "action references an absent renderer"
                );
            }
        }
        drop((renderer_ids, action_names));
        Ok(Self {
            snapshot: Arc::new(snapshot),
            schema: Arc::new(schema),
            documents,
        })
    }

    pub async fn dispatch(&self, method: &str, args: &Value) -> Result<Value> {
        match method {
            "get_config" => {
                parse::<EmptyJsonRenderInput>(args, method)?;
                let (config, revision) = self.config().await?;
                encode(ConfigOutput { config, revision })
            }
            "set_config" => {
                let input = parse::<SetJsonRenderConfigInput>(args, method)?;
                self.set_config(input.config).await
            }
            "get_health" => {
                parse::<EmptyJsonRenderInput>(args, method)?;
                encode(HealthOutput {
                    status: self.snapshot.status.clone(),
                    package_count: self.snapshot.packages.len(),
                    component_count: self.snapshot.components.len(),
                    action_count: self.snapshot.actions.len(),
                    source_commit: self.snapshot.source.commit.clone(),
                    catalog_kind: "manifest_pinned_upstream_reference".into(),
                })
            }
            "list_tools" => {
                parse::<EmptyJsonRenderInput>(args, method)?;
                let (config, _) = self.config().await?;
                encode(ToolsOutput {
                    tools: self.tools(&config),
                })
            }
            "list_packages" => {
                parse::<EmptyJsonRenderInput>(args, method)?;
                self.require_catalog().await?;
                encode(PackagesOutput {
                    packages: self.snapshot.packages.clone(),
                })
            }
            "get_package" => {
                let input = parse::<PackageLookupInput>(args, method)?;
                validate_lookup("package_name", &input.package_name)?;
                self.require_catalog().await?;
                encode(PackageOutput {
                    package: self
                        .snapshot
                        .packages
                        .iter()
                        .find(|item| item.package_name == input.package_name)
                        .cloned(),
                })
            }
            "list_components" => {
                parse::<EmptyJsonRenderInput>(args, method)?;
                self.require_catalog().await?;
                encode(ComponentsOutput {
                    components: self.snapshot.components.clone(),
                })
            }
            "get_component_schema" => {
                let input = parse::<ComponentLookupInput>(args, method)?;
                validate_lookup("component name", &input.name)?;
                self.require_catalog().await?;
                encode(ComponentOutput {
                    component: self.component(&input.name).cloned(),
                })
            }
            "list_actions" => {
                parse::<EmptyJsonRenderInput>(args, method)?;
                self.require_catalog().await?;
                let (config, _) = self.config().await?;
                encode(ActionsOutput {
                    actions: runtime_contract::renderer_actions(
                        &self.snapshot.actions,
                        config.default_renderer,
                    )
                    .into_iter()
                    .cloned()
                    .collect(),
                })
            }
            "list_core_exports" => {
                parse::<EmptyJsonRenderInput>(args, method)?;
                self.require_catalog().await?;
                encode(CoreExportsOutput {
                    exports: self.snapshot.core_exports.clone(),
                })
            }
            "list_renderers" => {
                parse::<EmptyJsonRenderInput>(args, method)?;
                self.require_catalog().await?;
                encode(RenderersOutput {
                    renderers: self.snapshot.renderers.clone(),
                })
            }
            "get_spec_schema" => {
                parse::<EmptyJsonRenderInput>(args, method)?;
                let (config, _) = self.config().await?;
                ensure!(config.expose_catalog, "catalog exposure is disabled");
                encode(SchemaExportOutput {
                    mode: config.schema_mode,
                    schema: self.export_schema(config.schema_mode, config.default_renderer),
                })
            }
            "validate_spec" => {
                let input = parse::<SpecValidationInput>(args, method)?;
                let (config, _) = self.config().await?;
                ensure!(config.expose_catalog, "catalog exposure is disabled");
                self.validate_spec(&input.spec, config.schema_mode, config.default_renderer)
            }
            "export_json_schema" => {
                let input = parse::<SchemaExportInput>(args, method)?;
                let (config, _) = self.config().await?;
                ensure!(config.expose_catalog, "catalog exposure is disabled");
                let mode = input.mode.unwrap_or(config.schema_mode);
                encode(SchemaExportOutput {
                    mode,
                    schema: self.export_schema(mode, config.default_renderer),
                })
            }
            "build_prompt_surface" => {
                let input = parse::<PromptSurfaceInput>(args, method)?;
                self.build_prompt(input).await
            }
            _ => bail!("unsupported json_render method"),
        }
    }

    /// Materialize the immutable manifest snapshot with the currently committed
    /// policy. The bridge publishes this value as observed plugin state after a
    /// successful method invocation.
    pub async fn projection_state(&self) -> Result<JsonRenderState> {
        let (config, _) = self.config().await?;
        let mut state = self.snapshot.as_ref().clone();
        state.config = config;
        Ok(state)
    }

    async fn config(&self) -> Result<(JsonRenderConfig, u64)> {
        match self.documents.read(PLUGIN_NAME).await? {
            None => Ok((self.snapshot.config.clone(), 0)),
            Some(row) => {
                let policy: StoredPolicy = serde_json::from_value(row.document)
                    .context("invalid stored json_render policy")?;
                self.validate_config(&policy.config)?;
                Ok((policy.config, row.revision))
            }
        }
    }

    async fn set_config(&self, config: JsonRenderConfig) -> Result<Value> {
        self.validate_config(&config)?;
        let fallback = self.snapshot.config.clone();
        let stored = config.clone();
        let (row, changed) = self
            .documents
            .update_with_result(PLUGIN_NAME, move |old| {
                let previous = old
                    .map(serde_json::from_value::<StoredPolicy>)
                    .transpose()
                    .context("invalid stored json_render policy")?
                    .map_or(fallback, |policy| policy.config);
                let changed = previous != stored;
                Ok((
                    serde_json::to_value(StoredPolicy { config: stored })?,
                    changed,
                ))
            })
            .await?;
        let observed: StoredPolicy = serde_json::from_value(row.document)
            .context("committed json_render policy is unreadable")?;
        ensure!(
            observed.config == config,
            "json_render policy readback mismatch"
        );
        encode(SetConfigOutput {
            config,
            changed,
            revision: row.revision,
        })
    }

    fn validate_config(&self, config: &JsonRenderConfig) -> Result<()> {
        let selected = serde_json::to_value(config.default_renderer)?;
        let selected = selected.as_str().context("invalid renderer target")?;
        ensure!(
            self.snapshot
                .renderers
                .iter()
                .any(|item| item.id == selected),
            "renderer is absent from the pinned catalog"
        );
        Ok(())
    }

    async fn require_catalog(&self) -> Result<()> {
        let (config, _) = self.config().await?;
        ensure!(config.expose_catalog, "catalog exposure is disabled");
        Ok(())
    }

    fn component(&self, name: &str) -> Option<&ComponentDecl> {
        self.snapshot
            .components
            .iter()
            .find(|item| item.name == name)
    }

    fn tools(&self, config: &JsonRenderConfig) -> Vec<MethodSurface> {
        let mut tools: Vec<_> = self
            .schema
            .methods
            .values()
            .map(|method| MethodSurface {
                name: method.name.clone(),
                side_effect: match method.side_effect {
                    SideEffect::Read => "read",
                    SideEffect::Mutation => "mutation",
                }
                .into(),
                required_capability: method.required_capability.clone().unwrap_or_default(),
                subid: method.subid.clone(),
                available: method_available(&method.name, config),
            })
            .collect();
        tools.sort_by(|left, right| left.name.cmp(&right.name));
        tools
    }

    fn validate_spec(
        &self,
        spec: &Value,
        mode: JsonSchemaMode,
        renderer: super::RendererTarget,
    ) -> Result<Value> {
        super::validation_bounds::check_json(
            spec,
            super::validation_bounds::JsonLimits {
                max_depth: 128,
                max_nodes: 262_144,
                max_bytes: MAX_SPEC_BYTES,
            },
        )?;
        let mut issues = Vec::new();
        let runtime_schema = self.export_schema(mode, renderer);
        if let Err(error) = jsonschema::validate(&runtime_schema, spec) {
            issues.push(format!("runtime schema: {error}"));
        }
        let Some(object) = spec.as_object() else {
            return encode(ValidationResultOutput {
                valid: false,
                issues: vec!["spec must be an object".into()],
                checked_elements: 0,
            });
        };
        if matches!(mode, JsonSchemaMode::Strict) {
            let allowed: BTreeSet<_> = ["root", "elements", "state"].into_iter().collect();
            for field in object.keys().filter(|key| !allowed.contains(key.as_str())) {
                issues.push(format!("unsupported top-level field '{field}'"));
            }
        }
        let root = object.get("root").and_then(Value::as_str);
        if root.is_none_or(str::is_empty) {
            issues.push("root must be a non-empty string".into());
        }
        let Some(elements) = object.get("elements").and_then(Value::as_object) else {
            issues.push("elements must be an object".into());
            return encode(ValidationResultOutput {
                valid: false,
                issues,
                checked_elements: 0,
            });
        };
        ensure!(elements.len() <= MAX_ELEMENTS, "spec exceeds 4096 elements");
        if let Some(root) = root {
            if !elements.contains_key(root) {
                issues.push(format!("root element '{root}' does not exist"));
            }
        }
        for (key, element) in elements {
            self.validate_element(key, element, elements, &mut issues);
        }
        self.validate_graph(root, elements, &mut issues);
        issues.sort();
        issues.dedup();
        encode(ValidationResultOutput {
            valid: issues.is_empty(),
            issues,
            checked_elements: elements.len(),
        })
    }

    fn validate_element(
        &self,
        key: &str,
        element: &Value,
        elements: &serde_json::Map<String, Value>,
        issues: &mut Vec<String>,
    ) {
        let Some(object) = element.as_object() else {
            issues.push(format!("element '{key}' must be an object"));
            return;
        };
        let Some(kind) = object.get("type").and_then(Value::as_str) else {
            issues.push(format!("element '{key}' type must be a string"));
            return;
        };
        let Some(component) = self.component(kind) else {
            issues.push(format!("element '{key}' uses unknown component '{kind}'"));
            return;
        };
        match object.get("children") {
            Some(Value::Array(children)) => {
                if component.slots.is_empty() && !children.is_empty() {
                    issues.push(format!(
                        "element '{key}' component '{kind}' has no child slot"
                    ));
                }
                for child in children {
                    match child.as_str() {
                        Some(child) if elements.contains_key(child) => {}
                        Some(child) => issues.push(format!(
                            "element '{key}' references missing child '{child}'"
                        )),
                        None => issues.push(format!(
                            "element '{key}' children must contain only strings"
                        )),
                    }
                }
            }
            Some(_) => issues.push(format!("element '{key}' children must be an array")),
            None => issues.push(format!("element '{key}' is missing children")),
        }
    }

    /// Validate the exact flat `children` graph accepted by the pinned runtime
    /// schema. Named `slots` are not part of that sealed element contract and
    /// therefore are neither accepted nor interpreted as hidden edges here.
    fn validate_graph(
        &self,
        root: Option<&str>,
        elements: &serde_json::Map<String, Value>,
        issues: &mut Vec<String>,
    ) {
        let Some(root) = root else {
            return;
        };
        if let Err(error) = super::validation_bounds::check_children_graph(
            root,
            elements,
            super::validation_bounds::GraphLimits {
                max_elements: MAX_ELEMENTS,
                max_edges: MAX_GRAPH_EDGES,
                max_depth: MAX_GRAPH_DEPTH,
                max_expanded_nodes: MAX_EXPANDED_RENDER_NODES,
            },
        ) {
            issues.push(error.to_string());
        }
    }

    fn export_schema(&self, mode: JsonSchemaMode, renderer: super::RendererTarget) -> Value {
        runtime_contract::spec_schema(
            &self.snapshot.components,
            &self.snapshot.actions,
            renderer,
            mode,
        )
    }

    async fn build_prompt(&self, input: PromptSurfaceInput) -> Result<Value> {
        let (config, _) = self.config().await?;
        ensure!(config.expose_catalog, "catalog exposure is disabled");
        ensure!(
            config.expose_prompt_surface,
            "prompt surface exposure is disabled"
        );
        ensure!(
            input.custom_rules.len() <= 32,
            "at most 32 custom rules are allowed"
        );
        for rule in &input.custom_rules {
            ensure!(!rule.trim().is_empty(), "custom rules cannot be empty");
            ensure!(rule.len() <= 2048, "custom rule exceeds 2048 bytes");
        }
        let mode = input.mode.unwrap_or(PromptMode::Standalone);
        let mut lines = vec![
            "You are a UI generator for the manifest-pinned json-render reference catalog.".to_string(),
            format!("Renderer target: {}.", serde_json::to_value(config.default_renderer)?.as_str().unwrap_or("unknown")),
            match mode {
                PromptMode::Standalone => "Return RFC 6902 JSON Patch as JSONL without prose.".into(),
                PromptMode::Inline => "Respond briefly, then place RFC 6902 JSON Patch JSONL in a spec code fence.".into(),
            },
            "Every element requires type, props, and children. Every root and child key must resolve.".into(),
            "Use only the following component declarations and exact prop schemas:".into(),
        ];
        for component in &self.snapshot.components {
            lines.push(format!(
                "- {}: props={} slots={} events={}",
                component.name,
                serde_json::to_string(&component.props_schema)?,
                serde_json::to_string(&component.slots)?,
                serde_json::to_string(&component.events)?
            ));
        }
        lines.push("Available actions:".into());
        for action in
            runtime_contract::renderer_actions(&self.snapshot.actions, config.default_renderer)
        {
            lines.push(format!(
                "- {}({}): {}",
                action.name,
                action.params.join(", "),
                action.description
            ));
        }
        lines.push(format!(
            "Runtime JSON Schema: {}",
            serde_json::to_string(
                &self.export_schema(config.schema_mode, config.default_renderer)
            )?
        ));
        lines.extend(input.custom_rules);
        encode(PromptSurfaceOutput {
            mode,
            renderer: config.default_renderer,
            prompt: lines.join("\n"),
        })
    }
}

fn method_available(method: &str, config: &JsonRenderConfig) -> bool {
    match method {
        "get_config" | "set_config" | "get_health" | "list_tools" => true,
        "build_prompt_surface" => config.expose_catalog && config.expose_prompt_surface,
        _ => config.expose_catalog,
    }
}

fn parse<T: serde::de::DeserializeOwned>(args: &Value, method: &str) -> Result<T> {
    serde_json::from_value(args.clone()).with_context(|| format!("invalid {method} arguments"))
}

fn encode<T: Serialize>(output: T) -> Result<Value> {
    serde_json::to_value(output).map_err(Into::into)
}

fn validate_lookup(field: &str, value: &str) -> Result<()> {
    ensure!(!value.trim().is_empty(), "{field} is required");
    ensure!(value.len() <= 256, "{field} is too long");
    ensure!(
        !value.chars().any(char::is_control),
        "{field} contains control characters"
    );
    Ok(())
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::state_plugins::json_render::json_render_schema;
    use op_cozo_store::CozoGraphShuttle;

    fn service(store: CozoGraphShuttle) -> JsonRenderMethods {
        JsonRenderMethods::new(
            JsonRenderState::default(),
            json_render_schema(),
            Arc::new(RuntimeDocuments::new(store)),
        )
        .unwrap()
    }

    fn card(children: Vec<String>) -> Value {
        json!({
            "type":"Card",
            "props":{
                "title":null,"description":null,"maxWidth":null,
                "centered":null,"className":null
            },
            "children":children
        })
    }

    fn button() -> Value {
        json!({
            "type":"Button",
            "props":{"label":"leaf","variant":null,"disabled":null},
            "children":[]
        })
    }

    async fn validate_elements(
        service: &JsonRenderMethods,
        root: &str,
        elements: serde_json::Map<String, Value>,
    ) -> Value {
        service
            .dispatch(
                "validate_spec",
                &json!({"spec":{"root":root,"elements":elements}}),
            )
            .await
            .unwrap()
    }

    fn has_issue(output: &Value, needle: &str) -> bool {
        output["issues"]
            .as_array()
            .unwrap()
            .iter()
            .any(|issue| issue.as_str().is_some_and(|issue| issue.contains(needle)))
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn all_methods_dispatch_and_tools_derive_from_schema() {
        let service = service(CozoGraphShuttle::new_in_memory().unwrap());
        let cases = [
            ("get_config", json!({})),
            (
                "set_config",
                json!({"config":{"expose_catalog":true,"expose_prompt_surface":true,"schema_mode":"strict","default_renderer":"react"}}),
            ),
            ("get_health", json!({})),
            ("list_tools", json!({})),
            ("list_packages", json!({})),
            ("get_package", json!({"package_name":"@json-render/core"})),
            ("list_components", json!({})),
            ("get_component_schema", json!({"name":"Button"})),
            ("list_actions", json!({})),
            ("list_core_exports", json!({})),
            ("list_renderers", json!({})),
            ("get_spec_schema", json!({})),
            (
                "validate_spec",
                json!({"spec":{"root":"x","elements":{"x":{"type":"Button","props":{"label":"Go","variant":null,"disabled":null},"children":[]}}}}),
            ),
            ("export_json_schema", json!({})),
            ("build_prompt_surface", json!({})),
        ];
        assert_eq!(cases.len(), 15);
        let mut outputs = std::collections::BTreeMap::new();
        for (method, args) in cases {
            outputs.insert(method, service.dispatch(method, &args).await.unwrap());
        }
        // A successful return alone does not prove these read methods. Check
        // independently useful catalog facts and consistency between public
        // lookup, listing, health, prompt, validation and schema-export methods.
        let packages = outputs["list_packages"]["packages"].as_array().unwrap();
        let core = packages
            .iter()
            .find(|p| p["package_name"] == "@json-render/core")
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(&outputs["get_package"]["package"], core);
        assert!(!core["version"].as_str().unwrap().is_empty());
        let components = outputs["list_components"]["components"].as_array().unwrap();
        let button = components.iter().find(|c| c["name"] == "Button").unwrap();
        assert_eq!(&outputs["get_component_schema"]["component"], button);
        let valid_props = json!({"label":"Go","variant":null,"disabled":null});
        jsonschema::validate(&button["props_schema"], &valid_props).unwrap();
        assert!(jsonschema::validate(&button["props_schema"], &json!({"label":42})).is_err());
        let actions = outputs["list_actions"]["actions"].as_array().unwrap();
        assert!(!actions.is_empty());
        assert!(outputs["list_core_exports"]["exports"]
            .as_array()
            .unwrap()
            .iter()
            .any(|item| item["name"] == "defineCatalog" && item["package"] == "@json-render/core"));
        assert!(outputs["list_renderers"]["renderers"]
            .as_array()
            .unwrap()
            .iter()
            .any(|renderer| renderer["id"] == "react"
                && renderer["package_name"] == "@json-render/react"));
        let health = &outputs["get_health"];
        assert_eq!(health["status"], "catalog_snapshot");
        assert_eq!(health["package_count"], packages.len());
        assert_eq!(health["component_count"], components.len());
        assert_eq!(health["catalog_kind"], "manifest_pinned_upstream_reference");
        assert_eq!(outputs["validate_spec"]["valid"], true);
        assert_eq!(outputs["validate_spec"]["checked_elements"], 1);
        assert_eq!(outputs["validate_spec"]["issues"], json!([]));
        let valid_spec = json!({"root":"x","elements":{"x":{
            "type":"Button","props":valid_props,"children":[]
        }}});
        for method in ["get_spec_schema", "export_json_schema"] {
            jsonschema::validate(&outputs[method]["schema"], &valid_spec).unwrap();
            let mut invalid = valid_spec.clone();
            invalid["elements"]["x"]["props"]["label"] = json!(42);
            assert!(
                jsonschema::validate(&outputs[method]["schema"], &invalid).is_err(),
                "{method}"
            );
        }
        let prompt = outputs["build_prompt_surface"]["prompt"].as_str().unwrap();
        assert_eq!(outputs["build_prompt_surface"]["renderer"], "react");
        assert!(prompt.contains("Renderer target: react."));
        assert!(prompt.contains("Button: props="));
        assert!(prompt.contains("Runtime JSON Schema:"));
        for action in actions {
            assert!(prompt.contains(&format!("- {}(", action["name"].as_str().unwrap())));
        }
        let readback = service.dispatch("get_config", &json!({})).await.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(readback["config"], outputs["set_config"]["config"]);
        assert_eq!(readback["revision"], outputs["set_config"]["revision"]);
        let tools = service.dispatch("list_tools", &json!({})).await.unwrap();
        let names: BTreeSet<_> = tools["tools"]
            .as_array()
            .unwrap()
            .iter()
            .map(|tool| tool["name"].as_str().unwrap())
            .collect();
        let declared: BTreeSet<_> = service.schema.methods.keys().map(String::as_str).collect();
        assert_eq!(names, declared);
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn exact_component_schema_and_graph_integrity_are_enforced() {
        let service = service(CozoGraphShuttle::new_in_memory().unwrap());
        let output = service.dispatch("validate_spec", &json!({"spec":{
            "root":"root","elements":{
                "root":{"type":"Button","props":{"label":7,"variant":null,"disabled":null,"invented":true},"children":["missing"]}
            }
        }})).await.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(output["valid"], false);
        let issues = output["issues"].as_array().unwrap();
        assert!(issues
            .iter()
            .any(|issue| issue.as_str().unwrap().contains("props")));
        assert!(issues
            .iter()
            .any(|issue| issue.as_str().unwrap().contains("missing child")));
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn graph_rejects_self_cycles_and_disconnected_multi_node_cycles() {
        let service = service(CozoGraphShuttle::new_in_memory().unwrap());
        let self_cycle = serde_json::Map::from_iter([("root".into(), card(vec!["root".into()]))]);
        let output = validate_elements(&service, "root", self_cycle).await;
        assert_eq!(output["valid"], false);
        assert!(has_issue(&output, "contains a cycle"));

        let disconnected = serde_json::Map::from_iter([
            ("root".into(), button()),
            ("a".into(), card(vec!["b".into()])),
            ("b".into(), card(vec!["a".into()])),
        ]);
        let output = validate_elements(&service, "root", disconnected).await;
        assert_eq!(output["valid"], false);
        assert!(has_issue(&output, "disconnected cycle"));
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn graph_rejects_excessive_depth_and_edge_count_iteratively() {
        let service = service(CozoGraphShuttle::new_in_memory().unwrap());
        let mut deep = serde_json::Map::new();
        for index in 0..=MAX_GRAPH_DEPTH {
            let key = format!("n{index}");
            let element = if index == MAX_GRAPH_DEPTH {
                button()
            } else {
                card(vec![format!("n{}", index + 1)])
            };
            deep.insert(key, element);
        }
        let output = validate_elements(&service, "n0", deep).await;
        assert_eq!(output["valid"], false);
        assert!(has_issue(&output, "maximum depth"));

        let too_many_edges = serde_json::Map::from_iter([
            (
                "root".into(),
                card(vec!["leaf".into(); MAX_GRAPH_EDGES + 1]),
            ),
            ("leaf".into(), button()),
        ]);
        let output = validate_elements(&service, "root", too_many_edges).await;
        assert_eq!(output["valid"], false);
        assert!(has_issue(&output, "child edges"));
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn graph_bounds_expanded_dag_cost_but_allows_bounded_shared_children() {
        let service = service(CozoGraphShuttle::new_in_memory().unwrap());
        let shared = serde_json::Map::from_iter([
            ("root".into(), card(vec!["left".into(), "right".into()])),
            ("left".into(), card(vec!["leaf".into()])),
            ("right".into(), card(vec!["leaf".into()])),
            ("leaf".into(), button()),
        ]);
        let output = validate_elements(&service, "root", shared).await;
        assert_eq!(output["valid"], true);

        // Each pair points to both nodes in the next layer. The serialized DAG
        // stays tiny while the number of render occurrences doubles per layer.
        let mut exponential = serde_json::Map::new();
        exponential.insert("root".into(), card(vec!["a0".into(), "b0".into()]));
        for layer in 0..16 {
            let children = vec![format!("a{}", layer + 1), format!("b{}", layer + 1)];
            exponential.insert(format!("a{layer}"), card(children.clone()));
            exponential.insert(format!("b{layer}"), card(children));
        }
        exponential.insert("a16".into(), button());
        exponential.insert("b16".into(), button());
        let output = validate_elements(&service, "root", exponential).await;
        assert_eq!(output["valid"], false);
        assert!(has_issue(&output, "expanded render graph"));
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn runtime_fields_share_exported_validation_and_renderer_actions() {
        let service = service(CozoGraphShuttle::new_in_memory().unwrap());
        let valid = json!({"spec":{
            "root":"root","state":{"saving":false},"elements":{
                "root":{
                    "type":"Button",
                    "props":{"label":{"$template":"Save ${/name}"},"variant":null,"disabled":{"$state":"/saving"}},
                    "children":[],
                    "visible":{"$state":"/allowed","eq":true},
                    "on":{"press":{"action":"setState","params":{"statePath":"/saving","value":true}}},
                    "watch":{"/saving":{"action":"validateForm"}}
                }
            }
        }});
        assert_eq!(
            service.dispatch("validate_spec", &valid).await.unwrap()["valid"],
            true
        );

        for invalid in [
            json!({"spec":{"root":"root","elements":{"root":{"type":"Button","props":{"label":"Save","variant":null,"disabled":null},"children":[],"on":{"change":{"action":"setState","params":{"statePath":"/x","value":1}}}}}}}),
            json!({"spec":{"root":"root","elements":{"root":{"type":"Button","props":{"label":"Save","variant":null,"disabled":null},"children":[],"on":{"press":{"action":"push","params":{"screen":"detail"}}}}}}}),
            json!({"spec":{"root":"root","elements":{"root":{"type":"Button","props":{"label":"Save","variant":null,"disabled":null},"children":[],"visible":{"$state":"/x","$item":"x"}}}}}),
        ] {
            assert_eq!(
                service.dispatch("validate_spec", &invalid).await.unwrap()["valid"],
                false
            );
        }

        service
            .dispatch(
                "set_config",
                &json!({"config":{
                    "expose_catalog":true,"expose_prompt_surface":true,
                    "schema_mode":"strict","default_renderer":"react-native"
                }}),
            )
            .await
            .unwrap();
        let native = json!({"spec":{"root":"root","elements":{"root":{
            "type":"Button","props":{"label":"Open","variant":null,"disabled":null},
            "children":[],"on":{"press":{"action":"push","params":{"screen":"detail"}}}
        }}}});
        assert_eq!(
            service.dispatch("validate_spec", &native).await.unwrap()["valid"],
            true
        );
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn policy_persists_reopens_and_gates_catalog_and_prompt() {
        let dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let path = dir.path().join("runtime");
        {
            let service = service(CozoGraphShuttle::new_persistent(path.clone()).unwrap());
            let result = service
                .dispatch(
                    "set_config",
                    &json!({"config":{
                        "expose_catalog":false,"expose_prompt_surface":false,
                        "schema_mode":"standard","default_renderer":"react"
                    }}),
                )
                .await
                .unwrap();
            assert_eq!(result["changed"], true);
            assert!(service
                .dispatch("list_components", &json!({}))
                .await
                .is_err());
            let tools = service.dispatch("list_tools", &json!({})).await.unwrap();
            assert_eq!(
                tools["tools"]
                    .as_array()
                    .unwrap()
                    .iter()
                    .find(|tool| tool["name"] == "build_prompt_surface")
                    .unwrap()["available"],
                false
            );
        }
        // The dropped handle releases RocksDB's LOCK asynchronously; under a
        // loaded parallel test run the reopen can race it. Production never
        // reopens a path in-process, so the test waits rather than the code.
        let reopened = {
            let mut attempt = 0;
            loop {
                match CozoGraphShuttle::new_persistent(path.clone()) {
                    Ok(store) => break store,
                    Err(error) if attempt < 50 && error.to_string().contains("LOCK") => {
                        attempt += 1;
                        tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(100)).await;
                    }
                    Err(error) => panic!("reopen runtime store: {error}"),
                }
            }
        };
        let service = service(reopened);
        let config = service.dispatch("get_config", &json!({})).await.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(config["config"]["expose_catalog"], false);
        assert!(service
            .dispatch("build_prompt_surface", &json!({}))
            .await
            .is_err());
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn malformed_inputs_and_unsupported_renderer_fail_before_write() {
        let service = service(CozoGraphShuttle::new_in_memory().unwrap());
        assert!(service
            .dispatch("get_config", &json!({"extra":true}))
            .await
            .is_err());
        assert!(service
            .dispatch("get_component_schema", &json!({"name":"\n"}))
            .await
            .is_err());
        assert!(service
            .dispatch("build_prompt_surface", &json!({"mode":"invented"}))
            .await
            .is_err());
        assert!(service
            .dispatch(
                "set_config",
                &json!({"config":{
                    "expose_catalog":true,"expose_prompt_surface":true,
                    "schema_mode":"strict","default_renderer":"react-pdf","extra":true
                }})
            )
            .await
            .is_err());
        assert_eq!(
            service.dispatch("get_config", &json!({})).await.unwrap()["revision"],
            0
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn malformed_injected_snapshot_is_rejected() {
        let documents = Arc::new(RuntimeDocuments::new(
            CozoGraphShuttle::new_in_memory().unwrap(),
        ));
        let mut snapshot = JsonRenderState::default();
        snapshot.components[0].props_schema = json!({"type":"invented"});
        assert!(JsonRenderMethods::new(snapshot, json_render_schema(), documents).is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn sealed_projection_seed_reconstructs_the_manifest_snapshot() {
        let schema = json_render_schema();
        let seed = crate::projection_seed_state_from_schema(&schema);
        let snapshot: JsonRenderState = simd_json::serde::from_owned_value(seed).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            snapshot.source.commit,
            super::super::JSON_RENDER_SOURCE_COMMIT
        );
        assert_eq!(snapshot.components.len(), 36);
        let button = snapshot
            .components
            .iter()
            .find(|item| item.name == "Button")
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(button.props_schema["additionalProperties"], false);
        assert_eq!(
            button.props_schema["required"],
            json!(["label", "variant", "disabled"])
        );
        JsonRenderMethods::new(
            snapshot,
            schema,
            Arc::new(RuntimeDocuments::new(
                CozoGraphShuttle::new_in_memory().unwrap(),
            )),
        )
        .unwrap();
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn projection_state_merges_the_committed_policy() {
        let service = service(CozoGraphShuttle::new_in_memory().unwrap());
        service
            .dispatch(
                "set_config",
                &json!({"config":{
                    "expose_catalog":false,"expose_prompt_surface":false,
                    "schema_mode":"standard","default_renderer":"react"
                }}),
            )
            .await
            .unwrap();
        let projected = service.projection_state().await.unwrap();
        assert!(!projected.config.expose_catalog);
        assert_eq!(projected.components.len(), 36);
        assert_eq!(
            projected.source.commit,
            super::super::JSON_RENDER_SOURCE_COMMIT
        );
    }
}
