<file path="op-plugins/src/state_plugins/json_render_runtime_contract.rs">
//! Runtime specification contract derived from the pinned json-render core types.

use serde_json::{json, Map, Value};

use super::{ActionDecl, ComponentDecl, JsonSchemaMode, RendererTarget};

pub(super) fn renderer_actions(
    actions: &[ActionDecl],
    renderer: RendererTarget,
) -> Vec<&ActionDecl> {
    actions
        .iter()
        .filter(|action| action.renderers.contains(&renderer))
        .collect()
}

pub(super) fn spec_schema(
    components: &[ComponentDecl],
    actions: &[ActionDecl],
    renderer: RendererTarget,
    mode: JsonSchemaMode,
) -> Value {
    let strict = matches!(mode, JsonSchemaMode::Strict);
    let action_binding = action_binding_schema(actions, renderer);
    let variants: Vec<_> = components
        .iter()
        .map(|component| element_schema(component, &action_binding, strict))
        .collect();
    json!({
        "$schema":"http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#",
        "title":"Manifest-pinned json-render runtime specification",
        "type":"object",
        "properties":{
            "root":{"type":"string","minLength":1},
            "elements":{"type":"object","additionalProperties":{"oneOf":variants}},
            "state":{"type":"object"}
        },
        "required":["root","elements"],
        "additionalProperties":!strict,
        "definitions":{"visibilityCondition":visibility_schema()}
    })
}

fn element_schema(component: &ComponentDecl, binding: &Value, strict: bool) -> Value {
    let event_properties: Map<_, _> = component
        .events
        .iter()
        .map(|event| (event.clone(), binding.clone()))
        .collect();
    json!({
        "type":"object",
        "properties":{
            "type":{"const":component.name},
            "props":runtime_props_schema(&component.props_schema),
            "children":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}},
            "visible":{"$ref":"#/definitions/visibilityCondition"},
            "on":{"type":"object","properties":event_properties,"additionalProperties":false},
            "repeat":{
                "type":"object",
                "properties":{"statePath":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"key":{"type":"string","minLength":1}},
                "required":["statePath"],
                "additionalProperties":false
            },
            "watch":{"type":"object","additionalProperties":binding}
        },
        "required":["type","props","children"],
        "additionalProperties":!strict
    })
}

fn runtime_props_schema(literal: &Value) -> Value {
    let mut schema = literal.clone();
    if let Some(properties) = schema.get_mut("properties").and_then(Value::as_object_mut) {
        for property in properties.values_mut() {
            *property = json!({"anyOf":[property.clone(), prop_expression_schema()]});
        }
    }
    schema
}

fn prop_expression_schema() -> Value {
    let exact_string = |key: &str| {
        let mut properties = Map::new();
        properties.insert(key.to_string(), json!({"type":"string"}));
        json!({
            "type":"object","properties":properties,"required":[key],"additionalProperties":false
        })
    };
    json!({"oneOf":[
        exact_string("$state"), exact_string("$item"), exact_string("$bindState"),
        exact_string("$bindItem"), exact_string("$template"),
        {"type":"object","properties":{"$index":{"const":true}},"required":["$index"],"additionalProperties":false},
        {"type":"object","properties":{"$computed":{"type":"string"},"args":{"type":"object"}},"required":["$computed"],"additionalProperties":false},
        {"type":"object","properties":{"$cond":{"$ref":"#/definitions/visibilityCondition"},"$then":{},"$else":{}},"required":["$cond","$then","$else"],"additionalProperties":false},
        format_directive(), math_directive(),
        {"type":"object","properties":{"$concat":{"type":"array"}},"required":["$concat"],"additionalProperties":false},
        {"type":"object","properties":{"$count":{}},"required":["$count"],"additionalProperties":false},
        {"type":"object","properties":{"$truncate":{},"length":{"type":"number"},"suffix":{"type":"string"}},"required":["$truncate"],"additionalProperties":false},
        {"type":"object","properties":{"$pluralize":{},"zero":{"type":"string"},"one":{"type":"string"},"other":{"type":"string"}},"required":["$pluralize","one","other"],"additionalProperties":false},
        {"type":"object","properties":{"$join":{},"separator":{"type":"string"}},"required":["$join"],"additionalProperties":false},
        {"type":"object","properties":{"$t":{"type":"string"},"params":{"type":"object"}},"required":["$t"],"additionalProperties":false}
    ]})
}

fn format_directive() -> Value {
    json!({"type":"object","properties":{
        "$format":{"enum":["date","currency","number","percent"]},"value":{},
        "locale":{"type":"string"},"currency":{"type":"string"},"notation":{"type":"string"},
        "style":{"type":"string"},"options":{"type":"object"},"now":{"type":"number"}
    },"required":["$format","value"],"additionalProperties":false})
}

fn math_directive() -> Value {
    json!({"type":"object","properties":{
        "$math":{"enum":["add","subtract","multiply","divide","mod","min","max","round","floor","ceil","abs"]},
        "a":{},"b":{}
    },"required":["$math"],"additionalProperties":false})
}

fn action_binding_schema(actions: &[ActionDecl], renderer: RendererTarget) -> Value {
    let actions = renderer_actions(actions, renderer);
    if actions.is_empty() {
        return json!(false);
    }
    let variants: Vec<_> = actions
        .iter()
        .map(|action| {
            let required = if matches!(action.name.as_str(), "pop" | "validateForm") {
                json!(["action"])
            } else {
                json!(["action", "params"])
            };
            json!({"type":"object","properties":{
                "action":{"const":action.name},"params":action.params_schema,
                "confirm":confirm_schema(),"onSuccess":outcome_schema(true),
                "onError":outcome_schema(false),"preventDefault":{"type":"boolean"}
            },"required":required,"additionalProperties":false})
        })
        .collect();
    let single = json!({"oneOf":variants});
    json!({"oneOf":[single.clone(),{"type":"array","items":single,"minItems":1}]})
}

pub(super) fn builtin_action_params_schema(action: &str) -> Value {
    let (properties, required): (Value, &[&str]) = match action {
        "setState" => (
            json!({"statePath":dynamic_action_value(json!({"type":"string","minLength":1})),"value":{}}),
            &["statePath", "value"],
        ),
        "pushState" => (
            json!({"statePath":dynamic_action_value(json!({"type":"string","minLength":1})),"value":{},"clearStatePath":dynamic_action_value(json!({"type":"string","minLength":1}))}),
            &["statePath", "value"],
        ),
        "removeState" => (
            json!({"statePath":dynamic_action_value(json!({"type":"string","minLength":1})),"index":dynamic_action_value(json!({"type":"integer","minimum":0}))}),
            &["statePath", "index"],
        ),
        "validateForm" => (
            json!({"statePath":dynamic_action_value(json!({"type":"string","minLength":1}))}),
            &[],
        ),
        "push" => (
            json!({"screen":dynamic_action_value(json!({"type":"string","minLength":1}))}),
            &["screen"],
        ),
        "pop" => (json!({}), &[]),
        _ => unreachable!("renderer action inventory is closed"),
    };
    json!({"type":"object","properties":properties,"required":required,"additionalProperties":false})
}

fn dynamic_action_value(literal: Value) -> Value {
    json!({"oneOf":[
        literal,
        {"type":"object","properties":{"$state":{"type":"string"}},"required":["$state"],"additionalProperties":false}
    ]})
}

fn confirm_schema() -> Value {
    json!({"type":"object","properties":{
        "title":{"type":"string"},"message":{"type":"string"},"confirmLabel":{"type":"string"},
        "cancelLabel":{"type":"string"},"variant":{"enum":["default","danger"]}
    },"required":["title","message"],"additionalProperties":false})
}

fn outcome_schema(success: bool) -> Value {
    let mut variants = vec![
        json!({"type":"object","properties":{"set":{"type":"object"}},"required":["set"],"additionalProperties":false}),
        json!({"type":"object","properties":{"action":{"type":"string"}},"required":["action"],"additionalProperties":false}),
    ];
    if success {
        variants.push(json!({"type":"object","properties":{"navigate":{"type":"string"}},"required":["navigate"],"additionalProperties":false}));
    }
    json!({"oneOf":variants})
}

fn visibility_schema() -> Value {
    let number_or_state = json!({"oneOf":[{"type":"number"},{"type":"object","properties":{"$state":{"type":"string"}},"required":["$state"],"additionalProperties":false}]});
    let comparison = |selector: &str, selector_schema: Value| {
        let mut properties = Map::new();
        properties.insert(selector.to_string(), selector_schema);
        properties.insert("eq".into(), json!({}));
        properties.insert("neq".into(), json!({}));
        properties.insert("gt".into(), number_or_state.clone());
        properties.insert("gte".into(), number_or_state.clone());
        properties.insert("lt".into(), number_or_state.clone());
        properties.insert("lte".into(), number_or_state.clone());
        properties.insert("not".into(), json!({"const":true}));
        json!({
            "type":"object","properties":properties,"required":[selector],"additionalProperties":false
        })
    };
    let single = json!({"oneOf":[
        comparison("$state",json!({"type":"string"})),
        comparison("$item",json!({"type":"string"})),
        comparison("$index",json!({"const":true}))
    ]});
    json!({"oneOf":[
        {"type":"boolean"}, single.clone(), {"type":"array","items":single},
        {"type":"object","properties":{"$and":{"type":"array","items":{"$ref":"#/definitions/visibilityCondition"}}},"required":["$and"],"additionalProperties":false},
        {"type":"object","properties":{"$or":{"type":"array","items":{"$ref":"#/definitions/visibilityCondition"}}},"required":["$or"],"additionalProperties":false}
    ]})
}
</file>

<file path="op-plugins/src/state_plugins/json_render_validation_bounds.rs">
//! Shared, iterative resource gates for reference and private Canvas specs.
use std::collections::{HashMap, VecDeque};

use anyhow::{ensure, Context, Result};
use serde_json::{Map, Value};

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, serde::Serialize, serde::Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct JsonLimits {
    pub max_depth: usize,
    pub max_nodes: usize,
    pub max_bytes: usize,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, serde::Serialize, serde::Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct GraphLimits {
    pub max_elements: usize,
    pub max_edges: usize,
    pub max_depth: usize,
    pub max_expanded_nodes: usize,
}

/// Check depth/nodes before entering recursive serializers or validators.
/// Byte counting then uses a bounded sink without duplicating the document.
pub fn check_json(value: &Value, limits: JsonLimits) -> Result<()> {
    let mut pending = vec![(value, 0usize)];
    let mut nodes = 0usize;
    while let Some((value, depth)) = pending.pop() {
        nodes = nodes.checked_add(1).context("JSON node count overflow")?;
        ensure!(nodes <= limits.max_nodes, "JSON node limit exceeded");
        ensure!(depth <= limits.max_depth, "JSON depth limit exceeded");
        let count = match value {
            Value::Object(object) => object.len(),
            Value::Array(array) => array.len(),
            _ => 0,
        };
        ensure!(
            nodes.saturating_add(pending.len()).saturating_add(count) <= limits.max_nodes,
            "JSON node limit exceeded"
        );
        match value {
            Value::Object(object) => {
                pending.extend(object.values().map(|child| (child, depth + 1)))
            }
            Value::Array(array) => pending.extend(array.iter().map(|child| (child, depth + 1))),
            _ => {}
        }
    }
    struct Counter {
        written: usize,
        maximum: usize,
    }
    impl std::io::Write for Counter {
        fn write(&mut self, bytes: &[u8]) -> std::io::Result<usize> {
            self.written = self
                .written
                .checked_add(bytes.len())
                .filter(|size| *size <= self.maximum)
                .ok_or_else(|| std::io::Error::other("JSON byte limit exceeded"))?;
            Ok(bytes.len())
        }
        fn flush(&mut self) -> std::io::Result<()> {
            Ok(())
        }
    }
    serde_json::to_writer(
        &mut Counter {
            written: 0,
            maximum: limits.max_bytes,
        },
        value,
    )
    .context("JSON byte limit exceeded")
}

/// Validate every child edge, including unreachable cycles, and count actual
/// static DAG expansion. Dynamic repeats are a separate profile admission.
pub fn check_children_graph(
    root: &str,
    elements: &Map<String, Value>,
    limits: GraphLimits,
) -> Result<()> {
    ensure!(
        !elements.is_empty() && elements.len() <= limits.max_elements,
        "element graph count limit exceeded"
    );
    let keys: Vec<_> = elements.keys().map(String::as_str).collect();
    let indexes: HashMap<_, _> = keys.iter().enumerate().map(|(i, key)| (*key, i)).collect();
    let root = *indexes.get(root).context("root element does not exist")?;
    let mut edges = vec![Vec::new(); keys.len()];
    let mut indegree = vec![0usize; keys.len()];
    let mut edge_count = 0usize;
    for (index, key) in keys.iter().enumerate() {
        let children = elements[*key]
            .get("children")
            .and_then(Value::as_array)
            .context("element children must be an array")?;
        for child in children {
            edge_count = edge_count
                .checked_add(1)
                .context("element graph edge count overflow")?;
            ensure!(
                edge_count <= limits.max_edges,
                "element graph exceeds child edges limit"
            );
            let child = child.as_str().context("child reference must be a string")?;
            let target = *indexes
                .get(child)
                .context("child references missing element")?;
            edges[index].push(target);
            indegree[target] += 1;
        }
    }
    let mut queue: VecDeque<_> = indegree
        .iter()
        .enumerate()
        .filter_map(|(i, count)| (*count == 0).then_some(i))
        .collect();
    let mut order = Vec::with_capacity(keys.len());
    let mut depth = vec![1usize; keys.len()];
    while let Some(source) = queue.pop_front() {
        order.push(source);
        for &target in &edges[source] {
            depth[target] = depth[target].max(depth[source].saturating_add(1));
            indegree[target] -= 1;
            if indegree[target] == 0 {
                queue.push_back(target);
            }
        }
    }
    ensure!(
        order.len() == keys.len(),
        "element graph contains a cycle, including disconnected cycles"
    );
    ensure!(
        depth.iter().all(|value| *value <= limits.max_depth),
        "element graph exceeds maximum depth"
    );
    let cap = limits.max_expanded_nodes.saturating_add(1);
    let mut copies = vec![0usize; keys.len()];
    copies[root] = 1;
    let mut expanded = 1usize;
    for source in order {
        if copies[source] == 0 {
            continue;
        }
        for &target in &edges[source] {
            copies[target] = copies[target].saturating_add(copies[source]).min(cap);
            expanded = expanded.saturating_add(copies[source]).min(cap);
            ensure!(
                expanded <= limits.max_expanded_nodes,
                "expanded render graph exceeds node limit"
            );
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use serde_json::json;
    const GRAPH: GraphLimits = GraphLimits {
        max_elements: 4096,
        max_edges: 16384,
        max_depth: 64,
        max_expanded_nodes: 4096,
    };
    fn node(children: Vec<String>) -> Value {
        json!({"children":children})
    }
    #[test]
    fn rejects_hidden_disconnected_cycles_and_bounded_map_exponential_expansion() {
        let mut elements = Map::new();
        elements.insert("root".into(), node(vec![]));
        elements.insert("hidden".into(), node(vec!["hidden".into()]));
        assert!(check_children_graph("root", &elements, GRAPH)
            .unwrap_err()
            .to_string()
            .contains("cycle"));
        elements.clear();
        for index in 0..14 {
            let next = (index + 1).to_string();
            elements.insert(
                index.to_string(),
                node(if index == 13 {
                    vec![]
                } else {
                    vec![next.clone(), next]
                }),
            );
        }
        assert!(check_children_graph("0", &elements, GRAPH)
            .unwrap_err()
            .to_string()
            .contains("expanded"));
    }
    #[test]
    fn bounds_depth_before_recursive_serialization_and_counts_bytes() {
        let limits = JsonLimits {
            max_depth: 64,
            max_nodes: 1024,
            max_bytes: 4096,
        };
        let mut deep = Value::Null;
        for _ in 0..66 {
            deep = json!([deep]);
        }
        assert!(check_json(&deep, limits)
            .unwrap_err()
            .to_string()
            .contains("depth"));
        assert!(check_json(&json!("x".repeat(4096)), limits).is_err());
        assert!(check_json(&json!([1, 2, 3]), limits).is_ok());
    }
}
</file>

// =============================================================================

pub struct JsonRenderPlugin;

impl Default for JsonRenderPlugin {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self
    }
}

impl JsonRenderPlugin {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self
    }

    pub(crate) fn current_state() -> JsonRenderState {
        JsonRenderState::default()
    }
}

#[async_trait]
impl StatePlugin for JsonRenderPlugin {
    fn name(&self) -> &str {
        PLUGIN_NAME
    }

    fn version(&self) -> &str {
        PLUGIN_VERSION
    }

    fn schema(&self) -> Option<PluginSchema> {
        Some(json_render_schema())
    }

    async fn calculate_diff(&self, _current: &Value, _desired: &Value) -> Result<StateDiff> {
        Ok(StateDiff {
            plugin: PLUGIN_NAME.to_string(),
            actions: vec![],
            metadata: DiffMetadata {
                timestamp: chrono::Utc::now().timestamp(),
                current_hash: String::new(),
                desired_hash: String::new(),
            },
        })
    }

    async fn apply_state(&self, _diff: &StateDiff) -> Result<ApplyResult> {
        Ok(ApplyResult {
            success: true,
            changes_applied: vec![],
            errors: vec![],
            checkpoint: None,
        })
    }

    async fn verify_state(&self, _desired: &Value) -> Result<bool> {
        Ok(true)
    }

    async fn create_checkpoint(&self) -> Result<Checkpoint> {
        Ok(Checkpoint {
            id: uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string(),
            plugin: PLUGIN_NAME.to_string(),
            timestamp: chrono::Utc::now().timestamp(),
            state_snapshot: simd_json::serde::to_owned_value(Self::current_state())?,
            backend_checkpoint: None,
        })
    }

    async fn rollback(&self, _checkpoint: &Checkpoint) -> Result<()> {
        Ok(())
    }

    fn capabilities(&self) -> PluginCapabilities {
        PluginCapabilities {
            supports_rollback: false,
            supports_checkpoints: true,
            supports_verification: true,
            atomic_operations: false,
        }
    }
}

// =============================================================================
// PLUGIN EXIT: publish the single PluginSchema contract
// =============================================================================

/// Derived `json_render` schema from the typed [`JsonRenderState`] struct via schemars.
pub(crate) fn json_render_schema() -> PluginSchema {
    let root = serde_json::to_value(schemars::schema_for!(JsonRenderState))
        .expect("schemars schema serializes to JSON");
    let mut schema = super::schemars_adapter::plugin_schema_from_json(
        PLUGIN_NAME,
        PLUGIN_VERSION,
        PLUGIN_DESCRIPTION,
        &root,
    );
    schema.category = PLUGIN_CATEGORY.to_string();
    schema.display_name = Some(PLUGIN_DISPLAY_NAME.to_string());
    let state = simd_json::serde::to_owned_value(&JsonRenderState::default())
        .expect("JsonRenderState default serializes");
    super::schemars_adapter::apply_state_defaults(&mut schema, &state);

    // Add methods
    schema.methods.insert(
        "get_config".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<EmptyJsonRenderInput, ConfigOutput>(
            "get_config",
            SideEffect::Read,
            true,
            "json_render.read",
            "obs.software.plugin.json-render.config.get@v2",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "set_config".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<SetJsonRenderConfigInput, SetConfigOutput>(
            "set_config",
            SideEffect::Mutation,
            false,
            "json_render.invoke",
            "mut.software.plugin.json-render.config.set@v2",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "get_health".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<EmptyJsonRenderInput, HealthOutput>(
            "get_health",
            SideEffect::Read,
            true,
            "json_render.read",
            "obs.software.plugin.json-render.health@v2",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "list_tools".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<EmptyJsonRenderInput, ToolsOutput>(
            "list_tools",
            SideEffect::Read,
            true,
            "json_render.read",
            "obs.software.plugin.json-render.tool.list@v2",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "list_packages".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<EmptyJsonRenderInput, PackagesOutput>(
            "list_packages",
            SideEffect::Read,
            true,
            "json_render.read",
            "obs.software.plugin.json-render.package.list@v2",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "get_package".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<PackageLookupInput, PackageOutput>(
            "get_package",
            SideEffect::Read,
            true,
            "json_render.read",
            "obs.software.plugin.json-render.package.get@v2",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "list_components".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<EmptyJsonRenderInput, ComponentsOutput>(
            "list_components",
            SideEffect::Read,
            true,
            "json_render.read",
            "obs.software.plugin.json-render.component.list@v2",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "get_component_schema".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<ComponentLookupInput, ComponentOutput>(
            "get_component_schema",
            SideEffect::Read,
            true,
            "json_render.read",
            "obs.software.plugin.json-render.component.get@v2",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "list_actions".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<EmptyJsonRenderInput, ActionsOutput>(
            "list_actions",
            SideEffect::Read,
            true,
            "json_render.read",
            "obs.software.plugin.json-render.action.list@v2",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "list_core_exports".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<EmptyJsonRenderInput, CoreExportsOutput>(
            "list_core_exports",
            SideEffect::Read,
            true,
            "json_render.read",
            "obs.software.plugin.json-render.core-export.list@v2",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "list_renderers".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<EmptyJsonRenderInput, RenderersOutput>(
            "list_renderers",
            SideEffect::Read,
            true,
            "json_render.read",
            "obs.software.plugin.json-render.renderer.list@v2",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "get_spec_schema".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<EmptyJsonRenderInput, SchemaExportOutput>(
            "get_spec_schema",
            SideEffect::Read,
            true,
            "json_render.read",
            "obs.software.plugin.json-render.spec.get@v2",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "validate_spec".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<SpecValidationInput, ValidationResultOutput>(
            "validate_spec",
            SideEffect::Read,
            true,
            "json_render.read",
            "obs.software.plugin.json-render.spec.validate@v2",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "export_json_schema".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<SchemaExportInput, SchemaExportOutput>(
            "export_json_schema",
            SideEffect::Read,
            true,
            "json_render.read",
            "obs.software.plugin.json-render.schema.export@v2",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "build_prompt_surface".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<PromptSurfaceInput, PromptSurfaceOutput>(
            "build_prompt_surface",
            SideEffect::Read,
            true,
            "json_render.read",
            "obs.software.plugin.json-render.prompt.build@v2",
        ),
    );

    schema.capabilities.insert(
        "json_render.read".to_string(),
        op_state_store::CapabilityDecl {
            id: "json_render.read".to_string(),
            description: "Grants: get_config, get_health, list_tools, list_packages, get_package, list_components, get_component_schema, list_actions, list_core_exports, list_renderers, get_spec_schema, validate_spec, export_json_schema, build_prompt_surface.".to_string(),
        },
    );
    schema.capabilities.insert(
        "json_render.invoke".to_string(),
        op_state_store::CapabilityDecl {
            id: "json_render.invoke".to_string(),
            description: "Grants: set_config.".to_string(),
        },
    );

    // The local exposure policy and source pin are themselves public
    // metadata. Catalog and prompt material remains behind the plugin's
    // runtime configuration and method surface rather than being streamed
    // unconditionally.
    schema.public_state.paths = vec![
        "/status".to_string(),
        "/source".to_string(),
        "/config".to_string(),
    ];

    schema
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::state_plugins::common::oscal::validate_subid;
    use serde_json::Value as JVal;

    fn collect_subids(value: &JVal, out: &mut Vec<String>) {
        if let Some(obj) = value.as_object() {
            if let Some(JVal::String(subid)) = obj.get("x-oscal-subid") {
                out.push(subid.clone());
            }
            for v in obj.values() {
                collect_subids(v, out);
            }
        }
        if let Some(arr) = value.as_array() {
            for v in arr {
                collect_subids(v, out);
            }
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn all_subids_are_valid() {
        let root = serde_json::to_value(schemars::schema_for!(JsonRenderState))
            .expect("schemars schema serializes to JSON");
        let mut subids = Vec::new();
        collect_subids(&root, &mut subids);
        assert!(!subids.is_empty(), "expected at least one subid");
        for subid in subids {
            validate_subid(&subid).unwrap_or_else(|error| panic!("invalid subid {subid}: {error}"));
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn schema_declares_expected_methods() {
        let schema = json_render_schema();
        for method in [
            "get_config",
            "set_config",
            "get_health",
            "list_tools",
            "list_packages",
            "get_package",
            "list_components",
            "get_component_schema",
            "list_actions",
            "list_core_exports",
            "list_renderers",
            "get_spec_schema",
            "validate_spec",
            "export_json_schema",
            "build_prompt_surface",
        ] {
            assert!(
                schema.methods.contains_key(method),
                "missing method {method}"
            );
        }
    }
}

inventory::submit! {
    crate::default_registry::PluginReg::new(PLUGIN_NAME, |_ctx| std::sync::Arc::new(JsonRenderPlugin::new()))
}
</file>
