//! GB.Keypair plugin — schemars-seeded, D-Bus-backed keypair declaration state.
//!
//! This is the reference implementation of the GB (Golden Bridge) plugin
//! pattern: the plugin file owns the schemars seed (state struct), the
//! `PluginSchema` contract is derived from that seed, and method declarations
//! use typed input/output structs via `method_decl_from_schemars_with_output`.

use anyhow::Result;
use async_trait::async_trait;
use op_state::{ApplyResult, Checkpoint, DiffMetadata, PluginCapabilities, StateDiff, StatePlugin};
use op_state_store::{PluginSchema, SideEffect};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use simd_json::json;
use simd_json::prelude::*;
use simd_json::OwnedValue as Value;

use super::plugin_scaffold_helpers::method_decl_from_schemars_with_output;
mod agent;
pub use agent::dispatch_keypair_method;

// =============================================================================
// PLUGIN ENTRY: identity and typed schema seed
// =============================================================================

const PLUGIN_NAME: &str = "keypair";
const PLUGIN_VERSION: &str = "2.0.0";
const PLUGIN_CATEGORY: &str = "service";
const PLUGIN_DESCRIPTION: &str = "Public identities advertised by the configured SSH agent";
const PLUGIN_DISPLAY_NAME: &str = "GB.Keypair";

/// Keypair declaration state.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, Default, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "sch.software.plugin.keypair.schema@v1"))]
#[schemars(extend("x-oscal-category" = "service"))]
pub struct KeypairState {
    /// Managed keypairs.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(
        description = "Managed keypairs",
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "exp.service.keypair.keypairs.render@v1")
    )]
    pub keypairs: Vec<Keypair>,
}

/// A single SSH keypair (state-side declaration).
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct Keypair {
    /// Keypair name.
    #[schemars(
        description = "Keypair name",
        example = &"id_ed25519",
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "exp.service.keypair.name.declare@v1")
    )]
    pub name: String,

    /// Public-key algorithm.
    #[schemars(
        description = "Public-key algorithm",
        example = &"ssh-ed25519",
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "exp.service.keypair.algorithm.declare@v1")
    )]
    pub algorithm: String,

    /// Public key material.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(
        description = "Public key material",
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "exp.service.keypair.public-key.declare@v1")
    )]
    pub public_key: Option<String>,

    /// Whether the keypair is present on the system.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(
        description = "Whether the keypair is present on the system",
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "obs.service.keypair.present.detect@v1")
    )]
    pub present: bool,
}

/// Typed input for the `list_keypairs` method (empty — no parameters).
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "obs.service.keypair.list.input@v1"))]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct ListKeypairsInput {}

/// Typed output for the `list_keypairs` method.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "obs.service.keypair.list.output@v1"))]
pub struct ListKeypairsOutput {
    /// Provider scope; this is an agent inventory, not a scan of key files.
    pub source: String,
    /// Discovered keypairs.
    #[schemars(
        description = "Discovered keypairs",
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "exp.service.keypair.list.keypairs.render@v1")
    )]
    pub keypairs: Vec<KeypairInfo>,
}

/// A single keypair as returned by `list_keypairs` (output-side view).
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "obs.service.keypair.keypair-info.list@v1"))]
pub struct KeypairInfo {
    /// SHA-256 fingerprint of the SSH public-key wire encoding.
    pub fingerprint: String,
    /// Keypair name.
    #[schemars(
        description = "Keypair name",
        example = &"id_ed25519",
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "exp.service.keypair.info.name.render@v1")
    )]
    pub name: String,

    /// Public-key algorithm.
    #[schemars(
        description = "Public-key algorithm",
        example = &"ssh-ed25519",
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "exp.service.keypair.info.algorithm.render@v1")
    )]
    pub algorithm: String,

    /// Public key material.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(
        description = "Public key material",
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "exp.service.keypair.info.public-key.render@v1")
    )]
    pub public_key: Option<String>,

    /// Whether the agent advertised this identity. This does not assert that
    /// signing is currently permitted or that private material is exportable.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(
        description = "Identity advertised by the SSH agent; signing availability is not tested",
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "obs.service.keypair.info.present.render@v1")
    )]
    pub present: bool,
}

// =============================================================================
// PLUGIN BODY: D-Bus-backed behavior only
// =============================================================================

pub struct KeypairPlugin;

impl Default for KeypairPlugin {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self
    }
}

impl KeypairPlugin {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self
    }
}

#[async_trait]
impl StatePlugin for KeypairPlugin {
    fn name(&self) -> &str {
        PLUGIN_NAME
    }

    fn version(&self) -> &str {
        PLUGIN_VERSION
    }

    fn schema(&self) -> Option<PluginSchema> {
        Some(keypair_schema())
    }

    async fn calculate_diff(&self, _current: &Value, _desired: &Value) -> Result<StateDiff> {
        Ok(StateDiff {
            plugin: self.name().to_string(),
            actions: vec![],
            metadata: DiffMetadata {
                timestamp: chrono::Utc::now().timestamp(),
                current_hash: "unknown".to_string(),
                desired_hash: "unknown".to_string(),
            },
        })
    }

    async fn apply_state(&self, _diff: &StateDiff) -> Result<ApplyResult> {
        Ok(ApplyResult {
            success: true,
            changes_applied: vec![],
            errors: vec![],
            checkpoint: None,
        })
    }

    async fn verify_state(&self, _desired: &Value) -> Result<bool> {
        Ok(true)
    }

    async fn create_checkpoint(&self) -> Result<Checkpoint> {
        Ok(Checkpoint {
            id: uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string(),
            plugin: self.name().to_string(),
            timestamp: chrono::Utc::now().timestamp(),
            state_snapshot: Value::null(),
            backend_checkpoint: None,
        })
    }

    async fn rollback(&self, _checkpoint: &Checkpoint) -> Result<()> {
        Ok(())
    }

    fn capabilities(&self) -> PluginCapabilities {
        PluginCapabilities {
            supports_rollback: true,
            supports_checkpoints: true,
            supports_verification: true,
            atomic_operations: false,
        }
    }
}

// =============================================================================
// PLUGIN EXIT: publish the single PluginSchema contract
// =============================================================================

/// Derived `keypair` schema from the `KeypairState` struct.
pub fn keypair_schema() -> PluginSchema {
    let root = serde_json::to_value(schemars::schema_for!(KeypairState))
        .expect("schemars schema serializes to JSON");
    let mut schema = super::schemars_adapter::plugin_schema_from_json(
        PLUGIN_NAME,
        PLUGIN_VERSION,
        PLUGIN_DESCRIPTION,
        &root,
    );
    schema.category = PLUGIN_CATEGORY.to_string();
    schema.display_name = Some(PLUGIN_DISPLAY_NAME.to_string());
    schema.methods.insert(
        "list_keypairs".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<ListKeypairsInput, ListKeypairsOutput>(
            "list_keypairs",
            SideEffect::Read,
            true,
            "cap.service.keypair.list@v1",
            "obs.service.keypair.list@v1",
        ),
    );
    schema.capabilities.insert(
        "cap.service.keypair.list@v1".to_string(),
        op_state_store::CapabilityDecl {
            id: "cap.service.keypair.list@v1".to_string(),
            description: "Grants: list_keypairs.".to_string(),
        },
    );

    schema
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn schema_is_schemars_seeded_and_typed() {
        let schema = keypair_schema();
        assert_eq!(schema.name, PLUGIN_NAME);
        assert_eq!(schema.version, PLUGIN_VERSION);
        assert_eq!(schema.display_name, Some(PLUGIN_DISPLAY_NAME.to_string()));
        assert!(schema.fields.contains_key("keypairs"));
        assert!(schema.methods.contains_key("list_keypairs"));
    }

    /// Every `x-oscal-subid` annotation in the derived schema must be a valid
    /// OSCAL subid according to the canonical taxonomy.
    #[test]
    fn all_subids_are_valid() {
        let raw = serde_json::to_value(schemars::schema_for!(KeypairState)).unwrap();
        let mut subids = Vec::new();
        collect_subids(&raw, &mut subids);
        assert!(!subids.is_empty(), "expected at least one subid");
        for subid in subids {
            crate::state_plugins::common::oscal::validate_subid(&subid)
                .unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("invalid subid {subid}: {e}"));
        }
    }

    fn collect_subids(value: &serde_json::Value, out: &mut Vec<String>) {
        if let serde_json::Value::Object(map) = value {
            if let Some(subid) = map.get("x-oscal-subid").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {
                out.push(subid.to_string());
            }
            for v in map.values() {
                collect_subids(v, out);
            }
        } else if let serde_json::Value::Array(arr) = value {
            for v in arr {
                collect_subids(v, out);
            }
        }
    }
}

// Self-registration: the plugin registry discovers this via inventory
// (single source of the catalog; no central dispatch list).
inventory::submit! {
    crate::default_registry::PluginReg::new(PLUGIN_NAME, |_ctx| std::sync::Arc::new(KeypairPlugin::new()))
}
</file>

<file path="op-plugins/src/state_plugins/keyring.rs">
//! GNOME Keyring plugin - freedesktop.org Secret Service integration
#![allow(dead_code)]
//!
//! Implements the org.freedesktop.secrets D-Bus service for secure credential storage.
//! This allows applications like Cursor to store and retrieve passwords, API keys, etc.
//!
//! The Secret Service API provides:
//! - Collections (like "default", "login")
//! - Items (individual secrets with attributes)
//! - Secure storage with optional encryption

use anyhow::Result;
use async_trait::async_trait;
use op_state::{
    ApplyResult, Checkpoint, DiffMetadata, PluginCapabilities, StateAction, StateDiff, StatePlugin,
};
use op_state_store::PluginSchema;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use simd_json::prelude::*;
use simd_json::{json, OwnedValue as Value};
use zbus::{
    zvariant::{ObjectPath, OwnedObjectPath},
    Connection, Proxy,
};

/// Keyring state representation
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, Default, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[schemars(extend("x-oscal-category" = "security"))]
pub struct KeyringState {
    /// Available collections
    pub collections: Vec<CollectionInfo>,
    /// Default collection path
    pub default_collection: Option<String>,
}

/// Information about a secret collection
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, Default, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct CollectionInfo {
    pub path: String,
    pub label: String,
    pub locked: bool,
    pub created: u64,
    pub modified: u64,
}

/// GNOME Keyring plugin implementing freedesktop.org Secret Service
pub struct KeyringPlugin {
    connection: Option<Connection>,
}

impl KeyringPlugin {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self { connection: None }
    }

    #[cfg(test)]
    fn with_connection(connection: Connection) -> Self {
        Self {
            connection: Some(connection),
        }
    }

    /// Connect to the upstream Secret Service owner on the session bus.
    async fn connect_service(&self) -> Result<Proxy<'static>> {
        let conn = match &self.connection {
            Some(connection) => connection.clone(),
            None => Connection::session().await?,
        };
        let proxy = Proxy::new(
            &conn,
            "org.freedesktop.secrets",
            "/org/freedesktop/secrets",
            "org.freedesktop.Secret.Service",
        )
        .await?;
        Ok(proxy)
    }

    /// Get available collections from the upstream Secret Service.
    async fn get_collections(&self) -> Result<Vec<CollectionInfo>> {
        let service = self.connect_service().await?;
        let paths: Vec<OwnedObjectPath> = service.get_property("Collections").await?;
        let mut result = Vec::with_capacity(paths.len());
        for path in paths {
            result.push(self.collection_info(&path).await?);
        }
        Ok(result)
    }

    /// Get typed metadata for one upstream Secret Service collection.
    async fn get_collection_info(&self, path: &ObjectPath<'_>) -> Result<CollectionInfo> {
        self.collection_info(path).await
    }

    /// Resolve the upstream Secret Service default alias.
    async fn get_default_collection(&self) -> Result<Option<String>> {
        let service = self.connect_service().await?;
        let path: OwnedObjectPath = service.call("ReadAlias", &"default").await?;
        Ok((path.as_str() != "/").then(|| path.to_string()))
    }

    async fn collection_info(&self, path: &ObjectPath<'_>) -> Result<CollectionInfo> {
        let conn = match &self.connection {
            Some(connection) => connection.clone(),
            None => Connection::session().await?,
        };
        let proxy = Proxy::new(
            &conn,
            "org.freedesktop.secrets",
            path,
            "org.freedesktop.Secret.Collection",
        )
        .await?;
        Ok(CollectionInfo {
            path: path.to_string(),
            label: proxy.get_property("Label").await?,
            locked: proxy.get_property("Locked").await?,
            created: proxy.get_property("Created").await?,
            modified: proxy.get_property("Modified").await?,
        })
    }
}

impl Default for KeyringPlugin {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}

impl KeyringPlugin {
    /// Check whether the session bus is available for Secret Service access.
    /// NOTE: is_available() must NOT spawn subprocesses or do blocking I/O
    /// because it runs during daemon initialization before the D-Bus name is claimed.
    fn check_service_available(&self) -> bool {
        // Check if the op-dbus session bus socket exists, which means the
        // The actual Secret Service call remains authoritative and propagates
        // errors; this is only a cheap availability hint for registration.
        std::path::Path::new(op_core::config::SESSION_BUS_SOCKET_PATH).exists()
    }
}

#[async_trait]
impl StatePlugin for KeyringPlugin {
    fn name(&self) -> &str {
        "keyring"
    }

    fn version(&self) -> &str {
        "0.1.0"
    }

    fn schema(&self) -> Option<PluginSchema> {
        Some(keyring_schema())
    }

    fn capabilities(&self) -> PluginCapabilities {
        PluginCapabilities {
            supports_rollback: false, // Security reasons
            supports_checkpoints: true,
            supports_verification: true,
            atomic_operations: false, // Keyring operations are not atomic
        }
    }

    fn is_available(&self) -> bool {
        self.check_service_available()
    }

    fn unavailable_reason(&self) -> String {
        "org.freedesktop Secret Service is not available on the session bus".to_string()
    }

    async fn apply_state(&self, _diff: &StateDiff) -> Result<ApplyResult> {
        // Keyring operations are typically interactive and should not be automated
        Err(anyhow::anyhow!(
            "Keyring apply operations are not supported for security reasons"
        ))
    }

    async fn calculate_diff(&self, current: &Value, desired: &Value) -> Result<StateDiff> {
        let mut actions = Vec::new();

        if current != desired {
            actions.push(StateAction::Modify {
                resource: "keyring-collections".to_string(),
                changes: json!({
                    "current": current,
                    "desired": desired
                }),
            });
        }

        let metadata = DiffMetadata {
            timestamp: chrono::Utc::now().timestamp(),
            current_hash: format!("{:x}", md5::compute(simd_json::to_string(current)?)),
            desired_hash: format!("{:x}", md5::compute(simd_json::to_string(desired)?)),
        };

        Ok(StateDiff {
            plugin: self.name().to_string(),
            actions,
            metadata,
        })
    }

    async fn verify_state(&self, desired: &Value) -> Result<bool> {
        // For keyring, we can only verify that the structure is valid
        // We can't verify actual secrets without user interaction
        Ok(desired.is_object())
    }

    async fn create_checkpoint(&self) -> Result<Checkpoint> {
        let state = simd_json::json!(null);
        Ok(Checkpoint {
            id: format!("keyring-{}", chrono::Utc::now().timestamp()),
            plugin: self.name().to_string(),
            timestamp: chrono::Utc::now().timestamp(),
            state_snapshot: state,
            backend_checkpoint: None,
        })
    }

    async fn rollback(&self, _checkpoint: &Checkpoint) -> Result<()> {
        // Keyring rollback is not supported for security reasons
        Err(anyhow::anyhow!(
            "Keyring rollback is not supported for security reasons"
        ))
    }
}

pub(crate) fn keyring_schema() -> PluginSchema {
    let mut schema = super::schemars_adapter::plugin_schema_from_json(
        "keyring",
        "0.1.0",
        "Secret service collections state",
        &serde_json::to_value(schemars::schema_for!(KeyringState)).unwrap(),
    );
    super::schemars_adapter::apply_state_defaults(
        &mut schema,
        &simd_json::serde::to_owned_value(&KeyringState::default()).unwrap(),
    );

    use super::plugin_scaffold_helpers::{method_decl_from_schemars_with_output, EmptyInput};
    use op_state_store::SideEffect;

    #[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
    pub struct ListCollectionsOutput {
        pub collections: Vec<CollectionInfo>,
    }
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
    pub struct GetDefaultCollectionOutput {
        pub default_collection: Option<String>,
    }

    // These methods query the upstream Secret Service. Unavailable providers
    // return an error; a successful empty list means the provider has none.
    schema.methods.insert(
        "list_collections".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<EmptyInput, ListCollectionsOutput>(
            "list_collections",
            SideEffect::Read,
            true,
            "keyring.read",
            "obs.security.plugin.keyring.collections.list@v1",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "get_default_collection".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<EmptyInput, GetDefaultCollectionOutput>(
            "get_default_collection",
            SideEffect::Read,
            true,
            "keyring.read",
            "obs.security.plugin.keyring.default-collection.get@v1",
        ),
    );

    schema.capabilities.insert(
        "keyring.read".to_string(),
        op_state_store::CapabilityDecl {
            id: "keyring.read".to_string(),
            description: "Grants: list_collections, get_default_collection.".to_string(),
        },
    );

    schema
}

/// Dispatch a `keyring` schema method. Called from `op-grpc-bridge`'s
/// `MutationEngine::dispatch_method_call`.
pub async fn dispatch_keyring_method(
    method: &str,
    _args: &serde_json::Value,
) -> Result<serde_json::Value> {
    let plugin = KeyringPlugin::new();
    match method {
        "list_collections" => {
            let collections = plugin.get_collections().await?;
            Ok(serde_json::json!({ "collections": collections }))
        }
        "get_default_collection" => {
            let default_collection = plugin.get_default_collection().await?;
            Ok(serde_json::json!({ "default_collection": default_collection }))
        }
        other => Err(anyhow::anyhow!("unknown keyring method: {}", other)),
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use zbus::connection;

    struct SecretFixture {
        default_available: bool,
    }
    #[zbus::interface(name = "org.freedesktop.Secret.Service")]
    impl SecretFixture {
        #[zbus(property)]
        async fn collections(&self) -> Vec<OwnedObjectPath> {
            vec![OwnedObjectPath::try_from("/org/freedesktop/secrets/collection/login").unwrap()]
        }
        async fn read_alias(&self, alias: &str) -> OwnedObjectPath {
            if alias == "default" && self.default_available {
                OwnedObjectPath::try_from("/org/freedesktop/secrets/collection/login").unwrap()
            } else {
                OwnedObjectPath::try_from("/").unwrap()
            }
        }
    }

    struct CollectionFixture;
    #[zbus::interface(name = "org.freedesktop.Secret.Collection")]
    impl CollectionFixture {
        #[zbus(property)]
        async fn label(&self) -> String {
            "Login".to_string()
        }
        #[zbus(property)]
        async fn locked(&self) -> bool {
            false
        }
        #[zbus(property)]
        async fn created(&self) -> u64 {
            11
        }
        #[zbus(property)]
        async fn modified(&self) -> u64 {
            22
        }
    }

    async fn fixture_connection(default_available: bool) -> (Connection, Connection) {
        let (server_stream, client_stream) = tokio::net::UnixStream::pair().unwrap();
        let guid = zbus::Guid::generate();
        let server = connection::Builder::unix_stream(server_stream)
            .server(guid)
            .unwrap()
            .p2p()
            .serve_at(
                "/org/freedesktop/secrets",
                SecretFixture { default_available },
            )
            .unwrap();
        let server = server
            .serve_at(
                "/org/freedesktop/secrets/collection/login",
                CollectionFixture,
            )
            .unwrap();
        let client = connection::Builder::unix_stream(client_stream)
            .p2p()
            .build();
        let (server, client) = tokio::time::timeout(std::time::Duration::from_secs(5), async {
            tokio::try_join!(server.build(), client)
        })
        .await
        .expect("p2p fixture handshake timed out")
        .unwrap();
        (server, client)
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn test_keyring_plugin_creation() {
        let plugin = KeyringPlugin::new();
        assert_eq!(plugin.name(), "keyring");
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn test_capabilities() {
        let plugin = KeyringPlugin::new();
        let caps = plugin.capabilities();
        // KeyringPlugin capabilities from op_state::PluginCapabilities
        assert!(!caps.supports_rollback); // Security reasons - no rollback
        assert!(caps.supports_checkpoints);
        assert!(caps.supports_verification);
        assert!(!caps.atomic_operations);
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn secret_service_fixture_returns_collection_and_default() {
        let (_server, client) = fixture_connection(true).await;
        let plugin = KeyringPlugin::with_connection(client);
        let collections = plugin.get_collections().await.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(collections[0].label, "Login");
        assert!(!collections[0].locked);
        assert_eq!(
            plugin.get_default_collection().await.unwrap().as_deref(),
            Some("/org/freedesktop/secrets/collection/login")
        );
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn secret_service_failure_is_propagated() {
        let (server, client) = fixture_connection(true).await;
        drop(server);
        let plugin = KeyringPlugin::with_connection(client);
        assert!(plugin.get_collections().await.is_err());
        assert!(plugin.get_default_collection().await.is_err());
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn secret_service_missing_default_alias_is_none() {
        let (_server, client) = fixture_connection(false).await;
        let plugin = KeyringPlugin::with_connection(client);
        assert_eq!(plugin.get_default_collection().await.unwrap(), None);
    }
}

// Self-registration: the plugin registry discovers this via inventory
// (single source of the catalog; no central dispatch list).
inventory::submit! {
    crate::default_registry::PluginReg::new("keyring", |_ctx| std::sync::Arc::new(KeyringPlugin::new()))
}
</file>

<file path="op-plugins/src/state_plugins/large_language_model_methods.rs">
use anyhow::{anyhow, Context, Result};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use serde_json::Value;

use super::common::llm_projection::Provider;
use super::tched_router::{
    ChatInput, ChatOutput, GetStateOutput, ListModelsInput, ListModelsOutput, ListProvidersOutput,
    SetProviderInput, SetProviderOutput, SetSelectionInput, SetSelectionOutput,
};

pub const TARGET_PLUGIN_ID: &str = "tched_router";

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub struct TargetPlan {
    pub plugin_id: &'static str,
    pub method: &'static str,
    pub required_capability: String,
    pub args: Value,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct EmptyInput {}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct GetProviderOutput {
    pub selected_provider: String,
    pub provider: Provider,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct SelectionConfig {
    pub selected_provider: String,
    pub selected_model: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct GetConfigOutput {
    pub config: SelectionConfig,
}

pub fn target_method_for(method: &str) -> Option<&'static str> {
    match method {
        "list_providers" => Some("ListProviders"),
        "get_provider" | "get_config" => Some("GetState"),
        "set_provider" => Some("SetProvider"),
        "generate" => Some("Chat"),
        "stream_generate" => Some("start_generation"),
        "list_models" => Some("ListModels"),
        "update_config" => Some("SetSelection"),
        _ => None,
    }
}

/// Resolve the target capability from the owning schema. No capability string
/// is copied into this compatibility module.
pub fn target_capability(target_method: &str) -> Result<String> {
    let schema = super::tched_router::tched_router_schema();
    let declaration = schema.methods.get(target_method).ok_or_else(|| {
        anyhow!("tched_router schema does not declare target method '{target_method}'")
    })?;
    Ok(schema
        .resolve_method_capability(declaration)
        .capability()
        .to_string())
}

fn decode<T: serde::de::DeserializeOwned>(args: &Value, method: &str) -> Result<T> {
    serde_json::from_value(args.clone())
        .with_context(|| format!("invalid large_language_model.{method} arguments"))
}

fn reject_extra_keys(args: &Value, allowed: &[&str], method: &str) -> Result<()> {
    let object = args
        .as_object()
        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("large_language_model.{method} arguments must be an object"))?;
    if let Some(key) = object.keys().find(|key| !allowed.contains(&key.as_str())) {
        return Err(anyhow!(
            "large_language_model.{method} does not accept field '{key}'"
        ));
    }
    Ok(())
}

/// Validate a compatibility call and identify the exact canonical tched_router
/// operation and capability it requires.
///
/// The caller MUST run target-method admission against the same pinned
/// tched_router PluginSchema and verified identity before invoking this plan.
/// Possession of the outer large_language_model capability is not sufficient.
pub fn plan_method(method: &str, args: &Value) -> Result<TargetPlan> {
    let (target_method, target_args) = match method {
        "list_providers" => {
            reject_extra_keys(args, &[], method)?;
            let _: EmptyInput = decode(args, method)?;
            ("ListProviders", serde_json::json!({}))
        }
        "get_provider" => {
            reject_extra_keys(args, &[], method)?;
            let _: EmptyInput = decode(args, method)?;
            ("GetState", serde_json::json!({}))
        }
        "set_provider" => {
            reject_extra_keys(args, &["provider_id"], method)?;
            let input: SetProviderInput = decode(args, method)?;
            ("SetProvider", serde_json::to_value(input)?)
        }
        "generate" => {
            reject_extra_keys(args, &["message", "messages", "provider", "model"], method)?;
            let input: ChatInput = decode(args, method)?;
            ("Chat", serde_json::to_value(input)?)
        }
        "list_models" => {
            reject_extra_keys(args, &["provider"], method)?;
            let input: ListModelsInput = decode(args, method)?;
            ("ListModels", serde_json::to_value(input)?)
        }
        "get_config" => {
            reject_extra_keys(args, &[], method)?;
            let _: EmptyInput = decode(args, method)?;
            ("GetState", serde_json::json!({}))
        }
        "update_config" => {
            reject_extra_keys(args, &["provider_id", "model_id"], method)?;
            let input: SetSelectionInput = decode(args, method)?;
            ("SetSelection", serde_json::to_value(input)?)
        }
        "stream_generate" => {
            let input: super::tched_router::generation::StartGenerationInput =
                decode(args, method)?;
            input.validate()?;
            ("start_generation", serde_json::to_value(input)?)
        }
        other => return Err(anyhow!("unknown large_language_model method: {other}")),
    };
    Ok(TargetPlan {
        plugin_id: TARGET_PLUGIN_ID,
        method: target_method,
        required_capability: target_capability(target_method)?,
        args: target_args,
    })
}

/// Validate and shape the canonical target result for the compatibility caller.
/// This function has no state or side effects.
pub fn complete_method(method: &str, target_result: Value) -> Result<Value> {
    match method {
        "list_providers" => Ok(serde_json::to_value(
            serde_json::from_value::<ListProvidersOutput>(target_result)
                .context("tched_router.ListProviders returned an invalid result")?,
        )?),
        "get_provider" => {
            let state = serde_json::from_value::<GetStateOutput>(target_result)
                .context("tched_router.GetState returned an invalid result")?
                .state;
            let selected_provider = state.selected_provider;
            let mut matches = state
                .providers
                .into_iter()
                .filter(|provider| provider.id == selected_provider);
            let provider = matches.next().ok_or_else(|| {
                anyhow!(
                    "tched_router selected provider '{}' is absent from its observed catalog",
                    selected_provider
                )
            })?;
            if matches.next().is_some() {
                return Err(anyhow!(
                    "tched_router observed catalog contains duplicate provider id '{}'",
                    selected_provider
                ));
            }
            Ok(serde_json::to_value(GetProviderOutput {
                selected_provider,
                provider,
            })?)
        }
        "set_provider" => Ok(serde_json::to_value(
            serde_json::from_value::<SetProviderOutput>(target_result)
                .context("tched_router.SetProvider returned an invalid result")?,
        )?),
        "generate" => Ok(serde_json::to_value(
            serde_json::from_value::<ChatOutput>(target_result)
                .context("tched_router.Chat returned an invalid result")?,
        )?),
        "list_models" => Ok(serde_json::to_value(
            serde_json::from_value::<ListModelsOutput>(target_result)
                .context("tched_router.ListModels returned an invalid result")?,
        )?),
        "get_config" => {
            let state = serde_json::from_value::<GetStateOutput>(target_result)
                .context("tched_router.GetState returned an invalid result")?
                .state;
            Ok(serde_json::to_value(GetConfigOutput {
                config: SelectionConfig {
                    selected_provider: state.selected_provider,
                    selected_model: state.selected_model,
                },
            })?)
        }
        "update_config" => Ok(serde_json::to_value(
            serde_json::from_value::<SetSelectionOutput>(target_result)
                .context("tched_router.SetSelection returned an invalid result")?,
        )?),
        "stream_generate" => Ok(serde_json::to_value(
            serde_json::from_value::<super::tched_router::generation::GenerationMutationOutput>(
                target_result,
            )
            .context("tched_router generation returned an invalid receipt")?,
        )?),
        other => Err(anyhow!("unknown large_language_model method: {other}")),
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::state_plugins::tched_router::TchedRouterPlugin;

    #[test]
    fn plans_exact_target_methods_and_nested_capabilities() {
        let cases = [
            ("list_providers", serde_json::json!({}), "ListProviders"),
            ("get_provider", serde_json::json!({}), "GetState"),
            (
                "set_provider",
                serde_json::json!({"provider_id":"opencode"}),
                "SetProvider",
            ),
            ("generate", serde_json::json!({"message":"hello"}), "Chat"),
            (
                "list_models",
                serde_json::json!({"provider":"opencode"}),
                "ListModels",
            ),
            ("get_config", serde_json::json!({}), "GetState"),
            (
                "update_config",
                serde_json::json!({"provider_id":"opencode","model_id":"model"}),
                "SetSelection",
            ),
        ];
        for (method, args, target) in cases {
            let plan = plan_method(method, &args).unwrap();
            assert_eq!(plan.plugin_id, "tched_router");
            assert_eq!(plan.method, target);
            assert_eq!(plan.required_capability, target_capability(target).unwrap());
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn malformed_or_extra_inputs_never_produce_a_target_plan() {
        for (method, args) in [
            ("list_providers", serde_json::json!({"unexpected":true})),
            ("set_provider", serde_json::json!({})),
            (
                "set_provider",
                serde_json::json!({"provider_id":"x","extra":1}),
            ),
            ("generate", serde_json::json!({"messages":"not-an-array"})),
            ("update_config", serde_json::json!({"provider_id":"x"})),
        ] {
            assert!(
                plan_method(method, &args).is_err(),
                "{method} accepted {args}"
            );
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn stream_generate_requires_real_typed_input_and_nested_start_grant() {
        assert!(plan_method("stream_generate", &serde_json::json!({})).is_err());
        let plan = plan_method(
            "stream_generate",
            &serde_json::json!({"agent_alias":"fixture", "prompt":"hello"}),
        )
        .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(plan.method, "start_generation");
        assert_eq!(
            plan.required_capability,
            super::super::tched_router::generation::START_CAPABILITY
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn derived_reads_use_the_target_state_without_an_llm_state_store() {
        let state = TchedRouterPlugin::current_state();
        let selected = state.selected_provider.clone();
        let raw = serde_json::json!({"state": {
            "status": state.status,
            "selected_provider": state.selected_provider,
            "selected_model": state.selected_model,
            "providers": state.catalog.providers,
            "model_routes": state.catalog.model_routes,
        }});
        let provider = complete_method("get_provider", raw.clone()).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(provider["selected_provider"], selected);
        assert_eq!(provider["provider"]["id"], selected);

        let config = complete_method("get_config", raw).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(config["config"]["selected_provider"], selected);
        assert!(config["config"]["selected_model"].is_string());
    }

    #[test]
    fn malformed_target_results_fail_closed() {
        assert!(complete_method("list_providers", serde_json::json!({"providers":"bad"})).is_err());
        assert!(complete_method("get_provider", serde_json::json!({"state":{}})).is_err());
        assert!(complete_method("set_provider", serde_json::json!({"accepted":true})).is_err());
    }
}
</file>

<file path="op-plugins/src/state_plugins/large_language_model.rs">
//! Compatibility LLM surface backed exclusively by the canonical tched_router.
//!
//! This plugin owns only its facade method schema. Provider/model discovery,
//! selection, configuration, inference, and committed state remain owned by
//! tched_router.

use anyhow::Result;
use async_trait::async_trait;
use op_state::{ApplyResult, Checkpoint, DiffMetadata, PluginCapabilities, StateDiff, StatePlugin};
use op_state_store::{CapabilityDecl, PluginSchema, SideEffect};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use simd_json::OwnedValue as Value;

use super::large_language_model_methods::{EmptyInput, GetConfigOutput, GetProviderOutput};
use super::tched_router::{
    ChatInput, ChatOutput, ListModelsInput, ListModelsOutput, ListProvidersOutput,
    SetProviderInput, SetProviderOutput, SetSelectionInput, SetSelectionOutput,
};

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
#[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "sch.software.plugin.large-language-model.schema@v3"))]
#[schemars(extend("x-oscal-category" = "llm"))]
pub struct LargeLanguageModelState {}

pub struct LargeLanguageModelPlugin;

impl Default for LargeLanguageModelPlugin {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self
    }
}

impl LargeLanguageModelPlugin {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self
    }
    fn state() -> LargeLanguageModelState {
        LargeLanguageModelState {}
    }
}

#[async_trait]
impl StatePlugin for LargeLanguageModelPlugin {
    fn name(&self) -> &str {
        "large_language_model"
    }
    fn version(&self) -> &str {
        "3.0.0"
    }
    fn schema(&self) -> Option<PluginSchema> {
        let mut schema = large_language_model_schema();
        super::common::oscal::ensure_category_metadata_fields(&mut schema);
        Some(schema)
    }
    async fn calculate_diff(&self, _current: &Value, _desired: &Value) -> Result<StateDiff> {
        Ok(StateDiff {
            plugin: self.name().to_string(),
            actions: vec![],
            metadata: DiffMetadata {
                timestamp: chrono::Utc::now().timestamp(),
                current_hash: "facade".into(),
                desired_hash: "facade".into(),
            },
        })
    }
    async fn apply_state(&self, diff: &StateDiff) -> Result<ApplyResult> {
        anyhow::ensure!(
            diff.actions.is_empty(),
            "large_language_model has no independent state mutation surface"
        );
        Ok(ApplyResult {
            success: true,
            changes_applied: vec![],
            errors: vec![],
            checkpoint: None,
        })
    }
    async fn verify_state(&self, desired: &Value) -> Result<bool> {
        Ok(desired == &simd_json::serde::to_owned_value(Self::state())?)
    }
    async fn create_checkpoint(&self) -> Result<Checkpoint> {
        Ok(Checkpoint {
            id: uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string(),
            plugin: self.name().to_string(),
            timestamp: chrono::Utc::now().timestamp(),
            state_snapshot: simd_json::serde::to_owned_value(Self::state())?,
            backend_checkpoint: None,
        })
    }
    async fn rollback(&self, _checkpoint: &Checkpoint) -> Result<()> {
        anyhow::bail!("large_language_model has no independent rollback surface")
    }
    fn capabilities(&self) -> PluginCapabilities {
        PluginCapabilities {
            supports_rollback: false,
            supports_checkpoints: true,
            supports_verification: true,
            atomic_operations: false,
        }
    }
}

pub(crate) fn add_forwarded_method<Input: schemars::JsonSchema, Output: schemars::JsonSchema>(
    schema: &mut PluginSchema,
    target_schema: &PluginSchema,
    facade_name: &str,
    target_name: &str,
    subid: &str,
) {
    let target = target_schema
        .methods
        .get(target_name)
        .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("tched_router must declare {target_name}"));
    let capability = target_schema
        .resolve_method_capability(target)
        .capability()
        .to_string();
    let capability_decl = target_schema
        .capabilities
        .get(&capability)
        .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("tched_router must declare capability {capability}"))
        .clone();
    let mut declaration =
        super::plugin_scaffold_helpers::method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<Input, Output>(
            facade_name,
            target.side_effect.clone(),
            target.idempotent,
            &capability,
            subid,
        );
    // Some reused upstream input types predate deny_unknown_fields. The facade
    // rejects undeclared keys before producing a target plan, and its sealed
    // method schema must describe the same admission rule.
    let mut args: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(
        &simd_json::to_string(&declaration.args).expect("method arguments serialize"),
    )
    .expect("method arguments are JSON");
    args.as_object_mut()
        .expect("method arguments schema is an object")
        .insert(
            "additionalProperties".to_string(),
            serde_json::Value::Bool(false),
        );
    declaration.args = simd_json::serde::to_owned_value(args).expect("method arguments convert");
    schema.methods.insert(facade_name.to_string(), declaration);
    schema.capabilities.insert(capability, capability_decl);
}

pub(crate) fn large_language_model_schema() -> PluginSchema {
    let root = serde_json::to_value(schemars::schema_for!(LargeLanguageModelState))
        .expect("schema serializes");
    let mut schema = super::schemars_adapter::plugin_schema_from_json(
        "large_language_model", "3.0.0",
        "Compatibility LLM method surface; tched_router exclusively owns provider, model, configuration, inference, and state", &root);
    let state = simd_json::serde::to_owned_value(LargeLanguageModelPlugin::state())
        .expect("state serializes");
    super::schemars_adapter::apply_state_defaults(&mut schema, &state);
    schema.example = Some(state);
    schema.dependencies = vec!["tched_router".to_string()];
    let target = super::tched_router::tched_router_schema();

    add_forwarded_method::<EmptyInput, ListProvidersOutput>(
        &mut schema,
        &target,
        "list_providers",
        "ListProviders",
        "obs.service.llm.provider.list@v1",
    );
    add_forwarded_method::<EmptyInput, GetProviderOutput>(
        &mut schema,
        &target,
        "get_provider",
        "GetState",
        "obs.service.llm.provider.get@v1",
    );
    add_forwarded_method::<SetProviderInput, SetProviderOutput>(
        &mut schema,
        &target,
        "set_provider",
        "SetProvider",
        "mut.service.llm.provider.set@v1",
    );
    add_forwarded_method::<ChatInput, ChatOutput>(
        &mut schema,
        &target,
        "generate",
        "Chat",
        "mut.service.llm.generate@v1",
    );
    add_forwarded_method::<ListModelsInput, ListModelsOutput>(
        &mut schema,
        &target,
        "list_models",
        "ListModels",
        "obs.service.llm.model.list@v1",
    );
    add_forwarded_method::<EmptyInput, GetConfigOutput>(
        &mut schema,
        &target,
        "get_config",
        "GetState",
        "obs.service.llm.config.get@v1",
    );
    add_forwarded_method::<SetSelectionInput, SetSelectionOutput>(
        &mut schema,
        &target,
        "update_config",
        "SetSelection",
        "mut.service.llm.config.update@v1",
    );

    // The facade starts one canonical private tched_router generation job.
    // Existing StateSync subscriptions read committed job children.
    schema.methods.insert(
        "stream_generate".to_string(),
        super::plugin_scaffold_helpers::method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<
            super::tched_router::generation::StartGenerationInput,
            super::tched_router::generation::GenerationMutationOutput,
        >(
            "stream_generate",
            SideEffect::Mutation,
            false,
            "llm.invoke",
            "mut.service.llm.stream@v1",
        ),
    );
    schema.capabilities.insert(
        "llm.invoke".to_string(),
        CapabilityDecl {
            id: "llm.invoke".to_string(),
            description:
                "Invoke the generation facade; the exact nested tched_router start grant is also required."
                    .to_string(),
        },
    );
    schema
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn forwarded_capabilities_are_derived_from_target_methods() {
        let facade = large_language_model_schema();
        let target = super::super::tched_router::tched_router_schema();
        for (facade_name, target_name) in [
            ("list_providers", "ListProviders"),
            ("get_provider", "GetState"),
            ("set_provider", "SetProvider"),
            ("generate", "Chat"),
            ("list_models", "ListModels"),
            ("get_config", "GetState"),
            ("update_config", "SetSelection"),
        ] {
            let expected = target
                .resolve_method_capability(&target.methods[target_name])
                .capability()
                .to_string();
            assert_eq!(
                facade.methods[facade_name].required_capability.as_deref(),
                Some(expected.as_str())
            );
            assert!(facade.capabilities.contains_key(&expected));
            assert_eq!(
                facade.methods[facade_name].args["additionalProperties"],
                simd_json::json!(false)
            );
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn facade_has_no_provider_or_model_state_authority() {
        let schema = large_language_model_schema();
        assert_eq!(schema.version, "3.0.0");
        assert!(schema.fields.is_empty());
        assert_eq!(schema.dependencies, vec!["tched_router"]);
    }

    #[test]
    fn stream_resolves_to_the_canonical_private_job_owner() {
        assert!(
            super::super::large_language_model_methods::target_method_for("stream_generate")
                == Some("start_generation")
        );
    }
}

inventory::submit! {
    crate::default_registry::PluginReg::new("large_language_model", |_ctx| std::sync::Arc::new(LargeLanguageModelPlugin::new()))
}
</file>

<file path="op-plugins/src/state_plugins/login1.rs">
//! Login/session management through the upstream login1 D-Bus interface.

mod methods;
pub use methods::*;

use anyhow::Result;
use async_trait::async_trait;
use op_state::{
    ApplyResult, Checkpoint, DiffMetadata, PluginCapabilities, StateAction, StateDiff, StatePlugin,
};
use op_state_store::{FieldSchema, FieldType, PluginSchema};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use simd_json::{json, OwnedValue as Value};
use zbus::zvariant::OwnedObjectPath;
use zbus::{Connection, Proxy};

/// Login1 state containing active sessions.
/// See: https://www.freedesktop.org/wiki/Software/systemd/Login1/
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct Login1State {
    /// Active login sessions
    pub sessions: Vec<SessionInfo>,
}

/// Login1 session information.
/// See: https://www.freedesktop.org/wiki/Software/systemd/Login1/
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct SessionInfo {
    /// Session ID
    pub id: String,
    /// User ID
    pub uid: u32,
    /// Username
    pub user: String,
    /// Seat name
    pub seat: String,
    /// Session object path
    pub path: String,
}

pub struct Login1Plugin;

impl Login1Plugin {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self
    }

    async fn connect_manager(&self) -> Result<Proxy<'static>> {
        let conn = Connection::system().await?;
        let p = Proxy::new(
            &conn,
            "org.freedesktop.login1",
            "/org/freedesktop/login1",
            "org.freedesktop.login1.Manager",
        )
        .await?;
        Ok(p)
    }
}

impl Default for Login1Plugin {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}

#[async_trait]
impl StatePlugin for Login1Plugin {
    fn name(&self) -> &str {
        "login1"
    }
    fn version(&self) -> &str {
        "2.0.0"
    }

    fn schema(&self) -> Option<PluginSchema> {
        Some(login1_schema())
    }

    async fn calculate_diff(&self, current: &Value, desired: &Value) -> Result<StateDiff> {
        let actions = if current != desired {
            vec![StateAction::Modify {
                resource: "login1".into(),
                changes: desired.clone(),
            }]
        } else {
            vec![]
        };
        Ok(StateDiff {
            plugin: self.name().to_string(),
            actions,
            metadata: DiffMetadata {
                timestamp: chrono::Utc::now().timestamp(),
                current_hash: format!("{:x}", md5::compute(simd_json::to_string(current)?)),
                desired_hash: format!("{:x}", md5::compute(simd_json::to_string(desired)?)),
            },
        })
    }

    async fn apply_state(&self, _diff: &StateDiff) -> Result<ApplyResult> {
        Ok(ApplyResult {
            success: true,
            changes_applied: vec!["read-only".into()],
            errors: vec![],
            checkpoint: None,
        })
    }

    async fn verify_state(&self, _desired: &Value) -> Result<bool> {
        Ok(true)
    }

    async fn create_checkpoint(&self) -> Result<Checkpoint> {
        Ok(Checkpoint {
            id: format!("login1-{}", chrono::Utc::now().timestamp()),
            plugin: self.name().into(),
            timestamp: chrono::Utc::now().timestamp(),
            state_snapshot: json!({}),
            backend_checkpoint: None,
        })
    }

    async fn rollback(&self, _checkpoint: &Checkpoint) -> Result<()> {
        Ok(())
    }

    fn capabilities(&self) -> PluginCapabilities {
        PluginCapabilities {
            supports_rollback: false,
            supports_checkpoints: false,
            supports_verification: false,
            atomic_operations: false,
        }
    }
}

<file path="op-plugins/src/state_plugins/mail_server.rs">
//! Mail server state plugin - manages Incus mail container and D-Bus registration.
//!
//! Tracks Postfix/Dovecot runtime state, Unix socket endpoints for Xray routing,
//! and exposes mail configuration as a D-Bus object via zbus.

#[path = "mail_server/methods.rs"]
pub mod methods;
#[path = "mail_server/native_owner.rs"]
pub mod native_owner;

use anyhow::{Context, Result};
use async_trait::async_trait;
use op_state::{ApplyResult, Checkpoint, DiffMetadata, PluginCapabilities, StateDiff, StatePlugin};
use op_state_store::{FieldSchema, PluginSchema};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use simd_json::prelude::*;
use simd_json::{json, OwnedValue as Value};
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::time::Duration;
use tokio::io::{AsyncReadExt, AsyncWriteExt};

/// Top-level state for the mail server plugin.
/// See: https://doc.dovecot.org/configuration_manual/references/
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema, Default)]
pub struct MailServerState {
    /// Incus container name running the mail stack
    pub container_name: String,
    /// Container status: "Running", "Stopped", "Frozen"
    pub container_status: String,
    /// Primary mail domain
    pub domain: String,
    /// Unix socket path for Xray naive routing integration
    pub xray_socket_path: String,
    /// D-Bus service name registered for this mail instance
    pub dbus_service_name: String,
    /// Active mail service endpoints
    pub endpoints: MailEndpoints,
    /// Container IPv4 address
    pub container_ip: Option<String>,
    /// Whether the mail stack is healthy
    pub healthy: bool,
    /// Last error message if unhealthy
    pub last_error: Option<String>,
    /// Additional container devices (unix socket mounts, etc.)
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub devices: Option<HashMap<String, HashMap<String, String>>>,
    /// Administration state observed from the native Postfix/Dovecot owner.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub administration: MailAdministrationState,
}

/// Mail protocol endpoints.
/// See: https://doc.dovecot.org/configuration_manual/references/
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, Default, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct MailEndpoints {
    /// SMTP submission port (587)
    pub smtp_submission: Option<String>,
    /// SMTP TLS port (465)
    pub smtp_tls: Option<String>,
    /// IMAP port (143)
    pub imap: Option<String>,
    /// IMAPS port (993)
    pub imaps: Option<String>,
    /// Dovecot LDA/LMTP unix socket inside container
    pub dovecot_lmtp: Option<String>,
    /// Postfix pickup unix socket inside container
    pub postfix_pickup: Option<String>,
}

pub struct MailServerPlugin;

impl MailServerPlugin {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self
    }

    /// Default state for 3tched.com mail stack
    pub fn declared_state() -> MailServerState {
        MailServerState {
            container_name: "mail-3tched".to_string(),
            container_status: "Unknown".to_string(),
            domain: "3tched.com".to_string(),
            xray_socket_path: "/run/xray/mail-naive.sock".to_string(),
            dbus_service_name: "org.opdbus.MailServer.3tched".to_string(),
            endpoints: MailEndpoints {
                smtp_submission: Some("0.0.0.0:587".to_string()),
                smtp_tls: Some("0.0.0.0:465".to_string()),
                imap: Some("0.0.0.0:143".to_string()),
                imaps: Some("0.0.0.0:993".to_string()),
                dovecot_lmtp: Some("/var/spool/postfix/private/dovecot-lmtp".to_string()),
                postfix_pickup: Some("/var/spool/postfix/private/pickup".to_string()),
            },
            container_ip: None,
            healthy: false,
            last_error: None,
            devices: None,
            administration: MailAdministrationState::default(),
        }
    }

    /// Minimal HTTP-over-UnixSocket helper for Incus REST API
    async fn incus_api_get(path: &str) -> Result<simd_json::OwnedValue> {
        let socket_path = "/var/lib/incus/unix.socket";
        if !std::path::Path::new(socket_path).exists() {
            return Err(anyhow::anyhow!(
                "Incus Unix socket not found at {}",
                socket_path
            ));
        }

        let mut stream = tokio::net::UnixStream::connect(socket_path)
            .await
            .context("Failed to connect to Incus Unix socket")?;

        let request = format!(
            "GET {} HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: localhost\r\nAccept: application/json\r\n\r\n",
            path
        );
        stream.write_all(request.as_bytes()).await?;

        let mut response = Vec::new();
        let mut buf = [0u8; 4096];
        loop {
            match tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_millis(500), stream.read(&mut buf)).await {
                Ok(Ok(0)) => break,
                Ok(Ok(n)) => response.extend_from_slice(&buf[..n]),
                Ok(Err(e)) => return Err(e.into()),
                Err(_) => break,
            }
        }

        let body_start = if let Some(idx) = response.windows(4).position(|w| w == b"\r\n\r\n") {
            idx + 4
        } else if let Some(idx) = response.windows(2).position(|w| w == b"\n\n") {
            idx + 2
        } else {
            return Ok(simd_json::json!({}));
        };

        let mut body = response[body_start..].to_vec();
        let headers = std::str::from_utf8(&response[..body_start]).unwrap_or("");
        if headers
            .to_lowercase()
            .contains("transfer-encoding: chunked")
        {
            let mut decoded = Vec::new();
            let mut pos = 0;
            while pos < body.len() {
                let mut line_end = pos;
                while line_end < body.len() && body[line_end] != b'\n' {
                    line_end += 1;
                }
                if line_end >= body.len() {
                    break;
                }
                let line = std::str::from_utf8(&body[pos..line_end])
                    .unwrap_or("")
                    .trim();
                let size = usize::from_str_radix(line.split(';').next().unwrap_or("0").trim(), 16)
                    .unwrap_or(0);
                if size == 0 {
                    break;
                }
                pos = line_end + 1;
                if pos < body.len() && body[pos] == b'\r' {
                    pos += 1;
                }
                decoded.extend_from_slice(&body[pos..pos + size]);
                pos += size;
                if pos < body.len() && body[pos] == b'\r' {
                    pos += 1;
                }
                if pos < body.len() && body[pos] == b'\n' {
                    pos += 1;
                }
            }
            body = decoded;
        }

        let mut raw = body;
        let val: simd_json::OwnedValue =
            simd_json::from_slice(&mut raw).context("Failed to parse Incus API response")?;
        let metadata = val.get("metadata").cloned().unwrap_or(simd_json::json!({}));
        Ok(metadata)
    }

    /// Query incus for container status via REST API (AGENTS.md §4: no subprocess bypasses)
    async fn query_container_status(&self, name: &str) -> Result<(String, Option<String>)> {
        let inst = Self::incus_api_get(&format!("/1.0/instances/{}?recursion=1", name)).await?;

        let status = inst
            .get("status")
            .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
            .unwrap_or("Unknown")
            .to_string();

        let ip = inst
            .get("state")
            .and_then(|s| s.get("network"))
            .and_then(|n| n.get("eth0"))
            .and_then(|e| e.get("addresses"))
            .and_then(|a| a.as_array())
            .and_then(|addrs| {
                addrs.iter().find_map(|addr| {
                    if addr.get("family")?.as_str()? == "inet" {
                        addr.get("address")?.as_str().map(String::from)
                    } else {
                        None
                    }
                })
            });

        Ok((status, ip))
    }

    /// Check if container is Running as a proxy for mail health
    /// (AGENTS.md §4: incus exec is a subprocess bypass; we use container state instead)
    async fn check_mail_health(&self, container: &str) -> (bool, Option<String>) {
        match Self::incus_api_get(&format!("/1.0/instances/{}?recursion=1", container)).await {
            Ok(inst) => {
                let status = inst
                    .get("status")
                    .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
                    .unwrap_or("Unknown");
                if status == "Running" {
                    (true, None)
                } else {
                    let err = format!("container_status={}", status);
                    (false, Some(err))
                }
            }
            Err(e) => {
                let err = format!("failed to query container: {}", e);
                (false, Some(err))
            }
        }
    }
}

impl Default for MailServerPlugin {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}

#[async_trait]
impl StatePlugin for MailServerPlugin {
    fn metadata(&self) -> op_state::PluginMetadata {
        op_state::PluginMetadata {
            name: self.name().to_string(),
            version: self.version().to_string(),
            description: "Postfix/Dovecot state and native D-Bus administration for mail-3tched"
                .to_string(),
            author: None,
            license: None,
            dependencies: vec![
                "incus".to_string(),
                "postfix".to_string(),
                "dovecot".to_string(),
                "unix_socket".to_string(),
            ],
            dbus_services: vec!["org.opdbus.MailServer.3tched".to_string()],
            feature_schemas: vec![],
            object_schemas: std::collections::HashMap::new(),
        }
    }

    fn name(&self) -> &str {
        "mail_server"
    }

    fn version(&self) -> &str {
        "2.0.0"
    }

    fn schema(&self) -> Option<op_state_store::PluginSchema> {
        Some(mail_server_schema())
    }

    async fn calculate_diff(&self, _current: &Value, _desired: &Value) -> Result<StateDiff> {
        Ok(StateDiff {
            plugin: self.name().to_string(),
            actions: vec![],
            metadata: DiffMetadata {
                timestamp: chrono::Utc::now().timestamp(),
                current_hash: "unknown".to_string(),
                desired_hash: "unknown".to_string(),
            },
        })
    }

    async fn apply_state(&self, _diff: &StateDiff) -> Result<ApplyResult> {
        Ok(ApplyResult {
            success: true,
            changes_applied: vec![],
            errors: vec![],
            checkpoint: None,
        })
    }

    async fn verify_state(&self, _desired: &Value) -> Result<bool> {
        Ok(true)
    }

    async fn create_checkpoint(&self) -> Result<Checkpoint> {
        Ok(Checkpoint {
            id: uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string(),
            plugin: self.name().to_string(),
            timestamp: chrono::Utc::now().timestamp(),
            state_snapshot: Value::null(),
            backend_checkpoint: None,
        })
    }

    async fn rollback(&self, _checkpoint: &Checkpoint) -> Result<()> {
        Ok(())
    }

    fn capabilities(&self) -> PluginCapabilities {
        PluginCapabilities {
            supports_rollback: false,
            supports_checkpoints: true,
            supports_verification: true,
            atomic_operations: false,
        }
    }
}

pub(crate) fn mail_server_schema() -> PluginSchema {
    use op_state_store::FieldType;

    let endpoint_fields = {
        let mut fields = HashMap::new();
        fields.insert(
            "smtp_submission".to_string(),
            FieldSchema {
                field_type: FieldType::String,
                required: false,
                description: "SMTP submission endpoint (port 587)".to_string(),
                default: Some(json!("0.0.0.0:587")),
                example: None,
                constraints: Vec::new(),
                read_only: false,
                read_only_when: None,
            },
        );
        fields.insert(
            "smtp_tls".to_string(),
            FieldSchema {
                field_type: FieldType::String,
                required: false,
                description: "SMTP TLS endpoint (port 465)".to_string(),
                default: Some(json!("0.0.0.0:465")),
                example: None,
                constraints: Vec::new(),
                read_only: false,
                read_only_when: None,
            },
        );
        fields.insert(
            "imap".to_string(),
            FieldSchema {
                field_type: FieldType::String,
                required: false,
                description: "IMAP endpoint (port 143)".to_string(),
                default: Some(json!("0.0.0.0:143")),
                example: None,
                constraints: Vec::new(),
                read_only: false,
                read_only_when: None,
            },
        );
        fields.insert(
            "imaps".to_string(),
            FieldSchema {
                field_type: FieldType::String,
                required: false,
                description: "IMAPS endpoint (port 993)".to_string(),
                default: Some(json!("0.0.0.0:993")),
                example: None,
                constraints: Vec::new(),
                read_only: false,
                read_only_when: None,
            },
        );
        fields.insert(
            "dovecot_lmtp".to_string(),
            FieldSchema {
                field_type: FieldType::String,
                required: false,
                description: "Dovecot LMTP unix socket path inside container".to_string(),
                default: Some(json!("/var/spool/postfix/private/dovecot-lmtp")),
                example: None,
                constraints: Vec::new(),
                read_only: false,
                read_only_when: None,
            },
        );
        fields.insert(
            "postfix_pickup".to_string(),
            FieldSchema {
                field_type: FieldType::String,
                required: false,
                description: "Postfix pickup unix socket path inside container".to_string(),

                example: None,
                constraints: Vec::new(),
                read_only: false,
                read_only_when: None,
            },
        );
        fields
    };

    let mut schema = PluginSchema::builder("mail_server")
        .category("service")
        .version("2.0.0")
        .description(
            "Postfix/Dovecot mail administration through the mail-3tched native D-Bus owner",
        )
        .dependency("incus")
        .dependency("unix_socket")
        .field(
            "container_name",
            FieldSchema {
                field_type: FieldType::String,
                required: true,
                description: "Incus container name running the mail stack".to_string(),
                default: Some(json!("mail-3tched")),
                example: None,
                constraints: Vec::new(),
                read_only: false,
                read_only_when: None,
            },
        )
        .field(
            "container_status",
            FieldSchema {
                field_type: FieldType::String,
                required: true,
                description: "Container runtime status".to_string(),
                default: Some(json!("Unknown")),
                example: None,
                constraints: Vec::new(),
                read_only: true,
                read_only_when: None,

        )
        .field(

                constraints: Vec::new(),

        .field(

            FieldSchema {
                field_type: FieldType::String,
                required: true,
                description: "Unix socket path for Xray naive routing integration".to_string(),
                default: Some(json!("/run/xray/mail-naive.sock")),
                example: None,
                constraints: Vec::new(),
                read_only: false,

        .field(

            FieldSchema {

                required: true,
                description: "Active mail service endpoints".to_string(),
                default: Some(json!({})),
                example: None,

        .field(
            "healthy",
            FieldSchema {
                field_type: FieldType::Boolean,

                example: None,

        .field(
            "last_error",

                field_type: FieldType::String,
                required: false,
                description: "Last error message if unhealthy".to_string(),

                example: None,
                constraints: Vec::new(),

        .example(json!({

            "container_status": "Running",
            "domain": "3tched.com",
            "xray_socket_path": "/run/xray/mail-naive.sock",

    let derived_state = super::schemars_adapter::plugin_schema_from_json(

        "2.0.0",

    administration.read_only = true;
    administration.description =

    schema

    schema.methods.insert(

    schema.methods.insert(

            "RemoveMailbox",
            op_state_store::SideEffect::Mutation,

        ),

    schema.methods.insert(
        "add_alias".to_string(),
        super::plugin_scaffold_helpers::method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<

            AliasMutationOutput,
        >(
            "AddAlias",
            op_state_store::SideEffect::Mutation,

        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(

        super::plugin_scaffold_helpers::method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<
            RemoveAliasInput,
            AliasMutationOutput,
        >(
            "RemoveAlias",
            op_state_store::SideEffect::Mutation,
            false,
            "mail.write",
            "mut.service.mail.alias.remove@v1",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "set_quota".to_string(),
        super::plugin_scaffold_helpers::method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<
            QuotaInput,
            QuotaMutationOutput,
        >(
            "SetQuota",
            op_state_store::SideEffect::Mutation,
            false,
            "mail.write",
            "mut.service.mail.quota.set@v1",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "get_queue".to_string(),
        super::plugin_scaffold_helpers::method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<
            super::plugin_scaffold_helpers::EmptyInput,
            GetQueueOutput,
        >(
            "GetQueue",
            op_state_store::SideEffect::Read,
            true,
            "mail.read",
            "obs.service.mail.queue.get@v1",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "flush_queue".to_string(),

            "FlushQueue",

    );
    schema.capabilities.insert(
        "mail.write".to_string(),
        op_state_store::CapabilityDecl {
            id: "mail.write".to_string(),
            description: "Grants: add_domain, remove_domain, add_mailbox, remove_mailbox, add_alias, remove_alias, set_quota, flush_queue.".to_string(),
        },
    );
    schema.capabilities.insert(
        "mail.read".to_string(),
        op_state_store::CapabilityDecl {
            id: "mail.read".to_string(),
            description: "Grants: get_queue, connect.".to_string(),
        },
    );

    schema
}

// Self-registration: the plugin registry discovers this via inventory
// (single source of the catalog; no central dispatch list).
inventory::submit! {
    crate::default_registry::PluginReg::new("mail_server", |_ctx| std::sync::Arc::new(MailServerPlugin::new()))
}

<file path="op-plugins/src/state_plugins/mcp_methods.rs">
//! Authenticated compatibility facade for the native tched_router MCP section.

use anyhow::{anyhow, ensure, Context, Result};
use serde_json::Value;

use crate::state_plugins::tched_router::{
    ConfigPatchInput, ConfigPatchOperation, ConfigPatchOutput,
};
use crate::state_plugins::tched_router_config_surface::{ConfigMethodInput, GetMcpConfigOutput};

pub struct McpMethodPlan {
    pub target_method: &'static str,
    pub required_capability: String,
    pub args: Value,
}

fn target_capability(method: &str) -> Result<String> {
    let schema = crate::state_plugins::tched_router::tched_router_schema();
    let declaration = schema
        .methods
        .get(method)
        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("tched_router does not declare '{method}'"))?;
    Ok(schema
        .resolve_method_capability(declaration)
        .capability()
        .to_string())
}

fn valid_segment(segment: &str) -> bool {
    !segment.is_empty()
        && segment
            .bytes()
            .all(|b| b.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || matches!(b, b'_' | b'-'))
}

fn validate_server_path(path: &str) -> Result<()> {
    ensure!(
        path.starts_with('/'),
        "MCP server patch path must be a JSON pointer"
    );
    ensure!(path.len() <= 256, "MCP server patch path is too long");
    let segments: Vec<&str> = path[1..].split('/').collect();
    ensure!(
        segments.len() >= 4
            && segments[0] == "mcp"
            && segments[1] == "servers"
            && segments.iter().all(|segment| valid_segment(segment)),
        "MCP server patches must target /mcp/servers/<server> or a descendant"
    );
    Ok(())
}

fn patch_path(operation: &ConfigPatchOperation) -> &str {
    match operation {
        ConfigPatchOperation::Add { path, .. }
        | ConfigPatchOperation::Remove { path }
        | ConfigPatchOperation::Replace { path, .. }
        | ConfigPatchOperation::Test { path, .. } => path,
    }
}

pub fn plan_method(method: &str, args: &Value) -> Result<McpMethodPlan> {
    match method {
        "get_config" => {
            let _: ConfigMethodInput =
                serde_json::from_value(args.clone()).context("invalid mcp.get_config arguments")?;
            Ok(McpMethodPlan {
                target_method: "GetMcpConfig",
                required_capability: target_capability("GetMcpConfig")?,
                args: args.clone(),
            })
        }
        "configure_server" => {
            let input: ConfigPatchInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())
                .context("invalid mcp.configure_server arguments")?;
            ensure!(
                !input.operations.is_empty() && input.operations.len() <= 64,
                "mcp.configure_server requires 1..=64 operations"
            );
            for operation in &input.operations {
                validate_server_path(patch_path(operation))?;
            }
            Ok(McpMethodPlan {
                target_method: "PatchConfig",
                required_capability: target_capability("PatchConfig")?,
                args: args.clone(),
            })
        }
        "configure_tool_groups" => Err(anyhow!(
            "mcp.configure_tool_groups is owned by the bridge MCP projection policy"
        )),
        other => Err(anyhow!("unknown mcp method: {other}")),
    }
}

pub fn complete_method(method: &str, result: Value) -> Result<Value> {
    match method {
        "get_config" => Ok(serde_json::to_value(
            serde_json::from_value::<GetMcpConfigOutput>(result)
                .context("tched_router.GetMcpConfig returned an invalid result")?,
        )?),
        "configure_server" => Ok(serde_json::to_value(
            serde_json::from_value::<ConfigPatchOutput>(result)
                .context("tched_router.PatchConfig returned an invalid result")?,
        )?),
        "configure_tool_groups" => Err(anyhow!(
            "mcp.configure_tool_groups is completed by the bridge MCP projection policy"
        )),
        other => Err(anyhow!("unknown mcp method: {other}")),
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn patch(path: &str) -> Value {
        serde_json::json!({"operations": [{"op": "replace", "path": path, "value": "x"}]})
    }

    #[test]
    fn server_patch_targets_native_router_and_retains_args() {
        let args = patch("/mcp/servers/demo/command");
        let plan = plan_method("configure_server", &args).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(plan.target_method, "PatchConfig");
        assert_eq!(plan.args, args);
    }

    #[test]
    fn server_path_requires_exact_root_and_segments() {
        for path in [
            "/mcp/servers",
            "/mcp/servers/demo",
            "/fake/mcp/servers/demo/command",
            "/mcp/servers/demo/command/",
            "/mcp/servers//command",
            "/mcp/servers/demo/bad space",
            "/mcp/servers/demo/command.name",
        ] {
            assert!(
                plan_method("configure_server", &patch(path)).is_err(),
                "{path}"
            );
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn server_property_is_allowed_and_unknown_fields_are_rejected() {
        assert!(plan_method("configure_server", &patch("/mcp/servers/demo/url")).is_ok());
        assert!(plan_method(
            "configure_server",
            &serde_json::json!({"operations": [], "extra": true})
        )
        .is_err());
        assert!(plan_method(
            "configure_server",
            &serde_json::json!({"operations": [{"op": "replace", "path": "/mcp/servers_evil/demo", "value": "x"}]})
        )
        .is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn patch_count_is_bounded() {
        let args = serde_json::json!({"operations": []});
        assert!(plan_method("configure_server", &args).is_err());

        let operations = (0..65)
            .map(|_| serde_json::json!({"op": "remove", "path": "/mcp/servers/demo/url"}))
            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
        assert!(plan_method(
            "configure_server",
            &serde_json::json!({"operations": operations})
        )
        .is_err());
    }
}
</file>

<file path="op-plugins/src/state_plugins/mcp.rs">
//! Native tched_router MCP server facade plus the bridge-owned public gateway
//! toolset policy.

use crate::state_plugins::plugin_scaffold_helpers::method_decl_from_schemars_with_output;
use anyhow::Result;
use async_trait::async_trait;
use op_state::{ApplyResult, Checkpoint, PluginCapabilities, StateDiff, StatePlugin};
use op_state_store::{PluginSchema, SideEffect, StateStore};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use simd_json::OwnedValue as Value;
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::sync::Arc;

#[path = "mcp_methods.rs"]
pub mod methods;

/// MCP configuration schema - mirrors the state JSON structure
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct McpConfig {
    /// External MCP servers indexed by name
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub servers: Option<HashMap<String, McpServerConfig>>,

    /// Tool groups configuration
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
