/// MCP state plugin
pub struct McpStatePlugin {
    // Retained for constructor compatibility. Native ownership belongs to
    // tched_router; this facade never reads or writes either value.
    _state_store: Arc<dyn op_state_store::StateStore>,
    _config_path: String,
}

impl McpStatePlugin {
    pub fn new(state_store: Arc<dyn StateStore>, config_path: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
        Self {
            _state_store: state_store,
            _config_path: config_path.into(),
        }
    }
}

// ── Schema-only borrowed view of the native tched_router MCP section ──

fn default_empty_object() -> serde_json::Value {
    serde_json::json!({})
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "sch.software.plugin.mcp.schema@v1"))]
#[schemars(extend("x-oscal-category" = "service"))]
pub struct McpState {
    #[serde(default = "default_empty_object")]
    #[schemars(
        description = "Native tched_router mcp configuration",
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "exp.software.plugin.mcp.config@v2")
    )]
    config: serde_json::Value,
    /// Canonical gateway projection policy, updated only by
    /// configure_tool_groups after durable readback and live owner swap.
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    toolsets: Option<ConfigureToolGroupsOutput>,
}

pub(crate) fn mcp_schema() -> PluginSchema {
    let root = serde_json::to_value(schemars::schema_for!(McpState))
        .expect("schemars schema serializes to JSON");
    let mut schema = super::schemars_adapter::plugin_schema_from_json(
        "mcp",
        "3.0.0",
        "MCP server and tool-group configuration",
        &root,
    );
    schema
        .fields
        .get_mut("config")
        .expect("MCP config field exists")
        .field_type =
        op_state_store::FieldType::exact_json_schema(super::tched_router_contract::section("mcp"))
            .expect("native MCP section is a self-contained exact schema");
    schema.dependencies = vec!["tched_router".to_string()];

    let native = super::tched_router::tched_router_schema();
    let mut get_config = native.methods["GetMcpConfig"].clone();
    get_config.name = "get_config".to_string();
    get_config.required_capability = Some("mcp.read".to_string());
    get_config.subid = "obs.software.plugin.mcp.config.get@v2".to_string();
    schema.methods.insert("get_config".to_string(), get_config);
    let mut configure_server = native.methods["PatchConfig"].clone();
    configure_server.name = "configure_server".to_string();
    configure_server.required_capability = Some("mcp.write".to_string());
    configure_server.subid = "mut.software.plugin.mcp.server.configure@v2".to_string();
    schema
        .methods
        .insert("configure_server".to_string(), configure_server);
    schema.methods.insert(
        "configure_tool_groups".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<
            ConfigureToolGroupsInput,
            ConfigureToolGroupsOutput,
        >(
            "configure_tool_groups",
            SideEffect::Mutation,
            true,
            "mcp.write",
            "mut.software.plugin.mcp.tool-groups.configure@v1",
        ),
    );

    schema.capabilities.insert(
        "mcp.read".to_string(),
        op_state_store::CapabilityDecl {
            id: "mcp.read".to_string(),
            description: "Grants: get_config.".to_string(),
        },
    );
    schema.capabilities.insert(
        "mcp.write".to_string(),
        op_state_store::CapabilityDecl {
            id: "mcp.write".to_string(),
            description: "Grants: configure_server, configure_tool_groups.".to_string(),
        },
    );

    schema
}

#[async_trait]
impl StatePlugin for McpStatePlugin {
    fn name(&self) -> &str {
        "mcp"
    }

    fn version(&self) -> &str {
        "3.0.0"
    }

    fn schema(&self) -> Option<op_state_store::PluginSchema> {
        Some(mcp_schema())
    }

    async fn calculate_diff(&self, current: &Value, desired: &Value) -> Result<StateDiff> {
        let _ = (current, desired);
        anyhow::bail!("mcp facade has no local diff owner; use tched_router PatchConfig")
    }

    async fn apply_state(&self, diff: &StateDiff) -> Result<ApplyResult> {
        let _ = diff;
        anyhow::bail!("mcp facade has no local apply owner; use tched_router PatchConfig")
    }

    async fn verify_state(&self, _desired: &Value) -> Result<bool> {
        anyhow::bail!("mcp facade has no local verification owner; use tched_router readback")
    }

    async fn create_checkpoint(&self) -> Result<Checkpoint> {
        anyhow::bail!("mcp facade has no local checkpoint owner")
    }

    async fn rollback(&self, _checkpoint: &Checkpoint) -> Result<()> {
        anyhow::bail!("mcp facade has no local rollback owner")
    }

    fn capabilities(&self) -> PluginCapabilities {
        PluginCapabilities {
            supports_rollback: false,
            supports_checkpoints: false,
            supports_verification: false,
            atomic_operations: false,
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::state_plugins::common::oscal::validate_subid;
    use op_state_store::MemoryStore;
    use serde_json::Value as JVal;

    fn collect_subids(node: &JVal, out: &mut Vec<String>) {
        if let Some(subid) = node.get("x-oscal-subid").and_then(JVal::as_str) {
            out.push(subid.to_string());
        }
        if let Some(props) = node.get("properties").and_then(JVal::as_object) {
            for v in props.values() {
                collect_subids(v, out);
            }
        }
        if let Some(defs) = node
            .get("$defs")
            .or_else(|| node.get("definitions"))
            .and_then(JVal::as_object)
        {
            for v in defs.values() {
                collect_subids(v, out);
            }
        }
        if let Some(items) = node.get("items") {
            collect_subids(items, out);
        }
        if let Some(alternatives) = node
            .get("anyOf")
            .or_else(|| node.get("oneOf"))
            .and_then(JVal::as_array)
        {
            for v in alternatives {
                collect_subids(v, out);
            }
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn should_publish_plugin_owned_mcp_schema() {
        let store = Arc::new(MemoryStore::new());
        let plugin = McpStatePlugin::new(store, "/tmp/test-mcp-schema.json");
        let schema = plugin.schema().expect("mcp schema");

        assert_eq!(schema.name, "mcp");
        assert_eq!(schema.version, "3.0.0");
        assert!(schema.fields.contains_key("config"));
        assert_eq!(schema.dependencies, vec!["tched_router".to_string()]);
    }

    #[test]
    fn native_method_contracts_are_cloned_before_facade_renames() {
        let native = crate::state_plugins::tched_router::tched_router_schema();
        let facade = mcp_schema();
        for (facade_name, native_name) in [
            ("get_config", "GetMcpConfig"),
            ("configure_server", "PatchConfig"),
        ] {
            let lhs = &facade.methods[facade_name];
            let rhs = &native.methods[native_name];
            assert_eq!(lhs.args, rhs.args);
            assert_eq!(lhs.returns, rhs.returns);
            assert_eq!(lhs.side_effect, rhs.side_effect);
            assert_eq!(lhs.idempotent, rhs.idempotent);
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn all_subids_are_valid() {
        let raw = serde_json::to_value(schemars::schema_for!(McpState)).unwrap();
        let mut subids = Vec::new();
        collect_subids(&raw, &mut subids);
        assert!(
            !subids.is_empty(),
            "expected at least one x-oscal-subid in the derived schema"
        );
        for subid in subids {
            validate_subid(&subid).expect("invalid subid: {subid}");
        }
    }
}

// Self-registration: the plugin registry discovers this via inventory
// (single source of the catalog; no central dispatch list).
inventory::submit! {
    crate::default_registry::PluginReg::new("mcp", |ctx| std::sync::Arc::new(McpStatePlugin::new(ctx.state_store(), ctx.config_path("mcp", "/etc/op-dbus/mcp-config.json"))))
}
</file>

<file path="op-plugins/src/state_plugins/memory_methods.rs">
//! Durable method adapter for the `memory` plugin.
//!
//! The plugin schema remains in `memory_plugin.rs`. This module stores only
//! caller-scoped mutable domain data in the existing Cozo runtime-document
//! relation and never publishes entry contents to projections or logs.

use std::collections::BTreeMap;
use std::sync::Arc;

use anyhow::{bail, ensure, Context, Result};
use op_cozo_store::CozoGraphShuttle;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use serde_json::Value;
use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};

#[cfg(test)]
use serde_json::json;

use super::memory_plugin::{
    ClearNamespaceInput, ClearNamespaceOutput, CompactOutput, CreateNamespaceInput,
    CreateNamespaceOutput, DeleteEntryInput, DeleteEntryOutput, DeleteNamespaceInput,
    DeleteNamespaceOutput, EntryInfo, GetEntryInput, GetEntryOutput, GetStatsOutput,
    InsertEntryInput, InsertEntryOutput, NamespaceInfo, NamespaceStats, QueryNamespaceInput,
    QueryNamespaceOutput, UpdateEntryInput, UpdateEntryOutput,
};
use super::runtime_documents::{RuntimeDocument, RuntimeDocuments};

type Compactor = Arc<dyn Fn() -> Result<()> + Send + Sync>;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct MemoryAccessContext {
    pub principal_id: String,
    pub session_id: String,
}

impl MemoryAccessContext {
    fn validate(&self) -> Result<()> {
        validate_identity_component("principal_id", &self.principal_id)?;
        validate_identity_component("session_id", &self.session_id)
    }
}

/// Long-lived method service. Callers should share one instance per process so
/// every update uses the same [`RuntimeDocuments`] writer lock.
pub struct MemoryMethods {
    documents: Arc<RuntimeDocuments>,
    compactor: Compactor,
}

impl MemoryMethods {
    /// Create the one process-wide memory service over the bridge's injected
    /// Cozo handle. Both document writes and compaction use this exact handle.
    pub fn from_shared(store: Arc<CozoGraphShuttle>) -> Self {
        let documents = Arc::new(RuntimeDocuments::from_shared(store.clone()));
        let compaction_store = store;
        Self {
            documents,
            compactor: Arc::new(move || {
                compaction_store
                    .run_query("::compact", None)
                    .context("Cozo compaction failed")?;
                Ok(())
            }),
        }
    }

    #[cfg(test)]
    fn with_compactor(documents: Arc<RuntimeDocuments>, compactor: Compactor) -> Self {
        Self {
            documents,
            compactor,
        }
    }

    pub async fn dispatch(
        &self,
        context: &MemoryAccessContext,
        method: &str,
        args: &Value,
    ) -> Result<Value> {
        context.validate()?;
        let owner = owner_document_key(context);
        match method {
            "create_namespace" => {
                let input: CreateNamespaceInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
                self.create_namespace(&owner, input).await
            }
            "delete_namespace" => {
                let input: DeleteNamespaceInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
                self.delete_namespace(&owner, input).await
            }
            "query_namespace" => {
                let input: QueryNamespaceInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
                self.query_namespace(&owner, input).await
            }
            "insert_entry" => {
                let input: InsertEntryInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
                self.insert_entry(&owner, input).await
            }
            "update_entry" => {
                let input: UpdateEntryInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
                self.update_entry(&owner, input).await
            }
            "get_entry" => {
                let input: GetEntryInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
                self.get_entry(&owner, input).await
            }
            "delete_entry" => {
                let input: DeleteEntryInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
                self.delete_entry(&owner, input).await
            }
            "clear_namespace" => {
                let input: ClearNamespaceInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
                self.clear_namespace(&owner, input).await
            }
            "get_stats" => {
                validate_empty_input(args)?;
                self.get_stats(&owner).await
            }
            "compact" => {
                validate_empty_input(args)?;
                self.compact().await
            }
            _ => bail!("unsupported memory method"),
        }
    }

    async fn read_document(&self, owner: &str) -> Result<MemoryDocument> {
        self.documents
            .read(owner)
            .await?
            .map(parse_document)
            .transpose()
            .map(|document| document.unwrap_or_default())
    }

    async fn create_namespace(&self, owner: &str, input: CreateNamespaceInput) -> Result<Value> {
        validate_namespace(&input.name)?;
        if let Some(max_entries) = input.max_entries {
            ensure!(max_entries > 0, "max_entries must be positive when set");
        }
        validate_domain_value(&input.config)?;
        let name = input.name;
        let now = chrono::Utc::now().to_rfc3339();
        let id = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();
        let (row, (namespace, created)) = self
            .documents
            .update_with_result(owner, move |old| {
                let mut document = parse_optional_document(old)?;
                if let Some(existing) = document.namespaces.get(&name) {
                    ensure!(
                        existing.max_entries == input.max_entries
                            && existing.read_only == input.read_only
                            && existing.config == input.config,
                        "namespace already exists with different settings"
                    );
                    let existing = existing.clone();
                    return Ok((serde_json::to_value(document)?, (existing, false)));
                }
                let namespace = StoredNamespace {
                    id,
                    name: name.clone(),
                    max_entries: input.max_entries,
                    read_only: input.read_only,
                    config: input.config,
                    entries: BTreeMap::new(),
                    created_at: now.clone(),
                    updated_at: now,
                };
                document.namespaces.insert(name, namespace.clone());
                Ok((serde_json::to_value(document)?, (namespace, true)))
            })
            .await?;
        let _revision = row.revision;
        Ok(serde_json::to_value(CreateNamespaceOutput {
            namespace: namespace_info(&namespace)?,
            created,
        })?)
    }

    async fn delete_namespace(&self, owner: &str, input: DeleteNamespaceInput) -> Result<Value> {
        validate_namespace(&input.name)?;
        let name = input.name;
        let (_, receipt) = self
            .documents
            .update_with_result(owner, move |old| {
                let mut document = parse_optional_document(old)?;
                if let Some(namespace) = document.namespaces.get(&name) {
                    ensure!(!namespace.read_only, "namespace is read-only");
                }
                let removed = document.namespaces.remove(&name);
                let deleted_entries = removed
                    .as_ref()
                    .map(|namespace| u64::try_from(namespace.entries.len()))
                    .transpose()?
                    .unwrap_or(0);
                Ok((
                    serde_json::to_value(document)?,
                    (removed.is_some(), deleted_entries),
                ))
            })
            .await?;
        Ok(serde_json::to_value(DeleteNamespaceOutput {
            deleted: receipt.0,
            deleted_entries: receipt.1,
        })?)
    }

    async fn query_namespace(&self, owner: &str, input: QueryNamespaceInput) -> Result<Value> {
        validate_namespace(&input.name)?;
        let document = self.read_document(owner).await?;
        let namespace = document
            .namespaces
            .get(&input.name)
            .map(namespace_info)
            .transpose()?;
        Ok(serde_json::to_value(QueryNamespaceOutput { namespace })?)
    }

    async fn insert_entry(&self, owner: &str, input: InsertEntryInput) -> Result<Value> {
        validate_namespace(&input.namespace)?;
        validate_entry_key(&input.key)?;
        validate_domain_value(&input.value)?;
        let namespace_name = input.namespace;
        let key = input.key;
        let now = chrono::Utc::now().to_rfc3339();
        let id = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();
        let (_, (namespace, entry)) = self
            .documents
            .update_with_result(owner, move |old| {
                let mut document = parse_optional_document(old)?;
                let namespace = document
                    .namespaces
                    .get_mut(&namespace_name)
                    .context("namespace not found")?;
                ensure!(!namespace.read_only, "namespace is read-only");
                ensure!(
                    !namespace.entries.contains_key(&key),
                    "entry already exists"
                );
                if let Some(max_entries) = namespace.max_entries {
                    ensure!(
                        u64::try_from(namespace.entries.len())? < max_entries,
                        "namespace capacity reached"
                    );
                }
                let entry = StoredEntry {
                    id,
                    key: key.clone(),
                    value: input.value,
                    created_at: now.clone(),
                    updated_at: now.clone(),
                };
                namespace.entries.insert(key, entry.clone());
                namespace.updated_at = now;
                let namespace = namespace.clone();
                Ok((serde_json::to_value(document)?, (namespace, entry)))
            })
            .await?;
        Ok(serde_json::to_value(InsertEntryOutput {
            entry: entry_info(&namespace.name, &entry),
            entry_count: u64::try_from(namespace.entries.len())?,
        })?)
    }

    async fn update_entry(&self, owner: &str, input: UpdateEntryInput) -> Result<Value> {
        validate_namespace(&input.namespace)?;
        validate_entry_key(&input.key)?;
        validate_domain_value(&input.value)?;
        let namespace_name = input.namespace;
        let key = input.key;
        let now = chrono::Utc::now().to_rfc3339();
        let (_, (namespace_name, entry, previous_value)) = self
            .documents
            .update_with_result(owner, move |old| {
                let mut document = parse_optional_document(old)?;
                let namespace = document
                    .namespaces
                    .get_mut(&namespace_name)
                    .context("namespace not found")?;
                ensure!(!namespace.read_only, "namespace is read-only");
                let entry = namespace.entries.get_mut(&key).context("entry not found")?;
                let previous_value = std::mem::replace(&mut entry.value, input.value);
                entry.updated_at = now.clone();
                let entry = entry.clone();
                namespace.updated_at = now;
                let namespace_name = namespace_name.clone();
                Ok((
                    serde_json::to_value(document)?,
                    (namespace_name, entry, previous_value),
                ))
            })
            .await?;
        Ok(serde_json::to_value(UpdateEntryOutput {
            entry: entry_info(&namespace_name, &entry),
            previous_value,
        })?)
    }

    async fn get_entry(&self, owner: &str, input: GetEntryInput) -> Result<Value> {
        validate_namespace(&input.namespace)?;
        validate_entry_key(&input.key)?;
        let document = self.read_document(owner).await?;
        let entry = document
            .namespaces
            .get(&input.namespace)
            .and_then(|namespace| namespace.entries.get(&input.key))
            .map(|entry| entry_info(&input.namespace, entry));
        Ok(serde_json::to_value(GetEntryOutput { entry })?)
    }

    async fn delete_entry(&self, owner: &str, input: DeleteEntryInput) -> Result<Value> {
        validate_namespace(&input.namespace)?;
        validate_entry_key(&input.key)?;
        let namespace_name = input.namespace;
        let key = input.key;
        let now = chrono::Utc::now().to_rfc3339();
        let (_, deleted_entry_id) = self
            .documents
            .update_with_result(owner, move |old| {
                let mut document = parse_optional_document(old)?;
                let namespace = document
                    .namespaces
                    .get_mut(&namespace_name)
                    .context("namespace not found")?;
                ensure!(!namespace.read_only, "namespace is read-only");
                let removed = namespace.entries.remove(&key).map(|entry| entry.id);
                if removed.is_some() {
                    namespace.updated_at = now;
                }
                Ok((serde_json::to_value(document)?, removed))
            })
            .await?;
        Ok(serde_json::to_value(DeleteEntryOutput {
            deleted_entry_id,
        })?)
    }

    async fn clear_namespace(&self, owner: &str, input: ClearNamespaceInput) -> Result<Value> {
        validate_namespace(&input.name)?;
        let name = input.name;
        let now = chrono::Utc::now().to_rfc3339();
        let (_, deleted_entries) = self
            .documents
            .update_with_result(owner, move |old| {
                let mut document = parse_optional_document(old)?;
                let namespace = document
                    .namespaces
                    .get_mut(&name)
                    .context("namespace not found")?;
                ensure!(!namespace.read_only, "namespace is read-only");
                let deleted_entries = u64::try_from(namespace.entries.len())?;
                namespace.entries.clear();
                if deleted_entries > 0 {
                    namespace.updated_at = now;
                }
                Ok((serde_json::to_value(document)?, deleted_entries))
            })
            .await?;
        Ok(serde_json::to_value(ClearNamespaceOutput {
            deleted_entries,
        })?)
    }

    async fn get_stats(&self, owner: &str) -> Result<Value> {
        let document = self.read_document(owner).await?;
        let namespaces = document
            .namespaces
            .values()
            .map(|namespace| {
                Ok(NamespaceStats {
                    name: namespace.name.clone(),
                    entries: u64::try_from(namespace.entries.len())?,
                    max_entries: namespace.max_entries,
                    read_only: namespace.read_only,
                })
            })
            .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
        let total_entries = namespaces.iter().try_fold(0_u64, |total, namespace| {
            total
                .checked_add(namespace.entries)
                .context("entry count overflow")
        })?;
        Ok(serde_json::to_value(GetStatsOutput {
            total_namespaces: u64::try_from(namespaces.len())?,
            total_entries,
            namespaces,
        })?)
    }

    async fn compact(&self) -> Result<Value> {
        let compactor = self.compactor.clone();
        tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || compactor()).await??;
        Ok(serde_json::to_value(CompactOutput {
            scope: "cozo_store".to_string(),
            compacted_at: chrono::Utc::now().to_rfc3339(),
            reclaimed_bytes: None,
        })?)
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Serialize, Deserialize)]
struct MemoryDocument {
    namespaces: BTreeMap<String, StoredNamespace>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
struct StoredNamespace {
    id: String,
    name: String,
    max_entries: Option<u64>,
    read_only: bool,
    config: Value,
    entries: BTreeMap<String, StoredEntry>,
    created_at: String,
    updated_at: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
struct StoredEntry {
    id: String,
    key: String,
    value: Value,
    created_at: String,
    updated_at: String,
}

fn parse_optional_document(value: Option<Value>) -> Result<MemoryDocument> {
    value
        .map(|document| serde_json::from_value(document).context("invalid memory document"))
        .transpose()
        .map(|document| document.unwrap_or_default())
}

fn parse_document(row: RuntimeDocument) -> Result<MemoryDocument> {
    serde_json::from_value(row.document).context("invalid memory document")
}

fn namespace_info(namespace: &StoredNamespace) -> Result<NamespaceInfo> {
    Ok(NamespaceInfo {
        id: namespace.id.clone(),
        name: namespace.name.clone(),
        max_entries: namespace.max_entries,
        read_only: namespace.read_only,
        entry_count: u64::try_from(namespace.entries.len())?,
        config: namespace.config.clone(),
        created_at: namespace.created_at.clone(),
        updated_at: namespace.updated_at.clone(),
    })
}

fn entry_info(namespace: &str, entry: &StoredEntry) -> EntryInfo {
    EntryInfo {
        id: entry.id.clone(),
        namespace: namespace.to_string(),
        key: entry.key.clone(),
        value: entry.value.clone(),
        created_at: entry.created_at.clone(),
        updated_at: entry.updated_at.clone(),
    }
}

fn validate_identity_component(field: &str, value: &str) -> Result<()> {
    ensure!(!value.is_empty(), "verified {field} is required");
    ensure!(value.len() <= 512, "verified {field} is too long");
    ensure!(
        !value.chars().any(char::is_control),
        "verified {field} contains control characters"
    );
    Ok(())
}

fn validate_namespace(value: &str) -> Result<()> {
    ensure!(!value.trim().is_empty(), "namespace name is required");
    ensure!(value.len() <= 128, "namespace name is too long");
    ensure!(
        value
            .chars()
            .all(|ch| ch.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || "-_.:/".contains(ch)),
        "namespace name contains unsupported characters"
    );
    Ok(())
}

fn validate_entry_key(value: &str) -> Result<()> {
    ensure!(!value.trim().is_empty(), "entry key is required");
    ensure!(value.len() <= 512, "entry key is too long");
    ensure!(
        !value.chars().any(char::is_control),
        "entry key contains control characters"
    );
    Ok(())
}

fn validate_domain_value(value: &Value) -> Result<()> {
    ensure!(
        serde_json::to_vec(value)?.len() <= 1024 * 1024,
        "entry value exceeds 1 MiB"
    );
    reject_credential_fields(value)?;
    Ok(())
}

fn reject_credential_fields(value: &Value) -> Result<()> {
    match value {
        Value::Object(object) => {
            for (key, nested) in object {
                let normalized = key.to_ascii_lowercase().replace('-', "_");
                ensure!(
                    !matches!(
                        normalized.as_str(),
                        "password"
                            | "passwd"
                            | "secret"
                            | "token"
                            | "access_token"
                            | "refresh_token"
                            | "api_key"
                            | "private_key"
                            | "psk"
                            | "sealed_id"
                            | "credential"
                            | "credentials"
                    ),
                    "memory values cannot store credential fields"
                );
                reject_credential_fields(nested)?;
            }
        }
        Value::Array(values) => {
            for nested in values {
                reject_credential_fields(nested)?;
            }
        }
        _ => {}
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn validate_empty_input(value: &Value) -> Result<()> {
    let object = value
        .as_object()
        .context("method input must be an object")?;
    ensure!(object.is_empty(), "method does not accept input fields");
    Ok(())
}

fn owner_document_key(context: &MemoryAccessContext) -> String {
    let mut hash = Sha256::new();
    hash.update(b"op-dbus.memory.owner.v1\0");
    hash.update(
        u64::try_from(context.principal_id.len())
            .expect("validated identity length fits u64")
            .to_be_bytes(),
    );
    hash.update(context.principal_id.as_bytes());
    hash.update(
        u64::try_from(context.session_id.len())
            .expect("validated identity length fits u64")
            .to_be_bytes(),
    );
    hash.update(context.session_id.as_bytes());
    format!("memory:{:x}", hash.finalize())
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn context(principal: &str, session: &str) -> MemoryAccessContext {
        MemoryAccessContext {
            principal_id: principal.to_string(),
            session_id: session.to_string(),
        }
    }

    fn fixture() -> (MemoryMethods, MemoryAccessContext) {
        let store = Arc::new(CozoGraphShuttle::new_in_memory().unwrap());
        (
            MemoryMethods::from_shared(store),
            context("principal-a", "session-a"),
        )
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn retained_crud_methods_enforce_capacity_readonly_and_stable_ids() {
        let (service, owner) = fixture();
        let created = service
            .dispatch(
                &owner,
                "create_namespace",
                &json!({"name":"notes","max_entries":1,"read_only":false,"config":{"purpose":"test"}}),
            )
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(created["created"], true);
        assert_eq!(created["namespace"]["max_entries"], 1);
        let namespace_id = created["namespace"]["id"].as_str().unwrap().to_string();
        let existing = service
            .dispatch(
                &owner,
                "create_namespace",
                &json!({"name":"notes","max_entries":1,"read_only":false,"config":{"purpose":"test"}}),
            )
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(existing["created"], false);
        assert_eq!(existing["namespace"]["id"], namespace_id);

        let inserted = service
            .dispatch(
                &owner,
                "insert_entry",
                &json!({"namespace":"notes","key":"one","value":{"note":"kept-private"}}),
            )
            .await
            .unwrap();
        let entry_id = inserted["entry"]["id"].as_str().unwrap().to_string();
        assert!(service
            .dispatch(
                &owner,
                "insert_entry",
                &json!({"namespace":"notes","key":"two","value":2}),
            )
            .await
            .is_err());

        let updated = service
            .dispatch(
                &owner,
                "update_entry",
                &json!({"namespace":"notes","key":"one","value":3}),
            )
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(updated["entry"]["id"], entry_id);
        assert_eq!(updated["previous_value"], json!({"note":"kept-private"}));

        let fetched = service
            .dispatch(
                &owner,
                "get_entry",
                &json!({"namespace":"notes","key":"one"}),
            )
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(fetched["entry"]["value"], 3);
        let queried = service
            .dispatch(&owner, "query_namespace", &json!({"name":"notes"}))
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(queried["namespace"]["entry_count"], 1);
        let stats = service
            .dispatch(&owner, "get_stats", &json!({}))
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(stats["total_entries"], 1);

        let deleted = service
            .dispatch(
                &owner,
                "delete_entry",
                &json!({"namespace":"notes","key":"one"}),
            )
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(deleted["deleted_entry_id"], entry_id);
        let cleared = service
            .dispatch(&owner, "clear_namespace", &json!({"name":"notes"}))
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(cleared["deleted_entries"], 0);
        let removed = service
            .dispatch(&owner, "delete_namespace", &json!({"name":"notes"}))
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(removed["deleted"], true);

        service
            .dispatch(
                &owner,
                "create_namespace",
                &json!({"name":"locked","read_only":true}),
            )
            .await
            .unwrap();
        let locked_owner = owner_document_key(&owner);
        service
            .documents
            .update(&locked_owner, |old| {
                let mut document = parse_optional_document(old)?;
                let namespace = document.namespaces.get_mut("locked").unwrap();
                namespace.entries.insert(
                    "seed".to_string(),
                    StoredEntry {
                        id: "fixture-entry".to_string(),
                        key: "seed".to_string(),
                        value: json!(1),
                        created_at: "t0".to_string(),
                        updated_at: "t0".to_string(),
                    },
                );
                Ok(serde_json::to_value(document)?)
            })
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert!(service
            .dispatch(
                &owner,
                "insert_entry",
                &json!({"namespace":"locked","key":"no","value":1}),
            )
            .await
            .is_err());
        assert!(validate_domain_value(&json!({"api_key":"forbidden"})).is_err());
        for (method, input) in [
            (
                "update_entry",
                json!({"namespace":"locked","key":"seed","value":2}),
            ),
            ("delete_entry", json!({"namespace":"locked","key":"seed"})),
            ("clear_namespace", json!({"name":"locked"})),
            ("delete_namespace", json!({"name":"locked"})),
        ] {
            assert!(service.dispatch(&owner, method, &input).await.is_err());
        }
        let still_locked = service
            .dispatch(&owner, "query_namespace", &json!({"name":"locked"}))
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(still_locked["namespace"]["entry_count"], 1);
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn exact_context_is_required_and_other_sessions_cannot_read_entries() {
        let (service, owner) = fixture();
        service
            .dispatch(&owner, "create_namespace", &json!({"name":"private"}))
            .await
            .unwrap();
        service
            .dispatch(
                &owner,
                "insert_entry",
                &json!({"namespace":"private","key":"one","value":"secret"}),
            )
            .await
            .unwrap();

        let other_session = context("principal-a", "session-b");
        let hidden = service
            .dispatch(
                &other_session,
                "get_entry",
                &json!({"namespace":"private","key":"one"}),
            )
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert!(hidden["entry"].is_null());
        let other_principal = context("principal-b", "session-a");
        let hidden = service
            .dispatch(
                &other_principal,
                "get_entry",
                &json!({"namespace":"private","key":"one"}),
            )
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert!(hidden["entry"].is_null());
        assert!(service
            .dispatch(&context("", "session-a"), "get_stats", &json!({}),)
            .await
            .is_err());
        assert_ne!(
            owner_document_key(&context("ab", "c")),
            owner_document_key(&context("a", "bc"))
        );
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn compaction_errors_are_not_reported_as_completion() {
        let store = Arc::new(CozoGraphShuttle::new_in_memory().unwrap());
        let documents = Arc::new(RuntimeDocuments::from_shared(store));
        let service = MemoryMethods::with_compactor(
            documents,
            Arc::new(|| bail!("unsupported fixture backend")),
        );
        assert!(service
            .dispatch(&context("principal", "session"), "compact", &json!({}))
            .await
            .is_err());
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn persistent_cozo_executes_real_store_compaction_without_invented_bytes() {
        let directory = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let path = directory.path().join("memory-cozo");
        let owner = context("principal", "session");
        {
            let store = Arc::new(CozoGraphShuttle::new_persistent(path.clone()).unwrap());
            let service = MemoryMethods::from_shared(store);
            service
                .dispatch(&owner, "create_namespace", &json!({"name":"durable"}))
                .await
                .unwrap();
            service
                .dispatch(
                    &owner,
                    "insert_entry",
                    &json!({"namespace":"durable","key":"entry","value":7}),
                )
                .await
                .unwrap();
            let output = service
                .dispatch(&owner, "compact", &json!({}))
                .await
                .unwrap();
            assert_eq!(output["scope"], "cozo_store");
            assert!(output["reclaimed_bytes"].is_null());
            assert!(output["compacted_at"].as_str().is_some());
        }
        let reopened = Arc::new(CozoGraphShuttle::new_persistent(path).unwrap());
        let service = MemoryMethods::from_shared(reopened);
        let entry = service
            .dispatch(
                &owner,
                "get_entry",
                &json!({"namespace":"durable","key":"entry"}),
            )
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(entry["entry"]["value"], 7);
    }
}

use super::plugin_scaffold_helpers::{method_decl_from_schemars_with_output, EmptyInput};
use anyhow::Result;
use async_trait::async_trait;
use op_state::{ApplyResult, Checkpoint, DiffMetadata, PluginCapabilities, StateDiff, StatePlugin};
use op_state_store::{CapabilityDecl, PluginSchema, SideEffect};
use schemars::JsonSchema;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use serde_json::Value as JsonValue;
use simd_json::OwnedValue as Value;

/// Public plugin state contains only durable-backend semantics. Private memory
/// contents remain in Cozo and are returned only by context-scoped methods.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[schemars(extend("x-oscal-category" = "data"))]
pub struct MemoryState {
    pub backend: String,
    pub isolation: String,
}

pub struct MemoryPlugin;

impl Default for MemoryPlugin {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self
    }
}

impl MemoryPlugin {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self
    }

    pub(crate) fn current_state() -> MemoryState {
        MemoryState {
            backend: "cozo".to_string(),
            isolation: "principal_session".to_string(),
        }
    }
}

#[async_trait]
impl StatePlugin for MemoryPlugin {
    fn name(&self) -> &str {
        "memory"
    }

    fn version(&self) -> &str {
        "2.0.0"
    }

    fn schema(&self) -> Option<PluginSchema> {
        Some(memory_schema())
    }

    async fn calculate_diff(&self, _current: &Value, _desired: &Value) -> Result<StateDiff> {
        Ok(StateDiff {
            plugin: self.name().to_string(),
            actions: Vec::new(),
            metadata: DiffMetadata {
                timestamp: chrono::Utc::now().timestamp(),
                current_hash: String::new(),
                desired_hash: String::new(),
            },
        })
    }

    async fn apply_state(&self, _diff: &StateDiff) -> Result<ApplyResult> {
        Ok(ApplyResult {
            success: true,
            changes_applied: vec![],
            errors: vec![],
            checkpoint: None,
        })
    }

    async fn verify_state(&self, _desired: &Value) -> Result<bool> {
        Ok(true)
    }

    async fn create_checkpoint(&self) -> Result<Checkpoint> {
        Ok(Checkpoint {
            id: uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string(),
            plugin: self.name().to_string(),
            timestamp: chrono::Utc::now().timestamp(),
            state_snapshot: simd_json::serde::to_owned_value(Self::current_state())?,
            backend_checkpoint: None,
        })
    }

    async fn rollback(&self, _checkpoint: &Checkpoint) -> Result<()> {
        Ok(())
    }

    fn capabilities(&self) -> PluginCapabilities {
        PluginCapabilities {
            supports_rollback: false,
            supports_checkpoints: true,
            supports_verification: true,
            atomic_operations: false,
        }
    }
}

pub(crate) fn memory_schema() -> PluginSchema {
    let root = serde_json::to_value(schemars::schema_for!(MemoryState))
        .expect("schemars schema serializes to JSON");
    let mut schema = super::schemars_adapter::plugin_schema_from_json(
        "memory",
        "2.0.0",
        "Private principal-and-session memory stored durably in Cozo",
        &root,
    );

    let methods = [
        (
            "create_namespace",
            method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<CreateNamespaceInput, CreateNamespaceOutput>(
                "create_namespace",
                SideEffect::Mutation,
                true,
                "memory.namespace.create",
                "mut.data.memory.create-namespace@v1",
            ),
        ),
        (
            "delete_namespace",
            method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<DeleteNamespaceInput, DeleteNamespaceOutput>(
                "delete_namespace",
                SideEffect::Mutation,
                true,
                "memory.namespace.delete",
                "mut.data.memory.delete-namespace@v1",
            ),
        ),
        (
            "query_namespace",
            method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<QueryNamespaceInput, QueryNamespaceOutput>(
                "query_namespace",
                SideEffect::Read,
                true,
                "memory.namespace.read",
                "obs.data.memory.query-namespace@v1",
            ),
        ),
        (
            "insert_entry",
            method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<InsertEntryInput, InsertEntryOutput>(
                "insert_entry",
                SideEffect::Mutation,
                false,
                "memory.entry.create",
                "mut.data.memory.insert-entry@v1",
            ),
        ),
        (
            "update_entry",
            method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<UpdateEntryInput, UpdateEntryOutput>(
                "update_entry",
                SideEffect::Mutation,
                false,
                "memory.entry.write",
                "mut.data.memory.update-entry@v1",
            ),
        ),
        (
            "get_entry",
            method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<GetEntryInput, GetEntryOutput>(
                "get_entry",
                SideEffect::Read,
                true,
                "memory.entry.read",
                "obs.data.memory.get-entry@v1",
            ),
        ),
        (
            "delete_entry",
            method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<DeleteEntryInput, DeleteEntryOutput>(
                "delete_entry",
                SideEffect::Mutation,
                true,
                "memory.entry.delete",
                "mut.data.memory.delete-entry@v1",
            ),
        ),
        (
            "clear_namespace",
            method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<ClearNamespaceInput, ClearNamespaceOutput>(
                "clear_namespace",
                SideEffect::Mutation,
                true,
                "memory.namespace.clear",
                "mut.data.memory.clear-namespace@v1",
            ),
        ),
        (
            "get_stats",
            method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<EmptyInput, GetStatsOutput>(
                "get_stats",
                SideEffect::Read,
                true,
                "memory.stats.read",
                "obs.data.memory.get-stats@v1",
            ),
        ),
        (
            "compact",
            method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<EmptyInput, CompactOutput>(
                "compact",
                SideEffect::Mutation,
                true,
                "memory.memory.compact",
                "mut.data.memory.compact@v1",
            ),
        ),
    ];
    schema.methods.extend(
        methods
            .into_iter()
            .map(|(name, declaration)| (name.to_string(), declaration)),
    );

    for (id, methods) in [
        ("memory.namespace.create", "create_namespace"),
        ("memory.namespace.delete", "delete_namespace"),
        ("memory.namespace.read", "query_namespace"),
        ("memory.entry.create", "insert_entry"),
        ("memory.entry.write", "update_entry"),
        ("memory.entry.read", "get_entry"),
        ("memory.entry.delete", "delete_entry"),
        ("memory.namespace.clear", "clear_namespace"),
        ("memory.stats.read", "get_stats"),
        ("memory.memory.compact", "compact"),
    ] {
        schema.capabilities.insert(
            id.to_string(),
            CapabilityDecl {
                id: id.to_string(),
                description: format!("Grants: {methods}."),
            },
        );
    }
    schema
        .capabilities
        .get_mut("memory.memory.compact")
        .expect("compact capability inserted")
        .description = "Grants only whole-store Cozo physical maintenance via compact; it does not grant namespace or entry access."
        .to_string();

    schema
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn schema_has_typed_name_matched_methods() {
        let schema = memory_schema();
        assert_eq!(schema.version, "2.0.0");
        assert_eq!(schema.methods.len(), 10);
        for (key, method) in &schema.methods {
            assert_eq!(key, &method.name);
            assert!(method.returns.is_some(), "{key} needs a typed output");
        }
    }
}

inventory::submit! {
    crate::default_registry::PluginReg::new("memory", |_ctx| std::sync::Arc::new(MemoryPlugin::new()))
}
</file>

<file path="op-plugins/src/state_plugins/mongodb_mcp.rs">
//! Typed projection of the runit-supervised MongoDB MCP provider.
//!
//! The provider itself is loopback-only and starts read-only. This schema is
//! intentionally limited to read/metadata/knowledge methods: connection
//! strings and Atlas write administration are not accepted through this
//! public typed surface.

use anyhow::Result;
use async_trait::async_trait;
use op_state::{ApplyResult, Checkpoint, DiffMetadata, PluginCapabilities, StateDiff, StatePlugin};
use op_state_store::{CapabilityDecl, PluginSchema, SideEffect};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use simd_json::OwnedValue as Value;
use std::path::Path;

use super::plugin_scaffold_helpers::method_decl_from_schemars_with_output;

const READY_PATH: &str = "/run/opdbus/runit-ready/mongodb-mcp-server";
const AUTH_READY_PATH: &str = "/run/opdbus/runit-ready/mongodb-mcp-server-authenticated";

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "sch.software.plugin.mongodb-mcp.schema@v1"))]
#[schemars(extend("x-oscal-category" = "service"))]
pub struct MongoDbMcpState {
    pub status: String,
    pub endpoint: String,
    pub read_only: bool,
    pub credential_source_configured: bool,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct EmptyInput {}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct ConnectionInput {
    pub connection_id: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct DatabaseInput {
    pub connection_id: String,
    pub database: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct CollectionInput {
    pub connection_id: String,
    pub database: String,
    pub collection: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct CollectionSchemaInput {
    pub connection_id: String,
    pub database: String,
    pub collection: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub sample_size: Option<u64>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub response_bytes_limit: Option<u64>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct FindInput {
    pub connection_id: String,
    pub database: String,
    pub collection: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub filter: Option<serde_json::Value>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub projection: Option<serde_json::Value>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub limit: Option<u64>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub sort: Option<serde_json::Value>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub response_bytes_limit: Option<u64>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct CountInput {
    pub connection_id: String,
    pub database: String,
    pub collection: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub query: Option<serde_json::Value>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct AggregateInput {
    pub connection_id: String,
    pub database: String,
    pub collection: String,
    pub pipeline: Vec<serde_json::Value>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub response_bytes_limit: Option<u64>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct AggregateDatabaseInput {
    pub connection_id: String,
    pub database: String,
    pub pipeline: Vec<serde_json::Value>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub response_bytes_limit: Option<u64>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct KnowledgeSourceFilter {
    pub name: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub version_label: Option<String>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct SearchKnowledgeInput {
    pub query: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub limit: Option<u64>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub data_sources: Option<Vec<KnowledgeSourceFilter>>,
}

/// Provider MCP result is retained verbatim; the bridge normalizes it to the
/// single public endpoint's `tools/call` result shape.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct ProviderResult {
    #[serde(flatten)]
    pub value: serde_json::Map<String, serde_json::Value>,
}

pub struct MongoDbMcpPlugin;

impl MongoDbMcpPlugin {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self
    }

    pub(crate) fn current_state() -> MongoDbMcpState {
        let ready = Path::new(READY_PATH).exists();
        MongoDbMcpState {
            status: if ready { "ready" } else { "unavailable" }.to_string(),
            endpoint: "http://127.0.0.1:3102/mcp".to_string(),
            read_only: true,
            credential_source_configured: Path::new(AUTH_READY_PATH).exists(),
        }
    }
}

impl Default for MongoDbMcpPlugin {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}

#[async_trait]
impl StatePlugin for MongoDbMcpPlugin {
    fn name(&self) -> &str {
        "mongodb_mcp"
    }

    fn version(&self) -> &str {
        "2.1.0"
    }

    fn schema(&self) -> Option<PluginSchema> {
        Some(mongodb_mcp_schema())
    }

    async fn calculate_diff(&self, _current: &Value, _desired: &Value) -> Result<StateDiff> {
        Ok(StateDiff {
            plugin: self.name().to_string(),
            actions: vec![],
            metadata: DiffMetadata {
                timestamp: chrono::Utc::now().timestamp(),
                current_hash: String::new(),
                desired_hash: String::new(),
            },
        })
    }

    async fn apply_state(&self, _diff: &StateDiff) -> Result<ApplyResult> {
        Ok(ApplyResult {
            success: true,
            changes_applied: vec![],
            errors: vec![],
            checkpoint: None,
        })
    }

    async fn verify_state(&self, _desired: &Value) -> Result<bool> {
        Ok(Path::new(READY_PATH).exists())
    }

    async fn create_checkpoint(&self) -> Result<Checkpoint> {
        Ok(Checkpoint {
            id: uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string(),
            plugin: self.name().to_string(),
            timestamp: chrono::Utc::now().timestamp(),
            state_snapshot: simd_json::serde::to_owned_value(Self::current_state())?,
            backend_checkpoint: None,
        })
    }

    async fn rollback(&self, _checkpoint: &Checkpoint) -> Result<()> {
        Ok(())
    }

    fn capabilities(&self) -> PluginCapabilities {
        PluginCapabilities {
            supports_rollback: false,
            supports_checkpoints: true,
            supports_verification: true,
            atomic_operations: false,
        }
    }
}

pub(crate) fn mongodb_mcp_schema() -> PluginSchema {
    let root = serde_json::to_value(schemars::schema_for!(MongoDbMcpState))
        .expect("MongoDB MCP state schema serializes");
    let mut schema = super::schemars_adapter::plugin_schema_from_json(
        "mongodb_mcp",
        "2.1.0",
        "Read-only MongoDB MCP data, metadata, and official knowledge provider",
        &root,
    );

    macro_rules! read_method {
        ($name:literal, $input:ty, $subid:literal) => {
            schema.methods.insert(
                $name.to_string(),
                method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<$input, ProviderResult>(
                    $name,
                    SideEffect::Read,
                    true,
                    "mongodb_mcp.read",
                    $subid,
                ),
            );
        };
    }

    read_method!(
        "list_connections",
        EmptyInput,
        "obs.service.plugin.mongodb-mcp.connection.list@v1"
    );
    read_method!(
        "list_databases",
        ConnectionInput,
        "obs.service.plugin.mongodb-mcp.database.list@v1"
    );
    read_method!(
        "list_collections",
        DatabaseInput,
        "obs.service.plugin.mongodb-mcp.collection.list@v1"
    );
    read_method!(
        "db_stats",
        DatabaseInput,
        "obs.service.plugin.mongodb-mcp.database.stats@v1"
    );
    read_method!(
        "collection_schema",
        CollectionSchemaInput,
        "obs.service.plugin.mongodb-mcp.collection.schema@v1"
    );
    read_method!(
        "collection_indexes",
        CollectionInput,
        "obs.service.mongodb-mcp.collection-index.list@v1"
    );
    read_method!(
        "collection_storage_size",
        CollectionInput,
        "obs.service.plugin.mongodb-mcp.collection.storage@v1"
    );
    read_method!(
        "find",
        FindInput,
        "obs.service.plugin.mongodb-mcp.document.find@v1"
    );
    read_method!(
        "count",
        CountInput,
        "obs.service.plugin.mongodb-mcp.document.count@v1"
    );
    read_method!(
        "aggregate",
        AggregateInput,
        "obs.service.plugin.mongodb-mcp.collection.aggregate@v1"
    );
    read_method!(
        "aggregate_db",
        AggregateDatabaseInput,
        "obs.service.plugin.mongodb-mcp.database.aggregate@v1"
    );
    read_method!(
        "list_knowledge_sources",
        EmptyInput,
        "obs.service.mongodb-mcp.knowledge-source.list@v1"
    );
    read_method!(
        "search_knowledge",
        SearchKnowledgeInput,
        "obs.service.plugin.mongodb-mcp.knowledge.search@v1"
    );

    schema.capabilities.insert(
        "mongodb_mcp.read".to_string(),
        CapabilityDecl {
            id: "mongodb_mcp.read".to_string(),
            description:
                "Read-only MongoDB metadata, queries, aggregations, and official knowledge search"
                    .to_string(),
        },
    );
    schema
}

inventory::submit! {
    crate::default_registry::PluginReg::new("mongodb_mcp", |_ctx| std::sync::Arc::new(MongoDbMcpPlugin::new()))
}
</file>

<file path="op-plugins/src/state_plugins/net.rs">
// Net state plugin - authoritative OVS state management via D-Bus
// Handles: interfaces, bridges, IPs, basic connectivity via plugin schema
// Integrates with systemd-networkd as subordinate service for L3 configuration
use op_snowball::PluginFootprint;

// Use D-Bus introspection instead of CLI commands
use anyhow::{Context, Result};
use async_trait::async_trait;
use log;
use op_state::{ApplyResult, Checkpoint, PluginCapabilities, StateAction, StateDiff, StatePlugin};
use op_state_store::{CapabilityDecl, PluginSchema};
use schemars::JsonSchema;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use serde_json;
use simd_json::{prelude::*, OwnedValue as Value};
use std::collections::HashMap;
// use std::net::Ipv4Addr; // not needed currently

/// Network interface management via rtnetlink.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, Default, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "sch.software.plugin.net.schema@v1"))]
#[schemars(extend("x-oscal-category" = "network"))]
pub struct NetworkConfig {
    /// List of network interfaces.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(
        description = "List of network interfaces",
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "exp.service.net.interfaces.render@v1")
    )]
    pub interfaces: Vec<InterfaceConfig>,
}

/// Interface configuration with immutable identity and tunable config.
/// Pattern matches LXC plugin: immutable core + tunable properties.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct InterfaceConfig {
    /// Interface name (e.g., "ovsbr0", "mesh").
    #[schemars(
        description = "Interface name",
        example = &"eth0",
        extend("readOnly" = true),
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "exp.service.net.interface.name.declare@v1")
    )]
    pub name: String,

    /// Interface type (e.g., "ovs-bridge", "ethernet").
    #[serde(rename = "type")]
    #[schemars(
        description = "Interface type",
        example = &"ethernet",
        extend("readOnly" = true),
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "exp.service.net.interface.type.declare@v1")
    )]
    pub if_type: InterfaceType,

    /// L2 driver to use (e.g., "openvswitch", "linux-bridge").
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    #[schemars(
        description = "L2 driver to use",
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "exp.service.net.interface.driver.declare@v1")
    )]
    pub driver: Option<String>,

    /// All tunable configuration in a single object.
    #[serde(flatten)]
    pub tunable: TunableConfig,
}

/// Tunable configuration - can be changed, each change tracked in snowball.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, Default, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct TunableConfig {
    /// Ports attached to this interface.
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    #[schemars(
        description = "Ports attached to this interface",
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "exp.service.net.interface.ports.declare@v1")
    )]
    pub ports: Option<Vec<String>>,

    /// L3 driver for IP configuration (e.g., "rtnetlink", "ovs-rpc", "systemd-networkd").
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    #[schemars(
        description = "L3 driver for IP configuration",
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "exp.service.net.interface.l3-driver.declare@v1")
    )]
    pub l3_driver: Option<String>,

    /// IPv4 configuration.
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    #[schemars(
        description = "IPv4 configuration",
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "exp.service.net.interface.ipv4.configure@v1")
    )]
    pub ipv4: Option<Ipv4Config>,

    /// IPv6 configuration.
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    #[schemars(
        description = "IPv6 configuration",
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "exp.service.net.interface.ipv6.configure@v1")
    )]
    pub ipv6: Option<Ipv6Config>,

    /// SDN controller (for OpenFlow).
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    #[schemars(
        description = "SDN controller (for OpenFlow)",
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "exp.service.net.interface.controller.declare@v1")
    )]
    pub controller: Option<String>,

    /// Dynamic properties - introspection captures ALL hardware properties here.
    /// Examples: mtu, mac_addresses (array), speed, duplex, txqueuelen, etc.
    ///
    /// APPEND-ONLY: Field names are permanent once added (by introspection or user).
    /// Values are mutable (ledger tracks all changes).
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    #[schemars(
        with = "serde_json::Value",
        description = "Dynamic properties captured by introspection",
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "exp.service.net.interface.properties.collect@v1")
    )]
    pub properties: Option<HashMap<String, Value>>,

    /// Property schema - tracks which fields exist (append-only set).
    /// Used for validation: new fields can be added, existing fields cannot be removed.
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    #[schemars(
        description = "Property schema - tracks which fields exist",
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "exp.service.net.interface.property-schema.declare@v1")
    )]
    pub property_schema: Option<Vec<String>>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(rename_all = "kebab-case")]
pub enum InterfaceType {
    Ethernet,
    OvsBridge,
    OvsPort,
    Bridge,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, Default, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct Ipv4Config {
    /// Whether IPv4 is enabled.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(
        description = "Whether IPv4 is enabled",
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "exp.service.net.ipv4.enabled.declare@v1")
    )]
    pub enabled: bool,
    /// Whether DHCP is enabled for IPv4.
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    #[schemars(
        description = "Whether DHCP is enabled for IPv4",
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "exp.service.net.ipv4.dhcp.declare@v1")
    )]
    pub dhcp: Option<bool>,
    /// Static IPv4 addresses.
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    #[schemars(
        description = "Static IPv4 addresses",
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "exp.service.net.ipv4.address.declare@v1")
    )]
    pub address: Option<Vec<AddressConfig>>,
    /// IPv4 default gateway.
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    #[schemars(
        description = "IPv4 default gateway",
        example = &"192.168.1.1",
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "exp.service.net.ipv4.gateway.declare@v1")
    )]
    pub gateway: Option<String>,
    /// IPv4 DNS servers.
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    #[schemars(
        description = "IPv4 DNS servers",
        example = &["1.1.1.1", "8.8.8.8"],
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "exp.service.net.ipv4.dns.declare@v1")
    )]
    pub dns: Option<Vec<String>>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, Default, schemars::JsonSchema)]

    #[serde(default)]

        description = "Whether IPv6 is enabled",
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "exp.service.net.ipv6.enabled.declare@v1")
    )]
    pub enabled: bool,
    /// Whether DHCP is enabled for IPv6.
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    #[schemars(
        description = "Whether DHCP is enabled for IPv6",
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "exp.service.net.ipv6.dhcp.declare@v1")
    )]
    pub dhcp: Option<bool>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]

        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "exp.service.net.address.ip.declare@v1")

        description = "CIDR prefix length",
        example = 24,
        extend("x-oscal-subid" = "exp.service.net.address.prefix.declare@v1")
    )]
