<file path="op-plugins/src/state_plugins/sessdecl.rs">
//! Caller-scoped runtime session metadata.
//!
//! This plugin never creates an identity or credential. The bridge supplies an
//! already verified principal and identity-authored session ID; declarations
//! only attach a display label to that exact pair in the shared Cozo runtime
//! document store.

use std::sync::Arc;

use anyhow::{bail, ensure, Context, Result};
use async_trait::async_trait;
use op_state::{ApplyResult, Checkpoint, DiffMetadata, PluginCapabilities, StateDiff, StatePlugin};
use op_state_store::{CapabilityDecl, PluginSchema};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use serde_json::Value as JsonValue;
use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
use simd_json::OwnedValue as Value;

use super::runtime_documents::RuntimeDocuments;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
#[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "sch.software.plugin.sessdecl.schema@v2"))]
#[schemars(extend("x-oscal-category" = "software"))]
pub struct SessDeclState {
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(
        description = "Caller-scoped display metadata for verified identity sessions",
        extend("default" = serde_json::json!([]), "x-oscal-subid" = "obs.software.plugin.sessdecl.sessions@v2")
    )]
    pub sessions: Vec<SessionDeclaration>,
}

/// Non-authoritative display metadata for an identity-authored session.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct SessionDeclaration {
    /// Exact session ID supplied by the verified invocation context.
    pub id: String,
    /// Exact stable principal ID supplied by the verified invocation context.
    pub user: String,
    /// Caller-selected display label. It has no authentication meaning.
    pub label: String,
    pub declared_at: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct DeclareSessionInput {
    #[schemars(length(min = 1, max = 128))]
    pub label: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum SessionListScope {
    CurrentSession,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct DeclareSessionOutput {
    pub declaration: SessionDeclaration,
    /// Whether this call created the metadata record. Repeating the same label
    /// for the same verified session is idempotent.
    pub created: bool,
    pub revision: u64,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct ListSessionsOutput {
    pub scope: SessionListScope,
    pub sessions: Vec<SessionDeclaration>,
    pub revision: u64,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct SessDeclAccessContext {
    pub principal_id: String,
    pub session_id: String,
}

impl SessDeclAccessContext {
    fn validate(&self) -> Result<()> {
        validate_identity_component("principal_id", &self.principal_id)?;
        validate_identity_component("session_id", &self.session_id)
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
struct SessionDocument {
    declaration: Option<SessionDeclaration>,
}

/// Long-lived adapter over the bridge's shared runtime-document handle.
pub struct SessDeclMethods {
    documents: Arc<RuntimeDocuments>,
}

impl SessDeclMethods {
    pub fn new(documents: Arc<RuntimeDocuments>) -> Self {
        Self { documents }
    }

    pub async fn dispatch(
        &self,
        context: &SessDeclAccessContext,
        method: &str,
        args: &JsonValue,
    ) -> Result<JsonValue> {
        context.validate()?;
        match method {
            "declare_session" => {
                let input: DeclareSessionInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())
                    .context("invalid declare_session arguments")?;
                self.declare_session(context, input).await
            }
            "list_sessions" => {
                validate_empty_input(args)?;
                self.list_sessions(context).await
            }
            _ => bail!("unsupported sess_decl method"),
        }
    }

    async fn declare_session(
        &self,
        context: &SessDeclAccessContext,
        input: DeclareSessionInput,
    ) -> Result<JsonValue> {
        validate_label(&input.label)?;
        let owner = owner_document_key(context);
        let principal_id = context.principal_id.clone();
        let session_id = context.session_id.clone();
        let label = input.label;
        let declared_at = chrono::Utc::now().to_rfc3339();
        let (row, (declaration, created)) = self
            .documents
            .update_with_result(&owner, move |old| {
                let mut document = parse_optional_document(old)?;
                if let Some(existing) = &document.declaration {
                    validate_stored_owner(existing, &principal_id, &session_id)?;
                    ensure!(
                        existing.label == label,
                        "session metadata is already declared with a different label"
                    );
                    return Ok((serde_json::to_value(&document)?, (existing.clone(), false)));
                }
                let declaration = SessionDeclaration {
                    id: session_id,
                    user: principal_id,
                    label,
                    declared_at,
                };
                document.declaration = Some(declaration.clone());
                Ok((serde_json::to_value(document)?, (declaration, true)))
            })
            .await?;
        Ok(serde_json::to_value(DeclareSessionOutput {
            declaration,
            created,
            revision: row.revision,
        })?)
    }

    async fn list_sessions(&self, context: &SessDeclAccessContext) -> Result<JsonValue> {
        let owner = owner_document_key(context);
        let Some(row) = self.documents.read(&owner).await? else {
            return Ok(serde_json::to_value(ListSessionsOutput {
                scope: SessionListScope::CurrentSession,
                sessions: Vec::new(),
                revision: 0,
            })?);
        };
        let document = parse_document(row.document)?;
        let sessions = match document.declaration {
            Some(declaration) => {
                validate_stored_owner(&declaration, &context.principal_id, &context.session_id)?;
                vec![declaration]
            }
            None => Vec::new(),
        };
        Ok(serde_json::to_value(ListSessionsOutput {
            scope: SessionListScope::CurrentSession,
            sessions,
            revision: row.revision,
        })?)
    }
}

fn parse_optional_document(value: Option<JsonValue>) -> Result<SessionDocument> {
    value
        .map(parse_document)
        .transpose()
        .map(Option::unwrap_or_default)
}

fn parse_document(value: JsonValue) -> Result<SessionDocument> {
    serde_json::from_value(value).context("invalid stored sess_decl document")
}

fn validate_identity_component(field: &str, value: &str) -> Result<()> {
    ensure!(!value.is_empty(), "verified {field} is required");
    ensure!(value.len() <= 512, "verified {field} is too long");
    ensure!(
        !value.chars().any(char::is_control),
        "verified {field} contains control characters"
    );
    Ok(())
}

fn validate_label(value: &str) -> Result<()> {
    ensure!(!value.trim().is_empty(), "session label is required");
    ensure!(value.len() <= 128, "session label is too long");
    ensure!(
        !value.chars().any(char::is_control),
        "session label contains control characters"
    );
    Ok(())
}

fn validate_stored_owner(
    declaration: &SessionDeclaration,
    principal_id: &str,
    session_id: &str,
) -> Result<()> {
    ensure!(
        declaration.user == principal_id && declaration.id == session_id,
        "stored session metadata owner binding is invalid"
    );
    Ok(())
}

fn validate_empty_input(value: &JsonValue) -> Result<()> {
    let object = value
        .as_object()
        .context("method input must be an object")?;
    ensure!(object.is_empty(), "method does not accept input fields");
    Ok(())
}

fn owner_document_key(context: &SessDeclAccessContext) -> String {
    let mut hash = Sha256::new();
    hash.update(b"op-dbus.sess-decl.owner.v2\0");
    hash.update(
        u64::try_from(context.principal_id.len())
            .expect("validated identity length fits u64")
            .to_be_bytes(),
    );
    hash.update(context.principal_id.as_bytes());
    hash.update(
        u64::try_from(context.session_id.len())
            .expect("validated identity length fits u64")
            .to_be_bytes(),
    );
    hash.update(context.session_id.as_bytes());
    format!("sess_decl:{:x}", hash.finalize())
}

pub struct SessDeclPlugin;

impl Default for SessDeclPlugin {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self
    }
}

impl SessDeclPlugin {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self
    }
}

#[async_trait]
impl StatePlugin for SessDeclPlugin {
    fn name(&self) -> &str {
        "sess_decl"
    }

    fn version(&self) -> &str {
        "2.0.0"
    }

    fn schema(&self) -> Option<PluginSchema> {
        Some(sess_decl_schema())
    }

    async fn calculate_diff(&self, _current: &Value, _desired: &Value) -> Result<StateDiff> {
        Ok(StateDiff {
            plugin: self.name().to_string(),
            actions: vec![],
            metadata: DiffMetadata {
                timestamp: chrono::Utc::now().timestamp(),
                current_hash: "unknown".to_string(),
                desired_hash: "unknown".to_string(),
            },
        })
    }

    async fn apply_state(&self, _diff: &StateDiff) -> Result<ApplyResult> {
        Ok(ApplyResult {
            success: true,
            changes_applied: vec![],
            errors: vec![],
            checkpoint: None,
        })
    }

    async fn verify_state(&self, _desired: &Value) -> Result<bool> {
        Ok(true)
    }

    async fn create_checkpoint(&self) -> Result<Checkpoint> {
        Ok(Checkpoint {
            id: uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string(),
            plugin: self.name().to_string(),
            timestamp: chrono::Utc::now().timestamp(),
            state_snapshot: simd_json::json!(null),
            backend_checkpoint: None,
        })
    }

    async fn rollback(&self, _checkpoint: &Checkpoint) -> Result<()> {
        Ok(())
    }

    fn capabilities(&self) -> PluginCapabilities {
        PluginCapabilities {
            supports_rollback: false,
            supports_checkpoints: false,
            supports_verification: false,
            atomic_operations: false,
        }
    }
}

pub(crate) fn sess_decl_schema() -> PluginSchema {
    let root = serde_json::to_value(schemars::schema_for!(SessDeclState))
        .expect("schemars schema serializes to JSON");
    let mut schema = super::schemars_adapter::plugin_schema_from_json(
        "sess_decl",
        "2.0.0",
        "Display metadata bound to an already verified identity session; this plugin does not mint identity or grant authentication",
        &root,
    );

    use super::plugin_scaffold_helpers::{method_decl_from_schemars_with_output, EmptyInput};
    use op_state_store::SideEffect;

    schema.methods.insert(
        "list_sessions".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<EmptyInput, ListSessionsOutput>(
            "list_sessions",
            SideEffect::Read,
            true,
            "sess_decl.read",
            "obs.software.plugin.sessdecl.sessions.list@v2",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "declare_session".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<DeclareSessionInput, DeclareSessionOutput>(
            "declare_session",
            SideEffect::Mutation,
            false,
            "sess_decl.write",
            "mut.software.plugin.sessdecl.session.declare@v2",
        ),
    );

    schema.capabilities.insert(
        "sess_decl.read".to_string(),
        CapabilityDecl {
            id: "sess_decl.read".to_string(),
            description: "Grants: list metadata for the caller's exact verified session."
                .to_string(),
        },
    );
    schema.capabilities.insert(
        "sess_decl.write".to_string(),
        CapabilityDecl {
            id: "sess_decl.write".to_string(),
            description: "Grants: attach display metadata to the caller's exact verified session. Does not create identity or authentication.".to_string(),
        },
    );
    schema.example = Some(simd_json::json!({"scope":"current_session","sessions":[]}));
    schema
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use op_cozo_store::CozoGraphShuttle;
    use serde_json::json;

    fn context(principal: &str, session: &str) -> SessDeclAccessContext {
        SessDeclAccessContext {
            principal_id: principal.to_string(),
            session_id: session.to_string(),
        }
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn declaration_uses_verified_owner_and_is_idempotent() {
        let service = SessDeclMethods::new(Arc::new(RuntimeDocuments::new(
            CozoGraphShuttle::new_in_memory().unwrap(),
        )));
        let owner = context("principal-a", "session-a");
        let first = service
            .dispatch(&owner, "declare_session", &json!({"label":"terminal"}))
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(first["declaration"]["id"], "session-a");
        assert_eq!(first["declaration"]["user"], "principal-a");
        assert_eq!(first["created"], true);
        assert!(first.get("sealed_id").is_none());

        let repeated = service
            .dispatch(&owner, "declare_session", &json!({"label":"terminal"}))
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(repeated["created"], false);
        assert!(service
            .dispatch(&owner, "declare_session", &json!({"label":"other"}))
            .await
            .is_err());
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn listing_isolated_by_exact_principal_and_session() {
        let service = SessDeclMethods::new(Arc::new(RuntimeDocuments::new(
            CozoGraphShuttle::new_in_memory().unwrap(),
        )));
        let owner = context("principal-a", "session-a");
        service
            .dispatch(&owner, "declare_session", &json!({"label":"private"}))
            .await
            .unwrap();
        let own = service
            .dispatch(&owner, "list_sessions", &json!({}))
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(own["scope"], "current_session");
        assert_eq!(own["sessions"].as_array().unwrap().len(), 1);

        for other in [
            context("principal-a", "session-b"),
            context("principal-b", "session-a"),
        ] {
            let hidden = service
                .dispatch(&other, "list_sessions", &json!({}))
                .await
                .unwrap();
            assert!(hidden["sessions"].as_array().unwrap().is_empty());
        }
        assert_ne!(
            owner_document_key(&context("ab", "c")),
            owner_document_key(&context("a", "bc"))
        );
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn declarations_survive_store_reopen() {
        let directory = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let path = directory.path().join("session-metadata");
        let owner = context("principal", "session");
        {
            let service = SessDeclMethods::new(Arc::new(RuntimeDocuments::new(
                CozoGraphShuttle::new_persistent(path.clone()).unwrap(),
            )));
            service
                .dispatch(&owner, "declare_session", &json!({"label":"durable"}))
                .await
                .unwrap();
        }
        let service = SessDeclMethods::new(Arc::new(RuntimeDocuments::new(
            CozoGraphShuttle::new_persistent(path).unwrap(),
        )));
        let listed = service
            .dispatch(&owner, "list_sessions", &json!({}))
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(listed["sessions"][0]["label"], "durable");
        assert_eq!(listed["sessions"][0]["id"], "session");
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn invalid_or_caller_asserted_identity_inputs_are_rejected() {
        let service = SessDeclMethods::new(Arc::new(RuntimeDocuments::new(
            CozoGraphShuttle::new_in_memory().unwrap(),
        )));
        let owner = context("principal", "session");
        for args in [
            json!({"label":""}),
            json!({"label":"bad\nlabel"}),
            json!({"label":"x".repeat(129)}),
            json!({"label":"ok","id":"forged"}),
            json!({"label":"ok","user":"forged"}),
        ] {
            assert!(service
                .dispatch(&owner, "declare_session", &args)
                .await
                .is_err());
        }
        assert!(service
            .dispatch(&context("", "session"), "list_sessions", &json!({}))
            .await
            .is_err());
        assert!(service
            .dispatch(&owner, "list_sessions", &json!({"principal":"forged"}))
            .await
            .is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn schema_declares_only_the_two_backed_methods() {
        let schema = sess_decl_schema();
        assert_eq!(schema.methods.len(), 2);
        assert!(schema.methods.contains_key("declare_session"));
        assert!(schema.methods.contains_key("list_sessions"));
        assert_eq!(schema.version, "2.0.0");
    }

    #[test]
    fn all_state_subids_are_valid() {
        fn collect(value: &JsonValue, output: &mut Vec<String>) {
            if let Some(object) = value.as_object() {
                if let Some(subid) = object.get("x-oscal-subid").and_then(JsonValue::as_str) {
                    output.push(subid.to_string());
                }
                for nested in object.values() {
                    collect(nested, output);
                }
            }
            if let Some(array) = value.as_array() {
                for nested in array {
                    collect(nested, output);
                }
            }
        }
        let schema = serde_json::to_value(schemars::schema_for!(SessDeclState)).unwrap();
        let mut subids = Vec::new();
        collect(&schema, &mut subids);
        assert!(!subids.is_empty());
        for subid in subids {
            assert!(crate::state_plugins::common::oscal::validate_subid(&subid).is_ok());
        }
    }
}

inventory::submit! {
    crate::default_registry::PluginReg::new("sess_decl", |_ctx| Arc::new(SessDeclPlugin::new()))
}
</file>

<file path="op-plugins/src/state_plugins/shared_unix_socket_methods.rs">
//! Durable native adapter for `shared_unix_socket` registration metadata.
//! The bridge injects its listener path; this module performs no socket or
//! filesystem operations.

use std::collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet};
use std::path::Path;
use std::sync::Arc;

use anyhow::{bail, ensure, Context, Result};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use serde_json::Value;

use super::runtime_documents::{RuntimeDocument, RuntimeDocuments};
use super::shared_unix_socket::{
    CreateUnixSocketInput, CreateUnixSocketOutput, GetConfigOutput, ListRegistrationsOutput,
    SharedRegistration, SharedUnixSocketConfig, SharedUnixSocketState,
};

const DOCUMENT_ID: &str = "shared_unix_socket";
const LISTENER_OWNER: &str = "op-grpc-bridge";

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
struct SharedUnixSocketDocument {
    registrations: BTreeMap<String, SharedRegistration>,
}

pub struct SharedUnixSocketMethods {
    documents: Arc<RuntimeDocuments>,
    shared_socket: String,
}

impl SharedUnixSocketMethods {
    /// The path was selected by bridge startup. Validation here is data-only.
    pub fn new(documents: Arc<RuntimeDocuments>, shared_socket: impl AsRef<Path>) -> Result<Self> {
        let shared_socket = shared_socket.as_ref();
        ensure!(
            shared_socket.is_absolute(),
            "shared socket path must be absolute"
        );
        let shared_socket = shared_socket
            .to_str()
            .context("shared socket path must be valid UTF-8")?
            .to_string();
        Ok(Self {
            documents,
            shared_socket,
        })
    }

    pub async fn dispatch(&self, method: &str, args: &Value) -> Result<Value> {
        match method {
            "create_unix_socket" => {
                self.create_unix_socket(serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?)
                    .await
            }
            "list_registrations" => {
                validate_empty_input(args)?;
                self.list_registrations().await
            }
            "get_config" => {
                validate_empty_input(args)?;
                self.get_config().await
            }
            _ => bail!("unsupported shared_unix_socket method"),
        }
    }

    async fn create_unix_socket(&self, input: CreateUnixSocketInput) -> Result<Value> {
        validate_name(&input.name)?;
        let mut ports = input.ports;
        ensure!(!ports.is_empty(), "ports must not be empty");
        ensure!(
            ports.iter().all(|port| *port != 0),
            "ports must be non-zero"
        );
        ports.sort_unstable();
        ports.dedup();

        let name = input.name;
        let now = chrono::Utc::now().to_rfc3339();
        let new_id = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();
        let (row, (registration, created, changed)) = self
            .documents
            .update_with_result(DOCUMENT_ID, move |old| {
                let mut document = parse_optional_document(old)?;
                let receipt = if let Some(existing) = document.registrations.get_mut(&name) {
                    let changed = existing.ports != ports || existing.protocol != "grpc";
                    if changed {
                        existing.ports = ports;
                        existing.protocol = "grpc".to_string();
                        existing.updated_at = now;
                    }
                    (existing.clone(), false, changed)
                } else {
                    let registration = SharedRegistration {
                        id: new_id,
                        name: name.clone(),
                        ports,
                        protocol: "grpc".to_string(),
                        created_at: now.clone(),
                        updated_at: now,
                    };
                    document.registrations.insert(name, registration.clone());
                    (registration, true, true)
                };
                Ok((serde_json::to_value(document)?, receipt))
            })
            .await?;

        Ok(serde_json::to_value(CreateUnixSocketOutput {
            registration,
            created,
            changed,
            revision: row.revision,
        })?)
    }

    async fn list_registrations(&self) -> Result<Value> {
        let (document, revision) = self.read_document().await?;
        Ok(serde_json::to_value(ListRegistrationsOutput {
            registrations: document.registrations.into_values().collect(),
            revision,
        })?)
    }

    async fn get_config(&self) -> Result<Value> {
        let (document, revision) = self.read_document().await?;
        Ok(serde_json::to_value(GetConfigOutput {
            config: SharedUnixSocketConfig {
                shared_socket: self.shared_socket.clone(),
                listener_owner: LISTENER_OWNER.to_string(),
                registration_count: u64::try_from(document.registrations.len())?,
                revision,
            },
        })?)
    }

    async fn read_document(&self) -> Result<(SharedUnixSocketDocument, u64)> {
        match self.documents.read(DOCUMENT_ID).await? {
            Some(row) => Ok((parse_document(row.document)?, row.revision)),
            None => Ok((SharedUnixSocketDocument::default(), 0)),
        }
    }
}

fn parse_optional_document(value: Option<Value>) -> Result<SharedUnixSocketDocument> {
    value
        .map(parse_document)
        .transpose()
        .map(Option::unwrap_or_default)
}

fn parse_document(value: Value) -> Result<SharedUnixSocketDocument> {
    let document: SharedUnixSocketDocument =
        serde_json::from_value(value).context("invalid shared Unix-socket runtime document")?;
    validate_document(&document)?;
    Ok(document)
}

fn validate_document(document: &SharedUnixSocketDocument) -> Result<()> {
    let mut ids = BTreeSet::new();
    for (key, registration) in &document.registrations {
        validate_name(&registration.name)?;
        ensure!(key == &registration.name, "registration key/name mismatch");
        ensure!(
            uuid::Uuid::parse_str(&registration.id).is_ok(),
            "registration id is not a UUID"
        );
        ensure!(ids.insert(&registration.id), "duplicate registration id");
        ensure!(registration.protocol == "grpc", "unsupported protocol");
        ensure!(!registration.ports.is_empty(), "ports must not be empty");
        ensure!(
            registration.ports.iter().all(|port| *port != 0),
            "ports must be non-zero"
        );
        ensure!(
            registration.ports.windows(2).all(|pair| pair[0] < pair[1]),
            "ports must be sorted and de-duplicated"
        );
        let created = chrono::DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(&registration.created_at)
            .context("invalid registration created_at")?;
        let updated = chrono::DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(&registration.updated_at)
            .context("invalid registration updated_at")?;
        ensure!(
            updated >= created,
            "registration updated_at predates created_at"
        );
    }
    Ok(())
}

/// Convert an owned durable row into startup registration state. Validation is
/// identical to the live method path, so corrupt rows cannot enter the bridge's
/// restoration pipeline.
pub fn restored_shared_registration_state(row: RuntimeDocument) -> Result<SharedUnixSocketState> {
    let document = parse_document(row.document)?;
    Ok(SharedUnixSocketState {
        registrations: document.registrations.into_values().collect(),
    })
}

fn validate_name(name: &str) -> Result<()> {
    ensure!(!name.is_empty(), "name must not be empty");
    ensure!(name.len() <= 256, "name is too long");
    ensure!(
        name.trim() == name,
        "name must not have surrounding whitespace"
    );
    ensure!(
        !name.chars().any(char::is_control),
        "name must not contain control characters"
    );
    Ok(())
}

fn validate_empty_input(args: &Value) -> Result<()> {
    ensure!(
        args.as_object().is_some_and(serde_json::Map::is_empty),
        "method takes no arguments"
    );
    Ok(())
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use op_cozo_store::CozoGraphShuttle;
    use serde_json::json;

    fn fixture(path: &str) -> SharedUnixSocketMethods {
        SharedUnixSocketMethods::new(
            Arc::new(RuntimeDocuments::new(
                CozoGraphShuttle::new_in_memory().unwrap(),
            )),
            path,
        )
        .unwrap()
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn all_methods_return_durable_actual_metadata() {
        let service = fixture("/fixture/bridge-owned.sock");
        let created = service
            .dispatch(
                "create_unix_socket",
                &json!({"name":"qdrant","ports":[6334,6333,6333]}),
            )
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(created["created"], true);
        assert_eq!(created["registration"]["ports"], json!([6333, 6334]));
        let id = created["registration"]["id"].as_str().unwrap().to_string();

        let repeated = service
            .dispatch(
                "create_unix_socket",
                &json!({"name":"qdrant","ports":[6333,6334]}),
            )
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(repeated["created"], false);
        assert_eq!(repeated["changed"], false);
        assert_eq!(repeated["registration"]["id"], id);

        let updated = service
            .dispatch(
                "create_unix_socket",
                &json!({"name":"qdrant","ports":[6335]}),
            )
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(updated["created"], false);
        assert_eq!(updated["changed"], true);
        assert_eq!(updated["registration"]["id"], id);

        let listed = service
            .dispatch("list_registrations", &json!({}))
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(listed["registrations"].as_array().unwrap().len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(listed["registrations"][0]["ports"], json!([6335]));
        assert_eq!(listed["revision"], 3);

        let config = service.dispatch("get_config", &json!({})).await.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            config["config"]["shared_socket"],
            "/fixture/bridge-owned.sock"
        );
        assert_eq!(config["config"]["listener_owner"], LISTENER_OWNER);
        assert_eq!(config["config"]["registration_count"], 1);
        assert_eq!(config["config"]["revision"], 3);

        let row = service.documents.read(DOCUMENT_ID).await.unwrap().unwrap();
        let restored = restored_shared_registration_state(row).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(restored.registrations.len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(restored.registrations[0].id, id);
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn invalid_inputs_do_not_commit() {
        assert!(SharedUnixSocketMethods::new(
            Arc::new(RuntimeDocuments::new(
                CozoGraphShuttle::new_in_memory().unwrap(),
            )),
            "relative.sock",
        )
        .is_err());
        let service = fixture("/fixture/bridge-owned.sock");
        for args in [
            json!({"name":"","ports":[1]}),
            json!({"name":" qdrant","ports":[1]}),
            json!({"name":"qdrant","ports":[]}),
            json!({"name":"qdrant","ports":[0]}),
        ] {
            assert!(service.dispatch("create_unix_socket", &args).await.is_err());
        }
        assert!(service
            .dispatch("list_registrations", &json!({"unexpected":true}))
            .await
            .is_err());
        let listed = service
            .dispatch("list_registrations", &json!({}))
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(listed["revision"], 0);
        assert!(listed["registrations"].as_array().unwrap().is_empty());

        let invalid = RuntimeDocument {
            revision: 1,
            document: json!({"registrations":{"wrong-key":{
                "id":uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string(),
                "name":"other-name","ports":[2,1],"protocol":"grpc",
                "created_at":"2026-09-13T00:00:00Z","updated_at":"2026-09-13T00:00:00Z"
            }}}),
        };
        assert!(restored_shared_registration_state(invalid).is_err());
    }
}
</file>

<file path="op-plugins/src/state_plugins/shared_unix_socket.rs">
//! Schema carrier for durable shared Unix-socket registrations.
//!
//! The bridge owns and binds the listener. Runtime methods store metadata only.

use anyhow::{bail, Result};
use async_trait::async_trait;
use op_state::{ApplyResult, Checkpoint, DiffMetadata, PluginCapabilities, StateDiff, StatePlugin};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use simd_json::OwnedValue as Value;

fn default_protocol() -> String {
    "grpc".to_string()
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
#[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "sch.software.shared-unix-socket.registration.schema@v2"))]
pub struct SharedRegistration {
    /// Stable across updates to the same registration name.
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "obs.service.shared-unix-socket.registration.id@v1"))]
    pub id: String,
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "mut.service.shared-unix-socket.registration.name@v1"))]
    pub name: String,
    /// Recorded metadata only; this plugin opens no ports.
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "mut.service.shared-unix-socket.registration.ports@v1"))]
    pub ports: Vec<u16>,
    #[serde(default = "default_protocol")]
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "obs.service.shared-unix-socket.registration.protocol@v1"))]
    pub protocol: String,
    pub created_at: String,
    pub updated_at: String,
}

/// Public metadata shape. Values come from the durable method adapter, never a
/// sealed-schema example.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, Default, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "sch.software.plugin.shared-unix-socket.schema@v2"))]
#[schemars(extend("x-oscal-category" = "service"))]
pub struct SharedUnixSocketState {
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "obs.service.shared-unix-socket.registrations@v1"))]
    pub registrations: Vec<SharedRegistration>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct CreateUnixSocketInput {
    pub name: String,
    pub ports: Vec<u16>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct CreateUnixSocketOutput {
    pub registration: SharedRegistration,
    pub created: bool,
    pub changed: bool,
    pub revision: u64,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct ListRegistrationsOutput {
    pub registrations: Vec<SharedRegistration>,
    pub revision: u64,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct SharedUnixSocketConfig {
    /// Exact listener path supplied by bridge startup.
    pub shared_socket: String,
    pub listener_owner: String,
    pub registration_count: u64,
    pub revision: u64,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct GetConfigOutput {
    pub config: SharedUnixSocketConfig,
}

pub struct SharedUnixSocketPlugin;

impl SharedUnixSocketPlugin {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self
    }
}

impl Default for SharedUnixSocketPlugin {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}

#[async_trait]
impl StatePlugin for SharedUnixSocketPlugin {
    fn name(&self) -> &str {
        "shared_unix_socket"
    }

    fn version(&self) -> &str {
        "2.0.0"
    }

    fn schema(&self) -> Option<op_state_store::PluginSchema> {
        let mut schema = super::plugin_scaffold_helpers::shared_unix_socket_plugin_schema();
        super::common::oscal::ensure_category_metadata_fields(&mut schema);
        Some(schema)
    }

    async fn calculate_diff(&self, _current: &Value, _desired: &Value) -> Result<StateDiff> {
        Ok(StateDiff {
            plugin: self.name().to_string(),
            actions: vec![],
            metadata: DiffMetadata {
                timestamp: chrono::Utc::now().timestamp(),
                current_hash: String::new(),
                desired_hash: String::new(),
            },
        })
    }

    async fn apply_state(&self, _diff: &StateDiff) -> Result<ApplyResult> {
        Ok(ApplyResult {
            success: true,
            changes_applied: vec![],
            errors: vec![],
            checkpoint: None,
        })
    }

    async fn verify_state(&self, _desired: &Value) -> Result<bool> {
        bail!("shared Unix-socket metadata has no StatePlugin verification operation")
    }

    async fn create_checkpoint(&self) -> Result<Checkpoint> {
        bail!("shared Unix-socket metadata has no StatePlugin checkpoint operation")
    }

    async fn rollback(&self, _checkpoint: &Checkpoint) -> Result<()> {
        bail!("shared Unix-socket metadata has no StatePlugin rollback operation")
    }

    fn capabilities(&self) -> PluginCapabilities {
        PluginCapabilities {
            supports_rollback: false,
            supports_checkpoints: false,
            supports_verification: false,
            atomic_operations: false,
        }
    }
}

pub(crate) fn shared_unix_socket_schema() -> op_state_store::PluginSchema {
    let root = serde_json::to_value(schemars::schema_for!(SharedUnixSocketState))
        .expect("schemars schema serializes to JSON");
    let mut schema = super::schemars_adapter::plugin_schema_from_json(
        "shared_unix_socket",
        "2.0.0",
        "Durable service registrations for the bridge-owned shared Unix socket",
        &root,
    );
    use super::plugin_scaffold_helpers::method_decl_from_schemars_with_output;
    use op_state_store::SideEffect;

    schema.methods.insert(
        "create_unix_socket".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<CreateUnixSocketInput, CreateUnixSocketOutput>(
            "create_unix_socket",
            SideEffect::Mutation,
            true,
            "shared_unix_socket.invoke",
            "mut.service.shared-unix-socket.create@v2",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "list_registrations".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<(), ListRegistrationsOutput>(
            "list_registrations",
            SideEffect::Read,
            true,
            "shared_unix_socket.read",
            "obs.service.shared-unix-socket.registrations.list@v2",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "get_config".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<(), GetConfigOutput>(
            "get_config",
            SideEffect::Read,
            true,
            "shared_unix_socket.read",
            "obs.service.shared-unix-socket.config.get@v2",
        ),
    );
    schema.capabilities.insert(
        "shared_unix_socket.invoke".to_string(),
        op_state_store::CapabilityDecl {
            id: "shared_unix_socket.invoke".to_string(),
            description: "Grants only durable create_unix_socket metadata registration; it does not grant listener or routing control.".to_string(),
        },
    );
    schema.capabilities.insert(
        "shared_unix_socket.read".to_string(),
        op_state_store::CapabilityDecl {
            id: "shared_unix_socket.read".to_string(),
            description: "Grants: list_registrations, get_config.".to_string(),
        },
    );
    schema
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn retained_methods_have_typed_outputs_and_matching_names() {
        let schema = shared_unix_socket_schema();
        assert_eq!(schema.version, "2.0.0");
        for name in ["create_unix_socket", "list_registrations", "get_config"] {
            let method = &schema.methods[name];
            assert_eq!(method.name, name);
            assert!(method.returns.is_some());
        }
    }
}

inventory::submit! {
    crate::default_registry::PluginReg::new("shared_unix_socket", |_ctx| std::sync::Arc::new(SharedUnixSocketPlugin::new()))
}
</file>

<file path="op-plugins/src/state_plugins/snowball_methods.rs">
//! Typed canonical-method adapter over the bridge-owned Snowball chain.

use std::sync::Arc;

use anyhow::{bail, ensure, Context, Result};
use op_snowball::{RetentionPolicy, StreamingSnowball};
use serde_json::Value;
use tokio::sync::Mutex;

use super::snowball_plugin::{
    CreateSnapshotOutput, GetCurrentStateOutput, GetSnapshotOutput, ListSnapshotsOutput,
    RetentionView, RollbackOutput, SetRetentionInput, SetRetentionOutput, SnapshotInput,
    SnapshotRecord, SnowballEmptyInput, SnowballStatsOutput,
};

const MAX_RETENTION_PER_BUCKET: u32 = 10_000;

pub struct SnowballMethods {
    chain: Arc<StreamingSnowball>,
    canonical_operation: Mutex<()>,
}

impl SnowballMethods {
    pub fn from_shared(chain: Arc<StreamingSnowball>) -> Self {
        Self {
            chain,
            canonical_operation: Mutex::new(()),
        }
    }

    pub async fn dispatch(&self, method: &str, args: &Value) -> Result<Value> {
        match method {
            "create_snapshot" => {
                let _: SnowballEmptyInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
                serde_json::to_value(self.create_snapshot().await?).map_err(Into::into)
            }
            "get_current_state" => {
                let _: SnowballEmptyInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
                serde_json::to_value(self.get_current_state().await?).map_err(Into::into)
            }
            "get_snapshot" => {
                let input: SnapshotInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
                serde_json::to_value(self.get_snapshot(&input.snapshot_name).await?)
                    .map_err(Into::into)
            }
            "get_stats" => {
                let _: SnowballEmptyInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
                serde_json::to_value(self.get_stats().await?).map_err(Into::into)
            }
            "list_snapshots" => {
                let _: SnowballEmptyInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
                serde_json::to_value(self.list_snapshots().await?).map_err(Into::into)
            }
            "rollback" => {
                let input: SnapshotInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
                serde_json::to_value(self.rollback(&input.snapshot_name).await?).map_err(Into::into)
            }
            "set_retention" => {
                let input: SetRetentionInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())?;
                serde_json::to_value(self.set_retention(input).await?).map_err(Into::into)
            }
            _ => bail!("unsupported snowball method: {method}"),
        }
    }

    async fn create_snapshot(&self) -> Result<CreateSnapshotOutput> {
        let _guard = self.canonical_operation.lock().await;
        let name = self.chain.create_snapshot().await?;
        let snapshot = self.snapshot(&name).await?;
        Ok(CreateSnapshotOutput { snapshot })
    }

    async fn get_current_state(&self) -> Result<GetCurrentStateOutput> {
        let state = self.chain.current_state().await?;
        Ok(GetCurrentStateOutput {
            initialized: state.is_some(),
            state: state.map(simd_to_json).transpose()?,
        })
    }

    async fn list_snapshots(&self) -> Result<ListSnapshotsOutput> {
        let snapshots = self.chain.list_snapshots().await?;
        let snapshots = snapshots
            .into_iter()
            .map(|(name, created)| {
                Ok(SnapshotRecord {
                    counter: self.chain.state_snapshot_counter(&name)?,
                    name,
                    created,
                    state: None,
                })
            })
            .collect::<Result<_>>()?;
        Ok(ListSnapshotsOutput { snapshots })
    }

    async fn get_snapshot(&self, name: &str) -> Result<GetSnapshotOutput> {
        Ok(GetSnapshotOutput {
            snapshot: self.snapshot(name).await?,
        })
    }

    async fn snapshot(&self, name: &str) -> Result<SnapshotRecord> {
        let counter = self.chain.state_snapshot_counter(name)?;
        let created = self
            .chain
            .list_snapshots()
            .await?
            .into_iter()
            .find_map(|(candidate, created)| (candidate == name).then_some(created))
            .with_context(|| format!("Snowball snapshot not found: {name}"))?;
        let state = self
            .chain
            .read_snapshot_state(name)
            .await?
            .map(simd_to_json)
            .transpose()?;
        Ok(SnapshotRecord {
            name: name.to_string(),
            counter,
            created,
            state,
        })
    }

    async fn get_stats(&self) -> Result<SnowballStatsOutput> {
        let blocks = self.chain.blocks().await?;
        let snapshots = self.chain.list_snapshots().await?;
        let retention = retention_view(self.chain.retention_policy().await);
        Ok(SnowballStatsOutput {
            readable_block_count: u64::try_from(blocks.len())?,
            vectorized_block_count: u64::try_from(
                blocks.iter().filter(|block| block.has_vector).count(),
            )?,
            snapshot_count: u64::try_from(snapshots.len())?,
            latest_block_number: blocks.last().map(|block| block.block_num),
            retention,
        })
    }

    async fn rollback(&self, name: &str) -> Result<RollbackOutput> {
        let _guard = self.canonical_operation.lock().await;
        self.chain.state_snapshot_counter(name)?;
        let restored_state = self.chain.rollback(name).await?;
        Ok(RollbackOutput {
            snapshot_name: name.to_string(),
            restored_current_state: simd_to_json(restored_state)?,
        })
    }

    async fn set_retention(&self, input: SetRetentionInput) -> Result<SetRetentionOutput> {
        let _guard = self.canonical_operation.lock().await;
        for count in [input.hourly, input.daily, input.weekly, input.quarterly] {
            ensure!(
                count <= MAX_RETENTION_PER_BUCKET,
                "Snowball retention bucket exceeds {MAX_RETENTION_PER_BUCKET}"
            );
        }
        ensure!(
            input.hourly + input.daily + input.weekly + input.quarterly > 0,
            "Snowball retention must keep at least one snapshot"
        );
        let policy = RetentionPolicy::new(
            input.hourly as usize,
            input.daily as usize,
            input.weekly as usize,
            input.quarterly as usize,
        );
        self.chain.set_retention_policy(policy).await?;
        Ok(SetRetentionOutput {
            retention: retention_view(policy),
            remaining_snapshots: u64::try_from(self.chain.list_snapshots().await?.len())?,
        })
    }
}

fn retention_view(policy: RetentionPolicy) -> RetentionView {
    RetentionView {
        hourly: policy.hourly,
        daily: policy.daily,
        weekly: policy.weekly,
        quarterly: policy.quarterly,
    }
}

fn simd_to_json(value: simd_json::OwnedValue) -> Result<Value> {
    serde_json::to_value(value).context("convert Snowball state to transport JSON")
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    async fn fixture() -> (tempfile::TempDir, Arc<StreamingSnowball>, SnowballMethods) {
        let dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let chain = Arc::new(
            StreamingSnowball::new(dir.path().join("snowball"))
                .await
                .unwrap(),
        );
        let methods = SnowballMethods::from_shared(Arc::clone(&chain));
        (dir, chain, methods)
    }

    async fn snapshot_readback(methods: &SnowballMethods, names: &[String]) -> Value {
        let empty = serde_json::json!({});
        let mut records = Vec::new();
        for name in names {
            records.push(
                methods
                    .dispatch("get_snapshot", &serde_json::json!({"snapshot_name": name}))
                    .await
                    .unwrap(),
            );
        }
        serde_json::json!({
            "current": methods.dispatch("get_current_state", &empty).await.unwrap(),
            "list": methods.dispatch("list_snapshots", &empty).await.unwrap(),
            "records": records,
        })
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn failed_unknown_rollback_preserves_state_and_retained_snapshots_after_reopen() {
        let (dir, chain, methods) = fixture().await;
        chain
            .set_retention_policy(RetentionPolicy::new(10, 0, 0, 0))
            .await
            .unwrap();
        let mut names = Vec::new();
        for generation in 1..=2 {
            chain
                .write_current_state(&simd_json::json!({
                    "generation": generation,
                    "unrelated": format!("state-{generation}"),
                }))
                .await
                .unwrap();
            let created = methods
                .dispatch("create_snapshot", &serde_json::json!({}))
                .await
                .unwrap();
            assert_eq!(created["snapshot"]["state"]["generation"], generation);
            names.push(created["snapshot"]["name"].as_str().unwrap().to_owned());
        }
        assert_ne!(names[0], names[1]);
        let before = snapshot_readback(&methods, &names).await;
        assert_eq!(before["current"]["state"]["generation"], 2);
        assert_eq!(before["list"]["snapshots"].as_array().unwrap().len(), 2);
        assert!(methods
            .dispatch(
                "rollback",
                &serde_json::json!({"snapshot_name": "SNP-999999"})
            )
            .await
            .is_err());
        assert!(
            !tokio::fs::try_exists(dir.path().join("snowball/snapshots/SNP-999999"))
                .await
                .unwrap()
        );
        assert_eq!(snapshot_readback(&methods, &names).await, before);

        drop(methods);
        drop(chain);
        let reopened = Arc::new(
            StreamingSnowball::new(dir.path().join("snowball"))
                .await
                .unwrap(),
        );
        let reopened_methods = SnowballMethods::from_shared(reopened);
        assert_eq!(snapshot_readback(&reopened_methods, &names).await, before);
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn seven_methods_use_persistent_snapshot_state() {
        let (dir, chain, methods) = fixture().await;
        let empty = serde_json::json!({});

        let initial = methods.dispatch("get_current_state", &empty).await.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(initial["initialized"], false);

        chain
            .write_current_state(&simd_json::json!({"generation": 1}))
            .await
            .unwrap();
        let first = methods.dispatch("create_snapshot", &empty).await.unwrap();
        let first_name = first["snapshot"]["name"].as_str().unwrap().to_string();
        assert_eq!(first["snapshot"]["state"]["generation"], 1);

        chain
            .write_current_state(&simd_json::json!({"generation": 2}))
            .await
            .unwrap();
        methods.dispatch("create_snapshot", &empty).await.unwrap();
        let listed = methods.dispatch("list_snapshots", &empty).await.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(listed["snapshots"].as_array().unwrap().len(), 2);

        let fetched = methods
            .dispatch(
                "get_snapshot",
                &serde_json::json!({"snapshot_name": first_name}),
            )
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(fetched["snapshot"]["state"]["generation"], 1);

        let rolled_back = methods
            .dispatch(
                "rollback",
                &serde_json::json!({"snapshot_name": first_name}),
            )
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(rolled_back["restored_current_state"]["generation"], 1);
        let current = methods.dispatch("get_current_state", &empty).await.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(current["state"]["generation"], 1);

        let stats = methods.dispatch("get_stats", &empty).await.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(stats["snapshot_count"], 2);
        assert_eq!(stats["readable_block_count"], 0);

        let retained = methods
            .dispatch(
                "set_retention",
                &serde_json::json!({"hourly":1,"daily":0,"weekly":0,"quarterly":0}),
            )
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(retained["remaining_snapshots"], 1);

        drop(methods);
        drop(chain);
        let reopened = Arc::new(
            StreamingSnowball::new(dir.path().join("snowball"))
                .await
                .unwrap(),
        );
        let reopened_methods = SnowballMethods::from_shared(reopened);
        let reopened_stats = reopened_methods
            .dispatch("get_stats", &empty)
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(reopened_stats["retention"]["hourly"], 1);
        assert_eq!(reopened_stats["snapshot_count"], 1);
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn rejects_missing_invalid_and_unsafe_requests() {
        let (_dir, chain, methods) = fixture().await;
        assert!(methods
            .dispatch(
                "get_snapshot",
                &serde_json::json!({"snapshot_name":"../state"})
            )
            .await
            .is_err());
        assert!(methods
            .dispatch(
                "rollback",
                &serde_json::json!({"snapshot_name":"SNP-999999"})
            )
            .await
            .is_err());
        assert!(methods
            .dispatch(
                "set_retention",
                &serde_json::json!({"hourly":0,"daily":0,"weekly":0,"quarterly":0}),
            )
            .await
            .is_err());
        assert!(methods
            .dispatch("get_stats", &serde_json::json!({"unexpected":true}))
            .await
            .is_err());

        let corrupt = chain.base_path().join("snapshots/SNP-000001");
        tokio::fs::create_dir_all(corrupt.join("state"))
            .await
            .unwrap();
        tokio::fs::write(corrupt.join(".committed"), b"")
            .await
            .unwrap();
        tokio::fs::write(corrupt.join("state/current.json"), b"not-json")
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert!(methods
            .dispatch(
                "rollback",
                &serde_json::json!({"snapshot_name":"SNP-000001"}),
            )
            .await
            .is_err());
        assert_eq!(chain.current_state().await.unwrap(), None);
    }
}

<file path="op-plugins/src/state_plugins/snowball_plugin.rs">
//! `snowball` StatePlugin — exposes the live streaming-snowball audit chain
//! (`op-snowball`) through the `org.opdbus.v1.plugins` surface, reachable over
//! `PluginService.CallMethod`.
//!
//! This is the correct home for the capability the Lovable frontend mistakenly
//! called as a standalone `operation.snowball.v1.SnowballService` gRPC
//! package — there is no such proto and there must not be one. New backend
//! capabilities register here as plugins; the served gRPC surface stays the one
//! shared route-builder.
//!
//! Every canonical method uses the bridge-owned shared Snowball handle. The
//! legacy `StatePlugin` view can read the configured chain, but refuses writes
//! so it cannot create a competing writer lifecycle.

use anyhow::Result;
use async_trait::async_trait;
use op_snowball::StreamingSnowball;
use op_state::{
    ApplyResult, Checkpoint, DiffMetadata, PluginCapabilities, StateAction, StateDiff, StatePlugin,
};
use op_state_store::PluginSchema;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use simd_json::OwnedValue as Value;
use std::path::PathBuf;

/// Default on-disk location of the streaming snowball when
/// `$OPDBUS_SNOWBALL_PATH` is unset.
const DEFAULT_BASE_PATH: &str = "/var/lib/opdbus/snowball";

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct RetentionView {
    /// Hourly retention count.
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "obs.software.snowball.retention.hourly@v1"))]
    pub hourly: usize,
    /// Daily retention count.
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "obs.software.snowball.retention.daily@v1"))]
    pub daily: usize,
    /// Weekly retention count.
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "obs.software.snowball.retention.weekly@v1"))]
    pub weekly: usize,
    /// Quarterly retention count.
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "obs.software.snowball.retention.quarterly@v1"))]
    pub quarterly: usize,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct SnapshotEntry {
    /// Snapshot name.
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "exp.software.snowball.snapshot.name@v1"))]
    pub name: String,
    /// Snapshot creation timestamp.
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "exp.software.snowball.snapshot.created@v1"))]
    pub created: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct SnowballEmptyInput {}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct SnapshotInput {
    pub snapshot_name: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct SnapshotRecord {
    pub name: String,
    pub counter: u64,
    pub created: String,
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub state: Option<serde_json::Value>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct CreateSnapshotOutput {
    pub snapshot: SnapshotRecord,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct ListSnapshotsOutput {
    pub snapshots: Vec<SnapshotRecord>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct GetSnapshotOutput {
    pub snapshot: SnapshotRecord,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct GetCurrentStateOutput {
    pub initialized: bool,
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub state: Option<serde_json::Value>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct SnowballStatsOutput {
    /// Timing records that parsed as complete Snowball blocks.
    pub readable_block_count: u64,
    pub vectorized_block_count: u64,
    pub snapshot_count: u64,
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub latest_block_number: Option<u64>,
    pub retention: RetentionView,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct RollbackOutput {
    /// The Snowball state-directory snapshot used as the source.
    pub snapshot_name: String,
    /// Restored disaster-recovery image only. This does not apply state to any
    /// live provider; provider restoration must use that plugin's own method.
    pub restored_current_state: serde_json::Value,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct SetRetentionInput {
    pub hourly: u32,
    pub daily: u32,
    pub weekly: u32,
    pub quarterly: u32,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct SetRetentionOutput {
    pub retention: RetentionView,
    pub remaining_snapshots: u64,
}

// ── Audit-trail query surface (accountability-audit-trail spec) ──────────────
//
// These types are declared at module scope (not inside `snowball_schema()`
// like the older output structs) because `op-grpc-bridge`'s MutationEngine
// imports them to implement the `query_events` / `verify_chain` dispatch arm.
// The same `EventChain` that the gRPC `EventChainService` serves is read here,
// so the D-Bus/MCP path and the gRPC path never disagree.

/// Input for `query_events` — paginated audit-trail query.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema, Default)]
#[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "sch.service.snowball.query-events-input@v1"))]
pub struct QueryEventsInput {
    /// Filter by plugin_id. Absent or empty means all plugins.
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub plugin_id: Option<String>,
    /// Return events with `event_id >= from_event_id`.
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub from_event_id: Option<u64>,
    /// Return events with `event_id <= to_event_id`.
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub to_event_id: Option<u64>,
    /// Max events to return. Default 50, clamped to 100.
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub limit: Option<u32>,
    /// Filter by decision: `allow`, `deny`, or absent for all.
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub decision: Option<String>,
}

/// One audit event, flattened for transport across the plugin surface.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "sch.service.snowball.audit-event-record@v1"))]
pub struct AuditEventRecord {
    pub event_id: u64,
    pub event_hash: String,
    pub prev_hash: String,
    /// ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 timestamp.
    pub timestamp: String,
    pub actor_id: String,
    pub capability_id: String,
    pub plugin_id: String,
    pub method_name: String,
    pub operation_type: String,
    pub target: String,
    pub tags_touched: Vec<String>,
    pub decision: String,
    pub input_patch_hash: String,
    pub result_effective_hash: String,
}

/// Output for `query_events`.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "sch.service.snowball.query-events-output@v1"))]
pub struct QueryEventsOutput {
    /// The page of events, oldest-first within the requested range.
    pub events: Vec<AuditEventRecord>,
    /// True when more events match the filter beyond this page.
    pub has_more: bool,
    /// Total number of events currently in the chain.
    pub total_in_chain: u64,
}

/// Input for `verify_chain` — hash-chain integrity check.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema, Default)]
#[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "sch.service.snowball.verify-chain-input@v1"))]
pub struct VerifyChainInput {
    /// Verify from this event_id. Absent or 0 means from genesis.
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub from_event_id: Option<u64>,
    /// Verify to this event_id. Absent or 0 means to the latest event.
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub to_event_id: Option<u64>,
}

/// Output for `verify_chain`.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "sch.service.snowball.verify-chain-output@v1"))]
pub struct VerifyChainOutput {
    /// True when every event in range hashes correctly and links to its predecessor.
    pub valid: bool,
    /// Number of events checked.
    pub events_verified: u64,
    /// One entry per detected integrity violation. Empty when `valid` is true.
    pub errors: Vec<String>,
}

/// Snowball plugin state schema.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "sch.software.plugin.snowball.schema@v1"))]
#[schemars(extend("x-oscal-category" = "service"))]
pub struct SnowballState {
    /// `active` once the chain exists on disk, `uninitialized` before first write.
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "obs.software.snowball.status@v1"))]
    pub status: String,
    /// Snowball base path.
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "exp.software.snowball.base-path@v1"))]
    pub base_path: String,
    /// Snowball snapshot interval.
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "mut.service.snowball.snapshot-interval@v1"))]
    pub snapshot_interval: String,
    /// Snowball retention policy.
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "obs.service.snowball.retention@v1"))]
    pub retention: RetentionView,
    /// Number of snapshots.
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "exp.software.snowball.snapshot-count@v1"))]
    pub snapshot_count: usize,
    /// List of snapshots.
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "exp.software.snowball.snapshots@v1"))]
    pub snapshots: Vec<SnapshotEntry>,
    /// Current snowball state.
    #[schemars(skip)]
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "obs.software.snowball.current-state@v1"))]
    pub current_state: Option<Value>,
}

pub struct SnowballPlugin {
    base_path: PathBuf,
}

impl Default for SnowballPlugin {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}

impl SnowballPlugin {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        let base_path = std::env::var("OPDBUS_SNOWBALL_PATH")
            .map(PathBuf::from)
            .unwrap_or_else(|_| PathBuf::from(DEFAULT_BASE_PATH));
        Self { base_path }
    }

    /// Open the on-disk chain. `StreamingSnowball::new` is idempotent: it only
    /// (re)creates subvolumes that do not already exist, so opening an existing
    /// chain is non-destructive. Callers that must not create the chain should
    /// gate on `base_path.exists()` first (see [`read_live`]).
    async fn open(&self) -> Result<StreamingSnowball> {
        StreamingSnowball::new(&self.base_path).await
    }

    /// Read the live chain state. If the chain has not been initialized on disk
    /// yet, report an honest `uninitialized` state rather than creating it as a
    /// side effect of a read.
    async fn read_live(&self) -> Result<SnowballState> {
        if !self.base_path.exists() {
            return Ok(SnowballState {
                status: "uninitialized".to_string(),
                base_path: self.base_path.display().to_string(),
                snapshot_interval: String::new(),
                retention: RetentionView {
                    hourly: 0,
                    daily: 0,
                    weekly: 0,
                    quarterly: 0,
                },
                snapshot_count: 0,
                snapshots: Vec::new(),
                current_state: None,
            });
        }

        let chain = self.open().await?;

        let snapshots: Vec<SnapshotEntry> = chain
            .list_snapshots()
            .await?
            .into_iter()
            .map(|(name, created)| SnapshotEntry { name, created })
            .collect();

        let current_state = chain.current_state().await?;

        let retention = chain.retention_policy().await;

        Ok(SnowballState {
            status: "active".to_string(),
            base_path: chain.base_path().display().to_string(),
            snapshot_interval: chain.snapshot_interval().to_string(),
            retention: RetentionView {
                hourly: retention.hourly,
                daily: retention.daily,
                weekly: retention.weekly,
                quarterly: retention.quarterly,
            },
            snapshot_count: snapshots.len(),
            snapshots,
            current_state,
        })
    }

    /// Synchronous shape exemplar used only to derive the [`PluginSchema`]. The
    /// schema describes the *shape* of the plugin's live state output (field
    /// names + types); the data path itself is always live.
    fn schema_exemplar() -> SnowballState {
        SnowballState {
            status: "active".to_string(),
            base_path: DEFAULT_BASE_PATH.to_string(),
            snapshot_interval: "every-15-minutes".to_string(),
            retention: RetentionView {
                hourly: 24,
                daily: 7,
                weekly: 4,
                quarterly: 4,
            },
            snapshot_count: 0,
            snapshots: vec![SnapshotEntry {
                name: "state-000001".to_string(),
                created: "1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC".to_string(),
            }],
            current_state: None,
        }
    }
}

#[async_trait]
impl StatePlugin for SnowballPlugin {
    fn name(&self) -> &str {
        "snowball"
    }

    fn version(&self) -> &str {
        "2.0.0"
    }

    fn schema(&self) -> Option<PluginSchema> {
        Some(snowball_schema())
    }

    async fn calculate_diff(&self, current: &Value, desired: &Value) -> Result<StateDiff> {
        // The only writable projection of an append-only audit chain is its DR
        // `current_state` blob. Emit a real Modify when the desired state
        // differs, otherwise a NoOp.
        let actions = if current == desired {
            vec![StateAction::NoOp {
                resource: "current_state".to_string(),
            }]
        } else {
            vec![StateAction::Modify {
                resource: "current_state".to_string(),
                changes: desired.clone(),
            }]
        };
        Ok(StateDiff {
            plugin: self.name().to_string(),
            actions,
            metadata: DiffMetadata {
                timestamp: chrono::Utc::now().timestamp(),
                current_hash: String::new(),
                desired_hash: String::new(),
            },
        })
    }

    async fn apply_state(&self, diff: &StateDiff) -> Result<ApplyResult> {
        let _ = diff;
        anyhow::bail!(
            "Snowball state mutation requires the canonical shared Snowball method adapter"
        )
    }

    async fn verify_state(&self, desired: &Value) -> Result<bool> {
        let current = simd_json::serde::to_owned_value(self.read_live().await?)?;
        Ok(&current == desired)
    }

    async fn create_checkpoint(&self) -> Result<Checkpoint> {
        anyhow::bail!("Snowball checkpoints require the canonical shared Snowball method adapter")
    }

    async fn rollback(&self, checkpoint: &Checkpoint) -> Result<()> {
        let _ = checkpoint;
        anyhow::bail!("Snowball rollback requires the canonical shared Snowball method adapter")
    }

    fn capabilities(&self) -> PluginCapabilities {
        PluginCapabilities {
            supports_rollback: false,
            supports_checkpoints: false,
            supports_verification: true,
            atomic_operations: false,
        }
    }
}

pub(crate) fn snowball_schema() -> PluginSchema {
    let root = serde_json::to_value(schemars::schema_for!(SnowballState))
        .expect("schemars schema serializes to JSON");
    let mut schema = super::schemars_adapter::plugin_schema_from_json(
        "snowball",
        "2.0.0",
        "Streaming snowball audit chain — snapshots, DR current-state, retention/interval",
        &root,
    );

    // Add methods
    use super::plugin_scaffold_helpers::method_decl_from_schemars_with_output;
    use op_state_store::SideEffect;

    schema.methods.insert(
        "create_snapshot".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<SnowballEmptyInput, CreateSnapshotOutput>(
            "create_snapshot",
            SideEffect::Mutation,
            false,
            "snowball.invoke",
            "mut.service.snowball.snapshot.create@v1",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "list_snapshots".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<SnowballEmptyInput, ListSnapshotsOutput>(
            "list_snapshots",
            SideEffect::Read,
            true,
            "snowball.read",
            "obs.service.snowball.snapshot.list@v1",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "get_snapshot".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<SnapshotInput, GetSnapshotOutput>(
            "get_snapshot",
            SideEffect::Read,
            true,
            "snowball.read",
            "obs.service.snowball.snapshot.get@v1",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "rollback".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<SnapshotInput, RollbackOutput>(
            "rollback",
            SideEffect::Mutation,
            true,
            "snowball.invoke",
            "mut.service.snowball.rollback@v1",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "get_current_state".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<SnowballEmptyInput, GetCurrentStateOutput>(
            "get_current_state",
            SideEffect::Read,
            true,
            "snowball.read",
            "obs.service.snowball.state.get@v1",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "set_retention".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<SetRetentionInput, SetRetentionOutput>(
            "set_retention",
            SideEffect::Mutation,
            false,
            "snowball.invoke",
            "mut.service.snowball.retention.set@v1",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "get_stats".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<SnowballEmptyInput, SnowballStatsOutput>(
            "get_stats",
            SideEffect::Read,
            true,
            "snowball.read",
            "obs.service.snowball.stats@v1",
        ),
    );

    // Audit-trail query surface. MutationEngine dispatches these two through
    // EventChain and the seven native methods above through SnowballMethods.
    schema.methods.insert(
        "query_events".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<QueryEventsInput, QueryEventsOutput>(
            "query_events",
            SideEffect::Read,
            true,
            "snowball.read",
            "obs.service.snowball.events.query@v1",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "verify_chain".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<VerifyChainInput, VerifyChainOutput>(
            "verify_chain",
            SideEffect::Read,
            true,
            "snowball.read",
            "obs.service.snowball.chain.verify@v1",
        ),
    );

    schema.capabilities.insert(
        "snowball.read".to_string(),
        op_state_store::CapabilityDecl {
            id: "snowball.read".to_string(),
            description: "Grants: list_snapshots, get_snapshot, get_current_state, get_stats, query_events, verify_chain.".to_string(),
        },
    );
    schema.capabilities.insert(
        "snowball.invoke".to_string(),
        op_state_store::CapabilityDecl {
            id: "snowball.invoke".to_string(),
            description: "Grants: create_snapshot, rollback, set_retention.".to_string(),
        },
    );

    schema
}

// Self-registration: the plugin registry discovers this via inventory
// (single source of the catalog; no central dispatch list).
inventory::submit! {
    crate::default_registry::PluginReg::new("snowball", |_ctx| std::sync::Arc::new(SnowballPlugin::new()))
}
