          "description": "ModelProvider-specific quirk: fold the system prompt into the first user message instead of sending a separate system role. Only needed for models that reject (or mishandle) a standalone system role, e.g. certain older Mistral variants.",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "model": {
          "description": "Model identifier to send with each request: the ID string from the model_provider's catalog (e.g. `gpt-4o`, `claude-sonnet-4-5`, `llama-3.3-70b`). Must match a model the model_provider actually serves on this account.",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "native_tools": {
          "description": "Override the provider's default for native tool calling.\n`None` (default) honors the provider's built-in choice. `Some(true)`\nforces native tool calls on, `Some(false)` forces text-fallback.\nCurrently consulted only by the Groq factory, which defaults to\ntext-fallback because llama-family Groq models reject native tool\ncalls with HTTP 400. Setting `native_tools = true` re-enables native\ntool calling for Groq models that support it.",
          "type": [
            "boolean",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "pricing": {
          "additionalProperties": {
            "format": "double",
            "type": "number"
          },
          "description": "Per-model pricing for cost tracking, USD per 1M tokens.\n\nFree-form key/value map. Keys are user-defined model identifiers; an\noptional `.input` / `.output` suffix encodes pricing dimension when\nthe operator wants to split rates. A bare key without a suffix is\nused as a flat per-token rate when neither dimension is specified.\nDefault is empty: cost tracking falls back to \"unknown\" rates and\nonly token usage is recorded.\n\nExample: `pricing = { opus = 15.0, sonnet = 3.0 }`\nOr split: `pricing = { \"opus.input\" = 15.0, \"opus.output\" = 75.0 }`",
          "type": "object"
        },
        "provider_extra": {
          "description": "Extra JSON parameters to include in API requests.\nMerged at the top level of the request body, allowing provider-specific\nfeatures (routing, transforms, etc.) without code changes.\nExample: `provider_extra = { model_provider = { only = [\"Anthropic\"] } }`"
        },
        "replay_assistant_reasoning": {
          "description": "Whether stored assistant reasoning should be replayed on outbound\nassistant history messages. `Some(false)` strips `reasoning_content`\nand `reasoning` before sending. `None` (default) honours the provider's\nbuilt-in default (true for most compat providers, false for Groq).",
          "type": [
            "boolean",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "requires_openai_auth": {
          "description": "When true, the client pulls credentials from ZeroClaw's stored `openai-codex` auth profile instead of the `api_key` field above. Import an existing Codex CLI login with `zeroclaw auth login --model-provider openai-codex --import ~/.codex/auth.json`, or run `zeroclaw auth login --model-provider openai-codex`. Turn on only for the OpenAI Codex model_provider; leave off for standard API-key model_providers.",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "temperature": {
          "description": "Sampling temperature passed to the model. Lower values (0.0–0.3) give\ndeterministic, near-verbatim output, which fits code, routing, summarization.\nHigher values (0.7–1.2) give more varied output, which fits open-ended chat.",
          "format": "double",
          "type": [
            "number",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "think": {
          "description": "Enable or disable chain-of-thought thinking for models that support it\n(e.g. Qwen3, GLM-4). `true` turns thinking on, `false` turns it off.\n`None` (default) lets the model decide. Forwarded as `enable_thinking`\nin the request body; mirrors the Ollama provider's `think` field.",
          "type": [
            "boolean",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "timeout_secs": {
          "description": "HTTP request timeout in seconds. Bump this for slow local model_providers (Ollama on CPU, big local models) or high-latency networks; leave unset otherwise.",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": [
            "integer",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "tls_ca_cert_path": {
          "description": "Path to a PEM-encoded CA certificate for TLS connections to this provider.\nMust be an absolute path; shell expansion (e.g. `~`) is not performed.\nLeave unset to use the system's default trust store.",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "uri": {
          "description": "Endpoint URI the client hits. Override the family's default endpoint when pointing at a self-hosted gateway (LiteLLM, vLLM, Ollama), a custom proxy, or any non-standard URL. Leave unset to use the family's default URI from its `ModelEndpoint` impl. Set this to the FULL endpoint URL; there is no separate path-suffix field.",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "vision": {
          "description": "Override the provider's vision (image input) capability.\n`None` (default) uses the provider family's built-in default. Several\nfamilies (llama.cpp, the generic OpenAI-compatible endpoint, etc.)\nassume vision-capable because they can serve multimodal models. Set\n`vision = false` for a text-only model served by such a family (e.g. a\ntext LLM behind llama.cpp) so image messages are routed to a configured\n`[multimodal] vision_model_provider` instead of being sent to a model\nthat rejects them. `Some(true)` forces vision on.",
          "type": [
            "boolean",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "wire_api": {
          "anyOf": [
            {
              "$ref": "#/$defs/WireApi"
            },
            {
              "type": "null"
            }
          ],
          "description": "Wire protocol flavor: `responses` for OpenAI's Responses API (`POST /v1/responses`), `chat_completions` for the legacy chat wire and most OpenAI-compatible gateways. New OpenAI provider slots default to `responses`; other families default to chat-completions (or ignore the field). Only override if you're forcing an unusual combination."
        }
      },
      "type": "object"
    },
    "DelegateExecutionMode": {
      "description": "Execution semantics for one explicit delegate target.",
      "oneOf": [
        {
          "const": "bounded",
          "description": "Parent-bounded delegation: the target is reachable through the caller,\nshares caller budgets, and agentic tools are capped by the caller's\ntool envelope.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "independent",
          "description": "Independent delegation: the target runs under its own configured\npolicy/tool envelope, like opening a new chat with that agent.",
          "type": "string"
        }
      ]
    },
    "DelegateTargetConfig": {
      "description": "One explicit delegate target listed under `[agents.<alias>].delegates`.\n\nString entries deserialize as `{ agent = \"<string>\", mode = \"bounded\" }`\nfor concise manual editing. Serialization always emits the object form so\nthe config surface is a pure object array.",
      "properties": {
        "agent": {
          "description": "Target agent alias.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "mode": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/DelegateExecutionMode",
          "default": "bounded",
          "description": "Whether this target is parent-bounded or independent."
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "agent"
      ],
      "type": "object"
    },
    "DelegateToolConfig": {
      "description": "Global delegate tool configuration for default timeout values.",
      "properties": {
        "agentic_timeout_secs": {
          "default": 300,
          "description": "Default timeout in seconds for agentic sub-agent runs.\nCan be overridden per-agent in `[agents.<name>]` config.\nDefault: 300 seconds.",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "timeout_secs": {
          "default": 120,
          "description": "Default timeout in seconds for non-agentic sub-agent model_provider calls.\nCan be overridden per-agent in `[agents.<name>]` config.\nDefault: 120 seconds.",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        }
      },
      "type": "object"
    },
    "DelegationMode": {
      "description": "Delegation mode for a risk profile.",
      "oneOf": [
        {
          "const": "forbidden",
          "description": "No delegation permitted.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "allow",
          "description": "Delegation permitted to the agents named in the allow-list.",
          "type": "string"
        }
      ]
    },
    "DelegationPolicy": {
      "description": "Risk-profile delegation policy for work sent to agents that share it.",
      "properties": {
        "mode": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/DelegationMode",
          "default": "forbidden"
        }
      },
      "type": "object"
    },
    "DeliveryConfigDecl": {
      "description": "Delivery configuration for declarative cron jobs.",
      "properties": {
        "best_effort": {
          "default": true,
          "description": "Best-effort delivery. Default: `true`.",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "channel": {
          "default": null,
          "description": "Channel name (e.g. `\"telegram\"`, `\"discord\"`).",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "mode": {
          "default": "none",
          "description": "Delivery mode: `\"none\"` or `\"announce\"`.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "thread_id": {
          "description": "Optional thread/conversation identifier carried into the outbound send.\nRequired by channels that route on a separate `thread_id` field (e.g.\nwebhook callbacks bridging into agent-chat platforms).",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "to": {
          "default": null,
          "description": "Target/recipient identifier.",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        }
      },
      "type": "object"
    },
    "DingTalkConfig": {
      "description": "DingTalk configuration for Stream Mode messaging",
      "properties": {
        "client_id": {
          "description": "Client ID (AppKey) from DingTalk developer console",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "client_secret": {
          "description": "Client Secret (AppSecret) from DingTalk developer console",
          "type": "string",
          "x-secret": true
        },
        "enabled": {
          "default": false,
          "description": "Whether this channel is active. The runtime only loads channels whose\n`enabled = true`. Default: `false` so an operator who pastes a partial\n`[channels.<type>.<alias>]` block doesn't accidentally bring a channel\nlive before the rest of its config is filled in.",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "excluded_tools": {
          "default": [],
          "description": "Tools excluded from this channel's tool spec. When set, these tools\nare not exposed to the model when responding via this channel.",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "type": "array"
        },
        "proxy_url": {
          "default": null,
          "description": "Per-channel proxy URL (http, https, socks5, socks5h).\nOverrides the global `[proxy]` setting for this channel only.",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "client_id",
        "client_secret"
      ],
      "type": "object"
    },
    "DiscordConfig": {
      "description": "Discord bot channel configuration.",
      "properties": {
        "approval_timeout_secs": {
          "default": 300,
          "description": "Seconds to wait for operator approval on `always_ask` tools before auto-denying.",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "archive": {
          "default": false,
          "description": "When true, the channel opens a sidecar `discord.db` SQLite memory\nbackend, archives every non-bot message it sees, and registers the\n`discord_search` tool against it. Default: false. Folded in from\nthe legacy `[channels.discord-history]` block.",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "bot_token": {
          "default": "",
          "description": "Discord bot token (from Discord Developer Portal). `#[serde(default)]`\nfor the same reason as `TelegramConfig::bot_token`: a missing token\nmust deserialize as an empty string instead of salvage-dropping the\nalias; `validate_bot_token` still requires a real token once\n`enabled = true`.",
          "type": "string",
          "x-secret": true
        },
        "channel_ids": {
          "default": [],
          "description": "Channel IDs to watch. Empty = watch every channel the bot can see.\nUsed by the archive sidecar (when `archive = true`) and by the\nin-channel filter when set.",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "type": "array"
        },
        "draft_update_interval_ms": {
          "default": 1000,
          "description": "Minimum interval (ms) between draft message edits to avoid rate limits.\nOnly used when `stream_mode = \"partial\"`.",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "enabled": {
          "default": false,
          "description": "Whether this channel is active. The runtime only loads channels whose\n`enabled = true`. Default: `false` so an operator who pastes a partial\n`[channels.<type>.<alias>]` block doesn't accidentally bring a channel\nlive before the rest of its config is filled in.",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "excluded_tools": {
          "default": [],
          "description": "Tools excluded from this channel's tool spec. When set, these tools\nare not exposed to the model when responding via this channel.",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "type": "array"
        },
        "guild_ids": {
          "default": [],
          "description": "Guild (server) IDs to restrict the bot to. Empty = listen across all\nguilds the bot is invited to. Migrated from the legacy `guild_id`\nsingular field.",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "type": "array"
        },
        "intents_mask": {
          "default": null,
          "description": "Raw gateway intent mask override. When set, this exact value is sent\nin IDENTIFY instead of the derived mask: an operator escape hatch\nfor downstream deployments that consume gateway events through\ncustom builds or forks. The operator owns the consequences:\nprivileged bits still need their Developer Portal toggles, and\ndropping baseline bits silences message handling (a warning is\nlogged). Unset (default) = derive the mask from the channel's\nfeature config.",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": [
            "integer",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "interrupt_on_new_message": {
          "default": false,
          "description": "When true, a newer Discord message from the same sender in the same channel\ncancels the in-flight request and starts a fresh response with preserved history.",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "listen_to_bots": {
          "default": false,
          "description": "When true, process messages from other bots (not just humans).\nThe bot still ignores its own messages to prevent feedback loops.",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "mention_only": {
          "default": false,
          "description": "When true, only respond to messages that @-mention the bot.\nOther messages in the guild are silently ignored.",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "multi_message_delay_ms": {
          "default": 800,
          "description": "Delay (ms) between sending each message chunk in multi-message mode.\nOnly used when `stream_mode = \"multi_message\"`.",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "proxy_url": {
          "default": null,
          "description": "Per-channel proxy URL (http, https, socks5, socks5h).\nOverrides the global `[proxy]` setting for this channel only.",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "reaction_notifications": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/DiscordReactionScope",
          "default": "off",
          "description": "Which inbound reactions to record: `off` (default: reaction events\nare not even requested from the gateway), `own` (reactions to the\nbot's messages), or `all` (reactions to any message passing the\nchannel's filters). Recorded reactions are archived to `discord.db`\nwhen `archive` is enabled, and removed again when a user removes\ntheir reaction (bulk clears, remove-all / remove-emoji, are not\nyet swept). A set `intents_mask` overrides the derived mask: if it\nomits the reaction intents, nothing is recorded."
        },
        "reply_min_interval_secs": {
          "default": 0,
          "description": "Per-(channel, recipient) outbound pacing floor in seconds.\nRange: `0..=REPLY_MIN_INTERVAL_MAX_SECS` (0 disables).",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "reply_queue_depth_max": {
          "default": 0,
          "description": "Per-(channel, recipient) outbound pacing queue depth.\nRange: `0..=REPLY_QUEUE_DEPTH_CEILING`. When `reply_min_interval_secs > 0`\nand this value is `0`, the pacing wrapper substitutes\n`DEFAULT_REPLY_QUEUE_DEPTH` (16). When the queue is full, the\nnewest send is dropped and a `WARN` is logged.",
          "format": "uint16",
          "maximum": 65535,
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "slash_command_scope": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/SlashCommandScope",
          "default": "global",
          "description": "Scope for registered slash commands: `global` (default, application-wide,\n~1h propagation) or `guild` (registered to each `guild_ids` entry,\ninstant). Only meaningful when `slash_commands = true`; `guild` with an\nempty `guild_ids` warns and falls back to global. Switching scope reaps\nowned commands from the now-inactive scope; note that *removing* a guild\nfrom `guild_ids` (without switching scope) does not reap that guild's\ncommands - remove the bot from the guild, or switch scope, to clear them."
        },
        "slash_commands": {
          "default": false,
          "description": "When true, register and serve Discord slash commands (e.g. `/ask`)\nover the Gateway WebSocket, in addition to message handling. Default\nfalse. (Prototype: currently registers a single `/ask <prompt>`.)",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "stall_timeout_secs": {
          "default": 0,
          "description": "Stall-watchdog timeout in seconds. When non-zero, the bot will abort\nand retry if no progress is made within this duration. 0 = disabled.",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "stream_mode": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/StreamMode",
          "default": "off",
          "description": "Streaming mode for progressive response delivery.\n`off` (default): single message. `partial`: editable draft updates.\n`multi_message`: split response into separate messages at paragraph boundaries."
        }
      },
      "type": "object"
    },
    "DiscordReactionScope": {
      "description": "Scope of inbound Discord reaction events the bot records.\n\nAnything other than `Off` adds the GUILD_MESSAGE_REACTIONS and\nDIRECT_MESSAGE_REACTIONS gateway intents (both unprivileged; no\nDeveloper Portal toggle needed) and archives matching reactions to the\nchannel's `discord.db` sidecar when `archive` is enabled.",
      "oneOf": [
        {
          "const": "off",
          "description": "Ignore inbound reaction events entirely (no reaction intents requested).",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "own",
          "description": "Record reactions to the bot's own messages only.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "all",
          "description": "Record reactions to any message that passes the channel's filters.",
          "type": "string"
        }
      ]
    },
    "DockerRuntimeConfig": {
      "description": "Docker runtime configuration (`[runtime.docker]` section).",
      "properties": {
        "allowed_workspace_roots": {
          "default": [],
          "description": "Optional workspace root allowlist for Docker mount validation.",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "type": "array"
        },
        "cpu_limit": {
          "default": 1.0,
          "description": "Optional CPU limit (`None` = no explicit limit).",
          "format": "double",
          "type": [
            "number",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "image": {
          "default": "alpine:3.20",
          "description": "Runtime image used to execute shell commands.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "memory_limit_mb": {
          "default": 512,
          "description": "Optional memory limit in MB (`None` = no explicit limit).",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": [
            "integer",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "mount_workspace": {
          "default": true,
          "description": "Mount configured workspace into `/workspace`.",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "network": {
          "default": "none",
          "description": "Docker network mode (`none`, `bridge`, etc.).",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "read_only_rootfs": {
          "default": true,
          "description": "Mount root filesystem as read-only.",
          "type": "boolean"
        }
      },
      "type": "object"
    },
    "DoubaoModelProviderConfig": {
      "description": "Named model_provider profile definition.",
      "properties": {
        "api_key": {
          "description": "Secret API token for this model_provider. Grab it from the model_provider's dashboard (OpenAI platform, Anthropic console, OpenRouter keys page, etc.). Stored via the OS keyring when possible; never commit it to config.toml directly.",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ],
          "x-secret": true
        },
        "chat_template_kwargs": {
          "description": "Arbitrary key/value pairs forwarded verbatim as `chat_template_kwargs`\nin the request body (llama.cpp-specific). Use this to pass model-family\ntemplate variables that control behaviour not exposed by other fields.\nExample (Qwen3 thinking suppression):\n  `chat_template_kwargs = { enable_thinking = false }`"
        },
        "context_window": {
          "description": "Context window size (max input tokens) for this model.\nAuto-populated on setup from provider's /models endpoint if available.\nOverride manually for custom endpoints or when auto-detection fails.",
          "format": "uint",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": [
            "integer",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "extra_headers": {
          "additionalProperties": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "description": "Extra HTTP headers sent with every request. Niche: used for auth bridges, corporate proxies, or custom gateways that demand a tracing header. Most users never touch this; edit `config.toml` directly if you need it.",
          "type": "object",
          "x-secret": true
        },
        "fallback": {
          "description": "Ordered list of other provider aliases to try when every model on this\nalias has failed. Each entry is a dotted `<type>.<alias>` reference into\n`providers.models` and resolves with its own credentials, endpoint, and\nmodel. A fallback never inherits this alias's key. The walk is\ndepth-first: this alias's models are exhausted first, then each fallback\nalias is descended in turn (applying its own `fallback_models` and\n`fallback`). Empty means no provider-level fallback.",
          "items": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/ModelProviderRef"
          },
          "type": "array"
        },
        "fallback_models": {
          "description": "Ordered alternate models to try on THIS provider before falling over to\nthe `fallback` aliases. Same endpoint, key, and headers as the primary\n`model`. Only the model identifier changes. Use this when a provider\nserves a backup model (e.g. a smaller or older variant) that should be\ntried before leaving the provider entirely. Empty means only `model` is\ntried.",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "type": "array"
        },
        "kind": {
          "description": "Provider implementation to instantiate for this profile. Use this\nwhen a canonical typed slot should run through a compatible\nimplementation, e.g. `[providers.models.openai.proxy] kind =\n\"openai-compatible\"`.",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "live_pricing": {
          "description": "Pull live token prices for this provider's models from its own\nOpenAI-compatible `/models` listing (the gateway is the source of truth\nfor its prices), filling cost-tracking rates for models the operator\nhas NOT priced under `[cost.rates]` / `pricing`. Models the gateway does\nnot price (or providers with no HTTP `/models` listing at all, such as\na subprocess gateway like `kilocli`) fall back to the public models.dev\ncatalog. Configured rates always win; live prices only fill gaps. A\nbackground task refreshes the price snapshot hourly; the cost-recording\npath reads the cached snapshot and never blocks on the network. Default\n`false`: off means no fetching and behavior identical to a build\nwithout the feature.",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "max_tokens": {
          "description": "Hard cap on response length in tokens. Most models enforce sensible built-in limits already; leave unset unless you specifically need to clip long outputs for cost or latency reasons.",
          "format": "uint32",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": [
            "integer",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "merge_system_into_user": {
          "description": "ModelProvider-specific quirk: fold the system prompt into the first user message instead of sending a separate system role. Only needed for models that reject (or mishandle) a standalone system role, e.g. certain older Mistral variants.",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "model": {
          "description": "Model identifier to send with each request: the ID string from the model_provider's catalog (e.g. `gpt-4o`, `claude-sonnet-4-5`, `llama-3.3-70b`). Must match a model the model_provider actually serves on this account.",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "native_tools": {
          "description": "Override the provider's default for native tool calling.\n`None` (default) honors the provider's built-in choice. `Some(true)`\nforces native tool calls on, `Some(false)` forces text-fallback.\nCurrently consulted only by the Groq factory, which defaults to\ntext-fallback because llama-family Groq models reject native tool\ncalls with HTTP 400. Setting `native_tools = true` re-enables native\ntool calling for Groq models that support it.",
          "type": [
            "boolean",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "pricing": {
          "additionalProperties": {
            "format": "double",
            "type": "number"
          },
          "description": "Per-model pricing for cost tracking, USD per 1M tokens.\n\nFree-form key/value map. Keys are user-defined model identifiers; an\noptional `.input` / `.output` suffix encodes pricing dimension when\nthe operator wants to split rates. A bare key without a suffix is\nused as a flat per-token rate when neither dimension is specified.\nDefault is empty: cost tracking falls back to \"unknown\" rates and\nonly token usage is recorded.\n\nExample: `pricing = { opus = 15.0, sonnet = 3.0 }`\nOr split: `pricing = { \"opus.input\" = 15.0, \"opus.output\" = 75.0 }`",
          "type": "object"
        },
        "provider_extra": {
          "description": "Extra JSON parameters to include in API requests.\nMerged at the top level of the request body, allowing provider-specific\nfeatures (routing, transforms, etc.) without code changes.\nExample: `provider_extra = { model_provider = { only = [\"Anthropic\"] } }`"
        },
        "replay_assistant_reasoning": {
          "description": "Whether stored assistant reasoning should be replayed on outbound\nassistant history messages. `Some(false)` strips `reasoning_content`\nand `reasoning` before sending. `None` (default) honours the provider's\nbuilt-in default (true for most compat providers, false for Groq).",
          "type": [
            "boolean",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "requires_openai_auth": {
          "description": "When true, the client pulls credentials from ZeroClaw's stored `openai-codex` auth profile instead of the `api_key` field above. Import an existing Codex CLI login with `zeroclaw auth login --model-provider openai-codex --import ~/.codex/auth.json`, or run `zeroclaw auth login --model-provider openai-codex`. Turn on only for the OpenAI Codex model_provider; leave off for standard API-key model_providers.",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "temperature": {
          "description": "Sampling temperature passed to the model. Lower values (0.0–0.3) give\ndeterministic, near-verbatim output, which fits code, routing, summarization.\nHigher values (0.7–1.2) give more varied output, which fits open-ended chat.",
          "format": "double",
          "type": [
            "number",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "think": {
          "description": "Enable or disable chain-of-thought thinking for models that support it\n(e.g. Qwen3, GLM-4). `true` turns thinking on, `false` turns it off.\n`None` (default) lets the model decide. Forwarded as `enable_thinking`\nin the request body; mirrors the Ollama provider's `think` field.",
          "type": [
            "boolean",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "timeout_secs": {
          "description": "HTTP request timeout in seconds. Bump this for slow local model_providers (Ollama on CPU, big local models) or high-latency networks; leave unset otherwise.",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": [
            "integer",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "tls_ca_cert_path": {
          "description": "Path to a PEM-encoded CA certificate for TLS connections to this provider.\nMust be an absolute path; shell expansion (e.g. `~`) is not performed.\nLeave unset to use the system's default trust store.",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "uri": {
          "description": "Endpoint URI the client hits. Override the family's default endpoint when pointing at a self-hosted gateway (LiteLLM, vLLM, Ollama), a custom proxy, or any non-standard URL. Leave unset to use the family's default URI from its `ModelEndpoint` impl. Set this to the FULL endpoint URL; there is no separate path-suffix field.",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "vision": {
          "description": "Override the provider's vision (image input) capability.\n`None` (default) uses the provider family's built-in default. Several\nfamilies (llama.cpp, the generic OpenAI-compatible endpoint, etc.)\nassume vision-capable because they can serve multimodal models. Set\n`vision = false` for a text-only model served by such a family (e.g. a\ntext LLM behind llama.cpp) so image messages are routed to a configured\n`[multimodal] vision_model_provider` instead of being sent to a model\nthat rejects them. `Some(true)` forces vision on.",
          "type": [
            "boolean",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "wire_api": {
          "anyOf": [
            {
              "$ref": "#/$defs/WireApi"
            },
            {
              "type": "null"
            }
          ],
          "description": "Wire protocol flavor: `responses` for OpenAI's Responses API (`POST /v1/responses`), `chat_completions` for the legacy chat wire and most OpenAI-compatible gateways. New OpenAI provider slots default to `responses`; other families default to chat-completions (or ignore the field). Only override if you're forcing an unusual combination."
        }
      },
      "type": "object"
    },
    "EdgeTtsProviderConfig": {
      "description": "Per-instance TTS model_provider configuration (`[tts_providers.<type>.<alias>]`).\n\nMirrors `ModelProviderConfig` in shape — one struct holds the union of\nfields across backends. Only the fields relevant to the selected backend\n(determined by the outer `<type>` map key) are read at runtime; others\nare quietly ignored.",
      "properties": {
        "api_key": {
          "default": null,
          "description": "API key (openai, elevenlabs, google).",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ],
          "x-secret": true
        },
        "binary_path": {
          "default": null,
          "description": "Path to backend binary (edge-tts subprocess; piper local server).",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "language_code": {
          "default": null,
          "description": "Language code for google (e.g. `en-US`).",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "model": {
          "default": null,
          "description": "Model name. OpenAI uses this for `tts-1`/`tts-1-hd`; elevenlabs uses\nit as the model_id (e.g. `eleven_monolingual_v1`).",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "response_format": {
          "default": null,
          "description": "Audio response format sent to the TTS backend (e.g. `\"opus\"`, `\"mp3\"`,\n`\"wav\"`). Defaults to `\"opus\"` for the OpenAI family. Override to\n`\"wav\"` for Orpheus-class models (e.g. `canopylabs/orpheus-v1-english`\non Groq) or `\"mp3\"` for broader compatibility.",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "similarity_boost": {
          "default": null,

          "format": "double",
          "type": [
            "number",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "speed": {
          "default": null,
          "description": "Playback speed multiplier (openai only; default `1.0`).",
          "format": "double",
          "type": [
            "number",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "stability": {
          "default": null,
          "description": "Voice stability for elevenlabs (0.0-1.0; default `0.5`).",
          "format": "double",
          "type": [
            "number",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "uri": {
          "default": null,
          "description": "Endpoint URI for HTTP-based backends. Overrides the family default\nwhen pointing at a compatible third-party API (Groq, Azure, self-hosted\nproxies). Set to the **full** URL — there is no separate path-suffix\nfield. Renamed from `api_url` for parity with `ModelProviderConfig.uri`.",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "voice": {
          "default": null,

          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        }
      },
      "type": "object"
    },

    "EmailConfig": {
      "properties": {
        "default_subject": {
          "default": "Re: Message",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "enabled": {
          "default": false,
          "description": "Whether this channel is active. The runtime only loads channels whose\n`enabled = true`. Default: `false` so an operator who pastes a partial\n`[channels.<type>.<alias>]` block doesn't accidentally bring a channel\nlive before the rest of its config is filled in.",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "excluded_tools": {
          "default": [],
          "description": "Tools excluded from this channel's tool spec. When set, these tools\nare not exposed to the model when responding via this channel.",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "type": "array"
        },
        "from_address": {
          "type": "string"
        },
        "html_body": {
          "default": true,
          "description": "When `true` (default), outbound emails are rendered as HTML via Markdown conversion.\nSet to `false` to send plain-text emails instead.",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "idle_timeout_secs": {
          "default": 1740,
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "imap_folder": {
          "default": "INBOX",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "imap_host": {
          "type": "string"
        },
        "imap_port": {
          "default": 993,
          "format": "uint16",
          "maximum": 65535,
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "max_attachment_bytes": {
          "default": 26214400,
          "format": "uint",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "oauth2": {
          "anyOf": [
            {
              "$ref": "#/$defs/EmailOAuth2Config"
            },
            {
              "type": "null"
            }
          ],
          "default": null,
          "description": "OAuth2 settings for IMAP authentication. When present, IMAP uses\nXOAUTH2 instead of plain LOGIN. Required for providers like\nOutlook/Hotmail that have deprecated password auth."
        },
        "observer_mode": {
          "default": false,
          "description": "When true, the daemon observes new mail but never modifies any IMAP flag.",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "password": {
          "type": "string"
        },
        "poll_interval_secs": {
          "default": 60,
          "description": "Polling interval used when the IMAP server does not advertise the IDLE\ncapability (RFC 2177). Ignored when IDLE is available.",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "smtp_host": {
          "type": "string"
        },
        "smtp_password": {
          "default": null,
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "smtp_port": {
          "default": 465,
          "format": "uint16",
          "maximum": 65535,
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "smtp_tls": {
          "default": true,
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "smtp_username": {
          "default": null,
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "username": {
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "imap_host",
        "smtp_host",
        "username",
        "password",
        "from_address"
      ],
      "type": "object"
    },
    "EmailOAuth2Config": {
      "description": "OAuth2 settings for IMAP email authentication (XOAUTH2 / RFC 8628).\nPopulate these to use OAuth2 bearer tokens instead of plain-password LOGIN.\nAll major providers (Microsoft, Google) support this flow via device code.",
      "properties": {
        "client_id": {
          "description": "OAuth2 application client ID (public client; no secret required for device flow).",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "device_code_url": {
          "description": "Device-code initiation endpoint\n(e.g. `https://login.microsoftonline.com/consumers/oauth2/v2.0/devicecode`).",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "scopes": {
          "description": "OAuth2 scopes to request (must include `offline_access` for refresh tokens).",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "type": "array"
        },
        "token_url": {
          "description": "Token endpoint for refresh and device-code polling\n(e.g. `https://login.microsoftonline.com/consumers/oauth2/v2.0/token`).",
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "client_id",
        "token_url",
        "device_code_url",
        "scopes"
      ],
      "type": "object"
    },
    "EmbeddingRouteConfig": {
      "description": "Route an embedding hint to a specific model_provider + model.\n\n```toml\n[[embedding_routes]]\nhint = \"semantic\"\nmodel_provider = \"openai.embeddings\"\nmodel = \"text-embedding-3-small\"\ndimensions = 1536\n\n[memory]\nembedding_model = \"hint:semantic\"\n```",
      "properties": {
        "api_key": {
          "default": null,
          "description": "Optional API key override for this route's model_provider",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ],
          "x-secret": true
        },
        "dimensions": {
          "default": null,
          "description": "Optional embedding dimension override for this route",
          "format": "uint",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": [
            "integer",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "hint": {
          "default": "",
          "description": "Route hint name (e.g. \"semantic\", \"archive\", \"faq\")\n`#[serde(default)]` lets the `create_map_key` macro default-construct\nfrom `{}` before the hint gets injected via `set_prop`. Empty strings\nare rejected by `Config::validate()`.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "model": {
          "default": "",
          "description": "Provider-local embedding model identifier to use with that provider profile\n`#[serde(default)]` is required for `Default` + `create_map_key` construction.\nEmpty strings are rejected by `Config::validate()`.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "model_provider": {
          "default": "",
          "description": "Dotted embedding-capable provider profile ref\n`#[serde(default)]` is required for `Default` + `create_map_key` construction.\nEmpty strings are rejected by `Config::validate()`.",
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "type": "object"
    },
    "EscalationConfig": {
      "description": "Escalation routing configuration (`[escalation]` section).\n\nControls which channels receive alert notifications when\n`escalate_to_human` is called with high or critical urgency.\nChannels are identified by name (e.g. `\"telegram\"`, `\"slack\"`).\nAlerts are sent best-effort and do not block the escalation.",
      "properties": {
        "alert_channels": {
          "default": [],
          "description": "Channel names to alert on high/critical escalations (default: empty).\n\nEach name must match a configured channel. Unrecognised names are\nlogged at WARN level and skipped.",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "type": "array"
        }
      },
      "type": "object"
    },
    "EstopConfig": {

        "state_file": {

          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "type": "object"
    },
    "EvalConfig": {
      "properties": {
        "enabled": {
          "default": false,

        },
        "max_retries": {
          "default": 1,

        },

          "default": 0.5,

          "type": "number"
        }
      },

    },

      "description": "Configuration for the agent evaluation harness (`[eval]`), surfaced via the\n`zeroclaw eval` command. Distinct from `[agent.eval]`, which is the in-loop\nresponse-quality scorer.",
      "properties": {
        "mode": {
          "default": "replay",

          "type": "string"
        },

        }
      },

    },
    "ExternalRegistry": {
      "properties": {
        "enabled": {
          "default": true,
          "description": "Whether this registry is eligible for installs. Default: `true`.",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "kind": {
          "default": "git",
          "description": "Registry protocol. Only `\"git\"` is supported today; other protocols\nare reserved for a future additive release.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "name": {
          "description": "Short alias used in `registry:<name>/<skill>` install specs.",
          "type": "string"
        },

          "description": "Git repository URL of the registry (must expose a top-level `skills/` dir).",
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "name",
        "url"
      ],
      "type": "object"
    },
    "FeatherlessModelProviderConfig": {
      "description": "Named model_provider profile definition.",
      "properties": {
        "api_key": {
          "description": "Secret API token for this model_provider. Grab it from the model_provider's dashboard (OpenAI platform, Anthropic console, OpenRouter keys page, etc.). Stored via the OS keyring when possible; never commit it to config.toml directly.",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ],
          "x-secret": true
        },
        "chat_template_kwargs": {
          "description": "Arbitrary key/value pairs forwarded verbatim as `chat_template_kwargs`\nin the request body (llama.cpp-specific). Use this to pass model-family\ntemplate variables that control behaviour not exposed by other fields.\nExample (Qwen3 thinking suppression):\n  `chat_template_kwargs = { enable_thinking = false }`"
        },
        "context_window": {
          "description": "Context window size (max input tokens) for this model.\nAuto-populated on setup from provider's /models endpoint if available.\nOverride manually for custom endpoints or when auto-detection fails.",
          "format": "uint",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": [
            "integer",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "extra_headers": {
          "additionalProperties": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "description": "Extra HTTP headers sent with every request. Niche: used for auth bridges, corporate proxies, or custom gateways that demand a tracing header. Most users never touch this; edit `config.toml` directly if you need it.",
          "type": "object",
          "x-secret": true
        },
        "fallback": {
          "description": "Ordered list of other provider aliases to try when every model on this\nalias has failed. Each entry is a dotted `<type>.<alias>` reference into\n`providers.models` and resolves with its own credentials, endpoint, and\nmodel. A fallback never inherits this alias's key. The walk is\ndepth-first: this alias's models are exhausted first, then each fallback\nalias is descended in turn (applying its own `fallback_models` and\n`fallback`). Empty means no provider-level fallback.",
          "items": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/ModelProviderRef"
          },
          "type": "array"
        },
        "fallback_models": {
          "description": "Ordered alternate models to try on THIS provider before falling over to\nthe `fallback` aliases. Same endpoint, key, and headers as the primary\n`model`. Only the model identifier changes. Use this when a provider\nserves a backup model (e.g. a smaller or older variant) that should be\ntried before leaving the provider entirely. Empty means only `model` is\ntried.",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "type": "array"
        },
        "kind": {
          "description": "Provider implementation to instantiate for this profile. Use this\nwhen a canonical typed slot should run through a compatible\nimplementation, e.g. `[providers.models.openai.proxy] kind =\n\"openai-compatible\"`.",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "live_pricing": {
          "description": "Pull live token prices for this provider's models from its own\nOpenAI-compatible `/models` listing (the gateway is the source of truth\nfor its prices), filling cost-tracking rates for models the operator\nhas NOT priced under `[cost.rates]` / `pricing`. Models the gateway does\nnot price (or providers with no HTTP `/models` listing at all, such as\na subprocess gateway like `kilocli`) fall back to the public models.dev\ncatalog. Configured rates always win; live prices only fill gaps. A\nbackground task refreshes the price snapshot hourly; the cost-recording\npath reads the cached snapshot and never blocks on the network. Default\n`false`: off means no fetching and behavior identical to a build\nwithout the feature.",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "max_tokens": {
          "description": "Hard cap on response length in tokens. Most models enforce sensible built-in limits already; leave unset unless you specifically need to clip long outputs for cost or latency reasons.",
          "format": "uint32",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": [
            "integer",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "merge_system_into_user": {
          "description": "ModelProvider-specific quirk: fold the system prompt into the first user message instead of sending a separate system role. Only needed for models that reject (or mishandle) a standalone system role, e.g. certain older Mistral variants.",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "model": {
          "description": "Model identifier to send with each request: the ID string from the model_provider's catalog (e.g. `gpt-4o`, `claude-sonnet-4-5`, `llama-3.3-70b`). Must match a model the model_provider actually serves on this account.",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "native_tools": {
          "description": "Override the provider's default for native tool calling.\n`None` (default) honors the provider's built-in choice. `Some(true)`\nforces native tool calls on, `Some(false)` forces text-fallback.\nCurrently consulted only by the Groq factory, which defaults to\ntext-fallback because llama-family Groq models reject native tool\ncalls with HTTP 400. Setting `native_tools = true` re-enables native\ntool calling for Groq models that support it.",
          "type": [
            "boolean",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "pricing": {
          "additionalProperties": {
            "format": "double",
            "type": "number"
          },
          "description": "Per-model pricing for cost tracking, USD per 1M tokens.\n\nFree-form key/value map. Keys are user-defined model identifiers; an\noptional `.input` / `.output` suffix encodes pricing dimension when\nthe operator wants to split rates. A bare key without a suffix is\nused as a flat per-token rate when neither dimension is specified.\nDefault is empty: cost tracking falls back to \"unknown\" rates and\nonly token usage is recorded.\n\nExample: `pricing = { opus = 15.0, sonnet = 3.0 }`\nOr split: `pricing = { \"opus.input\" = 15.0, \"opus.output\" = 75.0 }`",
          "type": "object"
        },
        "provider_extra": {
          "description": "Extra JSON parameters to include in API requests.\nMerged at the top level of the request body, allowing provider-specific\nfeatures (routing, transforms, etc.) without code changes.\nExample: `provider_extra = { model_provider = { only = [\"Anthropic\"] } }`"
        },
        "replay_assistant_reasoning": {
          "description": "Whether stored assistant reasoning should be replayed on outbound\nassistant history messages. `Some(false)` strips `reasoning_content`\nand `reasoning` before sending. `None` (default) honours the provider's\nbuilt-in default (true for most compat providers, false for Groq).",
          "type": [
            "boolean",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "requires_openai_auth": {
          "description": "When true, the client pulls credentials from ZeroClaw's stored `openai-codex` auth profile instead of the `api_key` field above. Import an existing Codex CLI login with `zeroclaw auth login --model-provider openai-codex --import ~/.codex/auth.json`, or run `zeroclaw auth login --model-provider openai-codex`. Turn on only for the OpenAI Codex model_provider; leave off for standard API-key model_providers.",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "temperature": {
          "description": "Sampling temperature passed to the model. Lower values (0.0–0.3) give\ndeterministic, near-verbatim output, which fits code, routing, summarization.\nHigher values (0.7–1.2) give more varied output, which fits open-ended chat.",
          "format": "double",
          "type": [
            "number",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "think": {
          "description": "Enable or disable chain-of-thought thinking for models that support it\n(e.g. Qwen3, GLM-4). `true` turns thinking on, `false` turns it off.\n`None` (default) lets the model decide. Forwarded as `enable_thinking`\nin the request body; mirrors the Ollama provider's `think` field.",
          "type": [
            "boolean",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "timeout_secs": {
          "description": "HTTP request timeout in seconds. Bump this for slow local model_providers (Ollama on CPU, big local models) or high-latency networks; leave unset otherwise.",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": [
            "integer",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "tls_ca_cert_path": {
          "description": "Path to a PEM-encoded CA certificate for TLS connections to this provider.\nMust be an absolute path; shell expansion (e.g. `~`) is not performed.\nLeave unset to use the system's default trust store.",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "uri": {
          "description": "Endpoint URI the client hits. Override the family's default endpoint when pointing at a self-hosted gateway (LiteLLM, vLLM, Ollama), a custom proxy, or any non-standard URL. Leave unset to use the family's default URI from its `ModelEndpoint` impl. Set this to the FULL endpoint URL; there is no separate path-suffix field.",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "vision": {
          "description": "Override the provider's vision (image input) capability.\n`None` (default) uses the provider family's built-in default. Several\nfamilies (llama.cpp, the generic OpenAI-compatible endpoint, etc.)\nassume vision-capable because they can serve multimodal models. Set\n`vision = false` for a text-only model served by such a family (e.g. a\ntext LLM behind llama.cpp) so image messages are routed to a configured\n`[multimodal] vision_model_provider` instead of being sent to a model\nthat rejects them. `Some(true)` forces vision on.",
          "type": [
            "boolean",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "wire_api": {
          "anyOf": [
            {
              "$ref": "#/$defs/WireApi"
            },
            {
              "type": "null"
            }
          ],
          "description": "Wire protocol flavor: `responses` for OpenAI's Responses API (`POST /v1/responses`), `chat_completions` for the legacy chat wire and most OpenAI-compatible gateways. New OpenAI provider slots default to `responses`; other families default to chat-completions (or ignore the field). Only override if you're forcing an unusual combination."
        }
      },
      "type": "object"
    },
    "FileDownloadConfig": {
      "description": "Standalone file download tool configuration (`[file_download]`).\n\nWhen `url` is set to a non-empty value, registers a `file_download` tool\nthat GETs a file from the configured endpoint and writes it to the agent's\nworkspace filesystem. The LLM supplies only a document identifier and a\nworkspace-relative destination path; the endpoint URL comes solely from this\nconfig and is never model-controlled. Response bytes are streamed to disk\nand never loaded into model context.\n\nWhen `url` is `None` or empty, the tool is not registered.",
      "properties": {
        "headers": {
          "additionalProperties": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "default": {},
          "description": "Static HTTP headers attached to every download request — typically an\n`Authorization: Bearer …` token for the upstream endpoint. Same shape as\n`[mcp.servers.*.headers]`.",
          "type": "object",
          "x-secret": true
        },
        "max_file_size_bytes": {
          "default": 26214400,
          "description": "Maximum download size in bytes. Enforced while streaming: the transfer\nis aborted and the partial file removed once this ceiling is exceeded,\nso an oversized or unbounded body never fully buffers in memory or lands\non disk. Default: 25 MiB.",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "timeout_secs": {
          "default": 120,
          "description": "Request timeout in seconds. Default: 120.",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "url": {
          "default": null,
          "description": "Download endpoint URL. Tool is disabled when this is `None` or empty.\nThe file to fetch is selected by the `document_id` query parameter.",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        }
      },
      "type": "object"
    },
    "FileUploadBundleConfig": {
      "description": "Standalone multi-file bundle upload tool configuration\n(`[file_upload_bundle]`).\n\nWhen `url` is set to a non-empty value, registers a `file_upload_bundle`\ntool that POSTs N files from the agent's local filesystem to the\nconfigured endpoint as a single `multipart/form-data` request. The LLM\nprovides only file paths; the host reads the bytes.\n\nWhen `url` is `None` or empty, the tool is not registered.",
      "properties": {
        "field_name": {
          "default": "file",
          "description": "Multipart form-field name reused across every file part. Default: `file`.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "headers": {
          "additionalProperties": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "default": {},
          "description": "Static HTTP headers attached to every upload request.",
          "type": "object",
          "x-secret": true
        },
        "max_file_size_bytes": {
          "default": 10485760,
          "description": "Maximum per-file size in bytes. Default: 10 MiB.",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "max_files": {
          "default": 16,
          "description": "Maximum number of files per call. Default: 16.",
          "format": "uint32",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "max_response_body_bytes": {
          "default": 4096,
          "description": "Maximum response body bytes to read from the upload endpoint.\nPrevents unbounded memory use from a malicious or verbose receiver.\nDefault: 4096 (4 KiB).",
          "format": "uint",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "max_total_size_bytes": {
          "default": 33554432,
          "description": "Maximum cumulative size across every file in one call. Default: 32 MiB.",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "method": {
          "default": "POST",
          "description": "HTTP method. Only `POST` (default) and `PUT` are accepted.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "timeout_secs": {
          "default": 120,
          "description": "Request timeout in seconds. Default: 120.",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "url": {
          "default": null,
          "description": "Upload endpoint URL. Tool is disabled when this is `None` or empty.",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        }
      },
      "type": "object"
    },
    "FileUploadConfig": {
      "description": "Standalone file upload tool configuration (`[file_upload]`).\n\nWhen `url` is set to a non-empty value, registers a `file_upload` tool that\nPOSTs files from the agent's local filesystem to the configured endpoint\nusing `multipart/form-data`. The LLM provides only a file path; the host\nreads the bytes and uploads them without ever including file content in\nthe model context.\n\nWhen `url` is `None` or empty, the tool is not registered.",
      "properties": {
        "field_name": {
          "default": "file",
          "description": "Multipart form-field name for the file part. Default: `file`.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "headers": {
          "additionalProperties": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "default": {},
          "description": "Static HTTP headers attached to every upload request. Same shape as\n`[mcp.servers.*.headers]`.",
          "type": "object",
          "x-secret": true
        },
        "max_file_size_bytes": {
          "default": 26214400,
          "description": "Maximum file size in bytes. Larger files are rejected before any\nbytes hit the network. Default: 25 MiB.",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "method": {
          "default": "POST",
          "description": "HTTP method. Only `POST` (default) and `PUT` are accepted.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "timeout_secs": {
          "default": 60,
          "description": "Request timeout in seconds. Default: 60.",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "url": {
          "default": null,
          "description": "Upload endpoint URL. Tool is disabled when this is `None` or empty.",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        }
      },
      "type": "object"
    },
    "FilesystemConfig": {
      "description": "Filesystem SOP listener configuration.\n\nWatches configured paths and dispatches file create/modify/delete/rename\nevents to the SOP engine. This is a fan-in listener, not a chat channel:\nits `Channel::send` has no outbound surface.",
      "properties": {
        "allow_broad_roots": {
          "default": false,
          "description": "Watch broad system roots (`/`, `/home`, `/etc`, `/var`, `/proc`,\n`/sys`, `/dev`, `/tmp`) despite the deny-broad-roots default. The\npseudo-filesystems `/proc` and `/sys` would surface kernel object\npaths in SOP payloads and flood the watcher with events. Off unless\nexplicitly enabled.",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "debounce_ms": {
          "default": 500,
          "description": "Collapse rapid repeated events per path/kind within this window.",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "enabled": {
          "default": false,
          "description": "Whether this channel is active. The runtime only loads channels whose\n`enabled = true`. Default: `false` so an operator who pastes a partial\n`[channels.<type>.<alias>]` block doesn't accidentally bring a channel\nlive before the rest of its config is filled in.",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "events": {
          "default": [
            "created",
            "modified",
            "deleted",
            "renamed"
          ],
          "description": "Event kinds to emit (`created`, `modified`, `deleted`, `renamed`).",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "type": "array"
        },
        "exclude": {
          "default": [],
          "description": "Glob patterns to exclude. Applied after `include`.",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "type": "array"
        },
        "excluded_tools": {
          "default": [],
          "description": "Tools excluded from this channel's tool spec.",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "type": "array"
        },
        "follow_symlinks": {
          "default": false,
          "description": "Follow symlinks when reading event-path metadata, hash, and content.\nOff by default: a symlink under a watched root is rejected before any\nmetadata/hash/content handling so its target cannot escape the root. When\non, the canonical target must still resolve inside a configured root.",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "include": {
          "default": [],
          "description": "Glob patterns to include. Empty matches all paths under the roots.",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "type": "array"
        },
        "max_content_bytes": {
          "default": 65536,
          "description": "Maximum file content bytes admitted into a payload when `read_content`,\nand the size ceiling for hashing. `Some(n)` caps reads and hashing at\n`n` bytes; oversize files are skipped rather than truncated. `None`\nremoves the ceiling entirely (unbounded reads). Defaults to\n`Some(65536)` (64 KiB), so the cap applies by default whenever\n`read_content` or hashing runs.",
          "format": "uint",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": [
            "integer",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "paths": {
          "default": [],
          "description": "Root paths to watch. At least one is required.",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "type": "array"
        },
        "read_content": {
          "default": false,
          "description": "Read file content into the event payload. Opt-in.",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "recursive": {
          "default": true,
          "description": "Watch nested paths beneath each root.",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "settle_ms": {
          "default": 250,
          "description": "Wait this long after the last event before reading metadata or content,\ngiving atomic writes and slow copies time to finish.",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        }
      },
      "type": "object"
    },
    "FirecrawlConfig": {
      "description": "Firecrawl fallback configuration for JS-heavy and bot-blocked sites.\n\nWhen enabled, if the standard web fetch fails (HTTP error, empty body, or\nbody shorter than 100 characters suggesting a JS-only page), the tool\nfalls back to the Firecrawl API for stealth content extraction.",
      "properties": {
        "api_key_env": {
          "default": "FIRECRAWL_API_KEY",
          "description": "Environment variable name for the Firecrawl API key",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "api_url": {
          "default": "https://api.firecrawl.dev/v1",
          "description": "Firecrawl API base URL",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "enabled": {
          "default": false,
          "description": "Enable Firecrawl fallback",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "mode": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/FirecrawlMode",
          "default": "scrape",
          "description": "Firecrawl extraction mode"
        }
      },
      "type": "object"
    },
    "FirecrawlMode": {
      "description": "Firecrawl fallback mode: scrape a single page or crawl linked pages.",
      "oneOf": [
        {
          "enum": [
            "scrape"
          ],
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "crawl",
          "description": "Reserved for future multi-page crawl support. Accepted in config\ndeserialization to avoid breaking existing files, but not yet\nimplemented — `fetch_via_firecrawl` always uses the `/scrape` endpoint.",
          "type": "string"
        }
      ]
    },
    "FireworksModelProviderConfig": {
      "description": "Named model_provider profile definition.",
      "properties": {
        "api_key": {
          "description": "Secret API token for this model_provider. Grab it from the model_provider's dashboard (OpenAI platform, Anthropic console, OpenRouter keys page, etc.). Stored via the OS keyring when possible; never commit it to config.toml directly.",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ],
          "x-secret": true
        },
        "chat_template_kwargs": {
          "description": "Arbitrary key/value pairs forwarded verbatim as `chat_template_kwargs`\nin the request body (llama.cpp-specific). Use this to pass model-family\ntemplate variables that control behaviour not exposed by other fields.\nExample (Qwen3 thinking suppression):\n  `chat_template_kwargs = { enable_thinking = false }`"
        },
        "context_window": {
          "description": "Context window size (max input tokens) for this model.\nAuto-populated on setup from provider's /models endpoint if available.\nOverride manually for custom endpoints or when auto-detection fails.",
          "format": "uint",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": [
            "integer",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "extra_headers": {
          "additionalProperties": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "description": "Extra HTTP headers sent with every request. Niche: used for auth bridges, corporate proxies, or custom gateways that demand a tracing header. Most users never touch this; edit `config.toml` directly if you need it.",
          "type": "object",
          "x-secret": true
        },
        "fallback": {
          "description": "Ordered list of other provider aliases to try when every model on this\nalias has failed. Each entry is a dotted `<type>.<alias>` reference into\n`providers.models` and resolves with its own credentials, endpoint, and\nmodel. A fallback never inherits this alias's key. The walk is\ndepth-first: this alias's models are exhausted first, then each fallback\nalias is descended in turn (applying its own `fallback_models` and\n`fallback`). Empty means no provider-level fallback.",
          "items": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/ModelProviderRef"
          },
          "type": "array"
        },
        "fallback_models": {
          "description": "Ordered alternate models to try on THIS provider before falling over to\nthe `fallback` aliases. Same endpoint, key, and headers as the primary\n`model`. Only the model identifier changes. Use this when a provider\nserves a backup model (e.g. a smaller or older variant) that should be\ntried before leaving the provider entirely. Empty means only `model` is\ntried.",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "type": "array"
        },
        "kind": {
          "description": "Provider implementation to instantiate for this profile. Use this\nwhen a canonical typed slot should run through a compatible\nimplementation, e.g. `[providers.models.openai.proxy] kind =\n\"openai-compatible\"`.",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "live_pricing": {
          "description": "Pull live token prices for this provider's models from its own\nOpenAI-compatible `/models` listing (the gateway is the source of truth\nfor its prices), filling cost-tracking rates for models the operator\nhas NOT priced under `[cost.rates]` / `pricing`. Models the gateway does\nnot price (or providers with no HTTP `/models` listing at all, such as\na subprocess gateway like `kilocli`) fall back to the public models.dev\ncatalog. Configured rates always win; live prices only fill gaps. A\nbackground task refreshes the price snapshot hourly; the cost-recording\npath reads the cached snapshot and never blocks on the network. Default\n`false`: off means no fetching and behavior identical to a build\nwithout the feature.",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "max_tokens": {
          "description": "Hard cap on response length in tokens. Most models enforce sensible built-in limits already; leave unset unless you specifically need to clip long outputs for cost or latency reasons.",
          "format": "uint32",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": [
            "integer",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "merge_system_into_user": {
          "description": "ModelProvider-specific quirk: fold the system prompt into the first user message instead of sending a separate system role. Only needed for models that reject (or mishandle) a standalone system role, e.g. certain older Mistral variants.",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "model": {
          "description": "Model identifier to send with each request: the ID string from the model_provider's catalog (e.g. `gpt-4o`, `claude-sonnet-4-5`, `llama-3.3-70b`). Must match a model the model_provider actually serves on this account.",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "native_tools": {
          "description": "Override the provider's default for native tool calling.\n`None` (default) honors the provider's built-in choice. `Some(true)`\nforces native tool calls on, `Some(false)` forces text-fallback.\nCurrently consulted only by the Groq factory, which defaults to\ntext-fallback because llama-family Groq models reject native tool\ncalls with HTTP 400. Setting `native_tools = true` re-enables native\ntool calling for Groq models that support it.",
          "type": [
            "boolean",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "pricing": {
          "additionalProperties": {
            "format": "double",
            "type": "number"
          },
          "description": "Per-model pricing for cost tracking, USD per 1M tokens.\n\nFree-form key/value map. Keys are user-defined model identifiers; an\noptional `.input` / `.output` suffix encodes pricing dimension when\nthe operator wants to split rates. A bare key without a suffix is\nused as a flat per-token rate when neither dimension is specified.\nDefault is empty: cost tracking falls back to \"unknown\" rates and\nonly token usage is recorded.\n\nExample: `pricing = { opus = 15.0, sonnet = 3.0 }`\nOr split: `pricing = { \"opus.input\" = 15.0, \"opus.output\" = 75.0 }`",
          "type": "object"

        "provider_extra": {

        },
        "replay_assistant_reasoning": {
          "description": "Whether stored assistant reasoning should be replayed on outbound\nassistant history messages. `Some(false)` strips `reasoning_content`\nand `reasoning` before sending. `None` (default) honours the provider's\nbuilt-in default (true for most compat providers, false for Groq).",
          "type": [

        "requires_openai_auth": {

Import an existing Codex CLI login with `zeroclaw auth login --model-provider openai-codex --import ~/.codex/auth.json`, or run `zeroclaw auth login --model-provider openai-codex`.           "format": "double",

          "format": "uint64",

          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "uri": {
          "description": "Endpoint URI the client hits. Override the family's default endpoint when pointing at a self-hosted gateway (LiteLLM, vLLM, Ollama), a custom proxy, or any non-standard URL. Leave unset to use the family's default URI from its `ModelEndpoint` impl. Set this to the FULL endpoint URL; there is no separate path-suffix field.",
          "type": [
            "string",

          ]
        },

Set\n`vision = false` for a text-only model served by such a family (e.g. a\ntext LLM behind llama.cpp) so image messages are routed to a configured\n`[multimodal] vision_model_provider` instead of being sent to a model\nthat rejects them. `Some(true)` forces vision on.",
