          "type": "object"
        },
        "provider_extra": {
          "description": "Extra JSON parameters to include in API requests.\nMerged at the top level of the request body, allowing provider-specific\nfeatures (routing, transforms, etc.) without code changes.\nExample: `provider_extra = { model_provider = { only = [\"Anthropic\"] } }`"
        },
        "replay_assistant_reasoning": {
          "description": "Whether stored assistant reasoning should be replayed on outbound\nassistant history messages. `Some(false)` strips `reasoning_content`\nand `reasoning` before sending. `None` (default) honours the provider's\nbuilt-in default (true for most compat providers, false for Groq).",
          "type": [
            "boolean",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "requires_openai_auth": {
          "description": "When true, the client pulls credentials from ZeroClaw's stored `openai-codex` auth profile instead of the `api_key` field above. Import an existing Codex CLI login with `zeroclaw auth login --model-provider openai-codex --import ~/.codex/auth.json`, or run `zeroclaw auth login --model-provider openai-codex`. Turn on only for the OpenAI Codex model_provider; leave off for standard API-key model_providers.",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "temperature": {
          "description": "Sampling temperature passed to the model. Lower values (0.0–0.3) give\ndeterministic, near-verbatim output, which fits code, routing, summarization.\nHigher values (0.7–1.2) give more varied output, which fits open-ended chat.",
          "format": "double",
          "type": [
            "number",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "think": {
          "description": "Enable or disable chain-of-thought thinking for models that support it\n(e.g. Qwen3, GLM-4). `true` turns thinking on, `false` turns it off.\n`None` (default) lets the model decide. Forwarded as `enable_thinking`\nin the request body; mirrors the Ollama provider's `think` field.",
          "type": [
            "boolean",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "timeout_secs": {
          "description": "HTTP request timeout in seconds. Bump this for slow local model_providers (Ollama on CPU, big local models) or high-latency networks; leave unset otherwise.",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": [
            "integer",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "tls_ca_cert_path": {
          "description": "Path to a PEM-encoded CA certificate for TLS connections to this provider.\nMust be an absolute path; shell expansion (e.g. `~`) is not performed.\nLeave unset to use the system's default trust store.",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "uri": {
          "description": "Endpoint URI the client hits. Override the family's default endpoint when pointing at a self-hosted gateway (LiteLLM, vLLM, Ollama), a custom proxy, or any non-standard URL. Leave unset to use the family's default URI from its `ModelEndpoint` impl. Set this to the FULL endpoint URL; there is no separate path-suffix field.",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "vision": {
          "description": "Override the provider's vision (image input) capability.\n`None` (default) uses the provider family's built-in default. Several\nfamilies (llama.cpp, the generic OpenAI-compatible endpoint, etc.)\nassume vision-capable because they can serve multimodal models. Set\n`vision = false` for a text-only model served by such a family (e.g. a\ntext LLM behind llama.cpp) so image messages are routed to a configured\n`[multimodal] vision_model_provider` instead of being sent to a model\nthat rejects them. `Some(true)` forces vision on.",
          "type": [
            "boolean",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "wire_api": {
          "anyOf": [
            {
              "$ref": "#/$defs/WireApi"
            },
            {
              "type": "null"
            }
          ],
          "description": "Wire protocol flavor: `responses` for OpenAI's Responses API (`POST /v1/responses`), `chat_completions` for the legacy chat wire and most OpenAI-compatible gateways. New OpenAI provider slots default to `responses`; other families default to chat-completions (or ignore the field). Only override if you're forcing an unusual combination."
        }
      },
      "type": "object"
    },
    "LocalWhisperConfig": {
      "description": "Local/self-hosted Whisper-compatible STT endpoint (`[transcription.local_whisper]`).\n\nConfigures a self-hosted STT endpoint. Can be on localhost, a private network host, or any reachable URL.",
      "properties": {
        "bearer_token": {
          "default": null,
          "description": "Bearer token for endpoint authentication.\nOmit for unauthenticated local endpoints.",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ],
          "x-secret": true
        },
        "max_audio_bytes": {
          "default": 26214400,
          "description": "Maximum audio file size in bytes accepted by this endpoint.\nDefaults to 25 MB — matching the cloud API cap for a safe out-of-the-box\nexperience. Self-hosted endpoints can accept much larger files; raise this\nas needed, but note that each transcription call clones the audio buffer\ninto a multipart payload, so peak memory per request is ~2× this value.",
          "format": "uint",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "timeout_secs": {
          "default": 300,
          "description": "Request timeout in seconds. Defaults to 300 (large files on local GPU).",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "url": {
          "description": "HTTP or HTTPS endpoint URL, e.g. `\"http://10.10.0.1:8001/v1/transcribe\"`.",
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "url"
      ],
      "type": "object"
    },
    "LocalWhisperTranscriptionProviderConfig": {
      "description": "Local / self-hosted Whisper-compatible transcription endpoint. Skips the\nshared `TranscriptionProviderConfig` base because it uses a bearer-token\nscheme and a per-instance URL rather than a vendor API key.",
      "properties": {
        "bearer_token": {
          "default": null,
          "description": "Bearer token for endpoint authentication. Omit for unauthenticated\nlocal endpoints.",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ],
          "x-secret": true
        },
        "language": {
          "default": null,
          "description": "Optional language hint (passed through to the local endpoint).",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "max_audio_bytes": {
          "default": 26214400,
          "description": "Maximum audio file size in bytes accepted by this endpoint.\nDefaults to 25 MB to match the cloud cap; raise as needed.",
          "format": "uint",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "timeout_secs": {
          "default": 300,
          "description": "Request timeout in seconds.",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "uri": {
          "description": "Endpoint URL, e.g. `\"http://10.10.0.1:8001/v1/transcribe\"`.",
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "uri"
      ],
      "type": "object"
    },
    "LogLlmRequestPayload": {
      "description": "LLM request payload capture policy. Mirrors [`LogToolIo`] but gates the\nprompt/messages sent on each `llm_request`. Defaults to `Off` because the\nfull payload is the entire system prompt plus conversation every turn.",
      "enum": [
        "off",
        "redacted",
        "full"
      ],
      "type": "string"
    },
    "LogPersistence": {
      "description": "JSONL log persistence mode.",
      "oneOf": [
        {
          "enum": [
            "none",
            "rolling",
            "full"
          ],
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "rotating",
          "description": "Persist all events, but with ZeroClaw-managed archive rotation: the\nactive file is rotated to a timestamped archive on a size and/or daily\nboundary, and old archives are pruned by count and/or age. Unlike\n`rolling` (entry-count trim of the active file), rotated events are\npreserved in archive files for later diagnostics. Rotation is tuned via\nthe `log_persistence_max_bytes`, `log_persistence_rotate_daily`,\n`log_persistence_retention_max_files`, and\n`log_persistence_retention_max_age_days` settings.",
          "type": "string"
        }
      ]
    },
    "LogToolIo": {
      "description": "Tool I/O capture policy.",
      "enum": [
        "off",
        "redacted",
        "full"
      ],
      "type": "string"
    },
    "LucidStorageConfig": {
      "description": "Lucid CLI sync backend (`[storage.lucid.<alias>]`).",
      "properties": {
        "binary_path": {
          "default": null,
          "description": "Optional path to the lucid-memory binary. When unset, the bare `lucid`\nexecutable is resolved on `PATH`. A blank or whitespace-only value is\nrejected at config validation and remains invalid if startup continues,\nso an invalid explicit selector never falls through to `PATH`.",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "recall_timeout_ms": {
          "default": null,
          "description": "Recall (context) timeout override, in milliseconds. Lucid CLI cold\nstarts (loading the local embedding model) can exceed 1.5s on ARM\nhosts; raise this if recalls still time out on your hardware.\nUnset falls back to the built-in default (3000ms). `0` is rejected\nat config validation; because startup warns and continues after\nvalidation errors, a `0` that reaches the runtime is treated as\nunset and falls back to the default.",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": [
            "integer",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "store_timeout_ms": {
          "default": null,
          "description": "Store timeout override, in milliseconds. Same cold-start\nconsideration as `recall_timeout_ms`. Unset falls back to the\nbuilt-in default (3000ms); `0` is rejected at validation and, if\nstartup continues after the warning, is likewise treated as unset.",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": [
            "integer",
            "null"
          ]
        }
      },
      "type": "object"
    },
    "ManifestModelProviderConfig": {
      "description": "Named model_provider profile definition.",
      "properties": {
        "api_key": {
          "description": "Secret API token for this model_provider. Grab it from the model_provider's dashboard (OpenAI platform, Anthropic console, OpenRouter keys page, etc.). Stored via the OS keyring when possible; never commit it to config.toml directly.",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ],
          "x-secret": true
        },
        "chat_template_kwargs": {
          "description": "Arbitrary key/value pairs forwarded verbatim as `chat_template_kwargs`\nin the request body (llama.cpp-specific). Use this to pass model-family\ntemplate variables that control behaviour not exposed by other fields.\nExample (Qwen3 thinking suppression):\n  `chat_template_kwargs = { enable_thinking = false }`"
        },
        "context_window": {
          "description": "Context window size (max input tokens) for this model.\nAuto-populated on setup from provider's /models endpoint if available.\nOverride manually for custom endpoints or when auto-detection fails.",
          "format": "uint",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": [
            "integer",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "extra_headers": {
          "additionalProperties": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "description": "Extra HTTP headers sent with every request. Niche: used for auth bridges, corporate proxies, or custom gateways that demand a tracing header. Most users never touch this; edit `config.toml` directly if you need it.",
          "type": "object",
          "x-secret": true
        },
        "fallback": {
          "description": "Ordered list of other provider aliases to try when every model on this\nalias has failed. Each entry is a dotted `<type>.<alias>` reference into\n`providers.models` and resolves with its own credentials, endpoint, and\nmodel. A fallback never inherits this alias's key. The walk is\ndepth-first: this alias's models are exhausted first, then each fallback\nalias is descended in turn (applying its own `fallback_models` and\n`fallback`). Empty means no provider-level fallback.",
          "items": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/ModelProviderRef"
          },
          "type": "array"
        },
        "fallback_models": {
          "description": "Ordered alternate models to try on THIS provider before falling over to\nthe `fallback` aliases. Same endpoint, key, and headers as the primary\n`model`. Only the model identifier changes. Use this when a provider\nserves a backup model (e.g. a smaller or older variant) that should be\ntried before leaving the provider entirely. Empty means only `model` is\ntried.",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "type": "array"
        },
        "kind": {
          "description": "Provider implementation to instantiate for this profile. Use this\nwhen a canonical typed slot should run through a compatible\nimplementation, e.g. `[providers.models.openai.proxy] kind =\n\"openai-compatible\"`.",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "live_pricing": {
          "description": "Pull live token prices for this provider's models from its own\nOpenAI-compatible `/models` listing (the gateway is the source of truth\nfor its prices), filling cost-tracking rates for models the operator\nhas NOT priced under `[cost.rates]` / `pricing`. Models the gateway does\nnot price (or providers with no HTTP `/models` listing at all, such as\na subprocess gateway like `kilocli`) fall back to the public models.dev\ncatalog. Configured rates always win; live prices only fill gaps. A\nbackground task refreshes the price snapshot hourly; the cost-recording\npath reads the cached snapshot and never blocks on the network. Default\n`false`: off means no fetching and behavior identical to a build\nwithout the feature.",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "max_tokens": {
          "description": "Hard cap on response length in tokens. Most models enforce sensible built-in limits already; leave unset unless you specifically need to clip long outputs for cost or latency reasons.",
          "format": "uint32",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": [
            "integer",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "merge_system_into_user": {
          "description": "ModelProvider-specific quirk: fold the system prompt into the first user message instead of sending a separate system role. Only needed for models that reject (or mishandle) a standalone system role, e.g. certain older Mistral variants.",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "model": {
          "description": "Model identifier to send with each request: the ID string from the model_provider's catalog (e.g. `gpt-4o`, `claude-sonnet-4-5`, `llama-3.3-70b`). Must match a model the model_provider actually serves on this account.",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "native_tools": {
          "description": "Override the provider's default for native tool calling.\n`None` (default) honors the provider's built-in choice. `Some(true)`\nforces native tool calls on, `Some(false)` forces text-fallback.\nCurrently consulted only by the Groq factory, which defaults to\ntext-fallback because llama-family Groq models reject native tool\ncalls with HTTP 400. Setting `native_tools = true` re-enables native\ntool calling for Groq models that support it.",
          "type": [
            "boolean",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "pricing": {
          "additionalProperties": {
            "format": "double",
            "type": "number"
          },
          "description": "Per-model pricing for cost tracking, USD per 1M tokens.\n\nFree-form key/value map. Keys are user-defined model identifiers; an\noptional `.input` / `.output` suffix encodes pricing dimension when\nthe operator wants to split rates. A bare key without a suffix is\nused as a flat per-token rate when neither dimension is specified.\nDefault is empty: cost tracking falls back to \"unknown\" rates and\nonly token usage is recorded.\n\nExample: `pricing = { opus = 15.0, sonnet = 3.0 }`\nOr split: `pricing = { \"opus.input\" = 15.0, \"opus.output\" = 75.0 }`",
          "type": "object"
        },
        "provider_extra": {
          "description": "Extra JSON parameters to include in API requests.\nMerged at the top level of the request body, allowing provider-specific\nfeatures (routing, transforms, etc.) without code changes.\nExample: `provider_extra = { model_provider = { only = [\"Anthropic\"] } }`"
        },
        "replay_assistant_reasoning": {
          "description": "Whether stored assistant reasoning should be replayed on outbound\nassistant history messages. `Some(false)` strips `reasoning_content`\nand `reasoning` before sending. `None` (default) honours the provider's\nbuilt-in default (true for most compat providers, false for Groq).",
          "type": [
            "boolean",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "requires_openai_auth": {
          "description": "When true, the client pulls credentials from ZeroClaw's stored `openai-codex` auth profile instead of the `api_key` field above. Import an existing Codex CLI login with `zeroclaw auth login --model-provider openai-codex --import ~/.codex/auth.json`, or run `zeroclaw auth login --model-provider openai-codex`. Turn on only for the OpenAI Codex model_provider; leave off for standard API-key model_providers.",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "temperature": {
          "description": "Sampling temperature passed to the model. Lower values (0.0–0.3) give\ndeterministic, near-verbatim output, which fits code, routing, summarization.\nHigher values (0.7–1.2) give more varied output, which fits open-ended chat.",
          "format": "double",
          "type": [
            "number",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "think": {
          "description": "Enable or disable chain-of-thought thinking for models that support it\n(e.g. Qwen3, GLM-4). `true` turns thinking on, `false` turns it off.\n`None` (default) lets the model decide. Forwarded as `enable_thinking`\nin the request body; mirrors the Ollama provider's `think` field.",
          "type": [
            "boolean",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "timeout_secs": {
          "description": "HTTP request timeout in seconds. Bump this for slow local model_providers (Ollama on CPU, big local models) or high-latency networks; leave unset otherwise.",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": [
            "integer",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "tls_ca_cert_path": {
          "description": "Path to a PEM-encoded CA certificate for TLS connections to this provider.\nMust be an absolute path; shell expansion (e.g. `~`) is not performed.\nLeave unset to use the system's default trust store.",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "uri": {
          "description": "Endpoint URI the client hits. Override the family's default endpoint when pointing at a self-hosted gateway (LiteLLM, vLLM, Ollama), a custom proxy, or any non-standard URL. Leave unset to use the family's default URI from its `ModelEndpoint` impl. Set this to the FULL endpoint URL; there is no separate path-suffix field.",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "vision": {
          "description": "Override the provider's vision (image input) capability.\n`None` (default) uses the provider family's built-in default. Several\nfamilies (llama.cpp, the generic OpenAI-compatible endpoint, etc.)\nassume vision-capable because they can serve multimodal models. Set\n`vision = false` for a text-only model served by such a family (e.g. a\ntext LLM behind llama.cpp) so image messages are routed to a configured\n`[multimodal] vision_model_provider` instead of being sent to a model\nthat rejects them. `Some(true)` forces vision on.",
          "type": [
            "boolean",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "wire_api": {
          "anyOf": [
            {
              "$ref": "#/$defs/WireApi"
            },
            {
              "type": "null"
            }
          ],
          "description": "Wire protocol flavor: `responses` for OpenAI's Responses API (`POST /v1/responses`), `chat_completions` for the legacy chat wire and most OpenAI-compatible gateways. New OpenAI provider slots default to `responses`; other families default to chat-completions (or ignore the field). Only override if you're forcing an unusual combination."
        }
      },
      "type": "object"
    },
    "MarkdownStorageConfig": {
      "description": "Markdown directory storage (`[storage.markdown.<alias>]`).",
      "properties": {
        "directory": {
          "default": null,
          "description": "Optional override for the markdown root directory.\nWhen unset, defaults to `<workspace_dir>/memory/`.",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        }
      },
      "type": "object"
    },
    "MatrixConfig": {
      "description": "Matrix channel configuration.",
      "properties": {
        "access_token": {
          "default": null,
          "description": "Matrix access token for the bot account. When unset, the channel\nfalls back to password login using `user_id` + `password`.",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ],
          "x-secret": true
        },
        "ack_reactions": {
          "default": null,
          "description": "Override for the top-level `[channels].ack_reactions`. When\n`None`, falls back to the channels-wide default. When set\nexplicitly (`true`/`false`), takes precedence for this Matrix\ninstance only.",
          "type": [
            "boolean",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "allowed_rooms": {
          "default": [],
          "description": "Allowed Matrix room IDs. Empty = allow all rooms the bot has joined.\nEntries are matched literally against the canonical room ID\n(`!abc:server`) of each incoming message; `#room:server` aliases are\nnot resolved for this allowlist (they are resolved only for outbound\ndelivery targets such as cron `delivery.to`).",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "type": "array"
        },
        "approval_timeout_secs": {
          "default": 300,
          "description": "Seconds to wait for operator approval on `always_ask` tools before auto-denying.",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "device_id": {
          "default": null,
          "description": "Optional Matrix device ID.",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "draft_update_interval_ms": {
          "default": 1500,
          "description": "Minimum interval (ms) between draft message edits in Partial mode.",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "enabled": {
          "default": false,
          "description": "Whether this channel is active. The runtime only loads channels whose\n`enabled = true`. Default: `false` so an operator who pastes a partial\n`[channels.<type>.<alias>]` block doesn't accidentally bring a channel\nlive before the rest of its config is filled in.",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "excluded_tools": {
          "default": [],
          "description": "Tools excluded from this channel's tool spec. When set, these tools\nare not exposed to the model when responding via this channel.",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "type": "array"
        },
        "homeserver": {
          "description": "Matrix homeserver URL (e.g. `\"https://matrix.org\"`).",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "interrupt_on_new_message": {
          "default": false,
          "description": "Whether to interrupt an in-flight agent response when a new message arrives.",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "mention_only": {
          "default": false,
          "description": "When true, only respond to messages that @-mention the bot in groups.\nDirect messages are always processed.",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "multi_message_delay_ms": {
          "default": 800,
          "description": "Delay (ms) between sending each paragraph in MultiMessage mode.",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "password": {
          "default": null,
          "description": "Optional login password for Matrix account (used for initial login flow).",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ],
          "x-secret": true
        },
        "recovery_key": {
          "default": null,
          "description": "Optional Matrix recovery key for automatic E2EE key backup restore.\nWhen set, ZeroClaw recovers room keys and cross-signing secrets on startup.",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ],
          "x-secret": true
        },
        "reply_in_thread": {
          "default": true,
          "description": "When true (default), replies are sent as thread replies. Starts a new thread from the\nincoming message when none exists. When false, only continues existing threads.",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "reply_min_interval_secs": {
          "default": 0,
          "description": "Per-(channel, recipient) outbound pacing floor in seconds.\nRange: `0..=REPLY_MIN_INTERVAL_MAX_SECS` (0 disables).",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "reply_queue_depth_max": {
          "default": 0,
          "description": "Per-(channel, recipient) outbound pacing queue depth.\nRange: `0..=REPLY_QUEUE_DEPTH_CEILING`. When `reply_min_interval_secs > 0`\nand this value is `0`, the pacing wrapper substitutes\n`DEFAULT_REPLY_QUEUE_DEPTH` (16). When the queue is full, the\nnewest send is dropped and a `WARN` is logged.",
          "format": "uint16",
          "maximum": 65535,
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "stream_mode": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/StreamMode",
          "default": "off",
          "description": "Streaming mode for progressive response delivery.\n`\"off\"` (default): single message. `\"partial\"`: edit-in-place draft.\n`\"multi_message\"`: paragraph-split delivery."
        },
        "user_id": {
          "default": null,
          "description": "Optional Matrix user ID (e.g. `\"@bot:matrix.org\"`).",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "homeserver"
      ],
      "type": "object"
    },
    "MattermostConfig": {
      "description": "Mattermost bot channel configuration.",
      "properties": {
        "bot_token": {
          "default": null,
          "description": "Mattermost bot access token. When unset, the channel falls back to\nthe login flow using `login_id` + `password`.",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ],
          "x-secret": true
        },
        "channel_ids": {
          "default": [],
          "description": "Channel IDs to restrict the bot to. Empty or `[\"*\"]` = auto-discover\nevery channel the bot can read (public, private, DMs, group DMs) and\npoll them all. Explicit IDs disable discovery and pin the bot to the\nlisted channels only. Migrated from the legacy `channel_id` singular\nfield.",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "type": "array"
        },
        "discover_dms": {
          "default": null,
          "description": "When true (default), auto-discovery includes DM (`type=D`) and group\nDM (`type=G`) channels. Set false to restrict the bot to public and\nprivate team channels only. Has no effect when `channel_ids` lists\nexplicit IDs. Defaults to `true` at the call site via\n`discover_dms.unwrap_or(true)`.",
          "type": [
            "boolean",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "enabled": {
          "default": false,
          "description": "Whether this channel is active. The runtime only loads channels whose\n`enabled = true`. Default: `false` so an operator who pastes a partial\n`[channels.<type>.<alias>]` block doesn't accidentally bring a channel\nlive before the rest of its config is filled in.",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "excluded_tools": {
          "default": [],
          "description": "Tools excluded from this channel's tool spec. When set, these tools\nare not exposed to the model when responding via this channel.",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "type": "array"
        },
        "interrupt_on_new_message": {
          "default": false,
          "description": "When true, a newer Mattermost message from the same sender in the same channel\ncancels the in-flight request and starts a fresh response with preserved history.",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "listen_mode": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/MattermostListenMode",
          "default": "polling",
          "description": "Listen mode: `\"polling\"` (REST API every 3s, default) or `\"websocket\"`\n(persistent WebSocket connection to `/api/v4/websocket` for near-real-time\nevent delivery). WebSocket mode reduces server load and delivers events\nfaster but requires a WebSocket-capable Mattermost server (v4.0+)."
        },
        "login_id": {
          "default": null,
          "description": "Login ID (email or username) for the password login flow. Used only\nwhen `bot_token` is unset; both `login_id` and `password` must be\nset together.",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "mention_only": {
          "default": null,
          "description": "When true, only respond to messages that @-mention the bot. Other\nmessages in the channel are silently ignored. DM and group DM\nchannels always bypass this filter: a 1:1 (or small-group) direct\nconversation has no ambient noise to gate against, so every message\nis treated as addressed to the bot.",
          "type": [
            "boolean",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "password": {
          "default": null,
          "description": "Account password for the login flow. Used only when `bot_token` is\nunset; both `login_id` and `password` must be set together.",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ],
          "x-secret": true
        },
        "proxy_url": {
          "default": null,
          "description": "Per-channel proxy URL (http, https, socks5, socks5h).\nOverrides the global `[proxy]` setting for this channel only.",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "reply_min_interval_secs": {
          "default": 0,
          "description": "Per-(channel, recipient) outbound pacing floor in seconds.\nRange: `0..=REPLY_MIN_INTERVAL_MAX_SECS` (0 disables).",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "reply_queue_depth_max": {
          "default": 0,
          "description": "Per-(channel, recipient) outbound pacing queue depth.\nRange: `0..=REPLY_QUEUE_DEPTH_CEILING`. When `reply_min_interval_secs > 0`\nand this value is `0`, the pacing wrapper substitutes\n`DEFAULT_REPLY_QUEUE_DEPTH` (16). When the queue is full, the\nnewest send is dropped and a `WARN` is logged.",
          "format": "uint16",
          "maximum": 65535,
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "team_ids": {
          "default": [],
          "description": "Team IDs to restrict auto-discovery to. Empty = discover across every\nteam the bot belongs to. Non-empty = only discover public/private\nchannels whose `team_id` is in this list. DMs and group DMs (which\nhave no team) are governed by `discover_dms` instead.",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "type": "array"
        },
        "thread_replies": {
          "default": null,
          "description": "When true (default), replies thread on the original post.\nWhen false, replies go to the channel root.",
          "type": [
            "boolean",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "url": {
          "description": "Mattermost server URL (e.g. `\"https://mattermost.example.com\"`).",
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "url"
      ],
      "type": "object"
    },
    "MattermostListenMode": {
      "description": "How the Mattermost channel receives inbound messages.",
      "oneOf": [
        {
          "const": "polling",
          "description": "Poll REST API every 3 seconds. The default — all existing configs\ncontinue to work without changes.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "websocket",
          "description": "Connect to `/api/v4/websocket` for near-real-time event delivery.",
          "type": "string"
        }
      ]
    },
    "McpBundleConfig": {
      "description": "Named MCP server bundle (`[mcp_bundles.<alias>]`).\n\nA reusable group of MCP servers granted to an agent that references the\nbundle by alias in `agents.<alias>.mcp_bundles`. Server IDs are matched\nagainst `[mcp.servers]` by `name`. Resolution is secure by default (see\n`Config::mcp_servers_for_bundles`): an ID with no matching server grants\nnothing, and `exclude` wins over `servers` across every bundle an agent\nreferences.",
      "properties": {
        "exclude": {
          "default": [],
          "description": "MCP server IDs removed from the grant. Deny wins: a name listed here is\nexcluded even if another referenced bundle includes it.",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "type": "array"
        },
        "servers": {
          "default": [],
          "description": "MCP server IDs (`[mcp.servers].name`) granted by this bundle.",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "type": "array"
        }
      },
      "type": "object"
    },
    "McpConfig": {
      "description": "External MCP client configuration (`[mcp]` section).",
      "properties": {
        "deferred_loading": {
          "default": false,
          "description": "Load MCP tool schemas on-demand via `tool_search` instead of eagerly\nincluding them in the LLM context window. When enabled, only tool names\nare listed in the system prompt; the LLM must call `tool_search` to fetch\nfull schemas before invoking a deferred tool.",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "enabled": {
          "default": true,
          "description": "Enable MCP tool loading.",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "servers": {
          "default": [],
          "description": "Configured MCP servers. The `#[nested]` annotation makes the macro\nexpose this as a List section in `map_key_sections()`, so the\ndashboard's `+ Add MCP server` affordance and the `POST\n/api/config/map-key?path=mcp.servers&key=<name>` endpoint pick it\nup automatically (no hand-table on the gateway side).\n\n`#[natural_key = \"name\"]` opts the Vec into per-element property\nrouting (see `route_vec_path` and the `Configurable` derive's\n`#[natural_key]` arm). With it, `set_prop(\"mcp.servers.<name>.url\",\n...)` and `get_prop(\"mcp.servers.<name>.transport\")` resolve to\nthe matching element's own `set_prop` / `get_prop`, and the\n`mcp.servers` section behaves like a `HashMap<String,\nMcpServerConfig>` from the dashboard / TUI's point of view.\n`name` itself becomes read-only via `set_prop`; rename goes\nthrough `rename_map_key` which mutates the `name` field in place.",
          "items": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/McpServerConfig"
          },
          "type": "array"
        }
      },
      "type": "object"
    },
    "McpServerConfig": {
      "description": "Configuration for a single external MCP server.",
      "properties": {
        "args": {
          "default": [],
          "description": "Command arguments for stdio transport.",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "type": "array"
        },
        "command": {
          "default": "",
          "description": "Executable to spawn for stdio transport.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "env": {
          "additionalProperties": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "default": {},
          "description": "Optional environment variables for stdio transport.",
          "type": "object",
          "x-secret": true
        },
        "headers": {
          "additionalProperties": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "default": {},
          "description": "Optional HTTP headers for HTTP/SSE transports. Treated as secret:\nthe values commonly carry Bearer tokens for the upstream MCP server.",
          "type": "object",
          "x-secret": true
        },
        "name": {
          "default": "",
          "description": "Display name used as a tool prefix (`<server>__<tool>`). Filled in\nfrom the supplied `map_key` when the entry is created via\n`create_map_key(\"mcp.servers\", \"<name>\")`; `#[serde(default)]` lets\nthe macro default-construct from `{}` before the name gets injected.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "pinned_resources": {
          "default": [],
          "description": "Resource URIs to read once at agent startup and inject into the system\nprompt as untrusted, server-origin context. Each is read via\n`resources/read` on this server; pins on a server that does not advertise\nresources, or that the agent's tool policy denies, are skipped with a\nwarning. Read once per run (not refreshed; no subscriptions).",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "type": "array"
        },
        "tool_timeout_secs": {
          "default": null,
          "description": "Optional per-call timeout in seconds (hard capped in validation).",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": [
            "integer",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "transport": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/McpTransport",
          "default": "stdio",
          "description": "Transport type (default: stdio)."
        },
        "url": {
          "default": null,
          "description": "URL for HTTP/SSE transports.",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        }
      },
      "type": "object",
      "x-required-by-transport": {
        "http": "url",
        "sse": "url",
        "stdio": "command"
      }
    },
    "McpTransport": {
      "description": "Transport type for MCP server connections.",
      "oneOf": [
        {
          "const": "stdio",
          "description": "Spawn a local process and communicate over stdin/stdout.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "http",
          "description": "Connect via HTTP POST.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "sse",
          "description": "Connect via HTTP + Server-Sent Events.",
          "type": "string"
        }
      ]
    },
    "MdnsConfig": {
      "description": "Configuration for LAN-local mDNS peer discovery (`[nodes.mdns]`).\n\nThis config controls only discovery behavior. The advertised gateway\nendpoint is derived from the running gateway's actual host, port, and path\nprefix at startup so `[nodes.mdns]` does not duplicate gateway listen state.",
      "properties": {
        "announce_interval_secs": {
          "default": 30,
          "description": "How often this node re-broadcasts its presence, in seconds.",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "enabled": {
          "default": false,
          "description": "Enable mDNS local peer discovery.",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "max_peers": {
          "default": 16,
          "description": "Maximum number of unauthenticated LAN peer hints retained in memory.",
          "format": "uint",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "node_name": {
          "default": null,
          "description": "Human-readable node name advertised to LAN peers. Defaults to a stable\nlocal fallback when unset.",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "peer_ttl_secs": {
          "default": 90,
          "description": "Seconds after the last announcement before a peer is evicted.",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        }
      },
      "type": "object"
    },
    "MediaPipelineConfig": {
      "description": "Automatic media understanding pipeline configuration (`[media_pipeline]`).\n\nWhen enabled, inbound channel messages with media attachments are\npre-processed before reaching the agent: audio is transcribed, images are\nannotated, and videos are summarised.",
      "properties": {
        "describe_images": {
          "default": true,
          "description": "Add image descriptions when a vision-capable model is active.",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "enabled": {
          "default": false,
          "description": "Master toggle for the media pipeline (default: false).",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "summarize_video": {
          "default": true,
          "description": "Summarize video attachments (placeholder — requires external API).",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "transcribe_audio": {
          "default": true,
          "description": "Transcribe audio attachments using the configured transcription model_provider.",
          "type": "boolean"
        }
      },
      "type": "object"
    },
    "MemoryBackendKind": {
      "description": "Selects the memory backend used by an agent.",
      "oneOf": [
        {
          "const": "none",
          "description": "No memory backend. Recall returns empty; stores are no-ops.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "sqlite",
          "description": "Embedded SQLite (`crates/zeroclaw-memory/src/sqlite.rs`). Default for\nnew installs because every supported platform can run it without\nextra services.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "postgres",
          "description": "PostgreSQL with optional pgvector\n(`crates/zeroclaw-memory/src/postgres.rs`, feature `memory-postgres`).",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "qdrant",
          "description": "Qdrant vector store (`crates/zeroclaw-memory/src/qdrant.rs`).",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "markdown",
          "description": "Markdown files in the agent's workspace\n(`crates/zeroclaw-memory/src/markdown.rs`).",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "lucid",
          "description": "Hybrid local SQLite + external Lucid CLI\n(`crates/zeroclaw-memory/src/lucid.rs`).",
          "type": "string"
        }
      ]
    },
    "MemoryConfig": {
      "description": "Memory backend configuration (`[memory]` section).\n\nControls conversation memory storage, embeddings, hybrid search, response\ncaching, and memory snapshot/hydration. Backend-specific connection settings\nlive under `[storage.<backend>.<alias>]`; this section selects which storage\ninstance to use via the `backend` dotted reference.",
      "properties": {
        "archive_after_days": {
          "default": 7,
          "description": "Move daily/session files to the archive directory after this many days. Keeps the hot working set small without deleting history.",
          "format": "uint32",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "audit_enabled": {
          "default": false,
          "description": "Enable audit logging of memory operations.",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "audit_retention_days": {
          "default": 30,
          "description": "Retention period for audit entries in days (default: 30).",
          "format": "uint32",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "auto_hydrate": {
          "default": true,
          "description": "Auto-hydrate from MEMORY_SNAPSHOT.md when brain.db is missing",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "auto_reindex_on_identity_change": {
          "default": false,
          "description": "Automatically re-embed all memories in the background when a change of embedding provider/model/dimensions is detected at startup (after the stale vectors have been cleared). Costs one embedding API call per memory, so it's off by default — leave it off for large stores and run `zeroclaw memory reindex` explicitly instead.",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "auto_save": {
          "default": true,
          "description": "Auto-save what *you* tell ZeroClaw into memory as conversation history — the agent's own replies are not saved. Turn off if you want memory to only hold things you explicitly record via the memory tool.",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "backend": {
          "default": "sqlite",
          "description": "Dotted reference to the active storage instance: `<backend>.<alias>`\n(e.g. `\"sqlite.default\"`, `\"postgres.work\"`). Resolves through\n`Config.storage.<backend>.<alias>` at runtime. Bare backend names\n(`\"sqlite\"`) are treated as `\"<backend>.default\"`. Set to `\"none\"` to\ndisable persistence entirely.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "candidate_multiplier": {
          "default": 4,
          "description": "Candidate pool multiplier over the final recall limit before blend/rerank trimming.\nValues must be in 1..=20; runtime also enforces a bounded candidate pool.",
          "format": "uint",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "chunk_max_tokens": {
          "default": 512,
          "description": "Max tokens per chunk for document splitting",
          "format": "uint",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "conflict_supersede_enabled": {
          "default": true,
          "description": "Enable reversible supersede soft-hide machinery when wired.",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "conflict_threshold": {
          "default": 0.85,
          "description": "Cosine similarity threshold for conflict detection (0.0–1.0).",
          "format": "double",
          "type": "number"
        },
        "consolidation_extract_facts": {
          "default": false,
          "description": "Also extract atomic durable facts from each consolidated turn and store\nthem as individual Core memories. Default off; the flip is sequenced in\na later phase. SQLite-only: enabling this requires the sqlite memory\nbackend globally and on every agent (validated at config load).",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "conversation_retention_days": {
          "default": 30,
          "description": "Delete conversation rows older than this many days from the DB (sqlite backend only). Age is measured by `updated_at` (last write time). 0 = keep forever.",
          "format": "uint32",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "core_max_bytes": {
          "default": 0,
          "description": "Maximum Core bytes before budget compaction. 0 = unbounded.",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "core_max_rows": {
          "default": 0,
          "description": "Maximum Core rows before budget compaction. 0 = unbounded.",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "core_retention_days": {
          "default": 0,
          "description": "Delete core memory rows older than this many days from the DB. Age is measured by `created_at` (first-write time). Neither recall nor ordinary rewrites refresh `created_at` under the current SQLite upsert, so core retention is an absolute age limit from first write. Set this to a generously large window for durable core memories, or keep 0 = keep forever.",
          "format": "uint32",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "daily_max_rows": {
          "default": 0,
          "description": "Maximum Daily rows before budget compaction. 0 = unbounded.",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "daily_retention_days": {
          "default": 0,
          "description": "Delete daily memory rows older than this many days from the DB. Age is measured by `updated_at` (last write time). 0 = keep forever.",
          "format": "uint32",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "dedup_action": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/MemoryDedupAction",
          "default": "reject",
          "description": "Action to take when a duplicate is detected."
        },
        "dedup_jaccard_threshold": {
          "default": 0.8,
          "description": "Jaccard threshold for text-only duplicate detection.",
          "format": "double",
          "type": "number"
        },
        "dedup_on_write": {
          "default": false,
          "description": "Enable write-time near-duplicate detection.",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "default_namespace": {
          "default": "default",
          "description": "Default namespace for memory entries.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "embedding_api_key": {
          "description": "Optional API key for the embedding endpoint. When set, embedding calls use this key instead of inheriting one from the seed model provider — decoupling embeddings from the chat model. Use it when the chat model runs on a provider that carries no usable embedding credential (e.g. an OAuth-only provider) while embeddings keep hitting an `openai`/`custom:` endpoint with their own key. Leave unset to inherit the seed provider's key (backward-compatible default).",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ],
          "x-secret": true
        },
        "embedding_cache_size": {
          "default": 10000,
          "description": "Max embedding cache entries before LRU eviction",
          "format": "uint",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "embedding_dimensions": {
          "default": 1536,
          "description": "Vector width produced by the embedding model — must match the model's native dimension or vectors won't store correctly. Look up the number on the model_provider's model page.",
          "format": "uint",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "embedding_model": {
          "default": "text-embedding-3-small",
          "description": "Embedding model identifier — must match a model your chosen embedding model_provider serves (e.g. `text-embedding-3-small` for OpenAI). Changing this invalidates existing embeddings: the change is detected at startup and stale vectors are cleared automatically; run `zeroclaw memory reindex` to re-embed (or set `auto_reindex_on_identity_change`).",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "embedding_provider": {
          "default": "none",
          "description": "Source of embedding vectors for semantic search. `none` = keyword-only retrieval (no API calls, no vector cost); `openai` = OpenAI's embedding API; `custom:URL` = any OpenAI-compatible embedding endpoint (LiteLLM, local gateway, etc.).",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "evict_order": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/MemoryEvictOrder",
          "default": "value",
          "description": "Eviction ordering for budget compaction."
        },
        "fts_early_return_score": {
          "default": 0.85,
          "description": "Reserved (0.0-1.0): the FTS score above which recall would skip the\nvector stage. Inert until the backend exposes distinct FTS and vector\noperations; recall is a single hybrid call today, so this has no effect.",
          "format": "double",
          "type": "number"
        },
        "hygiene_enabled": {
          "default": true,
          "description": "Run the periodic hygiene pass that archives stale daily/session files and enforces retention windows. Leave on unless you want to manage cleanup yourself.",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "importance_weight": {
          "default": 0.2,
          "description": "Importance weight used by the recall blend.",
          "format": "double",
          "type": "number"
        },
        "keyword_weight": {
          "default": 0.3,
          "description": "How heavily BM25 (keyword) overlap counts when `search_mode = hybrid`. Raise toward 1.0 for exact-term matching; lower it when paraphrases should still score well.",
          "format": "double",
          "type": "number"
        },
        "min_relevance_score": {
          "default": 0.4,
          "description": "Minimum hybrid score (0.0–1.0) for a memory to be included in context.\nMemories scoring below this threshold are dropped to prevent irrelevant\ncontext from bleeding into conversations. Default: 0.4",
          "format": "double",
          "type": "number"
        },
        "mmr_lambda": {
          "default": 0.7,
          "description": "MMR relevance-vs-diversity weight, where 1.0 means relevance-only.",
          "format": "double",
          "type": "number"
        },
        "pin_min_importance": {
          "default": 1.01,
          "description": "Pin entries at or above this importance. >1.0 means disabled.",
          "format": "double",
          "type": "number"
        },
        "pin_namespaces": {
          "default": [],
          "description": "Namespaces protected from budget eviction.",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "type": "array"
        },
        "policy": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/MemoryPolicyConfig",
          "default": {
            "max_entries_per_category": 0,
            "max_entries_per_namespace": 0,
            "read_only_namespaces": [],
            "redact_categories": [
              "secret",
              "api_key",
              "private_key",
              "email",
              "phone"
            ],
            "redact_on_write": false,
            "retention_days_by_category": {},
            "threat_scan": "on",
            "threat_scan_load_time": true,
            "threat_scan_on_hit": "reject"
          },
          "description": "Memory policy configuration."
        },
        "purge_after_days": {
          "default": 30,
          "description": "Delete archived files permanently after this many days. Set high if you need long-term history; set low for privacy / disk-space reasons.",
          "format": "uint32",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "recency_weight": {
          "default": 0.1,
          "description": "Recency weight used by the recall blend.",
          "format": "double",
          "type": "number"
        },
        "rerank_enabled": {
          "default": false,
          "description": "Enable the recall rerank stage: blend retrieval score with importance\nand recency, collapse near-duplicate entries, then trim back to the\nrecall limit. The advanced strategy below runs when the candidate\ncount reaches `rerank_threshold`.",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "rerank_strategy": {
          "default": "none",
          "description": "Advanced rerank strategy. Valid: \"none\", \"mmr\".",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "rerank_threshold": {
          "default": 5,
          "description": "Minimum candidate count to trigger the advanced rerank strategy.",
          "format": "uint",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "response_cache_enabled": {
          "default": false,
          "description": "Enable LLM response caching to avoid paying for duplicate prompts",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "response_cache_hot_entries": {
          "default": 256,
          "description": "Max in-memory hot cache entries for the two-tier response cache (default: 256)",
          "format": "uint",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "response_cache_max_entries": {
          "default": 5000,
          "description": "Max number of cached responses before LRU eviction (default: 5000)",
          "format": "uint",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "response_cache_ttl_minutes": {
          "default": 60,
          "description": "TTL in minutes for cached responses (default: 60)",
          "format": "uint32",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "retrieval_stages": {
          "default": [
            "fts",
            "vector"
          ],
          "description": "Retrieval stages for per-agent recall. Only `\"cache\"` is active: it\nenables an in-process, per-handle hot cache over recall results and is\nomitted from the default so recall stays coherent across handles.\n`\"fts\"` and `\"vector\"` are reserved for when the backend exposes\ndistinct FTS and vector operations; recall is a single hybrid backend\ncall today, so those names have no effect (kept for forward compat).",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "type": "array"
        },
        "search_mode": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/SearchMode",
          "default": "hybrid",
          "description": "How memories are retrieved: `bm25` = keyword-only (no embeddings, cheapest); `embedding` = vector similarity only (needs an embedding model_provider); `hybrid` = blended keyword + vector score using the weights above (most robust)."
        },
        "snapshot_enabled": {
          "default": false,
          "description": "Enable periodic export of core memories to MEMORY_SNAPSHOT.md",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "snapshot_on_hygiene": {
          "default": false,
          "description": "Run snapshot during hygiene passes (heartbeat-driven)",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "types": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/MemoryTypesConfig",
          "default": {
            "enabled": false
          },
          "description": "Typed memory configuration (`[memory.types]` section)."
        },
        "vector_weight": {
          "default": 0.7,
          "description": "How heavily vector (semantic) similarity counts when `search_mode = hybrid`. Raise toward 1.0 to favor meaning-based matches; lower it to lean on keyword overlap instead.",
          "format": "double",
          "type": "number"
        }
      },
      "type": "object"
    },
    "MemoryDedupAction": {
      "description": "Write-time duplicate handling policy for memory entries.",
      "oneOf": [
        {
          "const": "reject",
          "description": "Reject an incoming near-duplicate.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "merge",
          "description": "Merge an incoming near-duplicate into a survivor.",
          "type": "string"
        }
      ]
    },
    "MemoryEvictOrder": {
      "description": "Memory budget eviction order.",
      "oneOf": [
        {
          "const": "value",
          "description": "Evict the lowest-value rows first.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "oldest",
          "description": "Evict the oldest rows first.",
          "type": "string"
        }
      ]
    },
    "MemoryPolicyConfig": {
      "description": "Memory policy configuration (`[memory.policy]` section).",
      "properties": {
        "max_entries_per_category": {
          "default": 0,
          "description": "Maximum entries per category (0 = unlimited).",
          "format": "uint",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "max_entries_per_namespace": {
          "default": 0,
          "description": "Maximum entries per namespace (0 = unlimited).",
          "format": "uint",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "read_only_namespaces": {
          "default": [],
          "description": "Namespaces that are read-only (writes are rejected).",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "type": "array"
        },
        "redact_categories": {
          "default": [
            "secret",
            "api_key",
            "private_key",
            "email",
            "phone"
          ],
          "description": "Redaction categories applied when `redact_on_write` is true.",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "type": "array"
        },
        "redact_on_write": {
          "default": false,
          "description": "Redact configured secret/PII categories before persistence.",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "retention_days_by_category": {
          "additionalProperties": {
            "format": "uint32",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "default": {},
          "description": "Retention days by category (overrides global). Keys: \"core\", \"daily\", \"conversation\".",
          "type": "object"
        },
        "threat_scan": {
          "default": "on",
          "description": "Content scan mode for durable memory writes: \"off\", \"on\", or \"strict\".",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "threat_scan_load_time": {
          "default": true,
          "description": "Re-scan stored entries at recall/read time and withhold flagged entries.",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "threat_scan_on_hit": {
          "default": "reject",
          "description": "Behavior when a write-time content scan matches: \"reject\" or\n\"block-on-read\".",
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "type": "object"
    },
    "MemoryTypesConfig": {
      "description": "Typed memory configuration (`[memory.types]` section).\n\nBehaviour-neutral by default: `enabled` gates MemoryKind assignment on new\nconsolidation writes and defaults off; the flip is sequenced in a later\nphase. SQLite-only: enabling requires the sqlite memory backend globally\nand on every agent (validated at config load).",
      "properties": {
        "enabled": {
          "default": false,
          "description": "Assign a first-class MemoryKind to new consolidation writes.",
          "type": "boolean"
        }
      },
      "type": "object"
    },
    "Microsoft365Config": {
      "description": "Microsoft 365 integration via Microsoft Graph API (`[microsoft365]` section).\n\nProvides access to Outlook mail, Teams messages, Calendar events,\nOneDrive files, and SharePoint search.",
      "properties": {
        "auth_flow": {
          "default": "client_credentials",
          "description": "Authentication flow: \"client_credentials\" or \"device_code\"",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "client_id": {
          "default": null,
          "description": "Azure AD application (client) ID",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "client_secret": {
          "default": null,
          "description": "Azure AD client secret (stored encrypted when secrets.encrypt = true)",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ],
          "x-secret": true
        },
        "enabled": {
          "default": false,
          "description": "Enable Microsoft 365 integration",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "scopes": {
          "default": [
            "https://graph.microsoft.com/.default"
          ],
          "description": "OAuth scopes to request",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "type": "array"
        },
        "tenant_id": {
          "default": null,
          "description": "Azure AD tenant ID",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "token_cache_encrypted": {
          "default": true,
          "description": "Encrypt the token cache file on disk",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "user_id": {
          "default": null,
          "description": "User principal name or \"me\" (for delegated flows)",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        }
      },
      "type": "object"
    },
    "MinimaxEndpoint": {
      "enum": [
        "cn",
        "intl"
      ],
      "type": "string"
    },
    "MinimaxModelProviderConfig": {
      "description": "Named model_provider profile definition.",
      "properties": {
        "api_key": {
          "description": "Secret API token for this model_provider. Grab it from the model_provider's dashboard (OpenAI platform, Anthropic console, OpenRouter keys page, etc.). Stored via the OS keyring when possible; never commit it to config.toml directly.",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ],
          "x-secret": true
        },
        "auth_mode": {
          "anyOf": [
            {
              "$ref": "#/$defs/AuthMode"
            },
            {
              "type": "null"
            }
          ]
        },
        "chat_template_kwargs": {
          "description": "Arbitrary key/value pairs forwarded verbatim as `chat_template_kwargs`\nin the request body (llama.cpp-specific). Use this to pass model-family\ntemplate variables that control behaviour not exposed by other fields.\nExample (Qwen3 thinking suppression):\n  `chat_template_kwargs = { enable_thinking = false }`"
        },
        "context_window": {
          "description": "Context window size (max input tokens) for this model.\nAuto-populated on setup from provider's /models endpoint if available.\nOverride manually for custom endpoints or when auto-detection fails.",
          "format": "uint",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": [
            "integer",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "endpoint": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/MinimaxEndpoint",
          "default": "intl"
        },
        "extra_headers": {
          "additionalProperties": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "description": "Extra HTTP headers sent with every request. Niche: used for auth bridges, corporate proxies, or custom gateways that demand a tracing header. Most users never touch this; edit `config.toml` directly if you need it.",
          "type": "object",
          "x-secret": true
        },
        "fallback": {
          "description": "Ordered list of other provider aliases to try when every model on this\nalias has failed. Each entry is a dotted `<type>.<alias>` reference into\n`providers.models` and resolves with its own credentials, endpoint, and\nmodel. A fallback never inherits this alias's key. The walk is\ndepth-first: this alias's models are exhausted first, then each fallback\nalias is descended in turn (applying its own `fallback_models` and\n`fallback`). Empty means no provider-level fallback.",
          "items": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/ModelProviderRef"
          },
          "type": "array"
        },
        "fallback_models": {
          "description": "Ordered alternate models to try on THIS provider before falling over to\nthe `fallback` aliases. Same endpoint, key, and headers as the primary\n`model`. Only the model identifier changes. Use this when a provider\nserves a backup model (e.g. a smaller or older variant) that should be\ntried before leaving the provider entirely. Empty means only `model` is\ntried.",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "type": "array"
        },
        "kind": {
          "description": "Provider implementation to instantiate for this profile. Use this\nwhen a canonical typed slot should run through a compatible\nimplementation, e.g. `[providers.models.openai.proxy] kind =\n\"openai-compatible\"`.",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "live_pricing": {
          "description": "Pull live token prices for this provider's models from its own\nOpenAI-compatible `/models` listing (the gateway is the source of truth\nfor its prices), filling cost-tracking rates for models the operator\nhas NOT priced under `[cost.rates]` / `pricing`. Models the gateway does\nnot price (or providers with no HTTP `/models` listing at all, such as\na subprocess gateway like `kilocli`) fall back to the public models.dev\ncatalog. Configured rates always win; live prices only fill gaps. A\nbackground task refreshes the price snapshot hourly; the cost-recording\npath reads the cached snapshot and never blocks on the network. Default\n`false`: off means no fetching and behavior identical to a build\nwithout the feature.",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "max_tokens": {
          "description": "Hard cap on response length in tokens. Most models enforce sensible built-in limits already; leave unset unless you specifically need to clip long outputs for cost or latency reasons.",
          "format": "uint32",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": [
            "integer",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "merge_system_into_user": {
          "description": "ModelProvider-specific quirk: fold the system prompt into the first user message instead of sending a separate system role. Only needed for models that reject (or mishandle) a standalone system role, e.g. certain older Mistral variants.",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "model": {
          "description": "Model identifier to send with each request: the ID string from the model_provider's catalog (e.g. `gpt-4o`, `claude-sonnet-4-5`, `llama-3.3-70b`). Must match a model the model_provider actually serves on this account.",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "native_tools": {
          "description": "Override the provider's default for native tool calling.\n`None` (default) honors the provider's built-in choice. `Some(true)`\nforces native tool calls on, `Some(false)` forces text-fallback.\nCurrently consulted only by the Groq factory, which defaults to\ntext-fallback because llama-family Groq models reject native tool\ncalls with HTTP 400. Setting `native_tools = true` re-enables native\ntool calling for Groq models that support it.",
          "type": [
            "boolean",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "oauth_client_id": {
          "description": "Override of MiniMax's published OAuth client_id. Most operators\nshould leave this unset; the runtime defaults to the\nvendor-published client_id (same one MiniMax's own portal uses).",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "oauth_refresh_token": {
          "description": "Long-lived OAuth refresh token issued by MiniMax. When set, the\nruntime exchanges it for a short-lived access token at provider\nconstruction time and uses that as the API credential. Operators\nwho prefer dashboard-generated long-lived API keys can leave this\nunset and populate `api_key` directly.",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "pricing": {
          "additionalProperties": {
            "format": "double",
            "type": "number"
          },
          "description": "Per-model pricing for cost tracking, USD per 1M tokens.\n\nFree-form key/value map. Keys are user-defined model identifiers; an\noptional `.input` / `.output` suffix encodes pricing dimension when\nthe operator wants to split rates. A bare key without a suffix is\nused as a flat per-token rate when neither dimension is specified.\nDefault is empty: cost tracking falls back to \"unknown\" rates and\nonly token usage is recorded.\n\nExample: `pricing = { opus = 15.0, sonnet = 3.0 }`\nOr split: `pricing = { \"opus.input\" = 15.0, \"opus.output\" = 75.0 }`",
          "type": "object"
        },
        "provider_extra": {
          "description": "Extra JSON parameters to include in API requests.\nMerged at the top level of the request body, allowing provider-specific\nfeatures (routing, transforms, etc.) without code changes.\nExample: `provider_extra = { model_provider = { only = [\"Anthropic\"] } }`"
        },
        "replay_assistant_reasoning": {
          "description": "Whether stored assistant reasoning should be replayed on outbound\nassistant history messages. `Some(false)` strips `reasoning_content`\nand `reasoning` before sending. `None` (default) honours the provider's\nbuilt-in default (true for most compat providers, false for Groq).",
          "type": [
            "boolean",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "requires_openai_auth": {
          "description": "When true, the client pulls credentials from ZeroClaw's stored `openai-codex` auth profile instead of the `api_key` field above. Import an existing Codex CLI login with `zeroclaw auth login --model-provider openai-codex --import ~/.codex/auth.json`, or run `zeroclaw auth login --model-provider openai-codex`. Turn on only for the OpenAI Codex model_provider; leave off for standard API-key model_providers.",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
        "temperature": {
          "description": "Sampling temperature passed to the model. Lower values (0.0–0.3) give\ndeterministic, near-verbatim output, which fits code, routing, summarization.\nHigher values (0.7–1.2) give more varied output, which fits open-ended chat.",
          "format": "double",
          "type": [
            "number",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "think": {
          "description": "Enable or disable chain-of-thought thinking for models that support it\n(e.g. Qwen3, GLM-4). `true` turns thinking on, `false` turns it off.\n`None` (default) lets the model decide. Forwarded as `enable_thinking`\nin the request body; mirrors the Ollama provider's `think` field.",
          "type": [
            "boolean",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "timeout_secs": {
          "description": "HTTP request timeout in seconds. Bump this for slow local model_providers (Ollama on CPU, big local models) or high-latency networks; leave unset otherwise.",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": [
            "integer",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "tls_ca_cert_path": {
          "description": "Path to a PEM-encoded CA certificate for TLS connections to this provider.\nMust be an absolute path; shell expansion (e.g. `~`) is not performed.\nLeave unset to use the system's default trust store.",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "uri": {
          "description": "Endpoint URI the client hits. Override the family's default endpoint when pointing at a self-hosted gateway (LiteLLM, vLLM, Ollama), a custom proxy, or any non-standard URL. Leave unset to use the family's default URI from its `ModelEndpoint` impl. Set this to the FULL endpoint URL; there is no separate path-suffix field.",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "vision": {
          "description": "Override the provider's vision (image input) capability.\n`None` (default) uses the provider family's built-in default. Several\nfamilies (llama.cpp, the generic OpenAI-compatible endpoint, etc.)\nassume vision-capable because they can serve multimodal models. Set\n`vision = false` for a text-only model served by such a family (e.g. a\ntext LLM behind llama.cpp) so image messages are routed to a configured\n`[multimodal] vision_model_provider` instead of being sent to a model\nthat rejects them. `Some(true)` forces vision on.",
          "type": [
            "boolean",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "wire_api": {
          "anyOf": [
            {
              "$ref": "#/$defs/WireApi"
            },
            {
              "type": "null"
            }
          ],
          "description": "Wire protocol flavor: `responses` for OpenAI's Responses API (`POST /v1/responses`), `chat_completions` for the legacy chat wire and most OpenAI-compatible gateways. New OpenAI provider slots default to `responses`; other families default to chat-completions (or ignore the field). Only override if you're forcing an unusual combination."
        }
      },
      "type": "object"
    },
