  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "description": "Top-level ZeroClaw configuration, loaded from `config.toml`.\n\nResolution order: `ZEROCLAW_CONFIG_DIR` env → `ZEROCLAW_WORKSPACE` env → `~/.zeroclaw/config.toml`.",
  "properties": {
    "a2a": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/A2aServerSection",
      "default": {
        "server": {
          "enabled": false,
          "public_base_url": ""
        }
      },
      "description": "Inbound A2A discovery server (`[a2a.server]`). Default-closed:\nserves the well-known catalog card and per-alias agent cards only\nwhen `enabled = true`. See `crate::multi_agent::A2aServerConfig`."
    },
    "acp": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/AcpConfig",
      "default": {
        "max_sessions": 10,
        "session_timeout_secs": 3600
      },
      "description": "ACP (Agent Client Protocol) server configuration (`[acp]`)."
    },
    "agents": {
      "additionalProperties": {
        "$ref": "#/$defs/AliasedAgentConfig"
      },
      "default": {},
      "description": "Aliased agents in this install. Each entry under `[agents.<alias>]`\nis one user-facing agent with its own identity, channels, model\nprovider, risk profile, workspace, and memory scope.\n`DelegateTool` consults this map when one agent delegates a\nsubtask to another.",
      "type": "object"
    },
    "backup": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/BackupConfig",
      "default": {
        "compress": true,
        "destination_dir": "state/backups",
        "enabled": true,
        "encrypt": false,
        "include_dirs": [
          "config",
          "memory",
          "audit",
          "knowledge"
        ],
        "max_keep": 10,
        "schedule_cron": null,
        "schedule_timezone": null
      },
      "description": "Backup tool configuration (`[backup]`)."
    },
    "browser": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/BrowserConfig",
      "default": {
        "allowed_domains": [
          "*"
        ],
        "allowed_private_hosts": [],
        "backend": "agent_browser",
        "computer_use": {
          "allow_remote_endpoint": false,
          "api_key": null,
          "endpoint": "http://127.0.0.1:8787/v1/actions",
          "max_coordinate_x": null,
          "max_coordinate_y": null,
          "timeout_ms": 15000,
          "window_allowlist": []
        },
        "enabled": true,
        "headed": null,
        "native_chrome_path": null,
        "native_headless": true,
        "native_webdriver_url": "http://127.0.0.1:9515",
        "session_name": null
      },
      "description": "Browser automation configuration (`[browser]`)."
    },
    "browser_delegate": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/BrowserDelegateConfig",
      "default": {
        "allowed_domains": [],
        "blocked_domains": [],
        "chrome_profile_dir": "",
        "cli_binary": "claude",
        "enabled": false,
        "task_timeout_secs": 120
      },
      "description": "Browser delegation configuration (`[browser_delegate]`).\n\nDelegates browser-based tasks to a browser-capable CLI subprocess (e.g.\nClaude Code with `claude-in-chrome` MCP tools). Useful for interacting\nwith corporate web apps (Teams, Outlook, Jira, Confluence) that lack\ndirect API access. A persistent Chrome profile can be configured so SSO\nsessions survive across invocations.\n\nFields:\n- `enabled` (`bool`, default `false`) — enable the browser delegation tool.\n- `cli_binary` (`String`, default `\"claude\"`) — CLI binary to spawn for browser tasks.\n- `chrome_profile_dir` (`String`, default `\"\"`) — Chrome user-data directory for\n  persistent SSO sessions. When empty, a fresh profile is used each invocation.\n- `allowed_domains` (`Vec<String>`, default `[]`) — allowlist of domains the browser\n  may navigate to. Empty means all non-blocked domains are permitted.\n- `blocked_domains` (`Vec<String>`, default `[]`) — denylist of domains. Blocked\n  domains take precedence over allowed domains.\n- `task_timeout_secs` (`u64`, default `120`) — per-task timeout in seconds.\n\nCompatibility: additive and disabled by default; existing configs remain valid when omitted.\nRollback/migration: remove `[browser_delegate]` or keep `enabled = false` to disable."
    },
    "channels": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/ChannelsConfig",
      "default": {
        "ack_reactions": true,
        "cli": true,
        "debounce_ms": 0,
        "max_concurrent_per_channel": 4,
        "message_timeout_secs": 300,
        "session_backend": "sqlite",
        "session_persistence": true,
        "session_ttl_hours": 0,
        "show_tool_calls": false
      },
      "description": "Channel configurations: Telegram, Discord, Slack, etc. (`[channels]`)."
    },
    "claude_code": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/ClaudeCodeConfig",
      "default": {
        "allowed_tools": [
          "Read",
          "Edit",
          "Bash",
          "Write"
        ],
        "enabled": false,
        "env_passthrough": [],
        "max_output_bytes": 2097152,
        "system_prompt": null,
        "timeout_secs": 600
      },
      "description": "Claude Code tool configuration (`[claude_code]`)."
    },

      "$ref": "#/$defs/ClaudeCodeRunnerConfig",

        "tmux_prefix": "zc-claude-"

      "description": "Claude Code task runner with Slack progress and SSH session handoff (`[claude_code_runner]`)."

    },
    "codex_cli": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/CodexCliConfig",
      "default": {
        "enabled": false,
        "env_passthrough": [],
        "extra_args": [],

        "timeout_secs": 600
      },
      "description": "Codex CLI tool configuration (`[codex_cli]`)."
    },
    "composio": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/ComposioConfig",
      "default": {
        "api_key": null,
        "enabled": false,
        "entity_id": "default"
      },
      "description": "Composio managed OAuth tools integration (`[composio]`)."
    },
    "conversational_ai": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/ConversationalAiConfig",
      "description": "Conversational AI agent builder configuration (`[conversational_ai]`).\n\nExperimental / future feature — not yet wired into the agent runtime.\nOmitted from generated config files when disabled (the default).\nExisting configs that already contain this section will continue to\ndeserialize correctly thanks to `#[serde(default)]`."
    },
    "cost": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/CostConfig",
      "default": {

        "daily_limit_usd": 10.0,
        "enabled": true,
        "enforcement": {
          "mode": "warn",

        "rates": {

            "tts": {}

          "tools": {}

      },
      "description": "Cost tracking and budget enforcement configuration (`[cost]`).\nAlso hosts the operator-managed rate sheet at\n`[cost.rates.<type>.<model>]`."
    },
    "cron": {
      "additionalProperties": {
        "$ref": "#/$defs/CronJobDecl"
      },
      "description": "Declarative cron jobs (`[cron.<alias>]`), alias-keyed.\n\nEach entry is a named scheduled job synced into the database at\nscheduler startup. Subsystem runtime knobs (enable/disable, catch-up,\nrun-history retention) live on `[scheduler]`.",
      "type": "object"
    },
    "data_retention": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/DataRetentionConfig",
      "default": {
        "categories": [],
        "dry_run": false,
        "enabled": false,
        "retention_days": 90
      },
      "description": "Data retention and purge configuration (`[data_retention]`)."
    },
    "delegate": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/DelegateToolConfig",
      "default": {

        "timeout_secs": 120
      },
      "description": "Delegate tool global default configuration (`[delegate]`)."
    },
    "embedding_routes": {
      "description": "Embedding-routing rules — route `hint:<name>` to specific\nmodel_provider + model combos for embedding requests.",
      "items": {
        "$ref": "#/$defs/EmbeddingRouteConfig"
      },
      "type": "array"
    },
    "escalation": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/EscalationConfig",
      "default": {
        "alert_channels": []
      },
      "description": "Escalation routing configuration (`[escalation]`)."
    },
    "eval": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/EvalHarnessConfig",
      "default": {
        "mode": "replay",
        "suite_dir": "evals"
      },
      "description": "Agent evaluation harness (`[eval]`) — surfaced via `zeroclaw eval`.\nDistinct from `[agent.eval]`, which is the in-loop response-quality scorer."
    },
    "file_download": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/FileDownloadConfig",
      "default": {
        "headers": {},
        "max_file_size_bytes": 26214400,
        "timeout_secs": 120,
        "url": null
      },
      "description": "Standalone file download tool configuration (`[file_download]`)."
    },
    "file_upload": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/FileUploadConfig",
      "default": {

pub fn document() -> &'static Value {
    static DOCUMENT: OnceLock<Value> = OnceLock::new();
    DOCUMENT.get_or_init(|| {
        serde_json::from_str(CONFIG_SCHEMA).expect("plugin config contract is valid JSON")
    })
}

fn references(node: &Value, out: &mut BTreeSet<String>) {
    match node {
        Value::Object(map) => {
            if let Some(name) = map
                .get("$ref")
                .and_then(Value::as_str)
                .and_then(|r| r.strip_prefix("#/$defs/"))
            {
                out.insert(name.to_string());
            }
            for child in map.values() {
                references(child, out);
            }
        }
        Value::Array(items) => {
            for child in items {
                references(child, out);
            }
        }
        _ => {}
    }
}

/// Derive a self-contained section from the plugin contract, retaining transitive definitions.
pub fn section_from(document: &Value, key: &str) -> Value {
    let property = &document["properties"][key];
    let mut section = property
        .as_object()
        .expect("config property is an object")
        .clone();
    let definitions = document["$defs"]
        .as_object()
        .expect("config contract has definitions");
    let mut pending = BTreeSet::new();
    let mut included = Map::new();
    references(property, &mut pending);
    while let Some(name) = pending.pop_first() {
        if included.contains_key(&name) {
            continue;
        }
        let definition = definitions.get(&name).expect("config reference resolves");
        references(definition, &mut pending);
        included.insert(name, definition.clone());
    }
    if !included.is_empty() {
        section.insert("$defs".into(), Value::Object(included));
    }
    Value::Object(section)
}

pub fn section(key: &str) -> Value {
    section_from(document(), key)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn derived_section_keeps_recursive_dependencies_without_unrelated_definitions() {
        let contract = serde_json::json!({
            "properties": {"network": {"$ref": "#/$defs/Network"}},
            "$defs": {
                "Network": {"type": "object", "properties": {"peer": {"$ref": "#/$defs/Peer"}}},
                "Peer": {"type": "object", "properties": {"network": {"$ref": "#/$defs/Network"}}},
                "Unrelated": {"type": "string"}
            }
        });
        let section = section_from(&contract, "network");
        assert_eq!(section["$defs"].as_object().unwrap().len(), 2);
        assert_eq!(section["$ref"], "#/$defs/Network");
        jsonschema::validator_for(&section).expect("recursive section is self-contained");
    }

    #[test]
    fn every_plugin_section_is_self_contained_and_validates_without_external_files() {
        let contract = document();
        jsonschema::validator_for(contract).expect("full contract compiles");
        for key in contract["properties"].as_object().unwrap().keys() {
            jsonschema::validator_for(&section(key))
                .unwrap_or_else(|error| panic!("section {key}: {error}"));
        }
    }
}
</file>

<file path="op-plugins/src/state_plugins/tched_router_generation_tests.rs">
use super::*;
use op_cozo_store::CozoGraphShuttle;

fn owner(principal: &str, session: &str) -> GenerationOwner {
    GenerationOwner::new(principal.into(), session.into()).unwrap()
}
fn input() -> StartGenerationInput {
    StartGenerationInput {
        agent_alias: "fixture-agent_alias".into(),
        prompt: "PRIVATE_PROMPT_MUST_NOT_PERSIST".into(),
    }
}
fn service() -> GenerationMethods {
    GenerationMethods::new(Arc::new(RuntimeDocuments::new(
        CozoGraphShuttle::new_in_memory().unwrap(),
    )))
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn owner_scope_siblings_and_job_revisions_survive_transitions() {
    let service = service();
    let owner = owner("principal-a", "session-a");
    let hash = "a".repeat(64);
    service
        .create(&owner, &input(), "one", &hash)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    service
        .create(&owner, &input(), "two", &hash)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    service.running(&owner, "one").await.unwrap();
    let state = service
        .append(&owner, "one", "first\n".into())
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(state.generation_jobs["two"].revision, 1);
    assert_eq!(state.generation_jobs["one"].output, "first\n");
    let (a, b) = tokio::join!(
        service.append(&owner, "one", "second".into()),
        service.running(&owner, "two")
    );
    a.unwrap();
    b.unwrap();
    let state = service
        .finish(&owner, "one", GenerationStatus::Completed, None)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(state.generation_jobs["one"].output, "first\nsecond");
    assert_eq!(
        state.generation_jobs["two"].status,
        GenerationStatus::Running
    );
    assert!(service
        .recover(&super::GenerationOwner::new("principal-b".into(), "session-a".into()).unwrap())
        .await
        .unwrap()
        .is_none());
    assert!(service
        .recover(&super::GenerationOwner::new("principal-a".into(), "session-b".into()).unwrap())
        .await
        .unwrap()
        .is_none());
    assert!(!serde_json::to_string(&state)
        .unwrap()
        .contains(&input().prompt));
    let raw = service
        .documents
        .read(&owner.document_id())
        .await
        .unwrap()
        .unwrap();
    assert!(!serde_json::to_string(&raw.document)
        .unwrap()
        .contains(&input().prompt));
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn stale_cancel_active_delete_and_bounds_leave_the_durable_row_unchanged() {
    let service = service();
    let owner = owner("a", "b");
    let hash = "b".repeat(64);
    let created = service
        .create(&owner, &input(), "job", &hash)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert!(service.request_cancel(&owner, "job", 2).await.is_err());
    assert!(service.delete(&owner, "job", 1).await.is_err());
    let current = service
        .documents
        .read(&owner.document_id())
        .await
        .unwrap()
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(current.revision, created.generation_revision);
    service.running(&owner, "job").await.unwrap();
    assert!(service
        .append(&owner, "job", "x".repeat(MAX_CHUNK_BYTES + 1))
        .await
        .is_err());
    let cancelled = service.request_cancel(&owner, "job", 2).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        cancelled.generation_jobs["job"].status,
        GenerationStatus::CancelRequested
    );
    assert!(service.append(&owner, "job", "late".into()).await.is_err());
    let done = service
        .finish(&owner, "job", GenerationStatus::Cancelled, None)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    let deleted = service
        .delete(&owner, "job", done.generation_jobs["job"].revision)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert!(deleted.generation_jobs.is_empty());
    assert_eq!(
        GenerationState::from_plugin_state(&deleted.plugin_state().unwrap()).unwrap(),
        deleted
    );
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn reopen_recovery_interrupts_unfinished_work_without_replaying_prompt() {
    let root = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let path = root.path().join("db");
    let owner = owner("a", "b");
    {
        let service = GenerationMethods::new(Arc::new(RuntimeDocuments::new(
            CozoGraphShuttle::new_persistent_private(path.clone()).unwrap(),
        )));
        service
            .create(&owner, &input(), "job", &"a".repeat(64))
            .await
            .unwrap();
        service.running(&owner, "job").await.unwrap();
        service
            .append(&owner, "job", "last committed text".into())
            .await
            .unwrap();
    }
    let service = GenerationMethods::new(Arc::new(RuntimeDocuments::new(
        CozoGraphShuttle::new_persistent_private(path).unwrap(),
    )));
    let recovered = service.recover(&owner).await.unwrap().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        recovered.generation_jobs["job"].status,
        GenerationStatus::Interrupted
    );
    assert_eq!(
        recovered.generation_jobs["job"].failure,
        Some(GenerationFailure::ProcessInterrupted)
    );
    assert_eq!(
        recovered.generation_jobs["job"].output,
        "last committed text"
    );
    assert_eq!(service.recover(&owner).await.unwrap().unwrap(), recovered);
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn forged_owner_and_corrupt_retained_rows_fail_closed() {
    let service = service();
    let owner = owner("a", "b");
    service
        .create(&owner, &input(), "job", &"a".repeat(64))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    service
        .documents
        .update(&owner.document_id(), |prior| {
            let mut value = prior.unwrap();
            value["session"] = serde_json::json!("other");
            Ok(value)
        })
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert!(service.recover(&owner).await.is_err());
    assert!(service.running(&owner, "job").await.is_err());
}

#[test]
fn selectors_are_reused_but_storage_domains_and_inputs_stay_separate() {
    let a = owner("ab", "c");
    let b = owner("a", "bc");
    assert_ne!(a.selector(), b.selector());
    assert!(a.document_id().starts_with("tched_generation:v1:"));
    for agent_alias in ["", "../another", "different/session", "bad name"] {
        assert!(StartGenerationInput {
            agent_alias: agent_alias.into(),
            prompt: "hello".into()
        }
        .validate()
        .is_err());
    }
    assert!(serde_json::from_value::<StartGenerationInput>(
        serde_json::json!({"agent_alias":"a","prompt":"x","session_id":"victim"})
    )
    .is_err());
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn escaped_output_aggregate_budget_fits_document_and_rejects_before_append() {
    let service = service();
    let owner = owner("owner", "session");
    let state = service
        .create(&owner, &input(), "base", &"a".repeat(64))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    let mut jobs = BTreeMap::new();
    for number in 0..4 {
        let mut job = state.generation_jobs["base"].clone();
        job.job_id = format!("full-{number}");
        job.status = GenerationStatus::Completed;
        job.output = "\u{0000}".repeat(MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES);
        jobs.insert(job.job_id.clone(), job);
    }
    let mut next = state.generation_jobs["base"].clone();
    next.job_id = "next".into();
    next.status = GenerationStatus::Running;
    jobs.insert(next.job_id.clone(), next);
    let snapshot = GenerationState {
        generation_revision: 10,
        generation_jobs: jobs,
    };
    validate_jobs(&snapshot.generation_jobs).unwrap();
    assert!(serde_json::to_vec(&snapshot).unwrap().len() < MAX_DOCUMENT_BYTES);
    let stored = StoredGenerations {
        format_version: 1,
        principal: owner.principal.clone(),
        session: owner.session.clone(),
        jobs: snapshot.generation_jobs.clone(),
    };
    assert!(serde_json::to_vec(&stored).unwrap().len() < MAX_DOCUMENT_BYTES);
    assert!(snapshot.preflight_append("next", "x").is_err());
    // The same invariant is enforced by the actual durable transition. Seed an
    // exact bounded fixture row and prove a rejected append creates no revision.
    let row = service
        .documents
        .update_with_result(&owner.document_id(), move |_| {
            Ok((serde_json::to_value(stored)?, ()))
        })
        .await
        .unwrap()
        .0;
    assert!(service.append(&owner, "next", "x".into()).await.is_err());
    assert_eq!(
        service
            .documents
            .read(&owner.document_id())
            .await
            .unwrap()
            .unwrap()
            .revision,
        row.revision
    );
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn completion_cannot_replace_the_committed_incremental_text() {
    let service = service();
    let owner = owner("a", "b");
    service
        .create(&owner, &input(), "job", &"a".repeat(64))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    service.running(&owner, "job").await.unwrap();
    let state = service
        .append(&owner, "job", "actual".into())
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert!(service
        .complete(&owner, "job", "fabricated".into(), None, None)
        .await
        .is_err());
    assert_eq!(
        service
            .documents
            .read(&owner.document_id())
            .await
            .unwrap()
            .unwrap()
            .revision,
        state.generation_revision
    );
    assert_eq!(
        service
            .complete(&owner, "job", "actual".into(), None, None)
            .await
            .unwrap()
            .generation_jobs["job"]
            .status,
        GenerationStatus::Completed
    );
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn bounded_fragment_batch_is_one_revision_with_original_order_and_count() {
    let service = service();
    let owner = owner("batch-owner", "batch-session");
    service
        .create(&owner, &input(), "job", &"a".repeat(64))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    service
        .create(&owner, &input(), "sibling", &"a".repeat(64))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    let prior = service.running(&owner, "job").await.unwrap();
    let fragments = vec!["first".into(), "\n".into(), "λ".into()];
    prior.preflight_append_batch("job", &fragments).unwrap();
    let committed = service
        .append_batch(&owner, "job", fragments)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(committed.generation_revision, prior.generation_revision + 1);
    assert_eq!(
        committed.generation_jobs["job"].revision,
        prior.generation_jobs["job"].revision + 1
    );
    assert_eq!(committed.generation_jobs["job"].committed_chunks, 3);
    assert_eq!(committed.generation_jobs["job"].output, "first\nλ");
    assert_eq!(
        committed.generation_jobs["sibling"],
        prior.generation_jobs["sibling"]
    );
    let finished = service
        .complete(&owner, "job", "first\nλ".into(), None, None)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(finished.generation_jobs["job"].committed_chunks, 3);
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn invalid_batches_and_cancelled_jobs_leave_the_durable_revision_unchanged() {
    let service = service();
    let owner = owner("batch-owner", "batch-session");
    service
        .create(&owner, &input(), "job", &"a".repeat(64))
        .await
        .unwrap();
    let prior = service.running(&owner, "job").await.unwrap();
    for fragments in [
        vec![],
        vec![String::new()],
        vec!["x".repeat(MAX_CHUNK_BYTES + 1)],
        vec!["x".repeat(MAX_CHUNK_BYTES), "y".into()],
        vec!["x".into(); MAX_BATCH_FRAGMENTS + 1],
    ] {
        assert!(prior.preflight_append_batch("job", &fragments).is_err());
        assert!(service
            .append_batch(&owner, "job", fragments)
            .await
            .is_err());
    }
    assert_eq!(
        service
            .documents
            .read(&owner.document_id())
            .await
            .unwrap()
            .unwrap()
            .revision,
        prior.generation_revision
    );
    let mut frame_limited = prior.clone();
    frame_limited
        .generation_jobs
        .get_mut("job")
        .unwrap()
        .committed_chunks = MAX_FRAMES - 1;
    assert!(frame_limited
        .preflight_append_batch("job", &["one".into(), "two".into()])
        .is_err());
    let cancelled = service
        .request_cancel(&owner, "job", prior.generation_jobs["job"].revision)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert!(service
        .append_batch(&owner, "job", vec!["queued-before-cancel".into()])
        .await
        .is_err());
    assert_eq!(
        service
            .documents
            .read(&owner.document_id())
            .await
            .unwrap()
            .unwrap()
            .revision,
        cancelled.generation_revision
    );
}

<file path="op-plugins/src/state_plugins/tched_router_generation.rs">
//! The tched_router-owned private generation contract and durable transitions.
//! Native execution and SHM publication belong to MutationEngine. This module
//! never contacts a model, writes SHM, grants access, or stores a raw prompt.
use anyhow::{ensure, Context, Result};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use serde_json::Value;
use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
use std::{collections::BTreeMap, sync::Arc};

use super::super::{
    gemma_brain::workspace::UiAccessContext,
    plugin_scaffold_helpers::method_decl_from_schemars_with_output,
    runtime_documents::RuntimeDocuments,
};

pub const START_CAPABILITY: &str = "cap.software.tched-router.generation.start@v1";
pub const READ_CAPABILITY: &str = "cap.software.tched-router.generation.read@v1";
pub const CANCEL_CAPABILITY: &str = "cap.software.tched-router.generation.cancel@v1";
pub const DELETE_CAPABILITY: &str = "cap.software.tched-router.generation.delete@v1";
pub const RECOVER_CAPABILITY: &str = "cap.software.tched-router.generation.recover@v1";
pub const MAX_JOBS: usize = 32;
pub const MAX_ACTIVE_JOBS: usize = 4;
pub const MAX_PROMPT_BYTES: usize = 64 * 1024;
pub const MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES: usize = 256 * 1024;
/// Aggregate UTF-8 output retained across this owner's jobs. JSON can expand
/// one control byte to six bytes; 1 MiB output plus bounded job metadata fits
/// below the 9 MiB encoded document ceiling and existing stream frame budget.
pub const MAX_OWNER_OUTPUT_BYTES: usize = 1024 * 1024;
pub const MAX_CHUNK_BYTES: usize = 16 * 1024;
/// Opportunistic publication groups never exceed one fragment's byte limit.
/// Fragments retain their original ordering/count; the group is one durable
/// state transition, not a timer-buffered or unary response.
pub const MAX_BATCH_FRAGMENTS: usize = 64;
pub const MAX_FRAMES: u32 = 4096;
pub const MAX_DOCUMENT_BYTES: usize = 9 * 1024 * 1024;

#[derive(Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct StartGenerationInput {
    pub agent_alias: String,
    pub prompt: String,
}

impl StartGenerationInput {
    pub fn validate(&self) -> Result<()> {
        validate_id(&self.agent_alias)?;
        ensure!(
            !self.prompt.trim().is_empty() && self.prompt.len() <= MAX_PROMPT_BYTES,
            "generation prompt is empty or exceeds its bound"
        );
        Ok(())
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct GenerationJobInput {
    pub job_id: String,
}
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct GenerationRevisionInput {

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum GenerationStatus {
    Queued,
    Running,
    CancelRequested,
    Completed,
    Cancelled,
    Failed,
    Interrupted,
}
impl GenerationStatus {
    pub fn terminal(self) -> bool {
        matches!(
            self,
            Self::Completed | Self::Cancelled | Self::Failed | Self::Interrupted
        )
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum GenerationFailure {
    NativeError,
    NativeDisconnected,
    NativeAborted,
    ToolApprovalRequired,
    OutputLimit,
    Deadline,
    AdmissionWithdrawn,
    ProcessInterrupted,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
#[schemars(extend("x-opdbus-exact-json-schema" = true))]
pub struct GenerationJob {
    /// OP-DBUS job ID, never a fabricated native task ID.
    pub job_id: String,
    pub revision: u64,
    pub agent_alias: String,
    pub status: GenerationStatus,
    pub output: String,
    pub committed_chunks: u32,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub reported_provider: Option<String>,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub reported_model: Option<String>,
    pub prompt_digest: String,
    pub source_schema_hash: String,
    pub created_at: i64,
    pub updated_at: i64,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub failure: Option<GenerationFailure>,
}

#[derive(Clone)]
pub struct GenerationOwner {
    principal: String,
    session: String,
    selector: String,
}
impl GenerationOwner {
    /// Reuse the established length-prefixed principal/session selector. The
    /// generation directory and Cozo document prefix separate domain storage;
    /// constructing this value itself does not authenticate either identifier.
    pub fn new(principal: String, session: String) -> Result<Self> {
        let key = UiAccessContext {
            principal_id: principal.clone(),
            session_id: session.clone(),
            session_genesis: None,
        }
        .owner_key()?;
        Ok(Self {
            principal,
            session,
            selector: key.namespace_component().to_owned(),
        })
    }
    pub fn selector(&self) -> &str {
        &self.selector
    }
    /// Opaque document selector for trusted owner recovery/inspection. This is
    /// not an authorization credential and contains no raw principal/session.
    pub fn document_id(&self) -> String {
        format!("tched_generation:v1:{}", self.selector)
    }
}

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
struct StoredGenerations {
    format_version: u32,
    principal: String,
    session: String,
    jobs: BTreeMap<String, GenerationJob>,
}
impl StoredGenerations {
    fn empty(owner: &GenerationOwner) -> Self {
        Self {
            format_version: 1,
            principal: owner.principal.clone(),
            session: owner.session.clone(),
            jobs: BTreeMap::new(),
        }
    }
    fn decode(owner: &GenerationOwner, value: Value) -> Result<Self> {
        ensure!(
            serde_json::to_vec(&value)?.len() <= MAX_DOCUMENT_BYTES,
            "generation document exceeds its bound"
        );
        let stored: Self = serde_json::from_value(value)
            .map_err(|_| anyhow::anyhow!("invalid durable generation document"))?;
        ensure!(
            stored.format_version == 1
                && stored.principal == owner.principal
                && stored.session == owner.session,
            "generation document owner or format mismatch"
        );
        validate_jobs(&stored.jobs)?;
        Ok(stored)
    }
}

impl GenerationState {
    /// Pure preflight before the publisher enters its durable pending gate.
    /// The durable transition independently enforces the same aggregate bound.
    pub fn preflight_append(&self, id: &str, chunk: &str) -> Result<()> {
        self.preflight_append_batch(id, &[chunk.to_owned()])
    }

    pub fn preflight_append_batch(&self, id: &str, fragments: &[String]) -> Result<()> {
        let (bytes, count) = fragment_batch_size(fragments)?;
        validate_jobs(&self.generation_jobs)?;
        let job = self
            .generation_jobs
            .get(id)
            .context("generation job is absent")?;
        ensure!(
            job.status == GenerationStatus::Running
                && job
                    .committed_chunks
                    .checked_add(count)
                    .is_some_and(|total| total <= MAX_FRAMES),
            "generation chunk cannot be appended"
        );
        ensure!(
            job.output
                .len()
                .checked_add(bytes)
                .is_some_and(|size| size <= MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES)
                && output_bytes(&self.generation_jobs)?
                    .checked_add(bytes)
                    .is_some_and(|size| size <= MAX_OWNER_OUTPUT_BYTES),
            "generation owner or job output limit reached"
        );
        Ok(())
    }
    pub fn from_plugin_state(value: &Value) -> Result<Self> {
        ensure!(
            serde_json::to_vec(value)?.len() <= MAX_DOCUMENT_BYTES,
            "generation projection exceeds its bound"
        );
        let state: Self = serde_json::from_value(value.clone())
            .map_err(|_| anyhow::anyhow!("invalid generation projection"))?;
        ensure!(
            state.generation_revision > 0,
            "generation document revision is absent"
        );
        validate_jobs(&state.generation_jobs)?;
        Ok(state)
    }
    pub fn plugin_state(&self) -> Result<Value> {
        Ok(serde_json::to_value(self)?)
    }
}

fn fragment_batch_size(fragments: &[String]) -> Result<(usize, u32)> {
    ensure!(
        !fragments.is_empty() && fragments.len() <= MAX_BATCH_FRAGMENTS,
        "generation fragment batch count exceeds its bound"
    );
    let bytes = fragments.iter().try_fold(0usize, |sum, fragment| {
        ensure!(
            !fragment.is_empty() && fragment.len() <= MAX_CHUNK_BYTES,
            "native generation fragment exceeds its bound"
        );
        sum.checked_add(fragment.len())
            .context("generation fragment batch size overflow")
    })?;
    ensure!(
        bytes <= MAX_CHUNK_BYTES,
        "generation fragment batch exceeds its byte bound"
    );
    Ok((
        bytes,
        u32::try_from(fragments.len()).context("generation fragment count overflow")?,
    ))
}

fn output_bytes(jobs: &BTreeMap<String, GenerationJob>) -> Result<usize> {
    jobs.values().try_fold(0usize, |sum, job| {
        sum.checked_add(job.output.len())
            .context("generation output size overflow")
    })
}
fn validate_jobs(jobs: &BTreeMap<String, GenerationJob>) -> Result<()> {
    ensure!(jobs.len() <= MAX_JOBS, "generation job capacity exceeded");
    ensure!(
        output_bytes(jobs)? <= MAX_OWNER_OUTPUT_BYTES,
        "generation owner output limit reached"
    );
    ensure!(
        jobs.values().filter(|job| !job.status.terminal()).count() <= MAX_ACTIVE_JOBS,
        "active generation job capacity exceeded"
    );
    for (id, job) in jobs {
        validate_id(id)?;
        validate_id(&job.agent_alias)?;
        ensure!(
            id == &job.job_id
                && job.revision > 0
                && job.committed_chunks <= MAX_FRAMES
                && job.output.len() <= MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES,
            "invalid generation job bounds or identity"
        );
        for hash in [&job.prompt_digest, &job.source_schema_hash] {
            ensure!(
                hash.len() == 64 && hash.bytes().all(|b| b.is_ascii_hexdigit()),
                "invalid generation provenance"
            );
        }
        ensure!(
            job.created_at >= 0 && job.updated_at >= job.created_at,
            "invalid generation timestamps"
        );
        for label in [&job.reported_provider, &job.reported_model]
            .into_iter()
            .flatten()
        {
            ensure!(
                !label.is_empty() && label.len() <= 256,
                "invalid generation attribution"
            );
        }
        ensure!(
            matches!(
                job.status,
                GenerationStatus::Failed | GenerationStatus::Interrupted
            ) == job.failure.is_some(),
            "generation terminal reason does not match status"
        );
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub fn validate_id(value: &str) -> Result<()> {
    ensure!(
        !value.is_empty()
            && value.len() <= 128
            && value
                .bytes()
                .all(|b| b.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || matches!(b, b'-' | b'_')),
        "invalid generation identifier"
    );
    Ok(())
}
fn now() -> Result<i64> {
    let value = chrono::Utc::now().timestamp();
    ensure!(value >= 0, "generation clock predates epoch");
    Ok(value)
}
fn advance(job: &mut GenerationJob) -> Result<()> {
    job.revision = job
        .revision
        .checked_add(1)
        .context("generation job revision overflow")?;
    job.updated_at = now()?.max(job.updated_at);
    Ok(())
}

#[derive(Clone)]
pub struct GenerationMethods {
    documents: Arc<RuntimeDocuments>,
}
impl GenerationMethods {
    pub fn new(documents: Arc<RuntimeDocuments>) -> Self {
        Self { documents }
    }

    pub async fn recover(&self, owner: &GenerationOwner) -> Result<Option<GenerationState>> {
        let Some(row) = self.documents.read_durable(&owner.document_id()).await? else {
            return Ok(None);
        };
        let stored = StoredGenerations::decode(owner, row.document)?;
        if stored.jobs.values().all(|job| job.status.terminal()) {
            return Ok(Some(GenerationState {
                generation_revision: row.revision,
                generation_jobs: stored.jobs,
            }));
        }
        let recovered = self
            .update(owner, Some(row.revision), |stored| {
                for job in stored
                    .jobs
                    .values_mut()
                    .filter(|job| !job.status.terminal())
                {
                    job.status = GenerationStatus::Interrupted;
                    job.failure = Some(GenerationFailure::ProcessInterrupted);
                    advance(job)?;
                }
                Ok(())
            })
            .await?;
        Ok(Some(recovered))
    }

    pub async fn create(
        &self,
        owner: &GenerationOwner,
        input: &StartGenerationInput,
        id: &str,
        schema_hash: &str,
    ) -> Result<GenerationState> {
        input.validate()?;
        validate_id(id)?;
        ensure!(
            schema_hash.len() == 64 && schema_hash.bytes().all(|b| b.is_ascii_hexdigit()),
            "invalid generation schema pin"
        );
        let timestamp = now()?;
        let job = GenerationJob {
            job_id: id.to_owned(),
            revision: 1,
            agent_alias: input.agent_alias.clone(),
            status: GenerationStatus::Queued,
            output: String::new(),
            committed_chunks: 0,
            reported_provider: None,
            reported_model: None,
            prompt_digest: format!("{:x}", Sha256::digest(input.prompt.as_bytes())),
            source_schema_hash: schema_hash.to_owned(),
            created_at: timestamp,
            updated_at: timestamp,
            failure: None,
        };
        self.update(owner, None, move |stored| {
            ensure!(
                !stored.jobs.contains_key(&job.job_id),
                "generation job already exists"
            );
            ensure!(
                stored.jobs.len() < MAX_JOBS,
                "generation job capacity reached; delete a terminal job"
            );
            stored.jobs.insert(job.job_id.clone(), job);
            Ok(())
        })
        .await
    }

    pub async fn running(&self, owner: &GenerationOwner, id: &str) -> Result<GenerationState> {
        self.change_job(owner, id, None, |job| {
            ensure!(
                job.status == GenerationStatus::Queued,
                "generation job is not queued"
            );
            job.status = GenerationStatus::Running;
            advance(job)
        })
        .await
    }

    pub async fn append(
        &self,
        owner: &GenerationOwner,
        id: &str,
        chunk: String,
    ) -> Result<GenerationState> {
        self.append_batch(owner, id, vec![chunk]).await
    }

    /// One durable revision preserves all original nonempty fragment counts.
    pub async fn append_batch(
        &self,
        owner: &GenerationOwner,
        id: &str,
        fragments: Vec<String>,
    ) -> Result<GenerationState> {
        let (bytes, count) = fragment_batch_size(&fragments)?;
        self.change_job(owner, id, None, move |job| {
            ensure!(
                job.status == GenerationStatus::Running,
                "generation job is not running"
            );
            ensure!(
                job.committed_chunks
                    .checked_add(count)
                    .is_some_and(|total| total <= MAX_FRAMES)
                    && job
                        .output
                        .len()
                        .checked_add(bytes)
                        .is_some_and(|size| size <= MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES),
                "generation output limit reached"
            );
            for fragment in fragments {
                job.output.push_str(&fragment);
            }
            job.committed_chunks = job
                .committed_chunks
                .checked_add(count)
                .context("generation committed fragment count overflow")?;
            advance(job)
        })
        .await
    }

    pub async fn request_cancel(
        &self,
        owner: &GenerationOwner,
        id: &str,
        expected: u64,
    ) -> Result<GenerationState> {
        self.change_job(owner, id, Some(expected), |job| {
            ensure!(!job.status.terminal(), "generation job is already terminal");
            job.status = GenerationStatus::CancelRequested;
            advance(job)
        })
        .await
    }

    /// The admitted stateless protocol guarantees final text equals its deltas.
    /// Completion cannot replace committed output with a buffered unary result.
    pub async fn complete(
        &self,
        owner: &GenerationOwner,
        id: &str,
        output: String,
        provider: Option<String>,
        model: Option<String>,
    ) -> Result<GenerationState> {
        ensure!(
            output.len() <= MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES,
            "generation final output exceeds its bound"
        );
        self.change_job(owner, id, None, move |job| {
            ensure!(
                job.status == GenerationStatus::Running,
                "generation is not running"
            );
            ensure!(
                job.output == output,
                "native completion differs from committed deltas"
            );
            job.reported_provider = provider;
            job.reported_model = model;
            job.status = GenerationStatus::Completed;
            job.failure = None;
            advance(job)
        })
        .await
    }

    pub async fn finish(
        &self,
        owner: &GenerationOwner,
        id: &str,
        status: GenerationStatus,
        reason: Option<GenerationFailure>,
    ) -> Result<GenerationState> {
        ensure!(
            status.terminal(),
            "generation completion status is not terminal"
        );
        self.change_job(owner, id, None, move |job| {
            ensure!(!job.status.terminal(), "generation job is already terminal");
            ensure!(
                status != GenerationStatus::Completed || job.status == GenerationStatus::Running,
                "generation completion is not valid after cancellation"
            );
            job.status = status;
            job.failure = reason;
            advance(job)
        })
        .await
    }

    pub async fn delete(
        &self,
        owner: &GenerationOwner,
        id: &str,
        expected: u64,
    ) -> Result<GenerationState> {
        validate_id(id)?;
        let id = id.to_owned();
        self.update(owner, None, move |stored| {
            let job = stored.jobs.get(&id).context("generation job is absent")?;
            ensure!(
                job.revision == expected && expected > 0,
                "generation job revision conflict"
            );
            ensure!(
                job.status.terminal(),
                "active generation job cannot be deleted"
            );
            stored.jobs.remove(&id);
            Ok(())
        })
        .await
    }

    async fn change_job<F>(
        &self,
        owner: &GenerationOwner,
        id: &str,
        expected: Option<u64>,
        change: F,
    ) -> Result<GenerationState>
    where
        F: FnOnce(&mut GenerationJob) -> Result<()> + Send + 'static,
    {
        validate_id(id)?;
        let id = id.to_owned();
        self.update(owner, None, move |stored| {
            let job = stored
                .jobs
                .get_mut(&id)
                .context("generation job is absent")?;
            if let Some(expected) = expected {
                ensure!(
                    expected > 0 && expected == job.revision,
                    "generation job revision conflict"
                );
            }
            change(job)
        })
        .await
    }

    async fn update<F>(
        &self,
        owner: &GenerationOwner,
        revision: Option<u64>,
        change: F,
    ) -> Result<GenerationState>
    where
        F: FnOnce(&mut StoredGenerations) -> Result<()> + Send + 'static,
    {
        let id = owner.document_id();
        let owner = owner.clone();
        let update = move |previous| {
            let mut stored = match previous {
                Some(value) => StoredGenerations::decode(&owner, value)?,
                None => StoredGenerations::empty(&owner),
            };
            change(&mut stored)?;
            validate_jobs(&stored.jobs)?;
            let value = serde_json::to_value(&stored)?;
            ensure!(
                serde_json::to_vec(&value)?.len() <= MAX_DOCUMENT_BYTES,
                "generation document exceeds its bound"
            );
            Ok((value, stored.jobs))
        };
        let (row, jobs) = if let Some(revision) = revision {
            self.documents
                .update_at_revision_with_result(&id, revision, update)
                .await?
        } else {
            self.documents.update_with_result(&id, update).await?
        };
        Ok(GenerationState {
            generation_revision: row.revision,
            generation_jobs: jobs,
        })
    }
}

/// Classify the compiled execution path from these declarations. Runtime
/// existence and admission still come from the caller's pinned sealed plugin.
pub fn is_method(method: &str) -> bool {
    static METHODS: std::sync::LazyLock<std::collections::BTreeSet<String>> =
        std::sync::LazyLock::new(|| {
            let mut schema = op_state_store::PluginSchema::builder("tched_router").build();
            declare_methods(&mut schema);
            schema.methods.into_keys().collect()
        });
    METHODS.contains(method)
}

pub fn declare_methods(schema: &mut op_state_store::PluginSchema) {
    use op_state_store::{CapabilityDecl, SideEffect};
    macro_rules! declare {
        ($name:literal, $input:ty, $output:ty, $side:ident, $cap:ident, $subid:literal) => {
            schema.methods.insert(
                $name.into(),
                method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<$input, $output>(
                    $name,
                    SideEffect::$side,
                    false,
                    $cap,
                    $subid,
                ),
            );
        };
    }
    declare!(
        "start_generation",
        StartGenerationInput,
        GenerationMutationOutput,
        Mutation,
        START_CAPABILITY,
        "mut.service.tched-router.generation.start@v1"
    );
    declare!(
        "get_generation_job",
        GenerationJobInput,
        GenerationJobOutput,
        Read,
        READ_CAPABILITY,
        "obs.service.tched-router.generation.get@v1"
    );
    declare!(
        "get_generation_jobs",
        GenerationEmptyInput,
        GenerationWorkspaceOutput,
        Read,
        READ_CAPABILITY,
        "obs.service.tched-router.generation.list@v1"
    );
    declare!(
        "cancel_generation",
        GenerationRevisionInput,
        GenerationMutationOutput,
        Mutation,
        CANCEL_CAPABILITY,
        "mut.service.tched-router.generation.cancel@v1"
    );
    declare!(
        "delete_generation_job",
        GenerationRevisionInput,
        GenerationDeleteOutput,
        Mutation,
        DELETE_CAPABILITY,
        "mut.service.tched-router.generation.delete@v1"
    );
    declare!(
        "recover_generation_jobs",
        GenerationEmptyInput,
        GenerationWorkspaceOutput,
        Mutation,
        RECOVER_CAPABILITY,
        "mut.service.tched-router.generation.recover@v1"
    );
    for (id, description) in [
        (START_CAPABILITY,"Start native generation for this verified principal and session"),
        (READ_CAPABILITY,"Read this verified principal and session's private generation jobs"),
        (CANCEL_CAPABILITY,"Request cancellation of this verified principal and session's generation job"),
        (DELETE_CAPABILITY,"Delete a terminal generation job owned by this principal and session"),
        (RECOVER_CAPABILITY,"Recover this principal and session's durable generation jobs without replaying prompts"),
    ] { schema.capabilities.insert(id.into(), CapabilityDecl { id:id.into(), description:description.into() }); }
    for method in ["get_generation_job", "get_generation_jobs"] {
        schema.methods.get_mut(method).unwrap().idempotent = true;
    }
}

<file path="op-plugins/src/state_plugins/tched_router_legacy_methods_tests.rs">
use super::*;
use crate::state_plugins::common::llm_projection::{ModelRoute, Provider};
use op_cozo_store::CozoGraphShuttle;

fn provider(id: &str) -> Provider {
    Provider {
        id: id.into(),
        ..Default::default()
    }
}

fn route(hint: &str, provider: &str, model: &str) -> ModelRoute {
    ModelRoute {
        hint: hint.into(),
        provider: provider.into(),
        model: model.into(),
        available: true,
        status: "available".into(),
        ..Default::default()
    }
}

fn observed() -> ObservedTchedRouterState {
    ObservedTchedRouterState {
        status: "ready".into(),
        selected_provider: "p1".into(),
        selected_model: "m1".into(),
        providers: vec![provider("p1"), provider("p2")],
        model_routes: vec![route("fast", "p1", "m1"), route("reason", "p2", "m2")],
    }
}

fn methods() -> TchedRouterLegacyMethods {
    TchedRouterLegacyMethods::new(Arc::new(RuntimeDocuments::new(
        CozoGraphShuttle::new_in_memory().unwrap(),
    )))
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn runtime_reads_and_state_use_the_same_observation() {
    let methods = methods();
    let view = methods
        .observe("GetModelRoutes", &json!({}), &observed())
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        view.output["model_routes"],
        view.represented_state["model_routes"]
    );
    let resolved = methods
        .observe("ResolveRoute", &json!({"hint":"reason"}), &observed())
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(
        resolved.output["route"],
        serde_json::to_value(&observed().model_routes[1]).unwrap()
    );
    let by_model = methods
        .observe("ResolveRoute", &json!({"hint":"m1"}), &observed())
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(by_model.output["route"]["hint"], "fast");
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn assignments_preserve_siblings_and_are_durable_receipts() {
    let methods = methods();
    let (first, _) = methods
        .assign(ModelRole::OvsRouting, "m1", &observed())
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(first.document_revision, 1);
    assert!(first.changed);
    let (second, state) = methods
        .assign(ModelRole::Obfuscation, "m2", &observed())
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(second.document_revision, 2);
    assert_eq!(second.model_assignments.ovs_routing.as_deref(), Some("m1"));
    assert_eq!(second.model_assignments.obfuscation.as_deref(), Some("m2"));
    assert_eq!(
        state["model_assignments"],
        serde_json::to_value(&second.model_assignments).unwrap()
    );
    let (same, _) = methods
        .assign(ModelRole::Obfuscation, "m2", &observed())
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(same.document_revision, 3);
    assert!(!same.changed);
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn every_declared_role_updates_only_its_owned_field() {
    let methods = methods();
    for (role, model) in [
        (ModelRole::OvsRouting, "m1"),
        (ModelRole::Obfuscation, "m2"),
        (ModelRole::Vectorization, "m1"),
        (ModelRole::QdrantRetrieval, "m2"),
        (ModelRole::CozoRetrieval, "m1"),
    ] {
        let (receipt, _) = methods.assign(role, model, &observed()).await.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(receipt.role, role.field());
        assert_eq!(receipt.model_id, model);
    }
    let (_, all) = methods.assignments().await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(all.ovs_routing.as_deref(), Some("m1"));
    assert_eq!(all.obfuscation.as_deref(), Some("m2"));
    assert_eq!(all.vectorization.as_deref(), Some("m1"));
    assert_eq!(all.qdrant_retrieval.as_deref(), Some("m2"));
    assert_eq!(all.cozo_retrieval.as_deref(), Some("m1"));
}

#[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread")]
async fn concurrent_role_writes_preserve_siblings() {
    let methods = Arc::new(methods());
    let mut writes = tokio::task::JoinSet::new();
    for (role, model) in [
        (ModelRole::OvsRouting, "m1"),
        (ModelRole::Obfuscation, "m2"),
        (ModelRole::Vectorization, "m1"),
        (ModelRole::QdrantRetrieval, "m2"),
        (ModelRole::CozoRetrieval, "m1"),
    ] {
        let methods = methods.clone();
        writes.spawn(async move { methods.assign(role, model, &observed()).await });
    }
    while let Some(write) = writes.join_next().await {
        write.unwrap().unwrap();
    }
    let (_, all) = methods.assignments().await.unwrap();
    assert!(all.ovs_routing.is_some());
    assert!(all.obfuscation.is_some());
    assert!(all.vectorization.is_some());
    assert!(all.qdrant_retrieval.is_some());
    assert!(all.cozo_retrieval.is_some());
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn malformed_or_ambiguous_inputs_fail_before_durable_write() {
    let methods = methods();
    assert!(methods
        .assign(ModelRole::OvsRouting, "missing", &observed())
        .await
        .is_err());
    assert!(methods
        .observe(
            "ResolveRoute",
            &json!({"hint":"fast","extra":1}),
            &observed()
        )
        .await
        .is_err());
    let mut ambiguous = observed();
    ambiguous.model_routes.push(route("other", "p2", "m1"));
    assert!(methods
        .assign(ModelRole::OvsRouting, "m1", &ambiguous)
        .await
        .is_err());
    assert_eq!(methods.assignments().await.unwrap().0, 0);
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn partial_assignment_document_does_not_invent_defaults() {
    let methods = methods();
    let (_, assignments) = methods.assignments().await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(serde_json::to_value(assignments).unwrap(), json!({}));
    let (_, state) = methods
        .assign(ModelRole::Vectorization, "m2", &observed())
        .await
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(state["model_assignments"], json!({"vectorization":"m2"}));
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn assignments_survive_durable_reopen() {
    let directory = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
    let path = directory.path().join("cozo");
    {
        let methods = TchedRouterLegacyMethods::new(Arc::new(RuntimeDocuments::new(
            CozoGraphShuttle::new_persistent(path.clone()).unwrap(),
        )));
        methods
            .assign(ModelRole::QdrantRetrieval, "m2", &observed())
            .await
            .unwrap();
    }
    let reopened = TchedRouterLegacyMethods::new(Arc::new(RuntimeDocuments::new(
        CozoGraphShuttle::new_persistent(path).unwrap(),
    )));
    let (revision, assignments) = reopened.assignments().await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(revision, 1);
    assert_eq!(assignments.qdrant_retrieval.as_deref(), Some("m2"));
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn duplicate_hint_is_rejected_instead_of_first_match_wins() {
    let methods = methods();
    let mut ambiguous = observed();
    ambiguous.model_routes.push(route("fast", "p2", "m2"));
    let error = methods
        .observe("ResolveRoute", &json!({"hint":"fast"}), &ambiguous)
        .await
        .unwrap_err();
    assert!(error.to_string().contains("ambiguous"));
}

<file path="op-plugins/src/state_plugins/tched_router_legacy_methods.rs">
//! Native-observation and durable role-assignment methods for the retained
//! tched_router surface. This module owns no provider/config/schema authority.

use super::runtime_documents::{RuntimeDocument, RuntimeDocuments};
use super::tched_router::{ObservedTchedRouterState, ResolveRouteInput};
use anyhow::{Context, Result};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use serde_json::{json, Value};
use std::{collections::BTreeSet, sync::Arc};

const ASSIGNMENTS_DOCUMENT_ID: &str = "tched_router.model_assignments";
const MAX_MODEL_ID_BYTES: usize = 256;
const MAX_HINT_BYTES: usize = 128;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum ModelRole {
    OvsRouting,
    Obfuscation,
    Vectorization,
    QdrantRetrieval,
    CozoRetrieval,
}

impl ModelRole {
    pub fn method(self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            Self::OvsRouting => "SetOvsRoutingModel",
            Self::Obfuscation => "SetObfuscationModel",
            Self::Vectorization => "SetVectorizationModel",
            Self::QdrantRetrieval => "SetQdrantRetrievalModel",
            Self::CozoRetrieval => "SetCozoRetrievalModel",
        }
    }

    fn field(self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            Self::OvsRouting => "ovs_routing",
            Self::Obfuscation => "obfuscation",
            Self::Vectorization => "vectorization",
            Self::QdrantRetrieval => "qdrant_retrieval",
            Self::CozoRetrieval => "cozo_retrieval",
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq, Default)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct DurableModelAssignments {
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub ovs_routing: Option<String>,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub obfuscation: Option<String>,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub vectorization: Option<String>,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub qdrant_retrieval: Option<String>,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub cozo_retrieval: Option<String>,
}

impl DurableModelAssignments {
    fn set(&mut self, role: ModelRole, model: String) -> bool {
        let slot = match role {
            ModelRole::OvsRouting => &mut self.ovs_routing,
            ModelRole::Obfuscation => &mut self.obfuscation,
            ModelRole::Vectorization => &mut self.vectorization,
            ModelRole::QdrantRetrieval => &mut self.qdrant_retrieval,
            ModelRole::CozoRetrieval => &mut self.cozo_retrieval,
        };
        if slot.as_deref() == Some(model.as_str()) {
            false
        } else {
            *slot = Some(model);
            true
        }
    }

    fn get(&self, role: ModelRole) -> Option<&str> {
        match role {
            ModelRole::OvsRouting => self.ovs_routing.as_deref(),
            ModelRole::Obfuscation => self.obfuscation.as_deref(),
            ModelRole::Vectorization => self.vectorization.as_deref(),
            ModelRole::QdrantRetrieval => self.qdrant_retrieval.as_deref(),
            ModelRole::CozoRetrieval => self.cozo_retrieval.as_deref(),
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, PartialEq)]
pub struct RoleAssignmentReceipt {
    pub role: &'static str,
    pub model_id: String,
    pub model_assignments: DurableModelAssignments,
    pub document_revision: u64,
    pub changed: bool,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub struct LegacyObservation {
    pub output: Value,
    /// Complete set of fields this adapter can prove in one observation.
    pub represented_state: Value,
}

pub struct TchedRouterLegacyMethods {
    documents: Arc<RuntimeDocuments>,
}

impl TchedRouterLegacyMethods {
    pub fn new(documents: Arc<RuntimeDocuments>) -> Self {
        Self { documents }
    }

    pub async fn assignments(&self) -> Result<(u64, DurableModelAssignments)> {
        match self.documents.read_durable(ASSIGNMENTS_DOCUMENT_ID).await? {
            None => Ok((0, DurableModelAssignments::default())),
            Some(row) => parse_document(row),
        }
    }

    pub async fn observe(
        &self,
        method: &str,
        args: &Value,
        observed: &ObservedTchedRouterState,
    ) -> Result<LegacyObservation> {
        validate_observation(observed)?;
        let (_, assignments) = self.assignments().await?;
        let represented_state = represented_state(observed, &assignments)?;
        let output = match method {
            "GetModelRoutes" => json!({"model_routes": observed.model_routes.clone()}),
            "GetProviderCatalog" => json!({"providers": observed.providers.clone()}),
            "ResolveRoute" => {
                let input: ResolveRouteInput =
                    serde_json::from_value(args.clone()).context("invalid ResolveRoute input")?;
                let hint = bounded_nonempty("hint", &input.hint, MAX_HINT_BYTES)?;
                let matches = observed
                    .model_routes
                    .iter()
                    .filter(|route| route.hint == hint || route.model == hint)
                    .collect::<Vec<_>>();
                anyhow::ensure!(
                    !matches.is_empty(),
                    "route hint is not declared by the native runtime"
                );
                anyhow::ensure!(
                    matches.len() == 1,
                    "route hint is ambiguous in the native runtime catalog"
                );
                json!({"route": matches[0]})
            }
            _ => anyhow::bail!("unsupported retained runtime read: {method}"),
        };
        Ok(LegacyObservation {
            output,
            represented_state,
        })
    }

    /// Commit one assignment with RuntimeDocuments CAS. The caller must hold
    /// the process-wide tched runtime selection guard across native catalog
    /// observation, this commit, readback and SHM publication.
    pub async fn assign(
        &self,
        role: ModelRole,
        model_id: &str,
        observed: &ObservedTchedRouterState,
    ) -> Result<(RoleAssignmentReceipt, Value)> {
        validate_observation(observed)?;
        let model_id = bounded_nonempty("model_id", model_id, MAX_MODEL_ID_BYTES)?.to_owned();
        let bindings = observed
            .model_routes
            .iter()
            .filter(|route| route.model == model_id)
            .map(|route| (route.provider.as_str(), route.model.as_str()))
            .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
        anyhow::ensure!(
            !bindings.is_empty(),
            "model_id is absent from the native runtime catalog"
        );
        anyhow::ensure!(
            bindings.len() == 1,
            "model_id is ambiguous across native providers"
        );

        let role_copy = role;
        let model_for_commit = model_id.clone();
        let (row, changed) = self
            .documents
            .update_with_result(ASSIGNMENTS_DOCUMENT_ID, move |old| {
                let mut assignments = match old {
                    None => DurableModelAssignments::default(),
                    Some(value) => serde_json::from_value(value)
                        .context("stored tched_router model assignments are malformed")?,
                };
                let changed = assignments.set(role_copy, model_for_commit);
                Ok((serde_json::to_value(assignments)?, changed))
            })
            .await?;
        let (revision, assignments) = parse_document(row)?;
        let committed_model = assignments
            .get(role)
            .context("committed assignment row omitted the requested role")?
            .to_owned();
        let receipt = RoleAssignmentReceipt {
            role: role.field(),
            model_id: committed_model,
            model_assignments: assignments.clone(),
            document_revision: revision,
            changed,
        };
        Ok((receipt, represented_state(observed, &assignments)?))
    }
}

fn parse_document(row: RuntimeDocument) -> Result<(u64, DurableModelAssignments)> {
    let assignments = serde_json::from_value(row.document)
        .context("stored tched_router model assignments are malformed")?;
    Ok((row.revision, assignments))
}

fn bounded_nonempty<'a>(field: &str, value: &'a str, max: usize) -> Result<&'a str> {
    let value = value.trim();
    anyhow::ensure!(!value.is_empty(), "{field} must not be empty");
    anyhow::ensure!(value.len() <= max, "{field} exceeds {max} bytes");
    anyhow::ensure!(
        !value.chars().any(char::is_control),
        "{field} contains control characters"
    );
    Ok(value)
}

fn validate_observation(observed: &ObservedTchedRouterState) -> Result<()> {
    anyhow::ensure!(
        !observed.providers.is_empty(),
        "native provider catalog is empty"
    );
    let mut provider_ids = BTreeSet::new();
    for provider in &observed.providers {
        anyhow::ensure!(
            !provider.id.trim().is_empty() && provider_ids.insert(provider.id.as_str()),
            "native provider catalog contains an empty or duplicate provider id"
        );
    }
    let mut routes = BTreeSet::new();
    for route in &observed.model_routes {
        anyhow::ensure!(
            !route.hint.trim().is_empty()
                && !route.model.trim().is_empty()
                && provider_ids.contains(route.provider.as_str())
                && routes.insert((
                    route.hint.as_str(),
                    route.provider.as_str(),
                    route.model.as_str()
                )),
            "native model route is empty, duplicated, or references an unknown provider"
        );
    }
    anyhow::ensure!(
        provider_ids.contains(observed.selected_provider.as_str()),
        "selected provider is absent from native catalog"
    );
    anyhow::ensure!(
        observed
            .model_routes
            .iter()
            .any(|route| route.provider == observed.selected_provider
                && route.model == observed.selected_model),
        "selected model binding is absent from native catalog"
    );
    Ok(())
}

pub fn represented_state(
    observed: &ObservedTchedRouterState,
    assignments: &DurableModelAssignments,
) -> Result<Value> {
    Ok(json!({
        "status": observed.status.clone(),
        "selected_provider": observed.selected_provider.clone(),
        "selected_model": observed.selected_model.clone(),
        "providers": observed.providers.clone(),
        "model_routes": observed.model_routes.clone(),
        "model_assignments": assignments,
    }))
}

mod tests;

//! 3tched Router route surface plugin — GB.3tched Router.
//!
//! Publishes the Antigravity-facing model and CLI routing contract through
//! `PluginSchema` so the UI can render provider/model controls from D-Bus.

#[path = "tched_router_generation.rs"]
pub mod generation;

use super::common::errors::TchedRouterError;
use super::common::llm_projection::{
    ConfigSchema, LlmProjection, LlmTool, ModelRoute, Provider, Router, StructuredOutput, UiSurface,
};
use super::plugin_scaffold_helpers::method_decl_from_schemars_with_output;
use anyhow::Result;
use async_trait::async_trait;
use op_state::{ApplyResult, Checkpoint, DiffMetadata, PluginCapabilities, StateDiff, StatePlugin};
use op_state_store::PluginSchema;
use op_state_store::{CapabilityDecl, SideEffect};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use serde_json::Value as JsonValue;
use simd_json::OwnedValue as Value;

// =============================================================================
// PLUGIN ENTRY: identity and typed schema seed
// =============================================================================

const PLUGIN_NAME: &str = "tched_router";
const PLUGIN_VERSION: &str = "4.1.0";
const PLUGIN_CATEGORY: &str = "llm";
const PLUGIN_DESCRIPTION: &str = "3tched Router — schema/RPC-native model router for Antigravity UI, CLI providers, and structured JSON output";
const PLUGIN_DISPLAY_NAME: &str = "GB.3tchedRouter";

/// Existing native gateway wire bounds, shared with exact episode persistence.
pub const MAX_CHAT_REQUEST_BYTES: usize = 1024 * 1024;
pub const MAX_CHAT_RESPONSE_BYTES: usize = 8 * 1024 * 1024;

/// Transport layer metadata for the 3tched Router plugin.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "sch.software.3tched-router-transport.schema@v1"))]
pub struct LlmTransport {
    /// D-Bus object path served by this plugin.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "mut.service.3tched-router-transport.dbus-object@v1"))]
    pub dbus_object: String,
    /// gRPC upstream target.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "mut.service.3tched-router-transport.grpc-target@v1"))]
    pub grpc_target: String,
    /// Incus / WireGuard container target for xray routing. Kept as a
    /// published-schema field for backward compatibility, but zeroclaw's LLM
    /// transport now runs on the host (xray through its runit-managed service and
    /// the gRPC-bridge via `op-grpc-bridge-zeroclaw`); there is no per-service
    /// incus container. Defaults to the `"host"` sentinel.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "mut.service.3tched-router-transport.incus-container@v1"))]
    pub incus_container: String,
    /// Browser-facing surface description.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "exp.service.3tched-router-transport.browser-surface@v1"))]
    pub browser_surface: String,
    /// REST aliases exposed by the bridge.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "exp.service.3tched-router-transport.rest-aliases@v1"))]
    pub rest_aliases: Vec<String>,
    /// Canonical OSCAL/subid mapping authority.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "src.service.3tched-router-transport.policy-source@v1"))]
    pub policy_source: String,
}

/// Magic-link and WireGuard registration service schema.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "sch.service.3tched-router-options.registration-service.schema@v1"))]

    /// RPC methods exposed by the registration service.

/// Runtime fields observed together from the native tched_router backend.
///
/// Configuration-only fields in [`TchedRouterState`] are deliberately absent:
/// a runtime observation cannot prove their values, and a fresh read must not
/// substitute the plugin schema's example/default state.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
#[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "obs.service.3tched-router.runtime-state@v2"))]
pub struct ObservedTchedRouterState {
    pub status: String,
    pub selected_provider: String,
    pub selected_model: String,
    pub providers: Vec<Provider>,
    pub model_routes: Vec<ModelRoute>,
}

impl From<&TchedRouterState> for ObservedTchedRouterState {
    fn from(state: &TchedRouterState) -> Self {
        Self {
            status: state.status.clone(),
            selected_provider: state.selected_provider.clone(),
            selected_model: state.selected_model.clone(),
            providers: state.catalog.providers.clone(),
            model_routes: state.catalog.model_routes.clone(),
        }
    }
}
