#[async_trait]
impl StatePlugin for TchedRouterPlugin {
    fn name(&self) -> &str {
        PLUGIN_NAME
    }

    fn version(&self) -> &str {
        PLUGIN_VERSION
    }

    fn schema(&self) -> Option<PluginSchema> {
        let mut schema = tched_router_schema();
        super::common::llm_projection::rewrite_projection_subids_for_plugin(
            &mut schema,
            "3tched-router",
        );
        super::common::oscal::ensure_category_metadata_fields(&mut schema);
        Some(schema)
    }

    async fn schema_live(&self) -> Option<PluginSchema> {
        // No live probes — there is no projection, only declared state.
        self.schema()
    }

    async fn calculate_diff(&self, _current: &Value, _desired: &Value) -> Result<StateDiff> {
        Ok(StateDiff {
            plugin: PLUGIN_NAME.to_string(),
            actions: vec![],
            metadata: DiffMetadata {
                timestamp: chrono::Utc::now().timestamp(),
                current_hash: "schema-declared".to_string(),
                desired_hash: "schema-declared".to_string(),
            },
        })
    }

    async fn apply_state(&self, _diff: &StateDiff) -> Result<ApplyResult> {
        Ok(ApplyResult {
            success: true,
            changes_applied: vec![],
            errors: vec![],
            checkpoint: None,
        })
    }

    async fn verify_state(&self, _desired: &Value) -> Result<bool> {
        Ok(true)
    }

    async fn create_checkpoint(&self) -> Result<Checkpoint> {
        Ok(Checkpoint {
            id: uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string(),
            plugin: PLUGIN_NAME.to_string(),
            timestamp: chrono::Utc::now().timestamp(),
            state_snapshot: simd_json::serde::to_owned_value(Self::current_state())?,
            backend_checkpoint: None,
        })
    }

    async fn rollback(&self, _checkpoint: &Checkpoint) -> Result<()> {
        Ok(())
    }

    fn capabilities(&self) -> PluginCapabilities {
        PluginCapabilities {
            supports_rollback: false,
            supports_checkpoints: true,
            supports_verification: true,
            atomic_operations: false,
        }
    }
}

// =============================================================================
// PLUGIN EXIT: publish the single PluginSchema contract
// =============================================================================

/// Canonical `tched_router` schema derived from [`TchedRouterState`] via schemars.
pub(crate) fn tched_router_schema() -> PluginSchema {
    tched_router_schema_from_state(TchedRouterPlugin::current_state())
}

fn tched_router_schema_from_state(state: TchedRouterState) -> PluginSchema {
    let root = serde_json::to_value(schemars::schema_for!(TchedRouterState))
        .expect("schemars schema serializes to JSON");
    let mut schema = super::schemars_adapter::plugin_schema_from_json(
        PLUGIN_NAME,
        PLUGIN_VERSION,
        PLUGIN_DESCRIPTION,
        &root,
    );
    schema
        .fields
        .get_mut("native_config")
        .expect("tched_router native_config field is present")
        .field_type = op_state_store::FieldType::exact_json_schema(
        super::tched_router_contract::document().clone(),
    )
    .expect("plugin-owned tched_router config contract is a valid exact field schema");
    schema.category = PLUGIN_CATEGORY.to_string();
    schema.display_name = Some(PLUGIN_DISPLAY_NAME.to_string());

    if let Ok(state) = simd_json::serde::to_owned_value(state) {
        super::schemars_adapter::apply_state_defaults(&mut schema, &state);
        schema.example = Some(state);
    }

    schema.methods.insert(
        "GetState".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<EmptyTchedInput, GetStateOutput>(
            "GetState",
            op_state_store::SideEffect::Read,
            true,
            "cap.software.3tched-router.state.read@v1",
            "obs.service.3tched-router.state.get@v1",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "GetModelRoutes".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<EmptyTchedInput, GetModelRoutesOutput>(
            "GetModelRoutes",
            op_state_store::SideEffect::Read,
            true,
            "cap.software.3tched-router.routes.read@v1",
            "obs.service.3tched-router.model-routes.list@v1",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "ListProviders".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<EmptyTchedInput, ListProvidersOutput>(
            "ListProviders",
            op_state_store::SideEffect::Read,
            true,
            "cap.software.3tched-router.providers.read@v1",
            "obs.service.3tched-router.providers.list@v1",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "GetProviderCatalog".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<EmptyTchedInput, GetProviderCatalogOutput>(
            "GetProviderCatalog",
            op_state_store::SideEffect::Read,
            true,
            "cap.software.3tched-router.providers.read@v1",
            "obs.service.3tched-router.provider-catalog.list@v1",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "GetTools".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<EmptyTchedInput, GetToolsOutput>(
            "GetTools",
            op_state_store::SideEffect::Read,
            true,
            "cap.software.3tched-router.tools.read@v1",
            "obs.service.3tched-router.tools.list@v1",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "GetRouter".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<EmptyTchedInput, GetRouterOutput>(
            "GetRouter",
            op_state_store::SideEffect::Read,
            true,
            "cap.software.3tched-router.router.read@v1",
            "obs.service.3tched-router.router.get@v1",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "GetConfigSchema".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<EmptyTchedInput, GetConfigSchemaOutput>(
            "GetConfigSchema",
            op_state_store::SideEffect::Read,
            true,
            "cap.software.3tched-router.config-schema.read@v1",
            "obs.service.3tched-router.config-schema.get@v1",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "ListUiSurfaces".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<EmptyTchedInput, ListUiSurfacesOutput>(
            "ListUiSurfaces",
            op_state_store::SideEffect::Read,
            true,
            "cap.software.3tched-router.ui-surfaces.read@v1",
            "obs.service.3tched-router.ui-surfaces.list@v1",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "GetStructuredOutput".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<EmptyTchedInput, GetStructuredOutputOutput>(
            "GetStructuredOutput",
            op_state_store::SideEffect::Read,
            true,
            "cap.software.3tched-router.structured-output.read@v1",
            "obs.service.3tched-router.structured-output.get@v1",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "ResolveRoute".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<ResolveRouteInput, ResolveRouteOutput>(
            "ResolveRoute",
            op_state_store::SideEffect::Read,
            true,
            "cap.software.3tched-router.route.resolve@v1",
            "obs.service.3tched-router.route.resolve@v1",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "Chat".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<ChatInput, ChatOutput>(
            "Chat",
            op_state_store::SideEffect::Read,
            false,
            "cap.software.3tched-router.chat@v1",
            "exp.service.3tched-router.chat@v1",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "ListModels".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<ListModelsInput, ListModelsOutput>(
            "ListModels",
            op_state_store::SideEffect::Read,
            true,
            "cap.software.3tched-router.models.read@v1",
            "obs.service.3tched-router.models.list@v1",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "SetProvider".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<SetProviderInput, SetProviderOutput>(
            "SetProvider",
            op_state_store::SideEffect::Mutation,
            false,
            "cap.software.3tched-router.provider.set@v1",
            "mut.service.3tched-router.provider.set@v1",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "SetModel".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<SetModelInput, SetModelOutput>(
            "SetModel",
            op_state_store::SideEffect::Mutation,
            false,
            "cap.software.3tched-router.model.set@v1",
            "mut.service.3tched-router.model.set@v1",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "SetSelection".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<SetSelectionInput, SetSelectionOutput>(
            "SetSelection",
            op_state_store::SideEffect::Mutation,
            false,
            "cap.software.tched-router.selection.set@v1",
            "mut.service.tched-router.selection.set@v1",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "SetOvsRoutingModel".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<SetOvsRoutingModelInput, SetOvsRoutingModelOutput>(
            "SetOvsRoutingModel",
            op_state_store::SideEffect::Mutation,
            false,
            "cap.software.3tched-router.model-assignments.ovs-routing.set@v1",
            "mut.service.3tched-router.model-assignments.ovs-routing.set@v1",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "SetObfuscationModel".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<SetObfuscationModelInput, SetObfuscationModelOutput>(
            "SetObfuscationModel",
            op_state_store::SideEffect::Mutation,
            false,
            "cap.software.3tched-router.model-assignments.obfuscation.set@v1",
            "mut.service.3tched-router.model-assignments.obfuscation.set@v1",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "SetVectorizationModel".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<
            SetVectorizationModelInput,
            SetVectorizationModelOutput,
        >(
            "SetVectorizationModel",
            op_state_store::SideEffect::Mutation,
            false,
            "cap.software.3tched-router.model-assignments.vectorization.set@v1",
            "mut.service.3tched-router.model-assignments.vectorization.set@v1",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "SetQdrantRetrievalModel".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<
            SetQdrantRetrievalModelInput,
            SetQdrantRetrievalModelOutput,
        >(
            "SetQdrantRetrievalModel",
            op_state_store::SideEffect::Mutation,
            false,
            "cap.software.3tched-router.model-assignments.qdrant-retrieval.set@v1",
            "mut.service.3tched-router.model-assignments.qdrant-retrieval.set@v1",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "SetCozoRetrievalModel".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<
            SetCozoRetrievalModelInput,
            SetCozoRetrievalModelOutput,
        >(
            "SetCozoRetrievalModel",
            op_state_store::SideEffect::Mutation,
            false,
            "cap.software.3tched-router.model-assignments.cozo-retrieval.set@v1",
            "mut.service.3tched-router.model-assignments.cozo-retrieval.set@v1",
        ),
    );

    // Declare every capability this plugin's methods gate on — the plugin is
    // the single declaration point (closure-clean under
    // `validate_capability_closure`).
    for (id, description) in CARRIED_CAPABILITIES {
        schema.capabilities.insert(
            id.to_string(),
            CapabilityDecl {
                id: id.to_string(),
                description: description.to_string(),
            },
        );
    }

    // Complete config surface — generated from the upstream `zeroclaw` crate's
    // real types, the single source of truth for configuration.
    super::tched_router_config_surface::register_config_methods(&mut schema);

    register_cli_config_methods(&mut schema);
    generation::declare_methods(&mut schema);

    // Generic property writes are aliases for these real native operations.
    // Their existing method capabilities still apply to the original caller.
    for (property, method, argument) in [
        ("selected_provider", "SetProvider", "provider_id"),
        ("selected_model", "SetModel", "model_id"),
    ] {
        schema.field_writes.insert(
            property.to_string(),
            op_state_store::plugin_schema::FieldWriteDecl {
                method: method.to_string(),
                argument: argument.to_string(),
            },
        );
    }

    // Publish current model selection and its typed allocation policy. The
    // provider catalog, endpoints, authentication placeholders, identity,
    // memory, privacy, and arbitrary upstream configuration remain internal.
    schema.public_state.paths = vec![
        "/status".to_string(),
        "/selected_provider".to_string(),
        "/selected_model".to_string(),
        "/model_assignments".to_string(),
        "/selector_policy".to_string(),
    ];

    schema
}

fn register_cli_config_methods(schema: &mut PluginSchema) {
    let read_capability = "cap.software.tched-router.router.read@v1";
    let write_capability = "cap.software.tched-router.router.write@v1";
    schema.methods.insert(
        "config_list".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<ConfigListInput, ConfigListOutput>(
            "config_list",
            SideEffect::Read,
            true,
            read_capability,
            "obs.software.tched-router.config-list@v2",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "config_get".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<ConfigGetInput, ConfigPropertyOutput>(
            "config_get",
            SideEffect::Read,
            true,
            read_capability,
            "obs.software.tched-router.config-get@v2",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "config_set".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<ConfigSetInput, ConfigPropertyOutput>(
            "config_set",
            SideEffect::Mutation,
            false,
            write_capability,
            "mut.software.tched-router.config-set@v2",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "config_patch".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<ConfigPatchInput, ConfigPatchOutput>(
            "config_patch",
            SideEffect::Mutation,
            false,
            write_capability,
            "mut.software.tched-router.config-patch@v2",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "config_init".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<ConfigInitInput, ConfigInitOutput>(
            "config_init",
            SideEffect::Mutation,
            false,
            write_capability,
            "mut.software.tched-router.config-init@v2",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "config_migrate".to_string(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<ConfigMigrateInput, ConfigMigrateOutput>(
            "config_migrate",
            SideEffect::Mutation,
            false,
            write_capability,
            "mut.software.tched-router.config-migrate@v2",
        ),
    );
    schema.capabilities.insert(
        read_capability.to_string(),
        CapabilityDecl {
            id: read_capability.to_string(),
            description: "Read masked native tched_router configuration.".to_string(),
        },
    );
    schema.capabilities.insert(
        write_capability.to_string(),
        CapabilityDecl {
            id: write_capability.to_string(),
            description: "Mutate native tched_router configuration through its typed loopback API."
                .to_string(),
        },
    );
}

];

/// Public accessor for crates that embed the 3tched Router plugin contract.
pub fn tched_router_plugin_schema() -> PluginSchema {
    tched_router_schema()
}

/// A signal the bridge can emit after a successful plugin-owned dispatch.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub struct DispatchSignal {
    pub name: String,
    pub payload: JsonValue,
}

/// Outcome of a plugin-owned method dispatch.
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct DispatchOutcome {
    pub result: JsonValue,
    pub signal: Option<DispatchSignal>,
}

impl DispatchOutcome {
    pub(crate) fn plain(result: JsonValue) -> Self {
        Self {
            result,
            signal: None,
        }
    }
}

/// Plugin-owned method dispatch for the 3tched Router D-Bus/gRPC surface.
pub fn dispatch_tched_router_method(
    method: &str,
    json_args: &str,
    state: &TchedRouterState,
) -> std::result::Result<DispatchOutcome, TchedRouterError> {
    match method {
        "GetState" => Ok(DispatchOutcome::plain(serde_json::json!({
            "state": to_json(&ObservedTchedRouterState::from(state))
        }))),
        "GetModelRoutes" => Ok(DispatchOutcome::plain(
            serde_json::json!({ "model_routes": to_json(&state.catalog.model_routes) }),
        )),
        "GetProviderCatalog" => Ok(DispatchOutcome::plain(
            serde_json::json!({ "providers": to_json(&state.catalog.providers) }),
        )),
        "GetTools" => Ok(DispatchOutcome::plain(
            serde_json::json!({ "tools": to_json(&state.catalog.tools) }),
        )),
        "ListProviders" => Ok(DispatchOutcome::plain(
            serde_json::json!({ "providers": to_json(&state.catalog.providers) }),
        )),
        "GetRouter" => Ok(DispatchOutcome::plain(
            serde_json::json!({ "router": to_json(&state.catalog.router) }),
        )),
        "GetConfigSchema" => Ok(DispatchOutcome::plain(
            serde_json::json!({ "config_schema": to_json(&state.catalog.config_schema) }),
        )),
        "ListUiSurfaces" => Ok(DispatchOutcome::plain(
            serde_json::json!({ "ui_surfaces": to_json(&state.catalog.ui_surfaces) }),
        )),
        "GetStructuredOutput" => Ok(DispatchOutcome::plain(
            serde_json::json!({ "structured_output": to_json(&state.catalog.structured_output) }),
        )),
        "ResolveRoute" => resolve_route(json_args, state).map(DispatchOutcome::plain),
        "ListModels" => list_models(json_args, state).map(DispatchOutcome::plain),
        "SetProvider" => set_provider_handler(json_args, state),
        "SetModel" => set_model_handler(json_args, state),
        "SetSelection" => set_selection_handler(json_args, state),
        "SetOvsRoutingModel" => set_role_model_handler(json_args, state, "ovs_routing"),
        "SetObfuscationModel" => set_role_model_handler(json_args, state, "obfuscation"),
        "SetVectorizationModel" => set_role_model_handler(json_args, state, "vectorization"),
        "SetQdrantRetrievalModel" => set_role_model_handler(json_args, state, "qdrant_retrieval"),
        "SetCozoRetrievalModel" => set_role_model_handler(json_args, state, "cozo_retrieval"),
        other => {
            let native_method = super::tched_router_config_surface::config_method_backing(other)
                .is_some()
                || generation::is_method(other)
                || matches!(
                    other,
                    "Chat"
                        | "config_list"
                        | "config_get"
                        | "config_set"
                        | "config_patch"
                        | "config_init"
                        | "config_migrate"
                );
            Err(TchedRouterError::ExecutionDenied {
                reason: if native_method {
                    format!("method requires admitted native bridge dispatch: {other}")
                } else {
                    format!("undeclared method: {other}")
                },
            })
        }
    }
}

fn list_models(
    json_args: &str,
    state: &TchedRouterState,
) -> std::result::Result<JsonValue, TchedRouterError> {
    let args = parse_args("ListModels", json_args)?;
    let provider = args
        .get("provider")
        .and_then(JsonValue::as_str)
        .unwrap_or_default();
    let routes = state
        .catalog
        .model_routes
        .iter()
        .filter(|route| {
            provider.is_empty()
                || route.provider.eq_ignore_ascii_case(provider)
                || route.upstream_provider.eq_ignore_ascii_case(provider)
        })
        .cloned()
        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
    Ok(serde_json::json!({ "model_routes": to_json(&routes) }))
}

fn to_json<T: Serialize>(value: &T) -> JsonValue {
    serde_json::to_value(value).unwrap_or(JsonValue::Null)
}

fn parse_args(method: &str, json_args: &str) -> std::result::Result<JsonValue, TchedRouterError> {
    if json_args.trim().is_empty() {
        return Ok(serde_json::json!({}));
    }
    serde_json::from_str(json_args).map_err(|error| TchedRouterError::ExecutionDenied {
        reason: format!("{method} arguments are not valid JSON: {error}"),
    })
}

fn require_str(
    args: &JsonValue,
    field: &str,
    method: &str,
) -> std::result::Result<String, TchedRouterError> {
    args.get(field)
        .and_then(JsonValue::as_str)
        .map(str::to_string)
        .ok_or_else(|| TchedRouterError::ExecutionDenied {
            reason: format!("{method} requires string field '{field}'"),
        })
}

fn resolve_route(
    json_args: &str,
    state: &TchedRouterState,
) -> std::result::Result<JsonValue, TchedRouterError> {
    let args = parse_args("ResolveRoute", json_args)?;
    let hint = require_str(&args, "hint", "ResolveRoute")?;
    state
        .catalog
        .model_routes
        .iter()
        .find(|route| route.hint == hint || route.model == hint)
        .map(|route| serde_json::json!({ "route": to_json(route) }))
        .ok_or(TchedRouterError::RouteNotDeclared { hint })
}

fn set_provider_handler(
    json_args: &str,
    state: &TchedRouterState,
) -> std::result::Result<DispatchOutcome, TchedRouterError> {
    let args = parse_args("SetProvider", json_args)?;
    let provider_id = require_str(&args, "provider_id", "SetProvider")?;
    if !state.catalog.providers.iter().any(|p| p.id == provider_id) {
        return Err(TchedRouterError::ProviderNotDeclared {
            provider: provider_id,
        });
    }
    let old = state.selected_provider.clone();
    Ok(DispatchOutcome {
        result: serde_json::json!({ "selected_provider": provider_id }),
        signal: Some(DispatchSignal {
            name: "ProviderChanged".to_string(),
            payload: serde_json::json!({ "old": old, "new": provider_id, "reason": "explicit set" }),
        }),
    })
}

fn set_selection_handler(
    json_args: &str,
    state: &TchedRouterState,
) -> std::result::Result<DispatchOutcome, TchedRouterError> {
    let args = parse_args("SetSelection", json_args)?;
    let provider_id = args
        .get("provider_id")
        .or_else(|| args.get("providerId"))
        .and_then(JsonValue::as_str)
        .map(str::to_string)
        .ok_or_else(|| TchedRouterError::ExecutionDenied {
            reason: "SetSelection requires string field 'provider_id'".to_string(),
        })?;
    let model_id = args
        .get("model_id")
        .or_else(|| args.get("modelId"))
        .and_then(JsonValue::as_str)
        .map(str::to_string)
        .ok_or_else(|| TchedRouterError::ExecutionDenied {
            reason: "SetSelection requires string field 'model_id'".to_string(),
        })?;
    if !state.catalog.providers.iter().any(|p| p.id == provider_id) {
        return Err(TchedRouterError::ProviderNotDeclared {
            provider: provider_id,
        });
    }
    if !state
        .catalog
        .model_routes
        .iter()
        .any(|r| r.model == model_id)
    {
        return Err(TchedRouterError::ModelNotDeclared { model: model_id });
    }
    Ok(DispatchOutcome {
        result: serde_json::json!({
            "selected_provider": provider_id,
            "selected_model": model_id,
        }),
        signal: Some(DispatchSignal {
            name: "SelectionChanged".to_string(),
            payload: serde_json::json!({
                "provider": provider_id,
                "model": model_id,
            }),
        }),
    })
}

fn set_model_handler(
    json_args: &str,
    state: &TchedRouterState,
) -> std::result::Result<DispatchOutcome, TchedRouterError> {
    let args = parse_args("SetModel", json_args)?;
    let model_id = require_str(&args, "model_id", "SetModel")?;
    if !state
        .catalog
        .model_routes
        .iter()
        .any(|r| r.model == model_id)
    {
        return Err(TchedRouterError::ModelNotDeclared { model: model_id });
    }
    let old = state.selected_model.clone();
    Ok(DispatchOutcome {
        result: serde_json::json!({ "selected_model": model_id }),
        signal: Some(DispatchSignal {
            name: "ModelChanged".to_string(),
            payload: serde_json::json!({ "old": old, "new": model_id, "reason": "explicit set" }),
        }),
    })
}

fn set_role_model_handler(
    json_args: &str,
    state: &TchedRouterState,
    role: &str,
) -> std::result::Result<DispatchOutcome, TchedRouterError> {
    let args = parse_args("SetRoleModel", json_args)?;
    let model_id = require_str(&args, "model_id", "SetRoleModel")?;
    let result = match role {
        "ovs_routing" => serde_json::json!({ "ovs_routing": model_id }),
        "obfuscation" => serde_json::json!({ "obfuscation": model_id }),
        "vectorization" => serde_json::json!({ "vectorization": model_id }),
        "qdrant_retrieval" => serde_json::json!({ "qdrant_retrieval": model_id }),
        "cozo_retrieval" => serde_json::json!({ "cozo_retrieval": model_id }),
        _ => {
            return Err(TchedRouterError::ExecutionDenied {
                reason: format!("unknown model role: {role}"),
            });
        }
    };
    let signal = serde_json::json!({
        "role": role,
        "model_id": model_id,
        "selected_provider": state.selected_provider,
    });
    Ok(DispatchOutcome {
        result,
        signal: Some(DispatchSignal {
            name: "ModelRoleChanged".to_string(),
            payload: signal,
        }),
    })
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::state_plugins::common::oscal::validate_subid;
    use serde_json::Value as JVal;

    fn collect_subids(node: &JVal, out: &mut Vec<String>) {
        if let Some(subid) = node.get("x-oscal-subid").and_then(JVal::as_str) {
            out.push(subid.to_string());
        }
        if let Some(props) = node.get("properties").and_then(JVal::as_object) {
            for v in props.values() {
                collect_subids(v, out);
            }
        }
        if let Some(defs) = node
            .get("$defs")
            .or_else(|| node.get("definitions"))
            .and_then(JVal::as_object)
        {
            for v in defs.values() {
                collect_subids(v, out);
            }
        }
        if let Some(items) = node.get("items") {
            collect_subids(items, out);
        }
        if let Some(alts) = node
            .get("anyOf")
            .or_else(|| node.get("oneOf"))
            .and_then(JVal::as_array)
        {
            for v in alts {
                collect_subids(v, out);
            }
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn all_subids_are_valid() {
        let raw = serde_json::to_value(schemars::schema_for!(TchedRouterState)).unwrap();
        let mut subids = Vec::new();
        collect_subids(&raw, &mut subids);
        assert!(!subids.is_empty(), "expected at least one x-oscal-subid");
        for subid in subids {
            validate_subid(&subid).expect("invalid subid: {subid}");
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn declared_routes_do_not_invent_factory_routing_or_availability() {
        let state = TchedRouterPlugin::current_state();
        assert!(state
            .catalog
            .model_routes
            .iter()
            .all(|route| !route.available));
        assert!(state
            .catalog
            .model_routes
            .iter()
            .all(|route| route.provider != "factory"));
        let factory = state
            .catalog
            .providers
            .iter()
            .find(|provider| provider.id == "factory")
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(factory.kind, "provider");
        assert!(factory.aliases.is_empty());
    }

    #[test]
    fn public_schema_accessor_returns_tched_router_schema() {
        let schema = tched_router_plugin_schema();
        assert_eq!(schema.name, PLUGIN_NAME);
        assert_eq!(schema.version, PLUGIN_VERSION);
        assert_eq!(schema.display_name, Some(PLUGIN_DISPLAY_NAME.to_string()));
        assert!(
            schema.capability_grants.is_empty(),
            "plugin schemas declare capabilities but never grant principal authority"
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn generated_method_docs_include_input_and_output_field_descriptions() {
        let schema = tched_router_plugin_schema();
        let chat = schema.methods.get("Chat").unwrap();
        let chat_returns = serde_json::to_value(chat.returns.as_ref().unwrap()).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            chat_returns
                .pointer("/properties/content/description")
                .and_then(JVal::as_str),
            Some("Assistant response text.")
        );

        let list_models = schema.methods.get("ListModels").unwrap();
        let list_args = serde_json::to_value(&list_models.args).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            list_args
                .pointer("/properties/provider/description")
                .and_then(JVal::as_str),
            Some("Optional provider id, route, or alias used to filter the model catalog.")
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn native_config_uses_exact_private_imported_contract() {
        let schema = tched_router_schema();
        assert!(matches!(
            &schema.fields["native_config"].field_type,
            op_state_store::FieldType::JsonSchema(_)
        ));
        let op_state_store::FieldType::JsonSchema(exact) =
            &schema.fields["native_config"].field_type
        else {
            unreachable!();
        };
        assert_eq!(
            exact.as_ref(),
            &simd_json::serde::to_owned_value(
                crate::state_plugins::tched_router_contract::document().clone()
            )
            .unwrap()
        );
        assert!(!schema
            .public_state
            .paths
            .iter()
            .any(|path| path == "/native_config" || path.starts_with("/native_config/")));
    }

    #[test]
    fn every_declared_method_has_a_domain_dispatcher() {
        let schema = tched_router_plugin_schema();
        let state = TchedRouterPlugin::current_state();

        for method in schema.methods.keys() {
            if generation::is_method(method) {
                // MutationEngine owns authenticated private generation state;
                // the synchronous helper must not bypass that owner.
                let error = dispatch_tched_router_method(method, "{}", &state).unwrap_err();
                assert!(error
                    .to_string()
                    .contains("requires admitted native bridge dispatch"));
                continue;
            }
            if method == "Chat" {
                // Chat is declared here but executed by the bridge runtime,
                // which owns provider credentials and the event chain.
                continue;
            }
            if super::super::tched_router_config_surface::CONFIG_METHODS.contains(&method.as_str())
                || matches!(
                    method.as_str(),
                    "config_list"
                        | "config_get"
                        | "config_set"
                        | "config_patch"
                        | "config_init"
                        | "config_migrate"
                )
            {
                // Config calls require async admitted bridge dispatch to the
                // native loopback API or exact committed protected state.
                continue;
            }
            let args = match method.as_str() {
                "ResolveRoute" => serde_json::json!({ "hint": "balanced" }),
                "ListModels" => serde_json::json!({ "provider": "salad" }),
                "SetProvider" => serde_json::json!({ "provider_id": "salad" }),
                "SetModel" => serde_json::json!({ "model_id": "qwen3.6-27b" }),
                "SetSelection" => serde_json::json!({
                    "provider_id": "salad",
                    "model_id": "qwen3.6-27b"
                }),
                name if name.starts_with("Set") => {
                    serde_json::json!({ "model_id": "qwen3.6-27b" })
                }
                _ => serde_json::json!({}),
            };
            match dispatch_tched_router_method(method, &args.to_string(), &state) {
                Ok(_) => {}
                Err(error) => {
                    let msg = error.to_string();
                    if msg.contains("config section missing")
                        || msg.contains("required field")
                        || msg.contains("unknown field")
                        || msg.contains("execution denied: read")
                    {
                        continue;
                    }
                    panic!("{method} is not executable: {error}");
                }
            }
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn generic_selection_writes_bind_to_existing_capability_gated_methods() {
        let schema = tched_router_plugin_schema();
        for (field, method_name, argument) in [
            ("selected_provider", "SetProvider", "provider_id"),
            ("selected_model", "SetModel", "model_id"),
        ] {
            assert!(schema.fields.contains_key(field));
            let binding = &schema.field_writes[field];
            assert_eq!(binding.method, method_name);
            assert_eq!(binding.argument, argument);
            let method = &schema.methods[method_name];
            assert_eq!(method.side_effect, op_state_store::SideEffect::Mutation);
            assert!(schema
                .capabilities
                .contains_key(method.required_capability.as_ref().unwrap()));
            let args = serde_json::to_value(&method.args).unwrap();
            assert!(args["properties"].get(argument).is_some());
        }
        assert_eq!(schema.field_writes.len(), 2);
    }

    #[test]
    fn undeclared_method_is_rejected() {
        let error =
            dispatch_tched_router_method("NotDeclared", "{}", &TchedRouterPlugin::current_state())
                .unwrap_err();
        assert!(error.to_string().contains("undeclared method"));
    }
}

// Self-registration: the plugin registry discovers this via inventory
// (single source of the catalog; no central dispatch list).
inventory::submit! {
    crate::default_registry::PluginReg::new(PLUGIN_NAME, |_ctx| std::sync::Arc::new(TchedRouterPlugin::new()))
}

/// Imported upstream version recorded in the plugin-owned contract.
pub fn tched_router_binary_version() -> &'static str {
    super::tched_router_contract::BINARY_SCHEMA_VERSION
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod official_schema_tests {
    //! Guard against truncated upstream imports and missing generated method fields.

    use super::tched_router_binary_version;
    use crate::state_plugins::tched_router_config_surface::GetGatewayConfigOutput;

    #[test]
    fn imported_contract_is_not_a_stub() {
        let value = super::super::tched_router_contract::document();
        let sections = value
            .get("properties")
            .and_then(|p| p.as_object())
            .expect("imported contract has properties");
        let defs = value
            .get("$defs")
            .and_then(|d| d.as_object())
            .expect("imported contract has $defs");
        assert!(
            sections.len() >= 32,
            "imported contract has only {} sections — import `zeroclaw config schema` \
             through gen_tched_router_config_surface before rebuilding",
            sections.len()
        );
        assert!(
            defs.len() >= 64,
            "imported contract has only {} $defs — looks stubbed or truncated",
            defs.len()
        );

        let gateway = defs
            .get("GatewayConfig")
            .and_then(|g| g.get("properties"))
            .and_then(|p| p.as_object())
            .expect("GatewayConfig is defined with properties");
        for field in [
            "port",
            "host",
            "require_pairing",
            "paired_tokens",
            "session_ttl_hours",
        ] {
            assert!(gateway.contains_key(field), "GatewayConfig missing {field}");
        }
        assert_eq!(
            gateway
                .get("require_pairing")
                .and_then(|v| v.get("type"))
                .and_then(|t| t.as_str()),
            Some("boolean")
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn sealed_method_schema_carries_real_section_fields() {
        // With a stubbed source this passed while the payload was `{}`.
        let schema = schemars::schema_for!(GetGatewayConfigOutput);
        let text = serde_json::to_value(&schema)
            .expect("schema serializes")
            .to_string();
        for field in ["port", "host", "require_pairing", "session_ttl_hours"] {
            assert!(
                text.contains(field),
                "GetGatewayConfigOutput payload is missing `{field}` — generated from a stub?"
            );
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn imported_contract_records_the_binary_version() {
        let version = tched_router_binary_version();
        assert!(!version.is_empty());
        assert_ne!(
            version, "unknown",
            "record the upstream version during the plugin contract import"
        );
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod config_v3_contract_tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn patch_contract_accepts_only_supported_typed_property_operations() {
        let input: ConfigPatchInput = serde_json::from_value(serde_json::json!({
            "operations": [
                {"op":"test", "path":"/gateway/port", "value": 8080},
                {"op":"replace", "path":"/gateway/port", "value": 8081},
                {"op":"remove", "path":"/gateway/public_base_url"}
            ]
        }))
        .expect("supported operations");
        assert_eq!(input.operations.len(), 3);
        assert!(
            serde_json::from_value::<ConfigPatchInput>(serde_json::json!({
                "section": "gateway", "value": {}
            }))
            .is_err()
        );
        assert!(
            serde_json::from_value::<ConfigPatchInput>(serde_json::json!({
                "operations": [{"op":"comment", "path":"/gateway/port", "comment":"x"}]
            }))
            .is_err()
        );
        assert!(
            serde_json::from_value::<ConfigPatchInput>(serde_json::json!({
                "operations": [{"op":"move", "path":"/gateway/port"}]
            }))
            .is_err()
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn property_contract_has_stable_protobuf_fields_for_both_variants() {
        let secret: ConfigPropertyOutput = serde_json::from_value(serde_json::json!({
            "kind": "secret",
            "path": "providers.models.openai.default.api_key",
            "populated": true
        }))
        .expect("populated-only secret");
        assert!(matches!(secret.kind, ConfigPropertyKind::Secret));
        let value: ConfigPropertyOutput = serde_json::from_value(serde_json::json!({
            "kind": "value", "path": "gateway.port", "value": "8080"
        }))
        .expect("display value");
        assert!(matches!(value.kind, ConfigPropertyKind::Value));

        let schema = serde_json::to_value(schemars::schema_for!(ConfigPropertyOutput)).unwrap();
        let properties = schema["properties"]
            .as_object()
            .expect("stable object schema");
        for field in ["kind", "path", "value", "populated", "warnings"] {
            assert!(properties.contains_key(field), "missing {field}");
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn config_contract_break_bumps_plugin_version() {
        assert_eq!(tched_router_plugin_schema().version, "4.1.0");
    }
}

//! Canonical method DTOs owned by gemma_brain's private UI workspace.
use super::super::super::plugin_scaffold_helpers::method_decl_from_schemars_with_output;
use super::*;
use op_state_store::{PluginSchema, SideEffect};

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct UiEmptyInput {}
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct UiSpecInput {
    pub spec_id: String,
}
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct UiJobInput {
    pub job_id: String,
}
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct UiListSpecsInput {
    #[serde(default)]
    pub after: Option<String>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub limit: u32,
}
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]

    pub spec: Value,

/// Input contracts have no owner ID, session ID, provider or storage path.
pub(crate) fn declare_methods(schema: &mut PluginSchema) {
    macro_rules! method {
        ($name:literal, $input:ty, $output:ty, $effect:ident, $idem:literal, $cap:literal, $subid:literal) => {
            schema.methods.insert(
                $name.into(),
                method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<$input, $output>(
                    $name,
                    SideEffect::$effect,
                    $idem,
                    $cap,
                    $subid,
                ),
            );
        };
    }
    method!(
        "get_ui_workspace",
        UiEmptyInput,
        UiWorkspaceOutput,
        Read,
        true,
        "gemma.read",
        "obs.service.gemma.ui-workspace.get@v2"
    );
    method!(
        "get_ui_spec",
        UiSpecInput,
        UiSpecOutput,
        Read,
        true,
        "gemma.read",
        "obs.service.gemma.ui-spec.get@v2"
    );
    method!(
        "get_ui_job",
        UiJobInput,
        UiJobOutput,
        Read,
        true,
        "gemma.read",
        "obs.service.gemma.ui-job.get@v2"
    );
    method!(
        "list_ui_specs",
        UiListSpecsInput,
        UiListSpecsOutput,
        Read,
        true,
        "gemma.read",
        "obs.service.gemma.ui-spec.list@v2"
    );
    method!(
        "create_ui_spec",
        UiCreateSpecInput,
        UiSpecMutationOutput,
        Mutation,
        false,
        "gemma.invoke",
        "mut.service.gemma.ui-spec.create@v2"
    );
    method!(
        "update_ui_spec",
        UiUpdateSpecInput,
        UiSpecMutationOutput,
        Mutation,
        false,
        "gemma.invoke",
        "mut.service.gemma.ui-spec.update@v2"
    );
    method!(
        "handle_ui_event",
        UiHandleEventInput,
        UiHandleEventOutput,
        Mutation,
        false,
        "gemma.invoke",
        "mut.service.gemma.ui-event.handle@v1"
    );
    method!(
        "delete_ui_spec",
        UiDeleteSpecInput,
        UiDeleteSpecOutput,
        Mutation,
        false,
        "gemma.invoke",
        "mut.service.gemma.ui-spec.delete@v2"
    );
    method!(
        "delete_ui_job",
        UiDeleteJobInput,
        UiDeleteJobOutput,
        Mutation,
        false,
        "gemma.invoke",
        "mut.service.gemma.ui-job.delete@v2"
    );
    method!(
        "rebind_ui_renderer",
        UiRebindInput,
        UiRebindOutput,
        Mutation,
        false,
        "gemma.invoke",
        "mut.service.gemma.ui-renderer.rebind@v2"
    );
    method!(
        "recover_ui_workspace",
        UiEmptyInput,
        UiWorkspaceOutput,
        Mutation,
        true,
        "gemma.invoke",
        "mut.service.gemma.ui-workspace.recover@v2"
    );
}

impl UiWorkspaceMethods {
    /// Trusted engine adapter: call only after canonical identity/capability/
    /// contract admission. The returned full projection is engine-private;
    /// publish it before returning `UiWorkspaceCommit::method_result`.
    pub async fn dispatch_mutation(
        &self,
        access: &UiAccessContext,
        method: &str,
        args: &Value,
        engine_minted_spec_id: Option<&str>,
    ) -> Result<UiWorkspaceCommit> {
        reject_precommit(check_json(
            args,
            JsonLimits {
                max_depth: 68,
                max_nodes: 70_000,
                max_bytes: MAX_SPEC_BYTES + 8192,
            },
        ))?;
        fn decode<T: serde::de::DeserializeOwned>(args: &Value) -> Result<T> {
            reject_precommit(
                serde_json::from_value(args.clone())
                    .map_err(|_| anyhow::anyhow!("invalid UI workspace arguments")),
            )
        }
        match method {
            "create_ui_spec" => {
                let input: UiCreateSpecInput = decode(args)?;
                self.create_spec(
                    access,
                    reject_precommit(
                        engine_minted_spec_id.context("engine-minted spec ID is required"),
                    )?,
                    input.spec,
                    input.tags,
                )
                .await
            }
            "update_ui_spec" => {
                let input: UiUpdateSpecInput = decode(args)?;
                self.update_spec_properties(
                    access,
                    &input.spec_id,
                    input.expected_revision,
                    &input.element_id,
                    input.properties,
                )
                .await
            }
            "handle_ui_event" => {
                let input: UiHandleEventInput = decode(args)?;
                self.handle_event(
                    access,
                    &input.spec_id,
                    input.expected_revision,
                    &input.element_id,
                    &input.event,
                )
                .await
            }
            "delete_ui_spec" => {
                let input: UiDeleteSpecInput = decode(args)?;
                self.delete_spec(access, &input.spec_id, input.expected_revision)
                    .await
            }
            "delete_ui_job" => {
                let input: UiDeleteJobInput = decode(args)?;
                self.delete_job(access, &input.job_id, input.expected_revision)
                    .await
            }
            "rebind_ui_renderer" => {
                let input: UiRebindInput = decode(args)?;
                self.rebind_renderer(
                    access,
                    input.expected_document_revision,
                    &input.expected_previous_catalog_hash,
                )
                .await
            }
            "register_tag" => {
                let input: super::super::methods::RegisterTagInput = decode(args)?;
                let owner = reject_precommit(Owner::new(access))?;
                self.update(owner, move |mut workspace| {
                    let output = taxonomy_methods::register_tag(&mut workspace.taxonomy, input)?;
                    Ok((workspace, UiMutationReceipt::TagRegistered { output }))
                })
                .await
            }
            _ => reject_precommit(Err(anyhow::anyhow!(
                "method is not a UI workspace mutation"
            ))),
        }
    }
}

impl UiWorkspaceCommit {
    /// No unrelated private siblings leak through a mutation's output DTO.
    pub fn method_result(&self) -> Result<Value> {
        match &self.receipt {
            UiMutationReceipt::SpecCreated { spec } | UiMutationReceipt::SpecUpdated { spec } => {
                Ok(serde_json::to_value(UiSpecMutationOutput {
                    document_revision: self.document_revision,
                    spec: spec.clone(),
                })?)
            }
            UiMutationReceipt::SpecDeleted {
                spec_id,
                deleted_revision,
            } => Ok(serde_json::to_value(UiDeleteSpecOutput {
                document_revision: self.document_revision,
                spec_id: spec_id.clone(),
                deleted_revision: *deleted_revision,
            })?),
            UiMutationReceipt::JobDeleted {
                job_id,
                deleted_revision,
            } => Ok(serde_json::to_value(UiDeleteJobOutput {
                document_revision: self.document_revision,
                job_id: job_id.clone(),
                deleted_revision: *deleted_revision,
            })?),
            UiMutationReceipt::RendererRebound {
                previous_catalog_hash,
                catalog_hash,
            } => Ok(serde_json::to_value(UiRebindOutput {
                document_revision: self.document_revision,
                previous_catalog_hash: previous_catalog_hash.clone(),
                catalog_hash: catalog_hash.clone(),
            })?),
            UiMutationReceipt::TagRegistered { output } => Ok(serde_json::to_value(output)?),
            UiMutationReceipt::EventHandled {
                spec,
                event,
                action,
            } => Ok(serde_json::to_value(UiHandleEventOutput {
                document_revision: self.document_revision,
                spec: spec.clone(),
                event: event.clone(),
                action: action.clone(),
            })?),
            _ => anyhow::bail!("internal job transition has no public mutation result"),
        }
    }
}

pub(crate) fn page_specs(
    snapshot: Option<&UiWorkspaceProjection>,
    after: Option<&str>,
    limit: usize,
    current_catalog_hash: &str,
) -> UiListSpecsOutput {
    let mut records = snapshot
        .into_iter()
        .flat_map(|snapshot| snapshot.specs.values())
        .filter(|record| after.is_none_or(|cursor| record.id.as_str() > cursor));
    let specs: Vec<_> = records
        .by_ref()
        .take(limit)
        .map(|record| UiListedSpec {
            record: record.clone(),
            render_admitted: record.catalog_hash == current_catalog_hash,
        })
        .collect();
    let next_cursor = records
        .next()
        .and_then(|_| specs.last().map(|spec| spec.record.id.clone()));
    UiListSpecsOutput { specs, next_cursor }
}

impl UiWorkspaceRecovery {
    /// The canonical gemma_brain private root is flat: document_revision,
    /// catalog_hash, jobs and specs. This domain receipt's projection envelope
    /// is not a second state shape and must not be written directly to SHM.
    pub fn plugin_state(&self) -> Result<Value> {
        ensure!(self.document_revision > 0, "invalid UI document revision");
        validate_workspace_content(
            &self.projection.catalog_hash,
            &self.projection.jobs,
            &self.projection.specs,
        )?;
        taxonomy_methods::validate_taxonomy(&GemmaTaxonomy {
            revision: self.projection.taxonomy_revision,
            tags: self.projection.tags.clone(),
        })?;
        let mut state = serde_json::to_value(&self.projection)?;
        state
            .as_object_mut()
            .context("UI projection must be an object")?
            .insert(
                "document_revision".into(),
                Value::from(self.document_revision),
            );
        validate_document_bound(&state)?;
        Ok(state)
    }

    /// Decode only an already committed, authorized private-SHM plugin root.
    /// The bridge supplies its principal/session scope; no caller owner field,
    /// Cozo read, defaults, or stale process cache can provide that authority.
    pub fn from_plugin_state(state: &Value) -> Result<Self> {
        validate_document_bound(state)?;
        let mut object = state
            .as_object()
            .context("invalid committed UI root")?
            .clone();
        let document_revision = object
            .remove("document_revision")
            .and_then(|v| v.as_u64())
            .context("invalid committed UI revision")?;
        ensure!(document_revision > 0, "invalid committed UI revision");
        let projection: UiWorkspaceProjection = serde_json::from_value(Value::Object(object))
            .map_err(|_| anyhow::anyhow!("invalid committed UI projection"))?;
        validate_workspace_content(
            &projection.catalog_hash,
            &projection.jobs,
            &projection.specs,
        )?;
        taxonomy_methods::validate_taxonomy(&GemmaTaxonomy {
            revision: projection.taxonomy_revision,
            tags: projection.tags.clone(),
        })?;
        Ok(Self {
            document_revision,
            projection,
        })
    }
}
impl UiWorkspaceCommit {
    pub fn plugin_state(&self) -> Result<Value> {
        UiWorkspaceRecovery {
            document_revision: self.document_revision,
            projection: self.projection.clone(),
        }
        .plugin_state()
    }
}
impl UiWorkspaceMethods {
    /// Pure read over a committed private-SHM receipt, after bridge authorization.
    /// Never reads Cozo or chooses a principal, directory, cache or catalog.
    pub fn dispatch_committed_read(
        &self,
        method: &str,
        args: &Value,
        snapshot: Option<UiWorkspaceRecovery>,
    ) -> Result<Value> {
        check_json(
            args,
            JsonLimits {
                max_depth: 8,
                max_nodes: 64,
                max_bytes: 72 * 1024,
            },
        )?;
        fn decode<T: serde::de::DeserializeOwned>(args: &Value) -> Result<T> {
            serde_json::from_value(args.clone())
                .map_err(|_| anyhow::anyhow!("invalid UI workspace arguments"))
        }
        if let Some(snapshot) = &snapshot {
            ensure!(
                snapshot.document_revision > 0,
                "invalid committed UI revision"
            );
            validate_workspace_content(
                &snapshot.projection.catalog_hash,
                &snapshot.projection.jobs,
                &snapshot.projection.specs,
            )?;
            taxonomy_methods::validate_taxonomy(&GemmaTaxonomy {
                revision: snapshot.projection.taxonomy_revision,
                tags: snapshot.projection.tags.clone(),
            })?;
        }
        match method {
            "get_ui_workspace" => {
                let _: UiEmptyInput = decode(args)?;
                Ok(serde_json::to_value(UiWorkspaceOutput {
                    workspace: snapshot,
                })?)
            }
            "get_ui_spec" => {
                let input: UiSpecInput = decode(args)?;
                validate_id("spec_id", &input.spec_id)?;
                let record = snapshot
                    .and_then(|snapshot| snapshot.projection.specs.get(&input.spec_id).cloned());
                Ok(serde_json::to_value(self.spec_view(record))?)
            }
            "get_ui_job" => {
                let input: UiJobInput = decode(args)?;
                validate_id("job_id", &input.job_id)?;
                let job = snapshot
                    .and_then(|snapshot| snapshot.projection.jobs.get(&input.job_id).cloned());
                Ok(serde_json::to_value(UiJobOutput { job })?)
            }
            "list_ui_specs" => {
                let input: UiListSpecsInput = decode(args)?;
                let limit = if input.limit == 0 {
                    50
                } else {
                    input.limit as usize
                };
                ensure!(limit <= MAX_SPECS, "UI list limit exceeds capacity");
                if let Some(cursor) = &input.after {
                    validate_id("cursor", cursor)?;
                }
                let mut page = page_specs(
                    snapshot.as_ref().map(|snapshot| &snapshot.projection),
                    input.after.as_deref(),
                    limit,
                    &self.catalog_hash,
                );
                for item in &mut page.specs {
                    item.render_admitted = self.record_is_render_admitted(&item.record);
                }
                Ok(serde_json::to_value(page)?)
            }
            "list_tags" => {
                let _: super::super::methods::ListTaxonomyInput = decode(args)?;
                let taxonomy = snapshot
                    .map(|snapshot| GemmaTaxonomy {
                        revision: snapshot.projection.taxonomy_revision,
                        tags: snapshot.projection.tags,
                    })
                    .unwrap_or_default();
                Ok(serde_json::to_value(taxonomy_methods::list_tags(
                    &taxonomy,
                )?)?)
            }
            "list_perspectives" => {
                let _: super::super::methods::ListTaxonomyInput = decode(args)?;
                let taxonomy = snapshot
                    .map(|snapshot| GemmaTaxonomy {
                        revision: snapshot.projection.taxonomy_revision,
                        tags: snapshot.projection.tags,
                    })
                    .unwrap_or_default();
                Ok(serde_json::to_value(taxonomy_methods::list_perspectives(
                    &taxonomy,
                )?)?)
            }
            "classify" => {
                let input: super::super::methods::ClassifyInput = decode(args)?;
                let taxonomy = snapshot
                    .map(|snapshot| GemmaTaxonomy {
                        revision: snapshot.projection.taxonomy_revision,
                        tags: snapshot.projection.tags,
                    })
                    .unwrap_or_default();
                Ok(serde_json::to_value(taxonomy_methods::classify(
                    &taxonomy, input,
                )?)?)
            }
            "analyze_intent" => {
                let input: super::super::methods::AnalyzeIntentInput = decode(args)?;
                let taxonomy = snapshot
                    .map(|snapshot| GemmaTaxonomy {
                        revision: snapshot.projection.taxonomy_revision,
                        tags: snapshot.projection.tags,
                    })
                    .unwrap_or_default();
                Ok(serde_json::to_value(taxonomy_methods::analyze_intent(
                    &taxonomy, input,
                )?)?)
            }
            _ => anyhow::bail!("method is not a UI workspace read"),
        }
    }
}

<file path="op-plugins/src/state_plugins/ui_workspace_methods.rs">
//! Durable, principal/session-owned UI generation jobs and validated specs.
//!
//! Cozo (through `RuntimeDocuments`) is durable mutable-domain storage. This
//! adapter performs no SHM publication; MutationEngine publishes the returned
//! committed projection before sending a scoped wakeup.

use std::collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet};
use std::sync::Arc;

use anyhow::{ensure, Context, Result};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use serde_json::Value;
use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};

use super::super::json_render::{
    canvas_profile::PinnedCanvasValidator,
    validation_bounds::{check_json, JsonLimits},
};
use super::super::runtime_documents::{RuntimeDocumentRejected, RuntimeDocuments};
use super::methods::{self as taxonomy_methods, GemmaTaxonomy, RegisterTagOutput};

const DOCUMENT_PREFIX: &str = "ui_workspace:v1:";
const OWNER_DOMAIN: &[u8] = b"opdbus.ui-workspace.owner.v1\0";
const MAX_JOBS: usize = 32;
const MAX_SPECS: usize = 200;
const MAX_SPEC_BYTES: usize = 1024 * 1024;
const MAX_DOCUMENT_BYTES: usize = 8 * 1024 * 1024;
const MAX_ELEMENTS: usize = 4096;
const MAX_TAGS: usize = 16;
const MAX_TAG_BYTES: usize = 64;
const MAX_ID_BYTES: usize = 128;

fn reject_precommit<T>(result: Result<T>) -> Result<T> {
    result.map_err(|error| RuntimeDocumentRejected::new(error).into())
}

#[path = "ui_workspace_contract.rs"]
mod contract;
pub use contract::*;

/// A derived storage selector, never a caller-supplied authority or wire ID.
#[derive(Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct UiOwnerKey(String);
impl UiOwnerKey {
    pub fn namespace_component(&self) -> &str {
        &self.0
    }
}

impl UiAccessContext {
    pub fn owner_key(&self) -> Result<UiOwnerKey> {
        Ok(UiOwnerKey(Owner::new(self)?.owner_key))
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct UiAccessContext {
    pub principal_id: String,
    pub session_id: String,
    /// Present for authenticated private Gemma state. Legacy generation
    /// helpers may omit it and remain in their separate owner domain.
    pub session_genesis: Option<String>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum UiJobStatus {
    Pending,
    Running,
    Completed,
    Failed,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum UiJobFailureCode {
    ProviderUnavailable,
    InvalidProviderOutput,
    CatalogChanged,
    /// The process lost the provider execution term. The prompt is not
    /// persisted, so recovery cannot reconstruct or silently resume it.
    Interrupted,
    PublicationFailed,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
#[schemars(extend("x-opdbus-exact-json-schema" = true))]
pub struct UiGenerationJob {
    pub id: String,
    pub revision: u64,
    pub status: UiJobStatus,
    pub requested_at: i64,
    pub updated_at: i64,
    pub prompt_digest: String,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub result_spec_id: Option<String>,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub error_code: Option<UiJobFailureCode>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
#[schemars(extend("x-opdbus-exact-json-schema" = true))]
pub struct UiSpecRecord {
    pub id: String,
    pub revision: u64,
    pub catalog_hash: String,
    pub spec: Value,
    pub tags: Vec<String>,
    pub created_at: i64,
    pub updated_at: i64,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
struct StoredUiWorkspace {
    format_version: u32,
    principal_id: String,
    session_id: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    session_genesis: Option<String>,
    owner_key: String,
    catalog_hash: String,
    jobs: BTreeMap<String, UiGenerationJob>,
    specs: BTreeMap<String, UiSpecRecord>,
    #[serde(default)]
    taxonomy: GemmaTaxonomy,
}

/// Private values suitable for MutationEngine's principal-scoped projection.
/// Raw principal/session identifiers never enter the projection.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct UiWorkspaceProjection {
    pub catalog_hash: String,
    pub jobs: BTreeMap<String, UiGenerationJob>,
    pub specs: BTreeMap<String, UiSpecRecord>,
    pub tags: BTreeMap<String, super::methods::GemmaTag>,
    pub taxonomy_revision: u64,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(tag = "kind", rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum UiMutationReceipt {
    SpecCreated {
        spec: UiSpecRecord,
    },
    JobCreated {
        job: UiGenerationJob,
        /// Terminal jobs removed to make room. Their referenced specs remain.
        pruned_job_ids: Vec<String>,
    },
    JobRunning {
        job: UiGenerationJob,
    },
    JobFailed {
        job: UiGenerationJob,
    },
    SpecCompleted {
        job: UiGenerationJob,
        spec: UiSpecRecord,
    },
    SpecUpdated {
        spec: UiSpecRecord,
    },
    SpecDeleted {
        spec_id: String,
        deleted_revision: u64,
    },
    JobDeleted {
        job_id: String,
        deleted_revision: u64,
    },
    RendererRebound {
        previous_catalog_hash: String,
        catalog_hash: String,
    },
    TagRegistered {
        output: RegisterTagOutput,
    },
    EventHandled {
        spec: UiSpecRecord,
        event: String,
        action: String,
    },
}

/// Exact Cozo commit returned to MutationEngine. `projection` is derived from
/// the same row returned by `update_with_result`, never a later racy read.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct UiWorkspaceCommit {
    pub document_revision: u64,
    pub receipt: UiMutationReceipt,
    pub projection: UiWorkspaceProjection,
}

/// Durable row recovered from the injected `RuntimeDocuments` owner.
///
/// This receipt proves only that the retained workspace passed its immutable
/// format, owner, provenance, and aggregate-size checks at `document_revision`.
/// A retained spec whose `catalog_hash` differs from the validator's current
/// renderer-contract hash remains eligible for deletion and audit display, but
/// is not admitted for new rendering or mutation.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct UiWorkspaceRecovery {
    pub document_revision: u64,
    pub projection: UiWorkspaceProjection,
}

pub trait UiSpecValidator: Send + Sync {
    /// Immutable hash of the exact sealed renderer contract used for new-spec
    /// validation by this handle. This should not be a hash of unrelated
    /// plugins in the wider catalog.
    fn catalog_hash(&self) -> &str;

    /// Pure, deterministic validation against the injected pinned catalog.
    /// Implementations must perform no I/O and consult no mutable catalog or
    /// caller-selected schema/component registry.
    fn validate_spec(&self, spec: &Value) -> Result<()>;

    fn apply_event(&self, _spec: &Value, _element_id: &str, _event: &str) -> Result<Value> {
        anyhow::bail!("renderer does not implement server event reduction")
    }
}

impl UiSpecValidator for PinnedCanvasValidator {
    fn catalog_hash(&self) -> &str {
        self.schema_hash()
    }
    fn validate_spec(&self, spec: &Value) -> Result<()> {
        self.validate(spec)
    }
    fn apply_event(&self, spec: &Value, element_id: &str, event: &str) -> Result<Value> {
        PinnedCanvasValidator::apply_event(self, spec, element_id, event)
    }
}

pub struct UiWorkspaceMethods {
    documents: Arc<RuntimeDocuments>,
    validator: Arc<dyn UiSpecValidator>,
    catalog_hash: String,
}

impl UiWorkspaceMethods {
    /// The bridge supplies original bytes/hash from one manifest-pinned
    /// json_render blob after compiled-state admission. No runtime hash or
    /// fallback registry is constructed here.
    pub fn from_manifest_pinned_renderer(
        documents: Arc<RuntimeDocuments>,
        schema_json: Arc<str>,
        schema_hash: String,
    ) -> Result<Self> {
        Self::new(
            documents,
            Arc::new(PinnedCanvasValidator::from_manifest_pinned_schema(
                schema_json,
                schema_hash,
            )?),
        )
    }

    fn new(documents: Arc<RuntimeDocuments>, validator: Arc<dyn UiSpecValidator>) -> Result<Self> {
        let catalog_hash = validator.catalog_hash().to_string();
        validate_digest("catalog_hash", &catalog_hash)?;
        Ok(Self {
            documents,
            validator,
            catalog_hash,
        })
    }

    pub fn catalog_hash(&self) -> &str {
        &self.catalog_hash
    }

    /// Provider-independent creation; the engine, not the caller, mints spec_id.
    pub async fn create_spec(
        &self,
        access: &UiAccessContext,
        spec_id: &str,
        spec: Value,
        tags: Vec<String>,
    ) -> Result<UiWorkspaceCommit> {
        reject_precommit(validate_id("spec_id", spec_id))?;
        reject_precommit(validate_tags(&tags))?;
        reject_precommit(validate_spec_bounds(&spec))?;
        reject_precommit(self.validator.validate_spec(&spec))?;
        let id = spec_id.to_owned();
        let catalog_hash = self.catalog_hash.clone();
        self.update(
            reject_precommit(Owner::new(access))?,
            move |mut workspace| {
                ensure!(
                    workspace.specs.len() < MAX_SPECS,
                    "UI spec capacity reached"
                );
                ensure!(!workspace.specs.contains_key(&id), "UI spec already exists");
                let now = now_seconds()?;
                let record = UiSpecRecord {
                    id: id.clone(),
                    revision: 1,
                    catalog_hash,
                    spec,
                    tags,
                    created_at: now,
                    updated_at: now,
                };
                workspace.specs.insert(id, record.clone());
                Ok((workspace, UiMutationReceipt::SpecCreated { spec: record }))
            },
        )
        .await
    }

    /// Explicitly delete terminal job history; never cancel or remove an
    /// active provider job, and never implicitly delete its result spec.
    pub async fn delete_job(
        &self,
        access: &UiAccessContext,
        job_id: &str,
        expected_revision: u64,
    ) -> Result<UiWorkspaceCommit> {
        reject_precommit(validate_id("job_id", job_id))?;
        reject_precommit(validate_expected_revision(expected_revision))?;
        let job_id = job_id.to_owned();
        self.update_with_admission(
            reject_precommit(Owner::new(access))?,
            UpdateAdmission::RetainedCleanup,
            move |mut workspace| {
                let job = workspace.jobs.get(&job_id).context("UI job not found")?;
                ensure!(job.revision == expected_revision, "stale UI job revision");
                ensure!(
                    matches!(job.status, UiJobStatus::Completed | UiJobStatus::Failed),
                    "active UI job cannot be deleted"
                );
                workspace.jobs.remove(&job_id);
                Ok((
                    workspace,
                    UiMutationReceipt::JobDeleted {
                        job_id,
                        deleted_revision: expected_revision,
                    },
                ))
            },
        )
        .await
    }

    /// Explicit rebind only for a truly empty existing workspace. Neither
    /// artifacts nor history are silently removed or given a new provenance.
    /// Exact document revision is checked inside RuntimeDocuments' owned CAS.
    pub async fn rebind_renderer(
        &self,
        access: &UiAccessContext,
        expected_document_revision: u64,
        expected_previous_catalog_hash: &str,
    ) -> Result<UiWorkspaceCommit> {
        reject_precommit(validate_expected_revision(expected_document_revision))?;
        reject_precommit(validate_digest(
            "expected renderer hash",
            expected_previous_catalog_hash,
        ))?;
        let owner = reject_precommit(Owner::new(access))?;
        let previous_hash = expected_previous_catalog_hash.to_owned();
        let new_hash = self.catalog_hash.clone();
        reject_precommit(
            (previous_hash != new_hash)
                .then_some(())
                .context("renderer contract is unchanged"),
        )?;
        let document_id = owner.document_id.clone();
        let (row, (receipt, projection)) = self
            .documents
            .update_at_revision_with_result(&document_id, expected_document_revision, move |old| {
                let mut workspace =
                    decode_retained_workspace(&owner, old.context("UI workspace absent")?)?;
                ensure!(
                    workspace.catalog_hash == previous_hash,
                    "stale renderer provenance"
                );
                ensure!(
                    workspace.jobs.is_empty() && workspace.specs.is_empty(),
                    "renderer rebind requires an empty workspace"
                );
                workspace.catalog_hash = new_hash.clone();
                validate_retained_workspace(&owner, &workspace)?;
                let projection = workspace.projection();
                let document = serde_json::to_value(workspace)?;
                validate_document_bound(&document)?;
                Ok((
                    document,
                    (
                        UiMutationReceipt::RendererRebound {
                            previous_catalog_hash: previous_hash,
                            catalog_hash: new_hash,
                        },
                        projection,
                    ),
                ))
            })
            .await?;
        Ok(UiWorkspaceCommit {
            document_revision: row.revision,
            receipt,
            projection,
        })
    }

    /// Durable-domain management view. Canonical runtime methods and streams
    /// read engine-committed private SHM; they must not substitute this read.
    pub async fn list_specs(
        &self,
        access: &UiAccessContext,
        input: UiListSpecsInput,
    ) -> Result<UiListSpecsOutput> {
        let limit = if input.limit == 0 {
            50
        } else {
            input.limit as usize
        };
        ensure!(limit <= MAX_SPECS, "UI list limit exceeds capacity");
        if let Some(cursor) = &input.after {
            validate_id("cursor", cursor)?;
        }
        let snapshot = self.snapshot(access).await?;
        let mut page = page_specs(
            snapshot.as_ref(),
            input.after.as_deref(),
            limit,
            &self.catalog_hash,
        );
        for item in &mut page.specs {
            item.render_admitted = self.record_is_render_admitted(&item.record);
        }
        Ok(page)
    }

    /// Pure presentation over a record selected from committed private SHM.
    /// Matching a stored hash alone never validates corrupted/foreign props.
    pub fn spec_view(&self, spec: Option<UiSpecRecord>) -> UiSpecOutput {
        let render_admitted = spec
            .as_ref()
            .is_some_and(|record| self.record_is_render_admitted(record));
        UiSpecOutput {
            spec,
            render_admitted,
        }
    }

    fn record_is_render_admitted(&self, record: &UiSpecRecord) -> bool {
        record.catalog_hash == self.catalog_hash
            && self.validator.validate_spec(&record.spec).is_ok()
    }

    pub async fn snapshot(
        &self,
        access: &UiAccessContext,
    ) -> Result<Option<UiWorkspaceProjection>> {
        let owner = Owner::new(access)?;
        self.documents
            .read(&owner.document_id)
            .await?
            .map(|row| self.retained_projection(&owner, row.document))
            .transpose()
    }

    /// Reconcile an uncertain publication from the exact durable Cozo row.
    /// MutationEngine may publish this projection with the returned revision;
    /// it must never substitute a later ordinary read for a successful commit
    /// receipt or publish an older revision over a newer owner-scoped SHM row.
    pub async fn recover_snapshot(
        &self,
        access: &UiAccessContext,
    ) -> Result<Option<UiWorkspaceRecovery>> {
        let owner = Owner::new(access)?;
        self.documents
            .read_durable(&owner.document_id)
            .await?
            .map(|row| {
                Ok(UiWorkspaceRecovery {
                    document_revision: row.revision,
                    projection: self.retained_projection(&owner, row.document)?,
                })
            })
            .transpose()
    }

    pub async fn get_job(
        &self,
        access: &UiAccessContext,
        job_id: &str,
    ) -> Result<Option<UiGenerationJob>> {
        validate_id("job_id", job_id)?;
        Ok(self
            .snapshot(access)
            .await?
            .and_then(|snapshot| snapshot.jobs.get(job_id).cloned()))
    }

    pub async fn get_spec(
        &self,
        access: &UiAccessContext,
        spec_id: &str,
    ) -> Result<Option<UiSpecRecord>> {
        // This is a retained-artifact management read. The record's immutable
        // catalog_hash must equal the workspace provenance, but callers must
        // not treat it as approval to render under the current catalog.
        validate_id("spec_id", spec_id)?;
        Ok(self
            .snapshot(access)
            .await?
            .and_then(|snapshot| snapshot.specs.get(spec_id).cloned()))
    }

    pub async fn create_job(
        &self,
        access: &UiAccessContext,
        job_id: &str,
        prompt_digest: &str,
    ) -> Result<UiWorkspaceCommit> {
        reject_precommit(validate_id("job_id", job_id))?;
        reject_precommit(validate_digest("prompt_digest", prompt_digest))?;
        let owner = reject_precommit(Owner::new(access))?;
        let catalog_hash = self.catalog_hash.clone();
        let job_id = job_id.to_string();
        let prompt_digest = prompt_digest.to_string();
        self.update(owner, move |mut workspace| {
            ensure!(
                !workspace.jobs.contains_key(&job_id),
                "UI job already exists"
            );
            let pruned_job_ids = retain_job_capacity(&mut workspace.jobs)?;
            let now = now_seconds()?;
            let job = UiGenerationJob {
                id: job_id.clone(),
                revision: 1,
                status: UiJobStatus::Pending,
                requested_at: now,
                updated_at: now,
                prompt_digest,
                result_spec_id: None,
                error_code: None,
            };
            ensure!(workspace.catalog_hash == catalog_hash, "catalog changed");
            workspace.jobs.insert(job_id, job.clone());
            Ok((
                workspace,
                UiMutationReceipt::JobCreated {
                    job,
                    pruned_job_ids,
                },
            ))
        })
        .await
    }

    pub async fn mark_job_running(
        &self,
        access: &UiAccessContext,
        job_id: &str,
        expected_revision: u64,
    ) -> Result<UiWorkspaceCommit> {
        reject_precommit(validate_id("job_id", job_id))?;
        reject_precommit(validate_expected_revision(expected_revision))?;
        let owner = reject_precommit(Owner::new(access))?;
        let job_id = job_id.to_string();
        self.update(owner, move |mut workspace| {
            let job = workspace
                .jobs
                .get_mut(&job_id)
                .context("UI job not found")?;
            ensure!(job.revision == expected_revision, "stale UI job revision");
            ensure!(job.status == UiJobStatus::Pending, "UI job is not pending");
            job.revision = checked_next(job.revision, "UI job revision")?;
            job.status = UiJobStatus::Running;
            job.updated_at = now_seconds()?;
            let job = job.clone();
            Ok((workspace, UiMutationReceipt::JobRunning { job }))
        })
        .await
    }

    pub async fn fail_job(
        &self,
        access: &UiAccessContext,
        job_id: &str,
        expected_revision: u64,
        error_code: UiJobFailureCode,
    ) -> Result<UiWorkspaceCommit> {
        reject_precommit(validate_id("job_id", job_id))?;
