<file path="op-plugins/src/state_plugins/users.rs">
//! User-account operations backed by AccountsService on the system D-Bus.

use anyhow::{Context, Result};
use async_trait::async_trait;
use op_state::{ApplyResult, Checkpoint, DiffMetadata, PluginCapabilities, StateDiff, StatePlugin};
use op_state_store::{CapabilityDecl, PluginSchema, SideEffect};
use schemars::JsonSchema;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use simd_json::OwnedValue as Value;
use std::time::Duration;
use zbus::zvariant::OwnedObjectPath;

const DESTINATION: &str = "org.freedesktop.Accounts";
const MANAGER_PATH: &str = "/org/freedesktop/Accounts";
const MANAGER_INTERFACE: &str = "org.freedesktop.Accounts";
const USER_INTERFACE: &str = "org.freedesktop.Accounts.User";
const PROVIDER_DEADLINE: Duration = Duration::from_secs(30);

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
#[schemars(extend("x-oscal-category" = "service"))]
pub struct UsersState {
    pub provider: String,
    pub list_scope: String,
}
impl Default for UsersState {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            provider: "accountsservice".into(),
            list_scope: "cached_accounts".into(),
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum AccountType {
    Standard,
    Administrator,
}
impl AccountType {
    fn code(self) -> i32 {
        match self {
            Self::Standard => 0,
            Self::Administrator => 1,
        }
    }
    fn from_code(code: i32) -> Result<Self> {
        match code {
            0 => Ok(Self::Standard),
            1 => Ok(Self::Administrator),
            _ => anyhow::bail!("AccountsService returned unknown account type {code}"),
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct CreateUserInput {
    pub username: String,
    pub real_name: String,
    pub account_type: AccountType,
}
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct DeleteUserInput {
    pub username: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub remove_files: bool,
}
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct ModifyUserInput {
    pub username: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub real_name: Option<String>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub shell: Option<String>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub account_type: Option<AccountType>,
}
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct ListUsersInput {
    #[serde(default)]
    pub include_system_accounts: bool,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub account_type: Option<AccountType>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct UserRecord {
    pub uid: u64,
    pub username: String,
    pub real_name: String,
    pub account_type: AccountType,
    pub shell: String,
    pub system_account: bool,
}
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct UserMutationOutput {
    pub operation: String,
    pub changed: bool,
    pub user: UserRecord,
    pub changed_fields: Vec<String>,
}
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct DeleteUserOutput {
    pub username: String,
    pub uid: Option<u64>,
    pub deleted: bool,
    pub remove_files_requested: bool,
    pub provider_completed: bool,
}
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct ListUsersOutput {
    pub scope: String,
    pub exhaustive: bool,
    pub users: Vec<UserRecord>,
    pub total: u64,
}

fn validate_username(value: &str) -> Result<()> {
    anyhow::ensure!(
        !value.is_empty() && !value.contains('\0'),
        "username must be nonempty and contain no NUL"
    );
    Ok(())
}
fn validate_text(value: &str, field: &str, allow_empty: bool) -> Result<()> {
    anyhow::ensure!(
        (allow_empty || !value.is_empty()) && !value.contains('\0'),
        "{field} is invalid"
    );
    Ok(())
}
fn is_missing(error: &zbus::Error) -> bool {
    matches!(error, zbus::Error::MethodError(name, _, _) if name.as_str() == "org.freedesktop.Accounts.Error.UserDoesNotExist")
}

#[async_trait]
trait AccountsProvider: Send + Sync {
    async fn list_cached(&self) -> Result<Vec<String>>;
    async fn find(&self, username: &str) -> Result<Option<String>>;
    async fn read(&self, path: &str) -> Result<UserRecord>;
    async fn create(
        &self,
        username: &str,
        real_name: &str,
        account_type: AccountType,
    ) -> Result<String>;
    async fn delete(&self, uid: i64, remove_files: bool) -> Result<()>;
    async fn set_real_name(&self, path: &str, value: &str) -> Result<()>;
    async fn set_shell(&self, path: &str, value: &str) -> Result<()>;
    async fn set_account_type(&self, path: &str, value: AccountType) -> Result<()>;
}

struct DbusAccountsProvider {
    connection: zbus::Connection,
}
impl DbusAccountsProvider {
    async fn manager(&self) -> Result<zbus::Proxy<'_>> {
        zbus::Proxy::new(
            &self.connection,
            DESTINATION,
            MANAGER_PATH,
            MANAGER_INTERFACE,
        )
        .await
        .context("create AccountsService manager proxy")
    }
    async fn user<'a>(&'a self, path: &'a str) -> Result<zbus::Proxy<'a>> {
        zbus::Proxy::new(&self.connection, DESTINATION, path, USER_INTERFACE)
            .await
            .context("create AccountsService user proxy")
    }
}

#[async_trait]
impl AccountsProvider for DbusAccountsProvider {
    async fn list_cached(&self) -> Result<Vec<String>> {
        let paths: Vec<OwnedObjectPath> = self
            .manager()
            .await?
            .call("ListCachedUsers", &())
            .await
            .context("AccountsService ListCachedUsers")?;
        Ok(paths.into_iter().map(|path| path.to_string()).collect())
    }
    async fn find(&self, username: &str) -> Result<Option<String>> {
        match self
            .manager()
            .await?
            .call::<_, _, OwnedObjectPath>("FindUserByName", &(username,))
            .await
        {
            Ok(path) => Ok(Some(path.to_string())),
            Err(error) if is_missing(&error) => Ok(None),
            Err(error) => Err(error).context("AccountsService FindUserByName"),
        }
    }
    async fn read(&self, path: &str) -> Result<UserRecord> {
        let proxy = self.user(path).await?;
        Ok(UserRecord {
            uid: proxy
                .get_property("Uid")
                .await
                .context("read AccountsService Uid")?,
            username: proxy
                .get_property("UserName")
                .await
                .context("read AccountsService UserName")?,
            real_name: proxy
                .get_property("RealName")
                .await
                .context("read AccountsService RealName")?,
            account_type: AccountType::from_code(
                proxy
                    .get_property("AccountType")
                    .await
                    .context("read AccountsService AccountType")?,
            )?,
            shell: proxy
                .get_property("Shell")
                .await
                .context("read AccountsService Shell")?,
            system_account: proxy
                .get_property("SystemAccount")
                .await
                .context("read AccountsService SystemAccount")?,
        })
    }
    async fn create(
        &self,
        username: &str,
        real_name: &str,
        account_type: AccountType,
    ) -> Result<String> {
        let path: OwnedObjectPath = self
            .manager()
            .await?
            .call("CreateUser", &(username, real_name, account_type.code()))
            .await
            .context("AccountsService CreateUser")?;
        Ok(path.to_string())
    }
    async fn delete(&self, uid: i64, remove_files: bool) -> Result<()> {
        self.manager()
            .await?
            .call::<_, _, ()>("DeleteUser", &(uid, remove_files))
            .await
            .context("AccountsService DeleteUser")
    }
    async fn set_real_name(&self, path: &str, value: &str) -> Result<()> {
        self.user(path)
            .await?
            .call("SetRealName", &(value,))
            .await
            .context("AccountsService SetRealName")
    }
    async fn set_shell(&self, path: &str, value: &str) -> Result<()> {
        self.user(path)
            .await?
            .call("SetShell", &(value,))
            .await
            .context("AccountsService SetShell")
    }
    async fn set_account_type(&self, path: &str, value: AccountType) -> Result<()> {
        self.user(path)
            .await?
            .call("SetAccountType", &(value.code(),))
            .await
            .context("AccountsService SetAccountType")
    }
}

async fn dispatch_with_provider(
    provider: &dyn AccountsProvider,
    method: &str,
    args: &serde_json::Value,
) -> Result<serde_json::Value> {
    match method {
        "create_user" => {
            let input: CreateUserInput =
                serde_json::from_value(args.clone()).context("invalid create_user arguments")?;
            validate_username(&input.username)?;
            validate_text(&input.real_name, "real_name", true)?;
            anyhow::ensure!(
                provider.find(&input.username).await?.is_none(),
                "user already exists"
            );
            let path = provider
                .create(&input.username, &input.real_name, input.account_type)
                .await?;
            let user = provider.read(&path).await.context(
                "user creation completed but readback failed; account state is indeterminate",
            )?;
            anyhow::ensure!(
                user.username == input.username
                    && user.real_name == input.real_name
                    && user.account_type == input.account_type,
                "user creation completed but readback does not match request"
            );
            Ok(serde_json::to_value(UserMutationOutput {
                operation: "created".into(),
                changed: true,
                user,
                changed_fields: vec!["username".into(), "real_name".into(), "account_type".into()],
            })?)
        }
        "delete_user" => {
            let input: DeleteUserInput =
                serde_json::from_value(args.clone()).context("invalid delete_user arguments")?;
            validate_username(&input.username)?;
            let Some(path) = provider.find(&input.username).await? else {
                return Ok(serde_json::to_value(DeleteUserOutput {
                    username: input.username,
                    uid: None,
                    deleted: false,
                    remove_files_requested: input.remove_files,
                    provider_completed: false,
                })?);
            };
            let user = provider.read(&path).await?;
            anyhow::ensure!(
                user.username == input.username,
                "AccountsService lookup returned foreign username '{}' for requested '{}'",
                user.username,
                input.username
            );
            let uid = i64::try_from(user.uid)
                .context("AccountsService UID exceeds signed D-Bus range")?;
            provider.delete(uid, input.remove_files).await?;
            anyhow::ensure!(provider.find(&input.username).await.context("user deletion completed but absence readback failed; deletion state is indeterminate")?.is_none(), "user deletion returned but account remains present");
            Ok(serde_json::to_value(DeleteUserOutput {
                username: input.username,
                uid: Some(user.uid),
                deleted: true,
                remove_files_requested: input.remove_files,
                provider_completed: true,
            })?)
        }
        "modify_user" => {
            let input: ModifyUserInput =
                serde_json::from_value(args.clone()).context("invalid modify_user arguments")?;
            validate_username(&input.username)?;
            if let Some(value) = &input.real_name {
                validate_text(value, "real_name", true)?;
            }
            if let Some(value) = &input.shell {
                validate_text(value, "shell", false)?;
                anyhow::ensure!(value.starts_with('/'), "shell must be an absolute path");
            }
            let path = provider
                .find(&input.username)
                .await?
                .context("user does not exist")?;
            let before = provider.read(&path).await?;
            anyhow::ensure!(
                before.username == input.username,
                "AccountsService lookup returned foreign username '{}' for requested '{}'",
                before.username,
                input.username
            );
            let mut changed_fields = Vec::new();
            if input
                .real_name
                .as_ref()
                .is_some_and(|value| value != &before.real_name)
            {
                provider
                    .set_real_name(&path, input.real_name.as_deref().unwrap())
                    .await?;
                changed_fields.push("real_name".into());
            }
            if input
                .shell
                .as_ref()
                .is_some_and(|value| value != &before.shell)
            {
                provider
                    .set_shell(&path, input.shell.as_deref().unwrap())
                    .await
                    .with_context(|| {
                        format!(
                            "modify_user failed after fields {:?} were applied",
                            changed_fields
                        )
                    })?;
                changed_fields.push("shell".into());
            }
            if input
                .account_type
                .is_some_and(|value| value != before.account_type)
            {
                provider
                    .set_account_type(&path, input.account_type.unwrap())
                    .await
                    .with_context(|| {
                        format!(
                            "modify_user failed after fields {:?} were applied",
                            changed_fields
                        )
                    })?;
                changed_fields.push("account_type".into());
            }
            let user = provider.read(&path).await.context(
                "user modification completed but readback failed; applied state is indeterminate",
            )?;
            anyhow::ensure!(
                user.uid == before.uid && user.username == before.username,
                "user identity changed during modification"
            );
            if let Some(value) = input.real_name {
                anyhow::ensure!(
                    user.real_name == value,
                    "real_name readback mismatch after modification"
                );
            }
            if let Some(value) = input.shell {
                anyhow::ensure!(
                    user.shell == value,
                    "shell readback mismatch after modification"
                );
            }
            if let Some(value) = input.account_type {
                anyhow::ensure!(
                    user.account_type == value,
                    "account_type readback mismatch after modification"
                );
            }
            Ok(serde_json::to_value(UserMutationOutput {
                operation: "modified".into(),
                changed: !changed_fields.is_empty(),
                user,
                changed_fields,
            })?)
        }
        "list_users" => {
            let input: ListUsersInput =
                serde_json::from_value(args.clone()).context("invalid list_users arguments")?;
            let mut users = Vec::new();
            for path in provider.list_cached().await? {
                let user = provider.read(&path).await?;
                if (!input.include_system_accounts && user.system_account)
                    || input
                        .account_type
                        .is_some_and(|kind| kind != user.account_type)
                {
                    continue;
                }
                users.push(user);
            }
            users.sort_by(|a, b| a.username.cmp(&b.username));
            Ok(serde_json::to_value(ListUsersOutput {
                scope: "cached_accounts".into(),
                exhaustive: false,
                total: u64::try_from(users.len())?,
                users,
            })?)
        }
        other => anyhow::bail!("unknown users method '{other}'"),
    }
}

pub async fn dispatch_users_method(
    method: &str,
    args: &serde_json::Value,
) -> Result<serde_json::Value> {
    let connection = zbus::Connection::system()
        .await
        .context("connect to AccountsService system bus")?;
    tokio::time::timeout(
        PROVIDER_DEADLINE,
        dispatch_with_provider(&DbusAccountsProvider { connection }, method, args),
    )
    .await
    .context("AccountsService operation timeout")?
}

pub(crate) fn users_schema() -> PluginSchema {
    let root = serde_json::to_value(schemars::schema_for!(UsersState)).unwrap();
    let mut schema = super::schemars_adapter::plugin_schema_from_json(
        "users",
        "2.0.0",
        "AccountsService cached-account management",
        &root,
    );
    macro_rules! method {
        ($name:literal,$input:ty,$output:ty,$effect:expr,$idem:expr,$cap:literal,$subid:literal) => {{
            schema.methods.insert(
                $name.into(),
                super::plugin_scaffold_helpers::method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<
                    $input,
                    $output,
                >($name, $effect, $idem, $cap, $subid),
            );
        }};
    }
    method!(
        "create_user",
        CreateUserInput,
        UserMutationOutput,
        SideEffect::Mutation,
        false,
        "users.write",
        "mut.software.plugin.users.create@v2"
    );
    method!(
        "delete_user",
        DeleteUserInput,
        DeleteUserOutput,
        SideEffect::Mutation,
        false,
        "users.write",
        "mut.software.plugin.users.delete@v2"
    );
    method!(
        "modify_user",
        ModifyUserInput,
        UserMutationOutput,
        SideEffect::Mutation,
        false,
        "users.write",
        "mut.software.plugin.users.modify@v2"
    );
    method!(
        "list_users",
        ListUsersInput,
        ListUsersOutput,
        SideEffect::Read,
        true,
        "users.read",
        "obs.software.plugin.users.list@v2"
    );
    schema.capabilities.insert(
        "users.write".into(),
        CapabilityDecl {
            id: "users.write".into(),
            description: "Grants: create_user, delete_user, modify_user.".into(),
        },
    );
    schema.capabilities.insert(
        "users.read".into(),
        CapabilityDecl {
            id: "users.read".into(),
            description: "Grants: list_users.".into(),
        },
    );
    schema.example =
        Some(simd_json::json!({"provider":"accountsservice","list_scope":"cached_accounts"}));
    schema
}

pub struct UsersPlugin;
impl Default for UsersPlugin {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self
    }
}
impl UsersPlugin {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self
    }
}
#[async_trait]
impl StatePlugin for UsersPlugin {
    fn name(&self) -> &str {
        "users"
    }
    fn version(&self) -> &str {
        "2.0.0"
    }
    fn schema(&self) -> Option<PluginSchema> {
        Some(users_schema())
    }
    async fn calculate_diff(&self, _: &Value, _: &Value) -> Result<StateDiff> {
        Ok(StateDiff {
            plugin: self.name().into(),
            actions: vec![],
            metadata: DiffMetadata {
                timestamp: chrono::Utc::now().timestamp(),
                current_hash: String::new(),
                desired_hash: String::new(),
            },
        })
    }
    async fn apply_state(&self, _: &StateDiff) -> Result<ApplyResult> {
        Ok(ApplyResult {
            success: true,
            changes_applied: vec![],
            errors: vec![],
            checkpoint: None,
        })
    }
    async fn verify_state(&self, _: &Value) -> Result<bool> {
        Ok(true)
    }
    async fn create_checkpoint(&self) -> Result<Checkpoint> {
        Ok(Checkpoint {
            id: uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string(),
            plugin: self.name().into(),
            timestamp: chrono::Utc::now().timestamp(),
            state_snapshot: simd_json::serde::to_owned_value(UsersState::default())?,
            backend_checkpoint: None,
        })
    }
    async fn rollback(&self, _: &Checkpoint) -> Result<()> {
        Ok(())
    }
    fn capabilities(&self) -> PluginCapabilities {
        PluginCapabilities {
            supports_rollback: false,
            supports_checkpoints: true,
            supports_verification: true,
            atomic_operations: false,
        }
    }
}
inventory::submit! {crate::default_registry::PluginReg::new("users",|_ctx|std::sync::Arc::new(UsersPlugin::new()))}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};
    use tokio::time::Duration;
    use zbus::{connection::Builder, Guid};

    const USER_PATH: &str = "/org/freedesktop/Accounts/User1000";

    #[derive(Debug, zbus::DBusError)]
    #[zbus(prefix = "org.freedesktop.Accounts.Error")]
    enum FixtureError {
        UserDoesNotExist(String),
        Failed(String),
    }

    #[derive(Clone)]
    struct FixtureState {
        user: Arc<Mutex<Option<UserRecord>>>,
        calls: Arc<Mutex<Vec<String>>>,
        fail_shell: bool,
    }
    #[derive(Clone)]
    struct ManagerFixture(FixtureState);
    #[derive(Clone)]
    struct UserFixture(FixtureState);

    #[zbus::interface(name = "org.freedesktop.Accounts")]
    impl ManagerFixture {
        async fn list_cached_users(&self) -> Vec<OwnedObjectPath> {
            if self.0.user.lock().unwrap().is_some() {
                vec![OwnedObjectPath::try_from(USER_PATH).unwrap()]
            } else {
                vec![]
            }
        }
        async fn find_user_by_name(
            &self,
            name: &str,
        ) -> std::result::Result<OwnedObjectPath, FixtureError> {
            if name == "provider-failure" {
                return Err(FixtureError::Failed("provider unavailable".into()));
            }
            match self.0.user.lock().unwrap().as_ref() {
                Some(user) if user.username == name => {
                    Ok(OwnedObjectPath::try_from(USER_PATH).unwrap())
                }
                _ => Err(FixtureError::UserDoesNotExist(name.into())),
            }
        }
        async fn create_user(
            &self,
            name: &str,
            real_name: &str,
            account_type: i32,
        ) -> std::result::Result<OwnedObjectPath, FixtureError> {
            self.0.calls.lock().unwrap().push("CreateUser".into());
            let account_type = AccountType::from_code(account_type)
                .map_err(|error| FixtureError::Failed(error.to_string()))?;
            *self.0.user.lock().unwrap() = Some(UserRecord {
                uid: 1000,
                username: name.into(),
                real_name: real_name.into(),
                account_type,
                shell: "/bin/sh".into(),
                system_account: false,
            });
            Ok(OwnedObjectPath::try_from(USER_PATH).unwrap())
        }
        async fn delete_user(
            &self,
            uid: i64,
            _remove_files: bool,
        ) -> std::result::Result<(), FixtureError> {
            self.0.calls.lock().unwrap().push("DeleteUser".into());
            if uid != 1000 {
                return Err(FixtureError::UserDoesNotExist(uid.to_string()));
            }
            *self.0.user.lock().unwrap() = None;
            Ok(())
        }
    }

    #[zbus::interface(name = "org.freedesktop.Accounts.User")]
    impl UserFixture {
        async fn set_real_name(&self, value: &str) {
            self.0.calls.lock().unwrap().push("SetRealName".into());
            self.0.user.lock().unwrap().as_mut().unwrap().real_name = value.into();
        }
        async fn set_shell(&self, value: &str) -> std::result::Result<(), FixtureError> {
            self.0.calls.lock().unwrap().push("SetShell".into());
            if self.0.fail_shell {
                return Err(FixtureError::Failed("shell rejected".into()));
            }
            self.0.user.lock().unwrap().as_mut().unwrap().shell = value.into();
            Ok(())
        }
        async fn set_account_type(&self, value: i32) -> std::result::Result<(), FixtureError> {
            self.0.calls.lock().unwrap().push("SetAccountType".into());
            self.0.user.lock().unwrap().as_mut().unwrap().account_type =
                AccountType::from_code(value)
                    .map_err(|error| FixtureError::Failed(error.to_string()))?;
            Ok(())
        }
        #[zbus(property)]
        async fn uid(&self) -> u64 {
            self.0.user.lock().unwrap().as_ref().unwrap().uid
        }
        #[zbus(property)]
        async fn user_name(&self) -> String {
            self.0
                .user
                .lock()
                .unwrap()
                .as_ref()
                .unwrap()
                .username
                .clone()
        }
        #[zbus(property)]
        async fn real_name(&self) -> String {
            self.0
                .user
                .lock()
                .unwrap()
                .as_ref()
                .unwrap()
                .real_name
                .clone()
        }
        #[zbus(property)]
        async fn account_type(&self) -> i32 {
            self.0
                .user
                .lock()
                .unwrap()
                .as_ref()
                .unwrap()
                .account_type
                .code()
        }
        #[zbus(property)]
        async fn shell(&self) -> String {
            self.0.user.lock().unwrap().as_ref().unwrap().shell.clone()
        }
        #[zbus(property)]
        async fn system_account(&self) -> bool {
            self.0.user.lock().unwrap().as_ref().unwrap().system_account
        }
    }

    async fn fixture(
        user: Option<UserRecord>,
        fail_shell: bool,
    ) -> (
        zbus::Connection,
        DbusAccountsProvider,
        Arc<Mutex<Vec<String>>>,
    ) {
        let (server_stream, client_stream) = tokio::net::UnixStream::pair().unwrap();
        let calls = Arc::new(Mutex::new(Vec::new()));
        let state = FixtureState {
            user: Arc::new(Mutex::new(user)),
            calls: calls.clone(),
            fail_shell,
        };
        let server = Builder::unix_stream(server_stream)
            .server(Guid::generate())
            .unwrap()
            .p2p()
            .serve_at(MANAGER_PATH, ManagerFixture(state.clone()))
            .unwrap()
            .serve_at(USER_PATH, UserFixture(state))
            .unwrap()
            .build();
        let client = Builder::unix_stream(client_stream).p2p().build();
        let (server, client) = tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(3), async {
            tokio::try_join!(server, client)
        })
        .await
        .unwrap()
        .unwrap();
        (server, DbusAccountsProvider { connection: client }, calls)
    }
    fn user() -> UserRecord {
        UserRecord {
            uid: 1000,
            username: "alice".into(),
            real_name: "Alice".into(),
            account_type: AccountType::Standard,
            shell: "/bin/sh".into(),
            system_account: false,
        }
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn all_four_methods_use_accountsservice_and_typed_readback() {
        let (_server, provider, calls) = fixture(None, false).await;
        let created = dispatch_with_provider(
            &provider,
            "create_user",
            &serde_json::json!({"username":"alice","real_name":"Alice","account_type":"standard"}),
        )
        .await
        .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(created["user"]["uid"], 1000);
        let modified=dispatch_with_provider(&provider,"modify_user",&serde_json::json!({"username":"alice","real_name":"Alice A","shell":"/bin/bash","account_type":"administrator"})).await.unwrap();
        assert_eq!(modified["user"]["shell"], "/bin/bash");
        let listed = dispatch_with_provider(&provider, "list_users", &serde_json::json!({}))
            .await
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(listed["scope"], "cached_accounts");
        assert_eq!(listed["exhaustive"], false);
        assert_eq!(listed["total"], 1);
        let deleted = dispatch_with_provider(
            &provider,
            "delete_user",
            &serde_json::json!({"username":"alice","remove_files":true}),
        )
        .await
        .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(deleted["deleted"], true);
        assert_eq!(
            *calls.lock().unwrap(),
            vec![
                "CreateUser",
                "SetRealName",
                "SetShell",
                "SetAccountType",
                "DeleteUser"
            ]
        );
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn modify_noop_and_partial_failure_are_honest() {
        let (_server, provider, _) = fixture(Some(user()), false).await;
        let output = dispatch_with_provider(
            &provider,
            "modify_user",
            &serde_json::json!({"username":"alice","real_name":"Alice"}),
        )
        .await
        .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(output["changed"], false);

        let (_server, provider, calls) = fixture(Some(user()), true).await;
        let error = dispatch_with_provider(
            &provider,
            "modify_user",
            &serde_json::json!({"username":"alice","real_name":"Applied","shell":"/bad"}),
        )
        .await
        .unwrap_err();
        assert!(error.to_string().contains("after fields"));
        assert_eq!(*calls.lock().unwrap(), vec!["SetRealName", "SetShell"]);
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn unsupported_old_fields_and_missing_users_are_distinct() {
        let (_server, provider, calls) = fixture(None, false).await;
        assert!(dispatch_with_provider(&provider,"create_user",&serde_json::json!({"username":"alice","real_name":"Alice","account_type":"standard","uid":1000})).await.is_err());
        assert!(calls.lock().unwrap().is_empty());
        let deleted = dispatch_with_provider(
            &provider,
            "delete_user",
            &serde_json::json!({"username":"absent"}),
        )
        .await
        .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(deleted["deleted"], false);

        let error = dispatch_with_provider(
            &provider,
            "delete_user",
            &serde_json::json!({"username":"provider-failure"}),
        )
        .await
        .unwrap_err();
        assert!(error.to_string().contains("FindUserByName"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn schema_is_typed_and_preserves_capability_ids() {
        let schema = users_schema();
        assert_eq!(schema.methods.len(), 4);
        assert!(schema.capabilities.contains_key("users.write"));
        assert!(schema.capabilities.contains_key("users.read"));
        let encoded = serde_json::to_string(&schema).unwrap();
        assert!(!encoded.contains("AckOutput"));
        assert!(!encoded.contains("groups"));
    }
}
</file>

<file path="op-plugins/src/state_plugins/web_ui_methods.rs">
//! Provider-free Web UI facade plans over the canonical Gemma UI workspace.

use anyhow::{anyhow, Context, Result};
use op_state_store::{PluginSchema, SideEffect};
use serde_json::Value;

use super::gemma_brain::workspace::{
    UiHandleEventInput, UiHandleEventOutput, UiSpecInput, UiSpecMutationOutput, UiSpecOutput,
    UiUpdateSpecInput,
};

pub const TARGET_PLUGIN_ID: &str = "gemma_brain";

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub struct TargetPlan {
    pub plugin_id: &'static str,
    pub method: &'static str,
    pub required_capability: String,
    pub args: Value,
}

pub fn target_method_for(method: &str) -> Option<&'static str> {
    match method {
        "render_page" => Some("get_ui_spec"),
        "update_component" => Some("update_ui_spec"),
        "handle_event" => Some("handle_ui_event"),
        _ => None,
    }
}

pub fn target_capability(target_method: &str) -> Result<String> {
    let schema = super::gemma_brain::gemma_brain_schema();
    let declaration = schema.methods.get(target_method).ok_or_else(|| {
        anyhow!("gemma_brain schema does not declare target method '{target_method}'")
    })?;
    Ok(schema
        .resolve_method_capability(declaration)
        .capability()
        .to_owned())
}

pub fn declare_methods(schema: &mut PluginSchema) {
    let target = super::gemma_brain::gemma_brain_schema();
    for (key, transport, target_method, subid, read) in [
        (
            "render_page",
            "RenderPage",
            "get_ui_spec",
            "obs.software.plugin.web-ui.render-page@v2",
            true,
        ),
        (
            "update_component",
            "UpdateComponent",
            "update_ui_spec",
            "mut.software.plugin.web-ui.update-component@v2",
            false,
        ),
        (
            "handle_event",
            "HandleEvent",
            "handle_ui_event",
            "mut.software.plugin.web-ui.handle-event@v2",
            false,
        ),
    ] {
        let owned = target
            .methods
            .get(target_method)
            .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("gemma_brain must declare {target_method}"));
        let capability = target
            .resolve_method_capability(owned)
            .capability()
            .to_owned();
        let capability_decl = target
            .capabilities
            .get(&capability)
            .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("gemma_brain must declare capability {capability}"))
            .clone();
        let mut declaration = owned.clone();
        declaration.name = transport.to_owned();
        declaration.subid = subid.to_owned();
        declaration.side_effect = if read {
            SideEffect::Read
        } else {
            SideEffect::Mutation
        };
        schema.methods.insert(key.to_owned(), declaration);
        schema.capabilities.insert(capability, capability_decl);
    }
}

pub fn plan_method(method: &str, args: &Value) -> Result<TargetPlan> {
    let (target_method, target_args) = match method {
        "render_page" => {
            let input: UiSpecInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())
                .context("invalid web_ui.render_page arguments")?;
            ("get_ui_spec", serde_json::to_value(input)?)
        }
        "update_component" => {
            let input: UiUpdateSpecInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())
                .context("invalid web_ui.update_component arguments")?;
            ("update_ui_spec", serde_json::to_value(input)?)
        }
        "handle_event" => {
            let input: UiHandleEventInput = serde_json::from_value(args.clone())
                .context("invalid web_ui.handle_event arguments")?;
            ("handle_ui_event", serde_json::to_value(input)?)
        }
        other => return Err(anyhow!("unknown web_ui method: {other}")),
    };
    Ok(TargetPlan {
        plugin_id: TARGET_PLUGIN_ID,
        method: target_method,
        required_capability: target_capability(target_method)?,
        args: target_args,
    })
}

pub fn complete_method(method: &str, target_result: Value) -> Result<Value> {
    match method {
        "render_page" => Ok(serde_json::to_value(
            serde_json::from_value::<UiSpecOutput>(target_result)
                .context("gemma_brain.get_ui_spec returned an invalid result")?,
        )?),
        "update_component" => Ok(serde_json::to_value(
            serde_json::from_value::<UiSpecMutationOutput>(target_result)
                .context("gemma_brain.update_ui_spec returned an invalid result")?,
        )?),
        "handle_event" => Ok(serde_json::to_value(
            serde_json::from_value::<UiHandleEventOutput>(target_result)
                .context("gemma_brain.handle_ui_event returned an invalid result")?,
        )?),
        other => Err(anyhow!("unknown web_ui method: {other}")),
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn facade_reuses_exact_target_contracts_and_capabilities() {
        let web = super::super::web_ui::web_ui_schema();
        let gemma = super::super::gemma_brain::gemma_brain_schema();
        for (facade, target) in [
            ("render_page", "get_ui_spec"),
            ("update_component", "update_ui_spec"),
            ("handle_event", "handle_ui_event"),
        ] {
            let outer = &web.methods[facade];
            let inner = &gemma.methods[target];
            assert_eq!(outer.args, inner.args);
            assert_eq!(outer.returns, inner.returns);
            assert_eq!(
                web.resolve_method_capability(outer).capability(),
                gemma.resolve_method_capability(inner).capability()
            );
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn plans_exact_workspace_calls_and_rejects_legacy_or_event_inputs() {
        let render = plan_method("render_page", &serde_json::json!({"spec_id":"spec"})).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(render.method, "get_ui_spec");
        assert_eq!(render.args, serde_json::json!({"spec_id":"spec"}));

        let update = plan_method(
            "update_component",
            &serde_json::json!({
                "spec_id":"spec",
                "expected_revision":3,
                "element_id":"heading",
                "properties":{"text":"updated"}
            }),
        )
        .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(update.method, "update_ui_spec");
        assert_eq!(
            update.required_capability,
            target_capability("update_ui_spec").unwrap()
        );

        assert!(plan_method(
            "render_page",
            &serde_json::json!({"page_id":"old","locale":"en"})
        )
        .is_err());
        assert!(plan_method(
            "update_component",
            &serde_json::json!({"component_path":"old","properties":{}})
        )
        .is_err());
        let event = plan_method(
            "handle_event",
            &serde_json::json!({"spec_id":"spec","expected_revision":1,"element_id":"tile","event":"resize"}),
        )
        .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(event.method, "handle_ui_event");
        assert!(plan_method(
            "handle_event",
            &serde_json::json!({"event_type":"submit","payload":{}})
        )
        .is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn completion_preserves_exact_workspace_shape_and_rejects_fake_ack() {
        let read = complete_method(
            "render_page",
            serde_json::json!({"spec":null,"render_admitted":false}),
        )
        .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            read,
            serde_json::json!({"spec":null,"render_admitted":false})
        );
        assert!(complete_method("render_page", serde_json::json!({"success":true})).is_err());
        assert!(complete_method("update_component", serde_json::json!({"success":true})).is_err());
    }
}
</file>

<file path="op-plugins/src/state_plugins/web_ui.rs">
//! Web UI Plugin - serves embedded React SPA
//!
//! Follows the 3-section plugin pattern:
//! - SECTION 1: Immutable Identity (set once, never changes)
//! - SECTION 2: Tunable Config (can change, snowball tracks all changes)
//! - SECTION 3: Capabilities (what this plugin can do)
//!
//! Uses op-identity crate for WireGuard-based authentication.

use anyhow::Result;
use async_trait::async_trait;
use op_snowball::PluginFootprint;
use op_state::{ApplyResult, Checkpoint, PluginCapabilities, StateDiff, StatePlugin};
use op_state_store::PluginSchema;
#[cfg(test)]
use op_state_store::{Constraint, FieldSchema, FieldType};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
#[cfg(test)]
use simd_json::json;
use simd_json::{prelude::*, OwnedValue as Value};
use std::collections::HashMap;

// ============================================================================
// SECTION 1: IMMUTABLE IDENTITY (set once, never changes)
// ============================================================================

/// Plugin identity - immutable after creation.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "sch.software.plugin.web-ui.identity.schema@v1"))]
pub struct WebUiIdentity {
    /// Plugin name (immutable).
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "obs.software.plugin.web-ui.identity.name@v1"))]
    pub name: String,
    /// Semantic version.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "obs.software.plugin.web-ui.identity.version@v1"))]
    pub version: String,
    /// Plugin classification.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "obs.software.plugin.web-ui.identity.plugin-type@v1"))]
    pub plugin_type: String,
    /// Asset serving driver.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "obs.software.plugin.web-ui.identity.driver@v1"))]
    pub driver: String,
}

impl Default for WebUiIdentity {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            name: "web_ui".to_string(),
            version: "3.0.0".to_string(),
            plugin_type: "ui".to_string(),
            driver: "rust-embed".to_string(),
        }
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// SECTION 2: TUNABLE CONFIG (can change, snowball tracks all changes)
// ============================================================================

/// Tunable configuration - changes tracked in snowball.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "sch.software.plugin.web-ui.tunables.schema@v1"))]
pub struct WebUiTunables {
    /// Whether UI serving is enabled.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "mut.software.plugin.web-ui.tunables.enabled@v1"))]
    pub enabled: bool,
    /// CORS allowed origins.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "mut.software.plugin.web-ui.tunables.cors-origins@v1"))]
    pub cors_origins: Vec<String>,
    /// Enable gzip/brotli compression.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "mut.software.plugin.web-ui.tunables.compression@v1"))]
    pub compression: bool,
    /// Cache TTL for static assets (seconds).
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "mut.software.plugin.web-ui.tunables.cache-ttl@v1"))]
    pub cache_ttl: u64,
    /// UI theme preference.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "mut.software.plugin.web-ui.tunables.theme@v1"))]
    pub theme: String,
    /// Feature flags for progressive rollout.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "mut.software.plugin.web-ui.tunables.feature-flags@v1"))]
    pub feature_flags: HashMap<String, bool>,
    /// WebSocket configuration.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "mut.software.plugin.web-ui.tunables.websocket@v1"))]
    pub websocket: WebSocketConfig,
    /// API configuration.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "mut.software.plugin.web-ui.tunables.api@v1"))]
    pub api: ApiConfig,
    /// Security configuration.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "mut.software.plugin.web-ui.tunables.security@v1"))]
    pub security: SecurityConfig,
}

impl Default for WebUiTunables {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            enabled: true,
            cors_origins: vec!["*".to_string()],
            compression: true,
            cache_ttl: 86400,
            theme: "dark".to_string(),
            feature_flags: HashMap::new(),
            websocket: WebSocketConfig::default(),
            api: ApiConfig::default(),
            security: SecurityConfig::default(),
        }
    }
}

/// WebSocket runtime configuration.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "sch.software.plugin.web-ui.websocket.schema@v1"))]
pub struct WebSocketConfig {
    /// Whether WebSocket is enabled.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "mut.software.plugin.web-ui.websocket.enabled@v1"))]
    pub enabled: bool,
    /// Maximum concurrent WebSocket connections.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "mut.software.plugin.web-ui.websocket.max-connections@v1"))]
    pub max_connections: u32,
    /// Ping interval in milliseconds.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "mut.software.plugin.web-ui.websocket.ping-interval-ms@v1"))]
    pub ping_interval_ms: u64,
    /// Maximum inbound message size in bytes.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "mut.software.plugin.web-ui.websocket.message-size-limit@v1"))]
    pub message_size_limit: usize,
}

impl Default for WebSocketConfig {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            enabled: true,
            max_connections: 1000,
            ping_interval_ms: 30000,
            message_size_limit: 1024 * 1024,
        }
    }
}

/// API runtime configuration.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "sch.software.plugin.web-ui.api.schema@v1"))]
pub struct ApiConfig {
    /// Rate limit in requests per second.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "mut.software.plugin.web-ui.api.rate-limit-rps@v1"))]
    pub rate_limit_rps: u32,
    /// Request timeout in milliseconds.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "mut.software.plugin.web-ui.api.timeout-ms@v1"))]
    pub timeout_ms: u64,
    /// Maximum request payload size in bytes.
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "mut.software.plugin.web-ui.api.max-payload-bytes@v1"))]
    pub max_payload_bytes: usize,
}

impl Default for ApiConfig {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            rate_limit_rps: 100,
            timeout_ms: 30000,
            max_payload_bytes: 10 * 1024 * 1024,
        }
    }
}

/// Security runtime configuration.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[schemars(extend("x-oscal-subid" = "sch.software.plugin.web-ui.security.schema@v1"))]
pub struct SecurityConfig {
    /// Whether authentication is required.
    #[serde(default)]

impl Default for SecurityConfig {

// ============================================================================
// PLUGIN IMPLEMENTATION
// ============================================================================

/// Web UI State Plugin
pub struct WebUiPlugin {
    identity: WebUiIdentity,
    tunables: WebUiTunables,
    capabilities: WebUiCapabilities,
    #[allow(dead_code)]
    snowball_sender: Option<tokio::sync::mpsc::UnboundedSender<PluginFootprint>>,
}

impl WebUiPlugin {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            identity: WebUiIdentity::default(),
            tunables: WebUiTunables::default(),
            capabilities: WebUiCapabilities::default(),
            snowball_sender: None,
        }
    }

    pub fn with_snowball_sender(
        snowball_sender: tokio::sync::mpsc::UnboundedSender<PluginFootprint>,
    ) -> Self {
        Self {
            identity: WebUiIdentity::default(),
            tunables: WebUiTunables::default(),
            capabilities: WebUiCapabilities::default(),
            snowball_sender: Some(snowball_sender),
        }
    }

    /// Get identity.
    pub fn identity(&self) -> &WebUiIdentity {
        &self.identity
    }

    /// Get tunables.
    pub fn tunables(&self) -> &WebUiTunables {
        &self.tunables
    }

    /// Get capabilities.
    pub fn capabilities(&self) -> &WebUiCapabilities {
        &self.capabilities
    }

    /// Check if a path is immutable.
    pub fn is_path_immutable(path: &str) -> bool {
        let immutable_paths = [
            "/identity",
            "/identity/name",
            "/identity/plugin_type",
            "/identity/driver",
        ];
        immutable_paths.iter().any(|p| path.starts_with(p))
    }

    /// Validate tunables against schema.
    pub fn validate_tunables(tunables: &Value) -> Result<()> {
        if !tunables.is_object() {
            anyhow::bail!("Tunables must be an object");
        }

        if tunables.get("enabled").is_none() {
            anyhow::bail!("Missing required field: enabled");
        }

        // Validate theme enum.
        if let Some(theme) = tunables.get("theme") {
            if let Some(theme_str) = theme.as_str() {
                if !["dark", "light", "system"].contains(&theme_str) {
                    anyhow::bail!("Invalid theme: must be dark, light, or system");
                }
            }
        }

        Ok(())
    }

    pub(crate) fn current_state() -> WebUiState {
        WebUiState {
            identity: WebUiIdentity::default(),
            tunables: WebUiTunables::default(),
            capabilities: WebUiCapabilities::default(),
        }
    }
}

impl Default for WebUiPlugin {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}

#[async_trait]
impl StatePlugin for WebUiPlugin {
    fn name(&self) -> &str {
        &self.identity.name
    }

    fn version(&self) -> &str {
        &self.identity.version
    }

    fn schema(&self) -> Option<op_state_store::PluginSchema> {
        let mut schema = web_ui_schema();
        super::common::oscal::ensure_category_metadata_fields(&mut schema);
        Some(schema)
    }

    fn is_available(&self) -> bool {
        true // UI is always available (embedded).
    }

    fn unavailable_reason(&self) -> String {
        String::new() // Never unavailable.
    }

    async fn calculate_diff(&self, current: &Value, desired: &Value) -> Result<StateDiff> {
        let _ = (current, desired);
        anyhow::bail!(
            "generic web_ui state diff is unsupported; use its canonical principal/session-owned workspace methods"
        )
    }

    async fn apply_state(&self, diff: &StateDiff) -> Result<ApplyResult> {
        let _ = diff;
        anyhow::bail!(
            "generic web_ui state apply is unsupported; use its canonical principal/session-owned workspace methods"
        )
    }

    async fn verify_state(&self, desired: &Value) -> Result<bool> {
        let _ = desired;
        anyhow::bail!(
            "generic web_ui verification is unsupported; use a canonical workspace read receipt"
        )
    }

    async fn create_checkpoint(&self) -> Result<Checkpoint> {
        anyhow::bail!(
            "generic web_ui checkpoints are unsupported; workspace revisions are owned by the canonical durable document methods"
        )
    }

    async fn rollback(&self, checkpoint: &Checkpoint) -> Result<()> {
        let _ = checkpoint;
        anyhow::bail!(
            "generic web_ui rollback is unsupported; no canonical rollback method is declared"
        )
    }

    fn capabilities(&self) -> PluginCapabilities {
        PluginCapabilities {
            supports_rollback: false,
            supports_checkpoints: false,
            supports_verification: false,
            atomic_operations: false,
        }
    }
}

/// Derived `web_ui` schema from the typed [`WebUiState`] struct via schemars.
pub(crate) fn web_ui_schema() -> PluginSchema {
    let root = serde_json::to_value(schemars::schema_for!(WebUiState))
        .expect("schemars schema serializes to JSON");
    let mut schema = super::schemars_adapter::plugin_schema_from_json(
        "web_ui",
        "3.0.0",
        "Web UI facade over the principal/session-owned Gemma workspace; no independent page or component state",
        &root,
    );
    let state = simd_json::serde::to_owned_value(&WebUiState::default())
        .expect("WebUiState default serializes");
    super::schemars_adapter::apply_state_defaults(&mut schema, &state);

    super::web_ui_methods::declare_methods(&mut schema);
    schema.dependencies = vec!["gemma_brain".to_owned()];

    schema
}

// ============================================================================
// TESTS
// ============================================================================

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::state_plugins::common::oscal::validate_subid;
    use crate::state_plugins::schemars_adapter::schema_diffs;
    use serde_json::Value as JVal;

    fn collect_subids(value: &JVal, out: &mut Vec<String>) {
        if let Some(obj) = value.as_object() {
            if let Some(JVal::String(subid)) = obj.get("x-oscal-subid") {
                out.push(subid.clone());
            }
            for v in obj.values() {
                collect_subids(v, out);
            }
        }
        if let Some(arr) = value.as_array() {
            for v in arr {
                collect_subids(v, out);
            }
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_default_identity() {
        let identity = WebUiIdentity::default();
        assert_eq!(identity.name, "web_ui");
        assert_eq!(identity.version, "3.0.0");
        assert_eq!(identity.plugin_type, "ui");
        assert_eq!(identity.driver, "rust-embed");
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_default_tunables() {
        let tunables = WebUiTunables::default();
        assert!(tunables.enabled);
        assert!(tunables.compression);
        assert_eq!(tunables.theme, "dark");
        assert_eq!(tunables.cache_ttl, 86400);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_default_capabilities() {
        let caps = WebUiCapabilities::default();
        assert!(caps.can_serve_static);
        assert!(caps.can_websocket);
        assert!(!caps.supports_hot_reload);
        assert!(!caps.requires_root);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_immutable_paths() {
        assert!(WebUiPlugin::is_path_immutable("/identity/name"));
        assert!(WebUiPlugin::is_path_immutable("/identity/plugin_type"));
        assert!(!WebUiPlugin::is_path_immutable("/tunables/enabled"));
        assert!(!WebUiPlugin::is_path_immutable("/tunables/theme"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_property_schema() {
        let schema = WebUiTunables::property_schema();
        assert!(schema.contains(&"enabled".to_string()));
        assert!(schema.contains(&"theme".to_string()));
        assert!(schema.contains(&"websocket".to_string()));
    }

    #[tokio::test]
    async fn generic_lifecycle_hooks_never_claim_workspace_effects() {
        let plugin = WebUiPlugin::new();
        let current = simd_json::serde::to_owned_value(WebUiState::default()).unwrap();
        let mut desired_state = WebUiState::default();
        desired_state.tunables.theme = "light".into();
        let desired = simd_json::serde::to_owned_value(desired_state).unwrap();
        assert!(plugin.calculate_diff(&current, &desired).await.is_err());
        let diff = StateDiff {
            plugin: plugin.name().into(),
            actions: Vec::new(),
            metadata: op_state::DiffMetadata {
                timestamp: 0,
                current_hash: String::new(),
                desired_hash: String::new(),
            },
        };
        assert!(plugin.apply_state(&diff).await.is_err());
        assert!(plugin.verify_state(&desired).await.is_err());
        assert!(plugin.create_checkpoint().await.is_err());
        let checkpoint = Checkpoint {
            id: "untrusted-fixture".into(),
            plugin: plugin.name().into(),
            timestamp: 0,
            state_snapshot: simd_json::json!(null),
            backend_checkpoint: None,
        };
        assert!(plugin.rollback(&checkpoint).await.is_err());
        let capabilities = StatePlugin::capabilities(&plugin);
        assert!(!capabilities.supports_rollback);
        assert!(!capabilities.supports_checkpoints);
        assert!(!capabilities.supports_verification);
        assert!(!capabilities.atomic_operations);
    }

    #[test]
    fn all_subids_are_valid() {
        let root = serde_json::to_value(schemars::schema_for!(WebUiState))
            .expect("schemars schema serializes to JSON");
        let mut subids = Vec::new();
        collect_subids(&root, &mut subids);
        assert!(!subids.is_empty(), "expected at least one subid");
        for subid in subids {
            assert!(validate_subid(&subid).is_ok(), "invalid subid: {subid}");
        }
    }
}

// Self-registration: the plugin registry discovers this via inventory
// (single source of the catalog; no central dispatch list).
inventory::submit! {
    crate::default_registry::PluginReg::new("web_ui", |_ctx| std::sync::Arc::new(WebUiPlugin::new()))
}

//! A.N.N.A. Scribe façade over the single decoy WireGuard kernel owner.

use anyhow::Result;
use async_trait::async_trait;
use op_state::{ApplyResult, Checkpoint, PluginCapabilities, StateDiff, StatePlugin};
use op_state_store::{CapabilityDecl, PluginSchema, SideEffect};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use simd_json::OwnedValue as Value;
use std::collections::BTreeMap;

use super::plugin_scaffold_helpers::method_decl_from_schemars_with_output;
use super::wireguard::{WireGuardDeviceConfig, WireGuardInterface};

const PLUGIN_NAME: &str = "wg_opdbus";
const PLUGIN_VERSION: &str = "2.0.0";
const PLUGIN_CATEGORY: &str = "network";
const PLUGIN_DESCRIPTION: &str = "A.N.N.A. Scribe identity binding on the decoy WireGuard owner";
const PLUGIN_DISPLAY_NAME: &str = "A.N.N.A. Scribe WireGuard Identity";

pub const ANNA_SCRIBE_PRINCIPAL_ID: &str = "did:op:service:anna-scribe";
pub const ANNA_SCRIBE_PERSONA_ID: &str = "anna-scribe";
pub const ANNA_SCRIBE_EMAIL: &str = "anna.scribe@3tched.com";
pub const ANNA_SCRIBE_PLUGIN_REF: &str = PLUGIN_NAME;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct AnnaScribeServicePersona {
    principal_id: String,
    persona_id: String,
    email: String,
    plugin_ref: String,
}

impl Default for AnnaScribeServicePersona {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            principal_id: ANNA_SCRIBE_PRINCIPAL_ID.into(),
            persona_id: ANNA_SCRIBE_PERSONA_ID.into(),
            email: ANNA_SCRIBE_EMAIL.into(),
            plugin_ref: ANNA_SCRIBE_PLUGIN_REF.into(),
        }
    }
}

impl<'de> Deserialize<'de> for AnnaScribeServicePersona {
    fn deserialize<D>(deserializer: D) -> std::result::Result<Self, D::Error>
    where
        D: serde::Deserializer<'de>,
    {
        #[derive(Deserialize)]
        #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
        struct WireIdentity {
            principal_id: String,
            persona_id: String,
            email: String,
            plugin_ref: String,
        }
        let supplied = WireIdentity::deserialize(deserializer)?;
        if supplied.principal_id != ANNA_SCRIBE_PRINCIPAL_ID
            || supplied.persona_id != ANNA_SCRIBE_PERSONA_ID
            || supplied.email != ANNA_SCRIBE_EMAIL
            || supplied.plugin_ref != ANNA_SCRIBE_PLUGIN_REF
        {
            return Err(serde::de::Error::custom(
                "A.N.N.A. Scribe service-persona identity is immutable",
            ));
        }
        Ok(Self::default())
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
#[schemars(extend("x-immutable-paths" = ["/service_persona"]))]
pub struct WgOpdbusState {
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(extend("readOnly" = true))]
    pub service_persona: AnnaScribeServicePersona,
    pub interface: Option<WireGuardInterface>,
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(extend("x-opdbus-exact-json-schema" = true))]
    pub addresses: Vec<String>,
    pub mtu: Option<u32>,
    pub admin_up: bool,
}

/// Complete native projection for the shared decoy WireGuard owner.
///
/// Every allowlisted interface has an entry. An absent kernel interface is
/// represented by a default status whose `interface` is `None`, so consumers
/// can distinguish known absence from an omitted sibling.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
#[schemars(
    extend("x-immutable-paths" = ["/service_persona"]),
    extend("x-opdbus-exact-json-schema" = true)
)]
pub struct WgOpdbusAggregateState {
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(extend("readOnly" = true))]
    pub service_persona: AnnaScribeServicePersona,
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(extend("x-opdbus-exact-json-schema" = true))]
    pub interfaces: BTreeMap<String, WgOpdbusState>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct CreateInterfaceInput {
    pub interface_name: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(extend("x-opdbus-exact-json-schema" = true))]
    pub addresses: Vec<String>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub mtu: Option<u32>,
    #[serde(default)]
    #[schemars(extend("x-opdbus-exact-json-schema" = true))]
    pub device: WireGuardDeviceConfig,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct GetStatusInput {
    pub interface_name: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub struct CreateInterfaceOutput {
    pub status: WgOpdbusState,
}

pub type WgOpdbusStatusOutput = WgOpdbusState;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default)]
pub struct WgOpdbusPlugin;
impl WgOpdbusPlugin {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self
    }
}

#[async_trait]
impl StatePlugin for WgOpdbusPlugin {
    fn name(&self) -> &str {
        PLUGIN_NAME
    }
    fn version(&self) -> &str {
        PLUGIN_VERSION
    }
    fn schema(&self) -> Option<PluginSchema> {
        Some(wg_opdbus_schema())
    }
    async fn calculate_diff(&self, _current: &Value, _desired: &Value) -> Result<StateDiff> {
        anyhow::bail!("wg_opdbus is owned by the authenticated decoy D-Bus service")
    }
    async fn apply_state(&self, _diff: &StateDiff) -> Result<ApplyResult> {
        anyhow::bail!("wg_opdbus is owned by the authenticated decoy D-Bus service")
    }
    async fn verify_state(&self, _desired: &Value) -> Result<bool> {
        anyhow::bail!("wg_opdbus verification requires decoy kernel readback")
    }
    async fn create_checkpoint(&self) -> Result<Checkpoint> {
        anyhow::bail!("wg_opdbus checkpointing is not supported")
    }
    async fn rollback(&self, _checkpoint: &Checkpoint) -> Result<()> {
        anyhow::bail!("wg_opdbus rollback is not supported")
    }
    fn capabilities(&self) -> PluginCapabilities {
        PluginCapabilities {
            supports_rollback: false,
            supports_checkpoints: false,
            supports_verification: false,
            atomic_operations: false,
        }
    }
}

pub(crate) fn wg_opdbus_schema() -> PluginSchema {
    let root = serde_json::to_value(schemars::schema_for!(WgOpdbusAggregateState))
        .expect("schema serializes");
    let mut schema = super::schemars_adapter::plugin_schema_from_json(
        PLUGIN_NAME,
        PLUGIN_VERSION,
        PLUGIN_DESCRIPTION,
        &root,
    );
    schema.category = PLUGIN_CATEGORY.into();
    schema.display_name = Some(PLUGIN_DISPLAY_NAME.into());
    schema.dependencies.push("wireguard".into());
    schema.methods.insert(
        "create_interface".into(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<CreateInterfaceInput, CreateInterfaceOutput>(
            "create_interface",
            SideEffect::Mutation,
            false,
            "wg_opdbus.invoke",
            "mut.network.wg-opdbus.interface.create@v2",
        ),
    );
    schema.methods.insert(
        "get_status".into(),
        method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<GetStatusInput, WgOpdbusStatusOutput>(
            "get_status",
            SideEffect::Read,
            true,
            "wg_opdbus.read",
            "obs.network.wg-opdbus.status.get@v2",
        ),
    );
    schema.example = Some({
        let mut bytes =
            serde_json::to_vec(&WgOpdbusAggregateState::default()).expect("default serializes");
        simd_json::to_owned_value(&mut bytes).expect("default is JSON")
    });
    schema.capabilities.insert(
        "wg_opdbus.invoke".into(),
        CapabilityDecl {
            id: "wg_opdbus.invoke".into(),
            description: "Grants: create_interface.".into(),
        },
    );
    schema.capabilities.insert(
        "wg_opdbus.read".into(),
        CapabilityDecl {
            id: "wg_opdbus.read".into(),
            description: "Grants: get_status.".into(),
        },
    );
    schema
}

inventory::submit! { crate::default_registry::PluginReg::new(PLUGIN_NAME, |_ctx| std::sync::Arc::new(WgOpdbusPlugin::new())) }

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    #[test]
    fn canonical_service_persona_is_immutable() {
        let identity = serde_json::to_value(AnnaScribeServicePersona::default()).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(identity["principal_id"], ANNA_SCRIBE_PRINCIPAL_ID);
        let mut changed = identity;
        changed["email"] = serde_json::json!("caller@example.invalid");
        assert!(serde_json::from_value::<AnnaScribeServicePersona>(changed).is_err());
    }
    #[test]
    fn retired_netmaker_and_config_path_fields_are_absent() {
        let schema = wg_opdbus_schema();
        let input = serde_json::to_value(&schema.methods["create_interface"].args).unwrap();
        let text = input.to_string();
        assert!(!text.contains("netmaker"));
        assert!(!text.contains("config_path"));
        assert_eq!(schema.immutable_paths, vec!["/service_persona"]);
    }

    #[test]
    fn state_schema_is_an_exact_aggregate_while_method_outputs_remain_per_interface() {
        let schema = wg_opdbus_schema();
        let interfaces = serde_json::to_value(&schema.fields["interfaces"]).unwrap();
        assert!(interfaces
            .to_string()
            .contains("x-opdbus-exact-json-schema"));

        let output = serde_json::to_value(&schema.methods["get_status"].returns).unwrap();
        assert!(output.to_string().contains("interface"));
        assert!(!output.to_string().contains("interfaces"));
    }
}
</file>

//! Decoy-side Cloudflare WARP account and WireGuard profile contract.

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]

fn default_interface() -> String {

pub struct WgcfState {

pub struct WgcfPlugin {

}
impl WgcfPlugin {
    pub fn new(config: WgcfConfig) -> Self {
        Self { _config: config }
    }
    pub(crate) fn current_state() -> WgcfState {
        WgcfState::default()
    }
}
#[async_trait]
impl StatePlugin for WgcfPlugin {
    fn name(&self) -> &'static str {
        "wgcf"
    }
    fn version(&self) -> &str {
        "2.0.0"
    }
    fn schema(&self) -> Option<PluginSchema> {
        let mut s = wgcf_schema();
        super::common::oscal::ensure_category_metadata_fields(&mut s);
        Some(s)
    }
    fn capabilities(&self) -> PluginCapabilities {
        PluginCapabilities {
            supports_rollback: false,
            supports_checkpoints: false,
            supports_verification: false,
            atomic_operations: false,
        }
    }
    async fn calculate_diff(&self, _: &Value, _: &Value) -> Result<StateDiff> {
        anyhow::bail!("wgcf uses admitted native methods")
    }
    async fn apply_state(&self, _: &StateDiff) -> Result<ApplyResult> {
        anyhow::bail!("wgcf uses admitted native methods")
    }
    async fn verify_state(&self, _: &Value) -> Result<bool> {
        anyhow::bail!("wgcf uses admitted native methods")
    }
    async fn create_checkpoint(&self) -> Result<Checkpoint> {
        anyhow::bail!("wgcf does not support checkpoints")
    }
    async fn rollback(&self, _: &Checkpoint) -> Result<()> {
        anyhow::bail!("wgcf does not support rollback")
    }
}

pub(crate) fn wgcf_schema() -> PluginSchema {
    let root = serde_json::to_value(schemars::schema_for!(WgcfState)).unwrap();
    let mut schema = super::schemars_adapter::plugin_schema_from_json(
        "wgcf",
        "2.0.0",
        "Decoy-owned Cloudflare WARP account and kernel-applied WireGuard profiles; generated DNS values are retained but not installed",
        &root,
    );
    super::schemars_adapter::apply_state_defaults(
        &mut schema,
        &simd_json::serde::to_owned_value(WgcfState::default()).unwrap(),
    );
    macro_rules! m {
        ($id:literal,$i:ty,$o:ty,$e:ident,$cap:literal,$sub:literal) => {
            schema.methods.insert(
                $id.into(),
                method_decl_from_schemars_with_output::<$i, $o>(
                    $id,
                    SideEffect::$e,
                    matches!(SideEffect::$e, SideEffect::Read),
                    $cap,
                    $sub,
                ),
            );
        };
    }
    m!(
        "register",
        RegisterInput,
        WgcfStatusOutput,
        Mutation,
        "wgcf.register",
        "mut.software.plugin.wgcf.register@v2"
    );
    m!(
        "update",
        UpdateInput,
        WgcfStatusOutput,
        Mutation,
        "wgcf.write",
        "mut.software.plugin.wgcf.update@v2"
    );
    m!(
        "status",
        EmptyInput,
        WgcfStatusOutput,
        Read,
        "wgcf.read",
        "obs.software.plugin.wgcf.status@v2"
    );
    m!(
        "rotate_keys",
        EmptyInput,
        WgcfStatusOutput,
        Mutation,
        "wgcf.write",
        "mut.software.plugin.wgcf.keys.rotate@v2"
    );
    m!(
        "set_endpoint",
        SetEndpointInput,
        GenerateConfigOutput,
        Mutation,
        "wgcf.write",
        "mut.software.plugin.wgcf.endpoint.set@v2"
    );
    m!(
        "generate_config",
        GenerateConfigInput,
        GenerateConfigOutput,
        Mutation,
        "wgcf.write",
        "mut.software.plugin.wgcf.config.generate@v2"
    );
    m!(
        "apply_config",
        ApplyConfigInput,
        ApplyConfigOutput,
        Mutation,
        "wgcf.write",
        "mut.software.plugin.wgcf.config.apply@v2"
    );
    m!(
        "refresh",
        RefreshInput,
        WgcfStatusOutput,
        Mutation,
        "wgcf.write",
        "mut.software.plugin.wgcf.refresh@v2"
    );
    for (id, methods) in [
        ("wgcf.read", "status"),
        ("wgcf.register", "register"),
        (
            "wgcf.write",
            "update, rotate_keys, set_endpoint, generate_config, apply_config, refresh",
        ),
    ] {
        schema.capabilities.insert(
            id.into(),
            op_state_store::CapabilityDecl {
                id: id.into(),
                description: format!("Grants: {methods}."),
            },
        );
    }
    schema
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use op_state::StatePlugin;
    #[test]
    fn eight_typed_methods_never_project_secrets() {
        let s = WgcfPlugin::new(WgcfConfig::default()).schema().unwrap();
        assert_eq!(s.version, "2.0.0");
        assert_eq!(s.methods.len(), 8);
        let j = serde_json::to_string(&s).unwrap();
        assert!(!j.contains("private_key"));
        assert!(!j.contains("access_token"));
        assert!(j.contains("accept_tos"));
    }
}
inventory::submit! {crate::default_registry::PluginReg::new("wgcf",|_ctx|std::sync::Arc::new(WgcfPlugin::new(WgcfConfig::default())))}
</file>
