<file path="op-web/src/privacy_routes.rs">
use anyhow::{anyhow, bail, Context, Result};
use base64::Engine as _;
use chrono::Utc;
use ring::hkdf;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};

use crate::users::PrivacyUser;

const DEFAULT_INGRESS_PORT: &str = "ovsbr0-sock";
const DEFAULT_NEXT_HOP: &str = "gbr_wg";
const ROUTE_HKDF_INFO: &[u8] = b"op-dbus/privacy-route/v1";

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct PrivacyRoutesState {
    #[serde(default)]
    pub routes: Vec<PrivacyRoute>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct PrivacyRoute {
    pub name: String,
    pub route_id: String,
    pub user_id: String,
    pub email: String,
    pub wireguard_public_key: String,
    pub assigned_ip: String,
    pub selector_ip: String,
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub container_name: Option<String>,
    pub ingress_port: String,
    pub next_hop: String,
    pub enabled: bool,
    pub created_at: String,
    pub updated_at: String,
}

struct RouteIdKeyLen;

impl hkdf::KeyType for RouteIdKeyLen {
    fn len(&self) -> usize {
        32
    }
}

pub async fn publish_user_privacy_route(
    user: &PrivacyUser,
    container_name: Option<&str>,
) -> Result<String> {
    let route_id = derive_route_id(&user.wg_public_key)?;
    let mut state = crate::state_manager_client::query_plugin_state("privacy_routes")
        .await?
        .unwrap_or(PrivacyRoutesState { routes: Vec::new() });
    upsert_route(
        &mut state,
        PrivacyRoute::from_user(user, route_id.clone(), container_name),
    );
    crate::state_manager_client::apply_plugin_state("privacy_routes", &state).await?;

    Ok(route_id)
}

fn upsert_route(state: &mut PrivacyRoutesState, route: PrivacyRoute) {
    match state
        .routes
        .iter_mut()
        .find(|existing| existing.route_id == route.route_id)
    {
        Some(existing) => {
            let created_at = existing.created_at.clone();
            *existing = route;
            existing.created_at = created_at;
        }
        None => state.routes.push(route),
    }

    state.routes.sort_by(|a, b| a.route_id.cmp(&b.route_id));
}

pub fn derive_route_id(wg_public_key: &str) -> Result<String> {
    let shared_secret = std::env::var("PRIVACY_ROUTE_SHARED_SECRET")
        .context("PRIVACY_ROUTE_SHARED_SECRET is required for privacy route derivation")?;
    if shared_secret.trim().is_empty() {
        bail!("PRIVACY_ROUTE_SHARED_SECRET must not be empty");
    }

    let public_key_bytes = base64::engine::general_purpose::STANDARD
        .decode(wg_public_key.trim())
        .with_context(|| format!("invalid WireGuard public key '{}'", wg_public_key))?;
    if public_key_bytes.len() != 32 {
        bail!(
            "WireGuard public key must decode to 32 bytes, got {}",
            public_key_bytes.len()
        );
    }

    let salt = hkdf::Salt::new(hkdf::HKDF_SHA256, shared_secret.as_bytes());
    let prk = salt.extract(&public_key_bytes);
    let okm = prk
        .expand(&[ROUTE_HKDF_INFO], RouteIdKeyLen)
        .map_err(|_| anyhow!("failed to expand HKDF route ID"))?;
    let mut route_id = [0u8; 32];
    okm.fill(&mut route_id)
        .map_err(|_| anyhow!("failed to derive HKDF route ID bytes"))?;
    Ok(hex::encode(route_id))
}

impl PrivacyRoute {
    fn from_user(user: &PrivacyUser, route_id: String, container_name: Option<&str>) -> Self {
        let now = Utc::now().to_rfc3339();
        Self {
            name: route_id.clone(),
            route_id,
            user_id: user.id.clone(),
            email: user.email.clone(),
            wireguard_public_key: user.wg_public_key.clone(),
            assigned_ip: user.assigned_ip.clone(),
            selector_ip: selector_ip(&user.assigned_ip),
            container_name: container_name.map(ToOwned::to_owned),
            ingress_port: std::env::var("PRIVACY_ROUTE_INGRESS_PORT")
                .unwrap_or_else(|_| DEFAULT_INGRESS_PORT.to_string()),
            next_hop: std::env::var("PRIVACY_ROUTE_NEXT_HOP")
                .unwrap_or_else(|_| DEFAULT_NEXT_HOP.to_string()),
            enabled: true,
            created_at: now.clone(),
            updated_at: now,
        }
    }
}

fn selector_ip(cidr: &str) -> String {
    cidr.split('/').next().unwrap_or(cidr).to_string()
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn test_route_id_is_deterministic() {
        std::env::set_var("PRIVACY_ROUTE_SHARED_SECRET", "test-shared-secret");
        let key = "AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA=";
        let a = derive_route_id(key).expect("derive a");
        let b = derive_route_id(key).expect("derive b");
        assert_eq!(a, b);
        assert_eq!(a.len(), 64);
    }

    #[test]
    fn test_selector_ip_strips_prefix() {
        assert_eq!(selector_ip("10.100.0.2/32"), "10.100.0.2");
        assert_eq!(selector_ip("10.100.0.2"), "10.100.0.2");
    }
}
</file>

<file path="op-web/src/sse_tests.rs">
use super::*;
use axum::response::IntoResponse;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicUsize, Ordering};

struct Fixture {
    state: tempfile::TempDir,
    catalog: tempfile::TempDir,
}

impl Fixture {
    fn new() -> Self {
        let state = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let catalog = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
        let one = op_state_store::PluginSchema::builder("one")
            .boolean_field("enabled", false, "Enabled flag")
            .integer_field("count", false, "Item count")
            .build()
            .fields;
        let removed = op_state_store::PluginSchema::builder("removed")
            .integer_field("value", false, "Prior child value")
            .build()
            .fields;
        let children = op_state_store::PluginSchema::builder("children")
            .object_field("one", one, false, "Current child")
            .object_field("removed", removed, false, "Removable child")
            .build()
            .fields;
        let schema = op_state_store::PluginSchema::builder("demo")
            .string_field("value", false, "Current value")
            .boolean_field("enabled", false, "Enabled flag")
            .object_field("children", children, false, "Typed child state")
            .public_state_paths(&["/value", "/enabled", "/children"])
            .build();
        op_blob::BlobStore::open(catalog.path())
            .unwrap()
            .write(&op_blob::blobify_plugin_schema("demo", schema))
            .unwrap();
        Self { state, catalog }
    }
    fn commit(&self, data: &[u8]) {
        op_core::projection_shm::update_projection_in(
            self.state.path().to_str().unwrap(),
            "demo",
            |_| Ok(Some(data.to_vec())),
        )
        .unwrap();
    }
    fn refresh(&self) -> impl FnMut() -> Refresh + Send + 'static {
        let state = self.state.path().to_str().unwrap().to_owned();
        let catalog = self.catalog.path().to_owned();
        move || {
            let state = state.clone();
            let catalog = catalog.clone();
            Box::pin(async move {
                hydration_from_tree(
                    crate::state_tree::read_committed_tree_from(state, catalog).await?,
                )
            })
        }
    }
}

async fn collected(
    stream: impl Stream<Item = std::result::Result<Event, Infallible>> + Send + 'static,
) -> Vec<(String, Value)> {
    let response = Sse::new(stream).into_response();
    let bytes = axum::body::to_bytes(response.into_body(), MAX_HYDRATION_BYTES * 2)
        .await
        .unwrap();
    std::str::from_utf8(&bytes)
        .unwrap()
        .split("\n\n")
        .filter_map(|block| {
            let event = block
                .lines()
                .find_map(|line| line.strip_prefix("event:"))
                .map(str::trim)?;
            let data = block
                .lines()
                .find_map(|line| line.strip_prefix("data:"))
                .map(str::trim)?;
            Some((event.to_owned(), serde_json::from_str(data).unwrap()))
        })
        .collect()
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn actual_sse_hydration_reads_shm_contract_then_whole_nested_state() {
    let fixture = Fixture::new();
    fixture.commit(br#"{"children":{"one":{"enabled":false,"count":0}}}"#);
    let (tx, rx) = broadcast::channel(4);
    drop(tx);
    let frames = collected(state_event_stream(rx, fixture.refresh())).await;
    let kinds: Vec<_> = frames.iter().map(|(kind, _)| kind.as_str()).collect();
    assert_eq!(
        kinds,
        [
            "state_reset",
            "schema_update",
            "state_update",
            "state_ready"
        ]
    );
    assert_eq!(
        frames[2].1["new_value"]["children"]["one"]["enabled"],
        false
    );
    assert_eq!(frames[2].1["new_value"]["children"]["one"]["count"], 0);
    assert_eq!(frames[2].1["state_generation"], "1");
    assert_eq!(frames[2].1["replace"], true);
    assert_eq!(frames[1].1["schema_hash"], frames[2].1["schema_hash"]);
    assert_eq!(frames[0].1["catalog_hash"], frames[2].1["catalog_hash"]);
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn lag_rehydrates_from_current_shm_and_exposes_unreplayed_audit_gap() {
    let fixture = Fixture::new();
    fixture.commit(br#"{"children":{"removed":{"value":1}}}"#);
    let state = fixture.state.path().to_str().unwrap().to_owned();
    let catalog = fixture.catalog.path().to_owned();
    let (tx, rx) = broadcast::channel(1);
    let mut sender = Some(tx);
    let reads = Arc::new(AtomicUsize::new(0));
    let count = reads.clone();
    let refresh = move || -> Refresh {
        let state = state.clone();
        let catalog = catalog.clone();
        let first_sender = sender.take();
        let count = count.clone();
        Box::pin(async move {
            count.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst);
            let snapshot =
                crate::state_tree::read_committed_tree_from(state.clone(), catalog).await?;
            if let Some(sender) = first_sender {
                op_core::projection_shm::update_projection_in(&state, "demo", |_| {
                    Ok(Some(br#"{"children":{}}"#.to_vec()))
                })?;
                for value in 0..3 {
                    sender
                        .send(event("state_unavailable", json!({"test_wakeup":value}))?)
                        .unwrap();
                }
            }
            hydration_from_tree(snapshot)
        })
    };
    let frames = collected(state_event_stream(rx, refresh)).await;
    assert_eq!(reads.load(Ordering::SeqCst), 2);
    assert_eq!(
        frames
            .iter()
            .filter(|(kind, _)| kind == "state_reset")
            .count(),
        2
    );
    assert!(frames
        .iter()
        .any(|(kind, value)| kind == "stream_gap" && value["state"] == "rehydrating"));
    let latest = frames
        .iter()
        .rfind(|(kind, _)| kind == "state_update")
        .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(latest.1["new_value"], json!({"children":{}}));
    assert_eq!(latest.1["state_generation"], "2");
    assert_eq!(latest.1["replace"], true);
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn reconnect_clears_removed_plugin_even_if_its_old_file_remains() {
    let fixture = Fixture::new();
    fixture.commit(br#"{"value":"old"}"#);
    let (tx, rx) = broadcast::channel(1);
    drop(tx);
    let old = collected(state_event_stream(rx, fixture.refresh())).await;
    assert!(old.iter().any(|(kind, _)| kind == "state_update"));
    op_blob::BlobStore::open(fixture.catalog.path())
        .unwrap()
        .remove_blob("demo")
        .unwrap();
    let (tx, rx) = broadcast::channel(1);
    drop(tx);
    let current = collected(state_event_stream(rx, fixture.refresh())).await;
    assert_eq!(
        current
            .iter()
            .map(|(kind, _)| kind.as_str())
            .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
        ["state_reset", "state_ready"]
    );
    assert_ne!(old[0].1["catalog_hash"], current[0].1["catalog_hash"]);
    assert!(fixture.state.path().join("demo.json").exists());
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn removed_public_policy_clears_prior_values_but_retains_sealed_contract() {
    let fixture = Fixture::new();
    fixture.commit(br#"{"value":"formerly-visible"}"#);
    let (tx, rx) = broadcast::channel(1);
    drop(tx);
    let old = collected(state_event_stream(rx, fixture.refresh())).await;
    assert_eq!(old[2].1["new_value"]["value"], "formerly-visible");

    let tree = crate::state_tree::read_committed_tree_from(
        fixture.state.path().to_str().unwrap().to_owned(),
        fixture.catalog.path().to_owned(),
    )
    .await
    .unwrap();
    let mut schema = tree.plugins["demo"].schema.clone();
    schema.public_state.paths.clear();
    op_blob::BlobStore::open(fixture.catalog.path())
        .unwrap()
        .write(&op_blob::blobify_plugin_schema("demo", schema))
        .unwrap();
    let (tx, rx) = broadcast::channel(1);
    drop(tx);
    let current = collected(state_event_stream(rx, fixture.refresh())).await;
    assert_eq!(current[0].0, "state_reset");
    assert_eq!(current[1].0, "schema_update");
    assert_ne!(old[1].1["schema_hash"], current[1].1["schema_hash"]);
    assert_eq!(current[2].0, "state_update");
    assert_eq!(current[2].1["new_value"], Value::Null);
    assert_eq!(current[2].1["removed"], true);
    assert_eq!(current[2].1["state_generation"], "1");
    assert_eq!(current[3].0, "state_ready");
    assert!(!current
        .iter()
        .any(|(_, value)| value.to_string().contains("formerly-visible")));
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn incomplete_publication_never_replays_old_cached_or_partial_state() {
    let fixture = Fixture::new();
    fixture.commit(br#"{"value":"committed"}"#);
    std::fs::write(
        fixture.state.path().join(".manifest.json"),
        br#"{"generation":1,"publishing":true}"#,
    )
    .unwrap();
    std::fs::write(
        fixture.state.path().join("demo.json"),
        br#"{"value":"partial"}"#,
    )
    .unwrap();
    let (tx, rx) = broadcast::channel(1);
    drop(tx);
    let frames = collected(state_event_stream(rx, fixture.refresh())).await;
    assert_eq!(frames.len(), 1);
    assert_eq!(frames[0].0, "state_unavailable");
    assert!(!frames[0].1.to_string().contains("partial"));
}

fn message() -> StateUpdateMessage {
    StateUpdateMessage {
        plugin_id: "demo".into(),
        object_path: "/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/demo".into(),
        property_name: None,
        new_value: Some(simd_json::json!({"enabled":false})),
        event_id: "0".into(),
        tags_touched: vec![],
        change_type: ChangeType::PropertySet as i32,
        frame_kind: StateFrameKind::Update as i32,
        schema_hash: "a".repeat(64),
        catalog_hash: "b".repeat(64),
        state_generation: u64::MAX,
    }
}

#[test]
fn metadata_retains_exact_u64_and_tombstones_keep_existing_payload_fields() {
    let mut message = message();
    let encoded = state_message_event(&message).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(encoded.event_type, "state_update");
    let value: Value = serde_json::from_str(&encoded.data).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(value["state_generation"], u64::MAX.to_string());
    assert_eq!(value["new_value"]["enabled"], false);
    assert_eq!(state_cursor(&encoded).unwrap().generation, u64::MAX);
    message.new_value = None;
    message.change_type = ChangeType::ObjectRemoved as i32;
    message.schema_hash.clear();
    let encoded = state_message_event(&message).unwrap();
    let value: Value = serde_json::from_str(&encoded.data).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(value["removed"], true);
    assert!(value["new_value"].is_null());
    message.change_type = ChangeType::SchemaMigration as i32;
    assert_eq!(
        state_message_event(&message).unwrap().event_type,
        "schema_update"
    );
    message.change_type = ChangeType::MethodCall as i32;
    assert!(state_message_event(&message).is_err());
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn shared_sse_cannot_forward_privileged_audit_metadata() {
    let broadcaster = SseEventBroadcaster::new();
    let mut receiver = broadcaster.subscribe();
    broadcaster.broadcast("audit_event", "{\"target\":\"private-target\"}");
    assert!(matches!(
        receiver.try_recv(),
        Err(broadcast::error::TryRecvError::Empty)
    ));
    broadcaster.broadcast("state_resync", "{}");
    assert_eq!(receiver.try_recv().unwrap().event_type, "state_resync");

    // Defend even against an internal sender bypassing the broadcaster wrapper.
    let fixture = Fixture::new();
    fixture.commit(br#"{"value":"public"}"#);
    let (sender, receiver) = broadcast::channel(4);
    sender
        .send(event("audit_event", json!({"target":"private-target"})).unwrap())
        .unwrap();
    drop(sender);
    let frames = collected(state_event_stream(receiver, fixture.refresh())).await;
    assert!(!frames.iter().any(|(kind, _)| kind == "audit_event"));
    assert!(frames
        .iter()
        .any(|(kind, value)| kind == "state_update" && value["new_value"]["value"] == "public"));
}
</file>

<file path="op-web/src/sse.rs">
//! SSE framing for the existing committed public state subscription.
//! Hydration always reads the pinned catalog and committed SHM; replayed RAM
//! frames are never the source for a new or lagging connection.

use anyhow::{ensure, Context, Result};
use axum::{
    extract::Extension,
    response::sse::{Event, Sse},
};
use futures::Stream;
use op_grpc_bridge::{
    grpc_client::StateUpdateMessage,
    proto::{ChangeType, StateFrameKind},
};
use serde_json::{json, Value};
use std::{convert::Infallible, future::Future, pin::Pin, sync::Arc, time::Duration};
use tokio::sync::broadcast;

use crate::{state::AppState, state_tree::CommittedStateTree};

const MAX_HYDRATION_BYTES: usize = 16 * 1024 * 1024;
const MAX_HYDRATION_FRAMES: usize = 4096;

pub struct SseEventBroadcaster {
    tx: broadcast::Sender<SseEvent>,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct SseEvent {
    pub event_type: String,
    pub data: String,
}

impl Default for SseEventBroadcaster {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}
impl SseEventBroadcaster {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        let (tx, _) = broadcast::channel(1024);
        Self { tx }
    }
    pub fn broadcast(&self, event_type: &str, data: &str) {
        // This shared endpoint has no verified per-HTTP-caller audit context.
        // Even metadata (targets/tags/actors) needs its exact Snowball grant.
        if event_type == "audit_event" {
            return;
        }
        let _ = self.tx.send(SseEvent {
            event_type: event_type.into(),
            data: data.into(),
        });
    }
    pub fn subscribe(&self) -> broadcast::Receiver<SseEvent> {
        self.tx.subscribe()
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
struct StateCursor {
    catalog_hash: String,
    generation: u64,
}

struct Hydration {
    cursor: StateCursor,
    frames: Vec<SseEvent>,
}

fn event(event_type: &str, data: Value) -> Result<SseEvent> {
    let data = serde_json::to_string(&data)?;
    ensure!(
        data.len() <= MAX_HYDRATION_BYTES,
        "state frame exceeds 16 MiB"
    );
    Ok(SseEvent {
        event_type: event_type.into(),
        data,
    })
}

/// Preserve existing state_update fields plus transport shape/revision metadata.
/// Generation is a decimal string on JSON/SSE so JavaScript cannot round u64.
pub(crate) fn state_message_event(message: &StateUpdateMessage) -> Result<SseEvent> {
    ensure!(
        matches!(
            StateFrameKind::try_from(message.frame_kind),
            Ok(StateFrameKind::InitialState | StateFrameKind::Update | StateFrameKind::Heartbeat)
        ),
        "state frame has no committed stream kind"
    );
    let heartbeat = message.frame_kind == StateFrameKind::Heartbeat as i32;
    let schema = message.change_type == ChangeType::SchemaMigration as i32;
    if !heartbeat {
        let plugin = &message.plugin_id;
        ensure!(
            !plugin.is_empty()
                && plugin.as_bytes()[0].is_ascii_alphanumeric()
                && plugin
                    .bytes()
                    .all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || matches!(byte, b'_' | b'-' | b'.')),
            "state frame plugin id is invalid"
        );
        let root = format!("/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/{plugin}");
        ensure!(
            message.object_path == root || message.object_path.starts_with(&(root + "/")),
            "state frame is outside its canonical public plugin path"
        );
        ensure!(
            matches!(
                ChangeType::try_from(message.change_type),
                Ok(ChangeType::PropertySet
                    | ChangeType::ObjectAdded
                    | ChangeType::ObjectRemoved
                    | ChangeType::PropertyDelete
                    | ChangeType::SchemaMigration)
            ),
            "non-state event cannot become public state"
        );
    }
    ensure!(
        valid_hash(&message.catalog_hash),
        "state frame has no valid catalog identity"
    );
    let removed = message.new_value.is_none()
        && (schema || message.change_type == ChangeType::ObjectRemoved as i32);
    ensure!(
        heartbeat
            || valid_hash(&message.schema_hash)
            || (removed && message.schema_hash.is_empty()),
        "state frame has no valid schema identity"
    );
    event(
        if heartbeat {
            "state_heartbeat"
        } else if schema {
            "schema_update"
        } else {
            "state_update"
        },
        json!({
            "plugin_id": &message.plugin_id,
            "object_path": &message.object_path,
            "property_name": &message.property_name,
            "new_value": &message.new_value,
            "event_id": &message.event_id,
            "tags": &message.tags_touched,
            "change_type": message.change_type,
            "frame_kind": message.frame_kind,
            "schema_hash": &message.schema_hash,
            "catalog_hash": &message.catalog_hash,
            "state_generation": message.state_generation.to_string(),
            "removed": removed,
            "replace": !schema && message.property_name.as_deref().is_none_or(str::is_empty),
        }),
    )
}

fn valid_hash(value: &str) -> bool {
    value.len() == 64 && value.bytes().all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_hexdigit())
}

fn hydration_from_tree(tree: CommittedStateTree) -> Result<Hydration> {
    let cursor = StateCursor {
        catalog_hash: tree.catalog_hash,
        generation: tree.projection_generation,
    };
    let mut frames = vec![event(
        "state_reset",
        json!({
            "scope": "public_projection", "catalog_hash": &cursor.catalog_hash,
            "state_generation": cursor.generation.to_string(),
            "frame_kind": StateFrameKind::InitialState as i32,
        }),
    )?];
    let mut states = Vec::new();
    let mut selected_bytes = frames[0].data.len();
    for (plugin_id, plugin) in tree.plugins {
        let path = format!("/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/{plugin_id}");
        // Serialize the original sealed JSON, never a typed schema with new
        // serde defaults inserted by the currently compiled consumer.
        let schema: Value = serde_json::from_str(&plugin.schema_json)?;
        frames.push(event(
            "schema_update",
            json!({
                "plugin_id": &plugin_id, "object_path": &path,
                "property_name": &plugin.schema_hash, "new_value": schema,
                "event_id": "0", "tags": [], "change_type": ChangeType::SchemaMigration as i32,
                "frame_kind": StateFrameKind::InitialState as i32,
                "schema_hash": &plugin.schema_hash, "catalog_hash": &cursor.catalog_hash,
                "state_generation": cursor.generation.to_string(), "removed": false,
            }),
        )?);
        let absent = plugin.state.is_none();
        states.push(event("state_update", json!({
            "plugin_id": plugin_id, "object_path": path, "property_name": null,
            "new_value": plugin.state, "event_id": "0", "tags": [],
            "change_type": if absent { ChangeType::ObjectRemoved as i32 } else { ChangeType::PropertySet as i32 },
            "frame_kind": StateFrameKind::InitialState as i32,
            "schema_hash": plugin.schema_hash, "catalog_hash": &cursor.catalog_hash,
            "state_generation": cursor.generation.to_string(), "removed": absent, "replace": true,
        }))?);
        selected_bytes = selected_bytes
            .checked_add(frames.last().context("schema frame missing")?.data.len())
            .and_then(|bytes| bytes.checked_add(states.last().map_or(0, |frame| frame.data.len())))
            .context("state hydration size overflow")?;
        ensure!(
            selected_bytes <= MAX_HYDRATION_BYTES,
            "state hydration exceeds 16 MiB"
        );
        ensure!(
            frames.len() + states.len() < MAX_HYDRATION_FRAMES,
            "state hydration exceeds 4096 frames"
        );
    }
    // Contracts precede every value, including absent-state tombstones.
    frames.extend(states);
    frames.push(event(
        "state_ready",
        json!({
            "scope": "public_projection", "catalog_hash": &cursor.catalog_hash,
            "state_generation": cursor.generation.to_string(),
            "frame_kind": StateFrameKind::InitialState as i32,
        }),
    )?);
    ensure!(
        frames.len() <= MAX_HYDRATION_FRAMES,
        "state hydration exceeds 4096 frames"
    );
    let bytes = frames
        .iter()
        .try_fold(0usize, |total, frame| total.checked_add(frame.data.len()))
        .context("state hydration size overflow")?;
    ensure!(
        bytes <= MAX_HYDRATION_BYTES,
        "state hydration exceeds 16 MiB"
    );
    Ok(Hydration { cursor, frames })
}

async fn load_hydration() -> Result<Hydration> {
    hydration_from_tree(crate::state_tree::read_committed_tree().await?)
}

fn state_cursor(event: &SseEvent) -> Result<StateCursor> {
    let value: Value = serde_json::from_str(&event.data)?;
    let catalog_hash = value
        .get("catalog_hash")
        .and_then(Value::as_str)
        .filter(|hash| valid_hash(hash))
        .context("SSE state frame has no catalog identity")?
        .to_owned();
    let generation = value
        .get("state_generation")
        .and_then(Value::as_str)
        .context("SSE state generation must be an exact decimal string")?
        .parse::<u64>()?;
    Ok(StateCursor {
        catalog_hash,
        generation,
    })
}

fn wire(event: SseEvent) -> Event {
    Event::default().event(event.event_type).data(event.data)
}

fn unavailable() -> Event {
    Event::default()
        .event("state_unavailable")
        .data("{\"reason\":\"committed_projection_unavailable\"}")
        .retry(Duration::from_secs(5))
}

type Refresh = Pin<Box<dyn Future<Output = Result<Hydration>> + Send>>;

fn state_event_stream(
    mut rx: broadcast::Receiver<SseEvent>,
    mut refresh: impl FnMut() -> Refresh + Send + 'static,
) -> impl Stream<Item = std::result::Result<Event, Infallible>> + Send {
    async_stream::stream! {
        let initial = match refresh().await {
            Ok(hydration) => hydration,
            Err(error) => { tracing::warn!(%error, "Cannot hydrate SSE from committed SHM"); yield Ok(unavailable()); return; }
        };
        let mut baseline = initial.cursor;
        let mut last_forwarded = baseline.generation;
        for frame in initial.frames { yield Ok(wire(frame)); }
        loop {
            let received = rx.recv().await;
            let (pending, resync) = match received {
                Ok(frame) if frame.event_type == "state_resync" => (None, true),
                Ok(frame) if matches!(frame.event_type.as_str(), "state_update" | "schema_update" | "state_heartbeat") => {
                    let cursor = match state_cursor(&frame) {
                        Ok(cursor) => cursor,
                        Err(error) => { tracing::warn!(%error, "Invalid SSE state framing"); yield Ok(unavailable()); return; }
                    };
                    if cursor.catalog_hash == baseline.catalog_hash && cursor.generation <= baseline.generation {
                        // This frame was queued before fresh hydration. Every
                        // selected public root is already represented above.
                        continue;
                    }
                    let resync = cursor.catalog_hash != baseline.catalog_hash || cursor.generation < last_forwarded;
                    (Some((frame, cursor)), resync)
                }
                Ok(frame) if frame.event_type == "audit_event" => continue,
                Ok(frame) => { yield Ok(wire(frame)); continue; }
                Err(broadcast::error::RecvError::Lagged(_)) => {
                    yield Ok(Event::default().event("stream_gap").data("{\"state\":\"rehydrating\"}"));
                    (None, true)
                }
                Err(broadcast::error::RecvError::Closed) => return,
            };
            if resync {
                let fresh = match refresh().await {
                    Ok(hydration) => hydration,
                    Err(error) => { tracing::warn!(%error, "Cannot rehydrate SSE from committed SHM"); yield Ok(unavailable()); return; }
                };
                baseline = fresh.cursor;
                last_forwarded = baseline.generation;
                for frame in fresh.frames { yield Ok(wire(frame)); }
            }
            if let Some((frame, cursor)) = pending {
                if cursor.catalog_hash == baseline.catalog_hash && cursor.generation > baseline.generation && cursor.generation >= last_forwarded {
                    last_forwarded = cursor.generation;
                    yield Ok(wire(frame));
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

/// GET /api/events. The shared endpoint carries only the selected public SHM
/// namespace, never credential files or privileged audit history.
/// state_reset clears prior public schema/state keys; state_ready completes a
/// fresh bounded hydration. State generations are decimal strings.
pub async fn sse_handler(
    Extension(state): Extension<Arc<AppState>>,
) -> Sse<impl Stream<Item = std::result::Result<Event, Infallible>>> {
    // Subscribe before the filesystem read to avoid losing a concurrent commit.
    let rx = state.sse_broadcaster.subscribe();
    Sse::new(state_event_stream(rx, || Box::pin(load_hydration()))).keep_alive(
        axum::response::sse::KeepAlive::new()
            .interval(Duration::from_secs(15))
            .text("ping"),
    )
}

<file path="op-web/src/state_manager_client.rs">
//! Plugin state client — routes reads/writes through the gRPC MutationEngine
//! (the single write door) instead of the excised D-Bus StateManager.
//!
//! Reads go to `RemoteOperationClient::get_state` (state_cache, the mutation
//! fold). Writes go to `RemoteOperationClient::set_state` (ApplyPatch through
//! the MutationEngine → EventChain → shm projection). No second write door,
//! no StateManager, no drift.

use anyhow::{Context, Result};
use op_grpc_bridge::{GhostbridgeCallMetadata, GrpcClientPool, RemoteOperationClient};
use serde::de::DeserializeOwned;
use serde::Serialize;
use std::sync::{Arc, OnceLock};

static GRPC_CLIENT: OnceLock<RemoteOperationClient> = OnceLock::new();

/// Lazily initialize a singleton RemoteOperationClient backed by the
/// MutationEngine's gRPC endpoint (env `OP_DBUS_GRPC_ADDR`, default
/// `https://10.0.0.3:8090` — the fabric/TCP TLS-only tonic door; trust anchor
/// via `OP_DBUS_GRPC_CA_FILE`, see GrpcClientPool::configure_endpoint).
fn client() -> &'static RemoteOperationClient {
    GRPC_CLIENT.get_or_init(|| {
        let grpc_addr = std::env::var("OP_DBUS_GRPC_ADDR")
            .or_else(|_| std::env::var("FABRIC_GRPC_ADDR"))
            .or_else(|_| std::env::var("OP_FABRIC_GRPC_ADDR"))
            .unwrap_or_else(|_| "https://10.0.0.3:8090".to_string());
        let pool = Arc::new(GrpcClientPool::new());
        RemoteOperationClient::new(pool, &grpc_addr, "op-web")
    })
}

pub async fn query_plugin_state<T>(plugin_id: &str) -> Result<Option<T>>
where
    T: DeserializeOwned,
{
    match client().get_state(plugin_id, "").await {
        Ok(state) => match simd_json::serde::from_owned_value::<T>(state) {
            Ok(value) => Ok(Some(value)),
            Err(_) => Ok(None),
        },
        Err(_) => Ok(None),
    }
}

pub async fn apply_plugin_state<T>(plugin_id: &str, value: &T) -> Result<()>
where
    T: Serialize,
{
    let state = simd_json::serde::to_owned_value(value)
        .with_context(|| format!("serialize {} plugin state", plugin_id))?;
    client()
        .set_state(plugin_id, "", state, "op-web", "")
        .await
        .map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!("apply {} state via gRPC: {}", plugin_id, e))?;
    Ok(())
}

/// Dispatch a schema-declared plugin method through the bridge while
/// preserving the identity supplied by the outer HTTP request.
pub async fn call_plugin_method(
    plugin_id: &str,
    method: &str,
    arguments: simd_json::OwnedValue,
    capability_id: &str,
    identity: &GhostbridgeCallMetadata,
) -> Result<simd_json::OwnedValue> {
    client()
        .call_method_with_metadata(
            plugin_id,
            &format!("/org/opdbus/v1/plugins/{plugin_id}"),
            "org.opdbus.v1.PluginV1",
            method,
            vec![arguments],
            "op-web",
            capability_id,
            identity,
        )
        .await
        .map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!("call {plugin_id}.{method} through bridge: {e}"))
}
</file>

<file path="op-web/src/state_tree.rs">
//! Committed public state-tree reader.
//!
//! Plugin membership comes only from the sealer-owned blob manifest. State
//! bytes come from one locked projection transaction selected by that
//! membership. This reader never enumerates the projection directory and never
//! opens a mutable blob store.

use anyhow::{ensure, Context, Result};
use simd_json::OwnedValue as Value;
use std::collections::{BTreeMap, HashMap};
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

const BLOB_CATALOG_DIR: &str = op_blob::catalog::DEFAULT_SHM_DIR;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, serde::Serialize)]
pub struct CommittedPluginState {
    pub schema_hash: String,
    /// Exact schema JSON section from the manifest-pinned sealed blob.
    pub schema_json: String,
    pub schema: op_state_store::PluginSchema,
    pub state: Option<Value>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, serde::Serialize)]
pub struct CommittedStateTree {
    pub catalog_hash: String,
    pub projection_generation: u64,
    pub plugins: BTreeMap<String, CommittedPluginState>,
}

struct SealedCatalog {
    catalog_hash: String,
    plugins: BTreeMap<String, String>,
    manifest: Vec<u8>,
}

/// Read a sealed plugin's committed public state. A sealed plugin without a
/// committed projection returns `None`; catalog and projection errors fail.
pub async fn read_plugin(plugin: &str) -> Result<Option<Value>> {
    let plugin = plugin.to_string();
    let state_dir = op_core::projection_shm::shm_state_dir();
    let catalog_dir = blob_catalog_dir();
    tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || read_plugin_in(&state_dir, &catalog_dir, &plugin))
        .await
        .map_err(|error| anyhow::anyhow!("committed state reader task failed: {error}"))?
}

/// Read every sealed plugin state present in one committed projection snapshot.
/// Sealed plugins without state and state files without a sealed plugin are
/// absent from the result.
pub async fn read_all() -> Result<HashMap<String, Value>> {
    let state_dir = op_core::projection_shm::shm_state_dir();
    let catalog_dir = blob_catalog_dir();
    tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || read_all_in(&state_dir, &catalog_dir))
        .await
        .map_err(|error| anyhow::anyhow!("committed state reader task failed: {error}"))?
}

/// Read a manifest-pinned catalog and its complete committed public state in
/// one receipt. Callers can use missing `state` entries and the catalog hash to
/// clear retired or not-yet-published values during push-driven hydration.
pub async fn read_committed_tree() -> Result<CommittedStateTree> {
    read_committed_tree_from(op_core::projection_shm::shm_state_dir(), blob_catalog_dir()).await
}

pub(crate) async fn read_committed_tree_from(
    state_dir: String,
    catalog_dir: PathBuf,
) -> Result<CommittedStateTree> {
    tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || read_committed_tree_in(&state_dir, &catalog_dir))
        .await
        .map_err(|error| anyhow::anyhow!("committed state reader task failed: {error}"))?
}

fn blob_catalog_dir() -> PathBuf {
    std::env::var_os("OP_BLOB_CATALOG_DIR")
        .map(PathBuf::from)
        .unwrap_or_else(|| PathBuf::from(BLOB_CATALOG_DIR))
}

fn read_plugin_in(state_dir: &str, catalog_dir: &Path, plugin: &str) -> Result<Option<Value>> {
    let sealed = sealed_catalog(catalog_dir)?;
    ensure!(
        sealed.plugins.contains_key(plugin),
        "plugin '{plugin}' is not a current sealed catalog member"
    );
    let schema = validate_sealed_plugin(catalog_dir, plugin)?;
    ensure_manifest_unchanged(catalog_dir, &sealed.manifest)?;

    let plugin_id = plugin.to_string();
    let snapshot = op_core::projection_shm::read_projection_snapshot_in(
        state_dir,
        std::slice::from_ref(&plugin_id),
    )?;
    ensure_manifest_unchanged(catalog_dir, &sealed.manifest)?;
    snapshot
        .states
        .get(plugin)
        .map(|bytes| decode_public_state(plugin, &schema, bytes))
        .transpose()
        .map(Option::flatten)
}

fn read_all_in(state_dir: &str, catalog_dir: &Path) -> Result<HashMap<String, Value>> {
    Ok(read_committed_tree_in(state_dir, catalog_dir)?
        .plugins
        .into_iter()
        .filter_map(|(plugin, entry)| entry.state.map(|state| (plugin, state)))
        .collect())
}

fn read_committed_tree_in(state_dir: &str, catalog_dir: &Path) -> Result<CommittedStateTree> {
    let sealed = sealed_catalog(catalog_dir)?;
    let mut schemas = BTreeMap::new();
    for (plugin, schema_hash) in &sealed.plugins {
        schemas.insert(
            plugin.clone(),
            (
                validate_sealed_plugin(catalog_dir, plugin)?,
                original_schema_json(catalog_dir, plugin, schema_hash)?,
            ),
        );
    }
    ensure_manifest_unchanged(catalog_dir, &sealed.manifest)?;
    let ids: Vec<String> = sealed.plugins.keys().cloned().collect();
    let snapshot = op_core::projection_shm::read_projection_snapshot_in(state_dir, &ids)?;
    ensure_manifest_unchanged(catalog_dir, &sealed.manifest)?;

    let mut plugins = BTreeMap::new();
    for (plugin, schema_hash) in sealed.plugins {
        let (schema, schema_json) = schemas
            .remove(&plugin)
            .context("validated schema disappeared")?;
        let state = snapshot
            .states
            .get(&plugin)
            .map(|bytes| decode_public_state(&plugin, &schema, bytes))
            .transpose()?
            .flatten();
        plugins.insert(
            plugin.clone(),
            CommittedPluginState {
                schema_json,
                schema_hash,
                schema,
                state,
            },
        );
    }
    Ok(CommittedStateTree {
        catalog_hash: sealed.catalog_hash,
        projection_generation: snapshot.generation,
        plugins,
    })
}

fn original_schema_json(catalog_dir: &Path, plugin: &str, schema_hash: &str) -> Result<String> {
    let path = catalog_dir.join(format!("{plugin}.{}.blob", &schema_hash[..16]));
    let bytes = std::fs::read(&path)
        .with_context(|| format!("read sealed plugin blob {}", path.display()))?;
    let blob = op_blob::BlobRef::from_manifest_pinned(&bytes, schema_hash)
        .map_err(|error| anyhow::anyhow!("invalid sealed plugin blob: {error}"))?;
    let manifest = blob
        .manifest()
        .map_err(|error| anyhow::anyhow!("invalid sealed plugin manifest: {error}"))?;
    ensure!(
        manifest.plugin_id == plugin
            && manifest.schema_hash == schema_hash
            && manifest.blob_type == "active_reflection",
        "sealed plugin blob identity does not match catalog"
    );
    Ok(blob.schema_json().to_string())
}

fn sealed_catalog(catalog_dir: &Path) -> Result<SealedCatalog> {
    let manifest_path = catalog_dir.join(op_blob::catalog::MANIFEST_FILENAME);
    let bytes = std::fs::read(&manifest_path)
        .with_context(|| format!("read sealed catalog manifest {}", manifest_path.display()))?;
    let manifest: serde_json::Value =
        serde_json::from_slice(&bytes).context("parse sealed catalog manifest")?;
    let catalog_hash = manifest
        .get("catalog_hash")
        .and_then(serde_json::Value::as_str)
        .filter(|hash| hash.len() == 64 && hash.bytes().all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_hexdigit()))
        .context("sealed catalog manifest has no valid catalog hash")?
        .to_string();
    let plugins = manifest
        .get("plugins")
        .and_then(serde_json::Value::as_object)
        .context("sealed catalog manifest has no plugins map")?;
    let mut sealed = BTreeMap::new();
    for (id, hash) in plugins {
        ensure!(
            valid_plugin_id(id),
            "sealed catalog contains an invalid plugin id"
        );
        let hash = hash
            .as_str()
            .context("sealed catalog plugin hash is not a string")?;
        ensure!(
            hash.len() == 64 && hash.bytes().all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_hexdigit()),
            "sealed catalog contains a malformed plugin hash"
        );
        sealed.insert(id.clone(), hash.to_string());
    }
    Ok(SealedCatalog {
        catalog_hash,
        plugins: sealed,
        manifest: bytes,
    })
}

fn validate_sealed_plugin(
    catalog_dir: &Path,
    plugin: &str,
) -> Result<op_state_store::PluginSchema> {
    op_blob::catalog::read_plugin_state_store_schema(catalog_dir, plugin)
        .with_context(|| format!("sealed plugin '{plugin}' is missing or invalid"))
}

fn ensure_manifest_unchanged(catalog_dir: &Path, expected: &[u8]) -> Result<()> {
    ensure!(
        std::fs::read(catalog_dir.join(op_blob::catalog::MANIFEST_FILENAME))? == expected,
        "sealed catalog changed during state read"
    );
    Ok(())
}

fn valid_plugin_id(plugin: &str) -> bool {
    !plugin.is_empty()
        && plugin
            .bytes()
            .all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || matches!(byte, b'_' | b'-' | b'.'))
}

fn decode_public_state(
    plugin: &str,
    schema: &op_state_store::PluginSchema,
    bytes: &[u8],
) -> Result<Option<Value>> {
    let mut bytes = bytes.to_vec();
    let value = simd_json::to_owned_value(&mut bytes)
        .with_context(|| format!("committed state for '{plugin}' is invalid JSON"))?;
    let Some(mut value) = schema.project_public_state(&value)? else {
        return Ok(None);
    };
    if plugin == "identity_sled" {
        redact_identity_credentials(&mut value);
    }
    Ok(Some(value))
}

fn redact_identity_credentials(value: &mut Value) {
    match value {
        Value::Object(object) => {
            object.remove("sealed_id");
            for nested in object.values_mut() {
                redact_identity_credentials(nested);
            }
        }
        Value::Array(values) => {
            for nested in values {
                redact_identity_credentials(nested);
            }
        }
        _ => {}
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use simd_json::json;

    struct Fixture {
        state: tempfile::TempDir,
        catalog: tempfile::TempDir,
    }

    impl Fixture {
        fn new(plugins: &[&str]) -> Self {
            let state = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
            let catalog = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
            let mut sealer = op_blob::BlobStore::open(catalog.path()).unwrap();
            for plugin in plugins {
                let schema = if *plugin == "identity_sled" {
                    let mut identity = HashMap::new();
                    identity.insert(
                        "principal".to_string(),
                        op_state_store::FieldSchema {
                            field_type: op_state_store::FieldType::String,
                            required: false,
                            description: String::new(),
                            default: None,
                            example: None,
                            constraints: Vec::new(),
                            read_only: false,
                            read_only_when: None,
                        },
                    );
                    identity.insert(
                        "sealed_id".to_string(),
                        op_state_store::FieldSchema {
                            field_type: op_state_store::FieldType::String,
                            required: false,
                            description: String::new(),
                            default: None,
                            example: None,
                            constraints: Vec::new(),
                            read_only: false,
                            read_only_when: None,
                        },
                    );
                    op_state_store::PluginSchema::builder(plugin)
                        .object_field("nested", identity, false, "public identity")
                        .array_field(
                            "items",
                            op_state_store::FieldType::Object(HashMap::from([(
                                "sealed_id".to_string(),
                                op_state_store::FieldSchema {
                                    field_type: op_state_store::FieldType::String,
                                    required: false,
                                    description: String::new(),
                                    default: None,
                                    example: None,
                                    constraints: Vec::new(),
                                    read_only: false,
                                    read_only_when: None,
                                },
                            )])),
                            false,
                            "identity entries",
                        )
                        .public_state_paths(&["/nested", "/items"])
                        .build()
                } else {
                    op_state_store::PluginSchema::builder(plugin)
                        .string_field("status", false, "public status")
                        .public_state_path("/status")
                        .build()
                };
                sealer
                    .write(&op_blob::blobify_plugin_schema(plugin, schema))
                    .unwrap();
            }
            Self { state, catalog }
        }

        fn commit(&self, plugin: &str, bytes: &[u8]) {
            op_core::projection_shm::update_projection_in(
                self.state.path().to_str().unwrap(),
                plugin,
                |_| Ok(Some(bytes.to_vec())),
            )
            .unwrap();
        }

        fn read_plugin(&self, plugin: &str) -> Result<Option<Value>> {
            read_plugin_in(
                self.state.path().to_str().unwrap(),
                self.catalog.path(),
                plugin,
            )
        }

        fn read_all(&self) -> Result<HashMap<String, Value>> {
            read_all_in(self.state.path().to_str().unwrap(), self.catalog.path())
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn reads_committed_sealed_state_and_ignores_committed_orphans() {
        let fixture = Fixture::new(&["alpha", "beta"]);
        fixture.commit("alpha", br#"{"status":"ready","runtime_secret":"drop"}"#);
        fixture.commit("orphan", br#"{"secret":true}"#);

        assert_eq!(
            fixture.read_plugin("alpha").unwrap(),
            Some(json!({"status":"ready"}))
        );
        assert_eq!(fixture.read_plugin("beta").unwrap(), None);
        let all = fixture.read_all().unwrap();
        assert_eq!(all.len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(all["alpha"], json!({"status":"ready"}));
        assert!(!all.contains_key("orphan"));

        let receipt = read_committed_tree_in(
            fixture.state.path().to_str().unwrap(),
            fixture.catalog.path(),
        )
        .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(receipt.projection_generation, 2);
        assert_eq!(receipt.catalog_hash.len(), 64);
        assert_eq!(receipt.plugins.len(), 2);
        assert_eq!(receipt.plugins["beta"].state, None);
        assert_eq!(receipt.plugins["alpha"].schema.name, "alpha");
        assert_eq!(receipt.plugins["alpha"].schema_hash.len(), 64);
        let exact: serde_json::Value =
            serde_json::from_str(&receipt.plugins["alpha"].schema_json).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(exact["name"], "alpha");
    }

    #[test]
    fn rejects_unsealed_plugin_even_when_it_has_committed_state() {
        let fixture = Fixture::new(&["alpha"]);
        fixture.commit("orphan", br#"{"secret":true}"#);
        assert!(fixture.read_plugin("orphan").is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn malformed_committed_state_is_not_hidden_as_absent() {
        let fixture = Fixture::new(&["alpha"]);
        fixture.commit("alpha", b"{bad-json");
        assert!(fixture.read_plugin("alpha").is_err());
        assert!(fixture.read_all().is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn configured_public_field_type_drift_is_an_error() {
        let fixture = Fixture::new(&["alpha"]);
        fixture.commit("alpha", br#"{"status":7}"#);
        assert!(fixture.read_plugin("alpha").is_err());
        assert!(fixture.read_all().is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn invalid_public_policy_is_an_error() {
        let fixture = Fixture::new(&["alpha"]);
        let mut invalid = op_state_store::PluginSchema::builder("invalid_policy")
            .string_field("status", false, "status")
            .build();
        invalid.public_state = op_state_store::PublicStatePolicy {
            paths: vec!["/undeclared".into()],
        };
        op_blob::BlobStore::open(fixture.catalog.path())
            .unwrap()
            .write(&op_blob::blobify_plugin_schema("invalid_policy", invalid))
            .unwrap();
        fixture.commit("invalid_policy", br#"{"status":"private"}"#);
        assert!(fixture.read_plugin("invalid_policy").is_err());
        assert!(fixture.read_all().is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn identity_credentials_are_recursively_redacted() {
        let fixture = Fixture::new(&["identity_sled"]);
        fixture.commit(
            "identity_sled",
            br#"{"sealed_id":"root","nested":{"principal":"alice","sealed_id":"nested"},"items":[{"sealed_id":"array"}]}"#,
        );
        assert_eq!(
            fixture.read_plugin("identity_sled").unwrap(),
            Some(json!({"nested":{"principal":"alice"},"items":[{}]}))
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn absent_public_policy_retains_schema_and_withholds_state() {
        let fixture = Fixture::new(&["alpha"]);
        let closed = op_state_store::PluginSchema::builder("closed")
            .string_field("status", false, "private status")
            .build();
        op_blob::BlobStore::open(fixture.catalog.path())
            .unwrap()
            .write(&op_blob::blobify_plugin_schema("closed", closed))
            .unwrap();
        fixture.commit("closed", br#"{"status":"private"}"#);

        let receipt = read_committed_tree_in(
            fixture.state.path().to_str().unwrap(),
            fixture.catalog.path(),
        )
        .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(receipt.plugins["closed"].state, None);
        assert_eq!(receipt.plugins["closed"].schema.name, "closed");
    }

    #[test]
    fn invalid_catalog_or_incomplete_projection_is_an_error() {
        let fixture = Fixture::new(&["alpha"]);
        fixture.commit("alpha", br#"{"status":"old"}"#);
        std::fs::write(
            fixture.state.path().join(".manifest.json"),
            br#"{"generation":2,"publishing":true}"#,
        )
        .unwrap();
        assert!(fixture.read_all().is_err());

        std::fs::write(
            fixture
                .catalog
                .path()
                .join(op_blob::catalog::MANIFEST_FILENAME),
            b"not-json",
        )
        .unwrap();
        assert!(fixture.read_plugin("alpha").is_err());
    }
}
</file>

<file path="op-web/src/state.rs">
//! Application State
//!
//! Central state management for the web server.
//! Simple, direct tool access - no MCP complexity.

use anyhow::{anyhow, bail, Context};
use async_trait::async_trait;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use simd_json::prelude::*;
use simd_json::{json, OwnedValue as Value};
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::sync::Arc;
use tokio::sync::{broadcast, RwLock};
use tokio_stream::StreamExt;
use tracing::{debug, info, warn};

use op_agents::agent_registry::AgentRegistry;
use op_grpc_bridge::{GrpcClientPool, RemoteOperationClient};
use op_llm::chat::ChatManager;
use op_state_store::{MemoryStore, StateStore};
use op_tools::registry::ToolDefinition;
use op_tools::tool::{BoxedTool, Tool};
use op_tools::ToolRegistry;

use crate::email::{EmailConfig, EmailSender};
use crate::orchestrator::UnifiedOrchestrator;
use crate::sse::SseEventBroadcaster;
use crate::users::UserStore;
use crate::wireguard::WgServerConfig;

/// Google OAuth configuration
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct GoogleOAuthConfig {
    pub client_id: String,
    pub client_secret: String,
    pub redirect_url: String,
}

/// User-specific API credentials
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct UserApiCredentials {
    pub token: String,
    pub gemini_api_key: Option<String>,
    pub anthropic_api_key: Option<String>,
    pub openai_api_key: Option<String>,
    pub preferred_provider: Option<String>,
}

impl GoogleOAuthConfig {
    /// Load configuration from environment variables
    pub fn from_env() -> Option<Self> {
        let client_id = std::env::var("GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID").ok()?;
        let client_secret = std::env::var("GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET").ok()?;
        let redirect_url = std::env::var("GOOGLE_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URL")
            .unwrap_or_else(|_| "http://localhost:8080/api/privacy/google/callback".to_string());

        Some(Self {
            client_id,
            client_secret,
            redirect_url,
        })
    }
}

/// Application state shared across all handlers
pub struct AppState {
    /// Unified orchestrator - direct tool access
    pub orchestrator: Arc<UnifiedOrchestrator>,
    /// Tool registry
    pub tool_registry: Arc<ToolRegistry>,
    /// Agent registry
    pub agent_registry: Arc<RwLock<AgentRegistry>>,
    /// Chat manager for LLM access
    pub chat_manager: Arc<ChatManager>,
    /// Default model
    pub default_model: String,
    /// Provider name
    pub provider_name: String,
    /// Broadcast channel for WebSocket messages
    pub broadcast_tx: broadcast::Sender<String>,
    /// SSE event broadcaster
    pub sse_broadcaster: Arc<SseEventBroadcaster>,
    /// Server start time
    pub start_time: std::time::Instant,
    /// Conversation history — JSON flat file, no SQLite, no drift.
    pub conversations: Arc<crate::chat_store::ChatSessionStore>,
    /// Privacy router user store
    pub user_store: Arc<UserStore>,
    /// Email sender for magic links
    pub email_sender: Arc<EmailSender>,
    /// WireGuard server configuration
    pub server_config: WgServerConfig,
    /// Persistent state store (audit log)
    pub state_store: Arc<dyn StateStore>,
    /// Google OAuth configuration (optional)
    pub google_oauth_config: Option<GoogleOAuthConfig>,
    /// CSRF tokens for Google OAuth
    pub csrf_tokens: Arc<RwLock<HashMap<String, String>>>,
    /// Remote operation client (gRPC)
    pub grpc_client: Arc<RemoteOperationClient>,
    /// Recent activity feed from projection/D-Bus events
    pub activity_log: Arc<RwLock<Vec<simd_json::OwnedValue>>>,
}

impl AppState {
    /// Create new AppState with an optional shared tool registry
    /// If registry is provided, skips tool discovery (use registry from main binary)
    pub async fn new_with_registry(
        tool_registry: Option<Arc<ToolRegistry>>,
        state_store: Option<Arc<dyn StateStore>>,
    ) -> anyhow::Result<Self> {
        info!("Initializing application state...");

        let tool_registry = if let Some(registry) = tool_registry {
            info!("Using shared tool registry from main binary (projection already complete)");
            registry
        } else {
            if let Some(remote_url) = remote_tool_source_url() {
                info!("Creating tool registry from op-dbus at {}", remote_url);
                let registry = Arc::new(ToolRegistry::new());
                register_remote_tools(&registry, &remote_url).await?;
                registry
            } else {
                info!("Creating new tool registry (standalone mode)");
                let registry = Arc::new(ToolRegistry::new());

                // Register ALL tools (including D-Bus projection) - only in standalone mode
                register_all_tools(&registry).await?;

                registry
            }
        };

        // Log tool count
        let tools = tool_registry.list().await;
        info!("✅ Using registry with {} tools", tools.len());
        log_tool_summary(&tools);

        // Create chat manager for LLM access
        let chat_manager = Arc::new(ChatManager::new());

        // Load persisted provider/model
        if let Some(provider) = read_persisted_provider().await {
            if let Ok(provider_type) = provider.parse() {
                if let Err(e) = chat_manager.switch_provider(provider_type).await {
                    warn!("Failed to load provider '{}': {}", provider, e);
                } else {
                    info!("Loaded provider: {}", provider);
                }
            }
        }

        if let Some(model) = read_persisted_model().await {
            let non_sandboxed = read_persisted_model_non_sandboxed().await;
            if let Err(e) = chat_manager
                .switch_model_with_options(model.clone(), non_sandboxed)
                .await
            {
                warn!("Failed to load model '{}': {}", model, e);
            } else {
                info!("Loaded model: {}", model);
            }
        }

        // Get LLM info
        let provider_type = chat_manager.current_provider().await;
        let default_model = chat_manager.current_model().await;
        let provider_name = provider_type.to_string();

        info!("✅ LLM: {} ({})", provider_name, default_model);

        // Create agent registry
        let agent_registry = Arc::new(RwLock::new(AgentRegistry::new()));

        // Create orchestrator with direct tool access
        let orchestrator = Arc::new(UnifiedOrchestrator::new(
            tool_registry.clone(),
            chat_manager.clone(),
        ));

        // Create broadcast channel for WebSocket
        let (broadcast_tx, _) = broadcast::channel(100);

        // Create SSE broadcaster
        let sse_broadcaster = Arc::new(SseEventBroadcaster::new());

        // Initialize privacy router components
        // User database in CozoDB — graph-native, no JSON drift.
        let user_store = match UserStore::new("/var/lib/op-dbus/users-cozo").await {
            Ok(store) => Arc::new(store),
            Err(e) => {
                warn!(
                    "Failed to open CozoDB user store: {}, falling back to in-memory",
                    e
                );
                Arc::new(
                    UserStore::new("")
                        .await
                        .expect("Failed to create in-memory user store"),
                )
            }
        };

        let email_config = EmailConfig::from_env().unwrap_or_else(|e| {
            warn!("Failed to load email config: {}", e);
            EmailConfig {
                smtp_host: "localhost".to_string(),
                smtp_port: 587,
                smtp_user: String::new(),
                smtp_pass: String::new(),
                from_email: "noreply@example.com".to_string(),
                from_name: "Privacy Router".to_string(),
                base_url: "http://localhost:8080".to_string(),
            }
        });
        let email_sender = Arc::new(EmailSender::new(email_config));

        // Load WireGuard server config (will need to be configured properly)
        let server_config = WgServerConfig::default();

        // Load Google OAuth config
        let google_oauth_config = GoogleOAuthConfig::from_env();
        if google_oauth_config.is_some() {
            info!("✅ Google OAuth configured");
        } else {
            info!("⚠️  Google OAuth not configured (set GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET)");
        }

        // Initialize State Store
        let state_store: Arc<dyn StateStore> = if let Some(store) = state_store {
            info!("Using shared state store from main binary");
            store
        } else {
            // No persistent database — SHM is the single source of truth.
            // All ephemeral state (chat sessions, execution jobs) lives in-memory only.
            info!("Using in-memory state store (no persistent DB — SHM is source of truth)");
            Arc::new(MemoryStore::new())
        };

        info!("✅ Application state initialized");

        // Initialize gRPC client for remote operations.
        // Consolidated control plane is op-grpc-bridge on :8090 (not a separate :50051 opdbus).
        let grpc_addr = std::env::var("OP_DBUS_GRPC_ADDR")
            .or_else(|_| std::env::var("OP_DBUS_ADDR"))
            .or_else(|_| std::env::var("FABRIC_GRPC_ADDR"))
            .or_else(|_| std::env::var("OP_FABRIC_GRPC_ADDR"))
            // The :8090 door is TLS-only (tonic ClientTlsConfig; trust anchor
            // via OP_DBUS_GRPC_CA_FILE, see GrpcClientPool::configure_endpoint).
            .unwrap_or_else(|_| "https://10.0.0.3:8090".to_string());
        let pool = Arc::new(GrpcClientPool::new());
        let grpc_client = Arc::new(RemoteOperationClient::new(pool, &grpc_addr, "op-web"));

        Ok(Self {
            orchestrator,
            tool_registry,
            agent_registry,
            chat_manager,
            default_model,
            provider_name,
            broadcast_tx,
            sse_broadcaster,
            start_time: std::time::Instant::now(),
            conversations: Arc::new(crate::chat_store::ChatSessionStore::default_store().await?),
            user_store,
            email_sender,
            server_config,
            state_store,
            google_oauth_config,
            csrf_tokens: Arc::new(RwLock::new(HashMap::new())),
            grpc_client,
            activity_log: Arc::new(RwLock::new(Vec::new())),
        })
    }

    /// Create new AppState (standalone mode with its own tool discovery)
    pub async fn new() -> anyhow::Result<Self> {
        Self::new_with_registry(None, None).await
    }

    /// Get uptime in seconds
    pub fn uptime_secs(&self) -> u64 {
        self.start_time.elapsed().as_secs()
    }

    /// Start the event bridge from gRPC to SSE
    pub fn start_event_bridge(self: Arc<Self>) {
        let state = self.clone();

        // 1. State updates bridge
        let state_clone = state.clone();
        tokio::spawn(async move {
            info!("Starting gRPC -> SSE state updates bridge...");
            loop {
                match state_clone
                    .grpc_client
                    .subscribe(vec![], vec![], vec![])
                    .await
                {
                    Ok(mut stream) => {
                        info!("Subscribed to gRPC state updates");
                        state_clone
                            .sse_broadcaster
                            .broadcast("state_resync", "{\"reason\":\"upstream_connected\"}");
                        while let Some(msg_result) = stream.next().await {
                            match msg_result {
                                Ok(msg) => match crate::sse::state_message_event(&msg) {
                                    Ok(event) => state_clone
                                        .sse_broadcaster
                                        .broadcast(&event.event_type, &event.data),
                                    Err(error) => {
                                        warn!(%error, "Invalid committed state frame; reconnecting");
                                        break;
                                    }
                                },
                                Err(e) => {
                                    warn!("gRPC subscription stream error: {}", e);
                                    break;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        state_clone.sse_broadcaster.broadcast(
                            "state_unavailable",
                            "{\"reason\":\"upstream_disconnected\"}",
                        );
                        tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_secs(5)).await;
                    }
                    Err(e) => {
                        warn!("Failed to subscribe to gRPC updates: {}. Retrying...", e);
                        state_clone.sse_broadcaster.broadcast(
                            "state_unavailable",
                            "{\"reason\":\"upstream_unavailable\"}",
                        );
                        tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_secs(5)).await;
                    }
                }
            }
        });

        // Audit history is privileged and is never subscribed with the web
        // service identity for this shared, unauthenticated SSE endpoint.
    }
}

const PERSISTED_MODEL_PATH: &str = "/etc/op-dbus/llm-model";
const PERSISTED_MODEL_NON_SANDBOXED_PATH: &str = "/etc/op-dbus/llm-model-non-sandboxed";
const PERSISTED_PROVIDER_PATH: &str = "/etc/op-dbus/llm-provider";

async fn read_persisted_model() -> Option<String> {
    tokio::fs::read_to_string(PERSISTED_MODEL_PATH)
        .await
        .ok()
        .map(|s| s.trim().to_string())
        .filter(|s| !s.is_empty())
}

async fn read_persisted_model_non_sandboxed() -> Option<bool> {
    tokio::fs::read_to_string(PERSISTED_MODEL_NON_SANDBOXED_PATH)
        .await
        .ok()
        .map(|s| {
            let value = s.trim();
            value == "1" || value.eq_ignore_ascii_case("true")
        })
}

async fn read_persisted_provider() -> Option<String> {
    tokio::fs::read_to_string(PERSISTED_PROVIDER_PATH)
        .await
        .ok()
        .map(|s| s.trim().to_string())
        .filter(|s| !s.is_empty())
}

#[derive(Clone)]
struct RemoteToolProxy {
    name: String,
    description: String,
    input_schema: Value,
    base_url: String,
    client: reqwest::Client,
}

#[async_trait]
impl Tool for RemoteToolProxy {
    fn name(&self) -> &str {
        &self.name
    }

    fn description(&self) -> &str {
        &self.description
    }

    fn input_schema(&self) -> Value {
        self.input_schema.clone()
    }

    async fn execute(&self, input: Value) -> anyhow::Result<Value> {
        let url = format!("{}/api/tool", self.base_url);
        let payload = json!({
            "tool_name": self.name.clone(),
            "arguments": input,
        });
        let body = simd_json::to_string(&payload).context("failed to serialize tool payload")?;

        let response = self
            .client
            .post(&url)
            .header("content-type", "application/json")
            .body(body)
            .send()
            .await
            .with_context(|| format!("failed to call remote tool endpoint {}", url))?;

        let status = response.status();
        let response_body = response
            .text()
            .await
            .context("failed to read remote tool response body")?;
        if !status.is_success() {
            bail!(
                "remote tool execution failed ({}): {}",
                status,
                response_body
            );
        }

        let mut bytes = response_body.into_bytes();
        let parsed: Value =
            simd_json::to_owned_value(&mut bytes).context("failed to parse remote response")?;
        let parsed_obj = parsed
            .as_object()
            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("remote response is not an object"))?;
        let success = parsed_obj
            .get("success")
            .and_then(|v| v.as_bool())
            .unwrap_or(false);
        if success {
            return Ok(parsed_obj
                .get("result")
                .cloned()
                .unwrap_or_else(|| json!(null)));
        }

        let err = parsed_obj
            .get("error")
            .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
            .unwrap_or("remote tool execution failed");
        bail!("{}", err);
    }

    fn namespace(&self) -> &str {
        "op-dbus"
    }

    fn category(&self) -> &str {
        "remote"
    }
}

fn remote_tool_source_url() -> Option<String> {
    let mode = std::env::var("OP_WEB_TOOL_SOURCE")
        .ok()
        .map(|v| v.trim().to_lowercase());
    let use_remote = matches!(mode.as_deref(), Some("op-dbus") | Some("remote"))
        || std::env::var("OP_WEB_PULL_TOOLS_FROM_OP_DBUS")
            .map(|v| matches!(v.to_lowercase().as_str(), "1" | "true" | "yes" | "on"))
            .unwrap_or(false);
    if !use_remote {
        return None;
    }

    if let Ok(url) = std::env::var("OP_WEB_REMOTE_TOOL_URL") {
        let trimmed = url.trim().trim_end_matches('/').to_string();
        if !trimmed.is_empty() {
            return Some(trimmed);
        }
    }

    let host = std::env::var("OP_DBUS_WEB_HOST").unwrap_or_else(|_| "127.0.0.1".to_string());
    let port = std::env::var("OP_DBUS_WEB_PORT").unwrap_or_else(|_| "8081".to_string());
    Some(format!("http://{}:{}", host, port))
}

async fn register_remote_tools(registry: &Arc<ToolRegistry>, base_url: &str) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
    let client = reqwest::Client::new();
    let url = format!("{}/api/tools", base_url.trim_end_matches('/'));
    let response_body = client
        .get(&url)
        .send()
        .await
        .with_context(|| format!("failed to fetch remote tools from {}", url))?
        .error_for_status()
        .with_context(|| format!("remote tools endpoint returned error: {}", url))?
        .text()
        .await
        .context("failed reading remote tools response body")?;

    let mut bytes = response_body.into_bytes();
    let payload: Value = simd_json::to_owned_value(&mut bytes)
        .context("failed to parse remote tools payload as JSON")?;
    let tool_entries = payload
        .as_object()
        .and_then(|o| o.get("tools"))
        .and_then(|v| v.as_array())
        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("remote tools payload missing 'tools' array"))?;

    let mut registered = 0usize;
    for entry in tool_entries {
        let Some(entry_obj) = entry.as_object() else {
            continue;
        };
        let Some(name) = entry_obj.get("name").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) else {
            continue;
        };
        let name = name.trim();
        if name.is_empty() {
            continue;
        }

        let description = entry_obj
            .get("description")
            .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
            .unwrap_or("Remote op-dbus tool")
            .to_string();
        let category = entry_obj
            .get("category")
            .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
            .unwrap_or("remote")
            .to_string();
        let input_schema = json!({
            "type": "object",
            "additionalProperties": true
        });

        let tool: BoxedTool = Arc::new(RemoteToolProxy {
            name: name.to_string(),
            description: description.clone(),
            input_schema: input_schema.clone(),
            base_url: base_url.trim_end_matches('/').to_string(),
            client: client.clone(),
        });
        let definition = ToolDefinition {
            name: name.to_string(),
            description,
            input_schema,
            schema_version: "https://json-schema.org/draft/next/schema".to_string(),
            category,
            tags: vec!["remote".to_string(), "op-dbus".to_string()],
            namespace: "op-dbus".to_string(),
        };
        registry
            .register(Arc::from(name), tool, definition)
            .await
            .with_context(|| format!("failed to register remote tool '{}'", name))?;
        registered += 1;
    }

    info!(
        "Registered {} remote tools from op-dbus ({})",
        registered, base_url
    );
    Ok(())
}

/// Register all tools from all sources
async fn register_all_tools(registry: &Arc<ToolRegistry>) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
    info!("Registering tools...");

    // Canonical tool/agent registration lives in op_tools/op_dbus.
    op_tools::register_builtin_tools(registry).await?;

    // Perform D-Bus tool discovery to populate the registry with 16k+ tools
    let introspection = Arc::new(op_introspection::IntrospectionService::new());
    let projection = op_tools::discovery::projection_engine::ProjectionEngine::new(introspection);

    // Discover from System bus
    info!("Discovering D-Bus tools (System bus)...");
    match projection
        .discover_all(registry, op_core::BusType::System)
        .await
    {
        Ok(count) => info!("Registered {} tools from D-Bus System bus", count),
        Err(e) => warn!("System bus discovery failed: {}", e),
    }

    // Also discover from Session bus for user-level D-Bus services
    info!("Discovering D-Bus tools (Session bus)...");
    let session_introspection = Arc::new(op_introspection::IntrospectionService::new());
    let session_projection =
        op_tools::discovery::projection_engine::ProjectionEngine::new(session_introspection);
    match session_projection
        .discover_all(registry, op_core::BusType::Session)
        .await
    {
        Ok(count) => info!("Registered {} tools from D-Bus Session bus", count),
        Err(e) => warn!("Session bus discovery failed: {}", e),
    }

    Ok(())
}

/// Log tool summary
fn log_tool_summary(tools: &[op_tools::registry::ToolDefinition]) {
    let ovs = tools.iter().filter(|t| t.name.starts_with("ovs_")).count();
    let dbus = tools.iter().filter(|t| t.name.starts_with("dbus_")).count();
    let file = tools.iter().filter(|t| t.name.starts_with("file_")).count();
    let shell = tools
        .iter()
        .filter(|t| t.name.starts_with("shell_"))
        .count();
    let agent = tools
        .iter()
        .filter(|t| t.name.starts_with("agent_"))
        .count();
    let other = tools.len() - ovs - dbus - file - shell - agent;

    debug!(
        "  OVS: {}, D-Bus: {}, File: {}, Shell: {}, Agents: {}, Other: {}",
        ovs, dbus, file, shell, agent, other
    );
}
</file>

<file path="op-web/src/tched_router_routes.rs">
//! Router-plugin helpers backed by the SHM state tree.
//!
//! HTTP paths stay `/api/tched-router/*` and `/api/llm/*` (what the UI already
//! calls). The sealed plugin those handlers read is `tched_router`.

use anyhow::{bail, Result};
use simd_json::prelude::*;
use simd_json::OwnedValue as Value;

use crate::state_tree;

/// Canonical D-Bus / SHM plugin id after the OpenCode rebrand.
pub const ROUTER_PLUGIN_ID: &str = "tched_router";

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct TchedRouterRoute {
    pub provider: String,
    pub upstream_provider: String,
    pub transport: Option<String>,
    pub model: String,
    pub hint: Option<String>,
    pub kind: Option<String>,
    pub status: String,
    pub available: bool,
    pub status_reason: Option<String>,
    pub source: Option<String>,
}

impl TchedRouterRoute {
    fn from_value(value: &Value) -> Option<Self> {
        let model = value.get("model")?.as_str()?.to_string();
        let provider = value
            .get("provider")
            .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
            .unwrap_or(ROUTER_PLUGIN_ID)
            .to_string();
        let upstream_provider = value
            .get("upstream_provider")
            .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
            .unwrap_or(&provider)
            .to_string();
        let status = value
            .get("status")
            .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
            .unwrap_or("declared")
            .to_string();
        let available = value
            .get("available")
            .and_then(|v| v.as_bool())
            .unwrap_or_else(|| status == "available");

        Some(Self {
            provider,
            upstream_provider,
            transport: value
                .get("transport")
                .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
                .map(str::to_string),
            model,
            hint: value
                .get("hint")
                .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
                .map(str::to_string),
            kind: value
                .get("kind")
                .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
                .map(str::to_string),
            status,
            available,
            status_reason: value
                .get("status_reason")
                .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
                .map(str::to_string),
            source: value
                .get("source")
                .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
                .map(str::to_string),
        })
    }
}

/// Current committed state for the canonical sealed router plugin.
pub async fn read_router_plugin() -> Result<Option<Value>> {
    state_tree::read_plugin(ROUTER_PLUGIN_ID).await
}

/// `model_routes` live at the top level (flattened catalog) or under the
/// historical `projection` / `catalog` objects.
pub fn model_route_values(state: &Value) -> Option<&Vec<Value>> {
    state
        .get("model_routes")
        .and_then(|v| v.as_array())
        .or_else(|| {
            state
                .get("catalog")
                .and_then(|v| v.get("model_routes"))
                .and_then(|v| v.as_array())
        })
        .or_else(|| {
            state
                .get("projection")
                .and_then(|v| v.get("model_routes"))
                .and_then(|v| v.as_array())
        })
}

pub async fn routes() -> Result<Option<Vec<TchedRouterRoute>>> {
    let Some(state) = read_router_plugin().await? else {
        return Ok(None);
    };
    let Some(route_values) = model_route_values(&state) else {
        return Ok(None);
    };
    Ok(Some(
        route_values
            .iter()
            .filter_map(TchedRouterRoute::from_value)
            .collect(),
    ))
}

pub async fn route_for_model(model: &str) -> Result<Option<TchedRouterRoute>> {
    Ok(routes()
        .await?
        .and_then(|routes| routes.into_iter().find(|route| route.model == model)))
}

pub async fn ensure_model_available(model: &str) -> Result<()> {
    if let Some(route) = route_for_model(model).await? {
        if !route.available {
            let reason = route
                .status_reason
                .unwrap_or_else(|| "route is not available".to_string());
            bail!(
                "Router route '{}' is {} but not available: {}",
                model,
                route.status,
                reason
            );
        }
    }

    Ok(())
}

pub async fn selected_provider_model() -> Result<Option<(String, String)>> {
    let Some(state) = read_router_plugin().await? else {
        return Ok(None);
    };
    let Some(provider) = state
        .get("selected_provider")
        .and_then(|value| value.as_str())
    else {
        return Ok(None);
    };
    let Some(model) = state.get("selected_model").and_then(|value| value.as_str()) else {
        return Ok(None);
    };
